name: Getting up early, preparing, and waking the children.
description: At the first light of dawn, Ma Xiulan woke up, excited about going back to her parents' home today, and felt especially energetic. After a quick wash, she combed her hair neatly in front of the mirror, changed into a clean everyday cotton-padded jacket, and checked the bag she had prepared the night before. Inside were marinated pork tenderloin, wheat flour for hand-rolled noodles, dried black fungus and day lily flowers, and a bag of Red Fuji apples. Then she pushed open each child's door and woke them one by one. The eldest son, Xuanxuan, had already woken up on his own and was putting on his clothes in the dark. The second son, Mingzhe, still wanted to stay in bed; she gently lifted his quilt and said, “Let's go to Grandma's house for sweet-and-sour pork tenderloin!” He immediately sat up. The youngest daughter, Yuxin, rubbed her eyes and asked for a hug. Ma Xiulan hugged her, gave her a kiss, and took out the three pairs of bright red new cotton socks she had prepared earlier, putting them on the children while murmuring, “New socks for the New Year, wind beneath your feet, and a smooth and successful year.”
location: Bedroom, bathroom, and children's bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Breakfast and departure preparation
description: While the children were washing up, Ma Xiulan went to the kitchen to heat up the steamed meat buns made yesterday and warmed milk. Everyone ate hurriedly around the table. She reminded Xuanxuan to take his new drawing to show Grandma, told Mingzhe to put the assembled building blocks into his schoolbag, and brought Yuxin's favorite storybook along. Finally, she checked the whole house once, turned off the water, gas, and electricity, put hats and gloves on the children, and got ready to go out.
location: Kitchen and living room of the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Walking to her parents' home on New Year's Day
description: After locking the door, Ma Xiulan led the three children, carrying a heavy bag of groceries, and walked along Jingwen Road toward her parents' home. On New Year's morning there were not many people on the street; many shop doorways had new red couplets pasted up, giving a festive look. Mingzhe bounced along the way, Yuxin held her mother's hand, and Xuanxuan quietly followed behind carrying his painting. As they walked, Ma Xiulan told the children to be polite at grandma's house. After about 25 minutes, they arrived at her parents' home at 45 Shengli Avenue.
location: Along the route from Jingwen Road to Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Arrived at her parents' home and helped cook lunch
description: As soon as she entered the house, her mother, Li Xiuying, came up to greet her, took her things, and said with a smile, "I've been waiting for you to take over the cooking." The three children crowded around their grandmother and shouted "Happy New Year." Ma Xiulan told Xuanxuan to take his younger brother and sister to the inner room to play, and she and her mother went straight into the kitchen. She tied on an apron, quickly put the meat in water to thaw, then took out a large basin, scooped in flour, cracked in eggs, and started kneading dough, planning to roll out chewy noodles topped with wood ear mushrooms and day lily flowers. Her mother stood beside her, cleaning the greens, smashing garlic, and slicing ginger. Once the dough was kneaded and resting and the meat had thawed, Ma Xiulan began slicing and marinating the meat, mixing it evenly with starch, cooking wine, and white pepper. She heated oil in the wok, dropped the batter-coated pork tenderloin strips in one by one, fried them until golden, and removed them. After a second round of frying, she filled a large basin with them. In another pan, she made a sauce with sugar, vinegar, and ketchup, cooked it until thick, then added the fried pork pieces and quickly stir-fried them, sprinkled on white sesame seeds, and plated the dish—glossy red and glistening with oil. Her mother's rolled noodles were ready too: she folded the large thin sheet, cut it into noodles of various widths, and boiled them. Ma Xiulan made a sauce with wood ear mushrooms, day lily flowers, and egg. When all the dishes were ready, she picked up a piece of pork and offered it to her mother to taste. Her mother smacked her lips and said, "That's the taste—so fragrant!" Then she boiled water and cooked the noodles, removed them and rinsed them in cold water, put them into large bowls, ladled the sauce over them, and placed the sweet-and-sour pork right in the middle. Her father, Ma Jianguo, heard the commotion and came out of the inner room to help move chairs and set out bowls and chopsticks. The three children also ran over when they smelled the aroma. Mingzhe tried to grab a piece of the pork, but Ma Xiulan laughingly stopped him.
location: Kitchen and dining room at parents' home, 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family New Year's Day gathering
description: The family sat around the round table in a warm, cozy atmosphere. Ma Xiulan put a piece of pork tenderloin on her father's plate. He took a bite and beamed with joy: 'This tastes right! Even better than what the restaurants make.' As they ate and chatted, she said Xuanyuan had recently made progress on exams, Mingzhe, though mischievous, had good English grades, and Yuxin had learned several new nursery rhymes at kindergarten. The children eagerly slurped noodles and talked to their grandparents in turns, filling the room with laughter and joy.
location: Dining room at parents' home, No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: After-dinner cleanup and mother-daughter talk
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan quickly cleared the dishes and wiped the table. Her mother wanted to help, but she told her to sit and rest, and tidied up the kitchen all by herself. While washing the dishes, she shared her feelings with her mother: "Mom, in the new year, I want to take on more handicraft work. I've already told Sister Xiuqin to keep an eye out for embroidery jobs for me. Zhiqiang works hard driving too, and every little bit extra helps." Her mother looked at her with concern and said, "Xiulan, don't push yourself too hard. Your health matters most; three kids are already enough for you to worry about." Ma Xiulan nodded, feeling warm inside.
location: Kitchen and dining room at parents' home, 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Children's playful time in the courtyard.
description: The winter afternoon sunlight was just right, warm on the courtyard wall. The three children were playing happily in the yard. Mingzhe led Yuxin around in a game of hide-and-seek, while Xuanxuan found a sheltered corner, took out the comic A Shuai he had brought, and flipped through it quietly. Father moved a small stool and sat in the doorway soaking up the sun, smiling as he watched his grandchildren make a racket, his face full of contentment. Ma Xiulan brought a chair and sat under the eaves, feeling especially at ease. She pulled out her phone and snapped a few photos of the children running, laughing, and reading—each frame captured the happiness she treasured most.
location: The courtyard of her parents' home at 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Mother and daughter exchange embroidery skills
description: The children were tired from playing and were called inside to drink water and eat snacks. Ma Xiulan took out a new embroidery pattern from her bag, a blooming peony. She and her mother sat cross-legged on the warm kang, pointing at the pattern and asking about techniques for splitting threads and matching colors. Her mother put on her reading glasses, picked up her embroidery hoop, and demonstrated while explaining the old embroidery methods. Ma Xiulan tried stitch by stitch following her mother's technique, chatting about the finer points of needlework, and the half hour passed very quickly.
location: On the kang in the inner room of her parents' home, No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Said goodbye to my parents and walked home
description: At almost 4 p.m., Ma Xiulan got up to say goodbye. Her mother packed a bag of pickled vegetables she had made herself, a few heads of Chinese cabbage grown in the yard, and squeezed in a box of milk for the children to drink, telling her to go slowly on the way and not get too tired. She led the children back along the same road. Although everyone was a bit tired after playing for most of the day, they were all happy, and their steps were steadier than on the way there.
location: Along the route from No. 45 Shengli Avenue, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to No. 156 Jingwen Road

name: Return home to rest and prepare a simple dinner.
description: Back home, the children changed shoes, went inside, and washed their hands. Ma Xiulan put the pickled vegetables, cabbages, and milk she had brought back from her mother's house into the kitchen, and put the few pieces of sweet-and-sour pork and half a bowl of gravy packed from lunch into the refrigerator, intending to give them to her husband when he came back tomorrow. She poured herself a glass of water, drank it, and sat down to rest her legs. After resting enough, she had Xuanxuan go to his room to do homework, while Mingzhe and Yuxin played with building blocks in the living room. She went to the kitchen, rinsed the rice and cooked a fresh pot of rice, then cut up one of the cabbages her mother had given her, added some vermicelli, and stir-fried a vinegar cabbage dish. She planned to serve it with the leftovers from lunch and the meatballs in the fridge so everyone could have a hot, satisfying meal.
location: Entryway, kitchen, and living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Dinner for the family of four
description: After warming up the food, Ma Xiulan and the three children had a simple dinner. She divided the sweet and sour pork tenderloin brought back from Grandma's house among the children. Yuxin ate it with relish and said, "Grandma's meat is the best." Ma Xiulan smiled and told them to eat more, saying that she had also saved some for Dad, so he could taste it when he came back from this trip for the New Year.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Supervising homework and handling housework.
description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan urged Mingzhe and Yuxin to do their homework or draw, and she began to tidy up the house, mop the floor, and throw the day's dirty clothes into the washing machine to start a load. In the middle of this, her phone rang once. It was a WeChat message from her husband Ma Zhiqiang, saying he was still unloading goods in Tianjin, the traffic was heavy, and he wouldn't make it home tonight; he would head back early tomorrow morning. She replied, 'Okay, drive safe, I've saved some good food for you.' Then she casually picked out a few of today's family photos and sent them to him.
location: Various rooms of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Organize photos and exchange with craft friends.
description: After finishing all the housework, Ma Xiulan sat on the sofa, opened the photo album on her phone, and picked the 9 best photos taken that day (including the children playing in the yard, the dishes on the table, and group photos of her father and the children). She slightly adjusted the lighting with a beauty editing app, then posted a Moments update with the caption: “First day of 2025, back at my parents’ home, ate too much and had so much fun!” Just after posting, she received several likes and comments, including one from her handicraft friend Sister Zhou Xiuqin: “Xiulan, your skills have really improved!” She was delighted, chatted privately with Zhou Xiuqin for a while, and agreed to visit her home in a couple of days to look at new embroidery patterns and also talk about the thread-splitting technique she had learned from her mother today.
location: Sofa in the living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Urging everyone to wash up and preparing tomorrow's necessities
description: After playing all day, the children were sleepy. Ma Xiulan urged them one by one to wash their faces and brush their teeth. Xuanxuan got himself ready and went to bed, Mingzhe needed her to watch him brush for a full three minutes, and Yuxin needed her help to wash up. Once they were all in bed, she prepared their school uniforms and backpacks for the next day, and checked Yuxin’s little backpack again to make sure the water bottle wasn’t left out.
location: The bathroom and the children's rooms at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Bedtime phone call and falling asleep
description: The children were all asleep, and the room grew quiet. Ma Xiulan returned to the bedroom, folded the clothes she would wear tomorrow, and leaned against the headboard. Figuring her husband had also settled in for the night, she made a video call to him. In the frame, he was indeed still in the car, saying he was about to stop and spend the night at a service area. She told him to find a warm place to sleep and not catch a cold. After hanging up, she felt a little worried but mostly at ease. She turned off the bedside lamp, pulled the quilt over herself, lay in bed, and replayed the day's events like a movie in her mind: her parents' smiling faces, the children's joy, the steaming kitchen, the sweet and sour pork she had tasted... She felt utterly content and soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: Master bedroom of the home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Got up early, made breakfast, and ate breakfast with the children.
description: She got up when the alarm went off, washed up briefly, and went to the kitchen to rinse rice and cook porridge, and heat up steamed buns and eggs for breakfast. Then she woke the three children one by one. The eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, got up and dressed himself; the second son, Ma Mingzhe, lingered in bed; the youngest daughter, Ma Yuxin, obediently put on her dress by herself. The family sat around and ate breakfast. After the meal, she checked Mingxuan's and Mingzhe's schoolbags.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Take the youngest daughter to kindergarten
description: Put a hat and gloves on her daughter Ma Yuxin, then walked hand in hand to Huakang First Kindergarten. At the gate, she handed the child to the teacher and told her to be good. She did not go home until she watched her daughter enter the kindergarten.
location: Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Take her second son to school
description: After returning home, she got on her electric bike and took her second son, Ma Mingzhe, to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School. On the way, she listened to her son talk about the games he played at his grandma's house yesterday. At the school gate, she watched him enter the school and then left, riding on to the vegetable market.
location: Jinghai No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Buying groceries and daily necessities along the way
description: Rode an electric bike to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market and bought spinach, Chinese cabbage, glass noodles, and pork belly to make dinner. Then she stopped by Jingbai Supermarket, bought light soy sauce and iodized salt, noticed the laundry detergent promotion but did not buy it, and walked home.
location: Wutong Gongshe Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jingbai Supermarket, Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu

name: Tidying up and doing housework.
description: After arriving home, she first watered the spring onions in the vegetable garden in the yard, then put the newly bought vegetables into the refrigerator by category, washed the pots and bowls used for breakfast, wiped the stove clean, and finished up the day's housework.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Reconcile accounts and plan the family budget
description: Sitting by the coffee table in the living room, she took out the whole year's shopping receipts, utility bills, and handwritten accounts from an iron box and an old notebook. Putting on reading glasses, she sorted them by month and added them up entry by entry. Some receipts had blurry handwriting, so she used a pencil to estimate the amounts. After sorting out the accounts, she took out a new notebook, copied down the expenditure proportions, and focused on calculating the income. She came up with a plan to save 200 yuan each month for education savings and thought about how to discuss it with her husband.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: A simple lunch for myself.
description: Feeling a sore dryness in her eyes, she got up and went to the kitchen to boil water and cook dried noodles. She added spinach and two eggs, then slowly ate them by herself at the dining table, all the while continuing to mull over the conversation she would have with her husband that evening.
location: Kitchen and dining room of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Taking a midday rest and calling her mother
description: After lunch, she leaned back on the sofa to rest, then picked up her phone and called her mother Li Xiuying. She asked whether the leftover noodles with gravy from yesterday had been refrigerated and urged her not to be sparing with the heating since it was cold. When she heard her mother laugh and agree, she felt relieved.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Organizing accounts and preparing for the conversation
description: After hanging up, she sat back down at the coffee table, checked the income and expense records again, and wrote in her notebook: plan to save 200 yuan every month, set aside specifically for the three children's education. She kept mulling over the opening and wording of the evening conversation with her husband.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the youngest daughter from school and buy stationery on the way
description: She walked to Huakang First Kindergarten, chatted with other parents at the gate, and picked up Ma Yuxin. Then she rode an electric bike with her daughter to Dongzhai Fishing Gear & Stationery (Dongzhai Road store), bought a math exercise book and a Chinese character grid exercise book for her second son, and at her daughter's request also bought a pencil with stickers.
location: Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and Dongzhai Fishing Tackle & Stationery (Dongzhai Road Branch) on Dongzhai Road.

name: Returned home to give the daughter an extra meal and prepare dinner ingredients
description: After returning home, she washed an apple for her daughter and let her watch cartoons in the living room. She went into the kitchen and washed and cut the cabbage, vermicelli, and pork belly needed for the evening, prepared scallions, ginger, and garlic, and got everything ready for dinner.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the two sons from school.
description: Rode the electric bike first to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up Ma Mingzhe, then went together to the gate of Jinghai District No. 1 Middle School to wait for Ma Mingxuan. The three of them rode home on one electric bike. On the way, she asked the older son about his schoolwork and told the two children to sit steady.
location: Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jinghai District No. 1 Middle School, Jianshe Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Making dinner
description: After having the children wash their hands and change clothes, she went into the kitchen to cook rice, put the prepared cabbage and vermicelli on to stew, stir-fried sliced pork belly to render the fat, and then stir-fried a dish of eggs with spinach. The kitchen was filled with the aroma of the meal.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The family ate dinner together.
description: Husband Ma Zhiqiang came back from driving and brought two bags of oranges. The family of five sat around the table for dinner. Ma Xiulan casually mentioned that the family's expenses had been considerable last year; her husband just grunted in reply, while the children chattered about funny school stories. The atmosphere at the dinner table was harmonious.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Watch the children do homework and prepare items for the next day.
description: After clearing the table, she supervised Ma Mingzhe and Ma Mingxuan doing homework in the living room while also watching Ma Yuxin draw. She picked out the clothes the children would wear tomorrow morning and folded them at the head of the bed. In between, she found time to reply to her childhood friend Liu Chunmei on WeChat, and they agreed to visit the market together next week.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Discuss and agree on education savings with her husband.
description: After the children washed up, Ma Xiulan took the sorted account book into the master bedroom and explained last year's income and expenses item by item to her husband, who was leaning against the headboard smoking. She also proposed a plan to save 200 yuan every month as an education fund. Her husband frowned and sighed at first, but after a moment of silence he put out his cigarette, nodded in agreement, and said he would smoke less. Ma Xiulan felt a pang in her heart; the plan had finally been implemented.
location: Master bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Urge the children to wash up and coax them to sleep.
description: Feeling relaxed, she hurried the three children through their washing-up in turn. The eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, managed on his own and returned to his room to recite a lesson. The second son, Ma Mingzhe, was scolded for wanting to play with toys. She washed the youngest daughter, Ma Yuxin's face, brushed her teeth, washed her feet, then carried her to her little bed, tucked the quilt around her, and kissed her cheek.
location: Home bathroom and children's room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Wash up and rest
description: After all the children were asleep, she took a hot shower, changed into pajamas, and the exhaustion in her body melted away. Lying in bed, she thought back on the day: the accounts had been sorted out and the education fund had been agreed on. She felt life was promising and soon fell into a deep sleep in the quiet night.
location: Master bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Get up in the morning, prepare breakfast, wake the children, and eat breakfast.
description: Ma Xiulan woke up naturally before the alarm went off. Hearing the wind outside the window and thinking of the cold weather, she decided to dress the children warmly. After getting up and washing quickly, she went to the kitchen to cook millet porridge, heat steamed buns, and stir-fry spinach with eggs. While preparing, she mulled over the family savings plan. Then she went upstairs to wake up her youngest daughter Yuxin and helped her put on thick clothes, then woke up her second son Mingzhe and her eldest son Mingxuan. The family of four sat around the table for breakfast. Mingxuan hurriedly finished and went to school, Mingzhe shared funny stories from school, Yuxin slowly drank her porridge, and Ma Xiulan reminded the children to keep warm. After the meal, she cleared the dishes and filled Yuxin’s water bottle with warm water.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Take the youngest daughter and second son to school
description: Ma Xiulan put on a thick down jacket, hat, and gloves, and rode her electric bike out with Yuxin and Mingzhe. She first took Yuxin to Huakang First Kindergarten, handed her to the teacher, and watched her go into the classroom. Then she rode about 10 minutes to take Mingzhe to the Third Primary School of Jinghai District, watching him run through the school gate. Her eldest son Mingxuan rode his own bicycle to the First Middle School of Jinghai District. Ma Xiulan checked the tire pressure and reminded him to ride slowly.
location: Huakang First Kindergarten, Huakang Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Went to the Wutong Commune vegetable market to buy groceries and chatted at Sun Guifang's stall
description: After dropping off the children, Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike straight to the Wutong Commune Vegetable Market. After parking, she first bought vermicelli, kelp, and 1.5 jin of pork belly. Then she went to the vegetable stall of her acquaintance Sun Guifang, selected frost-kissed napa cabbage, potatoes, radishes, and scallions, and chatted with Aunt Sun. Aunt Sun gave her a bunch of scallions, and Ma Xiulan thanked her before leaving.
location: China, Tianjin City, Jinghai District, Wutong Commune Vegetable Market

name: Return home to organize the purchased items and learn to keep accounts on the phone
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan sorted and stored the vegetables, wrapping the Chinese cabbage in newspaper and putting the potatoes into mesh bags. After tidying up, she sat on the sofa, opened the bookkeeping app on her phone, and entered the grocery expenses one by one (pork belly 38 yuan, Chinese cabbage 5 yuan, radishes and potatoes 8 yuan in total, vermicelli and kelp 10.5 yuan). She became familiar with the app's functions and felt that bookkeeping wasn't difficult.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Did housework, contacted craft friend Zhou Xiuqin, and tended the courtyard vegetable garden
description: Ma Xiulan started with housework: she vacuumed the first-floor floor, wiped the stair railings, and started the washing machine to do laundry. While the washing machine was running, she called her craft friend Zhou Xiuqin to ask about new patterns. Zhou invited her to come over the next day to look at patterns and do embroidery together, and Ma Xiulan happily agreed. Then she went to the vegetable garden in the courtyard, re-pressed the cold-protection plastic sheeting that had been loosened by the wind, and wrapped the faucet in old cotton-padded clothes to keep it from freezing. Seeing that the spinach was growing well, she planned to eat it in a few days.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Make lunch by herself, rest at noon, and chat with her childhood friend Liu Chunmei
description: Home alone, Ma Xiulan reheated the leftover millet porridge and stir-fried spinach from the morning and had a simple lunch with pickled cucumbers, checking phone news while eating. After lunch, while resting on the living room sofa, her childhood friend Liu Chunmei sent a WeChat message to discuss a time to visit the new market. Ma Xiulan replied that she would be free next week. Liu Chunmei poured out family troubles, Ma Xiulan listened patiently and comforted her, and the two agreed to meet and talk in detail.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Use a computer to learn bookkeeping skills.
description: After taking a break, Ma Xiulan went to the study, turned on the old computer, and searched for phrases such as 'how to keep a family ledger' and 'how to classify daily expenses.' She carefully copied suggestions like 'make a monthly spending analysis' and 'set aside flexible spending' into her accounting notebook, and marked the key points in red pen. The computer froze once, and she patiently waited for it to recover before continuing to browse.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Pick up daughter Yuxin from school, give her a snack, and read fairy tales to her
description: At two in the afternoon, Ma Xiulan walked to Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up Yuxin. Yuxin waved happily when she saw her mother and talked about making paper airplanes in kindergarten on the way home. After arriving home, Ma Xiulan washed an apple and warmed some milk for Yuxin as a snack, then sat with her on the sofa and read the storybook "Little Rabbit, Be Good." Yuxin listened very attentively, occasionally pointing at the illustrations and asking questions. It was a heartwarming scene.
location: Huakang First Kindergarten, Huakang Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Pick up the two sons from school and go home together.
description: Ma Xiulan told Yuxin to stay at home watching TV and not touch electrical appliances, then rode her electric bike to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up Mingzhe, and on the way stopped at the gate of Jinghai District No. 1 Middle School to wait for her eldest son, Mingxuan. Mingxuan walked his bike out, and the three rode home together, arriving home at exactly 4 p.m.
location: Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Preparing and cooking dinner.
description: After getting home, the children each did their own things while Ma Xiulan went into the kitchen to prepare dinner. She first washed and cut the pork belly into pieces, blanched it, tore the cabbage into pieces, and soaked the vermicelli. Then she lit the stove and cooked: she caramelized sugar for braised pork, used another wok to fry shredded radish vegetarian meatballs, and at the same time stewed a big pot of cabbage with vermicelli. The kitchen was filled with a rich meaty aroma, full of the hustle and bustle of home cooking.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Husband Ma Zhiqiang came home, and the family had dinner together
description: When the braised pork was almost done, her husband Ma Zhiqiang came back from a driving job. Smelling the aroma, he came into the kitchen and praised it. Ma Xiulan told him to wash his hands, and the children excitedly welcomed him. The family of five sat around the dining table enjoying braised pork, cabbage stewed with vermicelli, fried vegetable meatballs, and soy-pickled cucumbers. Zhiqiang repeatedly praised how tenderly the meat was braised. Mingzhe burned his mouth on a meatball, making the whole family laugh. Ma Xiulan removed the bones from Yuxin's food. During the meal, they talked about keeping accounts; Zhiqiang teased, and Ma Xiulan smiled.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Clear the dishes, check and help son with homework, chat with husband
description: After dinner, Zhiqiang cleared the dishes and Ma Xiulan washed them. After cleaning up, Ma Xiulan checked Mingzhe's math and Chinese homework, pointed out that he had forgotten to carry over in column addition and had pinyin errors, and had him correct them. Then she went upstairs to see Mingxuan reviewing English and encouraged him to do more dictation and recitation. When she came downstairs, she had a brief conversation with Zhiqiang at the stairway about trucking and saving plans. After that, Ma Xiulan prepared the children's clothes and schoolbags for the next day.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Urge the three children to wash up.
description: Ma Xiulan first coaxed Yuxin into washing her face and feet and changing into pajamas, then tucked her into bed and laid out the next day's kindergarten clothes at the head of the bed. She urged Mingzhe to brush his teeth and wash up, and checked whether the window in his room was closed properly. Mingxuan washed up on his own, and Ma Xiulan made his bed, settling all the children.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Track today's expenses on dual tracks.
description: After the house grew quiet, Ma Xiulan took out her account book and phone app. She first wrote out the day's expenses in detail with a pen (groceries 61.5 yuan, estimated electric bike charging fee 1 yuan, totaling 62.5 yuan), then entered them into the app and selected the 'Food' and 'Daily necessities' categories. After checking that the two records matched, she closed the notebook with a sense of accomplishment.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: At 15:00, rode an electric bike to the vegetable market, bought radishes and greens at Sun Guifang's stall, listened to her talk about rising vegetable prices, and bought extra radishes to make winter pickles.
description: After keeping the accounts, Ma Xiulan stretched and went into the bathroom. She washed her face with hot water and soaked her feet to relieve fatigue, then applied moisturizer. Later, she went to the living room and looked through the account book, planning to visit Zhou Xiuqin tomorrow to see her patterns and the market next week. Zhiqiang urged her to sleep early. Ma Xiulan checked the kitchen gas and the door locks, then returned to the bedroom, set the alarm for 6:45 the next morning, and lay down to rest.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Falling asleep
description: The night had grown deep. Ma Xiulan looked back on her full day of picking up and dropping off the children, managing household chores, and learning to keep accounts. She felt grounded and hopeful, and soon fell asleep.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Getting up, breakfast, and morning chores
description: She got up early in the morning and saw cloudy weather outside. After putting on a cotton-padded jacket, she went into the kitchen to prepare breakfast: she rinsed millet to make porridge, steamed buns and stir-fried greens, and peeled garlic to prepare scrambled eggs. Once breakfast was ready, she woke the three children, reminded Mingzhe to do his homework, and helped Yuxin comb her hair. The family sat around the table and ate breakfast, pairing millet porridge with scallion scrambled eggs. After the meal, she cleared and washed the dishes. She changed into a thick coat and gloves, went to the courtyard to check the roses, and found that the roots were exposed. She wrapped them with straw and old cotton cloth, pressed them down, cleared away dead leaves and debris, and completed the courtyard winterization.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Ran into a neighbor on the way to Jingbai Supermarket for shopping and on the way back home
description: She walked to Jingbai Supermarket. In the children's section, she picked out two pairs of thick cotton socks for each of the three children, and also bought toilet paper and dish soap. Finally, in the craft fabric section, she took a liking to a piece of blue-and-white printed cloth and planned to make coasters with it, spending more than 40 yuan. On the way home, as she walked near Jingwen Road, she met Wang Guilan, the neighbor across the landing, who was picking vegetables at her door. They greeted each other and chatted. Wang Guilan said she still had pickled radish strips at home and would bring some over in the afternoon.
location: Jingbai Supermarket: Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu, Chaoyang Subdistrict, Jinghai District, Tianjin; on the way home: near the intersection of Jingwen Road and Fuqian Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Organizing the purchased items and taking a short rest.
description: Back home, she put the newly bought cotton socks into the wardrobe, rolled up the fabric, and set it next to the sewing machine. She poured herself a cup of hot water, sat on the sofa to rest, opened the expense-tracking app on her phone to record the supermarket spending, and mentally reviewed this month's budget.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing lunch and temporarily looking after the neighbors' children.
description: She started preparing lunch, planning to cook noodle soup and fry vegetarian meatballs. Wang Guilan had to attend to an urgent matter and temporarily left her 2-year-old grandson in Ma Xiulan's care. Ma Xiulan took the child and amused him with snacks while also tending to the kitchen, cooking the noodles and frying the balls.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Lunch and casual chat with neighbors, exchanging food.
description: After finishing her errands, Wang Guilan came to pick up her grandson. Ma Xiulan brought out fried vegetarian meatballs and her homemade pickled cabbage for her to taste, and gave her some pickled cabbage to take home. Wang Guilan gave her pickled radish strips in return. The two drank tea, chatted, and shared neighborhood news in a warm atmosphere.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tidying up the house and getting ready to go out to study
description: After seeing Wang Guilan off, she quickly washed the dishes and chopsticks, changed into a clean floral-patterned padded jacket, took the blue calico fabric she had bought, and got ready to go to Zhou Xiuqin's home to learn embroidery.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Go to Zhou Xiuqin's home to learn embroidery and receive the finished piece
description: Walked to Zhou Xiuqin's house to learn a new embroidery stitch, the "long and short stitch," used to express the layering of petals. Zhou Xiuqin taught her hand in hand, and Ma Xiulan practiced seriously. Then Zhou Xiuqin gave her an embroidered daisy pattern to take home for practice and shared news of piecework for custom children's bibs. Ma Xiulan's heart was stirred and she decided to take the job.
location: Zhou Xiuqin's home, No. 3 Courtyard, East Side of Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Return home to prepare dinner ingredients.
description: After saying goodbye to Zhou Xiuqin, she walked home in a light mood. She took tomatoes, Chinese cabbage, glass noodles, eggs, and luncheon meat out of the refrigerator, planning to make tomato scrambled eggs and stewed cabbage with glass noodles. She began picking vegetables, washing them, and soaking the noodles.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Cooking dinner and dining with the family
description: In the kitchen, she stir-fried and simmered dishes. First she made scrambled eggs with tomatoes, then stewed cabbage and glass noodles with some luncheon meat. She asked Mingxuan to help set out the bowls and chopsticks. The family sat around the dining table. Outside the window the sky was getting dark, but inside the warm light glowed. The children ate with great gusto, and Yuxin praised her mother's cooking.
location: Kitchen and dining room of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Clear the dishes and chopsticks and urge the children to do their homework.
description: After the meal, she cleaned up the dishes and wiped down the kitchen. Then she went to the living room to urge Mingzhe to do his math homework, checked Yuxin's calligraphy tracing book, and went to Mingxuan's room to tell him to think on his own first when encountering difficult problems.
location: Dining room and living room of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening embroidery practice.
description: While the children watched cartoons, Ma Xiulan sat on the living room sofa. By the warm light of the floor lamp, she took out the daisy pattern and embroidery hoop Zhou Xiuqin had given her and practiced the newly learned long-and-short stitch. Stitch by stitch, she carefully worked out how to make the petals fuller, occasionally looking up to remind the children to sit farther from the TV.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Supervise the children washing up and check their school supplies for tomorrow.
description: When the cartoon ended, she put down the embroidery hoop and urged the children to wash up. She helped Yuxin take a bath and get dressed, and urged Mingzhe and Mingxuan to brush their teeth and wash their faces. While the children were washing up, she checked the school uniforms and backpacks for the next day, filled Yuxin's water bottle with warm water, reminded Mingzhe to pack his art markers, and made sure everything was in order.
location: Bathroom and children's bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Household wrap-up and personal rest
description: After the children were asleep, she checked the doors, windows, and gas, then washed up. In bed, she took out her account book, checked the day's expenses, and recorded them. Thinking back on today's embroidery learning and casual talk with neighbors, she felt content, then turned off the light and went to sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Waking up and having a simple breakfast
description: She got up at 7:30 in the morning, opened the curtains, and saw sunlight streaming in. Wearing a maroon thick cotton coat, she went to the kitchen to cook millet porridge, with pickled vegetables and the radish strips Sister Guilan had given her yesterday. She sat alone in the kitchen eating slowly, listening to the sounds of the children and her husband Ma Zhiqiang sleeping in on Sunday, and felt content.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Organized winter clothes for the seasonal change.
description: After breakfast, she turned up the heating in the living room. She opened the wardrobes in the master bedroom and the second bedroom, took out the winter thick cotton-padded jackets, down jackets, sweaters, and thick trousers for the family of five, and folded them neatly by category. She bagged separately the two dark blue cotton-padded jackets that Ma Mingzhe and Ma Yuxin had outgrown, planning to take them to her relatives' children on her next visit to her parents' home. She also found Ma Zhiqiang's gray work jacket with frayed cuffs, marked it with chalk, and set it aside for mending.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Mending a coat and practicing embroidery
description: She sat on the sofa by the living room window with the best light and took out her sewing kit. First she carefully repaired the cuff of Ma Zhiqiang's work jacket, with tight and even stitches. Then she took out the blue calico and embroidery hoop obtained from Sister Xiuqin yesterday, and practiced the 'long-short stitch' to embroider little daisies on the edge of the fabric. The warm sunlight fell on her hands, and she thought that once she got good at it, she would make flower-patterned bibs for the children.
location: Living room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing and enjoying lunch, and visiting neighbors.
description: Ma Zhiqiang took the three children downstairs. Ma Xiulan put down her needlework and went to the kitchen to reheat yesterday's leftovers and stir-fried some cabbage with vinegar. The family sat together for lunch. After the meal, remembering the dried radish strips Wang Guilan had given her yesterday, she scooped out a bowl of preserved mustard greens from her own pickle jar, went across to Wang Guilan's house, gave them to her, and praised her newly pickled vegetables for being very crunchy. Wang Guilan smiled and thanked her.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and Wang Guilan's home across the street

name: Midday nap and embroidery practice
description: After returning from Wang Guilan's home, she told her eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, to keep an eye on his younger brother and sister while they did their homework. Ma Xiulan went back to the master bedroom and lay down for half an hour to rest her back. When she got up, she sat on the living room sofa and continued practicing long-and-short stitch embroidery, feeling more skilled than in the morning and very pleased.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Walked to the supermarket.
description: After dressing warmly and putting on hats and gloves, she took the three children out and strolled along Jingwen Road to the Shufen Convenience Store diagonally across the street. On the way, she told the children to behave in the store and not run around.
location: Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Taking the children to Shufen Convenience Supermarket
description: At the supermarket, she let the children pick out a bag of salt and a bottle of soy sauce themselves, and they both chose correctly. Ma Xiulan bought each of them a lollipop, and the children were very happy. She chatted with the supermarket owner Zhang Shufen by the counter. Zhang Shufen said soy sauce would go up in price in a couple of days and suggested stocking up an extra bottle, so Ma Xiulan bought one more. On the way out, she ran into Wang Guilan, and the two chatted for a bit about the potherb mustard she had just been given.
location: Shufen Convenience Store, No. 178 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Walk home
description: After leaving the supermarket, I walked slowly home with the children. It was a bit cold on the street, but the sun felt warm on us.
location: Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing and cooking dinner
description: After returning home, she put on an apron and started making dinner. Since it was cold, she stewed a warm dish of cabbage, tofu, and vermicelli, steamed the cured fish bought yesterday, and stir-fried a plate of golden shiny eggs. Her younger daughter Ma Yuxin came over to help peel garlic, and Ma Xiulan praised her as a good helper while busy.
location: Kitchen at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The whole family had dinner together.
description: Ma Zhiqiang helped bring the dishes to the table, and the family sat down for dinner together. Ma Xiulan mentioned hearing at the supermarket that afternoon that soy sauce prices were going up. Ma Zhiqiang also shared some things he had seen while driving. The children chattered about funny moments at school. The room was warm and full of laughter.
location: Dining room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Watching TV and doing activities as a family
description: After clearing away the dishes, Ma Xiulan switched to a family drama she liked. The children thought it was boring, so they took out Chinese checkers and played on the big coffee table, with Ma Zhiqiang coaching from the side. Ma Xiulan watched the drama and the children playing checkers at the same time, feeling steady and warm inside. Once in a while she got up and poured each child a glass of warm water.
location: Living room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Remind to wash up and prepare for the next day
description: After the TV drama ended, Ma Xiulan began urging the children to wash up, arranging for the eldest son to go first, followed by Mingzhe and Yuxin. She went to check the courtyard door lock and the gas, then returned to the bedroom, found the clothes the children would wear the next day, folded them, and placed them by each child's bedside.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Bedtime review and rest
description: After the children were all asleep, the house quieted down. Ma Xiulan leaned against the headboard and quietly calculated the day's expenses. She opened her ledger and checked against the mobile app, writing down 'soy sauce 4.5 yuan.' Then she put down her phone, turned off the bedside lamp, and soon fell asleep.
location: Master bedroom at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Getting up in the morning, preparing breakfast, and having breakfast with the whole family
description: Before dawn, after hearing the alarm, she got up quietly, washed up, and went to the yard to check whether the cold-proof cloth on the vegetable cellar was firmly pressed down. Then she went to the kitchen to prepare breakfast: she made soy milk with the soybeans soaked overnight, steamed mantou and vegetable buns, and sliced pickled cucumbers and shredded kelp. Then she went to the children's room to wake the three children. The eldest son Mingxuan got up on his own; the second son Mingzhe stayed in bed and was gently pulled up and helped into his thermal underwear; the youngest daughter Yuxin obediently dressed herself and asked for her braids to be tied. The whole family, including her husband Ma Zhiqiang, sat around eating breakfast, talking about the school's PE class, reminding the children to drink more water during breaks and not to run around after school. She did not mention the education savings plan for now.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Take the three children to school
description: The weather was cold. She rode the electric bike with Mingzhe and Yuxin, first to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, and watched Mingzhe run into the school gate. Then she turned to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, explained to the teacher that Yuxin had a stuffy nose yesterday, and asked her to look after her more. Finally, on the way, she went by the gate of Jinghai District No. 1 Middle School and happened to see her eldest son Mingxuan arrive by bike. She waved to him and watched him enter the school gate, making sure all three children arrived at school safely.
location: Starting from home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, then arriving successively at Jinghai No. 3 Primary School (South Shengli Street), Huakang First Kindergarten, and Jinghai No. 1 Middle School (No. 19 Diwei Road).

name: Buy groceries at the Wutong Commune vegetable market
description: After dropping off the children, she rode her bike over to the Wutong Commune vegetable market. Because of the strong north wind, the market was not crowded. As usual, she went to vendor Sun Guifang's stall and picked out Chinese cabbage, potatoes, spinach, tofu, and a small piece of pork belly, planning to give the children a treat. Sister Sun casually mentioned that Chinese cabbage was ten cents more expensive than last year, so Ma Xiulan silently noted it and planned to stock up on a few more heads.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Going home to prepare bank documents
description: After returning from buying groceries, she put the vegetables into their proper places in the kitchen, washed her hands, took an old notebook and a ballpoint pen from the desk drawer, then found her own and her husband Ma Zhiqiang's ID cards and carefully placed them in a kraft paper envelope, preparing to go to the bank to ask about education savings.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Ran into an old neighbor while walking to the bank
description: Put on a thick cotton coat, hat, and scarf and walked along Jingwen Road to Tianjin Rural Commercial Bank. On the way, she ran into her old neighbor Aunt Zhao, who was carrying celery back from the morning market. They stood and chatted for five or six minutes. The neighbor asked whether Mingxuan was adjusting to middle school. She smiled and replied that it was okay, just a bit more homework. But with the bank errand on her mind, she said goodbye and continued on her way.
location: Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Inquired about education savings at the bank
description: She entered Tianjin Rural Commercial Bank Jinghai Central Sub-branch, took a number, waited, then went to the counter. The teller patiently explained the education savings service with monthly deposits and lump-sum withdrawal: annual interest rate 1.75%, minimum monthly deposit of 100 yuan, maximum limit of 50,000 yuan, and the withdrawal rules. She took out an old notebook and wrote down the details one by one, and also asked about fixed-deposit interest rates for comparison. Finally, she picked up a product brochure and felt reassured.
location: Tianjin Rural Commercial Bank (Jinghai Central Sub-branch), Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Walk home and organize banking information.
description: Leaving the bank, she walked home against the wind. Once home, she first drank some hot water to warm up, then sat at the desk and circled important points on the bank brochure in her notebook with a red pen—the interest rate, minimum deposit amount, withdrawal requirements, and so on. She tucked the promotional flyer into the notebook and put it away, planning to discuss it with her husband in the evening.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Lunch and midday rest
description: Alone at home, she rinsed the rice and steamed it in an electric rice cooker, reheated leftovers, and mixed a plate of tofu with scallions. While eating, she watched the noon news to keep up with local Jinghai news. After the meal, she leaned back on the sofa, covered herself with a blanket, and napped for about half an hour. The room was warm, and she slept soundly.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Practice daisy embroidery
description: She took out the long-and-short stitch daisy kit she learned from Sister Zhou Xiuqin and sat in the brightest spot by the window to practice attentively. She slowed down to study the petal curves, trying to make every petal stand up, thinking that in the future she could take on odd jobs with this skill to earn a little more money.
location: By the living room window at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up daughter from school and buy pastries
description: She put down her embroidery, put on her padded coat, checked the battery level of her electric bike, and set off. Arriving ten minutes early at Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up her youngest daughter Yuxin, the little girl ran over and said she had been praised by the teacher for her painting today. On the way home, she stopped by the Qinxiangyuan pastry shop and bought a few pieces of jujube paste cake and half a jin of sesame seed cakes, spending 18 yuan in total, planning to give some to the children as snacks and leave two pieces for her husband as a midnight snack.
location: Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Qinxiangyuan Pastry Shop at the Chaoyang Road intersection, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Play with daughter and continue embroidering.
description: After getting home, Yuxin couldn't wait to finish a piece of jujube paste cake. After I poured her a glass of warm water, she sat by herself at the little table playing with tangram puzzles and drawing. I sat nearby, watching her while continuing to practice daisy embroidery. She occasionally asked if her drawing was good, and I smiled and encouraged her. The time was quiet and reassuring.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the two sons from school.
description: Riding the electric bike with Yuxin, she first went to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up Mingzhe. Mingzhe excitedly said he had come first in the running race in PE class. Then she went on to the gate of Jinghai District No. 1 Middle School to wait for her eldest son Mingxuan. Seeing him push his bicycle out, the mother and children went home together.
location: Jinghai District, Tianjin: from her home on Jingwen Road, went to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, then Jinghai District No. 1 Middle School, then returned home.

name: Prepared dinner, had dinner, and discussed education savings
description: Tying on an apron, she started working. She cut the pork belly she had bought in the morning into pieces, blanched them, caramelized some sugar, and braised red-cooked pork. She shredded potatoes and sliced green peppers to make hot-and-sour potato shreds, and also made a spinach and tofu soup. Her second son, Mingzhe, ran over to help peel garlic. When the meal was ready, the whole family sat around and enjoyed it; the braised pork was fragrant. Taking the opportunity during the meal, she brought up to her husband Ma Zhiqiang that she had gone to the bank during the day to ask about education savings. After the meal, they moved to the living room. She took out her notebook and explained the interest rate, minimum deposit amount, and withdrawal time in full detail. After discussing, they decided to go together the next morning (January 7) to open an account and deposit 500 yuan first. She also urged her husband to smoke less and save more money.
location: Kitchen, dining room, and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Clear the dishes and supervise the children doing homework
description: After clearing and washing the dishes, she went to the living room, checked her eldest son Mingxuan's math homework, pointed out a wrong problem for him to correct, then looked at her second son Mingzhe's Chinese copying and asked him to rewrite the untidy characters twice. Her youngest daughter Yuxin was drawing with colored pencils nearby. The TV was playing local news, and she occasionally glanced up at it.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening family leisure and bedtime preparation
description: After homework was finished, she brought out jujube paste cake and sesame flatbread. The whole family curled up on the sofa watching a variety show, and the children laughed until they doubled over. Her husband, Ma Zhiqiang, also took a bite of the flatbread and kept saying how crispy it was. After the show ended, she urged the three children to wash their faces, brush their teeth, and wash their feet, helped her youngest daughter Yuxin change into pajamas, laid out the school uniform and red scarf that her second son Mingzhe would wear the next day at the head of his bed, and also took out her own thick coat and set it in place.
location: At home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin: living room, bathroom, and children's bedroom

name: Bookkeeping, bedtime preparation, and going to bed
description: She sat down at the desk, opened the account book, and recorded the day's expenses: 25 yuan for vegetables and 18 yuan for pastries. She also wrote down: "Consulted about education savings; plan to open an account on January 7 and deposit 500 yuan (will go together with Zhiqiang tomorrow)" and tucked in the bank flyer. Then she went to the kitchen, cut the vegetables to be stir-fried the next day, and soaked the wood ear mushrooms. She tidied the living room coffee table, swept the floor, watered the pothos on the windowsill, and changed the kitchen trash bag. Finally, she washed up and went to bed. She chatted with her husband about the bank matter, set the alarm for six o'clock, and after turning off the light, listening to the wind outside the window, she soon fell asleep.
location: At home: bedroom, kitchen, and living room, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Get up, wash up, and do light activity
description: The alarm went off right at 6:30. After getting up, Ma Xiulan felt a stiff neck, so she slowly turned her neck and did a few stretches. Then she washed up, changed into thick loungewear, and got ready to prepare breakfast for the family.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare breakfast and wake up the family.
description: Ma Xiulan was preparing breakfast in the kitchen. The millet porridge was simmering on the stove, and she heated up the sesame cakes bought from Qinxiangyuan. She woke up her eldest son Ma Mingxuan, second son Ma Mingzhe, and youngest daughter Ma Yuxin one by one. The family sat around the dining table. Ma Xiulan put a sesame cake on her husband Ma Zhiqiang's plate and reminded him to find his ID card and household registration booklet so they could go to the bank to handle education savings.
location: Kitchen and dining room of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Took Mingzhe and Yuxin to school
description: The eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, rode his bicycle to Jinghai District No.1 Middle School. Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike with her younger daughter, Ma Yuxin, on the back seat and her second son, Ma Mingzhe, sitting in front. She first took Yuxin to Huakang No.1 Kindergarten and watched as the teacher led her into the classroom; then she took Mingzhe to Jinghai District No.3 Primary School (Shengli South Street), telling him to listen carefully in class and not to run around after school. The weather was cold and overcast, and the east wind felt chilly on her face.
location: Starting from home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, first go to Huakang First Kindergarten (Jinghai District, Tianjin), then to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin)

name: Go home, tidy up, and go to the bank to open an education savings account.
description: After taking the children to school and returning home, Ma Xiulan briskly put the dishes and chopsticks into the sink to soak and wiped the table clean. Her husband, Ma Zhiqiang, had already changed clothes, and the two went out together, walking to Tianjin Rural Commercial Bank (Jinghai Central Sub-branch) on Shengli Street. At the bank, Ma Zhiqiang provided his ID card and household register, and Ma Xiulan added the information she had asked about the day before, clearly stating that they wanted to open an education savings installment deposit account. She took out 500 yuan in cash from the inner pocket of her down jacket and deposited it. After finishing, they went home together, and Ma Xiulan felt a weight lift from her mind.
location: Tianjin Rural Commercial Bank (Jinghai Central Sub-branch), Victory Avenue, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Contact the part-time job referral contact and make a plan.
description: After returning home from the bank, Ma Zhiqiang changed into his work clothes and prepared to drive out. Ma Xiulan straightened his collar and told him to be safe. After her husband left, Ma Xiulan sat down on the living room sofa and called Sister Zheng Xiuying, the part-time job referral contact. Sister Zheng said there was still no news on handcraft piecework, advised her not to worry, and suggested preparing a few more samples so she could produce something immediately when work came up. After hanging up, Ma Xiulan looked through the snowflake patterns saved in her phone album yesterday and mulled over how to embroider them.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Design and trial-stitch the first draft of a new pattern.
description: After Ma Xiulan had this idea, she found her sewing basket and several shades of blue embroidery thread, and began to sketch the design on the embroidery fabric, following a pattern on her phone. She deliberately set the embroidery frame a little higher to remind herself not to keep her head down all the time. After embroidering for about half an hour, she felt her neck getting sore, so she stood up and walked around the room, stretching her shoulders and neck.
location: Beside the sofa in the living room at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare and eat lunch, then rest briefly
description: Ma Xiulan put down her embroidery work and went to the kitchen to prepare lunch. She simply made spinach tofu soup and heated two steamed buns. After eating quietly by herself, she cleaned up the dishes and leaned back on the sofa for a dozen minutes or so to refresh herself.
location: Kitchen and dining room of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up Yuxin from school and go to the vegetable market to buy groceries
description: At almost 1:30 p.m., Ma Xiulan put on her coat and rode her electric bike to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up her younger daughter Ma Yuxin. Yuxin bounced out, calling 'Mom.' On the way, mother and daughter went to the Wutong Commune Vegetable Market and, at the stall of Sister Sun Guifang, a familiar vendor, bought fresh pork hind leg meat to be ground and two zucchini, planning to make pork and zucchini dumplings for dinner. After shopping, the two walked slowly home.
location: Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Wutong Commune Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin; finally returned home at 156 Jingwen Road

name: Embroider a new pattern and watch over her daughter.
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan let Yuxin look at picture books by herself at the small table in the living room. She took out her embroidery frame again and continued the morning's embroidery. Sunlight streamed through the window. She carefully moved the needle, trying the newly learned long-and-short stitch technique to embroider snowflake petals; the light and dark blue combination made the petals more three-dimensional than a single color. After embroidering for about twenty minutes, she would look up at the trees and clouds outside the window, stretch her neck, and then continue.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up second son Mingzhe from school
description: When it was time to pick up Mingzhe, Ma Xiulan told Yuxin to wait obediently at home and rode her electric bike to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School. At the school gate, she saw Mingzhe coming out while playfully wrestling with classmates. She called out to him, and he ran over with sweat still on his face. Ma Xiulan asked if he had much homework. Mingzhe said it was okay—he had already done some at school, and he was in a good mood today.
location: Jinghai No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare dinner for family reunion
description: Back home, Ma Xiulan let Mingzhe and Yuxin play in the living room, while she put on an apron and started preparing dinner. She washed her hands, kneaded the dough, chopped the meat, and mixed the filling in one smooth flow. While she was wrapping the dumplings, her eldest son Ma Mingxuan came home from school, greeted her, and went into his room to do homework. Around six o'clock, her husband Ma Zhiqiang finished work, came home, changed clothes, and came over to help. The family chatted and laughed, and hot dumplings were soon ready.
location: Kitchen and dining room of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The whole family had dinner together.
description: When the dumplings were cooked and brought to the table, Ma Xiulan poured vinegar into small dipping dishes for the family. As they ate and chatted, Ma Xiulan mentioned opening a bank account that day, Ma Zhiqiang said the roads were not busy today so it went smoothly, and Ma Mingzhe told a funny school story that made Yuxin giggle. The family sat around together in a warm atmosphere, and most of the fatigue in Ma Xiulan's heart melted away.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tidy up the household and check the children's homework.
description: After dinner, Ma Zhiqiang watched TV with Yuxin, while Ma Xiulan quickly cleaned up the dishes, wiped the table, and washed the bowls. When she finished, she sat on the sofa and began checking her two sons' homework. First, she looked at eldest son Mingxuan's math homework—all answers were correct. Then she picked up second son Mingzhe's exercise book and looked carefully. She found that although the handwriting wasn't pretty, it was much neater than before. She pointed at the book and praised, 'Mingzhe, your handwriting today is really good—it looks so pleasant!' Mingzhe smiled sheepishly.
location: Dining room and living room of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family leisure time.
description: After checking the homework, Ma Xiulan took out her phone and entered today's spending on meat and vegetables into the bookkeeping app. Then the family snuggled on the sofa watching TV, chatting and laughing now and then. Ma Zhiqiang quietly discussed with her what to buy for both sets of parents for the New Year, and Ma Xiulan mulled it over in her mind. Her hands weren't idle either; she picked up the embroidery hoop and finished the snowflake petal she hadn't completed during the day.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Get the children to wash up and prepare for the next day's tasks.
description: Ma Xiulan began urging the children to wash up. The eldest and second sons took care of themselves, while she helped her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin fetch hot water to wash her face and feet. While at it, she picked up the children's school uniforms to check whether they were dirty or torn, and put her eldest son Mingxuan's bicycle key on the hall tray so it wouldn't be missing the next morning.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Personal washing up and relaxation
description: After the children had all lain down, Ma Xiulan could finally catch her breath. She went to the bathroom, washed her face well with hot water, and filled a basin with hot water to soak her feet. When she got into bed, her neck still felt a little sore, so she placed a hot towel on her neck and lay with her eyes closed for about ten minutes. The warmth made her feel a lot better.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: After applying the compress to her neck, Ma Xiulan got up and checked the doors, windows, and gas, confirming they were all closed. Back in the bedroom, she took out the clothes she would wear tomorrow morning from the wardrobe and draped them over the back of a chair. She glanced at her phone, saw no new messages, turned off the light, and lay down. Silently thinking about what breakfast to make for the children tomorrow, she gradually fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: At six in the morning, Ma Xiulan woke up on time. Because she had spent a long time bending over her embroidery the day before, her neck was still a bit sore. She gently moved it a few times, then put on her cotton-padded jacket and got up. After a quick wash, she tied up her hair and prepared herself physically and mentally for the new day.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Preparing breakfast and discovering that the faucet was leaking
description: Ma Xiulan went into the kitchen and started preparing breakfast. Today she cooked millet porridge and reheated the steamed pork-and-zucchini buns from the previous day. Because her husband Ma Zhiqiang wasn't taking the truck out today, she specially took out two eggs to fry him sunny-side up. While the porridge was cooking, she turned on the faucet to get water and noticed that the joint of the faucet was dripping continuously. She tried to tighten it but it didn't work, so she had to put a basin underneath to catch the drips, mentally planning to have her husband take a look when he came home in the evening. She used the basin of water she had caught last night to water the garlic sprouts on the windowsill.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Waking up the family and having breakfast together
description: After breakfast was ready, Ma Xiulan pushed open the doors of the three children's rooms one by one (Ma Mingxuan, Ma Mingzhe, and Ma Yuxin) and gently woke them. The family sat around the dining table. Ma Xiulan mentioned the leaking faucet to her husband, who told her not to worry and that he would fix it when he got back in the evening. When the children were reluctant to get up, the eldest son Ma Mingxuan's joke made them laugh. Ma Xiulan, sipping porridge, teased, 'Look at Dad—he can fix things for our family as soon as he comes, saving fifty yuan.' The children chimed in to praise their father, and the atmosphere was warm and lively.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Take the children to school.
description: After breakfast, Ma Xiulan put on a down jacket, helped her younger daughter Yuxin tie her scarf, and rode the electric bike, first taking Yuxin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten. She watched her enter the gate and waved to the teacher, then went straight to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to take her second son Mingzhe. At the school gate, she reminded Mingzhe, "It's colder today; don't take off your coat during recess." Only after confirming that he had entered the school did she ride back home.
location: Huakang First Kindergarten in Jinghai District, Tianjin, and Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street)

name: Resting, buying groceries, and going home to sort out the accounts
description: After dropping off the children and returning home, Ma Xiulan took off her helmet, drank some warm water to catch her breath, and deliberately moved her neck from side to side to relieve the soreness from yesterday. Then she picked up her shopping bag and coin purse and walked about five minutes to the Wutong Commune Vegetable Market. At Aunt Sun Guifang's stall, Aunt Sun greeted her warmly and recommended the local spinach that had just arrived that morning. Ma Xiulan picked out a bunch of spinach and also bought pork belly, vermicelli, and tofu. As they chatted, they also talked about the community dance team. When she left, Aunt Sun threw in two extra bunches of scallions. After returning home, Ma Xiulan sorted and put away the groceries: she cut the pork belly into pieces and blanched them, put the spinach in a plastic bag in the refrigerator, and soaked the tofu in water. Then she washed her hands, took out her account book and phone, and recorded the day's expenses: spinach 3 yuan, pork belly 28 yuan, vermicelli 5 yuan, tofu 2 yuan, for a total of 38 yuan.
location: From home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market in Jinghai District, Tianjin, and back home.

name: Do housework and get some exercise
description: Ma Xiulan put the dirty clothes from the previous day into the washing machine and started the wash. While the machine was running, she cleaned the living room and bedroom, wiping the tables and floor with a wet cloth. After about twenty minutes of housework, she remembered the sore neck she had from embroidering yesterday and deliberately paused to stretch her neck and twist her waist. When the washing machine signaled it was done, she went to the balcony and hung the clean clothes out to dry properly.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Practice embroidery
description: With housework temporarily at a pause, Ma Xiulan took out her embroidery hoop, blue-and-white ice silk thread, and the snowflake-pattern sample cloth she had started embroidering the day before, and sat in the sunny spot by the living room window. She slowed her movements and used the long-and-short stitch technique to close the petal curves stitch by stitch. She felt her hands were smooth that day, and her stitches were much more even than the day before. Twice during the process she looked up at her phone, following her self-reminder to get up and move every half hour, and stretched her neck. She planned to go see Sister Zhou Xiuqin on Friday after this sample was finished, to see if she could recommend her to Sister Zheng Xiuying for some custom bib piecework.
location: By the living room window at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Rest, simple lunch, tending the courtyard, and continuing embroidery
description: After finishing the morning embroidery, Ma Xiulan stood up to stretch, heated a bowl of millet porridge, and had a simple lunch with the leftover steamed buns and pickled vegetables from the morning. After lunch, she leaned back on the sofa and rested with her eyes closed for about half an hour to save energy for the afternoon's tasks. After the nap, she put on her coat and walked a lap around the vegetable plot in the courtyard, checking whether the frost-protection film was pressed down firmly. After confirming there was no damage, she went back inside with peace of mind. Then she continued with her embroidery and finished the last edge of the snowflake pattern. At the moment of completion, she felt a strong sense of accomplishment, feeling that this sample showed clear improvement over the first daisy she learned from Sister Zhou.
location: Living room, kitchen, and courtyard at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the youngest daughter from school and go to the supermarket on the way.
description: Seeing it was about time, Ma Xiulan put away her embroidery tools, grabbed her e-bike keys and a mask, and rode to Huakang First Kindergarten. Her younger daughter Yuxin was already waiting at the gate, and when she saw her, she happily called out "Mom!" Ma Xiulan put on her little gloves. Then she took a detour to the nearby Jingbai Supermarket, picked out a bottle of soy sauce and a bag of salt, and at checkout noted the soy sauce cost 6.5 yuan and the salt 2 yuan, for a total of 8.5 yuan. She felt lucky that she had already stocked up when she heard at the community supermarket that soy sauce was going to rise in price, so this time she was only filling a gap.
location: Home, Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and Jingbai Supermarket, Jinghai District, Tianjin (Yuzhou Zunfu, Building 19, Unit 104).

name: Take her daughter home and play with Jiacan.
description: Back home, Ma Xiulan first washed Yuxin's hands, warmed a glass of milk, and took out the jujube paste cake bought the day before as a snack. While eating, Yuxin showed her mother a crooked little rabbit she had drawn at kindergarten that day, and Ma Xiulan praised her drawing. In the meantime, she took a moment to send a WeChat message to Wang Guilan, the neighbor across the hall, asking if she would like to go for a stroll together in the evening, and then played with her daughter in the living room for a while.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare dinner ingredients and do housework
description: After letting Yuxin watch cartoons by herself in the living room, Ma Xiulan put on an apron and went into the kitchen to prepare ingredients. That evening she planned to make braised pork belly, garlic spinach, and hot and sour shredded potatoes. She cut the pork belly into pieces and blanched them, shredded the potatoes into thin strips and soaked them in water, and washed and drained the spinach. Thinking about how hard her husband had worked during the day, she also decided to add a cold cucumber salad. While preparing, she deliberately stretched her neck several times to avoid keeping her head down for too long.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Picked up the two sons from school and returned home
description: After finishing the meal prep, Ma Xiulan locked the door, got on her electric bike with Yuxin, and first went to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up her second son, Mingzhe. As soon as he got on the bike, Mingzhe excitedly talked about his new record of 98 jumps in the rope skipping test in PE class.
