Then they went to the gate of Jinghai District No. 1 Middle School, where her eldest son, Mingxuan, was already waiting with his bicycle. The three children chattered on the bike, and Ma Xiulan felt warm at heart as they returned home safely.
location: Home, Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Tianjin (Shengli South Street), Jinghai District No. 1 Middle School, Tianjin (No. 19 Diwei Road), home

name: Preparing dinner and fixing the faucet with her husband
description: After the whole family got home, Ma Xiulan sped up her cooking. In the kitchen, the braised pork was already stewing and filling the air with fragrance. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang came home from work and lent a hand. Seeing the faucet still dripping, he immediately took out a wrench and screwdriver and began to disassemble and inspect the valve core. Ma Xiulan handed him tools while stir-frying. Her husband carefully tightened the internal screws and cleaned the limescale from the filter screen. Half an hour later, the faucet was back to normal. The children gathered around to watch and kept praising their dad for being capable. Then Ma Xiulan finished making hot and sour shredded potatoes and garlic spinach, and dinner was ready.
location: Kitchen and sink at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The whole family had dinner together.
description: Ma Zhiqiang helped bring the last dish to the table, and the whole family sat around the dining table. Ma Xiulan put a piece of braised pork on everyone's plate and said with a smile, “The meat is simmered until tender today. You must try it! Dad did a great job and saved our family fifty yuan in repair costs!” The children praised as they ate, “Mom's cooking is the best” and “Dad is best at fixing things.” Ma Zhiqiang proudly raised an eyebrow. At the table, Mingzhe shared his new jump-rope record, and Mingxuan talked about interesting observations from biology class, making the meal especially delicious.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Housework and helping the children with homework.
description: After the meal, her husband Ma Zhiqiang took the initiative to wash the dishes, while Ma Xiulan was responsible for helping the children with their homework. Her eldest son Mingxuan went back to his room to do math homework. She sat in the living room with her second son Mingzhe as he practiced Chinese characters, reminding him from time to time to sit up straight. Her youngest daughter Yuxin sat quietly nearby coloring in a drawing book, and Ma Xiulan took the opportunity to check her schoolbag to see if she needed to bring anything extra the next day.
location: Living room and kitchen at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family leisure time.
description: After the children finished their homework, the family of five squeezed together on the sofa to watch a family-life drama, and the children watched with great interest. Ma Xiulan chatted with her husband about her embroidery progress that day, and her husband shared that he had run into a former colleague at the logistics park. During the commercial break, she took out her ledger and phone, recorded all of today's expenses (38 yuan at the vegetable market and 8.5 yuan at the supermarket) totaling 46.5 yuan, and told her husband that this month's spending was well controlled and the education fund was being deposited monthly, which made her feel at ease.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Remind the children to wash up and prepare their things for tomorrow.
description: After the leisure time ended, Ma Xiulan began urging the children to wash up. She arranged for Mingxuan and Mingzhe to wash their faces and brush their teeth in the bathroom, while she prepared bathwater for her little daughter Yuxin and helped her bathe. When everything was settled, she checked and prepared the clothes each child would wear the next day: Mingxuan's school uniform hung on the clothes rack, Mingzhe's sweater and red scarf placed on the chair, and Yuxin's little dress laid out. She also took out her husband's work uniform jacket and hung it up.
location: Bathrooms and bedrooms at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Personal washing up and getting ready for bed
description: After all the children were asleep, Ma Xiulan finally had time to wash up herself. While brushing her teeth and washing her face, she deliberately filled a hot water bottle and put it in the quilt to warm it. She applied some hand cream in front of the mirror because her hands were a little dry from doing needlework today. Before going to bed, she went to the balcony to feel the clothes hung out to dry, confirmed they were dry, and planned to take them in tomorrow morning. Finally, she checked the doors, windows, and gas valve and confirmed everything was closed before returning to the bedroom. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang was already leaning against the headboard looking at his phone. She turned off the light, slipped into the warm quilt, and said to him, "Today was pretty good. The children were happy, and the faucet was fixed too." Her husband patted her hand and told her not to tire herself out. Ma Xiulan felt at peace, closed her eyes, and welcomed another solid day.
location: Bathroom, living room, kitchen, and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Get up and prepare breakfast.
description: After the phone alarm rang, Ma Xiulan got up and saw that it was dark outside and the window was frosted. She put on a thick padded jacket, went to the kitchen, took millet and red beans from the soaking basin to cook porridge, heated the steamed meat buns, and washed and chopped the green onions she had picked, ready to sprinkle into the porridge to enhance the flavor.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Wake the children and supervise breakfast.
description: Ma Xiulan woke up her eldest son Ma Mingxuan, second son Ma Mingzhe, and youngest daughter Ma Yuxin one by one. Ma Mingxuan drank porridge and ate a steamed bun, and Ma Xiulan tucked a boiled egg into his pocket. After Mingzhe and Xinxin finished breakfast, Ma Xiulan filled Xinxin's small water bottle with warm water and checked her schoolbag.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Take the second son and the younger daughter to school.
description: Ma Xiulan put on her down jacket, wrapped her scarf around her neck, and pushed her electric bike out the door. Because it was cold, she had Xinxin sit in front and Mingzhe in back. She rode for about 10 minutes to send Xinxin to Huakang First Kindergarten, watched her go inside with the teacher. Then she took Mingzhe on another 10-plus-minute ride to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School on Shengli South Street, watched Mingzhe enter the school gate, and told him to drink plenty of warm water.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (departure), Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin, Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Buying groceries and preparing to go home
description: After dropping off the children, Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to the Wutong Commune Vegetable Market. At the stall run by her old acquaintance Sun Guifang, she bought small bok choy, soft tofu, vermicelli, and half a jin of pork belly for 27 yuan. She planned to make cabbage stew with vermicelli and stir-fried bok choy for lunch, and steamed buns for dinner. Then she cycled home to put away the food.
location: Baiye Company Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin; 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Household chores and finishing embroidery
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan changed clothes, put the clothes to be washed into the washing machine on the quick wash cycle, then wiped the table, mopped the floor, and tidied up the cloth dolls the children had left about. After finishing the housework, she sat on the living room sofa, took out the snowflake embroidery pattern, put on her reading glasses, and carefully finished it with long-and-short stitch. She thought about showing it to Sister Xiuqin the next day and asking whether she had any suitable bib work.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tending the vegetable garden and preparing lunch
description: Around noon, Ma Xiulan went to the courtyard garden to check the cilantro and scallions, which were covered with straw and plastic film and growing well. She lifted a corner to let them breathe and pulled out a few scallions. Back inside, she hung the laundry from the washing machine, then sautéed the scallions in the wok, cooked noodles, poached two eggs, and had a simple lunch.
location: Courtyard and kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Lunch break
description: After finishing lunch, Ma Xiulan leaned back on the living room sofa for a short rest. She did not fall fully asleep, mainly to give her lower back a break. She planned the afternoon: pick up Xinxin, go to the reading room, and stop by the supermarket on the way. She deliberately found some band-aids and put them in her bag, in case they were needed at the reading room with so many children.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up daughter from school
description: Ma Xiulan left early, warmed up the electric bike, and rode slowly to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten. After the gate opened, Xinxin ran over holding up a painted snowman. Ma Xiulan praised her and lifted her onto the back seat of the electric bike.
location: Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Parent-child reading in the community reading room.
description: Ma Xiulan rode with Xinxin for 6 minutes to the reading room of the Jingwen Road Community Service Center. Xinxin picked the picture book "The Good Little Rabbit" to read, while Ma Xiulan was reading "Family Life" magazine. Suddenly Xinxin slipped off her chair and scraped her knee. Ma Xiulan immediately took a band-aid from her bag and put it on, gently comforting her. The administrator, Sister Wang, handed over some warm water. Xinxin soon stopped crying and smiled.
location: Reading Room, Community Service Center, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Stopped by the supermarket on the way
description: After coming out of the reading room, Ma Xiulan rode with Xinxin along the way to Jingbai Supermarket. She bought dark soy sauce and aged vinegar, bought two white erasers for Mingzhe, and a coloring book for Xinxin, spending 22 yuan in total. Then they went home, where she washed an apple for Xinxin and let her watch cartoons, while she herself prepared to cook dinner.
location: Jingbai Supermarket, Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu, Jinghai District, Tianjin; 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare dinner (steamed buns)
description: Ma Xiulan put on an apron, minced the pork belly bought in the morning into filling, added minced scallion and ginger, soy sauce, salt, and oil, and stirred well. She chopped the cabbage, squeezed it dry, and mixed it with the meat filling to make cabbage-pork filling. She kneaded the dough that had risen overnight, cut it into portions, rolled out wrappers, wrapped more than twenty buns, and placed them on the steamer tray for a second proofing.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the two sons from school.
description: Ma Xiulan told Xinxin to stay at home and watch TV, then rode her electric bike alone to No. 3 Primary School in Jinghai District to pick up Ma Mingzhe, and then waited at the gate of No. 1 Middle School in Jinghai District for Ma Mingxuan. Ma Mingxuan rode his bicycle home, and Ma Xiulan told him to be careful on the road.
location: Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Tianjin; Tianjin Jinghai District No. 1 Middle School (Shengli Street)

name: The whole family had dinner together
description: Ma Xiulan steamed buns, cooked millet porridge, and stir-fried vinegar-potato shreds. Her husband, Ma Zhiqiang, came home from work and was delighted by the smell of the buns. The whole family sat together; the two children chatted about fun things at school, and Xinxin used a small dish of vinegar to dip the bun skins in. Ma Xiulan felt content.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Clearing the dishes and helping with homework.
description: Ma Zhiqiang voluntarily washed the dishes, while Ma Xiulan cleaned up the kitchen and wiped the stovetop. Afterward, she supervised Ma Mingzhe doing his homework in the living room, reminding him from time to time to stay focused. Ma Mingxuan finished his homework on his own, while Xinxin colored in a coloring book beside them.
location: Dining room and living room of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family leisure and washing up
description: After the children finished their homework, they played freely. Ma Xiulan sat on the sofa watching local news while the children played with building blocks. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang discussed with her the plan to visit her parents' home on the weekend. Around 9 p.m., Ma Xiulan urged Mingzhe and Xinxin to wash up, while Ma Mingxuan handled his own routine. After washing up, the children changed into pajamas and went to bed.
location: Living room and bathroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening bookkeeping and budget review
description: After the children went to sleep, Ma Xiulan took out her account book and phone app to check this week's accounts: 27 yuan for vegetables, 42 yuan for pork ribs, 22 yuan for supermarket shopping, and so on. She found that she had spent quite a lot this week, so she planned to curb snack spending next week and buy more fruit. She also decided to cook multigrain porridge tomorrow morning to save money, and wrote these ideas down in her account book.
location: Sofa in the living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing the next day's necessities and washing up
description: After keeping accounts, Ma Xiulan went to the kitchen, washed and soaked the mixed grains and rice for the next day's breakfast, picked out clothes for Mingzhe and Xinxin to wear the next day and placed them beside their pillows, and prepared clothes for herself. Then she went to the bathroom to wash her face and do her skincare routine carefully.
location: Kitchen, bedroom, and bathroom at the residence at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Checking and going to bed
description: Ma Xiulan checked the gas stove in the kitchen and the living room windows, and bolted the front door. Returning to the bedroom, her husband Ma Zhiqiang was already lying down, and she got under the quilt. Recalling that today she had handled Xinxin's bump smoothly, finished the embroidery, sorted out the accounts, and steamed buns, she felt at ease, turned off the light, and fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Get up and prepare breakfast for the whole family
description: At 6:30 in the morning, Ma Xiulan got up on time, washed up, and went into the kitchen. She made a pot of hot cabbage and tofu soup, reheated the 8 pork and scallion buns steamed yesterday, and cut a small plate of her own pickled radish peels. At the same time, she filled the three children's thermos cups with warm water, prepared breakfast for the whole family, and thought about the important matter of going to the bank to open an account today.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Waking the children and supervising breakfast
description: At 7:30, Ma Xiulan woke the three children one by one: the eldest son Ma Mingxuan had already woken up by himself, the second son Ma Mingzhe stayed in bed for a while, and the youngest daughter Ma Yuxin was very good. She watched the children wash up and sit at the table, and while serving soup she told them to eat slowly. After eating, Ma Mingxuan put on his backpack and wheeled out his bicycle, ready to go to school by himself.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Take the youngest daughter and second son to school
description: Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike, with her younger daughter Ma Yuxin standing in front and her second son Ma Mingzhe sitting behind. She first took Yuxin to Huakang First Kindergarten, then brought Mingzhe to the gate of the No. 3 Primary School of Jinghai District. Mingzhe jumped off the bike and ran into the school gate. The school drop-off took more than twenty minutes.
location: Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Huakang Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street

name: Dropped by neighbor Wang Guilan's place on the way.
description: After dropping off the children, Ma Xiulan met her neighbor Wang Guilan on Jingwen Road, and the two stood at the entrance of the building unit and chatted for over ten minutes. Ma Xiulan told Wang Guilan that she was going to the bank today to open education fund accounts for the children. Wang Guilan agreed and reminded her to be careful on the road in the cold. The two agreed to talk in detail in the afternoon after picking up the children.
location: At the entrance to Wang Guilan's apartment building on Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Going home for the documents and going to the bank to open an account
description: Ma Xiulan first returned home, took the family ledger, her ID card, and an envelope containing 500 yuan in cash from the desk drawer in the bedroom. After checking them, she walked to the Rural Credit Cooperative on Guangming Road. After taking a number and waiting at the bank, she told the female teller that she wanted to open an education savings account with small regular deposits for the children's future schooling. She carefully filled out the account application form, deposited 500 yuan, and finally received a brand-new red passbook, feeling very reassured.
location: Jinghai Branch of Tianjin Jinghai District Rural Credit Cooperative, Guangming Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Go to Zhou Xiuqin's house to show embroidery samples
description: After leaving the bank, Ma Xiulan went in a good mood to Zhou Xiuqin's home on Shengli Street. She showed Zhou Xiuqin her newly embroidered snowflake sample, and Zhou Xiuqin praised her fine craftsmanship. Ma Xiulan took the opportunity to ask whether the side job mentioned earlier — sewing children's bibs for a children's clothing store — still needed people, hoping to earn some money to deposit into her newly opened passbook. Zhou Xiuqin said that a boss happened to be looking for workers, but needed to see a sample first. She promised to show the sample to the boss and give an answer tomorrow.
location: Zhou Xiuqin's home on Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin (residence near No. 45 Shengli Street)

name: Go home to tend the vegetable garden and do housework.
description: After walking home from Zhou Xiuqin's house, Ma Xiulan first locked the new bankbook and accounting notebook in the desk drawer in the bedroom. Then she went to the vegetable plot in the yard, lifted the frost-protection film to let the scallions and spinach breathe, and watered the garlic sprouts. Back inside, she put yesterday's dirty clothes into the washing machine, mopped the floors in the living room and bedrooms, and tidied the home until it was bright and clean.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Having lunch alone, taking a midday rest, and mending clothes
description: At noon, Ma Xiulan cooked herself a bowl of tomato and egg noodle soup, then cleaned up the kitchen after eating. She took a short nap on the sofa, worrying about her husband Ma Zhiqiang's work clothes. When she woke up, she found Zhiqiang's work jacket with worn cuffs, sat by the window and sewed it stitch by stitch. She reinforced the cuffs and added a small patch. After sewing for nearly an hour, she got up, moved around, and drank a glass of warm water.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the youngest daughter from school and go to the supermarket on the way
description: She left at 1:30. Ma Xiulan walked to Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up her youngest daughter, Ma Yuxin. Yuxin was wearing a thick cotton-padded coat, her little face red from the cold. Ma Xiulan put a thick vest she had brought on her, then took her hand and walked with her to the nearby Jingbai Supermarket. At the supermarket she bought soy sauce, sugar tangerines, and apples for 28 yuan in total. Yuxin took a fancy to cartoon stickers, so Ma Xiulan bought her a little rabbit sticker. Yuxin was very happy.
location: Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jingbai Supermarket, Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu.

name: Play with daughter and prepare ingredients for dinner.
description: Back home, Yuxin sat at the small living room table concentrating on applying new stickers. Ma Xiulan began preparing dinner, planning to stew Chinese cabbage with tofu, vermicelli, and pork belly. She washed and chopped the vegetables, cut the tofu into pieces, soaked the vermicelli, and also soaked some wood ear mushrooms for a cold salad. While she was busy in the kitchen, Yuxin chattered beside her sharing fun stories from kindergarten. Ma Xiulan responded as she chopped vegetables, the sounds from the stove and the child's voice interweaving, filling her with a sense of stability.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Picked up the second son and eldest son from school
description: At 4 p.m., Ma Xiulan put on a thick down jacket and rode her electric bike first to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up her second son Ma Mingzhe, then went together with him to Jinghai District No. 1 Middle School to pick up her eldest son Ma Mingxuan. Mingxuan came out riding his bicycle, and the three met up and headed home together. On the way, Mingzhe excitedly talked about how his class had won the football game and he had scored a goal, while Mingxuan asked what was for dinner. Ma Xiulan answered stewed vermicelli, and Mingxuan nodded.
location: Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School on Shengli South Street, and Jinghai District No. 1 Middle School at 19 Diwei Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing dinner for the whole family
description: After getting home, Ma Xiulan had the children wash their hands and do homework first, while she busied herself in the kitchen. She heated oil in a wok, stir-fried the pork belly, then added napa cabbage, frozen tofu, and soaked vermicelli, along with soy sauce and star anise. She added water and let it simmer over low heat. The aroma of the food filled the house. She also quickly smashed cucumbers and tossed black fungus with garlic paste, preparing a hearty dinner.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner together and discussion of the education savings passbook
description: At 6:30 her husband Ma Zhiqiang came home, and dinner began. Ma Xiulan first served Zhiqiang some soup, then took out the newly opened red bankbook and handed it to him. She solemnly explained that this was an education savings account opened with 500 yuan from the household, reserved exclusively for the three children's future schooling, with money only going in and never coming out, and she hoped Zhiqiang would support it too. Zhiqiang took the bankbook, looked at it, and said with a smile, 'I feel assured when you handle things. From now on I'll smoke less and bring more money home, and we'll save together.' The children did not understand, but seeing their parents happy, they ate their meal happily.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Clearing dishes, helping with homework, and family leisure
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan cleared the dishes and went to the kitchen to wash them, while Ma Zhiqiang looked at his phone and played with Yuxin. After drying her hands, Ma Xiulan checked the math homework of her second son Ma Mingzhe, found a mistake in one word problem, and patiently helped him recalculate it. Her eldest son Ma Mingxuan did his homework independently in his room. After finishing, Ma Xiulan used a bookkeeping app on her phone to record the day's supermarket expenses and embroidery thread purchases, and checked them against her ledger with no discrepancies.
location: Living room and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Urge the children to wash up and prepare tomorrow's items.
description: At nine in the evening, Ma Xiulan urged the children to wash up. Ma Mingxuan washed up on his own; she helped Ma Mingzhe and Ma Yuxin brush their teeth, wash their faces, and wash their feet. Then she went back to the bedroom, picked out clothes and coats for everyone for the next day, and placed them at the foot of the bed. She also checked the natural gas and doors and windows, listened to the wind outside, and felt at peace.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Wash up and go to bed
description: Ma Xiulan finished washing up, changed into her fleece pajamas, and lay down on the bed. She looked through the new bankbook and felt that although the day had been busy, she had accomplished a major thing in her life: the education fund now had its own dedicated account, and her husband also agreed with the principle of only depositing and never withdrawing. It had been a secure and meaningful day. After a few intimate words with Zhiqiang, she turned off the light at 10:30 and fell into a deep sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Wake up, wash up, and morning activities
description: She woke up at exactly 7 a.m. Even though it was Saturday and she didn't need to take the children to school, her biological clock still woke her naturally. Lying in bed, she moved her neck; it felt better than yesterday but was still a bit stiff and sore. Then she went to the bathroom, washed up with warm water, and felt refreshed.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing the family breakfast
description: Entered the kitchen and began preparing breakfast for the family. Took steamed buns and millet porridge from the fridge to heat up, while stir-frying a plate of eggs and cutting a plate of homemade pickled radish strips. Steam rose in the kitchen, warm and cozy.
location: Kitchen at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family breakfast and cleanup.
description: At 8:15, she woke the three children to wash up. The family sat around the dining table for breakfast. Ma Xiulan served porridge and handed out steamed buns to everyone. After the meal, she quickly cleared the dishes, wiped the table, tidied the kitchen, and got ready to go out.
location: Dining room and kitchen at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Visited Zhou Xiuqin to take on some odd jobs.
description: At 9 o'clock, she put on a thick coat and wrapped her scarf, then walked to Zhou Xiuqin's home on Shengli Street, about a 12-minute walk. After arriving, the two sat down for tea. Zhou Xiuqin told her that the owner of the children's clothing store was very satisfied with the handkerchief sample and decided to have her try making 10 children's bibs first, at 8 yuan each, with fabric provided by the store; she could pick up the fabric samples tomorrow. Ma Xiulan felt steady and happy, and after exchanging embroidery edging and stitching techniques, she took her leave.
location: Zhou Xiuqin's home on Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Buying groceries at the market and contacting via WeChat
description: After leaving Zhou Xiuqin's house, she walked along the way to the Wutong Commune vegetable market and picked out Chinese cabbage, spinach, glass noodles, and tofu at Sun Guifang's stall. After paying, she took a photo of the handkerchief she had embroidered yesterday and sent it to her childhood friend Liu Chunmei. On the way home, she received a WeChat voice message from Liu Chunmei praising the bright colors and the layered petals, and encouraging her to embroider more and take custom orders. Ma Xiulan felt very happy.
location: Sun Guifang's stall at Wutong Gongshe Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and Jingwen Road

name: Returning Home to Tidy Up and Rest
description: After returning home, she sorted the vegetables she had bought and put them in the refrigerator, then glanced through the passbook opened yesterday and locked it back in the drawer. Then she sat on the sofa, moved her neck, and replied to a few WeChat messages from Liu Chunmei, feeling relaxed and content.
location: Living room and kitchen at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Prepared and enjoyed lunch, then took a midday nap.
description: At 11:30 she started preparing lunch. She stewed a pot of dishes with the newly bought Chinese cabbage and tofu, and steamed rice. The children got hungry quickly, so as soon as the food was ready they ate right away. Ma Xiulan also served herself rice and finished eating. Afterward, she soaked the bowls and chopsticks in the sink and went back to the bedroom to lie down for half an hour to relieve fatigue.
location: Kitchen and dining room, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Focus on handkerchief embroidery
description: While the three children played in the living room, Ma Xiulan sat in a bright spot by the window, focusing on embroidering the lotus petals on a handkerchief. She moved the needle steadily, but every half hour she got up and moved around, rubbing the back of her neck and stretching. As the soreness and stiffness in her neck gradually became noticeable, she still persisted, stitching on and off, determined to finish this flower.
location: By the living room window at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Playing with her daughter and preparing snacks.
description: At 15:00, she put down her embroidery frame, went to the living room carpet to play a bead-stringing game with her daughter Yuxin and teach her colors. Afterward, she went to the kitchen to heat four cups of milk, washed apples, cut them into pieces, and gave them to the three children as a snack. While the children were eating, she put the scattered throw pillows back in place and put the toys into the storage bin.
location: Living room and kitchen at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Preparing dinner for the whole family
description: At 4:30 p.m. she started preparing dinner. She sliced the pork belly and stir-fried it to render the fat, added napa cabbage and stir-fried, then put in the softened vermicelli and water to simmer. At the same time, she made a cold dressed spinach dish: after blanching, she mixed it with minced garlic, vinegar, and sesame oil. The kitchen was steaming hot and filled with the aroma of food.
location: Kitchen at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The whole family had dinner together.
description: Husband Ma Zhiqiang was resting at home today, and the whole family sat around the table at exactly 6 p.m. Ma Xiulan served steaming hot cabbage stew with vermicelli and cold dressed spinach. Her eldest son Mingxuan took the initiative to serve rice. The atmosphere at the table was harmonious; Ma Xiulan shared the good news with her husband that she had received some apron piecework today. The whole family chatted while eating.
location: Dining room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Cleaning up the kitchen and arranging the children's baths and homework
description: After the meal, she quickly cleaned up the dishes, wiped down the stove and range hood. Then she arranged for the three children to take turns showering in the bathroom. At the same time, she checked the weekend homework of Mingzhe, who is in elementary school, found errors in math, and patiently sat beside him to help him correct them.
location: Kitchen, bathroom, and living room at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The whole family watching TV and relaxing
description: After washing up, the family curled up on the living room sofa watching a lifestyle variety show. As she watched, Ma Xiulan sent a photo of the day’s finished lotus handkerchief to the “Happy Family” WeChat group on her phone and sent a voice message to her younger sister Fen’er to ask her opinion, receiving positive feedback. She also chatted with her husband about weekend plans while the children watched intently.
location: Living room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Remind the children to go to bed, keep accounts, and prepare for bedtime.
description: After the program ended, she turned off the TV and urged the children to brush their teeth, wash their faces, and go to bed. After the children went to sleep, she returned to the bedroom, took out the account book, recorded about 35 yuan spent today on groceries and pastries, and added picking up the bib fabric tomorrow to her to-do list. Then she took out clothes for herself and the children for tomorrow from the wardrobe, folded them, rubbed her neck, which was still aching, turned off the light, and rested.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Waking up early to prepare and have breakfast together.
description: Xiulan got up at around 7:15, washed up, and went to the kitchen to prepare breakfast. She cooked millet porridge, steamed some buns, and stir-fried a light dish of eggs with baby bok choy. Around 7:40, she woke her husband Ma Zhiqiang and the three children: the older son Mingxuan, the second son Mingzhe, and the youngest daughter Yuxin. Mingzhe was a little reluctant to get up, but Xiulan pulled him out of bed. The family sat around the dining table, sipping hot porridge and eating buns and stir-fried dishes while chatting. Mingzhe and Yuxin bickered over pickles, and Xiulan smoothed things over with a smile. The breakfast atmosphere was warm and pleasant.
location: Kitchen and dining room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Preparing album materials and organizing photos with the whole family
description: After breakfast, Xiulan let Zhiqiang take the children to play, while she took out a shoebox of old photos and a pack of colored paper from the wardrobe drawer in the bedroom, spread them on the coffee table in the living room, and prepared to make a family photo album. She found that there was only a little glue left at home and figured it definitely wouldn't be enough, so she decided to go out and buy a bottle. She put on her thick cotton-padded jacket, hurried to Shufen Convenience Store at the intersection of Jingwen Road and Shengli Avenue, bought a bottle of glue, and also picked up a pack of cartoon stickers with bear patterns, thinking they would be fun for Yuxin. She paid 7 yuan. After getting home, Xiulan put the glue and stickers on the coffee table. Ma Zhiqiang had already spilled all the photos out, covering half the table. Xiulan assigned everyone a job: Mingxuan was to pick out photos with dates, Mingzhe sorted them by place, and Yuxin kept the stickers for now. The whole family bustled about, and the room was full of laughter and talk.
location: Living room at home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and Shufen Convenience Store at the intersection of Shengli Street and Jingwen Road

name: Cut out the bib fabric.
description: Photo organizing was brought to a close for the time being. Xiulan let the family rest and began working on her tailoring. She took the fabric out of her bundle, spread it on the dining table, compared it with a cardboard pattern, carefully marked lines with tailor's chalk, and then picked up scissors and cut skillfully. In one go, she cut out the main and pocket pieces for 10 bibs, folded them neatly, and placed them beside the sewing machine, ready for formal sewing the next day.
location: At the dining table in the living room of her home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing lunch and taking a midday rest
description: Xiulan washed her hands and began preparing lunch. Using the leftover Chinese cabbage from yesterday, she cut some vermicelli and simmered a big pot of cabbage, tofu, and vermicelli. Ma Zhiqiang came over to help peel garlic. Once the simple, tasty lunch was on the table and eaten, Xiulan had Ma Zhiqiang wash the dishes while she leaned back on the sofa in the living room for about twenty minutes to refresh herself for the afternoon's activities.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The whole family made a family photo album and finished organizing it
description: After the lunch break, the “big project” of making the family photo album officially began. Xiulan laid out photos, colored paper, scissors, glue, and a ruler on the coffee table and assigned tasks like a commander-in-chief: the eldest son, Mingxuan, was in charge of cutting the photos and colored paper; the second son, Mingzhe, was in charge of pasting the photos onto the inner pages and had to make sure they were straight; the youngest daughter, Yuxin, drew little flowers and grass along the edges of each page with colored pens; and her husband, Ma Zhiqiang, picked up a pen to write the date and a note under each photo. Xiulan walked around supervising and giving directions, reminding Mingzhe not to paste the photos crooked and teaching Yuxin where to add a little red flower. The whole family worked and chatted, recalling fun stories about past trips and meals together, with constant laughter. After nearly three and a half hours, the album was finally finished. Zhiqiang wrote on the last page, “January 12, 2025, the whole family at home,” and Yuxin drew a big smiling face. Xiulan held the album and flipped through it, full of joy. Ma Zhiqiang suggested that the family take a photo together with the album as a memento, so Xiulan had Mingxuan use his phone to take a family picture. She then put away the remaining materials, wiped the coffee table clean, and solemnly placed the album, which embodied the whole family’s efforts, on the most prominent spot on the TV cabinet in the living room.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing dinner and having dinner together with the family.
description: Xiulan went into the kitchen and started getting dinner ready. She took a piece of pork belly from the fridge, sliced it thin, washed a bunch of garlic sprouts, stir-fried a fragrant twice-cooked pork, steamed rice, and made a tomato egg drop soup. When dinner was ready, the whole family sat down to eat. After the meal, they gathered in front of the TV cabinet and looked through the newly finished photo album again. Yuxin proudly pointed at the little flowers she had drawn, Mingzhe said the photos he had stuck in were the straightest, and Mingxuan boasted about his cutting and trimming skills. Xiulan and Ma Zhiqiang exchanged smiles, and the home was filled with a warm and contented atmosphere.
location: Kitchen, dining room, and living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening leisure: watching dramas and chatting.
description: The children each went off to do homework or play, and Xiulan finally had a moment to rest. She turned on the TV and switched to Tianjin TV, watching local news and a life drama while chatting casually with her husband Ma Zhiqiang sitting beside her. Zhiqiang reminded her to dress warmly when going out in the cold. Xiulan nodded in agreement, but in her mind she was already planning the work of sewing bibs tomorrow.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Urging the children to wash up and keeping household accounts
description: Xiulan began urging the children to wash up for bed, loudly reminding Mingzhe not to dawdle and telling Yuxin to put on face cream after washing her face. After all three children lay down, she took out her ledger, recorded the 7 yuan spent today on glue and stickers, and briefly went through the household expenses of the past few days, quietly calculating in her mind.
location: Various rooms of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Washed up and went to bed
description: Xiulan fetched hot water and soaked her feet well, washing away the day's fatigue. Then she and Ma Zhiqiang lay in bed and chatted about family matters, discussing arrangements for Ma Zhiqiang to take the truck out the next day and for Xiulan to start sewing bibs. After that, she turned off the light, listened to the howling north wind outside the window, thought about how the family had happily made the photo album together during the day, felt warm inside, and soon fell asleep peacefully.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Getting up early and preparing breakfast.
description: Ma Xiulan got up with neck pain, applied a hot towel to her neck, and moved her joints. Then she went to the kitchen to cook millet porridge, heat steamed buns, and stir-fry cabbage with vinegar. At 7:15 she woke the three children, and the family ate breakfast. Ma Xiulan told her eldest son Ma Mingxuan to ride carefully to school, while her second son Ma Mingzhe and youngest daughter Ma Yuxin ate quietly.
location: Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Taking the two children to school.
description: Ma Xiulan put on a thick coat and rode her electric bike, first taking her daughter Ma Yuxin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten and watching as the teacher received her. Then she carried her second son Ma Mingzhe on the bike, rode about eight minutes along Shengli Street, and arrived at Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School. She told him to listen carefully in class and pay attention to safety, and watched him walk through the school gate. The whole time, she tried to keep her neck as still as possible, because turning her head was excruciating every time.
location: Along Shengli Avenue in Jinghai District, Tianjin, China, from No. 156 Jingwen Road to Huakang First Kindergarten and Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School

name: Grocery shopping and neighborly small talk
description: After dropping off the child, Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to the Wutong Commune vegetable market. At Sun Guifang's stall, she bought Chinese cabbage, tomatoes, and tofu, and during that time mentioned her neck pain to Sun Guifang. Sun Guifang asked with concern, and she sighed that her old problem had flared up again. After buying the vegetables, she paid and left.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market (near Shengli Street), Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Return home to recuperate
description: Ma Xiulan returned home, first boiled water and used a hot water bag to apply heat to her neck. Then she leaned on the sofa, searched on her phone for ways to relieve neck soreness at home, and followed a video doing slow neck extensions and turns. Then she called Dr. Wang at Huxi Community Clinic and described her stiff neck and difficulty turning her head since morning. Dr. Wang advised applying heat, reducing looking down, and asked her to go to the clinic tomorrow for an X-ray. She agreed and thanked him.
location: Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Organizing photo albums and browsing embroidery
description: Ma Xiulan took out the family photo album completed yesterday, checked the crookedly pasted photos, and fixed them back in place. Then she returned to the bedroom, took out her earlier embroidery pieces, including an unfinished snowflake sample, and flipped through them page by page. Thinking that these fine crafts required keeping her head down for a long time, she felt upset, worrying that if her neck did not get better, the bib piecework and other handiwork would no longer be possible.
location: Living room and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Prepare lunch.
description: Ma Xiulan went into the kitchen to prepare lunch. To reduce looking down, she chose to make simple noodles: boiled dried noodles, cut tomatoes and cabbage leaves to cook together, and added beaten eggs before taking it off the heat. Throughout the whole process she deliberately kept her back straight and tried not to lower her head.
location: China, Tianjin Jinghai District, No. 156 Jingwen Road, home kitchen

name: Lunch and reporting to the handicraft group
description: Ma Xiulan ate the tomato and egg noodles alone. Then she sent a voice message in the handicraft WeChat group, telling Sister Xiuqin, Aunt Wu, and others that she couldn't look down because of neck pain, so she couldn't make the bibs today and would start again when it improved, feeling regretful.
location: Dining room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Noon break and catching up on sleep.
description: Ma Xiulan felt tired and decided to take a nap. She lay down on the bed, supporting her neck with a rolled towel, and dozed off. She ended up sleeping soundly for over an hour. When she woke up, her tense nerves had relaxed a bit and the neck pain was slightly relieved. She drank water, moved her shoulders, and got ready to go out to pick up her daughter.
location: Bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Pick up daughter from school
description: Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike along Shengli Street to Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up her daughter Ma Yuxin. She did not ride fast. When she saw her daughter, she helped her put on gloves and asked how kindergarten had been.
location: Huakang First Kindergarten, along Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Supermarket shopping
description: The mother and daughter rode their bikes to Jingbai Supermarket. Ma Xiulan held her daughter's hand while picking daily necessities such as tissues and laundry detergent. Because of neck pain, she had difficulty reaching items on high shelves and reading price tags, and could only try to stand as straight as possible. After checking out, she bought her daughter a lollipop as a reward.
location: Jingbai Supermarket, No. 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Parent-child time at home
description: Back home, Ma Xiulan let her daughter watch cartoons in the living room. She sat on the sofa beside her, watching her daughter while searching for cervical spine exercises on her phone, but she did not follow along, as her mind was still occupied by the discomfort and tomorrow's checkup.
location: Home living room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Pick up the second son and the eldest son from school
description: Ma Xiulan took her daughter and rode an electric bike to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up her second son, Ma Mingzhe. The three then rode along Diwei Road to the gate of Jinghai District No. 1 Middle School to wait for her eldest son, Ma Mingxuan. While waiting, she told Mingzhe not to cause trouble. When Ma Mingxuan came out, he asked his mother with concern whether her neck still hurt. She said they would talk about it at home, and the four of them rode home together.
location: Jinghai District, Tianjin, China: starting from 156 Jingwen Road, passing Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School on Shengli South Street, then to Jinghai District No. 1 Middle School at 19 Diwei Road, and returning home.

name: Prepare dinner
description: Ma Xiulan had her eldest son do his homework, while her daughter and second son played in the living room, and she went to the kitchen to prepare dinner for the family of five. To avoid looking down, she chose dishes that could be handled at a raised height: steamed rice, steamed egg tofu, and braised pork belly with potato chunks. She used a long-handled spatula to stir-fry, trying to keep her back straight.
location: China, Tianjin Jinghai District, No. 156 Jingwen Road, home kitchen

name: Dinner and family time.
description: Her husband, Ma Zhiqiang, came home after finishing a short-haul transport run, and the family sat around the table for dinner. Ma Xiulan told him her neck pain was severe and that she had called Dr. Wang; she needed to have an X-ray tomorrow. Ma Zhiqiang was concerned and said he would go with her. The children were sensible and did not make a fuss.
location: Dining room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: After dinner, pouring out feelings and receiving a massage from her husband.
description: After dinner, the children went to do homework. Ma Xiulan cleaned up the dishes, then leaned back on the sofa and poured out in detail to her husband her neck discomfort throughout the day and her worries about the apron piecework. Ma Zhiqiang moved a stool over and sat behind her, kneading her shoulders and neck, comforting her that health comes first, the work could wait, and she should get checked up tomorrow. Her husband's words made her feel at ease, but her worries had not fully dissipated.
location: Sofa in the living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Supervising children's studies and family leisure
description: Ma Xiulan forced herself to check her second son Ma Mingzhe's homework, correcting typos, and then watched her eldest son Ma Mingxuan review his lessons. Afterwards, the family leaned on the living room sofa watching Jinghai News and chatting about family matters. Because of neck discomfort, she couldn't lower her head, so she could only lean sideways against her husband.
location: Home living room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Urging everyone to wash up and get ready for bed
description: Ma Xiulan urged the children to wash up and change into pajamas, and put her daughter Ma Yuxin to bed. She and her husband washed up last, and Ma Zhiqiang helped her find the medical insurance card and medical record booklet for tomorrow's clinic visit.
location: Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Pre-bedtime tidying and going to sleep
description: Ma Xiulan applied the hot water bottle to her neck again and lay in bed. With her eyes closed, she thought about tomorrow's checkup, worrying about the results and the family expenses. Her husband turned off the light and gently comforted her. In the darkness, she slowly fell asleep with suppressed anxiety.
location: Bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Morning preparation and breakfast
description: Woken by the alarm at 5:30 a.m., she tried doing shoulder and neck stretches due to neck pain but with little effect. Then she went to the kitchen to prepare breakfast: millet porridge, heated fried pancakes, and boiled eggs, while also soaking and washing the children's clothes. At 6:40 she woke the three children, helped the youngest daughter Xinxin wash her face, urged the second son Zhezhe to stop playing on his phone, while the eldest son Xuanxuan got up on his own. The family ate breakfast together, she peeled an egg for Xinxin, and the children chatted and laughed.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Take the children to school.
description: Her eldest son Xuanxuan walked to school by himself with his backpack on. Then Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to take Zhezhe and Xinxin to school. She first dropped Zhezhe off at the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, then turned around and rode about 5 minutes to Huakang First Kindergarten, where she handed Xinxin to the teacher and reminded the teacher that Xinxin had a slight cough and should drink more water.
location: From No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street) to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten (Dongfanghong Road)

name: Going to the doctor, buying medicine, buying groceries, and returning home.
description: After dropping off the children, I rode the electric bike directly to Chaoyang Street Community Health Service Center to see Dr. Wang about my neck pain. He diagnosed it as neck muscle strain and gave me medium-frequency electrotherapy and cupping. Afterward, I called my childhood friend Liu Chunmei to let her know how the visit went, and she recommended buying a blood-activating and stasis-resolving medicated plaster. I left the clinic and went to Renxin Pharmacy on Dongfanghong Road, where I spent 25 yuan on the plaster. Then I rode to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market and bought bok choy, tofu, and pork ribs from Aunt Sun, a familiar vendor. Back home, I washed my neck with warm water, applied the Chinese medicine patch prescribed by the clinic and the plaster I bought, and felt better. Then I tidied up the living room and put away the children's toys.
location: Chaoyang Street Community Health Service Center at No. 16 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; then Renxin Pharmacy on Dongfanghong Road; then Wutong Commune Vegetable Market; finally returned to the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road.

name: Resting at home and handling phone messages.
description: Because of neck discomfort, she did not do embroidery and rested curled up on the living room sofa. She used her phone to chat in a handicraft WeChat group, watched short videos to learn neck-and-shoulder pain relief exercises, and meanwhile planned her trip to her parents' home next weekend.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Lunch and lunch break
description: Her husband called to say he would not go home at noon because he was at the freight yard. Ma Xiulan cooked herself tomato and egg noodles, reheated the leftover baked flatbread from last night, and listened to news on her phone while eating, paying attention to the new medical insurance policy. After the meal, she washed her face, adjusted the ointment on her neck, and took a short nap on the sofa for about half an hour.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Haircut and chores at home.
description: After the lunch break, feeling that my hair was oily, I walked to A Qiang Hair Salon on Jingwen Road, had my hair cut shorter and thinned, and the wash and trim took about an hour. At the stationery store next door, I bought replacement pen refills for the three children. After getting home, I drank water, checked the e-bike battery to prepare for picking up the kids, and used a bookkeeping app to record the morning medical expenses (registration and physiotherapy fee self-paid about 40 yuan, plus 25 yuan for plasters), with the note “Dr. Wang for neck pain + childhood friend recommended plasters.” I also plan to go to the clinic again tomorrow for physiotherapy.
location: Aqiang Styling Barbershop on Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; the stationery store next door; then return home to 156 Jingwen Road.

name: Pick the children up from school.
description: On time, she rode her electric bike to Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up Xinxin. The teacher praised Xinxin for napping well. Xinxin gave her mother a handmade little red flower and wished her neck a speedy recovery. Afterwards, she took Xinxin and stopped by Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up Zhezhe. Zhezhe complained that his deskmate had touched his pencil case, and Ma Xiulan comforted him, telling him to be accommodating.
location: Huakang First Kindergarten on Dongfanghong Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, then to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School on Shengli South Street

name: Supervising homework and preparing dinner.
description: After getting home, she arranged for Zhezhe to do homework in the living room while Xinxin drew pictures beside him. She put on an apron and prepared dinner: braised pork ribs and stir-fried tofu with baby bok choy. The aroma of meat floated out of the kitchen, and Zhezhe smelled it and shouted that it smelled great.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Dinner and family time.
description: The eldest son Xuanxuan came home from school, and the family sat around having dinner. The dishes included braised pork ribs, stir-fried baby bok choy with tofu, and seaweed egg drop soup. Ma Xiulan put food on the children's plates and asked Xuanxuan about school. The atmosphere at the dinner table was lively.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Housework and checking homework
description: Cleaned up the dishes and chopsticks, wiped the table, washed the dishes, and mopped the kitchen floor. Then she checked Zhezhe's Chinese and math homework, circled the mistakes, and had him correct them. Then she went to Xuanxuan's room to urge him to memorize English vocabulary, telling him not to read leisure books and to go to bed early. Xinxin was playing with building blocks by herself in the living room.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Soothe Xinxin and rest
description: Ran bath water for Xinxin, bathed her, changed her into pajamas, and told her a bedtime story. After she fell asleep, she left quietly. Back in the living room, she watched local news on Tianjin TV for a while. Feeling that her neck was still a bit stiff, she moved around slowly in the living room for a while.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening bookkeeping, washing up, and preparing for bed.
description: After the children were quiet, she leaned against the headboard and recorded the day's expenses in detail in the bookkeeping app, noting the medical expenses and her decision that she “definitely must go to the clinic again tomorrow.” Then she went to the bathroom to wash up, applied Dabao, and put on a new medicated patch. She sent a WeChat message to her husband, who was out on the road driving, to let him know she was safe and told him to stop work early.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Rest and Sleep
description: She turned off the light and lay down, feeling that her neck was much better than in the morning. Listening to the sound of her son turning off the desk lamp in the next room, she mulled over going to the clinic again tomorrow and her plan to bring pork ribs to her parents' home on the weekend, and gradually fell asleep.
location: Master bedroom of the home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning stretching, preparing breakfast, and waking the kids.
description: Ma Xiulan got up after the alarm went off, did simple shoulder and neck stretches by the bed, then washed up and rinsed her neck with hot water to relieve soreness. After that, she went to the kitchen to prepare breakfast, cooking millet porridge and scallion scrambled eggs while waking the three children, helping her daughter braid her hair, and urging her second son to brush his teeth.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family breakfast
description: The family of four sat around the table eating breakfast. Ma Xiulan put food into her daughter's bowl and told her sons to eat slowly, while mentally planning the day's schedule.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Taking the second son and daughter to school
description: Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to first take her second son Ma Mingzhe to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, then take her daughter Ma Yuxin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten. She left only after confirming both children had entered the campus. Her eldest son Ma Mingxuan walked to middle school by himself.
location: At the entrance of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin; at the entrance of Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Buying groceries at the vegetable market.
description: After dropping off the children, Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to the Wutong Commune vegetable market. At Aunt Sun's stall she bought green vegetables, cucumbers, and bones, and also bought soft tofu to prepare for dinner.
location: Wutong Commune Food Market at the intersection of Diwei Road and Xuhua Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Going home to do household chores.
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan put the vegetables into the refrigerator by category, soaked the bones in water to remove the blood, started the washing machine to wash clothes, and then mopped the floor and cleaned the living room.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Go to the community health service center to see a doctor.
description: Ma Xiulan walked to the Chaoyang Street Community Health Service Center in Jinghai District, registered to see Dr. Wang Jianguo, described in detail symptoms including a heavy, sore neck and difficulty turning over, and told him she had applied medicated patches on her own. Dr. Wang performed a palpation, diagnosed shoulder and neck muscle strain, prescribed a blood-activating and stasis-removing medicated patch, and taught her a set of shoulder and neck stretching exercises. Ma Xiulan recorded the session with her phone.
location: Chaoyang Street Community Health Service Center, Jinghai District, in the backyard of the Jinghai Grain Bureau, No. 16 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Picking up medicine, applying medicated patches at home, and stretching
description: Paid more than 30 yuan to get the medicine at the pharmacy, walked home, immediately applied a new medicated patch to the sore spot on her neck, and conscientiously did shoulder and neck stretching exercises following a video on her phone, feeling much more relaxed.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Simple lunch and catching up with a childhood friend
description: Ma Xiulan made a simple noodle soup with greens and tofu for herself as lunch. After the meal, she sent a WeChat voice message to her childhood friend Liu Chunmei to update her on the medical visit and reassure her, and received a reply urging her to keep stretching.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Lunch break
description: After cleaning up the dishes, Ma Xiulan lay half-reclined on the living room sofa with her eyes closed to rest. The warmth of the medicated patch made her feel relaxed and relieved the fatigue of the morning.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Choosing reward stationery
description: Ma Xiulan walked to the Chenguang Stationery Store on Jingwen Road. To reward her eldest son for his progress at the end of term, she carefully picked out a set of blue stationery (a pencil case, gel pens, a notebook, and drawing tools), spending 28 yuan; she also bought two cartoon stickers for her daughter.
location: M&G Stationery Store, No. 92 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing for dinner
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan blanched the pork bones to remove the smell, washed and cut the greens and ginger slices, and started preparing the pork bone soup for dinner.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the two children from school.
description: Ma Xiulan first rode her electric bike to Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up her daughter Ma Yuxin, listening to her share about her painting, then went to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up her second son Ma Mingzhe, and then took the two children home.
location: At the gate of Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin; at the gate of Jinghai District Third Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Supervising study and preparing dinner.
description: After getting home, Ma Xiulan had her second son do homework in the living room while her daughter drew pictures nearby. She herself continued simmering the pork bone soup in the kitchen, skimming off the foam, steaming egg custard, stir-frying garlic greens, and from time to time urging the children to study.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Dinner and praise
description: The family of four had dinner; the husband had not returned. At the table, Ma Xiulan gave the eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, new stationery as a reward for his progress at the end of term, while comforting the second son, Ma Mingzhe, for his disappointment and promising him a reward if he improves next time.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Housework and helping with homework
description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan cleared the dishes and wiped the table, then helped her eldest and second sons with their homework in the living room, and checked her daughter's kindergarten workbook, praising her drawing.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Give daughter a bath and put her to sleep
description: Ma Xiulan bathed her daughter Ma Yuxin, changed her into pajamas, told her a bedtime story, kissed her, and watched her fall asleep.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Soothing her second son with a bedtime story.
description: Ma Xiulan went to her second son Ma Mingzhe's room and told him the story of 'Clumsy Bird Learning to Fly Hard,' encouraging him to work hard and improve. Her son said he would strive like the clumsy bird, and then she soothed him to sleep.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Washing up and stretching before bed
description: After washing up, Ma Xiulan stood by the bed in the bedroom and carefully did the stretching moves taught by Dr. Wang, feeling her shoulders and neck stretched and relaxed.
location: Master bedroom of the home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Personal time and rest
description: Leaning against the headboard, Ma Xiulan sent her husband a message in the family WeChat group to let him know she was safe, scrolled through the news on her phone, turned off the light at 22:30, and went to sleep, feeling grounded and content as she reflected on the day.
location: Master bedroom of the home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning wake-up and stretching
description: My phone alarm went off, and I sat up slowly. The spot on my shoulder and neck where the medicated patch was still felt a bit sore and swollen, but better than yesterday. I went to the bathroom to wash up, then laid out the old yoga mat in the living room, opened my phone, and followed the shoulder-and-neck stretching video recommended by Dr. Wang to do side neck stretches, shoulder circles, arm raises, and other exercises for about 5 minutes. After stretching, the stiffness eased and my body felt refreshed.
location: At home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin: bedroom, living room.

name: Prepare breakfast and wake up the children.
description: After washing up, I put on an apron and went into the kitchen. I steamed the handmade mantou bought yesterday, washed the millet to cook porridge, and added a spoonful of homemade osmanthus sauce to each child's bowl of porridge to enhance the aroma. Then I went upstairs and woke Xuanxuan, Zhezhe, and Xinxin one by one, urging them gently to get up, telling them that today was the first day of winter vacation; although there was no school, they should not stay in bed, and mentioning that breakfast had their favorite osmanthus porridge.
location: Kitchen and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Family breakfast and checking grades.
description: After the children were seated, I brought the steaming millet porridge, steamed buns, and the meat sauce I had fried last night to the table. During the meal, I opened the parent group chat on my phone and checked the final report card posted by Homeroom Teacher Han. I found Xuanxuan's scores: math 89, Chinese 86, English 92, a clear improvement over the midterm math score of 78. Chinese reading was still a weak point. I specifically praised Xuanxuan for his progress in math and teased his younger brother ZheZhe. ZheZhe said grudgingly that he would do better next time.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Communicate with the homeroom teacher and make a winter vacation plan
description: After breakfast, I quickly cleared the dishes, wiped the dining table, and then contacted homeroom teacher Han Mei via WeChat voice message. I sincerely thanked her for Xuanxuan's improvement in math and asked how to improve his weak Chinese reading comprehension, as well as about his class performance and how he got along with classmates. Teacher Han suggested reading for half an hour every day and writing simple notes, and recommended "Dawn Blossoms Plucked at Dusk" and "Rickshaw Boy". After the 15-minute call, I immediately recorded the key points in my notebook and made a supervision plan for the winter vacation: check reading progress every evening, write a short weekly journal, and limit daily phone use to one hour.
location: Dining room and living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Handling household chores and looking after the children.
description: After finishing the children's study plan, I started tidying the living room, putting the snacks and toys on the coffee table into storage bins and carefully wiping the tabletop with a cloth. During that time, ZheZhe and Xinxin argued over the TV remote control. I calmed them down promptly, set a rule that each could watch for 20 minutes, and washed and cut apples for the children as a snack.
location: Living room and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare lunch, do small handcraft tasks, and have lunch together as a family.
description: Around noon, I started preparing lunch. First I blanched the pork ribs, and while they were blanching, I took out the peony embroidery piece that Sister Zheng from the community had introduced to me. I sat by the window and embroidered a dozen or so stitches, planning to continue it in the afternoon to earn some pocket money. Then I heated oil in the wok and made braised pork ribs, adding seasonings and scallions from my balcony, while steaming rice and cooking a baby bok choy and tofu soup. At 12 o'clock the dishes were on the table. I called the three children to wash their hands and eat, and specially gave Xuanxuan extra ribs, encouraging him to study hard.
location: At home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin: kitchen, living room corner, dining room.

name: Noon break
description: After the meal, I put the dishes and chopsticks away in the kitchen. Feeling a bit tired, I spread a blanket on the living room sofa, set a 45-minute alarm, and leaned against it to rest, closing my eyes to relax. My mind briefly thought about Xuanxuan's studies and the afternoon arrangements, but then I forced myself not to think anymore and took a peaceful nap.
location: Sofa in the living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Afternoon leisure and online socializing.
description: After the alarm went off, I didn't get up right away. I picked up my phone and scrolled through Moments, saw a plant photo shared by my childhood friend Liu Chunmei, liked it, and chatted with her by voice, agreeing to catch up in the evening. At that moment Xuanxuan came to ask if he could go to the bookstore with his classmate Li Haoran. I reminded him to be safe, gave him 20 yuan as pocket money, and asked him to be home before 3:30 pm.
location: Sofa in the living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Vegetable market shopping and keeping accounts.
description: After Xuanxuan left, I put on my down jacket, took a reusable bag, and walked to the Wutong Commune Vegetable Market. At Aunt Sun's stall, I bought fresh scallions, spinach, and tofu, and Aunt Sun also gave me some cilantro. I also bought half a jin of red dates to use in porridge. On the way home, I used the expense-tracking app on my phone to record the day's expenses in detail (spinach 4 yuan, tofu 2.5 yuan, scallions 1 yuan, red dates 8 yuan), and started planning the New Year shopping.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Leisure and organizing accounts
description: After putting away the groceries, I turned on the TV and switched to the arts channel. While listening to Ma Sanli's crosstalk, I searched on my phone for English animated movies for the kids during winter break, and I couldn't help laughing now and then. When the TV program ended, I sat down at the dining table, took out my ledger and the mobile app, and checked yesterday's stationery, ointment, and today's grocery expenses to make sure the accounts were clear. I sighed inwardly that running a household is not easy—every penny has to be budgeted carefully.
location: Living room and dining table at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Discuss winter vacation plans with Xuanxuan.
description: Xuanxuan came back from the bookstore with Dawn Blossoms Plucked at Dusk and two comic books. I sat him down and calmly passed on Teacher Han's praise, affirming his progress in math and his courage in raising his hand to speak in class, while pointing out that his Chinese reading needed strengthening. I suggested reading together for half an hour every day during the holiday and doing more writing practice. I took out the check-in chart I had made that morning; Xuanxuan looked at it and nodded in agreement. Mother and son agreed that from tomorrow on, this time every day would be reading time.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing dinner and having dinner with the family
description: After the conversation ended, I saw Zhezhe and Xinxin chasing each other and immediately stopped them. I arranged for Zhezhe to practice handwriting and Xinxin to color. Then I went into the kitchen to prepare dinner, reheated the leftover braised pork ribs from noon, and made garlic spinach and seaweed egg drop soup with the spinach I had just bought. When the food was served, the whole family sat around the table. I asked Xuanxuan about his interesting trip to the bookstore, and Xuanxuan shared his experience at the Xinhua Bookstore on Shengli Street. The atmosphere was relaxed. My stomach felt comfortable during the meal.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening housework, homework tutoring, and parent-child crafts
description: After the meal, I had Xuanxuan wash the dishes, and I wiped the kitchen countertops and took care of the trash. Then I sat down next to Zhezhe and helped him complete his winter vacation math homework, explaining line-segment allocation word problems through drawings. Next, I called the three children to sit down, took out the leftover colored thread and cardboard, and taught them to fold paper cranes and color them. I patiently helped Xinxin finish her origami, and the living room was filled with laughter.
location: Kitchen and living room of the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Bathing the children, putting them to sleep, and evening stretching.
description: After the handicraft session, I first helped Xinxin take a bath, carefully adjusting the water temperature, washing her hair, and scrubbing her back. After the bath, I wrapped her in a bath towel and had Xuanxuan help her get dressed. Then I quickly gave Zhezhe a shower. After that, I carried Xinxin to her small bed and read her The Little Prince to help her fall asleep. After leaving the room, I laid out the yoga mat in the living room and did a 5-minute evening stretch. The soreness in my shoulders and neck was clearly relieved, and my whole body relaxed.
location: Home bathroom, Xinxin's bedroom, and living room at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening contact, washing up, and rest.
description: Back in the bedroom, I changed into pajamas. First I sent a WeChat message to my husband Ma Zhiqiang, telling him about Xuanxuan's grades and the teacher's praise, and reminding him to drive safely. Then I had a voice call with Liu Chunmei for nearly half an hour, chatting about the children's winter vacation, dishes, and down jacket styles. After the call, I browsed some educational articles, then got up to brush my teeth, wash my face, and apply face cream. Before turning off the light, I charged my phone, drew the curtains, and laid out tomorrow's sweater. Lying down, I thought about today's warm conversation with Xuanxuan and the freshness of my morning stretching, felt a sense of peace and confidence about the future, and fell asleep soundly at 22:30.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Morning washing up and shoulder and neck stretches.
description: The phone alarm went off. Xiulan got up, walked into the living room, opened a shoulder and neck stretching video on her phone, and followed along for 5 minutes. She felt the tightness in her neck and back loosen considerably. Then she washed up in front of the mirror, splashed her face with cold water, and thought about finding time today to defrost the refrigerator.
location: Bedroom and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare and enjoy breakfast for the whole family.
description: Xiulan put on an apron, kneaded the dough she had prepared the night before, rolled it into flatbread rounds, and cooked five scallion-oil home-style flatbreads in a frying pan. On the other burner, a pot of golden millet porridge was simmering. She also sliced a plate of her own pickled crispy radish strips and shredded mustard greens, and stir-fried some shredded potatoes. Around 7:50, the family of five sat around the table. The children ate happily, and her husband, Ma Zhiqiang, said while eating that he would run a short trip in the afternoon and try to be home before seven.
location: Kitchen and dining room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Cleaning the kitchen and dining room
description: After her husband left for work, Xiulan started cleaning up. She soaked the dishes in the sink and scrubbed them, wiped down the dining table, stove top, and range hood surface with a cloth, wrung out the mop and mopped the dining room floor, and the kitchen was restored to neatness.
location: Kitchen and dining room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Supervise the children's studies and care for them.
description: Xiulan first went to Mingzhe's room and gently but firmly urged him to finish two pages of math problems before playing. Then she checked on Mingxuan, who was reading 100 Stories of Scientists as planned, and Xiulan nodded with satisfaction. Her youngest daughter Yuxin ran over holding a comb, and Xiulan smiled and braided her hair into two pigtails, pinning on a strawberry hair clip.
location: Various rooms of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin
