name: Preparing ingredients and tending the backyard vegetable garden
description: Xiulan trimmed and washed the greens she planned to stir-fry at noon, and took the leftover braised pork ribs from last night out of the fridge to thaw. Seeing that it was cold but windless, she went to the small vegetable garden in the backyard, cleared away the frost-damaged Chinese cabbage stalks, and covered the radishes in the field with an old quilt to protect them from freezing.
location: Kitchen and backyard, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Lunch and midday rest
description: At noon she made a simple meal of tomato scrambled eggs and lettuce in oyster sauce, reheated yesterday's pork ribs, and used the leftover flatbread and porridge from the morning to put together a meal for the children. After the meal, Xiulan let Xuanxuan watch TV with his younger brother and sister for a while, then went to the bedroom, lay down for about ten minutes, and rested with her eyes closed.
location: Dining room and living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Embroidering shoe insoles in the afternoon
description: Xiulan couldn't fall asleep, so she got up and took out the embroidered shoe insoles she had taken on as piecework. She put on her thimble, sat on the sofa in the winter sunlight, and stitched thread by thread. The outline of twin lotus flowers on the same stem had already taken shape on the insole. In her mind she planned to deliver the work by the end of the month.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Phone call with childhood friend Liu Chunmei
description: Childhood friend Liu Chunmei called. The two started talking about embroidery patterns. Chunmei shared the “Big-Leaf Peony” stitching technique she had newly learned, and Xiulan carefully asked about the starting-stitch skills. Then they talked about a newly opened traditional pastry shop on East Street in town, and agreed to go try it together when they had time. After half an hour, Xiulan glanced at the wall clock and got ready to go out to buy groceries.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: After reminding the children, went out shopping
description: After hanging up the phone, Xiulan looked out the window. Though it was cloudy, it wasn't raining. She called Mingxuan over and told him to keep an eye on his younger brother and sister, and if his sister woke up, let her drink some water. She would be back from the vegetable market in a little over half an hour. Then Xiulan grabbed her eco-friendly cloth bag, keys, and wallet and went out.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Shopping for ingredients at Wutong Commune Food Market
description: Xiulan put on a thick cotton-padded jacket, wrapped a scarf around her neck, and walked west along Jingwen Road for about 10 minutes to the Wutong Commune vegetable market. She went straight to Sun Guifang's stall, picked a few fresh white radishes, and also bought iron-stick yams, old ginger, and garlic. While shopping, Xiulan mentioned that she wanted to pickle radishes in soy sauce. Aunt Sun warmly taught her to wash them, cut them into strips, and sprinkle with salt to draw out the water. Xiulan noted it carefully.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market (Xingwang Vegetable Market) on Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Bought seasonings at the grocery store
description: Coming out of the vegetable market, Xiulan turned into the "Lao Zhou Local Products" grocery store next door, bought a bag of local soy sauce and a bottle of aged vinegar, and asked the shopkeeper to weigh out two yuan worth of Sichuan peppercorns to replenish household supplies.
location: Old Zhou's Local Products and Grocery Store, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Returned home and sorted out the purchased items.
description: When she got home, Xinxin was already awake and playing with building blocks with Xuanxuan. Xiulan sorted the vegetables and seasonings: radishes were spread in the basket to dry, yams and ginger and garlic went into the fridge, and seasonings were put back in place. Then she washed her hands and poured a glass of warm water to drink.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Help Mingzhe with his math homework.
description: Xiulan checked Mingzhe's homework and found he was stuck on the diagram part of a math word problem. She first had Mingxuan try to explain it twice, but when Mingzhe still shook his head, she drew line-segment diagrams and little figures on scratch paper, analyzing step by step what 'several times more' and 'a few fewer' meant. After about half an hour of explanation, Mingzhe finally understood and completed the problem on his own.
location: Study at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing dinner and answering her husband's phone call
description: Xiulan put on an apron to prepare dinner, planning to make cabbage and pork stew with vermicelli and a vegetable dish. While she was slicing the pork belly, her husband Ma Zhiqiang called, saying the unloading was taking longer than expected and he probably wouldn't be home until after 8 o'clock, so they shouldn't wait for him. Xiulan told him to drive slowly and be careful, and let him know that she had already arranged with Aunt Sun to buy radishes and would start pickling them the day after tomorrow. After hanging up, Xiulan continued cooking.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Have dinner with the children.
description: Xiulan had dinner with her three children. The hot cabbage and vermicelli stew was very popular. Her youngest daughter Xinxin picked a slice of meat from her own bowl and put it into Xiulan's bowl, saying in a babyish voice, "Mommy, you eat too." Xiulan felt a warmth in her heart and smiled, rubbing Xinxin's little head.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: After-meal household chores and parent-child time
description: After dinner, Xiulan asked Mingxuan to help clear the bowls, while she took Mingzhe and Xinxin to put the scattered toys in the living room into a storage bin. As she tidied up, she told the children about the plan to start making soy-pickled radish the day after tomorrow, saying Mingzhe and Xinxin could help wash the radishes and peel garlic. The two little ones happily agreed. After cleaning up the kitchen, she arranged for the three children to wash up in turns.
location: Living room and kitchen at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Helping the children wash up and get ready for bed
description: Xiulan first gave Xinxin a bath, changed her into thick pajamas, and read Guess How Much I Love You for 15 minutes until the child fell asleep. Then she went to Mingzhe, who had already washed up and was lying in bed. Xiulan tucked in the quilt for him and said good night. Finally, she went to Mingxuan's room. Mingxuan had already bathed and was reading an extracurricular book. Xiulan reminded Mingxuan not to stay up too late and to turn off the lights before 9:30.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Personal leisure and Spring Festival planning
description: Once the children settled down, Xiulan was finally able to sit and rest for a while. She turned on Tianjin TV to watch a family drama, and at the same time took out her blue-covered notebook and wrote down her plans before the Spring Festival: on the 24th of the twelfth lunar month, do a big cleaning—wipe the windows in the morning and wash the curtains in the afternoon; on the 25th of the twelfth lunar month, start pickling radishes and steaming buns; and next weekend go to the big market to buy Spring Festival couplets, window paper-cuts, and new clothes for the children. She also noted that she should ask the children what colors and styles they like.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Washing up before bed and stretching the shoulders and neck.
description: After turning off the TV and tidying up the coffee table, Xiulan went to the bathroom to wash her face carefully and apply winter face cream. Before bed, she did a 5-minute evening shoulder and neck stretch on the bedroom floor to ease the fatigue all over her body.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: Xiulan changed into her pajamas, put the thick sweater she would wear tomorrow at the head of the bed, and checked the alarm setting on her phone. She sent a WeChat message to her husband Ma Zhiqiang, reminding him to eat dinner and go to bed early. Then she turned off the light and lay down, listening to the occasional sound of cars passing outside the window, and quickly fell into a deep sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Waking up and morning stretching
description: At 7:10 in the early morning, Ma Xiulan woke up naturally and felt her shoulders were relaxed. Beside the bed in the bedroom, she did shoulder and neck exercises and neck rotations according to the movements Dr. Wang had taught her, stretching for about 5 minutes. After a week of persistence, the effect was obvious.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, master bedroom

name: Preparing the family breakfast
description: After stretching, Ma Xiulan went into the kitchen, tied on an apron, and made egg fried rice with last night's leftover rice, adding diced ham sausage and cucumber. She also boiled frozen black sesame glutinous rice balls as dessert. She quickly boiled water, beat eggs, and chopped vegetables, and the kitchen soon filled with aroma.
location: Kitchen, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Waking the children and having breakfast as a family
description: When breakfast was almost ready, Ma Xiulan woke the three children, 'Dabao, Zhezhe, Xinxin.' After lingering in bed for five minutes, they washed up and sat at the table. She served each of them egg fried rice and tangyuan, reminded them to be careful of the heat, and the family ate breakfast together in a lively atmosphere.
location: Dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tidy up the kitchen and do basic housework
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan let the children play by themselves. She cleared the dishes, washed and put away the bowls and plates, and wiped down the stove and table. Then she sorted the dirty clothes and put them in the washing machine, and used the time while the laundry was running to sweep and mop the living room and dining room floors.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Accompanied the youngest daughter in drawing and tidied the backyard.
description: Ma Xiulan took out crayons and plain paper from the cabinet, put them on the coffee table, and asked Yuxin to draw a picture for her. She sat in the living room near the back door, watching her daughter draw while browsing pickled radish recipes on her phone. During this time, she also went to the backyard to water the scallions and spinach in the vegetable plot.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, living room and backyard

name: Received the drawing, put it on the fridge, and shared it.
description: Yuxin finished drawing. The picture showed her mother in an apron stir-frying vegetables; though crooked, the colors were bright. Ma Xiulan happily praised her daughter, kissed her, taped the drawing to the center of the refrigerator door, took a photo and sent it to the family WeChat group 'One Family' with a voice message: "Come quick, look at what my daughter drew for me. Isn't she just so talented?"
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, living room and kitchen.

name: Preparing lunch ingredients
description: In high spirits, Ma Xiulan took out the pork ribs and Chinese yam she had bought yesterday from the refrigerator, and pulled some scallions from the backyard. She soaked the ribs in water to thaw, washed and peeled the yam, and prepared ginger slices, Sichuan peppercorns, and other soup ingredients.
location: Kitchen, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Cooking and eating lunch
description: Ma Xiulan blanched the pork ribs, then put them in a clay pot with plenty of water, ginger slices, and Sichuan peppercorns. She brought it to a boil over high heat, then turned it to low heat and simmered slowly. She also washed a Napa cabbage to prepare vinegar-sautéed cabbage. At noon, the milky white pork rib soup was ready, the stir-fried cabbage was bright green, and the family sat around the table. She filled each child's bowl with rib soup and told them to eat plenty of meat.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, kitchen and dining room

name: Noon break and leisure
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan let the children play freely. She covered herself with a thin blanket, leaned against the sofa to watch a rerun of “Avenue of Stars,” and fell asleep listening for about 40 minutes.
location: Living room, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare afternoon tea and personal time
description: After waking up, Ma Xiulan felt much more energetic. Thinking that Wang Guilan might come by for a visit, she took out jujube paste cakes and dragon beard candy from the cabinet, arranged them on a plate, boiled water, and brewed a pot of jasmine tea. Then she sat by the window in the living room, basking in the sun while embroidering the shoe insoles she had left unfinished yesterday.
location: Living room, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Neighbor Wang Guilan drops by for a visit
description: A little after two in the afternoon, Wang Guilan came by carrying a bag of home-dried sweet potato strips. Ma Xiulan received her warmly, and they chatted on the sofa. Ma Xiulan deliberately showed Guilan the drawing by Yuxin on the refrigerator, and it drew repeated praise. As they ate snacks, they talked about their plan to pickle radishes the day after tomorrow, intending to use Sister Sun's method from the vegetable market.
location: Living room, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Helping children with homework and crafts
description: After Wang Guilan left, Ma Xiulan urged her eldest son Xuanxuan to do the daily half-hour reading suggested by Teacher Han, while checking her second son Zhezhe's winter vacation homework. When she found mistakes in the math problems, she patiently explained them and had him recalculate. After the children finished, she continued embroidering shoe insoles.
location: Living room, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Went out to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market to buy groceries
description: At 4:30, Ma Xiulan found there was no ginger. After telling the children, she walked 5 minutes to the Wutong Gongshe vegetable market. At Sun Guifang's stall, which she usually went to, she bought ginger and also picked up a bunch of cilantro and two cucumbers to make a cold dish, spending less than ten yuan. After buying, she immediately returned home; the round trip and shopping together took half an hour.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, southeast corner of the intersection of Jingwen Road and Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Children's quarrel and mediation during dinner preparation
description: Ma Xiulan was just getting ready to stir-fry in the kitchen when she heard her second son Zhezhe running in crying, holding a spinning top that the neighbor kid Xiaopang had broken. She crouched down, wiped his tears with her apron, and asked what had happened. Then she took Zhezhe by the hand and knocked on the neighbor's door. The other parent quickly apologized and compensated with a new spinning top. Ma Xiulan taught Zhezhe to take good care of toys and get along with friends, and the two children made up.
location: No. 156 to No. 158 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin: at the front door of the house and the neighbor's house.

name: Dinner
description: After settling the children's dispute, Ma Xiulan returned to the kitchen, made smashed cucumber with garlic sauce using the cucumbers she had just bought, stir-fried tomatoes and eggs, and reheated the spare rib soup from lunch. The family sat down together again for dinner. Ma Xiulan chatted about the day's happy events while eating, and the atmosphere was warm.
location: Dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Clean up the kitchen and get the children to wash up
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan cleared the table, washed the dishes and scrubbed the pots, and wiped down the stove. Then she urged the three children to take turns bathing and prepared a change of clothes and pajamas for each of them.
location: Tianjin, Jinghai District, No. 156 Jingwen Road, kitchen and bathroom.

name: Evening leisure and phone socializing
description: After the children finished tidying up and were playing in the room, Ma Xiulan finally sat down to rest. She opened her phone and saw everyone in the 'One Family' group praising Yuxin's painting, and felt delighted. Then she sent a voice message to her childhood friend Liu Chunmei, explaining in detail the plan to pickle radishes tomorrow and asking if she would like a jar. The two agreed to exchange and taste each other's pickles once they were ready.
location: Living room, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Putting the youngest daughter to sleep and having a family evening chat.
description: Around nine o'clock, Yuxin got sleepy, so Ma Xiulan took her to the bedroom and told her two bedtime stories until she fell asleep. She tucked her in and tiptoed out. Then she went to the living room and sent a WeChat message to her husband Ma Zhiqiang, who had not yet returned home, telling him about their daughter's painting and where it was posted, so he could take a look when he got back.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, daughter's bedroom and living room.

name: Evening stretching and washing up
description: After settling everything, Ma Xiulan did a 5-minute evening shoulder and neck stretch on the living room floor and felt relaxed all over. Then she went to the bathroom to wash up and changed into her pajamas.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Wrap up before bed and review the day
description: Back in the bedroom, Ma Xiulan lay in bed and looked again at the photo on her phone of the drawing on the refrigerator, her heart full of happiness. After charging her phone and turning off the light, she reviewed the fulfilling day full of little joys in her mind and fell into a deep sleep with a smile.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, master bedroom

name: Morning self-care and breakfast preparation
description: Ma Xiulan did morning shoulder and neck stretches on the bed in the bedroom, then went to the bathroom to wash up, do a simple skincare routine, and tie her hair up. She then went to the kitchen to prepare breakfast: steamed pork buns, cooked millet porridge, sliced pickled radish, and boiled eggs. The kitchen was filled with the aroma of breakfast.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Wake the children and have breakfast together
description: Ma Xiulan woke the three children one by one, helped her youngest daughter put on socks, helped the children tidy up their personal belongings, and put the laundry into the washing machine. She checked the household register, ID cards, water bottles, snacks, and other items for going out. Then the family of four ate breakfast in the dining room, discussing plans to go to the library while eating. Ma Xiulan told the children to stay quiet and filled her youngest daughter's thermos with warm water.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Walk to the library
description: Ma Xiulan set out from home with her three children. They walked along the sidewalk on Jingwen Road to the intersection with Shengli Avenue, then turned left toward the Jinghai District Library in Tianjin. She walked in front holding Yuxin's hand, while the two boys followed behind, playfully wrestling. Ma Xiulan kept reminding them to be careful.
location: Along the route from No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin to No. 8 Shengli Street

name: Borrowing and reading at the library
description: At the Jinghai District Library in Tianjin, Ma Xiulan went to the service desk to apply for library cards for the three children and filled out forms. Then she took the children to the children's area to pick books: she helped Yuxin choose the picture book The Very Hungry Caterpillar, Mingzhe chose the comic Dinosaur Adventure, Mingxuan chose the popular science book Fun Science Experiments, and Ma Xiulan herself also took Family Life Encyclopedia. The family sat and read by the window. After reading, they completed the borrowing procedures and took the three books home. Then they walked back to their home at 156 Jingwen Road, with the children excitedly sharing what was in the books on the way.
location: No. 8 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (Tianjin Jinghai District Library)

name: Prepare and enjoy lunch
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan had the children wash their hands and drink water, then went into the kitchen to prepare a simple lunch: tomato and egg noodles and a plate of stir-fried greens with minced garlic. Half an hour later, the noodles were served, and the whole family enjoyed the hot lunch together.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Cleaning up after meals and hanging clothes to dry
description: Ma Xiulan cleared the dishes and washed them, then took the washed clothes out of the washing machine, shook each one open, and hung them on the balcony to dry, enjoying the fresh scent of the laundry detergent.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Noon rest and free activities.
description: Ma Xiulan leaned on the sofa in the living room, using her phone to reply to messages in the handicraft group and scroll through short videos. The three children were playing in the living room: Yuxin read a picture book, Mingzhe played with dinosaur toys, and Mingxuan read a newly borrowed popular science book. Ma Xiulan herself dozed off for about 20 minutes.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Childhood friend Liu Chunmei came to visit
description: Ma Xiulan's childhood friend Liu Chunmei visited on an electric bike, bringing freshly steamed bean paste buns. Ma Xiulan poured tea to entertain her, and the two chatted in the living room. Liu Chunmei told her that Boss Wang in the town had an urgent order needing 10 hand-embroidered plum blossom handkerchiefs, with a labor fee of 15 yuan each. Ma Xiulan immediately agreed to take the order. The two agreed on the handkerchief size and embroidery thread colors, and arranged to go to Boss Wang's shop tomorrow morning to look at the patterns and get the materials. After seeing Chunmei off, Ma Xiulan felt happy about this extra income.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Housework and tidying
description: Ma Xiulan took advantage of the children quietly reading to start cleaning the house. She used a broom and mop to clean the living room and bedroom floors, wiped down the kitchen stove, and tidied the home until it was spotless.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Supervise children's study and parent-child reading.
description: Ma Xiulan told Mingzhe to stop reading comics and finish his winter vacation math homework first. She then sat with Mingxuan and read Interesting Science Experiments together, listening to Mingxuan explain the experiment of making a small fountain with a straw. Ma Xiulan also asked a few questions to interact.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Prepare dinner
description: Ma Xiulan began preparing dinner. Because her husband would be home to eat tonight, she made a rather hearty meal: braised pork belly, cabbage with tofu and vermicelli, and hot-and-sour shredded potatoes. The kitchen was filled with the aroma of food.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Family dinner
description: Husband Ma Zhiqiang came home, and the family of five sat around eating dinner. The children excitedly shared their experience of going to the library today with their father. Ma Xiulan also mentioned receiving an embroidery order, and Ma Zhiqiang told her not to get too tired. The family atmosphere was warm.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: After-dinner cleanup and family time
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan cleared the dishes, and her husband Ma Zhiqiang volunteered to do the dishes. Ma Xiulan stayed with the children in the living room: she supervised Mingzhe to finish his homework, accompanied Yuxin in drawing, checked Mingxuan's reading progress, and praised him.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Suggestions: 1) Use real-life examples to explain problems, such as using shopping change to understand addition and subtraction; 2) Keep a mistake notebook, organizing only 1-2 problems a day, and let the child explain where they went wrong; 3) Divide homework into small tasks and reward 10 minutes of rest for each completed page to foster initiative; 4) When tutoring, first acknowledge their effort, then analyze together, and avoid being impatient.
description: Ma Xiulan ran hot water for Yuxin and Mingzhe, helped them bathe, blow-dried Yuxin's hair, while Mingxuan washed up by himself. Afterward, she placed the three borrowed books on the living room coffee table and reminded the children to remember to read them tomorrow, then settled the three children into bed.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Evening bookkeeping and savings.
description: In the bedroom, Ma Xiulan took out her phone, opened the expense-tracking app, and recorded the day's spending. Then she remembered that this month's education savings (200 yuan per month) had not been deposited yet, so she immediately used mobile banking to transfer 200 yuan from her change account to the dedicated savings jar, and set up an automatic reminder for the 1st of each month to prevent forgetting.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: Ma Xiulan did 10 minutes of evening stretching in bed to relax her muscles, then went to the bathroom to wash up. Back in the bedroom, she chatted with her husband Ma Zhiqiang, who was half-lying in bed, about picking up embroidery orders the next day and plans to take the children shopping for clothes on the weekend. Then she turned off the light and fell asleep peacefully, looking forward to tomorrow.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Morning stretching and breakfast preparation.
description: After the morning alarm went off, she first moved her wrists and ankles in bed for five minutes, then put on a cotton-padded jacket and sat on the edge of the bed to do her regular shoulder and neck stretches. Afterward, she went into the kitchen, rinsed the millet and cooked porridge, reheated the previous day's pancakes, and cut a plate of her homemade pickled mustard root to prepare breakfast for the family.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home)

name: Waking the children and breakfast time
description: Her eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, had already woken up on his own and was reading. Ma Xiulan mainly woke up Ma Mingzhe and Ma Yuxin, helped her daughter put on her sweater, and urged her second son to brush his teeth and wash his face. The family sat around the dining table, drinking hot millet porridge and eating pancakes with pickled vegetables. Ma Xiulan reminded Ma Mingxuan to take his younger brother and sister to read and do homework in the morning, not to just play.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home)

name: Go to the small shop to pick up the embroidery materials.
description: She quickly cleared away the dishes and chopsticks, changed into a padded cotton jacket for going out, and took her cloth bag, phone and keys, telling Ma Mingxuan to look after the house. She walked to the intersection of Jingwen Road and Shengli Avenue, where she met her childhood friend Liu Chunmei. The two walked side by side, chatting, to Boss Wang's small shop at 48 Shengli South Road. In the shop, Boss Wang took out 10 white pure-cotton handkerchiefs and embroidery thread in various colors, showed a sample pattern of red plum blossoms, and asked for neat, dense stitches with natural color transitions in the petals, with delivery within one week. Ma Xiulan put on her reading glasses to carefully check the texture of the handkerchiefs and the embroidery pattern. After confirming everything was correct, she carefully put away the materials, thanked Boss Wang together with Liu Chunmei, and left.

participant.relation: Client who commissioned the embroidery work.

name: Return home, tidy up, and keep the children company during household chores.
description: After parting with Liu Chunmei at the intersection, she went home alone, neatly arranged the handkerchief and embroidery thread beside the sewing box, and checked that the embroidery hoop and thimble were intact. Then she tidied up the house briefly. Seeing Ma Mingxuan reading and playing with Lego with his younger brother and sister on the living room coffee table, she didn't disturb them and went to the kitchen to prepare the dishes needed for lunch in advance.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home)

name: Preparing and enjoying lunch
description: At noon I made tomato and egg noodles with gravy. After boiling, the noodles were rinsed in cold water, topped with the gravy, and sprinkled with cilantro. All three kids loved it and each ate a big bowl with relish. After the meal, Ma Xiulan cleared the dishes into the kitchen.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home)

name: Midday rest and arrangements for the children's studies
description: She let the three children take a nap or do quiet activities for 30 minutes; Ma Xiulan herself dozed on the sofa for 20 minutes. After getting up, she urged Ma Mingzhe to start his winter break homework, while Ma Yuxin played with clay nearby and Ma Mingxuan went to his room to read.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home)

name: Afternoon embroidery and a midway break
description: Place the sewing box, embroidery hoop, and handkerchief in the best-lit spot next to the living room window. First, lightly trace the outline of a plum blossom in one corner of the handkerchief with a pencil, then thread pink silk floss and use satin stitch to embroider the first petal. After focusing for about 40 minutes, her right shoulder and neck felt sore, so she stood up, did shoulder circles and neck stretches, and drank hot water to relieve the discomfort. After resting, she sat back down, sped up, and worked on the petals' color gradient. When she was dissatisfied with the color layering, she removed the stitches and re-embroidered until she was satisfied.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (by the living room window at home)

name: Go to the food market to buy groceries
description: Thinking that the New Year was approaching, she put on her hat and gloves and walked to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market. On the way, she met her neighbor Sister Wang Guilan and exchanged a few pleasantries. At the market, she went straight to Sun Guifang's stall and bought five jin of Chinese cabbage, two pieces of tofu, a bunch of fresh garlic scapes, and fresh mushrooms. She also weighed out some vermicelli and daylily flowers at the dried goods stall to prepare for the New Year's Eve dinner. Sun Guifang even stuffed a handful of homegrown cilantro into her bag. After that, she carried her basket and walked home, put the ingredients away properly, and took a look at the handkerchief she had half-embroidered by the window.
location: Diwei Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (Wutong Commune Food Market)

name: Prepare dinner and have dinner with the family
description: In the afternoon she started preparing dinner. She rendered the pork belly in the wok, then added scallions, ginger, and star anise to sauté until fragrant. She put in cabbage and glass noodles, added water, and let it stew. At the same time, she steamed rice and Chinese sausage and stir-fried garlic scapes. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang came home early, and the whole family sat around the table eating steaming hot cabbage and pork stew with glass noodles, garlic scapes stir-fried with Chinese sausage, and pickled vegetables. At the table, Ma Mingxuan said he wanted to try the volcano eruption experiment from the book, and Ma Xiulan nodded in agreement.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home)

name: Household bookkeeping and a suggestion that her husband cut down on smoking
description: After the meal, Ma Zhiqiang voluntarily proposed cutting his daily smoking to ten cigarettes and saving the money for the children. Ma Xiulan was pleased to hear this, encouraged her husband that he would surely be able to do it, and suggested setting up a health-savings ledger to see what big purchase they could make at the end of the year. The two took out the ledger, recorded that day's income and expenses one by one—the groceries, the bean buns Liu Chunmei brought, Boss Wang's deposit—and on a new line wrote the initial entry for the health savings.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home)

name: Parent-child science experiment and homework check.
description: At the dining table, Ma Mingxuan led his younger brother Ma Mingzhe in doing a volcano eruption experiment with baking soda and white vinegar. When the bubbles erupted, the two shouted excitedly, while Ma Yuxin drew the experiment scene next to them with colored pens. Afterwards, Ma Xiulan checked Ma Mingzhe's math problems and Ma Mingxuan's reading notes and praised their performance.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home)

description: Urged the three children to wash up and go to bed one by one. After Ma Yuxin fell asleep, Ma Xiulan washed her face with hot water and did a 5-minute pre-bedtime neck and shoulder stretch, feeling much more relaxed all over.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home)

name: Personal tidying and relaxation before bed
description: Lying in bed, I took out my phone and briefly noted in the memo the day's embroidery progress, the details Boss Wang instructed, and the happy news that my husband is going to cut down on smoking. I also planned to finish embroidering the first plum blossom tomorrow. Then I scrolled through local news and the handicraft group for a while, saw new patterns others shared, saved a few, and felt the day was very fulfilling.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home bedroom)

name: Going to bed
description: Turning off the light and lying down, despite a slight ache in her shoulders, she was filled with joy at the smooth start of her embroidery and warmth at her husband's decision to support her, and soon fell fast asleep.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home bedroom)

name: Waking up and morning stretching
description: The alarm went off. Ma Xiulan slowly sat up and felt that her shoulders were a little looser than yesterday. She drew open the curtains and saw that the sky was overcast, remembering that the weather forecast had called for a northwest wind. She did shoulder and neck stretches and chest expansions by the bed, and twisted her waist to limber up her whole body.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare breakfast and wake up the children.
description: Ma Xiulan went to the kitchen, put on a blue plaid apron, cooked millet porridge, reheated yesterday's scallion pancake, and took out pickled cucumbers. Then she woke the three children one by one: called Xuanxuan to stop lying in bed, urged Zhezhe to get up quickly, and gently woke Xinxin.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family breakfast and reminders
description: The children sat around the dining table. Ma Xiulan reminded them to drink their porridge slowly and handed out the flatbread. She told Xuanxuan to write a science reading response after school, checked Zhezhe's math homework, and wiped Xinxin's face.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Taking the children to school and buying groceries on the way.
description: Ma Xiulan put gloves on Xinxin, helped Zhezhe zip up his down jacket, and rode an electric bike. She first took Zhezhe to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, then took Xinxin to Huakang First Kindergarten, and finally went to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market to buy groceries. At Sun Guifang's stall, she bought pears, baby bok choy, and pork belly, planning to make Chinese cabbage and vermicelli stew for dinner.
location: Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, 100 Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin   Huakang First Kindergarten at the intersection of Shengli Street and Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin   Wutong Commune Market, 100 meters east of the intersection of Jingwen Road and Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Focusing on embroidery and housework.
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan cleared the dishes, then sat by the living room window embroidering handkerchiefs, reminding herself to drink more water. Her fingers were nimble and the stitches were even. Every so often she got up to stretch or do laundry. By 11:30, she finished embroidering the 4th, 5th, and 6th plum-blossom handkerchiefs.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Simple lunch and rest.
description: Ma Xiulan rubbed her eyes and cooked herself tomato and egg noodles with a poached egg. While eating, she voice-chatted with her childhood friend Liu Chunmei on her phone about the delivery. After the meal, she leaned back on the sofa and took a 20-minute nap.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Mending socks and ironing handkerchiefs
description: After waking up, Ma Xiulan found that her husband Zhiqiang had holes in two pairs of socks, so she took out the sewing basket and mended them while watching TV. Then she used a steam iron to press the six handkerchiefs she had embroidered in the morning, making the petals lie flatter.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Picking up and dropping off the kids, helping with homework, and embroidering in spare moments
description: Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to pick up Xinxin and Zhezhe from school. After getting home, she urged Zhezhe to do his homework, kept Xinxin company while she doodled, and continued her embroidery whenever she had a free moment. In between, she taught Zhezhe math word problems. By 3 p.m., she had completed another three handkerchiefs.
location: No. 100 Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin  Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School  Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten  No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Get some exercise and check homework.
description: Ma Xiulan stood up, stretched her waist and rolled her neck, then checked Zhezhe's homework, circled the mistakes, and had him correct them. Xinxin showed her painting, and she praised her daughter.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing dinner and making a final push to finish the last handkerchief
date: Wash up and get ready for bed.
description: Ma Xiulan started preparing dinner: she sliced pork belly, soaked vermicelli, stir-fried cabbage, and stewed cabbage with pork and vermicelli in a clay pot. During a break in the stewing, she hurried to embroider the last handkerchief, stitching quickly and steadily, and finally finished it before dinner.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Complete all embroidery and detailed inspection.
description: After the last stitch on the final handkerchief, Ma Xiulan let out a long breath. She laid out the ten handkerchiefs flat to inspect them. She found two with curled embroidered edges and used a steam iron to set them, and one with petals whose color wasn't full enough, so she added a few more stitches. Looking at the elegant plum-blossom handkerchiefs at last, she felt reassured.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner
description: Her husband Ma Zhiqiang came home, and the casserole stew was steaming hot. Ma Xiulan also stir-fried baby bok choy with garlic. The family sat around the table eating, the children shared funny stories from school, and Zhiqiang praised her cooking. Ma Xiulan gave him extra meat, silently thinking that his effort to cut back on smoking had gotten off to a good start.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: After-dinner cleanup and family time
description: Zhiqiang volunteered to wash the dishes. Ma Xiulan carefully folded the handkerchiefs to be delivered tomorrow and packed them into bags. Then she watched "Peppa Pig" with Xinxin, checked Xuanxuan's reading progress, watched Zhezhe demonstrate a little experiment, and clapped to praise him.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Simmering pear water and urging the children to wash up
description: Feeling that her throat was dry, Ma Xiulan boiled pears and rock sugar bought during the day to make pear water and had the family drink some. Then she urged the children to wash up and brush their teeth.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Settle the children and prepare for bedtime
description: Ma Xiulan told Xinxin a bedtime story to help her fall asleep and reminded Xuanxuan and Zhezhe to go to bed early. Back in the bedroom, she did her evening stretches, recorded her embroidery progress and tomorrow's delivery plans, and set the alarm for 7 a.m.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Washed up and went to bed
description: Ma Xiulan washed up and changed clothes. She lay in bed, tired but at ease. She discussed with the half-asleep Zhiqiang going to the supermarket after tomorrow's delivery, and then fell into a deep sleep, feeling content.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Getting up, stretching, preparing breakfast, and helping the children eat
description: Woke up at 6:40 in the morning, did shoulder and neck stretches in bed to relax, then got dressed and went to the kitchen to cook millet porridge. Then I woke up the three children. In the kitchen, I made ten scallion pancakes and sliced some pickled radish. After washing up, the children sat around the table to eat. I combed Xinxin's hair, reminded Zhezhe to finish his food, and Xuanxuan prepared for school on his own after eating.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Took the second son and daughter to school.
description: After breakfast, she put thick coats on ZheZhe and XinXin, rode the electric bike to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to drop off ZheZhe, then went to Huakang First Kindergarten to drop off XinXin, handing each to their teacher.
location: Starting from No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, passing by the Third Primary School of Jinghai District on Shengli South Street, ending at Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten.

name: Tidied up the house and inspected the embroidered handkerchief
description: After returning home, cleaned up the stove and dishes, took out the 10 plum-blossom handkerchiefs embroidered yesterday from the cloth bag, carefully checked the loose threads, folded them neatly into a plastic bag once everything was confirmed fine, and got ready for delivery.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Went to Jinghai Town to deliver the handkerchiefs and received payment.
description: She put the handkerchief into a canvas bag, put on a thick padded jacket, and went out. She walked to the Jingwen Road bus stop and took a bus to Shengli Street, Jinghai Town. After getting off, she went to Boss Wang's shop as usual and handed over the handkerchief for inspection. Boss Wang praised her improved embroidery and paid 150 yuan in cash. Ma Xiulan took it with both hands and carefully put it away.
location: Mr. Wang's small shop, No. 68 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Buy flour and oil on the way and return home
description: After leaving Boss Wang's shop, she took another bus to the Jingbai Supermarket in Yuzhou Zunfu, bought a 20-jin bag of first-grade flour and a bottle of oil, then took the bus back home, resting a bit on the way.
location: Jingbai Supermarket, Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Bookkeeping, lunch, and afternoon nap
description: After returning home, she first moved the flour and oil into the kitchen, found the green ledger, recorded the income of 150 yuan, and noted Boss Wang's feedback, then put the money into the iron petty cash box. Afterwards she cooked herself a bowl of plain noodles with a poached egg and blanched greens. After a simple lunch, she took a half-hour nap. When she woke up, she browsed photos from last year's Yangliuqing handicraft market on her phone and mulled over plans for setting up a stall in early spring.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Walk to Wutong Community Vegetable Market
description: The weather was fine, so I carried my vegetable basket and walked to the Wutong Commune vegetable market to stretch my limbs.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market

name: Ran into a friend while buying groceries and asked about gig work opportunities.
description: At Sister Sun Guifang's stall, she picked out cabbages, potatoes, and green peppers. Sister Sun rounded off the change and threw in some cilantro. Then she ran into an old acquaintance, Zheng Xiuying, and the two chatted warmly by the roadside in the vegetable market. Ma Xiulan told her she had just earned 150 yuan, and Sister Zheng praised her for being very capable. Ma Xiulan took the opportunity to ask about odd jobs. Sister Zheng told her that the Qiaoshou Fabric Workshop and Old Zhou's Tailor Shop in town were short-handed and needed people for jobs like altering trouser hems and sewing quilt covers. Ma Xiulan quickly took out her notebook and noted down the shop names and the owners' surnames.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Returned home and sorted through potential job opportunities.
description: After arriving home, Ma Xiulan first washed her face, then took yesterday's leftover rice out of the fridge, cracked two eggs, and quickly stir-fried a bowl of egg fried rice. After finishing lunch, she did not rush to clean up. Instead, she moved a small folding stool into the sunlight in the living room and did another round of waist and back stretches, completely loosening up the muscles and joints that had been curled up on the train. Then she called her mother, Li Xiuying, to report that she was safe and said, "Mom, I'm home. I brought pear-syrup candy from Renqiu and will bring it to you on the weekend."
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Refine the street stall plan
description: She continued browsing the market fair photos, studying the stall layouts and embroidery displays, and decided to discuss with her friend Sister Xiuqin and start stocking up on goods, preparing to set up a stall in early spring.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the children from school and buy sugar-roasted chestnuts.
description: In the afternoon, she rode an electric bike first to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up Xinxin, then went to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up Zhezhe. Passing the corner snack stall at the intersection of Jingwen Road and Dongfanghong Road, she bought ten yuan worth of hot sugar-roasted chestnuts at the children's request.
location: Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District; Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School; and the roasted nuts and seeds stall at the intersection of Jingwen Road and Dongfanghong Road, Tianjin

name: Keep the children company and help with their homework
description: After returning home, the three children sat around eating chestnuts. While watching them do homework, Ma Xiulan sorted through the part-time job information again, copied it onto small slips of paper to take with her the next day, and urged the children to finish their schoolwork.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare dinner
description: Started preparing dinner for the family, making the pork and cabbage stewed vermicelli that her husband loved. She cut the meat, chopped the vegetables, soaked the vermicelli, sizzled the aromatics in oil, then simmered it slowly, filling the house with aroma.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The whole family had dinner together.
description: Husband Ma Zhiqiang arrived home, and the family sat around the dining table enjoying a hot dinner. Xuanxuan shared a physics experiment, Zhe Zhe said he won a jump rope competition, and Xinxin showed the peach blossoms she had painted in kindergarten, saying, 'Mom embroidered plum blossoms, and I painted peach blossoms.' The atmosphere was warm.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: After-dinner chores and getting the children to wash up
description: After dinner, her husband took the initiative to wash the dishes. Ma Xiulan bathed Xinxin, told her stories to help her fall asleep, then supervised Zhezhe's bath, and prepared Xuanxuan's school uniform for the next day.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening stretching and simple review
description: After the children fell asleep, she laid out a yoga mat in the living room and did ten minutes of stretching to relax. Then she took out her account book, calculated today's spending on groceries and chestnuts, and planned to wrap wontons for tomorrow's breakfast.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Wash up and have a casual chat with her husband.
description: After washing up, she returned to the bedroom and chatted with her husband, who was leaning against the headboard looking at his phone, about how the delivery went smoothly today and how she ran into Sister Zheng and heard about part-time work at a fabric workshop. Her husband said that when he makes deliveries tomorrow, he would stop by the two shops to check them out.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Turned off the lights and went to sleep.
description: After chatting for a few moments, she felt sleepy. She said goodnight to her husband, turned off the light, touched the notepad under her pillow, thought about the day's gains and tomorrow's new opportunities, and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Morning wake-up and preparation
description: The phone alarm rang, and Ma Xiulan woke from her sleep. Outside the window, it was still dark, and the northwest wind was howling. She first stretched in bed, moved her ankles, and did a few shoulder and neck stretches, her neck giving a faint crack. Then she quickly got up and washed up, took out the faded old cotton-padded jacket and fleece-lined pants, put on rubber gloves and a gauze mask, and neatly twisted her hair into a bun, ready for the day's thorough house cleaning.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Make a hearty breakfast
description: Ma Xiulan went into the kitchen and started kneading dough to make scallion pancakes, which turned out golden and fragrant. At the same time, she put the rice and millet that had been soaked overnight into a pot to make porridge. She also took some self-pickled mustard tubers from the pickle jar, cut them into thin strips, drizzled them with chili oil and sesame oil, and mixed them evenly. The aroma was appetizing. A hearty breakfast was ready.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family breakfast and house-cleaning drive
description: Once the food was on the table, Ma Xiulan woke her husband Ma Zhiqiang and their three children. The family sat around and had breakfast, and Ma Xiulan announced that today, the 24th day of the twelfth lunar month, was the day to sweep away the old dust. She assigned tasks: Ma Zhiqiang was to take down the lights and wipe the ceiling; she herself was responsible for the windows, spider webs in the corners, and stripping and washing the quilts; the eldest son Ma Mingxuan was to tidy up the desk and bookshelf; the second son Ma Mingzhe was to put away the toys; and the youngest daughter Ma Yuxin was to gather up the plush toys and puzzles. The whole family was in high spirits and ready to throw themselves into the big spring cleaning.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Practice hand-embroidery samples to prepare for the fabric workshop.
description: After breakfast, Ma Xiulan took out her sewing kit, red silk cloth, and multicolored thread. According to the sample patterns in the recruitment post for "Old Street Qiaoshou Cloth Art Workshop" on her phone, she began to embroider a sample of a small "Auspicious Fortune" hanging ornament. She sat by the window in bright light, stitching carefully stitch by stitch. An hour later, the rough shape of the ornament appeared with fine, tight stitches, and she felt more confident about checking out the workshop in the afternoon.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning thorough-cleaning campaign
description: Ma Xiulan tied on an apron, put on a mask and a hat, and officially started. Ma Zhiqiang moved the ladder over, took down all the lampshades, and soaked and washed them. Ma Xiulan tied a broom to a bamboo pole and cleaned the cobwebs and dust from the ceiling, coughing from the choking dust. While wiping the windows, cold wind blew in and her hands turned red from the cold, but seeing the glass get brighter and brighter made her feel happy. The children also actively joined in: Ma Mingxuan reorganized and arranged the books, Ma Mingzhe sorted the toys, throwing away damaged ones and ones no longer played with, and Ma Yuxin carried the plush dolls to the basin to prepare for washing. The whole family was full of energy, and the room gradually filled with the smell of dust.
location: Various rooms of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Cooking a simple lunch
description: The cleaning was paused for the moment, and everyone had dust on their faces. Ma Xiulan went to the kitchen and cooked a big pot of steaming hot tomato and egg noodles with plenty of broth and rich flavor. She also sliced a plate of previously braised beef to help the family regain their energy.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Lunch and midday rest
description: The family sat around the table eating noodles. Ma Mingzhe wanted an extra egg, and the atmosphere was relaxed. After the meal, Ma Xiulan urged Ma Zhiqiang to scrub the soaked range hood filter with heavy-duty cleaner. The children went to watch cartoons, and Ma Xiulan was finally able to sit down. She leaned against the sofa, pounded her sore and aching back, drank a full large glass of warm water, and rested for a while.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, home dining room and living room

name: Afternoon detailed cleaning and washing of quilts and bedding
description: After a short rest, Ma Xiulan and Ma Zhiqiang continued with their busy work. Ma Xiulan brought out four quilt covers and sheets and asked Ma Mingzhe to help put them in the washing machine, then poured in laundry detergent. While the machine was running, she took a steel wool ball and carefully cleaned hard-to-reach spots such as the baseboards, the side of the washing machine, and the top of the refrigerator. In the kitchen, Ma Zhiqiang used hot water and a strong degreaser to scrub the range hood filter and panel, and it was nearly two hours before the metal showed its original color. At around 3 p.m., the washed quilt covers were hung in the courtyard. Despite the cold, they gave off a fresh scent, and the house was already spotless.
location: Each room, bathroom, and small courtyard at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Went to the fabric workshop to offer her services.
description: After finishing the big cleanup, Ma Xiulan changed into a clean coat, took the "Auspicious Wishes" small hanging ornament sample she had embroidered in the morning, told her husband, and went out with Ma Mingzhe and Ma Yuxin. After walking about fifteen minutes, they arrived at Laojiekou Qiaoshou Cloth Art Workshop, No. 38 Shengli Street, Jinghai District. The shop was full of embroidered pieces. She found the shop owner, Sister Wang, and summoned her courage to show the sample. Sister Wang looked at it carefully, praised the fine stitching and festive colors, and said that she was short of skilled embroiderers after the New Year, asking Ma Xiulan to come for a trial after the Lantern Festival. Ma Xiulan felt much more relieved and thanked her repeatedly.
location: Old Street Corner Clever Hands Fabric Art Workshop, No. 38 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Take the children to the library to read and then return home.
description: When they came out of the fabric workshop, it was still early, so Ma Xiulan took the children to the nearby Jinghai District Library. The library was warm and cozy. Her younger daughter Ma Yuxin picked up the picture book “Guess How Much I Love You” and sat on the floor to read, while Ma Mingzhe was drawn to a dinosaur encyclopedia and kept asking questions. Ma Xiulan browsed the “New Year’s Eve Dinner Menu” section of “Complete Collection of Home-Cooking Recipes,” quietly noting new ideas. About forty-five minutes later, the children were reluctant to leave, so Ma Xiulan promised to come again next weekend, and then took them by the hand to walk home, arriving in about ten minutes.
location: Jinghai District Library, at the northeast corner of the intersection of Shengli Street and Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare a hearty dinner
description: After getting home, Ma Xiulan went straight into the kitchen. She sliced the leftover braised beef from noon, sliced the pork belly, chopped the napa cabbage, and soaked the wide potato starch noodles. She heated the iron wok, stir-fried the pork belly until the fat rendered, added scallions, ginger and star anise to bring out the aroma, then added the cabbage and stir-fried until soft. She added water and the noodles, and stewed a big pot of pork and cabbage stew with noodles. She also quickly stir-fried vinegar-shredded potatoes and cut a plate of assorted sausages. The kitchen was filled with a delicious aroma.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner and sharing of achievements
description: Steaming hot pork, cabbage, and vermicelli stew was served. Ma Zhiqiang opened a bottle of beer to celebrate. The family sat together in the clean, bright room eating the hot dishes. Ma Xiulan mentioned that she had been offered a trial shift at the fabric workshop in the afternoon, and everyone was delighted; the eldest son praised his mother for being amazing. Looking at the refreshed home, Ma Zhiqiang felt grateful for his wife's hard work. Ma Xiulan scolded him playfully, but felt pleased inside. The family was happy and harmonious.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening relay: cleaning up, tutoring, and bedtime preparations
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan asked her husband to take care of the little ones, while she cleaned up the dishes with her eldest son Ma Mingxuan. She washed the dishes with hot water, and Ma Mingxuan wiped the table and swept the floor; the young man did a proper job. After everything was tidied up, Ma Xiulan urged Ma Mingzhe and Ma Yuxin to go take a bath, checked and signed Ma Mingxuan's winter vacation homework, and reminded him of the half-hour reading plan. While the children were bathing, she took out the account book, recorded the meat expenses, put a checkmark next to the note 'Clever Hands Fabric Workshop', and wrote 'trial work on the 15th day of the first lunar month'.
location: Kitchen, living room, and bathroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening stretching and lower back care.
description: Her lower back was clearly sore, and Ma Xiulan had difficulty bending over. Ma Zhiqiang helped her apply a medicated patch and, seeing her lower back red, told her with concern not to tough it out tomorrow. After the patch was applied, a cool sensation spread and she felt more comfortable. Then Ma Xiulan lay on the bed and did a few minutes of simple lower-back relaxing stretches to relieve fatigue.
location: Master bedroom of the home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Phone contact and planning for tomorrow
description: The children had all settled down. Ma Xiulan leaned against the headboard and picked up her phone. She sent a WeChat message to her childhood friend Liu Chunmei, updating her on the progress at the fabric workshop, and arranged to go look together tomorrow afternoon. Then she checked local market fair information to scout suitable fairground spots for setting up a stall in early spring, and roughly formed a plan in her mind.
location: Master bedroom of the home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Put the youngest daughter to sleep
description: The youngest daughter Ma Yuxin came over rubbing her eyes and asked for a story. Ma Xiulan held her and lay down, softly telling the little rabbit story she had seen at the library today. Halfway through the story, the little one fell asleep with even breaths, her little face rosy. Ma Xiulan gently closed the door and left.
location: The second bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Washing up, bedtime conversation between husband and wife, and going to sleep
description: After gently closing her daughter's door, Ma Xiulan went to wash up and soaked her tired feet in hot water. Back in the master bedroom, Ma Zhiqiang was still awake. The two chatted about the results of the day's thorough cleaning and the trial job opportunity at the fabric workshop. They both felt that although it was hard work, the family was united and looked forward to a hopeful future. As they talked, drowsiness crept in. Ma Xiulan turned off the light and sank comfortably into sleep.
location: Master bedroom of the home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning family routine and breakfast
description: Got up at 6:45 a.m., first did 5 minutes of shoulder and neck stretches to relieve the soreness from yesterday's thorough cleaning, then washed up. At 7:15 began preparing breakfast for the family: cooked millet porridge, made egg pancakes and cut them into small pieces, and made sweet tomato salad. At 7:45 woke the three children and had breakfast with her husband Ma Zhiqiang and the kids. During the meal, she arranged the day's chores: she would finish the thorough cleaning herself, told the children to complete their winter vacation homework and put their toys away, and informed them that her close friend Liu Chunmei would visit in the afternoon.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Deep-cleaning wrap-up
description: After breakfast, they started wrapping up the big cleaning. First, she took in the dried quilt covers, fitted the quilt inserts in, and folded them neatly; she guided her son Mingxuan to wipe the water marks off the windows with a dry cloth until the glass was shining; she herself carefully mopped the floor with warm water mixed with floor cleaner, from the living room to the bedrooms and then the hallway, even wiping the baseboards with a rag; the children helped put scattered items back in their places, leaving the rooms bright and spotless.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Backyard tidying and making Laba garlic
description: After the big cleaning, she took the children to the backyard to bring in the small items that had been airing out. She found green garlic in the corner of the vegetable garden and decided on the spur of the moment to pickle Laba garlic for the New Year. She peeled and washed the garlic with the children, prepared the sweet and sour sauce herself, put it in glass jars, had the children help tighten the lids, and stored the jars in a cool place.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Housework break and parent-child reading
description: Taking advantage of the ample sunshine, she hung the heavy coats and the children's school uniforms on the balcony to air. Then she checked Mingxuan's winter vacation homework and praised his neat handwriting, read the picture book The Very Hungry Caterpillar with Yuxin, and patiently answered her questions. She also took out her sewing box, looked at the handkerchief sample embroidered with plum blossoms, and prepared for the afternoon discussion with Chunmei.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare and enjoy lunch
description: At 11:45 she started cooking lunch, making vinegar-flavored shredded potatoes that her husband loved, and stewing pork, cabbage, and vermicelli with fresh meat and cabbage. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang came home at noon, and the whole family ate together. At the table, she mentioned to her husband her plan to discuss the fabric workshop work and the market stall with Chunmei in the afternoon. Zhiqiang expressed support; the children were excited and wanted to help Mom make a sign. The atmosphere was warm.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Noon break and personal grooming
description: After clearing the table, her husband went out again to drive for work, and the children watched TV in the living room. Feeling drowsy, she went back to the bedroom for a half-hour nap to regain her energy. After getting up, she washed her face, changed into neat and proper clothes, combed her hair, and tidied herself up to prepare for the upcoming gathering with her good friends.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Going Out to Buy Pastries and Returning Home to Set Up Tea Snacks
description: After the afternoon nap, she walked to Zhao's Pastry Shop on Central Street and spent 15 yuan buying half a jin of jujube paste pastries and half a jin of mung bean cakes. The shopkeeper told her to eat them while warm. After returning home, she boiled water, arranged the pastries on a white porcelain plate, and set out home-roasted sunflower seeds and peanuts. She brewed a pot of jasmine tea, laid a handkerchief embroidered with plum blossoms and a newly learned pattern drawing flat on the tea table, making the living room elegant and cozy.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and Zhao's Pastry Shop on Central Street, Jinghai District.

name: Tasting tea and admiring embroidery with good friend Liu Chunmei.
description: Good friend Liu Chunmei came by carrying milk tea and flashcards. The two sat together in the living room, enjoying pastries with jasmine tea. Chunmei was full of praise for the plum blossom embroidery on the handkerchief. They chatted about topics from stitching and color matching to the prospects of handicrafts. Chunmei encouraged her to set up a stall at the market after the New Year, while she revealed that she planned to formally start work at the fabric workshop after the Lantern Festival, and once her skills were stable, she would try selling at a stall on weekends. They talked until dusk, and then Chunmei took her leave.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Dinner preparation and family meal
description: After Chunmei left, she began preparing dinner. She reheated the leftover pork and cabbage stew with vermicelli from lunch, stir-fried broccoli with garlic, and steamed white rice. Since her husband Ma Zhiqiang was unloading goods in Tanggu and couldn't get home in time, she had dinner with the three children. During the meal, she told the children in detail about her plans to work at the fabric workshop and set up a street stall. The children responded enthusiastically: Mingzhe said he would paint a billboard, and Yuxin wanted to cut window flowers for decoration. The dining table was filled with hopes for the future.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Cleaning Up After Meals and Helping with Homework
description: After the meal, she quickly cleared away the dishes and wiped down the stove and dining table. Then she went to the living room to urge Mingxuan and Mingzhe to finish their winter vacation homework, check their characters for mistakes, and explain math problems to them. Her youngest daughter, Yuxin, played with reading flashcards nearby, and she took time to praise her for making fast progress in recognizing characters.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening personal time: needlework and socializing
description: After the children wash up and go play, she enjoys some alone time. While listening to a TV drama, she sews the button back onto her husband Ma Zhiqiang's coat. Then she opens her phone, replies to messages in the handicraft group, and sees the group photo Chunmei sent from the afternoon, both of them smiling brightly. She replies with the "facepalm smile" emoji, feeling joyful.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Bookkeeping and next-day planning
description: Returned to the bedroom, took out the account book, recorded today's expense of 15 yuan for buying snacks, noted "Chunmei visited," and checked the scattered accounts for yesterday's cleaning supplies. Looking at the phone calendar, she planned tomorrow's traditional activities for the 26th day of the twelfth lunar month — steaming buns and stewing meat — and decided to go to the vegetable market early in the morning to buy pork belly and flour.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Urge the child to wash up and lull them to sleep.
description: She urged the three children to wash up, personally watched Yuxin brush her teeth and wash her face, and told her the story of "The Little Prince" to lull her to sleep; then she checked whether Mingzhe had secretly brought toys to bed, told Mingxuan to rest early, and gently closed the door.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening self-care and a call with her husband
description: After the children fell asleep, she washed up and applied body lotion. Once in bed, she sent a voice message to her husband Ma Zhiqiang sharing the joy of Chunmei's visit today. Zhiqiang replied that he was about to unload the goods; they cared for each other and reminded one another to be safe and take care of themselves. After the call, she felt very reassured.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pre-sleep review and falling asleep
description: She turned off the bedside lamp and, in the darkness, thought back on the fulfilling day: the spring cleaning had wrapped up neatly, the gathering with good friends was joyful, and the children had been well-behaved and sensible. Especially recalling Sister Wang's invitation to 'try the job after the Lantern Festival' and Chunmei's words encouraging her to set up a stall at the market, she felt full of new hope for life in the future and fell peacefully asleep with a smile.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning stretching and preparing breakfast for the family
description: Xiulan woke up naturally in the early morning and felt refreshed. She first did a few minutes of neck and shoulder stretches in bed to relieve the soreness in her back and waist from yesterday's big cleaning, then put on a thick coat and went to the backyard, moving her arms and legs in the cold air and taking deep breaths to loosen up her body. After that, she returned to the kitchen, put on an apron, and prepared breakfast: heating up millet porridge, steaming mantou and sugar-filled steamed buns, and slicing a plate of home-pickled mustard greens mixed with sesame oil and vinegar.
location: Bedroom and kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Breakfast and assignment of household chores.
description: Xiulan set out the dishes and woke the three children for breakfast. Mingxuan and Mingzhe came downstairs sleepy-eyed, and Xiulan carried Yuxin down. The family sat around the table, and Xiulan reminded them that weekends should also be spent doing something productive. After breakfast, Xiulan had Mingxuan take his younger brother and sister to wash the dishes and wipe the table, and urged Yuxin to practice pinyin. She herself went to the storage room and brought out white radish, pork belly, flour, and other ingredients, getting ready for pickling vegetables and for cooking in the days ahead.
location: Dining room and storage room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Wash the radishes and pickle the vegetables
description: Xiulan fetched water in the backyard and carefully washed the radishes, brushing off the mud, trimming the root hairs and blemishes, while her daughter Yuxin sat nearby helping to rinse them. Xiulan selected about 20 jin of radishes of even size, cut them into thick slices and then into finger-thick strips, spread them over two large basins, sprinkled with coarse salt and mixed evenly, so that every strip was coated with salt. She covered the basins and placed them in the corner to draw out water. Yuxin imitated and learned beside her, and Xiulan taught her simple household chores while she was busy.
location: Home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin: backyard and kitchen

name: Go out to buy New Year goods and prepare lunch.
description: Seeing that the radishes were already pickled, Xiulan took Mingzhe on an electric bike along Jingwen Road to the Wutong Commune vegetable market. At the familiar stall of Sun Guifang, she bought pork belly, all-purpose flour, scallions, ginger, garlic, and other items, and chatted with the stall owner about stocking up for the New Year. Then she rode home, put away the ingredients, and began preparing lunch: tomato and egg noodles with gravy, shredded cucumber, and fried peanuts as a side dish.
location: Set out from home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, went to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market (near the intersection of Jingwen Road and Shengli Street), then returned home.

name: Family lunch, sun-drying radishes, and preparing the sauce.
description: At 06:30, Ma Xiulan first woke up her second son, Ma Mingzhe, and her youngest daughter, Ma Yuxin, urging them to get dressed and wash up. Her husband, Ma Zhiqiang, was not driving that day and stayed home to help take care of the children. At 07:00, the family of four sat around the table and had breakfast together. During the meal, Ma Xiulan reminded Mingzhe to wear his thermal underwear to avoid catching a cold. Her husband, Ma Zhiqiang, offered to pick Mingzhe up from school in the afternoon, which put Ma Xiulan at ease. The family atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: Dining room, backyard, and kitchen of the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Organized the wardrobe and discovered an old camera.
description: Xiulan first tidied the drawer of the TV cabinet in the living room, putting odds and ends back in place and wiping off dust. Then she organized the large drawer at the bottom of the wardrobe in the master bedroom, pulling out a 2009 photo album and old stamps. Finally, at the very back of the drawer, she found a cloth bundle containing an old digital camera her husband had bought years ago. She tried putting in batteries and was surprised to find the screen could still light up. Although the focus was a bit blurry, it seemed the camera could still take photos.
location: Living room and master bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Take photos of the children with an old camera
description: Xiulan excitedly called the three children over and told them the old camera still worked. The children gathered around curiously. Xiulan had them stand in a row under the jujube tree in the backyard. She clumsily held up the camera, found the right angle, took a group photo, and then took several individual photos of each child. The children crowded around the small screen looking at themselves, laughing uproariously, and the yard was filled with laughter and joy.
location: Backyard of the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Bring in the sun-dried radishes and toss them with the sauce.
description: As the sun set, the radish strips had dried until half-dry and slightly soft. Xiulan carried the bamboo tray back into the kitchen, poured the radish strips into a clean large basin, poured the cooled sauce over them, and turned them over with chopsticks until each strip was coated with the dark sauce. Then she covered the basin with plastic wrap, ready to jar them formally the next day. The whole process was methodical, and the kitchen was filled with the aroma of the sauce.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Cooking and sharing a weekend dinner with the family
description: In the evening, Xiulan began to prepare dinner. She cut the pork belly into thick slices, heated the wok to caramelize sugar, then stir-fried the meat until the oil came out, added various seasonings, and slowly simmered the braised pork. She also prepared cabbage with vermicelli and rice. Her husband Zhiqiang didn't drive his truck today and came home in the evening. The family rarely sat together, enjoying the braised pork, cabbage and vermicelli stew, and smashed cucumbers. Xiulan poured wine for Zhiqiang and poured herself a drink. They chatted about the day's amusing events while eating.
location: Kitchen and dining room of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: After-meal chores, supervising the children's studies, and importing photos.
description: After the meal, Xiulan cleared the dishes and arranged for Mingxuan to help Mingzhe with his winter vacation homework while Yuxin drew beside them. After cleaning the kitchen, she sat on the sofa in the living room and sewed tighter gauze covers for the mouths of the glass jars used for the pickled vegetables.
