After the children fell asleep, Xiulan remembered the photos on the camera. She found an old data cable in the hidden compartment of the living room drawer, imported the photos to the computer, created a new folder called 'Family Album [2025]' in My Documents, and saved the seven or eight photos from that day, renaming them by date. Seeing the children's smiling faces, she felt warm inside.
location: The kitchen, living room, and study at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Video call with mother to learn the secret recipe
description: After washing up, Xiulan lay in bed and initiated a video call with her mother Li Xiuying, reporting on the process of pickling radishes in soy sauce and how they were drying. Her mother lives at No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District. Being experienced, she smiled and advised her to add a small spoonful of shrimp oil before bottling to bring out the flavor, and reminded her that the lid must be tightly closed. The mother and daughter also talked about Zhiqiang's work and the children's recent situation. Xiulan kept the key points in mind.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Keeping accounts and stretching before bed.
description: After hanging up, Xiulan took out her small account notebook and wrote down the day's expenses: pork belly 35 yuan, flour 20 yuan, scallions, ginger, garlic, etc. 5 yuan, totaling 60 yuan. Seeing the New Year goods expenses increasing, she reckoned she'd have to be more frugal. Once the bookkeeping was done, she did a 10-minute bedtime stretch to loosen up her tired muscles from a full day of busyness.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Go to bed and sleep peacefully
description: After stretching, Xiulan turned off the light and lay down. Recalling the fulfilling experiences of the day—pickling vegetables, taking photos of the children, and learning the secret recipe from her mother—she felt full of steadiness and satisfaction, and gradually fell asleep in peace.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Morning stretches, washing up, preparing breakfast for the family, and household chores
description: At 6:30 in the morning, Ma Xiulan woke up and first did 10 minutes of neck and shoulder stretches in bed. Then she went to the bathroom to wash up, washing her face with warm water. After that, she entered the kitchen to prepare breakfast for the family. She took out the pork belly she bought yesterday and the leftover braised pork sauce, cut some potatoes, and made braised pork with potatoes. She also stir-fried cabbage with vinegar, preparing lunch for the children and Zhiqiang when they came home. She also boiled hot water, made a cup of tea for her husband, and placed it on the dining table. Meanwhile, she hand-washed several jackets and socks that had been changed out last night and hung them on the balcony.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home)

name: Wake the children for breakfast and tidy up the house
description: At 7:30, Ma Xiulan woke up the three children one by one: Ma Mingxuan, Ma Mingzhe, and Ma Yuxin. She helped her youngest daughter Xinxin put on thermal underwear and urged Zhezhe and Xuanxuan to hurry up. After the children washed up, she ladled out millet porridge, peeled eggs, and heated up sugar triangles, and the family had breakfast. After breakfast, she asked Xuanxuan to take his younger siblings to the living room to do homework. She cleaned up the dishes and utensils, cleaned the kitchen stove and sink, and took in and folded the clothes that had been drying on the balcony.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home)

name: Discussed the plan with her husband and had a morning rest.
description: After cleaning up the kitchen, Ma Xiulan discussed the day's plan with her husband Ma Zhiqiang in the study and listed the things they needed to buy for the New Year. Then she rested on the sofa in the living room and looked at her phone. In her handicraft group, she saw an intricate embroidery pattern sent by Zhou Xiuqin and saved it, and also replied to her childhood friend Liu Chunmei.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home)

name: Enhanced the sauce's umami and completed the initial pickling of the radishes in the jar.
description: After resting, Ma Xiulan began making soy-pickled radish. She added shrimp oil to the sauce she had boiled and cooled yesterday to enhance the umami, and tasted the saltiness. Then she brought the semi-dried radish strips from yesterday into the kitchen, carried out a large porcelain jar, put on gloves, and layered the radish strips and sauce, mixing evenly to make sure every strip was coated with the pickling sauce. She covered the jar, sealed the gap tightly with a cotton cloth, pasted on a red paper label reading 'Initial pickling 2025.1.26', and moved the jar to a cool corner of the kitchen.
location: Home kitchen at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Make a New Year shopping list and budget with her husband
description: After the pickles were ready, Ma Xiulan and her husband Ma Zhiqiang made a shopping list for New Year goods together in the study. They discussed what to buy: candies and melon seeds, new clothes for the children, seasonings, and so on, and estimated the prices item by item: candies and dried goods about 60 yuan, Spring Festival couplets 10 yuan, small firecrackers 20 yuan, new clothes budget 300 yuan, seasonings 30 yuan, total controlled within 420 yuan. Ma Xiulan entered the budget into the mobile accounting app.
location: Home study at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Organize family photos
description: There was still some time before lunch. Ma Xiulan remembered the photos she had taken of the children under the jujube tree yesterday. She turned on the computer, imported the photos from the camera, selected a few group and individual shots where the children were smiling the happiest, adjusted the brightness, created a new folder named '2025 Spring Festival Preparation' and saved them.
location: Home study at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing and enjoying a family lunch
description: At noon, Ma Xiulan put on an apron to heat up dishes, reheated the braised pork with potatoes stewed in the morning, and stir-fried cabbage with vinegar. At 12:30, the family of five sat around for lunch. The children ate heartily, and her husband praised the cooking. Ma Xiulan felt very satisfied watching her family enjoy the meal.
location: Home dining room at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Midday rest and getting changed to go out
description: After lunch, Ma Xiulan asked her husband and eldest son to wash the dishes, while she coaxed her youngest daughter Xinxin onto the sofa to read picture books. Once the children settled down, she organized the kitchen cupboard to make room for the pickle jars. At two o'clock, she changed into her going-out clothes, helped the family put on thick coats, wrapped a scarf around Xinxin, and told Xuanxuan to keep an eye on the younger children. Then the family of five locked the door and set off for the market.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home)

name: The whole family went to the Spring Festival market on Shengli Street to buy New Year goods, ran into a neighbor, bought seasonings, and walked home.
description: At 2:20 p.m., the whole family walked about 20 minutes to the Spring Festival market on Shengli Street, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin. The market was lively, with stalls selling Spring Festival couplets, sugar melons, and roasted seeds and nuts everywhere. Ma Xiulan first let her son Xuanxuan pick a pair of Spring Festival couplets, which cost 10 yuan. Then she took the children to a dried goods stall and chose two jin of large sunflower seeds, one jin of peanut candy, and one jin of crisp candy; after bargaining, they settled at 48 yuan. Her husband Zhiqiang bought the children small firecrackers (just for display) for 20 yuan. Each time something was bought, Ma Xiulan recorded the amount on her phone using a bookkeeping app, and told her son that this was the importance of keeping accounts. At the candy stall, they ran into their neighbor Zhang Shufen. The two exchanged New Year shopping tips, and Zhang Shufen gave the children some sesame candy to eat. They also agreed to fry New Year treats together. Later, Ma Xiulan remembered that the seasonings at home were almost used up. She and her husband went to Chen Ji Dried Goods and Grocery Store by the roadside and bought a small bag of Sichuan peppercorns, a small bag of star anise, and one jin of potato starch, spending 18 yuan, and recorded it. After shopping, the family walked home carrying their purchases. Xinxin was tired, so her father carried her on his back. Looking at her family, Ma Xiulan felt secure and happy.
location: Spring Festival market on Shengli Street, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and Chen's Dried Goods and Grocery Store

name: Going home to rest and deal with the New Year goods
description: After arriving home, Ma Xiulan asked her husband to put away the Spring Festival couplets and other items. She poured dried goods such as melon seeds and peanuts into sealed jars, and stored the meat and seasonings separately in the refrigerator. Then she poured a glass of water and rested on the sofa, feeling sore in the legs but satisfied.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home)

name: Practice embroidery stitches.
description: After resting, Ma Xiulan took out her embroidery needles and white cotton cloth, sat in a well-lit spot by the window, and began practicing the basic straight stitch and backstitch. On a small piece of fabric scrap, she embroidered the outline of a simple plum blossom. She remembered Sister Wang from the fabric workshop saying that stitches should be fine, dense, and even, and she felt satisfied that she hadn't completely let her craft skills go to waste.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home)

name: Preparing dinner for the whole family
description: At 6:30 in the evening, Ma Xiulan put down her embroidery hoop and went to prepare dinner. She stewed the leftover braised pork from noon with cabbage and glass noodles, made a smashed cucumber salad, and heated steamed buns as the staple food. The family enjoyed a warm, hearty meal.
location: Home kitchen at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening family interaction and settling the accounts.
description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan cleared away the dishes. The whole family sat in the living room: Xuanxuan watched Animal World, Zhezhe and Xinxin did puzzles, and Ma Xiulan chatted with her husband about what she had seen at the market and the children's winter vacation studies. At 8:30, Ma Xiulan opened the expense-tracking app and checked all of today's expenses: Spring Festival couplets 10 yuan, candies 48 yuan, small firecrackers 20 yuan, dried goods and seasonings 18 yuan, totaling 96 yuan, within budget. She showed it to her husband, and he praised the bookkeeping method. Ma Xiulan felt more confident about running the household.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Supervising the children's washing, personal hygiene, and bedtime preparation.
description: At nine o'clock, Ma Xiulan urged the children to wash up, helped Xinxin wash her face and brush her teeth, and watched Zhezhe wash his feet. When the children climbed into bed, she told Xinxin the story of The Three Little Pigs to lull her to sleep. After all the children were asleep, she soaked her feet in hot water to relieve fatigue, then washed up, wiped her face, and applied hand cream. At ten she got into bed, leaned against the headboard and looked at her embroidery for a while, did a few minutes of pre-sleep stretching, and after turning off the light, thought about the next day's matters and fell asleep with a sense of contentment.
location: Bedroom and children's room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning recovery stretching and washing up
description: At 7:00 in the morning, Ma Xiulan woke up naturally before the alarm went off. She first moved her neck while lying flat, then slowly sat up and did 5 minutes of shoulder and neck stretches by the bedside—a habit she had kept every day since being diagnosed with shoulder and neck strain in mid-January. Then she went to the bathroom to wash up, using warm water to wash away fatigue.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare breakfast and wake the children for their meal.
description: After washing up, Ma Xiulan went into the kitchen, cooked a pot of hot millet porridge, reheated the big steamed buns left from yesterday, stir-fried scallion eggs, and sliced a plate of her own pickled radish peels. When the porridge was almost ready, she woke the three children one by one: the eldest, Mingxuan, was already dressed and reading; the second, Mingzhe, was still lying in bed and got a few gentle scoldings; the youngest daughter, Yuxin, was sleepily acting cute. The family sat together for breakfast, chatting about winter vacation homework and new clothes, in a warm atmosphere.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tidying up the house and washing dishes
description: After breakfast, the children went off to play by themselves. Ma Xiulan quickly cleared the dishes, washed, dried, and put them away. Then she tidied up the living room and bedroom, wiped the tables, swept the floor, and soaked the clothes that had been taken off yesterday. After finishing the chores, she calculated in her mind the tasks she needed to do today.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Turning Over the Jar of Soy-Pickled Radishes and Fine-Tuning the Flavor
description: The highlight of the morning. Xiulan went to the backyard, carefully lifted the cotton cloth strip on the pickle jar, and used clean long bamboo chopsticks to turn the radish strips at the bottom of the jar over to the top, ensuring they were evenly soaked in the sauce. She tasted one and felt the soy aroma was not rich enough, so she went back to the kitchen, added two spoonfuls of dark soy sauce and a few pieces of rock sugar, and stirred slowly. She put the lid back on the jar and carefully stuffed the cloth strip into the gap to seal it. Then she scalded several cleaned and air-dried glass jars with hot water, turned them upside down on a clean cloth to drain, and prepared for bottling the next day.
location: Backyard and kitchen of home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Plan the afternoon shopping route.
description: After finishing the pickled vegetables, Ma Xiulan sat on the sofa in the living room, took out her phone's map app to check the bus route and schedule to the discount supermarket, mentally calculating the colors and sizes of clothes for the three children, and after checking the time, planned to leave at 2 p.m.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Simple lunch
description: Husband Zhiqiang ate lunch at the factory, so Xiulan had a simple lunch with the three children. She reheated the porridge left over from lunch and ate it with the morning's steamed buns and eggs. The children ate quickly and went off to play as soon as they finished.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Mother came over to deliver rice cakes and hand over caregiving duties
description: Just after clearing the table, her mother Li Xiuying arrived carrying steaming hot rice cakes wrapped in a steamer cloth. Xiulan quickly invited her mother in to sit, called over her younger daughter Yuxin, and told her mother that she planned to take the two boys out to buy clothes in the afternoon and asked her mother to look after Yuxin for a while. Her mother agreed readily, took out the rice cake for her granddaughter to taste, and Yuxin was overjoyed. Xiulan made tea for her mother and then, feeling reassured, got ready to go out.
location: Doorway of 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and the living room at home

name: Commute to Juxin Supermarket and pick out children's clothing.
description: Ma Xiulan and her husband Ma Zhiqiang went out with Mingxuan and Mingzhe, walked to the Jingwen Road bus stop, took the bus for about 25 minutes, got off at Beiwei Lou Station, and walked to the entrance of Juxin Supermarket. Once inside the supermarket, they went straight to the children's clothing section. Xiulan first picked out a gray padded cotton jacket for Mingxuan, and it fit perfectly. Then she chose a durable blue tracksuit for Mingzhe, which he didn't want to take off after putting it on. Finally, she saw a red woolen dress in the girls' section and thought Yuxin would look like a little lucky girl in it, so she bought it as well. The three items cost 272 yuan in total. Before paying, she carefully checked the loose threads and zippers, and after confirming they were all fine, she paid by scanning a QR code. After checkout, she immediately recorded the expense in her bookkeeping app.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to Juxin Supermarket, Beiwei Building, Jinghai District

name: Returning home
description: After buying clothes, the family did not linger. They carried their shopping bags to the bus stop, waited for the bus, got on smoothly, and after about 20 minutes got off and walked back to their home on Jingwen Road.
location: Juxin Supermarket, Beiwei Building, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District

name: Husband brought back workplace benefits and organized New Year goods
description: Just as she arrived home, she ran into her mother Li Xiuying playing with Yuxin in the yard. Soon after, her husband Ma Zhiqiang came home from work, carrying two large cardboard boxes of New Year goods from the factory: a box of Red Fuji apples and a box of navel oranges. Xiulan happily took them. After seeing her mother off, she picked out a few apples and oranges with the best appearance and brightest color, carefully arranged them in a fruit bowl in the living room, and the house immediately filled with a festive Spring Festival atmosphere.
location: Doorway of 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and the living room at home

name: Prepare and enjoy dinner
description: After setting out the fruit platter, Ma Xiulan began preparing dinner. She sliced the rice cake her mother had brought, steamed it soft as a snack, stir-fried two home-style dishes, and made tomato egg drop soup. The family sat around the table; the children excitedly discussed new clothes, her husband praised the benefits, and Xiulan felt a deep sense of contentment looking at her reunited family.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Summarize and reconcile family expenses
description: After dinner, the children went to watch TV. After cleaning up the kitchen, Ma Xiulan took out her account book and phone, spread all the shopping receipts from the past few days on the coffee table, and checked them item by item: New Year snacks 121 yuan, old-style Spring Festival couplets 10 yuan, today's new clothes 272 yuan, plus miscellaneous expenses, totaling 475 yuan. She calculated several times to make sure it was correct, then showed it to Zhiqiang, saying with a smile that of the 500-yuan budget she had saved 25 yuan. Her husband also praised her for managing the accounts better and better.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family leisure and bedtime preparation
description: After balancing the accounts, Xiulan felt pleased. She watched TV with her husband and children and chatted about plans for visiting relatives during the New Year. Then she urged the children to wash up one by one. She also took a shower, dried her hair, and laid out clean clothes for tomorrow on the bedside.
location: Living room, bathroom, and bedroom of the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Personal time and bedtime
description: Before going to sleep, Ma Xiulan used a ballpoint pen to neatly write on the flyleaf of her account book: manage the household wisely, and the heart will not be flustered. When she opened her phone and saw her younger sister Xiufen posting lively street scenes of Binhai New Area in the family group, she smiled and liked the post. She turned off the phone, lay on her side, listened to the wind outside the window, and planned the next day's tasks of packing pickled vegetables and frying New Year treats. Looking forward to the next day, she turned off the light and fell asleep at 22:50 as planned.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Get up and do morning stretches.
description: On the morning of Chinese New Year's Eve, Ma Xiulan woke up naturally, feeling some soreness in her shoulders and neck but filled with holiday excitement. Lying in bed, she moved her wrists and ankles and stretched her shoulders and neck to gradually relax her body, while planning the day's schedule: making pickled vegetables, pasting Spring Festival couplets, and going back to her parents' home in the afternoon to make dumplings.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing and enjoying the New Year breakfast
description: After washing up, Ma Xiulan went into the kitchen and set out the apples and oranges from the New Year goods her husband had brought back, symbolizing good fortune. She boiled a big pot of frozen cabbage and pork dumplings (meaning 'a hundred kinds of wealth'), and pan-fried the rice cakes her mother had given her until both sides were golden. Then she woke up her husband Ma Zhiqiang and the three children Ma Mingxuan, Ma Mingzhe, and Ma Yuxin, and the family sat together for breakfast. The children were full of anticipation for going to grandma's house and wearing new clothes. The second child, Ma Mingzhe, had a good appetite and ate a few extra pieces of fried rice cake.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tidy up the house.
description: After breakfast, Ma Xiulan quickly cleared the dishes, wiped the table, and swept the floor. She put the leftover dumplings in the refrigerator and put away the pan-fried rice cakes as a snack for the second child. She organized the toys the children had left scattered the night before, making sure the house was tidy and ready for the new year.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Packing pickled radish into jars and labeling them
description: Ma Xiulan brought out the jar of pickled radish she had prepared. Using clean chopsticks, she drained the liquid from the pickled radish strips and neatly packed them into 8 glass jars, pressing them down and leaving a little space at the top. With a writing brush, she wrote 'Ma Xiulan's hand-made pickled radish, Yisi Year Spring Festival' on small red paper and pasted it onto the jars. For the two jars she kept at home, she pasted the character 'Fu' (blessing). Her youngest daughter, Ma Yuxin, watched curiously and helped put the empty jars back in the cupboard. The 8 jars of pickled vegetables were lined up on the counter, full of New Year's atmosphere.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Putting Up Spring Festival Couplets to Decorate the Home
description: The whole family pitched in to decorate the house. Ma Zhiqiang moved the ladder, the eldest son Ma Mingxuan steadied it, the second son Ma Mingzhe handed over tape and scissors, and the youngest daughter Ma Yuxin directed. Ma Xiulan and her husband put up Spring Festival couplets on the front door, pasted the "fu" character upside down, and hung red lanterns under the corridor eaves. Ma Mingxuan stuck paper window decorations on the living room glass, and sunlight showed red shadows through them. The home looked brand new and full of New Year atmosphere.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Simple lunch
description: At noon, Ma Xiulan steamed some rice and stir-fried three dishes: scrambled eggs with tomatoes, lamb slices stir-fried with scallions (using the lamb bought yesterday), and sautéed baby bok choy. She also opened a jar of pickled radish for everyone to taste. The family said the pickled radish was just right in saltiness and had a nice chewy texture. After the meal, Ma Xiulan urged the children to take a nap or play, while she and her husband washed the dishes and checked the gifts to take to her parents' home.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare to visit her parents' home and change into new clothes
description: Ma Xiulan tied four jars of soy-pickled radish with red string and packed them together with the apples and oranges her husband had brought back. She took out the new clothes she had bought for the children from the cabinet, helped Ma Yuxin change into a red wool skirt, helped Ma Mingzhe change into a blue tracksuit, and her eldest son Ma Mingxuan put on his gray padded jacket himself. Ma Xiulan also changed into a maroon wool sweater, checked the keys, phone, cash, and red envelopes in her shoulder bag, and when everything was ready, she rested on the sofa for a moment and had the family get ready to go out.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Walk to her parents' home.
description: At a little after 2 p.m., the family dressed neatly and went out. Ma Zhiqiang carried apples and oranges, Ma Mingxuan held two bundles of pickled radish, Ma Xiulan held Ma Yuxin's hand, and Ma Mingzhe hopped ahead. They walked west along Jingwen Road and turned onto Shengli Avenue. The winter sun was warm. On the way, they met neighbors putting up Spring Festival couplets and exchanged blessings. After about thirty minutes, they arrived at the gate of the parents' home.
location: Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin to Shengli Street

name: Getting together with sisters to make dumplings.
description: When they arrived at her parents' home, her parents Li Xiuying and Ma Jianguo, eldest sister Li Xiuyun's family, and younger sister Ma Xiufen's family were all already there. The courtyard was lively, and the children were playing in the living room under the lead of her father. Ma Xiulan, Li Xiuyun, and Ma Xiufen went into the kitchen, where their mother had already kneaded the dough and was letting it rest. The eldest sister chopped the pork and cabbage filling, the younger sister cut scallions and ginger, and Ma Xiulan was in charge of making fancy dumplings in shapes like crescent moons, wheat ears, and small buns. The three sisters chatted about family life while working. The eldest sister said her niece Yingchun was doing well in junior high school, and the younger sister said a new park had opened in Binhai New Area. The kitchen was steaming and filled with laughter.
location: No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Chinese New Year's Eve reunion dinner
description: At six in the evening, the New Year's Eve dinner was laid out on the big round table. The dishes were abundant: the soy-braised beef, marinated chicken feet, and assorted vegetables prepared by her mother; the red-braised fish from her eldest sister; the roast duck from her younger sister; Ma Xiulan's soy-pickled radish; and freshly cooked dumplings. Her father, Ma Jianguo, raised his glass and offered blessings, wishing the whole family peace and health. Everyone raised their glasses in celebration, and the children drank soft drinks. Ma Xiulan watched her parents' busy figures and the white hair at their temples, and felt a pang of sadness, deciding to spend more time with them in the future. During the meal, they picked up food for one another and chatted about amusing moments from the Spring Festival Gala, filling the room with a warm atmosphere.
location: No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Watching the Spring Festival Gala and staying up to see the New Year in
description: After the meal, the whole family gathered in the living room to watch the Spring Festival Gala. The children played with building blocks on the mat while the adults watched the show and chatted. The sketches brought bursts of laughter. Ma Xiulan leaned against her husband, feeling the fatigue of the year melt away. Near midnight, the sound of firecrackers grew louder, and the family went to the yard to watch fireworks. Colorful fireworks lit up the night sky, and the children screamed with excitement. As the midnight bell rang, Ma Xiulan made her New Year wish.
location: No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Ended the New Year's Eve vigil and settled down for sleep.
description: After the midnight program, the children were sleepy, and their mother called everyone to rest. Ma Xiulan, along with her eldest sister and younger sister, settled the three children into the guest room beds. She washed her face and, though her shoulders were sore, felt content inside. Then the three sisters squeezed into their mother's bedroom, chatted like they did when they were young, and fell peacefully asleep amid their drowsiness.
location: No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning stretching and the whole family washing up
description: On the morning of Chinese New Year's Day, Ma Xiulan woke up at her parents' home. Using the light filtering in through the curtain gap, she did 5 minutes of shoulder and neck stretches to ease the soreness from staying up late. Then she gently woke the three children, Mingxuan, Mingzhe, and Yuxin, and put a new red sweater on Mingzhe, who was reluctant to get out of bed. The family of five squeezed into the bathroom, where she helped Yuxin comb two braids. The sound of water and laughter mixed together in a lively New Year atmosphere.
location: Parents' home bedroom and bathroom, 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The whole family eats dumplings on the first day of the Lunar New Year
description: The square table in the main room was covered with pork and cabbage dumplings made by her mother Li Xiuying, and the whole family sat around it. Father Ma Jianguo said a few auspicious words, the children ate happily, and Ma Xiulan chatted with her eldest sister Li Xiuyun and younger sister Ma Xiufen about the Spring Festival Gala while eating. The atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: Dining room at parents' home, No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Elder sister privately gave money and kept track of accounts.
description: After eating dumplings, the eldest sister, Li Xiuyun, quietly pulled Ma Xiulan into a corner of the kitchen and pressed 500 yuan into her hand, urging her to buy new clothes for the children and not to tell their father. Ma Xiulan felt warm at heart and accepted it after declining a few times. She immediately took out her pocket ledger, neatly wrote 1/29 sister's kindness 500 yuan, and drew a small heart.
location: Kitchen corner at her parents' home, 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Walk home and organize the bookkeeping
description: Ma Xiulan's family of five said goodbye to her parents and sisters and walked back home along Shengli Street. The children excitedly discussed lucky money, and Ma Xiulan told them not to spend it recklessly. After arriving home, she first put the 500 yuan given by her eldest sister into the iron box in the bedroom cabinet. Then she took out the ledger, recorded the gift under "other income" and noted "for children's education fund." She also carefully checked the scattered expenses for New Year shopping and firecrackers from New Year's Eve to that day, confirming that they had not exceeded the budget.
location: Own home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Packing New Year gifts and sending New Year voice messages
description: Ma Xiulan went to the backyard and moved out the 8 sealed jars of pickled radish. She picked the two jars with the best appearance as gifts for her uncle. She found a red gift bag, put the pickled radish in it, then added her home-made candy and peanuts, tied the bag, and checked the sealing rubber ring. Afterward, she sent Aunt Wang Guilan, who lives across the hall, a voice message on WeChat to wish her a happy New Year and ask whether she was going to her daughter's place in the afternoon, agreeing to catch up when she returned. Then she tidied up the nutshells on the living room coffee table.
location: Her own kitchen and living room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Supervised the children doing their winter vacation homework.
description: Ma Xiulan had the three children do their winter homework in the living room: Mingxuan worked on math problems, Mingzhe wrote new characters, and Yuxin doodled beside them. While she trimmed vegetables, she kept an eye on them. When Mingxuan came across a difficult problem, she went over and worked through it with him, offering guidance.
location: Home living room at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Simple lunch and rest after the meal.
description: Because they had to go out for New Year visits in the afternoon, Ma Xiulan used the leftover braised fish pieces and soy-sauce beef brought back from her parents' home on Lunar New Year's Eve to cook dried noodles into a hot noodle soup, and called the three children to sit around and eat lunch. After the meal, the children watched TV in the living room. Yuxin curled up on the sofa with a plush toy, Mingzhe changed channels looking for cartoons, and Mingxuan played with his new pencil case. Ma Xiulan sat nearby resting while thinking about what to talk about at the maternal uncle's home that afternoon.
location: Home kitchen, dining room, and living room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Went to my maternal uncle's home to pay a New Year's call.
description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan got the children into their coats, zipped up Mingzhe's down jacket, straightened Yuxin's red woolen skirt, and changed into a dark red padded jacket herself, neatening her hair. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang placed two jars of pickled radish and two boxes of pastries on the entryway cabinet, and she checked again that the gifts were intact. The family of five walked to the bus stop on Jingwen Road and boarded a bus heading toward Jinghai Town. The children pressed against the windows watching the street scenes. About 30 minutes later, they got off at Hongxing Community Neighborhood Center stop. When they arrived at her uncle's home, the three children greeted them in unison with New Year blessings. Her uncle and aunt received them happily. Ma Xiulan handed over the gifts and specially opened the pickled radish for everyone to taste. Her cousin's wife praised her skill and asked about the pickling method, and she briefly shared it. The adults sat in the living room drinking tea and chatting, while the children compared their lucky money in the corner. Mingxuan got 100 yuan and Mingzhe got 150 yuan, and the scene was lively. It was not until the sky had darkened that the family got up to say goodbye. Her uncle and aunt saw them to the door and told them to be safe.
location: Uncle's home, Room 201, Building 3, Neighborhood Home, Hongxing Residential Community, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Returning to her own home and preparing dinner
description: After saying goodbye to her uncle, Ma Xiulan's family walked to the Hongxing Community Neighborhood Center stop and took the bus back. The children were tired from playing and a little sleepy; Mingzhe leaned against his father and yawned. It took about 30 minutes to reach Jingwen Road Station. After getting home, Ma Xiulan immediately started preparing dinner. She used the leftover dumpling filling in the fridge, kneaded dough, rolled wrappers, and wrapped more than sixty cabbage-and-pork dumplings. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang helped by peeling garlic and mixing the vinegar dipping sauce. Steam rose in the kitchen, a scene of solid, homely warmth.
location: Own home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The whole family eats dinner
description: The family of five sat around the table eating steaming hot dumplings. Ma Xiulan asked the children about interesting things at their maternal uncle's house that afternoon. Mingzhe spoke animatedly about comparing New Year's money, and Yuxin said the candy from their aunt was very sweet. After the meal, Ma Xiulan and Zhiqiang cleared the dishes together.
location: Home restaurant, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening stretching, watching TV, and a family call
description: After a busy day, Ma Xiulan felt tightness in her shoulders, neck, and lower back, so she conscientiously did 10 minutes of stretching in front of the coffee table, moving her shoulders, neck, and waist, and felt much lighter. Then the whole family sat on the sofa watching the Spring Festival special program on TV. Crosstalk, skits, and songs and dances made the children laugh, while Mingxuan was more interested in the phone red packets. During a break in the program, she walked to the balcony and called her younger sister Ma Xiufen, asking with concern whether she had arrived home safely and whether there was traffic on the way. After learning that her sister had arrived home safely in the afternoon, she felt relieved, chatted a bit about everyday life, and agreed to video call in a couple of days.
location: Home living room and balcony, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Before bed: keep accounts and wash up.
description: Ma Xiulan returned to the bedroom, took out her account book, recorded the 25 yuan she spent on snacks that day in the expense column, and checked the record of her sister's gift money. The day's accounts were neat and clear, which made her feel at ease. Then she took her change of clothes to the bathroom to wash up and carefully applied face cream.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Settling the children down and going to bed
description: After washing up, Ma Xiulan went to the children's bedroom to check whether they had finished washing up, helped Yuxin tuck in her quilt, and told Mingxuan and Mingzhe not to play on their phones for too long. Once the children settled down, she returned to the master bedroom, dimmed the bedside lamp, and got into bed, recalling the warm moments of the day—the older sister's care, the praise from the uncle's family, the cozy feeling of the whole family sitting together—and fell into a deep sleep with contentment.
location: Her own bedroom at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning preparation and breakfast
description: In the early morning, Ma Xiulan woke up and first did some shoulder and neck stretches in bed to relieve the previous day's fatigue, then got up refreshed. She woke the three children one by one, urged them to wash up, put a red woolen skirt on her youngest daughter Yuxin, checked the tag on Mingzhe's new tracksuit, and urged Mingxuan to change into his padded jacket. Then she went to the kitchen to cook pork and cabbage dumplings and millet porridge, and the family sat together to enjoy a simple, warm breakfast.
location: Tianjin, Jinghai District, 156 Jingwen Road, various rooms and kitchen at home

name: Set off for his parents' home
description: After breakfast, Ma Xiulan and her husband Ma Zhiqiang checked and packed the gifts for visiting her parents' home — preserved radish, candy gift boxes, and new tea — and tidied up the family's appearance. The family set out from their home on Jingwen Road with gifts in hand and walked to her parents' home on Shengli Street. On the way they met their neighbor Wang Guilan, and they exchanged warm New Year greetings; the children also greeted her sweetly. The sun was mild and the street was full of festive New Year atmosphere.
location: Along the route from No. 156 Jingwen Road to No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Reunion and lunch at parents' home
description: After arriving at her parents' home, her father Ma Jianguo was already looking out from the doorway. The three children ran forward to greet him with New Year wishes, and Ma Xiulan and Zhiqiang also offered their blessings. Her mother Li Xiuying took the gifts, and the whole family gathered in the living room to chat. The children compared new clothes and talked about lucky money, while Zhiqiang and his father chatted about hauling work. Then Li Xiuying cooked a hearty lunch, with Ma Xiulan and her younger sister Ma Xiufen alongside kneading dough, rolling wrappers, peeling scallions, and chopping garlic, chatting as they worked about their plan to take the children to Jinghai Park the following week. At noon, the whole family sat together to enjoy Tianjin baozi, noodles with gravy sauce, and sweet and sour pork tenderloin, in a warm and harmonious atmosphere.
location: No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin; the living room, kitchen and dining room at her parents' home

name: After-dinner family time and farewells
description: After lunch, her father Ma Jianguo gave red envelopes with lucky money to his three grandchildren. While Ma Xiulan chatted with her father, she noticed that the white hair at his temples had increased and his back was more stooped. A wave of sadness rose in her heart, and she held his hand tightly, promising to bring the children back every week from now on. Afterwards, the family said goodbye at the door. Ma Xiulan and her younger sister Ma Xiufen took out their phones to check the calendar and agreed to bring the children to the west gate of Jinghai Park at 2 p.m. next Monday (February 3).
location: Parents' home living room and doorway, 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Returning home and making family plans
description: The family walked home along the same route, with the children discussing lucky money and the park trip next week. Ma Xiulan and Zhiqiang walked behind, feeling very much at ease. After arriving home, Ma Xiulan rested for a while, then sat down at the desk and wrote on the Family Plan page of her notebook: visit her parents' home at least once or twice a week, buy her father his favorite jasmine tea every month, check her parents' regular medications, and so on.
location: Along the route from 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin to 156 Jingwen Road, as well as the living room and study at home

name: Virtual New Year greetings and household tidying
description: At her desk, Ma Xiulan used her phone to send a Chinese New Year greeting via WeChat to her eldest sister Li Xiuyun, who lives in Beijing, wishing her a happy new year. Then she confirmed the details of next week's park outing with her younger sister Ma Xiufen, deciding to bring a kite and snacks. Afterwards, she put away the miscellaneous items brought back from home, hung up the children's jackets, cleared the fruit peels from the living room coffee table, and restored the house to order.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, at the desk at home and around the living room.

name: Prepare and enjoy dinner
description: Because lunch was hearty, Ma Xiulan decided to make a light dinner. She used the leftover cabbage and vermicelli to make stewed cabbage with vermicelli, steamed a bowl of tender egg custard, and sliced a plate of pickled radish brought back from her parents' home. When the food was served, Ma Zhiqiang helped carry the dishes. The family enjoyed dinner in a relaxed manner, and Mingzhe drank two bowls of porridge in a row.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Help the children with their studies.
description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan urged the three children to do their winter vacation homework. Mingxuan voluntarily worked on math problems, Mingzhe wrote new characters under his mother's watchful eye, and Yuxin drew pictures nearby. Ma Xiulan checked Mingxuan's math homework and pointed out calculation errors, watched Mingzhe finish two lines of writing, then helped Yuxin plan tomorrow's drawing schedule.
location: Living room and children's rooms at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tidying up and relaxing stretches
description: Ma Xiulan cleared away the dishes and wiped the kitchen clean. Then she went to the living room and, following a video on her phone, did a set of evening stretches for about ten minutes, stretching the day's tension from her body and feeling relaxed all over.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, kitchen and living room at home

name: Family entertainment time
description: The family gathered on the living room sofa to watch a rerun of the Spring Festival Gala skits, and the children were kept laughing out loud. Ma Xiulan and her husband Ma Zhiqiang chatted while watching about taking the children to the park next week, enjoying a warm and happy evening together.
location: Living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Children's evening wash-up and bedtime settling
description: Ma Xiulan helped her youngest daughter Yuxin wash her face, brush her teeth, and wash her feet, then changed her into pajamas. At Yuxin's request, she told her the story of "Little Red Riding Hood." Yuxin fell asleep peacefully before the story was finished.
location: No. 156, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin: the bathroom and Yuxin's room at home

name: Evening personal activities and going to bed
description: After settling the children, Ma Xiulan washed up and soaked her feet. Returning to the bedroom, she took out her account book to record the day's expenses and confirmed that income and expenses were balanced. Then she leaned against the headboard and scrolled on her phone for a few minutes, checking the New Year greetings in the family group chat. She turned off the light and fell asleep, entering a dream with a steady sense of hope for the future.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; home bathroom and bedroom

name: Morning stretching and teaching her husband healthy methods
description: Today I got up a little later than usual. When I stretched my shoulders and neck on the living room carpet, it felt especially comfortable. My husband Ma Zhiqiang happened to get up to pour some water, so I pulled him over and taught him a few moves. I said that since he drives a big truck every day, his neck was like an iron plate, and told him to follow along. He learned clumsily, but after doing the shoulder roll twice, he said his neck felt a bit looser. I told him to do a few minutes of simple exercises every day before leaving for work from now on, and take this chance to prevent cervical spondylosis. He agreed, and I was glad to see it.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home)

name: Prepare breakfast for the family
description: She reheated the pork and scallion buns brought back from her parents' home yesterday, cooked a pot of cornmeal porridge, and boiled three free-range eggs. She shredded the old pickled mustard tuber from the fridge and drizzled a little sesame oil over it. While bustling about, she was thinking about getting the accounts in order today, mulling it over in her mind.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home)

name: The family had breakfast together and shared their holiday plans.
description: The family sat around the table and ate heartily, enjoying warm porridge and steamed buns. I told the kids that we had arranged with their aunt yesterday to meet at the west gate of Jinghai Park at 2 p.m. next Monday (February 3) and take them out for some fun. As soon as the three children heard this, they burst into excitement. Yuxin clapped her hands and said she wanted to see the ducks, Mingzhe shouted that he wanted to go skateboarding, and Mingxuan urged the two of them to hurry up and finish their winter vacation homework. The house was lively and cheerful.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home)

name: Whole-family spring cleaning on the fourth day of the Lunar New Year
description: After the meal, seeing the melon seed shells and candy wrappers on the living room floor, I immediately started directing everyone. Mingxuan swept the floor, Mingzhe put the misplaced chairs back in place, and Yuxin wiped the coffee table with her little cloth. I tied up the trash bags that had accumulated over the past few days in the kitchen and entryway, and had Zhiqiang take them to the community dumpster on his way. The whole family worked swiftly, and in less than half an hour the house was neat and tidy again.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home)

name: In-depth housework: washing, drying, and organizing
description: She sorted the duvet covers, sheets, and the coats the children had worn once, which had been taken off during the thorough cleaning, into the washing machine by type. Taking advantage of this free time, she tidied up the scattered winter vacation homework and extracurricular books on Mingxuan's desk, then went to the second bedroom to pick up the LEGO pieces Mingzhe had thrown all over the floor and put them back in the box. Only when every corner of the house looked pleasant did she feel at ease.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home)

name: Tending to the houseplants and checking the backyard
description: The washing machine was still running, so I went to the living room and watered the pots of pothos and clivia, wiping their leaves until they shone. Out of habit, I also checked the small vegetable garden in the backyard. In winter the ground is bare; I pulled up a few dead weeds, walked a lap along the courtyard wall, and checked whether the iron fence gate was loose—it will need reinforcing when spring comes.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home)

name: Call parents to greet them and plan a visit
description: After settling the housework, I sat on the sofa and called my parents' home. My mother Li Xiuying answered. We chatted about what they had eaten today, and I asked if her back still hurt. I said I was free the day after tomorrow, February 2, in the afternoon and wanted to bring the children back for a visit and also have a face-to-face chat with my father. Mother readily agreed, saying the food was already prepared at home and she was looking forward to our visit. We said we'd confirm the exact time later. After hanging up, I felt warm inside.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home)

name: Prepare and enjoy a simple lunch.
description: It was getting late, so she started to prepare lunch. She took half a napa cabbage and a piece of frozen tofu out of the fridge and stewed them in a big pot with vermicelli. She also stir-fried a plate of eggs and sliced a plate of the pickled radish brought back yesterday. She heated up the flower rolls, and lunch was ready. The family ate and chatted; Zhiqiang said he would stay home and rest in the afternoon instead of going out.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home)

name: Lunch break and quiet alone time
description: After lunch, I told the three children to each go back to their own rooms and not make a loud noise. I spread a blanket on the living room sofa and dozed for half an hour. After waking up, I drank a few sips of warm water, felt refreshed, and began to plan in my mind how to sort out the accounts later.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home)

name: January Financial Review
description: The children were quiet. I made a cup of tea and sat down at the dining table. I took out the account book and calculator, and also opened the bookkeeping app on my phone, carefully checking and categorizing every income and expense from January 2 to today. With a pen, I wrote on a scratch sheet: Income — embroidery part-time work 150 yuan, elder sister's gift 500 yuan, Zhiqiang's salary in the twelfth lunar month 2,800 yuan; Expenses — New Year goods and new clothes 482 yuan, daily food and miscellaneous expenses about 600 yuan, Zhiqiang's cigarette money 210 yuan, education savings deposit 500 yuan (January 10), other odds and ends about 65 yuan. After adding and subtracting, I calculated that this month's balance was about 1,093 yuan. Looking at that number, I felt more confident — I managed to get through this month after all.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home)

name: Made the February budget and brewed some tea to rest.
description: After the review, I began to plan next month's budget in my head. I took out the account book and wrote a few lines on the flyleaf: 'February new plan: education fixed deposit 150 yuan; Zhiqiang's cigarette money capped at 10 yuan per day; keep daily groceries and other expenses within 600 yuan.' After writing it, I felt a little lighter in the shoulders. I got up, went to the kitchen to refill my cup of hot water, and stretched my shoulders and waist that had been sitting for a long time.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home)

name: Brief chat with neighbor Sister Wang
description: I walked to the door with a cup of water to get some fresh air and happened to see Sister Wang Guilan next door coming out to sweep up the firecracker paper on the ground. I called out, 'Sister Wang, how was the New Year?' She said cheerfully, 'Not bad. The relatives have almost all left, so I only got free this afternoon.' We chatted across the courtyard wall for about ten minutes about household matters. She said her daughter would be returning to her parents' home the day after tomorrow, and I also said I would go back to my mother's home the day after tomorrow. After that, I went inside to prepare dinner.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home)

name: Preparing dinner for the family
description: I went back to the kitchen and started bustling around. I took out several pieces of pre-fried hairtail fish and re-fried them in a skillet until the skin was golden and crispy. Then I cut up a head of Chinese cabbage and stir-fried it with the vinegar-tossed method, and finally made a pot of tomato and egg soup. Zhiqiang came in and helped me carry the dishes to the table.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home)

name: The whole family enjoys dinner together
description: The family sat together, eating, drinking, chatting, and laughing. The kids loved the fried hairtail, and Zhiqiang praised the vinegar-sauced cabbage for being flavorful. Watching them eat so happily filled me with contentment. At the dinner table I didn't bring up money; I planned to wait until after the meal when the children had scattered to discuss it with Zhiqiang in detail.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home)

name: Discussing the February budget with my husband
description: The children scattered to watch TV. I pulled Zhiqiang over to sit in the living room and spread open the ledger I had reviewed that afternoon for him to see. Pointing at the 'cigarette money' item, I said, 'Look, this month this part came to 210 yuan, more than you said yourself. Next month we need to set a hard limit: 10 yuan a day, not even a pack a day. OK?' Zhiqiang thought for a moment and was about to speak when I added, 'You could save more than a hundred yuan a month. Wouldn't it be nice to use that money to buy Mingxuan a reference book?' He paused, listened, and finally nodded. 'Fine, I'll listen to you. I'll try to cut down.' I went on, 'Now that it's winter and there are few odd jobs, let's lower our monthly fixed deposit from 500 to 150, and save the money first. When spring comes and I can take on work again, we'll adjust it back.' He had no objection. On the flyleaf of the ledger, I wrote down the final budget we had agreed on, feeling that family matters were finally back on track.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home)

name: Family entertainment: drawing and watching TV with the children
description: After we finished discussing things, I relaxed. Yuxin took out her crayons and drew. I sat beside her and watched her draw a big, lopsided rabbit, and praised her for drawing well. Mingxuan and Mingzhe were building a house with blocks on the carpet, occasionally roughhousing. Zhiqiang called out, "Stop messing around, play nicely!" The TV was on in the room, the sound mixing with the children's laughter, and the New Year atmosphere hadn't faded yet.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home)

name: Coaxed the children into washing up and going to bed.
description: The TV drama was almost over, so I started getting the children to wash up and go to bed. First I helped Yuxin wash her face and brush her teeth, carried her to her little bed, and told her a three-minute story about a little bear looking for honey. She hugged her little bear and soon fell asleep. Then I went to urge Mingzhe and Mingxuan: "Stop reading, go wash up and go to bed. We have to get up early tomorrow." The two children answered and obediently went to wash up.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home)

name: Wash up alone and finish the bookkeeping
description: After the children were all settled, I went and took a hot bath. Back in the master bedroom, I opened the ledger and added the few yuan of small expenses for buying flour and sugar for dinner, then updated it on the mobile app as well. After confirming the accounts were correct, I leaned against the headboard and watched a short video on my phone about how to pickle cucumbers, thinking that when spring came and the cucumbers grew in the small vegetable garden, I would be able to make it myself.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home)

name: Evening stretching and bedtime
description: Before bed, I called Zhiqiang over, and the two of us did a few simple pre-sleep stretches on the bed to loosen up our muscles. Before turning off the light, I said to Zhiqiang, "Now that the accounts are sorted out, I feel much more at ease. If our family lives well together, life will surely get better and better." Zhiqiang held my hand and said, "Mm, you've worked hard." We both closed our eyes peacefully in the dark and slowly fell asleep.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home)

name: Morning stretching and organizing the camera
description: Early on the morning of the fourth day of Chinese New Year, Ma Xiulan got up quietly after the alarm rang. She first did a five-minute full-body stretch in bed, rotating her neck, stretching her sides, and bending to touch her toes, and felt her body get slightly warm. Then she went to the storage room in the backyard to find the digital camera her husband had taken back to settle a debt. She wiped the lens, found it low on battery, and plugged it in to charge in the living room. Then she turned on the old computer, checked the family album folder, formatted the memory card, and sorted the photos of the children's winter vacation homework for later use.
location: Ma Xiulan's bedroom, storage cabinet, and living room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Wake up the whole family and urge everyone to get ready.
description: After heating water, Ma Xiulan went from room to room waking the three children. Mingzhe lingered in bed and was hurried along when she pulled off his blanket; Xinxin was well-behaved; Mingxuan had already washed up on his own. She braided her daughter's hair, helped her son find new clothes, and repeatedly reminded everyone of the New Year visiting etiquette, making sure the whole family was full of energy and ready to set out.
location: Morning Baduanjin practice.

name: The whole family has breakfast.
description: Reheated yesterday's leftover baozi and mantou, served with pickled cucumbers and soy-pickled radish, and made cornmeal porridge. The family sat around eating breakfast. Ma Xiulan, while peeling an egg for Xinxin, once again emphasized the New Year visiting rules: greet people happily, don't rummage through cabinets, accept red envelopes with both hands and say thank you. The children nodded in agreement.
location: Ma Xiulan's home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Check the gifts, change clothes, and set out
description: Ma Xiulan covered the gift box of three jars of pickled radish with a red cloth and put it into a carrying bag. She changed into a red down jacket and told her husband to change into a decent coat. After the children put on their shoes, she checked the doors, windows, and gas one last time, locked the door, and led the family out to pay New Year's greetings at her uncle's home.
location: Foyer and living room of Ma Xiulan's home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Took the bus to my maternal uncle's house.
description: The family of five walked along Jingwen Road to the Jinghai District bus terminal, took bus No. 2, got off at Jianshe Road Intersection Station after 6 stops, and walked to the entrance of their maternal uncle's building. On the bus, the children excitedly discussed what to do with the red envelope money, and Ma Xiulan reminded them of the etiquette for meeting relatives.
location: Jianshe Road Intersection Station, Bus Route 2, Jinghai District Bus Terminal, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (intersection of Jingwen Road and Shengli Street)

name: New Year visit to maternal uncle's home and tasting soy-pickled radish
description: Arrived at Uncle Li Guohua's home. The children offered New Year greetings in unison, and Aunt distributed red envelopes. Ma Xiulan presented a gift box of homemade pickled radish. Aunt opened a jar on the spot and sliced it onto a plate; after tasting it, relatives were full of praise. Cousin-in-law Zhang Min and older female cousin Li Yue placed orders for 3 jars and 5 jars respectively, and asked about storage methods. Ma Xiulan helped serve tea and arrange fruit, and watched over the children as they played.
location: Uncle Li Guohua's living room and dining room, 58 Jianshe Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Having lunch at her maternal uncle's home
description: Aunt and cousin prepared a rich lunch: braised pork ribs, steamed sea bass, stir-fried greens, and sliced soy-pickled radish. During the meal, her uncle praised Ma Xiulan for being a good household manager and raising her children well, and her husband agreed. While eating, she took care of the children, helped her aunt clear the empty plates, and served soup to Xinxin. The atmosphere was warm.
location: Uncle Li Guohua's dining room, No. 58 Jianshe Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Said goodbye to the uncle's family and took a car to go home.
description: After a half-hour rest following the meal, Ma Xiulan got up to take her leave. Her aunt and Li Yue helped pack up the remaining gift boxes and gave them some jujube paste rice cakes. The family walked to the bus stop at Jianshe Road intersection, waited 8 minutes for the bus, and took Route 2 back; the children were gradually getting sleepy. They got off at Jingwen Road Station and walked home.
location: No. 58 Jianshe Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, Jianshe Road Intersection Bus Stop, Bus No. 2, Jingwen Road Station, No. 156 Jingwen Road.

name: Taking photos of the children for records
description: After getting home, Ma Xiulan took out the fully charged camera and called the three children together for a group photo in a sunny spot in the yard, with the sago palm as the background. She directed their smiles and took retakes. Then she imported the photos to the computer, named them, and saved them to the February folder in the Family Album for easy searching later.
location: Ma Xiulan's courtyard and living room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Lunch break and side business plan record.
description: Ma Xiulan returned to the master bedroom to rest for half an hour, thinking about ways to improve the pickled radish. After waking up, she used her account book in the study to record the purchase intentions of Zhang Min and Li Yue (quantities, phone numbers, and delivery times), and listed possible improvements such as adding chili oil and adjusting the sweet-and-sour ratio. Then she used her phone to watch videos on handmade pickled vegetables to learn techniques and weighed the feasibility of starting a family side business.
location: Bedroom and study of Ma Xiulan's home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare dinner and discuss the side business.
description: Ma Xiulan tied on an apron, cut the cabbage, and soaked the vermicelli to prepare ingredients for stewed tofu. When her husband came into the kitchen, she shared how the pickled radish had been well received by relatives and suggested turning it into a family sideline business. Zhiqiang expressed support but reminded her to calculate the costs first. Mingxuan came over to ask an English question, and she dried her hands and helped him with a few multiple-choice questions.
location: Kitchen and living room of Ma Xiulan's home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Making dinner
description: Ma Xiulan cooked cabbage stewed with tofu and vermicelli, simmering slowly over low heat to bring out the flavor; she also stir-fried eggs with tomatoes, which looked appealing; she sliced pickled radish and arranged it into a petal-shaped cold dish. In between, she found time to wash the lunch dishes and wipe down the stove. Xinxin was attracted by the aroma, and Ma Xiulan picked up a piece of tofu for her to taste.
location: Kitchen at Ma Xiulan's home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The whole family eats dinner
description: At dinner, the pickled radish was a big hit, and Mingzhe kept taking piece after piece. Ma Xiulan reminded everyone to eat a balanced diet. During the meal they discussed the plan to visit grandma's home the next day to pay New Year's greetings, and decided to bring the newly taken photos and a jar of pickled radish. Xinxin looked forward to playing with grandma, and the atmosphere was relaxed.
location: Ma Xiulan's home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Clean up the kitchen and have parent-child playtime.
description: Ma Xiulan cleared the dishes, wiped the stove, and swept the floor, while Zhiqiang helped take out the trash. Then she accompanied the children in the living room watching TV, changed the channel to cartoons for Xinxin, and as they watched, she re-braided Xinxin's hair and put in a barrette. Mingxuan came over to ask about a word problem. She guided him to read the problem and draw a diagram. When he finally solved it, the child cheered.
location: Kitchen and living room of Ma Xiulan's home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Supervise son's winter vacation homework.
description: Turning off the TV, Ma Xiulan had Mingzhe and Mingxuan do their homework under the desk lamp in the study. She supervised Mingzhe as he reviewed formulas and corrected two calculation mistakes, and praised Mingxuan for being serious about his vocabulary dictation. Xinxin was drawing in the living room, with Zhiqiang keeping her company and complimenting her. Every 15 minutes she checked their progress to make sure studying was efficient.
location: Ma Xiulan's home study and living room coffee table, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Help the daughter wash up and soothe her to sleep.
description: Ma Xiulan fetched warm water to wash Xinxin's face and feet and changed her into pajamas. Sitting by the bed, she told the story Little Rabbit Be Good, gently patted her back, and hummed a nursery rhyme. After her daughter fell asleep, she quietly closed the door and left.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at Ma Xiulan's home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Personal hygiene.
description: Ma Xiulan washed her face and brushed her teeth, applied face cream, and soaked her feet in warm water to warm up. She neatened her appearance in the mirror, hung up clothes, tidied the bedroom briefly, and prepared for bed.
location: Bathroom of Ma Xiulan's home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Record the plan for pickled radish and pre-bedtime stretching
description: Leaning against the headboard, Ma Xiulan copied down clearly the reservation information and contact details for her cousin's wife Zhang Min (3 jars, to be picked up before the Lantern Festival) and her older female cousin Li Yue (5 jars, not urgent). She listed the key improvements for the pickled radish: less salt, slightly spicy, keep it crisp, and try green radish. She also planned to first make a trial batch of 5 jars to give to relatives and friends for tasting, and considered expanding the vegetable market channel through her neighbor Wang Guilan. After closing the notebook, she did 5 minutes of supine leg and waist stretches, turned off the light, thought back on the fulfilling day, and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Bedroom at Ma Xiulan's home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning stretching and waking the family
description: Early in the morning, Ma Xiulan did a 5-minute full-body stretch on her bed in the bedroom, from her shoulders and neck to her lower back and legs. She still felt some stiffness in her shoulders, but it was slightly better than yesterday. After stretching, she woke up her husband Ma Zhiqiang and the three children Mingxuan, Mingzhe, and Yuxin one by one, getting ready for the trip to grandma's house for Po Wu. The children quickly got up, excited about the New Year.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Making Po Wu dumplings, breakfast, and cleaning up and preparing
description: Ma Xiulan was busy making jiaozi for the fifth day of the Lunar New Year in her own kitchen. She used the prepared minced pork and Chinese cabbage to make the filling, kneaded dough, rolled wrappers, and wrapped the dumplings, while millet porridge simmered on the stove. After the dumplings came out of the pot, the whole family sat around the dining table to eat breakfast. Ma Zhiqiang praised the delicious dumplings, and the children ate happily. Little Yuxin tried to pick up a dumpling with chopsticks, making everyone laugh. After the meal, Ma Xiulan quickly cleaned up the dishes and chopsticks, took out the prepared pickled radish and nut gift boxes from the cabinet, tied them with red string, put the notebook recording her recipe ideas into a cloth bag, and everything was ready to leave for her mother's house.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Going to mother's house, discussing the pickled vegetable side business, and family lunch
description: The family of five walked from their home on Jingwen Road to her mother's home on Shengli Avenue. The children played and laughed ahead, while Ma Xiulan and her husband chatted as they walked. After arriving, the children paid New Year's greetings to their maternal grandparents. Ma Xiulan helped her mother Li Xiuying prepare vegetables and tidy up, and recounted in detail how her cousins' wives at her uncle's house had been interested in the pickled radish yesterday. The mother and daughter discussed in depth how to improve the recipe for the pickled vegetable side business. Ma Xiulan noted down in her notebook the suggestions to add a spicy flavor and put the chili peppers in last, along with plans for bottling and pricing, and they formally decided to launch the side business. In the meantime, Ma Xiulan found time to send her younger sister Ma Xiufen a WeChat message, arranging to teach her Alipay by video call in the afternoon. At noon, Ma Xiulan cooked stewed pork with cabbage and vermicelli and sliced the pickled radish she had brought. The whole family had lunch with her parents. Ma Jianguo and his son-in-law drank medicinal wine, and the atmosphere was warm.
location: No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Returning home and settling down to study
description: After lunch, Ma Xiulan's family took their leave. The children, carrying the red envelopes and bean paste buns their grandmother had given them, walked back along the same route to their home on Jingwen Road. Once home, Ma Xiulan arranged for the children to play or take an afternoon nap and asked Ma Zhiqiang to keep an eye on them. She put away the things she had brought back, put on her reading glasses, placed the cloth bag containing her notebook on the tea table, and waited for her sister's WeChat message. At 13:50, her sister Ma Xiufen sent a WeChat message. After a brief exchange, Ma Xiulan connected the video call, ready to start learning.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Video learning on installing Alipay, linking it, and practicing simulated operations
description: Under her sister Ma Xiufen's video guidance, Ma Xiulan learned to use Alipay in her living room. She first downloaded the app. Being unfamiliar with the operation, she often tapped the wrong places. Her sister patiently guided her with screenshots, and after nearly an hour and a half, it was finally installed successfully. Then she registered and completed real-name authentication. When it came to linking a bank card, she was extra cautious. Only after repeatedly confirming the security did she take out the bank card she used for buying groceries from her wallet and enter the number digit by digit. She felt at ease only after seeing “Binding successful.” Afterward, she also learned to use the payment QR code and the collection QR code, transferring 1 yuan to her sister and receiving 1 yuan to simulate a payment, truly experiencing the convenience of electronic payment. After hanging up the video call, she excitedly opened various Alipay features by herself to look around, and gained confidence in receiving payments for her pickled vegetables in the future.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare dinner, check homework, and have family dinner.
description: In the kitchen, Ma Xiulan rolled out the leftover dough from noon into wide noodles to prepare hot tomato-egg noodle soup. At the same time, she urged Mingzhe and Yuxin to finish their winter vacation homework and checked Mingxuan's math problems. At dinner, the whole family ate the hot noodle soup and pickled radish brought back from her mother's home in the dining room. Ma Xiulan excitedly shared her side-business plan and joy of learning to use Alipay with her husband. Ma Zhiqiang expressed support, and the children also vied to be little helpers.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening family entertainment time
description: After dinner, Ma Zhiqiang took the initiative to wash the dishes, while Ma Xiulan played cards with the three children in the living room. She took out the old camera charged yesterday to take a group photo of everyone for the fifth day of the Lunar New Year, saying she would put it in the family album. The children jostled for position, laughter never stopped, and the room was filled with a warm and joyful atmosphere.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Help the children wash up and get them to sleep
description: Ma Xiulan began to get the children ready to wash up. She first washed the face and feet of the youngest, Yuxin, carried her to the small bed, and told her the story Little Horse Crossing the River until she fell asleep. Then she checked Mingzhe's tooth brushing and reminded Mingxuan to go to bed early and not to read leisure books. After settling the three children, the house gradually quieted down.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Bookkeeping, organizing pickle recipes, and stretching before bed
description: After the children were sound asleep, Ma Xiulan opened the ledger at the desk in the bedroom and carefully recorded the key points for improving the pickled vegetable recipe discussed with her mother that day: add a spicy flavor by putting fresh small chili peppers in last, sell by the jin or trial-sell in small bottles, use a warm packaging style, etc. She also added the day's expenses. Then she pulled her husband Ma Zhiqiang to do a 5-minute pre-sleep stretch on the carpet, helping each other press their legs to relieve fatigue. Finally, she turned off the light and went to bed, feeling grounded and looking forward to the future.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning stretching exercises
description: Woke up naturally at 6:50 in the morning and first did 5 minutes of full-body stretching in bed, focusing on loosening the shoulders, neck, and waist. Then she woke her husband Ma Zhiqiang and led him through shoulder, neck, and leg stretches. He was stiff but cooperative. The stretching warmed up their bodies, and the two had a relaxed atmosphere.
location: Her own bedroom at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare and enjoy breakfast
description: Ma Xiulan heated steamed buns, cooked millet porridge, sliced pickled radish, and boiled eggs in the kitchen. At 7:35 she and her husband woke the three children to wash up, and at 7:45 the whole family sat down to breakfast. Ma Xiulan told the children to wear thick coats and hats because of the cold weather.
location: Her own kitchen and dining room at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Cleaning up after breakfast and supervising the children's homework.
description: Ma Xiulan cleared the dishes, wiped the table, and washed the dishes while urging the three children to do their winter vacation homework. The oldest, Xuanxuan, worked on a math test paper. The second, Zhezhe, dawdled as he took out his copybook. The youngest daughter, Xinxin, doodled. Ma Xiulan observed the children as she cleaned.
location: Her own kitchen and living room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Sorting out key points for the pickle side-business research
description: Ma Xiulan sat at the desk in the living room, took out her notebook, and systematically thought about the pickled-vegetable side business. She listed target products (spicy radish strips, five-spice pickled cucumber, sweet-and-sour Chinese onions), estimated raw material costs (radish 2 yuan/jin, salt 1 yuan/pack, dried chili 10 yuan/jin), considered sales channels (recommendations from acquaintances, park market, neighbor Zhang Shufen selling on consignment), looked into market entry requirements (consulting the subdistrict office about the food hygiene license), and planned initial output of 10-15 jin per week. Her thinking gradually became clear.
location: Desk in the living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Check children's homework and take a short break
description: Ma Xiulan got up to check the children's homework.
