She pointed out the mistakes in the eldest child's math test paper and had him correct them, criticized the second child's copybook handwriting as sloppy and required one page to be rewritten, and praised her youngest daughter's drawing of a rabbit. She drank some warm water and rested briefly.
location: Own living room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing and making lunchtime noodles with thick gravy
description: Ma Xiulan prepared the ingredients: dried noodles, sliced pork belly, wood ear mushrooms, day lily flowers, eggs, etc. She cut up scallions and ginger, blanched the pork slices, and soaked the dried goods. She stir-fried the pork slices until fragrant, added light soy sauce and water, then put in the wood ear mushrooms and day lily flowers to simmer. She drizzled in beaten egg and thickened it into gravy. In another pot, she cooked the noodles, and stir-fried a plate of seasonal greens. The noodles with gravy smelled delicious.
location: Home kitchen at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The whole family enjoys lunch.
description: The family sat together for lunch. Ma Xiulan served noodles with gravy and stir-fried seasonal vegetables. As they ate and chatted, Ma Xiulan stressed that the children should wear masks and gloves when going out in the afternoon, and her husband reminded the eldest child to be careful crossing the street. The atmosphere was harmonious.
location: Home restaurant, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Clean up the kitchen and take a lunch break
description: After the meal, she cleaned up the dishes, wiped down the stove, and took out the trash. Then she sat on the bed with her eyes closed to rest for 15 minutes, and took the opportunity to check the expense-tracking app on her phone to record the lunch ingredient expense (8 yuan for noodles).
location: Own kitchen and bedroom at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Second son's injury during play and care
description: The second son, Ma Mingzhe, was chasing and playing in the front yard. At 13:40, he accidentally stepped into a frozen mud puddle and fell, scraping his knee and rubbing his palm red. Hearing his cries, Ma Xiulan quickly fetched the first-aid kit, cleaned the wound with iodophor cotton swabs, applied a band-aid, comforted him gently, and taught him to watch where he was going.
location: Own front yard and living room at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Getting ready to go out and walking to Jinghai Park
description: After treating the wound, Ma Xiulan tidied herself up, put on her down jacket, scarf and gloves, took her phone and small bag, and told the oldest child to look after the younger ones. She left home at 14:15, walked 15 minutes along Jingwen Road and Shengli Street, and arrived at the west gate of Jinghai Park.
location: West Gate of Jinghai Park, Shengli Street, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Met her younger sister in the park to learn and then returned home.
description: At 14:30 met up with younger sister Ma Xiufen at the West Gate. The two sat on a sheltered bench, and her sister taught her to search for a non-staple food wholesale market on Amap and bookmark it, and practice screenshotting the Alipay payment QR code. Ma Xiulan shared her pickled vegetable notes; her sister suggested asking prices in the dried goods area, and they discussed trying to make spicy radish next week. Said goodbye at 16:00, Ma Xiulan walked home and arrived at 16:15.
location: Bench inside the west gate of Jinghai Park on Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, then return to 156 Jingwen Road

name: Preparing dinner ingredients and checking the children's homework
description: After getting home, first checked on the children: the eldest child's math homework was done but had mistakes that needed to be redone; the second child had dry knees and sat quietly; the youngest daughter was playing with blocks. Then went to the kitchen to wash and cut potatoes and carrots, prepared half a three-yellow chicken, and prepped the dinner ingredients.
location: Living room and kitchen at home, No. 156, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Making dinner
description: First stir-fried the tomatoes and eggs and set them aside, then sautéed ginger and garlic until fragrant, stir-fried the chicken pieces, added soy sauce and water, put in potato and carrot chunks, and simmered over low heat for 20 minutes, tasting and adding sugar during the process. The rice was already cooked.
location: Home kitchen at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The whole family had dinner together.
description: Ma Zhiqiang helped set out the bowls and chopsticks, and the family ate dinner together. Ma Xiulan talked about learning phone features from her younger sister and reminded the children about their homework for the next day. Everyone responded, and the atmosphere was warm.
location: Home restaurant, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Clean up the kitchen and parent-child family activities
description: Ma Xiulan cleared the dishes, wiped the stove, and washed the pots, while her youngest daughter Xinxin stayed beside her helping hand over rags. At 19:00, she sat on the living room sofa with her youngest daughter in her arms watching a lifestyle program (a cooking tutorial).
location: Own kitchen and living room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Accompanying the youngest daughter to wash up and coaxing her to sleep.
description: Took Ma Yuxin to wash up and change into pajamas, told her the fairy tale The Kitten Goes Fishing, and after coaxing her to sleep, quietly left the room.
location: Own bathroom and youngest daughter's bedroom at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Check the two sons' homework and urge them to wash up.
description: Checked the eldest son Xuanxuan's math test paper; the redone parts were correct. The second son Zhezhe showed improvement in the last two lines of his calligraphy practice sheets, so I encouraged him to keep practicing tomorrow. At 20:30, urged the two sons to wash up and get ready for bed.
location: Own living room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Bookkeeping and sorting out pickled vegetable notes.
description: Used the ledger and mobile app to record the day's expenses: noodles 8 yuan, three-yellow chicken 18 yuan, potatoes and carrots 4 yuan, tomatoes 3 yuan, totaling 33 yuan. Then looked through the pickled vegetable notes, marked the research summary as complete, and wrote down tomorrow's plan: go to Wutong Commune vegetable market in the morning to ask about dried goods prices and the freshness of radishes.
location: Desk in the living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Stretching and foot soaking before bed
description: Ma Xiulan asked her husband to join her in a 5-minute pre-bedtime shoulder and neck stretch, the third day in a row. Afterward, she soaked her feet in hot water for 10 minutes, leaving her whole body warm and relaxed.
location: Her own bedroom at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Bedtime preparation and falling asleep
description: Charge the phone, mentally plan tomorrow morning's trip to the vegetable market, chat briefly with her husband, turn off the lights, and fall asleep before 22:00.
location: Her own bedroom at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning stretching
description: Ma Xiulan began her daily stretching on the bedroom floor. She first moved her wrists and ankles, then slowly lowered and raised her head, feeling the stretch in her shoulders and neck. She did a few Cat and Downward Dog poses, focusing on relaxing her back. The session lasted about 8 minutes, and her body awakened from a deep sleep.
location: In the bedroom of her home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Breakfast preparation and family breakfast
description: After stretching, Xiulan first went to the children's rooms to check on them, then went into the kitchen to cook millet porridge, steam mantou, prepare pickled radish and drizzle it with hot oil, and stir-fry cabbage with vinegar. Then she woke the three children, helped Xinxin tie her hair into braids, and urged them to get dressed and wash up. The family of four sat around the table drinking porridge and eating mantou and pickled vegetables. Xiulan asked about the children's homework plans. Xuanxuan said he still had two math test papers to do; Zhezhe promised to practice calligraphy; Xinxin wanted to draw a picture for Grandma. Xiulan reminded them to clear the table after the meal.
location: Her own kitchen and dining room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Housework and online pickled-vegetable making
description: After the children ate and went to the living room to play, Xiulan cleared the table, washed the dishes, wiped the kitchen counter, and soaked the dirty clothes. Then she sat on the living room sofa, used her phone to search for Tianjin local pickled vegetable recipes, specifically saved the spicy radish recipe video, looked up raw material prices at wholesale markets, and took screenshots to save.
location: Living room at the family residence, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Walking to the vegetable market to shop
description: Xiulan changed into a down jacket, put on a hat and gloves, and walked to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market carrying a shopping bag. On the way she met her neighbor Wang Guilan, chatted for a while, and agreed to go shopping for vegetables together another day. At the market, she went to the vegetable stall run by her acquaintance Sun Guifang and, while helping sort the vegetables, asked about the wholesale prices of white radishes and chili peppers. She also asked at the dried goods shop and the stall selling jars. Finally, she spent less than 20 yuan on five jin of white radishes, two jin of red chili peppers, and a bag of rock sugar, preparing for a trial batch of spicy radish pickles the next day. Then she walked home with her basket, mulling over the details of the trial.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and the journey there and back

name: Organizing ingredients and calculating side-business costs
description: After returning home, Xiulan sorted and placed the white radishes, red peppers, and rock sugar she had bought, putting the radishes and peppers in a cool place. After washing her hands, she sat on the living room sofa with a notebook and pen, calculating and using her phone calculator to work out the raw material costs for making spicy radish (white radish, peppers, salt, sugar, etc.). She also organized and recorded the information she had looked up online that morning, and initially set a cost control target per jar.
location: Living room at the family residence, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Accompanying the children with their studies
description: Xiulan had the children do their homework at the big table in the living room. Xuanxuan was doing a math test paper, Zhezhe was practicing calligraphy, and Xinxin was drawing simple sketches. Xiulan sat nearby, while looking at the account book and keeping an eye on the children. She explained a geometry problem to Xuanxuan, praised Zhezhe for his improved handwriting, and guided Xinxin on the petal colors.
location: Living room at the family residence, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Prepare and enjoy lunch
description: Xiulan went to the kitchen to prepare lunch. Using the pork belly and Chinese cabbage her mother had given her, she made cabbage and pork stew with vermicelli and steamed egg custard. The children ate with relish. Xinxin mixed the egg custard into her rice. The atmosphere at the table was warm and cozy.
location: Her own kitchen and dining room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Cleaning up after the meal and afternoon rest
description: After the meal, Xiulan urged the children to rinse their mouths and use the bathroom, and had Xuanxuan take his younger brother and sister to the small bedroom for a nap. She quickly washed the dishes, wiped down the stove counter and the floor, then curled up on the living room sofa with a thin blanket and rested for half an hour.
location: Own residence, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Washing and drying clothes
description: After waking up from her nap, Xiulan put the clothes that had been soaking in the morning into the washing machine to wash, wiped the drying rack, and after the machine finished, she shook out each piece of clothing and hung it on the balcony to dry in the midday sun.
location: Balcony and bathroom of her home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Parent-child crafting and tidying up at home.
description: After the children woke up from their nap, Xiulan sat on the floor with Xinxin doing a castle puzzle, encouraging her to observe the colors and patterns; Zhezhe was focused on drawing a future tank; Xuanxuan was reading Twenty Thousand Leagues Under the Sea. Xiulan took out her embroidery hoop, practiced a new stitch, and embroidered small daisies on the sleeves of Xinxin's dress. Afterwards, she had the children put away their toys and books, and she wiped down the living room tables and cabinets and swept the floor.
location: Living room at the family residence, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: In-depth planning for the pickled vegetable side business
description: The children were playing quietly. Xiulan poured a cup of hot water, returned to the living room, and spread out the pickled vegetable materials she had gathered over the past two days. Following the spicy radish recipe, she itemized the ingredient list, quantities, and unit prices, used a calculator to work out the total cost, and wrote down the plan to trial-make spicy radish in the second week of February in her memo notebook.
location: Living room at the family residence, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Preparing ingredients and family bookkeeping
description: Xiulan planned a light dinner. She blanched the tomatoes, peeled and cut them into pieces, and cut the potatoes into thin shreds and soaked them in water. Then she took out the ledger and recorded today's grocery expense of 20 yuan and yesterday's 3 yuan for buying band-aids for Zhezhe, completing the day's bookkeeping.
location: Home kitchen at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Cook dinner and tidy up clothes
description: Xiulan kneaded dough, rolled out noodles, made tomato and egg sauce, and stir-fried vinegar potatoes. While boiling the noodles, she asked Xuanxuan to go to the balcony, collect the dried clothes, fold them, and put them in the wardrobe. The kitchen was filled with cooking steam and the aroma of food; dinner was ready.
location: Home kitchen at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner
description: Xiulan and the children sat around the table eating noodles with gravy and shredded potatoes. Xinxin ate a small bowl, Zhezhe ate two bowls in a row, and everyone felt content.
location: Home restaurant, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Post-meal cleanup and homework check
description: After the meal, Xiulan had Xuanxuan take his younger brother to do homework while she washed the dishes and wiped the table. Then she checked Xuanxuan's math test paper and helped him with two difficult problems; she also commented that Zhezhe's handwriting had improved. She gave both of them praise.
location: Kitchen and living room of the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Bathed her daughter and told her a bedtime story.
description: Xiulan bathed Xinxin, tested the water temperature, scrubbed her back and washed her hair. Xinxin played with a rubber duck and talked about the little flowers she had drawn. After the bath, she changed Xinxin into clean pajamas, carried her to the small bed, and read The Little Horse Crosses the River. Xinxin soon fell asleep.
location: Own bathroom and children's room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Video call with husband
description: Xinxin had fallen asleep, while Xuanxuan and Zhezhe were watching cartoons. Xiulan turned down the volume and made a video call on her phone to her husband Ma Zhiqiang, who was away on a transport job. She told him about checking prices and calculating costs at the vegetable market, and that the children were all doing well and had finished their homework. Her husband told her to take care of herself and said he would be home the day after tomorrow in the afternoon. They talked for about ten minutes.
location: Home living room at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Personal hygiene and relaxation
description: Xiulan urged Xuanxuan and Zhezhe to brush their teeth and wash their faces, then sent them to bed. She herself got hot water to soak her feet, scrolling through local news and life tips on her phone to relieve fatigue.
location: My own bathroom at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and falling asleep.
description: After soaking her feet, Xiulan went back to the bedroom and took out the pickle cost accounting notes for a look, confirming that she had the numbers clear in her mind. Then she did some pre-sleep stretching to relax her waist and arms. After that, she washed up, applied Yumeijing, checked the children's quilt covers, and set the alarm for 6:30 the next morning. She turned off the light, lay down, reviewed the fulfilling day, and soon fell asleep.
location: In the bedroom of her home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Morning stretching and waking the children
description: At 6:45 in the morning, Ma Xiulan woke up naturally and did shoulder, neck, and full-body stretches with her husband Ma Zhiqiang on the bedroom exercise mat, and coached Zhiqiang on adjusting his breathing. After stretching, Ma Xiulan washed up quickly, then she and Zhiqiang split up to wake the three children. She helped her youngest daughter Yuxin put on a sweater and urged her second son Mingzhe to speed up, making sure all the children got out of bed smoothly.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (own master bedroom and bathroom)

name: Family breakfast
description: Ma Xiulan cooked millet porridge in the kitchen, heated steamed buns, fried five fried eggs, and served them with homemade pickled radish to prepare breakfast for the whole family. At 7:45, the family of five sat around the dining table, eating and chatting. Ma Xiulan reminded her eldest son Xuanxuan to finish the geometry problems in the morning, and picked food for her second son Mingzhe. The family enjoyed a warm meal together.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home kitchen and dining room)

name: Supervising the children's winter vacation homework
description: After breakfast, Ma Xiulan quickly cleared the dishes and wiped the stove clean, then checked the three children's winter vacation homework on the living room sofa. She focused on explaining a complex geometry auxiliary-line problem to Xuanxuan, praised Mingzhe for his neater English copybook writing, and personally guided her youngest daughter Yuxin as she practiced new characters.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (own living room)

name: Exchanged pickled vegetable-making experience with neighbor Wang Guilan.
description: Ma Xiulan went out for some fresh air and ran into her neighbor, Sister Wang Guilan, who was trimming spinach at the doorstep. The two chatted warmly about her plan to make pickled vegetables. Wang Guilan unreservedly shared tips for pickling peppers, including adding salt, high-proof liquor, and air-drying the peppers to remove moisture before sealing the jar. She also promised to bring over some of her own homegrown peppers that afternoon for Ma Xiulan to practice with.
location: No. 154 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (at Wang Guilan's front door)

name: Recording the pickle recipe and putting away ingredients
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan took out her account book and carefully wrote down the pickling tips Wang Guilan had mentioned. Then she went into the kitchen, reorganized the radishes and peppers bought yesterday, and silently planned the steps for a trial batch.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home living room and kitchen)

name: Preparing and enjoying lunch
description: Ma Xiulan asked her husband to supervise the children's homework while she took pork belly, cabbage, and vermicelli out of the refrigerator and prepared the ingredients. Then she cooked pork and cabbage stew with vermicelli and garlic spinach in the kitchen. At noon the whole family ate together. During the meal, her husband Zhiqiang mentioned that he would be driving to Shandong the day after tomorrow in the afternoon. As she placed food on his plate, Ma Xiulan told him to be safe on the road.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home kitchen and dining room)

name: Midday nap
description: After lunch, Ma Xiulan cleaned up the kitchen by herself, sealed the leftovers and put them in the refrigerator. Around 12:40, she felt tired, so she covered herself with a thin blanket on the living room sofa and took a nap for about half an hour to regain her energy.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (own living room)

name: Afternoon homework check and embroidery practice
description: After the afternoon nap, Ma Xiulan checked the children's afternoon homework plan. She found that Xuanxuan had finished most of his work, Mingzhe was drawing, and Yuxin was doing a jigsaw puzzle. She took out her embroidery hoop and sat by the window practicing the stitch for embroidering daisy petals on her daughter's skirt. Sunlight streamed into the room as the family quietly busied themselves.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (own living room)

name: Shopping at the supermarket and running into childhood friend Liu Chunmei
description: Remembering that she was almost out of laundry detergent, Ma Xiulan changed into a heavy coat, grabbed her shopping bag, and went to Shufen Convenience Supermarket. While choosing promotional laundry detergent, dishwashing liquid, and toilet paper, she ran into her childhood friend Liu Chunmei. The two chatted warmly in front of the shelves about the craft of silk ribbon flowers and agreed to find time next week to try it together. After shopping, Ma Xiulan walked home carrying her things and put them away.
location: Shufen Convenience Store (intersection of Jingwen Road and Gongnong Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Shop 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu)

name: Preparing dinner and receiving peppers from Wang Guilan
description: Ma Xiulan put on an apron and began to prepare noodles with sauce. She kneaded the dough, rolled it out, and made egg-and-tomato sauce, asking her husband to help peel garlic. Near 5 o'clock, neighbor Wang Guilan brought over a bag of homegrown red chili peppers. Ma Xiulan thanked her repeatedly and carefully put them away in the kitchen, planning to use them to make chili sauce. Then she stir-fried some baby bok choy to finish the family dinner preparations.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (own kitchen and front door).

name: Family dinner
description: When the noodles with gravy were brought to the table, the family of five sat around and enjoyed the meal. Ma Xiulan shared the amusing story of running into Chunmei at the supermarket. The children excitedly reported on the day's homework achievements, while Zhiqiang listened with a smile. A warm family atmosphere filled the dinner table.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home dining room)

name: Family leisure after dinner
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan cleaned up the kitchen while her husband watched cartoons with the children in the living room. When she finished tidying up, Ma Xiulan also sat down and chatted softly with Zhiqiang, enjoying a leisurely moment alone as a couple.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (own living room)

name: Evening care: helping the children wash up and putting them to bed
description: At seven in the evening, Ma Xiulan bathed her younger daughter Yuxin, changed her into pajamas, and told her two bedtime stories to lull her to sleep. Then she urged her two sons to brush their teeth and wash their faces, making sure they didn't dawdle and completed their bedtime routine in an orderly manner.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (own bathroom and bedroom)

name: Casual talk between the couple and bookkeeping
description: After settling the children, Ma Xiulan and Zhiqiang returned to the master bedroom. She took out the ledger and recorded the day's grocery shopping cost of 38.5 yuan. Then the couple discussed the clothes and dry provisions Zhiqiang needed to take for his trip the day after tomorrow, and she carefully reminded him to eat meals on time on the way. Before bed, they did five minutes of stretching together and said goodnight to each other.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (own master bedroom)

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and falling asleep.
description: Ma Xiulan washed up and did her skincare routine, then checked on the sleeping children, made sure doors, windows, and gas were safe, and set the alarm for 6:30 the next morning. Around 10 she turned off the light and lay down, replaying Sister Wang's pickling recipe in her mind and drifting off to sleep full of anticipation.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home bathroom and master bedroom)

name: Morning stretching and communication
description: At the first light of dawn, Ma Xiulan gently turned off her phone alarm and slowly sat up, afraid of waking her still-sleeping husband Ma Zhiqiang. Barefoot by the window, she began her sixth day of five-minute full-body stretching in the dim light. Her movements were smoother than before, and the soreness in her shoulders and neck had almost disappeared. After stretching, Zhiqiang woke up. She whispered to him about coming home earlier that evening and about making a trial batch of chili sauce. Zhiqiang mumbled an acknowledgment and turned over to sleep again.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare breakfast and wake up the family
description: Ma Xiulan washed up and went downstairs. She first rinsed the millet and started cooking millet porridge, then took out the big steamed buns bought yesterday from the fridge and put them in the steamer. She quickly sliced a plate of homemade pickled vegetables, and from the small flowerpot on the back windowsill picked a few scallions and chopped them for later. At exactly 7 o'clock, she went upstairs and woke the children one by one: the eldest, Xuanxuan, was lying on the bed looking at his winter break homework and said, 'Getting up now'; the second child, Zhezhe, was reluctant to get up, so she gently patted his back; the youngest daughter, Xinxin, rubbed her eyes and acted coquettishly, and Ma Xiulan gently braided her hair.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family breakfast and planning the day's affairs
description: The whole family sat around the dining table drinking porridge and eating steamed buns. As she ate, Ma Xiulan told the children, “Today Mom is going to make chili sauce at home. You three play in the living room and don't come into the kitchen. Xuanxuan, keep an eye on your younger brother and sister while they do their homework.” The children answered cheerfully. After the meal, she quickly cleared the dishes and wiped the dining table clean with a cloth.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tidying up around the house and capturing everyday moments of winter break.
description: Ma Xiulan first cleaned up the dining table and kitchen, then poured the bag of red peppers Sister Wang had sent yesterday out of the bag and spread them on a bamboo winnowing basket to air. She wiped her hands, took out the old digital camera from the cabinet, and put in a fully charged battery. Seeing that all three children were in the living room—Xuanxuan doing math winter vacation homework on the coffee table, Zhezhe and Xinxin building a block castle on the carpet—she quickly raised the camera, found the right angle, and with a few clicks captured this warm, ordinary moment. She looked back at the photos, was basically satisfied with the image quality, and a smile curled at the corners of her mouth.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Go to Wutong Commune Market to shop.
description: Ma Xiulan saw that it was about time, wrapped her headscarf, got on the electric bike in the yard, and rode out into the cold wind. A few minutes later, she arrived at the familiar Wutong Commune vegetable market and went straight to Aunt Sun Guifang's stall. "Aunt Sun, give me 5 jin of crisp white radishes, a large piece of fresh ginger, and half a jin of dried chili peppers." She picked carefully, then also bought a few spring onions and a small bunch of cilantro, spending 18 yuan in total. Aunt Sun smiled and asked, "Making something delicious today?" Xiulan replied, "I'm trying to make some pickled vegetables. If they turn out well, I'll bring you some to taste." Aunt Sun nodded repeatedly.
location: Wutong Commune Market at the intersection of Wutong Road and Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Go home to prepare materials for the trial production.
description: Back home, Ma Xiulan thoroughly washed the white radishes and fresh ginger, sliced them into thin pieces and fine shreds, and spread them in a draining basket to air-dry the surface moisture. She then found several clean large glass jars, scalded them with boiling water to sterilize, and drained them dry. Next, she took out her phone and reviewed the “Spicy Radish Sauce” recipe video she had saved yesterday, silently noting the proportions as she watched, and wrote down key points in her notebook: “More oil, stir-fry on low heat, add vinegar last.” The kitchen was filled with the fresh, sweet aroma of radishes.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Make lunch.
description: Keep lunch simple. Ma Xiulan deftly kneaded the dough, rolled it into a thin large sheet, and cut it into wide noodles. She put water on to boil in the pot and meanwhile stir-fried a bowl of tomato and egg sauce. When the water boiled, she added the noodles, cooked them, scooped them out, and poured the sauce over them. She also blanched a few leafy greens. A warm bowl of noodle with sauce was ready. She set the food on the table and called the children to come eat. Xuanxuan loved noodles and ate two full bowls, while Zhezhe and Xinxin also ate with big mouthfuls.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Lunch break and preparing to simmer the sauce
description: After the meal, she urged the three children to go to their rooms for a nap. Ma Xiulan herself also sprawled on the living room sofa and dozed for half an hour. After waking up, she felt refreshed, so she got up, went into the kitchen, and tied on a blue floral apron. She neatly arranged on the stove the dried radish shreds, ginger shreds, and the red peppers Sister Wang had given her yesterday (partly cut into shreds), dried chili segments, Sichuan peppercorns, star anise, and other ingredients, ready to officially start simmering the sauce.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Trial-making spicy radish sauce
description: Ma Xiulan took a deep breath, lit the gas stove, and poured into the large iron wok twice as much peanut oil as she normally used for stir-frying. When the oil was hot, she first added minced scallion, ginger, garlic, and dried chili shreds, and stir-fried them over low heat until fragrant. The kitchen immediately filled with a pungent yet tempting aroma. Then she added the shredded radish and kept stirring. After the radish shreds were soaked through with oil and softened, she added chili powder, sugar, salt, light soy sauce, and a little fragrant vinegar one by one, and continued to simmer slowly over low heat. While stirring to prevent sticking to the pan, she wrote down each step and the time each seasoning was added in her notebook. Half an hour later, the sauce became shiny, red, and thick. She tasted it; the flavor was rich, but she felt she could still add a little fermented black beans to enhance the umami. As she bottled it, the steaming aroma in the glass bottle filled her with anticipation.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare dinner and take care of the children
description: After the sauce had been cooked and cooled, Ma Xiulan put it into a prepared glass jar and tightened the lid. Then she started making dinner: she made a pot of cornmeal porridge and steamed the frozen buns she had bought at the supermarket yesterday. She also stir-fried a plate of vinegar potato shreds and reheated the half bowl of leftover noodles with gravy from lunch. When it was ready, she called the children to eat and urged them to finish the easy homework at the table first. Xuanxuan's math worksheet was done well, so she praised him; Zhezhe had two characters in his copying exercise that were not neat, so she had him rewrite them; Xinxin was already lying on the sofa watching cartoons.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Waiting for husband to come home and family dinner
description: Ma Xiulan and the children had dinner first. After eating, she cleared the dishes and checked the children's winter vacation homework. Xuanxuan's test paper was all correct, which made her happy; Zhezhe's new-character exercises had also been corrected. Xinxin giggled while watching cartoons, and Xiulan sat nearby, thinking about what she wanted to discuss with Zhiqiang in the evening. At about 6:50, a familiar car sound came from outside the door — Ma Zhiqiang had returned from work. She went up to help him take his coat, and the family sat back around the dining table. Zhiqiang ate while praising the vinegar-shredded potatoes and asked how the children were today. Xiulan smiled and didn't rush to bring up the chili sauce matter.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family meeting to discuss the pickled vegetable side business.
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan pulled Ma Zhiqiang to the dining table and laid out the receipts for ingredients bought at the vegetable market, the notebook recording the production process, and the bottle of spicy radish sauce she had just made that day. She seriously told Zhiqiang everything she had researched over the past few days about costs, recipes, and ideas: “Look, the material cost is less than ten yuan to make two big bottles, much cheaper than the ones sold outside. Let’s first try making a batch. If the neighbors say it’s good, we’ll think about the next step.” Zhiqiang unscrewed the bottle and tasted it, smacking his lips: “Tastes good! This is a proper endeavor. I’ll go over the costs with you, but you have to keep a close eye on hygiene.” He agreed to help her move the unused heavy items at home to the storage room before leaving for Shandong the day after tomorrow, to free up space for her. After hearing this, Ma Xiulan felt much more at ease.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening family activity
description: After discussing the important matters, Ma Xiulan felt much more relaxed. She told the children to wash up, gave Xinxin a bath, and urged her two sons to brush their teeth and wash their faces. Then she soaked her feet in hot water to relieve the day's fatigue. While soaking her feet, she picked up her phone to check tomorrow's weather forecast and scrolled through some short food videos from Jinghai. She saw a new way to make baked sesame cakes with pickled vegetables and thought she might try it later.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: Ma Xiulan made the bed, then took a change of clothes into the bathroom. After washing up and doing her skincare routine, she went back to the bedroom and saw Ma Zhiqiang already leaning against the headboard, browsing news on his phone. She checked the thick socks and thermal underwear he would need for his trip the day after tomorrow and put them in the travel bag at the head of the bed. The couple chatted a bit and agreed that after Zhiqiang got back from this trip, they would take the children to the city's science museum. Then Xiulan went downstairs and checked the kitchen gas valve, the living room window, and the front door one by one, confirming they were all closed. She also looked in on the children's room, where all three children were sleeping soundly. She tucked in their blankets, turned off the light, and returned to the bedroom. Back in the room, they softly said 'Let's go to sleep' and turned off the light. Ma Xiulan set the alarm for 6:30 the next morning and, accompanied by the sound of the cold wind howling outside the window, soon fell asleep. She thought about trying the chili sauce tomorrow. Life was ordinary, but there was something to look forward to.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning stretching
description: Ma Xiulan completed the 5-minute full-body stretch for the 7th day on the bedroom floor. She felt her shoulders and neck were especially relaxed thanks to a week of persistence, and her movements were smoother. She decided to keep up the stretching habit long-term.
location: Bedroom on the second floor, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Prepared breakfast, woke the children, and the whole family had breakfast together.
description: After washing up, Ma Xiulan prepared breakfast in the kitchen. She specially cooked millet porridge for her husband, who was going out driving that afternoon, heated up big steamed buns, sliced pickled radish and homemade spicy radish sauce, and fried some sunny-side-up eggs. Then she woke the three children one by one: the eldest, Mingxuan, quickly put on his school uniform by himself; the second, Mingzhe, stayed in bed and dawdled through washing up after being urged; the youngest daughter, Yuxin, obediently let her mother braid her little pigtails. Afterwards, all five family members sat around the dinner table and had breakfast together. Ma Xiulan told her husband Zhiqiang to bring enough warm clothes and reminded the children to be good because their father was going on a long trip in the afternoon.
location: Kitchen, bedroom, and dining room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Taking the two children to school.
description: Ma Xiulan put on her down jacket, gloves, and hat, then rode her electric bike to take her second child, Mingzhe, to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, watching him enter the school gate. Then she took her youngest daughter, Yuxin, to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten and handed her over to the teacher. Afterward, she rode home alone. The sky was overcast and the wind was cold along the way, and she was worried about her husband having to drive a long distance in the afternoon.
location: Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Huakang Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Returning home and chatting with neighbors
description: Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike back to her own door, just as her neighbor Wang Guilan was taking out the trash. The two stood at the door and chatted for five or six minutes. Wang Guilan asked whether it would snow, Ma Xiulan replied that snow was forecast, and asked whether Wang Guilan's husband was off work. Only after the chat did Ma Xiulan push her bike into the yard.
location: Entrance of 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tidy up the kitchen and clean the house
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan washed and cleaned all the breakfast bowls, chopsticks, pots, and basins, wiped the stove top clean, and mopped the living room and kitchen floors with a mop. She noticed empty cardboard boxes piled at the entrance of the storage room and planned to use them for the pickle jars once her husband made room.
location: Kitchen and living room, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Organize the pickled vegetable business research and cost table.
description: At the living room coffee table, Ma Xiulan took out her previous market research notebook, phone screenshots of prices, and a hand-drawn layout of the market stalls. She spread out A4 paper and itemized the costs of pickled vegetable ingredients such as white radish, chili peppers, salt, sugar, and jars, calculating the estimated total cost and selling price. She also checked the location of the handicraft market she had visited with her sister last time (near Shengli Street) on her phone map, noting the driving route and estimated time.
location: Living room coffee table, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Arranged tomorrow's itinerary with craft friend Zhou Xiuqin
description: Ma Xiulan called her handicraft friend Zhou Xiuqin. After exchanging pleasantries, she directly asked her to go to the handicraft market together the next afternoon to inspect the pickled vegetable stall on site. Zhou Xiuqin readily agreed, and the two arranged to meet at the entrance of the Jinghai District Library at 2 p.m. the next day.
location: Sofa in the living room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Simple lunch and a midday nap.
description: Ma Xiulan cooked a bowl of dried noodles for herself, poached an egg, blanched some greens, and had a simple lunch along with the leftover shredded potatoes. After cleaning up the dishes and chopsticks, she felt sleepy, so she lay down on the living room sofa with a thin blanket and rested with her eyes closed for half an hour.
location: Kitchen, dining room, and living room sofa at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Helped her husband clear out the storage room and organize the miscellaneous items
description: Her husband Zhiqiang began cleaning out the storage room before leaving for a trip. Ma Xiulan helped him move out old fishing gear and accumulated odds and ends, putting usable tools in a corner of the yard and loading useless clutter into sacks to be sold as scrap. She specially wiped clean the driest, best-ventilated spot against the wall in the storage room to make room for the pickled vegetable jars. After Zhiqiang went to take a shower and prepare to leave, Ma Xiulan sorted the moved-out items on her own and carefully placed the spicy radish relish made the day before on the newly freed shelf, feeling a strong sense of accomplishment.
location: The storage room and courtyard at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Looking through old photo albums on a snowy day
description: Light snow was drifting outside the window. Ma Xiulan made a cup of hot tea, took out the worn old photo album, and sat on the sofa slowly flipping through it. Inside were her wedding photo with Zhiqiang, a hundred-day photo of her eldest son Mingxuan, and old photos of Mingzhe and Yuxin playing in the yard when they were little. Her eyes were tender, and the corners of her mouth turned up involuntarily.
location: Sofa in the living room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Remind husband to bring all his warm clothes.
description: Ma Xiulan returned to the bedroom, saw that Zhiqiang had already changed his clothes, so she handed him a thick sweater and a down jacket, reminding him that driving at night would be cold. She also checked Zhiqiang's usual stomach medicine and thermos to confirm that everything had been packed.
location: Bedroom at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the children from school and shop on the way.
description: Although the snow was not heavy, Ma Xiulan put on a rain poncho and rode her electric bike to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up Mingzhe, then went to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up Yuxin. Yuxin happily held out her hand to catch snowflakes. On the way back, passing Shufen Convenience Store, Ma Xiulan went in and spent 3.5 yuan on a thick notebook, planning to use it exclusively for recording pickled vegetable recipes and cost accounts, then took the children home.
location: Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Huakang Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Shufen Convenience Store, intersection of Jingwen Road and Dongfanghong Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing a hearty dinner, having a family meal, and seeing the husband off.
description: To see off her husband, Ma Xiulan carefully prepared dinner: braised pork ribs, shredded pork in garlic sauce, stir-fried lettuce with garlic, braised beef with soy sauce, and tomato and egg drop soup. The kitchen was filled with the aroma of food. The whole family ate early; Ma Xiulan kept putting food into Zhiqiang's bowl and urging him to eat more so he would have strength for the road. Zhiqiang smiled and encouraged the children to be obedient. After the meal, Zhiqiang went to get his luggage, and Ma Xiulan walked him to the courtyard gate. She watched him put the suitcase into the truck bed, then told him to call when he reached his destination and to drive slowly and not rush. Zhiqiang drove the truck slowly out of Jingwen Road, and Ma Xiulan stood in the fine snow for a moment before turning back into the house.
location: Kitchen, dining room, and courtyard gate at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tidy up the kitchen and urge the children to do their homework.
description: Ma Xiulan cleaned off the dining table, washed and put away the dishes and chopsticks, and wiped down the gas stove and range hood. Then she went to the living room. Seeing Mingxuan doing math homework, she explained a word problem he didn't quite understand; she checked Mingzhe's calligraphy practice book and praised him for writing the character for 'tiger' with strength; and she taught Yuxin to draw prettier little snowflakes.
location: Kitchen and living room, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Checked the children's thick school uniforms and prepared the clothes for the next day
description: As the weather turned colder, Ma Xiulan went into the children's bedroom, took out thick school uniform jackets for Mingzhe and Yuxin from the wardrobe and hung them on hangers, checked that Mingxuan's down jacket zipper was intact, and thought that she would need to add a scarf when taking the children to school the next day.
location: Children's bedroom, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening bookkeeping and notes on pickled vegetable ideas
description: The children were playing or reading in the living room. Ma Xiulan took out her newly bought notebook, first recorded the 3.5 yuan expense for the notebook, then copied in the pickle cost table she had organized in the afternoon, and wrote down her plans: go to Jinghai Wholesale Market to ask about jar prices, and ask Xiuqin about food labeling matters when she sees her tomorrow.
location: Living room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Urge the children to wash up and put the youngest daughter to bed.
description: Ma Xiulan first washed Yuxin's face and brushed her teeth, changed her into her little pajamas, and told her the story of 'The Good Little Rabbit' to lull her to sleep. Then she urged Mingzhe to take a bath and watched as he changed into his thermal underwear. Then she went to see Mingxuan, who had already washed up and was looking at his textbook.
location: Bathroom and children's bedroom at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Personal washing and bedtime stretching.
description: Ma Xiulan felt tired, went to the bathroom to wash her face, and applied face cream. Back in the bedroom, she did 10 minutes of relaxing pre-sleep stretches on the floor by the bed, focusing on relieving the soreness in her arms and lower back from organizing the storage room.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Bedtime safety check and going to sleep.
description: Ma Xiulan put on her slippers and carefully checked whether the gas valve in the kitchen was tightly closed, then confirmed that the doors and windows in the living room and courtyard were locked. Back in the bedroom, she set the alarm for 6:30 the next morning and turned off the bedside lamp. Outside the window, the snow had stopped and it was quiet all around. Thinking about her appointment with Xiuqin the next day, she fell asleep full of anticipation.
location: Kitchen, living room, yard, and bedroom at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Early morning family activities
description: Just as day was breaking, Ma Xiulan woke up naturally, laid out a yoga mat in the living room, and did stretching exercises with the three children. Xuanxuan (13), though a bit shy, still moved his wrists and shoulders; Zhezhe (10) was the most eager and performed the movements with proper form; Xinxin (6) giggled and imitated, clumsy but adorable. Ma Xiulan took a few photos with her phone, planning to send them to her husband Zhiqiang, who was out of town, later. After stretching, she told the children to go wash up, and prepared breakfast herself: hot millet porridge, reheated steamed buns bought the day before, a plate of sliced pickled cucumbers, and one boiled egg for each person. It was cold, so the children needed to eat well and stay warm. During breakfast, everyone sat around the table. As they ate, Ma Xiulan reminded the children that even though it was Saturday, they still had to finish their homework on time. After the meal, she quickly cleared the dishes and cleaned up the kitchen, wiping the stove clean.
location: Own home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Housework and making sample packs of pickled vegetables
description: She let the children go to the living room to do homework or read, and Ma Xiulan began her daily chores: she used the washing machine to wash clothes, hung her husband's work jacket from yesterday back in the wardrobe, and simply mopped the floor. Then she walked into the storage room, took out the spicy radish pickle made last month, found a few small clean glass jars, divided the pickles into them, carefully wiped the jar rims, wrote "Sister Ma's Spicy Radish Pickle" and the date on sticky notes, and attached them neatly. In total, she packed five small jars and felt very pleased, having taken another step forward in her pickled vegetable sideline business.
location: own living room, kitchen, and storage room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Deliver pickled vegetables to neighbors and ask them to look after things.
description: Ma Xiulan took two small jars of pickled vegetables and went across to Wang Guilan's house. Sister Wang opened a jar, smelled it, and praised it as authentic. Ma Xiulan told her that she needed to go out to the market in the afternoon and asked her to keep an eye on the children, and to call anytime if anything came up. Sister Wang readily agreed and told her to go without worry.
location: Wang Guilan's home, No. 158 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Visit parents, share pickled vegetables, and do shopping.
description: After leaving Sister Wang's house, Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike straight to her parents' home on Shengli Street. She handed her mother the other two jars of pickled vegetables. Her mother happily tasted one and kept saying it was delicious, and her father nodded in agreement. The three chatted about family matters for a while. Her mother told her to dress warmly in the cold weather and insisted on giving her a bag of freshly bought napa cabbage. After leaving her parents' home, Ma Xiulan made a detour to the Wutong Commune Vegetable Market on the way. She saw that the dried goods stall had cheap small chili peppers and dried sweet potato noodles, so she bought a jin of each. She also picked up a few cheap glass jars from the sundry stall, planning to try pickling other flavors when she got home.
location: Parents' home at 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Wutong Commune vegetable market on Chaoyang Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Lunch and midday break
description: After arriving home, Ma Xiulan put away the things she had bought. It was cold, so she planned to stew a pot of hot cabbage, tofu, and vermicelli. She sliced a plate of braised beef that Zhiqiang hadn't had time to eat yesterday, and also stir-fried garlic broccoli. The kitchen soon became steaming hot and filled with the aroma of food. She called the children to eat. The eldest, Xuanxuan, ate two bowls; Zhezhe wolfed down his food; even Xinxin, who didn't like vegetables, drank most of a bowl of soup. After eating, she had the children clean up their own dishes and chopsticks. Ma Xiulan rested on the living room sofa with her eyes closed for fifteen minutes.
location: Kitchen, dining room, and living room in the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Afternoon outing to survey the handicraft market
description: After resting, Ma Xiulan put on her down jacket, wrapped her scarf, put on her gloves, and rode her e-bike for about fifteen minutes to meet Zhou Xiuqin at the entrance of Jinghai District Library. The two parked their bikes and walked arm in arm into the handicraft market in the square near the intersection of Dongfanghong Road and Shengli Avenue. Ma Xiulan went straight to the point and found the stall selling pickled vegetables and cured products. She carefully looked at the display style, price tags, and observed the customers' reactions. She noticed that a stall selling spicy cabbage had the best business. She and Sister Xiuqin stood there for a long time, quietly took a few photos with her phone, and noted the best-selling varieties and prices. Sister Xiuqin encouraged her, "Xiulan, I think it'll work! Your pickled radish is even more fragrant than this!" Ma Xiulan felt more confident. After leaving the market, she said goodbye to Sister Xiuqin. The wind outside was a bit strong, so she wrapped her scarf tighter and rode her e-bike home, thinking all the way about improving the packaging and pricing.
location: Depart from 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jinghai District Library at the intersection of Shengli Street and Donghongfang Road; handicraft market in the square near the intersection of Donghongfang Road and Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Get home and supervise the children's homework
description: After arriving home, Ma Xiulan caught her breath and checked the children's homework progress. Xuanxuan had almost finished math, Zhezhe had done most of his calligraphy practice, and Xinxin was drawing a crooked little rabbit. She praised them and let them rest for a while before dinner.
location: Own home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Dinner and cleaning up
description: Ma Xiulan put away everything she had bought today and began to prepare dinner: she soaked the fresh sweet potato vermicelli she had bought and stewed it with the leftover cabbage and tofu; cut some green pepper and pork into strips and stir-fried a dish of yuxiang shredded pork; then sliced a plate of braised beef and tossed a sweet-and-sour shredded radish salad. She called the children to eat. Zhe-Zhe loved the yuxiang shredded pork and ate two bowls of rice; Xinxin ate a lot of the vermicelli; Xuanxuan said little but ate with gusto. After the meal, Ma Xiulan cleared the tableware, put the leftovers in the refrigerator, and wiped the dining table clean.
location: Home kitchen and dining room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening homework check and helping the children wash up.
description: Ma Xiulan checked the children's homework: Xuanxuan had the wrong approach on a math problem, so she patiently explained it; Zhezhe had some sloppy characters in his handwriting practice, so she made him rewrite it. Then she urged the children to take turns bathing and washing up. Xinxin dawdled the most, and only finished washing after Ma Xiulan accompanied her.
location: Children's room and bathroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Put daughter to bed and sort out the market haul
description: Ma Xiulan put Xinxin to bed and told her two little stories before Xinxin was willing to close her eyes and sleep. After she fell asleep, Ma Xiulan quietly returned to the living room, took out the photos she had taken at the market today, and wrote down the information she had seen in her notebook: which pickled vegetable stall sold the most, what prices were, and how the packaging was done. Then she labeled all the pickle jars she had brought back and wiped off the dust.
location: Xinxin's bedroom and living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Video call with husband
description: After pulling herself together, Ma Xiulan made a video call to her husband Ma Zhiqiang. Zhiqiang had just arrived in Shandong and was resting at a service area. He chatted with the children for a while and told them to listen to their mother. Ma Xiulan told him about what she had gained and thought at the market today. Zhiqiang smiled and said, "Okay, honey, you handle it, I support you!" After hanging up, Ma Xiulan felt reassured and full of motivation.
location: Home living room at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: After washing up and changing into pajamas, Ma Xiulan did more than ten minutes of pre-sleep stretches in the bedroom, a habit she had developed this week; after finishing, she felt much more relaxed. Then she turned off the light and lay down, reviewing the busy and fulfilling day. Especially the new progress in the pickled vegetables side business filled her with hope for the future, and she slowly drifted off to sleep.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning stretching maintenance
description: Early Sunday morning, Xiulan woke up naturally thanks to her body clock. She remembered the stretching she had done yesterday and decided to keep consolidating this good habit. She spread an old blanket on the living room floor and followed a video on her phone to complete a 5-minute shoulder and neck stretch. Feeling her body gradually loosen up, her mood also became more settled.
location: Living room of her own home in Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing weekend breakfast
description: The children did not have school, and Xiulan wanted to give the family a change of flavor. Using the dough she had leavened last night, she steamed a pot of huajuan (twisted steamed rolls) and red bean paste buns, and also cooked millet porridge. In between, she soaked the clothes changed off yesterday in laundry detergent, doing household chores at intervals. She glanced at the thick clouds outside the window and thought that it might clear up in the evening to see the stars.
location: Kitchen of her home in Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Wake up the family and share breakfast.
description: At exactly eight o'clock, Xiulan woke up her husband and three children, who were still sound asleep. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang rarely had a Sunday off from driving, so he had slept until now. The whole family sat around the table, eating hot steamed rolls and rice porridge with their homemade pickled vegetables. Xuanxuan and Zhezhe wanted to watch TV as soon as they finished eating; Xiulan stopped them and asked them to take out that day's homework plan first before discussing it. The two children grumbled and went to get their schoolbags.
location: Dining room at my own home in Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Make a pickled vegetable shopping list and calculate the costs.
description: After cleaning up the kitchen, Xiulan arranged for her husband and children to stay in the small living room and sat down at the desk in the master bedroom. She took out the photo she had secretly taken of the pickled-vegetable stall at the market the day before, opened an old notebook, and began listing the ingredients she would need—fresh white radish, cowpeas, chili peppers, and other seasonings—as well as 60 transparent glass jars of 500 ml. While writing, she searched wholesale and retail prices on her phone and did repeated calculations in the notebook: “Radishes are 1.5 yuan per jin at the market price, so buying 20 jin first would be 30 yuan. The cheapest sealed jars online are 1.2 yuan each, so 60 jars would be 72 yuan—this item alone exceeds the budget... Well, I can use some of the used fermented tofu bottles and fruit jar bottles at home to make do; buying 30 new jars would be enough, saving more than 30 yuan.” After several rounds of adding and subtracting, she arrived at an estimated total cost of 85 yuan, just barely within budget. Looking at this number, Xiulan felt much more at ease, as if she could already see the first batch of pickles being put into jars.
location: At the desk in the master bedroom at home, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Purchasing raw materials for pickled vegetables and daily supplies
description: With the list in hand, Xiulan felt reassured. She told her husband, then put on her down jacket and rode her electric bike out. First she rode 5 minutes to the Wutong Commune Vegetable Market and went straight to Aunt Sun Guifang's stall, buying 20 jin of crisp white radishes, 5 jin of long beans, and 2 jin of fresh chili peppers from the list. When Aunt Sun heard she was going to pickle vegetables, she warmly shared a few tips for keeping them longer, saying a little baijiu can prevent spoilage. Buying the vegetables took about 20 minutes. Then she rode about 10 minutes to Jingbai Supermarket, picked up salt, sugar, Sichuan peppercorns, star anise, and other seasonings, and after carefully comparing several kinds of brewed soy sauce, chose the most cost-effective one. She deliberately stopped by the household goods section to look at clear glass jars, but decided to use the old jars at home first to save money. When she came out of the supermarket, bags hung from both handlebars of the electric bike. Fully loaded, she rode 10 minutes home.
location: Vegetable market at Wutong Community, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jingbai Supermarket, Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare and enjoy a hearty lunch
description: It was almost 12 o'clock when she got home. Xiulan didn't take a rest and began preparing lunch — the noodles with thick gravy that the children loved. She deftly kneaded the dough, rolled it out, and cut the noodles, then made a large pot of fragrant gravy with pork belly, wood ear mushrooms, daylily buds, and eggs. The whole family sat around the table, slurping the noodles. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang, who was rarely home, also praised the noodles for being chewy. During the meal, Xiulan mentioned her plan to make pickled vegetables. Her husband was silent for a moment, then said, 'Don't work too hard. Just don't lose money.' Although he said little, Xiulan knew this counted as tacit approval.
location: Kitchen and dining room at her home in Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Midday housework and a short nap.
description: After the meal, Xiulan let her husband go accompany the children while she cleaned up the dishes and chopsticks. She washed the radishes and cowpeas she had bought, spread them in a bamboo basket to drain, laying the foundation for the afternoon's pickled vegetable processing. After finishing these things, drowsiness came over her. She did not go to bed, but just covered herself with a coat on the living room sofa and dozed with her eyes closed for 40 minutes.
location: Kitchen and living room at her home in Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Supervise the children's studies and complete the preparatory work for the pickled vegetables
description: After waking at 1:30 p.m., Xiulan urged the three children to start their homework. Xuanxuan and Zhezhe went to their own rooms, while Xinxin drew pictures lying on the coffee table in the living room. Xiulan cleared the kitchen windowsill and dining table, spread a clean plastic sheet over them, cut the drained radishes into even strips, and sprinkled salt over them to draw out the water. The room filled with the fresh fragrance of radishes.
location: Living room and kitchen at home in Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Argument with eldest son over phone use
description: Xiulan was turning the radishes in the kitchen when she passed by her eldest son's room. The door wasn't closed tightly, and she caught a glimpse of Ma Mingxuan's phone screen glowing on the desk — he was playing a battle royale game. She immediately flew into a rage. Pushing the door open, she saw that he was indeed looking at the game instead of studying. Suppressing her anger, she said, "Xuanxuan! You're playing games again? Have you finished your homework? What happened to the rules we agreed on?" The eldest son, face red, froze for a moment, then stiffened his neck and retorted, "I finished ages ago! What's the big deal about playing for a while? You won't even let me play during the holiday!" Mother and son froze. Xiulan felt humiliated, angry, and wronged. She took a deep breath and decided to change her approach, so she said, "Fine, turn it off for now. Come to the living room, and Mom will have a proper talk with you."
location: Outside the eldest son's room and in the living room at her own home in Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Reconciled with eldest son and made a new agreement
description: On the living room sofa, mother and son sat down facing each other. Xiulan first took the initiative to apologize, admitting that she had been too hasty just now and had not asked about the situation clearly. Ma Mingxuan also calmed down and explained that he had finished all his homework in the morning and had only played for a while because he was bored. Xiulan had a serious talk with him about the winter vacation schedule and the importance of protecting his eyes. In the end, the two reached a new agreement: as long as he completed that day's study tasks with quality and quantity every morning, he could play games for 40 minutes afterward, but he had to play in the living room or his parents' room and could not secretly hide away to play; if he exceeded the time limit, he would lose the next day's eligibility. The eldest son thought it was fair enough and nodded.
location: Sofa in the living room at her home in Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Hanging clothes to dry and family relaxation time
description: After the heart-to-heart talk with her son, Xiulan felt a great weight lifted from her mind. She went to the balcony to hang up the clothes washed that morning, then returned to the living room, where the family sat together and watched TV for a while. Ma Mingzhe turned somersaults on the sofa, and Ma Yuxin ran around showing everyone her painting, insisting that each person give her a kiss. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang leaned against the sofa and scrolled on his phone. Xiulan felt that this moment was ordinary yet happy.
location: Balcony and living room at home in Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pre-treatment of pickled vegetables and hand embroidery finishing
description: While the children were watching TV, Xiulan went back to the kitchen, took out the radish strips and cowpeas that had been salted and drained of excess water, and left them to dry, ready to officially make the pickling sauce the next day. Then she remembered that the hand-embroidery order Sister Zheng had introduced the day before was still a little short of finishing, so she took out the needle, thread, and the semi-finished piece from the cabinet, and under the soft sunlight in the living room, she embroidered it stitch by stitch. She was calculating in her mind that once this batch of pickled vegetables was made, it could also add to the family income just like the handcraft work.
location: In her own home in Jinghai District, Tianjin: the kitchen and beside the sewing machine in the living room

name: Prepare dinner
description: Feeling cheerful, Xiulan reheated the leftover noodles and gravy from lunch, tossed a cold dish with the newly bought vegetables, and fried a plate of peanuts to go with her husband's drink. The simple dinner was full of warm family feeling.
location: Kitchen of her home in Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Dinner and casual family chat.
description: The family chatted while eating dinner. Xuanxuan took the initiative to talk about the start of school, Zhezhe complained that there was too much winter vacation homework, and her husband, Ma Zhiqiang, said he had to make a long trip to Shandong the next day and asked Xiulan to take care of things at home. While listening, Xiulan served food to everyone and began planning to start making the first batch of pickled vegetables as soon as her husband left.
location: Dining room at my own home in Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Watching stars with my daughter.
description: After dinner, Xiulan walked into the small courtyard and looked up. The sky had actually cleared, the clouds had parted, and a few glittering stars were visible. She hurried back inside and called out to her youngest daughter: "Xinxin, come quick, the stars are out!" Ma Yuxin cheered and ran into the courtyard. Xiulan pointed to the brightest star in the north and told her it was the North Star. Her daughter hummed the nursery rhyme "Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star" she had learned in kindergarten in a sweet, childish voice. The mother and daughter spent a good while identifying stars in the courtyard, feeling the peace of the early spring night. Xiulan felt especially happy.
location: Small courtyard at home in Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Finished up the handmade embroidery order
description: Back inside from the yard, Xinxin was coaxed by her dad to go wash up. Xiulan continued to sit at the sewing machine and finished the last few stitches. This handmade embroidery order was a pair of pillowcases that could be delivered to Sister Zheng tomorrow, earning 40 yuan in handwork fees, just enough to help offset the cost of buying jars. She carefully checked the stitches to make sure there were no mistakes.
location: At her home in Jinghai District, Tianjin, next to the sewing machine in the living room.

name: Urge the children to wash up and put the youngest daughter to bed.
description: At nine o'clock, Xiulan put down her needlework and urged the three children to tidy up and get ready for bed. After a bit of commotion, Xuanxuan and Zhezhe went to wash up by themselves. Xiulan carefully washed Ma Yuxin's face, applied cream, then told her a bedtime story, watching her youngest daughter close her eyes and fall soundly asleep.
location: Bathroom and children's room in her own home, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Wrapping up the bookkeeping and planning tomorrow's tasks.
description: The children were all asleep, and her husband, who had to get up early to drive for work tomorrow, had also turned in early. Xiulan quietly tidied the living room, put the radish strips and cowpeas she had bought today into a large basin, and prepared to make the pickling brine the next morning. She took out her account book, gathered the receipts one by one, and recorded every expense from the day—the 85 yuan for supplementary ingredients and the money spent at the vegetable market—without missing a single item. name: Mobilize the whole family for a thorough cleaning and divide up the chores
description: Woke up the whole family. After everyone had breakfast, held a brief mobilization meeting in the living room. Took out the written task list and divided the work clearly: her husband Ma Zhiqiang was responsible for wiping all the windows and cleaning the range hood; her eldest son Ma Mingxuan tidied his desk and bookshelf; her second son Ma Mingzhe sorted the toys in his room into storage boxes; her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin wiped her small desk, chair, and toy shelf. She herself started taking apart and washing the bed sheets and pillowcases, and put them into the washing machine. The whole family took their positions and began cleaning with great enthusiasm.
location: Living room and various rooms at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Deep Cleaning and Encouraging Her Daughter
description: Propose reasonable adjustment suggestions: shorten each embroidery session (for example, move around every half hour), and combine with lower back protection exercises (such as the stretching movements the doctor taught).
location: Various rooms of the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Family lunch and midday rest to recover.
description: The children were all tired, so she simply made tomato and egg noodles. Her husband went downstairs to dispose of the accumulated rubbish all at once. The whole family sat around the refreshed dining table. Though the meal was simple, it tasted especially delicious. After eating, she urged everyone to take a half-hour nap to recover their energy for the afternoon's plans.
location: Dining room and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Final cleaning and checking the pickle jars
description: The children and her husband were still resting, and she began the finishing touches alone. She first took a tour of the whole house, using a damp cloth to wipe down details such as all doorknobs, light switches, and baseboards. Then she took the washed sheets, quilt covers, and curtains to the yard to air out. After finishing, she walked to the corner of the yard to check the pickled vegetable jars that had been sealed yesterday. She carefully lifted the lids and gently turned the radish strips and cowpeas with clean chopsticks to let them breathe. Smelling the nice aroma, she felt a bit more at ease.
location: The rooms and courtyard of the family home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Shopping at the vegetable market and supermarket
description: After changing into outdoor clothes, she first walked to the Wutong Commune vegetable market, found the stall of her acquaintance Aunt Sun Guifang, picked two jin of fresh pork ribs, and also bought a bunch of baby bok choy, some scallions and ginger, green peppers, and potatoes. Aunt Sun heard the children were about to start school and wished the family all the best. Then on the way she stopped by the Jingbai Supermarket at Yuzhou Zunfu, bought soy sauce, vinegar, and a bag of sugar that were almost used up, and chatted a few words of everyday small talk with Shufen, an acquaintance at the supermarket. Then she walked home.

participant.name: Sun Guifang
participant.relation: An acquaintance who runs a stall at the vegetable market

location: Wutong Commune Food Market, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China; then to Jingbai Supermarket, Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu

name: Prepare a hearty dinner
description: After returning home, she went into the kitchen, blanched the pork ribs, and started making the braised pork ribs the children love. Meanwhile she washed and cut baby bok choy and green peppers for a stir-fry, and beat eggs and sliced tomatoes for soup. She deliberately used low-sodium salt for seasoning. The rich aroma of stewed ribs gradually filled the kitchen — this was a special "cheer-up meal" prepared for the children's first day of school tomorrow.
location: Own kitchen at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Family dinner and back-to-school encouragement
description: The husband and children helped set out the bowls and chopsticks, and the whole family sat around the newly refreshed dining table to enjoy the steaming hot dinner. She picked up a piece of sparerib for her second son and took the opportunity to encourage the children: "School starts tomorrow. Today we cleaned the house thoroughly, so you should go to school with a brand-new spirit. Xuanxuan is in the second year of junior high, so schoolwork matters; Zhezhe needs to focus and not just think about playing; Xinxin is in the top kindergarten class now and must be more obedient. Dad will be going out on the road again the day after tomorrow, so you need to take care of each other at home." The children all nodded earnestly in agreement.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Parent-child leisure and homework check
description: After the meal, her husband cleared the dishes. She supervised her second son Ma Mingzhe as he checked his winter vacation homework, made sure all the assignments had been made up, and helped him sharpen the pencils he would need the next day. At the same time, she kept her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin company as she drew a picture of the family on white paper. The eldest son Ma Mingxuan quietly read a book in his room by himself. Around eight o'clock, she sat with Zhezhe and Xinxin on the living room sofa, turned down the TV volume, and watched cartoons for a while, enjoying the sense of comfort that a clean and tidy home brought.
location: Own living room and bedroom at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Urge the children to wash up and go to bed.
description: Urged the two children to go wash up. She helped her daughter brush her teeth and wash her face, coaxed her into bed, and then told her a short part of the story 'The Little Horse Crosses the River.' She fell into a sweet sleep before nine. Then she went to her second son's room, saw that he was already lying down, and reminded him to set his alarm. Finally, she went to her eldest son's room; he was still reviewing his lessons on his own. She chatted with him for a bit and told him to rest early too.
location: Own bathroom and bedroom at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Tidying up and relaxing before bed.
description: The children were all sound asleep. I went back to the living room and simply tidied up the coffee table. Then I opened my phone and sent a message in the family WeChat group reminding everyone to pay attention to the weather changes. After washing up alone, I lay down on the bed. After a day of work, I felt an aching back and sore waist. I did a simple set of leg stretches, thinking about getting up early to take the children to school tomorrow while planning what to make for lunch. Around ten-thirty, I turned off the lights and fell asleep, ending a fulfilling and satisfying day.
location: Own bedroom at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Morning wake-up and stretching
description: The alarm went off at 5:50 a.m. She lingered in the warm bed for another 5 minutes, feeling completely awake. Then she slowly sat up, leaned against the headboard, and did a simple 5-minute stretch to loosen her shoulder and back that had grown stiff from sleeping.
