The sky outside was still dark, and she could hear the wind howling. Today was a northwest wind of force 3 to 4, so she had to keep the windows tightly closed.
location: Her own bedroom at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Carefully prepared breakfast for the family
description: She got up quietly, washed up briefly, and changed into loungewear. For breakfast today she made something warm: millet and sweet potato porridge in a clay pot, steamed a few firm mantou buns bought yesterday, sliced a plate of her own crisp pickled radish strips, and quickly stir-fried scallion eggs. The whole house filled with fragrance. Thinking that today was Friday and the three children didn't need to go to kindergarten or after-school care in the afternoon, she felt at ease.
location: Home kitchen at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Waking up the children and breakfast time
description: At 7:20 I went to wake the children one by one. The eldest, Xuanxuan, didn't need urging—he was already dressed and previewing English. The second child, Zhezhe, and my little daughter Xinxin were wriggling in bed, and it took a lot of talking to get them up. The four of us sat around the table, and I told them that the most important thing this morning was to check their winter vacation homework. Come one by one after eating, and be mindful of it.
location: Home restaurant, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Check the winter vacation homework of the three children one by one
description: After clearing the dishes, I officially started checking homework. First, I sat with Xinxin in the small study and looked at her tracing book and drawings, praising her smooth lines, then pointed out three crooked strokes for her to trace again. Next I called over the second child, Zhezhe. He was indeed the one who worries me most: he got two math word problems wrong, and the new Chinese characters in his language homework were written crookedly. I circled them in red pen and patiently took him through them one by one. Finally, I checked Xuanxuan's homework and found that he had basically gotten everything right, and had even previewed the classical Chinese texts for the new semester on his own. That reassured me a lot. I only helped him correct the spelling of two English words.
location: Living room and study at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Rest break and preparing lunch ingredients.
description: After three hours of hard work, I let the children read their own books or play for a while. I stretched my sore neck and took Xinxin into the kitchen. From the fridge I found the Chinese cabbage, tofu, and pork belly bought yesterday, and planned to make Chinese cabbage stewed with tofu—warm and appetizing. I had Xinxin peel two garlic cloves. My daughter happily followed me around, peeling garlic and chattering about kindergarten, and the kitchen was full of lively noise.
location: Her own kitchen and living room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Simple lunch and a short midday rest.
description: At 11:40 noon, the meal was served on time. A steaming hot dish of Chinese cabbage stewed with tofu was put on the table, along with warm steamed buns. The three children all had good appetites at noon, especially Zhezhe, who ate two bowls. I served myself a small bowl of porridge. After the meal, I urged the children to brush their teeth and get ready for their afternoon nap. I quickly cleared the dishes, wrapped the leftovers in plastic wrap, and put them in the fridge. I also leaned back on the living room sofa with my eyes closed for 20 minutes. Lately I keep thinking about selling pickled vegetables, and I tend to wake up easily at night.
location: Home restaurant, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The children's midday nap and my miscellaneous tasks
description: Urged my eldest son Xuanxuan to take his younger brother and sister for an afternoon nap and closed the door for them. I sat down quietly in the living room, found the loose thread of an embroidered insole I had been helping someone make last week, finished it off during this quiet time, and gently ironed it flat, planning to deliver it tomorrow.
location: Living room and bedroom of home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Calling Mom and contacting her cousin's wife to collect feedback on the pickled vegetables
description: After the afternoon nap ended, the children were still asleep. I first called my mother, who lives at 45 Shengli Street, to ask how she was. Since the temperature had dropped these past two days, I told her not to go out. After hanging up, I remembered the pickled vegetables. I took out my phone and opened WeChat, and sent voice messages one by one to my second cousin-in-law, third cousin-in-law, and older female cousin, sincerely asking them how the "Ma Family Pickles" trial packs tasted—whether the saltiness was right, whether the texture was crunchy, and whether they had any suggestions for improvement. Replies came quickly. Everyone said it was not bad and went great with rice. My third cousin-in-law even kept asking when I would make a larger batch, because she planned to buy several jars to give as gifts. Hearing these words, my heart felt as sweet as if I had eaten honey, and I felt more confident.
location: Home living room at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Afternoon preparations and changing into a thick coat to go out
description: The WeChat chat was lively, and I was in a great mood. I looked out the window; the sunshine was nice but the wind was quite strong. Remembering that I had planned to take photos today, I went back to the bedroom and changed into that thick maroon cotton-padded jacket, wrapped a scarf around my neck, and put on a hat. I took out the old digital camera, checked the battery and memory card, and confirmed it had enough battery. When passing by my daughter's room, I saw her sleeping soundly, her little face rosy, and couldn't help gently closing the door.
location: Own bedroom and living room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Documenting neighborly warmth: Wang Guilan and Zhang Shufen
description: At 2:10 p.m., I took my camera and went out. Sure enough, Sister Wang Guilan from No. 158 across the street was sitting at her doorstep enjoying the sun and trimming chives. I walked over with a smile to greet her, naturally pulled up a small stool and sat down. While helping her trim the vegetables, I chatted about receiving Zhiqiang's call last night—he had made another trip to Cangzhou, and the children would be starting school next week. When the conversation got lively, I raised my camera and snapped two candid shots of the two of us sitting on small stools, fingers moving quickly and chatting merrily. Then I strolled over to Zhang Shufen's convenience store at No. 154 diagonally opposite, pushed the door open, and saw Zhang Shufen arranging newly arrived shelves. I explained that I wanted to record neighbors' daily lives, and she was very generous, letting me take a few close-up shots of her giving change to customers and tidying up goods—very natural.
location: At the entrance of No. 158 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and Zhang Shufen Convenience Store at No. 154

name: Treating herself: buying new hair ties.
description: After coming out of the supermarket, I deliberately turned into the little sundries stall at the alley entrance that I often visited. I stopped in front of the colorful hair tie stall. My black elastic band had been used for nearly a year and was getting loose. I paused in front of a row of hair ties and finally picked a bright red elastic one with a few tiny white flowers on it. 'Boss, how much is this?' 'Three yuan.' I paid without hesitation, and facing the small mirror the stall owner handed over, I tied the new hair tie into a ponytail at the back of my head on the spot. I looked left and right, feeling both spirited and festive, and was secretly delighted. It felt really good to treat myself occasionally.
location: A small commodities stall at the alley entrance near No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Returning home, tidying up, and taking a short rest
description: When I got home, the children were already awake, and Xuanxuan was watching cartoons with his younger brother and sister. I first imported the photos from the camera into the computer, created a subfolder 20250214 under the Neighborhood Daily folder, and saved the dozens of photos I had just taken into it. I also looked through the photos from taking the children out yesterday, feeling warm inside. Then I poured myself a glass of warm water and sat on the sofa to rest my feet.
location: Home living room at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Carefully preparing dinner for the whole family
description: Rested enough, I got up to prepare dinner. Today is Friday, and I wanted to give the children a better meal. I took out the pork ribs I bought yesterday from the fridge to thaw, and soaked some dried shiitake mushrooms and wood ear mushrooms. I planned to braise the ribs with mushrooms until tender in a pressure cooker, stir-fry a refreshing garlic lettuce, and make a tomato and egg soup, with both meat and vegetables. In the kitchen, the sounds of washing vegetables, cutting, and blanching rose and fell one after another. Smelling the aroma of the ribs browning in the pot, I felt especially happy.
location: Home kitchen at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: A warm dinner time
description: At 5:30, the food was served. The ribs stewed in the pressure cooker were tender and flavorful, the shiitake mushrooms had absorbed all the meat juices, and the aroma spread the moment the pot was opened. The three children gathered around as soon as they smelled it. I put a big rib in each of their bowls, picked up my own rice bowl, and chatted with them while eating. I asked Xuanxuan whether he had previewed today's lessons, reminded Zhezhe that playing was fine but homework must not be forgotten, and praised Xinxin for writing the characters in her tracing book more neatly today. The dining table was filled with warm questions and the children's replies.
location: Home restaurant, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Supervising study and bedtime preparation
description: After dinner, I quickly cleared the dishes and put away the chopsticks. Then I accompanied Zhezhe and Xinxin in planning tomorrow's study schedule and urged them to do some of the weekend homework in advance. I watched Xuanxuan go back to his room to read by himself and felt very relieved. Afterwards, I supervised the three children as they took turns brushing their teeth, washing their faces, and washing their feet. As I watched Xinxin clumsily hang up her little towel, I felt that although life was plain, the children were growing up day by day.
location: Living room and bathroom of her home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Putting her daughter to sleep and keeping her son company
description: At 8 o'clock, I took Xinxin to bed and told her two stories from my own childhood. Hearing her breathing gradually steady, I hugged her little face and gave her a kiss, then gently turned off the light and came out. In the living room, Xuanxuan was packing his schoolbag. I walked over, stroked his head, and told him not to get too tired tomorrow even though it was Saturday, and that he could relax a bit.
location: Daughter's bedroom and eldest son's room, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Personal washing up and relaxing stretches.
description: At 9 o'clock, I finally had some time to myself. I enjoyed a comfortable hot bath and changed into thick pajamas. Lying in bed, I did a set of before-sleep stretches and felt my whole body relax. I picked up my phone and saw someone in the extended family group say that it was going to get colder again tomorrow, so I forwarded it to our own family group.
location: Own bathroom and bedroom at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Sleep peacefully.
description: After Mingxuan finished his supervised homework, the family sat down together for lunch, and Xiulan told the children the afternoon arrangements. After the meal, Mingxuan led his younger siblings to wash the dishes and wipe the table, while Xiulan fished out the salted radish strips and drained them in a bamboo basket. The afternoon sun was just right, so she spread the radish strips evenly on a bamboo drying tray in the yard and set it in a ventilated spot to dry. Then she went back to the kitchen and, following her mother's recipe, made a sauce with light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, aged vinegar, sugar, star anise, and dried chili peppers. After it boiled and gave off a fragrant aroma, she turned off the heat and let it cool.
location: Her own bedroom at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning stretching
description: After waking up naturally in the early morning, Ma Xiulan gently moved her arms and legs while still in bed, then got out of bed and stretched for 5 minutes on the floor mat, specifically adding waist-twisting movements to relieve the soreness from checking the children's homework the day before. After stretching, she felt refreshed and was in an especially light mood at the thought of her husband's return.
location: Her own bedroom at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Breakfast time
description: Xiulan prepared breakfast in the kitchen: she heated millet porridge, fried scallion eggs, heated big white steamed buns, and mixed pickled vegetables. Then she woke the three children, urged them to wash up, and they sat around the table to eat. While eating, she reminded the children to do their homework and read in the morning and not to horse around, and told them she would take them to buy school supplies in the afternoon.
location: Her own kitchen and dining room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Housework and embroidery organizing
description: She put away the dishes and chopsticks, scrubbed the stove, cleaned the living room, and tidied up the children's toys. Then she went back to the bedroom, put away the ironed embroidered insoles, and prepared to show them to Sister Zhou Xiuqin on the next market day.
location: Living room and bedroom of home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Shopping at the vegetable market.
description: Xiulan walked to the Wutong Commune vegetable market. She first went to Sun Guifang's vegetable stall to pick Chinese cabbage, garlic sprouts, spinach, and so on. Auntie Sun warmly gave her some cilantro and chatted about her husband's return. Then she went to the butcher shop to buy pork ribs and pork belly, preparing for lunch and the reunion.

participant.name: Sun Guifang
participant.relation: The aunt at the vegetable stall

location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare lunch.
description: After returning home, Xiulan immediately dealt with the ingredients: she blanched the pork ribs, sliced the napa cabbage, soaked the vermicelli, and slowly simmered a rib soup in a clay pot. Meanwhile, she prepared stir-fried mixed vegetables and leaf lettuce, and while washing and chopping, she kept glancing at the courtyard gate, hoping her husband would return.
location: Home kitchen at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family lunch and gathering.
description: Her husband, Ma Zhiqiang, drove back. Xiulan welcomed him at the courtyard gate, and the children swarmed around. Xiulan quickly finished the last few dishes, and the family sat together to enjoy stewed pork with Chinese cabbage and vermicelli, stir-fried mixed vegetables, and more. During the meal, Zhiqiang told a story about encountering heavy fog on the road and how drivers helped each other, and the atmosphere was warm and lively.
location: The yard entrance and dining room of home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Casual chat on lunch break
description: After the meal, Xiulan brewed tea for her husband, and the two returned to the bedroom to rest. She talked with Zhiqiang about the children's winter vacation homework and also mentioned that the pickle tasting had received good feedback. Third Cousin-in-law wanted to buy more to give as gifts. The couple discussed the prospects of the small business, warm and understanding.
location: Home master bedroom at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Depositing education savings at the bank
description: Xiulan took 150 yuan in cash and her bankbook out of the iron box and walked to the Jinghai Sub-branch of China Construction Bank. At the counter, she handled the February education savings deposit. After checking the figures in her bankbook, she carefully put it away, feeling much more at ease.
location: China Construction Bank Tianjin Jinghai Sub-branch, No. 5 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Taking the children to pick out stationery
description: After depositing the money, she went home and took the three children to Jingbai Supermarket and the nearby stationery store. She chose a black backpack for Xuanxuan and a pink cartoon schoolbag for Xinxin, and bought exercise books, pencils, erasers, and other school supplies, budgeting carefully to make the most of everything.
location: Jingbai Supermarket and the adjacent stationery store, Unit 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Organizing stationery and preparing dinner ingredients.
description: After returning home, Xiulan had the children organize their new school supplies and old schoolbags. She went into the kitchen, washed the Hebei smoked sausage her husband had brought back with warm water and set it aside, and dealt with the leftover lunch dishes to prepare for dinner.
location: Her living room and kitchen at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Preparing the stove-side dinner.
description: Xiulan swept the yard clean, gathered up the clutter, and made space for the stove gathering. Then in the kitchen she sliced smoked sausage, stir-fried cured sausage with green peppers, sautéed spinach with garlic, heated the pork, cabbage, and vermicelli stew, and made seaweed egg drop soup, setting everything up for the family's outdoor dinner.
location: Own yard and kitchen, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Fireside family dinner
description: As dusk fell, Xiulan lit the charcoal stove in the middle of the yard and the whole family sat around it. Zhiqiang talked about amusing things on the road, such as a little dog at the service area that made a bowing gesture, and the children were fascinated. Everyone enjoyed dishes such as smoked sausage, laughing and chatting in a warm, happy atmosphere.
location: Home courtyard at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: After-meal cleanup and children's washing up
description: Xiulan and Zhiqiang washed the dishes and tidied up together, then urged the three children to wash up in turn, keeping a special eye on Zhezhe to make sure he brushed his teeth properly. She told her youngest daughter Xinxin a bedtime story about a little dog that she had heard from Zhiqiang, until the child fell peacefully asleep.
location: The kitchen, bathroom, and bedroom of their home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Couple's alone time and financial review
description: After getting the children settled, the couple sat side by side on the sofa watching local news. Xiulan noted the day's expenses, checked the vehicle expenses with Zhiqiang, and discussed taking pickled vegetables to neighbor Wang Guilan the next day—a sign of their tacit understanding in daily life.
location: Home living room at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Bedtime relaxation exercises.
description: Xiulan arranged cushions and a thin blanket in the bedroom and turned off the main light to create an ambiance. Then she sat side by side with Zhiqiang on the edge of the bed and followed the phone's instructions to practice deep inhalation, breath holding, and slow exhalation. After a 5-minute cycle, both felt relief from fatigue and inner calm.
location: Home master bedroom at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Pre-bedtime check and going to bed
description: After the relaxation practice, Xiulan wrote in her ledger, "Day one of deep breathing practice, feels great, need to stick with it." She exchanged goodnights with Zhiqiang, turned off the light, and went to bed, ending a fulfilling day in the quiet night.
location: Home master bedroom at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Morning stretching, blood pressure monitoring, and breakfast
description: Starting at 06:50, Ma Xiulan got up and did morning stretching and shoulder-neck exercises. Then she measured and recorded her father Ma Jianguo's blood pressure (systolic 135, diastolic 80). Afterwards, she washed up and prepared breakfast for the family, including millet porridge, steamed buns, flower rolls, and scrambled eggs. During this time, she woke the children and urged them to eat breakfast. The whole family ate together.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home)

name: Visiting parents and picking up packages
description: After breakfast, Ma Xiulan took her younger daughter Ma Yuxin and walked to her parents' home (No. 45 Shengli Street) to visit, carrying a thermos of millet porridge and scrambled eggs. At her parents' home, she chatted with her mother Li Xiuying, her father Ma Jianguo enjoyed the breakfast she had brought, and Ma Yuxin played in the yard. After about half an hour, she returned alone, picking up a package on the way at the parcel collection point at the intersection of Jingwen Road, then went home.
location: 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin (parents' home)

name: Making the first batch of soy-pickled radish
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan and her husband Ma Zhiqiang processed the white radishes together, washing, peeling, and cutting them into strips. Following the family's ancestral recipe, they added salt, sugar, soy sauce, black vinegar, ginger, garlic, and baijiu, mixed everything evenly, pressed a heavy object on top to start pickling, and recorded the start time in a notebook.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home kitchen)

name: Checked and organized the back-to-school supplies for her two sons
description: Ma Xiulan called her eldest son Ma Mingxuan and her second son Ma Mingzhe over and checked their schoolbags, winter vacation homework, and school uniforms. She fixed the zipper on Ma Mingxuan's schoolbag and praised his neat work; she urged Ma Mingzhe to correct his math mistakes, sewed up the open seam on the cuff of his school uniform, and reminded him to concentrate on his studies when the new term began.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home living room and children's bedroom)

name: Organize the youngest daughter's back-to-school items and communicate with her homeroom teacher.
description: After picking up her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin, Ma Xiulan checked her picture books and crayons, washed the kindergarten nap bedding, and proactively contacted her eldest son's homeroom teacher, Teacher Han Mei, via WeChat to confirm the school registration time (February 28 at 8:30), the class schedule, and the parent-teacher meeting arrangements, expressing her willingness to cooperate with the school.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home living room)

name: Tended to the soy-pickled radish that was curing.
description: After the soy-pickled radishes had been curing for nearly two hours, Ma Xiulan took out the radish strips, drained them, and rinsed them with clean water. She prepared the pickling sauce (boiling light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, rock sugar, dried chilies, star anise, etc., then letting it cool), arranged the radish strips in a glass jar, poured in the sauce and baijiu, sealed it, and placed it in a cool spot in the kitchen, looking forward to eating it in three to five days.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home kitchen)

name: Preparing lunch, having lunch, and taking a midday rest
description: Ma Xiulan cooked a pot of shredded pork noodles with cabbage, mushrooms, and pork belly, and made a cucumber salad. The whole family had lunch together. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang praised the delicious soup. After the meal, Ma Xiulan rested briefly in the living room, scrolled through messages on her phone, then reminded the children to change clothes and get ready to go out.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home kitchen and dining room)

name: The whole family goes to People's Park for a brisk walk and takes a family photo
description: The family of five walked to Jinghai District People’s Park, did brisk walking on the path to exercise, and Ma Xiulan used her phone to capture candid shots of the children playing. Afterwards, they set up a tripod in front of the central flower bed, took several family portraits, and set the best one as the phone wallpaper.
location: West side of the intersection of Shengli Street and Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (Jinghai District People's Park)

name: Deliver homemade pickled vegetables to neighbor Wang Guilan
description: After returning from the park, Ma Xiulan went home to get two bottles of spicy pickled vegetables and a jar of newly pickled radish, and took them to her next-door neighbor Wang Guilan's home. After tasting them, Wang Guilan repeatedly praised her skill. The two chatted about daily life, and Ma Xiulan shared her idea of making more to sell.
location: 158 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (neighbor Wang Guilan's home)

name: Brief midday rest.
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan felt tired and rested with her eyes closed on the living room sofa for half an hour. The children each played on their own, and her husband Ma Zhiqiang did not disturb her.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home living room)

name: Went to Wutong Commune Market to buy ingredients for dinner
description: Ma Xiulan walked to the Wutong Community Vegetable Market on the eastern section of Wutong Road. At Aunt Sun Guifang's stall, she bought celery, mushrooms, garlic sprouts, tomatoes, and lemons, then went to the butcher shop to buy pork belly and chicken legs. After returning home, she sorted and stored the ingredients, and began preparing dinner, slicing the pork belly, tearing the mushrooms into small pieces, and so on.
location: The Wutong Commune vegetable market on the eastern section of Wutong Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and home at 156 Jingwen Road

name: Guide the children to finish the back-to-school wrap-up and prepare and enjoy dinner.
description: Ma Xiulan checked the three children's preparation for the new school term. She praised Ma Mingxuan for keeping his room tidy, taught Ma Mingzhe how to fold his school uniform, and guided Ma Yuxin in organizing her picture albums. Then she went into the kitchen to make cucumber salad with newly bought lemons and minced garlic, stir-fried garlic sprouts with shredded pork, mushrooms with green peppers, and steamed egg custard, adjusting the seasoning to suit the family's low-salt diet. At 18:00 the whole family enjoyed dinner; the cucumber salad was well received, and the atmosphere was warm.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (living room, children's room, and kitchen at home)

name: Housework after dinner and supervising the children's bedtime washing
description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan cleared the dishes while her husband Ma Zhiqiang helped wipe the table. Ma Xiulan put the leftovers in the refrigerator and washed the pots, pans, bowls, and dishes. Then she urged the three children to take baths one by one, hurrying along her dawdling second son, Ma Mingzhe. In the meantime, she recorded today's grocery expenses of 56 yuan and about 15 yuan for pickled vegetable seasonings, and checked the education savings. Finally, she dried her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin's hair, told her the story "The Little Horse Crosses the River," and coaxed her to sleep.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home kitchen, bathroom, and bedroom)

name: Family free activity and bedtime preparation
description: After the youngest daughter fell asleep, Ma Xiulan went to the living room and saw her eldest son Ma Mingxuan using a tablet to look up study materials, while her second son Ma Mingzhe and her husband Ma Zhiqiang were doing a jigsaw puzzle. Ma Xiulan sat on the sofa browsing her phone and saved the Lantern Festival event link. At 21:00 she urged the two boys to brush their teeth and washed up herself, ready for bed.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (living room and bedroom at home)

name: Bedtime deep breathing exercise.
description: Ma Xiulan and her husband Ma Zhiqiang did deep breathing exercises in the master bedroom, timing themselves with a phone. They used a rhythm of inhaling for 4 seconds, holding for 2 seconds, and exhaling for 6 seconds, repeating it for 8 minutes. They felt more relaxed than yesterday, and their breathing was steady. Ma Xiulan wrote down her feelings about the practice in her diary, felt good, and checked her father's blood pressure records to confirm everything was normal.
location: Tianjin, Jinghai District, 156 Jingwen Road (master bedroom at home)

name: Keeping accounts and going to bed
description: Ma Xiulan opened the account book in the bedroom and recorded all of the day's expenses: 56 yuan for groceries and about 15 yuan for pickling seasonings. She flipped through her father's blood pressure log, confirmed everything was normal, then turned off her phone, reviewed the fulfilling day, and fell asleep peacefully around 22:20.
location: Tianjin, Jinghai District, 156 Jingwen Road (master bedroom at home)

name: Morning preparations and taking the children to school
description: At 6:30 in the morning the alarm went off, and Xiulan got up quietly so as not to wake the sleeping children. She put on a jacket, washed up, and went into the kitchen to start preparing breakfast for the children who were about to start school. She specially cooked millet and red date porridge and reheated the steamed meat buns made the day before. The kitchen was filled with a warm, cozy aroma. At 7 o'clock sharp, she woke the three children one by one: the eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, was the quickest and changed into his school uniform by himself; the second son, Ma Mingzhe, was sleepy-eyed and took a long time finding his socks; the youngest daughter, Ma Yuxin, pouted and lingered in bed, and Xiulan coaxed her while dressing her by saying the kindergarten was handing out new books today. She urged the children to wash up and checked their schoolbags to make sure the red scarves were all ready. At 7:25 the family sat around the table. Xiulan peeled an egg for Yuxin, reminded Mingxuan that eighth-grade schoolwork was important, then called Mingzhe over and seriously reminded him that his math homework notebook had been put back in his schoolbag, so he did not need to run back home at noon. Mingzhe mumbled in agreement and ate quickly. At 7:45 the children put on their schoolbags. While Xiulan was tidying their collars at the door, she suddenly remembered Mingzhe's homework notebook. She took it out of the bag behind the door, stuffed it into his schoolbag, and sternly told him to hand it in as soon as he arrived at school. She watched them until they disappeared at the end of the alley, then went back inside, finished the remaining porridge, cleared the dishes, and opened the living room curtains.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning exercise and communication.
description: At exactly 8 o'clock, Xiulan did 10 minutes of morning stretching on the living room mat. After several days of practice, her movements were smooth and the soreness in her shoulders and neck eased. After stretching, she took out her notebook, wrote down her feelings, took a photo, and sent it to her neighbor Wang Guilan with encouraging words. Wang Guilan quickly replied with a thumbs-up animation and a voice message: 'Xiulan, you really have perseverance! I have been following along for the past two days and I feel quite comfortable too.' After resting for a moment, Xiulan called her father Ma Jianguo, who lives on Shengli Street. Learning that he had measured his blood pressure, that it was normal, and that he had written it in his notebook, she felt relieved. Then she found her third cousin's wife on WeChat, introduced in detail the prices and packaging of the soy-pickled radish and pickled vegetables (packed in small jars, vacuum-packed), and took sample photos to send. Her third cousin's wife was very interested and said she needed to discuss the quantity with her family.
location: In the living room and by the dining table at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Inspected and tasted the pickled radishes
description: After dealing with miscellaneous matters, Xiulan went into the kitchen to check the newly pickled soy-sauce radishes. When she opened the jar lid, the pungent aroma of soy sauce and spices hit her nose, and the radishes had clearly deepened in color. She used clean chopsticks to turn the radishes so the seasoning would spread evenly. Noticing the brine was a bit low, she dissolved salt in cooled boiled water and added it along the inner wall of the jar. Satisfied with how they looked, she picked a small piece to taste. It was just right in saltiness and rich in soy flavor, so she couldn't resist tasting another slice. However, eating salty food on an empty stomach irritated her stomach, and she soon felt slight burning and discomfort. She quickly drank some warm water and paced around, and the discomfort gradually disappeared. She noted in her pickling record: "Tasting caused mild acid reflux; avoid eating too much on an empty stomach."
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Household chores and account book checking
description: Once her stomach felt better, Xiulan began doing housework. She sorted the sheets, quilt covers removed yesterday, and the children's clothes into the washing machine, then picked up a rag and mop and carefully wiped the furniture and floors in the living room and bedrooms. While the washing machine was running, she took out the family ledger from a drawer, put on her reading glasses, checked last week's expenses item by item, and added today's grocery and daily necessities budget to the month-end summary. She paid special attention to vegetable prices and planned what to buy at the market in the afternoon.
location: Various rooms and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Simple lunch and waiting for her second son to come home
description: Nearing noon, because her stomach had been feeling unwell earlier, Xiulan decided to make a light lunch. She boiled water and cooked thin noodles, sliced some braised beef left over from the day before, blanched some baby bok choy, and made a bowl of beef and vegetable noodles. She sat at the table and ate slowly, feeling warm in her stomach. After the meal, she rested while keeping an eye on the door. Around 11:40, her second son, Mingzhe, ran back breathless, went straight to the desk, and rummaged for his homework notebook. Xiulan did not scold him much, reminded him to put his homework into his schoolbag when finished in the future, and urged him to hurry back to school so he wouldn't miss class. She watched him leave hurriedly with his homework notebook.
location: Kitchen, dining room, and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Lunch break
description: There were still things to do in the afternoon, so Xiulan took advantage of the break to lie in bed for half an hour. She set her phone alarm and closed her eyes to rest. Although she didn't fully fall asleep, the busy morning was eased, and her spirits recovered considerably.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Hand-stitched embroidered pieces
description: After the afternoon rest, she felt refreshed. Xiulan remembered that a batch of embroidery Sister Zheng had sent over last week was still unfinished. She took out her embroidery needle and materials, sat on the sofa, and embroidered quietly for about half an hour. It was a pair of pillowcases for a newlywed couple next door, with the meaning “a hundred years of happy union.” She sewed with extra care, her stitches even and dense.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Vegetable market shopping and sorting
description: Considering the children need to eat after school, Xiulan put on a thick coat, took her shopping bag and wallet, and walked about 15 minutes to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market. She went to Aunt Sun Guifang's stall and picked out Chinese cabbage, garlic sprouts, and tender tofu. At the meat stall she bought half a jin of pork belly to make braised pork. While paying, she chatted a bit with Aunt Sun and said her grandson also started school today. Then she went to the dried goods stall and bought wood ear mushrooms and vermicelli. After walking home, she sorted the vegetables, soaked the ones needing washing in the sink, cut the meat into portions and froze them. She also swept the kitchen and dining room briefly with a broom to prepare for dinner.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Wutong Commune, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and home at 156 Jingwen Road

name: Dinner preparation and rest
description: Xiulan put the rinsed rice into the rice cooker in advance and set it to cook on a timer, blanched the pork belly, and prepared the ingredients for caramelizing sugar, so cooking dinner in the evening would be more relaxed. After finishing, she went back to the living room, sat down, poured a glass of warm water to rest her feet, and while browsing her phone, checked the notifications in the community WeChat group.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick the children up from school.
description: At 3:30 p.m., Xiulan changed into her outdoor shoes, put on a helmet, and rode her electric bike to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up her second son. She left early to avoid traffic. Around 4:00, third grade let out. Xiulan met Mingzhe at the school gate. As soon as he came out of the school gate, he shouted that he was hungry. Xiulan let him get on the bike and said there was meat at home to eat. Then she rode to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten and arrived about 10 minutes later. At 4:30, the kindergarten opened. Her daughter Yuxin saw her mother and brother and excitedly rushed over, holding a small red flower and a newly issued picture book. Xiulan smiled and praised her, settled the two children, and rode home.
location: Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School on Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and on the way back to 156 Jingwen Road

name: Preparing dinner and family dinner
description: Back home, Xiulan first settled the two children down to do their homework, then tied on an apron and started making dinner. She skillfully heated oil in the wok and caramelized sugar to make the braised pork belly the kids loved, and the kitchen soon filled with a tempting aroma. While the meat was simmering, she quickly stir-fried garlic sprouts with pork and made a cabbage, tofu, and vermicelli soup. Every now and then she poked her head out to urge Mingzhe to focus on his homework. When the eldest son, Mingxuan, came home from school, the whole family sat around the table, enjoying the braised pork, the stir-fried garlic sprouts with pork, and the steaming hot soup. As she served the children, Xiulan asked about their first day of school: Mingxuan said his schedule was packed; Mingzhe hemmed and hawed and said the teacher had scolded him again for forgetting his Chinese textbook. Xiulan didn't know whether to laugh or cry and reminded him again. Yuxin chattered on about a new kid in her kindergarten class.
location: Kitchen, dining room, and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Finishing up housework and helping with homework
description: After dinner, Xiulan quickly cleared the dishes and wiped down the stove. Then she sat at the desk, first checking Yuxin's pinyin tracing homework and praising her neat handwriting. Next, she focused on checking Mingzhe's math homework. Finding several word problems with incorrect calculation steps, she patiently helped him re-read the problems, set up the equations, and work through the calculations until he understood.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Bedtime preparation: storytelling and washing up
description: Just after 8 o'clock, Xiulan urged the three children to take turns bathing and brushing their teeth. She bathed Yuxin first and changed her into clean pajamas, then picked up a picture book and told two short stories about courage by the bedside until Yuxin fell asleep sweetly. After that, she went to check on Mingzhe and Mingxuan, confirming that they had washed up and were lying down to rest.
location: Living room and bedrooms at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening personal time and going to sleep.
description: All the children were asleep, and the house was completely quiet. Her husband, Ma Zhiqiang, was still out on a long-distance driving job, so Xiulan went back to the bedroom alone. She turned on the bedside lamp and did 5 minutes of deep breathing exercises by the bed, clearing her mind in the rhythm of “inhale for 4 seconds, hold for 2 seconds, exhale for 6 seconds.” She deliberately extended the exhale to relieve the stomach acid discomfort from the day, and her body became completely relaxed. After that, she took out her diary and recorded the day's expenses (groceries: 38 yuan), the progress of the pickled radish (today she turned the jar, replenished the salt water, and tasted it to confirm the flavor), and wrote, “February 17, the children started school smoothly and everything went well.” She also sent her husband a goodnight message: “Everything went fine today. The children have started school. Drive safely and rest early if you are tired.” After finishing her notes, she dimmed the light, browsed a few life-hack articles on her phone, and when she felt sleepy, she set the alarm for 6:30 the next morning, turned off the light, and fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Morning Stretching and Checking Father's Blood Pressure
description: After her phone alarm went off, Ma Xiulan got up and did 10 minutes of full-body stretching, feeling that her neck was more flexible and her body was stretched out. During the stretching, she called her father, who lives at 45 Shengli Street. Her father told her that his blood pressure this morning was 135/85, slightly higher than yesterday. Ma Xiulan immediately urged him to eat a light and low-salt lunch, and reminded him to measure it again the next day.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Family breakfast and soy-pickled radish taste test
description: After washing up, Ma Xiulan went into the kitchen, heated the meat buns, cooked millet porridge, and fried eggs. After the children got up, she brought out slices of the newly pickled radish for the family to taste. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang said it tasted good but suggested adding Sichuan peppercorns to enhance the aroma; her second son Ma Mingzhe and youngest daughter Ma Yuxin both said the sweetness could be reduced a bit. Ma Xiulan carefully noted down their feedback, and then the whole family had breakfast together. During the meal, she reminded her second son to check his schoolbag to make sure nothing was left behind, and told her youngest daughter to bring her nap supplies. Her husband finished eating in a hurry and went to start the semi-trailer truck for a short transport run.
location: Kitchen and dining room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Taking the children to school by electric bike
description: Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to take her two children to school. She first arrived at the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School on Shengli South Street, watched her second son Ma Mingzhe run into the school gate, then turned around and went to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, where she handed her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin to the morning check-up teacher before leaving with peace of mind.
location: From 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School on Shengli South Street, then to Huakang First Kindergarten.

name: Buy groceries at the market and remind father again
description: After dropping off the child, Ma Xiulan stopped by Sun Guifang's stall at Wutong Commune Vegetable Market to buy fresh garlic sprouts and tofu for her own lunch. While shopping, she called her father again and urged him to keep his lunch light and not to settle for a hasty meal, and to keep monitoring his blood pressure.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, northwest of the intersection of Jingwen Road and Chunxi Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Cook millet porridge and record adjustments to the pickle recipe
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan rinsed the millet and simmered it slowly over low heat to nourish her stomach after the discomfort from tasting pickles on an empty stomach the day before. While the porridge was cooking, she recorded in her pickle notebook the family's tasting feedback in detail: the sweetness could be reduced, her husband suggested adding Sichuan peppercorns for fragrance, and she made notes to slightly adjust the ratio of sugar to soy sauce. When the porridge was ready, she drank it while hot and felt warm and comfortable in her stomach. Then she checked the pickle jar and tasted the preserved radish to confirm that the soy sauce aroma had penetrated and the saltiness was just right, and added a note that she must eat something before tasting.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Embroidering a mandarin duck pillowcase in the living room.
description: Ma Xiulan sat on the sofa by the window in the living room where the light was sufficient, embroidering a mandarin ducks playing in water pillowcase for the newlywed young couple next door, stitching quietly and meticulously by hand. When she got up to refill her water midway, she checked her phone and replied to her friend Liu Chunmei's afternoon invitation, saying she couldn't make it because she had to pick up the child.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Had lunch and a midday rest alone
description: After embroidering, Ma Xiulan got up and moved around a bit, turned on the TV to watch local news and relax, then went to the kitchen and cooked a hot bowl of noodles with the leftover greens and mushrooms for lunch. After eating quietly alone at 11:30, she washed the dishes. At 12:00, she dimmed the lights and lay down for a midday nap. She woke naturally around 1:00, feeling in good spirits, and while resting with her eyes closed, planned to organize old photos in the afternoon.
location: Kitchen, dining room, and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Go through boxes and organize old family photos
description: Ma Xiulan took out a shoebox full of old photos from the bedroom drawer, sat on the carpet, took them out one by one, wiped off the dust with a soft cloth, and roughly sorted them by year: the children's births, a trip to Fragrant Hills in Beijing, photos with her young sisters, and so on. Each photo brought back memories, and she decided to share these stories with the children in the evening.
location: Beside the coffee table in the living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare ingredients in advance for dinner.
description: Ma Xiulan went into the kitchen, put rice on to cook, took out the pork belly and fresh garlic sprouts, and finished the prep work of cutting the meat, cleaning the vegetables, and slicing them, so that she could start stir-frying quickly after picking up the children.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up her daughter from school and receive a handmade flower from her.
description: At 16:10, Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up her second son Ma Mingzhe and urged him to finish his homework quickly. Then the mother and son went together to Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin. The daughter held up a paper flower made in her crafts class and gave it to her mother, and the three chatted happily all the way home.
location: From 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School on Shengli South Street, then to Huakang First Kindergarten.

name: Warm family dinner for four
description: After arriving home, Ma Xiulan arranged for the children to wash their hands and do homework, while she quickly stir-fried sliced pork with garlic sprouts and made tomato and egg drop soup. Around 5:30 p.m., her eldest son Ma Mingxuan came home from school by bike, and the whole family sat around the table for dinner. The youngest daughter talked about funny moments at kindergarten, and her second son shared the joy of being praised by his math teacher. The atmosphere was lively.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: After-meal chores and supervising the children's studies.
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan quickly cleared the dishes, wiped the table, and washed the dishes. She then sat down in the living room to supervise her second son, Ma Mingzhe, as he finished his math homework, checked her youngest daughter, Ma Yuxin's tracing copybook, and corrected her pinyin pronunciation. Her eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, did his exercises independently nearby and came over to ask questions when he ran into difficult problems.
location: Home dining room and living room, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: The whole family looks through old photos and agrees on the annual photo album plan
description: After the children finished their homework, Ma Xiulan brought out an old shoebox of photos. The four of them sat together on the sofa, and she explained the stories behind each photo: her husband's bashful look when he married her, their eldest son's chubby face at his one-month celebration, and the funny memory of their daughter hiding in her arms during Spring Festival firecrackers, which made the children giggle. Then she called her husband Ma Zhiqiang, who was out on the road driving, to share how moved she was while sorting the photos. They agreed to take a family portrait every month starting this year and make a family album at the end of the year as a keepsake. Her husband gladly agreed.
location: Sofa in the living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Put the youngest daughter to sleep and checked the second son's homework.
description: Ma Xiulan read two new storybooks to her youngest daughter, Ma Yuxin. After she fell asleep, she turned off the light and left. Then she went to the desk to check all of her second son Ma Mingzhe’s homework and signed his workbook after confirming it was done.
location: Children's room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Deep breathing before bed, keeping accounts, and going to sleep.
description: After all the children were asleep, Ma Xiulan changed into her pajamas and sat cross-legged in the dim light at the head of the bed for five minutes of deep-breathing relaxation to relieve the day's shoulder and neck fatigue. Then she took out her diary to record the day's expenses and especially wrote down her hopes for the year-end photo album. After turning off her phone and setting the alarm for the next morning, she turned off the light and fell asleep amid warm memories.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Morning activities and breakfast
description: When the morning alarm went off, Ma Xiulan got up gently, washed up, and drank some warm water. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang got up right after. She laid out a mat in the living room and did some stretching, teaching Zhiqiang the 'knee-to-chest roll' and 'cat stretch' to relieve his sore lower back; the two practiced for more than ten minutes. Then she made her first phone call to her father Ma Jianguo, learned his blood pressure was 135/80, and told him to dress warmly in the cold weather. Next she heated up millet porridge, steamed mantou and eggs, and stir-fried garlic spinach, then woke her son Ma Mingzhe and daughter Ma Yuxin. The whole family had breakfast together. Ma Xiulan watched Zhezhe finish his egg and reminded him to listen carefully in class.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Taking the children to school
description: After putting on jackets for the two children and checking their schoolbags, Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to first take her son Ma Mingzhe to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School. She watched him walk through the school gate, then turned the bike around and rode for a few minutes to take her daughter Ma Yuxin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten. After a brief exchange with the teacher, she left.
location: Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin), Huakang First Kindergarten (Jinghai District, Tianjin)

name: Morning shopping
description: After dropping off the children, Ma Xiulan rode along the way to Sun Guifang's stall at Wutong Commune Vegetable Market and bought discounted spinach, tender garlic sprouts, and tomatoes. Sun Guifang warmly helped her pack them and even slipped in a handful of cilantro. Ma Xiulan scanned the code to pay 12.5 yuan and then rode home.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Check the camera and make a shopping list.
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan did not put away the vegetables right away. Instead, she carefully took out her old DSLR camera, opened the battery compartment to check the contacts, and aimed it out the window for a test shot to make sure the shutter was working. Then, on a blank page of her pickled-vegetable journal, she wrote a shopping list: 3 rolls of Fuji color film (ISO 200) and one acid-free blank photo album, and planned to inquire about photo printing prices.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Husband and wife went shopping together
description: Ma Xiulan and her husband Ma Zhiqiang drove together to Jingbai Supermarket. In the digital section they bought the last 3 rolls of Fuji film; in the stationery section they picked out a blank photo album with "Family Memories" printed on the cover; and in the condiment section they restocked Sichuan peppercorns, star anise, and scallions. Ma Zhiqiang also grabbed a pack of her favorite strange-flavor broad beans. At checkout, Ma Xiulan specifically asked about the price for printing 6-inch photos, which was 1.5 yuan per photo, and made a mental note.
location: Jingbai Supermarket, Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Go home to tidy up and do housework
description: After returning home from the supermarket, Ma Xiulan carefully put the film rolls and photo albums into the cabinet, neatly put away the vegetables and seasonings, then wiped the coffee table and TV stand, and collected the scattered LEGO blocks from the floor mat into a storage box.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up daughter and lunch
description: Ma Xiulan reminded her husband Ma Zhiqiang to reheat the leftover food himself, then rode her electric bike to Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up her daughter Ma Yuxin. After arriving home, she first washed her daughter's hands and let her look at picture books in the living room. Then she went into the kitchen, reheated the leftover braised pork with potatoes, and cooked some thin noodles. Around 12 o'clock, she had a simple lunch with her husband and daughter.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Noon break
description: After cleaning up the dishes and chopsticks, Ma Xiulan set an alarm for 13:10 and lay on the bed with her eyes closed to rest for half an hour, giving her body, which had been busy all morning, a chance to recover.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Take daughter back to kindergarten
description: After the alarm rang, Ma Xiulan got up, washed her face, woke her daughter Ma Yuxin, who was dozing on the sofa, helped her put on her coat, and took her back to Huakang First Kindergarten on her electric bike. She arranged with the teacher to pick her up at 4 p.m.
location: Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Opened the jar and portioned out the pickled radish.
description: Ma Xiulan tied on an apron, carried the pickle jar out of the storage room, and lifted the sealed plastic wrap. A rich, savory aroma with a slight saltiness and spiciness assailed her nose; the radish strips were amber-colored. She put on disposable gloves, fished out the radish strips, and drained the sauce. Then she took out four cleaned and dried glass jars for portioning: the first jar had the most, left for the family to eat; the second was labeled 'For Mom and Dad'; the third was for 'Sister Wang across the way'; the fourth was for 'Third Cousin's Wife.' Each jar was sealed with plastic wrap on the opening and the lid tightened to ensure an airtight seal.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Deliver pickled radish to her father and visit him.
description: After packing, Ma Xiulan changed into her coat, picked up the jar labeled 'For Mom and Dad,' and rode her electric bike to her parents' home (No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin). Her mother, Li Xiuying, was picking vegetables on the balcony, and her father, Ma Jianguo, was watching TV. She handed the pickled radish to her mother and said, 'Mom, this is freshly pickled, less sweet than last time, and I added Sichuan pepper as Zhiqiang suggested. You and Dad should try it.' Then she sat down and chatted with her parents for half an hour, asked about her father's blood pressure medication, and urged them to turn on the heating when it got cold.
location: No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Deliver pickled radish to the neighbor
description: After returning from her parents' home, Ma Xiulan knocked on the door of Wang Guilan, the neighbor across the hallway, and handed over the third jar of soy-pickled radish. Wang Guilan beamed with joy. The two chatted for a while at the door and agreed to go to the vegetable market together another day.
location: 158 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the child from school
description: At 4 p.m., Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to Huakang First Kindergarten on time to pick up her daughter Ma Yuxin, then hurried to the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School and waited a few minutes to pick up her son Ma Mingzhe. As soon as the two children saw each other, they vied to share what happened at school; the daughter said the teacher praised her for improving in drawing, and the son muttered that the math problems were too hard.
location: Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten (Jinghai District, Tianjin), Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin)

name: Urged the children to do their homework.
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan poured water for the children to wash their hands, then took out her son Ma Mingzhe's math exercise book and sat beside him as he worked. He made a mistake in a word problem. She tapped the book lightly with a pencil and reminded him: “Zhezhe, read the question again and see whether it’s equal sharing or division by grouping.” Zhezhe scratched his head, reread it, and got the answer right. Her daughter Ma Yuxin was drawing with crayons nearby, and Ma Xiulan praised her from time to time.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing and enjoying dinner
description: Ma Xiulan began preparing dinner, reheating the noon's braised pork and also stir-frying garlic spinach and scrambled eggs with tomatoes. When her eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, came home from school, the family of five finally gathered. During dinner, Ma Xiulan served food to everyone. Her husband, Ma Zhiqiang, praised the spinach for being tender, and she casually asked Mingxuan how things were; Mingxuan simply replied, "Not bad." She also brought out her homemade pickled radish for everyone to taste. The children all said it was delicious, and Zhiqiang also remarked that adding Sichuan peppercorns really made a difference.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tidy up the kitchen
description: After dinner, her husband took the children to the living room to rest. Ma Xiulan cleaned up the dishes alone, scrubbed the stove, and cleaned the sink. While waiting for the dishwasher to run, she gathered the leftover trimmings from portioning out the soy-pickled radish and the sauce at the bottom of the jar, planning to make sauce-flavored tofu tomorrow. She never wastes anything.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family evening time and contacting relatives and friends
description: After cleaning up the kitchen, Ma Xiulan came to the living room, took out the newly bought blank photo album, and inserted the old photos by year together with the children. Her daughter pointed at the photos and asked all kinds of questions, and the atmosphere was warm. During this time, she remembered that the pickled vegetables for Third Cousin's wife had not been sent yet, so she used her phone to send Third Cousin's wife a photo of the pickled radish and a voice message: "Third Sister-in-law, the radishes are pickled. Do you want to come by these two days to pick them up, or should I send them over to you?" Third Cousin's wife replied by voice message that she would come get them another day. Then, while the children played by themselves, Ma Xiulan called her father Ma Jianguo for the second time that day. She learned that after dinner her father's blood pressure was 135/80, and he also said the pickled radishes were very fragrant; he had eaten half of one with porridge in the evening. After hearing this, she felt relieved and happy.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Remind the children to wash up and go to bed.
description: It was getting late, so Ma Xiulan began urging the children to wash up. First she washed her daughter Ma Yuxin, changed her into pajamas, and coaxed her into bed, told two short stories, and she quickly fell asleep. Then she told her son Ma Mingzhe to brush his teeth and wash his face quickly, checked his schoolbag to make sure the homework was inside, and watched him get into bed and lie down.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening personal time and going to bed
description: After the children were settled, Ma Xiulan took a comfortable hot bath to wash away the day's fatigue. After changing into her nightgown, she applied some moisturizer at the dressing table. She turned off the main light, leaving only the bedside lamp on, and sat cross-legged on the edge of the bed for a 5-minute deep-breathing exercise: inhale for 4 seconds, hold for 2 seconds, exhale for 6 seconds. She felt her back relax and her concentration improve. Then she took out her pickled vegetable notes and expense book, recorded the day's grocery and supermarket spending totaling 76.5 yuan, and wrote: “The pickled radish is packed in portions; Mom, Dad, and the neighbors all said it was good. The camera is checked; we'll start taking family photos tomorrow!” After that, she set the phone alarm for 6:30 the next morning and placed it on the bedside table. At exactly 22:00, she turned off the light and lay down, thinking about tomorrow's plans, and soon fell into a peaceful sleep.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning health check and breakfast preparation
description: After getting up, Ma Xiulan did 10 minutes of morning stretching, measured her blood pressure at 138/88, then called her father Ma Jianguo to ask about his health and urged her mother to use less soy sauce. Afterward, she prepared breakfast in the kitchen, cooking millet porridge, steaming buns, and scrambling eggs with scallions.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Household chores and family breakfast
description: Ma Xiulan calculated the cost of pickled radish at the dining table, compared glass jar prices on her phone, and settled on a price of 10 yuan per jar with an initial batch of 50 jars. Then she woke up Ma Mingzhe and Ma Yuxin, urged them to wash up, and checked their school uniforms and backpacks. The whole family (except Ma Mingxuan, who had already left) had breakfast together. She reminded Mingzhe to pick up his homework at noon and asked Yuxin about kindergarten activities.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Take the children to school.
description: Ma Xiulan rode her e-bike, first taking Ma Mingzhe to Jinghai No.3 Primary School, then Ma Yuxin to Huakang No.1 Kindergarten.
location: Jinghai No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Purchase photographic supplies
description: Ma Xiulan went to Wenhui Stationery Store to buy an acid-free photo album and a regular photo album, then went to Ruiguang Photo Equipment Store to buy 3 rolls of Fuji film and obtain a photo printing voucher.
location: Ruiguang Photographic Equipment Store, South Section of Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Household tidying and lunch preparation.
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan put the purchased photo album and film in the bedroom, then cleared away the dishes, washed the bed sheets and duvet covers, hung out the laundry, rested for a while, and drank some warm water. Afterward, she began preparing lunch, making tomato and egg noodles.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up daughter and go home for lunch
description: Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up Ma Yuxin, and on the way listened to her daughter share fun stories from kindergarten. The mother and daughter went home and shared a lunch of tomato and egg noodles. After the meal, she urged her daughter to rinse her mouth and cleared the dishes.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Nap, price comparison, and taking the child to kindergarten
description: During the midday break, Ma Xiulan coaxed Ma Yuxin to take a nap and also dozed off for a short while. After waking up, she browsed glass sealed jars on Taobao on her phone, comparing review ratings and shipping costs. At 13:30 she woke her daughter, tidied her clothes and hair, then rode an electric bike to take her back to Huakang First Kindergarten.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Working in the vegetable garden and recording family moments
description: Ma Xiulan loosened the soil and watered the spinach and scallions in the backyard vegetable garden. After school, her eldest son Ma Mingxuan helped take a photo of her working from behind with his phone for the family image archive.
location: Backyard of No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the two children from school.
description: Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School first to pick up Ma Mingzhe, then went to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up Ma Yuxin, and the three of them went home together.
location: Jinghai No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Supervising homework, preparing dinner, and taking a family photo
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan had Ma Mingzhe do his homework and checked his textbooks, gave Ma Yuxin paintbrushes so she could draw, and then prepared dinner herself: steamed rice, stir-fried mu shu pork and seasonal vegetables, and sliced preserved radish. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang and Ma Mingxuan also came home. Ma Xiulan taught her younger daughter how to press the shutter and took a natural family photo of everyone sitting around the dining table, and then the whole family enjoyed dinner together. The preserved radish was well received by the family.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: After-dinner cleanup and casual family chat.
description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan and her husband cleared the table together, washing dishes and wiping the table. The children played in the living room. The couple chatted about amusing anecdotes about pricing the pickled radish and taking the family portrait. After cleaning up, Ma Xiulan went to the living room to talk with the children and listen to their stories about school.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening parent-child time and contacting a childhood friend
description: Ma Xiulan sent a voice message to her childhood friend Liu Chunmei and arranged to go to the market in a couple of days. Then she urged the three children to wash up one by one. After washing up, she told Ma Yuxin the bedtime story "Little Red Riding Hood" until her daughter fell asleep.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Personal washing time
description: Ma Xiulan took a hot shower in the master bedroom bathroom and changed into clean pajamas.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Organizing accounts and bookkeeping
description: At her desk, Ma Xiulan recorded the day's expenses (photo album and film 85 yuan, etc.) and copied the cost and pricing details of the soy-pickled radish into her notebook. She calculated the gross profit at about half and thought it was worth trying.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pre-sleep relaxation and bedtime
description: Ma Xiulan checked the doors and windows, dimmed the bedside lamp, and sat cross-legged for a 5-minute deep-breathing relaxation exercise. Then she got into bed, exchanged good-night messages with her childhood friend on her phone, and watched life hacks videos. At 22:00, she set her alarm, turned off the light, and went to sleep.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning stretching and weekly summary
description: She laid out her yoga mat in the living room and completed the last 8-minute morning stretch of the week, focusing on the release in her neck, shoulders, and lower back. After stretching, she sat at the dining table, wrote a brief weekly summary, and sent a photo to the Ma Family WeChat group. Soon she received likes from the children and a reply from her husband, and felt the warmth and sense of accomplishment that perseverance brings.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepared breakfast and woke up the family to have breakfast together
description: After quickly washing up, she entered the kitchen, cooked millet porridge, reheated the steamed buns, and stir-fried a plate of seasonal vegetables. Then she woke up her younger daughter Xinxin and second son Zhezhe, tied Xinxin's hair, urged the children to wash up and sit at the table to eat breakfast, and quickly had a bowl of porridge and a small piece of steamed bun herself. Her eldest son Xuanxuan had already washed up on his own.
location: Kitchen and dining room of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Take the children to school.
description: Left at 7:50. Xinxin sat on the back of the electric bike, Zhezhe rode alongside on his bicycle, and Xuanxuan rode another bicycle alone ahead. Along the way, they first dropped Xinxin off at Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, watching her walk through the school gate with her teacher. Then they turned around and took Zhezhe to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, telling him to listen carefully in class before leaving.
location: Starting from No. 156, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to Huakang First Kindergarten (Jingwen Road), then to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street)

name: Buying groceries at the vegetable market.
description: She found Aunt Sun Guifang's stall with ease, picked three crisp fresh local white radishes, bought seasonal vegetables such as spinach and celery, and cut one and a half jin of streaky pork. Aunt Sun waived the odd amount and gave her a bunch of cilantro. The total cost was 16.5 yuan.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Cleaning, doing laundry, and airing bedding
description: After getting home, she sorted the dirty laundry and put it into the washing machine, then started it. Taking advantage of the good sunshine, she carried the comforters from the master bedroom and the second bedroom to the balcony to air. Then she swept and mopped the floors, wiped down the tables and chairs, and put away toys, working until her forehead was slightly sweaty.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Hand embroidery piecework.
description: Taking advantage of the gap between finishing housework and picking up the children, she took out her embroidery hoop and silk thread, sat in the sunniest spot under the window, and quietly embroidered a handkerchief with fine stitches, completing the remaining pattern from the piecework introduced by Sister Zheng.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Call Dad to remind him to measure his blood pressure
description: Dialed her father Ma Jianguo's number, asked about breakfast, reminded him to measure his blood pressure and record it, and urged him to dress warmly in the cold weather and eat less salt and more vegetables. Her father replied that he had already measured it, blood pressure 135/85, everything normal, and she felt a little reassured.
location: Living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (phone call).

name: Pickle the second batch of soy-sauced radish.
description: Wash the white radish and cut it into strips with the skin on. Following the modified recipe, reduce the sugar and add Sichuan peppercorns. Salt it to draw out the water, then pour off the liquid. Add light soy sauce, black vinegar, white sugar, Sichuan peppercorns, and dried chili sections. Toss to combine, pack tightly into a glass jar, seal it, and attach a label reading “February 21.”
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare lunch and pick up Xinxin to bring her home for lunch.
description: First, at home, she sliced the pork belly and stir-fried it to make twice-cooked pork with garlic sprouts, and made egg drop soup with spinach. At 11:20, she rode her electric bike to Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up Xinxin. After returning home, she took her to wash her hands, picked out the lean meat, and fed her a small half bowl of rice. She finished her own meal quickly and then cleaned up the dishes.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten

name: Accompany Xinxin for her afternoon nap.
description: She drew the curtains, held Xinxin in the soft quilt that had been aired in the sun, told her two short stories, and after she fell asleep, she also dozed off for a while to refresh herself.
location: Master bedroom of the home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Take Xinxin back to kindergarten and finish the embroidery
description: At 13:30, woke Xinxin, helped her put on her coat, then rode the electric bike to take her back to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten. After returning home, she continued embroidering, finished all the remaining patterns, checked the stitches, and put the embroidered handkerchief into a storage bag to give to Sister Zheng.
location: Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and home at 156 Jingwen Road.

name: Chat with neighbor Wang Guilan
description: When she went out to take out the trash, she ran into her neighbor across the hall, Wang Guilan, who was sitting in the yard getting some sun. She went over and chatted for a while, showed her the morning stretching photos, and Wang Guilan said she looked well and wanted to learn, so she agreed to teach her a few simple moves the next day.
location: Entrance of 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Free time and household chores.
description: After returning home, she brought in the bedding that had been aired out in the morning, folded it, and put it back in the wardrobe. Then she sat on the sofa, browsed local life news on her phone, looked up tips for pickling vegetables, and got ready to pick up the children.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the second son and youngest daughter from school
description: At 16:00, she rode her electric bike to the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School. After waiting for Zhezhe, she picked him up, then went by Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up Xinxin. The two children chattered away on the back seat, sharing funny school stories, and went home together.
location: Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street), Huakang First Kindergarten (Jingwen Road), and the way home, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Supervise the children's homework and prepare dinner
description: After arriving home, let the children wash their hands. Xinxin is playing with building blocks in the living room; Zhezhe and Xuanxuan, who has already come home, are doing homework in the study. I moved a small stool to sit by the door, trimming vegetables while keeping an eye on Zhezhe so he wouldn't get distracted. Then in the kitchen I reheated the leftover twice-cooked pork from lunch, stir-fried fresh cabbage with vinegar, made tomato and egg drop soup, and steamed rice.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Having dinner
description: The whole family sat around the table eating. She served Xinxin some food, told Zhezhe to eat more vegetables, and asked Xuanxuan about his schoolwork. The table was filled with the warmth of everyday life and the buzz of chatter; although it was a bit chaotic, she felt at ease.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Supervise the children's homework and tidy up the house
description: After the meal, she urged Zhezhe to finish the remaining homework and checked it, had Xuanxuan take the younger brother and sister to wash up, then cleared the dishes, wiped the table, washed the dishes, and tidied the kitchen.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Soothing the youngest daughter to sleep.
