description: Xinxin was getting sleepy, so I changed her into pajamas, told the last story Little Rabbit Be Good, gently patted her back, and she fell asleep before long.
location: Children's room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Bedtime preparation, deep breathing, and weekly review
description: Took out tomorrow's breakfast ingredients from the fridge to thaw, checked that the children's quilts were tucked in and the doors and windows were shut. After washing up and changing into pajamas, sat on the edge of the bed and did the last deep-breathing exercise of the week, feeling the shoulders relax and the mind calm. Reviewing the week: fell asleep faster, shoulder and neck pain disappeared, mood more stable. Decided to also do brief deep breathing whenever tired next week.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Using the phone, resting, and falling asleep.
description: Got into bed, used her phone to reply to WeChat messages, viewed photos of Beijing that her elder sister had posted in the 'Ma Family Group' chat, and made plans for the next year while chatting casually with her younger sister Ma Xiufen. Around 22:30 she put down her phone, turned off the light, and went to sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Morning partner stretching.
description: Today is Saturday, and Zhiqiang didn't take the car out. It was just getting light outside the window when we both woke up. While the children were still asleep, we spread out mats on the bedroom floor and did a 10-minute stretch together. He pressed down on my back, and I stretched his legs, focusing on the shoulders, neck, and lower back and hips. When we finished, I asked him as usual, "Did Dad's blood pressure stay normal yesterday?" He said, "It was normal. I called and asked in the morning, so don't keep worrying." Only then did I feel at ease.
location: Home master bedroom, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning wash-up and preparing breakfast
description: I went to wash up first, then got busy in the kitchen. Today I wanted to try something different: I cooked millet porridge, cut a few pieces of the brown sugar steamed cake I bought yesterday and heated them up, and fried some eggs and ham sausages. Zhiqiang was in the living room looking at product sourcing information on his phone. I called three times before Mingzhe and Yuxin dawdled out of bed. Mingxuan, on the other hand, had already been memorizing English words for a while.
location: No. 156, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin - home kitchen and bathroom

name: Family breakfast
description: The whole family sat around the steaming table. I urged Mingxuan: 'Finish the math test paper at home this morning, don't just stare at your phone.' Then I said to Mingzhe and Yuxin: 'You two can play this morning, but you still have to finish your homework, hear me?' Zhiqiang took a couple of quick bites and said to me: 'I've got a short-haul job at 2 p.m., so I need to go to the yard and check the car after I eat.' With that, he wiped his mouth and left first.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Household cleaning and calling mother.
description: After Zhiqiang left, the children each kept themselves busy, and I started tidying up. First I washed the dishes and wiped the table, then mopped the floors in the living room and bedroom. Then I took the sheets and quilt covers washed yesterday to the balcony to hang them up. While catching my breath, I called my mother: "Mom, did Dad have his blood pressure measured this morning? What was it?" My mother said on the phone, "Measured, 120/80, fine. Don't worry, get on with your things." Hearing this, I felt relieved, and after chatting a bit more, I hung up.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin: home living room, kitchen, and balcony

name: Walking to the vegetable market
description: I went out with a reusable cloth bag. The weather was nice today, a bit cold but sunny. I strolled along Jingwen Road toward the vegetable market. On the way I ran into Sister Wang Guilan from across the street, who was coming back from walking her dog. We stood by the roadside chatting for a while. She said she also wanted to learn stretching, and I promised to teach her tomorrow morning.
location: Along Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, en route from 156 Jingwen Road to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market.

name: Shopping at the vegetable market.
description: The market was lively. I first went to Aunt Sun's vegetable stall. "Xiulan, you're here! Today's spinach and baby bok choy are so fresh!" Aunt Sun greeted warmly. I picked spinach and tomatoes, and grabbed a handful of cilantro and scallions. Aunt Sun then pointed to the fish nearby: "Crucian carp, just arrived this morning. Make soup for your kids—it's delicious!" I took a look, and it did look good, so I took two. Then I went to buy a piece of tofu and a few potatoes, and only then headed back, quite satisfied.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: On the way home
description: Carrying a full bag of groceries, I walked home slowly. On the way, I kept thinking that Yulan would be coming in the afternoon, so I needed to wipe the house down again and set out the tea and snacks. I couldn't let her think I was an unqualified homemaker.
location: On Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, on the way back from Wutong Commune Vegetable Market to No. 156 Jingwen Road

name: Housework wrap-up and tasting pickled radish
description: After returning home, I first sorted the vegetables and put them in the fridge. I remembered the soy-sauce pickled radish I tried making yesterday and wondered how it tasted. I took out a piece from the fridge, sliced it thinly, and tasted it. Well, the saltiness was just right, but the aroma still seemed a bit lacking; next time I can add more star anise. At that moment the phone rang. It was a voice message from Yulan: "Xiulan, I just arrived at Liu Chunmei's house. I'll chat with her a while and come to your place around two in the afternoon!" I quickly replied, "Okay, Sister Lan, I've already brewed the tea and am waiting for you!"
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin: the kitchen and living room at home.

name: Preparing lunch and having a family meal
description: The children said they were hungry, so I hurried to make lunch. I fried a crucian carp golden on both sides, added boiling water, and simmered it into a milky-white soup; I also stir-fried tomato and eggs, which the children all love, and baby bok choy with minced garlic. During lunch, Mingzhe gestured as he talked about the cartoon he had watched, and Yuxin laughed along. I picked a piece of fish for Mingxuan and asked him, "Did you finish that test paper this morning?" He said almost, with two big questions left.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin - home kitchen and dining room

name: Midday rest and preparation for guests
description: After the meal, I asked Mingxuan to watch his younger brother and sister do their homework while I quickly cleared the dishes. I polished the living room coffee table until it shone, took out the good tea leaves Zhiqiang brought back last time, and set out a plate of sunflower seeds and a plate of peanuts. I also deliberately placed the old photo album I had dug out a few days ago by the sofa, thinking that when Yulan came we could look through it together. Everything was ready, so I sat on the sofa, scrolling through local news on my phone while waiting for her to arrive.
location: Living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Go to the intersection to welcome Chen Yulan.
description: Seeing that it was almost two o'clock, I thought Yulan would come from Liu Chunmei's place, and Shengli Avenue was on the way, so I changed into a clean jacket and went out to meet her. When I got to the intersection of Shengli Avenue and Jingwen Road, I happened to see Yulan walking over carrying a cloth bag. I quickly waved at her and called, "Sister Lan! Over here!"
location: Intersection of Shengli Street and Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Chen Yulan came to visit, bringing fabric and encouragement for her business venture.
description: The two of us talked all the way home. As soon as we got inside, I made her some tea and asked her to sit down and rest. Yulan took a piece of blue-and-white printed fabric out of her bag and handed it to me, saying, “Xiulan, I brought this back from Tangshan. It's handmade. See if you can make something with it.” I took it and felt it, and couldn't put it down: “This fabric is really nice! I was just thinking of making a little jacket for Yuxin!” The two of us drank tea, ate sunflower seeds, and flipped through an old photo album. Pointing at the photos, Yulan talked about the festive New Year traditions in Tangshan, such as pasting paper window cuttings and steaming rice cakes, and also said her clothing store's recent promotional sale had brought pretty good business. So I told her about my attempt to make pickled vegetables. As soon as Yulan heard this, she immediately encouraged me: “Your skill will work! Nowadays everyone loves this taste. Just go ahead and make it boldly; don't worry about sales. Next time I go to stock up, I'll keep an eye out for better soy sauce and vinegar, and see if I can get them at a wholesale price!” We chatted away enthusiastically, and before we knew it, the sky outside the window had darkened.
location: Living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Organizing pickled vegetable notes and checking Mingxuan's homework
description: After seeing Yulan off, I felt warm inside and had a sense of confidence. I sat at my desk, took out a new notebook, and carefully wrote down Yulan's recipe improvement ideas and ingredient purchasing suggestions. I also roughly calculated the cost of the several jars of pickled vegetables at home. Just then, Mingxuan came in with his math homework notebook. I put down my pen, checked it carefully, pointed out the errors in two calculation problems, and patiently explained the steps to him.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin — home study

name: Prepare dinner and have a family meal
description: There was still quite a lot of fish soup left from noon, so I reheated it and added some tofu. I also stir-fried green beans with minced pork and smashed a cucumber. At dinner, the three children chattered about the day while I listened and told them to eat slowly. Mingzhe insisted on mixing fish soup into his rice. I scolded him a little, and he just grinned.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin - home kitchen and dining room

name: Evening chores and putting the youngest daughter to sleep
description: After the meal, I quickly washed the dishes and wiped down the stove top. Then I gave Yuxin a hot bath and changed her into clean pajamas. The little girl was tired from playing today and kept yawning. I dried her hair with the hairdryer, kissed her forehead, and told her to go lie in bed first.
location: No. 156, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin - home kitchen and bathroom

name: Tutoring Mingzhe with homework and planning sewing designs.
description: After settling Yuxin down, I went to check Mingzhe's homework. He is a bit playful and his handwriting was crooked, so I had him erase it and rewrite it. Mingxuan, meanwhile, was quietly doing physics problems beside him. I sat next to them, supervising them while taking out the piece of fabric Yulan had given me, holding it up and measuring it in my hands, thinking about what style of little jacket to make for Yuxin.
location: Study and living room at the home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening leisure: watching TV and sending messages
description: The children had all washed up and returned to their rooms, and I finally had some time to myself. I curled up on the living room sofa, turned on the TV, and flipped through channels randomly until I stopped at a legal affairs program. I took out my phone and sent Yulan a message: "Sister Lan, thank you so much today. After talking with you, I feel really confident; making pickled vegetables feels like something that can really work!"
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, sofa in home living room

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and deep breathing exercises
description: I yawned, went to the bathroom to wash up, and changed into my pajamas. I turned off the main light, leaving only the bedside lamp on, and sat cross-legged on the bed. I closed my eyes and began today's deep breathing exercise. On the inhale, I silently said "calm"; on the exhale, I silently said "relax." The encouraging words of Yulan during the day and the aroma of pickled vegetables intertwined in my mind, and I felt especially settled and at peace.
location: Home master bedroom, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Going to bed
description: I got into bed, and Zhiqiang called to say he had finished the job and was on his way back. I said "mm" in acknowledgment and told him to drive carefully. After hanging up, I reviewed today in my mind: the heart-to-heart talk with Yulan, the children's smiling faces, and those strips of pickled radish hanging out to dry... I fell into a deep sleep with a smile and confidence.
location: Home master bedroom, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Waking up and morning stretching
description: At 6:55 in the morning, the phone alarm rang. Ma Xiulan stretched and got up. Seeing her husband Ma Zhiqiang still fast asleep, she gently woke him. They spread yoga mats on the bedroom floor and, following soothing music playing on the phone, did a simple ten-minute stretching routine together to loosen up their muscles and joints. After stretching, Ma Xiulan urged her husband to go wash up, while she began making the bed, getting ready for a busy day ahead.
location: Bedroom at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Call father to ask about his blood pressure.
description: While waiting for the water to boil, Ma Xiulan called her mother on the phone. During the call, she asked about her father Ma Jianguo and learned that his blood pressure reading this morning was 130/80, which was normal, putting her mind at ease. She told her mother Li Xiuying to make sure her father took his medication on time, chatted about family matters for a while, then recorded the blood pressure reading in the small notebook on the living room coffee table for future tracking.
location: Living room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare breakfast for the whole family
description: Ma Xiulan put on an apron, quickly steamed a pot of buns, reheated the leftover millet porridge from the previous day, took out baby bok choy from the refrigerator, cut it into sections, and stir-fried it. The aroma of the dishes soon filled the kitchen. She called the eldest son Ma Mingxuan, who was still lying in bed, the mischievous second son Ma Mingzhe, and the youngest daughter Ma Yuxin to get up and wash up. Then the family of five sat around the dining table and enjoyed the hot breakfast. While eating, Ma Xiulan reminded the children that although it was Sunday, they still needed to find some time in the afternoon to finish their unfinished homework. The eldest son nodded in agreement, while the second son pouted unwillingly.
location: Kitchen and dining room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tidying up the house and checking the weather.
description: After breakfast, Ma Xiulan told her eldest son to take his younger siblings to the living room to watch TV so they would not cause trouble, while she quickly cleared the dishes and wiped down the stove and dining table. After finishing the kitchen work, she walked to the window and looked outside; the sky was gray and overcast. She picked up her phone and checked the weather forecast, which showed cloudy, temperature 1 to 8 degrees, north wind level 3. She thought the weather was still cold and decided to put on more clothes when working in the backyard in the afternoon.
location: Kitchen and living room at No. 156, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing materials and handcraft supplies.
description: Ma Xiulan found the sewing box in the drawer and took out a piece of remnant fabric with a moon-white base and a small spool of dark blue silk thread that her neighbor Chen Yulan had brought yesterday. She called her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin over, had her watch how she threaded the needle, and put on her sewing thimble, preparing to teach her daughter the simplest “backstitch” and “knot stitch” for the upcoming parent-child handicraft time.
location: Living room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Parent-child craft: teaching Yuxin to embroider
description: Sunlight streamed through the window onto the living room floor. Ma Xiulan sat on the sofa, teaching six-year-old Yuxin to embroider hand over hand. She first drew the outline of a small five-petaled plum blossom on the cloth, then demonstrated how to insert the needle and flatten the thread, explaining softly, “You see, the stitches should be even. Imagine a little bee walking on the petals, step by step.” Yuxin studied very earnestly. Her little hand was clumsy but held the needle with focus. Ma Xiulan praised her from time to time, “Our Yuxin has such nimble fingers. This flower is embroidered even prettier than your mother's!” Yuxin giggled at this. Mother and daughter chatted and laughed, filling the living room with a warm atmosphere.
location: Living room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Neighborhood socializing: teaching Sister Wang stretching and having a tea chat
description: As Ma Xiulan was teaching Yuxin to embroider the second petal, the doorbell rang. When she opened the door, it was their neighbor from across the hall, Sister Wang Guilan. Wang Guilan said she wanted to learn the stretching exercises mentioned yesterday. Ma Xiulan smiled and welcomed her inside, letting her youngest daughter practice on her own for a while. She led Wang Guilan to the open space in the living room and, while demonstrating, explained a few simple stretches for the neck, shoulders, and back. Wang Guilan followed along earnestly and caught on quickly. After more than ten minutes of instruction, the two sat down to rest. Ma Xiulan brought over hot tea, and they sat on the sofa chatting about everyday things. Wang Guilan brought up her daughter-in-law's job search, and Ma Xiulan also shared her recent idea of learning to make pickled vegetables. The more they talked, the more they hit it off, deepening their neighborly friendship.
location: Living room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing and enjoying lunch
description: After seeing Wang Guilan off, Ma Xiulan saw that it was almost noon, so she quickly put on an apron and started preparing lunch. She reheated the leftover half pot of braised pork from the night before and cooked a pot of rice. While the rice was cooking, she quickly sliced a cucumber and tossed it with minced garlic as a cold dish. At 12 noon, the family of five sat down to eat on time. At the table, Ma Xiulan served the children while reminding them again not to forget their homework in the afternoon. The eldest and second child both agreed, and the family happily finished lunch.
location: Kitchen and dining room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Midday housework and tidying up
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan asked her husband to take the children to the living room to rest, while she cleaned up the table full of dishes by herself. She washed the bowls and plates with hot water, wiped the stove and dining table spotlessly clean, and took out the kitchen trash. When she was done, she felt her waist was a bit sore, so she leaned against the kitchen doorframe to rest for a while. After catching her breath, she got ready to busy herself in the backyard.
location: Kitchen and dining room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Courtyard work: cleaning and watering.
description: Ma Xiulan changed into an old cotton jacket, put on rubber gloves, and went to the backyard with a broom and a shovel. She first gathered last week's dead leaves and a dry tree branch into a pile and put them in a garbage bag. Then she squatted down and carefully checked the celery in the vegetable bed. Seeing that the celery leaves were dark green and growing well, she brought over a small bucket and poured water on the celery ladle by ladle until it was thoroughly watered. She also pulled out a few weeds in the plot. Looking at the neatly tended little vegetable garden, she felt very content.
location: Backyard vegetable garden, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Summary of the trial production stage of pickled vegetables
description: After coming back from the backyard and washing her hands, Ma Xiulan took out a new notebook with a kraft-paper cover from the drawer. On the dining table, she spread out the old notebook recording last week's pickled radish and the notes she had taken yesterday while chatting with Chen Yulan. Recalling as she went, she neatly wrote the four-character title "Pickled Vegetable Notes" in the new notebook, then carefully copied down the latest recipe ratios and calculated the ingredient costs. Finally, she added a note beside it: "Sister Yulan suggested adding star anise to enhance the aroma, so try it next time." When she closed the notebook, she felt that it was the starting point of her future "big undertaking" and was full of confidence.
location: Dining table at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Mending the second son's school uniform
description: Ma Xiulan took out the school uniform of her second son, Ma Mingzhe, whose sleeves had worn through at the cuffs. She found thread of a similar color, threaded the needle, and carefully sewed back and forth over the worn area with fine, dense stitches. As she sewed, she thought about how her son was always climbing and active, and that he must not be laughed at for wearing this uniform on Monday. After mending the uniform, she folded it, checked again that the stitches were sturdy, and only then put it down with satisfaction.
location: Living room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Midday rest and household chores
description: Ma Xiulan finally got a chance to rest. She sat down on the sofa, picked up the remote, and flipped through a few channels before stopping on a TV drama channel. After watching for a while, she felt drowsy and dozed off against the sofa. She woke up about half an hour later, feeling much more refreshed. She went to the kitchen, poured herself a glass of water, and took the pork belly she needed for dinner out of the freezer to thaw, preparing for the evening meal.
location: Living room and kitchen at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Carefully preparing dinner
description: Ma Xiulan tied on her apron and started to prepare the highlight of tonight's dinner—braised pork belly. She first cut the thawed pork belly into two-finger-wide chunks, put them in a pot of cold water to blanch, and skimmed off the foam. Then she heated oil in the wok, added rock sugar and stir-fried it to make caramel color, then added the pork belly chunks and stir-fried them to coat them in the color. Next she added scallions, ginger, star anise, bay leaves, and a little light and dark soy sauce. When the aroma of meat wafted out, she poured in plenty of boiling water, brought it to a boil over high heat, then turned down to low heat to simmer slowly. While the meat was simmering, she went to the backyard and picked a handful of crisp celery, washed and cut it into sections, and planned to make a simple stir-fried celery. The kitchen was filled with the aroma of meat, radiating the happy flavor of home.
location: Kitchen at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Dinner enjoyed by the whole family
description: Braised pork belly was stewed until tender and flavorful, shiny with oil. Ma Xiulan quickly stir-fried a plate of bright green celery as well. When the meal was served, the children cheered happily at the sight of the braised pork on the table. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang repeatedly praised her cooking. Ma Xiulan smiled and put meat into everyone's bowl. The family sat around the table, eating with greasy mouths, chatting and laughing, melting the day's fatigue away in this delicious dinner.
location: Dining room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Greeted her parents with a video call.
description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan had her husband clear the table while she picked up her phone and made a video call to her parents' home. When the call connected, she saw her father Ma Jianguo sitting in the living room watching TV, looking well. She asked whether he had measured his blood pressure that evening. Her mother Li Xiuying said beside him that it had been measured long ago and everything was normal. Ma Xiulan turned the phone toward the dining table to let her parents see the children eating, and the elderly couple beamed with joy. The family chatted on video for nearly thirty minutes before reluctantly hanging up.
location: Living room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Check the three children's weekend homework.
description: After the video call ended, Ma Xiulan put on a serious expression and began checking the children's weekend homework. She first looked at her eldest son Ma Mingxuan's math test paper, focusing on the solution steps of several word problems, and pointed out a careless calculation error. Then she turned to her second son Ma Mingzhe, opened his math exercise book, and found that he had indeed made several mental arithmetic errors due to carelessness, so she had him recalculate and correct them on the spot. Finally, she picked up her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin's Chinese character tracing workbook and pinyin exercise book. Seeing the neat handwriting, she praised her and encouraged her to keep it up.
location: Living room and study at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family leisure time
description: After checking the homework, Ma Xiulan breathed a sigh of relief and called the whole family to watch TV together. Ma Zhiqiang turned on the TV and switched to a light entertainment program. The eldest son Ma Mingxuan leaned on the sofa reading a sci-fi novel on his tablet, the second son Ma Mingzhe lay on the coffee table fiddling with his LEGO set, and the youngest daughter Yuxin cuddled in her mother's arms acting spoiled. Ma Xiulan stroked her daughter's soft hair and felt deeply grounded and happy seeing her husband and children quietly by her side.
location: Living room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Remind the children to wash up and prepare for bed
description: After the TV program ended, Ma Xiulan clapped her hands and said, “Alright, it's getting late, everyone should wash up and go to bed.” She urged the three children to go to the bathroom one by one to wash up, helped her youngest daughter Yuxin comb her hair, and reminded her eldest son to get up early tomorrow to preview his lessons. After finishing these tasks, she returned to her bedroom, changed into her pajamas, turned on the bedside lamp, and prepared to relax.
location: All rooms at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Relaxation before bed and falling asleep
description: After the bedroom door was closed, the world finally became quiet. Ma Xiulan leaned against the headboard, closed her eyes, and began five minutes of deep breathing. She breathed in deeply and breathed out slowly, silently repeating 'calm' and 'relax' in her mind, and the toil and trivialities of the day gradually drifted away with her breath. After finishing the breathing exercise, she lay down and reviewed the day in her mind: she taught her daughter to embroider flowers, chatted with her neighbor Sister Wang, tidied the vegetable garden, wrote in the pickle ledger, sewed the school uniform, and made braised pork that the children all said was delicious... She felt content and fulfilled. Listening to the wind outside gradually weaken, she yawned and fell into a peaceful sleep, ready for the new week.
location: Bedroom at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning family activity
description: At the crack of dawn, Ma Xiulan woke up while her husband Ma Zhiqiang was still sound asleep. She gently moved her ankles, and when the alarm went off she woke Zhiqiang. The two of them did stretches together in front of the bed. She taught Zhiqiang to try the Cat-Cow pose, and his clumsy movements were funny. After stretching, Ma Xiulan called her father Ma Jianguo, who lived on Shengli Street in Jinghai District. She learned that he had just measured his blood pressure and it was 130/80—everything was stable—so she told him not to forget to bring his medical insurance card to the community clinic for the follow-up in the afternoon. After hanging up, she tied on an apron and went into the kitchen. She cooked millet porridge, heated up steamed buns and flower rolls, and stir-fried scallion eggs, and quickly prepared breakfast. She went upstairs to wake the children: Ma Mingxuan, an eighth grader, washed up on his own without being urged; her second son Ma Mingzhe stayed in bed until she pretended to pull the quilt off him; her little daughter Ma Yuxin rubbed her eyes while her mother braided her hair. The whole family sat around the table. Ma Zhiqiang drank two bowls of porridge, the children ate happily, and Ma Xiulan especially put extra eggs on Mingxuan's plate, saying that he was in the second year of middle school with heavy coursework and needed to eat his fill.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home)

name: Taking the children to school
description: Ma Xiulan cleared away the dishes, put on her coat and helmet, and wheeled out the electric bike. She first took her second son, Ma Mingzhe, along Jingwen Road, turned onto Shengli South Street, and arrived at the Third Primary School of Jinghai District. She watched Mingzhe walk into the school gate and nod to the guard on duty; then she turned the bike around and rode south along Shengli Street to Huakang Road, where she took her youngest daughter, Ma Yuxin, to Huakang First Kindergarten. She handed her personally to the teacher and told her to sleep well at noon. After leaving the kindergarten, she rode directly home, wheeled the electric bike into the yard, and washed the children's thermos cups.
location: Starting from home at No. 156 Zhenwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin, passing Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street) and Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten (Huakang Road), then returning home.

name: Writing out the secret pickled-vegetable recipe and contacting the market
description: After finishing the housework, Ma Xiulan made a cup of hot tea, took out her carefully covered "Pickled Vegetable Notebook" and a carbon pen, and neatly wrote, stroke by stroke, the best pickled radish recipe she had fine-tuned through repeated tastings on the flyleaf of the notebook, thinking that this would be her family heirloom. After writing the recipe, she also sent a voice message to Sister Zheng Xiuying, who had introduced her to handcraft work, asking whether there was a spring market nearby where she could set up a stall. Sister Zheng quickly replied that the market usually took place at the end of March and that she would notify her as soon as she had news, telling her to get her things ready first. This made Ma Xiulan feel more hopeful about life.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Shopping for ingredients at the market
description: After putting down her phone, Ma Xiulan went back to the bedroom and changed into her army-green thin cotton jacket. She picked up an eco-friendly shopping bag and a small coin purse, then walked to the Wutong Commune vegetable market, two stops away. The weather was cold and overcast, and she wanted to make a warm dinner. She first went to Aunt Sun's stall, where she usually shopped, and bought fresh baby spinach and tender tofu. Then she went to the meat stall and picked out two pork ribs to braise tomorrow. Passing the dried goods stall, she also bought a bundle of vermicelli. After shopping for about forty minutes, she carried the heavy groceries home, put the ribs in the freezer to freeze, and soaked the spinach and tofu in water on the kitchen counter for later.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up daughter from school and go home
description: After a short rest, Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to Huakang First Kindergarten on Huakang Road and arrived just in time at 11:05 to pick up Ma Yuxin. Xinxin was very happy, chattering that the teacher had taught them a new nursery rhyme, and she sang it to her mother. The mother and daughter sang together all the way and got home at 11:20.
location: From home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten (Huakang Road), and then back home

name: Lunch and lunch break.
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan used the leftover steamed buns from the morning, stir-fried some scallion eggs, and cooked some millet porridge, having a simple lunch with Xinxin. After the meal she cleaned up the kitchen and put Xinxin down for a nap, gently patting her back and humming a tune. Only after Xinxin was sound asleep did she get up quietly, and she also leaned by the bed and dozed for twenty minutes to regain her energy.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home)

name: Take daughter back to kindergarten and buy medicine on the way.
description: At 1 p.m. sharp, Ma Xiulan woke Xinxin, washed her face, then took her back to Huakang First Kindergarten and handed her to the teacher. On the way back, she stopped by Kangcao Pharmacy. Thinking that her husband Ma Zhiqiang had recently been complaining of sore knees, she bought some pain-relieving patches for him and also stocked up on some common medicines for headaches and minor ailments for herself.
location: Via Huakang First Kindergarten, Huakang Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to Kangcao Pharmacy on Huakang Road.

name: Deep clean the kitchen
description: Ma Xiulan changed into old clothes, filled a basin with hot water and added dishwashing liquid, and began a thorough cleaning of the kitchen. She took apart the range hood's oil cup and soaked it, scrubbed the grease stains on the stove with a steel wool ball, and wiped the wall tiles and cabinet doors until they shone. Only when the whole kitchen was clean and tidy again did she feel at ease.
location: Home kitchen at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Housework and needlework
description: After cleaning the kitchen, Ma Xiulan rested on the sofa in the living room, turned on the TV to listen to local news, and took out the handkerchief half-embroidered for Xinxin from the sewing basket. In the light by the window, she embroidered petals with the newly learned plum-blossom stitch, stitch by stitch, full of patience, enjoying a moment of peace.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the second son from school
description: After the school bell rang, Ma Xiulan put down her embroidery and walked to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to stretch her limbs. At the school gate, she saw Ma Mingzhe coming out with his classmates. As soon as Mingzhe saw her, he pouted and said he had made mistakes on two calculation problems in the math quiz and had a lot of homework. Ma Xiulan patted him on the shoulder and comforted him, "It's okay, Mom will help you correct them when we get home."
location: At the gate of Jinghai District Third Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tutoring homework and preparing crafts.
description: After getting home, Ma Xiulan asked Mingzhe to correct his math test paper first, while she watched over him and picked spinach. After Mingzhe recalculated the wrong problems, she made up two similar problems to reinforce his understanding. Then Mingzhe remembered that tomorrow's labor skills class required leaf collage; Ma Xiulan told him to wait until his younger sister came back and they would pick leaves together, saying there were colored paper and glue sticks at home.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Picking up the youngest daughter and evening tutoring
description: Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to pick up Ma Yuxin. On the way home, she had Mingzhe and Xinxin pick up a few pretty fallen leaves from the flower beds in the residential complex. When they got home, her eldest son Ma Mingxuan had also come back from school and went straight to his room to do physics homework. He looked confused when he saw the circuit diagram. Ma Xiulan told him to do the ones he knew first, while she dictated new Chinese characters to Mingzhe in the living room. Xinxin obediently took her little notebook and drew the nursery rhyme she had learned today.
location: Returned from Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to home at No. 156, Jingwen Road

name: Prepare dinner
description: Ma Xiulan put on an apron and started making dinner: she washed and blanched the spinach, cut the tofu into pieces, and soaked the vermicelli, while a spinach-tofu-vermicelli soup simmered on the stove. On the other burner she stir-fried baby bok choy and hot-and-sour shredded potatoes, served with the small radishes pickled yesterday. Xinxin ran into the kitchen to help. Ma Xiulan smiled and had her peel two scallions. The little girl sat on a small stool and peeled them very carefully, and the kitchen filled with the aroma of the meal.
location: Home kitchen at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner
description: Her husband Ma Zhiqiang helped set out the bowls and chopsticks, and the whole family sat around the dining table. Ma Xiulan served soup to everyone, and the children's faces turned rosy from drinking it. At the table, she mentioned that Sister Zheng had said the market might not open until the end of March. Zhiqiang reassured her, "No rush. Good wine needs no bush." Then she asked Mingxuan about physics; Mingxuan said electrical circuits were a bit confusing, and she suggested asking the teacher the next day. The family ate and chatted, full of the warm, homely atmosphere of everyday life.
location: Home dining room at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Evening chores and finishing homework tutoring
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan cleared the dishes and washed them in the kitchen, while Ma Zhiqiang helped wipe the table. After the children went back to their rooms, she checked Mingxuan's physics homework, circled the multiple-choice questions on electricity, and drew diagrams to analyze them; she checked Mingzhe's dictation notebook and had him correct each wrong character three times. Xinxin ran over to show off her drawing for a nursery rhyme. After being praised by her mother, she obediently brushed her teeth and washed her face. Ma Xiulan bathed her and changed her into pajamas.
location: The kitchen and children's room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family leisure and putting the children to sleep.
description: After the children finished washing up, Ma Xiulan and Ma Zhiqiang sat in the living room for a while. Zhiqiang watched the news, and she continued sewing a few stitches on a handkerchief. Near nine o'clock, she took Xinxin to the bedroom and told her the story "The Little Horse Crosses the River." After coaxing her daughter to sleep, she checked that Mingzhe and Mingxuan's room had gone quiet, then tiptoed out and turned off the living room light.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home)

name: Pre-sleep relaxation and rest
description: Ma Xiulan went back to the master bedroom and invited Ma Zhiqiang to do some deep-breathing relaxation together. The two sat cross-legged on the floor mat and, following the rhythm she taught, inhaled through the nose for 4 seconds, held their breath for 7 seconds, and exhaled slowly for 8 seconds. After several cycles, only steady breathing sounds remained in the room, and the day's fatigue seemed to melt away. After finishing the relaxation, Ma Xiulan turned off the light and got under the covers. She reviewed the day: her father's blood pressure was normal, the pickle recipe was noted down, the market trip was something to look forward to, the house was neat, and the children were obedient. She felt especially grounded and content. Zhiqiang had already started to snore softly. Listening to the wind outside seem to have stopped, she too fell into a deep sleep.
location: Master bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning partner stretching and greeting Father.
description: The alarm went off at 6:50 a.m. Ma Xiulan woke up and roused her husband Ma Zhiqiang. The two laid out yoga mats on the living room floor and did 15 minutes of morning partner stretching. Xiulan deliberately led Zhiqiang through extra neck stretches and relaxation moves, asking him as they stretched, "Does your neck still feel sore? Don't just nod; try moving it around and see." Zhiqiang grinned sheepishly and said it felt much better. After the stretching ended at 7:10, Xiulan wiped the sweat from her face with a towel, then picked up her phone and called her father, Ma Jianguo. Her father said his blood pressure had been rechecked yesterday at 130/80, and the doctor said it was stable, so she should not worry. Xiulan told him to keep warm and drink more water, then hung up with peace of mind.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare breakfast and take the children to school.
description: After hanging up, Xiulan put on an apron and went into the kitchen. She heated up millet porridge, steamed large buns, and stir-fried pickled radish cubes and eggs. At 7:25, she woke up her second son, Ma Mingzhe, and her younger daughter, Ma Yuxin, and the family ate breakfast. Xiulan cleared away the dishes, told her husband Ma Zhiqiang to heat up some leftovers for himself at noon, then put on her helmet and set off on her electric bike at 8:00. She first took Mingzhe to the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School and urged him to listen carefully in class. Then she turned the bike around and took Yuxin to the gate of Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten at 8:15, watching her skip inside.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Do household chores to calm down
description: At 8:25, Ma Xiulan returned home. Without resting, she first put the clothes from last night into the washing machine, then took the mop and mopped the living room and dining room floors. Looking at the clean floors, her earlier nervousness and anticipation about the market application gradually calmed down. She poured herself a glass of warm water, sat on the sofa, and took out her phone to contact the organizers.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Contacting craft friends to ask about the details of the market.
description: Xiulan opened WeChat, found her handicraft friend Zhou Xiuqin, sent a smiley face first, and then directly initiated a voice call. Zhou Xiuqin warmly told her that the spring handicraft market was the "Jinghai Spring Breeze" market hosted by the Jinghai District Cultural and Creative Industry Association, provided the association's phone number and the surname of the person in charge, and told her that the application required filling out a registration form and submitting sample photos and an introduction; the association cared most about hygiene and traditional craftsmanship. Xiulan listened while quickly jotting down key information in her notebook.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Call to ask about applying for the market
description: Xiulan plucked up her courage and dialed the number she had written down for the Jinghai District Cultural and Creative Association. The person who answered was a gentle staff member surnamed Liu. Xiulan said she wanted to apply for a pickled vegetable stall at the handicraft market. The other party patiently explained: the stall fee is 200 yuan (tables and chairs provided), and she needed to provide a photocopy of her ID card, a stall application form, and at least 5 tasting samples for review. Once the materials were approved, she would be notified to go through the formalities together. Xiulan cautiously asked how difficult it was to apply, and the other party said that as long as the products had distinctive features and met hygiene standards, they were welcome, and reminded her that the deadline was this weekend. This warmed Xiulan's heart. She thanked them excitedly and hung up.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Organizing application materials and relaxing with embroidery.
description: After hanging up the phone, Xiulan did not immediately fill out the form; instead, she first calmed herself down. She carefully copied the key points from the phone call and Sister Xiuqin's suggestions onto the last page of her pickle notebook. Then she went into the bedroom, took out the half-embroidered plum blossom handkerchief, and began stitching it needle by needle. Embroidering quieted her whole body, and her nervousness and unease faded with each stitch. After more than half an hour of embroidery, seeing the increasingly complete plum blossom branch on the handkerchief, she felt delighted.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the younger daughter from school
description: At 11:10, Xiulan put down her needlework and rode her electric bike to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten. When she arrived at the gate, the children were lining up. Her younger daughter Ma Yuxin saw her mother and immediately ran over happily, throwing herself into her arms. Xiulan lifted her daughter onto the back seat of the electric bike, told her to sit steady, and then they went home together.
location: Huakang First Kindergarten, Huakang Subdistrict, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Lunch and coaxing her daughter to take a nap
description: When she got home, her husband Ma Zhiqiang had already reheated yesterday's spinach and tofu soup. Xiulan also made scallion pancakes and scrambled eggs. On the table was a plate of newly pickled radishes. Remembering the lesson of yesterday's upset stomach, Xiulan couldn't resist taking a small piece to taste. Finding it crisp and rich with the aroma of star anise, she took two more pieces. After lunch, she coaxed Yuxin to take a nap and told her the story of Little Red Riding Hood. Only when her daughter's breathing became even did she lean against the edge of the bed and doze for 15 minutes.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Taking daughter back to kindergarten and stomach discomfort
description: At 13:00, Xiulan woke Yuxin, washed her face, and took her to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten by electric bike. On the way back, she felt a faint burning sensation in her stomach and regretted eating too much pickled radish at lunch. After getting home, the heartburn became more and more obvious. She quickly poured a glass of warm water, sat on the sofa and sipped it slowly, closed her eyes to relax, feeling both regretful and wronged.
location: Huakang First Kindergarten, Huakang Subdistrict, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Fill out the registration form and submit the application.
description: After resting for half an hour, the burning sensation in her stomach eased. Xiulan pulled herself together, sat down at the dining table, and took out her notebook and phone to begin filling in the electronic stall application form item by item. In the "Product Features" section, she emphasized "old family broth, traditional pickling methods, pure handmade, zero additives." Then she found the previously taken photos of the pickled radish samples and rewrote them into a concise and persuasive sample introduction, emphasizing the traditional craftsmanship and the hygiene guarantee of the family workshop. Finally, she packed the application form, sample introduction, and ID card photo into a compressed file and pressed send. Seeing the "Sent successfully" prompt, she let out a long sigh of relief, feeling as though a heavy weight had been lifted from her heart.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Buying dinner ingredients
description: After submitting the application, Xiulan was in a great mood, and her stomach felt much better. She picked up her coin purse and shopping bag and walked to the Wutong Commune vegetable market. She knew her way around and went straight to the stall owner, Aunt Sun, to choose a piece of tender tofu, a bunch of baby bok choy, and a few tomatoes. She also saw fresh crucian carp and bought one to make soup. Since the spinach she bought yesterday had not been finished, she didn't buy any more this time.
location: Tianjin, Jinghai District, Wutong Commune Street, Wutong Commune Vegetable Market

name: Pick up the second son from school and help with homework
description: After buying groceries and returning home, Xiulan put the ingredients away, then went out again at 15:40, riding her electric bike to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up her second son Ma Mingzhe. As soon as Mingzhe came out of the school gate, he chattered about interesting things at school. Back home, Xiulan urged him to do his homework. Mingzhe did not understand a math problem, so Xiulan patiently guided him to draw a line-segment diagram and analyze the problem. Mother and son studied it together for a while before finally solving it. Xiulan praised him.
location: Jinghai No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the younger daughter from school
description: At 17:00, Xiulan had Mingzhe continue with his homework, and she went to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up Yuxin. Yuxin had painted a picture in kindergarten today, showing her mother and her planting flowers together. She held up the picture to show off to her mother. Xiulan smiled and praised her for painting well, carefully put the picture into her bag, and then took her daughter home.
location: Huakang First Kindergarten, Huakang Subdistrict, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare dinner and have a family meal
description: After returning home, her eldest son Ma Mingxuan was also back from school and doing homework in his room. Xiulan tied on an apron and started cooking dinner. She first pan-fried the crucian carp until both sides were golden, added water, and simmered it into a milky white soup. Then she made a light vegetable and tofu dish with baby bok choy and tofu, and heated up scallion pancakes. At 18:10 the meal was served, and she placed the crucian carp and tofu soup in the center. At the dinner table, Xiulan excitedly shared that she had submitted the application for a market stall today. Her husband Zhiqiang nodded in approval, and her eldest son Mingxuan also praised her as awesome. The family atmosphere was very good. Remembering the lesson she had learned, Xiulan did not touch the pickled vegetables for the entire meal.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tidying up and helping with homework
description: After the meal, Ma Zhiqiang took the initiative to wash the dishes and let Xiulan rest for a while. Xiulan began her daily routine check: first she looked at the eldest son Ma Mingxuan's physics homework, found two wrong problems and explained them patiently; then she listened to the second son Ma Mingzhe recite the text; finally she accompanied the youngest daughter Ma Yuxin in practicing character tracing. The children all did well, and she felt very gratified.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Helping her daughter bathe and family leisure time
description: After checking homework, Xiulan ran warm water for Yuxin and helped her take a bath. After the bath, Yuxin, in her little pajamas, played with building blocks in the living room, while Xiulan sat on the sofa, watching the weather forecast and taking out her embroidery needle to continue embroidering the plum blossom handkerchief. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang sat nearby watching TV and using his phone.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Wrapping up household chores and free time
description: At 21:00, Xiulan urged the children to wash up and brush their teeth. She gave the living room and kitchen a quick tidy, then took tomorrow's clothes out of the washing machine and hung them up. The elder son Ma Mingxuan went back to his room to read, and the younger son Ma Mingzhe was still playing with his dad. Seeing that it was getting late, Xiulan called the children to bed.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Bedtime deep breathing exercise.
description: After the children had all fallen asleep, the house quieted down. At 21:20, Xiulan and Zhiqiang sat cross-legged in the master bedroom and began the bedtime deep-breathing exercise they had been doing for a week. Xiulan closed her eyes and inhaled slowly, silently repeating, “Come on, everything will be fine.” As she exhaled, she imagined the day's stomach acid discomfort and tense nerves fading away with her breath. She felt her heart becoming calmer and calmer.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Relaxing and chatting before bed
description: After the deep breathing, Xiulan and Zhiqiang lay in bed chatting. Zhiqiang asked about her application today, and Xiulan explained it in detail, her tone full of anticipation. Zhiqiang held her hand and said, "Don't worry, it will definitely work out." Xiulan felt warm inside, and leaning against her husband, she felt extremely secure.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Going to bed
description: At 22:10, Xiulan glanced at her phone; there were no new email notifications. She turned off the light and closed her eyes, recalling the scenes of the day: despite a minor acid reflux hiccup in the middle, the core task of applying for the market had been submitted. Thinking of her father’s stable blood pressure, the children’s good behavior, and her husband’s support, she gradually fell asleep with a smile and expectations for the future.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning activities and preparing breakfast
description: Woke up at 6:50 in the morning, first did stretching and the wind-blowing tree pose in bed, then called her father to ask about his blood pressure. Relieved after hearing it was stable, she reminded him to put on more clothes. Then she woke her husband Ma Zhiqiang. After washing up, she went into the kitchen to prepare breakfast: sliced leftover steamed buns and pan-fried them until golden, cooked millet porridge, and served homemade pickled radish strips. Then she went to each room to wake the children: the eldest son Mingxuan had already dressed himself and was reading; the second son Mingzhe was reluctant to get up; the youngest daughter Yuxin wanted her mother to hold her. She helped Yuxin put on her cotton-padded jacket and urged Mingzhe to wash up. The whole morning was warm and orderly.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Take the children to school.
description: After breakfast, Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to first take her second son Mingzhe to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, telling him to listen attentively in class and watching him enter the school gate. Then she took her youngest daughter Yuxin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, and left only after watching her say hello to the teacher and skip happily into the kindergarten.
location: Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School and Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Buy pickling ingredients at the vegetable market
description: After dropping off the children, Ma Xiulan walked to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, found the stall owner Sun Guifang, and ordered 30 jin of white radish, coarse salt, soy sauce, aged vinegar, and other large quantities of ingredients for making pickled radish. Sun Guifang packed them warmly and gave her some cilantro. Because the ingredients were too heavy, she suggested storing the heavy items behind the stall for her husband to pick up later. Ma Xiulan first carried the light seasonings home.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Household chores and hand embroidery
description: Ma Xiulan returned home, first put on an apron and tidied the kitchen, scrubbed the stove and cutting board, cleaned the pickling vat and turned it upside down to drain, and put away the coarse salt, soy sauce and other seasonings she had bought. Then she sat on the living room sofa embroidering a white handkerchief, finished embroidering the plum blossom branch, and enjoyed a moment of peace. Afterwards she went back to the kitchen, sliced the ginger and garlic, cut the dried chili peppers into sections for later use, and from time to time looked out, waiting for her husband to return with the radishes.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Simple lunch
description: A little after eleven, her husband Ma Zhiqiang brought back the stored materials on a handcart, and the two of them carried them into the kitchen. Since Zhiqiang still had to go out driving in the afternoon, Ma Xiulan quickly cooked two bowls of hot noodle soup with pickled vegetables, and the two had a simple lunch.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Batch pickling soy-marinated radish.
description: After lunch, Ma Xiulan changed into old clothes and began making pickled radishes in bulk. She scrubbed 30 jin of white radishes one by one, drained them, cut them into even strips, and layered them in a large vat, one layer of radish and one layer of salt. She sprinkled in ginger slices, garlic slices, and dried chilies, then slowly poured in a sauce made from soy sauce, aged vinegar, sugar, and spices until it covered everything. After sealing the lid, she weighed it down with stones. When she finished, her back was sore but she felt satisfied. She wrote in her pickle record book: "February 26, Wednesday, cloudy, first batch with the new recipe, expected to open the vat and taste it on March 5."
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Rest and check email
description: After pickling the radishes, Ma Xiulan washed her face and rested on the sofa. She checked her email on her phone and found there was still no reply to her market-stall application. Slightly disappointed, she comforted herself to wait a little longer. To take her mind off it, she watched some short videos about home organization for a while.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Picking up children from school
description: At three in the afternoon, Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up her youngest daughter Yuxin. Yuxin rushed over and hugged her, sharing a song she had learned in kindergarten. Then she picked up Mingzhe at Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School. Mingzhe happily told his mother he had scored 95 on his math test. Along the way, the children chattered cheerfully, and the atmosphere was lively.
location: Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jinghai District Third Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tutor the children and prepare dinner
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan urged Mingzhe to do his homework and let Yuxin trace characters at the tea table. She put on an apron and started preparing dinner, taking out pork tenderloin, greens, and scallions. She cut the tenderloin into strips and marinated them with cooking wine, salt, egg white, and starch. Then she mixed the sweet-and-sour sauce, heated oil and fried the pork strips until golden, then stir-fried scallions and ginger to fragrance, boiled the sweet-and-sour sauce and coated the pork strips evenly, filling the kitchen with a sweet and sour aroma. Meanwhile, she kept an eye on the children's homework.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner
description: Her husband Ma Zhiqiang came back from driving his truck just in time for dinner. The family sat around the table, eating sweet-and-sour pork tenderloin, stir-fried greens, and millet porridge. Yuxin ate with sauce all over her mouth, and Mingxuan and Mingzhe also ate with hearty appetites. The couple chatted about pickled radishes, and the family atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Cleaning up the kitchen and helping the eldest son with his homework
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan cleared the table and washed the dishes while Zhiqiang took the two younger children to the living room to watch TV. After she finished washing the dishes, she went to the study and checked her eldest son Mingxuan's physics homework. She patiently explained a drawing problem in mechanics and found the textbook example to help him consolidate his understanding.
location: Kitchen and study at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family leisure and hand embroidery
description: After helping with homework, Ma Xiulan returned to the living room, where her husband was watching an animated movie with Mingzhe and Yuxin. She sat back on the sofa, picked up the unfinished handkerchief, and continued embroidering. The family each quietly did their own thing, chatting occasionally, enjoying a warm evening together.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and deep-breathing relaxation
description: After the movie ended, Ma Xiulan urged the children to wash up and go to bed. The couple also washed up simply and lay down. Ma Xiulan suggested continuing to practice the 4-7-8 breathing technique to relieve anxiety. With the lights off, the two lay side by side, following the guidance as they slowly inhaled, held their breath, and gently exhaled, silently repeating 'let it be' in their minds. After several rounds, the anxiety eased. At 21:30, the lights went off on time, and she held Zhiqiang's hand and fell into a sound sleep.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning partner stretching and blood pressure monitoring
description: After hearing the alarm, Ma Xiulan did stretching exercises in bed with her husband Ma Zhiqiang, including Cat-Cow and Wind-Blowing-Tree poses, to relieve the soreness in her lower back from moving radishes yesterday. After stretching, Ma Xiulan called her mother to ask about her father's blood pressure. Her mother said his blood pressure was normal at 130/80 and advised her parents not to go out on cloudy days. Relieved that her parents were healthy, Ma Xiulan felt at ease.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing breakfast and sending the son to school
description: Ma Xiulan cooked millet porridge, steamed mantou and flower rolls, and sliced pickled radish skin. She woke up Ma Mingzhe and Ma Yuxin for breakfast and helped Xinxin put on thick cotton pants. Then she rode her electric bike to first take Ma Mingzhe to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, telling him to listen carefully in class; then she took Ma Yuxin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten and left only after watching her skip into the kindergarten.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home); Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Handling pickled vegetables and household cleaning
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan changed into old clothes and checked the three jars of radishes, two jars of mustard tubers, and one small jar of sweet garlic she had pickled the day before. She turned them, tasted them, and added more coarse salt to make sure the brine covered the vegetables. Then she sealed the jar openings with plastic wrap and weighed them down with stones. Afterward she scrubbed the stove and sink and tidied the kitchen.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Collecting packages and consulting about market stall experience.
description: After receiving a delivery notification text message, Ma Xiulan went downstairs to the Cainiao Station to pick up the package with embroidery patterns. After returning home, she had a video call with her friend Zhou Xiuqin to ask about her street vending experience last year, including strategies such as layered display of goods, small-portion pricing, buy-one-get-one-free offers, and tips for attracting customers, and she took notes. The two agreed that if the application was approved, they would go set up a practice stall together on the weekend.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Embroidering handkerchiefs and preparing lunch
description: Ma Xiulan continued embroidering the peony flowers on the handkerchief for about half an hour, then stopped because her eyes were sore and put away the needle and thread. She went to the kitchen and made herself hot soup noodles with the leftover cabbage from yesterday, adding a poached egg as a simple lunch.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up daughter, lunch, and midday rest.
description: At 11 o'clock, Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up Ma Yuxin. On the way, Xinxin sang the nursery rhyme she had just learned. After getting home, Ma Xiulan cooked noodles and Xinxin helped peel garlic. The two finished the hot noodle soup, then Ma Xiulan washed Xinxin's hands and face, coaxed her to take a nap, and she herself also lay down and dozed for about twenty minutes.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Take her daughter back to the kindergarten and finish the handkerchief work
description: At 1:50 p.m., Ma Xiulan woke Ma Yuxin, braided her hair, and dressed her. At exactly 2:00, she rode an electric bike to take her back to Huakang First Kindergarten. After getting home, she continued making handkerchiefs, using leftover pieces of blue calico to decorate the backs of the handkerchiefs, carefully sewing them in a style similar to the printed fabric her former classmate Chen Yulan had given her.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Decorating handkerchiefs and preparing to pick up the children
description: Ma Xiulan focused on sewing a handkerchief, using a thimble to assist her, and finished it with blue calico decoration, making a rustic and delicate handkerchief. She folded it carefully and put it in her sewing box. Then she washed her hands, changed clothes, and got ready to pick up the children from school.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Picking up the two children from school and going home.
description: At 15:25, Ma Xiulan first went to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up Ma Mingzhe, and on the way they talked about fractions in math class. Then she went to Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up Ma Yuxin. When the two children met, they chattered incessantly. Mingzhe shouted that he wanted to eat candied hawthorns, and Ma Xiulan promised to buy them after he finished his homework. The three walked home together.
location: Jinghai No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Supervising homework and preparing ingredients
description: After getting home, Ma Xiulan told Ma Mingzhe to wash his hands first and do his homework at the small table in the living room, telling him to write carefully. She went into the kitchen to prepare dinner: she diced pork belly, soaked shiitake mushrooms, daylily buds, and wood ear fungus, boiled water for noodles, and took out tomatoes and cilantro.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Make noodle soup with gravy and have a family dinner
description: After Ma Zhiqiang and Ma Mingxuan got home, Ma Xiulan started making noodles with thick gravy: she stir-fried diced pork belly, added minced scallion and ginger, then added shiitake mushrooms, day lily buds, and wood ear mushrooms, stirring and seasoning. She thickened it with water starch, then poured in beaten egg and sprinkled minced garlic. Once the hand-rolled noodles were cooked, she ladled the gravy over them and sprinkled chopped cilantro. The family sat around and ate the steaming noodles together.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Dinner table chat and family plans.
description: While eating noodles, Ma Xiulan shared the stall-running experience she had learned from consulting Zhou Xiuqin. Ma Zhiqiang expressed support and offered to help with moving goods. Ma Mingxuan proposed helping with the accounts, Ma Mingzhe wanted to be the cashier, and Ma Yuxin said in a baby voice that she would be responsible for being adorable. The whole family laughed, and the atmosphere was warm and lively.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tidy up the kitchen and help with homework.
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan cleared the dishes and wiped down the kitchen. Then she checked Ma Mingzhe's homework, circling the wrong characters with a red pen so he could correct them; listened to Ma Mingxuan explain a physics problem, nodding along; and at the same time urged Ma Yuxin to review the nursery rhymes taught in kindergarten.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family leisure and bedtime preparation
description: Ma Xiulan washed Ma Yuxin up and told her the story 'Little Horse Crossing the River' to coax her to sleep. Then she went to the living room to chat with Ma Zhiqiang, exchanging Xiuqin's suggestions and the children's behavior. The two discussed that if the market application was approved, they could clear a spot on the balcony for a folding table.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Deep breathing as a couple before bed.
description: Ma Xiulan and Ma Zhiqiang returned to the bedroom, turned off the main light and left the bedside lamp on, and leaned side by side against the headboard doing three cycles of the 4-7-8 breathing technique. Zhiqiang comforted Xiulan, telling her not to worry — no matter whether the market works out, the family is fine. Xiulan felt relieved and her anxiety dissipated.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening rest
description: The two chatted about the children's growth, feeling content, then turned off the light and went to sleep. Ma Xiulan listened to the wind outside the window and drifted peacefully into sleep.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning partner stretching and phone greetings
description: As dawn was breaking, Ma Xiulan and her husband Ma Zhiqiang, who had the day off, began partner stretching in bed. With slow, steady breathing, they moved through Cat-Cow and swaying-tree poses, stretching out their bodies that had grown stiff overnight. After stretching, Xiulan dialed her mother Li Xiuying's number, and with concern asked about her father Ma Jianguo's morning blood pressure. When she learned it was a normal 128/78, she carefully reminded him that it would be colder today and to remember to put on an extra vest, and noted that this was the last phone health check for February.
location: Master bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare breakfast
description: Ma Xiulan got up and went to the kitchen. On the gas stove she cooked a pot of golden millet porridge and heated the baozi and mantou made yesterday in the steamer. She quickly stir-fried a plate of scallion eggs and sliced a dish of her own crispy pickled radish peels. The rich aroma of home cooking dispelled the morning chill.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Take the two little ones to school
description: After waking the children and urging them to wash up and eat breakfast, Xiulan left at 7:35 with the two children on her e-bike. First she took her second son, Mingzhe, to the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School on the way, telling him to pay attention in class. Then she turned around and took her younger daughter, Yuxin, to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten at about 7:48 and handed her to the teacher.
location: Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School and Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten on Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Cleaning the kitchen and chatting about housework
description: After dropping off the children, Xiulan got home around 7:55. While cleaning the stove and washing the dishes, she chatted with Zhiqiang, who had just gotten up and was drinking tea in the living room. She asked Zhiqiang what he planned to do on his day off. Zhiqiang said he wanted to fix the slightly wobbly clothes drying rack on the balcony, then go downstairs to buy a pack of cigarettes. Listening, Xiulan silently made a note to praise him for how well he had saved on cigarette money this month when she did the accounts later. After tidying up, she made herself a cup of hot tea, took a breather on the sofa, and got ready to start the day's most important task—sorting out the accounts.
location: Kitchen and living room of the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: End-of-month financial review and next month's budget
description: Xiulan took out the hardcover family account book she had used for several years, spread it open on the living room desk, and began a final check of all February expenses. Cross-referencing shopping receipts and mobile payment records, she went through each item and confirmed that this month's education savings goal of 300 yuan had been met (including the 150 yuan saved earlier and the 150 yuan she needed to deposit today). Her husband Zhiqiang had indeed saved about 120 yuan on cigarettes this month. Total spending had been successfully kept within 3,800 yuan. She nodded with satisfaction, then turned to a new page to set the March budget. Under 'Miscellaneous', she specially listed 'Pickled vegetable ingredients: 50 yuan', drew a small circle beside it, and wrote 'Keep going' to encourage herself.
location: Desk in the living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Go to the vegetable market to buy groceries and send a remittance on the way
description: After putting away the account book, Xiulan put on her coat and went out. She first rode her e-bike to the Tianjin Rural Commercial Bank (Jinghai Central Sub-branch) near the neighborhood, withdrew 150 yuan in cash from the card she usually uses for spare change, and deposited it into a dedicated education savings card for the children. With that done, she rode with peace of mind to the Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, found the familiar stall owner Auntie Sun Guifang, and bought a piece of soft tofu, a bunch of fresh baby bok choy, a few tomatoes, and some vermicelli to prepare stuffing for steaming buns in the evening. She also chatted with Auntie Sun for a while, asking about recent vegetable prices.
location: Tianjin Rural Commercial Bank (Jinghai Central Sub-branch), Jinghai District, Tianjin; Wutong Community Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Doing Housework and Taking a Break
description: She got home around 10:30. Xiulan put the groceries in the kitchen and started tidying the house. She vacuumed the living room and bedroom floors and put the toys the children had scattered around last night into storage bins. She took down the bed sheets that had been washed and dried on the balcony the day before, folded them, and put them back in the cabinet. Zhiqiang was on the balcony fixing the clothes-drying rack with a clatter. Xiulan poured him a glass of water. After finishing the housework, she sat down to rest for a while. She opened her phone and saw that Sister Xiuqin had posted a photo of herself practicing tai chi in her Moments, so she gave it a like. She thought about the market matter but told herself not to rush and to wait patiently for news.
location: Living room and balcony at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up Xinxin, make lunch, and put her down for a nap.
description: At 11:20, Xiulan rode her electric bike to Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up Xinxin. After returning home, she reheated the leftover millet porridge from the morning and half a steamed bun for Xinxin, and also steamed a bowl of soft, smooth egg custard. After Xinxin obediently finished eating, Xiulan helped her wash her face and hands, then coaxed her to bed for a nap. She gently patted Xinxin and told the story The Little Horse Crosses the River for five minutes until the little one fell asleep with steady breathing. She herself then went to the kitchen and cooked a simple bowl of plain noodles with the fresh tofu and baby bok choy bought that morning, and ate it with pickled vegetables.
location: Kitchen and children's room at the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Taking Xinxin to afternoon class and having a midday rest
description: Xiulan set the alarm for 12:45 for both herself and Xinxin. When the alarm rang, she gently woke Xinxin, wiped her face, re-tied her little pigtails, and took her back to Huakang First Kindergarten. She got home around 13:00. Feeling a bit tired, Xiulan set an alarm for 30 minutes later, lay down on the bed in the master bedroom, closed her eyes, and took a short nap.
location: Home master bedroom, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Monthly family photo organization
description: After her lunch break, Xiulan sat down at the desk feeling refreshed, opened the somewhat old laptop, and plugged in the camera data cable. She spent nearly two hours importing all the photos taken in February, more than a hundred of them, from the camera to the computer. She carefully browsed through them one by one, deleted blurry and duplicate photos, then created folders such as "Children Growing Up (Mingxuan, Mingzhe, Xinxin)," "Family Food (Noodles with Gravy, Baozi, Newly Pickled Vegetables)," and "Backyard Work" to categorize the photos.
