She also opened a notepad and wrote simple stories behind a few particularly meaningful photos, such as "On February 15, Mingzhe got 95 points on the exam and asked for a baked sweet potato as a reward." These images recorded the small joys of ordinary days.
location: Desk in the living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the two younger children from school and supervise their homework.
description: At 15:20, Xiulan left on time. She first rode her e-bike to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up Mingzhe, then stopped by Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up Xinxin on the way. After arriving home, she urged Mingzhe to go to his room and do homework first, telling him to finish what he could do and circle what he couldn't for her. She then soaked the vermicelli she had bought and took out flour to knead dough for the evening's steamed buns.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare dinner: make steamed stuffed buns.
description: Zhiqiang had already fixed the clothes rack and came over to help. Xiulan took the leftover meat sauce from yesterday's braised sauce noodles, added softened vermicelli, chopped cabbage, and minced scallion and ginger, and mixed it into a fragrant filling for steamed buns. Zhiqiang was responsible for kneading the dough and rolling out the wrappers, while Xiulan quickly wrapped the buns. One by one, plump white buns were neatly arranged on the steaming tray. The two chatted about daily life while working, filling the home with a warm atmosphere.
location: Kitchen and living room of the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The whole family eats dinner
description: At 17:30, Zhiqiang brought the first steamer of buns to the table. Xiulan had also made a big pot of seaweed egg drop soup. The eldest son Mingxuan had come home from school. The whole family sat around the table, having a lively dinner. At the table, Xiulan brought up the results of today's bookkeeping and said to Zhiqiang with a smile, 'Dear, you saved quite a bit on cigarettes this month; I should give you credit for that.' Mingxuan and Mingzhe chattered about school, Xinxin ate her buns eagerly, and the whole family was happy and harmonious.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Visiting Wang Guilan and agreeing to do stretching check-ins.
description: Xiulan carried a plate of six steaming hot buns and walked over to knock on the door of Wang Guilan, who lived across the hall. Wang Guilan warmly welcomed her in. The two sat down on the sofa in the living room. Xiulan put the buns on the tea table and got down to business. She excitedly shared with Sister Guilan the benefits she had gained from her morning stretching over the past month, saying that her shoulders and neck used to feel stiff but now felt much looser. She even stood up on the spot and taught Sister Guilan a simple “wall standing” exercise. When Sister Guilan tried it, she did feel a stretch in her back and became interested too. The two hit it off immediately and agreed on the spot that, starting tomorrow, March 1, they would post check-in photos of their stretching in the WeChat group every day to supervise each other and learn new moves together.
location: Wang Guilan's home, No. 158 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Check homework, tidy up the house, and wash up
description: After returning from Sister Guilan's house, Xiulan first checked Mingzhe's homework and helped him solve two math word problems he didn't understand. Then she cleared the dining table, washed the dishes and chopsticks, and wiped the kitchen stove spotless. Mingxuan was doing physics problems in his own room; she went in and took a look but didn't disturb him. Then she gave Xinxin a bath and urged Mingzhe to brush his teeth and wash his face to get ready for bed.
location: Living room, kitchen, and bathroom, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Putting the kids to bed and evening preparations
description: After Xinxin finished bathing, Xiulan changed her into pajamas, read her a picture-book story, and coaxed her to sleep. Once Xinxin was asleep, she came out, picked out the clothes the children would wear tomorrow, folded them, and placed them at the head of each bed. Mingzhe was already in bed too. Xiulan herself took a hot shower, changed into pajamas, and felt much of the day's fatigue melt away.
location: Bathroom, children's room, and master bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Bedtime deep breathing exercise.
description: Zhiqiang was already leaning against the headboard looking at his phone. Xiulan sat down on the edge of the bed and exchanged a smile with him. In tacit agreement, the two began the last 4-7-8 deep breathing exercise of this February. She closed her eyes, inhaled through her nose for 4 seconds, held the breath for 7 seconds, then slowly exhaled through her mouth for 8 seconds. Silently repeating "calm" and "relax" in her mind. After five rounds, her body felt heavy, sleepiness crept over her, and she felt calm and grounded.
location: Master bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Lights out, bedtime
description: Xiulan dimmed the bedside lamp, softly said Goodnight to Zhiqiang, then turned off the light and lay down. In her mind, she went over the day's events like a movie: she had sorted out the accounts, organized the photos, and made a check-in appointment with Sister Guilan, and she felt very confident. With this calm anticipation of life in March, she peacefully fell asleep.
location: Master bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning walk start and stretching check-in
description: The alarm went off on time. I turned over and got out of bed gently, afraid of waking my husband, who was still fast asleep. I put on the new sneakers I had bought a few days ago, threw on a coat, and quietly left the house. The air was crisp on the small path in Jingwen Road Community. I walked briskly along the sidewalk for about ten minutes and saw that the tips of the grass at the base of the wall were really turning green again. After returning home, I stood in the courtyard and did a five-minute shoulder and neck stretch, feeling my muscles and bones loosen up. I sent Sister Guilan a voice message: "Sister Guilan, I'm up. I just took a walk and stretched, and I feel much more energetic!" She quickly replied with a thumbs-up emoji, and I started preparing breakfast.
location: Jingwen Road Community paths and the courtyard at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare breakfast and wake up the children.
description: I tied on an apron and started preparing breakfast for the family of five. Millet porridge was bubbling in the pot. I reheated yesterday's leftover steamed buns, sliced a plate of pickled vegetables, and steamed frozen custard buns for the children. While busy, I called out, "Mingxuan, Mingzhe, Xinxin, get up! The sun is shining on your butts!" My husband Ma Zhiqiang came out first and helped set out the bowls and chopsticks. The three children slowly came out to wash up; the youngest daughter Xinxin was still half-asleep with her arms out wanting to be held.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family breakfast
description: The family sat around the dinner table. I urged Mingzhe not to just eat the dishes but to drink more porridge. My husband mentioned that he would be heading out on another long-distance trip next week, this time to Shanxi. I said 'be careful on the road' out loud, but in my mind I was already planning to pack more dry food for him. The laughter and talk at the dinner table is the moment I feel most at ease all day.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tidy up housework and plan to go out
description: After the meal, I quickly cleared the dishes, wiped down the stove, and tidied up the kitchen. I told my eldest and second sons to go into the room and do their homework, instructing them that they could watch TV only after finishing. I played with blocks with 6-year-old Xinxin in the living room, thinking about this morning's plan: first go to Sister Guilan's house across the street to learn how to make pickled vegetables, then go to the vegetable market to buy radishes.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Ask a neighbor for pickled vegetable recipes.
description: Holding Xinxin’s hand, I knocked on the door of Sister Guilan, who lived across the hall. She warmly welcomed us into her kitchen, took out an old clay jar from the cabinet, and opened the lid; a salty aroma filled the air. She patiently explained how to pickle Tianjin radish: 'The ratio of salt, sugar, and soy sauce is 1:2:6. After cutting the radish into sticks, the key step is curing it with salt. Once fully cured, squeeze it dry; then pickling gives you no bitter taste and a crisp texture.' I carefully noted every step in my phone’s memo app, even asking about the amounts of Sichuan peppercorns and star anise. Before we left, Sister Guilan pressed a small packet of her homemade five-spice powder into my hand, saying it was her secret recipe. I was extremely grateful.
location: 154 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Vegetable market shopping and taking my daughter home
description: After leaving Sister Guilan's house, I got on the electric bike, with Xinxin on the front, and headed straight for the Wutong Commune vegetable market. I went directly to Aunt Sun Guifang's stall and bought 5 jin of white radish and 2 jin of carrots, and also picked out a bunch of tender celery and a piece of fresh tofu. Aunt Sun teased me, 'Xiulan, have you been studying pickled vegetables lately? You look like a pro!' I smiled and played along. Back home, I first carefully scrubbed the radishes with clean water in the yard, cut them into strips, sprinkled them with salt, and put them in a large basin to draw out the water.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and 156 Jingwen Road

name: First time making soy-pickled radish
description: After the radish strips had been salted and drained, I turned on the tap to rinse the salt off the surface, then used both hands to squeeze the water out of the strips. Next I began to mix the sauce: a large bowl of soy sauce, a few spoonfuls of rice vinegar and white sugar, some Sichuan peppercorns, and finally the spices Sister Guilan had given me. I dumped the squeezed-dry radish strips all in, stirring back and forth with a spoon so that every strip was coated with the dark sauce. Finally I packed them into a clay jar that I had washed and dried in advance, pressed them down with the spoon, and covered and sealed it tightly. I solemnly wrote 'March 1, First Batch of Soy-Pickled Radish' on the jar's label. Looking at it, I felt a great sense of accomplishment.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing lunch and looking after the children
description: After making the pickles, I started preparing lunch. Xinxin called out that she was hungry, and I reassured her it would be ready soon. For lunch I made something simple: tomato scrambled eggs, stir-fried baby bok choy, and a pot of hot noodle soup. I worked quickly, and soon the kitchen was filled with aroma.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family lunch
description: I called the family to come eat lunch. At the table, I casually mentioned that I had learned a new recipe from Sister Guilan today and pickled a jar of soy-sauce radish. My husband said, "You just learned it and you're already putting it to use—not bad!" The children weren't very interested in the pickled vegetables and just buried their heads in their noodles.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Midday nap
description: After the meal, my husband helped watch the children, and I finally had a chance to catch my breath. I leaned on the living room sofa and dozed for half an hour. That short nap made me feel much more energetic in the afternoon.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Research Alipay payment QR code.
description: After waking from her nap, the children were all playing on their own and the living room had become quiet. She took out her phone and began carefully looking into Alipay's payment collection QR code. She opened Alipay, found “Merchant Services,” and read through the entire application process. She confirmed that the application was free and that she could apply with her personal identity. She also casually looked at WeChat's payment collection QR code application and felt it was much the same. She filled in Alipay's information on her phone, planning to submit it formally tomorrow, to prepare for setting up a stall at the market to sell handmade items in the future.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Supervising the children's studies and playing with her daughter
description: Putting away my phone, I got up to check Mingzhe's homework. The boy got one math problem wrong, and I patiently explained it to him. Then I spot-checked Mingxuan on a few English words and saw that he recited them pretty well. My little daughter Xinxin tugged at me to look at her picture book, pointing at a little rabbit and saying, "Mommy, it's so cute." I held her close, feeling warm inside.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing dinner
description: Seeing that it was almost time to make dinner, I tied on an apron and plunged into the kitchen. Tonight I planned to make the braised pork belly the kids love, plus a stew of cabbage, tofu, and glass noodles, served with rice — a simple, hearty home-cooked meal. I first blanched the meat, then started cutting the cabbage and soaking the glass noodles.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner
description: When dinner was served, the braised pork was bright red and glossy, the children wolfed it down, and her husband kept praising how tasty it was. The atmosphere at the table was great, everyone eating and chatting.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Cleaning up the kitchen and evening family time
description: After dinner, as usual, I cleared the dishes and wiped the kitchen until it shone. I heard my husband in the living room watching cartoons with the children, with bursts of laughter. I dried my hands and sat down on the sofa, watching TV and reminding Mingxuan not to forget to preview the new lesson tomorrow.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Mother called to chat about daily life and prepare for bed
description: Just then, the phone rang — it was my mother. She chatted with me about neighborhood gossip and funny things the children had done, and casually mentioned that my father, Ma Jianguo, had recently said he sometimes felt dizzy. I urged her, "Mom, keep an eye on him. If it doesn't get better, take him to the community clinic and have Dr. Wang measure his blood pressure. Dad just can't sit idle — he always says he's fine." After hanging up, I urged Xinxin to go take a bath. Then I quickly washed up as well.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pre-sleep communication and stretching feedback
description: Lying in bed, I picked up my phone and sent a voice message to Sister Guilan: "Sister Guilan, I felt so good after stretching this morning. Let's keep it up tomorrow!" She quickly replied: "Sure, let's keep at it together!" My husband asked who I was talking to, and I said it was Sister Guilan. He gave an "mm-hmm" and turned over, ready to sleep.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Deep-breathing exercise for the husband and wife
description: After turning off the light, my husband and I lay side by side. I said softly, "Zhiqiang, come on, let's do a few rounds of breathing." We began the 4-7-8 breathing technique. I silently repeated "calm" and "relax" to myself, feeling the day's fatigue slowly dissipate with each breath, and my heart gradually calmed down.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Going to bed
description: I turned over in bed and thought back on the day: I had learned a new recipe, pickled vegetables, looked into payment QR codes, and talked to Mom and Dad on the phone... Life felt so fulfilling, and I had more hope for the future. I closed my eyes and soon fell asleep.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning walk exercise and applying for a payment QR code
description: At 6:30 a.m., Ma Xiulan woke up naturally and walked slowly in her courtyard to loosen up. She then strolled east along Jingwen Road to near Dongxing Road and felt cheerful when she saw the willow trees sprouting. After returning, she completed the shoulder-neck stretches and side bends that Wang Guilan had taught her in the courtyard, and shared her completed workout and photos of the willows with Wang Guilan via WeChat. Then, while the children had not yet woken up, she went back to the living room, used Alipay on her phone to submit an application for a QR code for receiving money, uploaded a photo of her ID card, and chose the blue design. Next, she used her husband Ma Zhiqiang's phone to set up voice alerts for incoming payments.
location: Home courtyard at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, the eastern section of Jingwen Road Community, and the home living room

name: Preparing and enjoying the whole family's breakfast and doing post-meal chores.
description: In the kitchen, Ma Xiulan rinsed the millet and cooked millet porridge, heated steamed buns, pickled radish peels, sliced pickled vegetables, and made garlic cucumber salad. Then she woke the three children, and the family sat around the dining table for breakfast. During the meal, she told her sons to finish their homework before playing, and her husband Ma Zhiqiang agreed. After the meal, the children went to do homework while Ma Xiulan cleared the dishes, wiped the table, washed the dishes, cleaned the stove, and tidied the clothes drying on the balcony, hanging her daughter's floral dress and thick coat in the sunny spot to dry a bit more.
location: Kitchen, dining room, and balcony at the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Calling father to say hello, morning chores, and chatting with neighbors
description: Ma Xiulan called her natal family in the living room. She chatted with her mother Li Xiuying, asked about whether her father Ma Jianguo's dizziness had improved and how he was taking his medication, and reminded her parents to take care of their health and measure their blood pressure regularly. After hanging up, she checked and turned over the pickled radish jar made the day before yesterday so that the seasonings would penetrate evenly, then resealed it. She sat down and continued last week's embroidery handicraft, while thinking that she didn't have much inventory of handicrafts and planned to contact the introducer Zhou Xiuqin. Wang Guilan, the neighbor across the hallway, dropped by, and the two exchanged tips on applying for payment QR codes, raising children, and cooking.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Going to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market for shopping
description: Ma Xiulan walked to the Wutong Commune Vegetable Market (located on the eastern section of Shengli Avenue) pulling a small cart. At the stall of her familiar vendor Sun Guifang, she bought two jin of fresh chives and a piece of pork belly to make dumplings at home, and because the baby bok choy was cheap, she also picked up a bunch. After chatting with Aunt Sun, she walked back and bought some fresh scallions from a roadside stall on the way.

participant.name: Sun Guifang
participant.relation: An acquaintance who runs a stall at the vegetable market

location: Wutong Commune Food Market on the east section of Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and the route along the way

name: Preparing lunch, checking the pickled vegetables, and contacting about handcraft work.
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan first put away the groceries she had bought, then prepared a simple lunch: she cooked a large pot of hot noodle soup and reheated the steamed buns left over from the morning, then called the children to wash their hands and eat. After the meal, she checked the other two jars of large radishes and mustard tubers she had pickled a few days earlier to make sure the seals were intact. Before the children's nap, she contacted Zhou Xiuqin, who connected her with handicraft jobs, via WeChat, and arranged to meet the next afternoon to look at new samples.
location: Kitchen and storage area at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Accompanying younger daughter for courtyard painting and nap time
description: After lunch, the sunlight was warm. Her youngest daughter, Ma Yuxin, insisted on drawing, so Ma Xiulan found a box of chalk and taught her to draw the sun and little flowers on the cement floor of the courtyard. She took photos of her daughter drawing, and the mother and daughter took a photo together with the drawings as the background, saving them to the phone's album. At two in the afternoon, seeing that her daughter was sleepy, she took her back into the room, told her stories to lull her to sleep, and then leaned against the bed herself to rest for half an hour.
location: Home courtyard and bedroom, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Supervising son's study and preparing afternoon snacks
description: After waking from her midday nap, Ma Xiulan checked the homework progress of her two sons. She explained a geometry problem to her eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, and told her second son, Ma Mingzhe, to erase his crooked handwriting and rewrite it, supervising his corrections. Then she went to the kitchen, cut an apple, and poured yogurt as a snack for the children.
location: Living room and kitchen at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Taking in laundry, preparing dumpling filling, and organizing handmade goods inventory.
description: Seeing the sky turn cloudy, Ma Xiulan hurried to the balcony to bring in the clothes hung out to dry that morning and folded them neatly. Then in the kitchen she washed and minced the pork belly, chopped the chives, prepared minced scallion and ginger, and mixed the dumpling filling. Finally she went to the storage room to sort the scraps from her handwork odd jobs, categorizing and putting away the usable fabric pieces.
location: Balcony, kitchen, and storage room of the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The whole family made dumplings together and had a family discussion
description: Ma Xiulan brought the prepared dough and filling to the dining room, and the family of five sat around wrapping dumplings. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang rolled the wrappers, Ma Xiulan wrapped, and the two sons also tried to help. Although the dumplings came out in odd shapes, the room was full of laughter. While wrapping dumplings, Ma Xiulan discussed with Ma Zhiqiang what packaging to use for the pickled vegetables in the future, suggested buying small glass jars, and said she also wanted to buy a new small electric pot, asking her husband to help search online in the evening.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Dinner and sharing dumplings with neighbors.
description: After the steaming hot dumplings came out of the pot, the whole family sat around and enjoyed them. Ma Xiulan saw that there were quite a few dumplings, so she put a dozen or more on a plate and took them to share with the neighbor across the hall, Wang Guilan (154 Jingwen Road). Wang Guilan took the plate, expressed her thanks, and invited her in to sit down. Ma Xiulan declined and returned because her family was waiting to eat.
location: The dining room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and Wang Guilan's home at No. 154 Jingwen Road.

name: Post-meal housework, homework tutoring, and washing up
description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan had her husband Ma Zhiqiang do the dishes while she bathed her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin. After the bath, she checked the Chinese homework of her second son Ma Mingzhe and urged her eldest son Ma Mingxuan to finish his math test paper. Then she cleaned up the kitchen, mopped the floor, and arranged for the two sons to wash up in turn.
location: Kitchen, living room, and bathroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Organize family expenses and keep records
description: After the children fell asleep, Ma Xiulan took out her ledger and phone in the living room to check the February expenses, recording utilities, grocery money, and children's miscellaneous costs. She noticed that her husband's cigarette spending was 20 yuan more than last month and planned to remind him to smoke less. Finally, in red pen, she wrote "Education savings: 150 yuan" in the March budget, specifically for the children's books and school fees.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Relaxing before bed, couple communication, and going to sleep
description: After keeping the accounts, Ma Xiulan returned to the bedroom and, together with her husband Ma Zhiqiang, looked for a new small electric pot on their phones, and was satisfied with the chosen model. During idle chat, she told her husband that her father's dizziness had improved. Then the two did 4-7-8 breathing exercises together. After relaxing, they turned off the lights and went to bed at 10 p.m.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Getting up and morning exercise
description: Ma Xiulan got up quietly so as not to wake her sleeping husband Ma Zhiqiang. She put on her padded jacket and first sent a WeChat message to the neighbor across the hall, Wang Guilan: "Sister Guilan, I'm up. The usual." Then she washed up, changed into light shoes, and went out to the community garden for a brisk 15-minute walk, moving her shoulders and neck. She ran into Wang Guilan, who was coming back from buying groceries, and the two chatted about daily life. Ma Xiulan suggested that she would write down stretching instructions for Wang Guilan later so they could practice together. After chatting, she walked two more laps and felt comfortable.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and the Jingwen Road Community Garden (near the intersection of Jingwen Road and Shengli Street)

name: Preparing a creative breakfast and taking care of the family's meal.
description: Ma Xiulan went home and entered the kitchen. Using the leftover dough from last night, she rolled it thin, brushed on oil pastry and chopped scallions, rolled it up and cut into sections, and made crispy spiral scallion pancakes. At the same time, she cooked millet porridge, fried four fried eggs, and served them with pickled radish peel drizzled with sesame oil. Then she went upstairs to wake the children, urged them to get dressed and wash up, and patted her husband Ma Zhiqiang awake to eat breakfast. While braiding her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin's hair, she reminded her son Ma Mingzhe to check his schoolbag. The whole family ate in the dining room.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Taking the two children to school.
description: Ma Xiulan went out on her electric tricycle, first taking her son Ma Mingzhe to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street) and watched him enter the school gate. Then she turned around and rode about 10 minutes to take her daughter Ma Yuxin to Huakang First Kindergarten. When she handed her to the teacher, her daughter turned around and gave her a kiss.
location: From No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, to Huakang First Kindergarten

name: Shopping at the vegetable market.
description: After leaving the kindergarten, she rode an electric bike for about five minutes to the Wutong Commune vegetable market. She found Auntie Sun Guifang's stall and, as planned, bought fresh spinach and ground meat filling to make noodles with savory sauce. Auntie Sun threw in an extra handful of cilantro and two scallions. Ma Xiulan also bought a piece of soft tofu, planning to make tofu and egg drop soup for her daughter in the evening.

Then she swept, mopped, and wiped tables, and put away the toys the children had scattered around. In the middle of it, she opened the jar of pickled radish and tasted it; the saltiness was just right. After finishing, she sat in the living room and called her parents. Learning that her father's dizziness had not recurred and his blood pressure was normal, she felt relieved. Her mother told her to rest more.

At the same time, she folded the note she had written titled 'Neck and Shoulder Stretch Instructions' and prepared to bring it to Wang Guilan.

Then she got up, walked two minutes to Wang Guilan's door, and slipped a note explaining the stretching moves into the door crack.

Then she took out ground meat, wood ear mushrooms, daylily flowers, and other ingredients to prepare noodles with gravy for dinner.

After returning home, she had her son do homework while she went into the kitchen to continue preparing noodles with gravy: she stir-fried minced meat until the oil came out, added soaked wood ear mushrooms, daylily buds, and a secret sauce, and simmered a rich gravy; then she blanched spinach and put the noodles in the pot. When they got home, her husband Ma Zhiqiang also returned. Ma Xiulan served steaming bowls of noodles with thick gravy, with spinach on the side, one large bowl for each person. Zhiqiang couldn't praise it enough, and the children ate happily. At the table, she mentioned taking on some handicraft work, and Zhiqiang expressed his support.

Then, while the children watched TV in the living room, she pulled her husband Ma Zhiqiang to the balcony, took out the account book, and calmly pointed out that overspending on cigarettes was affecting the education fund. Zhiqiang felt embarrassed and took the initiative to promise that from tomorrow on he would only take 10 yuan a day, and the money saved would go toward their daughter's college fund. Ma Xiulan smiled and patted him on the shoulder, and they reached an agreement.

Her husband Ma Zhiqiang fixed the loose zipper on her daughter's schoolbag. Her son Ma Mingzhe was building LEGO nearby. The family enjoyed a peaceful evening.

Back in the bedroom, she opened her ledger and recorded the day's expenses: vegetables 28 yuan, transportation 0 yuan, handicraft samples 0 yuan, with a good surplus. Then she lay down side by side with her husband Ma Zhiqiang and guided him through the 4-7-8 breathing technique to relax; after five rounds, their nerves were soothed. Finally, she adjusted her sleeping position, reflected that everything had been handled properly during the day, and fell asleep peacefully with a sense of satisfaction.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

She walked slowly along the flagstone path in the community garden, listening to raindrops tapping on the umbrella and seeing crystal dewdrops on the winter jasmine buds in the flower beds. The air was especially fresh. After walking for 15 minutes, she went home. The bottoms of her trousers were a little damp, but she felt full of energy.

name: Morning stretching and breakfast for the whole family.
description: After returning home, Xiulan did 5 minutes of shoulder, neck, and waist stretches on the living room floor. Then she picked up her phone and sent a WeChat voice message to Sister Wang Guilan, the neighbor across the hall, completing their daily mutual check-in. Next, she nimbly tied on an apron and started making breakfast. She cooked a pot of millet porridge, steamed a few buns, took out a plate of her homemade crispy pickled radish from the pickle jar, and specially fried three eggs. Then she woke her second son Mingzhe and little daughter Yuxin and urged them to wash up. The family of four sat around the dining table and had a simple breakfast with hot porridge and buns. Zhiqiang praised that today's fried eggs were cooked just right. The eldest son, Mingxuan, usually rode his bike to school himself and did not eat breakfast at home because he was in middle school.

On the way, she ran into her neighbor Zhang Shufen, who was also taking her child to school, and the two exchanged a few words through their rain ponchos.

Next, she took out the wool animal samples and embroidered handkerchief she had brought back from Zhou Xiuqin's house yesterday, examined them carefully, studied the stitching, and planned next week's delivery schedule. After a busy spell, she sat down on the sofa to catch her breath, drank a few sips of warm water, and remembered that her mother had said the day before that her father occasionally felt dizzy. She called her mother and learned that her father was in good spirits today and had taken his blood pressure on time. After warning them to be careful on the slippery roads in the rain, she hung up. Then she began preparing lunch for herself and her daughter, stir-frying the leftover chives from yesterday and cooking a bowl of hot noodle soup. While busying herself, she kept glancing out the window, preoccupied with the delivery of the Alipay QR code for collecting payments.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Picked up Yuxin to come home for lunch and coaxed her to take a nap.

Xiulan tiptoed over to the living room window, took out the handkerchief she had half embroidered, and, using the light coming through the window, stitched the petals stitch by stitch, feeling very calm inside. Just as she was absorbed in her needlework, the doorbell rang; it was a courier handing over a thin delivery envelope. Xiulan's heart jumped with joy. She quickly tore it open—it was indeed the physical payment QR code sticker from Alipay. She carefully peeled off the adhesive backing, stuck it neatly on the side of the kitchen cabinet, then took out her phone to scan the code. When she saw the familiar payment page appear, everything was normal. Happily, she took a photo and sent it to her childhood friend Liu Chunmei.
location: Living room and kitchen at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

On the way back, she rode her electric bike into Wutong Commune Vegetable Market and bought a bunch of fresh chives and two jin of pork filling from Aunt Sun Guifang's stall, planning to make dumplings for the whole family tomorrow.

After getting home, she began preparing dinner. Zhiqiang helped serve food to Yuxin, and Xiulan ate while asking Mingzhe what he had learned at school today. The atmosphere was warm.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

Xiulan immediately perked up and agreed enthusiastically, already starting to think that both her pickled vegetables and embroidery could be displayed — it was a good opportunity. After settling her daughter, she returned to the master bedroom and found Zhiqiang already lying down. Like last night, the two turned off the lights, lay side by side, and did several rounds of the 4-7-8 breathing technique, feeling the day's fatigue gradually melt away.

She made a simple note of today's grocery expenses (28 yuan for meat filling and chives), then set tomorrow's alarm. Looking forward to the market, she lay down peacefully and prepared to sleep.

After returning home, she laid out a mat in the living room and seriously did shoulder and neck stretches, then tried standing on one leg with her eyes closed. She nearly wobbled over and couldn't help laughing. After stretching, she picked up her phone and sent a WeChat voice message to Wang Guilan, her neighbor across the hall, reminding her to get some exercise too.

description: She walked about 10 minutes from the kindergarten to the Wutong Commune vegetable market, bought spinach and tender tofu at Sun Guifang's vegetable stall, chatted briefly about the weather, and spent 19.5 yuan. Then she walked to Jingbai Supermarket, bought laundry detergent and toilet paper that was on promotion, spent 37.5 yuan, and carried the things home.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and Jingbai Supermarket, Unit 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Crochet handicrafts, discussing pickled vegetable consignment opportunities, and getting ready to go out
description: At about 14:00, she got home and received a WeChat voice message from her friend Liu Chunmei, saying that a colleague from the supermarket purchasing department was willing to look at the preserved vegetable samples and could sell them on consignment to retail customers, with a weekend meeting arranged. Ma Xiulan excitedly replied and arranged to meet at 15 Square on the weekend, then contacted Zhou Xiuqin to confirm the meeting time. Feeling cheerful, she took out a crochet hook and pink yarn to crochet a little rabbit hair clip for her daughter, humming as she worked. At 14:45, she put away her handiwork, locked the door, and wheeled out her electric bike to pick up her younger son from school.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up second son from school, supervise homework, and check the pickled vegetables.
description: At 15:00, arrived at the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up second son Ma Mingzhe, reminding him to do his homework first when he got home. On the way, Mingzhe shared funny stories from school. After arriving home, she had Mingzhe do his homework while she went to the storage room to check the pickled vegetable jars. She opened the earthen jar; the rich aroma of the sauce filled her nose, and the radish strips were dark brown. She tasted one, found the saltiness just right, then sealed the jar and wiped its rim, nodding with satisfaction.
location: At home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin)

name: Picking up daughter from school and preparing dinner
description: At 15:40 she picked up her daughter Ma Yuxin from Huakang First Kindergarten, and Yuxin hummed a children's song all the way. After returning home, she cut the pork belly into pieces to make braised pork, washed the spinach, cut the tofu into pieces, and took out the hand-rolled noodles she had bought in the morning. The children were doing homework nearby, and Ma Xiulan occasionally corrected her second son's handwriting.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten

name: Dinner, family communication, homework tutoring, and planning the stall.
description: Around 17:00, her husband Ma Zhiqiang came home after finishing his shift, and her eldest son Ma Mingxuan also returned from school. The family sat together for dinner, eating braised pork, spinach with tofu, and other dishes. Ma Xiulan shared the good news about the pickled vegetables that Liu Chunmei had brought. Everyone was happy, and Ma Zhiqiang said he would help move the jars on the weekend. They also discussed the stall layout for the community craft market. After dinner, she cleared the dishes and wiped down the stove, then went to the study to focus on helping Mingxuan with his physics problems. She checked Mingzhe's homework and made him rewrite the sloppy parts, and taught Yuxin pinyin. After the children settled down, she drew a simple stall layout at the coffee table in the living room, marking the pickled vegetable area and the embroidery and crochet area.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family leisure, washing up and putting the kids to bed, and bookkeeping
description: The family was relaxing in the living room. Ma Xiulan continued crocheting little rabbit hair clips, Ma Zhiqiang watched videos on his phone, and the children watched cartoons. Ma Xiulan and Ma Zhiqiang discussed delivering pickled vegetables to Plaza 15 on the weekend. After 20:30, she coaxed her daughter Yuxin to wash up and change into pajamas, told her two stories until she fell asleep, then urged Mingzhe and Mingxuan to take a bath and brush their teeth. After settling everyone down, she took out the account book to record the day's expenses: 19.5 yuan for groceries, 37.5 yuan at the supermarket, and wrote a note: 'Good feedback on the pickled vegetables, plan to meet this weekend.' She sent Liu Chunmei a WeChat message saying goodnight.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening relaxation and sleep
description: Around 22:00, she turned off the lights and went into the bedroom. She weighed herself: 56.0 kg, 0.1 kg lighter than the previous day, and wrote in her journal: “March 6, sunny. New progress on the pickled vegetables, and something to look forward to this weekend. Weight 56.0, keep going!” After that, she did the 4-7-8 breathing exercise with her husband Ma Zhiqiang to relax, checked the doors, windows, and gas, turned off the lights, and fell asleep. The moonlight outside the window was peaceful, and she looked forward to tomorrow with contentment.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Morning wake-up and summary of the first week of morning exercise.
description: Ma Xiulan woke up naturally before the alarm went off. She first stretched her arms and legs in bed, feeling that her neck was much more flexible, and felt pleased that a week of morning exercise had paid off. After getting up, she did a few minutes of stretching under the persimmon tree in the yard, then walked slowly along the community path for about ten minutes. As she walked, she reviewed the progress over the week, from initially heavy legs to easily completing a full lap now, and planned to add chest-expanding exercises next week. After the walk, her whole body felt comfortable and her spirits were high.
location: Home bedroom and courtyard at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare breakfast and eat breakfast with the family
description: Ma Xiulan went into the kitchen. Since her husband Ma Zhiqiang was not on the road that day, she carefully cooked millet porridge, steamed white buns, cut a plate of homemade pickled radish strips and dressed them with sesame oil and vinegar, and reheated the leftover scrambled eggs from last night. While the children were still asleep, she drank a bowl of porridge to warm her stomach. Ma Zhiqiang got up afterward and ate two buns with pickled vegetables, saying he planned to fix the leaking water pipe at home today. Then Ma Xiulan woke up Ma Mingzhe and Ma Yuxin one by one. Yuxin was reluctant to get out of bed, so she put the freshly washed sweater on her youngest daughter to coax her out from under the covers. Mingzhe took a few bites of food and tried to run outside, but his father stopped him and stuffed half a bun into his hand. The eldest son, Mingxuan, rode his bike to Jinghai District No. 2 Middle School by himself. Ma Xiulan saw that he had left porridge in his bowl and gave him a few words of reminder.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Taking the children to school and shopping at the market
description: Ma Xiulan took the two children out. First she walked Ma Mingzhe to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School. On Shengli South Street, she watched him meet his classmates and go through the school gate. Then she took Ma Yuxin's hand and walked a little farther to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, and only felt reassured after handing her directly to the teacher. Afterwards she strolled for about ten minutes to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market and stopped in front of the stall of her acquaintance Sun Guifang. Sun Guifang greeted her warmly and recommended tender chives, saying they were good for making dumplings. Ma Xiulan bought two jin of chives, one jin of fresh shiitake mushrooms, half a jin of black fungus, and a few cucumbers with blossoms and prickles. Sun Guifang took the initiative to round off the odd amount, and the two chatted for a while about Sun Guifang's grandson's schooling.
location: Depart from 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, pass Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street) and Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, and arrive at Wutong Commune Vegetable Market (Diwei Road)

name: Doing housework and video-calling with mother.
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan stored the purchased vegetables by category and soaked the shiitake mushrooms and wood ear mushrooms. Then she sat in the living room and made a video call to her mother Li Xiuying, who lives in Dagang. She first showed the photos of the pickle jars taken yesterday. Her mother looked closely and said the color was about right, and in another two or three days they could open the jars and taste them, reminding her not to open the lids too often to prevent mold. Ma Xiulan also mentioned that her father had been feeling dizzy recently, urged her mother to pay more attention, and planned to take her parents to the community clinic in a few days for a check-up. Her mother agreed and told her not to overwork herself.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Meal preparation and hand-embroidery color matching.
description: Ma Xiulan started preparing the noodle dish with gravy for lunch. In the kitchen, she shredded the black fungus, beat the eggs, soaked the day lily flowers, and kneaded the dough, covering it with a damp cloth to rest. Using this spare time, she took out the new embroidery patterns and colored threads that Zhou Xiuqin had given her a few days earlier, and tried matching colors in the bright light by the window, getting ready for the weekend embroidery work.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Making noodles in gravy for the whole family.
description: Hearing the sounds of the children coming home from school, Ma Xiulan started cooking. She first made a sauce with eggs, wood ear mushrooms, and day lily flowers, then mixed cucumbers with garlic paste. After the noodles were cooked, she rinsed them in cold water, giving them a chewy texture. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang and the three children sat around the dining table. Ma Zhiqiang ate two large bowls in a row and praised that home-cooked food was still the most to his taste.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Midday nap and pickled vegetable observation
description: After tidying up the dishes, Ma Xiulan had her husband watch over the children while they rested, and she went back to the bedroom and lay down. Though her eyes were closed, she was still mentally calculating the progress of the pickled vegetables. After resting for about half an hour, while the family was taking their midday break, she quietly carried out the clay jar from the corner of the yard, picked out a piece of radish with clean chopsticks to inspect it — the color had deepened and the soy aroma was rich, but the core was still a little white and not fully permeated. So she turned the radish pieces in the upper layer to the lower layer, added clean stones to press them down, made sure they were all submerged in the brine, wiped the jar rim clean, and sealed it again. Finally, she took two photos to keep as a record.
location: Bedroom and corner of the yard at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Measuring blood pressure and receiving a health consultation at the community clinic.
description: Ma Xiulan walked about ten minutes to the Chaoyang Street Community Health Service Center in Jinghai District. It happened that Doctor Wang was free in the afternoon, so she measured her blood pressure. The reading was 120 systolic and 75 diastolic, completely normal. Doctor Wang praised her, saying her complexion was much better than the last time they met and that the walking exercise had been quite effective. Ma Xiulan took the opportunity to ask about specific methods for a low-salt diet. Doctor Wang handed her a leaflet and patiently explained that she could use vinegar, scallions, ginger, and garlic to replace part of the soy sauce and MSG, and suggested she use fewer processed seasonings. Ma Xiulan asked for an extra leaflet, planning to bring it to her parents for reference, and intended to bring her father for a check-up soon.
location: Tianjin, Jinghai District, No. 16 Jingwen Road, backyard of Jinghai Grain Bureau, Chaoyang Street Community Health Service Center, Jinghai District

name: Chat with neighbor Wang Guilan.
description: Returning from the clinic, Ma Xiulan met her neighbor across the hallway, Wang Guilan, who was bending over weeding her vegetable garden at the entrance to the home. As soon as Wang Guilan saw her, she praised her for having a rosy and glowing complexion these past few days and asked her secret for staying so healthy and radiant. Ma Xiulan smiled and shared how she had been sticking to her morning exercise routine, and even pulled up photos of pickled vegetables on her phone to show her. Wang Guilan pointed to the crisp, fresh baby bok choy in the garden and said that in two days it would be ready to harvest, and she would definitely pick two stalks for Ma Xiulan to try — even better than what you buy at the market.
location: At Wang Guilan's doorstep, near No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Tend the courtyard, pick up her daughter from school, and prepare dinner
description: After getting home, Ma Xiulan noticed that the soil under the persimmon sapling in the yard was rather dry, so she took a small bucket, filled it with water, and slowly watered it thoroughly. Then she trimmed the dead leaves from several spider plants on the balcony with scissors. After that, she peeled and chopped the scallions, ginger, and garlic needed for the evening stir-fries. At 4:30 p.m., she went to Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up her younger daughter Ma Yuxin, helped her wash her hands, and let the child watch cartoons in the living room for a while. Ma Xiulan then cooked her husband's favorite braised eggplant, stir-fried a plate of garlic spinach, reheated the leftover sauce from lunch, and finally cut a plate of fruit to have as a TV snack in the evening.
location: Home courtyard, balcony, and kitchen at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and Huakang First Kindergarten

name: The whole family had dinner together.
description: At dinner time, the whole family sat around the dining table. Ma Mingzhe and Ma Yuxin were starving and wolfed down their food. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang was in a good mood, sipping a small glass of baijiu, and mentioned that since he wasn't driving these two days, he would take the opportunity to fix the leaking faucet at home. The eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, ate as slowly as ever, flipping through an extracurricular book while eating. Seeing this, Ma Xiulan urged him a couple of times. The family chatted as they ate, with a warm atmosphere.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Clearing the dining table and cleaning the kitchen
description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan asked her husband to take the children to the living room to rest. She quickly cleared the dishes into the kitchen, washed the pots and bowls, and wiped the stove spotless. Looking at the clean kitchen, she felt the day's busy work had not been in vain.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family TV night and embroidery preparation
description: The whole family gathered on the living room sofa to watch TV. Ma Xiulan, while watching the children do their homework, moved the new patterns and the basket of colored thread that Zhou Xiuqin had given her onto the coffee table. By coincidence, Tianjin local news came on, reporting on a handmade pickle shop called 'Jinwei Garden'. An old master was demonstrating his family's secret recipe. Ma Xiulan watched intently. Her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin excitedly shouted, 'Mom, open a shop too!' Ma Mingzhe chimed in teasingly, 'Mom sells radishes!' Ma Zhiqiang smiled and said that opening a shop is not easy; you have to pass the food safety requirements first. Ma Mingxuan didn't respond and kept his head buried in his book. Ma Xiulan kept the name 'Jinwei Garden' in mind, thinking she might go learn from them someday. At the same time, her hands did not stop. While watching TV, she carefully wound several spools of colored thread and sorted them into small cloth bags.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Urge the children to wash up.
description: After the news finished, Ma Xiulan got the children ready for washing up. She bathed Ma Yuxin, changed her into clean pajamas, and coaxed her into bed first; Ma Mingzhe washed his face on his own and was urged to go to sleep; then she knocked on Ma Mingxuan's door, reminding him not to focus only on extracurricular books and to rest early so as not to affect school the next day.
location: Bathroom and washroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Self-reflection and side business planning
description: The house finally quieted down. Her husband had gone to fix the faucet. Ma Xiulan sat alone on the living room sofa and muted the TV. She took out her phone, looked again at the photos of the pickled vegetables she had taken in the afternoon, and searched for information about the “Jinweiyuan” pickle shop she had seen on TV. She calculated in her mind: this first batch of samples should be pickled as soon as possible, and next week she would find time to go to Hualian Supermarket to see her acquaintance Liu Chunmei and ask her to taste them, to see if they could finalize the consignment arrangement. She then picked up the flyer given by Dr. Wang, thinking that when her father came, she would explain the low-salt diet to him properly. She had been busy all day, but felt very fulfilled.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Washing up and going to bed.
description: After a simple wash, Ma Xiulan noticed while applying skincare in the mirror that her complexion was indeed more rosy and radiant than last week. She lay on the bed. Though her body was tired, her heart felt especially at ease. Turning off the light, she heard faint insect chirping outside the window and soon drifted off to sleep, thinking: life goes step by step, steady and solid—that's good.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Getting up in the early morning and taking a walk
description: After getting up in the early morning, I walked briskly alone in the community garden for exercise. Seeing the roses sprouting new buds, I felt happy and relaxed. While stretching, I still felt some soreness in my right shoulder, but it was better than in previous days.
location: Garden inside the residential complex at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Caring for Her Drunk Husband and Preparing Breakfast
description: After exercising, she returned home and began taking care of her husband Ma Zhiqiang, who had woken up drunk, making him honey water and millet porridge. She woke the three children, Xuanxuan, Zhezhe, and Xinxin, and urged them to get up and wash up. She prepared breakfast including millet porridge, meat buns, and boiled eggs. She specially peeled an egg for her husband and reminded him to drink less. Each child behaved differently: Xuanxuan packed his schoolbag on his own, Zhezhe lingered in bed, and Xinxin rubbed her eyes and called for Mom.
location: Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Cleaning the kitchen and doing housework
description: After breakfast, she cleared away the dishes, scrubbed the stove, sorted the children's dirty clothes and put them in the washing machine. She checked the pothos on the balcony, found the leaves turning yellow, and thought about finding time to tend to it. Xuanxuan suggested going to Xinhua Bookstore to buy supplementary study books, and they agreed to go together after lunch.
location: Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Helped neighbor Wang Guilan order an apron online.
description: Neighbor Wang Guilan came by knocking, bringing freshly pulled small radishes. She asked Ma Xiulan to help her buy a plain, stain-resistant apron online. The two of them used their phones to choose a light gray, waterproof, pure cotton apron with a front pocket, priced at 14 yuan. Ma Xiulan placed the order and paid. Wang Guilan insisted on giving her 15 yuan in cash. Unable to talk her out of it, Ma Xiulan accepted it and promised to bring her a sugar-baked pastry later.
location: At Wang Guilan's home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (across the way)

name: Mother called to say that Father is seriously ill
description: While chatting with Wang Guilan, she received a call from her mother Li Xiuying and learned that her father Ma Jianguo had felt dizzy and couldn't stand in the morning, his face deathly pale, and her mother was helping him to the community clinic. Her head began to buzz; she hurried home to grab her bag and medical insurance card, left a note for her husband explaining the situation, told him to take care of the children, and prepared to rush to her parents' home.
location: Home living room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Hurried to my parents' house.
description: She rode her electric bike at full speed to her parents' home, anxious and worried about her father's condition, even running a red light. Along the way, she kept praying that her father would be safe. The trip took about 30 minutes.
location: On the way from 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China to 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District.

name: Accompanying her father to the hospital and arranging hospitalization
description: Rushed to the community clinic, where her father was having his blood pressure measured; the systolic pressure was over 170. The clinic doctor recommended transferring to the district hospital. She immediately hailed a taxi and, with her mother, helped her father into the car and went to Jinghai District Hospital. At the emergency room, the doctor diagnosed high blood pressure and said he needed to be hospitalized for observation. Ma Xiulan forced herself to handle the payment and admission procedures and pick up medicine, while her mother stayed with her father in the ward.
location: From Chaoyang Street Community Health Service Center, No. 16 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China, to the Emergency Department of Jinghai District Hospital on Shengli South Street, Jinghai District

name: Hospital accompaniment and notifying family
description: After her father was hospitalized, he was on an IV, his complexion was a little better, and he could talk but felt dizzy. Ma Xiulan comforted him by his bedside, reassuring him that it was just high blood pressure and he would be fine after two days in the hospital. Her mother wiped tears beside her, and Ma Xiulan consoled her. At noon she bought three boxed lunches in the hospital cafeteria. Her father had no appetite and only drank half a bowl of porridge. In the afternoon, after her father fell asleep, she let her mother rest in the reclining chair while she watched over the IV drip. During this time she called her younger sister Ma Xiufen on her phone to come over, and instructed her husband Ma Zhiqiang not to go out driving that night and to go home to look after the children. She was worried about the children’s lunch.
location: Cardiology Ward, Jinghai District Hospital, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Go home to take care of things, prepare dinner, and check notices
description: After her younger sister Ma Xiufen arrived at the hospital, Ma Xiulan temporarily left to go home and take care of the children. The sun was dazzling on the ride home. When she got home, she found Xuanxuan watching TV with his younger siblings, and her husband had cooked noodles for lunch. She started preparing dinner but was distracted, her mind still on the hospital. She made scrambled eggs with tomatoes and vinegar-sautéed cabbage. When she went to the hallway to get the pickled vegetables, she saw a notice from the neighborhood committee saying that free saplings would be distributed at the community square tomorrow morning to celebrate Arbor Day. She planned to get one and plant it in the yard if her father's condition was stable.
location: Home and hallway at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Family dinner and communication.
description: Her husband Ma Zhiqiang came home, and the family sat down for dinner. Ma Xiulan told him that her father was hospitalized. Her husband said that since his evening routes were short, he could come back early to take over. When the children learned their grandfather was sick, they behaved well. Xinxin put an egg on her mother's plate and said, 'Mom, you've worked so hard.' Ma Xiulan was so moved she almost cried. During the meal, she told Xuanxuan to take good care of the younger siblings tomorrow morning. The family ate in silence, in a warm yet heavy atmosphere.
location: Dining room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Bringing Meals to the Hospital and Evening Care
description: She put warm rice porridge and stir-fried broccoli into an insulated lunch box and rode an electric bike to the hospital. Father was awake and in better spirits. Mother and younger sister were talking with him. She gave the porridge to Mother to feed Father, and younger sister said she would stay overnight, letting Mother and Ma Xiulan go home to rest. Seeing Father able to drink porridge by himself, she felt much more at ease.
location: Cardiology Ward, Jinghai District Hospital, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Returning home, washing up, chores, and thoughts before bed
description: Returning home from the hospital, physically and mentally exhausted. She washed her daughter Xinxin's face and feet and coaxed her to sleep. She urged Xuanxuan and Zhezhe to wash up and checked Xuanxuan's homework. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang told her that he had asked for leave to go to the hospital to see her father the next morning. Afterward, lying in bed with back pain and soreness, she recalled the hospital scene and used her phone to ask her mother about her father's condition. She felt a little relieved only after receiving a steady reply. She remembered that the consignment of pickled vegetables had been postponed and pondered where to plant the saplings the next day. With a dull pain in her right shoulder, listening to her husband's snoring, she gradually fell asleep amid worry and exhaustion.
location: Bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Waking up in the early morning, preparing breakfast and meal delivery items
description: Woken in the early morning by a sore right shoulder, she was worried about her father in the hospital. After a quick wash, she did stretching exercises in the courtyard to relieve the stiffness in her shoulder. Then she put on an apron and went into the kitchen, slowly simmering the soaked millet porridge. She took out the pickled mustard greens, shredded them finely, drizzled sesame oil over them, and arranged them on a plate as a side dish for her father. Since the children did not need to get up early on the weekend, she left bread and milk for them.
location: China, Tianjin, Jinghai District, No. 156 Jingwen Road (home kitchen and bathroom).

name: Riding an electric bike to the hospital to bring breakfast to her father and stay with him.
description: She put the cooked millet porridge into a thermal container, packed the pickled vegetable shreds and a spoon, checked her father's medical insurance card, and rode her electric bike along Jingwen Road, turned onto Shengli South Street, and headed to Jinghai District Hospital. After arriving, she took the elevator to the cardiovascular medicine ward on the fifth floor. Seeing that her father's spirits had improved, she asked about his condition, helped him sit up, blew on the warm millet porridge, and fed him patiently. Her father praised the porridge for being well-cooked and the pickled vegetables for being refreshing.
location: China, Tianjin, Jinghai District, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District Hospital, Inpatient Building, 5th Floor, Cardiology Ward

name: Shift handover with sister, hospital exercise, and returning home to prepare to pick up saplings
description: Her younger sister Ma Xiufen arrived with breakfast. Outside the ward, they discussed their father's condition: his blood pressure had been stable overnight and he had gotten up once during the night. Ma Xiulan also reminded her sister about the precautions for the day's IV infusion. After going downstairs, she walked briskly for two laps on the path in the hospital's rear garden, about ten minutes, stretching her shoulders and breathing fresh air. Then she rode her electric bicycle home, found her own and her husband's ID cards, and put them in her pocket to prepare for collecting the saplings. Seeing that the children were awake and watching TV in the living room, she briefly told them about the sapling collection.
location: The back garden of Jinghai District Hospital on Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China, and the way home

name: Queuing up at the community plaza to pick up persimmon tree saplings
description: Walked to the square in front of the Sunshine Garden Community Residents' Committee. A line of more than ten people had already formed, and after chatting with the neighbors in front and behind, I joined the queue. Using my own and my husband's ID cards to register, I received a persimmon sapling about 1.5 meters tall with a soil clump around its roots. The staff also gave me a planting tip sheet. Then I walked home carefully supporting the sapling.
location: The square in front of the community neighborhood committee office in Sunshine Garden Residential Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Exchanging with neighbors, planning the planting, and planting a persimmon tree as a family.
description: At the door of her house, she met her neighbor Zhang Shufen, who had come back from buying groceries. The neighbor praised the sapling for being strong, and after chatting for a few minutes, she went inside. With her husband Ma Zhiqiang, she chose a sunny planting spot in the southeast corner of the yard. Her husband dug the hole, Ma Xiulan cleared the broken stones at the bottom, and their second son Ma Mingzhe excitedly held the sapling straight. After the family worked together to mound soil and stamp it firm, her husband brought water and watered it thoroughly. Finally, they used wooden sticks and hemp rope to set up a windbreak support, and Ma Xiulan personally hung a waterproof wooden tag reading "Planted on March 9, 2025," symbolizing the tree of hope.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (home courtyard)

name: Organized tools, prepared lunch, and packed lunch for her father.
description: After planting the tree, she rinsed the spade and shovel and put them back in the tool room, then swept the dirt in the yard. She then went into the kitchen and made scallion egg stir-fried steamed buns and tomato egg drop soup using steamed buns, eggs, tomatoes, and scallions as lunch for the whole family. Before the meal, she reminded the children to do their homework in the afternoon and fed her daughter Ma Yuxin. After the meal, she packed the stir-fry and reheated steamed buns, and also boiled a bowl of longxu noodles and put it in an insulated container as lunch for her father.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (home kitchen and dining room)

name: Delivered lunch by electric bike, shared the joy of planting trees, then returned home to rest.
description: She rode her electric bike to the hospital again. Her father had already eaten the lunch her younger sister had brought, but he was still happy to eat half a bowl of the dragon beard noodles she had brought. Sitting by the bed, she told her father about the earnest scene of planting the persimmon tree and her son holding the tree steady. Her father rarely showed a smile. After staying with him for a while, she rode home. Feeling tired, she moved a chair in the courtyard to sunbathe and rest for half an hour. Seeing that the newly planted sapling was stable, she felt a little relieved.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (home courtyard)

name: Catching up on housework in the afternoon
description: She got up to take care of the afternoon chores: sorted the dirty clothes and put them into the washing machine; went to the three children's rooms to find the school uniforms and red scarves needed for Monday, checked them for damage, and pressed them with a garment steamer; and gathered the toys and shoes scattered around the yard and put them into storage bins.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (home living room, children's room, courtyard)

name: Video call with elder sister in Beijing
description: Sitting on the living room sofa, I called my eldest sister Li Xiuyun, who is far away in Beijing, to let her know that Dad's condition had stabilized and set her mind at ease. Then I held up the phone in the yard to show the newly planted persimmon tree. My sister laughed and said she also wanted to taste the persimmons from the tree in autumn, and the two agreed to contact each other again next week.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (home living room and courtyard)

name: Prepare dinner, deliver it on foot, and accompany father in the evening
description: After ending the call, she began preparing dinner, using a meat grinder to mince the meat for making zhajiang noodles for the children. At the same time, she cooked millet porridge, stir-fried eggs with spinach, and made a cucumber salad, packing them as dinner for her father. She walked to the hospital and brought the meal to her father's bedside. Her father was in better spirits and could eat slowly by himself. Ma Xiulan stayed with him and peeled a banana for him. Family members of other patients in the room praised her filial devotion. Her father was moved and urged her to go home and take care of the children.
location: China, Tianjin, Jinghai District, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District Hospital, Inpatient Building, 5th Floor, Cardiology Ward

name: Supermarket shopping, family dinner, and homework tutoring preparation
description: After leaving the hospital, she stopped by Jingbai Supermarket on the way to buy three cartons of plain milk and a small bag of baking soda (to clean the range hood the next day). When she walked home, her husband Ma Zhiqiang and the children had already started eating zhajiang noodles. Ma Xiulan served herself a bowl, ate, and then cleaned up the kitchen. Afterwards, she urged the three children to get ready to do their homework at the dining table.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China, and Jingbai Supermarket, Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu

name: Checking homework and family tutoring
description: Checked eldest son Ma Mingxuan's math weekly journal and pointed out calculation errors; helped second son Ma Mingzhe with English dictation; read picture books with daughter Ma Yuxin. Husband Ma Zhiqiang was responsible for clearing the dishes, sweeping the floor, and looking after the youngest daughter. They divided the work and completed the evening tutoring together.
location: China, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (dining room and living room at home).

name: Leisure, socializing, and handicraft time
description: The children go off to wash up one after another. Ma Xiulan sits down, takes out the half-embroidered floral pillowcase and continues embroidering, while sending voice messages to her friend Aunt Wu to share tree-planting photos and ask about her embroidery progress. She also chats with Sister Wang Guilan and learns that she plans to go pick up saplings tomorrow too. She enjoys a moment of quiet handcraft and social time.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (home living room)

name: Urge the children to wash up, get ready for bed, and soak their feet before sleeping.
description: She urged her daughter Ma Yuxin to finish her bath, then helped her blow-dry her hair and told her stories to lull her to sleep. She watched her second son Ma Mingzhe brush his teeth by himself and checked whether he had folded the clothes he would wear the next day. Afterward, she went to the kitchen to prepare the rice and water for the next morning's porridge. The busy day came to an end. While soaking her feet in hot water, she browsed community group messages and mentally reviewed tomorrow's plan: take the children to school, go to the hospital, and buy ribs for stew. She got up, took another look at the small tree in the moonlight, silently prayed for her father's recovery, turned off the light, and went to bed.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (home bathroom, bedroom, and kitchen)

name: Morning preparations and breakfast
description: It was still dark when Ma Xiulan got up and went into the kitchen, thinking of her father in the hospital. She rinsed the millet and put it in a pot, simmering a pot of thick millet porridge over low heat, and steamed a tray of tender egg custard — her father Ma Jianguo's favorite. She carefully packed the porridge and custard into an insulated food jar and cut a plate of homemade crisp soy-marinated cucumbers. Then she prepared breakfast for the three children: hot milk, toast, and fried eggs, making sure the children ate nutritiously.
location: Home kitchen at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Took the child to school and entrusted a neighbor with help
description: At 6:15, Ma Xiulan woke the three children. The eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, who is in the second year of middle school, quickly washed up, ate breakfast, and rode his bike alone to Jinghai District No. 7 Middle School. The second son, Ma Mingzhe, was a bit slow, so Ma Xiulan hurried him to pack his schoolbag, then rode her electric bike to take him to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School and watched him enter the school gate before leaving. She turned around, went home, picked up her youngest daughter, Ma Yuxin, and rode to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten. At the kindergarten gate, she ran into her neighbor Wang Guilan and quickly asked Sister Wang to help pick up Xinxin at 4 p.m. Wang Guilan readily agreed, letting her take care of her father with peace of mind.
location: From home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten.

name: Commute to the hospital
description: After settling Xinxin in, Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike straight along Shengli Street toward Jinghai District Hospital. The cool morning breeze on her face refreshed her considerably. Upon arriving at the hospital, she parked in the designated bike shed, locked it, took a deep breath, and walked briskly toward the inpatient building.
location: Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin (section from Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to Jinghai District Hospital)

name: All-day hospital companionship, learning massage, and midday rest.
description: Ma Xiulan gently pushed open the ward door. Seeing her mother, Li Xiuying, dozing by her father's bedside, she asked her to go home and rest. She first helped her father wash up, supported him into a sitting position, and fed him the millet porridge, egg cake, and pickled cucumbers she had brought. Her father had a good appetite and ate most of a bowl. At 8:00, the nurse measured his blood pressure. Ma Xiulan quickly took out her notebook and recorded: systolic 142, diastolic 88. Then the doctor made rounds and said her father was stable, which put her somewhat at ease. To prevent blood clots, she took the initiative to ask the charge nurse about leg massage techniques. She carefully watched the nurse demonstrate on her father's right leg, in five steps from the ankle to the upper thigh, repeating each movement 10 times. She mimicked the movements on her own leg, asked questions repeatedly, and finally, under the nurse's guidance, massaged her father herself until her technique was correct. At noon, her father became drowsy after taking his medicine. She helped him lie down and went to the ninth-floor staff cafeteria to eat, ordering stir-fried zucchini, scrambled eggs with tomatoes, and a bowl of rice. After the meal, she filled hot water for both of them and returned to the ward. In the afternoon, her father woke up. She helped him sit up, propped up the pillow, continued massaging his legs, and chatted with him at the same time. A little after 2 p.m., his blood pressure was measured again, and the readings were stable. At 3 p.m., her younger sister Ma Xiufen called, saying she could come to take over the shift tomorrow morning. Ma Xiulan reminded her younger sister not to forget to bring the blood pressure record book and the Guifaxiang fried dough twists her father had been asking about.
location: Eighth-floor wards and ninth-floor staff cafeteria of the inpatient department, Jinghai District Hospital, No. 14 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Community shopping on the way back
description: Seeing that her father was in stable condition and under the nurse's care, Ma Xiulan left the hospital on her electric bike at 3:30, first stopping by the Wutong Commune vegetable market. At the stall of Aunt Sun Guifang, whom she knew well, she bought tender greens, red bell peppers, scallions, and eggs. Aunt Sun asked about her father's condition; she briefly explained, and Aunt Sun grabbed an extra handful of cilantro and pressed it into her hands, telling her to take care of herself.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Husband and wife prepare dinner together
description: Ma Xiulan came home carrying groceries and found her husband Ma Zhiqiang had specially taken leave and come back early. He was wearing an apron and preparing a big carp, saying he wanted to make soup for her father. Her heart warmed, but she playfully scolded him for being careless, then put on an apron to help, quickly picking and washing vegetables. The two chatted about her father's condition while busy in the kitchen. They simmered a milky white crucian carp soup and also made scrambled eggs with tomatoes and stir-fried choy sum. The courtyard soon filled with aroma.
location: Home kitchen at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: A warm dinner for the family of five
description: When the food was served, the neighbor Wang Guilan brought their youngest daughter Xinxin back. The family of five sat around the table.
