Ma Xiulan asked her eldest son Xuanxuan about his chemistry quiz and reminded her second son Zhezhe to eat more vegetables, while her husband kept putting fish on Xinxin's plate. The couple agreed that after the meal Zhiqiang would take the crucian carp soup and food to the hospital, and she would stay home to watch the children do their homework. After dinner, Zhiqiang, in a rare move, sat down next to Zhezhe, and the father and son put their heads together over math word problems.
location: Home restaurant, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening family matters, multiple contacts, and bedtime.
description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan cleared the table and washed the dishes, then packed the reserved food into an insulated lunch box and asked her husband Ma Zhiqiang to deliver it to the hospital by bike. After that, she checked the three children's homework and urged them to wash up. At 7:30 p.m., she called her mother, Li Xiuying, to say that her father's condition was stable that day. At 8:00, she called her younger sister, Ma Xiufen, and again told her to bring the blood pressure record book and fried dough twists the next day. At 8:30, she hurried her second son and youngest daughter to take their baths, and packed clean towels, a change of clothes, and blood pressure medicine for the next day's trip to the hospital into a canvas bag. At 9:00, she bathed as well, deliberately soaking her feet in hot water while scrolling through her phone and giving a thumbs-up to Sister Zhou Xiuqin in the crafts group. At 9:30, her husband came back from delivering the meal and said that her father had drunk half a bowl of fish soup, was in good spirits, and even asked about the persimmon seedlings. She copied the day's blood pressure readings into the record book and wrote “Bring Dad two red bean buns tomorrow morning” in her memo. At 10:00, she urged Zhe Zhe to go to bed. At 10:30, after checking the children's schoolbags, she lay down at ease, listening to her husband's soft snoring and the rustling of the persimmon seedlings in the yard, ending a full and warm day.
location: Own residence, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Early morning meal prep and morning routine.
description: At 5:30 in the morning, Ma Xiulan got out of bed quietly, afraid of waking the children. She went to the kitchen to boil water and prepared breakfast and the children's lunch. Today she steamed a pot of white-flour steamed buns, made millet porridge, boiled six eggs, and sliced pickled cucumbers. Meanwhile, she was worried about her hospitalized father and thought about her younger sister Xiufen bringing him fried dough twists.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Wake up the children and help them with breakfast
description: At 6:10, Ma Xiulan woke up the three children: the eldest, Mingxuan, went to wash up by himself; the second, Zhezhe, was still groggy; and the third, Xinxin, wanted a hug. She helped Xinxin get dressed and urged Zhezhe to brush his teeth and wash his face. After the whole family finished breakfast, Ma Xiulan handed Mingxuan and Zhezhe lunch boxes containing steamed buns, eggs, and pickled cucumbers, reminding them not to forget them.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Taking the children to school
description: At 6:40, Ma Xiulan brought out the electric bike, with Zhe Zhe on the back seat and Xin Xin on the front seat. She first went to the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School and watched Zhe Zhe run into the school. Then she turned and rode five minutes to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, where she handed Xin Xin to Teacher Li. The eldest, Mingxuan, rode his bike to middle school on his own.
location: Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School and Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten on Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Buy breakfast and keep company at the hospital in the early morning.
description: After dropping off the children, Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike along Shengli Street to the hospital. Passing the breakfast stall at the hospital entrance, she bought buns and soy milk for herself and a serving of tofu pudding for her father, packed in an insulated bag. She arrived at the cardiovascular medicine ward of the inpatient building at Jinghai District Hospital at 7:30. Her father was already awake; she helped him wash his face and hands and fed him the tofu pudding. Then she opened her phone. Her elder sister, Li Xiuyun, called via video from Beijing. Seeing that their father was in stable condition, the three discussed the duty schedule: during the day she and Xiufen would take turns, their mother would bring dinner in the evening, and the eldest sister would come back on the weekend to take over.
location: Cardiovascular Medicine Ward, Inpatient Department, Jinghai District Hospital, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Hand over the shift with my younger sister.
description: At exactly 8:00, her younger sister Ma Xiufen arrived at the ward on time, carrying Guifaxiang fried dough twists and a blood pressure record notebook. Ma Xiulan explained the precautions to her in detail outside the ward: Dad takes his medicine at 8:30, with the dosage written on the medicine box; at 1 p.m. he needs an electrocardiogram and must be helped while walking; she also demonstrated the leg massage technique. Xiufen nodded repeatedly and told her sister to go home and rest with peace of mind.
location: Cardiovascular Medicine Ward, Inpatient Department, Jinghai District Hospital, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Relaxing in the hospital corridor and returning home
description: After the handover, Ma Xiulan slowly paced back and forth in the hospital corridor for ten minutes to stretch her stiff legs and feet. Feeling that the swelling in her ankles had gone down a bit, and with a gentle breeze on her face, she relaxed. Then she rode her electric bike along Shengli Street back to her home on Jingwen Road.
location: On the way from Jinghai District Hospital on Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin to No. 156 Jingwen Road

name: Time spent shopping at the vegetable market and doing housework
description: Ma Xiulan stopped by the Wutong Commune Vegetable Market on the way and bought fresh celery, black fungus, tomatoes, and tender tofu at Aunt Sun Guifang's stall. When Aunt Sun learned that she was cooking according to a low-salt diet, she advised her not to stir-fry the celery too much and to add more black fungus. It was almost 10 when she got home. She put the clothes she had changed out of into the washing machine, watered the small persimmon sapling in the yard, and felt full of hope when she saw the newly grown tender leaves.

participant.name: Sun Guifang
participant.relation: An acquaintance who runs a stall at the vegetable market

location: Wutong Commune Food Market in Jinghai District, Tianjin, and home at 156 Jingwen Road

name: Learning low-salt recipes and meal preparation
description: After finishing housework, Ma Xiulan took out her phone in the kitchen to search for low-salt recipes for high blood pressure. She carefully wrote down the low-oil, low-salt methods for cold mixed wood ear salad, stir-fried celery with meat, and stir-fried spinach, and used an electronic scale to weigh the grams of oil and salt. She also asked Dr. Wang at the community hospital via WeChat whether these dishes were suitable. Dr. Wang replied that they were good and reminded her to use less soy sauce. Looking at the pickle jar, she decided to use half as much salt the next time she made pickled vegetables.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Lunch alone and contacting the hospital
description: At lunchtime, Ma Xiulan simply ate the leftover millet porridge and half a steamed bun from the morning, with pickled cucumbers. During the meal, she called her younger sister Xiufen to ask about their father's condition that morning. Learning that his blood pressure was normal, he had eaten half a bowl of porridge, and was watching TV, she felt relieved and told Xiufen to buy something tasty at the hospital cafeteria.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Rest and recharge during the lunch break.
description: After several consecutive busy days, Ma Xiulan felt physically exhausted. She set an alarm, lay in bed for forty minutes, and slept soundly, recharging her energy to handle the afternoon's matters.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Video call with my eldest sister to discuss the follow-up arrangements.
description: After waking from her midday rest, Ma Xiulan proactively made a video call to her eldest sister, Li Xiuyun, telling her that their father was in good condition that morning, wanted to eat pickles, and had normal ECG results, and she also showed her the fried dough twists Xiufen had brought. The three sisters once again clarified their division of labor: during the day Ma Xiulan and Ma Xiufen take turns accompanying him, their mother brings dinner in the evening, and the eldest sister comes back on weekends to relieve them, so everyone can catch their breath.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Going to the hospital again to accompany my father for his check-up and keep him company.
description: After hanging up the phone, Ma Xiulan was still a little worried and decided to make another trip to the hospital in the afternoon. She rode her electric bike to Jinghai District Hospital and, together with her younger sister Xiufen, accompanied her father to the examination room on the second floor for an electrocardiogram. She supported her father with one hand and held his coat in the other, while her sister followed behind. While waiting, her father again muttered that the jar of pickled vegetables had been opened and asked her to bring some with less salt to satisfy his craving. The test result came back normal, and both she and her sister breathed a sigh of relief.
location: ECG Room, Inpatient Department, Jinghai District Hospital, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare for the return trip and pick up the children from school
description: After leaving the hospital, Ma Xiulan rode back to the home on Jingwen Road. She got home close to 3:30 p.m. and quickly soaked black fungus in warm water, washed and cut the celery and spinach, and packed them separately to prepare for a low-salt dinner. At 4 o'clock, she rode her electric bike first to Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up her daughter Xinxin, then went along Shengli Avenue to the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to wait for Zhezhe, telling the two children to stand still and not run around. Just after 5 o'clock, the three of them returned home, and she had Zhezhe take his sister to do homework in the living room.
location: Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten in Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School on Shengli South Street; and home at 156 Jingwen Road

name: Practice a low-salt dinner
description: Ma Xiulan showed off her skills in the kitchen. First she blanched the soaked wood ear mushrooms and dressed them with a little light soy sauce, black vinegar, and minced garlic to make cold dressed wood ear mushrooms. Then she heated the wok, added cold oil, and stir-fried shredded pork with celery and garlic spinach over low heat using half the usual amount of oil, strictly controlling oil and salt in every dish. After tasting, the flavor was light but preserved the natural sweetness of the vegetables. She was quite satisfied with her beginner cooking results.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The whole family had a low-salt dinner together.
description: At 6:20, the eldest son Mingxuan rode his bike home, and shortly after, her husband Ma Zhiqiang also returned. The whole family sat around the table. Ma Xiulan specifically explained that for Grandpa's health, the family would eat lighter from now on. The children tasted the dishes and, though they found them mild, said they understood.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Housework, homework tutoring, and neighborly interactions
description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan cleared the dishes and chopsticks, checked the children's homework, and corrected a few typos. Then she took a bowl of black fungus salad and brought it to Sister Wang Guilan's home across the hall, thanking her for helping pick up the children yesterday. Sister Wang happily accepted it and praised her cooking.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and neighbor Wang Guilan's home

name: Evening rest and communication
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan sat on the sofa to catch her breath, turned on the TV, and casually watched the news. At 8:30, she sent a WeChat message to her younger sister Xiufen to ask about their father's condition. Learning that he was fine and already asleep, she was completely relieved.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Putting the children to bed and personal bedtime preparation
description: At 9:00, Ma Xiulan urged the two younger children to wash up and brush their teeth, watched them get into bed, tucked in the quilt corners, turned off the lights, and soothed them to sleep. The eldest, Mingxuan, was reading by himself, so she didn't need to worry about him. After the children were all asleep, she boiled water to soak her feet. While soaking, she massaged her calves and felt the day's fatigue melt away. Then she lay down, thought back over her busy but fulfilling day, and quickly fell into a deep sleep.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Got up early to prepare breakfast and a low-salt soup base
description: At 5:30 in the morning, Ma Xiulan got up early to prepare breakfast for her family. She specially simmered a pot of low-salt white radish and kelp soup base, using fresh white radish and kelp slowly cooked over low heat, without soy sauce, planning to give her hospitalized father a change of taste at noon. She also prepared millet porridge, steamed rice, and other home-style breakfast foods, and closed the kitchen window to keep out the cold.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Wake up the whole family and arrange morning tasks
description: At 6:10, Ma Xiulan woke up the children: the eldest son Mingxuan, the second son Mingzhe, and the youngest daughter Yuxin, and urged her husband Ma Zhiqiang to get up for breakfast. She arranged for Mingzhe to water the persimmon saplings, helped Yuxin put on her little patterned padded jacket, and told Zhiqiang to put on more clothes. Then she served rice to the children and took care of them as they finished breakfast. Mingzhe ate quickly and even brought an apple, Mingxuan took his time, and Yuxin needed to be fed.
location: Various rooms of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Took the child to school and bought groceries
description: At 7:20, Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to take the children to school. She first took Yuxin to Huakang First Kindergarten, kissed her daughter at the gate, and told her to be good; then she took Mingzhe to Jinghai District Third Primary School and watched him run through the school gate. Afterward, she turned to Wutong Commune Market, bought spinach, tofu, and fresh shiitake mushrooms from Aunt Sun Guifang's stall, and also bought half a jin of shrimp, planning to make steamed eggs with shrimp in the evening. After shopping, she rode home.
location: Along the route: Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District Third Primary School, and Wutong Community Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Brief return home and blood pressure recording
description: At 8:10, Ma Xiulan returned home. She first sorted the vegetables, then took out her wrist blood pressure monitor and measured her blood pressure by following the steps in her phone notes. The result was 116/76, and she felt relieved. Then she put the blood pressure monitor, journal, and insulated lunch box (containing white radish and kelp soup base and noodles) into her canvas bag, preparing to go to the hospital.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Mood on the way to the hospital
description: At 8:25, Ma Xiulan braved the north wind and rode her electric bike to Jinghai District Hospital. The ride was cold, but the thought that her father would be moved out of the observation room today warmed her heart. Seeing the care everyone showed in the sisters' WeChat group, she felt that with the sisters united, there was hope in life.
location: On the way from 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to Jinghai District Hospital on Shengli South Street

name: Assisted father with the ward transfer and learned to use a blood pressure monitor
description: At 8:45, Ma Xiulan arrived at the hospital. She first went to the nurse station to ask about transferring wards. Nurse Xiao Zhou said they would need to wait for the doctor’s rounds. She went into the observation room, wiped her father Ma Jianguo’s face, and gave him warm water to drink. After the doctor’s rounds at 9:30, her father could be moved to a regular ward. Ma Xiulan helped the nurse transfer her father to Bed 15 in Ward 601. Then the nurse taught her again how to use the wrist blood pressure monitor. She recorded it in her notebook and took her father’s blood pressure herself; the result was 130/85, and the nurse said it was stable. She comforted her father, telling him he could go home in another week.
location: Room 601, 6th Floor, Inpatient Department, Jinghai District Hospital, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Hospital lunch and accompanying her father to relax
description: At 11:10, her younger sister Xiufen was about to take over the shift. Ma Xiulan first went to the hospital cafeteria and prepared a bowl of low-salt noodle soup using the broth and noodles she had brought, plus two boiled eggs. She brought it back to the ward and fed most of it to her father. She herself simply ate a vegetarian steamed bun. After the meal, the weather was fine, so she pushed her father in a wheelchair to the small garden downstairs for ten minutes to let him get some fresh air.
location: The inpatient department of Jinghai District Hospital, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and the small garden downstairs.

name: Handed over the shift to her younger sister and reminded her of the details
description: At 12:20, her younger sister Ma Xiufen arrived carrying fruit. Ma Xiulan pulled her aside, handed over the blood pressure monitor and the record book, taught her how to use them step by step, and stressed the importance of a low-salt diet, drinking more water, and regular measurements, especially not giving their father pickled vegetables or fermented bean curd. Xiufen noted it carefully and told her to rest assured and go back to rest.
location: Sixth Floor, Inpatient Department, Jinghai District Hospital, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Return home and shop along the way
description: At 12:40, Ma Xiulan left the hospital and rode her electric bike home. Passing Jingbai Supermarket, she went in and bought a pack of xylitol cookies and some small cookies for her daughter. She arrived home around 1:00 p.m., parked the bike, and felt that the big task of the day had been accomplished.
location: Jinghai District, Tianjin: on the way back from Jinghai District Hospital to home at 156 Jingwen Road, and stopped at Jingbai Supermarket, Unit 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu

name: Afternoon rest and improving the low-salt menu
description: From 1:00 to 2:30 pm, Ma Xiulan first drank water and rested, then looked through the low-salt menu draft on her phone and searched online for new recipes. She refined the menu in her journal into three sections: breakfast, lunch, and dinner, and wrote down in detail how to make the white radish and kelp soup base. Afterward, she took a photo of the menu and sent it to her mother, with a voice message reminding her to also follow a low-salt diet.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Handle handicraft piecework and maintain neighborhood contacts
description: From 2:30 to 3:30 in the afternoon, Ma Xiulan started embroidering shoe insoles, hurrying to make handicrafts. During a break, she remembered that her neighbor Wang Guilan had knee discomfort, so she found the homemade mugwort sachet and planned to take it over in the evening. Then she received a call from Zhou Xiuqin, a friend from the handicraft group. The two exchanged new embroidery stitches and agreed to meet next week to see each other's works.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Picking up the children from school and sharing the good news
description: At 3:20, Ma Xiulan went out to pick up the children from school. She first went to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up Yuxin and listened to her talk about drawing a big tree; then she went to No. 3 Primary School to pick up Mingzhe. On the way, she told the two children the good news that Grandpa had been moved to a regular ward today. Mingzhe jumped up happily and said he wanted Grandpa to see the persimmon tree, and Yuxin was also thinking about the drawing she had made for Grandpa. The family walked home together amid laughter.
location: Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, and the route home, in Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Preparing a low-salt dinner and guiding her daughter in drawing
description: After arriving home at 4:45, Ma Xiulan had Mingzhe do homework and water the persimmon tree, while she put on an apron and prepared a low-salt dinner: stir-fried spinach, mushroom tofu, steamed egg with shrimp, steamed buns, and also boiled noodle soup. Yuxin spread paper on the living room coffee table and drew a get-well card. Ma Xiulan, while stir-frying, guided her from across the room, asking her to draw the sun and a family holding hands. Yuxin carefully drew a bright red sun and five little figures holding hands, and wrote in crooked characters: Wish Grandpa good health.
location: Kitchen and dining room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Family dinner and discussing the medical condition.
description: At 6:30 in the evening, her husband Ma Zhiqiang came back from a driving job, and her eldest son Ma Mingxuan came home from school. The family sat around the table for dinner. The dishes were light but colorful, and the children ate eagerly. Ma Xiulan recounted in detail how her father had been moved to a different ward, how she had learned to use the blood pressure monitor, and the doctor's expectation that he would be discharged in about a week, putting the whole family at ease. She proposed that the family should eat a low-salt, low-oil diet from now on, which would be better for her husband's health too. Yuxin showed everyone her drawing as if presenting a treasure, which made the whole family laugh. Ma Xiulan reminded Mingzhe not to forget to water the plants after dinner.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Cleaning up the kitchen and checking the children's homework
description: At 7:30, Ma Xiulan washed the dishes and tidied the kitchen. Then she checked on Mingxuan doing geometry homework and did not disturb him; she checked Mingzhe's homework, found the handwriting messy, made him erase it and rewrite it; helped Yuxin put away the building blocks and get ready for a bath.
location: Kitchen and other rooms at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Neighbor visits and evening relaxation
description: At 8:30, Ma Xiulan first urged Yuxin to take a bath and Mingzhe to brush his teeth. After seeing that both were lying down, she pocketed a mugwort sachet and went across to Wang Guilan's home. She gave her the sachet and suggested using a hot water bottle on her knees to relieve the pain. Sister Wang happily pulled her into a chat, and Ma Xiulan shared the low-salt soup base method she had learned that day. After sitting for half an hour, she went home, saw that Mingxuan was still reading, and told him to go to bed early.
location: At home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and Wang Guilan's home at 154 across the street.

name: Soaking feet to relieve fatigue and recording life.
description: At 9:30, Ma Xiulan fetched hot water to soak her feet, feeling the day's fatigue melt away. She picked up her journal to record today's expenses (tofu 3 yuan, spinach 2 yuan, etc.), organized the nursing tips she had learned at the hospital, and crossed off today's date on the calendar, looking forward to her father coming home in a week. At 10:00, after soaking her feet, she charged her phone, turned off the light, and lay down. Listening to the dogs barking outside the window, she felt life was solid, and at 10:30 she fell into a deep sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Morning wake-up preparation, breakfast, and getting ready for school
description: Woke up at 6 a.m., washed up, and prepared breakfast in the kitchen: sliced pickled cucumbers, cooked millet porridge, steamed buns, and boiled eggs. Meanwhile, she took the soaked clothes out to hang dry. Then she woke the three children, helped the youngest daughter braid her hair, urged them to eat breakfast, packed lunch boxes with cookies for the second son and the youngest daughter, and reminded the eldest son to ride his bike carefully.
location: Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Take the children to school and buy groceries along the way.
description: She rode her electric bike to first take her second son to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, reminding him to drink water, then took her younger daughter to Huakang First Kindergarten, handed her to the teacher, and watched her enter the classroom. Afterward, she went to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market and bought spinach, tofu, and lean meat at Sun Guifang's stall, chatting with her about her father's illness.
location: Jinghai District, Tianjin, China: departing from 156 Jingwen Road, proceeding in turn to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (56 Shengli South Street), Huakang First Kindergarten (10 Huakang Road), and Wutong Commune Vegetable Market (east side of Wutong Commune).

name: Returning home to organize ingredients, receive the package, and check the blood pressure monitor.
description: After returning home, she washed the spinach and drained it, soaked the tofu in water, cut the lean meat into pieces, and packed them in fresh-keeping boxes to take to the hospital. She received the express delivery of the wrist blood pressure monitor sent by her elder sister from Beijing, opened it, checked its functions according to the manual, and confirmed it was simple and easy to use. Then she shook out the clothes from the washing machine and hung them on the clothesline in the yard.
location: Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Rode the electric scooter to the hospital to take over from her younger sister.
description: She brought low-salt ingredients and a blood pressure monitor and rode her electric bike to Jinghai District Hospital. Arriving at Ward 601 on the 6th floor of the inpatient building, she did the shift handover with her younger sister Ma Xiufen, learned that their father's blood pressure had been stable during the night shift, and handed her the breakfast she had brought.
location: 6th Floor, Inpatient Department, Jinghai District Hospital (No. 45 Shengli South Street), Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Hospital accompaniment, rehabilitation encouragement, and blood pressure measurement.
description: After my younger sister left, I helped my father Ma Jianguo walk two slow laps in the corridor for rehabilitation, encouraging him to keep going. Back in the ward, I measured his blood pressure with the new monitor (128/82), recorded it in the book, and chatted with him about family matters such as my younger daughter's kindergarten drawings.
location: Wards and corridor on the 6th floor of the inpatient department, Jinghai District Hospital (No. 45 Shengli South Street), Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: For vertical addition carrying, you can make up a mnemonic: "When the sum reaches ten, carry one; align the place values." Use colored pens to mark the carry points. For English words, I recommend using the Baicizhan or Momo Beidanci app, with picture-association memory, for a fixed 10 minutes every day.
description: In the inpatient department's food preparation room, she cooked low-salt noodles for her father with ingredients she brought: soft noodles boiled in plain water, added spinach and lean pork slices, seasoned with just a few drops of light soy sauce. She brought it to the bedside, watched her father eat it bite by bite, and coaxed him to drink the broth.
location: Diet preparation room and wards on the 6th floor of the inpatient department of Jinghai District Hospital (45 Shengli South Street), Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Brisk walking in the hospital garden during father's lunch break
description: After her father took a nap, she walked briskly for 15 minutes in the garden on the south side of the first floor of the inpatient building, got some sun, rested on a bench for 10 minutes, and had a brief conversation with a nearby patient's family member.
location: Garden on the south side of the first floor, Jinghai District Hospital (45 Shengli South Street), Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Continue accompanying father and chatting with him.
description: When she returned to the ward, her father was already awake. She helped him drink water and chatted with him about trivial family matters, such as the persimmon tree sprouting and the children’s studies. She also measured his blood pressure again (128/84), noted that it was stable, and helped him tuck in the blanket.
location: China, Tianjin Municipality, Jinghai District, Jinghai District Hospital (No. 45 Shengli South Street), Inpatient Department, 6th Floor, Room 601

name: Mother brings food, completes the handover, and prepares to leave the hospital
description: Her mother, Li Xiuying, brought low-salt dumplings in an insulated food container and took over as the caregiver. Ma Xiulan handed the blood pressure monitor and record book to her mother, reminded her about how to make the low-salt noodles, said goodbye to her father, and packed up and left.
location: China, Tianjin Municipality, Jinghai District, Jinghai District Hospital (No. 45 Shengli South Street), Inpatient Department, 6th Floor, Room 601

name: On the way home, stopped at the supermarket for groceries, then returned home to rest and hang clothes to dry.
description: After leaving the hospital, she rode her electric bike to Jingbai Supermarket to buy xylitol biscuits and steamed buns, then went home. Once home, she drank some water and rested, then took down the clothes that had been airing since morning and sorted them: she folded the dry ones and turned the damp ones over to continue airing.
location: Jinghai District, Tianjin, China, from Jinghai District Hospital to Jingbai Supermarket (Building 19, Room 104, Yuzhou Zunfu), finally returning home at No. 156 Jingwen Road

name: Picking up the second son and youngest daughter from school
description: Riding her electric bike, she first went to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up her youngest daughter Yuxin and helped her zip up her jacket. Then she went to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up her second son Mingzhe, who was already waiting at the gate. She put his schoolbag into the bike basket, and the three of them went home together. On the way, Yuxin shared the fun story of folding paper cranes in her handicraft class.
location: In Jinghai District, Tianjin, China, from 156 Jingwen Road to Huakang First Kindergarten (10 Huakang Road), then to No. 3 Primary School of Jinghai District (56 Shengli South Street), and return to Jingwen Road.

name: Take care of the persimmon tree and take photos to document it.
description: After arriving home, she asked her second son Mingzhe to water the persimmon tree with a small bucket, while she checked the sapling's stability and taught him to pull out weeds. When she saw tender green new shoots sprouting around the roots, she was pleasantly surprised and called her husband Ma Zhiqiang over to look, then took close-up photos with her phone.
location: Courtyard at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Preparing dinner and family dinner
description: Ma Xiulan was preparing dinner in the kitchen: stir-fried spinach, tofu and lean pork soup, and steamed buns warming up. Her eldest son Ma Mingxuan came home and helped peel garlic and set the bowls and chopsticks. The family sat together for dinner and talked about how the children were doing at school: the second son was praised for math, the youngest daughter performed a nursery rhyme, the eldest son seemed a little down, and her husband mentioned going to Shijiazhuang next week to stock up on goods.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Tidying the kitchen and checking the second son's homework
description: After the meal, she cleared the dishes, washed the bowls, and wiped down the stove. Then she checked her second son Mingzhe's copybook and math workbook, praised his handwriting for improving, pointed out that the correction notebook had blank spaces, and told him to fill them in.
location: Kitchen and living room of the residence at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Give the youngest daughter a bath and soothe her to sleep.
description: Ran bath water for her youngest daughter Yuxin, helped her bathe, played and splashed in the water, and carefully scrubbed her neck and behind her ears. After washing, she wrapped her in a bath towel, carried her to bed, told the short story Little Rabbit Looks for a Carrot, and gently patted her until she fell asleep.
location: Bathroom of the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China, and Yuxin's bedroom.

name: Video call with craft friends to exchange embroidery inspiration
description: She set up her phone in the courtyard and video-called her craft friend Zhou Xiuqin. She showed photos of the persimmon seedlings. Zhou Xiuqin suggested embroidering a 'persimmons for good fortune' pattern, and they discussed stitching techniques, such as backstitch for the branches and Suzhou-style gradient embroidery for the leaves. They agreed to go to Zhou's home next Monday afternoon to design the embroidery pattern.
location: Courtyard at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Supervise the two sons in completing their homework and tutor the eldest son in math
description: After the video call ended, she urged her second son Mingzhe to continue finishing his homework. She went to her eldest son Mingxuan's room to check his math test paper and found many mistakes in inequality problems. She sat down and explained them step by step until he understood two problems. Then she checked Mingzhe's homework and signed it.
location: The living room and Mingxuan's room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Personal grooming, expense tracking, and calendar marking
description: She poured hot water to soak her feet and relax, then took out the account book to record the day's expenses: 28 yuan for vegetables, 5 yuan for steamed buns, and 12 yuan for xylitol biscuits, 45 yuan in total. She crossed off March 13 on the wall calendar and opened the care log to write down her father's blood pressure readings.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Communicated with older sister and younger sister to confirm the caregiving arrangement.
description: First, she sent a WeChat message to her eldest sister Li Xiuyun, reporting their father's blood pressure and how his walk went. Her eldest sister said she would come back early on the weekend. Then she had a voice call with her younger sister Ma Xiufen, and they agreed to meet at the hospital at 8:30 tomorrow morning for the handover. Ma Xiufen would bring breakfast, and she herself would prepare low-salt ingredients in advance and put them in the fridge.
location: Bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Measure my blood pressure and go to bed.
description: Before bed, she measures her blood pressure with a wrist blood pressure monitor, and the result is 118/76. She changes into pajamas, checks outside the window, turns off the light, sets the phone alarm for 5:50 the next morning, reviews the day's schedule, and falls asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Early morning preparations and family breakfast.
description: At six o'clock in the morning, the phone alarm rang. Ma Xiulan got up, went to the bathroom to wash her face and do some light stretching, and moved her shoulders in front of the mirror while mentally planning the day's tasks. Then she went into the kitchen and quickly prepared breakfast for the whole family: millet porridge simmered on the stove, old-dough steamed buns heated in the steamer, and a small pan of scrambled eggs with scallions cooked with little oil. She also made a low-salt steamed egg custard for her father and cut a small plate of pickled cucumbers made yesterday. At exactly seven o'clock, she loudly woke up the three children, Mingxuan, Mingzhe, and Xinyu, and urged them to get up. The family of five sat around the dining table. Ma Xiulan peeled an egg for her daughter while reminding her eldest son to check his schoolbag. Her husband Zhiqiang drank his porridge silently, occasionally responding. The whole morning was busy but orderly.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Took the child to school and bought groceries
description: Ma Xiulan urged the two children to put on their little yellow hats, wheeled out her electric bike, and first took her second son Mingzhe to the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School along the way. She watched him greet his classmates and run through the school gate, then turned to Huakang First Kindergarten, handed her daughter Yuxin to the teacher, kissed her cheek, and said she would be the first to pick her up in the afternoon. Then she rode to her usual Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, went straight to the stall of Aunt Sun Guifang, whom she knew well, and picked out three long, shiny purple eggplants, a piece of tender tofu, and a few tomatoes and scallions, intending to make a cold dish for dinner. Aunt Sun rounded down the price and threw in a bunch of cilantro, and the two exchanged small talk.
location: Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, No. 54 Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, No. 16 Chunxi Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Wutong Commune Food Market, No. 12 Chaoyang Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tidy up the house and collect the persimmon saplings.
description: After Ma Xiulan got home, she first put the groceries away. Seeing that her husband Zhiqiang had already changed clothes, the two took their ID cards and a wet cloth and rode an electric bike together to the Jinghai Town Community Greening Station. While waiting in line, she had Zhiqiang fill out the form while she carefully examined the saplings the staff had brought out. She picked two with intact root systems and plump buds, and after squatting down to check the root balls, she insisted on wrapping them tightly in two layers of her wet cloth before she was satisfied letting Zhiqiang hold them. After returning home, she directed Zhiqiang to lean the saplings securely against the north wall of the courtyard in the shade. In the meantime, she saw a WeChat message from her younger sister Xiufen saying that their father's blood pressure had been normal in the morning and he had a good appetite. Somewhat relieved, she poured a glass of water and rested for a while in the courtyard.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home); Jinghai Town Community Greening Station, 32 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing lunch and going to the hospital
description: Ma Xiulan tied on an apron and went into the kitchen to make a low-oil version of soy-paste braised eggplant: instead of deep-frying the eggplant, she cut it into roll-cut chunks, salted them, and squeezed out the water. She put a small amount of oil in the pot, sautéed minced garlic and dried chili peppers until fragrant, added the eggplant and stir-fried it until soft, then added a large spoonful of homemade soybean paste and a little water. She let it simmer over low heat, and before serving sprinkled chopped green peppers and minced garlic on top, filling the room with aroma. At the same time, she blanched the wood ear mushrooms that had been soaked overnight, preparing them for a cold dish in the evening. She put the braised eggplant into an insulated lunchbox, also took some egg custard in a small bowl, checked that the wrist blood pressure monitor and phone charger were in her bag, called out to Zhiqiang in the yard, and rode off on her bike. On the way, she passed a date cake stall and, remembering that her father loved it, stopped and bought 5 yuan of sugar-free traditional date cake, then continued on to Jinghai District Hospital.
location: Kitchen at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and along the route to Jinghai District Hospital at No. 14 Shengli South Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Accompanying her father at the hospital.
description: Ma Xiulan gently pushed open the ward door. Her father, Ma Jianguo, was dozing, and her mother, Li Xiuying, was accompanying him. She asked her mother to go home and rest first. After handing over the jujube cake, her mother gave a few instructions and left. When her father woke up and saw the soy-braised eggplant she had brought, his eyes lit up. She helped him sit up against the headboard and fed him egg custard and soft eggplant with a small spoon, while she herself ate some leftovers with a steamed bun. After the meal, she measured his blood pressure with the new monitor, and the reading was 130/82, very stable. Then she sat by the bed and read him livelihood news from her phone. When she mentioned the policy on installing elevators in old residential communities, her father even chimed in with a few questions. After his afternoon nap, he was in better spirits. Ma Xiulan helped him walk two slow laps in the corridor, chatting about the newly received saplings and the children's grades as they walked. At three in the afternoon, her mother came to take over on time. Before leaving, her father held her hand and thanked her for her hard work. Ma Xiulan's eyes reddened. She quickly walked out of the ward, composed herself at the end of the corridor, and then went downstairs to take a five-minute stroll in the hospital's small garden.
location: Bed 15, Room 601, 6th Floor, Inpatient Department, Jinghai District Hospital, 14 Shengli South Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and the hospital garden

name: Picked up the express delivery on the way home.
description: Ma Xiulan rode her e-bike home, and on the way picked up several pairs of children's socks she had bought in a group order at the Cainiao station at the entrance of the community, planning to use them for her daughter Xinyu.
location: Cainiao Station at the northeast corner of the intersection of Shengli Street and Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparations for opening the jar of pickled vegetables
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan immediately washed her hands, found the white porcelain plates with red floral patterns, two pairs of new bamboo chopsticks, and two small glass jars needed for opening the pickle jar tomorrow, scalded them with boiling water, and placed them in a draining basket to dry. She also took out a square piece of red cloth from the cabinet, washed it, and hung it up to dry. Then she picked up her phone and sent a WeChat message to her husband Zhiqiang, reminding him to be sure to come home at noon tomorrow to taste the pickled vegetables from the jar. She also sent a voice message to her younger sister Xiufen, asking her to bring a small portion of the pickled vegetables to their father tomorrow so he could check the seasoning.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the child from school
description: Ma Xiulan left at exactly the right time on her electric bike, first going to Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up her daughter Yuxin. As soon as the little girl saw her mother, she rushed over and chattered about how she had painted today. Then she went to the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to wait for her second son Mingzhe. Seeing that he looked unhappy, she asked and learned that he had had a little falling-out with his deskmate. Ma Xiulan did not say much, just patted his head and said they would talk about it later at home.
location: Huakang First Kindergarten, 16 Chunxi Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, 54 Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Go home, tidy up, and wait for eldest son
description: After arriving home, Ma Xiulan let her daughter play in the yard and urged Mingzhe to do his homework first. She then sorted the vegetables bought at the evening market for use tomorrow, washed the red cloth needed for opening the jar again in clean water, hung it to dry, while keeping an eye out for her eldest son Mingxuan's return.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner
description: Her husband Ma Zhiqiang brought back dumplings from Old Sun's Dumpling Shop at the end of the alley, with two kinds of filling: pork and napa cabbage, and fennel and egg. As soon as he came in, he called out 'boss lady.' Ma Xiulan took the dumplings, had Zhiqiang prepare vinegar and garlic, and Yuxin helped set out chopsticks. The eldest son Mingxuan rode his bicycle home, just in time for dinner. The whole family sat around the table. Ma Xiulan first announced the news that her father's condition had improved, and the children cheered. Mingzhe put down his chopsticks and carefully pulled out from his schoolbag a math certificate for scoring 95. Ma Xiulan, pleasantly surprised, gave him a kiss. During the meal, everyone ate and chatted. Zhiqiang told an amusing story about collecting saplings, and Mingxuan shared that his class was preparing for a recitation competition. Laughter filled the room, and the atmosphere was warm.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Clear the dishes and check homework
description: After dinner, Ma Zhiqiang took the initiative to do the dishes. Ma Xiulan sat on the living room sofa and first checked her second son Mingzhe's math test paper, had him redo the wrong problems, and then urged him to recite the Chinese language text. Then she went to her eldest son Mingxuan's room, saw that he was doing an English workbook, and told him to arrange his time reasonably and go to bed early.
location: Living room and son's bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Give daughter a bath and put her to sleep
description: Ma Xiulan gave her daughter Yuxin a careful bath, changed her into clean pajamas, and carried her to the little bed. Yuxin asked for a story, so Ma Xiulan told her about the persimmon saplings they had just picked up that day, saying that next autumn they would bear big golden persimmons, and when the time came they would give them to Grandpa to eat. As Yuxin listened, her eyelids grew heavy, and before long she fell soundly asleep.
location: Bathroom and daughter's bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Personal washing, bookkeeping, and weighing
description: Ma Xiulan quietly walked out of her daughter's room, washed up in the bathroom, then went back to the bedroom, took out the account book, and recorded the day's expenses: 35 yuan for vegetables, 5 yuan for date cake, and 9.9 yuan for socks. Then she stepped on the electronic scale, which showed 55.8 kg, the same as yesterday. She picked up the bedside calendar and wrote '55.8kg' in the March 14 box.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Think up embroidery patterns before bed.
description: After turning off the lights and lying down, Ma Xiulan did not fall asleep right away. She ran through the procedure for opening the pickle jar tomorrow in her mind: wash hands, remove the red cloth, smell the aroma, and use clean chopsticks to take out the pickles and arrange them on a plate. Then she started thinking about the 'Everything Goes as You Wish' persimmon embroidery pattern that Sister Xiuqin had mentioned, pondering which stitch would make the persimmons look plump and whether the calyxes should be paired with dark green thread. Gradually she felt more assured and finally drifted off to sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Morning exercise
description: The birdsong outside the window woke Ma Xiulan. She deliberately got up fifteen minutes early and walked briskly in the neighborhood for 15 minutes, feeling her heartbeat quicken slightly and sweat appear on her forehead. After returning home, she added 5 minutes of stretching in the courtyard — leg stretches, chest expansions, and waist twists — and felt her body loosen up. Taking advantage of the freshness, she watered the two persimmon saplings brought back yesterday, looking forward to their taking root.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin - home courtyard and residential community.

name: Preparing the family breakfast
description: Ma Xiulan tied on an apron, quickly cooked a pot of millet porridge, cut two plates of her own pickled cucumbers, and put the buns bought yesterday in the steamer to heat. Because it was Saturday, the whole family was at home, so she took out four eggs from the fridge and made a scallion egg pancake. The flames on the stove danced, and the kitchen was filled with the aroma of millet and scallion eggs.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Wake up the family to have breakfast together
description: Ma Xiulan wiped her hands and went upstairs first to wake up her husband Ma Zhiqiang, who was still sleeping in, and the children. The second son, Mingzhe, scrambled up and shouted that he wanted to go see the saplings. The family sat around the dining table. Ma Xiulan served each person a bowl of porridge, put a piece of egg pancake on her husband's plate, and the children ate the pickled cucumbers with relish. When the day's tree-planting plan came up at the table, Mingzhe and Yuxin immediately got excited, and even the usually steady Mingxuan smiled.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Household chores and getting ready to go out.
description: After breakfast, Ma Xiulan quickly cleared the dishes and wiped the table, found old clothes and gloves for the family, and changed into neat old clothes herself, tying up her hair. She had prepared a spade, a bucket, and a small shovel in advance, and also took out the small wooden name tags and rope she had specially made yesterday. Once everything was ready, she called everyone to go out and start work.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The whole family plants trees together.
description: The courtyard immediately became lively. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang took off his coat, swung up a pickaxe, and dug two half-meter-deep pits at the chosen spots, while Ma Xiulan directed from the side. The eldest son Mingxuan helped straighten the saplings and shoveled soil around them; the second son Mingzhe insisted on holding the tree, only to get his hands covered in mud; the youngest daughter Yuxin carried her little bucket back and forth to fetch water, solemnly pouring the 'root-setting water' on them. Ma Xiulan took a few photos with her phone to record the lively scene. Finally, the children wrote their names and the tree species on small wooden tags and tied them to the trunks. Mingzhe also solemnly took on the task of watering the persimmon tree. Watching the new vitality added to the courtyard, Ma Xiulan felt great joy.
location: Home courtyard at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Finishing up planting trees and resting
description: After planting the trees, Ma Xiulan told her husband and children to go wash up, while she put the used tools back in their places and mounded soil around the newly planted saplings. Looking at the results of all their hard work, she wiped her sweat and felt especially pleased. Back inside, she washed apples for the children to quench their thirst and rest.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Opening the pickle jar and tasting the pickles
description: The long-awaited moment had come. Ma Xiulan washed her hands, solemnly carried out the clay jar that had been sealed for over a month from the storage room, and lifted the seal of yellow clay and several layers of oilcloth. A rich, mellow aroma of fermented sauce instantly filled the whole courtyard. She picked out a piece of radish and a piece of carrot, bright in color and crisp in texture, and let her husband and children taste them one by one. Everyone praised them endlessly. Her second son Mingzhe said, "Mom, this is a hundred times tastier than the ones from the supermarket!" Ma Xiulan was overjoyed. She first filled a small bowl and sealed it with plastic wrap, asking her husband Ma Zhiqiang to take it by bike to the hospital for her father while it was still warm. She then picked out a few of the best-looking pieces and put them in another small jar, intending to give them to Sister Wang Guilan across the way.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Taking pickles and a simple lunch to her father and neighbors
description: Her husband Ma Zhiqiang changed into a coat, took the bowl of pickled vegetables, and rode his electric bike straight to Jinghai District Hospital to deliver them to his father. Ma Xiulan, meanwhile, took a small jar of pickled vegetables across to the neighbor's door and knocked. Wang Guilan tasted them and kept exclaiming how fragrant they were, giving a thumbs-up and praising her superb skill. After delivering the pickles and returning home, Ma Xiulan had a simple lunch with her three children, reheating the leftover porridge and egg pancakes from morning and stir-frying a dish of cabbage with vinegar. After the meal, she urged the children to take a nap, and she herself leaned back on the sofa and dozed for twenty minutes to build up energy for the afternoon.
location: At No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin: home, Wang Guilan's home across the hall, and Jinghai District Hospital.

name: Selecting pickled vegetables and preparing for the meeting
description: Ma Xiulan was full of energy again. She went to the storage room and carefully selected radishes and carrots of uniform size and brightest color from a large earthen jar, and put them into two crystal-clear glass jars. She pressed them down, poured a little brine on top, wiped the rims clean, put on the lids, wrapped the jars in a clean cloth, and placed them in a cloth bag. These were samples she wanted to show her childhood friend Liu Chunmei, so she was especially careful.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Discussing consignment matters with a childhood friend.
description: The afternoon sun was warm and pleasant. Ma Xiulan walked to the Jingwen Road community square, where her childhood friend Liu Chunmei was already waiting under the corridor. As soon as they met, they chatted warmly. Ma Xiulan opened the jar for Chunmei to taste. Chunmei's eyes lit up, and she praised the pickled vegetables as crisp, fragrant, and not too salty. Sitting on the bench in the community square, the two discussed in detail the possibility of consignment sales. Chunmei, the stocking team leader at Hualian Supermarket, made the decision and said she would take a sample to the purchasing department manager next Monday to try. Ma Xiulan felt a weight lifted off her mind and thanked her again and again. Chunmei also mysteriously told Ma Xiulan that there would be a handicraft market here next Saturday, and she could bring her embroidery and pickled vegetables to try their luck. When parting, Chunmei insisted on giving her a bag of homemade red date cake.
location: Jingwen Road Community Square, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Deposited education savings on the way home.
description: After saying goodbye to Chunmei, Ma Xiulan walked home in a good mood. Today was the 15th, the day to save money. She took out her phone, opened mobile banking, and skillfully transferred 150 yuan into the education savings account she had set up for the children. Thinking to herself that her father's hospitalization had cost some money this month, but by saving a bit on groceries and buying two fewer new clothes, she could squeeze out this non-negotiable sum. Seeing the successful transfer notification, she silently drew another big smiley face in her planner in her mind.
location: On the way home along Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Organize the bookkeeping journal.
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan changed into house shoes, washed her face, then sat at the desk and opened the slightly worn accounting notebook. She solemnly wrote a line under that day's date: "March 15: deposited 150 yuan into education savings, totaling 1,800 yuan." Then she drew a smiley face and added below: "Keep going, we can definitely save 5,000 yuan!" Putting down her pen, she felt much of the day's fatigue melt away.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Prepare a hearty dinner
description: Husband Ma Zhiqiang had already returned from the hospital and told Ma Xiulan that her father had tasted the pickled vegetables and kept praising them, which made her even happier. She put on an apron and started preparing dinner. Since everyone had worked hard today planting trees and visiting friends, she decided to make something nice: she took out pork ribs from the fridge to braise, stir-fried garlic lettuce, and made a tomato and egg soup. Ma Zhiqiang helped peel garlic and wash vegetables beside her. The couple bustled around the kitchen chatting casually, full of warm, homely coziness.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Warm family dinner
description: The dishes were served, and the family sat together. The braised pork ribs were glossy red and fragrant. Ma Xiulan gave everyone a piece. As they ate and chatted about planting trees, Mingzhe pounded his chest and promised to water the tree well, while Yuxin said she wanted the sapling to grow taller than her. The dinner table was full of laughter and joy. Ma Xiulan also brought out the red date cake Chunmei had given her for everyone to taste, and the children all loved it.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tidying up the house and warm memories
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan and her husband cleaned up the dishes together. Instead of rushing off to do other things, she took out a few thick old photo albums from the cabinet and called the children over to look at them. The whole family squeezed together on the sofa. As Ma Xiulan turned the pages, she pointed at the people in the photos and told funny stories from their childhood: Mingzhe wetting the bed, Yuxin’s first tooth, Mingxuan’s first award certificate... The children listened with great interest, and the small courtyard was filled with warm laughter. Looking at her three healthy and happy children, Ma Xiulan felt that no matter how tired she was, it was all worth it.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Supervising the children washing up and going to bed
description: After the happy reminiscing time ended, Ma Xiulan began to urge the children to wash up. She told her eldest son Mingxuan to wash first and remember to check his homework, and told her second son Mingzhe not to sneak any more candy after brushing his teeth. Then she bathed her youngest daughter Yuxin, changed her into clean pajamas, told her a short bedtime story, and watched her fall asleep sweetly. Afterward, she went to check on the two boys' room, found Mingxuan reading and Mingzhe already asleep, turned off the light for them, and quietly closed the door behind her.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Relaxation and deep breathing for the couple
description: The children were all settled, and the world suddenly became quiet. Ma Xiulan changed into her pajamas and sat on the edge of the bed with her husband, leaning on each other without extra words. Together they did five minutes of deep breathing: inhale, hold, then slowly exhale, feeling their bodies relax and the day's fatigue gradually fade away. When it was over, she felt very calm inside. She glanced at the quiet night sky outside the window and thought: another fulfilling and peaceful day. Around 9 p.m., the couple turned off the lights and got ready to fall asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Morning activities and washing up
description: Woke up naturally at 6:10 a.m., first did 5 minutes of shoulder and neck stretches on the living room floor, then walked briskly in the courtyard for 15 minutes, checked the persimmon tree planted yesterday, and felt relieved to see the soil moist and the sapling standing upright. Afterward, she went back to the bathroom, rinsed her mouth and washed her face with warm water, and gently moved her wrists and ankles to prepare for the new day.
location: Living room and courtyard at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing breakfast for the family and cleaning up the kitchen
description: She cooked millet and pumpkin porridge, heated steamed buns, fried eggs, and sliced pickled cucumbers. She called the three children to get up. The eldest, Mingxuan, got up on his own; the second, Mingzhe, stayed in bed; and little Yuxin sat down obediently. The family sat together for breakfast, listening to the children talk about fun stories. After the meal, the children played or did homework, while Ma Xiulan put on an apron and washed dishes, wiped the stove, and mopped the kitchen floor, keeping the home clean.
location: Kitchen and dining room of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare and give pickled vegetables to thank the neighbors
description: She scooped a bowl of pickled vegetables from the jar and sealed it with plastic wrap. Remembering the salted duck eggs Sister Wang had given her in return, she heated two of them and brought them along as well. Carrying the pickled vegetables and salted duck eggs, she walked across to Wang Guilan's house. Wang Guilan took them warmly, and the two chatted about everyday things. Sister Wang asked with concern about Ma Xiulan's father's illness. Before leaving, Ma Xiulan pinched a small piece of pickled vegetables and tasted it.
location: 158 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (in front of Wang Guilan's house)

name: Go home and rest to relieve stomach acid discomfort
description: After returning home, she felt acid rising in her stomach. It may have been irritation from eating pickled vegetables on an empty stomach. She quickly poured a glass of warm water and drank it slowly, leaned back on the sofa for a while, rubbed her stomach, and the discomfort gradually eased.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Go to the food market to buy groceries
description: After her stomach felt more comfortable, she rode her e-bike to Wutong Commune Market. At Aunt Sun Guifang's stall, she bought tender tofu, baby spinach, shiitake mushrooms, two cleaned sea bass, plus eggs, tomatoes, snow pears, and bananas.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Chaoyang Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Return home to organize the dishes and prepare things for the hospital visit
description: After arriving home, she sorted and put away the vegetables. She went to the inner room, wrapped the half-jin jar of pickled vegetables that had been prepared yesterday in a cloth bag, picked the two largest snow pears, and took a carton of milk and a bag of sugar-free biscuits, putting them all into the canvas bag for visiting the sick.
location: Home kitchen and bedroom at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Preparing lunch and father's recovery meal
description: She cut the soft tofu into pieces and blanched them, cleaned the sea bass and stuffed it with ginger and scallions for steaming. Her second son Mingzhe finished his homework and came over to help peel garlic and make garlic paste for the cold dishes. She also prepared the ingredients for tomorrow's lunch and steamed a pot of rice.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The whole family had lunch together.
description: Steamed sea bass (half of it put into an insulated lunch box for her father), tofu mixed with chopped scallions, garlic broccoli, and tomato and egg soup were served. Ma Xiulan picked food for the children and told them to eat more vegetables.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Settling the children and taking a rest
description: After clearing the dishes, she had Mingxuan take his younger brother and sister to read books and play with building blocks. She herself felt sleepy, so she lay on the sofa with her eyes closed and rested for 20 minutes.
location: Living room and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Took her second son by bike to the hospital to visit her father.
description: After resting, she recovered her energy. She asked Mingzhe to come along, put on her canvas bag, took the insulated lunchbox, and the two rode an electric bike along Jingwen Road and Gongnong Street to Jinghai District People's Hospital, arriving in about 20 minutes. Her father was watching the TV news. Ma Xiulan put down her things and first asked the nurse about his blood pressure, learning that it was stable. She opened the insulated lunchbox and the jar of pickled vegetables. Her father tasted the pickles and nodded repeatedly. Mingzhe eagerly told him about watering the trees. Ma Xiulan measured her father's blood pressure (130/80), and her father told her not to work too hard. The ward was full of warmth.
location: Ward 307, 3rd Floor, Inpatient Department, Jinghai District Hospital, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: On the way home, stopped at the supermarket for groceries
description: Said goodbye to her father and reminded him to take his medicine on time. Riding the bike with Mingzhe, she went by Jingbai Supermarket on the way, and bought snacks for the children for next week (small cookies, jelly), household detergent, and batteries. Mingzhe pestered her into buying a box of watercolor pens. After leaving the supermarket, they went straight home by bike. Mingzhe played with his new watercolor pens, and Ma Xiulan reminded him not to lose the caps. After arriving home, she put things away and washed her hands.
location: Jingbai Supermarket, Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and the way home

name: Check son's homework
description: First she checked Mingxuan’s math homework; there were two wrong multiplication problems. She explained them patiently and had him correct them. Then she looked over Mingzhe’s Chinese copywork; the handwriting was neat, but there were some wrong characters, so she had him rewrite them.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Housework and preparing dinner ingredients
description: Took out the pork ribs to thaw, washed the cabbage, potatoes, and green peppers, and soaked the wood ear mushrooms. Then started cutting the meat and washing the vegetables. During this, her mother called, and Ma Xiulan reported that her father was safe.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Chat with neighbors and bring in the dried laundry
description: Wang Guilan from the opposite door came to return a bowl and also gave a few tomatoes. The two chatted for a bit, and Ma Xiulan thanked Sister Wang for helping pick up Yuxin. Back inside, she took in the dried sheets and school uniform, folded them, and put them back in the wardrobe.
location: In front of and courtyard of their home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Rushing to finish handmade embroidery.
description: Taking advantage of the time before dinner, she took out the embroidery hoop and silk fabric and continued working on the order for pillowcases with the "Fu" (blessing) character. Stitch by stitch, she mentally planned the meeting with Sister Xiuqin next week to design patterns.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing dinner for the whole family
description: Made braised pork ribs, stir-fried baby bok choy, scrambled eggs with tomatoes, and seaweed and egg drop soup. Mingzhe came over to help tear apart the cabbage and peel garlic, and Ma Xiulan praised him for being sensible. Also steamed a pot of white rice.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The whole family having dinner together
description: The food was served, and the three children sat down. Ma Xiulan put food in her daughter's bowl and reminded Mingzhe not to wolf down his meal. After dinner, she cleared the dishes, and the children helped wipe the table.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Play with daughter and check homework.
description: Yuxin took out her drawing book and drew a crooked but cute picture. Ma Xiulan praised her and helped her recognize characters. She helped Yuxin pack her schoolbag and put in the handkerchief and crayons needed for tomorrow.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Urge family members to wash up and wash up herself
description: Urged the three kids to wash their faces, brush their teeth, and wash their feet one by one. She herself washed her face with warm water and applied face cream. She arranged the clothes for tomorrow and cleaned the sink.
location: Bathroom and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Evening handicrafts, bookkeeping, and bedtime preparations
description: Sitting on the sofa and continuing her embroidery, her workmate Zhou Xiuqin sent a voice message suggesting they meet tomorrow afternoon to design patterns. Ma Xiulan replied 'OK', and the two chatted about the market fair. After that, she took out her account book and noted down expenses: 35 yuan for vegetables, 24 yuan for supermarket shopping, 18 yuan for fruit, no income, and weighed herself at 55.7 kg. Then she sat on the edge of the bed, closed her eyes, and did 5 minutes of deep breathing to relax. She went to the children's room, urged Mingxuan, who was reading an extracurricular book, to turn off the light; Mingzhe and Yuxin were already lying down. She closed the doors to each room. She soaked her feet in warm water for 15 minutes, then changed into cotton pajamas and lay down. She set the alarm for 5:50 tomorrow and wrote a note in the calendar: 'Go to Sister Xiuqin's house at 3 pm'. She checked the windows and drew the curtains. Turning off the light, she reflected on the day: although tired, the whole family was safe and sound, and her father's condition had improved. A sense of contentment rose in her heart, and she fell into a deep sleep.
location: Living room, bedroom, and bathroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning exercise and neighborhood chat
description: The alarm on her phone went off at 6:15 in the morning. After getting up, she drank some warm water, then did shoulder and neck stretches, then changed into her exercise clothes and walked briskly around the residential complex. In the community fitness equipment area, she ran into her neighbor Wang Guilan. The two chatted, and Ma Xiulan encouraged Wang Guilan to join her in morning exercise and asked about the health of the Wangs' grandson.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and the nearby community fitness area

name: Prepare breakfast and take the children to school
description: After returning home from a walk, she washed up and changed into loungewear, then prepared breakfast (millet and pumpkin porridge, meat buns, boiled eggs). She woke the three children and had breakfast together with them, reminded her eldest son Ma Mingxuan to bring his review materials, and checked Ma Mingzhe's schoolbag. Then she rode her electric bike to take Ma Mingzhe to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School first, then Ma Yuxin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten.
location: At home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, as well as Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street) and Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten (near Tuanbo Avenue)

name: Shopping at Wutong Commune Vegetable Market
description: After dropping off the children, she rode her electric bike to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market to buy vegetables, tofu, fruit, and spareribs. She chatted with vegetable seller Sun Guifang and bought spinach, tomatoes, firm tofu, bananas, snow pears, and pork ribs.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin (intersection of Jingwen Road and Wutong Road)

name: Household chores and hand embroidery
description: After returning home, she put the vegetables into the refrigerator by category and soaked the pork ribs in cold water. She cleared the dining table and washed the school uniforms and bed sheets. During the washing machine's working intervals, she continued embroidering the pillowcase with the character 'fortune'.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Discuss and prepare for the trial sale of pickled vegetables.
description: Received a WeChat message from childhood friend Liu Chunmei, learning that Jingbai Supermarket could do a trial sale of handmade pickled vegetables. After discussing with Liu Chunmei by phone, they decided to provide 5 jars of green beans and radish, priced at 15 yuan. Then she selected the pickled vegetables from the cellar, wiped the jars, and designed handwritten labels reading 'Guilan Sauce Garden'.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Lunch and lunch break
description: Heated up the leftover millet porridge from last night, and had it with homemade pickled cucumbers and steamed buns as a simple lunch. After the meal, I cleared the dishes, set an alarm, and rested in bed for half an hour.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare and go to Jingbai Supermarket to deliver pickled vegetables
description: After the lunch break, she received a notice from Liu Chunmei that the store manager had agreed to a trial sale. She immediately put five jars of labeled pickled vegetables into a bamboo basket, took the embroidery patterns, and walked to Jingbai Supermarket. At the supermarket she met Store Manager Zhang. After tasting them, the manager agreed to put them on the shelves, and they agreed on a commission ratio. She put the pickled vegetables on the shelf herself and felt a great sense of accomplishment.
location: Jingbai Supermarket, Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Visit Zhou Xiuqin to design handcraft patterns.
description: After leaving the supermarket, she walked to Zhou Xiuqin's home. Although the distance was not short, taking a shortcut made it quicker. At Sister Xiuqin's house, they discussed embroidery patterns, and Xiuqin praised Xiulan for her improved skills. The two drank tea while discussing works for next month's handicraft market, and Xiuqin suggested embroidering a Hundred Children tapestry. During the visit, Xiulan also shared the good news that her pickled vegetables would be sold in the supermarket.
location: Room 301, Building 12, Wutong Gongshe Beili Community, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the child from school
description: Said goodbye to Zhou Xiuqin, first went to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up daughter Ma Yuxin, then rode the electric bike to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up second son Ma Mingzhe. On the way, she listened to the children share funny stories from school; Mingzhe was praised in math class, and Yuxin was learning to draw a rooster.
location: Tianjin Jinghai District Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten and Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School.

name: Helping with homework, preparing dinner, and having family dinner
description: After arriving home, she urged Mingzhe to correct his typos while Yuxin drew. She began preparing dinner: blanched the ribs, peeled the Chinese yam, stewed yam and ribs, and while that was going on stir-fried spinach and made seaweed egg drop soup. Her eldest son, Mingxuan, rode home on his bike. The family ate dinner together, the children shared what happened at school, and the atmosphere was warm.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening housework and parent-child building block game
description: After dinner, she cleared the dishes, scrubbed the stove, had the two sons bathe first, and played with building blocks with her youngest daughter Yuxin, building a castle and enjoying family time together.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Supervise the children washing up and manage household finances.
description: First, she bathed her daughter, told her a bedtime story, and soothed her to sleep. Then she checked how her two sons had done with washing up. After that, she took out the ledger and recorded the day's spending on groceries and fruit, and made a special entry for the ingredient cost and expectations for the trial sale of the pickled vegetables. She also weighed herself: 55.7 kg, staying steady.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Soak feet to relax and talk with husband
description: After a busy day, she soaks her feet in hot water with mugwort, and at the same time sends her husband Ma Zhiqiang a WeChat message telling him that all is well at home and sharing the joy of getting her pickled vegetables into the supermarket.
