She enjoys a moment of peace and feels hopeful about the future.
location: Master bedroom of the home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: After soaking her feet, she washed up and applied facial cream, then smiled confidently at the mirror. She set the alarm for 5:50 the next day, turned off the light, lay down, reviewed the day, and fell asleep satisfied.
location: Master bedroom of the home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning wake-up, activities, and preparing breakfast
description: Got up after the alarm clock rang. Since I needed to pick up my father from the hospital today, I did not go out for a walk. Instead, I exercised in the yard with a brisk 10-minute walk. Then I prepared breakfast for the family in the kitchen: cooked millet porridge, heated up steamed buns, and sliced the homemade pickled radish and salted vegetables. The eldest son Mingxuan rode his bike to school by himself; the second son Mingzhe and the youngest daughter Yuxin were washing up, so I urged them to hurry up.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (home)

name: Take the children to school and rush to the hospital.
description: Riding an e-bike, she first took her second son Mingzhe to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (on Shengli South Street). At the school gate, she told him to listen to the teacher and eat well. Then she took her youngest daughter Yuxin to Huakang First Kindergarten and watched her enter. After that, she rode the e-bike directly to Jinghai District People's Hospital, preparing to handle discharge procedures for her father.
location: On the way from No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China, to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street), to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, to Jinghai District People's Hospital (No. 14 Shengli Street)

name: Handling hospital discharge procedures and taking father home
description: Arrived at the 3rd floor of the inpatient building to visit her father, then queued at the billing window to complete the discharge procedures, checked the fees, and settled the account. During the attending doctor's ward round, she asked in detail about post-discharge precautions. The doctor instructed that her father should take his blood pressure medication on time, maintain a low-salt diet, eat more celery and winter melon, and return for a follow-up in two weeks. She recorded the doctor's instructions in her notebook. Afterwards, she helped her father downstairs, hailed a taxi at the hospital entrance, and took him back to her parents' home at 45 Shengli Street. Together with her mother, she settled her father on the sofa, handed the medication and discharge instructions to her mother, and reminded her again about the precautions.
location: Jinghai District People's Hospital, No. 14 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China, and the parents' home at No. 45 Shengli Street.

name: Buying groceries, handling housework at home, and checking on pickled vegetable sales
description: Walked from her parents' home to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market and bought low-salt ingredients suitable for her father at Sun Guifang's stall: celery, winter melon, tender tofu, lean meat, tomatoes, and eggs. After returning home, she sorted the ingredients into the refrigerator, then tidied the room, folded clothes, and cleaned the floor with the vacuum cleaner. After finishing the housework, she contacted her childhood friend Liu Chunmei via WeChat to ask about sales of the pickles she had consigned. Learning that 4 of the 5 jars consigned to Jingbai Supermarket had been sold, she decided to go to the supermarket to restock.
location: Wutong Commune vegetable market, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China, and home at 156 Jingwen Road

name: Prepare lunch and deliver a patient meal to Father.
description: In the kitchen at home, she made scrambled eggs with tomatoes and tofu with minced pork for the children, and used the newly bought winter melon and lean meat to stew a light winter melon meatball soup for her father, and also cooked some millet porridge. During that time, her mother called saying her father wanted to drink porridge. After cooking, she packed the winter melon meatball soup and millet porridge into a thermal container, rode her electric bike to her parents' home, watched her father eat half a bowl of porridge and meatballs with a good appetite, stayed with him for a while, then cleaned up the dishes and went home.
location: The home kitchen at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China, and the parents' home at 45 Shengli Street

name: Hand embroidery, restocking pickled vegetables at the supermarket, and negotiating the market stall.
description: After returning home at noon, she continued working on the handmade embroidered Fu-character pillowcase. Soon she received a message and photos from Liu Chunmei, learning that Jingbai Supermarket had only one jar of pickled vegetables left, and the store manager invited her to restock. She rode her electric bike to Jingbai Supermarket, located at Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu, and talked with Liu Chunmei and the store manager Zhang Jianmin. The manager praised the pickled vegetables for their good taste and repeat customers. They discussed sending another 10 jars to the store the next day and settled the arrangements for participating in the handicraft market next month.
location: The living room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China, and Jingbai Supermarket, Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu

name: Picking up the children from school and sharing the good news of being praised
description: Riding an electric bike, she first went to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up her youngest daughter, Yuxin, and then went to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up her second son, Mingzhe. On the way home, Mingzhe excitedly showed off the "Little Green Guardian" commendation letter he had received for taking care of the persimmon saplings at school. After getting home, she placed the letter neatly under the glass tabletop in the living room, hugged Mingzhe, and praised him.
location: On the way from Huakang First Kindergarten in Jinghai District, Tianjin, China, to Jinghai District Third Primary School (Shengli South Street), and then to home at No. 156 Jingwen Road

name: Prepare dinner, interact with neighbors, and deliver dinner to parents
description: She started preparing dinner, keeping her father's low-salt diet in mind, washing and prepping vegetables. During this time, neighbor Wang Guilan brought over a bowl of freshly cooked vegetarian meatballs to share; Ma Xiulan gave her a serving of homemade wood ear mushroom salad in return, and the two chatted at the door. Then she continued cooking: a regular dinner for the children, and for her father a separate low-salt steamed sea bass, garlic broccoli, and multigrain rice. After it was ready, she packed the dinner into an insulated food container, rode her electric bike to her parents' home, saw that her father was in good spirits, had the meal and chatted with her parents, then cleaned up and went home.
location: The home kitchen at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China, and the parents' home at 45 Shengli Street

name: Family dinner together and a phone call with her husband
description: Back home, the three children had already set out the bowls and chopsticks, waiting. During dinner, they shared the good news of Mingzhe's letter of commendation and the success of the pickled vegetable sales, and the atmosphere at the table was warm. During the meal, her husband Ma Zhiqiang, who was out on a long-distance haul, called to say he wouldn't be home tonight and that they shouldn't wait for him.
location: Dining room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Checking homework and playing with the children
description: After the meal and cleanup, she checked the children's homework. She helped her eldest son Mingxuan analyze a difficult eighth-grade math problem, signed off on her second son Mingzhe's Chinese language homework, while her youngest daughter Yuxin doodled nearby. Then she played with building blocks with Yuxin and listened to Mingzhe tell a story about the persimmon tree at school, enjoying quality family time.
location: Living room and study at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Personal bookkeeping, handicrafts, and video calls with craft friends.
description: After the children wash up, take out the accounting book to record the day's expenses (35 yuan for groceries, 15 yuan for taxi) and the pickled vegetable profit-sharing income, and weigh in at 55.7kg. Continue the unfinished hand embroidery, and video call craft friend Zhou Xiuqin to share the results of the pickled vegetable trial sales and discuss the embroidered patterns for next month's handicraft market, deciding to make "Flowers of Wealth and Honor" insoles and Chinese knots with auspicious meanings.
location: Bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Washing up and reviewing rest before bed
description: After ending the video call, she soaked her feet in warm water to relax the day's fatigue. She set the alarm for 06:10 the next day, and lying in bed, she reviewed the happy events of the day — her father being discharged smoothly, Mingzhe being praised, and the pickled vegetables selling well — and felt satisfied and comforted, then fell asleep peacefully.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Morning exercise, breakfast, and waking the children up.
description: After the alarm went off at 6:20 in the morning, Ma Xiulan changed into workout clothes and did 10 minutes of neck and shoulder stretches in her small yard, then walked briskly along the alley for 15 minutes until her body felt slightly warm. After exercising, she went to the kitchen to make multigrain porridge, steam buns, slice pickled radish, and boil eggs to prepare breakfast for the family. At 7:15 she went upstairs to wake the three children, Ma Mingxuan, Ma Mingzhe, and Ma Yuxin, and urged them to wash up. During breakfast, she watched Mingzhe drink porridge in big mouthfuls, told Yuxin to finish her egg, checked Mingzhe's schoolbag, filled Yuxin's water bottle with warm water, and hurriedly drank a bowl of porridge and ate an egg herself.
location: Home and yard at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Taking children to and from school
description: At 7:45, Ma Xiulan wheeled out her electric bike, carrying Ma Mingzhe on the back seat and Yuxin on the front seat. She first went to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, watched Mingzhe run into the school gate, and reminded him to listen carefully in class. Then she turned the bike around and took Yuxin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, greeted the teacher, and left.
location: From 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street), then to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten

name: Shopping at the vegetable market.
description: After dropping off the children, Ma Xiulan stopped at the Wutong Commune Vegetable Market on the way. She picked out eggplants, peppers, and tomatoes at longtime stall owner Sun Guifang's stand, and also made a point of buying a bunch of tender spinach, a few pieces of tofu, and dried shrimp, to be used for low-salt dishes and to add umami.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing pickled vegetables and delivering them to Jingbai Supermarket.
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan sorted and stored the vegetables she had bought, counted and wiped clean the 10 jars of pickled vegetables prepared yesterday, and neatly arranged them in a bamboo basket. At 9 o'clock she walked about 25 minutes to Jingbai Supermarket, and with the shop assistant Liu Chunmei, placed the pickled vegetables in a prominent spot on the shelf. Chunmei told her there were already repeat customers, so Xiulan decided not to increase the quantity for now, and thanked the store manager Zhang Jianmin.
location: From No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin to Jingbai Supermarket (Building 19, Room 104, Yuzhou Zunfu, Jinghai District, Tianjin) and the supermarket's pickled vegetables section

name: Morning housework, handicrafts, and lunch preparation.
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan prepared for the afternoon health lecture. She dug out her father's blood pressure records and doctor's orders from his hospitalization and listed the questions she wanted to ask: 1. Is my father's frequent dizziness related to his blood pressure fluctuations? 2. What is the daily salt intake standard for a low-salt diet? 3. What are some recommended convenient low-salt recipes? Then she made tea and listened to pingshu storytelling, folded clothes, and mopped the floor. After finishing the housework, she took out the pillowcase prepared for the market and embroidered a pomegranate flower pattern. At 11 o'clock, she made herself a bowl of clear noodle soup with a poached egg. At the same time, she made a light spinach tofu soup with tender tofu and spinach and multigrain rice for her parents, strictly controlling the salt and adding only a little dried shrimp for flavor.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Lunch and lunch break.
description: Ma Xiulan ate a bowl of clear noodle soup while scrolling through short videos on her phone to look at recipes. After the meal, she cleared away the dishes, leaned back on the sofa and rested with her eyes closed for 20 minutes, then went to the bedroom, set a 12:40 alarm, and took a half-hour nap. As soon as the alarm rang, she got up immediately, washed her face with cold water, checked the insulated lunch boxes for her parents and the materials for the afternoon lecture, and packed them into an eco-friendly cloth bag.
location: Living room and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Bringing meals to her parents
description: Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to her parents' home on Shengli Street. As she entered, she heard her father Ma Jianguo coughing; her mother Li Xiuying was scolding him for trying to sneak some salted vegetables again. Xiulan put down the insulated lunchbox and told her mother that they would go to the hypertension prevention lecture together in the afternoon. Her mother agreed.
location: From 156 Jingwen Road to parents' home at 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Go to attend a health lecture.
description: After leaving her parents' home, Ma Xiulan returned to her own home, put down her bag, changed into flat cloth shoes, and walked to the Chaoyang Street Community Health Service Center with a notebook and water bottle. At the entrance of the residential community, she met her neighbor Wang Guilan. They chatted as they walked, and after Wang Guilan learned the situation, they agreed to take a walk together the next day. After arriving at the community hospital, Xiulan checked in and received the Hypertension Patient Home Care Manual, then found a seat in the front row. The lecture began at 14:00. Dr. Wang explained hypertension prevention and treatment, daily monitoring, and low-salt diet. Xiulan took careful notes. During the Q&A session, she raised her hand first and asked about her father's persistent dizziness after discharge. She received advice on monitoring blood pressure in the morning and evening, ruling out other causes, and low-salt recipes such as steamed fish and dressed lettuce shreds. The lecture ended at 15:30, and without lingering she left quickly.
location: Walk from No. 156 Jingwen Road to the Health Education Room on the third floor of Chaoyang Street Community Health Service Center, Jinghai District, Tianjin (No. 16 Jingwen Road)

name: Shared the lecture content at her parents' home and adjusted the diet.
description: Ma Xiulan returned to her parents' house, sat down with her mother, and shared the lecture notes and the low-salt diet plan recommended by Dr. Wang item by item. On the spot, she changed the evening menu at home from stir-fried sliced meat to stir-fried seasonal vegetables, swapped rice for mixed grain rice, and put away the soy sauce and salt. Then she went to her father's room, used her phone to show him pictures of the recipes to encourage him to follow the diet, poured warm water to help him take his blood pressure medication, and reminded him again to take his medicine on time and to lie down if he felt dizzy.
location: Parents' home, 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Return home to prepare and enjoy a low-salt dinner
description: Ma Xiulan rode back home, tied on an apron, and started preparing the low-salt dinner: tomato salad, steamed eggplant with garlic and vinegar sauce, and stir-fried mushrooms with greens. The whole family would be going low-salt tonight, so she put away the salt shaker and used only light soy sauce and oyster sauce for seasoning. After her eldest son Mingxuan came home from school, the family sat around the table. Xiulan shared what she had learned at the lecture and said that from now on the whole family should eat a light diet. Mingzhe praised the tomato salad, and Yuxin also learned to rinse her vegetables in a bowl of water.
location: Kitchen and dining room of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening chores and parent-child time.
description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan had Mingxuan take his younger siblings to do homework while she cleaned up the dishes and wiped down the kitchen, and posted a "Kitchen Salt-Reduction Tip" by the sink. She checked Mingzhe's Chinese and math homework, circled the typos and had him correct them, then played educational building blocks with Yuxin and listened to her daughter talk about fun things at kindergarten. At 7:20 p.m., she urged the three children to wash up one by one. Taking the opportunity, she sent her husband Ma Zhiqiang a WeChat message updating him on recent happenings along with photos of dinner. After that, she soaked her feet and took out the half-embroidered pillowcase to continue embroidering.
location: Various rooms of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Hand embroidery and video exchange.
description: While Ma Xiulan was embroidering, her craft sister Zhou Xiuqin started a WeChat video call, and the two showed each other their recent embroidery works. Xiulan shared what she had learned from today's health lecture, while Zhou Xiuqin suggested new patterns that could be used at the market. The two discussed combining tradition and innovation for more than ten minutes and agreed to talk in more detail the next day.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pre-bedtime activities and rest
description: After hanging up the video call, Ma Xiulan put away the pillowcase and took out her account book to record the day's expenses: 35 yuan for groceries, and the 150 yuan payment for pickled vegetables had already been credited. She also wrote down today's weight, 55.6 kg, with a note: "The lecture was very rewarding. The whole family has started a low-salt diet. Tomorrow I'll deliver pickled vegetables to my parents' home and remind them to take their medicine on time." Then she checked the doors, windows and gas, prepared the items for the next day, lay in bed and sent her husband Ma Zhiqiang a goodnight voice message. She turned off the light at 21:40 and fell asleep with a sense of fulfillment.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Getting up, morning stretches, and preparing breakfast
description: I woke up before the alarm, with thoughts churning about my father's follow-up checkup and the market trip. As usual, I did five minutes of shoulder and neck stretches by the bedside to relieve morning stiffness. Then I tiptoed into the kitchen and started preparing breakfast for the whole family: a light millet porridge and two boiled eggs for my parents; milk, cereal, and steamed buns for the children; and a bowl of porridge for myself with leftover cold dressed vegetables from last night.
location: Bedroom and kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Wake up the family to have breakfast together and take the children to school.
description: She went to each room in turn to wake up her husband Ma Zhiqiang and the three children. After washing up, the whole family sat around the dining table for breakfast. While adding milk to the children's cups, Ma Xiulan reminded her eldest son Mingxuan to leave for school early today and not be late, and reminded her second son Mingzhe and daughter Xinxin that the colored paper needed for the afternoon handicraft class was already in the side pocket of their schoolbags. She quickly drank a bowl of porridge. Then her husband rode his motorcycle to work, and Ma Xiulan took her second son and daughter out on her electric bike. She first turned right from Jingwen Road onto Dongfanghong Road, took Mingzhe to the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, and told him not to fool around when entering the classroom. Then she turned around and took her youngest daughter Xinxin along Dongfanghong Road to Huakang First Kindergarten, and only left with peace of mind after watching the teacher lead Xinxin into the class.
location: Dining room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; then went to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (112 Shengli South Street) and Huakang First Kindergarten (Dongfanghong Road)

name: Go to her parents' home to pick up her father and accompany him for a follow-up examination.
description: After dropping off the two children, Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to her parents' home on Shengli Street. When she got there, her mother Li Xiuying had already opened the door and was waiting, and her father Ma Jianguo was ready. Ma Xiulan helped her father walk to the nearby Jinghai District Community Health Service Center (36 Shengli Street). She skillfully queued up, registered, and then accompanied her father through blood pressure, blood sugar, and electrocardiogram tests one by one. During the intervals between tests, she kept reassuring her father. After looking over all the results, Doctor Wang smiled and said that all the indicators were well controlled; as long as he kept taking his medicine on time and ate a light diet, they would remain stable. Hearing this, Ma Xiulan felt the weight in her chest finally lift, and she turned to her father and said, “See, I told you so.”
location: Parents' home, 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, then went to Jinghai District Community Health Service Center (36 Shengli Street)

name: Take father home, relay the doctor's orders, and rest briefly.
description: After leaving the consulting room, Ma Xiulan and her father agreed that he would come for a follow-up visit around the 20th of every month from now on. She helped her father walk home, repeated Dr. Wang's instructions in detail to her mother Li Xiuying, and divided the newly prescribed medicine into doses according to the dosage. After finishing all this, she felt a little dizzy herself, so she quickly drank a glass of water at her mother's house and ate two biscuits she had brought with her to tide her over.
location: Parents' home, 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: While walking home, received the good news that the market was approved; after getting home, planned and prepared lunch.
description: After saying goodbye to her parents, Ma Xiulan walked home. Halfway there, her phone rang. It was Sister Zheng Xiuying from the community cultural center. Sister Zheng excitedly told her that the handicraft market stall she had applied for on the first weekend of April had been officially approved. Ma Xiulan was both surprised and delighted, and quickly confirmed the specifics with Sister Zheng, such as the stall number and whether she needed to bring her own tables and chairs. After hanging up, she was so excited that her steps felt much lighter. As soon as she got home, Ma Xiulan immediately took out the family calendar and solemnly wrote "Market!" in large characters in the squares for the first weekend of April (April 5 and 6). While preparing a simple lunch of noodles with gravy in the kitchen, she used her phone to search for wholesale prices of glass jars and nice label styles for making pickled vegetables, and began her initial planning. Carrying the noodles to the dining table, she browsed on her phone as she ate and saved several well-reviewed online stores selling glass jars. After eating, she washed the dishes and felt even more fulfilled.
location: On the way from Shengli Street to Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, then at home at No. 156 Jingwen Road.

name: At noon, visit neighbors to share the good news and ask for advice.
description: With something on her mind, Ma Xiulan could not nap at all. She took along some pickled cucumbers she had made herself and knocked on the door of Sister Wang Guilan across the hall. She excitedly shared the good news that her market stall application had been approved, and the two chatted enthusiastically. Ma Xiulan also asked Sister Guilan whether she knew where cheap and sturdy glass jars were sold. Guilan promised to ask her relative who worked in wholesale.
location: The home of Wang Guilan, across from No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Going to the vegetable market to check ingredient prices
description: After leaving Sister Guilan's home, Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to the Wutong Commune vegetable market. She went straight to the stall of Aunt Sun, a vegetable vendor she knew well, and carefully asked about the current prices of cucumbers and peppers. While chatting with Aunt Sun, she mentioned her plan to buy in small bulk quantities to make pickled vegetables. Aunt Sun said that if she needed a large amount, she could help her ask about prices at other wholesale stalls.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Midday rest and household chores
description: Feeling a bit tired after returning home, Ma Xiulan took a 20-minute nap on the sofa. After waking up, she brought in the dry clothes that had been hung on the balcony the day before, folded them and put them in the wardrobe, then briefly tidied the living room to prepare for the busy afternoon.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the children from school and buy stationery.
description: Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up her youngest daughter Xinxin, who was dismissed early in the afternoon. After picking up Xinxin, she first stopped by the stationery store next to the vegetable market to buy a pack of colored card stock Xinxin needed for her handicraft class. Then the mother and daughter walked together to the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to wait for her second son Mingzhe to finish school. After picking him up, she held one child in each hand and asked whether they had been praised by their teachers at school today. The two children chattered and vied to answer.
location: Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin; a stationery store near Wutong Commune Vegetable Market; and Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School

name: Helping children with homework and doing housework
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan first made the two children wash their hands and drink water, then urged Mingzhe to do his homework at the living room table, while she sat beside him, watching and occasionally guiding him through the math problems he found difficult. Her younger daughter Xinxin leaned quietly against her mother, flipping through a newly bought picture book. While keeping an eye on the children, Ma Xiulan folded the clothes that had been brought in from the afternoon and put them into their respective wardrobes.
location: The living room and balcony at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare a hearty dinner.
description: Seeing that it was about time, Ma Xiulan told Mingzhe to continue his homework, while she tied on an apron and started preparing dinner. Because she was in a particularly good mood today, she decided to make the children's favorite sweet and sour pork, stir-fry a seasonal vegetable dish with the fresh greens she had bought at the market, and simmer a pot of tomato and egg soup for her husband Ma Zhiqiang. The aroma of cooking gradually drifted through the kitchen.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner together, cleaning up afterward, and supervising homework.
description: The eldest son, Mingxuan, came home from school, and her husband, Ma Zhiqiang, also finished his shift and came home. The family of five sat around the dining table in a lively atmosphere. At dinner, Ma Xiulan served food to the children while eagerly telling her husband about the approval of the market stall and today's vegetable prices. The children also chimed in with funny stories about school, and everyone was happy. After dinner, Ma Xiulan quickly cleared the table, washed the dishes, and cleaned the kitchen. When she finished, she went to the study and watched her eldest son Mingxuan do his homework. She sat beside him, checking the test papers he had already completed while waiting for him to finish the last complicated bonus math problem. After confirming that it was correct, she broke into a satisfied smile.
location: Dining room and study at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Discuss market stall sales strategy with her husband
description: Ma Xiulan pulled her husband Ma Zhiqiang into the bedroom, closed the door, took out the vegetable prices she had recorded that afternoon and the jar prices she had found on her phone, and the two carefully worked out the accounts. After some discussion, they decided that the market stall would mainly promote pickled vegetables. For the first trial batch, they would make 50 jars, priced at 15 yuan per jar, and they initially planned the costs of ingredients such as cucumber and chili peppers as well as the production time.
location: Master bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Help the children wash up and coax the youngest daughter to sleep
description: After discussing the important matter with her husband, Ma Xiulan went to get the children ready for bed. She urged Mingzhe to brush his teeth and wash his face, helped Xinxin take a bath, then read them a picture-book story and coaxed her youngest daughter Xinxin to sleep. Looking at the children's peacefully sleeping faces, the day's fatigue melted away.
location: Home bathroom and children's room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Draft the first batch of pickled vegetable production plan and check the schoolbags
description: After the whole family had gone to sleep, Ma Xiulan sat at the desk in the study, laid out paper and a pen, and wrote down in detail the first batch production plan she had just discussed with Zhiqiang. She listed the specific ingredients: 10 jin of cucumbers, 5 jin of chili peppers, salt, sugar, soy sauce, and the 50 glass jars that needed to be purchased. After writing, she stuck the list on the most conspicuous spot with a refrigerator magnet, then carefully checked the three children's schoolbags to make sure the textbooks and stationery needed for the next day were not missing.
location: Study at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pre-sleep relaxation and bedtime
description: Lying in bed, Ma Xiulan was physically exhausted, but her mind was still buzzing with excitement over the market stall being approved. She closed her eyes, and her thoughts went round and round: how to design more eye-catching labels, how to tell her childhood friend Liu Chunmei the good news, and the production process for the first batch of pickles... Thinking and thinking, with hopes for the future, she gradually drifted off to sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Get up and prepare breakfast
description: After the alarm went off at 6:30 in the morning, Ma Xiulan got up and went to the kitchen to prepare breakfast. Outside the window, it was gloomy and damp. She cooked millet porridge, steamed buns and flower rolls, boiled eggs, and took pickled cucumbers and radish strips out of the pickle jar, preparing a simple, hot breakfast.
location: Kitchen at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Wake up the family and take the children to school.
description: Ma Xiulan woke the three children and reminded her eldest son, Mingxuan, to buy breakfast and not be late. Then she rode her electric bike to take Mingzhe and Xinxin to school. She first arrived at Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School and watched Mingzhe enter the school gate. Then she went to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, reminded the teacher about Xinxin's nap, and watched the child enter the classroom before leaving.
location: Jinghai District, Tianjin: starting from 156 Jingwen Road, then arriving at Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School on Shengli South Street and Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten.

name: Morning walk consolidation period ended, and returned home to tidy up.
description: After dropping off the children and returning home, Ma Xiulan briskly walked for 20 minutes near the flower beds in the residential community. She felt lighter than two weeks ago and was satisfied with her persistence. Afterwards, she went home to stretch, then cleaned up the breakfast dishes and sorted the dirty laundry into the washing machine to wash.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and inside the residential community.

name: Called parents to say hello and confirm the shopping list.
description: Ma Xiulan called her mother, Li Xiuying, at her parents' home and told her that she would go celebrate her father's 68th birthday tomorrow, and that she would prepare the cake and the dishes. Afterward, she took out her ledger and made a shopping list, including iron yam, pork tenderloin, sea bass, and seasonal greens for tomorrow's family dinner, as well as 10 jin of cucumbers, 5 jin of chili peppers, garlic, old ginger, and other ingredients for making pickled vegetables. Then she got her small cart and eco-friendly bags ready to go out.
location: Living room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Big grocery shopping at Xingwang Vegetable Market
description: Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike about 10 minutes to Xingwang Vegetable Market, found the stall of her regular customer Sun Guifang, learned that she wanted to pickle vegetables. Sun Guifang helped her select 10 jin of straight prickly cucumbers and 5 jin of red and green peppers, along with garlic and old ginger, and after rounding off the total, charged 35 yuan. Then she also bought iron stick yam, pork tenderloin with some fat, live sea bass, and fresh vegetables such as broccoli and mushrooms. The shopping cart and bags were packed full.
location: Xingwang Vegetable Market, southeast corner of the intersection of Shengli Street and Dongfanghong Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Go home to tidy up and prepare the cake ingredients.
description: After arriving home, Ma Xiulan spread the pickled vegetable ingredients on the kitchen floor to air out, washed and drained the vegetables for the family banquet, and marinated the pork tenderloin with soy sauce, cooking wine, and ginger slices before refrigerating it. She peeled and cut the yam into sections and put it in the steamer. For a simple lunch, she had a bowl of millet porridge with pickled mustard.
location: Kitchen at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Make a low-sugar yam paste cake and clean the pickled vegetable ingredients
description: After steaming the Chinese yam, Ma Xiulan mashed it into a puree, added xylitol, eggs, and a little flour to make a batter, poured it into a cake mold, tapped out the air bubbles, and baked it in a preheated oven for 40 minutes. Then she began to wash cucumbers and chili peppers and soak them in lightly salted water. Meanwhile, she took out glass jars, scalded them with boiling water, and drained them. The kitchen was filled with the sweet aroma of baking and the fresh scent of vegetables.
location: Kitchen at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Cake taken out of the oven to cool and a short midday nap
description: After the cake was baked, she tested it with a toothpick — perfect. She placed it on a cooling rack to cool naturally. Ma Xiulan went back to the bedroom, set a 15-minute alarm, and took a short nap to regain her strength.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Checking the draining progress of the pickled vegetable ingredients
description: After the afternoon nap, Ma Xiulan returned to the kitchen and checked that the cucumbers and chili peppers had drained dry and the glass jars were dry and water-free. She planned to pickle the vegetables before returning to her parents' home tomorrow morning, letting them absorb the flavor over the weekend and bottling them next week.
location: Kitchen at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the children from school and supervise their homework.
description: At 2:45 p.m., Ma Xiulan set out and first went to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up her daughter Xinxin. Xinxin excitedly told her about a new nursery rhyme she had learned, and on the way she bought her an eraser. Then she went to No. 3 Primary School to pick up Mingzhe. After getting home, she washed the children's hands and gave them freshly baked Chinese yam cake with warm water. Then she urged Mingzhe to do his math homework while Xinxin drew pictures beside him.
location: Jinghai District, Tianjin: from Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to Shengli South Street No. 3 Primary School, then back to home at 156 Jingwen Road.

name: Cooked dinner and chatted with the children.
description: Ma Xiulan prepared dinner, making stir-fried broccoli, mushroom and pork slices, and reheated leftovers. While cooking, she chatted with the children about celebrating Grandpa's birthday tomorrow, telling them to finish their homework early and behave well tomorrow. Xinxin said she wanted to sing, and Mingzhe wanted to bring his spinning top.
location: Kitchen and dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner
description: The eldest son Mingxuan came home from school, and the family of four sat down to dinner. Ma Xiulan asked Mingxuan about school and reminded him to help take care of his younger siblings at tomorrow's family gathering. Mingxuan sensibly agreed. After dinner, Xinxin helped clear the dishes, and Mingzhe went to watch cartoons.
location: Dining room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Evening chores and childcare
description: Ma Xiulan washed the dishes, wiped the stove, and tidied the kitchen. Then she checked the three children's homework: she signed Mingxuan's test paper, pointed out the careless mistakes in Mingzhe's math homework, and coaxed Xinxin into finishing writing her pinyin letters. She arranged for the children to wash up and found the clothes they would wear to Grandpa's house tomorrow, folding them neatly at the head of the bed.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Put the younger daughter to sleep and plan the pickled vegetable details
description: At 8 p.m., Ma Xiulan told Xinxin a short story to coax her to sleep, then went to the living room and sent a voice message to her childhood friend Liu Chunmei to talk about tomorrow's birthday plans and the progress of the pickled vegetable stall. After that, she silently reviewed tomorrow's pickling process: first layer the cucumbers and sprinkle with salt, cut the peppers into sections, and simmer the sauce. She felt everything was going well.
location: Children's room and living room at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Washed up and went to bed
description: Ma Xiulan washed up briefly, changed into pajamas, and lay down. Reviewing the day, she felt tired but inwardly satisfied. Thinking of her father's good health, the children's obedience, and the prospects of the pickle business, she felt secure and happy. She set the alarm for 6 a.m. the next morning, turned off the light, and fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Getting up in the early morning, washing up, and pickling vegetables.
description: At 6:45 in the morning the alarm went off right on time. Because today was her father’s 68th birthday, Ma Xiulan was excited and got up quickly. She went to the bathroom first to wash up and tied her hair neatly. Then she quietly slipped into the kitchen, put on gloves, and took out the cucumbers, chili peppers, and garlic that had been salted overnight. Following her newly recorded recipe, she mixed star anise, Sichuan peppercorns, dried chilies, sugar, light soy sauce, and other seasonings in the right proportions, stirred them evenly with the vegetables, pressed them into a clean enamel jar, and sealed it. She calculated in her mind that this jar of pickled vegetables would be ready in a few days and could be brought to the market for customers to taste her cooking.
location: Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Early morning brisk walking around the neighborhood and shoulder-and-neck stretches.
description: Ma Xiulan changed into her old running shoes and went out for a brisk-walking workout in the neighborhood, walking 5 laps around the central flowerbed while exercising her wrists and shoulders. After finishing, she did shoulder and neck stretches on a bench downstairs to relax. The fresh morning air and chirping sparrows lifted her spirits. After persisting for over half a month, she felt her waist and legs were much lighter and more agile.
location: Inside the residential compound at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Family breakfast and getting the children organized
description: Ma Xiulan returned home to find that her husband Ma Zhiqiang had already warmed up millet porridge, steamed buns, and boiled eggs. The three children got up one after another. The eldest son Mingxuan washed up by himself and sat down at the table. The second son Mingzhe was still drowsy and had to be led to wash his face. The youngest daughter Yuxin clung to Ma Xiulan and refused to get down. The whole family sat around the table eating breakfast. Ma Xiulan served the children while making arrangements: Dad was home today, Mingxuan would take his younger siblings to do their homework, Dad would make dumplings at noon, and she was going to Grandpa's birthday celebration and would video call when she came back in the evening. Zhiqiang nodded in agreement, and the home was filled with a warm and lively noise.
location: Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Prepare and ride to her parents' home.
description: After breakfast, Ma Xiulan quickly cleared the table and changed into a clean maroon coat. She checked the large canvas bag: homemade low-sugar yam cake, marinated pork tenderloin cubes, cleaned sea bass, and longevity noodles. After saying goodbye to her husband Zhiqiang, she rode her electric bike out of the residential community and headed south along Jingwen Road. The morning rush was already over, and the road was wet. Turning onto Shengli Street, the street gradually became lively, with the aroma of jianbing guozi filling the air. She rode carefully and soon arrived at her parents' building, locked the bike, and went upstairs.
location: Jinghai District, Tianjin, China: starting from 156 Jingwen Road, cycling along Jingwen Road and Shengli Street to 40 Shengli Street

name: Arrive at her parents' home and prepare for the birthday family dinner.
description: Ma Xiulan went to her parents' home at 40 Shengli Street. Her mother, Li Xiuying, opened the door wearing new clothes, and her younger sister, Ma Xiufen, was already inside with her 5-year-old nephew, Lele. The three of them immediately went into the kitchen and split the work. Ma Xiulan took charge as the main cook, making her specialty low-salt sweet-and-sour pork tenderloin and steamed sea bass. Her mother helped by trimming vegetables and slicing scallions, while Xiufen tended the fire and boiled water. In the kitchen, the sounds of chopping, sizzling, and talking interwove, creating a lively atmosphere. As she fried the pork, Ma Xiulan explained that she had seasoned it with xylitol so that her father's blood sugar would not spike. Her mother smiled and praised her for being thoughtful.
location: Kitchen of the parental home, 40 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Father's Birthday Family Dinner
description: The family dinner officially began in the living room of her parents' home. Her father, Ma Jianguo, sat in the seat of honor, looking hale and hearty. Ma Xiulan lit the "68" candles, and everyone clapped and sang the birthday song; her father smiled and blew out the candles. She cut the homemade yam paste cake, and after tasting it, her father praised it as delicious and not greasy. Everyone started eating. The sweet and sour pork and steamed fish Ma Xiulan made were very popular, and her father ate two bowls of rice. During the meal, she used her phone to video-call her eldest sister, Li Xiuyun, in Beijing. The phone stood on the table. Seeing the lively scene, her sister's eyes reddened with excitement, and she toasted her father through the screen, telling him to take care of his health. The whole family clinked glasses together. After the meal, Ma Xiulan measured her father's blood pressure; it was 135/85, and everyone breathed a sigh of relief.
location: Living room at her parents' home, No. 40 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Cleaning up after the family dinner and chatting with family.
description: After the family banquet, Ma Xiulan and her younger sister Ma Xiufen set about clearing the tableware, wiping the table, washing dishes, and cleaning the stove, while urging their mother to go rest on the sofa. The sisters chatted as they worked. Ma Xiulan mentioned that she had taken a market stall and was worried about finding glass jars for her pickled vegetables. Ma Xiufen said she knew a colleague whose family did glass jar wholesale and promised to help ask around. Once everything was tidied up, the family brewed jasmine tea and sat in the living room chatting about everyday things, while the children bounced a ball in the yard.
location: Parents' home, No. 40 Shengli Avenue, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Learn a new pickled vegetable recipe.
description: Taking advantage of a lull while her mother and sister were talking, Ma Xiulan took out her phone and searched short-video platforms for pickled vegetable making videos such as "spicy cucumber strips" and "sweet and sour garlic". When she came across good ideas, she noted them down in her memos. Seeing this, her mother smiled and said that her grandmother once had a recipe for five-spice dried radish and was willing to write it down for her by hand. Ma Xiulan's eyes lit up, and she immediately leaned in to ask. Her mother began to dictate, and she carefully entered each step into her phone memo, feeling that this was the most valuable gain of the day.
location: Living room at her parents' home, No. 40 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Return trip and ordering glass bottles
description: A little after 2 p.m., Ma Xiulan called the children to say goodbye to their grandparents and rode her electric bike back. Instead of going straight home, she turned into Shufen Convenience Store on Jingwen Road. The owner, Zhang Shufen, was stocking shelves. Ma Xiulan ordered 50 500ml glass bottles with lids at a wholesale price of 60 yuan, and they agreed she would pick them up the day after tomorrow. She also bought 5 jin of salt, two bags of white sugar, and a bottle of soy sauce, spending 20 yuan. After paying, she felt cheerful and rode home humming a tune.

participant.name: Zhang Shufen
participant.relation: The lady who runs the convenience store

location: Shufen Convenience Store, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Returning home to check the pickled vegetables and making dumplings with the whole family.
description: When Ma Xiulan arrived home, her husband Ma Zhiqiang was helping the eldest and second sons with homework, and the youngest daughter was watching cartoons on the sofa. She put down her things, went to the kitchen to check the pickle jar she had salted in the morning, pressed it with a spoon to confirm no air had escaped, and felt reassured. Seeing that Zhiqiang had already kneaded the dough and prepared the dumpling filling, she called the family together to make dumplings. Eldest son Mingxuan helped roll out wrappers, youngest daughter Yuxin pinched shapeless "dumplings" with her little hands, making everyone laugh. Amid laughter and chatter, they wrapped two large trays of dumplings. Ma Xiulan boiled water and put them in the pot, and soon steaming hot dumplings were served. The family sat around the table eating and talking about Grandpa's birthday.
location: Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Evening family activities and video calls
description: After finishing the dumplings and cleaning up the kitchen, Ma Xiulan video-called her eldest sister, Li Xiuyun, around 19:00. The whole family crowded in front of the phone screen, and she showed her sister photos from Grandpa's birthday banquet. The children sweetly called her Auntie and asked if she would come back for the New Year. The second son, Mingzhe, also showed off the new slingshot he had made, which made their aunt laugh. Ma Xiulan took the opportunity to talk with her sister about their father's health, the pickle recipe secret she had learned that day, and the good news about ordering glass jars. The two sisters agreed to go together to supervise their father's physical exam next time. After hanging up the video call, she urged her second son and youngest daughter to go wash up, while her eldest son, Mingxuan, continued doing his homework, and she checked his writing for typos.
location: Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Personal relaxation and pickled vegetable planning.
description: After the children were settled, Ma Xiulan finally caught her breath. She poured herself a glass of plain water and took it to the bedroom. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang was watching the TV news. She took out her notebook and pen, neatly copied down the traditional recipe for five-spice dried radish that she had learned from her mother that afternoon, and then began to plan: once she picked up the glass jars the day after tomorrow, she would do a big batch, and at next week's market she could put out her exclusive pickled vegetables. She felt pleased and sensed that life was becoming more promising. She chatted with Zhiqiang about the day's events, saying that seeing her father happy made all her fatigue worthwhile. She also mentioned that her younger sister had helped ask about the glass jars, and the two talked about how things were at home.
location: Bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Evening washing up and going to bed
description: Ma Xiulan went to the bathroom and soaked her feet in hot water. The rising steam dispelled the fatigue of the whole day, and she applied moisturizer to her skin. Back in the bedroom, she said goodnight to Zhiqiang, picked up her phone to check tomorrow's weather, and turned off the bedside lamp at around 22:10. In the darkness, with her concern for her father, her hopes for the pickled-vegetable business, and the comfort of having the family together, she fell into a deep sleep.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Wake up, morning stretching, and washing up
description: At 6:30 in the morning, Ma Xiulan woke up naturally. After doing some simple shoulder and neck exercises in bed, she got up and washed up. After washing up, she did a 10-minute shoulder and neck stretch on the living room floor. Looking at the sunshine in the yard outside the window, she felt refreshed and energetic.
location: Bedroom, bathroom, and living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Preparing breakfast and checking the pickle crock.
description: Ma Xiulan walked into the kitchen, tied on an apron, cooked millet porridge, reheated buns and steamed buns, and quickly stir-fried a plate of scallion eggs. While the porridge was simmering, she went to the corner of the courtyard, lifted the lid of the pickle jar, gently turned the pickled cucumbers and chili peppers with a wooden spatula, smelled the rich soy aroma, and after being satisfied with how well seasoned they were, closed the lid tightly.
location: Kitchen and courtyard of the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Family breakfast and assigning housecleaning tasks
description: Ma Xiulan brought the cooked millet porridge, reheated stuffed buns and steamed buns, and scrambled eggs to the table and called the family to breakfast. At the table she announced that today was a household cleaning day and assigned tasks: her husband Ma Zhiqiang was in charge of high places and heavy work; her eldest son Ma Mingxuan would tidy the study; her second son Ma Mingzhe would sweep the floor; and her daughter Ma Yuxin would wipe the low tables. The children were all full of enthusiasm after hearing this.
location: Dining room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: After the meal, cleaned up and walked to pick up her parents to come for a short stay.
description: After breakfast, Ma Xiulan quickly cleared the dishes, changed into going-out clothes, picked up her mother's usual medicines and a shopping bag, and walked from 156 Jingwen Road to her parents' home at 45 Shengli Street. After going upstairs and stating her purpose, she helped her mother pack a change of clothes and regular medications, checked the doors and windows, then supported her slow-moving father by one arm and held her mother's arm, and the three walked slowly home. On the way, she exchanged a few pleasantries with neighbor Wang Guilan. Once home, she settled her parents on the living room sofa and poured hot tea. Her father looked at the spring-cleaning scene outside the window and smiled, saying it was lively at home and they had come to the right place.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, 45 Shengli Avenue, and the route in between, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Whole-family quarterly deep cleaning
description: The thorough cleaning got fully under way, with Ma Xiulan acting as chief commander. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang stood on a ladder and wiped the high living room windows until they were spotless; her eldest son Ma Mingxuan used a small brush in the study to clean the dust off the bookshelves and wiped the old photo frames clean; her second son Ma Mingzhe carefully swept the living room and hallway floors; her daughter Ma Yuxin wiped the coffee table and TV cabinet with a damp cloth. Ma Xiulan herself focused on cleaning the kitchen, scrubbing the grease off the stove and cabinet doors and tidying up miscellaneous items. After the initial cleaning of the common areas, she also carefully cleaned the south-facing second-floor bedroom where her parents were temporarily staying, wiping the tables, chairs and cabinets, mopping the floor twice, putting on freshly washed sheets and quilt covers, and opening the windows for ventilation. The room was filled with a fresh, clean scent.
location: Various places in the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (living room, bedroom, kitchen, study, courtyard)

name: Lunch (simple meal of noodles with gravy)
description: After a busy morning, Ma Xiulan quickly made a large pot of noodles with thick gravy using the wood ear mushrooms and day lily flowers she had soaked in the morning. The gravy was savory and the noodles were chewy. The whole family sat around the clean dining table to eat. Her father Ma Jianguo kept praising the spotless room, and the atmosphere was warm.
location: Dining room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Afternoon rest and tea break for the whole family.
description: After lunch, Ma Xiulan urged the children to take a nap, while she and her husband sat in the living room with her parents drinking tea. The adults chatted about family matters, and the children squeezed together on the sofa watching TV for a while. The atmosphere was pleasant. Xiulan took the opportunity to knead her stiff shoulders with her hand.
location: Home living room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Rode the electric scooter to the supermarket to pick up glass bottles and buy seasonings.
description: After a short rest, Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to Shufen Convenience Store. The owner, Zhang Shufen, had prepared 50 glass bottles packed in a cardboard box. Xiulan counted them and paid the wholesale price of 60 yuan. She also bought three large bags of salt, two bags of white sugar, and a piece of old ginger at the store, spending 35 yuan in total, to use for making sweet and sour garlic next week. The two chatted about daily life, and Zhang Shufen praised the aroma of Xiulan's pickled vegetables and said she wanted to learn her technique. Afterward, Xiulan tied the things to the back seat of her electric bike and rode home.
location: Shufen Convenience Store, middle section of Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Go home to clean and sterilize glass jars and turn over the pickled vegetables in the vat.
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan put on rubber gloves and, at the sink in the courtyard, scrubbed the 50 glass bottles inside and out one by one with dishwashing liquid and a brush, then rinsed them with boiling water and placed them upside down on a clean bamboo tray to drain. After handling the bottles, she went to check the pickle jar, gently turning the pickles so they would absorb the seasoning evenly, while mentally planning to pickle spicy cucumber strips with a new recipe next week.
location: Courtyard at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Video-called with her sisters to discuss a health management plan for their father
description: Using her phone, Ma Xiulan set up a three-person video group chat with her eldest sister Li Xiuyun and younger sister Ma Xiufen. First she let her parents in the living room greet the two daughters, then she seriously brought up the matter of health. She told them that yesterday she had measured their father's blood pressure at 135/85, which was fairly stable, and proposed establishing a health management plan. The three agreed: the mother would supervise the father in measuring his blood pressure every morning and evening and take photos to send to the family group; the three sisters would each take one month in turn to return to their parents' home to cook low-salt healthy meals, with Ma Xiulan carrying out the first month.
location: Home living room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Preparing a hearty dinner and trying the new pickle recipe
description: After the video call ended, Ma Xiulan cheerfully began preparing dinner. She took out the cucumber strips she had pickled yesterday with the new recipe and tasted them; they were savory with a slight spicy kick and well flavored. She nodded in satisfaction. Then she heated oil in the wok and made braised hairtail in soy sauce, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, steamed egg custard with less oil and salt, and sliced a plate of pork hock that had been braised in soy sauce yesterday. The kitchen filled with tempting aromas.
location: China, Tianjin Jinghai District, No. 156 Jingwen Road, home kitchen

name: Family dinner
description: A bountiful meal filled the table, and Ma Xiulan called the family to eat. During the meal, she picked up food for her parents and let the children try the pickled cucumbers. Her father was full of praise for the egg custard, the children competed for the hairtail fish, and the whole family chatted and laughed, enjoying a clean, tidy, and reunited Sunday evening.
location: Dining room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Cleaning up after the meal, chatting with family, and checking the children's homework
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan cleared the table and washed the dishes. Her husband played with the two sons in the living room for a while, while Ma Xiulan sat on the sofa with her parents and daughter Yuxin, chatting about everyday things. At the same time, she checked Mingxuan's and Mingzhe's weekend homework, pointed out two small mistakes in Mingzhe's math problems, and urged him to correct them.
location: Kitchen and living room of the residence at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Tidying up around the house and copying out the pickled vegetable recipe
description: After the family members went back to their own rooms, Ma Xiulan took out the notebook filled with everyday moments from the study, found the page with her mother's dictation from yesterday, neatly recopied the "five-spice dried radish" recipe passed down from her grandmother with a fountain pen, and added today's practice note: "Star anise can be added last for a richer flavor."
location: Home study, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Washing up and pre-sleep relaxation
description: Ma Xiulan soaked her feet in comfortable hot water and felt much of her fatigue melt away. Before going to sleep, she deliberately did a serious shoulder and neck stretch on the bedroom floor to relieve the soreness from the day's thorough cleaning. Then she washed her face with hot water and applied face cream, feeling fully relaxed.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Putting the kids to bed.
description: Ma Xiulan first went to her daughter's room and told her two little stories, watching Yuxin fall asleep. Then she went to check on her son Mingzhe and found he was still awake, secretly reading comics with a flashlight under the covers. She confiscated the comics and urged him to go to sleep quickly.
location: The bedrooms at the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Chatting with her husband before bed and turning off the lights to sleep.
description: Back in the master bedroom, Ma Xiulan chatted with her husband Ma Zhiqiang, who was already lying down, about the day's family matters. Zhiqiang said considerately, "You worked hard today; Mom and Dad are happy staying here." At 22:00, Xiulan turned off the light, listened to the insects chirping outside the window in the dark, and fell into a deep, peaceful sleep.
location: Master bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Morning family routine
description: At 06:30 in the morning the phone alarm went off, and I gently turned it off so as not to wake my younger daughter. First I washed my face with warm water in the bathroom, then did 10 minutes of shoulder and neck stretches in front of the bedroom mirror to relieve the soreness from yesterday's big cleaning. At 06:50 I tied on an apron and prepared breakfast in the kitchen: cooked millet porridge, heated up pork and cabbage buns, quickly stir-fried a plate of shredded potatoes, and set aside a low-salt portion for my father Ma Jianguo. At 07:15 I went to the children's room and softly woke them. My eldest son Mingxuan quickly put on his school uniform by himself; my second son Mingzhe lingered in bed until I patted his bottom to get him up; my little daughter Xinxin was still groggy and looked for her mother. The whole family of five sat down to breakfast. My husband Zhiqiang wasn't driving today, so he ate leisurely, and I reminded the children to behave at school while eating. At 07:45 after breakfast, Zhiqiang took the initiative to drive the three children to school. Mingxuan carried his schoolbag himself, Mingzhe dawdled while putting on his shoes, and Xinxin skipped along behind. I saw them to the door and waved goodbye. At 07:55 I cleared the dishes and soaked them in water, took the low-salt breakfast upstairs to my parents' room, asked how they had slept, and measured my father's blood pressure: 136/83 mmHg. I took a photo and sent it to the three sisters' family group chat. At 08:20 I went downstairs, washed and dried the dishes, put on a light gray jacket, checked the e-bike battery, put a reusable shopping bag and phone in the basket, and planned to go to the vegetable market and supermarket to buy radishes, cucumbers, and sealing jars.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin: bedroom, bathroom, kitchen, dining room, entrance, and parents' bedroom on the second floor.

name: Going out to shop and washing vegetables.
description: At 08:35 I rode my electric bike to the Wutong Commune vegetable market. In the bustling market I found the stall of Sun Guifang, a regular customer, and bought 5 jin of white radishes and fresh cucumbers. Sun Guifang said this batch of cucumbers were good for making pickled vegetables, so I also bought a piece of old ginger. Then on the way I stopped by Jingbai Supermarket in Yuzhou Zunfu and picked out 20 glass jars with airtight seals. At 09:25 I returned home, moved the vegetables to the kitchen, put on rubber gloves, carefully rinsed the radishes and cucumbers with clean water to remove mud and impurities, then spread them in a large draining basket and placed it in a ventilated place to air-dry the surface moisture. This is the key to keeping pickled vegetables from turning moldy.
location: Sun Guifang's stall, Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jingbai Supermarket, Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu, Jinghai District, Tianjin; kitchen of the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pickle the first jar of vegetables in bulk.
description: I washed my hands, cut the air-dried vegetables into even strips, put them in a large stainless steel basin, sprinkled with coarse salt, rubbed evenly, and let them sit to draw out water. While waiting, I sterilized 20 new jars with boiling water and arranged them neatly on the counter. I prepared the five-spice sauce recipe left by my grandmother. After the vegetables released their water, I drained them, mixed them thoroughly with the sauce, then filled each jar, pressed it down tightly, and screwed on the lids. The kitchen was filled with the savory aroma of the sauce. While working, I accidentally cut off a small piece of skin on my finger with the kitchen knife, quickly bandaged it with a Band-Aid, and continued.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare and deliver lunch to her parents.
description: After finishing the first step of the process, she took a short break. She took the leftover noodles with gravy from yesterday out of the refrigerator and heated up a simple serving for herself and her parents. She served the low-salt noodles for her parents, carried them upstairs to the second floor, and brought back their empty bowls from earlier.
location: The home kitchen at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and the parents' bedroom on the second floor

name: Just now during the big cleanup, I found green garlic in the vegetable garden. The children and I pickled it into Laba garlic to eat for the New Year.
description: At the small table in my parents' room, the three of us had lunch together. After the meal, I again measured and recorded my father's blood pressure (135/80 mmHg), sent the result to the family group chat, and reminded my mother to note down the morning and evening measurement times.
location: Parents' bedroom on the second floor of the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Lunch break and mobile socializing
description: After clearing away the dishes, I went to the sofa in the living room for a short rest. I opened my phone and first replied to my craft friend Zhou Xiuqin's WeChat message, telling her that the pickled vegetables were going smoothly and that the first batch had already been jarred. Then I browsed the local craft group for a while to see if there was any new market information.
location: Sofa in the living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Check the pickling process and tidy up
description: After resting, I returned to the kitchen and checked all 20 jars of pickled vegetables to make sure the lids were tightly screwed on. I washed and put away the bowls and basins that had held the sauce and vegetables, then got ready to pick up the children.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Picking up her second son, Ma Mingzhe, from school
description: I checked the time; Mingzhe should be out of school soon. I got on my electric bike and reached the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School in a few minutes. Soon I spotted my youngest son Mingzhe with his schoolbag in the crowd.
location: At the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Tianjin

name: Mingzhe helped write labels and stick them on the bottles.
description: Back home, I took a marker and the pre-cut label paper out of the drawer. Mingzhe put down his schoolbag and naturally took the marker, neatly writing "Xiulan's Homemade Pickles - Five-Spice Radish" and "Xiulan's Homemade Pickles - Pickled Cucumber" on the labels. Meanwhile, I carefully stuck each label onto the corresponding jar. Mother and son chatted and laughed as they worked.
location: Kitchen and storage room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Organize the storage room and store the pickled vegetables
description: After all the jars were labeled, Mingzhe and I carefully placed this first batch of 20 jars of pickled vegetables neatly on the shelves in the cool storage room. Looking at the rows of pickles I had made with my own hands, I felt a great sense of accomplishment.
location: Storage room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Taking Mingzhe to pick up the youngest daughter from school
description: I took Mingzhe with me and rode the electric bike to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up my youngest daughter Yuxin. At the gate, Xinxin saw that her mother and older brother had come to pick her up and clapped her hands happily.
location: At the entrance to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare a low-salt dinner for the whole family
description: Back home, I let Xinxin and Mingzhe watch cartoons in the living room for a while. I put on an apron and started preparing dinner. Tonight I would make a low-salt meal that suits both my parents' and the family's tastes. I planned to make clear-simmered pork ribs (low salt), stir-fried crown daisy, and steam a plate of pickled cucumbers prepared yesterday. First I blanched the ribs to remove the gamey smell, and washed and cut the other vegetables.
location: Kitchen and living room of the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The eldest son came home from school.
description: Husband Zhiqiang called to say he had picked up our eldest son Mingxuan and they were almost home. I put down my work and went to the door to meet them. As soon as Mingxuan came in, he said he was hungry. I smiled and told him to go wash his hands first; dinner would be ready soon.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner
description: I brought the steaming hot dinner to the table, and the whole family sat around together. I specially introduced today's pickled cucumbers to everyone. My father and husband both tried them and praised the refreshing taste. Mingzhe even ate an extra steamed bun with the pickled cucumbers, and the dining table was full of warmth.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Cleaning up the kitchen and checking the children's homework
description: After dinner, I quickly cleared the dishes into the kitchen and washed them clean. Then I sat in the living room and first checked my eldest son Mingxuan's physics homework, pointing out two calculation errors. Next, I looked at Mingzhe's Chinese dictation notebook and urged him to correct his wrongly written characters. My youngest daughter Xinxin was practicing pinyin beside me. As I guided her, I was mentally planning tomorrow's arrangements.
location: Kitchen and living room of the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Helping parents soak their feet and recording household accounts.
description: I carried a pot of hot water, mixed in cold water, and took it to my parents' room on the second floor, urging them to soak their feet. After coming downstairs, I sat at the small living room table, took out the ledger, and roughly calculated today's grocery expenses (radishes + cucumbers + ginger totaled 20 yuan, airtight jars 30 yuan). I also recorded the cost and output quantity of the 20 jars of pickled vegetables so that it would be convenient to calculate the profit later.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin: parents' bedroom on the second floor, living room on the first floor.

name: Family leisure and getting the kids washed up
description: Urged the three children to take turns washing up in the bathroom. The youngest daughter Xinxin wanted her mother to help wash her hair, so I helped her wash and blow-dry it. After that, I told each child a bedtime story. Only after the children were all asleep did I wash up and change into comfortable pajamas.
location: Various rooms of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pre-bedtime stretching and couple chat
description: Back in the bedroom, my husband Zhiqiang was already lying down, and we chatted casually about the day's events. Then, as usual, I unrolled the yoga mat and did 10 minutes of pre-sleep stretching to relieve the day's tension in my shoulders, neck, and back.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Check family group messages
description: Lying in bed, I took out my phone and saw in the family group chat my elder sister Xiuyun's reply about our father's blood pressure, and my younger sister Xiufen saying she would call tomorrow to ask how things were. I went over tomorrow's plan in my mind again: I need to start preparing the ingredients for the second batch of spicy cucumber strips.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Turn off the lights and rest.
description: As I thought about it, drowsiness came over me. I turned off the bedside lamp and, with the fulfilling feeling of a busy day, gradually drifted into a dream.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Getting up, morning exercise, and health check
description: The alarm went off. Ma Xiulan slowly sat up while rubbing her sore right wrist. Outside the window the sky was overcast with a fine drizzle falling. She put on a coat and went to the bathroom to wash up. Today she deliberately chose the maroon coat with embroidery on the collar to make herself look more spirited. She did five minutes of shoulder and neck stretches on the bedroom carpet, being careful not to strain her right wrist. Then she went to the living room and measured her blood pressure with an electronic monitor: 120/80 mmHg, which put her mind at ease.
location: Master bedroom and living room of the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Prepare breakfast, eat together as a family, do after-meal chores, and take the husband and children to school
description: Put on an apron and started preparing breakfast: cooked millet porridge for parents and husband, served with steamed pickled cucumbers and fried eggs; for the children, boiled milk oatmeal and homemade ham sandwiches. Deliberately set aside his father's breakfast separately according to the low-salt standard. Loudly called upstairs for the parents to come down for breakfast, filled each person's bowl with porridge, and told the children to finish their eggs. The second child, Mingzhe, wanted another sandwich but was talked out of it. During the meal, asked the eldest, Mingxuan, about today's class schedule. She herself hastily ate a bowl of porridge with a fried egg, put the dishes in the sink, quickly wiped the dining table, checked the three children's schoolbags and water bottles, and confirmed nothing was left behind. The rain hadn't stopped, so she asked her husband Zhiqiang to drive the two children to school. At the door, she repeatedly told Mingzhe not to roughhouse with classmates and Yuxin to listen to the teacher, helped them button their raincoat buttons, and only breathed a sigh of relief after watching the car drive away.
location: Home kitchen, dining room, and doorway at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Morning outing: surveyed pickled vegetable sales at the supermarket, collected customer feedback, took notes, and shopped at the vegetable market.
description: After applying a warm compress to her wrists, Ma Xiulan changed into non-slip flat cloth shoes, picked up her long-handled umbrella from the entryway, and walked slowly along Jingwen Road toward the supermarket, carefully going around puddles on the road. Arriving at the condiment section of Jingbai Supermarket, she found the store manager, Zhang Jianmin, and asked with a smile about the pickled vegetables being sold on consignment since yesterday. Manager Zhang told her that 3 of the 5 jars delivered yesterday had already been sold, and customers all said the texture was crisp; she could replenish a few more jars tomorrow. With the manager's permission, she took the initiative to chat with customers who came to buy pickled vegetables. A middle-aged woman named Li Xiufang tasted some and said, "The flavor is quite authentic; if it were a bit spicier, it would go better with rice." Ma Xiulan quickly smiled and agreed, keeping the suggestion in mind. Then she sat down on the rest chair by the side door of the supermarket, took out a notebook and pen from her cloth bag, and wrote neatly: sold 3 jars, good texture; spiciness should be increased. She drew an asterisk next to the word "spiciness" and noted, "next time try increasing the chili ratio by 10%". When she came out of the supermarket, the rain had lightened, and she took the chance to drop by the Wutong Commune Market on the way, finding the familiar stall of Sun Guifang. Aunt Sun greeted her warmly. While selecting good-looking cucumbers, Ma Xiulan asked about the quality of the new small chili peppers arriving tomorrow and ordered 3 jin of fresh small chili peppers and 5 jin of local small cucumbers, agreeing to pick them up tomorrow afternoon.
