Then she walked home slowly with her umbrella, pondering the recipe adjustment along the way.
location: Starting from 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, I walked to Jingbai Supermarket (Building 19, Room 104, Yuzhou Zunfu, Jinghai District, Tianjin), then to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market (Jinghai District, Tianjin), and then returned home.

name: Heat therapy and rest for the wrist after returning home
description: After arriving home, I first washed my hands carefully with hand soap. The soreness in my right wrist was more obvious, so I decided to pause all housework. I boiled another pot of hot water, applied a hot towel to my wrist, and leaned back on the sofa with my eyes closed for half an hour, giving my wrist a good rest.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare a simple lunch and have lunch with the whole family
description: Mother Li Xiuying came downstairs to help pick vegetables. Mother and daughter worked together to make plain noodle soup, served with the leftover pickled cucumbers from the morning. They deliberately didn't add salt, only a few drops of sesame oil, keeping it light. Husband Zhiqiang came home for lunch, and the whole family sat together. Ma Xiulan served noodles to her father and mentioned the good news about the supermarket pickles. Zhiqiang was delighted to hear it: 'Our family's pickles have that authentic taste!' Mingzhe also chimed in that he would help Mom write labels next time. The atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: Kitchen and dining room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Lunch break and light housework
description: After the meal, she told Zhiqiang and his parents to go rest, quickly cleared the dishes, and wiped the stove counter clean with a rag. Then she lay down in the bedroom and set a 40-minute alarm to give her right wrist a complete rest.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: After the midday rest, planned the next day's ingredients, watered the flowers, and relaxed by listening to opera.
description: Waking from the midday nap, she opened WeChat on her phone and sent a voice message to Aunt Sun at the vegetable market to confirm the reservation of small chili peppers and cucumbers for tomorrow. After receiving a positive reply, she added the ingredients to the “Spicy Cucumber Strips” plan in her phone memo. She walked to the balcony, watered a few pots of pothos and spider plants, and watched the drizzle outside the window, feeling quite at ease. Back in the living room, she turned on the TV, switched to the opera channel, and listened to some Peking Opera just to relax.
location: Living room and balcony at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

Ma Xiulan put on her wrist guards, rode her electric bicycle to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up Mingzhe, then went to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up Yuxin. After picking up the children, she told them to walk carefully and not step in puddles. When they passed the small shop, she bought a lollipop for each of them. The children happily called out hello to Mom and made it home safely.

Mingxuan said the math test papers had been handed out and he scored 92. Ma Xiulan encouraged him: 'Not bad. Next time, if you fix the careless mistakes, you can do even better.'

Ma Xiulan patiently drew diagrams and explained. Beside him, Mingzhe needed help with pinyin, so she read each syllable aloud for him to follow. Her youngest daughter Yuxin was quietly drawing nearby.
location: Home kitchen and son's room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

Her husband Zhiqiang was beside her looking at his phone.

After the meal, Ma Xiulan quickly cleared the dishes, scrubbed the stove, and took out the trash, and saw her younger sister Xiufen reply in the WeChat group that their father's blood pressure was well controlled, reminding him to have a follow-up check-up.

name: Going to bed
description: At 23:00, after a quick wash, she changed into pajamas and felt that the day had been both fulfilling and warm. Lying in bed, she planned to pickle another batch of five-spice pickled vegetables early the next morning to restock the supermarket, and to confirm the weekend video call with her younger sister. Then she fell happily asleep.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning routine and checking the pickled vegetables
description: After the alarm rang, Ma Xiulan sat up gently and did a few simple shoulder and neck stretches. She threw on a coat, walked into the yard, and took a few deep breaths of the morning air. Then she went into the storage room, unscrewed the jar of spicy cucumber strips she had pickled yesterday, and used chopsticks to take one out for a taste. It was crisp and flavorful, with just the right amount of salt and spice. She then checked the condition of the other jars of five-spice pickles and, satisfied that they were all properly sealed, felt reassured.
location: Storage room in the family courtyard at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare breakfast and wake up the family.
description: Coming out of the storage room, Ma Xiulan put on an apron, reheated the leftover steamed buns and flower rolls from last night, cooked a pot of millet porridge, and fried a few eggs. In the spare moment, she went upstairs and woke her husband Ma Zhiqiang and the three children one by one. When she entered her parents' room, she gently reminded her father Ma Jianguo not to forget to take his blood pressure medication. Before 7:10, the family gradually gathered at the table and ate a simple but warm breakfast.
location: Her own kitchen and dining room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Taking the children to school
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan cleared the dishes, put the backpack on her second son Ma Mingzhe, and put the little yellow hat on her younger daughter Ma Yuxin. She got on the electric bike, first dropped Ma Mingzhe off at the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School on the way, telling him to listen carefully in class. Then she rode for seven or eight minutes, took Ma Yuxin to Huakang First Kindergarten, handed her to the teacher, and watched her skip inside.
location: From 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin) and Huakang First Kindergarten (Chaoyang Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin)

name: Pick up vegetables at the market.
description: After sending the children off, Ma Xiulan went by the Wutong Commune vegetable market and went straight to the stall of the vegetable vendor Sun Guifang. Sun Guifang smiled and brought out the 10 jin of small cucumbers, 2 jin of small chili peppers, and 2 jin of white radish she had set aside for her last night. Ma Xiulan checked the quality and found them all fresh. As Sun Guifang helped her bag them, she reminded her that fresh field cucumbers and green beans would be arriving next week, and Ma Xiulan kept that in mind.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, at the intersection of Chaoyang Road and Jingwang Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pickling a new batch of five-spice pickled vegetables
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan did not stop to rest and immediately carried the ingredients into the kitchen. She first sterilized 28 glass jars with boiling water and turned them upside down to drain. Then she washed and cut the vegetables: small cucumbers and white radish into strips, and small chili peppers into rings. She sprinkled them with salt, mixed well, and let them cure. While the vegetables were releasing water, she prepared the pickling liquid: light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, aged vinegar, white sugar, plus spices such as star anise, Sichuan peppercorns, and cinnamon bark. She brought it to a low boil, then let it cool. After the vegetables had released their water, she squeezed out the excess liquid, packed them into the jars layer by layer, poured in the pickling liquid, sealed the mouths of the jars with plastic wrap, screwed on the lids, and wiped the outside clean. Looking at the neatly lined-up jars of pickles, she felt a strong sense of accomplishment.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, own kitchen and storage room

name: Prepare lunch and taste the pickled vegetables.
description: After finishing the pickled vegetables, Ma Xiulan began preparing lunch for herself and her parents. Considering that her father Ma Jianguo had high blood pressure, she made light tomato and egg sauce noodles. She specially cut a small dish of freshly pickled spicy cucumber strips and a portion of last night's leftover soy-sauce cucumbers and put them on the table. During the meal, her father tasted the new pickles, nodded, and said they were crisp and tasty; her mother Li Xiuying also said they were better than store-bought. Ma Xiulan felt very pleased.
location: Her own kitchen and dining room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Lunch break and a nap
description: After putting away the dishes, Ma Xiulan felt a little sore in her lower back, so she lay down on the living room sofa with her eyes closed to rest. Her phone played her favorite Peking Opera excerpt from The Locked Silk Pouch at a very low volume. She did not fall asleep but, half dreaming, planned the afternoon trip to buy a blood pressure monitor, and mentally reviewed the pillowcase pattern she had embroidered with Sister Chunmei the night before.
location: Her living room sofa at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Going out to buy a blood pressure monitor and shopping at the vegetable market
description: After a brief rest, Ma Xiulan took her wallet and walked out. She first went to a medical equipment store on Shengli Street in Jinghai District, where the clerk greeted her warmly. She explained that it was for an elderly person at home, and she wanted something simple to operate with a large, clear screen. The clerk recommended an electronic blood pressure monitor priced at 280 yuan. Under the clerk's guidance, she strapped the arm cuff on herself and took a test reading; the screen showed 120/80, stable, and she was very satisfied. The clerk patiently taught her to set the elderly mode to make it easy for her father to operate. She paid and carefully put away the instruction manual and warranty card. Then she walked quickly to the Wutong Commune vegetable market and bought the planned low-sodium salt, a bunch of fresh crisp celery, and a piece of dried black fungus. On the way, she also stopped at the Jingbai Supermarket at the neighborhood gate to buy a pack of AA batteries, intending to put them in the blood pressure monitor. After returning home, she placed the new blood pressure monitor on the living room coffee table, put the vegetables in the kitchen, and soaked the celery in water.

participant.name: Shop assistant.
participant.relation: Clerk at a medical equipment store

location: Medical device store in Jinghai District (near No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin), then to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market (at the intersection of Chaoyang Road and Jingwang Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin), and finally back home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Researching blood pressure monitors and tidying up the house
description: After getting settled, Ma Xiulan sat down and carefully studied the blood pressure monitor’s instruction manual. She photographed the key operating steps with her phone so she could zoom in and show her father when teaching him. She also wrote down the usage steps and precautions in a small notebook, then took her own blood pressure again to make sure she was operating it correctly. Later, taking advantage of the quiet afternoon, she moved the jars of pickled vegetables she had made that morning onto the shelves in the storage room, arranging them neatly by type and counting exactly 28 jars. Finally, she wiped the floor and countertops of the storage room with a cloth to keep everything clean.
location: Living room and storage room at her home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the child from school
description: At 4 p.m., Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike out again. She first went to the gate of No. 3 Primary School in Jinghai District and waited for a while. Her second son, Ma Mingzhe, came out with his classmates; as soon as she waved, he ran over. After picking him up, she took him to the nearby Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up her youngest daughter, Ma Yuxin. Both children got on the bike and chattered behind her about interesting things at school. Ma Yuxin said she had drawn a little rabbit today, and Ma Mingzhe said he had been praised by the teacher in math class.
location: From 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin) and Huakang First Kindergarten (Chaoyang Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin)

name: Helping with homework and preparing ingredients for dinner
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan told her second son, Ma Mingzhe, to do his math homework at the desk in the living room, and let her youngest daughter, Ma Yuxin, draw by herself. She then put on an apron and started preparing dinner. She cut celery into sections, soaked and washed the black fungus, and took the frozen chicken breast out of the fridge to thaw, planning to make a few light and delicious home-style dishes.
location: Her living room and kitchen at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Prepare and enjoy dinner
description: At 5:30, Ma Xiulan started cooking. Tonight she made stir-fried celery with black fungus, Kung Pao chicken (deliberately with less oil and salt, reduced sugar, and using chicken thigh meat for extra tenderness), and seaweed egg drop soup, and also reheated the leftover tomato sauce noodles from lunch. When the dishes were served, her husband Ma Zhiqiang arrived home just in time. The whole family sat around the table together. She served her father Ma Jianguo a bowl of celery, saying it was good for lowering blood pressure. At the table, the children chatted about funny things at school, and the atmosphere was very warm.
location: Her own kitchen and dining room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tidy up the kitchen and continue helping with homework.
description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan asked her husband Ma Zhiqiang to go accompany his parents watching TV, while she briskly cleared the dining table, washed the bowls and chopsticks, and wiped the kitchen stove clean. Then she sat down in the living room and began to check her second son Ma Mingzhe's math homework. She found that a few word problems had the right approach but had careless calculation errors, so she patiently explained them to him. Her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin was quietly playing with play dough nearby, shaping a lopsided little duck.
location: Kitchen and living room of the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Teaching father to use the blood pressure monitor and reminding him to keep records
description: Taking advantage of the children having quieted down, Ma Xiulan took the newly bought blood pressure monitor and batteries to her parents' room. While putting the batteries into the monitor, she said with a smile, "Dad, I bought you a new gadget. From now on, you can measure your blood pressure yourself anytime." She asked her father Ma Jianguo to sit on the edge of the bed, then took out the step-by-step photos saved on her phone and taught him one step at a time how to wrap the arm cuff (it should be tight enough to fit one finger in) and how to press the start button. Her father was a little nervous during the first test, and the reading was high. She smiled and comforted him, "It's all right, don't be nervous. Just relax and do it the same as usual." After chatting about family trivialities for a while, once her father relaxed, she measured again. This time it was 135/85, within the normal range. Her mother Li Xiuying watched from the side and also thought the device was convenient. Afterward, Ma Xiulan wrote down the measured values in a notebook and posted it on the wall at the head of the bed. Then she took out sticky notes and wrote the key steps in large characters: "Sit still for 5 minutes first, then wrap the arm cuff (one-finger tightness), and finally press the start button." She told her father to measure once every morning and evening, and said she would come every evening to check the records. Her father nodded and said, "Okay, got it. This child knows better than before how to take care of people."
location: Parents' room on the second floor of home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Check family accounts and prepare for the video conference.
description: Coming out of her parents' room, Ma Xiulan returned to the living room and took out her small accounting notebook. She carefully recorded the day's expenses: blood pressure monitor 280 yuan, groceries (celery, black fungus, salt) 18 yuan, batteries 4 yuan, total 302 yuan. She also recorded the varieties, quantities, and material costs of the 28 jars of pickled vegetables she had newly made today in the notebook. Thinking that when she video-called Sister Chunmei, Aunt Wu and the others tomorrow morning, she could show them the sample list and quotation, and discuss the details of setting up a stall at next week's market, she felt quite hopeful.
location: Home living room at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Washing up and putting the children to bed
description: After finishing these things, Ma Xiulan urged her second son Ma Mingzhe and younger daughter Ma Yuxin to go wash up. She helped Ma Yuxin wash her face and brush her teeth, and checked that Ma Mingzhe had the textbooks and exercise books he needed for the next day. Once everything was in order, she picked up the picture book The Little Prince, which she hadn't finished the day before, and told the children a few pages of the story. When she came to the part where the little prince tames the fox, Ma Yuxin asked softly, "Mom, what does 'tame' mean?" She said gently, "It means two people have built a connection and become unique to each other." Soon after, Ma Yuxin fell asleep first, and Ma Mingzhe turned over and also sank into a deep sleep.
location: Children's room and bathroom, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Late-night couple talk and going to bed.
description: After settling the children, Ma Xiulan returned to the master bedroom. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang was leaning against the headboard looking at his phone. While changing into her pajamas, she told him about buying the blood pressure monitor today and teaching her father how to use it. Ma Zhiqiang nodded and said, "Okay, you've taken care of it. With you looking after Dad, I can rest easy when I'm away." They chatted for a few more minutes about his driving trip tomorrow and the plan to have dinner at her parents' house next weekend. As they talked, they both grew tired, and she turned off the bedside lamp, ready to sleep. Although the day had been busy, seeing that the whole family, young and old, were doing well, she felt at peace.
location: Own master bedroom at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Get up in the morning, stretch, prepare and enjoy breakfast, and tidy up afterward.
description: At 7 a.m., the alarm went off. Ma Xiulan got up quietly and did a 5-minute shoulder and neck stretch by the bed to relieve the shoulder soreness from making pickled vegetables. She then went into the kitchen, tied on an apron, and carefully prepared the family breakfast: she simmered millet porridge, pan-fried sliced mantou until golden on both sides, made scallion and egg pancakes, and chopped scallions with her homemade soybean paste as a side dish for the porridge. As the family members got up one after another and sat around the dining table, Ma Xiulan served porridge to her father Ma Jianguo and reminded him to take his blood pressure medication. Her younger daughter Ma Yuxin drank porridge by herself, getting rice grains all around her mouth. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang praised her skill at pan-frying the mantou slices. After breakfast, Ma Xiulan quickly cleared the table and wiped the kitchen clean, then went back to the bedroom to change into a clean floral jacket, ready for going out shopping.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Walk to Xingwang Vegetable Market to order pickled vegetable ingredients, drop by Jingbai Supermarket to shop, and then go home.
description: At 8:30, Ma Xiulan locked the door, walked about 15 minutes along Jingwen Road, and arrived at Xingwang Vegetable Market on Shengli Street. At the stall of her acquaintance Sun Guifang, she bought spinach and white radish, and also ordered 20 jin of fresh cucumbers and 10 jin of chili peppers for the pickles she planned to make next week. Aunt Sun readily agreed and threw in a bunch of scallions she had grown herself. After leaving the market, she stepped into the Jingbai Supermarket on Jingwen Road and selected two rolls of toilet paper, a 2.5kg bag of washing powder, and two glass sealing jars. After waiting in line, she paid less than 30 yuan. Then she carried her things home. When she reached the downstairs entrance, she heard her daughter Xinxin laughing inside; she pushed open the door and put the groceries and daily necessities away.
location: Xingwang Vegetable Market, Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jingbai Supermarket, Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District

name: Video group chat with sisters to discuss plans for a pickled vegetable stall
description: Ma Xiulan had a group video call on the living room sofa with Liu Chunmei, Li Xiuyun, and Ma Xiufen. She first shared the good news of successfully making 28 jars of pickled vegetables the day before, then went straight to the topic of setting up a stall: they planned to prepare small tasting dishes to attract customers, and first make simple promotional signs this week. Liu Chunmei said that the small night market at the street corner allowed stalls but required a management fee. The elder and younger sisters also mentioned the popular trend of livestreaming while selling at a stall. Everyone contributed suggestions one after another, and Ma Xiulan listened carefully while jotting down key points in a small notebook, making full preparations for the upcoming stall.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tidying up the house and preparing materials for the afternoon craft session.
description: After the video call ended, Ma Xiulan first went to check the 28 jars of pickled vegetables neatly arranged in the storage room, feeling reassured. Then she took out scraps of red, yellow, blue, green, pink and other colored cloth from her sewing box, and found cardboard, white glue, and a pair of safety scissors. When her daughter Ma Yuxin saw these materials, she immediately ran over to ask. Ma Xiulan smiled and promised to make handicraft collages together in the afternoon. Xinxin happily ran off to play with her brother, while Ma Xiulan continued to arrange the materials neatly on the coffee table, getting ready for the parent-child time after lunch.
location: Storage room and living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare a hearty lunch with her husband, share it as a family, and take a midday rest.
description: Ma Xiulan put on an apron and prepared lunch. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang took the initiative to come into the kitchen to help, cutting garlic scapes into sections and reheating yesterday's braised pork belly. The two chatted while working. Ma Zhiqiang talked about the recent route adjustment for his driving job, and Ma Xiulan advised him not to push himself too hard. On the dining table, besides garlic scape stir-fried meat and braised pork belly, there was also smashed cucumber mixed with garlic and vinegar. The whole family sat around the table to eat. Their son Mingxuan, in the middle of a growth spurt, ate two bowls of rice. Her father Ma Jianguo had a good appetite and ate most of a bowl. The youngest daughter Xinxin, with her mouth stuffed full, mumbled, "Delicious!" After lunch, Ma Zhiqiang took the initiative to clear the table and wash the dishes. Ma Xiulan leaned against the sofa to rest for a while, and Xinxin ran over to urge her to do crafts, so she got up and got ready.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Making a fabric collage with daughter Ma Yuxin and tidying up the tools
description: Ma Xiulan and her daughter Xinxin sat facing each other on the carpet, making a collage from fabric scraps. Ma Xiulan cut petals from pink fabric, let Xinxin apply glue and stick them on, then cut leaves and a stem from green fabric to form a flower. Xinxin suggested making a butterfly, so Ma Xiulan cut wings from yellow fabric, and Xinxin drew the body with a black marker. In an hour and a half, the two completed a picture with flowers, a butterfly, the sun, and clouds. Xinxin held up the picture and shouted, “I’m going to stick it on the fridge!” then ran over and put it up. Afterward, Ma Xiulan put the loose scraps, scissors, and glue back into the sewing box, used newspaper to wrap up the bits, and the living room was tidy again.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing dinner ingredients, cooking with her husband Ma Zhiqiang, having dinner with the family, and cleaning up
description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan took ribs out of the refrigerator to thaw, planning to make the clear-simmered ribs her father loved, and prepared lotus root to make sweet and sour lotus root slices. Her eldest son Mingxuan finished his homework and came over to help peel garlic. While peeling potatoes, she asked Mingxuan about his physics class. Toward evening, her husband Ma Zhiqiang woke up from his nap and came into the kitchen, and the old-partner mode began: Zhiqiang blanched the ribs and skimmed off the scum, while Xiulan sliced the lotus root and green peppers. After heating the oil, Xiulan caramelized the sugar for color, added the ribs and stir-fried them to coat evenly, then added ginger slices, scallion segments, star anise, and boiling water, and simmered over low heat. She also stir-fried sweet and sour lotus root slices and sautéed baby bok choy, and the kitchen filled with aroma. At dinner, the whole family was full of praise for the ribs. Her father said the meat was so tender it was easy to chew, and Xinxin mixed rib soup into her rice and ate until her mouth was shiny with oil. They also talked about Mingxuan's monthly exam next week. After dinner, Ma Zhiqiang volunteered to wash the dishes.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family walk in the community garden after the rain
description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan changed into cloth shoes, grabbed a jacket and walking cane for her father Ma Jianguo, and the family slowly walked to the small garden in the Jingwen Road community. The air was fresh after the rain, with the scent of earth and grass. In the garden, the roses were blooming brightly and the late cherry blossoms were still in bud. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang supported her father by the arm; her sons Mingxuan and Mingzhe chased each other ahead, and her daughter Xinxin skipped and ran around the flower beds like a butterfly. The whole family walked two laps along the path. When her father got tired, he sat on a bench to rest, watching his grandchildren play, his face full of contented smiles. The fatigue of the day seemed to melt away in the warm and harmonious atmosphere.
location: Small garden in the Jingwen Road Community, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Help son Ma Mingzhe and daughter Ma Yuxin with their homework.
description: After returning home from the walk, her husband went upstairs with his parents to rest, while Ma Xiulan urged Mingzhe and Xinxin to start their homework. Mingzhe got two questions wrong in mental arithmetic, and she patiently had him redo them. Xinxin drew a little rabbit for the picture homework assigned by the kindergarten teacher. Ma Xiulan helped her color it more evenly and encouraged her to use her creativity. After the children finished their homework one after another, Ma Xiulan let them pack their schoolbags themselves to develop good habits.
location: Study at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Record daily family accounts and check tomorrow's weather.
description: After helping with homework, Ma Xiulan sat at the desk by the window in the living room, took out her worn accounting book, and carefully recorded the day's expenses: 5 yuan for vegetables at Sun Guifang's vegetable stall and 28 yuan for daily necessities at Jingbai Supermarket. She also checked yesterday's family accounts and wrote every item clearly. After that, she opened the weather app on her phone and saw that tomorrow was forecast to be cloudy turning sunny with the temperature rising, so she thought she could take the thick quilts out of the storage room to air them while the weather was good.
location: At the desk at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Bathed her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin, put her to sleep, and told her a bedtime story
description: After finishing the accounts, Ma Xiulan called Xinxin to take a bath. She ran the warm water, lifted her daughter into the tub, washed her hair and body, changed her into clean pajamas, then carried her to the little bed and tucked her in. She also went by Mingzhe's room and, seeing that he was still reading an extracurricular book, urged him to go to bed early. Back in Xinxin's room, her daughter grabbed her hand and wouldn't let go, so Ma Xiulan sat on the edge of the bed and softly began telling the story of The Little Prince—about the little prince, the rose, and the fox. Before the story was finished, Xinxin's eyelids began to droop, and she gradually fell asleep.
location: The bathroom and daughter's bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Brief exchange with husband Ma Zhiqiang before bed, washing up together, and going to bed
description: After coaxing Xinxin to sleep, Ma Xiulan returned to the master bedroom. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang was leaning against the headboard looking at driver job listings on his phone. She sat on the edge of the bed and chatted with him about the day: she had ordered next week's pickle ingredients at the vegetable market, video-called with her sisters to discuss setting up a stall, and Xinxin's handmade painting was especially fun. Ma Zhiqiang also said he probably wouldn't travel far next week, only a few short trips within the city. The two then discussed taking the children to fly kites at the new park once the weather improved. After chatting for a while, they took turns washing up in the bathroom and then lay back in bed. Ma Xiulan went over the day in her mind: the vegetables were ordered, the craft was done, the walk was taken, and the accounts were recorded. Life was plain but fulfilling, and she soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: Master bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning stretching and morning walk
description: After the phone alarm rang, Ma Xiulan got up quietly so as not to wake her husband. She first did a 5-minute shoulder and neck stretch by the bedroom window on the second floor, feeling the morning sunlight. Then she changed into exercise clothes, tiptoed downstairs, and brisk-walked around the neighborhood for about 15 minutes, enjoying the fresh spring air. When she got back to the front door, she deliberately glanced at the half-worn gray sneakers on the shoe rack, planning to use them for the afternoon walk.
location: The second-floor bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and the small community garden nearby

name: Preparing a hearty breakfast and enjoying it with the whole family
description: After the walk, Ma Xiulan returned to the first-floor kitchen at home and poured a glass of warm water. She took the thawed pork ribs and pickled cabbage from the refrigerator and began making pickled cabbage rib rice noodle soup, and pan-fried scallion egg pancakes to go with homemade pickled cucumbers. Around 7:50, she woke the children and her husband. The whole family sat around the dining table; Xiulan served the pickled cabbage rib noodle soup and egg pancakes. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang ate until he was sweating, and her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin crunched loudly on the pickled cucumbers. The family enjoyed a warm Sunday breakfast.
location: Kitchen and dining room on the first floor of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tidy the kitchen, hunt for sports shoes, and clean up the phone.
description: After breakfast, Ma Xiulan told the family to rest and quickly cleared the table, washed the dishes, and put them away. Then she went up to the storage room on the second floor, found that pair of slightly worn gray sneakers, tried them on, and found them comfortable. She wiped them clean with a damp cloth and placed them in the shoe cabinet at the entrance. Next she sat on the living room sofa, opened her phone, cleaned up useless screenshots and duplicate videos in her photo album, and downloaded a highly rated step-counting app from the app store. After registering, she set the daily goal to 6,000 steps.
location: The kitchen on the first floor, storage room on the second floor, and living room on the first floor at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Cycling to her parents' home to visit family and help her parents with chores
description: Ma Xiulan put two bottles of freshly pickled spicy cucumber strips into the bike basket and rode her electric bike to her parents' home. About 10 minutes later, she arrived at her mother's courtyard at 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District. Seeing her mother Li Xiuying sprinkling water, she took over the watering can and helped clean weeds and loosen soil in the vegetable plot. Then she went inside and used a digital blood pressure monitor to measure her father Ma Jianguo's blood pressure; it was stable at 135/84. She recorded it on a sticky note and reminded her father to measure it on time. Father and daughter chatted warmly.
location: The courtyard and living room of her parents' home at No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Return home and prepare lunch
description: Ma Xiulan said goodbye to her parents and rode her electric bike back. Passing the vegetable shop at the entrance of the neighborhood, she bought tender chives and fresh tofu. After returning home, she went straight into the kitchen, tied on an apron, and prepared to make chive and egg dumplings. She quickly chopped the filling, kneaded the dough, rolled out the wrappers, and wrapped the dumplings, arranging them neatly on the dumpling board to prepare lunch for her family.
location: The vegetable shop at the entrance of the residential community at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and the kitchen on the first floor of her home.

name: The whole family enjoys lunch.
description: Steaming hot dumplings and clear tofu soup were brought to the table. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang ate two plates, dipping them in vinegar and chili oil. The two sons competed to see who could eat until their little bellies were round. The eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, chatted with his father about funny things at school while eating. The home was filled with the warmth of happiness.
location: First-floor dining room of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Lunch break
description: After lunch, her husband and the children each rested. Ma Xiulan cleaned up the kitchen, then went to the living room sofa, turned on the TV to the opera channel, but mainly leaned back against the sofa with her eyes closed, resting quietly for about half an hour to store up energy for the afternoon.
location: First-floor living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Organize the family photo albums.
description: After her afternoon nap, Ma Xiulan went to the study, opened the old laptop, imported more than a hundred photos taken with her phone over the past two months into the computer, and created a new folder '2025 Spring' to organize them. The photos included her father's birthday, a big family cleaning, a bountiful vegetable garden, and close-ups of the pickled vegetables. She sighed at how fast time flies and decided to pick a few photos each month to print and put into the family album.
location: Study at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Apply spring fertilizer to the persimmon tree
description: Ma Xiulan carried a small iron bucket to the backyard, dug shallow pits around the roots of the not-too-tall persimmon tree, buried the organic fertilizer composted before the New Year from vegetable leaves and soybean dregs, then refilled the soil and slowly watered it thoroughly with a hose. She gently touched the tender green new leaves, looking forward to the branches full of fruit in autumn.
location: Backyard of the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family time: doing crafts, helping with homework, and preparing dinner
description: After returning from the backyard, Ma Xiulan sat in the living room with her younger daughter Ma Yuxin doing sticker craft. Her second son Ma Mingzhe asked for help with a math problem, so she went to the study to patiently tutor him. Starting at 16:30, she went into the kitchen to begin preparing a hearty dinner. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang also came in to help trim vegetables, and the two worked together while chatting about family matters in a harmonious atmosphere.
location: Living room, study, and kitchen on the first floor at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner, cleaning up, and supervising homework
description: A rich dinner: braised pork ribs, stir-fried baby bok choy, steamed bass, and tomato egg drop soup. The whole family sat around and shared the meal. The eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, mentioned next week's monthly exam, and the little daughter showed off her stickers. After dinner, Ma Xiulan quickly cleared the dishes and wiped the stove, then urged her two sons to go into the study to do their homework. Ma Mingxuan did his test papers on his own, while Ma Mingzhe dawdled a bit. Xiulan sat nearby embroidering a peony pillowcase, supervising as she sewed.
location: First-floor dining room, kitchen, and study at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Get the children settled for baths and call the vegetable vendor.
description: The weather was a little cool. Ma Xiulan first bathed her youngest daughter, Ma Yuxin, changed her into soft pajamas, and told her two stories to get her to sleep. When she came downstairs, she saw her husband watching TV, so she called Aunt Sun Guifang at the vegetable market to confirm that she would go next Friday to pick up the pre-ordered 20 jin of cucumbers and 10 jin of peppers. Aunt Sun readily agreed. After that, she opened her step-counting app and saw that she had walked 3,500 steps, still a little short of her goal.
location: Second-floor bathroom and first-floor living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Chat with husband to plan next week.
description: Ma Xiulan and her husband Ma Zhiqiang returned to their second-floor bedroom and leaned against the headboard chatting. She mentioned that her father's blood pressure had been good that morning, and that next Friday she would pick up vegetables to make a new batch of pickled vegetables for the handicraft market. Her husband expressed support and was willing to help carry things. The two discussed the family chores for the coming week.
location: Second-floor bedroom in the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Evening washing up, relaxation, journaling, and bedtime
description: After chatting, Ma Xiulan went to the bathroom to wash up, carefully cleansed her face, and applied skincare products. Back in bed, she did a few minutes of pre-sleep neck and shoulder stretches. Then she picked up her phone, recorded the day's expenses in the memo (15 yuan for groceries), checked tomorrow's weather (sunny, comfortable temperature), put the phone on silent, and placed it on the nightstand. Finally, she gently turned off the bedside lamp. Listening to her husband's steady breathing, she felt at ease and full of anticipation for tomorrow, and soon fell asleep.
location: The bathroom and bedroom on the second floor of the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning wake-up, stretching, and walk
description: At 6:30 in the morning, Ma Xiulan was woken by the alarm clock. Sitting on the edge of the bed, she did shoulder and neck stretches to loosen up her muscles and joints. She opened the curtains and saw the clear weather, feeling cheerful. Then she got out of bed and washed her face with warm water to fully wake herself up. After changing into her sports shoes, she walked slowly around the neighborhood for morning exercise, moving her arms as she walked. Seeing the peach blossoms in full bloom and feeling the spring breeze on her face, she felt refreshed and energized.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and the nearby Chunxiyuan Community

name: Prepare and enjoy breakfast for the whole family.
description: After exercising, Ma Xiulan cooked millet porridge, made scallion pancakes, and boiled free-range eggs in the kitchen. She also woke the two children to wash up, and her husband Ma Zhiqiang also got up. At 7:20, the whole family sat around the table for breakfast. Ma Xiulan reminded her second son Ma Mingzhe to wear sports shoes for PE class, told her younger daughter Ma Yuxin to bring her small nap pillow, and her husband Ma Zhiqiang said he was on a short-distance trip today and could come home for lunch.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Taking the two children to school.
description: Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to first take her second son Ma Mingzhe to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, going along Jingwen Road then to Shengli Avenue and then Shengli South Street, arriving at the school at exactly 7:50, and watched him walk into the school gate. Then she turned around and a few minutes later arrived at Huakang First Kindergarten, handed her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin to Teacher Liu, told her to drink more water, and watched her enter the classroom.
location: Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School on Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Bought groceries at the vegetable market and chatted with the stall owner
description: After dropping off the children, Ma Xiulan stopped by the Wutong Commune vegetable market on the way. At the stall of her familiar vendor Sun Guifang, she picked out tofu, baby bok choy, and pork belly, spending fifteen yuan. At the same time, she confirmed with Sun Guifang that she would pick up the reserved twenty catties of ground cucumbers and ten catties of chili peppers next Friday. Sun Guifang warmly promised to set them aside.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Go home to tidy up
description: After returning home from grocery shopping, Ma Xiulan sorted the vegetables and put them in the fridge, wiped down the kitchen counter, put the dishes and chopsticks back in place, and loaded the dirty clothes into the washing machine on the quick wash setting. She also tidied up the picture books and toys the children had scattered on the living room sofa, leaving the house neat and orderly again.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Calculate the family's March income and expenses and analyze the balance
description: Ma Xiulan made tea, then sat down at the coffee table in the living room to organize her account book and receipts. First, she calculated March income: her husband Ma Zhiqiang's salary of 4,000 yuan, 300 yuan from her own handicraft odd jobs, and 80 yuan from childhood friend Liu Chunmei's transfer for trial sales of pickled vegetables, for a total income of 4,380 yuan. She then checked expenses item by item: 800 yuan as her share of her father's hospitalization, 120 yuan for pickled vegetable ingredients, 60 yuan for glass jars, 150 yuan for education savings, and about 2,500 yuan for daily expenses, for total expenses of 3,630 yuan. She calculated a March balance of 750 yuan. At the same time, she separately listed the subtotal for pickled vegetable income and expenses: 80 yuan in income and 180 yuan in expenses, a temporary loss of 100 yuan. She realized she needed to recoup the cost at the April market fair.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Made the April family budget plan
description: Ma Xiulan turned to a new page in the ledger and began planning the April budget. She wrote down market stall fee 200 yuan, additional packaging materials 100 yuan, daily household expenses 2,500 yuan, and education savings 150 yuan. She hesitated over the item for her husband's cigarette money, decided to keep it within 300 yuan, and finally set a total budget of 3,250 yuan, leaving room for a surplus.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Simple lunch and a phone call to say hello to parents
description: At noon, Ma Xiulan cooked a bowl of noodles in pork rib soup, blanched a few leafy greens, and simply settled her lunch. While eating, she called her parents who live on Shengli Street. Her mother told her that her father's blood pressure was 135 over 82 and relatively stable. Ma Xiulan urged them to take their blood pressure medicine on time and measure it again in the afternoon. Her father, who was nearby, told her not to worry, and then they hung up.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Midday nap
description: Ma Xiulan leaned back on the living room sofa and rested with her eyes closed for twenty minutes, storing up energy for the afternoon.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Hand embroidery and budget considerations
description: Ma Xiulan took out the embroidered handkerchief to do the finishing work. In the sunlight, she held the embroidery needle and sketched out the last few petals of the peony. At the same time, she kept turning over the April budget in her mind, especially thinking about how to broach the matter of the fifty yuan her husband had overspent on cigarettes last month.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Supermarket shopping and asking for feedback on pickled vegetables.
description: Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to Jingbai Supermarket to buy Weijixian soy sauce and flour. Then she went to the fresh food section to find the store manager, Zhang Jianmin, and asked about the trial sales of spicy cucumber strips. Zhang Jianmin told her that all five jars from last time were sold out, and some customers said the taste was good but could be spicier. Ma Xiulan happily responded that she would improve it next time and felt hopeful about her pickled vegetable business.

participant.name: Zhang Jianmin
participant.relation: Store manager of Jingbai Supermarket, an acquaintance

location: Jingbai Supermarket, Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Returned home for a brief rest
description: Ma Xiulan returned home with the flour and soy sauce she had bought, put the items away, drank a glass of warm water, checked the time on her phone, and prepared to pick up her child after school.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the two children from school and take them home
description: At three in the afternoon, Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike first to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up her second son Ma Mingzhe. She took his schoolbag and had him stand on the footboard. Then she went to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin and placed her in the rear child seat. The three of them returned home noisily along the way.
location: Shengli South Street and Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to 156 Jingwen Road

name: Helping with homework and preparing dinner ingredients
description: After getting home, Ma Xiulan urged her second son Ma Mingzhe to do his homework and took time to praise her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin's kindergarten artwork. While taking pork ribs out of the fridge to thaw and washing baby bok choy and tomatoes, she explained math word problems to Ma Mingzhe, then played with blocks with Ma Yuxin.
location: Living room and kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Preparing dinner for the whole family
description: At five o'clock, Ma Xiulan started cooking dinner. She made braised pork ribs slowly simmered with caramelized sugar, stir-fried baby bok choy, and tomato egg drop soup. While she was cooking, her husband Ma Zhiqiang and eldest son Ma Mingxuan came home one after another. Mingxuan smelled the ribs and exclaimed how delicious they smelled. The home was filled with the warm, lively atmosphere of family cooking.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The whole family has dinner together and chats about their daily lives.
description: At six o'clock the food was on the table, and all five family members sat around it. Ma Mingzhe shared that he had jumped rope 120 times in physical education class; Ma Yuxin proudly mentioned that the teacher had praised her painting; Ma Mingxuan talked about the circuit experiment in physics class. Ma Xiulan and her husband Ma Zhiqiang listened to the children's lively conversation, and also shared feedback from the supermarket on the pickled vegetables. Ma Zhiqiang expressed support for his wife to continue making pickled vegetables.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Cleaning up the kitchen and helping the eldest son with his homework
description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan had her husband watch TV with the children while she cleared the dishes and wiped down the stove. She then checked Ma Mingzhe's homework and signed it. After that, her eldest son Ma Mingxuan asked her about a physics circuit diagram problem. She patiently drew diagrams on scratch paper and explained until Mingxuan understood.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Communicated with her husband and agreed on the April family budget
description: After coaxing her younger daughter to sleep, Ma Xiulan took the ledger and had an honest conversation with her husband Ma Zhiqiang in the bedroom about the April budget. She raised the issue that her husband had overspent his cigarette allowance by fifty yuan last month, speaking in a calm tone. Ma Zhiqiang felt a little embarrassed but finally promised to strictly control it at ten yuan per day next month and not exceed the budget. The two reached a consensus, and Ma Xiulan felt a great weight lifted from her heart.
location: Master bedroom of the home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening personal activities and going to bed
description: After communicating with her husband, Ma Xiulan felt relaxed. At her desk, she wrote in her journal, recording that in March she had persisted in walking for seventeen days and that her physical condition had improved, and wrote plans for morning walks in April, inviting Wang Guilan or Liu Chunmei to accompany her. Then she did ten minutes of bedtime stretching, went to the bathroom to wash up, used her account book to note the day's expenses (15 yuan for groceries, 20 yuan at the supermarket), and checked her phone to confirm that tomorrow would be sunny. She turned off the main light, lay in bed and had an intimate talk with her husband, feeling that life was getting better and feeling at ease. At 21:45, after saying goodnight, they turned off the night light and rested peacefully.
location: Master bedroom and bathroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Get up, wash up, and change clothes
description: Ma Xiulan woke up half an hour earlier than usual. With the start of April and the pickled vegetables on her mind, she didn't lie down again. After a quick wash-up, she changed into sneakers and a loose jacket, ready to go out for some fresh air.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning exercise at the street park and buying breakfast.
description: Ma Xiulan walked briskly along the sidewalk on Jingwen Road to Central Park, walked two fast laps around the rubber track in the park, and recorded it with the pedometer app on her phone. On the way home, she ran into her neighbor Sun Guifang, who was coming back from buying vegetables early in the morning, and they exchanged a brief greeting. She then stopped by the 'Old Wang's Soy Milk' stall next to Central Park and bought two yuan worth of freshly ground soy milk. After arriving home, she washed the rice and cooked multigrain porridge, and chopped scallions to prepare egg pancakes.

participant.name: The owner of Old Wang Tou's soy milk stall

location: Street park on Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and the adjacent Old Wang's soy milk stall, finally returning to the home kitchen at 156 Jingwen Road.

name: Family breakfast
description: Ma Xiulan woke up the second child, Mingzhe, and her youngest daughter, Xinxin, at 6:45, urging them to get dressed and wash up. Around 7:00, the family sat around the table for breakfast, with multigrain porridge and egg pancakes. She gave Xinxin, who loved to linger in bed, an extra piece of egg pancake and told Mingzhe not to be distracted in class. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang said while eating that he had to make a short trip to Tanggu tomorrow to pick up goods, and that he could come home for dinner tonight.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Get ready and take the two children to school
description: Ma Xiulan quickly tidied up the kitchen and urged Mingzhe and Xinxin to check their backpacks and put on their coats. She rode her e-bike, first taking Mingzhe to the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School and watching him walk into the school. Then she took Xinxin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten and greeted the teacher. After dropping off the children, she felt somewhat relieved and rode back home.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Call parents to say hello and handle household chores
description: Back home, Ma Xiulan first called her parents at their home at 45 Shengli Street. Her mother, Li Xiuying, answered and said her father's blood pressure was stable, telling her not to worry. Ma Xiulan mentioned that she had to deal with the return of the pickled vegetables today, and her mother comforted her not to rush. After that, she stuffed yesterday's clothes into the washing machine, quickly mopped the floor, and tidied the living room, all the while thinking about the supermarket's phone call and glancing at her phone from time to time.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Answering a return call and talking with her childhood friend.
description: Zhang Jianmin, manager of Jingbai Supermarket, called and said in a troubled tone that for the second batch of 'Xiulan Handmade Pickled Vegetables', some customers reported that they tasted salty and bitter and asked for refunds, so the store did not dare to continue selling them for now. Ma Xiulan calmed herself down and asked Manager Zhang to set aside the 10 returned jars of pickles; she would pick them up later. After hanging up, she took out her notebook and quickly calculated: raw materials plus bottles and labor, a net loss of 200 yuan. Feeling upset, she called her childhood friend Liu Chunmei to vent. Liu Chunmei, being blunt and outspoken, complained that she was too careless, told her not to take it to heart, and to pay more attention next time.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Went to Jingbai Supermarket to process a return, then returned home to analyze the cause.
description: Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to Jingbai Supermarket. Manager Zhang was waiting for her at the entrance, with a cardboard box of pickled vegetables on the ground. After thanking him, she moved the 10 returned jars of pickled vegetables onto the footboard of her electric bike. Manager Zhang comforted her, saying that they could try again after he adjusted the recipe. When she got home, she lined up the pickle jars one by one on the kitchen counter, opened the lids to smell and taste, and confirmed they were so salty they tasted bitter. Leaning against the stove, she kept thinking back to the salt ratio used when pickling, then wiped the jars clean and put them in the cabinet.
location: Jingbai Supermarket, Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and the kitchen of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Simple Lunch and Nap
description: Something was weighing on her mind, so she had little appetite at noon. Ma Xiulan cooked a small pot of hanging noodles for herself and made do with the previously pickled spiced vegetables as a topping. While eating, she sent Liu Chunmei a WeChat message saying, "It was a bit salty; I'll pay attention next time." After eating, she leaned back on the living room sofa and closed her eyes to rest for half an hour, but with the pickled vegetable matter turning over and over in her head, she didn't really fall asleep.
location: Kitchen, dining room, and living room sofa at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Organize the family ledger and plan the April budget
description: After the lunch break, Ma Xiulan took out the family ledger, checked the March accounts, and confirmed that the balance of 750 yuan was correct. Then she turned to a new page to write the April budget, crossed out the 200 yuan in the education savings column, and solemnly wrote 100 yuan. She sent a WeChat message to her husband Ma Zhiqiang, who was out driving, to discuss it. He quickly replied with an OK. She wrote a note beside it: increase income and reduce spending.
location: Study at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Embroidery for calming the mind and re-checking the accounts
description: Ma Xiulan took out the half-embroidered peony pillowcase and embroidery hoop, sat on the sofa, and began to embroider the petals, her mood gradually calming. Forty minutes later, she put down the hoop and returned to the study. She recorded the account "net loss of 200 yuan from pickled vegetable returns" separately on the last pages of the ledger and wrote "lesson: must adjust the recipe." Then on the April 1 grid of the calendar she wrote "new starting point," and mentally planned to simplify the ingredients tomorrow and retry a small batch of pickled vegetables.
location: Living room and study at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the two children from school.
description: The phone alarm rang. Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike first to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up Xinxin, then went to the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to wait for Mingzhe. As soon as the children got on, they chattered about fun things at school. Ma Xiulan listened, and her brow relaxed a little.
location: Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School on Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin; return home to No. 156 Jingwen Road

name: Supervise the children's homework and prepare dinner
description: After getting home, Ma Xiulan washed the children's hands and gave them snacks. She had Ming Zhe do his homework in the living room while Xin Xin drew pictures beside him. She went into the kitchen, took pork tenderloin from the fridge to make sweet-and-sour pork, her eldest son's favorite, and cut garlic scapes and soaked black fungus to prepare home-style dishes. When her eldest son Ma Mingxuan came home from school and called out 'Mom' before going to his room, Ma Xiulan quickened her pace and plated the last dish.
location: Living room and kitchen at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner and discussing family matters
description: Her husband, Ma Zhiqiang, came back just before mealtime, and the family sat together. Ma Xiulan deliberately placed the sweet and sour pork in front of her eldest son. At the table, she brought up the pickled vegetable return in a low voice. Her husband comforted her, saying if they lost money on it, they lost money, and not to get upset. She also mentioned her decision to adjust the education savings budget. Her husband nodded in agreement, and the children listened without interrupting.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tidy up the kitchen and check the children's homework.
description: Ma Xiulan briskly cleared the dishes and wiped the kitchen spotless. Then she sat down with the children, checked Mingzhe's math homework and signed it, listened to Xinxin recite a newly learned nursery rhyme, and went to Mingxuan's room to look at his textbooks and offer a few reminders.
location: Kitchen, living room, and Mingxuan's room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Keeping accounts, nighttime talk with her husband, washing up, and putting her daughter to bed
description: Ma Xiulan recorded today's expenses in the study: vegetables and steamed buns totaled 22 yuan. Back in the bedroom, her husband Ma Zhiqiang was leaning against the headboard looking at his phone. She couldn't help bringing up the pickled vegetables again, repeatedly wondering where she had gone wrong. Her husband advised her not to overthink it and said he would ask his mother tomorrow. After that, Ma Xiulan gave Xinxin a bath, dried her hair, lay down on Xinxin's bed, and told a little rabbit story. Xinxin soon fell asleep.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin: home study, bedroom, and youngest daughter's bedroom

name: Sleepless night and self-reflection
description: Back in the master bedroom, Ma Xiulan turned off the light and closed her eyes, but scenes from pickling the vegetables to receiving the return call replayed in her mind like a movie: Did she add too much salt? Was the pickling time too long? Was the mixture not stirred evenly? The more she thought, the more she blamed herself, and the more she blamed herself, the less she could sleep. She tossed and turned in bed until the small hours, her head feeling heavy and groggy, and only fell into a dazed sleep around 3 a.m.
location: On the bed in the master bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Tossing and turning in the early hours and getting up
description: I didn't manage to fall asleep until after 2 a.m., but I couldn't stop thinking about the pickled vegetables being returned, and woke up again at 4. I lay there until almost 6, heard sounds outside the window, struggled to get up, splashed cold water on my face to wake myself up, looked in the mirror and encouraged myself, determined to pull myself together and face the new day.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Early morning brisk walk around the old city and buying soy milk
description: She changed into her running shoes and jogged along Jingwen Road to the central park, then power-walked two laps for about twenty minutes. There were a few elderly people doing morning exercises in the park, and the air was moist. She used a step-counting app to record her steps and felt her shoulders and neck were looser than yesterday. On the way back, she met Zhang Shufen opening the door of Shufen Convenience Store. After exchanging a few pleasantries, she bought three cups of hot soy milk to take home, spending 6 yuan in total.
location: Street park at the intersection of Jingwen Road and Chunxi Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and Shufen Convenience Supermarket at 148 Jingwen Road

name: Prepare breakfast and take the children to school.
description: After returning home, she reheated the leftover buns from yesterday, fried three eggs, cut up an apple, and poured the soy milk into bowls. She woke up her son Zhezhe and daughter Xinxin. Zhezhe stayed in bed and needed quite a bit of urging, while Xinxin obediently dressed herself. While washing up, Xinxin noticed that her mother's eyes were red and swollen. Xiulan casually explained that it was because she had drunk too much water. After breakfast, she first walked Zhezhe to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School and watched him enter the school, then rode the electric bike to take Xinxin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten. On the way, Xinxin asked when she would be picked up, and Xiulan promised to come in the afternoon.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street); Huakang First Kindergarten (near Wutong Commune)

name: Shopping for ingredients at the market
description: After dropping off the children, she rode her electric bike to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market on the way and stopped at the familiar vegetable stall run by Sun Guifang. Aunt Sun greeted her warmly and recommended fresh water radishes, baby bok choy, and local Chinese chives. Xiulan picked out chives, eggs, water radishes, and a piece of pork belly, planning to make chive pockets for lunch and braise radish with meat in the evening. She chatted with Aunt Sun about family matters and mentioned that she was a bit busy with things at home. The total cost was 32 yuan.
location: Wutong Commune South Gate Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tidying up the house and reviewing pickle recipes on her own.
description: After returning home, she put the groceries away, quickly washed the dishes, wiped down the stove and dining table, swept the floor, and put the scattered toys back in place. She did housework while listening to storytelling on the radio, and gradually felt at ease. Then she brewed a cup of tea, spread out the pickled vegetable notebook and The Complete Book of Home Pickling on the living room coffee table, and checked the recipe character by character. Suddenly she discovered that in the second batch she had mistakenly written 1 tablespoon instead of 1/2 teaspoon of salt. She immediately slapped her leg in realization. She drew a big circle around the mistake with a red pen, stuck a sticky note on it indicating the correct amount, and let out a long breath - the root cause had finally been found.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Chunmei hurried over to comfort her.
description: Although the cause was found, she still felt heartbroken over the loss of 200 yuan. She sent a voice message to her childhood friend Liu Chunmei, her voice choking up. Chunmei immediately replied telling her not to move, and arrived more than ten minutes later after finishing her supermarket shift handover. The two sat down on a bench in the street park. Chunmei held Xiulan's hand and listened patiently, then shared how she herself had been scolded for misremembering prices when she first started working, and encouraged her: "Everyone says the base flavor is good; being able to find the problem is a good thing." Xiulan's eyes grew warm and her mood improved greatly.
location: Bench in the street park at the intersection of Jingwen Road and Chunxi Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Concerned about her father's blood pressure
description: After calming down, she remembered that she hadn't asked about her father's blood pressure today and called him. Her mother answered and handed the phone to her father. She learned that his blood pressure was 135 over 80, and that the new blood pressure monitor Xiulan had bought was easy to use. Xiulan repeatedly urged him to take his medicine on time and only hung up at ease after her father agreed.
location: Street park at the intersection of Jingwen Road and Chunxi Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Shared lunch with Chunmei
description: Xiulan pulled Chunmei along to her home for lunch. She quickly kneaded dough, chopped the filling, and made more than a dozen chive-and-egg pockets. The two ate and chatted. Chunmei again urged her to attend the district's free technical training class and encouraged her to develop her pickled vegetable craft. Xiulan nodded in agreement and decided to go to the community to ask about it that afternoon.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Afternoon nap and browsing through notes
description: After Chunmei hurried back to the supermarket, Xiulan finished cleaning up the dishes and felt sleepy. Leaning on the sofa, she opened the pickled vegetable notebook again and went over the successful recipes and lessons from failures, gradually feeling more confident.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Nap and doing laundry and tidying up
description: Feeling really sleepy, she set a 25-minute alarm and took a nap on the sofa. When the alarm rang, she immediately washed her face with cold water to refresh herself. Then she put yesterday's clothes into the washing machine, went into the children's room, checked the school uniforms and backpacks, hung up the clothes for the next day, and added tissues and wet wipes to Xinxin's backpack.
location: Living room and children's room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Consulted about community technical training.
description: After making up her mind, Xiulan rode her electric bike to the Jingwen Road Community Service Center. The counter staff received her warmly, provided a flyer for the "Free Training Class in Pastry Making and Pickling Techniques", and told her she could sign up on site. Xiulan filled out the registration form immediately, choosing the Tuesday and Thursday afternoon sessions, which would start the next week. Holding the stamped registration receipt, she felt a weight lifted from her mind.
location: Community Service Center in the backyard of Jinghai Grain Bureau, No. 16 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (at the intersection of Jingwen Road and Shengli Street)

name: Tending to the courtyard plants and flowers.
description: On the way home she felt relaxed. Seeing the persimmon sapling in the yard along with the roses and sunflowers beside it, she took out the pruning shears to trim the yellow leaves off the roses, and also watered the pots of mint in the corner. The brief gardening time made her feel peaceful and calm.
location: Family courtyard, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up Zhezhe from school and buy groceries along the way
description: She rode the e-bike to the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School and waited. As soon as Zhezhe came out, he happily reported being praised in math class, and Xiulan praised him. On the way home, they passed Wutong Commune Vegetable Market again, and she went to Sun Guifang's stall to buy fresh oyster mushrooms and tofu, planning to make oyster mushroom and tofu soup for dinner. Aunt Sun asked what she was going to do with the chives she had bought that morning, and Xiulan said she would make radish stewed meat with soup.
location: Tianjin Jinghai District, Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School and Wutong Community South Gate Vegetable Market

name: Preparing dinner and doing housework
description: After returning home, immediately process the ingredients: blanch the pork belly, cut the radish into chunks, and prepare seasonings such as light soy sauce and dark soy sauce, making full preparations for braised pork with radish. At the same time, take the washed clothes out of the washing machine and hang them on the balcony to dry.
location: Kitchen and balcony at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Picking up Xinxin from school and tutoring the children.
description: Arrived at Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten on time. Xinxin ran over and hugged her mother, happily singing a newly learned nursery rhyme. After getting home, Xiulan had Zhezhe do his homework first while she trimmed vegetables beside him; Xinxin took out her drawing book and drew flowers. When Zhezhe met a math problem he couldn't solve, Xiulan put on her reading glasses and guided him by reading the problem together, and he finally finished the homework.
location: Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and home at 156 Jingwen Road.

name: Making dinner
description: She put the prepared pork belly and radish into a pot to stew, and in another pot made a soup with eggs, oyster mushrooms, and tofu. The kitchen filled with the aroma of meat and vegetables, and a table of dinner was soon ready.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner
description: Her husband Ma Zhiqiang came home after finishing a long-distance freight run, and the whole family sat together for dinner. Xiulan mentioned the matter of signing up for a technical training course. Zhiqiang told her to decide on her own and not get too tired; Zhezhe looked forward to his mother's pickles tasting even better after she finished the course, and Xinxin also praised that her mother's cooking was the best. The heartwarming dinner made Xiulan even more determined.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening tidy-up and spending time with the children
description: After the meal, quickly washed the dishes and wiped down the kitchen. Then accompanied Xinxin in the living room to play with building blocks for half an hour. Next, checked Zhezhe's math homework, praised him after confirming it was all correct. Then urged the two children to wash up, brush teeth, and wash feet, and at Xinxin's request told the story Little Horse Crosses the River to soothe her to sleep.
location: Home kitchen, living room, and children's room at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Couple communication and bedtime preparation
description: After the children were all asleep, Xiulan returned to the bedroom and saw her husband Ma Zhiqiang lying in bed looking at truck information on his phone. She leaned against the headboard and told him about finding the cause of the pickle error during the day and signing up for training. Zhiqiang comforted her, saying everyone makes mistakes and she shouldn't take it too much to heart. The simple conversation put Xiulan at ease. After saying goodnight to each other, she washed her face and applied moisturizer.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Late-night planning and bedtime
description: After lying in bed still not sleepy, she picked up the pickled vegetable notebook and, by the desk lamp light, read through the recipe with sticky notes again. Then she wrote on the last page: "April 2: found the root cause. Next step: attend sauce-making technical training and strive to create a new low-salt, healthy recipe." She closed the notebook, placed it under her pillow, and felt that tomorrow held promise. After turning off the light, she listened to the wind outside the window and gradually fell asleep with a measure of certainty.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Morning exercise
description: At six in the morning, the phone alarm rang. Ma Xiulan got up quietly, washed up briefly, changed into her workout clothes and running shoes, drank a glass of warm water, and loosened up. At 6:10 she left the house and jogged along Jingwen Road to the street-corner park, then started brisk walking. She kept a steady pace and walked three full laps, about 25 minutes. On the way back, she met her neighbor Zhang Shufen at the park gate, who had just bought soy milk. The two walked side by side for a while. Zhang Shufen invited her to go to the morning market together tomorrow, saying it was the weekend and a fresh batch of sea fish had arrived. Ma Xiulan smiled and agreed. She arrived home at 6:50.
location: Jingwen Road Street Park, Jinghai District, Tianjin (100 meters south along the street from 156 Jingwen Road)

name: Family breakfast
description: After returning from morning exercise, Ma Xiulan tied on an apron and prepared breakfast. She took out eggs and fresh milk from the refrigerator, chopped scallions, warmed the milk, made egg drop soup, steamed flower rolls, and boiled eggs. At seven o'clock sharp, she went upstairs and woke the three children one by one, urged Xuanxuan and Zhezhe to get up and get dressed, and tied a little braid for Xinxin. The family sat around the table; Ma Zhiqiang picked up a flower roll with pickled vegetables, Xuanxuan quietly drank soup, Zhezhe played while eating, and Ma Xiulan fed Xinxin eggs while gently nagging the children and asking her husband what he thought of the newly pickled vegetables. Her husband praised that they tasted just right.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Take the children to school.
description: At 7:55, Ma Xiulan urged Zhezhe to put on his schoolbag, put Xinxin's jacket on, and went out holding one child in each hand. She rode the electric bike to first take Xinxin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, briefed the teacher on the child's condition, then took Zhezhe to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, and watched him walk into the school gate with his classmates. At 8:30 she rode home.
location: Along the route from Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School.

name: Morning household chores
description: After dropping off the children and returning home, Ma Xiulan cleared the dining table, washed the dishes and wiped the stove, and tidied the living room and the children's rooms. She opened the refrigerator to check ingredients and plan meals, then went to the balcony, took in the dried clothes, and folded them. The house was quiet, and she got everything ready for the upcoming trial batch of pickled vegetables.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Developing new pickled vegetable products
description: Ma Xiulan began the most important trial production of pickled vegetables.
