She took out an electronic scale and, following the new recipe, carefully weighed 500 grams of cucumber, 250 grams of white radish, 250 grams of carrot, and 250 grams of green pepper, and mixed light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, sugar, high-proof liquor, and Sichuan peppercorn and star anise water strictly according to the proportions. This time she was especially careful: she measured every spoonful of salt precisely, checked her notes repeatedly, and also added the dried Sichuan peppercorns her mother had given her to enhance the flavor. The cut vegetables were put in batches into the cooled marinade, covered with plastic wrap, and placed in the refrigerator to chill. She was full of anticipation for this improvement.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Studying and a call with family
description: After finishing the pickled vegetables, Ma Xiulan sat on the sofa to rest. Remembering next week's community pastry training class, she took out the materials to preview basic dough making. She put on her reading glasses and studied carefully, thinking about the difference between low-gluten and all-purpose flour. At 10:50, her mother Li Xiuying called, concerned about the loss on the pickled vegetables. Ma Xiulan felt warmed and explained that the recipe had been wrong but had been corrected, telling her mother not to worry and saying they could talk in detail tomorrow when they meet at the grave during Qingming.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pickle tasting and a lunch break
description: It happened that her husband Ma Zhiqiang came home for lunch at noon, and her eldest son Ma Mingxuan was also home from school. Ma Xiulan took out a sample of the newly made pickles from the refrigerator, put out a plate of cucumber and radish pickles for the family to taste. Ma Zhiqiang's eyes lit up after tasting them, and he praised that they were neither too salty nor too bland and tasted just right. Ma Mingxuan also nodded and said they were better than last time. With the family's approval, Ma Xiulan finally felt at ease. Then the family had a simple lunch: they heated up egg drop soup, cooked dried noodles, and served them with the new pickles, eating comfortably. After lunch, Ma Zhiqiang went out to deliver goods, Ma Mingxuan went back to his room for a nap, and Ma Xiulan cleaned up the kitchen and then leaned back on the sofa for a twenty-minute doze.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Afternoon organizing and preparation for going out
description: After waking from her nap, Ma Xiulan washed her face with cold water and changed into her going-out clothes. She pushed the family tricycle to the door and checked the tires, then took out a clean cloth bag and a small basket from the cabinet, preparing to buy Qingming Festival offerings. In her mind she planned to buy joss paper, chrysanthemums, and fruit, and see if there were fresh pea shoots.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Bought offerings and ingredients at the food market
description: Ma Xiulan rode her tricycle at an unhurried pace to the Wutong Commune vegetable market. Finding her familiar stall, the vegetable vendor Sun Guifang greeted her warmly. Ma Xiulan bought three bundles of yellow joss paper, ten white chrysanthemums, and five jin each of apples and oranges as Qingming Festival offerings. After buying the offerings, she went to another stall and bought tender pea sprouts, tofu, and spring onions. While shopping, she chatted with Sun Guifang about family matters. At 3 p.m., she returned home fully loaded.
location: Wutong Commune Food Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin (2 kilometers west of Jingwen Road)

name: Preparing grave-sweeping items.
description: Back home, Ma Xiulan first washed and dried the fruit she had bought, then carefully placed it in a fruit basket. Then she went to the pickle vat in the courtyard, fished out a few pieces of the soy-pickled radishes preserved last year, rinsed them in clean water, sliced them thinly, and put them into a small earthenware jar to take to the grave the next day—that was her father's favorite food when he was alive. Finally, she folded a green handkerchief embroidered with orchids and put it into the cloth bag she would carry the next day.
location: Home courtyard at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Dinner preparation
description: Ma Xiulan washed her hands and started preparing dinner. She picked and cleaned the pea shoots, cut the tofu into pieces, planning to make stir-fried pea shoots with tofu and tomato and egg soup. After finishing the work, she sat on a bamboo chair in the yard to rest, looking at the roses she had planted, feeling calm.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Picking up the child from school and heading home
description: At 4:10 p.m., Ma Xiulan went out on her electric tricycle. She first picked up Xinxin at Huakang First Kindergarten. The little girl happily ran over and said she had painted today. Then she went to the gate of the No. 3 Primary School to wait for Zhezhe, who came out of the school gate chatting and laughing with classmates. The three of them chatted and laughed all the way home, arriving at 4:50 p.m.
location: Along the route from Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School.

name: Cooking dinner
description: Ma Xiulan plunged into the kitchen. She first put the rice on to cook, then heated oil in a wok and stir-fried tomatoes and eggs, sautéed scallions until fragrant, and lightly stir-fried pea shoots with tofu. The kitchen filled with the aroma of food. A little after five, Ma Zhiqiang came back from delivering goods, the children were playing in the living room, and Ma Xiulan set the dishes on the table.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner
description: The family sat around the dinner table. Ma Zhiqiang praised the freshness of the pea shoots, and Xinxin used a spoon to pick out just the eggs. As Ma Xiulan served the children food, she made arrangements: tomorrow is Qingming, we'll visit the graves of Grandpa and Grandma, and the day after tomorrow we'll go to the maternal grandma's house. Everyone should dress neatly. Xuanxuan and Zhezhe both said okay, and the atmosphere at the table was warm and cozy.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening chores and homework tutoring.
description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan had her husband watch the children do their homework while she quickly cleared the dishes, washed the bowls, and wiped down the stove. When she finished, she came out to check the homework. Xuanxuan did well in math, but Zhezhe's Chinese character writing was sloppy. She patiently made Zhezhe erase it and rewrite it. Xinxin was drawing the five family members with crayons nearby.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Qingming Festival tomb-sweeping preparations and explaining the customs.
description: Ma Xiulan pulled her husband aside to sit down and discuss: they would go to the grave early the next morning; incense, candles, joss paper and chrysanthemums were all prepared. Ma Zhiqiang said he would take a half day off and had washed the car. Then Ma Xiulan told the children about the origin of the Qingming Festival, saying that in ancient times people went on spring outings and flew kites around Qingming. She also took out a picture book and told the story of Jie Zitui and the Cold Food Festival, and the children listened with rapt attention.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepared what was needed for visiting relatives.
description: Ma Xiulan got up and organized things for going back to her parents' home the next day, packing a small jar of pickled vegetables and packaged flower rolls. She checked Xinxin's little coat, found the cuffs were frayed, so she found needle and thread and carefully sewed them; she also scrubbed Zhezhe's sneakers clean and hung them on the balcony to dry.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Nighttime washing up and going to bed.
description: Ma Xiulan urged the children to wash up. She helped Xinxin wash her face and feet, coaxed her into bed, and told Xuanxuan and Zhezhe to go to sleep quickly since they had to get up early the next day. Seeing all three children lying down, she quietly turned off the light.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening chat with partner and wrapping up household chores.
description: Late at night, Ma Xiulan chatted with her husband on the sofa. She mentioned that starting next week, she would go learn how to make pastries on Tuesday and Thursday afternoons. Ma Zhiqiang supported her learning new skills. Afterward, she went to the kitchen to look at the newly made jar of pickled vegetables. Through the glass lid, she saw the soy-colored vegetable chunks, and she felt full of satisfaction and expectations for the future.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Gratitude journal before bed.
description: At 9:30 p.m., Ma Xiulan lay down in bed, picked up the small notebook by the bedside and recorded the day's important events: successful improvement of pickled vegetables, bought Qingming Festival offerings, mother's caring phone call, and signing up for the training class. At the end she wrote: "The days are busy, but today I feel at ease. The children are obedient, and Zhiqiang is supportive too. That's good." After writing, she turned off the light and soon fell asleep, ending a fulfilling and peaceful day.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Getting up and personal preparation
description: Just at dawn, a fine rain was falling outside the window, and the Qingming morning was cool. Ma Xiulan's body clock woke her at 5:30. She got up gently, tucked in the quilt for her husband Zhiqiang, and mentally planned out the day's schedule. She went to the bathroom, washed up simply, changed into light sportswear and old sneakers, and got ready to go for a brisk walk in the rain.
location: Bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Brisk walking in the neighborhood park in the early morning.
description: Ma Xiulan went out holding an old umbrella and walked five minutes to the street park. The rain gradually lessened, so she put away her umbrella and walked briskly for two laps on the wet path, 20 minutes in total. The step-counting app showed a steady pace. On the way back, she met her neighbor Zhang Shufen, who was carrying soy milk. The two chatted as they walked and agreed to go for a walk together on the weekend. When she reached home, a light drizzle started again, and she jogged a few steps into the house.
location: Street park at the southeast corner of the intersection of Jingwen Road and Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Preparing breakfast for Qingming Festival
description: Back home, Ma Xiulan took off her slightly damp coat and hung it behind the door, put on an apron, and prepared breakfast. Today was Qingming Festival, so she specially cooked millet porridge and a few free-range eggs, and steamed frozen buns bought from Shufen's convenience store. The kitchen filled with the aroma of millet and eggs, and she deftly set out the bowls and chopsticks.
location: China, Tianjin Jinghai District, No. 156 Jingwen Road, home kitchen

name: Family breakfast and instructions for tomb-sweeping arrangements
description: Ma Xiulan called the whole family to the dinner table, peeling an egg for her daughter Xinxin while earnestly explaining the day's arrangements: after breakfast, they would change clothes and go to Jinghai Cemetery to visit Grandpa's grave. She asked Xuanxuan to carry the wine, and told Zhezhe and Xinxin to be obedient, follow the adults, and not run around or giggle. The children nodded obediently, and Zhiqiang said he would not take the car out today and would go with them.
location: Dining room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Cleaning up and preparing offerings
description: After breakfast, Ma Xiulan and Zhiqiang cleaned up the dishes together. Then she took out the joss paper, white chrysanthemums, incense, and the old man's favorite pickled radish and two red apples that she had bought yesterday, and put them into a cloth bag. Zhiqiang found a lighter and a small shovel. After confirming that everything was ready, the two called the children to get changed and set off.
location: At home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin: living room, storage room

name: The whole family goes to the cemetery to pay respects.
description: Ma Xiulan rode an electric tricycle carrying Xinxin and Zhezhe, while Zhiqiang followed on a bicycle with Xuanxuan. The rain had stopped and the air was fresh. After about 25 minutes, they arrived at Jinghai Cemetery and found her father's tombstone. Ma Xiulan arranged the offerings, lit incense and burned paper money, murmuring a prayer for the old man to bless the children with health and safety. The children also kowtowed respectfully.
location: Jinghai Cemetery, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (south side of Dongxing Road)

name: Finished tomb sweeping and went to the supermarket
description: After the tomb-sweeping, Zhiqiang waited for her at the cemetery gate with the children. Ma Xiulan told Zhiqiang that she had to go find Chunmei to talk about the pickled vegetables and asked him to take the children home first. Zhiqiang agreed and took the children back by bike. Ma Xiulan got on her tricycle, feeling both nervous and expectant, and rode toward Hualian Supermarket.
location: Hualian Supermarket, Dongfanghong Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Apologize to the supermarket and win back the trial sales opportunity.
description: Ma Xiulan found Liu Chunmei at the supermarket, took out samples of the newly made pickled vegetables from her bag, apologized sincerely, and explained that the previous batch had too little salt, asking Chunmei to taste them. After tasting, Chunmei said the flavor was about 80 to 90 percent back. Ma Xiulan explained the adjustment process in detail with a sincere manner. Chunmei finally agreed to take 6 jars for a trial sale and said, "Just these 6 jars. We'll talk about what comes next after they're sold." Ma Xiulan thanked her repeatedly, feeling relieved.
location: Grocery section of Hualian Supermarket, Dongfanghong Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: From the supermarket to her parents' home.
description: Ma Xiulan felt much more relaxed. She immediately rode her tricycle along Dongfanghong Road to her mother's home, replaying what had just happened on the way, feeling that Chunmei valued their old friendship, and warmed inside.
location: Parents' home, 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Mother and daughter work together to adjust the recipe and make lunch.
description: When she reached her parents' home, her mother Li Xiuying was tidying up in the kitchen. Ma Xiulan took out the sample and the feedback form, and the mother and daughter got busy. Her mother suggested adding half a spoonful of white sugar to enhance the flavor, dissolving it in warm water and mixing it in, saying it would make the taste softer. Ma Xiulan did as she suggested and wrote it down in her notebook. Her mother also brought out homemade dried tangerine peel for her to try next time. At noon, her father Ma Jianguo came home, and the three had lunch together. Her father asked about the pickled vegetables; Ma Xiulan smiled and said the issue was solved, and thanked her mother.
location: Kitchen and dining room at her parents' home, No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Saying goodbye to her parents' home, she bought groceries on the way.
description: At two in the afternoon, Ma Xiulan said goodbye to her parents and took her tricycle around to the Wutong Commune Vegetable Market. At Sun Guifang's stall, she bought a jin of chives and some ground pork with a good balance of fat and lean, planning to make dumplings that evening. Seeing that Ma Xiulan looked happy, Sun Guifang asked what the happy occasion was. Ma Xiulan smiled and said that today, the Qingming Festival, everything had gone well.

participant.name: Sun Guifang
participant.relation: Friend who is a vendor at the vegetable market

location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (near Jingwen Road)

name: Returning home
description: Coming out of the market, Ma Xiulan rode her tricycle home along familiar streets. The wind carried a moist, springlike feeling, and her mood, like the weather, was overcast yet suffused with steadiness and warmth.
location: Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Going home, urging the children to study, and preparing to make dumplings
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan put away the vegetables and meat filling. Zhezhe and Xinxin were watching TV. She urged Zhezhe to go to his online class and reminded Xuanxuan to finish his reading task. Then she put on an apron and prepared the dumpling filling: carefully picked over and washed the chives, drained them, chopped the meat, added soy sauce, salt, and sesame oil, and stirred in one direction. The kitchen filled with aroma.
location: Living room and kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: The whole family makes dumplings together.
description: After the dough and filling were ready, Ma Xiulan called Zhiqiang and Xuanxuan to help. The family sat around the dining table. She was in charge of rolling out the wrappers, while Zhiqiang and Xuanxuan wrapped the dumplings. Zhezhe also made a few crooked 'ingots' as a joke. The kitchen was filled with the aroma of chives and flour, with lively chatting and laughter — it was very warm.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Family dinner, sharing stories of the day
description: The steaming hot dumplings were brought to the table, and Ma Xiulan also blanched some greens in the dumpling broth. The whole family ate and chatted. She happily shared the good news that Chunmei agreed to a trial sale of the pickled vegetables, as well as the new recipe adjustments learned from her mother. Zhiqiang also praised her for handling things steadily. The children chattered about the interesting things from the day's tomb sweeping and studying.
location: Dining room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Tidying up, checking homework, and accompanying the children
description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan and Zhiqiang cleared the dishes, packed the leftover dumplings in boxes, and put them in the refrigerator. Then she checked Xuanxuan's and Zhezhe's homework, patiently pointed out the mistakes, and had them correct them. Xinxin brought her pinyin notebook and asked her to teach the characters "flower" and "grass." She taught them patiently several times and then watched some cartoons with her. Afterwards, she urged the children to wash up and change into pajamas one by one.
location: Kitchen, living room, and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Bedtime preparations and family conversation.
description: After the children were all in bed, Ma Xiulan finally had some time to rest. She and Zhiqiang curled up on the sofa and talked about going to the community library the next day to read books on soy sauce fermentation and pickled vegetable preservation, and Zhiqiang was supportive. Ma Xiulan took out a small notebook and wrote down the recipe adjustments her mother had suggested and the trial sales agreement with Chunmei, then sent Chunmei a long thank-you WeChat message. After that, she took a hot shower and changed into her pajamas.
location: Living room and master bedroom of the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Ended the day and fell asleep peacefully.
description: Ma Xiulan slipped into the warm, soft bedding and felt that everything today had gone just as she wished. Though busy, she felt steady and warm at heart. Outside the window a fine drizzle began to fall again. Listening to the rain, she recalled the way her mother made dried tangerine peel, and soon fell asleep with a smile.
location: Master bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Morning routine of chatting with neighbors.
description: After the rain, the air was fresh. Ma Xiulan got up at 6 a.m., put on her new sneakers, and went to the neighborhood park downstairs for a brisk walk. At the park entrance, she met her neighbor Wang Guilan, who had just come back from buying vegetables. The two exchanged recipes for shepherd's purse dumplings for Qingming Festival, and Wang Guilan shared the trick of adding egg white to the dough and adding oil. After chatting for about ten minutes, Ma Xiulan went home at around 6:40.
location: Street park on Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing breakfast and getting the whole family moving
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan reheated the leftover dumplings and steamed buns from last night and cooked a pot of porridge. She woke the three children and urged them to get ready to go tomb sweeping. At 7:20, the whole family ate breakfast together. After the meal, Ma Xiulan checked the spare supplies and had her husband Ma Zhiqiang go start the car.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The entire family visits the cemetery to sweep tombs and honor their ancestors
description: At 8 in the morning, Ma Xiulan's parents arrived on time. The family took the van driven by Ma Zhiqiang to Yong'an Cemetery. On the way, her son Zhe Zhe stepped in a puddle and wet his socks, and Ma Xiulan changed them for him in time. After arriving at the cemetery, the whole family wiped the gravestone, laid out pickled radish and white chrysanthemums. Ma Xiulan knelt on the ground and burned paper money, reporting recent news to her grandfather and father. The children kowtowed to show respect.
location: Yong'an Cemetery, Jinyong Highway, Wuqing District, Tianjin.

name: Gathering shepherd's purse in the fields, returning laden with rustic charm
description: After tomb sweeping, on the way back, Ma Xiulan's mother found shepherd's purse on the field ridges, and everyone eagerly picked them. Ma Zhiqiang took out a cloth bag. Ma Xiulan showed the children how to identify shepherd's purse, and her father asked about Ma Xiulan's health. After picking a big bagful of shepherd's purse, everyone got in the car and headed home.
location: Field near Yong'an Cemetery on Jinyong Road, Wuqing District, Tianjin.

name: Returning home to settle in and a simple lunch
description: She arrived home at around 10:30. Ma Xiulan put away the shepherd's purse and the offerings, cooked two pots of dragon whisker noodles with leftover dumplings, and the family had a simple lunch. After the meal, her parents went to the guest room to rest, Ma Zhiqiang helped clear the dishes, and the children watched TV in the living room. Ma Xiulan asked her husband to knead dough to prepare for making wontons.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Brief rest and household chores
description: During the midday break, Ma Xiulan picked and washed shepherd's purse, then took a short nap for twenty minutes. After waking, she sewed the button back on her son Renxuan's school uniform, tidied her daughter's skirt, and handled miscellaneous household chores.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Going to the library to consult reference materials
description: At 1 p.m., Ma Xiulan walked 15 minutes to Dong'an Road Community Library, borrowed "New Methods for Home Pickled Vegetables" and "Introduction to Lactic Acid Bacteria Fermentation Technology," recorded the temperature and time for low-salt fermentation, copied down notes on adding starter cultures, and prepared to improve her pickled vegetables. She went home an hour later.
location: Dong'an Road Community Library, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The whole family pitched in to make shepherd's purse wontons.
description: At 2 p.m., Ma Xiulan and her mother made wontons together: blanching shepherd's purse, chopping it, and mixing it with pork filling, seasoned only with light soy sauce, sesame oil, and a little sugar. Ma Zhiqiang rolled out the dough wrappers, and the children joined in, pinching wontons into all sorts of shapes. The family was full of joy and harmony. At 4:30 p.m., the first pot of wontons was done, and the aroma filled the air.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Cozy dinner and family time.
description: Dinner centered on shepherd's purse wontons, served with garlic vinegar, chili oil, and soy-pickled radish. The whole family sat around and shared the meal. After dinner, Ma Xiulan cleared the dishes, while Ma Zhiqiang watched TV with the children and made tea for his parents. Listening to her family's laughter, Ma Xiulan felt at peace.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Checking homework and communicating arrangements.
description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan checked her eldest son Renxuan's English homework and corrected grammar mistakes, tutored Zhe Zhe on math word problems, and taught her daughter Xinxin ten new Chinese characters. Afterwards, she and her husband Ma Zhiqiang agreed in the bedroom to go to the library again tomorrow to borrow books.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Routine before bed, fell asleep peacefully
description: At 8 p.m., Ma Xiulan urged the children to wash up, made their beds, and told them they could sleep in a bit on Sunday. After the children went to bed, she washed up herself, looked in the mirror and reviewed the day; though tired, she felt at ease.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Couple's evening talk, reviewing the day
description: After lying down in bed, Ma Xiulan and Ma Zhiqiang talked quietly and shared their feelings about the day: chatting with Sister Wang in the park, her father's care while they were picking shepherd's purse, and so on. They felt life was full of hope. The couple fell asleep content and full of expectation.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Getting up and tidying up
description: At 6 a.m., Xiulan naturally woke up. The weather had cleared up, and she felt happy. She first drank a glass of warm water, washed up briefly, changed into light sportswear, and got ready for morning exercise.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Brisk walking at the neighborhood park
description: Xiulan walked to the neighborhood park and briskly walked two laps in about 25 minutes, planning the lunch menu as she exercised. Afterward, she stretched her legs on the exercise equipment, feeling refreshed in body and mind.
location: Tianjin Jinghai District Street Park (intersection of Jingwen Road and Dong'an Road).

name: Go home to make breakfast and wake up the family.
description: After returning home, her husband was already awake, and the children were still lazing in bed. Xiulan cooked millet porridge, boiled shepherd's purse wontons, and sliced pickled radish strips. At 7:10 she woke the three children, and the family sat around the table for breakfast. Xiulan told the children to behave when they went to Grandma's house.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tidying up housework and preparing to go out
description: After breakfast, Xiulan cleared the dishes and wiped the stove, checked the items to take to her mother's home, including shepherd's purse, reminded her husband to change his shirt, helped her younger daughter braid her hair, closed the windows, and gathered her personal belongings before getting ready to leave.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Shopping at Wutong Commune Vegetable Market
description: Xiulan rode her electric tricycle to the vegetable market and bought live sea bass, spring onions, cilantro, and tender tofu at Aunt Sun Guifang's stall, spending 35 yuan. Aunt Sun gave her an extra bunch of cilantro, and the two chatted about what they had seen during the Qingming Festival.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin (intersection of Shengli Street and Wutong Road)

name: Go to her parents' home
description: Xiulan rode her electric bike with the groceries and took five minutes to get from the vegetable market to her parents' home.
location: Tianjin, Jinghai District, Shengli Street (from the food market to No. 45 Shengli Street)

name: Preparing dishes for the family meal
description: Xiulan and her mother began preparing ingredients: cleaning the bass, kneading dough, and wrapping wontons. Her eldest sister, Li Xiuyun, brought spinach salad and sweet garlic, and her younger sister, Ma Xiufen, brought low-salt braised chicken. Her father, Ma Jianguo, cooked oil-reduced braised tofu. The kitchen was full of laughter.
location: Parents' home, 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family low-salt dinner gathering
description: The whole family sat together to enjoy steamed sea bass, shepherd's purse wontons, braised tofu, cold dressed spinach, and roast chicken. Father praised the dishes for being healthy and made an exception to have more rice, making Xiulan feel gratified. During the meal, the sisters chatted and the children played, creating a warm atmosphere.
location: Parents' home, 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Cleaning up after the meal and chatting while taking a short rest
description: Xiulan, her mother, and her eldest sister cleared the dishes, and her younger sister wiped the table. Afterwards, everyone accompanied her parents for tea and chat. They talked about sweeping tombs at Qingming, Xiulan learning to make pickled vegetables, and her childhood friend Liu Chunmei being willing to test-sell them. Her mother encouraged her to do it well.
location: Parents' home, 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Return home for a brief rest
description: Xiulan asked her husband and children to stay at her mother's home, then rode her electric bike back and rested on the sofa with her eyes closed for 20 minutes to build up energy for steaming rice balls in the afternoon.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Steam shepherd's purse dumplings.
description: Xiulan used mature shepherd's purse, egg bits, vermicelli strips, and seasonings, mixed them with cornmeal, and shaped them into balls. After steaming for 25 minutes, two steaming trays of golden, fluffy shepherd's-purse-scented balls came out.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Delivering rice balls to neighbors and receiving feedback.
description: Xiulan carried a bowl of hot rice balls and first knocked on the door of Wang Guilan, who lived across the hall. Sister Wang happily gave her a bag of Luhua chicken eggs in return, and the two chatted about ways to eat shepherd's purse. Afterwards she went to Shufen Convenience Store. Zhang Shufen tasted them and praised them endlessly, suggesting that they could be sold on consignment at the store. Xiulan happily agreed.
location: Wang Guilan's house across from No. 156 Jingwen Road, and Shufen Convenience Store at No. 128 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Record the shepherd's purse planting plan
description: Inspired by Zhang Shufen, Xiulan went home and wrote down in her account book a plan to plant shepherd's purse and purslane in the courtyard next year, and recorded today's grocery spending of 35 yuan. She is full of expectation about turning wild vegetables into income.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Prepare dinner and pick up the children
description: Xiulan called her husband to bring the children home. She took out the dishes packed from lunch and prepared to make tomato egg drop soup. When the children came back, she arranged for her son to do homework and let her daughter play beside her.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Dinner
description: For dinner, she reheated the leftover braised tofu and roast chicken, made tomato egg drop soup, and also scrambled eggs with scallions using the Luhua chicken eggs given by a neighbor. As the family ate and chatted, Xiulan and her husband discussed selling the rice balls on consignment. Zhiqiang expressed support but reminded her not to overwork herself.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Helping the children with homework and family activities
description: Xiulan checked homework: she praised the eldest son Xuanxuan for his progress in math, corrected the second son Zhezhe's handwriting habits, and accompanied the youngest daughter Xinxin in character tracing. Afterward she played with blocks with Xinxin and listened to Zhezhe's funny stories about school. The family atmosphere was harmonious.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Washing the children up and settling them to sleep.
description: Xiulan made sure the children washed up, helped Xinxin wash her face and feet, made Zhezhe's bed, said goodnight after all three children lay down, then turned off the light and left.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Late-night talk with her husband
description: Xiulan and her husband leaned side by side against the headboard, chatting about how happily her father had eaten today, Zhang Shufen's consignment sales, and the planting plans. Zhiqiang teased her for never staying idle. Half an hour later, they felt sleepy and got ready for bed.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Phone communication and going to sleep.
description: After her husband fell asleep, Xiulan sent WeChat voice messages to her younger sister Xiufen and her childhood friend Chunmei, sharing how popular the rice balls had been. She then looked over the planting plan in her account book again, felt reassured, turned off the light, and went to sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Morning exercise (completed a seven-day streak)
description: After the 6:00 alarm went off, she got up, drank some water, and went out to the Street Park for brisk walking. Today was the last day of 7 consecutive days of morning exercise. She opened the step-counting app and reviewed the week's records; her total steps were 20% more than last week, and she felt a strong sense of accomplishment. At the park exit, she met her neighbor Zhang Shufen, who was walking slowly. They chatted for a bit. Zhang Shufen mentioned that her knees hurt occasionally. Based on her experience over the past few days, she suggested that Zhang Shufen walk more slowly and take smaller steps, and Zhang Shufen thanked her. She got home at 6:45, washed her face, and got ready to make breakfast.
location: From home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China, to the street park at the intersection of Jingwen Road and Dong'an Road

name: Preparing breakfast and having breakfast with the family
description: She tied on an apron and cooked millet porridge in the kitchen, fried eggs, and heated up the mantou. After breakfast was ready, she went upstairs and woke the children one by one: Ma Mingxuan had already gotten up by himself, Ma Mingzhe stayed in bed and had to be urged twice, and Ma Yuxin, the well-behaved one, woke up as soon as she was called. The family sat around the dining table for breakfast. She told the children to listen carefully at school, especially reminding Ma Mingxuan to pay full attention in class now that he was moving up to the second year of junior high and would have heavier schoolwork. Her husband, Ma Zhiqiang, had the day off and was not going out with the car, so he offered to repair the crooked-legged chair in the yard after taking the children to school. She also mentioned the shepherd's purse cornmeal balls she had left on consignment at Shufen Supermarket yesterday and planned to go ask about sales in the evening.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Take the children to school, buy groceries, and go home to tidy up
description: Riding the electric bike, she first took Ma Mingzhe to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School. On the way, he excitedly said that today's PE class would be relay running practice, and she told him to pay attention to safety. After watching him enter the school gate, she then took Ma Yuxin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten. Yuxin was wearing a little pink jacket, and she told her to listen to the teacher and take a good nap. After dropping off the children, she stopped by Wutong Commune Vegetable Market on the way, bought tender scallions and tofu at Aunt Sun Guifang's stall for 5 yuan, and chatted with her for a while. When she got home, her husband Ma Zhiqiang was already in the yard repairing a wobbly chair. She put the vegetables in the kitchen, soaked the jacket she had taken off in a basin, watered and weeded around the persimmon tree, and chatted with Zhiqiang about Ma Mingxuan's English and tomorrow's training class.
location: Jinghai District, Tianjin, China: Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street), Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten (No. 32 Dong'an Road), Wutong Commune Vegetable Market (No. 18 Chaoyang Road), home at No. 156 Jingwen Road.

name: Doing housework (laundry and sweeping the floor)
description: Put the coats from yesterday's outing and this morning's change of clothes, along with the children's school uniforms, into the washing machine. While the washing machine was running, she carefully swept the living room and bedroom with a broom, cleaning up the pencil shavings and small bits of paper the children had dropped. She was thinking about the accounts for the shepherd's purse dumplings consigned for sale at Shufen Supermarket yesterday, and planned to record them clearly when doing the books in the evening. After the washing machine finished, she took the clean clothes to the courtyard to dry.
location: Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Resting and doing hand embroidery
description: After tidying up the house, her husband fixed the chair and was in the living room drinking tea and looking at his phone. Ma Xiulan sat on the sofa to rest, took out the half-embroidered tablecloth prepared for the next handicraft market, and focused on embroidering roses in the bright light. Sunlight streamed into the room, and the atmosphere was quiet.
location: Home living room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Preparing lunch
description: She got up and went to the kitchen to prepare lunch; at noon only she and her husband would be eating. She took out the leftover shepherd's purse pork filling and wonton wrappers from last night from the fridge and made about twenty shepherd's purse wontons. Using the scallions and tofu bought in the morning, she made scallion-mixed tofu, and also stir-fried scrambled eggs with tomatoes. The dishes were light, in line with her recent habit of paying attention to a low-salt diet.
location: Home kitchen, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Had lunch with her husband.
description: Her husband came over to help set out the bowls and chopsticks, and brought out the cooked wontons, dressed tofu, and scrambled eggs. He praised the wonton filling, saying her mother's shepherd's purse cooking was authentic. They chatted while eating and mentioned that they would make braised pork belly when the children came back in the evening — there was still a piece of pork belly in the fridge.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Noon break
description: She asked her husband to clear the table, while she rested leaning on the bed and set the alarm for 13:00. Although she didn't fall completely asleep, after half an hour of resting with her eyes closed she felt much better.
location: Home bedroom, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Prepare for the community pastry-making and pickling techniques training class
description: When the 1 o'clock alarm went off, she got up and washed her face. Thinking that she would go to the community service center tomorrow afternoon for a training class, she took a new notebook and pen from the TV cabinet drawer, wrote "Community Training Record" on the first page, and on the weekly plan page wrote items such as "Contact Zheng Xiuying to ask about the pickled vegetable training time, call Mom to get the blood pressure report, prepare the tablecloth for the market stall." This made her feel much more at ease.
location: Home living room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Continue hand embroidery and prepare dinner ingredients in advance
description: After putting away her notebook, she continued embroidering the rose-patterned tablecloth; the outline was now visible. Around 3 o'clock, she put down her needlework and went to the kitchen to prepare dinner. She took the pork belly out of the fridge, cut it into pieces, blanched it with ginger slices and scallion segments, then braised it slowly on the stove. The aroma of red-braised pork filled the house, and her husband even poked his head in to ask.
location: Living room and kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Pick up the two children from school and talk with the teachers about their studies.
description: After putting the braised pork on to stew, she turned the heat down to low and let it simmer. She rode her e-bike to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten first to pick up Ma Yuxin, who happily rushed over to show her drawing of a persimmon tree. Then on the way she went to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up Ma Mingzhe. He had just finished PE class and excitedly said his relay race team had won. At the school gate, she happened to meet Han Mei, the English teacher of her eldest son Ma Mingxuan. After a brief conversation, she learned that Ma Mingxuan's English dictation had declined recently and his word spelling was not proficient. The teacher suggested he memorize and dictate more at home. After thanking her, she took the two children home.
location: Jinghai District, Tianjin, China: Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten (32 Dong'an Road), Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street)

name: Preparing dinner and giving the children initial tutoring
description: When she got home, the braised pork was already stewed until tender. Ma Xiulan then stir-fried broccoli with garlic and made tomato egg drop soup. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang was helping Ma Mingzhe with math homework in the living room, while Ma Yuxin played with building blocks nearby. Once the food was on the table, Ma Xiulan asked her husband to watch the children, and she went downstairs to wait for Ma Mingxuan to come home from school to start the meal together.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: The whole family has dinner together
description: After Ma Mingxuan came home and washed his hands, the family sat down to dinner. The braised pork was tender and flavorful, and the children ate with gusto. While putting food on Ma Yuxin's plate, Ma Xiulan asked Ma Mingxuan about school. He said he got most of the English dictation right but couldn't remember a few words. Recalling what Teacher Han Mei had said in the afternoon, she decided to do another dictation with him after dinner, and Ma Mingxuan nodded in agreement.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Tutoring the three children in their studies
description: After dinner, her husband cleared the dishes while Ma Xiulan led the children to study in the living room and the study. She had Ma Mingxuan take out the words he had misspelled in dictation and re-dictated them one by one until he got them all right. She checked Ma Mingzhe's homework, found a math problem he had answered incorrectly, and had him recalculate and correct it. Ma Yuxin was nearby with character cards, so she had her read the new characters from yesterday; she remembered almost all of them.
location: Living room and study at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Family leisure time.
description: After homework was finished, she allowed Ma Mingxuan to go back to his room to read science fiction books, while Ma Mingzhe and Ma Yuxin played with building blocks in the living room. Ma Xiulan and her husband sat on the sofa resting and chatting, and discussed going to her parents' home tomorrow to visit and bring some fruit.
location: Home living room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Evening bookkeeping and weekly planning
description: After the children washed up and went to bed, the living room became quiet. Ma Xiulan took out her account book and calculator. She calculated that today's spending was 5 yuan for vegetables and 15 yuan for meat, totaling 20 yuan. She recorded the account for selling shepherd's purse rice balls on consignment at Shufen Supermarket yesterday as unsettled. On her weekly planner, she listed the things to do tomorrow: contact Zheng Xiuying to ask about the pickled vegetable training time, call her mother to get the blood pressure report, and prepare the embroidered tablecloth for the market fair, drawing a checkbox next to each item. She checked the record of the 100 yuan education savings deposited that morning and confirmed it was correct.
location: Home living room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: After finishing the bookkeeping, she went to the bathroom to wash up and changed into pajamas. Her husband was already reclining in bed. The two chatted about the plan to go to her parents' home tomorrow, and also talked about the children's studies. At 10 p.m., she turned off the bedside lamp, and after saying goodnight to each other, they soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Fell asleep peacefully
description: On the first workday after Qingming Festival, although busy, she kept everything at home in perfect order. The seven consecutive days of morning exercise came to a successful end, and she felt the satisfaction of completing a small goal. Thinking about tomorrow's new challenge (training) and looking forward to visiting her parents, she fell asleep peacefully.
location: Home bedroom, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Morning brisk walk workout
description: At 6 a.m., Ma Xiulan set out from her home at 156 Jingwen Road and walked along Jingwen Road for about 6 minutes to reach the street park. This was her eighth consecutive day of morning exercise. She briskly walked two laps around the flower bed for about 20 minutes, used her phone to photograph the winter jasmine blooming by the roadside, breathed the fresh air, and felt refreshed in body and mind.
location: Street park at the southeast corner of the intersection of Jingwen Road and Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare breakfast and wake up the family
description: After Ma Xiulan got home, she went straight into the kitchen to cook shepherd's purse wontons, thinking about her father's blood pressure. She woke the three children one by one: her eldest son Ma Mingxuan was already memorizing English words; her second son Ma Mingzhe was reluctant to get up, so she gently patted his bottom to wake him; and her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin woke up obediently. She helped her daughter tie her pigtails and reminded everyone to wash up and eat.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (kitchen and bedroom at home)

name: Breakfast for the whole family and school drop-off arrangements.
description: The family sat around eating steaming hot shepherd's purse wontons. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang was not going out to drive that day, so he ate at a leisurely pace. Ma Xiulan reminded her husband to help blanch the pork ribs at noon, and Zhiqiang agreed readily. After breakfast, she rode her electric bike, with her younger daughter on the front footboard and her second son on the back seat, ready to take them to school, while her eldest son rode his own bike to Experimental Middle School.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home dining room)

name: Taking the children to school
description: Ma Xiulan first rode her bike to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School on Shengli South Street. At 7:50 she watched her second son, Ma Mingzhe, run into the school gate and reminded him not to wander off after school. Then she turned from Jingwen Road onto Huakang Road and arrived at Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten around 8:00. She handed her youngest daughter, Ma Yuxin, to the teacher. Her daughter said a sweet goodbye, and she felt warm inside.
location: Tianjin Jinghai District Shengli South Street Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, and Tianjin Jinghai District No. 12 Huakang Road Huakang First Kindergarten.

name: Visiting parents: taking blood pressure and teaching WeChat
description: Ma Xiulan rode her bike from the kindergarten to her parents' home at No. 45 Shengli Street. She measured her father Ma Jianguo's blood pressure: 139/85. Though slightly higher than yesterday, it was normal. She told her father to drink more water and worry less. Then she took out her phone and taught him how to send a WeChat voice message. After trying, he successfully sent his first voice message, slurred but joyful, while her mother Li Xiuying smiled happily beside them.
location: Floor 2, 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin (parents' home)

name: Buy ingredients for pickled vegetables at the vegetable market
description: Ma Xiulan rode her bike along Jingwen Road for 5 minutes to Sun Guifang's stall at Xingwang Vegetable Market. She took out the low-salt pickle recipe she had come up with overnight and explained her idea of replacing some of the salt with sea salt and celery juice. Sun Guifang quickly weighed out sea salt, celery, cucumber, white radish, and spices such as Sichuan peppercorn and star anise. She recommended bird's eye chili, but Ma Xiulan politely declined, saying she wanted a light flavor this time. The total cost was 28.5 yuan.
location: Xingwang Vegetable Market, east section of Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Return home to tidy up and prepare training materials.
description: After arriving home, Ma Xiulan sorted and put away the pickled vegetable ingredients, setting aside the sea salt and celery separately. She went to the living room to check again the notebook, pens, and folder for the community training class. Seeing her husband pumping air in the yard, she called out loudly to remind him to remember to soak the pork ribs at noon.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home kitchen and living room)

name: Help watch the store.
description: Ma Xiulan went out heading for the community service center. When she walked to the intersection of Jingwen Road and Dongxing Road, her neighbor Zhang Shufen, who had a stomachache, called out to her and asked her to watch the shop for ten minutes. Standing behind the cash register, she sold a pack of salt and two bottles of soy sauce and chatted briefly with a customer, Uncle Wang. When Zhang Shufen returned, she thanked her profusely and pressed a pack of goji berries into her hand.
location: Shufen Convenience Store, south side of the intersection of Jingwen Road and Dongxing Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Submitting handmade samples on behalf of someone.
description: Ma Xiulan walked 4 minutes along Dongxing Road to the Yinongli Community Service Center, handed the embroidered pillowcase sample made by Zheng Xiuying to the staff, and signed the form. The staff reminded her about the afternoon training class; she agreed with a smile and took the opportunity to chat a bit about new community activities.
location: Yinongli Community Service Center, ground-floor commercial unit, Building 3, Donghua Building, Chaoyang Subdistrict, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare and enjoy lunch
description: After Ma Xiulan got home, she saw that her husband had already soaked the pork ribs, so she tied on an apron and made tomato and egg noodles and smashed cucumber salad. The couple ate and chatted. She mentioned helping Zhang Shufen mind the store, and her husband teased her about being the boss. She replied that she still felt more grounded taking care of things at home.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home kitchen and dining room)

name: Lunch break and household tidying
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan quickly cleared the dishes. At 12:50 she leaned back on the sofa and dozed for 20 minutes. Waking at 13:10, she went through her training notes again, took out the sea salt and celery to ponder the recipe proportions, and packed them into bags after confirming they were correct. Then she blanched the ribs, skimmed off the blood foam, and prepped ingredients for dinner.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (bedroom and kitchen at home)

name: Went to the community activity center.
description: Ma Xiulan changed into a clean jacket, took her cloth bag and water bottle, reminded her husband to pick up the youngest daughter at 5 and have the eldest son pick up the second son on the way, then rode her electric bike along Jingwen Road and turned onto Dongxing Road, arriving at Yinongli Community Activity Center in 5 minutes. She was the first to enter Room 301 and sat by the window in the first row, enjoying the afternoon sunshine.
location: Room 301, Yinongli Community Activity Center, 21 Dongxing Road, Chaoyang Subdistrict, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Attend a community training class on pastry making and pickling techniques.
description: At 2 p.m. the training class began. The teacher explained the basic theory of pastry making and pickling principles, emphasizing salt-level control and food safety. Ma Xiulan took careful notes and asked two questions in a row about the key points of low-salt fermentation; the teacher patiently answered both. By the end of the class she felt she had gained a lot and was more confident about improving her low-salt pickled vegetable recipe.
location: Room 301, Yinongli Community Activity Center, 21 Dongxing Road, Chaoyang Subdistrict, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the younger daughter from school
description: The moment class ended, Ma Xiulan rode straight to Huakang First Kindergarten. She saw her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin already waiting under the teacher's care, holding up a drawing of the persimmon tree at Grandma's house. She gave her daughter a kiss, praised the drawing, felt warm inside, and planned to take it home to show her husband.
location: Huakang First Kindergarten, 12 Huakang Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Picking up the second son from school and buying tofu
description: Ma Xiulan rode her bike with her daughter for 8 minutes to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School. At 16:58 she saw her second son Ma Mingzhe and eldest son Ma Mingxuan come out together, so she told the eldest son to take his sister home to do homework first, while she took her second son and turned onto Wutong Road. At the Wutong Commune Vegetable Market she spent 2 yuan on a piece of brine-set tofu, and at 17:20 the mother and son arrived home.
location: Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School on Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Wutong Commune Vegetable Market on Wutong Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare dinner and family gathering
description: Ma Xiulan returned home and immediately started cooking. She put the pork ribs her husband had blanched in advance into the pot with radish chunks and tofu, added cooking wine, sliced ginger, star anise, a little sea salt, and celery juice, and simmered a low-salt version of pork rib and tofu soup. Meanwhile, she used the cucumbers bought in the morning to make a cucumber salad. Half an hour later the meal was served, and the whole family sat around the table to enjoy it. The children especially liked the tofu and radish in the soup, and the second son ate two bowls of rice.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home kitchen and dining room)

name: Helping children with homework
description: After dinner, her husband voluntarily washed the dishes while Ma Xiulan helped the children with their homework in the living room. She first dictated English words to her eldest son, redictating the misspelled words and making him copy them five times until he got them all right. Then she checked her second son's math homework and had him reread the problems to correct the careless mistakes. Her youngest daughter played quietly with building blocks, occasionally running over to show off her work. At 20:00, the children finished their homework and packed their schoolbags.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home living room)

name: Phone call and letting family know she was safe
description: While the children packed their schoolbags, Ma Xiulan sent a WeChat message to the community grid worker Zheng Xiuying to let her know that the samples had been delivered, and asked how the shepherd's purse dumplings were selling on consignment. Zheng Xiuying replied that they were selling well and made an appointment for her to settle the accounts when she had time. Later, she made a video call to her mother Li Xiuying, reported on her studies and her father's blood pressure. Her mother told her not to overdo it, and she smiled and replied that a full and busy life is what makes her feel grounded.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home living room)

name: Keeping accounts and preparing for bed
description: Ma Xiulan took out her account book and recorded the day's expenses: 28.5 yuan for groceries and 2 yuan for tofu, and she wrote the goji berries from Zhang Shufen under 'gift exchange.' She noted 'settlement available' on the consignment page for shepherd's purse cornmeal balls, then washed up and went to bed. While chatting with her husband about the next day's hands-on training class, she planned to ask the instructor for advice on the new recipe. Her husband was supportive, and she felt warm inside.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home living room and bedroom)

name: Going to bed
description: At 21:30 Ma Xiulan turned off the light and closed her eyes, reviewing the day in her mind: her father's blood pressure, shopping, helping watch the store, training gains... everything went smoothly as planned. She felt steady and content, her breathing gradually calmed, and at 22:00 she fell asleep peacefully.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home bedroom)

name: Waking up early and taking a brisk morning walk
description: Woke up before the alarm went off; the sky outside was just barely light. Drank half a glass of warm water, changed into workout clothes, and left on foot at 06:05 for the central park. Did brisk walking for 20 minutes in the park, then stretched for 5 minutes by the pavilion. During that time, heard cuckoo calls and smelled the scent of freshly turned soil in the air. The whole morning exercise made my shoulders feel much lighter.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home) to the street park at the intersection of Jingwen Road and Shengli Street, Jinghai District.

name: Prepare breakfast and help family members wash up.
description: She tied on an apron to prepare breakfast, sliced the leftover steamed buns from last night, cooked millet porridge, and fried three eggs. Meanwhile, she went to the balcony to bring in the dried school uniforms, folded them, and placed them on the sofa. At 06:50, she woke her husband and the three children one by one and urged them to wash up. Her youngest daughter, Xinxin, dressed herself and was very well-behaved; her second son, Zhezhe, stayed in bed, so she scolded him a couple of times.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Family breakfast and getting ready to go out
description: The family sits around the table eating breakfast. She serves food to the children, tells her eldest son Xuanxuan to eat more vegetables in the school cafeteria at noon, and asks her husband Zhiqiang whether he will come home for dinner. When she learns that he has a short-distance run and may return late, she quickly clears the dishes at 07:30, checks the three children's schoolbags and water bottles, changes her clothes, grabs the e-bike key, and prepares to leave.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Taking children to and from school
description: At 07:40, I took my second son Zhezhe and my little daughter Xinxin out on the electric bike. First we arrived at the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School. I told Zhezhe to listen carefully in class and watched him run into the school gate. Then I turned around and rode to Huakang First Kindergarten, where I handed Xinxin to the teacher. I also specifically asked the teacher to confirm that the ankle she had sprained yesterday was fine before I left with peace of mind.
location: From No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School at No. 76 Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, then to Huakang First Kindergarten at No. 12 Huakang Road, Jinghai District

name: Shopping at the market and tidying up at home
description: After dropping off the children, she rode on the way to the Wutong Commune Vegetable Market and went to the stall of her familiar Sister Sun Guifang. Following the new recipe, she picked fresh, crisp cucumbers, white radishes, and celery, spending 18 yuan in total, and also bought scallions and ginger. She got home at 08:35, sorted and washed the vegetables, drained them, and put the sea salt, Sichuan peppercorns, star anise, and other seasonings bought yesterday on the stove, preparing for the pickling work.

participant.name: Sun Guifang
participant.relation: Friend who is a vendor at the vegetable market

location: 12 Huakang Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, 168 Wutong Road, Jinghai District, then to home at 156 Jingwen Road

name: Pickle the first batch of low-salt pickles
description: After cleaning the kitchen, she officially started the main event of the day. She took out the new small spring scale, cut the cucumbers, white radish, and celery into even strips and sections, weighed them separately, and recorded them in her notebook. Strictly following the Low-Salt No. 1 recipe in her training notes, she mixed sea salt and regular salt in a 2:3 ratio, added celery juice, Sichuan peppercorns, star anise, and cloves, then boiled them in water and let it cool completely. She layered the vegetables into two clean glass jars, poured in the pickling liquid until everything was completely submerged. Using a sticky note and a marker, she neatly wrote Low-Salt No. 1 / pickled April 9 / salt amount XX g and stuck it on the jars, then recorded the exact total weight of the vegetables and the brine.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Simple lunch and household chores.
description: After finishing the pickling and cleaning up the kitchen, it was nearly noon. She cooked herself a bowl of tomato and egg noodles and had a simple lunch with the leftover rib and tofu soup from last night. While eating, she looked at her phone and saw a voice message sent half an hour ago by Sister Zheng Xiuying, saying that the money from selling handmade samples on consignment could be settled at the community service center in the afternoon. She quickly replied to thank her and agreed to go after the afternoon training class. After lunch, she washed the dishes, brought the dried clothes into the bedroom, and folded them.
location: Kitchen and dining room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Tending the courtyard and taking a midday nap
description: She remembered the scallion seedlings in the yard, picked up a watering can to water each scallion, squatted down to pull up the weeds that had just sprouted, and looked at the lush green scallions while planning to pinch off some for cooking in a few days. After finishing, she sat on the living room sofa for 15 minutes with her eyes closed to rest, and confirmed the samples and notebook to bring to the afternoon training class. At 13:50, she changed into a clean jacket, took two small boxes of "Low-Salt No. 1" samples and the electric bike keys, and got ready to leave.
location: The courtyard and living room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Attended the hands-on class of the community training course and settled the consignment sales payment
description: She rode an electric bike for 10 minutes to reach Yinongli Community Service Center, went up to the third floor, Room 301, and attended the hands-on class "Pastry and Pickling Techniques". She listened carefully as the teacher reviewed yesterday's theory and gave a demonstration. During the free practice session, she took out her own pickled sample jar and asked the teacher for comments. The teacher affirmed the formula direction and suggested adding some apple slices next time to enhance the flavor, which she quickly noted down. After class at 16:00, she went to the service hall on the first floor to find Sister Zheng Xiuying, the grid worker. Zheng Xiuying warmly checked the sales records for the 20 shepherd's purse dumplings delivered last Saturday: 18 had been sold, and the settlement was 36 yuan as agreed (1 yuan commission per piece). She was very happy to receive the money, chatted about everyday things for a while, and then they parted.
location: Room 301, Yinongli Community Service Center, 28 Dong'an Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and the first-floor service hall

name: Picking up the children from school and sitting briefly in the park
description: At 16:20, I arrived on time at Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up my youngest daughter, Xinxin. I squatted down and carefully checked her ankle, and only after confirming she could walk fine did I feel relieved. Then I rode with her to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School and picked up my second son, Zhezhe, at 16:40. It was still early, so instead of going straight home, I took the children to the pavilion at the street park for 10 minutes. The children were running and jumping in the open space. While watching them, I recorded into my phone memo the teacher's suggestion about adding apple slices.
location: From 28 Dong'an Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin to Huakang First Kindergarten at 12 Huakang Road, Jinghai District, then to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School at 76 Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, and finally to the street park at the intersection of Jingwen Road and Shengli Avenue.

name: Preparing dinner and household chores.
description: After arriving home, she arranged for Zhezhe and Xinxin to do homework and play with building blocks in the living room, then tied on an apron and started making dinner: reheated yesterday's pork rib and tofu soup, stir-fried a plate of garlic spinach, smashed a cucumber, and steamed a few flower rolls. The aroma of food filled the kitchen. She took a moment to call her husband Zhiqiang, who said he was on his way home and would be there around 7 o'clock.
location: Kitchen and dining room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Family dinner and homework tutoring
description: At 18:50, my husband Zhiqiang and my eldest son Xuanxuan (who had just finished evening self-study) arrived home one after another, and the whole family sat around eating dinner. I shared the success of today's pickling and the settlement of 36 yuan. Zhiqiang smiled and praised me for being capable. After dinner, I cleared the table and Zhiqiang did the dishes. At 19:30, I started tutoring homework: I had Xuanxuan do math problems by himself in his room, while I tutored Zhezhe on Chinese homework, helping him with dictation of new characters and correcting his strokes. Xinxin was beside me using word cards to recognize characters; when she came across one she didn't know, she would tug at my clothes, and I patiently taught her twice.
location: Dining room and study at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Video call with mother.
description: After the children had basically finished their study tasks, she sat on the sofa and made a video call to her mother Li Xiuying, telling her that she had successfully pickled low-salt vegetables today, that the teacher had given advice, and that the shepherd's purse balls had sold for 36 yuan. Her mother grinned from ear to ear on the video, praised her for being capable, and also told her not to work too hard. The two talked about her father's health and chatted about everyday things for a few minutes before hanging up.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and family wrap-up
description: After hanging up the phone, she urged the three children to wash up in turn and go to bed. Once they were all settled, she went back to the living room, took out her account book, and wrote down the day's income and expenses: 18 yuan spent on vegetables and 36 yuan earned from shepherd's purse dumplings. She also updated her phone memo: 'April 9, Low-Salt No. 1 has been pickled. The teacher suggested adding apple slices to test the flavor.' She prepared the things needed for tomorrow morning and checked the doors, windows, and gas. At 21:20, Zhiqiang had already prepared the footbath water. He sat on the edge of the bed and soaked his feet for a while, feeling the fatigue of the day dissolve.
location: Living room and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Going to bed
description: At 21:30, she turned off the living room light and went to the bedroom with her husband, lying down. She mulled over opening the jar in a few days to check the pickles' progress, and thought about trying something new with shepherd's purse dumplings next time. Listening to her husband's even snoring beside her, she felt secure and at ease. Around 22:00, she turned off the bedside lamp and soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Woken by the sound of rain at dawn, checked the newly pickled low-salt vegetables.
description: Raindrops tapped the window, waking Ma Xiulan, and she got up 10 minutes later than usual. Worried about the Low-Salt No. 1 pickles she had made last night, she threw on a coat and went to the kitchen. She opened the jar and used clean chopsticks to pick out a slice of radish to taste. The bitter saltiness of the sea salt had faded, and the sweet freshness of apple was just beginning to soak in, which made her feel much more at ease.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Persisting with brisk walking in the rain for exercise
description: The rain was quite heavy, but to keep her nine-day habit, Ma Xiulan took an umbrella, put on rain boots, and walked briskly for 15 minutes at Jingwen Road Park. The park was nearly empty, and the bottoms of her pants got wet, but thinking about the afternoon tasting session, she felt energized. When she got home, she dried her hair and changed into dry clothes.
location: Street park on Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Drink ginger tea to ward off cold and warm the body
description: In the kitchen, make a large cup of brown sugar ginger water, sip it slowly to ward off the morning chill, and warm up the whole body.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare and enjoy breakfast for the whole family.
description: Cooked a large pot of clear soup with thin noodles, put a poached egg in each bowl, blanched a few spinach leaves, and sliced a plate of homemade pickled dried radish. Woke up her husband Ma Zhiqiang and the three children, telling them to put on more clothes because the temperature had dropped. The family sat around the table slurping hot noodles, chatting and laughing, full of a steady, homely atmosphere.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Make sure the children put on rain gear and check their schoolbags
description: Helped younger daughter Ma Yuxin put on rain boots and tie the laces, reminding her to stay away from puddles; checked second son Ma Mingzhe's schoolbag and found he had forgotten his umbrella, found a folding umbrella from the shoe cabinet and stuffed it in; eldest son Ma Mingxuan had already packed up on his own and rode his bike to middle school.
location: Various rooms and entryway at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Riding an e-bike to take the children to school and buying groceries on the way
description: Riding her electric bike, she first took Ma Mingzhe to No. 3 Primary School in Jinghai District and watched him run into the school gate; then took Ma Yuxin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten and handed her over to Teacher Zhang. On the way back, she turned into Wutong Commune vegetable market and bought sliced steamed buns, Red Fuji apples, and spinach from stall owner Sun Guifang, spending 12 yuan in total.
location: Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Tianjin; Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepped ingredients, tidied the house, and contacted my mother.
description: She took off her raincoat and hung it up, then called her mother Li Xiuying to confirm she would come over at 2 p.m. and asked her to bring a piece of tofu on the way. Then she tidied the house, fluffed the sofa cushions, wiped down the coffee table, and set out small bowls and plates for tasting. She moved the pickled vegetable jar to a ventilated spot, used clean chopsticks to pick out a few pieces, and divided them into three small dishes in preparation for the afternoon tasting.
location: Kitchen and living room of the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing lunch as neighbor Wang Guilan delivers vegetables to the door.
description: Washed the rice and cooked it, and prepared the ingredients for garlic spinach and hot pork rib soup. The neighbor Wang Guilan knocked on the door and brought over radishes and celery freshly pulled from the field. Ma Xiulan thanked her repeatedly, invited her to stay for tea, and talked about the afternoon pickled vegetable tasting. Wang Guilan readily agreed to come on time and show her support.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Had a simple lunch with her husband.
description: Her husband Ma Zhiqiang was not driving today and rested at home. Ma Xiulan made scrambled eggs with tomatoes, heated up yesterday's pork rib soup, and the two ate with white rice while chatting. She told him that she had invited her mother and neighbors to taste the new pickles that afternoon. Ma Zhiqiang smiled and supported her, saying that if they tasted good, they would use this low-salt recipe from then on.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: A short midday nap
description: After clearing the dishes, drowsiness washed over her. Lying in bed in the bedroom, listening to the rain outside gradually fading, she still mulled over the afternoon tasting notes: whether the apple flavor was strong enough, whether to add a bit more rock sugar... She drifted off to sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Getting up, preparing tea and snacks, and grooming
description: After the alarm went off, she got up, washed her face, combed her hair, and tidied herself up. In the kitchen, she boiled water, washed an apple and cut it into pieces, and set out a few kinds of dried fruit. She opened the small dish of pickled vegetables again to smell it, confirming the flavor was just right, and felt confident.
location: Kitchen and bathroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Have relatives and friends taste the low-salt pickled vegetables and collect feedback
description: At 2 p.m., her mother, Li Xiuying, arrived on time carrying tofu, and Liu Chunmei and Wang Guilan came in one after the other. Ma Xiulan put three plates of new pickled vegetables and sliced steamed buns on the table and invited everyone to taste them. Liu Chunmei said the saltiness was just right and the texture was crisp and refreshing; Wang Guilan said the flavor was about the same as before, no worse. Her mother tasted them carefully and gave a key suggestion: “Xiulan, add a little rock sugar to suppress the slight bitterness of the sea salt, and pair it with the persimmon vinegar I brew — that would be absolutely perfect!” Ma Xiulan quickly wrote it down, feeling enlightened.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: See off guests and prepare to pick up the children.
description: The tasting event ended in a lively atmosphere. Mother urged them to come home for dinner on the weekend, Liu Chunmei encouraged her to keep up the good work, and Wang Guilan said she would be the first to buy once it hit the market. Ma Xiulan saw the three off at the courtyard gate, feeling warm inside. Seeing that it was about time, she went back inside, put on her coat, and wheeled out her electric bike to get the children.
location: Courtyard entrance at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the two children from school.
description: First I went to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up Ma Yuxin. She excitedly held up a drawing with a sun and a rainbow. Then I went to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up Ma Mingzhe. Passing the small stall at the community entrance, I bought a grilled sausage for each of the two children. They took turns taking bites, chatting and laughing all the way home.
location: Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin; on the way home

name: Made dinner and photographed the pickled vegetables to post on WeChat Moments
description: While the children did their homework, Ma Xiulan stir-fried garlic spinach in the kitchen, reheated the pork rib soup, and smashed cucumbers. She packed the new pickles into small glass jars, placed them in the good light by the window, and took several photos with her phone.
