She picked the best one and captioned it: "New low-salt recipe, healthy and delicious, certified by family and friends!" and posted it to her Moments.
location: Kitchen and living room of the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The family of five had dinner together.
description: When her eldest son Ma Mingxuan came home from school, the whole family of five sat around the dining table, and Ma Xiulan served stir-fried spinach, pork rib soup, cucumber salad, and the new pickled vegetables. While eating, she looked at her phone; the photos she had posted on Moments had only gotten three likes. She felt a bit disappointed but didn't say anything.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Helping with homework, video-chatting with mother, and receiving the first order.
description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan watched the children do their homework. Ma Yuxin was drawing beside her, and Ma Mingzhe was asked to redo two math problems he got wrong. A phone notification sounded: Wang Guilan commented on Moments, "It looks so appetizing!" Then her neighbor Zhang Shufen sent a private message: "Xiulan, give me two bottles of the new recipe. How much?" Ma Xiulan immediately replied, "10 yuan a bottle, neighbor's price," and the other party transferred 20 yuan at once. Then she video-called her mother Li Xiuying and shared the good news of the tasting feedback and the neighbor's order; her mother was happy for her on the other end of the line.
location: Various rooms of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Organize feedback and adjust the pickle strategy and mindset.
description: After hanging up, Ma Xiulan wrote down all the feedback from the day in her small notebook: Liu Chunmei's opinion, Wang Guilan's encouragement, the persimmon vinegar secret recipe her mother gave her, and Zhang Shufen's order. She decided to try adding rock sugar and persimmon vinegar tomorrow, and changed her Moments permission from "Visible for three days" to "All", resolving to run her Moments as a pickled-vegetable diary.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Wash up and share the joy with her husband.
description: She urged the children to wash up and go to bed, and took a hot bath herself to wash away the fatigue. Back in the bedroom, her husband Ma Zhiqiang was already lying down. She quietly told him about Zhang Shufen ordering pickled vegetables, with a rare tone of confidence and excitement.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Review the day's emotional journey and fall asleep peacefully.
description: Lying in bed, she reviewed the day in her mind: persisting in the rain, affirmation from family and friends, and genuine encouragement from customers. Her previous unease was swept away, replaced by real relief. After turning off the light, she listened to the rain outside the window and fell asleep quickly with a smile on her lips.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Morning exercise and breakfast
description: Got up at 6:15 in the morning, washed up, changed into sportswear, took her phone and left. She walked along Jingwen Road, turned onto Shengli Street, and headed to Xicheng Fitness Park, greeting old neighbors who were exercising along the way. At 6:50 she met Zhang Shufen at the park gate, and they took a 40-minute brisk walk along the lakeside trail, chatting about pickled vegetable orders and packaging plans as they walked. After the workout, the two went to Old Li Breakfast outside the east gate of the park and ordered crispy rice crust dish and Chinese crepes with fried dough sticks. During the meal, Zhang Shufen suggested upgrading the pickled vegetable packaging with small glass jars, handwritten red paper labels, and twine, and agreed to try selling them at the supermarket checkout counter. Ma Xiulan carefully recorded the suggestion on her phone.
location: Xicheng Fitness Park and Old Li's Breakfast at the East Gate, Shengli Avenue, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Take the children to school.
description: After breakfast, she rode her e-bike from the park gate along Shengli South Street. First she took her second son, Ma Mingzhe, to the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, helped him straighten his red scarf, and told him to listen carefully in class. Then she turned the bike around, doubled back, and turned again to take her daughter Ma Yuxin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten. She kissed her on the cheek and watched her skip into the classroom.
location: Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School and Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, No. 100 Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Bought groceries and went home.
description: After dropping off the children, she rode her electric bike to the Wutong Commune Vegetable Market on the way and bought spinach, lettuce, and young ginger at Sun Guifang's stall for 12 yuan. After a brief chat with Aunt Sun, she rode home to 156 Jingwen Road.
location: Wutong Commune vegetable market, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China, and home at 156 Jingwen Road

name: Housework and pickled vegetable packaging upgrade
description: After returning home, she quickly washed clothes and cleared the dining table. Then she took out the small glass bottles that had been washed in advance and scraps of fabric, sat by the window, and began making packaging by hand. She cut round cloth covers with scissors, sewed them stitch by stitch, and fitted them over the bottle caps. She also cut small labels from red paper and wrote Xiulan Low-Salt Pickles with a writing brush. After completing a few samples, she felt a strong sense of accomplishment.
location: Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Lunch and lunch break.
description: She reheated the leftover stew and rice from last night for lunch. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang came home during a break between short-distance trips. They briefly exchanged thoughts on the packaging upgrade idea, and he gave his approval. Ma Zhiqiang ate in a hurry and left again for work. After clearing the dishes, she leaned back on the sofa for a 15-minute afternoon rest.
location: Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Inspect the vegetable garden in the courtyard.
description: After the lunch break, she changed into cloth shoes and walked into the south-facing small courtyard. She carefully checked the scallions and spinach planted last month; the tender seedlings had grown to the height of a finger and broken through the soil. She watered them with a watering can, pulled out weeds, and enjoyed the pastoral time in the sunshine.
location: South-facing small courtyard at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Reviewing notes from the training class.
description: Made a cup of tea, sat down at the desk, and took out the “Key Points of Low-Salt Pickling Techniques” and “Food Hygiene and Safety Handbook” distributed by the community training class. She focused on reviewing the sections on avoiding nitrite peaks during fermentation and sealing and sterilizing finished products, underlining and taking notes in her notebook to prepare for talking with customers at the market at the end of the month.
location: At the desk in the bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Go to the community to ask about the market event.
description: Worried about the market booth registration at the end of the month, she rode her electric bike to the Yinongli Community Party-Mass Service Center. She found grid worker Sister Zheng Xiuying and learned that booth registration had closed, but she had been put on the backup list. Sister Zheng encouraged her, saying that the market judges would taste samples, and told her to prepare samples first and wait for notice. She left with hope.
location: Hall of Yinongli Community Party-Mass Service Center, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Pick the children up from school.
description: From the community service center, she rode her electric bike to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up her daughter Ma Yuxin, who excitedly shared that her painting had been praised. Then she took her along to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up her second son Ma Mingzhe. At a roadside stall by the school gate, she bought two grilled sausages for the children. Finally, she rode back home with the two children.
location: Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China; Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School at 100 Shengli South Street; and home at 156 Jingwen Road.

name: Helping with homework and preparing dinner
description: After returning home, she arranged for the three children to do their homework, while in the kitchen she sorted and washed the vegetables, occasionally checking on the children's progress. She put on an apron and started cooking, preparing scrambled eggs with tomatoes, garlic broccoli, and spinach tofu soup.
location: Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Family dinner
description: Husband Ma Zhiqiang made it home before dinner, and the family sat together. While eating, they listened to the children talk about funny things at school. Ma Xiulan mentioned the community registration, and her husband comforted her, saying, "Good things are not afraid of a deep alley." The atmosphere was warm.
location: Dining room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Evening family time
description: After dinner, once the kitchen was cleaned up, her husband Ma Zhiqiang repaired an old electric fan on the balcony. Ma Xiulan urged the children to put away their books, read a picture book with her daughter, then took out the finished cloth cover to show her husband and received his approval.
location: Living room and balcony of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Personal review and bookkeeping
description: After the children went back to their rooms, she sat at the desk and took out the account book to record the morning exercise, Zhang Shufen's trial sale promise, thoughts on making the packaging, and the backup list for the community market. Then she used her phone to take photos of the cloth cover samples, planning to post them on Moments the next day. She also replied to Liu Chunmei's inquiry about packaging.
location: At the desk in the bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Washing up and getting ready for bed
description: After washing up and changing into pajamas, she lay in bed and saw that her WeChat Sports step count was close to 10,000 steps. After a brief talk with her husband, she turned off the light to rest and fell asleep looking forward to trying the new pickled vegetables tomorrow.
location: Bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Preparing goods in the early morning, with husband helping to transport them
description: At 4:50 in the morning, Ma Xiulan got up quietly and, in the kitchen, counted the 20 jars of prepared pickled vegetables, 8 of which were new-recipe spicy pickled vegetables tied with red string. She prepared a tablecloth embroidered with the words Sister Ma, handwritten price tags, disposable small plates, and other items. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang was woken up and helped her load the goods onto the covered tricycle and tie them down firmly with rope. The two rode together to stall C-6 in the handicraft market at Yinongli Community Square. After arriving, Ma Zhiqiang helped set up the sun umbrella, arrange the folding table and the jars of pickled vegetables, and then left.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin to Yinongli Community Square

name: Brief stretch before the market starts
description: Ma Xiulan did simple stretches in the open space beside the stall, moving her neck, twisting her waist, taking deep breaths, and kicking her legs, replacing her usual brisk walking in the park. She encouraged herself that being busy at the stall today could still achieve the effect of exercise.
location: Yinongli Community Square, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Return home to prepare breakfast and take a short break.
description: Ma Xiulan rode her tricycle home, taking about 8 minutes. After returning, she quickly prepared breakfast: heated steamed buns and stuffed buns, sliced pickled radish skin and Jerusalem artichokes, and made a beaten egg drink. After finishing breakfast with her husband Ma Zhiqiang, she kept thinking about buying a flatbread stuffed with pork tenderloin for her childhood friend Liu Chunmei at the market later.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Selling pickled vegetables at the community craft market
description: In the morning the market crowd grew, and at first there were more onlookers than buyers. Her childhood friend Liu Chunmei specially swapped shifts to come, wearing a floral-print jacket. After discussing, Ma Xiulan opened a jar of the new-recipe spicy pickled vegetables for tasting. Liu Chunmei loudly hawked to attract customers, and Zhou Xiuqin, from the neighboring paper-cutting stall, also helped recommend them to acquaintances. The three worked together smoothly: Ma Xiulan handled taking money and giving change (she had prepared rolls of small bills in advance) and introduced the low-salt recipe to customers. In the morning she sold 13 jars of pickled vegetables, and 2 more jars were booked directly via WeChat after tasting. Counting up at 11 o'clock, the gross income was 260 yuan, and Ma Xiulan was very happy.

participant.name: Zhou Xiuqin
participant.relation: Fellow vendor at the neighboring stall

location: Stall C-6, Yinongli Community Square, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Packed up the stall and delivered pickled vegetables to her mother and neighbors on the way
description: After the market ended, Ma Xiulan made an appointment with Liu Chunmei and Zhou Xiuqin for the next stall, packed up the booth, and deliberately set aside two small jars of new pickled vegetables. She rode her tricycle first to her mother Li Xiuying's home at 45 Shengli Street, handed over the spicy pickled vegetables and chatted briefly. Then she rode back to her own building, first knocked on the door of neighbor Wang Guilan across the hallway, gave her a jar of pickled vegetables for tasting and comments, and Wang Guilan praised her for being capable.
location: No. 45 Shengli Street and No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Returned home for a simple lunch
description: On her way home, Ma Xiulan bought a few hot sesame cakes. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang had already made noodles with tomato and egg sauce. The family sat around the table eating. Ma Xiulan excitedly shared her market sales results, saying she had sold 13 jars and earned 260 yuan. Her son Ma Mingzhe asked when they would go next, and Ma Xiulan said she would go again next Saturday if the weather was nice.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Took a lunch break and contacted the supermarket about selling pickled vegetables on consignment.
description: After lunch, Ma Xiulan took a short nap of about 40 minutes and felt refreshed when she woke up. Leaning on the sofa, she used her phone to send a WeChat message to Zhang Shufen of Shufen Convenience Store diagonally across the street, telling her that the market sales had received good feedback and suggesting that she deliver samples to the store tomorrow afternoon to finalize the consignment arrangement in person, adding that she had already prepared the packaging as requested. After that, she browsed the customer feedback she had recorded on her phone and planned to pickle more spicy vegetables next time.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Helping children with homework and doing housework
description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan sat with her son Ma Mingzhe in the living room while he did his math homework. As she checked his stroke order, she also wiped the table and tidied up scattered toys. Her daughter Ma Yuxin was drawing nearby and gave her a smiling face. Ma Xiulan found a mistake in her son's word problems and patiently explained it. In between, she also made time to list the groceries to buy at the vegetable market tomorrow and stuck it on the refrigerator door.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Making hand-rolled noodles with fried sauce and five-spice quail eggs
description: Ma Xiulan began to prepare dinner: she kneaded the dough, let it rest, made hand-rolled noodles, and fried up a minced pork sauce. Recalling that she had promised the children five-spiced quail eggs, she took quail eggs out of the refrigerator, washed them, put them in cold water to boil, and used the back of a knife to crack the shells so they would absorb the flavor. The kitchen was filled with the aroma of fried sauce and braising spices.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The whole family enjoys dinner together
description: The eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, came back from a classmate's house, and the family of five gathered for dinner. On the table were noodles with soybean paste, five-spice quail eggs, and sliced tomatoes with sugar. Ma Zhiqiang ate two bowls and praised the handmade noodles for being chewy. The children also ate happily; daughter Ma Yuxin got her hands dirty peeling an egg herself. During the meal, Ma Mingxuan asked if he could earn money to buy new sneakers. Ma Xiulan said to save it first and buy them when school starts. The atmosphere was harmonious.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: After-meal cleanup and homework tutoring
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan cleared the dishes, wiped down the stove and sink, and soaked the braised quail eggs in the broth to cool before refrigerating them. Then she began supervising the children's studies: her eldest son Ma Mingxuan was doing physics and English in his room, and she checked on him occasionally to keep him from playing with his phone; Ma Mingzhe was doing Chinese homework in the living room, and she watched to make sure his handwriting was neat; Ma Yuxin was using character cards, and she taught her to read "spring, summer, autumn, winter." Seeing the children studying quietly, she felt at ease.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Bookkeeping, contacting clients, and personal time
description: After the children fell asleep, her husband watched TV in the living room. Ma Xiulan took out the account book in the bedroom, calculated the day's gross market income of 260 yuan, deducted the courier change and the 10 yuan spent on sesame cakes, and recorded a net profit of about 230 yuan. She added WeChat notes with names for the newly added customers and planned to go to the wholesale market the next day to buy Sichuan peppercorns, star anise, and other seasonings to pickle another batch of pickled vegetables. Then she called her mother to share the good news. After chatting about family life for more than ten minutes, she was happy to learn that her father had gone fishing.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Had a heated argument with her husband over education savings
description: After hanging up the phone, Ma Zhiqiang and Ma Xiulan talked about household expenses in the living room. Ma Zhiqiang suggested pausing the education savings for the three children due to the pressure of car loan payments and fuel costs. Ma Xiulan firmly opposed it and became emotional, claiming that everything else could be cut but education savings could not be interrupted. Their voices grew louder, and the argument woke up Ma Mingzhe in the next room, who hid under the blanket in fear; their daughter Ma Yuxin was also scared into crying. Hearing the crying, Ma Xiulan felt wronged and upset, was momentarily at a loss for words, slammed the door, and sat down on the sofa with tears welling up in her eyes.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Sat alone quietly, then went to bed late at night
description: The living room lights were off, with only the streetlight outside filtering through the curtains. Ma Xiulan sat alone on the sofa reflecting, understanding how hard her husband worked to support the family, but still worrying about the children's education costs, unable to calm her mind. After sitting for nearly an hour, her mood settled somewhat, and she decided to talk to her husband the next day after his anger had cooled. Then she went to the bathroom, washed her face with cold water, and quietly slipped into the bedroom to lie down fully clothed. She tossed and turned for a long time before finally drifting off to sleep.
location: Jinghai District, Tianjin, 156 Jingwen Road, home living room to bedroom

name: Send a long WeChat message to communicate with husband about education savings
description: After waking up in the morning, Ma Xiulan still felt a weight in her chest because of the quarrel with her husband Ma Zhiqiang the night before. She picked up her phone and composed a long WeChat message to her husband, first apologizing for her attitude last night, then taking a photo of the handwritten education expense forecast table she had made the previous night and sending it to him. She pointed out that even if they saved only 100 yuan a month, it would be more than 10,000 yuan after ten years, and suggested that the money come from the 10 yuan a day her husband spent on cigarettes. She proposed depositing at least 100 yuan a month into education savings. After sending it, her mood improved somewhat.
location: Master bedroom of the home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Washing up and preparing breakfast
description: After quickly washing up, Ma Xiulan went into the kitchen to prepare breakfast for the family. She heated up steamed buns, cooked millet porridge, and cut a plate of pickled vegetables given by her neighbor, Sister Wang Guilan.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Wake the children and have breakfast together
description: Ma Xiulan woke up her three children: the eldest, Ma Mingxuan, got up on his own; the second, Ma Mingzhe, stayed in bed and had to be called twice; she helped her youngest daughter, Ma Yuxin, braid her hair. The family of four had breakfast in the dining room. The atmosphere was quiet, and Xiulan forced herself to cheer up and put food on the children's plates.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tidy up the kitchen and check the pickled vegetable samples
description: After breakfast, Ma Xiulan cleared the dishes, wiped the table, swept the floor, and tidied the kitchen. Then she went to the storage room to check the 6 jars of pickled vegetables left from yesterday's market (3 low-salt and 3 spicy), confirmed the seals were intact, and cut red paper to write labels reading Sister Ma Low-Salt Pickles, ready to stick on the samples.
location: Kitchen and storage room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Deliver pickled vegetable samples to Shufen Convenience Store
description: Ma Xiulan packed 6 jars of pickled vegetables in a cloth bag and walked with her younger daughter Ma Yuxin to Shufen Convenience Store at 101 Jingwen Road. The shopkeeper Wang Shufen received them warmly. Xiulan gave the samples to Shufen to sell on consignment, asking her to put them in a prominent spot. The two chatted about yesterday's market situation.
location: Shufen Convenience Store, 101 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Taking her daughter to Wutong Community vegetable market to buy white radishes.
description: After coming out of the supermarket, Ma Xiulan took her younger daughter by the hand and walked along Jingwen Road to Diwei Road, arriving at the Wutong Commune vegetable market. At the stall of her familiar produce vendor Sun Guifang, she bought three jin of fresh white radishes for 4.5 yuan, and Aunt Sun also gave her a bunch of cilantro.

participant.name: Sun Guifang
participant.relation: An acquaintance who runs a stall at the vegetable market

location: Wutong Community Vegetable Market, Diwei Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Returned home to prepare lunch and pickle radish strips.
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan washed the tomatoes and cucumbers and set them aside. Then she washed the white radishes she had bought, cut them into strips, sprinkled them with salt to draw out the water, preparing to make pickled vegetables. Her younger daughter played nearby.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Turning over the soil in the courtyard to prepare for planting vegetables.
description: Ma Xiulan took a shovel from the storage room and went to the east corner of the courtyard to turn the soil, planning to plant some scallions and spinach. Her little daughter Xin Xin came over with a small toy watering can to help, and accidentally stepped on the soil ridge and knocked it askew. Xiulan was not angry; instead, she smiled and taught her daughter to water the plants hand over hand.
location: Home courtyard at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepared lunch, dried the radishes, and finished turning over the soil
description: Ma Xiulan went into the kitchen to start lunch. She took the radish strips that had been salted to draw out water, drained them, and spread them on a reed mat to dry. She lit the stove and cooked tomato and egg noodles. While the noodles were cooking, she went to the yard and finished tilling and leveling all the remaining soil.
location: Home kitchen and courtyard at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Having lunch with the children
description: At noon, Ma Xiulan and her three children ate tomato and egg noodles with smashed cucumber. The eldest, Ma Mingxuan, ate two big bowls. The second son, Ma Mingzhe, was picky but finished his. The youngest daughter also had a small bowl. At the table, Xiulan told the children to do their homework after the meal.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Short midday rest
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan asked the older two children to do their homework, put on a cartoon for the youngest daughter, and, because she had hardly slept the night before, lay down on the sofa in the master bedroom. She set a 20-minute alarm and rested with her eyes closed. Although she didn't fall into a deep sleep, she felt somewhat refreshed.
location: Master bedroom of the home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Finish pickling the radishes and continue vegetable gardening in the yard.
description: After the afternoon nap, she felt better. Ma Xiulan went to the kitchen, mixed the nearly dried radish strips with salt, sugar, Sichuan pepper and other seasonings, packed them into a small jar, pressed them down, sealed it, and placed it in a cool place. Then she went to the yard to sow scallions and spinach, covered them with soil and watered them. Her youngest daughter Xinxin also came to help, getting the ground covered with dirt, but Xiulan let her be.
location: Home kitchen and courtyard at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Answered her husband's call; the couple reconciled.
description: While watering the courtyard, Ma Xiulan received a call from her husband Ma Zhiqiang. Zhiqiang admitted that he had been impatient, agreed to leave the education savings untouched, and decided to save 2 yuan a day from his cigarette money. Xiulan replied softly, and the couple understood each other and made up. After hanging up, Xiulan felt completely relaxed.
location: Home courtyard at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Check children's homework and post the family rules on education savings
description: Ma Xiulan went to the study to check the children's homework. The oldest, Ma Mingxuan, got all the math problems right and was praised. The second son, Ma Mingzhe, made quite a few mistakes; she patiently explained and urged him to correct them. Then she posted a sticky note reading "Save at least 100 yuan per month for education" on the wall next to the living room refrigerator to motivate the whole family.
location: Study and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing dinner, with the children helping
description: Ma Xiulan's mood improved, and she decided to make stewed pork with potatoes and scrambled eggs. She cut the meat and potatoes, asked her oldest son Ma Mingxuan to peel garlic, her second son Ma Mingzhe to snap green beans, and her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin to pass the bowls. The kitchen was filled with a warm atmosphere. During this time, she saw the account-book photo her husband had sent, in which the smoking budget had been changed from 10 yuan to 8 yuan, and felt a warmth in her heart.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Having a family dinner and a video call with her husband
description: Dinner was ready, and Ma Xiulan called the children to eat. As soon as they sat down, her husband Ma Zhiqiang made a video call. He was resting at a service area and joined the family via video. The children shouted Daddy at the phone. Xiulan told her husband to drive safely and not to worry. At the table, she put extra meat on the children's plates, and the atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: After-meal chores and tutoring the youngest daughter
description: After dinner, the eldest son Ma Mingxuan took the initiative to wash the dishes. Ma Xiulan supervised her second son Ma Mingzhe doing homework in the living room and wiped down the dining table and chairs. The youngest daughter Ma Yuxin pestered to hear a story, so Xiulan told her the story of the Little White Rabbit and showed her the photos from the afternoon watering, which made her daughter giggle.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Keeping accounts and chatting with friends
description: While the children played in the living room, Ma Xiulan took out her account book, recorded the day's grocery spending of 4.5 yuan, and sorted out yesterday's market income and the costs of the pickled vegetables. She specially wrote the note: “Zhiqiang agreed to save, family plan launched.” Then she sent a voice message to her childhood friend Liu Chunmei about making up with her husband, and contacted her embroidery partner Zhou Xiuqin to ask about handcraft work, learning that a nearby factory had outsourcing opportunities for semi-finished products.

participant.name: Zhou Xiuqin
participant.relation: A friend she met through embroidery.

location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Wash up and coax the youngest daughter to sleep.
description: After urging her two sons to wash up and go to bed, Ma Xiulan bathed her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin, then carried her to bed and told her the story of Little Red Riding Hood. The little girl fell asleep quickly. Looking at her daughter's rosy sleeping face, Xiulan felt that the day's fatigue was all worth it.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Bedtime preparation and contacting her husband
description: After Ma Xiulan confirmed the alarm clocks for the children's school the next day, she lay down and sent a WeChat message to her husband Ma Zhiqiang: “You worked hard today. Drive safely tomorrow. Xinxin said she misses you.” Soon she received a reply: “Got it. You get some sleep too.” Only then did she turn off the light and fall asleep at ease, bringing the day to a satisfying end.
location: Master bedroom of the home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Getting up in the morning and morning exercise.
description: After getting up in the morning, she put on sneakers and went to Jingwen Road Street Park for two brisk laps, breathing fresh air and feeling spirited. Thanks to yesterday's reconciliation with her husband, she felt at ease and got up on time.
location: Street park on Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Buying breakfast on the way and exchanging pleasantries with neighbors.
description: After finishing the exercise, she stopped by Shufen Convenience Store at 158 Jingwen Road on the way to buy fried dough sticks and hot soy milk. She exchanged pleasantries with the store owner, Zhang Shufen. Zhang Shufen teased Ma Xiulan about being full of energy, and Ma Xiulan said she would come by later to ask for advice on WeChat marketing.
location: Shufen Convenience Store, 158 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare breakfast and have a family meal
description: After returning home, she cut up the fried dough sticks, made soy milk with the soybeans soaked last night, and boiled three eggs. She woke the three children one by one: the eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, washed up briskly by himself; the second son, Ma Mingzhe, had to be called out of bed; and the youngest daughter, Ma Yuxin, was the most obedient. The family sat around the table for breakfast. Ma Mingzhe talked about the cartoon he watched yesterday, while Ma Yuxin got soy milk foam on the corners of her mouth, creating a warm and cozy atmosphere.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Taking her second son and daughter to school.
description: She rode an electric bike to take Ma Mingzhe to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, watched him walk into the school gate with his classmates; then rode with Ma Yuxin for five or six minutes to Huakang First Kindergarten, handed her daughter to the teacher, and reminded her to drink more water at noon.
location: Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, No. 600 Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and Huakang First Kindergarten, Wanghai Road, Xincheng, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Stopped by the vegetable market to buy groceries on the way
description: After dropping off the child, she stopped by Wutong Commune Vegetable Market on the way and went straight to Sun Guifang's stall to buy white radish, green peppers, and scallions. Sun Guifang mentioned that she heard Ma Xiulan and her husband had made up, and encouraged her to live well together. After shopping, she cycled home.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Doing housework and checking on the pickled vegetables.
description: After getting home, I changed into loungewear, sorted the vegetables and put them in the fridge, then did laundry and tidied up the house. I specially took out the jar of radish strips I had pickled yesterday, turned them over, and smelled them. The color was clear and bright with no off odor, and I felt this batch turned out very successful.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Learn WeChat marketing from Zhang Shufen.
description: She packed a small bowl of freshly pickled vegetables, grabbed her phone and notebook, and went to Shufen Convenience Store. She let Zhang Shufen taste the reduced-salt radish strips, and Zhang Shufen praised them as delicious. Then Zhang Shufen personally taught Ma Xiulan how to create a customer group, change the group name and announcement, post to Moments with text and images, and use group sign-ups to tally orders. The two set up the "Xiulan Homemade Pickles" customer group on the spot, and Zhang Shufen promised to help invite people in the afternoon. Ma Xiulan carefully wrote down the key points and felt confident about her future business.
location: Shufen Convenience Store, 158 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Simple lunch and rest.
description: After getting home at 11:30, she used the leftover soft fried dough sticks from the morning and a luffa gourd to make stir-fried luffa with fried dough sticks, heated two steamed buns, and made a bowl of seaweed soup, eating a simple meal alone. After clearing the dishes, she took a nap on the living room sofa under a blanket, set an alarm for 13:00, and was still mulling over the video recording planned for the afternoon.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Recorded and edited a short video on making pickled vegetables
description: After the 13:00 alarm went off, she got up, washed her face, took out her phone stand, cleaned the kitchen stove, put the newly pickled radish strips on a plate, prepared serving chopsticks and glass bowls, and practiced her opening lines toward the phone. After setting up the phone, she started recording a video introducing Jinghai's authentic crispy radish strips, emphasizing that they are low-salt, healthy, purely handmade, and free of preservatives. She recorded two or three times and chose the best take. Then she fumbled with a phone editing app to add an opening title and subtitles, and it took nearly an hour to save successfully.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Publish short videos and interact online
description: She posted the video to her Moments with the caption: "The pickles everyone praised at the market can now be pre-ordered! Low-salt and healthy, a neighborhood recipe. Order today and you can eat them tomorrow!" She also forwarded it to the "Jingwen Road Parent-Child Exchange Group." After posting, she refreshed frequently and was very happy to see friends liking and commenting. Two neighbors privately messaged to ask how to buy, and she replied to each one.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up child from school and stop by the supermarket
description: At 15:25 she set off on her electric bicycle. First she went to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up her daughter Ma Yuxin, who excitedly shared that her teacher had praised her for helping other children. Then she went to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up her second son Ma Mingzhe. After that she stopped by Shufen Convenience Store. Zhang Shufen waved and told her someone in the group was asking about delivery. Ma Xiulan went into the store, checked her phone, and found that customer Wang Guilan had asked in the group for two bottles. She was very happy.
location: Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School; Shufen Convenience Store, 158 Jingwen Road.

name: Take the children to the neighborhood park for activities.
description: After leaving the supermarket, seeing that it was still early, she took the children to the Jingwen Road neighborhood park and let them eat biscuits to regain their energy. Ma Yuxin picked up flower petals, and Ma Mingzhe chased butterflies. Ma Xiulan sat on a bench and sent a voice message to her husband on her phone, asking what he wanted to eat for dinner and telling him that the business was taking shape, feeling very happy.
location: Street park on Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner and family tutoring
description: After returning home at 17:00, she changed into an apron and prepared dinner, making the potato stewed beef and garlic stir-fried lettuce the children wanted. Meanwhile, she told Ma Mingzhe to do his homework in the living room and Ma Yuxin to draw, and from time to time she checked the homework and corrected wrong characters. At 17:50, the eldest son Ma Mingxuan came home from school and took the initiative to set the table. The whole family sat around the table and ate. Ma Xiulan shared how she had learned to create a group and send videos today; the children did not fully understand but were happy for her. After dinner, she washed the dishes and wiped the table. Ma Mingxuan was responsible for tutoring Ma Mingzhe in math, Ma Yuxin practiced pinyin, and Ma Xiulan, after checking homework, accompanied Ma Yuxin in reading picture books.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Create a customer group and record orders
description: After the children were settled, Ma Xiulan took out her phone and pulled Liu Chunmei, Wang Guilan, Zhang Shufen, and two customers she had met at the market—who had been added during the day through private chats and Moments—into the “Xiulan Homemade Pickled Vegetables” group. She posted an announcement introducing the available flavors: classic spicy, low-salt original, and sweet-and-sour refreshing, emphasizing that everything is purely handmade with no additives. Then she recorded the day's orders in her account book: Liu Chunmei (mildly spicy) 1 jar, Aunt Wang (regular) 2 jars, Sister Zhang (extra sour) 1 jar, and Sister Zhao asked about a garlic-free version. One customer privately asked whether a customized birthday gift box could be made. She replied that she would look into packaging and pricing tomorrow, and felt the business prospects looked bright.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

Noticing that the seed coats were slightly cracked, she took photos to record the change and compared them with yesterday's photos, full of joy.
location: Home courtyard at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Picking up children from school and shopping on the way.
description: Ma Xiulan thawed the sea bass and soaked the wood ear mushrooms ahead of time to prepare for dinner, then walked to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up her younger daughter Xinxin, and then went to No. 3 Primary School to pick up her second son Zhezhe. The three of them went to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market and bought fruit cucumbers and apples at Aunt Sun's stall. On the way home, the children shared funny stories from school.
location: Huakang First Kindergarten in Jinghai District, Tianjin, Shengli South Street Third Primary School, Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, and along the route.

name: Preparing dinner and supervising the children's homework
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan cleaned and marinated the sea bass, trimmed and washed the leaf lettuce, and made smashed cucumber salad. At the same time, she urged Zhezhe and Xinxin to do their homework and drawing, and from time to time corrected Zhezhe's sitting posture and arithmetic problems. The eldest son, Xuanxuan, went to his room to read on his own after school.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner and family fitness initiative
description: Her husband Ma Zhiqiang came home, and dinner was served. The meal included steamed sea bass, garlic lettuce, and cucumber salad. Ma Xiulan shared her experience of feeling better after keeping up with her daily walks, and suggested that the whole family exercise together on weekends. Zhiqiang and the children agreed.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Household Chores and Parent-Child Time
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan cleared the table, and Zhiqiang volunteered to wash the dishes. Ma Xiulan played with building blocks with Xinxin and asked Xuanxuan about school. Xuanxuan shared an interesting story about the atmospheric pressure experiment in physics class.
location: Kitchen and living room of the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Helping with homework and making sure everyone washes up
description: Ma Xiulan accompanied Zhezhe to review the wrong answers on the math test paper and guided him to recalculate. Then she urged Zhezhe and Xinxin to brush their teeth and wash their faces. Xinxin was reminded for playing with water, while Xuanxuan washed up on his own.
location: Living room and bathroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Putting the youngest daughter to bed and organizing records before sleep
description: Ma Xiulan bathed Xinxin, changed her into pajamas, and told her the story Little Rabbit Be Good to lull her to sleep. Afterward, she tidied the toys in the living room, checked the doors and windows for safety, went back to the bedroom, recorded the day's expenses in the ledger, organized the flower and plant photos, replied to the pickled vegetables group about the pickup time, and reviewed Dr. Wang's medical instructions again.
location: At 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin: the youngest daughter's bedroom, living room, and master bedroom

name: Pre-sleep relaxation and rest
description: Ma Xiulan lay flat on her back and did deep breathing to relax for 5 minutes, reviewed that the day had gone smoothly, and felt content. She then fell asleep and enjoyed a peaceful night.
location: Master bedroom of the home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Getting up in the early morning, stretching, and waking up her husband.
description: Outside the window the sky was faintly light and birds sang crisply. Ma Xiulan turned over gently, sat on the edge of the bed for 5 minutes, slowly turned her neck, and rolled her shoulders. Then she nudged her husband Ma Zhiqiang beside her and whispered encouragement for him to join her for a morning walk. Zhiqiang drowsily mumbled in response, struggled to sit up and get dressed, and Xiulan quickly handed him his coat.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Morning walk with husband and home workout check-in
description: Ma Xiulan and her husband Ma Zhiqiang went out side by side and walked along Jingwen Road. Jingwen Road was quiet in the early morning, with the occasional jogger. As they walked, Xiulan talked about her plan to make low-salt pickles, while Zhiqiang responded half-heartedly. When they reached the flower beds at the street park, about 1.5 kilometers from home, Zhiqiang was out of breath and said he was sleepy and wanted to go back for a nap. Xiulan smiled and agreed, then continued brisk walking alone along the perimeter of the park to complete the remaining about 1.5 kilometers. After sweating, she felt refreshed all over. Back home, she took out her phone in the living room, opened the memo app, and carefully wrote: "April 19, 2025, Zhiqiang walked half the way with me for the first time—a good start. We agreed to walk together again next Saturday at 6:30 a.m." She underlined the text, feeling sweet inside. She drank a glass of warm water, wiped her face, and felt full of energy.
location: Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (section from residence to the street park) and the living room at home

name: Prepare and enjoy breakfast for the whole family.
description: The children woke up one by one. Ma Xiulan tied on an apron, cooked millet porridge in the kitchen, fried eggs, and baked scallion pancakes. Xuanxuan (13 years old) called them to breakfast, and Xiulan asked him to take his younger siblings to wash their faces. Xinxin (6 years old) came over rubbing her eyes, and Xiulan gave her a small piece of pancake. She deliberately left a portion for her husband Ma Zhiqiang, who was still catching up on sleep, keeping it warm in the pot. Afterward, Xiulan sat around the dining table with the three children, urging Xuanxuan to focus on his homework, Zhezhe (10 years old) to practice calligraphy more and watch fewer cartoons, and wiping Xinxin's porridge-smeared face. During the meal, she also reminded the children that it might rain in the evening and that they should not go far in the afternoon.
location: Kitchen and dining room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Hand-washing the embroidered tablecloth and drying it in the shade
description: After breakfast, Ma Xiulan took out a handmade tablecloth embroidered with large Luoyang peonies from the cabinet; it was to be brought to the trade fair next month. She noticed creases on the edges and gently washed it with clean water and mild soapy water. Wang Guilan, her neighbor across the way, came out to hang clothes and greeted her over the low wall; Xiulan agreed to visit her in the afternoon. After washing, Xiulan hung the tablecloth on a bamboo pole in a shady, ventilated spot in the yard and smoothed the edges.
location: Home courtyard at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Make low-salt pickled vegetables.
description: Ma Xiulan took out fresh cucumbers, white radish, and carrots, cut them into strips, and sprinkled them with salt to draw out the water. Meanwhile, she boiled Sichuan peppercorn water. Following her mother's method, she halved the salt, added more sugar and white vinegar, and grated in apple and pear strips. She drained the salted vegetable strips, packed them into a glass jar, poured in the mixture, sealed the lid tightly, and shook it to mix well. She stuck a note on the jar reading "4.19 Low-Salt Version" and put it in the refrigerator, thinking she would let her family taste it in the evening.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Reinforce the edge stitching on the embroidered tablecloth.
description: Ma Xiulan took the dried tablecloth from the courtyard and spread it flat on the living room coffee table. She threaded matching silk thread, carefully re-stitched the loose stitches along the edges, and added stitches at the junctions of the peony petals to make the pattern more three-dimensional. After finishing, she went to the courtyard and took photos against the sunlight, ready to send them to the sisters in the pickled vegetables group to enjoy.
location: Living room and yard at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepared simple lunch, had lunch, and took a midday rest
description: Lunch was simple. Ma Xiulan cooked a pot of tomato and egg noodles, and took out some low-salt pickles she had made earlier, putting them in a small dish. The children gathered around. Xiulan let them taste the pickles first. Xuanxuan praised them, saying they were delicious and not too salty, and Zhezhe also said they were good. Xiulan was delighted and said that they would eat these from now on, since they were good for Dad. After the meal, she cleared away the dishes and chopsticks, then went back to the bedroom for a half-hour nap. With her eyes closed, she planned the afternoon in her mind: call Fen'er and drop by Sister Wang's house next door.
location: Kitchen, dining room, and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Early morning preparation and morning walk
description: At 6:15 in the morning, Ma Xiulan woke up naturally, got out of bed quietly, washed up, and changed into her workout clothes. At 6:20 she left home and walked west along Jingwen Road to the street-corner park. She did 5 minutes of shoulder and neck stretches under the willow trees, then took a leisurely walk around the park. She started back at 6:40 and arrived home at 6:56. After getting home, she took out her phone and checked in on her memo app, recording how the walk felt.
location: Round trip from 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China to the street park near the intersection of Jingwen Road and Shengli Street

name: Family breakfast
description: Ma Xiulan prepared breakfast for the family: millet porridge, reheated steamed buns, sliced low-salt pickled vegetables, and fried eggs. After her husband Ma Zhiqiang and the three children got up, the five of them sat around the table to eat. Ma Xiulan reminded the children to play in the park in the morning and do their homework in the afternoon.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Taking the children to play at the street park
description: After breakfast, Ma Xiulan took a water bottle and a basketball and led the three children on foot to the neighborhood park. The eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, shot hoops on the basketball court; the second son, Ma Mingzhe, played with companions on the lawn; the youngest daughter, Ma Yuxin, built sandcastles in the sandpit. Ma Xiulan sat on a bench watching over them. During this time she used her phone to snap pictures of the children's smiling faces and went to a nearby convenience store to buy three bottles of water. Around 10:30 she took the children home.
location: Street park near the intersection of Jingwen Road and Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Preparing to make dumplings for lunch
description: Back home, Ma Xiulan asked her eldest son to take his younger brother and sister to wash their hands, and she went into the kitchen to knead the dough and prepare the pork and cabbage filling. Then she called the children to make dumplings together. The second son and the youngest daughter also joined in. Although the dumplings were lopsided, the atmosphere was happy.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: The whole family enjoyed a dumpling lunch.
description: After the dumplings were cooked, the whole family sat around the table to eat, with pickled vegetables and vinegar. After the meal, Ma Xiulan asked her husband to wash the dishes and took the opportunity to rest on the sofa.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Afternoon rest and phone call with older sister
description: After lunch, Ma Xiulan rested on the living room sofa and scrolled through WeChat to watch videos in her childhood friends' group chat. At 1 p.m., her older sister Li Xiuyun called from Beijing, and the sisters talked for nearly an hour. The conversation touched on bringing their parents to Beijing for summer vacation and educating children during adolescence. Ma Xiulan felt warm.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Sorted and mended clothes for the change of seasons.
description: After hanging up the phone, Ma Xiulan sorted seasonal clothes on the balcony and in the bedroom. She folded the washed thick coats and sweaters neatly, sorted them into storage bins on top of the wardrobe, took out the summer thin shirts and checked them one by one, and sewed a loose button back onto her eldest son Xuanxuan's T-shirt.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Take pickled vegetables and fresh vegetables to her parents' home.
description: Ma Xiulan took out the low-salt pickles she made the day before from the fridge, went to the small vegetable garden to pick cucumbers and scallions, packed them, then walked 15 minutes to her parents' home at 45 Shengli Street. She reminded her father to watch his diet, and her mother chatted with her about family matters. Seeing her parents in good spirits, she returned reassured.
location: No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Prepare and have dinner together.
description: Ma Xiulan used the leftover dumpling filling from lunch to cook sour soup dumplings, and also stir-fried scrambled eggs with tomatoes and garlicky water spinach. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang helped set the table, and the children brought bowls and chopsticks. At the table, her youngest daughter animatedly recounted her dream.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Evening household chores and spending time with the children
description: Ma Xiulan cleared the dishes and wiped the stove, then played cards with her husband and children in the living room. After the eldest son went back to his room to do homework, she urged the second son to check his schoolbag and read two picture books to the youngest daughter. At 8 o'clock she supervised the children as they took turns washing up, then returned to the master bedroom, leaned against the headboard, and scrolled through Moments on her phone. She saw photos her younger sister had posted and liked and commented on them.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Reviewing accounts before bed, relaxing, and falling asleep.
description: After 9 o'clock, Ma Xiulan took out her account book and recorded the day's shopping expenses. She chatted with her husband Ma Zhiqiang about everyday things, mentioning how content she felt giving pickled vegetables to her parents. Then she did a five-minute deep-breathing exercise, reviewed the smiling faces of the children through the day, felt fulfilled and satisfied, turned off the light, and fell asleep quickly.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Getting up and washing up briefly
description: Woke up naturally before the alarm went off; outside the window it was already faintly light. After simply folding the quilt, she went to the bathroom and washed her face with cold water, then applied Dabao face cream. She deliberately put on old pants that could get wet, preparing to wash her cotton shoes today.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning walk with neighbor Zhang Shufen
description: She slipped out quietly and met up with her neighbor Zhang Shufen. They power-walked west along Jingwen Road to the intersection with Shengli Street, turned back, and did shoulder and neck stretches at the entrance of the street-corner park at the Chaoyang Road intersection. Ma Xiulan shared how sticking with morning exercise had improved her complexion and bowel regularity, and proudly mentioned that her husband Ma Zhiqiang had once accompanied her for half the walk, and the two encouraged each other to keep going.
location: Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (from 156 Jingwen Road west to Shengli Street, including the entrance to the street park at the Chaoyang Road intersection)

name: After morning exercise: phone notes and message replies
description: After morning exercise, she returned to the door of her home, used her phone's memo to record "Monday morning workout check-in," checked WeChat, and replied to a question in the pickled vegetables group about how long the pickles should ferment.
location: In front of the house at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare tomato-and-egg sauce noodles for breakfast
description: She went into the kitchen to prepare the tomato and egg noodles the whole family loved. While boiling the water, she called her husband Ma Zhiqiang, eldest son Ma Mingxuan, second son Ma Mingzhe, and daughter Ma Yuxin to get up. She quickly cut tomatoes, beat eggs, and boiled the dried noodles, finishing breakfast quickly and deftly.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The whole family had breakfast together
description: The whole family sat around eating noodles. Ma Xiulan reminded her husband Ma Zhiqiang not to make do with lunch when he was out driving, asked her eldest son Ma Mingxuan about his preparations for the class cadre election in the class meeting, urged her second son Ma Mingzhe to eat quickly, and picked out the chopped green onions for her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin. The meal was full of ordinary family care.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Ride the electric scooter to take Zhezhe and Xinxin to school.
description: After putting the little backpack on Xinxin and straightening Zhezhe's red scarf, she rode the dark green electric tricycle along Jingwen Road, first taking her daughter Ma Yuxin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten and watching as the teacher led her inside; then she took her son Ma Mingzhe via Shengli South Street to Jinghai No. 3 Primary School, telling him to focus in class and wait for her at the school gate on time after school. She left only after confirming both children had entered school.
location: At the gate of Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin; at the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Shopping for ingredients at Wutong Commune Food Market
description: On the way from No. 3 Primary School, she went to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market and, at the stall of her acquaintance Sun Guifang, picked fresh cucumbers, tomatoes, shiitake mushrooms, as well as cilantro and ginger. She chatted with Aunt Sun about washing cotton shoes when the season changes, and Aunt Sun rounded down the price.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market at the intersection of Jingwen Road and Chunxi Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Tidy up the storage room and scrub the family's winter cotton shoes
description: After returning home and putting down the vegetables, she went into the storage room and dug out seven or eight pairs of cotton shoes of all sizes for the whole family, catching the smell of mothballs. In the yard, she fetched warm water, poured in laundry detergent, moved a small stool and sat down. She carefully scrubbed the soles, uppers, and insides of the shoes with a brush, and the water turned black. Looking at the shoes that seemed to have shrunk, she sighed that children's feet grow quickly and planned to give the shoes away next year. After scrubbing them clean, she arranged the shoes neatly under the clothesline to dry in the afternoon sun.
location: The courtyard and storage room of the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Embroider pillowcases and plan exhibits for the spring trade fair.
description: After washing the shoes and taking a short rest, she sat on the living room sofa, took out the sewing basket, and embroidered a pillowcase with a twin lotus flower pattern. She searched for "Jinghai District Spring Agricultural Products Fair" on her phone and planned to bring homemade low-salt pickles and embroidered insoles and coasters with the theme of "Abundance Year After Year" to the fair. Her stitches were especially light and brisk.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Lunch by herself and a brief midday rest
description: Using the leftover noodles and tomato-egg sauce from the morning, she made herself a bowl of hot noodle soup and sliced a plate of pickled cucumbers brought back from her parents' home as a side dish. After eating, she washed the dishes and cleaned up, then leaned back on the sofa and rested with her eyes closed for about twenty minutes, her mind still on the trade fair.
location: Dining room and living room of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Go to Shufen Convenience Store to shop and discuss signing up for the trade fair
description: After her midday rest, she walked to Zhang Shufen's convenience store diagonally across the street and bought salt, light soy sauce, and aged vinegar. At the checkout counter she chatted at length with Shufen about the spring agricultural products fair. She learned that to register she needed to go to the management committee office on the west side of the stadium from next Monday to Wednesday to fill out a form. Shufen encouraged her to bring pickled vegetables and embroidered pieces to the exhibition, and Ma Xiulan's confidence soared.
location: Shufen Convenience Store, 154 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Selecting daily necessities and inspecting display packaging at Jingbai Supermarket
description: Rode an electric bike along Jingwen Road and Shengli Street to Jingbai Supermarket. On the first floor in the daily necessities section, she picked out a few plain and elegant small porcelain dishes, planning to use them for pickled vegetable tasting at the sales fair. She also browsed the home goods section and noted the prices and models of small glass jars with lids as packaging references. Finally, she bought trash bags and kitchen paper towels.
location: Jingbai Supermarket, Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Turn and air cotton shoes and tend the small courtyard vegetable garden
description: After returning home from the supermarket, she first went to the yard to turn over the half-dried cotton shoes so the other side could also get sun. Then she changed into rubber shoes and walked into the small vegetable garden in the corner. She loosened the soil with a small hoe, pulled out weeds beside the scallion seedlings, carefully sowed the newly bought spinach seeds, and watered them thoroughly. Looking at the neat vegetable beds, she planned to plant a few small tomato plants in a few days.
location: Home courtyard and small vegetable garden at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up daughter Ma Yuxin and son Ma Mingzhe from school and go home
description: After changing into clean clothes, she rode her electric bike along Jingwen Road and first went to Huakang First Kindergarten, where she picked up her daughter Ma Yuxin, who rushed over like a swallow, and listened to her hum a newly learned nursery rhyme in a sweet childish voice. Then she had Xinxin sit properly on the back seat and rode to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School on Shengli South Street, waiting for her son Ma Mingzhe to get on the bike after saying goodbye to his classmates. Along the way, the two children vied to tell her about fun things at kindergarten and what happened when they played basketball in PE class. Ma Xiulan smiled and responded, reminding them to keep their school uniform zippers up, and they arrived home with a warm breeze brushing their faces.
location: At the gate of Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin; at the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Cook dinner and supervise the children's homework
description: After getting home, Ma Xiulan went straight to the kitchen to make braised pork belly, garlic crown daisy, and steamed egg custard. While blanching the meat and cutting scallions and ginger, she called out to the living room for Zhezhe to do his math homework and Xinxin to review her word cards. While stir-frying, she kept an ear out and occasionally poked her head out to correct Zhezhe for zoning out and playing with his eraser. Her eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, came home from school, said hello, and went to his room to do homework.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: The whole family enjoys dinner together
description: Husband Ma Zhiqiang finished his work and came home, and the whole family gathered. Ma Xiulan brought out the glossy red braised pork, and the children could hardly wait. At the dinner table, she shared her idea of participating in the trade fair and received Ma Zhiqiang's support. The family ate and chatted, and the atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Clean the kitchen and check and help with my son's homework
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan briskly washed the dishes, wiped the table, and tidied the kitchen. When she finished, she sat down in the living room, called Zhezhe over to check his math homework, and patiently guided him through understanding a word problem he had gotten wrong. She then went to knock on her eldest son Xuanxuan's door, asked about his studies, and signed the home-school communication notebook.
location: The kitchen, living room, and Xuanxuan's room at the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Give the daughter a bath and do pre-bedtime character recognition and reading.
description: After settling the two sons down, she gave her daughter Ma Yuxin a bath. She filled the tub with hot water, and Xinxin giggled while playing with a plastic duck. After getting clean and smelling nice, Xinxin changed into pajamas, and they played a "Find Friends" game with pinyin cards. Xinxin recognized b, p, m, f and clapped excitedly. Finally, she held Xinxin and read the picture book "Guess How Much I Love You". When the little rabbit stretched its arms wide, Xinxin imitated it, and gradually fell asleep in the warm atmosphere.
location: Home bathroom and Xinxin's bedroom at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Personal hygiene, safety inspection, and bedtime planning.
description: After gently closing her daughter's door, Ma Xiulan washed up and applied Yumeijing. She tiptoed into her two sons' room, turned off the lights for them, and tucked in their quilt corners. Then she went to the kitchen to confirm the gas stove and the main valve were off, and checked that the courtyard gate was locked. When everything was in order, she returned to the living room, closed her eyes, and did 5 minutes of deep breathing to settle her thoughts, clearly planning the registration materials for next week's trade fair and the preparation of pickled vegetables and embroidered pieces, feeling at ease inside.
location: Bathroom, all the rooms, kitchen, and living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Having a bedtime chat with her husband and going to sleep
description: Back in the bedroom, she chatted with Ma Zhiqiang, who was leaning against the headboard scrolling on his phone, about tomorrow's departure time and told him the specific date of the trade fair. Ma Zhiqiang voluntarily said that if work wasn't tight that day, he could drive her, and Ma Xiulan felt warm inside. After chatting, the two turned off the lights and went to sleep, sleeping soundly all night.
location: Bedroom at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning wash-up and walk
description: Got up in the early morning, washed up simply, and tied my hair back. Then went out with neighbor Zhang Shufen and walked along Jingwen Road to the small park beside the library, chatting about new supermarket products and the trade fair on the way, and did shoulder and neck stretching exercises on a park bench.
location: From No. 156 Jingwen Road, Chaoyang Subdistrict, Jinghai District, Tianjin to the small park beside the library.

name: Preparing breakfast for the family and seeing the family off
description: After returning home, she tied on an apron and prepared breakfast. She took out meat buns from the refrigerator to steam, cut a plate of ham sausage, cooked millet porridge, and served her homemade pickled radish strips. At exactly 7:00, she woke her husband, Ma Zhiqiang, and the three children. The whole family sat down to eat breakfast together, and she reminded the children to listen carefully in class. After breakfast, she saw them off: Zhiqiang took his teacup and car keys and went to start the small pickup truck; the eldest son, Xuanxuan, rode off first on his bicycle; she helped the youngest daughter, Xinxin, put on her backpack, checked the second son, ZheZhe's, homework notebook, and walked them to the courtyard gate.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Chaoyang Subdistrict, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Take the children to school and buy groceries along the way.
description: She rode the electric bike, with her second son Ma Mingzhe sitting in front and her younger daughter Ma Yuxin standing behind, holding on to her. First she took Zhezhe to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School and watched him enter the school gate. Then she turned around and rode about 5 minutes to send Xinxin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, greeted the teacher, and watched her walk into the classroom. On the way back, she stopped by Wutong Commune Vegetable Market and picked out fresh cucumbers, tomatoes, and tender scallions at Aunt Sun's stall. Since eggs were on sale, she also bought three jin, spending less than 30 yuan in total.
location: Wutong Community Vegetable Market, Chaoyang Subdistrict, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Household tidying and meal preparation
description: Returned home, put away the groceries, took the pork belly out of the freezer and placed it in a basin of cold water to thaw, planning to make braised pork in the evening. Then swept the floor, wiped the living room table, and washed yesterday's clothes in the washing machine.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Chaoyang Subdistrict, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Courtyard embroidery and exhibition fair planning
description: In the sunlit courtyard, I brought out the sewing basket and continued embroidering the twin lotus pattern on the pillowcase. At the same time, I thought about the upcoming trade fair: in addition to pickle jars, I planned to bring embroidered pillowcases, insoles, and other handicrafts, and I conceived of embroidering flower-and-bird insoles to increase their selling points.
location: Courtyard at 156 Jingwen Road, Chaoyang Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Lunch preparation and midday rest
description: She started preparing lunch: peeled potatoes, cut them into shreds and soaked them in water, and made a smashed cucumber salad. She cooked a bowl of noodles, mixed them with zhajiang sauce and cucumber shreds, and had a simple lunch, then washed the pots and dishes. After lunch she felt sleepy, so she leaned against the headboard and browsed Jinghai local public accounts on her phone. Seeing a notice about the Community Neighbors' Day, she forwarded it to the homeowners' group. Then she set an alarm for 13:20 and closed her eyes for a nap of about half an hour.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Chaoyang Subdistrict, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Supermarket shopping
description: After the alarm went off, she rode her electric bicycle to Jingbai Supermarket full of energy. She went straight up to the home textiles section on the second floor and chose two discounted summer quilts—a light blue floral one for her second son and younger daughter, and a light gray plaid one for her eldest son, which would also serve as a spare. She also bought salt and soy sauce, spending a bit over 90 yuan at checkout.
location: Jingbai Supermarket, Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Walk to the library
description: After returning home from the supermarket and putting away the items, she changed into a clean jacket, took her ID card and library card, locked the door, and walked to Jinghai District Library. The sunshine was warm along the way, and she felt full of anticipation for the canal stories she was about to hear.
location: Jinghai District Library, at the intersection of Shengli Street and Jianshe Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Attending a canal lecture and borrowing books
description: Attended the public lecture 'The Old Canal Stories of Jinghai' in the lecture hall on the second floor of the library on time. A retired old teacher vividly described in authentic Jinghai dialect the changes of the Grand Canal in Jinghai. I learned that Jingwen Road was originally an ancient post road that led directly to Dulin Old Wharf. The elderly woman next to me, who was with her grandson, softly agreed, and we smiled at each other. After the lecture, I went to the borrowing hall on the first floor, used my ID card to apply for a library card, and borrowed the book 'The Folk Customs of Tianjin'. I also asked a staff member, learned that the library has a WeChat official account, and scanned the QR code to follow it.
location: Jinghai District Library, at the intersection of Shengli Street and Jianshe Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Walk to pick up the children after school.
description: Walked briskly to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up her youngest daughter Xinxin. When the girl saw her mother, she ran over and hugged her. The mother and daughter then walked to the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School and waited. The second son, Zhezhe, came out of the school gate chatting and laughing with classmates. On the way home with the two children, she told them the canal story she had heard in the afternoon.
location: Along the route from Huakang First Kindergarten on Chaoyang Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to No. 3 Primary School on Shengli South Street, Jinghai Town

name: Prepare a hearty dinner
description: After returning home, she immediately started cooking. She cut the thawed pork belly into mahjong-sized cubes and slowly braised them; cleaned the crucian carp and made soup to nourish the children; pulled up some spring onions from the yard, chopped them, and sprinkled them over the fish soup. The kitchen was filled with steam and the warmth of home.
location: Kitchen and courtyard at 156 Jingwen Road, Chaoyang Subdistrict, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner and sharing stories about the canal
description: Her husband Ma Zhiqiang finished work early today, so the whole family had a rare gathering. At the dinner table, while picking braised pork for the children, he excitedly told stories about the ancient docks and post roads. The three children were so absorbed that they stopped their chopsticks and kept asking questions. Zhiqiang also chimed in, mentioning similar old sayings he had heard in Yangliuqing. The family was filled with laughter and joy.
location: Living room, 156 Jingwen Road, Chaoyang Subdistrict, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tidy up and help the children with homework
description: After the meal, she quickly cleared the dishes, wiped the table, and mopped the floor. Then she sat down at the small table to help her second son, Zhezhe, with his math homework and her youngest daughter, Xinxin, with character recognition practice. Zhezhe had difficulty understanding fractions, so she patiently used the analogy of cutting apples into pieces, which finally made him understand.
location: Living room, 156 Jingwen Road, Chaoyang Subdistrict, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Personal grooming and safety check.
description: After the children were settled, she started her personal hygiene routine. After showering and changing into pajamas, she checked the doors, windows, and gas valve one by one, then went to the courtyard to inspect the newly planted scallions and water them moderately, ensuring everything was in order.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Chaoyang Subdistrict, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Couple chat and relaxation
description: Back in the living room, she stood side by side with her husband Ma Zhiqiang in front of the window and did 5 minutes of deep breathing to relax. While they were in a good mood, they continued chatting about the afternoon lecture. Zhiqiang said he would like to join next time if he was free. She felt warm inside and felt that life was full of hope.
location: Living room, 156 Jingwen Road, Chaoyang Subdistrict, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Falling asleep
description: After saying goodnight to my husband, I lay in bed recalling the fulfilling experiences of the day, from morning exercise and the lecture to family time, and soon fell asleep with a sense of satisfaction.
location: Master bedroom, 156 Jingwen Road, Chaoyang Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Waking up and washing up
description: Ma Xiulan was woken by her phone alarm and woke up in bed. She remembered the pleasant experience of attending the lecture at the library yesterday and felt in a good mood. She got up briskly, washed up briefly, changed into her sportswear, and, still concerned about her second son Ma Mingzhe's math grades, decided to go out for morning exercise.
location: Bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Morning walk and heart-to-heart talk with a neighbor.
description: Ma Xiulan jogged along Jingwen Road to Jiexin Park and ran into her neighbor Zhang Shufen. The two chatted while doing shoulder and neck stretches.
