Zhang Shufen shared the good news that her granddaughter had scored 98 on her English test, while Ma Xiulan expressed concern about her second son Ma Mingzhe's math performance. Zhang Shufen comforted her, saying it was all right for a child to be a late bloomer and that she should take things slowly. After the walk, Ma Xiulan felt much relieved.
location: Jinghai District, Tianjin, China, Jinghai District Street Park (southeast corner of the intersection of Jingwen Road and Chaoyang Road)

name: Prepare breakfast and have a family meal
description: After Ma Xiulan returned home, she deftly rinsed the rice and put it in the pot, heated up yesterday's leftover steamed buns, and sliced a plate of her own pickled accordion cucumbers. At exactly 7 o'clock she woke the children who were staying in bed and urged them to wash up. The whole family sat around the dining table for breakfast, including her husband Ma Zhiqiang and the three children. Ma Xiulan reminded her second son Ma Mingzhe to listen carefully in class today, and put an extra egg in her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin's bowl.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Take the second son and youngest daughter to school and buy groceries on the way
description: After checking the children's backpacks and water bottles, Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to first take Ma Mingzhe to the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, watching him walk into the school. Then she turned around and rode north along Shengli South Street for about 10 minutes, took Ma Yuxin to Huakang First Kindergarten, and only felt at ease after handing her to the teacher. Next, she rode 5 minutes to the familiar Wutong Commune Market, came to the stall of her friend Sun Guifang, and picked a bunch of water spinach, two cucumbers, and tomatoes. Sun Guifang asked why she wasn't buying meat, and Ma Xiulan said she would decide based on the children's behavior. Sun Guifang gave her an extra bunch of spring onions.
location: No. 32 Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School), No. 169 Huakang Avenue (Huakang First Kindergarten), and the west side of the intersection of Jingwen Road and Wutong Road (Wutong Commune Vegetable Market).

name: Go home to do housework and water the vegetables
description: Ma Xiulan returned home, put the vegetables she had bought in the kitchen, and stuffed the dirty clothes from last night into the washing machine. She quickly wiped the dust off the TV cabinet and coffee table in the living room with a cloth. Then she went to the yard to water the spinach and the newly planted scallions. Seeing the new sprouts, she felt happy.
location: Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Go to the library to return books and ask about the lecture.
description: Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike east along Jingwen Road, then turned onto Shengli South Street, arriving at the Jinghai District Library in about 8 minutes. She returned Tianjin's Street Life and Customs at the self-service book return machine, then went to the service desk and asked the librarian whether any similar public lectures were coming up. The librarian told her there would be a lecture about Jinghai's old craftsmanship at the end of the month, and she made a mental note.
location: Jinghai District Library, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (next to Guanghua School).

name: Go to Jingbai Supermarket to restock.
description: After leaving the library, Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike for about 12 minutes to reach the Jingbai Supermarket in Yuzhou Zunfu. She headed straight to the household goods section, grabbed a large bottle of laundry detergent, and then in the snack section picked out a pack of bulk sea salt crackers, planning to give them to the kids as an afternoon snack. The total came to 32.5 yuan.
location: Jingbai Supermarket, ground-floor shop 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Morning hand embroidery work and ideas for the trade fair.
description: Ma Xiulan returned home, took out her embroidery tools, and sat on the sofa by the window in the living room. She brought out the blue cloth she had cut earlier and began embroidering a coaster with a 'fish playing among lotuses' pattern, preparing for next month's community fair. She stitched slowly but steadily. Midway, she stopped to sketch in her notebook the canal pattern she had seen in a book yesterday, thinking about whether she could incorporate it into a sachet.
location: Home living room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Simple lunch alone
description: Ma Xiulan felt hungry, so she reheated the half pot of porridge left from the morning, scrambled two eggs with the scallions that Aunt Sun had given her, and ate them with the steamed buns made yesterday. A simple meal. While eating, she picked up her phone and saw people in the community group discussing sign-ups for the trade fair, so she casually clicked follow.
location: China, Tianjin Jinghai District, No. 156 Jingwen Road, home kitchen

name: Midday nap
description: Ma Xiulan cleared away the dishes, set a 20-minute alarm, and dozed off sideways on the living room sofa to build up energy for the afternoon's work.
location: Sofa in the living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Afternoon crafts, tidying up, and preparing to pick up the children
description: After the alarm went off, Ma Xiulan continued her afternoon handicraft work with renewed energy. She finished the coaster she had not finished embroidering in the morning, then took out several small pouches and mugwort sachets she had made earlier, checked the stitching one by one, sorted them neatly, and put them in a clean cloth bag. In between, she got up and moved around a few times, turned over the padded cotton shoes airing in the yard, and pulled a few weeds in the vegetable garden. At 3:30 p.m., she washed the loose threads and dust off her hands, changed into a clean knit top, and picked up her electric bike keys and the small backpack she used to pick up the kids. She thought she should buy some meat in the evening—if Zhezhe really had done well in his exams, she would make a pot of braised pork to celebrate.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (home living room and courtyard)

name: Pick up the children from school, prepare dinner, and make the good-news phone call
description: Ma Xiulan first rode her electric bike to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up her youngest daughter, Ma Yuxin. As soon as Yuxin came out, she rushed over and said her teacher praised her for her origami. Then she rode with Yuxin to the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to wait for her second son, Ma Mingzhe. When she saw Zhezhe come out, she observed his expression and saw nothing unusual, so she didn't rush to ask about his grades and only asked if he was cold today. After getting home, Ma Xiulan told the children to do their homework first, then put on an apron and started preparing dinner. She took out the vegetables she had bought that morning and the pork belly frozen yesterday to thaw, then started cutting potatoes, washing tomatoes, and slicing ginger. While she was busy, the phone rang. It was Teacher Yang, Zhezhe's homeroom teacher. Ma Xiulan wiped her hands and answered excitedly. Teacher Yang told her in a gratified tone that Ma Mingzhe had improved by 15 points in the midterm math exam and had become much more active in class. Ma Xiulan thanked her again and again, her eyes suddenly welling up. After hanging up, she immediately called Zhezhe over, hugged him tightly, and said, "Son, you're awesome!"
location: 169 Huakang Avenue, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (Huakang First Kindergarten), 32 Shengli South Street (Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School), and home at 156 Jingwen Road

name: Celebration dinner: shopping, cooking, and a family meal together
description: Ma Xiulan immediately decided to celebrate Zhezhe's progress that very evening. She took his hand and kept her arm around his shoulder the whole way, praising him over and over for growing up. The two went to Sun Guifang's stall at Wutong Commune Vegetable Market and specially selected top-quality pork belly, large potatoes, and fresh tomatoes. When Sun Guifang heard it was to celebrate the boy's progress, she smiled and gave them two extra small cucumbers. Back home, Ma Xiulan had Zhezhe help peel garlic and wash tomatoes. Her younger daughter Yuxin also dragged a little stool to the kitchen doorway, sometimes asking when they could eat, sometimes helping hand over the sugar. Ma Xiulan deftly got the braised pork going, letting it simmer slowly over low heat. Meanwhile, she cut the tomatoes into crescent-shaped pieces and sprinkled them with sugar. The kitchen was filled with a delicious aroma. At seven in the evening, her husband Ma Zhiqiang came home and knew from the aroma that there was a good dish today. The family gathered around the dining table. Ma Xiulan announced the good news about Zhezhe, and Ma Zhiqiang happily made an exception and put two big pieces of braised pork into Zhezhe's bowl, saying, "That's the way to do it — work hard and you get good food." The younger daughter also joined in, clamoring for some, and the eldest son Xuanxuan even showed a rare smile. Looking at everyone at the table, Ma Xiulan felt a warmth in her heart even more satisfying than the braised pork.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (west side of the intersection of Jingwen Road and Wutong Road) and the kitchen and dining room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road

name: Cleaned the kitchen and checked homework
description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan briskly cleared the dishes and wiped down the stove. Then she sat beside her second son, Ma Mingzhe, and carefully checked today's math homework. Seeing that he really had made fewer mistakes, she praised him again. Her youngest daughter, Ma Yuxin, was flipping through a picture book by herself, and her eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, was reading in his own room.
location: Kitchen and living room of the residence at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Urge children to wash up and do pre-bedtime grooming
description: Ma Xiulan urged the three children to take turns washing up, especially the youngest daughter, whose hair she had to wash. She herself found time to go to the yard, watered the newly planted rose seedlings to settle their roots, and checked the windows and gas valve again to ensure safety.
location: Home bathroom and courtyard at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Deep breathing relaxation before bed
description: Ma Xiulan and her husband Ma Zhiqiang sat together on the living room sofa. She led him through 5 minutes of deep breathing relaxation exercises. As she slowly exhaled, she murmured to Zhiqiang, "Today is a really good day, sweeter than honey." Zhiqiang held her hand and said it was all because she had taught him well.
location: Home living room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Going to bed
description: Ma Xiulan lay in bed, replaying in her mind the image of Zhezhe's bright eyes when he heard the praise today and the scene of the whole family laughing together. Her heart felt full. With this deep sense of gratification and fulfillment, she soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Waking up and morning stretching
description: The alarm clock rang. Ma Xiulan woke up from a dream. Instead of getting up and moving right away, she sat up in bed, gently rotated her neck and shoulders, and then specially worked her right wrist to prepare for the day's heavy pickling work. Thinking about her daughter Xinxin's birthday tomorrow and the trade fair the day after, she felt both warm and busy.
location: Master bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning walk and conversation with neighbors
description: Ma Xiulan pushed open the courtyard gate. The morning mist had not yet cleared when Zhang Shufen, the neighbor across the street, happened to be going out too. The two walked slowly along Jingwen Road. Ma Xiulan told Zhang Shufen that she was going to Sister Zheng's house today to pick up the booth number for the exhibition, and that she would surely show off her skills on Saturday. Zhang Shufen smiled and said the pickled vegetables would definitely be popular, and that she would ask Sister Wang to come along and show support. The two chatted for about ten minutes at the entrance to the neighborhood park before turning back.
location: Street park near the intersection of Jingwen Road and Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare breakfast and wake up the family
description: Back home, Ma Xiulan put on an apron, used the leftover pickled cucumbers and stir-fried greens from the previous day, cooked a pot of millet porridge, and heated six large steamed buns. Then she went upstairs and woke the children one by one: she urged her eldest son Mingxuan to brush his teeth quickly so he would not be late, helped her drowsy second son Mingzhe put on his school uniform, and carefully tied two cute pigtails for her youngest daughter Yuxin.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The whole family had breakfast together
description: Today her husband Zhiqiang wasn't taking the truck out, and it was a rare occasion for the whole family of five to sit around the dining table. Ma Xiulan reminded Mingxuan not to forget to eat lunch at school, spot-checked Mingzhe's math mnemonics, and also stuffed a pack of tissues into Yuxin's little schoolbag. Zhiqiang asked about the trade fair. She told him everything had been arranged properly and she would go confirm with Sister Zheng in the afternoon, so he didn't need to worry.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Taking the two children to school.
description: After clearing the dishes, Ma Xiulan wheeled out her electric bike and first took her second son Mingzhe to the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, telling him to listen carefully in class and not to run around after school. Then she turned and took her youngest daughter Yuxin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, and only left after watching her wave to the teacher and walk into the classroom.
location: Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Shopping at the vegetable market.
description: After dropping off the kids, she stopped by Wutong Commune Vegetable Market on the way. Ma Xiulan, familiar with the place, went straight to Aunt Sun's stall and bought pork belly and a live grass carp for Yuxin's birthday tomorrow. She also remembered that the new pickled vegetables still needed white vinegar and Sichuan peppercorns, so she bought those too. Aunt Sun knew her family was going to set up a stall, so she insisted on adding an extra handful of cilantro, saying it would bring good luck.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Make the last batch of low-salt pickled vegetables and label them
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan took out the radishes and cucumbers that had been dried the night before and began putting them into jars according to the new recipe: adding more white vinegar and Sichuan peppercorns to enhance the aroma, and reducing the soy sauce by one third. While arranging the vegetables, she neatly wrote 'Xiulan Low-Salt Pickles, Net Weight 500g' on label paper with an oil-based marker and carefully stuck one on each jar, preparing for the sales fair in two days.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Check the trade fair goods, lunch, and midday rest.
description: After finishing the pickling, Ma Xiulan moved the 30 jars of pickled vegetables that had been packed earlier into the storage room, checked the seals one by one, and immediately tightened a loose lid when she found one. She also wrapped the embroidered tablecloth with lotus and fish patterns in newspaper and put it into a clean tote bag. Then she had a simple lunch of leftover noodles with fried sauce, set a half-hour alarm and took a nap on the living room sofa. After waking up, she went to the storage room, arranged the newly made pickles by size, and stuffed a few self-sewn coasters and handkerchiefs into the bag of embroidery pieces, preparing them for sale at the exhibition.
location: The storage room, kitchen, and living room at home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Went to Zheng Xiuying's home to confirm the trade fair registration.
description: After changing into clean clothes, Ma Xiulan took a small jar of freshly pickled vegetables as a thank-you gift and walked to Zheng Xiuying's home at No. 45 Shengli Street. Sister Zheng lived on the first floor and warmly brought out the stall assignment sheet, telling her that her stall was No. A12, right by the entrance — an excellent location. Relieved, Ma Xiulan thanked her repeatedly, then walked home at ease.
location: Zheng Xiuying's home at 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin; return trip to 156 Jingwen Road.

name: Supermarket shopping and exchanging for small change
description: Thinking about her daughter's birthday tomorrow, Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to Jingbai Supermarket. She bought pork belly and dried noodles to make longevity noodles for her daughter. Noticing a promotion on whitening laundry detergent, she picked up a bottle for Zhiqiang. At the checkout counter, she also exchanged 200 yuan in cash to use as change at the trade fair.
location: Jingbai Supermarket, Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the two children from school.
description: After leaving the supermarket, Ma Xiulan cycled to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up Yuxin. Her daughter rushed over to show the little red flower the teacher had given her as a reward and pestered for a candied hawthorn stick. After sending Yuxin home, she hurried to the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to wait for Mingzhe. As soon as Mingzhe came out, he proudly pulled out his math test paper with a score of 95. Ma Xiulan hugged him with relief and praised him, saying she would make braised pork and fish for the two of them in the evening.
location: Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin; return to 156 Jingwen Road

name: Preparing dinner, tutoring the child, and having dinner together
description: When she got home, Ma Xiulan had Yuxin draw and Mingzhe do mental arithmetic problems, then tied on an apron and stewed grass carp and tofu soup, stir-fried crown daisy stems with garlic, and mixed diced pickled cucumbers from the jar into the leftover zhajiang noodles from lunch. After her husband Zhiqiang got off work, the family sat around the table for dinner. Ma Xiulan put fish in Mingzhe's bowl and braised pork in Yuxin's bowl, and discussed the Saturday sales fair with Zhiqiang. Zhiqiang agreed to take half a day off to help transport the pickled vegetables and embroidered goods to Culture Square, then come back to take care of the children's lunch.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening chores, bookkeeping, and preparations
description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan quickly cleared the dishes, wiped down the stove, and mopped the floor. Then she urged Mingxuan to recite his lessons, signed Mingzhe's homework, and bathed Yuxin and coaxed her to sleep. Once the children were settled, she took out her notebook in the living room and checked the supplies checklist for the sales fair, confirming that soy sauce, vinegar, sesame oil, small tasting dishes, and everything else were ready. She then recorded the day's grocery and supermarket spending of 48 yuan, transferred 200 yuan from WeChat balance to her bank card as reserve funds for the fair, and sent a 20 yuan red envelope for Yuxin's birthday tomorrow.
location: Home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin: kitchen, living room, children's bedroom

name: Washing up and pre-sleep relaxation
description: Ma Xiulan washed up in the bathroom, changed into pajamas, got into bed, and turned off the light. After doing five minutes of deep breathing, she silently reviewed the plans for the birthday celebration and the sales fair the next day, repeated the fair sales slogans a few times to herself, and gradually fell asleep with joy over her daughter's birthday and anticipation for the fair.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Morning wake-up and first courtyard visit
description: Woke up naturally at 6:10 in the morning and felt well-rested. After washing up, she walked into the courtyard and was pleasantly surprised to find the sunflowers and impatiens blooming in the corner. She squatted down to admire them carefully, looking at the morning dew on the petals, feeling happy. She decided to go out for a walk first and take good photos after she came back.
location: Home courtyard at 156 Jingwen Road, Chaoyang Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning walk with a neighbor
description: At 6:35 she went out for a walk along Jingwen Road and ran into her neighbor Zhang Shufen; the two chatted as they walked. Ma Xiulan told Zhang Shufen that the flowers in the yard had bloomed, and Zhang Shufen asked how the preparations for tomorrow's sales fair were going. Ma Xiulan replied that she would do a final inventory check a little later. When they reached the street park, she did 5 minutes of shoulder and neck stretches, then headed back at 7:00.
location: Along the route from Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to the street park

name: Photographing courtyard flowers
description: Arrived home at 7:05, took out the old digital camera, and took more than twenty photos in the courtyard of the moss roses, balsam flowers, and tender leaves of the persimmon tree. The yard looked full of life through the lens. While taking photos, she thought about picking a few at the end of the year to make into a family wall calendar, and felt very happy.
location: Home courtyard at 156 Jingwen Road, Chaoyang Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare breakfast for the family and wake up the children
description: At 7:40, she put away the camera, quickly heated up the leftover porridge and steamed buns from last night, and fried three poached eggs. At 7:50, she went upstairs to wake the three children, Ma Mingxuan, Ma Mingzhe, and Ma Yuxin, urging them to wash up and eat breakfast. At 8:00, she hurriedly drank a bowl of porridge herself and reminded Xuanxuan to ride carefully.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Chaoyang Subdistrict, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Take the children to school and buy groceries along the way.
description: At 8:10, she rode her electric bike to first take her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin to Huakang First Kindergarten. On the way, she told her that the flowers in the yard were blooming and that she would take her to see them in the evening. At 8:20, they arrived at the kindergarten, and she watched her go inside. At 8:25, she then took her second son Ma Mingzhe to the gate of the Third Primary School of Jinghai District, watched him enter the school gate, and told him to pay attention in class. At 8:40, she stopped by Wutong Commune Vegetable Market on the way and bought three crucian carps, a bunch of spinach, and a piece of tofu, planning to simmer a fresh soup in the evening. At 8:55, she got home.
location: Starting from home (No. 156 Jingwen Road, Chaoyang Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin), she goes successively to Huakang First Kindergarten (Huakang First Kindergarten, Huakang Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin), Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin), Wutong Commune Vegetable Market (Jinghai District, Tianjin), and finally returns home

name: Sorted photos and shared them in the family group.
description: At 9:00, she got home, connected the camera to the computer, and imported all the photos into the 'April Courtyard Flowers' subfolder under the '2025' folder. She picked out the nine she was most satisfied with, took photos of them with her phone, and sent them to the family WeChat group with the caption: 'Our little courtyard is in bloom!' She soon received likes from her elder sister and younger sister, and replied to each with a smile.
location: Living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Chaoyang Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Completed final registration for the trade fair by phone
description: At 9:40, she received a call from Zheng Xiuying saying that booth A12 at the trade fair had been approved. Ma Xiulan, referring to the materials on hand, double-checked the name, booth number, and product categories with Zheng Xiuying over the phone and confirmed everything was correct. After hanging up, she felt much more at ease.
location: Living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Chaoyang Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Handle housework and organize the list of items for the sales expo
description: At 10:10 she hung up the phone and started doing laundry and tidying up the kitchen. While working, she planned in her head. At 10:40, after finishing the housework, she sat down in the living room, took out a small notebook, and made a list of things to bring to tomorrow's sales fair: 15 jars of low-salt pickled vegetables, 15 jars of wild-vegetable pickles, 1 embroidered tablecloth, a change box, small tasting dishes, disposable gloves, and so on.
location: Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Chaoyang Subdistrict, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Lunch and lunch break.
description: At 11:00 she washed some greens, cooked herself a bowl of dried noodles, and poached an egg in it. She finished lunch at 11:20, set an alarm for 12:00, and dozed off on the sofa to recharge for the busy afternoon. From 11:30 to 12:00 she rested on the sofa, felt a bit sore in her wrist, got up and moved around, drank some water, then continued napping until 12:30.
location: Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Chaoyang Subdistrict, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Went back to her parents' home to visit them.
description: At 12:30, she took two jars of freshly pickled low-salt vegetables and the apples bought yesterday, and rode her electric bike back to her parents' home. At 12:45, she arrived at her parents' home at No. 45 Shengli Street. She chatted with her mother Li Xiuying and asked how her father Ma Jianguo's blood pressure had been lately. She reminded her mother to use less salt in cooking and handed her the pickled vegetables. She left at 13:15, hummed a tune while riding home, and arrived at 13:30.
location: Round trip from home (No. 156 Jingwen Road, Chaoyang Subdistrict, Jinghai District, Tianjin) to her parents' home (No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin)

name: Counting and packing all the items for the sales exhibition.
description: Got home at 13:30 and started taking stock: moved the pickled vegetables out of the storage room, 15 jars each of low-salt pickles and wild vegetable pickles, not one jar missing. Then she folded the embroidered tablecloth, put loose change in the change box, and got the tasting saucers and gloves ready. She sorted everything into two large shopping bags and placed them in the entryway, making sure she could grab them and leave early the next morning.
location: Living room and storage room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Chaoyang Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the child from school and buy groceries
description: At 14:10 she left and walked to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten. At 14:30 she picked up her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin, who insisted on seeing flowers. She promised to look at the flowers at home in the evening, and said she would take her to the trade fair to 'help' tomorrow. Yuxin clapped her hands happily. At 14:45 she took Ma Yuxin to the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School and waited for her second son Ma Mingzhe to finish school, picking him up at 15:00. At 15:05 the three of them went to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, bought two cucumbers and a bag of tomatoes, and at 15:20 walked home with the two children, arriving home at 15:30.
location: Set off from home, go to Huakang First Kindergarten (Huakang Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin), then to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin), then to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market (Jinghai District, Tianjin), and finally return home (156 Jingwen Road, Chaoyang Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin).

name: Helping the children with homework and preparing dinner
description: After arriving home, she had her second son Ma Mingzhe do homework in the living room while her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin drew pictures beside him. She went to the kitchen to clean the crucian carp and prepare vegetables. Hearing that Ma Mingzhe had a problem he couldn't solve, she wiped her hands and went over to explain it to him. She told Ma Yuxin not to draw on the walls with colored markers. At 16:30 she started cooking dinner: braised crucian carp tofu soup, and stir-fried spinach. She also set aside a portion for her husband Ma Zhiqiang, sealed it with plastic wrap, and put it in the fridge. At 17:30 her eldest son Ma Mingxuan came back from school.
location: The living room and kitchen at 156 Jingwen Road, Chaoyang Subdistrict, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: The whole family had dinner together.
description: At 17:30 the family (Ma Xiulan, Ma Mingxuan, Ma Mingzhe, Ma Yuxin) had dinner together. At the table, the younger daughter Ma Yuxin clamored to call her father, and Ma Xiulan told her to call after finishing the meal. While eating, Ma Xiulan told her eldest son Ma Mingxuan about taking his sister to the exhibition tomorrow and asked him to look after his younger brother at home in the afternoon. Ma Mingxuan nodded in agreement. The dinner was simple but warm.
location: Dining room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Chaoyang Subdistrict, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening family time and bedtime preparation.
description: After clearing the table, she played with building blocks with her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin in the living room. At 18:30 she made a video call to her husband Ma Zhiqiang and told him that everything at the trade fair had been settled. He said he would come to the stall to help tomorrow morning. Ma Xiulan felt a warmth in her heart and told him to drive carefully at night. After hanging up, she urged Ma Mingzhe and Ma Yuxin to go wash up. Then she checked the shopping bags in the foyer again to make sure everything was there. Then she checked her eldest son Ma Mingxuan's math homework, signed it, and also looked at her second son Ma Mingzhe's homework, making him correct the wrong characters.
location: Living room and study at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Chaoyang Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Personal care and relaxation
description: At 19:40, finished washing up and changed into pajamas. Thinking about the tough battle ahead tomorrow, I sat on the edge of the bed and started five minutes of deep breathing to calm down. Then I took out my phone again, looked at the address of tomorrow's trade fair, and made final mental preparations for attending.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Chaoyang Subdistrict, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: At 20:30, she checked the doors, windows, and gas again, making sure everything was closed. At 20:45, she lay down, thinking that she needed to get up early tomorrow but shouldn't get too excited. At 21:10, with anticipation and a little nervousness about tomorrow, she gradually fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Chaoyang Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Early morning wake-up and morning activities
description: At 6:10 in the morning, Ma Xiulan woke up naturally. After washing up, she went to the yard to tend to the sunflowers and balsam flowers that had just bloomed the day before, gently dusting and watering them, feeling happy. At 6:40, she woke her husband Ma Zhiqiang, and the two put on their sneakers and walked from their home at 156 Jingwen Road to the street park. On the way, Xiulan chatted with Zhiqiang about the plan for today's trade fair and took the opportunity to suggest they exercise together next week. By the flower beds in the street park, Xiulan led Zhiqiang through shoulder, neck, and leg stretches to loosen up, preparing for the trade fair where they would be standing all day. Then the two quickly walked back home.
location: Street park at the intersection of Jingwen Road and Chaoyang Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Prepare breakfast and assign household chores
description: Back home, Xiulan quickly heated up the buns her husband had bought yesterday, cooked a pot of millet porridge, and fried a few eggs. As she called the whole family to sit down for breakfast, she specifically reminded her eldest son Xuanxuan to take good care of his younger brother and not let him touch anything electrical or play with fire. There were leftovers in the fridge for lunch that could be reheated. She and her younger sister were going to the trade fair and would probably be back in the evening.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Transporting goods and setting up the trade show booth
description: After breakfast, Xiulan and her husband Ma Zhiqiang carried out two large bags of goods — 15 jars of low-salt pickled vegetables, 15 jars of wild-vegetable pickles, plus the embroidered tablecloth and tasting plate — and tied them to both sides of the bicycle's rear rack. Zhiqiang pushed the bicycle, Xiulan held the bags on one side, and her youngest daughter Xinxin walked alongside. The three walked about 10 minutes to Stall A12 at the sales fair at Jinghai District Stadium. Then Xiulan spread out the tablecloth embroidered with the 'Fish Playing among Lotuses' pattern, arranged the pickled vegetables in two rows by flavor — the dark wild-vegetable pickles on the left and the light low-salt pickles on the right — and opened a jar of wild-vegetable pickles, cut them into small cubes, and set out the tasting plate. After Zhiqiang confirmed everything was ready, he walked home before 9:00.
location: Stall A12, Jinghai District Stadium, No. 1 Shuguang Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Selling pickled vegetables at the morning trade fair
description: The sales expo officially opened. Xiulan was full of energy, warmly hawking in her authentic Jinghai accent, proactively handing out tasting samples, and patiently introducing the features of the low-salt pickled vegetables and wild vegetable pickles. Xinxin sat obediently behind the stall and occasionally helped her mother pass bags. Throughout the morning, Xiulan was so busy that she barely had time for a few sips of water, but she sold 15 jars and brought in 300 yuan. At about 9:45, a purchasing representative in a dark blue work uniform was full of praise after tasting the pickles, left his contact information, and became the first prospective customer.
location: Stall A12, Jinghai District Stadium, No. 1 Shuguang Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Simple lunch at the stall
description: At noon, the flow of customers decreased slightly. Xiulan had Xinxin go to a nearby stall to buy two shaobing with egg and a bottle of water. Mother and daughter hastily ate their lunch standing behind the stall. While eating, Xiulan kept an eye on the passing customers, afraid of missing any opportunity.
location: Stall A12, Jinghai District Stadium, No. 1 Shuguang Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Afternoon sales at the trade fair and guidance from the Agricultural Commission.
description: The afternoon exhibition continued to draw a steady stream of visitors. Xiulan handled it more and more skillfully, successively receiving two purchasing representatives from different community supermarkets. At around 13:10 and 13:45, respectively, they left their contact information and expressed interest in cooperation. Individual customers were also buying enthusiastically, and the remaining pickled vegetables were soon almost gone. Around 14:00, a young man wearing a work badge that read "Jinghai District Agriculture Committee" passed by the booth. After tasting the wild vegetable pickles, he was full of praise and took the initiative to suggest that Xiulan apply for the "Jinghai Specialty Agricultural Products" label, briefly explaining that she needed to prepare materials such as her ID card, hygiene permit, and proof of processing location. Xiulan's eyes lit up as she listened. She quickly jotted down the key information on a sticky note, feeling as if she had opened the door to a whole new world.

participant.name: Comrade Li
participant.relation: Staff member of the Agricultural Committee of Jinghai District

location: Stall A12, Jinghai District Stadium, No. 1 Shuguang Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pack up the stall and take stock.
description: As the trade fair drew to a close, Xiulan and Xinxin carefully packed up the remaining 3 jars of pickles and the change box, and folded the tablecloth. Inventory check: 1 jar of low-salt pickles and 2 jars of wild vegetable pickles remained. A total of 27 jars were sold during the day, with cash income of 540 yuan, plus three business cards from purchasing representatives and valuable advice from the Agricultural Committee. Xiulan was delighted.
location: Stall A12, Jinghai District Stadium, No. 1 Shuguang Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Purchasing supplies and walking home.
description: At 3 p.m., Xiulan and Xinxin walked from the stadium to Jingbai Supermarket along Shengli Avenue, arriving in about 15 minutes. Xiulan figured that since tomorrow was Sunday and the children would all be home, she bought 3 yuan worth of fresh noodles and a bunch of scallions, planning to make scallion noodles the next morning. After shopping, the mother and daughter walked north along Shengli Avenue, turned into Jingwen Road, and walked about 15 minutes back home.
location: Jingbai Supermarket, Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu, Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Returning home to share the good news
description: As soon as she entered the house, Xiulan put the heavy box of change on the table and excitedly told her husband and children about the day's results: 27 jars of pickled vegetables were almost snapped up, bringing in 540 yuan. She also met three supermarket owners who were interested in cooperation. More importantly, the staff of the Agricultural Committee gave good advice on applying for a label. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang had a rare smile on his face and, for the first time ever, said, "You've worked hard." Xiulan felt sweeter than if she had eaten honey.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing dinner
description: Xiulan went into the kitchen to prepare dinner. She cleaned the crucian carp Zhiqiang had bought yesterday, made braised fish, stir-fried a plate of garlic lettuce, and, thinking today was a good day, took eggs from the fridge and made a tomato-and-egg soup.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner and praising the children
description: The family of five sat around the dinner table. Xiulan deliberately picked out fish for her eldest son, Xuanxuan, and praised him for watching over his younger brother at home during the day and helping out a lot—such a sensible boy. She also praised Xinxin for helping carry things at the stall, calling her her "little lucky star." The table was filled with laughter and joy, and the atmosphere was warmer than any other day.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Housework, homework help, and bookkeeping
description: After the meal, Xiulan quickly cleared the table, wiped it down, and washed the dishes. Then she checked Zhezhe's and Xinxin's weekend homework and signed the workbooks. After the children went back to their rooms, Xiulan took out the coin box and account book, used a calculator to record the day's income and expenses one by one, and neatly copied the contact information of three purchasing representatives and the key points for the Agricultural Commission application into an old notebook, noting next to them such information as "Fumanjia Supermarket," "Haolinju Supermarket," and "Community Fresh Produce Shop."
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening relaxation and heart-to-heart talk between spouses
description: After urging the children to wash up and go to bed, Xiulan was exhausted with an aching back and slightly swollen calves. She fetched hot water, sat on the living room sofa to soak her feet, and applied a hot towel to her calves. Her husband Zhiqiang came over on his own initiative to massage her shoulders and arms. Xiulan leaned against his shoulder and softly pictured the future: “If we really can close the deal with the supermarket and apply for that specialty agricultural product label, our family's life might truly become more prosperous.”
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pre-sleep relaxation and bedtime
description: After soaking her feet, Xiulan felt comfortable all over. She returned to the bedroom, lay in bed, and as usual took deep breaths for 5 minutes to empty her mind. After checking the doors, windows, and gas, she said goodnight to Zhiqiang and soon fell into a deep sleep, ending this full and fulfilling day.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Morning wake-up, washing up, and stretching
description: She woke up naturally at 6:25 in the morning and felt quite refreshed. She washed up briefly in the bathroom and checked her complexion in the mirror. Then she spread a thin blanket on the bedroom floor and did about 5 minutes of cat stretch, which relieved the lower-back soreness from standing at the sales fair all day the day before. After stretching, she felt much looser and more relaxed.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepared and ate breakfast alone
description: After washing up and stretching, she went into the kitchen and cooked a pot of millet porridge, while reheating the leftover steamed buns from yesterday and slicing a plate of her own pickled radish peels. The children had not woken up yet, so she served herself a bowl of porridge and ate it contentedly with pickled vegetable strips and half a bun. While eating, she mentally planned the things she needed to do today, especially several work calls she had to make.
location: Kitchen and dining room of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Wake up the family and clear the table
description: After breakfast, she went from room to room waking the children. The eldest son, Xuanxuan, was already awake and looking at his phone, so she urged him to wash up quickly. The second son, Zhezhe, lingered in bed and only got up reluctantly after his quilt was pulled off. The youngest daughter, Xinxin, was the easiest; she woke up at the first call and asked to have a little braid tied. The children sat down at the table, and she took the bowls and chopsticks into the kitchen and wiped the table.
location: At home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin: all bedrooms and the dining room.

name: Called three community supermarkets to follow up after the exhibition
description: While the children were eating breakfast, she took out the contact notebook from the trade fair and sat on the living room sofa making calls one by one. First she called Purchaser Li at Fumanjia Supermarket and arranged to go to the store on Tuesday morning to discuss details. Then she contacted Purchaser Wang at Good Neighbor Supermarket, who was quite interested in the wild vegetable pickles, and agreed to meet on Wednesday afternoon. Finally she called Boss Zhao at the community fresh food store, and directly settled the trial sales quantity and price over the phone, agreeing to deliver on Monday evening. She recorded the agreed times and important notes for all three calls in her notebook.
location: Sofa in the living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Called the district agricultural committee to ask about applying for the specialty agricultural product label
description: After hanging up with the supermarket, she found the contact phone number of the Jinghai District Agriculture and Rural Affairs Commission's official WeChat account, called, and asked the staff what materials were needed to apply for the 'Jinghai Specialty Agricultural Products' label. The other party told her to prepare a product description, photos of the business license copy, and actual product photos, and directed her to submit the materials to the Agricultural Product Quality and Safety Supervision Section. She used her account book to write down the key points and the detailed address one by one, and felt clearer about the follow-up process.

participant.name: Staff
participant.relation: Government staff member (Jinghai District Agriculture Committee)

location: Living room balcony at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Clean the storage room and prepare fertilizing tools.
description: After putting down the phone, she changed into old work clothes, went to the storage room, took out the fermented soybean cake fertilizer, and found a spade, a small trowel, and an old bucket. She smelled that the fertilizer was a bit sour but rich in nutrients, so she placed the tools beside the persimmon tree in the yard, ready to apply fertilizer together with her second son after he finished his homework.
location: Storage room and courtyard at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Supervising the second son's homework and tidying up the house
description: Returning from the yard to the house, she saw her second son Zhezhe dawdling over his homework at the coffee table, so she took out crucian carp and pork belly from the refrigerator to thaw. While tidying the kitchen, she kept an eye on him doing his homework. When Zhezhe was stuck on a math problem, she went over to read the problem with him, guided him patiently, and finally helped him understand it. Afterwards, she hung up the clothes from the washing machine and mopped the floor.
location: Living room and second bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Dig a trench and apply bean cake fertilizer around the persimmon tree together with the second son
description: After Zhezhe finished his homework, they came together to the persimmon tree in the yard. She carefully dug a shallow trench in a circle around the tree roots with a spade, while Zhezhe watched curiously. She evenly spread the dark brown soybean cake fertilizer into the trench, then covered it with soil and stamped it firm with each shovel. While working, she taught Zhezhe: only after the fertilizer is buried deep can the roots slowly absorb it, and in autumn the tree will bear big sweet, soft persimmons. Zhezhe didn't fully understand, but he picked up a small shovel and helped pat the soil.
location: Under the persimmon tree in the courtyard at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The second son watered the plants, observed the new leaves, and took photos to send to his father.
description: After covering with soil, Zhe Zhe took the initiative to fill a small bucket with water, carried it over unsteadily, and poured it around the base of the tree; the water quickly seeped in. After watering, he squatted beside the tree and observed the new sprouts, exclaiming that the branches seemed thicker than yesterday. Ma Xiulan smiled and identified the terminal buds and lateral buds with him, then used her phone to take a photo of the mother and son squatting under the tree from behind. She sent the photo to her husband Ma Zhiqiang, who was away driving his truck, via WeChat, with the message: "Dad, our persimmon tree has gotten its spring fertilizer." Soon she received a thumbs-up and a reply saying "You've worked hard." She felt deeply warm inside.
location: Under the persimmon tree in the courtyard at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing lunch, having a family meal, and urging the children to take their afternoon nap.
description: After finishing farm work, she washed her hands and started making lunch. She reheated the leftover baozi from the morning, used the pickled vegetables left from the expo, and quickly stir-fried scallions with eggs and made a tomato egg-drop soup. All four of them sat around the table to eat. Xuanxuan and Xinxin ate with gusto, and Zhezhe, who had worked all morning, ate two full bowls of rice. After the meal, she urged the three children to take their naps, and she herself leaned back on the sofa for a half-hour rest.
location: Kitchen and dining room of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Wrapping up the trade fair accounts and sorting out next week's work
description: After the afternoon nap, while the children were still sleeping, sat down at the desk and took out the account book and all of today's contact records. First settled yesterday's trade fair accounts, recording an income of 540 yuan; then planned next week's schedule: Monday afternoon deliver goods to the community fresh food store, Tuesday morning go to Fumanjia Supermarket for a face-to-face meeting, Wednesday afternoon visit Haolinju Supermarket to discuss business; also made a note to find time to prepare the label application materials required by the Agriculture Commission. Marked everything clearly on the calendar, and felt at ease after finishing.
location: At the desk in the living room of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Check the weather and bring in the clothes drying in the courtyard.
description: Checked the weather forecast on her phone and learned it would turn cloudy with scattered light rain in the afternoon, so she hurried to the courtyard and brought in all the clothes that had been hung out in the morning. The clothes were all completely dry, so she folded them one by one and put them in the wardrobe. Looking up, the sky was indeed gloomy, and she was glad the fertilizing had been finished in advance and was not affected.
location: The courtyard and balcony at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing dinner ingredients and teaching the younger daughter to read
description: After bringing in the clothes, she began preparing dinner. She cut the defrosted pork belly into pieces for braising, cleaned the crucian carp for soup, and prepared some greens. While busy in the kitchen, her youngest daughter Xinxin woke up and ran over asking for a hug. She wiped her hands clean, led Xinxin to the living room, took out some character cards, and taught her a few simple Chinese characters.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Cooking braised pork belly and crucian carp soup
description: After the children woke up one after another, she devoted herself to cooking. The pork belly was blanched, caramelized with sugar, then put into a clay pot to simmer slowly over low heat; the crucian carp was fried golden on both sides, then boiling water was added and a milky white fish soup was made over high heat. The kitchen was filled with the aroma of meat and fish. Wearing an apron, she skimmed off the foam while watching the pot bubble, and sighed that this was the true flavor of everyday life.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The whole family sits together to enjoy dinner
description: The braised pork was tender and soft, the crucian carp soup was delicious, and it was served with a large plate of stir-fried seasonal vegetables. The family of four sat around the table; she put meat in each child's bowl. Zhezhe ate most happily, and Xinxin obediently drank soup with her spoon. Watching the children eat contentedly, she felt that all the day's hard work was worthwhile.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tidied up the kitchen and helped the children with their homework
description: After the meal, she quickly washed the dishes and wiped down the kitchen, then checked Zhezhe's and Xinxin's homework and helped them fill in the gaps. The eldest son, Xuanxuan, had already finished his homework independently in his room, so there was no need for extra worry.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: After urging the children to finish washing up, she was the last to take a hot shower. The hot water washed away the day's fatigue. After showering, she changed into comfortable pajamas and felt completely relaxed.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Relaxing before bed and reflecting on the day
description: Leaning against the headboard, she opened the account book and neatly copied down the key points from her call to the Agricultural Committee. Then she turned off the main light, leaving only the night light, and took several deep breaths, feeling the air flow from her nose to her abdomen. Because she had bent over for a long time while fertilizing in the afternoon, her lower back was a bit tight again, so she did a few gentle cat stretches on the bed until the soreness gradually dispersed.
location: On the bed at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Fell asleep peacefully
description: Feeling settled and relaxed in mind and body, she turned over and pulled up the quilt. Thinking of how the persimmon tree was growing and how the children were growing too, she felt that life had a clear direction, and her heart was full of peace. Soon she fell into a deep sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Morning preparations and childcare
description: The phone alarm went off on time, and Ma Xiulan got up and washed up briskly. Today she planned to make the tomato and egg dough-drop soup the children loved. First she took two eggs and two tomatoes out of the fridge, and quickly kneaded the dough and stirred the dough drops. While the soup was cooking, she took three small bowls from the cupboard and put the youngest's milk powder, the second child's calcium tablets, and the eldest's carton of pure milk into them respectively. After breakfast was ready, Ma Xiulan went into the children's bedroom, gently woke up her youngest daughter Yuxin who was still lying in bed, then raised her voice to urge her youngest son Mingzhe to get dressed faster. While tying Yuxin's hair, she loudly reminded Mingxuan, the eldest, who was washing his hands slowly, not to forget his homework. At the table, she patiently fed Yuxin, told Mingzhe to finish his eggs, and checked Mingxuan's schoolbag to make sure nothing was missing.
location: Kitchen and dining room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Take the three children to school
description: The eldest child, Mingxuan, got on his bicycle and said to his mother, "Mom, I'm going first," then turned out of the hutong. Ma Xiulan, holding Yuxin's hand with one hand and pushing the electric bike with the other, had Mingzhe sitting on the back seat. On the way, she first took Mingzhe to the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (arriving around 7:25) and watched him walk into the school gate. Then she rode for another 5 minutes to take Yuxin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten (arriving around 7:35), handed her to the teacher at the door, and watched the little girl run skipping into the classroom before she felt relieved and rode home.
location: Starting from home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, passing Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School on Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and finally arriving at Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning walk and catching up with a friend
description: When she arrived home, she happened to run into her neighbor Zhang Shufen, who was coming back from outside carrying a vegetable basket. Sister Shufen said with a smile, "Xiulan, done dropping off the kids? Great, keep me company for a stroll. Let me tell you about the massager my daughter sent me yesterday." Ma Xiulan smiled and walked up to her, and while walking slowly with Sister Shufen in the community garden, she quickly told her in detail the good news that all 28 jars of pickled vegetables had been sold out at yesterday's trade fair, as well as the cooperation meeting she was going to attend today. Sister Shufen's eyes lit up as she listened, and she patted her hand and praised, "Amazing, amazing! Xiulan, you really are someone who gets big things done!"
location: Central garden of the residential compound at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Going home to do shoulder and neck stretches.
description: After getting home, Ma Xiulan did not sit down right away. She stood on the plastic floor in the living room, took a deep breath, and started a simple set of shoulder and neck stretches. She had learned it from a short video, and after sticking with it for nearly half a month, the old problem of shoulder pain from years of doing handwork with her head down had improved a lot. After loosening up, she deliberately rotated her wrists a few times as preparation for riding the electric bike and taking notes later.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare pickled vegetable samples and head out.
description: Ma Xiulan carefully took out the samples she needed to bring today from the shelf in the storage room: two 380ml jars of low-salt dried radish and mustard strips, labeled 'Xiulan Homemade Pickled Vegetables'. She wiped the jars thoroughly with a clean cloth and put them into a non-woven tote bag printed with 'Jinghai Specialty'. Then she put the household accounting notebook, a pen, and a calculator into her sling canvas bag, checked the e-bike keys one last time, locked the door, and got ready to leave.
location: Storage room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Visit two community supermarkets to discuss supplying pickled vegetables
description: First she rode her electric bike for 5 minutes to the Jingwen Road Community Convenience Store. There were few people in the store in the morning. Ma Xiulan found Manager Li, whom she had made an appointment with yesterday. She generously unscrewed a jar of dried radish, picked out a little with a toothpick, and asked the manager to taste it. After tasting it, the manager found it properly salted and very crispy, and agreed to take 10 jars on a trial sale basis, splitting the profits 70/30 and settling after they were sold. Ma Xiulan immediately wrote clearly in her small notebook: "4/28, Jingwen Road Community Store, consignment of 10 jars (low-salt dried radish / mustard stem shreds), 70/30 split, monthly settlement," and double-checked the date and ratio. Then she rode her electric bike along Jingwen Road and turned onto Diwei Road, arriving at Jinhaiyuan Community Living Supermarket about 15 minutes later. Sister Wang, the purchasing manager, was a straightforward person. After tasting the pickled vegetables, she carefully asked about the ingredients and production process. When she heard that no preservatives were added, she was very satisfied and immediately decided: she would take 12 jars from Ma Xiulan every month, 6 jars of each flavor, settled at the end of the month, and she even signed a simple written agreement. Ma Xiulan was overjoyed inside, but she still said steadily, "Don't worry, Sister Wang, I guarantee every jar tastes exactly like this—real ingredients, real quality!"

participant.name: Store Manager Li
participant.relation: Store manager, Jingwen Road Community Convenience Supermarket

location: Jingwen Road Community Convenience Store at No. 218 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and Jinhaiyuan Community Supermarket at No. 88 Diwei Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Stop by the vegetable market on the way to buy groceries.
description: Although she had closed deals with one large and one small shop today, which was a great achievement, life still had to go on as usual. On the way back, Ma Xiulan stopped by the familiar Xingwang Vegetable Market. At Aunt Sun's stall, she bought 500 grams of fresh pork belly, a bunch of green chives, and picked three cucumbers and five tomatoes. She made small talk with Aunt Sun and did not forget to say, 'Aunt Sun, in a couple of days, when my new flavor of pickled vegetables is ready, I will bring you a jar to try!'
location: Xingwang Vegetable Market at the intersection of Shengli Street and Jingwang Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Return home for a simple lunch and initial accounting.
description: After getting home, Ma Xiulan put the groceries away and quickly cooked herself a bowl of plain noodle soup with a poached egg. After a simple meal, she didn't rush to take a nap. Instead, she took out her account book and sorted out the two business deals she had made from the trade fair to today. At the trade fair she sold 28 jars for 560 yuan, with material costs of about 190 yuan; the two supermarket orders confirmed today together would sell an additional 22 jars per month. Pen in hand, she calculated the estimated income on the notebook, unable to suppress a smile, feeling warm inside.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Afternoon rest and handcrafts
description: After a busy morning, she was indeed a bit tired. Ma Xiulan lay flat on the sofa, closed her eyes, and rested for half an hour. After waking up, she took out an embroidery side job she had taken on a few days earlier — embroidering a cartoon bear pattern on the apron of the neighbor's child. As she embroidered, she listened to the occasional birdsong outside, treating it as a leisurely moment before the busy afternoon.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: In-depth profit accounting and planning of May delivery routes
description: After enough rest, Ma Xiulan was full of energy. She took out her account book again, put on her reading glasses, and began carefully working out all the income and expenses for April. She first added up all the orders from the trade fair and today's supermarket orders, then deducted the costs of the bottles, labels, raw materials, and the soybean cake fertilizer she had bought yesterday. She calculated it a full two times and, after confirming everything was correct, drew a big smiley face in red pen next to the last row of numbers: “April pickled vegetables gross profit: 695 yuan!” Then she opened the map of Tianjin and used a pencil to circle the approximate locations along Jingwen Road, Jinhaiyuan Community, and the Dongcheng Morning Market where she planned to set up a stall next month, mentally working out the most time-saving delivery route.
location: Desk in the living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up younger son and younger daughter from school
description: Seeing that it was almost time, Ma Xiulan stopped what she was doing, locked the door, and set off on her electric bicycle at 14:40. She first went to Huakang First Kindergarten (arrived at 14:50) to pick up her bouncy little daughter, Yuxin. Then she rode the electric bicycle to the gate of No. 3 Primary School (arrived at 15:05). After waiting a while, the second-grade students came out after school. When her second child, Mingzhe, saw her, he came over and whispered, "Mom, in P.E. class today I got third place in the running race!" Ma Xiulan smiled and patted his head, saying, "Great! I'll fry some ham sausage for you tonight!" Then they all returned home together.
location: From Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School on Shengli South Street, then back home at No. 156 Jingwen Road.

name: Supervising the children's homework and parent-child interaction
description: When she got home, the eldest son Mingxuan had already cycled back by himself. Ma Xiulan had Yuxin play with building blocks on the mat in the living room, then moved a chair to the desk and started checking Mingxuan's math test paper and Mingzhe's Chinese homework. Mingxuan had made a mistake on one word problem. Ma Xiulan didn't tell him the answer directly, but guided him to read the problem on his own and identify the known conditions. Mingzhe's handwriting was not neat, so she patiently made him rewrite a few characters. Yuxin drew a picture and happily held it up: “Mom, this is a picture of you selling pickled vegetables!” The picture showed a smiling chubby aunt with lots of colorful jars in front of her. Ma Xiulan and her two sons all burst into laughter.
location: Living room and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Cooking dinner and having dinner with the family.
description: After getting the children settled with their homework, Ma Xiulan tied on an apron and went into the kitchen. She decided to make a few of her signature dishes: first she simmered the pork belly bought at noon over low heat, planning to make braised pork; then chives scrambled with eggs, smashed cucumber, and tomato egg drop soup. The kitchen soon filled with the aroma of food. When the dishes were served, the three children were already seated at the table. While eating, Ma Xiulan told the children the good news that she had finalized deals with two supermarkets today, and encouraged them: "You see, Mom earns money with her own labor. You should study hard too and become even more successful than Mom in the future!"
location: Kitchen and dining room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Tidying up the kitchen and sharing the good news with her husband.
description: After urging the children to wash the dishes and chopsticks, Ma Xiulan wiped the kitchen counter clean. She noticed her husband Ma Zhiqiang's WeChat account was lit up on her phone screen, so she made a video call. When the call connected, her husband's honest, simple face appeared on the screen, with a row of trucks at a service area in the background. Ma Xiulan told him all the good news at once: she had reached deals with two supermarkets and calculated a profit of nearly 700 yuan. Ma Zhiqiang was very happy after hearing it and said cheerfully, "Xiulan, you're really something! The whole family depends on you. But don't overwork yourself — rest when you need to."
location: Kitchen and balcony at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Watching TV and doing handicrafts with the children.
description: After hanging up the phone, Ma Xiulan sat with the three children in the living room and watched their favorite animal documentary for a while. The eldest, Mingxuan, hugged a small notebook and jotted something down while watching; the second child, Mingzhe, and the youngest daughter, Yuxin, were already rocking with laughter at the adorable pandas on TV. Once the children were absorbed in the show, Ma Xiulan took out the apron she had not finished embroidering that afternoon and, under the soft light, continued to stitch the little bear's eyes and mouth, one stitch at a time.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Urge the children to wash up and go to sleep.
description: After watching TV, Ma Xiulan urged the children to wash up. She first washed Yuxin's face and brushed her teeth, then watched Mingzhe and Mingxuan finish washing up by themselves. Then she carried Yuxin to her little bed, told her the story "The Little Horse Crosses the River" for five minutes, and watched the little girl slowly close her eyes. She then checked whether Mingzhe and Mingxuan were secretly playing with their phones, and only felt reassured after confirming they were both lying down.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Pre-bed planning and relaxation
description: The children were all asleep. Ma Xiulan returned to the desk in the living room but did not go to bed right away. She turned on the desk lamp, took out the small notebook and pen from beside her pillow, and browsed the food delivery and errand apps on her phone, silently planning the detailed delivery schedule for the next month: deliveries could be concentrated on Mondays and Fridays to the supermarket on Diwei Road, and the community supermarket on Jingwen Road was right at the doorstep, so restocking was possible at any time. Then she went back to the bedroom, sat cross-legged on the bed, closed her eyes, and took deep breaths for 5 minutes, feeling the fatigue and excitement accumulated during the day gradually fade away. At 22:40, she turned off the lamp and fell into a deep sleep with hopes for tomorrow and a better life ahead.
location: Living room desk and bedroom, home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning stretching and washing up
description: The phone alarm went off at 6:20. Ma Xiulan dismissed it, stretched in bed, then sat up and did 5 minutes of shoulder and neck stretches to loosen up. She then went to the bathroom to wash up and splashed cold water on her face to refresh herself.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare and enjoy breakfast
description: Ma Xiulan cooked millet porridge, heated steamed buns, and took out pickled cucumbers. She woke up her second son Ma Mingzhe and daughter Ma Yuxin, urging them to wash up and get dressed. Around 7 o'clock the three sat at the table for breakfast. Mingzhe complained the porridge was too hot, Yuxin nibbled slowly on her bun, and Ma Xiulan urged them to eat quickly, because she had important matters to take care of today.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Taking the two children to school.
description: Ma Xiulan helped Yuxin wipe her face and checked Mingzhe's schoolbag. At 7:10 she rode the electric bike with the two children, first dropping Yuxin off at Huakang First Kindergarten (about a 10-minute ride), then turning around to take Mingzhe to No. 3 Primary School in Jinghai District (about an 8-minute ride), and finally riding home alone (about 7 minutes), arriving at 7:50.
location: Starting from No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, passing Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten (Dongfanghong Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin) and Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin), and returning home.

name: Take care of household chores and check the application materials.
description: Ma Xiulan first put the clothes to be changed into the washing machine and mopped the floors of the living room and bedroom. Then she took out the document folder and carefully checked the product descriptions, business certificates, trade fair photos, and other materials required for applying for the specialty product label, confirming that everything was complete and correct.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Go to the District Agricultural Commission to submit the application.
description: Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to the Jinghai District Agriculture and Rural Committee (about a 15-minute ride), feeling a little nervous. After arriving, she handed the prepared materials to the staff at the comprehensive service window and explained that she wanted to apply for the specialty product label. After reviewing them, the staff said the materials were basically complete, accepted them, and told her to go home and wait for notification. Ma Xiulan breathed a sigh of relief.

participant.name: Staff member of the Agricultural Committee

location: Comprehensive Service Hall of the Agriculture and Rural Affairs Committee, No. 99 Yingbin Avenue, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Buying ingredients and prepping pickled vegetables
description: After leaving the Agricultural Commission, Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to Xingwang Vegetable Market (about a 10-minute ride). At Sun Guifang's stall, she bought 20 jin of white radishes and 10 jin of cucumbers at wholesale prices, asked Aunt Sun to deliver them home before noon, and also bought a bunch of chives and a few scallions. Shortly after returning home, Aunt Sun had the vegetables delivered. Ma Xiulan moved the radishes and cucumbers to the water basin in the backyard, washed and drained them carefully, then cut the radishes into strips and the cucumbers into sections. She also washed and dried 15 large glass jars, preparing everything for making pickled vegetables in the afternoon.
location: Xingwang Vegetable Market at the intersection of Shengli Street and Jianshe Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; then returned to the kitchen and backyard at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Lunch and lunch break.
description: Ma Xiulan was home alone. She cooked a simple bowl of dried noodles, poached an egg, and ate lunch with the leftover pickled cucumbers from the morning. Afterward, she rested a bit, set an alarm for 12:45, and took a half-hour nap on the living room sofa to recharge for the afternoon's work.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Rush out a new batch of pickled vegetables
description: After the alarm went off, Ma Xiulan began making pickled vegetables. Following the low-salt recipe she had worked out on her own, she put the sliced radish strips and cucumber pieces into a large basin, added salt, sugar, and a variety of spices, and rubbed and stirred them vigorously until evenly mixed. Then she packed the mixture into 15 glass jars one by one, weighing each jar with a small scale to be sure of the amount. Finally, she put on handwritten labels reading '2025.04.29' and the flavor, and neatly stored the jars in a cool corner against the wall. The whole process took two and a half hours.
location: Backyard of the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Rest and call mother to discuss the new flavor.
description: After making the pickled vegetables, Ma Xiulan felt soreness in her wrists and shoulders. She poured a glass of water and sat down in the living room to rest. She called her mother, Li Xiuying, and after chatting about family matters, mentioned that she wanted to develop a new flavor of pickled radish with Sichuan pepper. Her mother was very interested and explained in detail that the Sichuan peppercorns should first be heated in hot oil to release their aroma, and gave her the approximate ratio of salt to Sichuan peppercorns. Ma Xiulan quickly wrote it down and planned to buy the ingredients next month to try making it.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Household tidying and hand embroidery.
description: After the phone call, Ma Xiulan tidied the utensils used for making pickled vegetables in the afternoon and wiped the stove clean with a cloth. Then she took out the embroidery hoop she had worked on for half a month, sat by the window, and stitched a few stitches, enjoying a moment of peace and contentment.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick the children up from school.
description: At 4:25 PM, Ma Xiulan left home on her electric bike and first went to Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up her daughter Yuxin (a 10-minute ride). The teacher praised Yuxin for being very well-behaved today. She then rode to the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to wait for her son Mingzhe (an 8-minute ride), and she picked him up after waiting five minutes. On the way home, she ran into neighbor Zhang Shufen at the entrance of the alley. They stood and chatted for a few words. When Zhang Shufen heard that the application had been submitted, she was happy for Ma Xiulan. She arrived home at nearly 5:30 PM.
location: Starting from 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, via Huakang First Kindergarten (Dongfanghong Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin) and Jinghai District Third Primary School (Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin), returning home.

name: Supervising homework and preparing dinner.
description: After arriving home, Ma Xiulan had the children wash their hands, urged Mingzhe to do his homework in the living room, while Yuxin drew pictures nearby. Ma Xiulan put on an apron and used the chives and eggs she had bought in the morning to prepare dinner. She chopped the chives, mixed the filling, rolled out the wrappers, made chive-and-egg dumplings, and prepared a garlic-vinegar dipping sauce.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Dinner and family time.
description: At 18:30, her eldest son Ma Mingxuan came home from school, and Ma Xiulan served the steaming hot dumplings at the table. Yuxin pestered to eat, while Mingzhe dipped his in vinegar and ate with relish. At the dinner table, Ma Xiulan briefly mentioned the matter of applying for the specialty product label. The children didn't quite understand, but they ate happily, and the whole family was warm and cheerful.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tidying up and evening tutoring
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan cleared the dishes to the kitchen and washed them. Back in the living room, she checked Mingzhe's math homework, pointed out two mistakes and explained them; Yuxin was playing with a rag doll nearby. While keeping an eye on the children, Ma Xiulan took out her embroidery hoop and stitched a few more stitches.
location: Living room and kitchen of home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: The children washed up and went to bed.
description: At 20:30, Ma Xiulan began urging the children to wash up. She first helped Yuxin wash her face and feet, change into pajamas, and coaxed her into bed; then she had Mingzhe brush his teeth by himself. Her oldest son, Mingxuan, was reading in his room by himself. By the time all three children were settled and asleep, it was nearly 21:15.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Organized household expenses and month-end inventory.
description: After the children fell asleep, the house became quiet. Ma Xiulan took out her account book and calculator to sort out the day's expenses: estimates for groceries, labels, salt, sugar, and other supplies.
