She then flipped through last month's ledger and checked April's total income and net profit on scrap paper, preparing the groundwork for tomorrow's formal end-of-month inventory.
location: Dining table in the living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Relaxation before bed and falling asleep
description: After a quick wash-up, Ma Xiulan returned to the bedroom, turned off the light, lay down, and did some deep-breathing relaxation before sleep. She deliberately moved her wrists and shoulders to relieve the fatigue from a day of making pickles. Then she set the alarm for 6:20 the next morning. As she mentally worked through tomorrow's delivery schedule and month-end inventory, she gradually drifted off and fell into a deep sleep at around 10:20 p.m.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Morning shoulder and neck stretches and an early morning walk
description: When the alarm went off, Ma Xiulan sat up on the edge of the bed and did 5 minutes of shoulder and neck stretches, feeling the stiffness in her shoulders completely disappear. Then she changed into cloth shoes, walked to Jingwen Road to meet her neighbor Zhang Shufen, and the two took a brisk walk on the trail around Wutong Commune community. Shufen praised her for having a slimmer waist, and the two agreed to continue walking in May, rain or shine, and make it a habit.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and the Jingwen Road intersection and the perimeter walking path of Wutong Commune residential community.

name: Wake up the family, prepare breakfast, and have breakfast with the whole family.
description: After coming back from the walk, Ma Xiulan went into the kitchen to prepare breakfast: millet porridge, steamed buns, and her own pickled vegetables. She woke the three children, Mingxuan, Mingzhe, and Yuxin, and helped her youngest daughter dress. The whole family sat around the table to eat. Xiulan, while eating, reminded her eldest son Mingxuan to take care of his younger brother on the way, reminded Mingzhe to come home early after school, and wiped Yuxin's mouth and filled her water bottle.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Riding an electric bicycle to take the child to school
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan rode an electric bike, with Mingzhe on the rear seat and Yuxin standing on the front footboard. She first took Yuxin to Huakang First Kindergarten and watched her go in with the teacher, then turned around and rode to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, where she watched Mingzhe and his classmates walk through the school gate before she felt relieved and went home.
location: Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: End-of-month deep cleaning.
description: After getting home, Ma Xiulan started her weekly deep cleaning to prepare for the May Day holiday. She took off all the sheets and quilt covers and threw them into the washing machine to wash, then stood on the windowsill to carefully wipe every pane of glass and the gaps in the window frames. Next, she put on rubber gloves and scrubbed the kitchen exhaust fan filter with a dedicated cleaner. While the washing machine thundered through its spin cycle, she wiped away her sweat and looked at the spotless home, feeling at ease.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Simple lunch, rest, and trying out a new recipe for Sichuan pepper sauce radish.
description: Taking a break from the big cleaning, Ma Xiulan sat at the dining table eating leftover porridge and steamed buns from the morning with pickled vegetables. She looked at phone messages while eating, and after finishing, leaned back on the sofa and rested with her eyes closed for about ten minutes. With her energy restored, she picked two well-shaped ones from the 20 jin of white radishes bought yesterday, washed and cut them into strips, salted them to draw out water using the new method her mother taught her, and prepared spices such as Sichuan peppercorns, chili peppers, and minced garlic, then poured hot oil over them to bring out the aroma. She put the mixed radish strips into small glass jars, pressed and sealed them, labeled them 'Sichuan Pepper Sauce Radish (trial)', recorded the date, and planned to check the taste after 3 days to prepare for mass production in May.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Cleaning up after the pickled vegetables and organizing the embroidery pieces.
description: After finishing the pickles, Ma Xiulan cleaned the stove top and put the jars and bottles back in place. Then she took out her embroidery basket, found the half-embroidered piece with the "fortune" character, and examined the stitches, thinking about asking the community tailor shop in May if they had any piecework embroidery she could take.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Midday nap
description: Thinking about having to pick up the children and finish the remaining housework in the afternoon, Ma Xiulan lay in bed for half an hour, set her phone alarm, and gave her eyes and body a brief rest.
location: Master bedroom of the home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Wrapping up the deep cleaning and tidying the rooms
description: Waking from her nap, Ma Xiulan was full of energy. She went to the balcony, brought in the sun-dried sheets and quilt covers, folded them, and put them in the cabinet. Then she mopped the living room and bedroom floors, making sure no corner was missed. Finally, she tidied the children's desks, straightened the scattered textbooks and homework books, and wiped away the eraser shavings and dust. Seeing the house look brand new, she let out a satisfied sigh.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Picking up the child from school and meeting a neighbor on the way home.
description: Ma Xiulan changed into going-out clothes, wheeled out her electric bike and checked the battery. She first rode to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up Yuxin, then rode to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to wait for Mingzhe after school. On the way home, she met neighbor Zhang Shufen. Xiulan stopped to say hello and confirmed again to meet at the usual place at 6:40 tomorrow morning. The two children went home together.
location: Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin; on the way home

name: Supervise the children's homework and prepare dinner.
description: After arriving home, Ma Xiulan had Mingzhe do his math homework at the dining table. She sat beside him to tutor him and urged him to correct his mistakes. Her younger daughter Yuxin played with building blocks on the play mat in the living room. At the same time, Xiulan quickly washed and cut vegetables, preparing to make braised eggplant, stir-fried tomatoes and eggs, and seaweed egg drop soup. The aroma of food floated from the kitchen.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner
description: The eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, came home from school, and the family of four sat around the dining table. Ma Xiulan served rice to everyone and asked about the children’s school situation: how Mingxuan’s quiz went, whether Mingzhe understood all the math problems, and what Yuxin learned in kindergarten. The family ate and chatted, full of warmth and joy.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening chores, checking homework, and putting the children to bed
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan cleared the dishes, washed them, wiped down the stove, and tidied up the kitchen. Then she checked all of Mingzhe's homework and signed it. Next she gave Yuxin a hot bath and put her in pajamas. She urged Mingzhe and Mingxuan to wash up, and after getting the children into bed, she turned off the main light, left the night light on, and gently closed the door.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: April family financial review and setting the May plan
description: After the children had all gone to bed, Ma Xiulan made a cup of tea, sat down at the dining table, took out her ledger and pen, put on her reading glasses, and carefully checked April's income and expenses. Her husband's salary was 5,800 yuan, pickle income was 920 yuan (560 yuan from the trade fair and 360 yuan from consignment at the community supermarket), and embroidery piecework was 200 yuan, bringing total income to 6,920 yuan. On the expense side, total expenses came to 5,150 yuan, including the mortgage of 2,300 yuan, food of 1,480 yuan, and utilities, property management, school fees, and so on. She calculated the month's surplus as 1,770 yuan and, satisfied, copied it into the monthly summary column. Then she turned to a new page and solemnly wrote out May's plans: continue saving 100 yuan for education, set a pickle sales target of 500 yuan, and ask around for more embroidery work to help with household expenses.
location: Home dining table, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Review exercise results, buy walking shoes online, and do deep-breathing relaxation before bed
description: After closing the ledger, Ma Xiulan opened the health app to check the April step statistics. Her average daily steps were 8,100, exceeding the original goal of 6,000 steps. She recorded her reflections: improved complexion, regular bowel movements, her husband's participation, and a stronger friendship with Shufen. Then she felt that her old cloth shoes needed replacing, so she used the income from selling pickled vegetables to order a pair of domestic black sports shoes with air cushions on a shopping app. After that, she returned to the master bedroom. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang had already lain down, and the two lay side by side doing a few minutes of deep breathing to relax. Xiulan reviewed the day and felt content and at peace.
location: Living room and master bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Fell asleep peacefully
description: With satisfaction and a sense of accomplishment, Ma Xiulan fell into a deep sleep beside her husband, ready to welcome the brand-new month of May.
location: Master bedroom of the home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning wake-up and shoulder and neck stretches
description: As soon as it was fully light, Ma Xiulan woke up naturally. Sitting on the edge of the bed, she first did a few slow head turns and shoulder shrugs, then stood in the open space of the bedroom and completed a 5-minute neck and shoulder stretching routine. The movements were smooth and thorough, and her neck and shoulders felt relaxed.
location: Bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Morning walk with a neighbor
description: After stretching, Ma Xiulan changed into lightweight cloth shoes and went out, walking briskly south along Jingwen Road. At the lane entrance she met her neighbor Zhang Shufen, who was also out early to exercise. The two walked together, chatting about everyday matters such as yesterday's cleaning and holiday preparations. They reached the central park, stretched their legs by the exercise equipment, and the whole trip took about 25 minutes.
location: Street park at the intersection of Jingwen Road and Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Watering flowers in the courtyard and family breakfast
description: After returning from the park, Ma Xiulan first carefully watered the newly planted rose seedlings and vegetable seeds in her courtyard. She took photos of the tender sprouts with water droplets on her phone and sent them to the family WeChat group "Happy Family" to share. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang and her son Ma Mingxuan, who was away from home, responded one after another. Then she went into the kitchen, heated up the buns and soy milk, boiled eggs, and called her husband and two children (Mingzhe and Yuxin) to get up and eat breakfast.
location: Courtyard and kitchen of residence at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Household tidying and holiday decorations
description: After breakfast, Ma Xiulan quickly cleared the dishes. To create a Labor Day atmosphere, she dug out small national flags and red lantern ornaments and had her husband Ma Zhiqiang stand on a stool to hang them on the living room window. She assisted from the side, and the room instantly took on a festive holiday feel.
location: Living room of the residence at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Loosening soil and weeding in the courtyard, and talking with mother on the phone.
description: Ma Xiulan brought out a small stool and continued loosening the soil and pulling weeds around the flower seedlings in the courtyard. During this, she called her mother Li Xiuying, who lives on Shengli Street, and carefully asked about the follow-up care for the Sichuan pepper soy-pickled radish she had made yesterday. Her mother reminded her not to touch it for the first three days, keep it in a cool, shady place, turn the jar after three days, and it would be ready to eat after another four or five days. She chatted about family matters for a while, then hung up and continued working in the courtyard.
location: Home courtyard at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Handicraft inventory check and market stocking plan.
description: Ma Xiulan carried the wicker basket to the living room, turned on the TV to play a rural drama as background noise, and began taking inventory of her handmade goods: 12 embroidered sachets, 8 crocheted rabbit hair clips, and 5 peace amulets. She checked the stitching, thought about sales at the May 10 market, wrote the inventory counts in her ledger, and considered adding new designs.
location: Living room of the residence at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Preparing the holiday lunch
description: Xiulan put down her handicraft and began preparing lunch. She took out pork belly and cut it into pieces, planning to make sweet and sour pork; at the same time she kneaded dough, washed day lily flowers and wood ear mushrooms, and prepared to make noodles with gravy. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang was in the yard collecting the dried sheets and quilt covers and folding them.
location: Home kitchen and courtyard at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Labor Day reunion lunch.
description: The kitchen was filled with aroma. Ma Xiulan brought out golden, crispy sweet-and-sour pork tenderloin and noodles with thick gravy. The family of four sat around and enjoyed a rare reunion meal. Xiulan talked about the amusing incident in April when customers praised her pickled vegetables at the trade fair. Her husband encouraged her to keep developing her craft. The children ate happily, and her youngest daughter Yuxin praised her mother's cooking as the best.
location: Home restaurant at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Afternoon nap and kitchen tidying
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan arranged for her husband and children to take a nap, while she cleaned up the kitchen: washing dishes, draining them, and wiping down the stove. After finishing, she felt a bit tired, so she went back to the bedroom, lay down, and rested with her eyes closed for half an hour, gradually recovering her energy.
location: Kitchen and bedroom at her residence, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Chatting with a neighbor at the doorstep
description: In the warm afternoon sunshine, Ma Xiulan brought out a small folding stool and sat in the shade at the entrance of her home. Her neighbor Wang Guilan strolled over, picked up the handkerchief Xiulan had newly embroidered, and praised the fine workmanship again and again. The two chatted about how the flowers and plants in the yard were growing and talked about everyday things for more than half an hour, in a relaxed and pleasant atmosphere.
location: At the front door of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Market preparation and bookkeeping
description: After the neighbor left, Ma Xiulan went back into the house, took out her account book and pen, and checked next month's market dates on her phone calendar. She planned the stocking list for the May 10 market and wrote down: pickled vegetables (peppercorn-pickled radish, can bring samples after tasting on May 3), sachets, hair clips, and amulets, and reminded herself to get some change.
location: Living room of the residence at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Learning new embroidery patterns and preparing dinner
description: After finishing the planning, Ma Xiulan used her spare time to scroll through short videos on her phone, learning tutorials for new embroidery patterns and thinking about adding new designs for the market fair. Then she got up and went to the kitchen to prepare a simple dinner: she reheated the leftover noodles with gravy from lunch and stir-fried garlic lettuce and shredded potatoes with green peppers.
location: Living room and kitchen of the residence at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Family dinner
description: The dinner was simple and warm; the family sat around the table eating. Ma Xiulan urged the children to eat more vegetables. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang mentioned that the children would be off school the next day and he could help look after them, letting Xiulan attend to her own things. Xiulan felt warmth in her heart.
location: Home restaurant at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Evening family time in the courtyard
description: After dinner, it was still light outside, and the children were playing in the courtyard: Mingzhe was playing with a water gun and Yuxin was playing hopscotch. Ma Xiulan sat under the porch, watching the children while crocheting a small hair clip for Yuxin. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang was repairing the loose flower stand. Each of the four family members was happily occupied.
location: Home courtyard at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Evening chores and washing up the children
description: As it grew dark, Ma Xiulan called the children home and urged Mingzhe and Yuxin to wash up. She turned on the TV to listen to the news and put the day's laundry into the washing machine. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang checked the courtyard gate and closed it.
location: Own home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Couple's evening talk and relaxation exercises
description: After the children fell asleep, Ma Xiulan and her husband Ma Zhiqiang leaned back against the bed. She shared photos of the tender rose shoots she had taken during the day, discussed the upcoming market trip next month, and made arrangements for the weekend shuttle to the children's hobby classes. After talking, they did deep-breathing relaxation exercises together, inhaling and exhaling for dozens of rounds, dispelling the day's fatigue.
location: Master bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Keeping accounts and going to bed
description: After taking a deep breath, Ma Xiulan felt relaxed in body and mind. She picked up the bedside ledger and briefly noted the day's affairs: Labor Day, home celebration, courtyard maintenance, handicraft inventory, no income, about 30 yuan spent on groceries. After setting the alarm for 6:20 the next day, she turned off the light and fell asleep peacefully, feeling that this Labor Day was enjoyable.
location: Master bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Morning stretching and a walk in the park
description: The 6:40 alarm went off. She first did a 5-minute neck, shoulder, and waist stretch in the bedroom. After changing into sneakers, she walked briskly west along Jingwen Road for about 300 meters, met her neighbor Zhang Shufen, and walked and chatted together. After arriving at the small park at the intersection of Jingwen Road and Shengli Avenue, she circled the square three times, completing a 2,000-step walk. Feeling warm and refreshed, she said goodbye to Zhang Shufen and went home.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to the street park at the intersection of Jingwen Road and Shengli Street

name: Inspect the courtyard and greet neighbors
description: After returning home from a walk, she went to the small vegetable garden in the courtyard to check the roses and green vegetable seedlings, pulled out a weed, and touched the vegetable leaves with her finger. Neighbor Wang Guilan came out to take out the trash, greeted her across the fence, chatted about the weather and vegetable prices, and then went inside.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (courtyard)

name: Preparing and enjoying breakfast with the family.
description: After entering the house, she washed her hands and prepared breakfast: reheated stuffed buns and steamed buns, cooked millet porridge, and fried eggs. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang and the children got up one by one, and the family sat around the table. During the meal, she discussed with Old Ma that he would take the children to the park today, and reminded him to buy green beans and tofu.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (kitchen and dining room)

name: Household chores and craft preparation.
description: After breakfast, she cleared the dishes and wiped the table clean. She cleared off the small tea table by the living room window, spread an old cotton cloth on it, and took out the sewing box, embroidery hoop, colored silk threads, crochet hooks, and spare fabric from the cabinet, arranging them neatly. Watching the sunlight fall on the materials, she felt content.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (living room)

name: Rushing to finish handmade crafts for the market.
description: First, I embroidered a twin lotus flower pattern on a peace sachet using emerald green and pink silk thread; it took about an hour. Then I embroidered a second one with yellow and blue thread. After rubbing my eyes and resting around 11 o'clock, I crocheted two coasters in a pineapple flower pattern in off-white and lake blue. In the end, I completed three sachets and two coasters, checked the stitches, and put them into a storage box.
location: No. 156, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (by the living room window)

name: Preparing and enjoying lunch, with family conversation
description: At 11:30 I started preparing lunch. My husband and the children came back from the park with green beans, tofu, and cooked food. I made the noodles with gravy the children love, dicing the green beans and stir-frying them with pork belly, then adding tofu and sweet bean sauce and thickening it. At the table we talked about the community handicraft contest. Ma Zhiqiang suggested teaming up with Chunmei, and I laughed and said just setting up a nice stall would do. After the meal, Old Ma volunteered to wash the dishes and let me rest.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (kitchen and dining room)

name: Midday rest and Moments interactions
description: She did not take a nap and looked at her phone on the sofa. Seeing the Moments post from her childhood friend Liu Chunmei about crocheted hair clips from that morning, she liked it and commented to ask for new patterns. Then she took photos of the new coasters she had made and posted them on Moments, with a caption sharing her feelings.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (living room sofa)

name: Watching TV and daily chores.
description: Feeling tired and sleepy, she turned on the TV and watched a lifestyle program. The program taught how to make sweet and sour pork ribs, but she gave up because she didn't have all the ingredients. During the commercial breaks, she went to the bathroom to hand-wash two T-shirts, her husband's and her own, and hung them on the balcony. Then she mopped the living room floor and put away the remote controls and water cups on the coffee table. After finishing the housework, she continued watching the program, and after moving her body around, she felt her energy return.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Contacted Chunmei on WeChat about the market matters.
description: Received a WeChat voice call from Chunmei. We talked about how the coasters looked nice in real life and agreed to meet at the west gate of the Jinghai District Cultural Activity Center at 8 a.m. on the day after tomorrow (May 4). Booths can be registered for free before 10 o'clock, so the two of us planned to go early to secure a spot. I also agreed to prepare more patterns and bring pickled vegetables. After that, we talked about how our children were doing, and we hung up after about 20 minutes.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (living room sofa)

name: Preparing Dinner Ingredients and Courtyard Parent-Child Time
description: After the call, she went to the yard for some air. She saw Lao Ma playing with the two children: Yuxin was chasing butterflies, and Mingzhe was drawing on the ground. After asking about the dinner plan, she went into the kitchen to trim the green beans, smash the cucumbers, wash the rice and start steaming it, and cut the tomatoes for later. Lao Ma said he would do the stir-frying in the evening.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (courtyard and kitchen)

name: The whole family cooked and enjoyed dinner together.
description: Just after four o'clock, Old Ma put on an apron and went into the kitchen to cook. He made scrambled eggs with tomatoes, braised pork with green beans, and cucumber salad with garlic. I helped by passing dishes and serving rice. Dinner started at five thirty. Mingzhe shared about the big kite he saw in the park, and Yuxin gestured along. The family ate and chatted in a warm and lively atmosphere.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (kitchen and dining room)

name: Clean up after meals and help the children with homework
description: After the meal, she let Lao Ma rest and cleaned up the dishes, washing the bowls and wiping the stove. Then she went into Mingzhe's room, checked his holiday homework, patiently guided him through the math word problems, helped him write out the equations to get the correct answers, and corrected his wrong characters.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family evening cooling off and couple conversation
description: After it got dark, she and her husband moved small folding stools into the courtyard to enjoy the cool evening air. They talked about Old Ma's work plan to pick up a short-distance cargo load in Cangzhou the day after tomorrow; she urged him to drive carefully and not to rush driving at night. She told him in detail about the market plans with Chunmei the day after tomorrow and her idea of bringing the handicrafts and pickled vegetables. Old Ma promised to come back early after delivering the goods to look after the children, and to ask her mother-in-law for help if things got too busy. The two chatted casually and enjoyed the peaceful time.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (courtyard and living room)

name: Evening wash-up and relaxation
description: At 8:30 she got the children to wash up and watched them brush their teeth and wash their faces. After the children were asleep, the couple washed up, changed into pajamas, and lay in bed doing a five-minute deep-breathing relaxation exercise together. The tiredness of the day faded away with their breathing; although her shoulders and wrists were sore, she felt fulfilled and content.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (bathroom and bedroom)

name: Write diary and go to sleep
description: After Old Ma fell asleep, she turned on the bedside lamp and took out the account book and diary. She recorded the handmade output (3 sachets, 2 coasters) and noted the plan to meet Chunmei at the market at 8 o'clock the day after tomorrow. After turning off the light, she reflected on the day: her husband had taken over the housework so she could focus on handicrafts, and the market plan was settled. Feeling happy and content, she soon fell asleep.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (master bedroom headboard)

name: Morning Exercise and Walk
description: I woke up naturally at 6:30 in the morning, did 5 minutes of shoulder and neck stretches on the bedroom floor, and felt my shoulders especially relaxed. At 7:00 I put on my sports shoes and went out for a brisk walk along Jingwen Road. I ran into my neighbor Zhang Shufen at the Jingwen Road street park, and the two of us chatted about everyday things as we walked. Zhang Shufen said your eldest had shot up again. The walk lasted about 20 minutes; I was lightly sweating and felt refreshed.
location: Jingwen Road Street Park at the intersection of Jingwen Road and Chunxi Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Family breakfast and household chores.
description: After the walk, they returned home. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang had already reheated the buns and porridge. Ma Xiulan fried eggs and warmed the pickled vegetables. At 7:30 the whole family sat down for breakfast, including Ma Zhiqiang, elder son Ma Mingzhe, and younger daughter Ma Yuxin. After breakfast, she quickly tidied the kitchen, washed and put away the dishes, and prepared for the big job of the day.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Market preparation and packing
description: After breakfast, she threw herself into preparing for the market. She moved the sealed jars of pickled radish with Sichuan pepper to the living room and placed them together with the previously made pickled vegetable bottles. She wiped each bottle, checked the seals, tightened the slightly loose ones, and attached Xiulan Handmade labels. She opened the handmade storage box, picked out three double-lotus peace sachets and two pineapple-pattern coasters, and wrapped them in soft cloth. She counted the change pouch, confirmed the payment QR code, and put the small sign reading Xiulan Handmade and the folding tablecloth on top, making sure everything was ready for tomorrow's stall.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Lunch and tasting pickled vegetables
description: With the preparations done for now, she made a simple lunch with Ma Zhiqiang. The main dish was tasting the newly pickled Sichuan pepper radish. Ma Xiulan washed her hands and solemnly opened the jar lid; a salty, slightly spicy aroma of Sichuan pepper wafted out. The radish she picked out was bright yellow and crispy to the bite, with just the right saltiness and a perfect numbing fragrance from the Sichuan pepper. The whole family was full of praise, and her second son Mingzhe took two extra pieces. Ma Xiulan felt reassured and thought it would surely be popular at the market the next day.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Called my mother during the lunch break
description: After the meal, while the children were taking their afternoon nap, she leaned against the headboard in the bedroom to rest and called her mother, Li Xiuying. She happily reported that the pickled radish had turned out delicious. Her mother carefully reminded her of things to pay attention to at the stall tomorrow, such as bringing small dishes for customers to sample and greeting customers warmly. Ma Xiulan did not mention the departure time tomorrow morning, only saying that she knew what she was doing and asked her mother not to worry. During the call, she felt her mother’s care.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Purchasing market supplies
description: After the midday nap, she rode her electric bike to the Xingwang Road Market to shop. Before leaving, she told Ma Zhiqiang to watch the children. She went north along Shengli Street and turned onto Xingwang Road, arriving after about 25 minutes of cycling. Knowing the place well, she bought three baked flatbreads for herself at tomorrow's market and two bottles of mineral water, added a bunch of greens and two heads of garlic for home, and also bought two packs of small wet wipes to keep on hand. After shopping, she rode back the same way and got home at about 14:50.
location: Xingwang Road Vegetable Market, No. 1 Xingwang Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Final check and putting things in order.
description: After returning home, she put the vegetables and sesame flatbreads in the kitchen, then sat in the living room and went through all the things to bring tomorrow against the list: pickled vegetables, handmade items, change, QR code, tablecloth, sign, wet wipes, flatbreads, and water. After confirming nothing was missing, she went to the bedroom and picked out a neat dark coat and a pair of comfortable flat shoes, draping them over the back of a chair so she could put them on and leave first thing in the morning.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Helping in the kitchen and quality time with the children
description: In the evening, she began helping Ma Zhiqiang prepare dinner, trimming green beans and peeling potatoes. Her younger daughter Ma Yuxin ran over and pulled her to the courtyard to look at the flower seeds planted yesterday. Ma Xiulan wiped her hands and followed her out, praising the seeds as she looked. Her second son Ma Mingzhe was also nearby drawing on the ground with a twig. She did not help with homework, just quietly accompanied them and enjoyed the leisure of the weekend.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Family dinner
description: Ma Zhiqiang did the cooking, making braised pork with green beans and scrambled eggs with tomatoes, with rice as the staple. Ma Xiulan set out the bowls and chopsticks, and the whole family sat around the table to eat. During the meal, Ma Xiulan said she was going to the market early the next morning. Ma Zhiqiang said he was not going out with the truck the next day and would take care of the children and housework, so she could go with peace of mind. The children also sensibly said they would listen to their father.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Evening family time
description: After dinner, they rarely relaxed like this. Ma Zhiqiang took the kids to watch TV in the living room. Ma Xiulan did not join in, just watched them. Her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin leaned against her husband's chest. Ma Xiulan walked over and sat down, gently stroking her daughter's soft hair. The nerves of a busy day completely relaxed, and the family quietly enjoyed the warmth of a weekend evening.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: At 8:30 she began urging the three children to wash up. The eldest, Ma Mingxuan, was self-disciplined; the second, Ma Mingzhe, needed a few prompts; the youngest daughter, Ma Yuxin, washed her face with help. After the children were all asleep, she went back to her own bedroom to wash up, then found her ID card and checked that the alarm was set for 6:00 the next morning.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Late-night couple talk and going to bed.
description: After turning off the lights, she lay down side by side with Ma Zhiqiang. Following her old habit, she took deep breaths for a few minutes. Ma Xiulan turned to her side and softly talked a bit about tomorrow's market, saying she felt everything was quite well prepared. Ma Zhiqiang patted her hand and told her not to overthink and to sleep peacefully. Ma Xiulan responded, closed her eyes, her heart full of anticipation for tomorrow, and soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: Master bedroom at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Wake up, wash up, and get ready
description: The alarm went off right on time. Thinking about her debut at the Sunday market today, she felt both nervous and full of anticipation. Lying in bed, she took a deep breath, quickly moved her shoulders, neck, wrists, and ankles, and did a few simple stretches for about 3 minutes, which counted as today's exercise. Then she washed up quickly and tied her hair into a neat ponytail. In the kitchen, she checked the large canvas bag again: the coin purse, printed payment QR code card, a stack of clean disposable gloves, several small plates for customers to sample, and the jars of pickled vegetables, handmade sachets, and coasters packed the night before. She also carefully touched the plain floral tablecloth and the handwritten sign reading “Xiulan Handmade” to make sure everything was there, and only then felt at ease.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Breakfast and family reminders.
description: Her husband Ma Zhiqiang was off work today and had already heated up the leftover steamed buns and porridge from last night. The two quickly finished breakfast, and Xiulan seized the last moment to remind him: "Zhiqiang, don't forget to cook for the kids at noon. There are green beans and meat in the fridge from yesterday — stew them for the children. Keep an eye on Mingzhe's homework and don't let him keep thinking about watching TV." Ma Zhiqiang agreed to each item and told her to go and focus on her work.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Walk to the meeting point and meet up with a childhood friend.
description: With a heavy canvas bag on her back and an eco-friendly bag full of jars of pickled vegetables in hand, Xiulan left the house full of energy. She walked east along Jingwen Road; a gentle breeze brushed her face and the weather was pleasant. The thought of soon seeing her childhood friend Chunmei made her steps brisk. The distance was about 800 meters, and the walk took 10 minutes. Xiulan arrived at the meeting spot a few minutes early and saw Chunmei also approaching with bags of all sizes. The two exchanged smiles and teased each other. 'Chunmei, you look even more spirited today!' 'Hey, so do you! Let's go grab a good spot!' Chatting, they walked toward the community square.
location: Intersection of Jingwen Road and Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Going to the market and setting up the stall
description: Walking along Jingwen Road for about 25 minutes (about 1.5 km), the two arrived at the market in the community square. They found their assigned stall, D-15. Xiulan deftly spread out a plain floral tablecloth, neatly arranged the pickle jars by flavor, hung the sachets on the small rack in front of the stall, stacked the coasters, and finally solemnly hung up the "Xiulan Handmade" sign. Chunmei also set out her handmade hair clips and hair ties. The two worked and chatted, cooperating in perfect sync.
location: Community Square, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (Stall No. 15, Zone D of the market).

name: Morning market sales and interaction
description: The number of customers at the market gradually increased. Xiulan was a little reserved at first, but soon plucked up courage and warmly greeted: "Ma'am, take a look at our homemade pickled vegetables—clean and hygienic. Would you like a taste? This sachet is hand-embroidered; it smells nice in a car or wardrobe." A gray-haired old lady tasted the pickled cucumbers and praised them endlessly, buying two jars. A young mother was drawn to the twin lotus flower sachet, and Xiulan told her it meant "peace and joy." The mother was very satisfied and bought one for her daughter. Chunmei also helped watch the stall, giving Xiulan a moment to grab a drink of water.
location: Community Square, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (Stall No. 15, Zone D of the market).

name: Lunch and rest break
description: Taking advantage of the midday lull in foot traffic, the two took turns going to buy two jianbing guozi with eggs and bottles of water, then sat behind the stall eating and chatting. Xiulan mentally counted the morning's results: she had sold two jars of pickled vegetables and one sachet, earning 55 yuan. This boosted her confidence and made her feel the afternoon held more promise.
location: Community Square, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (Stall No. 15, Zone D of the market).

name: Afternoon market sales and interaction
description: Afternoon foot traffic was steady, and Xiulan felt more confident. She carefully explained stitching techniques to a woman interested in embroidery and showed her photos of other embroidered pieces on her phone. The woman liked them very much and not only bought a peace sachet but also took the initiative to leave her phone number, saying she wanted to order a pair of embroidered pillowcases. Later in the afternoon, an older man tasted the pickled vegetables and bought a jar. In the end, her total income for the day settled at 85 yuan.
location: Community Square, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (Stall No. 15, Zone D of the market).

name: Closing the stall, settling accounts, and going home
description: As the market drew to a close, the two began to pack up their stall. Xiulan carefully wiped every item, rolled up the tablecloth, and took down the sign. She took out her small accounting notebook and solemnly wrote down the income: 85 yuan, with the note "Market debut, success!" Then she helped Chunmei tidy up the stall and returned the rented stall sign. The two parted at the intersection, and Chunmei was happy for her achievement. Xiulan carried the slightly lighter canvas bag and walked home briskly. She was calculating in her mind whether to use the 85 yuan to buy something nice for the children or to save it, with an irrepressible smile on her face. She walked 15 minutes home.
location: On the way from Jingwen Road Community Square, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to No. 156 Jingwen Road.

name: Returning home and sharing the joy.
description: As soon as she entered the house, her youngest daughter Yuxin threw herself at her. Xiulan smiled and handed the money to her husband: "Look, we sold 85 yuan today!" Ma Zhiqiang took the money and, showing a rare smile, praised her for being capable. The curious children gathered around and asked what was new at the market. Xiulan sat down and vividly told them the story of the old lady and the young mother; the family was full of joy.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing and enjoying dinner
description: It was getting late, so Xiulan rolled up her sleeves and started cooking dinner. She made braised pork with green beans using the beans bought last night, stir-fried a plate of tomatoes and eggs, and also made a seaweed egg drop soup. The family sat around the dining table eating home-style dishes, with a warm and lively atmosphere. During the meal, her husband mentioned that he might need to go on a long-distance trip next week.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Housework and helping with homework
description: After the meal, Xiulan quickly cleared the dishes and wiped the table. Then she checked Mingzhe's weekend homework and spotted mistakes in several math problems. She explained them very patiently until the child completely understood. Her younger daughter Yuxin was quietly drawing nearby, while her elder son Mingxuan was reading an extracurricular book in his room.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family leisure and handicraft time
description: Xiulan turned on the TV and switched to the kids' favorite animation channel, and the family snuggled on the sofa watching for a while. She took out her phone, saved the number the lady had left, and labeled it "custom pillowcase customer." Then she got out her sewing kit and, while keeping the family company, used leftover fabric scraps to try designing a new style of sachet, thinking to herself about how to communicate with the customer.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Children's washing and bedtime stories
description: Xiulan urged the three children to go wash up. She first helped Yuxin wash her face and brush her teeth, coaxed her into bed, and told her a story about "The Little Rabbit Sets Up a Stall." Only after all the children were settled did she finally get to catch her breath.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Bookkeeping reflections, pre-sleep relaxation, and falling asleep
description: Xiulan opened her ledger and carefully recorded every income and expense of the day. Then she turned to a new page and wrote down today's reflections: "The first stall was a good start. The lesson is: introduce yourself generously and prepare samples for tasting. That lady who wanted to order a custom pillowcase is a good opportunity; I need to think carefully about her needs." She silently decided to try to participate in more such fairs in the future. After washing up and changing into her pajamas, she lay in bed with her husband and only then felt that her legs and feet were a bit sore. Her husband asked with concern if she was tired. She smiled and said she was not, feeling very happy inside. The two chatted for a while about the day's experiences and plans for next week, then took several deep breaths together to relax. With a small hope for the future and a full sense of accomplishment, Ma Xiulan turned off the bedside lamp and fell deeply asleep in peace and contentment.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning stretching and a solo walk.
description: The alarm didn't go off, and she woke naturally at 6:45. She stretched in bed, stood against the wall for 5 minutes, and did a few shoulder and neck stretches. Then she went out alone, walking north along Jingwen Road from her door, listening to old songs by Teresa Teng on her earphones. There were not many people on the road. As she walked, she thought about the lady at yesterday's market who wanted a custom-made pillowcase and planned to contact her today.
location: Bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and the area along Jingwen Road.

name: Courtyard maintenance and growth records
description: After returning from her walk, she caught her breath in the courtyard. Crouching in front of the rose pot, she loosened the soil with a small trowel. Noticing weeds sprouting in the pot, she pulled them out one by one with her hands and pressed the soil firm. Delighted by the new tender branches, she took out her phone and took close-ups of the roses and the nearby flower seedlings. Comparing them with the photos saved on May 1, the leaves had clearly grown. She was happy and felt she could keep recording "Our Little Garden Growth Diary."
location: Home courtyard at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Washing up, breakfast, and taking her daughter to school
description: Wiped off sweat and went back inside, washed my face, and changed into clean loungewear. Called my younger daughter Ma Yuxin to get up, braided her hair, and had her drink a bowl of millet porridge. I heated up leftover buns from yesterday, had a bowl of egg drop soup, and made do with some shredded pickled vegetables. At 7:45 I took Yuxin on the electric bike to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten. Her kindergarten's graduating class had an activity today, so she attended school as usual. I said goodbye to her.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and Huakang First Kindergarten

name: Sewing a schoolbag (drafting patterns and cutting)
description: After returning from kindergarten, she moved the collected floral fabric scraps, various colored embroidery threads, and tool boxes from the storage room to the living room coffee table. She took out a pencil and paper, and designed the pattern based on the style Yuxin liked: one side with twin lotus flowers embroidered, and the other side with a cartoon bunny. She drew the paper pattern stroke by stroke, revised it repeatedly, then compared the fabric to select suitable base and floral colors, drew the outline with tailor's chalk, and carefully cut along the lines with scissors. In a morning's time, all the fabric pieces for the schoolbag were cut and neatly stacked to the side.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Cook lunch and eat lunch.
description: She was so busy all morning that she forgot the time, until her stomach started rumbling. She quickly cooked a bowl of dried noodles, added a poached egg and two leaves of the greens bought the day before yesterday, and ate the noodles with the leftover soup from last night's meal. It was finished in a few minutes — simple and quick, so she could start work earlier.
location: Home kitchen and dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Midday nap
description: Feeling a bit sleepy after lunch, she leaned against the living room sofa, draped a small blanket over her stomach, and dozed for a while. Her phone was on the coffee table; the screen lit up briefly because the handicraft group was discussing a new stitching technique, but she was too drowsy to check it.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Learn new stitching techniques and continue sewing
description: After resting for half an hour, she felt energetic. She picked up her phone, opened the handicraft group, and scrolled through the chat history of the ladies. Someone had posted a video of embroidering petals with the long-and-short stitch, which gives a more three-dimensional effect than traditional stitching. She watched it twice, then practiced on a scrap piece of fabric. Feeling she had learned it, she took out the cloth pieces she had cut in the morning and prepared to embroider the first petal of the twin lotus flower.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Formally embroider the twin-lotus petals.
description: The light was good, so she sat on the sofa by the window and began to embroider stitch by stitch. First she outlined the petals with dark pink thread, then used the newly learned "long-short stitch" to fill in the colors layer by layer, gradually transitioning from dark to light. She embroidered slowly and carefully, checking after every stitch whether the position was right. After about an hour, her neck became stiff, so she got up and walked two laps in the front yard, looked at the flowers, stretched her wrists, and then came back to continue. By four o'clock in the afternoon, the rough shape of more than half a lotus petal had emerged.
location: Living room and courtyard at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Pick up the youngest daughter from school and buy groceries on the way.
description: She carefully put the half-finished embroidery into a clean cloth bag to keep it from gathering dust. After changing into going-out clothes, she got on her electric bike and went first to Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up Yuxin. As soon as Yuxin saw her, she ran over and called out "Mommy." Smiling, Ma Xiulan lifted her onto the small seat at the back and fastened the safety belt. On the way, she stopped by the Wutong Commune vegetable market, bought some green beans and a few tomatoes, and thought about making a tasty dinner for the children that evening.
location: Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten in Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and the Wutong Community Vegetable Market

name: Prepare ingredients for dinner and clean up the craft table.
description: After returning home, she let Yuxin play by herself in the living room. She first prepped the dishes for dinner: trimming the green beans one by one, washing and cutting the tomatoes into chunks, and taking the pork ribs out of the fridge early to thaw. Then she quickly put away the scissors, spools of thread, and leftover fabric scraps from the coffee table into a storage box so the children wouldn't touch them.
location: Kitchen and living room of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Prepare dinner and the second son comes home from school
description: Once she was almost ready, she threw herself into the kitchen. She stewed pork ribs in the pressure cooker and blanched the trimmed green beans in hot water. Her second son, Ma Mingzhe, came home from school carrying his backpack by himself. As soon as he entered, he called 'Mom' and handed over a certificate, saying he scored 98 on the math exam. She happily praised him a little and told him to go do homework first. With quick hands, she stir-fried green beans with pork, made scrambled eggs with tomatoes, and finally made smashed cucumber with garlic. A pot of fragrant rice was also perfectly cooked.
location: Home kitchen and dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Dinner time
description: She brought the dishes to the table and called the two children to eat. While picking food for Yuxin, she asked Mingzhe what he had learned at school today. Mingzhe said they had a math test today; the questions were a bit hard, but he had also figured out the bonus questions that weren't on the test. She nodded and said, "As long as you did your best." The family chatted while eating, lively and warm.
location: Home dining room at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Clearing the dishes and checking homework.
description: After the meal, she had Mingzhe keep an eye on Yuxin while she quickly cleared the dishes and wiped the table clean. While washing the dishes, she heard Yuxin giggling at a cartoon in the living room. After tidying up the kitchen, she first checked Mingzhe's math test paper. She looked at the bonus question for a long time, then guided him step by step with her own simple method, and he finally understood it.
location: Kitchen and Mingzhe's bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Continuing embroidery and accompanying her daughter
description: After checking the homework, she took out that cloth bag again and continued embroidering the lotus petal by the living room light. Yuxin came over, looked at the embroidery hoop curiously, and asked, 'Mom, what are you embroidering?' She told her, 'I'm embroidering a little bunny you like. Later I'll make it into a schoolbag for you to carry to school, okay?' Yuxin clapped her hands happily. While she talked with the child, her hands never stopped working.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Urge the children to wash up and go to sleep.
description: Checked the time; it was time to wash up. First, she took Yuxin to wash her face and brush her teeth, changed her into pajamas, and then urged Mingzhe to take a shower. Once both children were in bed, she went over and told Yuxin two little stories, waiting until the child closed her eyes before turning off the light and leaving.
location: Bathroom and children's bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Write in her diary and plan tomorrow's client contacts
description: Once the house quieted down, she sat at the dresser and took out her notebook to record the day's simple accounts: the rose bush had sprouted new leaves, and the progress on the schoolbag (half of the lotus petals embroidered). Then she made a point of writing down the important task for tomorrow: call Ms. Wang, who wanted a custom pillowcase, on the morning of May 6 to ask what color fabric she likes and what size the pillowcase should be, so they can discuss the price. After writing it down, she checked Ms. Wang's phone number in her phone memo again, and only then felt at ease.
location: Dressing table in the bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Video-called with her husband and went to bed
description: Just finished the accounts when my husband Ma Zhiqiang called on video. I picked up and asked him where he had got to today and whether he had eaten. Zhiqiang said he was resting at a service area and had eaten a bowl of instant noodles. I chattered on about embroidering a schoolbag for Yuxin and also mentioned the latest progress on contacting a client tomorrow. Zhiqiang kept saying 'Fine, fine, just do as you see fit.' We talked for about twenty minutes, then I told him to drive safely and hung up. I stretched, turned off the light, and lay down with a peaceful heart.
location: Bedroom in the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Morning wake-up and walk
description: At 6:35 the alarm went off. Ma Xiulan felt she had slept deeply and her shoulders were not stiff. She stretched her ankles and wrists by the bed and did five minutes of neck and shoulder stretches. Then she changed into her sports shoes and went out for a brisk 24-minute walk on Jingwen Road. Passing by neighbor Zhang Shufen's door, she happened to run into her coming out to take out the trash, and the two chatted as they walked about the moving ending of last night's TV drama. After the walk, Ma Xiulan went into the courtyard to admire the roses and found a new bud the size of a grain of rice, feeling pleased.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and the Jingwen Road in front of the door

name: Wake children, breakfast, and school run
description: Ma Xiulan quickly woke the three children, helped her sleepy daughter Yuxin find clothes, while her son Mingzhe had already packed his schoolbag and the eldest son Mingxuan was the fastest and said he wanted to get to school early to copy down the questions. Breakfast was millet porridge, meat buns, and home-pickled soy-sauce cucumbers. At 7:30, Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike, with Yuxin on the back, to Huakang First Kindergarten. On the way, Yuxin happily said she had received a little red flower for her painting. After dropping her off at 7:45, she went to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to drop off Mingzhe. Mingzhe jumped off the bike himself and ran into the school gate; she reminded him to go to Grandma's house for lunch.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Housework and contacting clients
description: After dropping off the children and returning home, Ma Xiulan washed the dishes, wiped down the stove, and tidied the living room. Then she took out her ledger, called her client Ms. Wang, and asked in detail about the dimensions (48cm x 74cm) and pattern preferences for the custom pillowcases. Ms. Wang wanted an elegant orchid or bamboo design with a good meaning. Ma Xiulan recommended two embroidery styles and quoted 80 yuan per pair. Ms. Wang thought it was reasonable, and they agreed to deliver in one week, at which time she would pay a deposit.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Embroidered graduation school bag.
description: In a joyful mood, Ma Xiulan spread out the embroidery hoop and focused on embroidering the twin lotus petals onto her daughter Yuxin's graduation schoolbag. Using the newly learned long-and-short stitch technique, pink silk thread flew through her fingers as the petals gradually took on depth. She pictured Yuxin carrying the schoolbag to school, and the corners of her mouth curled into a smile. At 11:00, she stood up to stretch her neck and wrists, then went to the courtyard to water the young flower seedlings.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Lunch and lunch break.
description: At noon, Ma Xiulan cooked a simple bowl of dried noodles for herself, adding baby bok choy and a poached egg. After eating, she leaned back on the sofa and browsed messages in the handicraft group. Seeing the sisters discussing new designs for next week's market, she saved several videos. At 12:30 she felt sleepy and dozed on the sofa for half an hour.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Take inventory and continue embroidering
description: Refreshed after her midday rest, Ma Xiulan opened the storage cabinet and counted the goods for the May 10 market: 8 jars of Sichuan peppercorn pickled radish, 5 peace sachets, and 3 coasters. She took out the items, wiped the jars with a clean cloth, and mentally planned the display. Then she returned to the embroidery hoop and continued stitching the petals, striving to finish the largest one.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparation before going out
description: Ma Xiulan stopped her embroidery and rolled her shoulders. Seeing that it was time to pick up her daughter, she changed into a clean floral blouse and grabbed her change purse and electric bike keys. Suddenly remembering that her friend Wang Guilan had once said she would have her son look at the sachets she had embroidered, she casually put a peace sachet with a twin lotus pattern into her bag.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up daughter from school
description: Ma Xiulan arrived at the gate of Huakang First Kindergarten ten minutes early. As soon as Yuxin came out, she rushed into her arms like a little swallow and called her mom. She helped Yuxin put on her little backpack and asked what new song she had learned that day. Yuxin sang 'Little Swallow' in her childish voice, making her laugh.
location: The entrance of Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and Jingwen Road

name: Shopping at the vegetable market.
description: Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike with Yuxin to Xingwang Vegetable Market and went straight to her friend Sun Guifang's stall. She bought a bunch of baby bok choy and a piece of soft tofu. While the vegetables were being weighed, she chatted with Aunt Sun about the market day two days ago, saying that she had sold more than 80 yuan that day and had also received an order for work. Aunt Sun praised her cooking skills and, as she left, stuffed a bunch of scallions into her hands to make scallion pancakes at home.
location: Xingwang Vegetable Market, Dongfanghong Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing dinner
description: After getting home, Ma Xiulan hurriedly washed and trimmed the vegetables. She cleaned the baby bok choy, cut the soft tofu into pieces, heated up the ribs stewed the night before, and made a tomato and egg soup. Yuxin sat on a small stool building a house with blocks. At 16:30 her son Mingzhe came back from school by himself and said he was hungry. While cooking, she asked him about school. Mingzhe said he had already finished his math homework at school, leaving only Chinese.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner
description: At 17:45, the eldest son Mingxuan rode his bike home, and the whole family gathered for dinner. The dishes were braised pork ribs, stir-fried baby bok choy, and tomato and egg soup. Ma Xiulan picked a rib for Yuxin and let her eat it by herself. Mingzhe ate very quickly, while Mingxuan said slowly and unhurriedly that there would be a test next week. Ma Xiulan told him not to get too tired and to study the textbook knowledge in a down-to-earth way.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Checking homework and evening handicrafts.
description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan asked Mingzhe and Mingxuan to do their homework while Yuxin looked at picture books beside them. After clearing the dishes, she sat at the living room tea table, continuing her embroidery while checking Mingzhe's Chinese character exercises and correcting a stroke. Mingxuan studied quietly in his room. Under the warm yellow light, the family each did their own things, and Ma Xiulan felt grounded and content.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Children's washing and bedtime stories
description: At 8 o'clock, Ma Xiulan urged the children to wash up. Yuxin was too busy playing and didn't want to go, so she agreed to tell a bedtime story after the bath to get her to cooperate. Mingzhe brushed his teeth and washed his face quickly by himself, while Mingxuan was a bit slower. Ma Xiulan helped Yuxin bathe and change into pajamas, then picked up a fairy tale book and read The Little Horse Crossing the River. Halfway through the story, Yuxin drifted off to sleep. She gently kissed her daughter's forehead, turned off the night light, and quietly closed the door behind her.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Keeping accounts and writing a diary
description: After settling the children down, Ma Xiulan sat at the dressing table in the master bedroom and opened her account book, recording the day's expenses: 12 yuan for groceries. In the remarks column, she wrote, 'Ms. Wang ordered a pillowcase; the pattern and price have been agreed upon, delivery in one week.' Then she opened her diary and wrote down the embroidery progress, Aunt Sun's praise, and her plan to start designing the pattern for Ms. Wang's pillowcase tomorrow.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pre-sleep relaxation and bedtime
description: Closing her notebook, Ma Xiulan stretched her sore shoulders, walked to the window and pushed it open, feeling the coolness of the late spring night breeze and the smell of earth, listening to the crickets in the grass. The day's fatigue drifted away with the wind. She didn't wait for her husband Zhiqiang's call, knowing he was driving a long-distance route. At 22:00, she turned off the light, lay down, and quickly fell asleep.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning stretching, walking, and shopping at the vegetable market
description: After doing shoulder and neck stretches in the bedroom in the early morning, she walked along Jingwen Road and ran into her neighbor Zhang Shufen at the street park. The two walked together to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market. At the market, she bought fresh baby bok choy, spinach, tender tofu, and scallions from stall owner Sun Guifang, spending 8.5 yuan, and chatted with Sister Sun about pickling potherb mustard.
location: From No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market (intersection of Jingwen Road and Chaoyang Road)

name: Making breakfast and taking the children to school
description: After returning home from the vegetable market, she quickly prepared breakfast: cooked millet porridge, heated steamed buns, fried eggs, and sliced salted duck eggs. At 8 o'clock she woke the three children and urged them to wash up. After the family finished breakfast, she rode the electric bike, first taking her eldest son Mingxuan and second son Mingzhe to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, then taking her youngest daughter Yuxin to Huakang First Kindergarten, handed her personally to the teacher, and returned home.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (Home); Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street); Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten (Huakang Road)

name: Housework and embroidering a graduation backpack.
description: After returning home, she cleaned up the dishes, wiped the stove, and swept the floor. Then she sat at the living room tea table and continued embroidering the twin-lotus design on the graduation schoolbag, using dark green silk thread to create the upright stems and leaves and their veins. Meanwhile, she turned on the TV and played a life mediation show as background sound, while also working on the orchid pattern for the custom pillowcase ordered by Ms. Wang, sketching orchid and bamboo color schemes and stitches in an old notebook. She continued embroidering until noon.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Simple lunch and rest.
description: Cooked a bowl of dried noodles for herself, poached an egg, blanched two baby bok choy with a few drops of sesame oil, and made a simple lunch. After eating, she washed the dishes, scrolled through videos in the handmade crafts group on her phone while on the sofa, set the 13:00 alarm, and closed her eyes for a half-hour nap.
location: Home dining room and living room, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Organizing kitchen storage
description: After the midday rest, she began to thoroughly organize the kitchen wall cabinets and base cabinets. She sorted and cleaned the items, threw away the expired Sichuan peppercorn powder, damp starch, and dried shiitake mushrooms, and wiped the inside of the cabinets. She re-stored dried chili peppers, star anise, and cassia bark in glass jars and labeled them. She checked the mung beans, found they were not spoiled, and decided to cook soup with them another day. Finally, she rearranged the pots, pans, bowls, plates, and seasonings according to frequency of use.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the younger daughter from school
description: Rode her bike to Huakang First Kindergarten, chatted briefly with parents at the gate, then picked up her younger daughter Yuxin. Yuxin excitedly showed off the rabbit and her mother that she had drawn. Xiulan praised the drawing and took her daughter home.
location: Huakang First Kindergarten, Huakang Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing ingredients and making dinner.
description: After getting home, she had Yuxin play with building blocks and took out pork ribs from the fridge to thaw. Then she walked again to the Wutong Commune Vegetable Market to buy iron-stick yam. Back home, she blanched the ribs, put them in an electric pressure cooker with yam chunks and ginger slices to make soup, while also preparing greens, peeling garlic, and slicing pork. During this time, she explained math problems to her second son Mingzhe and put away Yuxin's scattered toys.
location: From home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market and then back home

name: A family of four having dinner
description: After eldest son Mingxuan came home from school, the family sat together for dinner, with dishes including yam and pork rib soup, shredded pork with garlic sprouts, and stir-fried spinach. During the meal, Mingxuan shared the joy of getting first place in the 50-meter run in PE class, Mingzhe showed off his 95 in math, and Yuxin said in a baby voice that she got a little red flower. The atmosphere was warm and happy.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Checking homework and getting ready for bed
description: After dinner, cleared the table and put leftovers in the fridge. At 19:00 checked the children's homework: focused on tutoring Mingxuan in math meeting problems, urged Mingzhe to rewrite his sloppy new characters, and let Yuxin look at picture books on her own. Afterward washed the dishes and soaked mung beans for later, then helped Yuxin wash up.
location: Living room and kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Put her youngest daughter to bed and practiced embroidery.
description: Told Yuxin the story Tom the Little Rabbit to lull her to sleep. After her daughter was sound asleep, she took out her embroidery hoop in the living room and practiced the short stitch method with light gray thread, thinking about how to apply it to Ms. Wang's orchid pillowcase to create a fluffy texture.
location: Second bedroom and living room at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Video call with husband
description: Her husband Ma Zhiqiang made a video call while resting at a service area. Xiulan urged him to be safe and not drive while fatigued, shared the children's good behavior today and her joy at receiving a pillowcase order. After chatting for 20 minutes, they said goodbye and wished each other safety.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Pre-sleep relaxation and bedtime
description: After washing up, I did some simple pre-sleep stretching to relax my body, reviewed what I had accomplished that day, and planned the next day: continue finishing the schoolbag embroidery, cook mung bean soup, and finalize the pillowcase color scheme. I turned off the light at 22:15 and fell asleep peacefully to the sound of crickets outside the window.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Morning activities and breakfast
description: Ma Xiulan woke up at 6:45 in the morning, did simple wrist and ankle exercises in bed, then got up and did neck, shoulder, and waist stretches on the master bedroom floor. She then went out and walked along Jingwen Road for about 18 minutes, enjoying the cool morning air, before returning home to prepare breakfast. She cooked millet porridge, heated up pork and scallion buns, and fried three eggs. The three children, Ma Mingxuan, Ma Mingzhe, and Ma Yuxin, came to the table one after another. Ma Xiulan ladled out the porridge while reminding the children to pack their school bags. She especially praised Ma Mingzhe for writing yesterday's new characters well and encouraged him to keep it up. After breakfast, she urged the children to get ready for school.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Take the children to school and return home to tidy up
description: After clearing the dishes, Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike with Yuxin and the schoolbags. She first went to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School on Shengli South Street, dropped off Mingxuan and Mingzhe, and watched them enter the school gate; then she rode to Huakang First Kindergarten and handed Yuxin to the teacher. After returning home, she wiped the dining table, washed and put away the dishes, mopped the dining room and kitchen floors, and arranged the slippers, making the house tidy.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Unusual discovery and salvage treatment of the pickled vegetables
description: After resting, Ma Xiulan checked the pickled vegetables stored in the kitchen cabinet and found that the newly pickled sweet and sour garlic had a white mold film on the surface and a sour, rancid smell. She immediately searched online on her phone for solutions and settled on the water bath heating method. Then she heated water to about 70°C, loosened the lid of the pickle jar, placed it in the pot, and heated it in the water bath for 15 minutes, staying by the stove to watch the heat. After heating, she took it out to cool. The white film disappeared and the flavor returned to normal. She transferred the rescued pickles into a clean bowl, washed the jar, and moved the remaining pickles to the coolest north-facing balcony in the house for storage. Finally, she recorded the rescue method and summer storage tips in detail in her phone memo.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Lunch, vegetable market shopping, and hanging out the laundry
description: Ma Xiulan cooked a bowl of dried noodles for herself as lunch and rested briefly in the living room after eating. Then she rode her e-bike to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market and bought ingredients such as potatoes, green beans, cilantro, and soft tofu. Back home, she took the clothes washed yesterday, including bed sheets and the children's T-shirts, and hung them out to dry on the balcony. While hanging the clothes, she brainstormed patterns for the custom pillowcase ordered by her neighbor Ms. Wang, and finally settled on an elegant bamboo-and-orchid design.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Wutong Commune Vegetable Market at the intersection of Jingwen Road and Wutong Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Hand embroidery: finishing the schoolbag and drawing patterns for the pillowcase
description: Ma Xiulan sat in the living room, took out Yuxin's graduation schoolbag and needle and thread, used green and pink silk thread to embroider the last leaves of a twin lotus flower, and reinforced the edges. Afterwards, she drew a pencil sketch of a bamboo pattern on the cotton fabric for the pillowcase she had prepared in advance, outlining the bamboo joints and leaf directions, preparing to start embroidering the pillowcase next week.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up Yuxin from school and visit Jingbai Supermarket.
description: Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up Yuxin, then stopped by Jingbai Supermarket at Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu, to talk with the owner, Sister Cao, about selling pickled vegetables on consignment. Sister Cao said the pickled vegetables were selling well—two jars had already been sold—and she hoped to get more stock. Ma Xiulan promised to deliver new goods soon, then took Yuxin home.
location: Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jingbai Supermarket, Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing dinner and doing small handicraft work
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan let Yuxin watch cartoons in the living room while she went into the kitchen to prepare dinner. She peeled and cut potatoes into chunks, trimmed and washed green beans and cut them into sections, and cut tofu into small cubes. While cooking rice, she returned to the living room to continue refining the pillowcase pattern, carefully drawing the bamboo joints and leaf vein details with a pencil. During this time, Yuxin occasionally came over to ask questions, and Ma Xiulan patiently responded and comforted her.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Picking up Mingxuan and Mingzhe from school and going home.
description: Ma Xiulan rode an electric bike with Yuxin to the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School. After waiting for a moment, Mingxuan and Mingzhe came out of the school gate. Ma Xiulan called them to get on the bike. Since Mingxuan was taller, she let him ride another bike himself, while she took Mingzhe and Yuxin back first. The family finally arrived safely at their home on Jingwen Road and washed their hands to prepare for dinner.
location: Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The whole family had dinner together.
description: Ma Xiulan brought the prepared potato and green bean stew, cold tofu salad, scrambled eggs, and rice to the table, and the family sat around to enjoy the meal. During dinner, Mingxuan mentioned that the school required a handwritten poster, and Mingzhe excitedly announced that he would represent his class in a jump rope competition tomorrow. Ma Xiulan served food to each child. The warm dinner time eased her fatigue from the day.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening homework help and children's bedtime arrangements.
