description: After cleaning up after the meal, Ma Xiulan began helping the children with their homework. She first helped Mingxuan analyze the word-problem errors on his math test paper caused by misplaced decimal points, explaining in detail; then she checked Mingzhe's Chinese handwriting workbook, pointed out the stroke-order problem with the character "ao" (proud), and had Mingzhe correct it and rewrite it three times. At the same time, she took time to read the picture book "Little Horse Crosses the River" with Yuxin. After the homework was done for the time being, she urged Mingxuan and Mingzhe to wash up on their own, while she helped Yuxin take a bath, dried her hair, and changed her into pajamas. She carried Yuxin to her small bed and told her stories to lull her to sleep. After Yuxin fell into a deep sleep, she tucked the child in and quietly left the room.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Focusing on embroidering pillowcases
description: With the children settled, Ma Xiulan took out the pillowcase embroidery cloth she had drawn in the afternoon, tightened it onto the embroidery hoop, and began embroidering a bamboo pattern with dark gray silk thread using cross-stitch. She stitched meticulously, checking the flatness of the stitches from time to time, and proactively unpicked and re-embroidered the bamboo leaves she was unhappy with. In the tranquil night, she focused on stitching several bamboo leaves, enjoying her own personal handicraft time.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Bookkeeping and recording life insights
description: Ma Xiulan put away her needle and thread, sat down at the dressing table, and first opened her account book to record the day's grocery shopping and several purchases at Jingbai Supermarket. Then, in her diary, she wrote in detail the whole process of rescuing the pickled vegetables, including the steps and effects of the water-bath heating method and the note that in the future the pickled vegetables should be stored on the north balcony and checked regularly. Finally, she recorded the embroidery progress on the pillowcase: 27 bamboo leaves had been embroidered so far, with harmonious colors and a smooth feel.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Washing up before bed and going to sleep
description: Ma Xiulan went to the bathroom to wash her face and soak her feet in warm water, relieving the fatigue of the day. After soaking her feet, she did simple leg and back stretches on the bedroom floor to relax her tense muscles. Then she drew the curtains, turned off the light, got into bed, and soon fell asleep in the quiet.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning walk and neighborly conversations.
description: Ma Xiulan got up at 06:30, did a simple 5-minute stretch in the bedroom, then went out for a slow walk along Jingwen Road. Near the intersection of Jingwen Road and Shengli Street, she met her neighbor Zhang Shufen. The two walked together to the Jingwen Road Park, chatting and sharing tips on saving pickles and watering flowers with rice-washing water. The walk took about 25 minutes.
location: Street park on Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning family interaction, breakfast, and school drop-off
description: Ma Xiulan arrived home at 07:10 and found that the Chinese roses in the courtyard had grown buds. She called her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin over to observe them together, took photos and sent them to the family group, where her husband Ma Zhiqiang and her mother Li Xiuying praised them. Then she woke the three children and prepared breakfast (millet porridge, steamed buns, and boiled eggs). Ma Yuxin wanted to draw the roses, so Ma Xiulan prepared drawing materials for her. At 07:40 she rode an electric bike to take Ma Yuxin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, then took Ma Mingzhe to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School. Her eldest son Ma Mingxuan rode his own bike to school, and she reminded him to pay attention to safety.
location: Residence on Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Vegetable market shopping and courtyard gardening.
description: After dropping off the children, Ma Xiulan stopped by the Wutong Commune vegetable market on the way and bought green beans, potatoes, soft tofu, and pork belly at Sun Guifang's stall, and received some cilantro as a gift. After arriving home at 09:00, she spent about 40 minutes watering the roses and vegetables in the courtyard with diluted cake fertilizer solution and pulling up weeds.
location: Wutong Commune vegetable market, Jinghai District, Tianjin; residential courtyard on Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Make an embroidered backpack for my daughter's graduation.
description: In the embroidery corner of the living room, Ma Xiulan continued embroidering the little rabbit pattern on her daughter's graduation schoolbag, using the long-and-short stitch for the pink ears. Meanwhile, she checked the family group chat, and her mother and husband praised her.
location: Living room of the residence on Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Had lunch and a midday rest alone
description: Ma Xiulan cooked herself some vegetable and egg noodles. After the meal, she washed the dishes, sat back on the sofa to browse her phone, then closed her eyes and rested for 15 minutes.
location: Residence on Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Prepare supplies for tomorrow's market
description: After waking up, Ma Xiulan checked the pickle jars and found no problems. She counted the items in the storage box: 8 jars of Sichuan pepper pickled radish, 5 peace sachets, 3 coasters, and a nearly finished pillowcase. She calculated the costs and expected selling prices, then packed the blue waterproof cloth and small folding stool for the street stall.
location: Residence on Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Restock pickled vegetables to Jingbai Supermarket
description: Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to Jingbai Supermarket with 8 jars of Sichuan-peppercorn pickled radish, where she counted and recorded the inventory with Sister Cao. Sister Cao told her the pickled vegetables were selling quickly, wished her success at the market, and said she could continue selling them on consignment.
location: Jingbai Supermarket, Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the child from school
description: Ma Xiulan first went to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up Ma Yuxin, and her daughter excitedly said she had painted roses; then she went to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up Ma Mingzhe, buying flatbread on the way, and they went home together.
location: Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jinghai District Third Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Helping the children with homework and preparing dinner
description: Ma Xiulan asked Ma Yuxin and Ma Mingzhe to do their homework in the living room. Ma Yuxin drew Chinese roses, Ma Mingzhe practiced writing new characters, and Ma Xiulan trimmed green beans and soaked wood ear mushrooms while helping the children with their homework and correcting their stroke order.
location: Residence on Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Family dinner and praising the children.
description: Ma Mingxuan came home. Ma Xiulan made braised pork with potatoes, sautéed lettuce with garlic, and tomato and egg soup. At dinner, she praised Ma Mingzhe for placing third in his grade in the rope-skipping competition, and the whole family had a happy gathering.
location: Home dining room, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening tutoring and handicraft catch-up
description: Ma Xiulan cleaned up the dishes, then first tutored Ma Mingxuan on his decimal point mistakes in math, accompanied Ma Yuxin in reading a picture book and coloring a rose painting. After the children did their own activities, Ma Xiulan continued embroidering a bamboo-pattern pillowcase while the TV played crosstalk.
location: Living room of the residence on Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Helping the children wash up for bed and her own bedtime washing
description: Ma Xiulan urged the children to wash up, told Ma Yuxin a bedtime story to put her to sleep, then washed up herself and soaked her feet for 15 minutes.
location: Residence on Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Pre-sleep review and bedtime
description: Ma Xiulan lay in bed, checked the replies to the rose bud photos in the family group, shared the pillowcase progress in the handicraft group, and then said goodnight. She turned off the light at 22:15, reviewed the day, and fell asleep before 22:50.
location: Master bedroom, residence on Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning stretching and a solo walk.
description: She woke up naturally in the faint morning light and did shoulder and neck stretches in bed, moving her sore and swollen fingers. Then she put on her sneakers and set off from home alone, walking slowly east along Jingwen Road to the intersection of Shengli Street, then turned back. Along the way, she observed the rose buds and climbing vines extending over the neighbors' courtyard walls and felt the fresh morning air. On her return, she stomped her feet at the door to shake off the dust.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin and along the way.

name: Preparing breakfast, eating, and tidying up before going out.
description: After returning home, she washed up, put on an apron, and began preparing breakfast: cooking millet porridge, steaming baozi, and stir-frying baby bok choy with minced garlic. At about 7:20, she called the children to get up. The eldest son, Mingxuan, washed up by himself and rode his bike to his interest class, taking a baozi with him as he left. Xiulan sat down with Mingzhe and Yuxin for breakfast, asking about Mingzhe's jump rope training progress and Yuxin's painting plans. After the meal, she quickly cleaned up the dishes, wiped the stove, covered the leftovers and put them in the refrigerator, filled her own thermos with warm water, checked her phone, mask, medical insurance card, and keys, and told Mingzhe and Yuxin to stay safe at home and not touch electrical appliances.
location: Kitchen and dining room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Participated in a community free clinic, visited the supermarket, and went home to rest.
description: Neighbor Wang Guilan met Xiulan at her front door, and the two walked together to the community square to attend a free health clinic. After waiting in line, Dr. Wang Jianguo measured her blood pressure (118/76 mmHg) and random blood glucose (5.6 mmol/L), and the results were ideal. Xiulan took the opportunity to ask about healthy ways to make homemade yogurt. Dr. Wang suggested fermenting low-fat milk and reminded her that commercially flavored yogurts are high in sugar. Wang Guilan's blood pressure was also normal, so both were happy. After the clinic, Xiulan walked south along Shengli Street to Jingbai Supermarket to check the sales of her homemade pickles. The store owner, Sister Cao, told her that the 8 jars of Sichuan peppercorn sauce radish supplied yesterday were almost sold out and that she should bring more next time. After chatting about the market situation, Xiulan walked home, drank some water, washed her face, and rested briefly.
location: Jinghai Town Community Square, Jinghai District, Tianjin (south side of the intersection of Jingwen Road and Chaoyang Avenue) Jingbai Supermarket, Building 19, Room 104, Yuzhou Zunfu, Jinghai District, Tianjin Home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Focused on learning low-salt pickle recipes
description: Ma Xiulan sat on the living room sofa, opened video and illustrated tutorials on her phone, and focused on researching low-salt fermented pickles, mainly kimchi and sweet pickled garlic. She wrote down on paper the ingredient ratios for kimchi (napa cabbage, coarse salt, chili powder, fish sauce, glutinous rice paste, apple, pear, ginger, garlic, etc.) and the method for sweet pickled garlic (new garlic, white sugar, rice vinegar, salt), with a special note: 'Sweet garlic must use new garlic to be crisp.' She repeatedly compared the fermentation temperatures and times across three tutorials and finally settled on a reliable recipe.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family lunch and midday nap
description: After stretching, Xiulan made a pot of tomato-egg noodles with gravy and a cold dish of smashed cucumbers with garlic. She called Mingzhe and Yuxin to lunch. Yuxin showed off her painting of a Chinese rose, and Mingzhe bragged that he had no homework over the weekend. Xiulan reminded them of the afternoon plan: after finishing homework, they could watch half an hour of cartoons. After the meal, she urged the children to go to their own rooms for a nap or quiet activities. Xiulan leaned against the headboard, set a 30-minute alarm, and rested with her eyes closed.
location: Home dining room and master bedroom, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Supervising children's studies and tidying up crafts
description: After the alarm rang, Xiulan washed her face and cleared the coffee table in the living room to make space for homework. She had Mingzhe do his weekend character-writing homework while Yuxin traced numbers beside him. Xiulan sat next to them, took out her sewing basket, and continued embroidering the closures of small sachets for Jingbai Supermarket, occasionally looking up to check the children's progress and correcting Mingzhe's posture.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Rode her electric bike to the vegetable market to shop and visit her parents.
description: Xiulan changed into going-out clothes, rode her electric bike south along Jingwen Road, then turned onto Shengli Street, reaching Wutong Commune Vegetable Market in about 15 minutes. She first went to Auntie Sun Guifang's stall and, according to her list, bought 5 jin of Chinese cabbage, 3 jin of new garlic, half a jin of chili powder, as well as apples, pears, ginger, and gauze. She chatted with Auntie Sun about how new garlic cost two mao more than last year. Auntie Sun told her that new garlic is what makes sweet garlic crisp. Then she went to the meat stall and bought a good piece of pork belly. Afterwards, she rode on to her parents' home at 45 Shengli Street and gave her mother, Li Xiuying, the small bundle of greens and a piece of tofu she had just bought. The mother and daughter chatted in the living room, and her mother taught her the trick to making low-salt pickled vegetables: adding persimmon vinegar and rock sugar to the sweet-and-sour sauce makes the flavor richer, and the brine for pickling garlic must soak for a full two hours to remove the spiciness. Learning that her father had gone to the park to play chess, Xiulan left with peace of mind.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (intersection of Huanhu Road and Wutong Road) and parents' home at 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Return home to process and prepare ingredients.
description: Setting out from her parents' home, she rode an electric bike and got home in 10 minutes. She carried the purchased ingredients into the kitchen and started processing them: wearing gloves, she cut open the Chinese cabbage, sprinkled coarse salt over it layer by layer, added water to cover, and pressed a plate on top to let it soak; she peeled the fresh garlic, trimmed the root ends, and soaked them in lightly salted water to reduce their pungency; she mixed glutinous rice flour with water into a thin paste, preparing the rice paste for making chili sauce. With all the preparations in place, Xiulan felt at ease.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare dinner and have dinner with the whole family.
description: Cut the pork belly into chunks and blanch them, preparing to make braised pork belly with potatoes, along with garlic stir-fried lettuce and seaweed egg drop soup. The eldest son, Mingxuan, went straight to his room after returning from his hobby class. When the meal was served, her husband Ma Zhiqiang called via video call. Xiulan showed him how heartily the children were eating. Ma Zhiqiang told Mingxuan to help his mother take care of his younger siblings and said he would be home tomorrow afternoon. After hanging up, Xiulan ate while asking Mingzhe to talk about his jump-rope competition training, praised him for getting third place last week, then asked Mingxuan to share interesting news from his hobby class, while Yuxin kept showing off her rose painting.
location: Kitchen and dining room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Evening housework and homework tutoring.
description: After dinner, Xiulan asked Mingzhe to finish the rest of his homework while Yuxin drew pictures beside him. She cleared the dishes, wiped the table, mopped the floor, and tidied up the kitchen. Then she sat down next to Mingzhe to check his characters, dictated new words, and corrected his strokes. Then she read the story The Little Horse Crosses the River with Yuxin and guided her to describe the story's characters.
location: Living room and dining room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pickling low-salt pickles
description: After the children washed up and went to bed, Xiulan began her own time. She drained the soaked napa cabbage and made the signature spicy paste: mixing chili powder, minced garlic, minced ginger, grated apple-pear, fish sauce, and salt into glutinous rice paste. Wearing disposable gloves, she spread the paste layer by layer over the cabbage leaves, rolled them up, put them into a cleaned glass jar, pressed down firmly, and sealed it. Then she handled the sweet garlic: she drained the soaked garlic cloves, put them into another jar, and poured in the sweet-and-sour liquid made from rice vinegar, white sugar, and a little persimmon vinegar, ensuring the garlic was fully submerged. She pasted labels on the two jars: Spicy Cabbage (2025.5.10) and Sweet Garlic (2025.5.10), noted the low-salt formula, and moved them to the cool place on the north balcony.
location: Home kitchen and north balcony at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Relaxing before bed, keeping accounts, and checking the house before going to sleep
description: After the pickled vegetables were ready, Xiulan heated water and soaked her feet for 20 minutes to relieve fatigue. While soaking her feet, she took out her account book and recorded the day's expenses of 86 yuan for groceries and seasonings. Then she sent her husband Ma Zhiqiang a voice message reporting the day's arrangements and the completion of the pickled vegetables. While browsing the handicraft group chat, she saw a group member asking about how to make peace sachets, so she replied a few sentences and planned to stock up again next week to sell at the market. After soaking her feet, she checked the living room light, the kitchen gas stove, and the north balcony doors and windows in turn, then went to the children's bedroom, tucked in each quilt corner and turned off the light, and finally returned to her own room, turned off the light, and fell asleep, mentally tallying the day's gains and feeling steady and content.
location: Home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin: bathroom, master bedroom, and other rooms

name: Waking up in the early morning and taking a walk around the neighborhood
description: The alarm went off. Ma Xiulan didn't linger in bed. She first did 5 minutes of stretching in bed, and felt full of anticipation when she remembered it was Mother's Day today. After getting dressed, she went out and walked briskly along the flower beds in the residential compound at No. 156 Jingwen Road for 15 minutes. The air was filled with the fragrance of roses. On the way, she met her neighbor across the hall, Sister Wang Guilan. The two stood and chatted for a bit. Ma Xiulan told her she was taking the children back to her parents' home for the holiday, and Wang Guilan asked her to send her regards to her mother. She returned home on time at 7:10.
location: Inside the residential community at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing breakfast, waking the children, and organizing gifts
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan went into the kitchen and made egg fried rice with the leftover rice from last night, adding eggs and diced ham, and warmed four cups of milk. Then she called the children to get up. 13-year-old Ma Mingxuan got up on his own; 10-year-old Ma Mingzhe lingered in bed and got a few scolding words; 6-year-old Ma Yuxin was the best behaved and had already put on her pretty little dress herself. After the family finished breakfast, Ma Xiulan urged the children to wash their faces and brush their teeth, and checked their clothes. Then she took out the peace sachet carefully wrapped in a red silk bag from the cabinet. The stitching was a pattern of 'may you have abundance every year' that she had embroidered over several late nights. She also put a few snacks and wet wipes into her pocket, preparing to go out.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Walking to her parents' home
description: After locking the door, Ma Xiulan took her three children south along the familiar Jingwen Road and turned onto Shengli Street. The sun was warm. When they passed the entrance of Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Ma Mingzhe said he was hungry. Ma Xiulan spent 2 yuan at a stall by the entrance to buy him a hot fried dough cake fresh from the pan and let him share it with his older brother and sister. Ma Yuxin skipped along the way, asking whether Grandma would praise her. Ma Mingxuan spoke little but kept protecting his younger siblings. After walking for about 25 minutes, the whole family arrived at her parents' home at 45 Shengli Street.
location: The section between Jingwen Road and Shengli Street in Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Mother's Day sachet gift and meal preparation
description: As soon as they entered her parents' house, the three children loudly wished their grandmother a happy Mother's Day. Her mother, Li Xiuying, was grinning from ear to ear. Ma Xiulan took out a peace sachet and hung it at the head of her mother's bed herself. Li Xiuying felt the fine stitching and exclaimed in delight that it was even more exquisite than store-bought ones. Ma Xiulan said she had learned it all from her mother. Her father, Ma Jianguo, also came out of the room and praised his daughter for being thoughtful. Then the mother and daughter went into the kitchen, took out the chives and flour bought the day before, and started preparing the ingredients. Ma Xiulan sorted and washed the chives while her mother kneaded the dough. Ma Yuxin brought a small stool and wanted to help, so Ma Xiulan taught her to tell chives apart from weeds. Ma Mingxuan and Ma Mingzhe stayed in the living room with their grandfather watching the TV show 'Journey to the West.'
location: Parents' home at No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Making dumplings and mother-daughter chat
description: After the dough rested, the mother and daughter began rolling out wrappers and making dumplings. Li Xiuying wrapped them very quickly, making ingot-shaped dumplings, while Ma Xiulan made crescent-shaped ones. They chatted while wrapping. Ma Xiulan told her mother that she had learned a low-salt pickled vegetable recipe yesterday and had already pickled spicy cabbage and sweet garlic, which would be ready to eat next week. Her mother said she also had a special secret technique and would teach her daughter when she made them. The kitchen was steaming, the fragrance of chives filled the air, and the atmosphere was warm and cozy.
location: Kitchen at her parents' home, No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Warm lunch and family reunion
description: Around 11:30, the chive and egg dumplings came out of the pot. The plump white dumplings were brought to the table, and the whole family sat around together. Father Ma Jianguo asked Ma Mingxuan about his monthly exam results and encouraged him to keep working hard. Ma Yuxin told everyone funny stories about the children at kindergarten, making everyone laugh. Ma Mingzhe, meanwhile, ate while gesturing about a scene on TV. Ma Xiulan and her mother helped each other to food, feeling warm inside and thinking that the whole morning's busy work had been worth it.
location: Her parents' home living room at 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Noon break and helping mother tidy up
description: After lunch, Ma Xiulan let the three children take a nap on the sofa and the kang, while she and her mother cleared the dishes, wiped the table, and cleaned the kitchen. Her mother again mentioned the pickled vegetables she had made last time, and Ma Xiulan promised to bring her own spicy pickled cabbage and sweet garlic for her to taste next time. After 2 p.m. the children woke up and chased each other around the yard. Ma Yuxin also watered a few loofah seedlings in the yard with her grandmother.
location: Parents' home at No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Parting from mother and returning home
description: At 2:30 in the afternoon, Ma Xiulan was ready to go home. Her mother, as usual, stuffed into her bag a large handful of tender spinach pulled from the vegetable garden and a few red persimmons. Ma Xiulan did not decline; she told her mother to take care of her health and said she would visit again next week. Then she and the children said goodbye to her mother at the door. Her mother advised her to cook something nice for her husband in the evening. The family walked back along Shengli Street to their home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, arriving home before 3 p.m.
location: The section from Shengli Street to Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Collect packages and rest in the neighborhood
description: Before heading home, Ma Xiulan stopped by the Cainiao Station on Jingwen Road (Xinhua Yingjun South District branch) and used the pickup code on her phone to collect a package sent by her elder sister Xiuyun from Beijing. When she opened it, she found a box of Beijing specialty pastries and several children's summer T-shirts. She had the children thank their aunt, then put the pastries on the coffee table and put the T-shirts away in the wardrobe. After that, she had the children drink water and rest their feet, while she took a short rest herself.
location: Cainiao Station (Xinhuaying Jun South District Branch) on Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and home at No. 156 Jingwen Road

name: Supermarket shopping and buying vegetables at the market.
description: After a short rest, Ma Xiulan told the children she was going out to buy things. She rode her old electric bike to Jingbai Supermarket (Unit 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu), used a coupon on her phone to buy discounted soy sauce and a bottle of dishwashing liquid on promotion, saving 5 yuan. Then, on the way back, she stopped at Wutong Commune Vegetable Market and spent 15 yuan on fresh tomatoes and a bunch of scallions for cooking dinner. She got home in about half an hour.
location: Jingbai Supermarket, Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and Wutong Commune Vegetable Market

name: Tend the vegetable garden and supervise the children's studies
description: Back home, Ma Xiulan first went to the courtyard, filled a bucket with water, and thoroughly watered the fruiting tomato plants and roses, pulling out a few weeds along the way. Then she went back inside to urge Ma Mingxuan to do his math homework in his room, had Ma Mingzhe practice calligraphy, and herself took out flashcards to help Ma Yuxin learn 10 new characters. The house was quiet, with only the rustling of pen tips.
location: Home courtyard and living room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare dinner
description: Ma Xiulan picked over and washed the tender spinach she had brought back from her mother's house, planning to make spinach egg drop soup. She also washed and cut tomatoes into pieces, preparing to make scrambled eggs with tomatoes. Then she took out the firm tofu bought the day before, cut it into pieces, and made scallion-braised tofu. Busy in the kitchen, she thought her husband Ma Zhiqiang should be home soon, and planned to make three dishes and a soup for the family.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The family of five had dinner together.
description: At 6:20 p.m., Ma Zhiqiang returned home from Cangzhou, travel-worn. Ma Xiulan asked him to go wash his face first. At 6:30, the family sat around the dining table. At the table, Ma Zhiqiang asked about her visit to her parents' home that day. Ma Xiulan recounted everything, and the children also vied to report that they had seen their grandmother and eaten dumplings. Ma Zhiqiang praised the sachet for being beautifully embroidered and the spinach soup for being delicious. The whole family talked and laughed, eating warmly and contentedly.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening tutoring and family time.
description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan and her husband divided the work and cooperated. Ma Xiulan cleared the dishes and washed them, while Ma Zhiqiang watched the documentary Aerial China with the two sons in the living room. After cleaning up, Ma Xiulan checked Ma Mingxuan's math homework and found no problems; she also taught Ma Yuxin a few pinyin syllables. Ma Zhiqiang tutored Ma Mingzhe to finish the unfinished new characters. The TV occasionally played a song, and the home was filled with ordinary, warm sounds.
location: Living room and study at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing the children for bed and contacting mother via video call
description: Ma Xiulan urged the children to wash up and change into pajamas, and she herself simply washed her face and wiped herself down. After the children were all lying down at 9:30, she made a video call to her mother Li Xiuying, asking whether she and her father had felt unwell today, and also chatted about tomorrow's grocery shopping arrangements. Her mother laughed on the other end of the line and said she was especially happy today, and only then did Ma Xiulan feel completely at ease.
location: At home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin: bedroom, living room.

name: Evening rest and sleep.
description: Her husband Ma Zhiqiang had already gone to sleep. Ma Xiulan leaned against the headboard and scrolled through the family group chat on her phone. Seeing her eldest sister ask in the group whether she had received the clothes, she replied. She also looked at tomorrow's weather forecast, which showed cloudy, good for airing things. Thinking back on today—giving her mother a sachet, making dumplings together, and the children's smiling faces—she felt very satisfied and felt life was full and real. At 22:45, she turned off her phone and the light, and slowly fell asleep in the quiet night, filled with happiness and emotion.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Waking up, morning stretching, and walking
description: Woke up naturally at 6:30 in the morning and felt energetic. First she stretched for 5 minutes by the bed to loosen up. At 6:35, she went out and met Zhang Shufen, the neighbor from across the way who ran a convenience store, in the residential area; she was about to open her shop. The two walked along the community flower beds for more than 20 minutes, chatting as they went. Zhang Shufen mentioned that the community social security subsidy list seemed to have been posted and reminded her to go check it. She made a mental note of this.
location: Inside the residential community at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare and enjoy breakfast, wake up the children, tidy up and head out.
description: At 7:10, I came back from my walk and hurried into the kitchen. Using the tender spinach my mother gave me yesterday, I made spinach and dough-drop soup. After blanching the spinach, I mixed in egg crumbles and dried shrimp, and also heated up the steamed buns brought back from my mother's house. At 7:20 I went upstairs to wake the three children and urged them to wash up. Mingxuan got ready quickly on his own, while Zhezhe and Xinxin stayed in bed for a while. At 7:30 the family sat down for breakfast. The children didn't like spinach, so I coaxed them, saying that eating spinach makes you strong and helps you grow tall. After the meal, I had Mingxuan help clear the dishes, while I braided Xinxin's hair and checked Zhezhe's schoolbag. At 8:00 I changed clothes, picked up my keys and a reusable bag, and got ready to go out.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Take the child to school and buy groceries along the way.
description: Left home at 8:10 and walked for 10 minutes, first taking Zhezhe to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School and watching him enter the school gate. Then led Xinxin south for 8 minutes, and at 8:25 sent her to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten. On the way back, at 8:35 she turned into Wutong Commune Market and bought scallions, tender tofu, and cilantro, planning to make spinach tofu soup for lunch and use up the spinach her mother gave her yesterday.
location: Along Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Wutong Community Vegetable Market)

name: Received the social security subsidy and recorded it in the ledger.
description: Left at 9:00, walked 12 minutes to the Chaoyang Street Community Health Service Center, and saw the grid worker Zheng Xiuying sorting documents at the front desk, so I hurried over to ask about the social security subsidy list. Sister Zheng smiled and congratulated me, saying it was approved, and starting next month 200 yuan per month would be paid into the bank account linked to the social security card. I asked her to copy a notice for me, and holding it in my hand made me feel much more at ease. Got home at 9:45, took out the ledger from the drawer, sat on the living room sofa, and carefully wrote down 'May 12, social security subsidy approved, 200 yuan/month (starting June), designated as the education fund for the three children, to be used for that purpose only.' After writing, I closed the book and felt very hopeful.
location: Chaoyang Street Community Health Service Center, No. 16 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road

name: Tidy the yard and remove aphids from the roses.
description: At 10:20, she carried a watering can to the yard and carefully examined the rose bushes. Sure enough, she found quite a few green aphids on the tender shoots and buds. She brought the diluted soapy water prepared earlier and carefully sprayed the infested areas, then pinched off a few particularly obvious ones with her fingers. Remembering the folk remedy taught by her childhood friend Chunmei yesterday of soaking cigarette butts in water, she decided to try the soapy water first and check the results tomorrow morning.
location: Home courtyard at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the children and prepare lunch.
description: At 11:00, she put down the watering can, washed her hands, and set off to Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up Xinxin. She arrived at the gate at 11:10 and waited a while, then picked up her bouncing daughter and went home. It was almost 11:30 when they got home, so she started preparing lunch: using the spinach her mother gave her yesterday and the soft tofu she bought in the morning, she made spinach and tofu soup, and with the leftover tomatoes from yesterday she made scrambled eggs with tomatoes and reheated leftover rice. Zhezhe had lunch at after-school care, and Mingxuan ate at school, so only the mother and daughter had lunch together.
location: Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and home at 156 Jingwen Road.

name: Lunch and lunch break.
description: At 12:00 she had lunch with Xinxin. The little girl stopped eating after drinking a couple of sips of soup and said she wanted to eat meat, so she coaxed her by saying they would make braised pork tomorrow. At 12:30 she cleaned up the kitchen, took Xinxin upstairs for an afternoon nap, told her two stories before she fell asleep, and dozed off herself for a bit. She had been going to bed early these past few nights, so after this nap she felt even more energetic in the afternoon.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Taking the children to school, picking up packages, and making inquiries
description: At 13:30 I woke Xinxin up and washed her face. At 13:40 I left and walked 8 minutes to take her to Huakang First Kindergarten. After dropping her off, I remembered that the package sent by my eldest sister yesterday had a note saying I could exchange the T-shirt if it didn't fit. So I stopped by the Cainiao Station in the South Area of Xinhua Yingjun on the way to ask about sending a package. After I got the information, I didn't rush to send it and walked home, arriving at 14:10.
location: Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Cainiao Station, Xinhua Yingjun South District, Jingwen Road; and home at 156 Jingwen Road

name: Doing handicrafts and having a phone call with a childhood friend.
description: She arrived home at 14:10, poured herself a glass of water, took out the half-finished child's bellyband she was embroidering, and sat on the sofa by the window in the living room to continue embroidering. After a short while, she thought of the rose pest control and the subsidy matter from the morning, so she called her childhood friend Liu Chunmei. The phone rang for a long time; Chunmei was busy out in the vegetable field but still picked up. Xiulan first thanked her for the pest-control method she had taught yesterday and told her that she had sprayed soapy water today. Chunmei said to wait and see how it worked. Then they talked about the pickled vegetables. Chunmei suggested trying a low-salt recipe, saying people pay attention to health these days, and that when the new recipe was ready, she would help taste it. They chatted for about 20 minutes before hanging up. Feeling warm inside, Xiulan continued focusing on her handiwork.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Go to Jingbai Supermarket to buy daily necessities.
description: At 16:00, she put away her sewing and noticed that the soy sauce bottle at home was almost empty, and there wasn't much dish soap left either. At 16:10, she took her coin purse and walked 10 minutes to Jingbai Supermarket. In the daily necessities section, she bought a bottle of light soy sauce and a bottle of dark soy sauce, and also picked up a bottle of lemon-scented dish soap, spending less than 15 yuan in total. While checking out at the cash register, she saw newly stocked pickled vegetables beside her, in glass jars. She picked one up, looked at the ingredient list, and thought that once her own pickled vegetables were done, she could try something similar.
location: Jingbai Supermarket, Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the child from school
description: At 16:40, after shopping, she hurried back, first to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, arriving at 16:50 just in time for Zhezhe's school dismissal. After picking him up, she quickly walked to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten and picked up Xinxin at 17:00. The two little ones chattered nonstop as soon as they saw each other. Holding Xinxin's hand with her left and Zhezhe's with her right, she strolled slowly home, arriving at 17:30.
location: Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Huakang First Kindergarten, and home at 156 Jingwen Road in Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare dinner
description: Arrived home at 17:30, told Zhezhe to have Xinxin do homework in the living room, put on an apron, and went into the kitchen. Since her husband wasn't going out on the truck today, she wanted to make something decent. She cut the pork belly bought yesterday into pieces and braised it, mixed a tiger salad with scallions and cilantro from the supermarket, and steamed rice in a pot. While she was busy, at 18:00 she heard the door. Old Ma came back, carrying a bag of strawberries, saying he had picked them up from the truck on the way back for the kids. She turned up the heat to reduce the braised pork sauce and served it.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner and discussion of family finances.
description: Dinner was served at 18:30. When the braised pork belly was brought to the table, the children's eyes lit up and they wolfed it down. At the table, I told my husband that the social security subsidy had been approved at 200 yuan, and told him that I had decided to save it all as an education fund for the children. My husband took a bite of rice, nodded, and said, "Okay, you handle the arrangements. Cut what should be cut and save what should be saved; this is how life is built." Seeing his weary but steady expression, I felt especially reassured.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Help with homework and tidy up housework
description: At 19:20, after dinner, my husband wiped the table and washed the dishes. I checked Mingxuan's physics homework. He basically got everything right, except two word problems where his thinking was unclear, so I gave him some pointers. Then I helped Zhezhe with his Chinese characters; his writing was messy and careless, so I made him erase and rewrite them. Xinxin drew a picture nearby and said it was for her mother. At 20:00, I had them pack their schoolbags by themselves, and I went to take in the laundry from the balcony and fold it.
location: Children’s room and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The children washed up and went to bed
description: At 20:30 urged the three children to wash up in turn. Mingxuan handled it himself, Zhezhe needed watching, and Xinxin needed help washing. Busy until 21:00. After settling them all to sleep, she tucked Xinxin's quilt in and kissed her forehead.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Personal time, video call with her birth family.
description: Return home, do housework, and prepare dinner.
location: Living room and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tidying up before bed, getting ready for rest
description: At 22:00 I lay down in bed, feeling that after this busy day I could finally catch my breath. I picked up my phone and glanced at tomorrow's weather forecast: cloudy, about the same temperature. In my mind I quietly planned tomorrow's tasks: in the morning I need to check how the rose aphids are doing; at noon, while picking up the kids, I can stop by the market to buy ground meat; in the evening I'll come back and make dumplings for the children. At 22:30 I turned off my phone and closed my eyes, and that steady, peaceful feeling in my heart carried me slowly into sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Getting up and morning stretching and walking
description: The phone alarm went off on time. After waking up, Ma Xiulan did five minutes of simple stretching in bed, moving her shoulders and waist. Then she put on her sneakers and went out to walk briskly along Jingwen Road and the nearby community paths, breathing in the fresh post-rain air while mentally sorting out what needed to be done today.
location: At home, No. 156, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and along the residential paths on Jingwen Road

name: Prepare breakfast and wake up the children.
description: After returning from the walk, Ma Xiulan washed her hands, tied on an apron, and in the kitchen rinsed the millet and made millet porridge, steamed the leftover meat buns from yesterday, and fried four eggs. Then she woke the three children one by one, helping Mingzhe, who was reluctant to get out of bed, and Yuxin, who was rubbing her eyes, to get up.
location: Kitchen and bedrooms at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The whole family had breakfast together
description: The whole family sat around the dining table. Ma Xiulan served porridge for everyone, told Mingxuan to behave at school, helped Yuxin break up her poached egg and stir it into the porridge, wiped a grain of rice from Mingzhe's mouth, and herself hurriedly drank a bowl of porridge and ate half a steamed bun.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Drop off children at school and buy groceries at the vegetable market
description: After putting away the dishes and chopsticks, Ma Xiulan first walked Mingzhe to the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School while holding Yuxin's hand, then walked about 10 minutes to take Yuxin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten and hand her over to the teacher. Afterwards, she stopped by the Wutong Commune vegetable market on the way and bought fresh celery, tofu skin, and spring onions from a vegetable vendor she knew, planning to make dumplings with them.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School on Shengli South Street, Huakang First Kindergarten, and various spots in Wutong Commune Vegetable Market.

name: Putting away groceries at home and sending a courier package
description: Ma Xiulan walked home carrying groceries and first put the vegetables in the fridge. Then she picked up the return/exchange T-shirt parcel she had wrapped last night, sent it out at the Cainiao Station at the community gate (Xinhua Yingjun South Area Store), paid 12 yuan in shipping, urged the staff to ship it as soon as possible, and felt a weight off her shoulders after getting the receipt.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and Cainiao Station on Jingwen Road (Xinhuaying Jun South Area Store)

name: Finishing up sewing her daughter's schoolbag
description: After washing her hands, Ma Xiulan sat down at the sewing machine in the living room. She took out the half-finished schoolbag with the little rabbit tail already embroidered on it, carefully compared the dimensions of the lining and the outer fabric, secured them with pins, sewed the edges flat with the machine, and hand-reinforced the joints where the handles and straps attached, imagining how cute her daughter would look carrying the bag.
location: Living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (beside the sewing machine near the window)

name: Pick up Yuxin, make lunch, and take a midday rest
description: Ma Xiulan walked to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up Yuxin. After returning home, she washed her hands and started cooking. She blanched the celery and chopped it, diced the tofu skin, and mixed it with leftover meat filling and chopped wild vegetables. She added salt and sesame oil to make the dumpling filling, then kneaded dough, rolled out wrappers, and made dumplings filled with celery, tofu skin, and meat. After the mother and daughter enjoyed the dumplings, Ma Xiulan coaxed Yuxin to take a nap and also lay down to rest for half an hour.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten

name: Taking Yuxin back to school
description: The alarm went off. Ma Xiulan gently woke Yuxin, re-braided her hair, helped her put on her coat, and took her by the hand to Huakang First Kindergarten again.
location: Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Household cleaning, watering flowers, and removing pests in the courtyard
description: Back home, Ma Xiulan first washed the lunch dishes and the stove top. Then she went to the yard, watered the tomato seedlings and cucumber seedlings transplanted yesterday thoroughly, and squatted down to check the rose leaves. She found that although the soapy water had killed some aphids, live insects remained, so she tried the cigarette-soaking method taught by her neighbor Chunmei, using a small spray bottle to spray the infested leaves.
location: Home kitchen and courtyard at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Organized craft materials and checked the pickled vegetables.
description: After returning indoors from the courtyard, Ma Xiulan neatly put away the leftover scraps of cloth and sewing tools from making the schoolbag into a sewing box. Then she went to the storage room, opened the jar of pickled vegetables she had made a few days earlier, leaned in and smelled it to check there was no odd odor, turned the pickled vegetables with clean chopsticks, added a small spoonful of salt, resealed the jar, and made sure the water around the rim was sufficient.
location: Living room and storage room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick Mingzhe up from school, parent-child courtyard activities, and pick up Yuxin
description: Ma Xiulan walked to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up Mingzhe and take him home. In the yard, she crouched with Mingzhe by the flower bed and taught him to distinguish weeds from vegetable seedlings. She had him pull weeds with a small trowel and water the roses with a watering can. Then together they used a small spray bottle with cigarette butts soaked in it to spray the remaining aphids on the roses. Afterward she held Mingzhe's hand and went to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up Yuxin. On the way, the siblings happily shared funny stories.
location: Along the route from No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School and Huakang First Kindergarten on Shengli South Street.

name: Prepare dinner
description: After getting the children settled, Ma Xiulan tied on an apron and began preparing dinner. She rinsed the rice and steamed it, took eggs, greens, and pork out of the fridge, and after chopping and prepping, cooked scrambled eggs with tomatoes, garlic-flavored greens, and the shredded pork with green peppers that her husband loved. She also kept the leftover dumpling filling from lunch as a side dish.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The whole family had dinner together.
description: Her husband Ma Zhiqiang brought the vehicle home, and the family sat down for a meal together. During the meal, Ma Xiulan mentioned that the schoolbag finishing, the social security subsidy, and her eldest sister's T-shirt having been sent back were all taken care of. Ma Zhiqiang put food in her bowl as a kind gesture, and the children eagerly shared funny stories from school, filling the room with laughter and joy.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Clearing up after meals and helping the children with homework
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan quickly washed the dishes and wiped down the kitchen. Then she sat in the living room and first checked Mingxuan's math homework, patiently explaining the reasoning for one wrong problem. Next she helped Mingzhe practice new Chinese characters, correcting his stroke order stroke by stroke. Yuxin quietly drew pictures nearby.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family bedtime activities
description: Ma Xiulan and Ma Zhiqiang divided the work: they urged their two sons to brush their teeth and wash their faces, and bathed Yuxin. Afterward, Ma Xiulan took out the finished little schoolbag and had Yuxin try it on. The little rabbit tail embroidered on the bag delighted Yuxin. Before bedtime, Ma Xiulan told the children the story of The Little Horse Crosses the River, then turned off the light and gently closed the bedroom door.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Video call with parents and rest
description: After the children fell asleep, the couple sat on the living room sofa and made a video call to her parents living on Shengli Street. Her mother, Li Xiuying, asked with concern about the children and her health, and told her not to overwork herself. After hanging up, Ma Xiulan leaned back on the sofa and scrolled through her phone. She saw a few pickled vegetable videos and saved them; Ma Zhiqiang watched sports news, and the two chatted about the next day's menu.
location: Living room and master bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Washed up and went to bed
description: Ma Xiulan felt sleepy. She went to the bathroom to wash her face, apply skincare products, and change into pajamas. Looking back, the day's plans had all gone smoothly, and she felt very at ease. At 22:30 she turned off the bedside lamp and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Bathroom and master bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning stretching and neighborly chat
description: At 6:35 in the morning, the alarm went off. Ma Xiulan got out of bed and did 5 minutes of simple stretches by the bed to loosen her lower back and wrists, which were stiff from housework. Then she went downstairs and took a walk in the Wutongyuan community. She ran into her neighbor Zhang Shufen, and the two chatted as they walked. Xiulan mentioned that she wanted to dig out her unused digital camera to record the children's daily lives. Zhang Shufen agreed and shared her regret that her own family lacked photos of the children growing up.
location: Central Garden, Wutongyuan Residential Community, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Shopping at the vegetable market.
description: After her walk, Ma Xiulan stopped by the Wutong Commune Market on the way. At a familiar stall she picked leeks, cucumbers, tomatoes and eggs, preparing ingredients for leek and egg dumplings in the evening, and chatted briefly with the stall owner.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Prepare breakfast and wake up the children.
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan put on an apron and started preparing breakfast: cooking millet porridge, making scallion egg pancakes, and stir-frying baby bok choy. Meanwhile, she moved between the bedrooms, waking up her daughter Ma Yuxin and son Ma Mingzhe, reminding them to get up, wash up, and get ready for school. Her eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, had already gotten up and gotten himself ready.
location: Room 101, Building 2, Wutongyuan Residential Community, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: The whole family had breakfast together
description: The family sat around the table, enjoying hot millet porridge, egg pancakes, and green vegetables. Xinxin mentioned that she needed to draw a little rabbit at kindergarten, Mingzhe urged everyone to hurry up, and Mingxuan finished his meal quietly and rode his bicycle to school ahead of the others.
location: Room 101, Building 2, Wutongyuan Residential Community, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Taking the children to school
description: Ma Xiulan carried the schoolbags and water bottles of Mingzhe and Xinxin, first walking to the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, where she watched Mingzhe go through the school gate with his classmates; then she took Xinxin by the hand and walked to the nearby Huakang First Kindergarten, sending her in for the morning health check.
location: Jinghai District Third Primary School and Huakang First Kindergarten on Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Tidying up the house and getting the camera ready.
description: After sending the children off and returning home, Ma Xiulan quickly cleared the dishes and tidied up the bedrooms. Then she remembered the digital camera. She found the silver compact camera in an old cardboard box in the storage room, wiped off the dust, found the charger, and charged the battery. Twenty minutes later, she put in the battery and turned it on, took a test shot of the pothos in the living room, and confirmed that the memory card and camera were functioning properly.
location: Room 101, Building 2, Wutongyuan Residential Community, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Courtyard photography and photo organization plan.
description: The sun was bright, and Ma Xiulan took her camera to her small yard to photograph the blooming roses and the cherry tomatoes that had just set fruit, exploring modes such as macro and portrait. Then she returned inside, connected the camera to her old computer with a data cable, browsed the April photos, created a new folder named 2025 - Family Images on the desktop, created subfolders by month, and renamed and organized the April photos in the date_event format.
location: Room 101, Building 2, Wutongyuan Residential Community, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China, and her own small courtyard

name: Pick up daughter from school and prepare lunch
description: At 11:25, Ma Xiulan turned off the computer and walked to Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up Xinxin, who was jumping around showing her painting and had been praised by the teacher. After returning home, Mingzhe was already home from school doing homework. She quickly made lunch with chive scrambled eggs and garlic cucumber. After the three of them ate simply, Xiulan told the story Little Rabbit Be Good to coax Xinxin to take a nap, and Mingzhe went back to his room for a nap on his own.
location: Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China, and Room 101, Building 2, Wutongyuan Community, No. 156 Jingwen Road.

name: Taking her daughter to school and doing errands on the way
description: At 1:10 p.m., Ma Xiulan woke Xinxin and took her back to kindergarten. On the way back, she made a detour to the Jingbai Supermarket in Yuzhou Zunfu, bought a bottle of dark soy sauce, a bag of salt, and a bottle of dish soap, then carried the things home.
location: Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten and Jingbai Supermarket (Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu), Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Afternoon nap
description: After walking all morning, her legs were a bit sore. Ma Xiulan put away the things she had bought and rested with her eyes closed on the living room sofa for half an hour. The breeze outside the window carried the smell of plants from the yard, making her feel very pleasant.
location: Room 101, Building 2, Wutongyuan Residential Community, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Organizing photos and attempting to print them.
description: After a short rest, Ma Xiulan returned to the computer and continued to rename the new photos on the memory card by date and sort them into the May folder. She selected a few photos she was happy with of the roses and Xinxin in the yard, adjusted the sizes, and printed them out with the inkjet printer. Seeing the clear images on paper, she felt a strong sense of accomplishment.
location: Room 101, Building 2, Wutongyuan Residential Community, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Pick up the child from school
description: Ma Xiulan tucked the printed photos into a book, locked the door, and walked to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up Mingzhe, who was in fourth grade. Then the two of them went together to the gate of Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up Kexin, and the three went home together.
location: Jinghai District Third Primary School and Huakang First Kindergarten on Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Accompanying the children with homework and handicrafts
description: After getting home, Mingzhe did his math homework at the living room table while Xinxin continued drawing a little rabbit beside him. Ma Xiulan took out the unfinished embroidered bellyband pouch and, while doing embroidery, corrected Mingzhe's sitting posture and praised Xinxin's drawing.
location: Room 101, Building 2, Wutongyuan Residential Community, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Prepare dinner
description: As it grew dark, Ma Xiulan put down her needlework and went to the kitchen. She carefully washed chives, cucumbers, and other ingredients, then began making chive and egg dumplings for her husband Ma Zhiqiang, along with cucumber salad and tomato egg drop soup. The aroma of stir-frying brought Xinxin running into the kitchen crying that she was hungry, and Xiulan smiled and gave her a taste.
location: Room 101, Building 2, Wutongyuan Residential Community, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: The whole family had dinner together.
description: Her husband Ma Zhiqiang returned home after finishing his transport work. The family of five sat around the table, and the room was filled with steaming hot dumplings and everyone's words of praise. Xiulan happily announced that she had found an old camera and decided to start recording family videos, and the children responded excitedly.
location: Room 101, Building 2, Wutongyuan Residential Community, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Cleaning up the kitchen and helping with homework
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan cleared and washed the dishes. Mingxuan went back to his room to study on his own, and Mingzhe brought his Chinese textbook and asked his mother to dictate new characters. Xiulan listened carefully while washing the dishes; whenever a character was written incorrectly, she dried her hands and went over to patiently guide him.
location: Room 101, Building 2, Wutongyuan Residential Community, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Evening parent-child interaction and taking photos to lull the child to sleep.
description: After tidying up, Ma Xiulan quietly picked up the camera on silent mode and took photos of Xuanxuan and Zhezhe doing their homework seriously in the study, then caught a candid shot of Xinxin quietly flipping through a book in the bedroom. Afterward, she urged the children to wash up, squeezed toothpaste for Xinxin, told her a new picture-book story, and gently patted her to sleep, while reminding Zhezhe to brush his teeth after finishing the LEGO.
location: Room 101, Building 2, Wutongyuan Residential Community, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Video call with parents
description: After the children were settled, Ma Xiulan sat on the sofa and made a video call to her parents Ma Jianguo and Li Xiuying, who lived on Shengli Street. She excitedly shared the results of finding the camera, taking photos, and printing them today, and held the printed photos up to the camera for them to see. Her parents praised her repeatedly.
location: No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (parents' home)

name: Personal washing up and relaxation
description: After ending the video call, Ma Xiulan took a hot bath to wash away her fatigue. Then she sat back on the bed in the bedroom and scrolled through the photos she had taken that day on her phone. Looking at Xinxin's smiling face and the children's focused backs, she felt warm inside.
location: Room 101, Building 2, Wutongyuan Residential Community, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Today's summary and bedtime
description: Ma Xiulan put down her phone with satisfaction and planned to bring her camera tomorrow when taking the children to school to photograph the scenery along the way. After turning off the lights, she savored the fulfillment and gains of the day and gradually drifted into sleep in the quiet.
location: Room 101, Building 2, Wutongyuan Residential Community, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Morning wake-up and stretching
description: In the early morning, Ma Xiulan woke up on time, did some simple stretches in bed, moved her shoulders, neck, and lower back to gradually wake up her body, and felt energetic.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Walking and chatting with a neighbor.
description: Ma Xiulan got changed and went out. Downstairs, she met her neighbor Zhang Shufen, and the two walked slowly along Jingwen Road, chatting about everyday life. Xiulan mentioned that she had dug out an old camera yesterday to take photos, wanting to record the flowers and plants in the yard; Shufen was very interested.
location: Along Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (starting from No. 156 Jingwen Road, heading south along Jingwen Road to the intersection with Shengli Street, then turning back)

name: Shopping at the vegetable market.
description: After the walk, Xiulan stopped by the Wutong Commune vegetable market on the way and bought fresh chives, cucumbers, and corn, spending about 25 yuan, to prepare for lunch and dinner.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family breakfast
description: After returning home, Xiulan quickly prepared breakfast: millet porridge, boiled eggs, steamed buns, and smashed cucumber. She woke the three children. The eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, biked to school by himself; the second son, Mingzhe, and the youngest daughter, Yuxin, were escorted by her. The family sat around eating breakfast and listened to the children talk about fun things at school.
location: Kitchen and dining room of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Take the second son and the younger daughter to school.
description: After breakfast, Xiulan tidied up, checked the school bags and red scarves, and rode her e-bike to first take Mingzhe to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, then take Yuxin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, watching them go through the school gate.
location: Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Tianjin (32 Shengli South Street) and Huakang First Kindergarten (1 Huakang Street)

name: Housework and tidying
description: After sending the children off and returning home, Xiulan washed the dishes, wiped the stove, swept and mopped the floor, making the house fresh and tidy.
location: Living room and kitchen at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Courtyard gardening and plant records
description: Xiulan came to the small courtyard, watered the roses and cucumber seedlings, pulled weeds, then used her phone to take close-up photos of the plants from sprouting to now, recording their growth changes.
location: Home courtyard at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Create a growth comparison chart and share it
description: Xiulan sat on the living room sofa and used a photo collage app on her phone to make a plant growth comparison chart from the photos taken that morning and earlier. With the caption “Sending out branches and leaves, quietly waiting for the flowers to bloom,” she posted it to the family WeChat group. Her mother Li Xiuying and her sisters all liked and praised it.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the younger daughter from school
description: Xiulan rode her electric bike to the gate of Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up her youngest daughter Yuxin from school. Yuxin happily ran over and showed the drawing she had painted in kindergarten.
location: Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin (1 Huakang Street).

name: Making lunch and taking a nap.
description: Xiulan went home to make lunch, preparing chive pockets and tomato and egg soup. Her second son Mingzhe came home after school, and the three of them had lunch together. Yuxin praised the chive pockets her mother made as delicious. After lunch, Xiulan coaxed Yuxin to take a nap, and she herself rested for half an hour.
location: Kitchen, dining room, and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Take daughter to school and go shopping
description: Xiulan woke Yuxin and took her to kindergarten. On the way back, she stopped by Jingbai Supermarket and bought a simple yogurt maker (39 yuan) and a packet of starter culture. She paid with the change she had saved from the last market fair, totaling less than 50 yuan, and felt it was a good deal.
location: Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin (No. 1 Huakang Street) to Jingbai Supermarket (Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu)

name: Watching a health program to learn how to make yogurt
description: Xiulan returned home and rested while watching TV. A health program happened to be discussing gut health and homemade yogurt. The host demonstrated the steps and mentioned that homemade yogurt has more live bacteria and controllable sugar content, which strengthened her resolve to make yogurt for her constipated youngest daughter over the weekend.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Finishing the hand-sewn school bag
description: Xiulan turned off the TV, took out her sewing box, and sat by the window. Stitch by stitch, she embroidered the veins of the twin lotus flowers on the schoolbag, carefully checking every stitch to make sure they were firm and even. A satisfied smile appeared on her face.
location: Living room at home (by the window), No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the second son and youngest daughter from school.
description: Xiulan rode her electric bike, first picked up Mingzhe at Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, then went together to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up Yuxin. When the two children saw their mother, they chattered about school.
location: Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Tianjin (32 Shengli South Street) and Huakang First Kindergarten (1 Huakang Street)

name: Daughter tried on the handmade schoolbag.
description: As soon as she got home, Xiulan took out the finished light blue schoolbag and had Yuxin try it on. It was just the right size, and the embroidered twin lotus flowers and little rabbit looked lifelike. Yuxin happily spun around and looked in the mirror. Mingzhe also wanted one, so Xiulan promised to make him a cooler one in fifth grade.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing dinner for a family gathering.
description: Xiulan hummed a tune as she prepared dinner, stewing chicken pieces, stir-frying greens, and boiling corn soup. At 6:30 p.m., her husband Ma Zhiqiang came home in his truck. When he heard about the schoolbag and yogurt plan, he praised Xiulan for being handy and keeping the household in good order.
location: Kitchen and dining room of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Dinner and homework tutoring.
description: The family of five sat around the table for dinner and chatted. After the meal, Xiulan cleared the dishes, while Ma Zhiqiang urged the two sons to do their homework. After finishing her chores, Xiulan accompanied Yuxin in drawing and looked after Mingzhe and Mingxuan as they did their homework.
location: Dining room, kitchen, and living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family washing up and bedtime stories.
description: Xiulan arranged for the children to wash up. She bathed Yuxin first, then urged the two boys to brush their teeth and wash their faces. After the children changed into their pajamas, Xiulan sat by Yuxin's bed and told two little stories.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Personal evening washing and preparation.
description: After the children went to sleep, Xiulan washed up, carefully cleansed and moisturized her face, laid out clothes for the next day, and checked the children's school supplies.
location: Master bedroom and bathroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Review before bed and plan for the next day
description: Xiulan lay in bed, scrolling through today's photos and the family group chat messages. Thinking about how the schoolbag was finished and the yogurt maker had been bought, she contentedly planned to try making yogurt tomorrow. Then she turned off the light and fell asleep with a smile.
location: Master bed in the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning exercise and brisk walking.
description: At 6:30 in the morning, Ma Xiulan did shoulder and neck stretches in the living room at home, first slowly tilting her head to the side, then doing shoulder circles to loosen her stiff joints. She then changed into sports shoes, briskly walked along Jingwen Road to the neighborhood park, reached her 3,200-step goal, breathed fresh air, and felt content.
location: From the living room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to the street park on the south side of Shengli Avenue.

name: Prepare breakfast, eat together as a family, do after-meal chores, and take the husband and children to school
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan prepared breakfast in the kitchen: she cooked millet porridge and reheated chive pockets and eggs. While the porridge was simmering, she went to the courtyard to water the roses and flower seedlings. Then she woke the three children one by one: urged Xuanxuan to do morning reading, got Mingzhe up, and braided Yuxin's hair. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang was not going out driving today, so the family sat around the dining table drinking porridge and eating chive pockets, and discussed making dumplings in the evening.
location: Kitchen, courtyard, and dining room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Taking the children to school
description: Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to first take her second son Mingzhe to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, telling him to listen carefully in class; then she took her daughter Yuxin to Huakang First Kindergarten and watched her run through the school gate.
location: No. 3 Primary School of Jinghai District on Shengli South Street and Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten on Huakang Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Courtyard work and vegetable market shopping
description: Ma Xiulan carefully tended the roses and newly sown flower seedlings in the courtyard at home, observed their growth, and took photos to post in the family group chat. She then walked to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market and selected tomatoes, greens, eggs, and pork belly at the stall of her acquaintance Sun Guifang. After a brief chat, she returned home, arriving at about 9:50.

participant.name: Sun Guifang
participant.relation: An acquaintance who runs a stall at the vegetable market

location: Courtyard at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and Wutong Commune Vegetable Market at the intersection of Jingwen Road and Wutong Road

name: Home Burglary and Emergency Response
description: When Ma Xiulan got home, she found the front door ajar with pry marks on the lock, the bedroom wardrobe was ransacked, and a silver necklace and 300 yuan in cash were missing from the jewelry box. Tearful, she called her husband Ma Zhiqiang, then called the police. At 10:30, Officer Wang arrived, inspected the scene, took photos, and made a statement, telling her that the chances of recovery were slim. After seeing the officers off, she tidied up the scene and confirmed that nothing else was missing. She then contacted Liu Jianguo, the community utility repairman, to arrange a lock replacement in the afternoon, and ordered a simple security door on his recommendation, paying a 300 yuan deposit in advance.

participant.name: Officer Wang
participant.relation: Police officer at Jinghai Town Police Station

location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Lunch and yogurt research
description: Ma Xiulan cooked some dried noodles with a poached egg for lunch by herself. While eating, she took out her phone to look up the steps and precautions for making homemade yogurt, using it to calm herself down.
location: Kitchen and dining room, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Changing the lock and midday rest
description: At 1 p.m., Master locksmith Liu Jianguo came to the house to replace the B-grade anti-theft lock cylinder, and Ma Xiulan paid 150 yuan in labor fees. After the lock was replaced, she copied the yogurt-making steps onto a sticky note and put it on the refrigerator, checked that all doors and windows were locked, then rested on the sofa flipping through garden photos, feeling heavy-hearted.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Deep cleaning and preparing the dumpling filling
description: To take her mind off things, Ma Xiulan vacuumed the floor, tidied the living room that had been turned upside down, and wiped the furniture. Then she began preparing dinner, mincing pork belly into filling and washing and draining the chives.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Picking up the children from school and outdoor activities.
description: Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike first to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up Mingzhe, then to Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up Yuxin. Afterward, instead of going straight home, she took the children to an open area near home to play and relax. Mingzhe chased his classmates, Yuxin watched ants, and they didn't return until nearly 5 o'clock.
location: Open ground near Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and No. 156 Jingwen Road

name: Dinner preparation and family meal
description: Ma Xiulan went home to stir-fry greens and make scrambled eggs with tomatoes. Ma Zhiqiang got off work early and helped mix the dough and roll out wrappers. Together they made dumplings stuffed with chives and pork. The whole family sat around for dinner. Ma Zhiqiang praised his wife for being brave, reminded the children to stay vigilant, and said that he would take the next day off to accompany Xiulan in arranging the installation of a security door and that they would hide valuables separately from now on. The conversation at the dinner table made the family feel at ease.
location: Kitchen and dining room, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening housework and homework tutoring.
description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan washed the dishes and chopsticks, and Ma Zhiqiang helped the eldest son with his homework. After tidying up, Ma Xiulan came to the living room desk to help Mingzhe with his math homework and Yuxin with pinyin reading and writing.
location: Kitchen and living room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Home safety check
description: Affected by the daytime theft, Ma Xiulan organized the whole family to check that doors and windows were locked. The children also took part in checking their own rooms. Ma Zhiqiang repeatedly confirmed the locks on the living room and kitchen, establishing a bedtime safety habit.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Children's wash-up and bedtime
