description: Ma Xiulan urged the children to take baths and brush their teeth, carried Yuxin to bed and told her a bedtime story. After she fell asleep, she went to tuck Mingzhe in and turn off the light.
location: Bathroom and children's room, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Couple's nighttime conversation and relaxation
description: After the children fell asleep, Ma Zhiqiang sat beside Ma Xiulan to comfort her. The two quietly leaned against each other in the living room, doing deep breathing together to relax their tense nerves. Ma Zhiqiang promised that he would be responsible for the safety check every night from now on, to put Xiulan at ease.
location: Living room and master bedroom, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Washing up before bed and reviewing the day
description: Ma Xiulan washed up in the bathroom, looking at her slightly tired but determined reflection in the mirror. After getting into bed, she reviewed the ups and downs of the whole day, jotted down a note in her phone memo to remind herself to install the security door tomorrow, then turned off the light and fell asleep in the safe feeling of being guarded by her family.
location: Bathroom and master bedroom at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning stretching, walking, and buying breakfast
description: After waking up in the early morning, Ma Xiulan first did a few slow neck and shoulder circles and head tilts backward in bed to loosen her stiff muscles and joints. Then she went downstairs and met her neighbor Zhang Shufen on Jingwen Road. The two walked together toward the street-corner park, chatting about yesterday's burglary at her home and today's plan to install a security door. At the street corner, at Old Jiang's breakfast stall, she bought six fried dough sticks, tea eggs, and two sweet baked flatbreads.
location: Breakfast shops along Jingwen Road in Jinghai District, Tianjin, and at street corners.

name: Family breakfast
description: Ma Xiulan brought breakfast home, heated up millet porridge, and woke her husband Ma Zhiqiang and the three children. The family sat together eating fried dough sticks, tea eggs, and sweet sesame cakes, and while eating she reminded them not to run around during the morning installation of the front door.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Inspecting and tasting the finished pickled vegetables.
description: After clearing the table, Ma Xiulan took out the jars of pickled spicy cabbage and sweet garlic. The spicy cabbage was full of sour and spicy flavor, and the sweet garlic was amber-colored. She picked out some for the family to taste, and everyone praised the taste. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang helped her take a photo with the jars as a memento.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Install security door and clean the entrance hall
description: To make room for installing the security door, Ma Xiulan first cleared out the clutter from the shoe cabinet near the entrance. At nine o'clock sharp, two workers from the building materials store arrived with the new dark gray security door. They removed the old wooden door, adjusted the door frame, filled it with cement, and installed the lock cylinder. Ma Xiulan watched the entire process and learned how to use it. She was very satisfied with the new door's sturdiness and tight seal and paid the 200 yuan balance. After the installation, she carefully swept up the dust, broken tiles, and foam in the foyer, wet-mopped the floor, and moved the pickled vegetable jar to the corner by the door.
location: At the front door and foyer of 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Cleaning the pickling equipment and preparing lunch
description: Ma Xiulan scrubbed the basin, knife, and cutting board used for pickling with dish soap, scalded them with boiling water to disinfect, and wiped the sauce stains off the stove. Then she chopped scallions and ginger, took out the ground meat, and prepared to make zhajiang noodles.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Simple lunch
description: Ma Xiulan fried ground pork with egg to make a meat-and-egg sauce, boiled noodles and rinsed them in cold water, and served them with freshly pickled spicy cabbage and sweet garlic. The family enjoyed the filling noodles with fried sauce; her husband Ma Zhiqiang ate two bowls.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Nap time and organizing keys.
description: After lunch, Ma Zhiqiang took the two younger children for a nap, while the eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, went back to his room to read. Ma Xiulan rested briefly in the living room, then took out the new security door keys and separated them with red, yellow, and blue keychains so the family could tell them apart.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Neighborly interaction and posting safety reminders
description: When Ma Xiulan went out to take out the trash, she ran into her neighbor across the hall, Wang Guilan, and told her about the burglary at home and the installation of a new door. Wang Guilan also planned to replace her lock cylinder. Ma Xiulan went home to get cardboard and markers, wrote 'Neighborhood watch: lock doors and windows when going out,' and posted it with Wang Guilan on the unit door and the bulletin board. Neighbor Zhang Shufen also joined the discussion, and the three stood at the stairwell entrance talking about burglary prevention and community safety.
location: Unit entrance and bulletin board, No. 156 Jingwen Road residential community, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tending the courtyard
description: Ma Xiulan returned to her own yard and saw that the cucumber seedlings and roses planted a few days earlier were growing well, so she loosened the soil around the roses with a small trowel, pulled out weeds, and sprayed water on the leaves with a watering can. Relaxing in the sunshine and birdsong, her tense nerves were soothed.
location: Home courtyard at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Dinner preparation and supermarket shopping
description: Ma Xiulan took the pork ribs out of the fridge to thaw, and washed and cut potatoes and green beans. Seeing that the oatmeal was almost used up, she walked to Jingbai Supermarket and bought a bag of plain oatmeal and a few bulk mini cakes. After returning home, she made oatmeal for the hungry children to tide them over.
location: Jingbai Supermarket, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The whole family tries the new key
description: After Ma Zhiqiang returned from adding water to the car, Ma Xiulan handed out the keys she had sorted. She personally taught her second son, Mingzhe, and her daughter, Yuxin, how to lock and unlock the door with the key, and told them that the first thing to do when they got home from school was to lock the door. The two children practiced repeatedly until they were skilled.
location: Home entrance, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: A hearty dinner.
description: Ma Xiulan made braised pork ribs, dry-fried green beans, and tomato and egg soup. The family sat around the table eating. The children said the new door was as thick and sturdy as a bank vault door, and the worry from yesterday's burglary finally disappeared completely.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Homework help and embroidery
description: Ma Xiulan supervised the three children doing homework and tutored the eldest son's lessons, while taking out the embroidery hoop to embroider the petals of a twin lotus flower. The TV in the living room was playing a Tianjin TV quyi program, and amid the drum songs she plied her needle and thread, feeling especially peaceful at heart.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Washing up and finishing up household chores
description: Ma Xiulan urged the three children to finish washing up and get into bed, laid out the clothes they would wear tomorrow, then washed and put away the kitchen dishes and utensils, and finally hung the new door lock key on the key rack by the door.
location: Bathroom and kitchen at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pre-sleep check, relaxation, and going to bed.
description: Ma Xiulan was still worried about the new door, so she went back and turned the doorknob to make sure it was locked. When she returned to the bedroom, her husband Ma Zhiqiang was already lying down looking at his phone. The two leaned against the headboard and quietly talked about installing the door and communicating with the neighbors today, feeling much more at ease. Then they followed a meditation guide on the phone and took deep breaths, turned off the lights, and went to bed. With insects chirping outside the window, Ma Xiulan felt that a peaceful day had ended, and thought that on Sunday she could try making yogurt with the yogurt maker and visit her parents.
location: Master bedroom of the home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning shoulder and neck stretching
description: Ma Xiulan woke up in the bedroom and, due to the right shoulder soreness from installing the door yesterday, did a 5-minute shoulder and neck stretching routine, slowly turning her neck and loosening her muscles to prepare for the day's housework.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Washing up and changing clothes
description: Ma Xiulan went to the bathroom to wash up simply, changed into an old cotton shirt and dark pants, neatly tied her hair into a ponytail, and moved lightly so as not to wake the children.
location: Home bathroom, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning walk and grocery shopping at the vegetable market.
description: Ma Xiulan took her shopping cart and coin purse, walked south along Jingwen Road, crossed Shengli Street, and reached Wutong Commune Food Market in 20 minutes. At Sun Guifang's meat stall she picked four pork ribs with thick, even meat, asked the stall owner to chop them into small pieces, and then bought pork belly, baby bok choy, tomatoes, scallions, ginger, and flour. She returned fully loaded, starting back at 7:35 and arriving home at 7:40.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Going home to organize and prep ingredients
description: After Ma Xiulan got home, she sorted the pork ribs and vegetables into the sink and refrigerator. She soaked the ribs in cold water to remove the blood, mixed flour with warm water to form a dough, covered it with a damp cloth to rest, preparing for hand-cut noodles. At the same time, she washed last night's dishes and wiped down the stove.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Waking up the children and preparing breakfast
description: Ma Xiulan went upstairs to wake the three children and tell them that their father was coming home today. Then she went downstairs, pan-fried the leftover dumplings, cooked millet porridge, and sliced the freshly pickled spicy cabbage and sweet garlic to prepare breakfast for the whole family.
location: Kitchen and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family breakfast and task assignments.
description: The family sat around the dining table eating breakfast. While taking care of the children, Ma Xiulan suggested that the children draw greeting cards for their father who was about to come home. The children responded enthusiastically, and the atmosphere was warm.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning housework and doing crafts with the children.
description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan cleaned up the dining room, while the children made greeting cards in the living room with colored paper, paintbrushes, and stickers. Ma Mingxuan drew the neatest, Ma Mingzhe drew a truck and wrote "Daddy, drive safely," and Ma Yuxin drew a mother in a skirt. Ma Xiulan took photos to record, then sorted the cardboard boxes and foam left from yesterday's door installation, flattened them, tied them up, and put them in the corner of the yard. She wiped the new security door and door frame with a rag, and went to the yard to weed the roses and cucumber seedlings.
location: Living room and courtyard of the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing a simple lunch.
description: Ma Xiulan reheated the leftover dumplings and boiled a small handful of dried noodles, preparing a simple lunch for the whole family, including piping hot dumpling soup.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Lunch and rest
description: She called the children to wash their hands and eat lunch. After the meal, Ma Xiulan asked Ma Mingxuan to keep the greeting card safe and let the children play on their own. She leaned back on the living room sofa and rested with her eyes closed for about half an hour.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, home dining room and living room

name: Lunch break and making homemade yogurt
description: After a short nap in the master bedroom, Ma Xiulan took out the yogurt maker and starter powder, mixed milk and starter powder according to the instructions, and switched it on to make yogurt, hoping the children could have some the next morning. At the same time, she blanched the soaked ribs and skimmed off the foam, kneaded the rested dough until smooth, and let it continue to rise.
location: Master bedroom and kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Carefully cooked: braised ribs and hand-rolled noodles.
description: Ma Xiulan put the blanched pork ribs into a large stew pot, added enough water, ginger slices, scallion sections, and star anise, brought it to a boil over high heat, then turned to low heat and simmered slowly. Meanwhile, she repeatedly rolled out the dough and cut it into noodles of even width, arranging them on the steaming tray. She also prepared the gravy toppings: soaked wood ear strips, day lily segments, sliced meat, and eggs. The kitchen was filled with a rich meaty aroma.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Right shoulder stretch and cold compress
description: After stewing the pork ribs, Ma Xiulan suddenly felt a sharp cracking pain in her right shoulder when she moved the soup pot, and strained her shoulder. She hurriedly put down the pot, took a wet towel from the refrigerator to cold-compress her right shoulder, and sat on the living room sofa to relieve the pain.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Asking neighbor Wang Guilan for help and applying a medicated patch
description: The pain in her right shoulder had eased slightly, but raising her arm was still difficult. Ma Xiulan sent a WeChat message to her neighbor across the hall, Wang Guilan, for help. Wang Guilan gave her a medicated patch. After bringing it home, Ma Xiulan asked her second son, Ma Mingzhe, to help apply it to the painful area. Once applied, it felt warm and somewhat more comfortable.
location: Wang Guilan's home across the street from 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and her own home

name: Setting the table and waiting
description: Ma Xiulan stir-fried the sauce with her left hand, took out the stewed pork ribs, and cooked the noodles before cooling them in cold water. The children helped set out bowls, chopsticks, and wine cups. The whole family opened the windows wide so the aroma of the food drifted out, waiting for Ma Zhiqiang to return.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Warm family dinner
description: Ma Zhiqiang opened the new security door and came home, and the children swarmed around him. Seeing the table of dishes and the medicated patch on his wife's right arm, he asked about them with concern. Before the meal, the children presented greeting cards. Ma Zhiqiang looked through each one and was especially moved by Ma Mingzhe's drawing of “Dad drives safely,” his eyes reddening. He raised his cup to Ma Xiulan and thanked her for her hard work, and the family enjoyed noodles with thick gravy and stewed pork ribs in a warm, cozy atmosphere.

name: Cleaning up after the meal and carefully storing the greeting cards
description: After the meal, Ma Zhiqiang took the initiative to clear the table and wash the dishes, letting Ma Xiulan rest. Ma Xiulan smoothed the corners of the greeting cards the children had given her, placed them into the "Love and Support" page of the family album, and carefully wrote down the date: May 18, 2025, Sunday, Old Ma's return.

name: Water the courtyard and record.

Ma Xiulan watered the cucumber seedlings and roses, admired the new leaves, and took photos with her phone to post in the family WeChat group, captioning them: “The little garden has grown a bit taller today. Old Ma is also safely back.” Family members liked it quickly.

name: Supervising the children's bedtime washing and couple's late-night chat

After the children went to sleep, the couple lay in bed chatting and discussed going back to the wife's parents' home to visit them the next day. Ma Zhiqiang agreed to go together next week when he was not driving.

name: Pre-sleep check and deep breathing relaxation.
description: Ma Zhiqiang checked the kitchen gas valve and windows and made sure the new security door was locked. Ma Xiulan, feeling discomfort in her right shoulder, sat on the edge of the bed and did deep breathing to relax for five or six rounds, feeling calm and content.
location: Various rooms and the master bedroom at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Rest
description: Ma Xiulan and Ma Zhiqiang went to bed, ending the day with a sense of steadiness and fulfillment.
location: Master bedroom of the home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

When she pulled open the curtains, the sky outside was overcast. Afterward, because of the discomfort in her right shoulder, she only walked slowly for 15 minutes in the Jingwen Road neighborhood to stretch her limbs. At the flower bed she met Sister Wang Guilan, who was doing morning exercises, and they exchanged brief greetings.

name: Take the children to school and visit the vegetable market on the way.

Then she took Xinxin to Huakang First Kindergarten and handed her to the teacher. Afterwards, she went by Wutong Commune Vegetable Market on the way, bought some greens and tofu, and carried the cloth bag in her left hand.
location: Along Shengli South Street in Jinghai District, Tianjin: Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Huakang First Kindergarten, and Wutong Commune Vegetable Market.

name: Go home and do housework
description: Ma Xiulan walked home from the vegetable market and put the groceries away. Using mainly her left hand, she wiped the tabletops and TV cabinet in the living room and bedroom, sorted the dirty clothes into the washing machine, and tried to use her left hand as much as possible when sweeping and mopping to avoid straining her right shoulder.
location: At home in the Jingwen Road Community, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Tend the courtyard and check the garden balsam.
description: After finishing the housework, Ma Xiulan went to the yard and used her left hand to water the flowers, trees, and vegetable seedlings. She squatted down to carefully check the pot of balsam flowers she had planted a few days earlier, and was delighted to find that one or two seeds seemed to have broken through the soil, showing tender green sprouts.
location: Home courtyard in Jingwen Road residential area, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Rest and call my mother.
description: Ma Xiulan returned to the living room sofa to rest and drink water. She remembered telling her mother that she would deliver sweet garlic today, so she called her. She arranged with her mother, Li Xiuying, to go over after lunch; her mother also asked with concern about her shoulder injury.
location: Living room of the home in Jingwen Road Community, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing lunch, picking up the children from school, and having lunch together
description: Ma Xiulan put down the phone, went into the kitchen to wash the greens and cut the tofu, and took out yesterday's leftover ribs and rolled noodles. She left at 11:20, first went to Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up Xinxin, then waited at the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School for Zhezhe, and the three walked home chatting and laughing. After arriving home, she cooked the noodles, poured the rib gravy over them, and they enjoyed a simple lunch together.
location: Home kitchen at Jingwen Road Residential Community, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten; Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School

name: Urging the children to take a nap and preparing sweet garlic
description: The children chatted about funny school stories while eating. Ma Xiulan ate simply and then urged them to take a nap. After settling the children down, she did not rest but hurriedly packed the two small jars of sweet garlic that she had portioned out the night before into a cloth bag, ready to go back to her parents' home.
location: At home in the Jingwen Road Community, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Return to her parents' home to give them sweet garlic, sit for a while, and take the child to school
description: Ma Xiulan asked her husband to look after the children during their nap and walked to her parents' home at No. 45 Shengli Street. She put two jars of sweet garlic in the kitchen, chatted with her mother Li Xiuying, and asked about her parents' health. At 13:10 she took her leave and returned home, woke the children, first took Xinxin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, then took Zhezhe to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School.
location: No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten; Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School.

description: After taking the children to school and returning home, Ma Xiulan lay on the bed, massaged her right shoulder, and applied a Yunnan Baiyao medicated plaster. The cool sensation relaxed her, and she napped for nearly an hour. After the nap, her spirits improved. She took out the family photo album and three greeting cards from the children from the drawer, smoothed the cards, and wrote on them with a pen: “May 18, 2025, Father returned from a trip, family dinner.” Then she placed the cards in the “Love and Support” section of the album and felt warm at the heartwarming pictures.
location: Bedroom and living room of the home in the Jingwen Road Community, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Shopping at Jingbai Supermarket and chatting with neighbors
description: Ma Xiulan walked to Jingbai Supermarket and bought a bottle of affordable soy sauce and a large bottle of dish detergent. On the way out, she ran into her neighbor Zhang Shufen at the entrance. They chatted briefly; Zhang Shufen asked about her shoulder, and she said it felt much better after applying a medicated patch, and promised to drop by Zhang Shufen's shop when she had time.
location: Jingbai Supermarket and its entrance, Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Pick the children up from school.

The children were in a good mood and chattered about school. After arriving home, she had the children do homework at the small table in the living room while she trimmed vegetables and kept an eye on them.
location: Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, No. 3 Primary School of Jinghai District, and home in the Jingwen Road community, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare dinner and help her husband fix the faucet.

After her husband Ma Zhiqiang comes back, he takes out his toolbox to fix the loose kitchen faucet. Ma Xiulan hands him a rag as they work together to tighten the faucet, and they smile at each other.
location: Kitchen at home, Jingwen Road Community, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The whole family had dinner together.
description: At dinner time, the family of five sat around the table, and the aroma of braised chicken pieces was appetizing. Ma Zhiqiang mentioned that he would drive out tomorrow to deliver goods nearby and would be back in two or three days; the children reported being praised at school. The atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: Home dining room, Jingwen Road Community, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: After-meal chores, homework help, parent-child reading, and washing up.
description: After dinner, Ma Zhiqiang watched the TV news in the living room, while Ma Xiulan slowly washed the dishes and cleaned up the kitchen with her left hand. Ma Mingxuan took the initiative to help his younger siblings with math problems. After washing the dishes, she checked Xinxin's pinyin notebook and corrected her pronunciation. Then she urged the children to wash up. After her bath, Xinxin asked to hear the story of The Three Little Pigs, so Ma Xiulan leaned against the headboard, held the picture book in her left hand, and read it to her word by word.
location: Kitchen, living room, and bedroom at home, Jingwen Road Community, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening conversation between husband and wife, pre-bed safety inspection, and going to sleep
description: After the children went to sleep, Ma Xiulan returned to the master bedroom and chatted with Ma Zhiqiang, who was leaning against the bed and scrolling on his phone, about the visit to her parents' home today. Ma Zhiqiang also told her about his delivery plan for tomorrow. Then the two together checked the doors, windows and gas in the house. After confirming safety, they returned to the bedside and did about five minutes of abdominal breathing with their eyes closed. Ma Xiulan felt that although her right shoulder was still stiff, she felt at ease inside. She changed into pajamas, lay down gently, and soon fell asleep.
location: Looking forward to the family's tasting feedback.

name: Morning stretching and walking
description: At 6:30 a.m., the phone alarm rang and Ma Xiulan woke up. Her right shoulder, with the medicated patch on it, felt somewhat better. She sat up slowly, first moved her wrists and neck, then did 5 minutes of shoulder and neck stretches. Although her right arm could not fully straighten, she could do gentle movements. Then she changed into athletic shoes and walked along the tree-lined path on Jingwen Road. The weather was fine, the sunlight was warm, and the new leaves of the plane trees by the road rustled. She slowed her pace and moved her shoulders as she walked. After 20 minutes, she felt much more energetic and the soreness in her shoulder had eased.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (master bedroom at home) and the tree-lined avenue on Jingwen Road (section up to Wutong Community).

name: Preparing breakfast and family breakfast time
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan first went to the courtyard and saw that the impatiens seeds had sprouted true leaves and the roses had put out new shoots. She watered the seedlings and roses with her left hand and pulled out weeds. Then she went into the kitchen, cooked golden millet porridge, made scallion egg pancakes, and sliced ham. The kitchen was filled with a fragrant aroma. At 7:50 she went upstairs to wake the three children: the eldest, Ma Mingxuan, got up on his own; the second, Ma Mingzhe, stayed in bed and only got up after having his ear pulled; the youngest daughter, Ma Yuxin, put on her dress by herself. The family sat around the dining table eating breakfast. Her husband, Ma Zhiqiang, said he was off work today and would stay home to tutor Ma Mingxuan.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home kitchen, dining room, and courtyard)

name: Take the children to school and take a walk along the way
description: At 8:10, Ma Xiulan set off on foot holding Ma Yuxin's and Ma Mingzhe's hands. First she went to Huakang First Kindergarten at the intersection of Shengli Street and Jingwen Road; Ma Yuxin skipped into the kindergarten. Then she turned onto Shengli South Street to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, walked Ma Mingzhe to the school gate, and told him to focus in class. After dropping off the children at 8:40, she did not go straight home but took a 20-minute walk along the plane-tree shade on Jingwen Road, enjoying the warm sun and breeze. She felt the soreness in her shoulders ease, and at the same time thought about making up with Liu Chunmei.
location: Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin (100 m east of the intersection of Shengli Street and Jingwen Road), Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (No. 1 Shengli South Street), and the Jingwen Road tree-lined avenue

name: Buying groceries at the vegetable market.
description: Ma Xiulan came to Sun Guifang's stall at Wutong Commune Vegetable Market and bought fresh vegetables such as spinach, spring onions, and celery, planning to make celery stir-fried with pork. Sun Guifang gave her a handful of cilantro. Ma Xiulan thanked her and left, mentally planning to bring some home-grown vegetables to Liu Chunmei's house in the evening.
location: Wutong Community Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin (at the intersection of Jingwen Road and Wutong Road)

name: Tending the courtyard and answering Chunmei's call
description: Ma Xiulan returned home, changed into old clothes, and went to the yard to tend to the flowers and plants. The impatiens seedlings had grown, lush and pleasing. She watered them with her left hand and pulled weeds. Then she took photos of the seedlings and the new rose shoots and posted them in the family group chat with the caption, “The seedlings change every day; our little garden is getting more and more thriving.” The family gave her likes. Just as she finished watering and returned to the living room, her phone rang—it was Liu Chunmei. After a moment of hesitation, she answered. Liu Chunmei sincerely invited her to come to her home for dinner that evening. Ma Xiulan agreed, feeling a weight lift from her heart.
location: Home courtyard and living room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Household tidying and preparing gifts
description: After finishing the phone call, Ma Xiulan felt even more motivated. She tidied the house and used the washing machine to do laundry. While hanging the clothes, she went to the small vegetable garden and cut some spinach and scallions, putting them in a basket. Then she took out the sweet pickled garlic made last year from the storage room, wiped the jar clean, and packed it in a cloth bag as a gift for the reconciliation visit to Liu Chunmei's home that evening.
location: No. 156, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home living room, kitchen, and small vegetable garden in the courtyard)

name: Pick the children up from school.
description: At 11 o'clock, Ma Xiulan first went to Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up Ma Yuxin, then went to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up Ma Mingzhe. The two children excitedly shared school news: Ma Yuxin was praised for her drawing, and Ma Mingzhe got all the math problems right. Listening, Ma Xiulan's mood completely improved.
location: Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin (100 m east of the intersection of Shengli Avenue and Jingwen Road), Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (1 Shengli South Street)

name: Prepare and enjoy lunch
description: When she got home, Ma Zhiqiang had already cooked rice. Ma Xiulan quickly stir-fried shredded pork with celery and tomato scrambled eggs. The family sat together to eat. She told him about Liu Chunmei's invitation to a meal. Ma Zhiqiang was happy for her and said that sisters never hold overnight grudges; having a good talk would make everything fine.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home kitchen and dining room)

name: Midday break
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan asked Ma Zhiqiang to look after the children during their nap. After clearing the dishes, she took a half-hour nap on the sofa herself. When she woke up, she took out her embroidery and embroidered a jasmine flower on Ma Yuxin's small schoolbag, while thinking about how to talk when meeting Liu Chunmei in the evening.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (living room and bedroom at home)

name: Take the children to school in the afternoon
description: At 13:40, Ma Xiulan took Ma Yuxin and Ma Mingzhe to school, reminding them on the way to listen carefully in class and that their mother would pick them up after school.
location: Third Primary School of Jinghai District, Tianjin (1 Shengli South Street), Huakang First Kindergarten (100 meters east of the intersection of Shengli Street and Jingwen Road)

name: Hand embroidery
description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan sat on the sofa by the window and concentrated on embroidering. She embroidered a handkerchief with a pattern of two jasmine flowers nestled together, planning to give it as a gift if she and Liu Chunmei made up. In the quiet afternoon, the only sound was the slight rustle of needle and thread through the fabric, and she felt calm.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home living room)

name: Getting washed, changing clothes, and preparing for the appointment
description: At 3:30 in the afternoon, Ma Xiulan finished her embroidery and got ready to go out. After taking a shower, she changed into a plain floral blouse and dark pants, carefully combed her hair, and applied face cream. Looking in the mirror, she encouraged herself, firmly believing that she could make up with Liu Chunmei today.
location: No. 156, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home bathroom and bedroom)

name: Walk to Liu Chunmei's home
description: At 4:30 p.m., Ma Xiulan picked up the vegetable basket and the jar of sweet garlic, locked the front door, and walked to Liu Chunmei's home at No. 88 Shengli Street. The sun slanted down, and she greeted acquaintances she met along the way. She walked slowly, thinking about what she would say.
location: Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin (on the way to Liu Chunmei's home at No. 88).

name: Reconciliation dinner and farewell.
description: Ma Xiulan arrived at Liu Chunmei's house; Liu Chunmei was busy in the kitchen. She handed over the vegetables and sweet garlic she had brought, and Liu Chunmei took the basket with reddened eyes. Without much conversation, Ma Xiulan helped prepare the vegetables. Liu Chunmei had made noodles with gravy and sweet-and-sour pork ribs. During the meal, the atmosphere was still somewhat awkward. Halfway through, Liu Chunmei put down her chopsticks and apologized, saying she had been wrong about the pickled vegetables. Ma Xiulan wept, raised her glass in reply, and they clinked glasses and drank it all in one go, dissolving the rift. Then they chatted easily, from their children to TV dramas, until dark. After dinner, Ma Xiulan helped clear the dishes. Liu Chunmei walked her to the door, held her hand, and urged her not to keep things bottled up, saying she would come by after work tomorrow to see the garden. Ma Xiulan went home happily in the moonlight.
location: No. 88 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin (Liu Chunmei's home kitchen and dining room)

name: Walk home while enjoying the night view along the way
description: Ma Xiulan walked along Shengli Avenue, turned onto Jingwen Road, and headed home. The streetlights lengthened her shadow and the evening breeze was refreshing. She noticed that the roadside fruit stand was still lit, and planned to buy lychees for the children tomorrow. She arrived home at 8:50 p.m.
location: Shengli Street and Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family evening time and buying a yogurt maker online
description: Ma Xiulan arrived home. Ma Zhiqiang was tutoring Ma Mingxuan with his homework, Ma Mingzhe was playing with building blocks, and Ma Yuxin was watching cartoons after her bath. She shared the good news, and the family was happy for her. She urged the two children to wash up, then took out her phone and, using the money she had saved from selling pickled vegetables, ordered a home yogurt maker (89 yuan) and yogurt starter powder (15 yuan) on Taobao to solve Ma Yuxin's constipation problem.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home living room)

name: Before-bed preparation and review
description: At 9:30, Ma Xiulan urged the children to go to bed. After they all fell asleep, she checked the doors, windows, and gas stove together with Ma Zhiqiang - a habit they had developed after the house was once broken into. At 10:15 they returned to the bedroom. Sitting side by side on the edge of the bed, they silently closed their eyes and did five minutes of deep breathing. Ma Xiulan recalled the scene of toasting with Liu Chunmei and felt warm and grateful; the last bit of soreness in her shoulders also disappeared.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (various rooms in the home and the master bedroom)

name: Fell asleep peacefully
description: At 22:45, Ma Xiulan checked the alarm on her phone to make sure she could get up early, closed her eyes with peace of mind, and recalled the wonderful day—reconciling with Liu Chunmei and buying a yogurt maker for the children. Feeling fulfilled, she knew she would sleep well tonight.
location: Tianjin, Jinghai District, 156 Jingwen Road (master bedroom at home)

name: Morning wake-up, exercise, and breakfast.
description: At 6:40, it was drizzling outside the window. Ma Xiulan got up, spread an old blanket in the living room, and did neck and shoulder stretches and shoulder rolls, then marched in place for 10 minutes while swinging her arms. After exercising, she went to the kitchen to prepare breakfast, cooking millet porridge, making scallion egg pancakes, and slicing ham, while also waking her husband Ma Zhiqiang and the children. At 7:40, the whole family sat around the dining table for breakfast. Xiulan reminded Lao Ma to drive slowly in the rain, put a pancake on her daughter's plate, and asked her son about his homework. The family atmosphere was warm.
location: Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Take the children to school and go to the vegetable market to buy groceries.
description: After breakfast and clearing the table, Ma Xiulan put raincoats and rain boots on Ma Mingzhe and Ma Yuxin, took an umbrella herself, and rode her bike with the children. She first took Ma Mingzhe to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School and told him to wait for her at the security guard's office, then took Ma Yuxin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten and handed her to the teacher. Afterwards, she dropped by the Wutong Commune Vegetable Market on the way, where she picked out Chinese cabbage, cilantro, and green garlic at Sun Guifang's stall. Sun Guifang teased her about whether she was going to make pickles, and Ma Xiulan answered with a smile. Then she bought coarse chili flakes and dried chilies at the seasoning shop and carried the groceries home.
location: From home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School on Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, then to Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District, and then to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Did housework and made samples of spicy cabbage for consignment.
description: After returning home from grocery shopping, Ma Xiulan peeled the leaves off the Chinese cabbage, washed and cut them into pieces, and salted them to draw out water. Meanwhile, she wiped down the living room coffee table and TV cabinet and put the bed sheets and dirty clothes into the washing machine. Then came the key step in making kimchi: she scalded the chili flakes with boiling water; after it cooled, she added minced garlic, minced ginger, fish sauce, shrimp paste, apple strips, and pear strips, deliberately reducing the salt to achieve a refreshing taste. She squeezed the water out of the salted cabbage, spread the sauce on layer by layer, packed it into a wide-mouthed glass jar, and attached a label reading "Ma Family Style Low-Salt Spicy Cabbage 2025.5.21" as a consignment sample.
location: Kitchen and living room of the residence at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Picking up the child from school and heading home
description: Because the roads were slippery from rain, Ma Xiulan set off early, put on a rain poncho, and rode her bike to pick up the children. She first went to Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up Ma Yuxin, then went to the entrance of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up Ma Mingzhe. The two children chattered along the way, sharing fun stories from school, and Ma Xiulan was happy to listen.
location: From home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Made lunch and had lunch together
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan quickly made scrambled eggs with tomatoes and garlic stir-fried lettuce, reheated the leftover stir-fried pork with celery from the day before, and took a small dish of the spicy cabbage kimchi she had made yesterday out of the pickle jar. At lunch, Ma Yuxin praised the kimchi, saying it was delicious, not too salty, and slightly sweet, which made Ma Xiulan very happy. After the meal, she took the two children for a midday nap.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Midday break and picking up packages
description: After putting Ma Mingzhe and Ma Yuxin to bed, Ma Xiulan lay down for half an hour to rest. When she woke up, she remembered that the yogurt maker she had bought online the day before had arrived, so she took an umbrella and went to the neighborhood security guard's office to ask. The guard told her the package had arrived. She took the heavy yogurt maker back, looking forward to teaching the children how to use it in the evening.

participant.name: The old security guard at the gate

location: Gatehouse of the residential compound, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Take the children to school in the afternoon
description: After the afternoon nap, the rain stopped. Ma Xiulan got the children ready, rode her bike to take Ma Mingzhe and Ma Yuxin to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School and Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten respectively, and told them not to rush off and run around after school.
location: From home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tending the garden, doing embroidery, and entertaining friend Liu Chunmei
description: After the rain, Ma Xiulan tidied the courtyard, pulled up weeds, and trimmed the blooming pink roses and phalaenopsis orchids to arrange in a vase in the living room. Then she sat by the window and embroidered a customer's custom pillowcase with twin lotus flowers for about 20 minutes. Soon after, her close friend Liu Chunmei came to visit. Ma Xiulan showed her around the vibrant garden, and then they tasted the newly made spicy pickled cabbage and hot tea together in the living room. Liu Chunmei was full of praise for the low-salt recipe. The two chatted about everyday matters while embroidering together. Liu Chunmei also offered to go to Shufen Supermarket to ask about selling goods on consignment. Around 15:45, Liu Chunmei left to pick up her child, and Ma Xiulan saw her to the door.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (home living room and courtyard)

name: Buying groceries and picking up children from school.
description: After seeing off Liu Chunmei, Ma Xiulan dropped by the Wutong Commune vegetable market to buy pork belly and spinach to prepare for dinner. She then picked up Ma Mingzhe and Ma Yuxin at the elementary school and kindergarten gates. On the way, she chatted with a neighbor about parenting, stopped the children from stomping in puddles, and took them home.
location: From home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China, to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin, then to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School on South Shengli Street and Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Evening embroidery.
description: After getting home, she had the children change clothes and play while she made good use of the time to continue embroidering the twin lotus pillowcase. Under the light, she smoothly completed the outline of a petal and felt a sense of achievement.
location: By the living room window at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Preparing dinner and family dinner
description: Ma Xiulan went into the kitchen, blanched and cut the pork belly, braised it as red-braised pork, and washed the spinach. Her daughter Ma Yuxin voluntarily helped set the table. At dinner, the family sat together, and Ma Xiulan suggested to her husband Ma Zhiqiang that she wanted to place the spicy cabbage on consignment at Sister Shufen's supermarket. Ma Zhiqiang readily supported the idea, which boosted her confidence.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Helping children with homework and doing housework
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan cleared the dishes and let Ma Zhiqiang rest. She tutored Ma Mingzhe on math word problems, explaining over and over until he understood; Ma Yuxin sat nearby drawing a crayon family portrait. At the same time, she wrote Ma Mingxuan's name on the clothes he would wear tomorrow.
location: Various rooms of the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Family yogurt-making activity
description: After homework was done, Ma Xiulan took out the cleaned yogurt maker, milk, and yogurt starter powder, and gathered the three children in the kitchen. She taught them to pour milk into the yogurt maker's inner container, sprinkle in the starter powder, and stir evenly, explaining the health benefits of homemade yogurt, especially for Ma Yuxin's digestion. The children excitedly fought to press the switch, while Ma Zhiqiang watched from the side. The whole family looked forward to the finished yogurt.
location: China, Tianjin Jinghai District, No. 156 Jingwen Road, home kitchen

name: Supervising the children washing up and going to bed
description: After turning off the TV, Ma Xiulan urged Ma Mingzhe and Ma Yuxin to wash up, helped Ma Yuxin brush her teeth, told her a bedtime story, and soothed her to sleep. Ma Mingxuan had already washed up on his own.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Evening conversation between husband and wife
description: After the children fell asleep, Ma Xiulan and Ma Zhiqiang sat down on the living room sofa. She described in detail the process of making spicy pickled cabbage that day and her idea of selling it on consignment. Ma Zhiqiang expressed full support, and the two then talked about the husband's driving route for the next day and household matters.
location: Home living room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Pre-sleep safety check and meditation
description: Ma Xiulan and Ma Zhiqiang together checked all doors, windows, and gas valves in the house. After ensuring safety, they returned to the master bedroom. The two sat side by side on the edge of the bed with their eyes closed, doing 5 minutes of deep breathing to relax. Ma Xiulan recalled the smooth sample-making today and her husband's support, and felt both expectant and slightly nervous about going to see Sister Shufen tomorrow.
location: Various rooms and the master bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Pre-bedtime free activity and going to bed
description: After taking a deep breath, Ma Xiulan lay in bed looking at the handicraft group patterns and the weather forecast on her phone. Ma Zhiqiang looked at his phone for a while and also got ready for bed. Around 22:45, they said goodnight to each other, turned off the lights, and rested. Ma Xiulan fell asleep with a smile, looking forward to tomorrow.
location: Master bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Morning neck and shoulder stretches and sharing the discovery of flower buds
description: Ma Xiulan woke up right at 6:35. As usual, she did a 5-minute shoulder and neck stretch in bed, feeling that her neck, which had been stiff the day before, became flexible and relaxed. After getting up, she pushed open the courtyard door and was pleasantly surprised to find a tender green flower bud the size of a mung bean at the tip of the flower seedling from yesterday. Overjoyed, she immediately took close-up and panoramic photos with her phone and sent them to the family group chat "Warm Family" with the message "Look! Our little flower is about to bloom, the first bud!" Her husband and children liked it right away, and the group was lively for a while.
location: Master bedroom and courtyard at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning walk, breakfast preparation, and family breakfast
description: Seizing the good mood, Ma Xiulan put on her sneakers and walked briskly for 20 minutes along the tree-lined Jingwen Road outside her door, feeling full of energy. She got home at 7:15 and began preparing breakfast: she cooked a pot of millet and pumpkin porridge, made five scallion and egg pancakes, and sliced a plate of spiced beef. At 7:25 she woke the whole family. As they sat around the table eating breakfast, she said to the children, “Today Mom is going to take care of a big thing — getting our homemade spicy pickled cabbage sold in the supermarket. You need to be good at school.” The eldest son, Xuanxuan, nodded; the second son, Zhezhe, playfully shouted, “Go, Mom!”; and the youngest daughter, Xinxin, said, “Mom is the best!”
location: The tree-lined avenue on Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and the kitchen and dining room at home

name: Taking the child to school and walking along the way
description: At 7:50, Ma Xiulan rode her bicycle to take her second son, Zhezhe, to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School first. After watching him enter the school gate, she took her younger daughter, Xinxin, to Huakang First Kindergarten. It was only 8:20 after dropping off the children, so she brisk-walked a short stretch along the tree-lined Jingwen Road while pushing her bicycle, and after working her muscles, returned home.
location: From No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street), Huakang First Kindergarten, and the Jingwen Road tree-lined avenue

name: Tending the courtyard and caring for the vegetable garden
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan first watered the small seedling that had sprouted flower buds, as well as the roses and cucumber seedlings in the yard. Then she squatted by the vegetable beds and pulled weeds from the scallions and lettuce. Seeing the thriving vegetable seedlings put her mind at ease.
location: Home courtyard at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Clean the house and sign for the yogurt maker delivery.
description: After going back inside, Ma Xiulan quickly cleared the dining table and put the dishes and chopsticks into the dishwasher. Around 9:40, the courier knocked on the door and delivered the yogurt maker and two packets of starter culture she had bought online yesterday. She signed for them, took them to the kitchen, and opened them to check. The accessories were complete and the starter culture packaging was intact, so she put them away satisfied.
location: Living room and front door of home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Making the first batch of yogurt and preparing spicy cabbage samples for consignment
description: After unboxing the yogurt maker, Ma Xiulan followed the instructions to mix a carton of pure milk with a small packet of yogurt starter powder, stirred it carefully, poured it into the inner pot, and plugged it in to ferment, hoping the kids could drink the healthy homemade yogurt in the evening. Then she picked out five jars of kimchi with the cleanest packaging from the utility room cabinet, wiped the jars shiny with a damp cloth, and mentally reviewed the price of 28 yuan per jar and the 15% commission rate.
location: Kitchen and utility room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Go to Shufen Convenience Supermarket to discuss and sign a consignment contract.
description: Ma Xiulan changed into a clean floral blouse, put the five sample bottles into a cloth bag, adjusted her hair in the mirror, and walked out to the Shufen Convenience Store across the street. When she arrived, her neighbor Zhang Shufen happened to be free. Ma Xiulan explained why she had come and opened a bottle of spicy cabbage for her to taste. Zhang Shufen tasted it, nodded repeatedly, and praised it as authentic. The two quickly settled the details: a price of 28 yuan per bottle, a 15% commission on the price, and settlement at the end of the month. Ma Xiulan took out the simple agreement her husband had already seen, and they each signed a copy and kept one.
location: Shufen Convenience Store, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Spicy cabbage listed for sale, picking up children from school, and lunch
description: After signing the agreement, Ma Xiulan hurried home to get the five sample jars. Zhang Shufen cleared a spot on a shelf in a prominent area near the seasoning section of the supermarket and helped her set out the kimchi. Ma Xiulan asked Zhang Shufen to be sure to let her know any customer feedback, then went home reassured. After a short rest, she set off to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up her second son, Zhezhe. On the way, she happily shared the news of the successful consignment with him. Back home, she made a simple tomato and egg noodle soup. The two ate and chatted, and she felt so pleased that she had an extra bowl of noodles.
location: Shufen Convenience Store on Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street); and the kitchen and dining room at home.

name: Send second son to school and take a midday rest
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan made Zhe Zhe take a 20-minute nap. At 13:00 she woke him up and walked him to the school gate. After returning home, she lay down on the bed to rest for 20 minutes. Although she had things on her mind and couldn't fall asleep, closing her eyes to rest still made her whole body feel relaxed.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street)

name: Embroidered a twin-lotus pillowcase.
description: The afternoon belonged entirely to her. Ma Xiulan took out the pillowcase with the half-embroidered twin lotus pattern, put on her thimble, and sat in a well-lit spot by the living room window, embroidering stitch by stitch. Sunlight streamed through the window curtain onto the fabric, and the outlines of the veins and petals were clearer than yesterday. She felt especially at peace.
location: By the living room window at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Picking up the youngest daughter from school and shopping at the market
description: At 15:30, Ma Xiulan put down her needlework, first went to Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up her younger daughter Xinxin, then stopped at Wutong Commune Vegetable Market on the way, and bought 500 grams of pork belly, a bunch of spinach, and two tomatoes from the familiar stall of Sun Guifang, planning to make the children's favorite dishes for dinner.
location: Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and Wutong Commune Vegetable Market

name: Preparing dinner and tasting homemade yogurt for the first time.
description: After getting home, Ma Xiulan first cut the pork belly into chunks, blanched them, and started stewing, then picked over the spinach. When she finished, she remembered the yogurt she had made in the morning and, guessing enough time had passed, opened the lid of the yogurt maker and tasted it — it was extremely sour. She called over her second son and eldest son, who had already come home from school, to try it, and both kids said it was too sour. Ma Xiulan wasn't discouraged and thought she should go ask Chunmei tomorrow whether she had used too much culture powder.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Helping the Three Children with Homework
description: While the meat was simmering, Ma Xiulan watched the three children doing their homework in the living room. Her oldest son Xuanxuan needed no supervision; she mainly kept an eye on Zhezhe, a second grader, doing character dictation. Her youngest daughter Xinxin was doodling on the easel nearby.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner and sharing joy.
description: Her husband Ma Zhiqiang arrived home on time at 18:00, and the family sat together eating braised pork and stir-fried spinach. At the table, Ma Xiulan animatedly recounted the details of closing the cooperation deal at Sister Shufen's supermarket, even telling the failed yogurt making as a joke. Ma Zhiqiang praised her for being capable and suggested making a few more jars over the weekend, restocking in time after the first batch sold out.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tidy up the kitchen
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan quickly gathered the dishes into the kitchen, washed them clean with dishwashing liquid, wiped down the stove, and put the leftovers in the refrigerator.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening tutoring and parent-child time.
description: After tidying up, Ma Xiulan continued to help the children finish the rest of their homework. Her eldest son, Xuanxuan, ran into a difficult math problem, and she and her husband guided him through it together. While her second son, Zhezhe, was reciting his text, her little daughter, Xinxin, was messing around nearby, so she patiently coaxed her daughter to the sofa to read picture books. During this time, the couple also enjoyed warm parent-child time with the children.
location: Living room and study at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Supervise the children's washing up and do a pre-bedtime safety check.
description: Ma Xiulan and her husband divided the tasks of supervising the three children brushing their teeth, washing their faces, and washing their feet; she was in charge of her youngest daughter Xinxin, and her husband was in charge of the two sons. Before bed, the couple thoroughly checked the doors, windows, and gas valves, and only felt reassured after confirming everything was closed.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin: bathroom and various rooms

name: Pre-bedtime couple talk and washing up
description: After the children had all fallen asleep, Ma Xiulan and her husband leaned against the headboard and chatted for a while about going to ask Chunmei for advice on making yogurt the next day. Then she went to the bathroom to wash up and changed into her pajamas.
location: Master bedroom and bathroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Pre-bed review, deep breathing, and lights out to rest
description: Ma Xiulan sat on the edge of the bed, took out her phone, and smiled at the photos of flower buds in the family group chat. Reviewing the day, she felt especially grounded: she had successfully signed her first consignment, the garden had its first bud, and although the yogurt making had failed, she gained new experience. As usual, she did 5 minutes of deep breathing to fully calm her mind, then turned off the lights and lay down at 21:15, soon falling asleep with anticipation and joy.
location: Master bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning wake-up, washing up, and walk
description: Ma Xiulan was woken by her phone alarm. After doing simple neck and shoulder stretches and a good stretch in bed, she got up, washed up, changed clothes, and put on her sportswear and mesh shoes. When she went out, she ran into her neighbor Zhang Shufen, and the two walked briskly together along the tree-lined avenue on Jingwen Road. Ma Xiulan told Shufen about the failure of the yogurt she had made yesterday and said she was going to ask Chunmei for advice. Shufen encouraged her and also praised the spicy cabbage she had given her before, saying the end-of-month settlement would be no problem, which made her feel relieved.
location: Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and home.

name: Morning chores and breakfast
description: After the walk, Ma Xiulan went home. She first went to the kitchen to put millet porridge on the stove, then woke up the three children and her husband, Ma Zhiqiang. Back in the kitchen, she busied herself making scallion egg pancakes, slicing soy-braised beef, preparing chili oil, ladling out the porridge to cool, and pouring warm milk for everyone. After the family sat together and finished breakfast, she quickly cleared the dishes, soaked them in the sink, then opened the fridge to check what was in stock and planned the ingredients to buy at the vegetable market later.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Take the children to school.
description: Ma Xiulan straightened her second son Mingzhe's collar, filled his water bottle, and led him and her younger daughter Yuxin out. They first walked to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School. She told Mingzhe to listen carefully in class and watched him enter the school gate, then held Yuxin's hand and walked about 10 minutes to Huakang First Kindergarten. She handed her daughter to the teacher, and after Yuxin sweetly said goodbye, Ma Xiulan left at ease.
location: Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Shopping at the vegetable market.
description: After dropping off the kids, Ma Xiulan stopped by the Wutong Commune Vegetable Market on the way. She first went to the stall of her familiar vegetable seller Sun Guifang, praised the fresh strawberries, and weighed out two jin to make yogurt. She also walked around the market, bought pork belly, spinach, and potatoes to prepare for dinner. After shopping, she walked home, soaked the strawberries in light salt water, changed into loungewear, and got ready to go find Chunmei.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin; home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Learning to make yogurt from Liu Chunmei
description: Ma Xiulan carried yesterday's failed yogurt and the sample Chunmei had given her, and walked to Chunmei's home on Shengli Street. In Chunmei's living room, the two didn't stand on ceremony and directly compared and tasted the yogurt. Chunmei pointed out the reasons for the failure: too little milk, too much culture powder, and over-fermentation. She explained in detail the control of proportions, temperature, and time, and wrote the key steps in a small notebook for Ma Xiulan. Before she left, Chunmei also gave her a box of homemade strawberry yogurt to compare at home.
location: Chunmei's home on Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Make yogurt a second time using the new method
description: Ma Xiulan left Chunmei's house, went to the small shop to buy a bag of pure milk, then returned home. She boiled water to sterilize the yogurt maker's inner pot and dried it. Following Chunmei's instructions, she poured one liter of pure milk into the inner pot, sprinkled in a small packet of starter culture, and stirred thoroughly. She set aside the washed and diced strawberries and a spoonful of honey, then placed the inner pot into the yogurt maker, set the timer, and sat on the living room sofa watching TV while waiting for it to ferment, thinking that it would be just about ready by the time she picked up the children.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the child from school
description: Around noon, Ma Xiulan turned off the TV, first went to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up Yuxin, then stopped by the entrance of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to wait for Mingzhe. When the two children saw their mother, they chattered about fun things at school. She held one by each hand and walked home smiling.
location: Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Lunch, midday rest, finishing with yogurt, and taking Mingzhe to school
description: When she got home, Ma Xiulan checked the yogurt maker and saw that the milk had set into a smooth pudding-like texture with a faint milky aroma. She was delighted. She quickly made tomato and egg noodles, had lunch with the two children, urged them to take a nap, and went to lie down in her own room as well. When she woke up at 1:30 p.m., she went to the kitchen, took out the yogurt maker's inner pot, gently stirred it to confirm it was silky, mixed in the prepared strawberry pieces and honey, and tasted it — the sweetness and tartness were just right. It had finally succeeded, and she put it in the refrigerator to chill with satisfaction. Then she woke the children, told Mingzhe to walk to school on his own, and walked him to the intersection.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Finishing embroidery and cleaning the living room.
description: In the afternoon, Yuxin did not go to kindergarten and stayed home with her mother. Ma Xiulan took out the custom-made twin lotus pillowcase, carefully trimmed the loose threads on the back at the desk, and ironed the pillowcase smooth with an iron over a damp towel. After confirming it was perfect, she stuck a note with the delivery address on the cloth bag. When she finished, she let her daughter play by herself and took the opportunity to clean up the toys, snack bags, and newspapers scattered on the living room coffee table. She wiped down the table and TV cabinet, swept and mopped the floor, and the living room looked brand new.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare dinner and video call with eldest sister
description: While her daughter watched cartoons, Ma Xiulan went into the kitchen, cut the pork belly into pieces and blanched them, peeled and roll-cut the potatoes, and washed the spinach. Then she received a video call from her eldest sister Li Xiuyun. The two chatted about what to wear to the wedding tomorrow. Ma Xiulan said her floral dress had become a bit tight, and her sister suggested she wear a navy blue skirt with a white chiffon top, which would be elegant and appropriate. After hanging up, she prepared the braising seasonings and started making braised pork.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner and tasting homemade yogurt
description: Husband Ma Zhiqiang and eldest son Mingxuan arrived home one after another, and the whole family sat around the dining table. Ma Xiulan brought out braised pork with potatoes, then took out the strawberry yogurt she had successfully made today, and smilingly asked everyone to try it. The children cheered and each drank a cup to the last drop. Mingzhe said it was so delicious he wanted more tomorrow, and Xinxin also drank it all. Old Ma tasted it and praised that it tasted as good as what was sold in the supermarket. Ma Xiulan felt sweeter than honey inside.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Helping with homework and preparing for tomorrow's wedding
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan asked her husband to take Yuxin out to play, while she supervised Mingzhe and Mingxuan doing homework in the living room, flipping through the clothes to wear for tomorrow's wedding while checking their homework. Finding wrong answers on Mingzhe's math test paper, she patiently pointed to the problems and explained until the child understood.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Ironing clothes and preparing red envelopes
description: After the children finished their homework, Ma Xiulan had them pack their schoolbags. She went to the bedroom, took out the shirts that her husband and two sons would wear tomorrow, set up the ironing board, and used a steam iron to press the clothes until they were crisp. After hanging them up, she took her wallet from the bedside table, counted out 500 yuan into a red envelope, and tucked it under the bag she would take tomorrow.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Trying on tomorrow's outfit
description: Ma Xiulan closed the bedroom door, first tried on the floral dress, and found it was indeed tight at the waist, so she changed back into a navy blue knee-length skirt with a white chiffon blouse, twirled in front of the mirror, found it simple and elegant, and satisfied, hung the outfit on the clothes rack, ready to wear the next day.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Urge the children to wash up.
description: Ma Xiulan urged the three children to brush their teeth and wash their faces and get ready for bed. Seeing that they had all obediently gone into the bathroom, she went to the balcony to bring in the clothes that had been drying all day, folded them one by one, and put them back in the wardrobe.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Kitchen cleaning and preparation for tomorrow's breakfast
description: After the children had fallen asleep, Ma Xiulan washed the dinner dishes and chopsticks, wiped down the stove, and tied up the garbage bag to take out the next morning. She put the rice and water for the next day's breakfast into the rice cooker, set the timer, and got ready for an early start.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Couple's evening chat and safety check
description: Ma Xiulan sat down next to her husband and talked about the day's experiences: successfully learning the craft from Chunmei, finishing the embroidery, and preparing everything for the wedding. Ma Zhiqiang praised her for her hard work and reminded her that the whole family should be in good spirits tomorrow to go to the wedding feast. The two got up together; Ma Xiulan checked the gas in the kitchen and the windows in the living room, while her husband checked the front door and the balcony door.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Relaxation before bed and falling asleep
description: After lying down and turning off the light, Ma Xiulan took a deep breath and slowly exhaled, silently reviewing in her mind: the yogurt had finally succeeded, the embroidery was smoothly finished, and everything was ready for the wedding—she felt a full sense of accomplishment. Carrying expectations for the next day, she soon fell into a sweet sleep.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning exercise
description: At 6:30 in the morning, sunlight streamed into the room through the gap in the curtains. After waking up, Ma Xiulan did gentle stretches in bed to loosen her sore right shoulder. Then she washed up briefly, put on her sneakers, and went for a brisk walk around the residential compound. In the neighborhood she met Grandpa Liu walking his dog and greeted him. She also noticed roses newly blooming in the flowerbed, and with today’s wedding on her mind, her pace was slightly quicker than usual.
location: Lianxiangyuan Residential Community, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare and enjoy breakfast
description: After exercising and returning home, Ma Xiulan took out the yogurt she had made the night before from the fridge. The three children immediately gathered around when they smelled it. She gave each of them a bowl and also brought out heated large steamed buns. The children ate without looking up, and her youngest son, Zhezhe, clamored that he wanted it again tomorrow. Her husband, Ma Zhiqiang, tasted it and nodded in approval. Ma Xiulan was delighted and decided to make yogurt twice a week from now on.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, Lianxiang Garden Community, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Changing clothes and getting ready to go out
description: After breakfast, Ma Xiulan changed into the plain-colored skirt she had ironed the night before and straightened the collars of her two sons' shirts. She put the twin lotus pillowcases she had made the day before into a cloth bag and placed it in a conspicuous spot in the entryway, telling her eldest son Mingxuan that if Aunt Liu Fang called in the afternoon, he should let her know the pillowcases were in the cloth bag by the door. Then she took the spare key, knocked on her neighbor Wang Guilan's door, and asked her to look after the house for the day.
location: The home in Lianxiangyuan Residential Community, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and the neighbor’s doorway.

name: Going to parents' home and taking a taxi to a dinner
description: Before departure, Ma Xiulan suggested visiting her parents first. The family of four walked 15 minutes to her parents' home at 45 Shengli Street. Her parents were very happy to see the grandchildren, and the children were affectionate with their maternal grandparents for a while. Ma Xiulan told her parents that today they were going to Hedong to attend a wedding and would come to see them in the evening. At 8:30, she called a taxi with her phone in front of her parents' home, and the family of four got in. On the way, she took out the red envelope containing 300 yuan in cash and checked it again, urging her husband Zhiqiang not to drink too much at the wedding banquet because he had to drive the next day. After about 55 minutes, the taxi arrived at the hotel.
location: From 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin to Tianjin R&F Wanda Vista Hotel, Bawei Road, Hedong District, Tianjin

name: Attending a wedding banquet
description: After arriving at the Tianjin Fuli Wanda Vista Hotel, Ma Xiulan's family checked in and handed over red envelopes, and were led to a table near the front. She chatted with a few sisters-in-law at the same table, topics involving the children's midterm exam scores and vegetable prices. After the banquet began, she noticed the sweet and sour pork ribs on the table looked good, and after tasting them, secretly felt they were not as good as her own. She was also attracted by the embroidered napkins under the plates, carefully observed the new stitching, and thought about using it for clients' pillowcases in the future. During the meal, her husband Zhiqiang was pulled away by a distant relative to toast, and when he came back with a red face, Ma Xiulan quickly handed him hangover tea and scolded him in a low voice. After eating quietly, her two sons played a hand-clapping game with a strange little boy, and she often turned back to look after them. As the wedding banquet drew to a close, Ma Xiulan said goodbye to relatives and asked a relative to take a family photo at the hotel entrance, with the hotel's grand main gate as the background. Then she took her family for a ten-minute walk around the front square to help digest the food.
location: Banquet hall and entrance square of Tianjin R&F Wanda Vista Hotel, Bawei Road, Hedong District, Tianjin

name: Returned home, rested, and settled accounts.
description: At one in the afternoon, the family hailed a taxi on the roadside to return to Jinghai. Shortly after getting in, the children leaned against the windows and dozed off. Ma Xiulan looked out the window, calculated the day's expenses, and felt a pang of reluctance. About 55 minutes later, they arrived home. She changed into loungewear, pulled her husband over to the sofa in the living room, and went over the accounts: a red envelope of 300 yuan and round-trip taxi fare of 80 yuan. She picked up a pen and wrote 300 yuan for the wedding red envelope under the "social visits" column and 80 yuan under "transportation" in the ledger. She sighed that they had spent nearly 400 yuan at once and would need to be more frugal next month, but she also understood that keeping in touch with relatives was the bond that held family ties together, and this was not money to save on.
location: Living room at home, Lianxiang Garden Residential Community, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Process handmade orders and contact customers
description: After keeping accounts, Ma Xiulan used the leftover fabric from making pillowcases to practice the new embroidery stitch she had seen at the morning wedding banquet, embroidering a small pattern, which both practiced her skills and relaxed her. Around 3:30 in the afternoon, Aunt Liu Fang called. Following her morning instructions, Mingxuan told Aunt Liu that the pillowcase was in the cloth bag in the hallway. Ma Xiulan took the phone and chatted with Aunt Liu Fang, sharing inspiration for the new stitch, and they agreed to talk in detail next time. Liu Fang said she would come over to pick up the pillowcase, and the matter was settled smoothly.
location: Living room at home, Lianxiang Garden Residential Community, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare and enjoy dinner
description: When it was time to make dinner, Ma Xiulan put on an apron and went into the kitchen. Since lunch at the wedding banquet had been greasy, she planned to make light noodles with gravy for dinner. She took cucumbers, tomatoes, eggs, and last night's leftover braised beef from the refrigerator to prepare dinner for the family. Around six o'clock, dinner was served. The steaming noodles with gravy, cucumber shreds, and garlic cloves were especially delicious to the family. While eating, she asked the children about their homework and reminded her husband to drive carefully tomorrow. The family sat around the table, and the day's fatigue melted away in the aroma of the noodles.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, Lianxiang Garden Community, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Courtyard care and photography
description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan went as usual to the small garden in the backyard to look at the flowers. To her delight, she found that the tightly closed flower buds from yesterday had grown rounder today, about to bloom. She hurried back inside to get her phone, adjusted the lighting, and carefully took several photos of the buds, recording the eve of this life blooming.
location: Small garden in the backyard of Lianxiangyuan Community, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family leisure and homework tutoring
