description: Back in the house, Ma Xiulan helped her daughter Xinxin with drawing while watching her son Zhezhe do homework, occasionally correcting his posture. Her husband Zhiqiang watched the TV news in the living room. After a while, she took out her phone, sent the photos of the flower buds she had just taken to the family WeChat group, and chatted with her friend Chunmei about what she had seen at the wedding.
location: Living room and other rooms at home, Lianxiangyuan Community, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening wash-up checks and handover with the neighbor.
description: After urging the children to wash up and go to bed, Ma Xiulan began tidying the house. Before bed, she and her husband habitually checked all the doors and windows to make sure they were locked. Then she knocked on the door of Wang Guilan across the hall, retrieved the spare key, and thanked her for helping look after the house.
location: The home in Lianxiangyuan Residential Community, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and the neighbor’s doorway.

name: Before-bed communication and deep breathing
description: Lying in bed with the lights off, Ma Xiulan and her husband lay side by side and took a few deep breaths together. With her eyes closed, scenes from the day flashed through her mind: the dishes at the wedding banquet, the stitching on the embroidered napkins, chatting with relatives, and the expense of nearly 400 yuan. She said softly to her husband that although spending the money stung a little, seeing the whole family together warmed her heart.
location: Master bedroom in the home at Lianxiangyuan Residential Community, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Falling asleep
description: After reviewing the fulfilling day, Ma Xiulan, listening to her husband's steady breathing, felt secure and content, and gradually drifted off to sleep, ready to welcome a new day.
location: Master bedroom in the home at Lianxiangyuan Residential Community, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Morning shoulder and neck stretching and brisk walking along the corridor
description: Waking up in the early morning, because she had sat for a long time at yesterday's wedding and talked at length with relatives, her shoulders and neck were noticeably sore and stiff. Leaning against the headboard, she slowly turned her neck and raised her arms to stretch and loosen up. Then she moved to the eaves of the building's corridor and walked briskly back and forth in the light rain for about twenty minutes. Raindrops occasionally fell on her face; the air was fresh and refreshing. She broke into a slight sweat, and the fatigue was greatly relieved.
location: Master bedroom at home and under the corridor eaves of the apartment building, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare and enjoy breakfast
description: While the children were still sleeping soundly, she alone heated the leftover millet porridge from last night in the kitchen, fried five eggs, and ate them with the newly pickled radish strips. After the meal, she left the remaining porridge and eggs warming in the pot so the children could serve themselves when they got up.
location: Kitchen and dining room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Cleaning up the kitchen and preparing yogurt ingredients.
description: Wash the breakfast bowls and chopsticks, and wipe the stove until it shines. Take out the yogurt starter powder given by Chunmei from the refrigerator, thoroughly wash two large glass jars and several small glass bottles, and turn them upside down in a draining basket for later use.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Making yogurt (boiling the milk, fermenting, and bottling it to keep warm).
description: Following the method Chunmei taught, she poured two cartons of pure milk into a small milk pot and simmered over low heat, stirring all the while to prevent sticking. Once small bubbles appeared, she turned off the heat and let it cool until it was not hot to the touch. Meanwhile, she woke the children for breakfast. After the milk had cooled, she added the yogurt culture powder and stirred it well, then divided it into glass bottles, wrapped them tightly in a clean small blanket, tucked them into a corner of the living room sofa, and pressed a cushion on top to keep them warm. Xinxin curiously asked about it, and she told her they could enjoy the homemade yogurt in the afternoon.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Supervising children's studies and picking vegetables in the courtyard
description: After the children finished breakfast, she arranged for Xuanxuan and Zhezhe to do their homework and Xinxin to read picture books. Taking advantage of a break in the rain, she put on rain boots and went to the vegetable garden. She picked the lush spinach and fresh green onions, rinsed off the soil under the tap, and wrapped them into two bundles with old newspaper.
location: Home courtyard at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Practice new embroidery stitches
description: She found the diagram of the chain stitch technique she remembered from yesterday's wedding banquet in her sewing box. She stretched a piece of scrap fabric onto an embroidery hoop and tried it stitch by stitch. This stitch tests the evenness of thread tension. After repeated practice, she gradually got the hang of it and felt delighted.
location: Sofa in the living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare a simple lunch together with the children
description: Near noon, she led the children into the kitchen together. Xuanxuan helped peel garlic, Zhezhe washed the tomatoes, and Xinxin set out the small bowls. Ma Xiulan stir-fried tomatoes and eggs and made a cold cucumber salad from the cucumbers she had brought back from her parents' home.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Lunch and catching up with family
description: The whole family sat around the table to enjoy lunch. The dishes were simple, but the atmosphere was lively. Xuanxuan had a big appetite and ate two bowls; Zhezhe gestured excitedly while describing a cartoon; Xinxin chatted about funny kindergarten moments with food in her mouth. Looking at her three children, Ma Xiulan felt deeply warmed.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Midday rest and waiting for the yogurt to ferment
description: After cleaning up following the meal, she felt tired and took a nap of about half an hour on the living room sofa. The first thing she did after waking was check the yogurt bottle; finding it still warm, she felt much more at ease.
location: Sofa in the living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pack yogurt into portions and prepare small gifts for guests
description: The yogurt fermented successfully. When opened, it has a rich milky aroma and a smooth, tender, sweet-and-sour taste. She carefully divided it into small glass jars, leaving some for the children as an afternoon snack, and prepared three extra portions as gifts. The washed spinach and scallions were also packed in clean plastic bags.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Give a small gift to neighbor Sister Wang
description: Put on a jacket and knocked on the door of Wang Guilan, the neighbor across the hall, to give her a bottle of homemade yogurt and a small bunch of spinach. Sister Wang happily accepted it, praised the craftsmanship, and gave back five free-range eggs for the children to supplement their nutrition.
location: The home of Wang Guilan, across from No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Cycling to parents’ home.
description: Put the eggs given by Sister Wang back at home, told the children to behave, then rode the old bicycle with yogurt and vegetables in the basket, heading toward Shengli Avenue amid the fresh air after the rain.
location: En route from 156 Jingwen Road to 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Visit parents and share homemade yogurt
description: When she arrived at her parents' home, her mother Li Xiuying tasted the yogurt and was full of praise, saying it had a pure taste with no artificial creamer flavor. Her father Ma Jianguo, as usual, asked whether the security door at their home was locked; Ma Xiulan smiled and said that she always checked it before bed every night.
location: Parents' home, 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Purchase yogurt ingredients and check the pickled vegetables
description: After leaving her parents' home, she first went to Wutong Commune Market to buy ten bags of pure milk, then went to Jingbai Supermarket to choose new yogurt starter powder and several small glass jars. On the way, she stopped by Shufen's supermarket to confirm that the pickled vegetables she had left there were still selling steadily on the shelves, and was relieved.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jingbai Supermarket, and Shufen's Supermarket in Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Returning home, tidying up, and preparing dinner
description: Returning home, the children were already playing noisily together. She quickly tied on an apron, made scrambled eggs with tomatoes using the free-range eggs Sister Wang had given her, and took out some meat to thaw, planning to make stir-fried shredded potatoes with minced pork.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The whole family had dinner together.
description: The dinner dishes were stir-fried tomatoes and eggs, minced pork with shredded potatoes, and smashed cucumber, served with hot congee. The family sat around and ate, and each had a small cup of the newly made yogurt. The children all said it was more delicious than store-bought yogurt, and Ma Xiulan was delighted.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Supervise homework and clean up the kitchen
description: After dinner, she arranged for Xuanxuan and Zhezhe to do their homework, while Xinxin played with dolls by herself. Ma Xiulan quickly washed the dishes, wiped down the counter, put away the newly bought milk and yogurt starter powder, and kept reminding Zhezhe to focus on his math problems.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Parent-child time and handicraft exchange.
description: She bathed Xinxin, changed her into pajamas, and told her two bedtime stories to lull her to sleep. Then she checked the homework of Xuanxuan and Zhezhe and urged them to pack their schoolbags. Back in the master bedroom, she sent photos of the newly learned chain stitch embroidery technique and the finished yogurt to the sisters' group chat with Chunmei and Xiuqin to share her joy.
location: Living room and master bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Before-bed safety check and greeting to her husband.
description: She sent a WeChat message to her husband Zhiqiang, asking where he was and telling him not to drive at night and to be safe. Then, holding a water cup, she started from the kitchen and checked one by one: the balcony windows, the living room, and the two locks on the front door, confirming that all were locked.
location: Various rooms of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pre-sleep relaxation and daily review
description: Go back to bed, turn off the overhead light, keep only the bedside lamp, close my eyes, and take several deep breaths. I think back on the busy but fulfilling day: the homemade yogurt turned out well and was shared with family and friends, the children ate happily, the family was warm and harmonious, and my heart feels grounded and content, full of energy for the new week ahead.
location: Master bedroom of the home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning shoulder and neck stretches
description: At 6:30 in the morning, Ma Xiulan woke up in the master bedroom. She deliberately spent a few minutes slowly moving her neck and shoulders in bed, reminding herself to arrange her embroidery work sensibly today so that she wouldn't forget to rest again.
location: Master bedroom of the home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning walk and conversation.
description: Ma Xiulan was power walking in the street park when she ran into her neighbor Zhang Shufen. The two exchanged tips on making homemade yogurt thick, and Zhang Shufen shared a refrigeration trick. They agreed to make strawberry sauce to pour over yogurt together next week.
location: Street park at the intersection of Shengli Street and Dongfanghong Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare breakfast and take the children to school.
description: After returning home from the walk, Ma Xiulan hurried into the kitchen, brought out the pre-set millet porridge, heated the steamed buns, boiled the eggs, and woke the three children. Mingxuan set his own alarm and washed up; Zhezhe stayed in bed and had to be urged twice; Xinxin was helped by her mother to get dressed and have her little braids tied. After the family finished a hot breakfast, Ma Xiulan rode her bicycle to first take Zhezhe to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, telling him to listen carefully in class, and then took Xinxin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, kissing her daughter before leaving. Mingxuan rode his bike to school by himself.
location: From home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street) and Huakang First Kindergarten

name: Vegetable market shopping and delivery preparation
description: After dropping off the children, Ma Xiulan rode her bicycle first to the Wutong Commune vegetable market. At the familiar stall run by Sun Guifang, she bought fresh baby bok choy, cucumbers, and tomatoes, and Aunt Sun threw in an extra bunch of cilantro. Then she went to Jingbai Supermarket and bought a carton of pure milk and a bag of flour. Back home, she sorted the vegetables into the refrigerator, then took the ironed twin-lotus embroidered pillowcases from the wardrobe, carefully wrapped them in cotton cloth, and put them into a tote bag in preparation for delivering the order.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jingbai Supermarket, Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu; then returned to No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, her home.

name: Deliver the embroidery and negotiate new orders.
description: Ma Xiulan walked to Liu Fang's home on Victory Street and unfolded the twin lotus pillowcase in person. Liu Fang was full of praise for the embroidery and immediately transferred 120 yuan via WeChat. Then Liu Fang introduced her neighbor Wang Juan, who also wanted to custom-order embroidered congratulatory gifts. After a phone call on the spot, Ma Xiulan and Wang Juan added each other on WeChat and agreed to send patterns later for selection and discuss sizes and prices.
location: Liu Fang's home, 76 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Visiting parents
description: After leaving Liu Fang's house, Ma Xiulan walked to her parents' home carrying homemade yogurt. Her mother was picking over chives, so she brought a small stool over and chatted while helping pick them, sharing the joy of having just received a new order. Her father tasted the yogurt and praised it as smoother than her mother's. Both parents were happy for their daughter. Ma Xiulan stayed and chatted for over half an hour, helped them tidy the yard, and then left.
location: Parents' home, 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Lunch and midday rest
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan quickly cooked a bowl of hot noodle soup with the baby bok choy and tomatoes she had bought that morning, and ate it with pickled vegetables. Feeling tired, she spread a blanket on the sofa and dozed for more than half an hour to recharge for the afternoon.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Embroidery practice and meal preparation
description: After waking from her afternoon nap feeling refreshed, Ma Xiulan took out her embroidery hoop to practice the chain stitch she had learned yesterday. Combining it with basic stitches, she tried embroidering a small piece of interlocking lotus pattern, thinking about how to incorporate the new stitch into the gift order. Seeing that it was about time, she went to the kitchen, took out the pork tenderloin to thaw, washed and put away the tomatoes and potatoes, and prepared the ingredients for dinner.
location: Living room and kitchen of home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Pick up the child from school
description: At three in the afternoon, Ma Xiulan rode her bicycle and arrived at the entrance of Huakang First Kindergarten on time to pick up Xinxin. Her daughter ran into her arms holding an origami bunny, chattering all the way about the new origami tricks the teacher taught. Then she rode to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up Zhezhe. Zhezhe walked out with his classmates and simply said 'not bad' when asked about the exam. The three of them rode home together.
location: Set out from 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, passed Huakang First Kindergarten and Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street), then returned home

name: Supervising homework and tending the garden
description: As soon as she got home, Ma Xiulan had Zhezhe go into the room to do homework, while Xinxin drew on the living room coffee table. She moved a small stool into the yard and found that the second rose bud had swelled a bit more, with a new millet-grain-sized bud sprouting beside it. Delighted, she took a photo and sent it to the family group with the caption 'The main force is coming soon.' Then she applied diluted cake fertilizer to several rose bushes and watered them thoroughly.
location: The courtyard and living room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Helping children with homework
description: After watering the flowers and going back inside, Ma Xiulan found that Zhezhe had made several mistakes in his math homework. She patiently explained them to him and had him redo them. Xinxin drew a little kitten wearing a bow beside her, held up the drawing and asked if it looked like the little spotted cat in the yard, and Ma Xiulan praised her warmly.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare dinner and have a family meal.
description: Ma Xiulan put on an apron and skillfully made sweet and sour pork tenderloin, scrambled eggs with tomatoes, and garlic stir-fried lettuce. The sweet and sour aroma drifting from the kitchen made Xinxin call out how good it smelled. After Mingxuan came home, the whole family sat down to eat. Zhezhe told a funny story about a classmate tripping, making everyone laugh. Xinxin scooped egg mixed into rice with a small spoon and ate with food all over her mouth. Ma Xiulan asked Mingxuan about school, and he simply answered, “Not bad.” Watching the children eat so happily, she felt very content.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Cleaning the kitchen and doing laundry
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan let the children watch TV while she quickly cleared the table, washed the dishes, wiped down the stove, sorted the family's dirty clothes and loaded them into the washing machine, then mopped the living room floor. Seeing the tidy home filled her with contentment.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Remind to wash up and read bedtime stories.
description: Ma Xiulan urged the three children to wash up. Mingxuan and ZheZhe handled it themselves, and she focused on helping XinXin take a bath and change into cute pajamas. Then she leaned against the headboard and read the picture book "Little Rabbit Tom" to XinXin. After XinXin fell asleep, she quietly got out of bed to check the two older children's homework and sign it.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Phone call between husband and wife and safety check
description: After the children were all asleep, Ma Xiulan made a WeChat video call to her husband Ma Zhiqiang, who was driving a truck away from home. She asked where he was and whether he was eating well, and repeatedly urged him to rest more while driving at night. After hanging up, she checked the kitchen window and the front door lock as usual, and only felt relieved after confirming everything was secure.
location: Bedroom and kitchen at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Washing up, reflecting, and going to sleep
description: After washing up and changing into her pajamas, Ma Xiulan lay down and sent her husband a few voice messages sharing the good news of the smooth delivery and the new order today. He was happy for her. After turning off the light, she thought of the budding Chinese rose and the customer's praise, feeling that life was becoming more and more promising, and fell asleep with a smile.
location: Master bedroom of the home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning exercise and admiring flowers.
description: At 6:30 in the morning, Ma Xiulan woke up on time. First, she gently turned her neck at the bedside and did five minutes of shoulder and neck stretches, feeling relaxed all over. Then she put on a thin cardigan and walked to the yard full of anticipation to check the swollen flower buds from the previous day. Next, she briskly walked along Jingwen Road for twenty minutes, breathing in the fresh air with the scent of dew. She got home at 7:10 and was surprised to find that the largest bud had bloomed into a pink-and-white rose with morning dew. She immediately bent down to admire it closely, filled with joy.
location: Home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and Jingwen Road

name: Recording flowers blooming and family sharing
description: Ma Xiulan excitedly went back into the house to get her phone and snapped more than a dozen photos and a short video of the newly blooming rose. She chose the most beautiful one and sent it to the WeChat group 'Happy Family' with the message, 'It's blooming! The first flower in our little garden has bloomed!' Her husband Ma Zhiqiang quickly sent a red envelope with the note 'Buy something nice for our flower fairy,' and the children also liked it one by one. Her daughter Ma Yuxin even sent a voice message saying, 'Mom, the flower is so pretty!' Xiulan carefully picked the flower and placed it in a clear glass cup filled with water in the living room, filling the whole room with spring.
location: The yard and living room of the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family breakfast and warm interaction
description: At 7:40, Ma Xiulan put on her apron, heated the pork and cabbage buns steamed yesterday, cooked millet porridge, prepared boiled eggs for everyone, and cut a plate of apples. She knocked on her son Xuanxuan's door one by one, then walked into Zhezhe and Xinxin's room and gently woke them, urging them to wash up and change clothes. At 8:10, the family of four sat around the dining table. Xiulan peeled an egg for Xinxin while unveiling the flower-bloom surprise; Zhezhe answered first, "The flower has bloomed!" and Xinxin cheered along. During the meal, she reminded Xuanxuan to ride carefully and told Zhezhe to bring his red scarf, their conversation full of smiles.
location: Kitchen, dining room, and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Send ZheZhe and XinXin to school
description: At 8:40, Ma Xiulan rode her electric bicycle, first taking her daughter Ma Yuxin to Huakang First Kindergarten. She watched as the teacher led her into the classroom, then rode about seven minutes with her son Ma Mingzhe to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School. Zhe Zhe jumped off the bike, waved, and ran into the school gate.
location: Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District

name: Embroidery order communication
description: At exactly nine o'clock, Ma Xiulan made a cup of flower tea, sat on the living room sofa, and sent a WeChat voice message to her client Wang Juan. The two chatted happily, and Wang Juan described in detail the pattern she wanted: Mandarin Ducks Playing in Water, a pair of mandarin ducks nestled under lotus leaves, with blooming lotus flowers dotting the water. As she listened, Xiulan thought about color combinations and stitching techniques, and also sent photos of her earlier embroidery works of twin lotus flowers and peonies. Wang Juan repeatedly praised her superb craftsmanship. The two preliminarily agreed on a size of about 40 cm by 40 cm and a price of 300 yuan, and agreed to look at an embroidery sample next week.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Buy Dragon Boat Festival ingredients at the vegetable market
description: After hanging up, Ma Xiulan was in a great mood. She picked up her shopping bag and walked to the Wutong Commune Vegetable Market. At Sun Guifang's dried goods stall, she skillfully chose glutinous rice, candied dates, and red bean paste. Sun Guifang also grabbed an extra handful of dried osmanthus and gave it to her, smiling, “If you put some of this in the zongzi, it'll be fragrant!” Xiulan smiled and thanked her. Then at Old Zhao's grocery store she bought 100 cotton strings for tying zongzi, and smelled the fresh aroma of zongzi leaves, so she also bought three bundles.

participant.name: Sun Guifang
participant.relation: Friend who is a vendor at the vegetable market

location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning housework and embroidery planning
description: Back at home, Ma Xiulan sorted and stored the Dragon Boat Festival supplies she had bought. Then she swept up fallen leaves in the courtyard, pulled out weeds beside the roses, vacuumed the living room and bedroom floors, and put the accumulated dirty clothes into the washing machine. At 11:30, taking a break from housework, she leaned back on the sofa, took out her embroidery hoop to practice chain stitch, and at the same time sketched out in her mind the color scheme for 'Mandarin Ducks Playing in Water,' pondering which silk threads could best express the layers of the mandarin ducks' feathers.
location: The yard and living room of the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Simple lunch and rest.
description: At noon, Ma Xiulan made herself a bowl of tomato and egg noodles with gravy, prepared with egg, wood ear mushrooms, day lily flowers, and cilantro. After the meal, she leaned on the sofa and scrolled through her phone for a while. Seeing many friends on Moments posting photos of flowers, she felt warm at heart. At 12:40, she lay down in bed for a half-hour nap to refresh herself.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Soaking ingredients and sharing embroidery skills
description: At 1:10 p.m., Ma Xiulan got up, went into the kitchen, rinsed the glutinous rice clean, soaked it in a large basin of water, and soaked the bamboo leaves in another large basin. Then she took out the mop and thoroughly cleaned the kitchen and dining room floors, and folded the dried clothes and put them back in each person's wardrobe. At 2:10, she sat down on the sofa, shared the morning photo of the Chinese rose in the handicrafts exchange group, with the caption 'Seeing the flowers bloom in the morning makes me feel the whole day is especially wonderful.' Sister Xiuqin and Aunt Wu all praised it. Xiulan continued practicing chain stitch and asked Sister Xiuqin for advice on techniques for creating layering in embroidering mandarin duck wings.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Picking up the children and supermarket shopping
description: At 2:50, Ma Xiulan changed into a clean floral shirt and walked to Huakang First Kindergarten, chatting with familiar parents while waiting. When she saw her daughter Ma Yuxin bouncing out with a small backpack, she smiled and stepped forward to take her hand. On the way, she stopped at the nearby Jingbai Supermarket and bought a pack of discounted tissues, a bottle of dish soap, and a pack of the milk tablets Xinxin loved. Then she rode her electric bike with Xinxin to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, and a few minutes later saw her son Ma Mingzhe walking out of the school gate chatting with his classmates.
location: Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jingbai Supermarket, Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu; Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District.

name: Help Zhezhe with his homework
description: After getting home, Ma Xiulan had her daughter Ma Yuxin draw pictures in the living room, while she sat at the dining table tutoring her son Ma Mingzhe in math homework and Chinese character dictation. Whenever ZheZhe got stuck, she explained patiently over and over until he understood.
location: At the dining table in the living room of her home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family time before and after dinner
description: At five o'clock, Ma Xiulan put on an apron and started to prepare dinner. She cut the thawed pork tenderloin into strips and marinated it, then deftly washed and cut the tomatoes and lettuce. At 5:30, her eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, came home by bike. The children watched cartoons in the living room, and bursts of laughter came from the room. At exactly six o'clock, sweet-and-sour pork tenderloin, tomato scrambled eggs, and stir-fried lettuce with garlic were served. The whole family sat around the table, and Xiulan shared two pieces of good news: the flowers had bloomed that morning, and she had received an embroidery order. The children all praised in unison, “Mom, you're amazing!” After the meal, she washed the dishes and cleaned up the kitchen, then took down the dry clothes from the balcony, folded them, and put them into the wardrobe by category.
location: Kitchen, dining room, living room, and bedroom in the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Parent-child companionship and homework checking
description: At 7:20, Ma Xiulan urged her daughter Ma Yuxin to take a bath and change into pajamas. At 8:00, she took out The Little Prince, leaned by Xinxin's small bed, and told a bedtime story in a gentle voice. At 8:20, she gently closed the book, turned off the desk lamp, and kissed her forehead. Then she went to the study, carefully checked Ma Mingzhe's math homework and Ma Mingxuan's English dictation, and after confirming they were correct, solemnly signed her name.
location: Bedroom and study at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Video call and going to bed
description: At 8:20, Ma Xiulan returned to the master bedroom and made a WeChat video call to her husband Ma Zhiqiang. She excitedly shared that the first rose had bloomed, that she had put it in a glass in the living room, and that she had accepted a 300-yuan embroidery order. Zhiqiang was taking a break at a service area. Hearing this, he was happy for her and kept praising her, saying, 'Wife, you are amazing!' He also reminded her not to overwork herself. After hanging up, she went to the courtyard and, by the moonlight, looked closely at the faded rose and the buds beside it, full of anticipation. At 9:10 she washed up, did her skincare routine, and changed into cotton pajamas. At 9:30 she lay in bed and called Zhiqiang again to revisit the topic of the flowers. At 10:45 they did five minutes of deep breathing together. At 10:55 she checked the gas and doors and windows, turned off the lights, and went to bed, quickly falling asleep with a sense of satisfaction.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; master bedroom, courtyard, and bathroom at home

name: Morning exercise and walk
description: She woke up at 6:20 in the morning and first did ten minutes of shoulder and neck stretches in bed, focusing on loosening the neck that had become stiff from the previous day's embroidery. Then she put on her walking shoes, briskly walked a lap around the neighborhood, went out through the south gate, and walked along the Jingwen Road sidewalk toward the Jingbai Supermarket and back. It was cloudy with a pleasant breeze. Passing Jingbai Supermarket, she smelled the aroma of jianbing but did not buy any, thinking of going home to prepare breakfast for the family.
location: Yuzhou Zunfu Residential Community, Chaoyang Subdistrict, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and the service road along Jingwen Road.

name: Prepare and enjoy breakfast
description: Together with her husband Ma Zhiqiang, she prepared breakfast: millet congee, steamed buns, cucumber salad with pickled vegetables, and tea eggs. Then she went upstairs to wake the three children. Her little daughter Xinxin was reluctant to get up, so she coaxed her out of bed with her favorite tea eggs and cucumber salad. The family of five sat around the dining table for breakfast. Zhe Zhe mentioned that his math teacher praised him. Xuan Xuan finished eating and rode his bike to school first, calling out as he left, Mom, I'm going. Xiulan reminded Zhe Zhe to be safe in P.E. class, filled Xinxin's bottle with warm water, and Zhiqiang said he wasn't taking the truck out today and could help run errands.
location: Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu Residential Community, Chaoyang Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Taking the two children to school.
description: The eldest son, Xuanxuan, had already ridden his bike to No. 1 Middle School by himself. Xiulan went out holding Zhezhe's and Xinxin's hands. She first took Xinxin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten and watched her enter, then walked ten minutes to No. 3 Primary School, straightened Zhezhe's red scarf, reminded him to wait at the school gate after school, and watched him walk through the school gate.
location: Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten in Jinghai District, Tianjin, and Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School

name: Stop by the vegetable market on the way
description: After dropping off the kids, I walked to the Wutong Commune vegetable market. At Aunt Sun Guifang's stall I bought tender Chinese chives, two celtuces, and a piece of soft tofu. Aunt Sun also threw in a bunch of scallions.

participant.name: Sun Guifang
participant.relation: An acquaintance who runs a stall at the vegetable market

location: Wutong Commune Market, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Check on the consignment status of the pickled vegetables.
description: On the way home, she went into Jingbai Supermarket downstairs and talked with Zhang Shufen about the sales of her pickled vegetables. She learned that two jars of the spicy cabbage she had made were sold in two days, and customers praised its authentic flavor. Xiulan gave Shufen a jar of newly pickled sweet garlic to try selling. The two chatted for a while in front of the shelves; then, because the store had more customers, Xiulan bought a bottle of soy sauce and went home.

participant.name: Zhang Shufen
participant.relation: Friend who is a supermarket owner

location: Jingbai Supermarket, ground-floor shops of Yuzhou Zunfu Community, Chaoyang Subdistrict, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Household chores and ingredient preparation.
description: Her husband helped take down the range hood filter, and Xiulan scrubbed it carefully with hot water and dish soap. Then she soaked the glutinous rice and bamboo leaves separately, preparing to make zongzi for the Dragon Boat Festival. She also pulled out the summer quilts and the children's seasonal clothes to wash and dry. While tidying the living room, she turned on the radio to listen to Tianjin Crosstalk Radio and wiped the furniture amid the laughter, feeling happy.
location: Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu Residential Community, Chaoyang Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Lunch for the couple
description: At noon, only Xiulan and Zhiqiang were there. They reheated the leftover porridge and steamed buns from the morning and stir-fried a plate of eggs with the tender chives bought that morning. As they ate, they chatted about the pickled vegetable business. Zhiqiang praised Xiulan for being capable, and Xiulan said she wanted to make life a bit more comfortable and was planning to enroll her younger daughter in a dance class.
location: Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu Residential Community, Chaoyang Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Noon break
description: After putting away the dishes and chopsticks, she went back to the bedroom for a half-hour nap, while her husband watched the noon news in the living room and turned down the volume so as not to disturb her.
location: Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu Residential Community, Chaoyang Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Making yogurt and tending the courtyard
description: After the afternoon nap, feeling refreshed, she boiled milk with sugar and light cream using a new recipe, let it cool, stirred in yogurt starter culture, and put it into the yogurt maker to ferment. Then she went to the courtyard to water the transplanted roses and was delighted to see two small buds at the tips of the branches. She took a photo and posted it to the family group chat with the caption: The roses are thoughtful too—they know good things come in pairs. After that, she pulled weeds from the small vegetable garden and loosened the soil.
location: Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu Residential Community, Chaoyang Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Hand embroidery and dinner preparation
description: On the living room sofa, she practiced the chain stitch while working out the color palette for the "Mandarin Ducks Playing in Water" design custom-ordered by her friend Wang Juan. Afterward, she went to the kitchen to prep dinner ingredients in advance: she shredded the pickled cabbage, sliced the pork belly, and soaked wood ear mushrooms and day lily flowers in warm water to get the gravy topping ready for the noodles.
location: Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu Residential Community, Chaoyang Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up children from school and supervise homework.
description: First went to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up her youngest daughter Xinxin. As soon as they met, Xinxin excitedly sang the newly learned 'Little Swallow'. After reuniting, the mother and daughter walked to the gate of No. 3 Primary School and waited for Zhezhe. Zhezhe ran out of the school gate while playfully wrestling with classmates. After returning home, she urged the two to do their homework: Zhezhe did mental math problems, while Xinxin drew pictures with colored pencils beside him.
location: Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Third Primary School of Jinghai District; and Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu Community

name: Prepare and enjoy dinner
description: Xiulan did the cooking, and her husband Zhiqiang helped by peeling garlic and trimming vegetables. Using the tofu and pickled cabbage from lunch, she made pickled cabbage fish, and stir-fried rehydrated wood ear mushrooms, day lily buds, and eggs into a fragrant sauce to go with hand-rolled noodles. The family of five sat together for dinner. Zhiqiang was full of praise for the pickled cabbage fish, and the children ate happily. Xiulan shared the good news that the roses had grown buds, and the whole family was excited.
location: Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu Residential Community, Chaoyang Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Cleaning up the kitchen and preparing for a walk
description: After the meal, Xiulan deftly washed the dishes and wiped the stove, while Zhiqiang wiped the table and swept the floor. She poured several cups of warm water to take out, preparing for the family's evening walk.
location: Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu Residential Community, Chaoyang Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening family walk
description: Xiulan suggested the whole family go downstairs for a walk to help digest the food. The five of them strolled on the neighborhood path, with the two sons chasing and playing, the little daughter riding her small bicycle in the middle, and Xiulan and Zhiqiang walking side by side behind. Seeing the children's smiling faces made them feel grounded, and they decided to go out for a walk every evening when the weather is good.
location: Walking path in the Yuzhou Zunfu residential community, Chaoyang Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening care and homework check.
description: After returning from the walk, she bathed Xinxin and told her the story of the rose in The Little Prince. She checked Zhezhe's math homework, pointed out the wrong problems, and had him correct them. She went to the door of her oldest son Xuanxuan's room, saw him memorizing history, and told him not to stay up too late. She took out the fermented yogurt and put it in the fridge.
location: Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu Residential Community, Chaoyang Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Chatting with her husband and interacting with the family group
description: After settling the children, the couple sat on the living room sofa to rest. Xiulan replied to Liu Chunmei's message in the handicraft group about the progress of the embroidery pattern and invited her to come over on Saturday to see the sample fabric. She shared a photo of rose buds in the family group and got likes and praise from her elder sister and younger sister.
location: Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu Residential Community, Chaoyang Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Washing up, skincare, and bedtime checks
description: After a hot shower, she carefully applied face cream and hand cream to care for her hands roughened by housework. Zhiqiang had already lain down. Xiulan turned off the living room light, habitually checked the doors, windows, and gas valve, and after confirming safety returned to the bedroom.
location: Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu Residential Community, Chaoyang Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Deep breathing and reflection before bed
description: Lying beside her husband, she closed her eyes in the dark, took a few deep breaths, and reviewed the day's gains: pickled vegetables found a new market, the roses were budding, the new batch of yogurt fermented successfully, and the whole family walked together. Feeling full in her heart, she drifted off to sleep with contentment.
location: Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu Residential Community, Chaoyang Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning shoulder and neck stretches
description: Waking up in the early morning, I lay in bed and did about 10 minutes of shoulder and neck stretches, crossing my hands behind my neck and slowly moving my joints to ease the long-standing soreness. My body felt much lighter.
location: Master bedroom of the home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning walk and courtyard chores
description: She took advantage of the cool morning to walk briskly along the tree-lined Jingwen Road to the intersection of Shengli Street and then turned back. On the way she met a neighbor and a sanitation worker and felt the vitality of the early morning. After returning home, she first went to the courtyard to check the roses and found that the new buds had grown bigger, so she took photos and sent them to the family group to share the joy. Then she entered the kitchen, put on an apron, cooked millet porridge, washed and cut small tomatoes for later, and prepared breakfast for the family.
location: Near No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, as well as the courtyard and kitchen

name: Family breakfast.
description: She brought the cooked millet porridge, tomato and egg pancakes, and pickled cucumbers to the table, then woke her husband Ma Zhiqiang and the three children. The family sat together for breakfast, chatting as they ate. Xiulan mentioned that she needed to buy reed leaves and do the accounts today, and her husband urged her not to overwork herself.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Take the second son and the younger daughter to school.
description: Rode the electric bicycle to first take the second son, Ma Mingzhe, to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School. After urging him to listen carefully in class, she watched him walk into the school gate. Then she took the youngest daughter, Ma Yuxin, to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, handed her directly to the teacher, and told her to cover herself with the small blanket during nap time.
location: Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School and Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Buying fresh reed leaves at the food market.
description: She rode her electric bike to Wutong Commune vegetable market, found the stall of the familiar Aunt Sun Guifang, and selected fresh, green, tender reed leaves for making zongzi. Satisfied with the fragrant smell, she paid, asked for an extra handful, and planned to wash them again at home.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin (Sun Guifang's stall)

name: Prepared all the ingredients for Dragon Boat Festival zongzi.
description: Back in the home kitchen, she soaked fresh reed leaves and dried bamboo leaves together in warm water, carefully scrubbed each leaf clean, stacked them, and covered them. Then she patiently removed the pits from the candied dates, rolled the red bean paste into small balls, rinsed and drained the pre-soaked glutinous rice, and placed all the zongzi ingredients in separate bowls. Looking at the ingredients on the cutting board, she felt very at ease.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Lunch and reviewing family accounts
description: She simply had lunch alone, pairing leftover tomato-egg pancakes with hot noodle soup. After the meal, she washed the dishes and chopsticks. After a short rest, she took out the account book, calculator, and receipts, and carefully calculated the household expenses from May 1 to May 28. She added up the grocery money, daily necessities, and children's allowance item by item, and listed the 580 yuan for replacing the security door separately as a safety fund, planning to save 50 yuan from the grocery money each month. In the end, she found that apart from the large expenditure, daily expenses were well controlled, with a surplus of 360 yuan at the end of the month, and she felt relieved.
location: Dining room and living room of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Short nap during lunch break
description: After calculating the accounts, she felt tired, lay down on the bed in the bedroom, set an alarm, and rested with her eyes closed. Although she didn't fall completely asleep, she dozed for a while and felt much more refreshed.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Designing a new embroidery order and testing stitches
description: In the living room, she took out the embroidery materials and, following the "Mandarin Ducks Playing in Water" sketch that Wang Juan had approved, tried to embroider lotus flowers and water ripples on scrap fabric using chain stitch and long-and-short stitch. Feeling that the result looked good, she shot a video and sent it to Wang Juan to ask whether the plan of adding lotus flowers was suitable. While waiting for the reply, she continued to practice for a while.
location: The living room and balcony at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Picking up the children from school and checking on the pickled vegetable situation on the way.
description: Rode the electric bike first to Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up youngest daughter Ma Yuxin, then went to Jingbai Supermarket in Yuzhou Zunfu Community, found the owner Zhang Shufen to ask about the trial sales of the sweet garlic samples delivered the day before. She learned that after tasting them, some people gave good feedback, and her own spicy cabbage was also popular. She was very pleased and bought a bottle of aromatic vinegar. Then she hurried to Jinghai No. 3 Primary School to pick up her second son, Ma Mingzhe. The siblings chatted and laughed on the back seat as they went home together.
location: Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jingbai Supermarket, Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu; near Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School

name: Supervising the children's homework and communicating about embroidery
description: In the living room at home, she let Xinxin draw by herself and urged ZheZhe to do his math homework, while she continued practicing lotus embroidery by their side. She received a reply from Wang Juan, who approved the lotus design and agreed to meet on Monday. Xiulan happily replied to confirm and felt that her needlework was getting more and more rewarding.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare dinner
description: She put on an apron and went into the kitchen, shredded the soaked black fungus, beat eggs, and made the children's favorite scrambled eggs with tomatoes and stir-fried baby bok choy, while steaming rice in the rice cooker.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The whole family had dinner together.
description: When the eldest son came home from school, the whole family was finally together. She served tomato scrambled eggs, stir-fried baby bok choy, and the leftover fish with pickled cabbage from last night, eating and chatting as they went. Xiulan shared the good news that the trial sales of sweet garlic had received positive feedback and that the accounts had a surplus, and the children cheered happily.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Cleaning the kitchen and doing housework
description: After the meal, she quickly cleared the dishes, wiped the table, and washed the dishes, cleaned the kitchen, then mopped the living room floor, folded the dried clothes, and put them into the wardrobe.
location: Kitchen and living room of the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening family walk
description: Called the children downstairs to walk in the community garden to help digestion. Her husband did not join because he was tired from driving. She walked slowly for 20 minutes on the open ground in the residential area. Pointing to the northern sky, she taught Xinxin to recognize the Big Dipper. The children looked up and chattered with endless questions, and the eldest son also followed behind.
location: Residential community garden near 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Child washing up, storytelling, and homework check
description: First I bathed Xinxin and told her a bedtime story about roses to help her fall asleep. Then I checked Zhezhe's math homework, found a word problem with an incorrect equation, and patiently explained it to him. Then I went to Xuanxuan's room to remind him about his school supplies for tomorrow and signed his English dictation notebook.
location: Bathroom and children's bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Personal washing up and bedtime review
description: After settling the children, she washed up carefully and applied moisturizer. Lying in bed, she picked up her phone and chatted softly with her husband, who was reading the news beside her, telling him that the Dragon Boat Festival zongzi ingredients were ready, the embroidery order was confirmed, and the accounts were in order, so he could rest assured. Then she posted the rose photos she had taken during the day and the neighborhood night scene to her Moments, with a caption remarking that life was busy but full of surprises. Seeing the likes and comments, she felt delighted inside.
location: Master bedroom and bathroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Take deep breaths, relax, and prepare for sleep
description: Before going to sleep, she still felt some tightness in her shoulders, so she did a few minutes of deep breathing and gradually relaxed. She silently reviewed the day in her mind: the accounts were in order, the embroidery had progressed, the Dragon Boat Festival ingredients were ready, and tomorrow the whole family could make zongzi. Feeling the day had been especially solid and satisfying, she fell asleep peacefully.
location: Master bedroom of the home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning stretching and walking
description: The sky was overcast. Ma Xiulan woke up before the alarm went off. Feeling the tightness in her shoulders and neck, she did her usual shoulder and neck stretches in bed, each movement slow and deliberate. After stretching, she changed into sneakers and went to Jingwen Road Neighborhood Park for a brisk walk. Quite a few people were doing morning exercises in the park. She walked along the path for 25 minutes, and when she passed the rose bed, she thought of the blooming roses at home and felt happy.
location: Street park along Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare breakfast and enjoy breakfast with the family
description: On the way home from a walk, she met her neighbor Wang Guilan at the entrance of the stairwell, and the two chatted about pickled vegetables. After returning home, Ma Xiulan washed her face, cooked millet porridge in the kitchen, and made hand-grabbed flatbread with lettuce and fried eggs. She woke the three children, Ma Mingxuan, Ma Mingzhe, and Ma Yuxin, and the family sat around the table eating breakfast. Xiulan reminded her youngest daughter Xinxin that there was a sachet competition today, and Xinxin excitedly sped up her eating.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Take the children to school.
description: After breakfast, the eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, rode his bike to school by himself. Ma Xiulan rode her electric bicycle with Ma Mingzhe on the back seat and Ma Yuxin standing on the front footboard. She first took Zhezhe to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School and watched him go through the school gate, then took Xinxin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten and told her to behave and wait for her mother to pick her up.
location: Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street) and Huakang First Kindergarten (Jingwen Road), Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Go home, rest up, and prepare supplies for the activity
description: After dropping off the children and returning home, Ma Xiulan first changed the water for the soaked bamboo leaves, then took out the sewing kit, scissors, and camera for making sachets and checked them one by one to make sure everything was perfect. Thinking about how happy Xinxin would be making sachets later, she felt warm inside.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Participated in the community Dragon Boat Festival parent-child activity (sachet-sewing competition) and won a prize.
description: Ma Xiulan walked to the Jingwen Road Community Service Center carrying a cloth bag. Passing by Zhang Shufen's supermarket, she went in to buy a pack of wet wipes and noticed that the stock of pickled vegetables she had placed on consignment was running low, so she talked with Zhang Shufen about restocking. Entering the multi-function hall, the event had been festively arranged, with long tables covered in fabric, silk thread, and mugwort. Xiulan arranged seats for the three children and personally taught her youngest daughter Xinxin how to thread a needle and sew a sachet. After the competition, the host announced that Xinxin's sachet had won the 'Cutest Award.' The judges praised it for being full of childlike fun and love despite the uneven stitches. Xinxin went on stage to receive a prize of a bag of colorful embroidery thread.
location: Multi-function hall, Jingwen Road Community Service Center, No. 58 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and Zhang Shufen Supermarket (No. 56 Jingwen Road)

name: Returning home after the event and sharing the good news of winning with her husband
description: After the event, Ma Xiulan took photos of Xinxin and the sachet with her camera. On the way home, Xinxin was still hopping and jumping while holding up the prize. Halfway home, Xiulan called her husband Ma Zhiqiang to tell him the good news that Xinxin had won an award, and her husband kept praising her over the phone. Afterwards, Xiulan sent the photos to the family group chat and received many likes.
location: Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (on the way from the community service center back home).

name: Prepare lunch and take care of the children
description: After getting home, Ma Xiulan put away Xinxin's prize and started preparing lunch. At noon she made noodles with tomato and egg sauce, simple and appetizing. After the meal, she made her two sons do homework while she rested with her youngest daughter on the sofa watching cartoons.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Noon break
description: At nearly eleven, Ma Xiulan urged the children to take their afternoon nap and lay down herself in the master bedroom. The morning's activities had not been tiring, but she was happy, and since tomorrow was the Dragon Boat Festival, she closed her eyes and rested quietly to store up energy for the afternoon.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Take Zhezhe to school, buy ingredients, and check the pickled vegetables.
description: At one o'clock, Ma Xiulan woke up Ma Mingzhe and took him on her electric bike to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School. Afterwards, she went to the Wutong Commune Food Market and bought millet, oats, red beans, and plain milk at Aunt Sun Guifang's stall. She chatted with Aunt Sun about making zongzi for the Dragon Boat Festival tomorrow. After leaving the market, she also stopped by Zhang Shufen's supermarket and saw that spicy pickled cabbage and sweet garlic were selling well. Sister Zhang said someone had reserved two jin of sweet garlic, and Xiulan agreed to restock after the holiday.
location: Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Tianjin (Shengli South Street), Wutong Commune Vegetable Market (Wutong Commune), Zhang Shufen Supermarket (No. 56 Jingwen Road).

name: Going Home to Organize the Purchased Items
description: Ma Xiulan rode her bike home, sorted and put away the millet, oats, red beans, and milk she had bought. Seeing Xinxin's little sachet hanging in the living room, she felt delighted. After catching her breath and drinking some water, she got ready to go out and pick up the children.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick the children up from school.
description: Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike first to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up Ma Yuxin. Xinxin happily showed off that her teacher also praised her colorful embroidery threads. Then they went together to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up Ma Mingzhe. The two children chattered and talked about fun things at school on the way.
location: Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten (Jingwen Road), Jinghai District, Tianjin, and Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street)

name: Supervising homework and preparing dinner.
description: After arriving home, Ma Xiulan had the children wash their hands and urged them to do their homework. The eldest son was self-disciplined, the second son needed his sitting posture corrected, and the youngest daughter was doodling a sachet nearby. At 4:30, Xiulan started preparing dinner, making garlic stir-fried lettuce, moo shu pork, and stir-fried seasonal vegetables to add festive cheer for the upcoming Dragon Boat Festival.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Dinner, and after dinner prepare the ingredients for making zongzi tomorrow.
description: The family sat around eating dinner, and Xinxin told the story of winning the award again, with a harmonious atmosphere. Ma Xiulan told the children to come home early after school tomorrow for the Dragon Boat Festival to wrap zongzi. After dinner, she cleared the dishes and wiped the stove, then prepared for wrapping zongzi the next day: she changed the water for the soaking bamboo leaves, rinsed the glutinous rice, drained it, mixed in a little alkali, and put it in the fridge; she cut off the hard stems of the bamboo leaves, and washed and soaked them one by one. The kitchen was filled with a fresh fragrance, and she hummed "Jasmine Flower" softly.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Took the children for a walk in the neighborhood.
description: The weather cooled down, so Ma Xiulan called the three children to take a walk in the community garden to aid digestion. Xinxin played by the flower bed holding colorful embroidery threads, while her two older brothers chatted nearby. Xiulan quietly followed behind, enjoying the evening breeze and the children's laughter.
location: Garden at Shangcheng Huayuan Community, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Bathed the children, read them stories, and put them to bed.
description: After returning home from the walk, Ma Xiulan gave Xinxin a bath and told her the story of The Little Prince to help her fall asleep. Then she urged her two sons to brush their teeth and wash their faces, checked Zhezhe's math homework, and signed it. By the time all three children were settled, it was nearly nine o'clock.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Personal grooming and skincare
description: The children were all asleep. Ma Xiulan washed her face carefully in the bathroom, applied skincare products, and massaged her skin thoroughly, looking at her weary but content self in the mirror.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Video call with husband
description: After skincare, Ma Xiulan called her husband Ma Zhiqiang via video call. Her husband was resting at a service area and would be home by tomorrow afternoon for the Dragon Boat Festival. Xiulan shared the news of Xinxin winning an award, the pickled vegetable orders, and the Dragon Boat Festival preparations. Her husband praised her for being capable and said the family could feel at ease only when she was at home.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Keeping accounts and planning tomorrow.
description: After hanging up the phone, Ma Xiulan took out her ledger and wrote down, item by item, today's spending on groceries and milk. She then planned tomorrow's Dragon Boat Festival schedule: get up early to wrap zongzi, wait for her husband to come home at noon, take the children to her parents' home in the afternoon to deliver zongzi, and give a few to Sister Wang and Zhang Shufen.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Relaxation before bed and falling asleep
description: After Ma Xiulan lay down, she kept only the bedside lamp on, closed her eyes, and did 5 minutes of deep breathing to relax. Warm scenes from the day flashed through her mind: Xinxin's pride at receiving the award, the satisfaction of shopping at the vegetable market, the warmth of the family sitting together. Feeling grounded and warm, with anticipation for the Dragon Boat Festival, she soon fell asleep.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning activities and breakfast
description: On the morning of the Dragon Boat Festival, Ma Xiulan woke up at 6:40 and stretched her shoulders and neck in the master bedroom: shoulder rolls 5 times, looking up 5 times, and side stretches 3 times on each side. She then went downstairs and walked briskly for 15 minutes in the Shengxinyuan residential complex, enjoying the fresh scent of zongzi leaves and earth. After returning home, she quickly washed up and changed into house clothes, then went into the kitchen to rinse the zongzi leaves and set out glutinous rice, candied dates, and red bean paste filling. At 7:10, she woke her husband Ma Zhiqiang and the three children, and prepared warm milk, glutinous rice strips, and mung bean cakes for each as a simple breakfast.
location: At home in Shengxinyuan Community, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Preparing zongzi and wrapping zongzi together
description: After breakfast, Ma Xiulan took her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin and spread a plastic sheet on the stone table in the yard, arranging the zongzi materials in order. At exactly 8 o'clock, her mother Li Xiuying and neighbor Wang Guilan arrived. The three sat around the table, chatting and laughing while making zongzi. Ma Xiulan was skillful: she rolled reed leaves into a funnel, filled them with rice and dates, pressed the contents firm, folded the leaves, and tied them. Her mother was responsible for filling the rice and stuffing, while Wang Guilan handed over the strings. In less than an hour, they made more than forty candied-date zongzi and red-bean-paste zongzi, neatly arranged in a basin.
location: The home courtyard at Shengxinyuan Community, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Boiling zongzi, hanging mugwort, and folding paper boats with the kids
description: After wrapping the zongzi, Ma Xiulan lit a fire in the firewood stove in the yard and boiled the zongzi in a large iron pot. After the water came to a boil, she turned the heat down and simmered slowly, and the fragrance of zongzi filled the air. Meanwhile, she and her husband Ma Zhiqiang tied wormwood and peach branches together with red string and hung them on the lintel of the front door to pray for peace. Then she went into the living room, taught her second son Ma Mingzhe to fold ingot-shaped paper boats, and folded a few small paper boats for her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin, drawing wavy lines on them. The children kept laughing cheerfully.
location: At the home and around the courtyard at Shengxinyuan Community, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Distributing zongzi to neighbors.
description: After the zongzi were cooked and taken out, at 11 o'clock Ma Xiulan first put 10 hot zongzi on a plate and took them to Zhang Shufen's supermarket diagonally opposite, wishing her a healthy Dragon Boat Festival. Zhang Shufen gave her a box of mung bean cakes in return. Then she packed 12 zongzi in a bag and walked to her childhood friend Liu Chunmei's home (120 Shengli Street). Liu Chunmei happily accepted them and wanted her to stay, but Ma Xiulan declined because she was concerned about the zongzi at home and returned.
location: Zhang Shufen's supermarket at 154 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and Liu Chunmei's home at 120 Shengli Street.

name: Received return gift and tidied up before lunch
description: When Ma Xiulan reached her doorstep, she ran into her neighbor Wang Guilan, who brought six fresh eggs from her own hens as a return gift, and she accepted them with a smile. After going inside, she put away the mung bean cakes and eggs, then laid out the cooked zongzi on a large plate, ready to taste them at noon.
location: At home in Shengxinyuan Community, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Simple Dragon Boat Festival lunch and midday rest
description: At noon, Ma Xiulan reheated last night’s leftover garlic lettuce and moo shu pork, and cut up several freshly cooked zongzi and salted duck eggs. The family sat around the table for lunch. The children thought the honey-date zongzi was sweet, and her husband praised the zongzi for being soft and sticky. After the meal, she arranged for the children to rest, coaxed her little daughter Ma Yuxin to sleep in bed for half an hour, and also closed her eyes to rest; her second son Ma Mingzhe read in the living room, and her husband leaned on the sofa scrolling on his phone.
location: At home in Shengxinyuan Community, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Prepare dinner ingredients and pre-trip preparations.
description: After the afternoon nap, Ma Xiulan began preparing for the Dragon Boat Festival family dinner: washing cucumbers, slicing the braised pork in soy sauce made last night into thin pieces, and preparing the gravy for the noodles, cutting up wood ear mushrooms and day lily buds. Meanwhile, her second son Ma Mingzhe had already put on his shoes and was holding a paper boat, eager to go. She checked the camera battery, stuffed wipes and a water bottle into her bag, and prepared for the afternoon trip to the canal to float paper boats.
location: At home in Shengxinyuan Community, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Floating paper boats with kids by the canal.
description: At 2 p.m., the family walked to the bank of the South Canal (the waterside platform about 200 meters south of the intersection of Jingwen Road and Xinye Road). Ma Zhiqiang took Ma Mingzhe to the bank and launched paper boats into the water, watching them drift away with the waves as Ma Mingzhe cheered happily. Ma Xiulan held Ma Yuxin's hand and stood behind them, using her camera to capture the warm backs of the two. The family enjoyed parent-child time by the river.
location: Waterfront platform on the east side of the canal levee, about 200 meters south of the intersection of Jingwen Road and Xinye Road, on the bank of the South Canal, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Return home and free time
description: After walking home from the canal, the children each had free time: Ma Mingzhe watched cartoons, Ma Yuxin played with a teddy bear plush, and Ma Mingxuan listened to music in his room. Ma Xiulan drank water and rested, looked through the photos on her camera, and picked a few to send to the family group chat.
location: At home in Shengxinyuan Community, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Prepare the Dragon Boat Festival family dinner
description: Once the children were quiet, Ma Xiulan and her husband Ma Zhiqiang focused on preparing dinner. She boiled water and cooked noodles, put the braised pork and cucumber salad on the table, and re-steamed the zongzi. Ma Zhiqiang poured wine and juice, and poured himself realgar wine. Ma Xiulan made the sauce and poured it over the drained noodles. A sumptuous Dragon Boat Festival family dinner was ready.
location: At home in Shengxinyuan Community, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Dragon Boat Festival Family Dinner
description: The family banquet began. On the table were honey-date zongzi, red bean paste zongzi, noodle with gravy sauce, cucumber salad, and braised pork in soy sauce. The whole family sat together, laughing and chatting. Ma Mingzhe excitedly told interesting stories about sailing paper boats, and Ma Yuxin showed off her award-winning embroidery thread. Ma Zhiqiang drank realgar wine and praised his wife's cooking skills, and Ma Xiulan felt warm in her heart.
location: At home in Shengxinyuan Community, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Post-meal cleanup and evening walk.
description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan began clearing the dishes, and her eldest son Ma Mingxuan took the initiative to help carry leftover dishes and wipe the table. She soaked and washed the dishes and organized the trash. Afterward, the whole family went downstairs and took a walk in the Shengxinyuan Community. The evening breeze was cool. Ma Xiulan chatted with her husband about June plans, reminded the children about summer vacation precautions, and enjoyed the tranquility of the festive evening.
location: Shengxinyuan Community, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Washing the children up, telling stories, and putting them to bed
description: After returning from the walk, Ma Xiulan arranged for the children to wash up. She bathed her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin, changed her into pajamas, carried her to bed, and told her the story The Legend of the Dragon Boat Festival. She talked about Qu Yuan throwing himself into the river and the origin of dragon boat racing, and Ma Yuxin soon fell asleep. Then she went to check whether Ma Mingzhe had washed up and urged him to go to bed.
location: At home in Shengxinyuan Community, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Reconciling May side income and planning for June
description: After the children went to bed, Ma Xiulan sat at the dining table and calculated May's sideline income: 48 yuan from consigned pickles at Shufen Supermarket, 117 yuan from a stall at the handicraft market, and 120 yuan from embroidery orders, for a total income of 285 yuan. After deducting 70 yuan in costs, net income was 215 yuan. Adding the 200 yuan social security subsidy, the total was 415 yuan, and the education reserve fund exceeded 10,000 yuan, reaching 10,150 yuan. She wrote "May handicrafts have started, keep going!" and set a June goal: increase pickle production to push monthly net income above 300 yuan, complete the "Mandarin Ducks Playing in Water" embroidery order, and continue working on the small courtyard garden. Then she checked the pickle jars in the kitchen and planned to buy fresh cabbage and garlic.
location: At home in Shengxinyuan Community, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Organizing Family Photos and Videos
description: Ma Xiulan opened her laptop, imported all the May family photos from the camera memory card, especially the ones taken by the canal, into the "May 2025" folder, sorted them into subfolders by date, and set a family photo as the desktop wallpaper. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang came over to look through them together, and the two of them viewed the photos and remarked on what a fulfilling and wonderful Dragon Boat Festival it had been.
location: At home in Shengxinyuan Community, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Personal washing, skincare, and preparing for bed
description: Ma Xiulan went to the bathroom to wash up, carefully washing her face, patting on toner, and applying moisturizer. Seeing her energetic reflection in the mirror, she remarked that the Dragon Boat Festival had ended perfectly. Then she changed into her pajamas and went to the master bedroom, where she chatted with her husband Ma Zhiqiang about plans for tomorrow. Ma Zhiqiang suggested taking a day off after the Dragon Boat Festival to take her into town for a stroll, and she felt warm inside.
location: At home in Shengxinyuan Community, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Relaxation before bed and falling asleep
description: Before turning off the light, Ma Xiulan and her husband sat side by side on the edge of the bed for a five-minute deep-breathing relaxation. She closed her eyes and felt the calm after a busy day, her heart full of fulfillment, joy, and anticipation for June. Then she whispered good night, turned off the bedside lamp, and soon fell asleep.
location: At home in Shengxinyuan Community, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Morning walk, courtyard roses, and delivery of pickled radish
description: Got up at 5:50, washed up briefly, did shoulder and neck stretches in the yard, then walked briskly for 20 minutes along the tree-lined Jingwen Road. Got home at 6:20 and found the pink roses in the southwest corner of the courtyard in full bloom. Took a photo and sent it to the "Our Home" WeChat group, receiving a like from her husband and voice replies from the children. Then she carried 10 jars of Sichuan pepper sauce pickled radish out of the storage room, labeled them "Sister Ma's Sichuan Pepper Sauce Pickled Radish", and rode her e-bike to Zhang Shufen Convenience Supermarket diagonally across the street (168 Jingwen Road). She handed the pickled radish to Zhang Shufen, who said the 6 jars from last week had sold very well and suggested trying a garlic-flavored version next time; they agreed that she would bring samples next time. After finishing the delivery, she rode home.
location: Zhang Shufen Convenience Store, 156 Jingwen Road and 168 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing and enjoying breakfast with the family.
description: After returning home, she prepared breakfast in the kitchen: simmered multigrain porridge in a clay pot (millet, brown rice, and red beans), took out homemade yogurt, fried sunny-side-up eggs, toasted bread, and sliced ham. When the fragrance of the porridge filled the air, she first woke up her eldest son Xuanxuan, then woke up Zhezhe and Xinxin who were reluctant to get out of bed. Hearing it was Children's Day, the three children got up excitedly and washed up. The family had breakfast together in the dining room, with foods including multigrain porridge, yogurt, fried eggs, bread, and ham — a balanced meal.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Packing for the amusement park
description: After breakfast, she got the children dressed and had them put on their little water bottles. She filled her canvas bag with apples, cherry tomatoes, cookies, cheese sticks, wet wipes, tissues, band-aids, and mosquito repellent. She changed into a comfortable cotton dress and sneakers and took 200 yuan in cash from her coin purse for backup.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Walked to Jinghai Town Amusement Park
description: The family of four set out from home and walked along Jingwen Road toward Jinghai Town Amusement Park. Ma Xiulan held Xinxin's hand, while Xuanxuan and Zhezhe played as they walked. The air along the way was fresh. They arrived at the amusement park after about 15 minutes, where the Ferris wheel and inflatable castle were visible in the distance.
location: Along the route from Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to the Jinghai Town Amusement Park at 18 Jingyi Street.

name: Enjoy a fun day at Jinghai Town Amusement Park
description: At the amusement park, they bought tickets with cash and entered. Xinxin chose the carousel first, while Ma Xiulan filmed from the side; Zhezhe and Xuanxuan played bumper cars, the two brothers laughing nonstop. After that, they queued together to ride the mini roller coaster, which was just thrilling enough. During a break, they bought a bubble machine for Xinxin (15 yuan), and she happily blew bubbles. Ma Xiulan rested in the shade, watching the children play and enjoying the festive day.
location: Jinghai Town Amusement Park, No. 18 Jingyi Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Lunch at the amusement park food street
description: After the children felt hungry from playing, she took them to the food stalls on the west side of the amusement park. She bought a rolled liangpi (8 yuan) for Xinxin, grilled cold noodles (10 yuan each) for Xuanxuan and Zhezhe, and soy milk (2 yuan) and a scallion pancake (2 yuan) for herself. The family sat together on a roadside bench, eating and sharing the happy moments of the morning.
location: Dining area on the west side of Jinghai Town Amusement Park, 18 Jingyi Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Returning to the Jingwen Road home
