description: After the filling meal, the children were a little drowsy. She put away the bubble machine and walked the children home. Once home, she made them wash their hands and faces and go to their rooms to prepare for their afternoon naps.
location: Along the route from No. 18 Jingyi Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin to No. 156 Jingwen Road, and at home

name: Lunch break and family free time
description: After washing up, Ma Xiulan lay on the bed to rest for about half an hour. Her two sons, full of energy, were playing with LEGO bricks in the living room; Xinxin was blowing bubbles in the yard, her laughter clear and crisp. Half-dozing, Ma Xiulan heard them and felt grounded and happy.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Organize amusement park photos and courtyard work.
description: She turned on the computer, imported the thirty-plus photos taken in the morning into the new folder '2025.06.01 Children's Day', and selected three to have printed the next day. Afterward, she watered the scallions and peppers in the courtyard with Xuanxuan and pulled weeds. Xuanxuan worked very carefully, and mother and son chatted while they worked.
location: Home and courtyard at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Visited parents and shared Children's Day joy
description: She put the multigrain porridge set aside in the morning (in an insulated box) and two bottles of homemade yogurt into a cloth bag, and walked with the children for about 12 minutes to her parents' home at No. 45 Shengli Street. Xinxin showed off her bubble machine, making the elderly laugh heartily. She handed the food to Mother; after tasting the yogurt, Mother was full of praise. She chatted with her parents and told them about the Children's Day plans; Father proudly praised her.
location: At parents' home, 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Return home and prepare a delicious dinner.
description: After saying goodbye to her parents, she walked home with the children. Once home, she let the children watch cartoons, tied on an apron, and went into the kitchen to start preparing dinner: sweet and sour pork tenderloin (Xuanxuan's favorite), scrambled eggs with tomatoes, and cucumber salad—simple and delicious.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Warm family dinner
description: The dishes were served, and the aroma filled the room. The family sat around the dining table, and the children eagerly talked about the fun times at grandma's house that afternoon. Ma Xiulan also shared her experiences at the amusement park and her thoughts on organizing the photos. Under the warm yellow light, laughter continued, warm and harmonious.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Household tidying and evening leisure time.
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan cleared the dishes, wiped the table, and washed the dishes. The children played Chinese chess and drew in the living room. When she finished cleaning up, she sat down on the sofa, replied to messages in the handicraft group, and sent photos to her childhood friend Liu Chunmei to share.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Children's washing and bedtime stories
description: Made sure the children washed up. Helped Xinxin take a bath and put on pajamas, read her the story “The Little Prince,” and she fell asleep listening to it. Checked Xuanxuan’s and Zhezhe’s rooms and reminded them to pack their schoolbags and get ready for school on Monday.
location: Home bathroom and Xinxin's bedroom, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Personal washing up and video call with husband
description: After the children settled down, Ma Xiulan took a hot bath and did her skincare routine. As soon as she lay down on the bed, her husband Ma Zhiqiang called via video. She shared with him funny stories from Children's Day, the sales situation of the sauce radish, photos of the roses, and a video of Xinxin blowing bubbles. Her husband told her to get more rest.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Bookkeeping records and tomorrow's plan.
description: After hanging up the phone, she took out the account book and recorded the day's expenses: amusement park tickets 200 yuan, lunch 28 yuan, bubble machine 15 yuan, total expenditure 243 yuan. Pickled radish income: 10 jars × 28 yuan/jar = 280 yuan; after deducting 15% commission, actual received 238 yuan. Net expenditure 5 yuan. In the notes she wrote down Monday's tasks: print photos, meet Wang Juan to finalize embroidery patterns, and try making a small batch of garlic-flavored pickled radish.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Calling a childhood friend and relaxing before bed
description: Leaning against the headboard, she chatted with her childhood friend Liu Chunmei via WeChat voice for half an hour, shared photos, and agreed to take the children to Nanhu Park in Jinghai District together next week. Afterward, she did deep breathing to relax both mind and body and prepared for sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Go to bed and rest
description: She turned off the bedside lamp, thought back on the fulfilling day, and though tired, felt content. With a smile, she soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Morning preparations for the Dragon Boat Festival and hanging mugwort
description: At dawn, Ma Xiulan woke up naturally. Thinking of the Dragon Boat Festival, she quietly got out of bed and went to the kitchen. She arranged the zongzi she had wrapped the day before using soaked glutinous rice and bamboo leaves into a large iron pot, added cold water to cover the zongzi, and turned the heat to high to start cooking. While the zongzi were cooking, she picked out a few vibrant sprigs from the fresh mugwort she had gathered yesterday, tied them with red string, and hung them on the doorframes of the kitchen and living room. The room immediately filled with a crisp, herbal fragrance, creating a Dragon Boat Festival atmosphere for the children.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Early morning stretching and brisk walking in the courtyard.
description: While the zongzi simmered in the pot, Ma Xiulan walked into the courtyard and stretched in front of the rose bush. She first loosened her shoulders with a 5-minute stretch, feeling that her right shoulder had become much more relaxed since the last acupuncture session. Then she pushed open the courtyard gate and walked briskly for 20 minutes along the tree-lined Jingwen Road in front of her home. The morning air was fresh, and the roadside fried dough stick stall was starting to steam. She took a few deep breaths and felt full of energy for the whole day.
location: The courtyard at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and the tree-lined avenue on Jingwen Road

name: Wake up the children and a warm breakfast.
description: She hurried back to find the whole house filled with the aroma of rice dumplings. Ma Xiulan woke the three children one by one. Fourteen-year-old Xuanxuan woke up as soon as she called and washed up quickly on his own; ten-year-old Zhezhe stayed in bed whining and only got up when she pulled off the quilt; six-year-old Xinxin, the clingiest, rubbed her eyes and wanted her mother to hold her. She helped Xinxin put on the dress with the little duck pattern and urged Zhezhe to wash his face. At the breakfast table, the steaming rice dumplings were the centerpiece, accompanied by boiled eggs, millet porridge made last night, and homemade yogurt. Zhezhe took a taste and said it was a bit sour, and she made a mental note to add some honey next time.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Taking the children to school and buying groceries on the way.
date: Mingzhe's homework notebook was spread open on the dining table, containing the math problems and test papers he had carefully finished, written in neat handwriting.
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan checked Zhezhe's and Xinxin's yellow safety hats and schoolbags, then got on her blue electric bike, with Zhezhe on the back seat and Xinxin standing on the front footboard. She first went to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School on Shengli South Street, watched Zhezhe wave to his classmates and run into the school gate; then rode a few more minutes to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten on the west section of Shengli Avenue, and only felt relieved after seeing Xinxin being taken in by a teacher. On the way back, she stopped by the Wutong Community vegetable market and spent 8 yuan at Aunt Sun's stall to buy fresh cilantro and two tender cucumbers, preparing for the noon cold dish.
location: Tianjin Jinghai District, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School; Tianjin Jinghai District, Shengli Avenue West Section, Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten; Tianjin Jinghai District, Wutong Commune East Gate Vegetable Market.

name: Printing photos and preparing embroidery pattern drafts
description: It was just past 8:30 when she got home. Ma Xiulan didn't stop to rest. She transferred the theme park photos saved on her computer last night to a USB drive, then took out the hand-drawn double lotus embroidery pattern from her sewing box, and carefully sketched the color scheme for "mandarin ducks playing in water" on the white paper beside it, marking the colors and thread numbers with colored pencils. Then she put the USB drive and pattern in her pocket, rode her bike to Songlin Copy Shop on the middle of Shengli Street, handed the three selected photos to the clerk for printing, and agreed to pick them up in half an hour.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Songlin Copy Shop, middle section of Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Visiting her parents to give festival gifts and show care
description: After picking up the printed photos, Ma Xiulan took out a few zongzi she had deliberately saved in the morning and two bottles of homemade yogurt from the bike basket, then rode straight to her parents' home at 45 Shengli Avenue. Her mother beamed the moment she opened the door and saw her. She handed over the zongzi and yogurt and asked about her father's health. Her father was watching the news in the living room, so she took out the blood pressure monitor she had brought and measured it for him: 128/82, as steady as usual. Then she sat down and chatted with her parents about the fun of taking the children to the amusement park for Children's Day the day before. When she mentioned that Xuanxuan drove the bumper cars around recklessly and Xinxin's face was red from the sun but she still didn't want to leave, the old couple rocked with laughter.
location: No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Communicate with client Wang Juan about embroidery sample business.
description: After leaving her parents' house, Ma Xiulan saw that it was almost ten o'clock, so she rode her bike to Wang Juan's residential complex. Wang Juan had already brewed tea and was waiting in the room. She brought out the twin-lotus pattern she had liked before, and Ma Xiulan unrolled her newly drawn color scheme for "Mandarin Ducks Playing in Water": soft pink lotus flowers in gradient silk thread, emerald green lotus leaves using dark and light green, and coffee-colored silk thread to outline the mandarin ducks. Wang Juan loved it at first sight and said repeatedly that it was livelier than the twin-lotus pattern. The two settled the embroidery details and a delivery date ten days later. Wang Juan counted out 100 yuan on the spot as a deposit, and Ma Xiulan felt very pleased.
location: Guyun Sunshine Home, near Shengli Avenue, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Returning home to check on the yogurt and pickled radish preparations
description: On the way home she was in an excellent mood. As soon as she entered, Ma Xiulan opened the refrigerator to check the yogurt she had made yesterday. Scooping it with a spoon, she found it had set smooth and fine, so she took out several clean glass jars, divided the yogurt into them, and prepared them as an afternoon snack for the children. Then she started making a small test batch of pickled radish. Following Zhang Shufen's earlier advice, she weighed out 500 grams of white radish, 30 grams of sugar, 15 grams of salt, 50 ml of white vinegar, and 10 ml of light soy sauce, added minced garlic and chopped chili, jotted down the proportions in her notebook while mixing the dressing, then pickled the radish slices, weighed them down with a heavy object, and left them to absorb the flavor by evening.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Simple lunch and a short midday rest.
description: Eating alone at home, Ma Xiulan made do with a simple lunch. She heated up two leftover zongzi from the morning, made a cold dish with the cilantro and cucumber she bought in the morning, and made a bowl of seaweed egg drop soup. After eating, she leaned back on the sofa for half an hour with her eyes closed to rest and build up energy for the busy afternoon.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Embroidery time by the window
description: Feeling refreshed after her nap, Ma Xiulan took out the embroidery pattern Wang Juan had ordered and a piece of plain white embroidery cloth. By the living room window, she began to sketch the outline, carefully positioning the lotus flower, lotus leaves, and two mandarin ducks and adjusting the density of the composition. Then she threaded a light pink silk thread and, using the most basic chain stitch, first worked along the outline of the lotus seed pattern, feeling the evenness and force of the stitches. Sunlight streamed through the window onto the embroidery fabric, and she felt especially peaceful inside.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Organize photos and share with family
description: Ma Xiulan stopped her sewing and took out the three printed photos again to look at them closely. As she was looking at them, Xuanxuan came home from school at noon to get something. She quickly called her son over to look through the photos together. When Xuanxuan saw the photo of his bumper car colliding with Zhezhe's, he couldn't help laughing. She told Xuanxuan, "When your younger brother and sister get home from school this evening, our whole family will stick the photos into the old album." Xuanxuan nodded in agreement, grabbed his homework notebook, and hurried back to school.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Household chores and radish inspection
description: There was still a while before picking up the children, so Ma Xiulan hung the clothes she had washed that morning on the wire in the yard, then patted the throw pillows on the living room sofa into place. She went to the kitchen, opened the jar of pickled radish, and tasted it. It had already released quite a bit of water, the saltiness was just right, and the garlic aroma was strong enough. Satisfied, she put the lid on and placed it in the refrigerator to absorb the flavor, to serve on the table in the evening.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Picking up children from school and sharing photos
description: At 3 p.m. sharp, Ma Xiulan left home and first went to Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up Xinxin. As soon as Xinxin saw her, she rushed over like a little bird, clutching a sticker given by her teacher and insisting on sticking it on Ma Xiulan's hand. Then she took Xinxin to the gate of the Third Primary School to wait for Zhezhe. Before long, Zhezhe ran out with his schoolbag. Back home, she urged the two children to wash their hands first, then placed the printed photos on the coffee table. Xinxin and Zhezhe immediately crowded around excitedly, pointing at the photos and chattering nonstop, and the house suddenly became lively.
location: Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, West Section of Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin; No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare a hearty dinner
description: Seeing the children look so happy, Ma Xiulan tied on her apron and quickly started preparing dinner. Today she was making the children's favorite sweet-and-sour pork fillet, along with a stir-fried seasonal vegetable and wood ear mushrooms with garlic sauce. She took the garlic-marinated radish she had pickled that morning from the fridge, sliced it thin, arranged it in a flower shape on a plate, and prepared to let everyone taste it. In the kitchen, the spatula flew, and the sweet-sour tang and the aroma of stir-fried dishes soon filled the whole house.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Warm family dinner and pasting photos
description: At dinnertime, the whole family sat around the table. Ma Xiulan brought out the last dish, sweet and sour pork, and urged everyone to start eating, making sure each person tasted the newly pickled garlic radish. Xuanxuan said it was delicious and crunchy, Zhezhe thought it was a bit spicy and gulped down a big glass of water, while Xinxin was attracted to the sweet and sour pork and ate with sauce all over her mouth. After the meal, she took out the old photo album and glue, and the three children immediately crowded around. She carefully pasted three photos onto the empty pages of the album, and the children chattered all at once, recalling what had happened that day. Just then, Zhezhe suddenly leaned close to her ear and whispered, “Mom, when I grow up and earn money, I'll take you to ride that Ferris wheel too.” Ma Xiulan was stunned for a moment, her nose stung and her eyes welled up, and she pulled her son into her arms. Her heart was warm—the day's hard work was all worth it.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Housework and helping the children with homework
description: After clearing away the dishes, Ma Xiulan urged the three children to go wash up. She bathed Xinxin first, then sat by the bed and told the child two stories from The Little Prince until Xinxin fell peacefully asleep. Then she checked Xuanxuan's junior high English homework and Zhezhe's math workbook, corrected a wrong problem, and carefully signed her name as the parent.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Video call with her husband, personal washing and keeping accounts
description: After the children fell asleep, the house became quiet. Ma Xiulan first took a comfortable hot bath, and her whole body relaxed. Just as she lay down on the bed, her husband Ma Zhiqiang, who was driving trucks far away, called via video. Leaning against the headboard, she smiled and shared every bit of today's events: getting photos printed, bringing zongzi to her parents, Wang Juan ordering an embroidery sample and giving a 100-yuan deposit, and Zhezhe's words that moved her deeply. On the other end of the phone, her husband remarked that his son had grown up, and said he had been busy with work these past two days and told her she'd worked hard at home. After chatting for nearly half an hour, they hung up. She took out the small ledger under her pillow and carefully recorded today's expenses: 8 yuan for groceries, 15 yuan for photo printing; income: 100 yuan deposit from Wang Juan. As the pen scratched across the paper, she felt reassured.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pre-sleep stretching and bedtime preparation
description: After finishing the accounts, Ma Xiulan got up and did some pre-bed stretching in front of the bed to relax her lower back, waist, and shoulders. She then ran through tomorrow's plan in her mind: get up early to take the children to school, hurry to make a start on Wang Juan's embroidery pattern in the morning, check how the jar of pickled radish in the fridge was coming along, and think about what the children wanted for dinner... As she thought, she gradually relaxed. She turned off the bedside lamp, took a few deep breaths, felt deeply grounded and content, and fell into a deep sleep at 22:30.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning family time
description: The alarm went off. Ma Xiulan did shoulder and neck stretches in the bedroom. Outside, the sky was overcast, and the forecast said there would be thunderstorms in the afternoon. Then she went to the kitchen to taste a sample of the pickled garlic radish and found the flavor just right. She heated up leftover zongzi and cooked millet porridge. She woke up the three children one by one. Ma Mingxuan washed up on his own, and she focused on urging Ma Mingzhe and Ma Yuxin. At breakfast she encouraged the children: if they behaved well during the summer break, she would take them to Beijing to see Tiananmen and their aunt. The children responded enthusiastically.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Sending the children to school in the rain and the husband's accidental injury
description: At seven o'clock it was raining. Ma Xiulan walked with Ma Mingzhe and Ma Yuxin to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, taking about 10 minutes. After returning home, she received a call from her husband's coworker and learned that Ma Zhiqiang had a tire blowout while driving a short-distance trip in the truck, and his right arm was bruised; he was being brought home. She immediately cleared the sofa, helped her husband lie down, and checked his injuries after the coworker left.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Went to the clinic to get medicine and returned home to treat the injured arm
description: After comforting her husband, Ma Xiulan walked in the rain to the Chaoyang Street Community Health Service Center in Jinghai District. Dr. Wang prescribed anti-inflammatory medicine and medicated plaster. After returning home, she wiped her husband's right arm with warm water, applied the plaster, told him to take the medicine on time, and had him rest in bed.
location: Rear courtyard of the Jinghai Grain Bureau, 16 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (Chaoyang Street Community Health Service Center, Jinghai District).

name: Courtyard drainage and tidying up the house
description: It continued raining. Ma Xiulan checked the yard, brought in the clothes hanging to dry, used an iron hook to clear leaves and debris from the drain to prevent waterlogging, and then used a mop to wipe the wet shoe marks from the living room and bedroom floors.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Indoor cleaning and drawing embroidery patterns
description: Taking advantage of the rainy day when she could not go out, she thoroughly cleaned every room: wiped the furniture, swept and mopped the floor. After tidying up, she took out the "Mandarin Ducks Playing in Water" embroidery hoop meant for Wang Juan, sketched the outlines of mandarin ducks and lotus flowers on plain cotton cloth with a pencil, and planned the color scheme of the embroidery thread.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Simple lunch and midday rest care
description: She cooked tomato and egg noodles, first bringing them to her husband in the bedroom so he could eat slowly with his left hand, then ate her own meal in the kitchen. After clearing the dishes, she leaned on the living room sofa for a 30-minute nap, keeping an eye on her husband.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Focused on embroidery and color selection
description: After a nap, she brewed some tea to refresh herself and began embroidering. She outlined the lotus leaves with chain stitches, then took out a bamboo basket to compare red, yellow, and blue silk threads. Referring to Wang Juan's pattern, she chose the best color scheme and gradually filled in the mandarin ducks.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Picking up children from school and shopping on the way.
description: The rain had stopped, but the ground was still wet. She first went to Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up Ma Yuxin, then stopped by Jingbai Supermarket to buy tissues and dish detergent, where she ran into neighbor Zhang Shufen and chatted for a bit. Then she went to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up Ma Mingzhe, and the three children walked home together, sharing funny school stories on the way.
location: Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Huakang Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jingbai Supermarket, Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu; and Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School on Shengli South Street.

name: Homework guidance and parent-child time.
description: Back home, she arranged for Ma Mingzhe to do homework in his room and Ma Yuxin to draw in the living room. Ma Xiulan tidied up the shopping items and tutored Ma Mingzhe through difficult math problems, patiently explaining.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare a nutritious dinner
description: Considering that her husband needed extra nutrition after being injured, Ma Xiulan cut and blanched pork ribs to stew lotus root soup, and also stir-fried lettuce and took out the pickled garlic radish as a side dish. The kitchen was filled with a delicious aroma.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Warm family dinner
description: After Ma Mingxuan came home from school, the family of five sat around the table. Ma Xiulan set the pork rib soup in front of her husband, and the children took the initiative to put food on their father's plate. The atmosphere was warm. Ma Zhiqiang slowly drank the soup with his left hand.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Post-meal cleanup and changing husband's dressing
description: The children went to watch TV, and Ma Xiulan quickly cleared the dishes and tidied the kitchen. Then she went to the bedroom to change her husband's dressing: removed the old plaster, wiped the area with an iodophor cotton swab, and applied a new plaster.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Discuss purchasing accident insurance
description: After changing the dressing, Ma Xiulan sat by the bed and suggested buying accident insurance for her husband to cover the risks of driving a truck. Her husband was silent at first, but finally agreed to go and ask about it. Ma Xiulan felt much more at ease.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Help the children wash up and go to bed
description: Ma Xiulan bathed Ma Yuxin, told her a bedtime story to help her fall asleep, and checked Ma Mingzhe's and Ma Mingxuan's schoolbags to make sure their textbooks and stationery were ready for the next day.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Personal washing up, bookkeeping, and relaxing before bed.
description: After the children fell asleep, Ma Xiulan took a hot bath. Then she recorded the day's expenses in her account book: medicine, groceries, and daily necessities, and wrote the next day's tasks in her planner (consulting about accident insurance, delivering garlic-flavored radish samples to her neighbor Zhang Shufen). Before bed, she did 10 minutes of stretching, shared color-matching tips in the handicraft group, and chatted on WeChat with her childhood friend Liu Chunmei. Finally, she turned off the light and went to sleep to the sound of drizzling rain.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning wake-up and neck and shoulder stretching.
description: At 6 a.m., after getting up, Ma Xiulan did shoulder and neck stretches to relieve the soreness in her right shoulder. Standing by the bedroom window, she did chest-opening and neck-rotation movements to prepare her body for the day's activities while mentally reviewing her housework plan for the day.
location: Master bedroom of the home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Making yogurt and cooking multigrain porridge
description: Ma Xiulan began making yogurt and cooking multigrain porridge in her home kitchen. She heated pure milk until it came to a slight boil, cooled it, added the starter culture and sugar, divided it into glass bottles, and put them in the rice cooker to ferment. Meanwhile, she rinsed millet and oats and slowly simmered the multigrain porridge over low heat. The kitchen filled with the fragrance of grains, which made her feel at ease.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Wake up the children and prepare breakfast
description: When the porridge was almost ready, Ma Xiulan went upstairs and woke the three children: eldest son Ma Mingxuan, second son Ma Mingzhe, and youngest daughter Ma Yuxin. She helped Xinxin, who was reluctant to get out of bed, get dressed. The whole family sat around the dining table, enjoying the warm multigrain porridge and the baozi and mantou bought last night. Zhezhe praised the porridge for tasting better than yesterday's, which filled her with joy.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Take the children to school.
description: After breakfast, Ma Xiulan told her eldest son Mingxuan to go to school by himself, then rode her electric bike in the light rain to take Mingzhe and Yuxin to school. She first dropped Mingzhe off at Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, then hurried to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to take Yuxin inside, and finally returned home before 8 o'clock.
location: Starting from 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, passing Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street) to Huakang First Kindergarten (near Shengli Street).

name: Tidying the kitchen and changing her husband's dressing
description: After sending the children off and returning home, Ma Xiulan first tidied up the kitchen and the medicine clutter after breakfast, then changed the dressing for her injured husband Ma Zhiqiang. She carefully removed the gauze from his right arm, disinfected it with povidone-iodine, applied a blood-circulation-promoting and stasis-resolving ointment, re-bandaged it, and told him to rest well.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Go out to consult about accident insurance and purchase ingredients
description: Ma Xiulan cycled out. She first went to the community health service center at 16 Jingwen Road to consult Dr. Wang about family accident insurance, and got the insurance company salesperson's contact information and flyer. Then she went to Xingwang Seafood Wholesale Market, bought sweet potatoes and corn at Sun Guifang's stall, and then bought millet and oats at Zhang Shufen's supermarket. Zhang Shufen asked about the pickled radish, and she promised to bring a sample the next day.
location: Community Health Service Center, 16 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, then Xingwang Seafood Wholesale Market, Haitai East Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Returning home to sort ingredients and pickle garlic-flavored radish
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan stored the purchased ingredients by category and immediately began pickling garlic-flavored radish. She sliced the white radish and salted it to draw out the water, then prepared seasonings such as garlic slices, ginger slices, and chili peppers. She mixed them with the radish and sealed the mixture in a glass jar. She tasted a piece; it was crisp and refreshing with a rich garlic flavor, and she felt satisfied.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Deliver samples of pickled radish to neighbor Zhang Shufen.
description: Ma Xiulan packed a small bowl of pickled garlic radish, sealed it with plastic wrap, and delivered it to Zhang Shufen's convenience store diagonally across the street. After tasting it, Zhang Shufen praised it repeatedly, said the flavor was authentic, agreed to a trial sale, and they arranged for Ma Xiulan to bring a large batch tomorrow for consignment.
location: Zhang Shufen Convenience Supermarket near Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Housework and embroidery preparation.
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan washed the clothes the children had changed out of, and then used her spare time to prepare for embroidery. She took out the dudou pattern sent by Zhou Xiuqin, carefully studied the stitching methods, and wound silk thread of various colors onto thread boards, labeling the colors to lay the foundation for starting embroidery the next day.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Had lunch with her husband.
description: At noon, Ma Xiulan reheated the morning's multigrain porridge, paired it with pickled vegetables, and had a simple meal with her husband Ma Zhiqiang. Zhiqiang praised the porridge for being easy on the stomach, and she planned to make corn and sweet potato porridge in the evening. After the meal, she helped Zhiqiang to the living room to rest.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Noon break
description: After a busy morning, Ma Xiulan set an alarm for 1 p.m. and took a nap in the bedroom to regain energy for the afternoon's activities, feeling at ease.
location: Master bedroom of the home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tidying up and preparing afternoon snacks
description: At 1 p.m., after getting up and washing up, Ma Xiulan checked the yogurt she had made in the morning and found it a success, with just the right balance of sweet and sour, so she put the yogurt bottles in the refrigerator to chill. Then she washed the sweet potatoes and corn she had bought that morning and steamed them, preparing an after-school snack for the children.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Handicraft leisure and phone consultation about insurance
description: Ma Xiulan was resting in the living room. She first called the insurance company agent to ask in detail about accident insurance terms and made an appointment to handle it the next day. Then she chatted with her good friend Chunmei on WeChat, shared the success of her pickled radishes, and arranged for Chunmei to come over on the weekend to learn how to make them. She also watched a DIY video on turning an old sweater into a floor mat and saved it.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Making yogurt and fruit snacks
description: Ma Xiulan took the chilled yogurt out of the fridge, washed and diced apples and mangoes, mixed them with yogurt to make a yogurt fruit bowl, and prepared a surprise for the children who were about to get out of school.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the children from school and share fruit snacks
description: At 4 p.m., Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to Huakang First Kindergarten and Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School one after another to pick up Yuxin and Mingzhe. As soon as she entered the door, she brought out yogurt fruit cups, and the children happily grabbed for them. Yuxin got it all over her face; it was a warm and amusing scene.
location: From home to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten (near Shengli Avenue) and Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street), then returned to home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Preparing Dinner and Helping with Homework
description: Ma Xiulan had Mingxuan and Mingzhe, who were doing homework, stay in the living room, while she went into the kitchen to prepare dinner. She cooked corn and sweet potato porridge, stir-fried tomatoes with eggs, made a cucumber salad, and sliced some newly pickled radish peels. The whole family sat together, drinking the warm porridge and sharing the day's experiences.
location: Dining room and kitchen of home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Family evening time and changing the husband's dressing
description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan cleared the dishes and changed the medicine on her husband Ma Zhiqiang's arm again. Then she accompanied the children in watching TV, urged them to finish the remaining homework, and coaxed the sleepy Yuxin to sleep.
location: Living room and children's bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening personal tidying and rest
description: After the children fell asleep, Ma Xiulan returned to the bedroom, reviewed what she had accomplished that day, and planned the next day's schedule: applying for accident insurance, delivering pickled radishes, and starting to embroider a bellyband. She also researched a tutorial on repurposing floor mats, then washed up and fell asleep peacefully around ten o'clock.
location: Master bedroom of the home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Getting up and morning exercise
description: Just as dawn was breaking, Ma Xiulan woke up. She first did a 5-minute shoulder and neck stretch in bed to relieve the stiffness from the night. Then she got up, washed up briefly, changed into light loungewear, and did another 10 minutes of gentle stretching on the living room floor to loosen her body and get ready for the new day.
location: Master bedroom and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing the family breakfast
description: The light came on in the kitchen. She first poured the mixed grains (millet, red beans, and pearl barley) that had been soaked last night into the rice cooker, added water, and cooked congee. Then she took out three eggs and a handful of scallions from the refrigerator, quickly chopped the scallions, mixed in some flour, and prepared to make egg pancakes. The yogurt she had made the day before was just ready, so she took it out and put it in the refrigerator to chill for later.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Wake up the children and have breakfast together
description: Ma Xiulan first pushed open the door of her eldest son Ma Mingxuan's room and gently woke him, then went to wake the two younger ones. She served the children multigrain porridge, gave each a warm egg pancake, and poured each a small bowl of yogurt. Mingxuan ate quietly, put on his backpack, got on his bicycle, and left first. Ma Xiulan urged Mingzhe to eat quickly while peeling an egg for Yuxin.
location: At home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin: all bedrooms and the dining room.

name: Take the second son and the younger daughter to school.
description: Ma Xiulan changed into going-out clothes and handed the children their pre-packed little backpacks. The three went downstairs. She got on the electric bike, with Mingzhe sitting in front and Yuxin behind. They first arrived at the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (about a 10-minute ride). She told Mingzhe to listen carefully in class and watched him walk through the school gate. Then they headed to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten (about a 5-minute ride). She handed Yuxin to the teacher at the gate and watched her skip inside before leaving with peace of mind.
location: Starting from 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, she went successively to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School on Shengli South Street and Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten in Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Change the dressing for her husband and discuss today's schedule.
description: Back home, her husband Ma Zhiqiang had already gotten up and was about to have breakfast. Ma Xiulan first checked the scrape on his right arm from loading and unloading goods the day before yesterday, carefully applied a new medicated plaster, and told him to rest well at home today and not move around too much. She told Ma Zhiqiang that she would go take care of the accident insurance matter this morning, so he could feel at ease.
location: Master bedroom of the home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Handle accident insurance and go to the market to buy groceries
description: Ma Xiulan took 150 yuan in cash and her husband's identity information out of her bag, got on her electric bike and headed straight to the insurance company (about a 10-minute ride). She told the agent that she wanted to buy accident insurance for her husband, who drives a truck. She carefully asked about the coverage, exclusions, and other details. After confirming everything was correct, she filled out the policy and paid the premium. Holding the red policy receipt, she felt much more at ease. On the way back, she rode to Xingwang Vegetable Market (about a 5-minute ride) and bought tender sweet potatoes and fresh corn at the stall of her regular vendor Sun Guifang, then bought a bunch of leafy greens, tomatoes, and a few cucumbers, spending 35 yuan in total. Sun Guifang, as usual, gave her a bunch of scallions.
location: First to the Dadi Insurance office at No. 28 Shengli North Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, then to Xingwang Vegetable Market at No. 18 Xingwang Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Doing housework and preparing embroidery materials.
description: Returning home (about a 15-minute drive), she first put the groceries in the kitchen. Then she started tidying the house: sweeping the floor, wiping tables, and putting away the toys the children had scattered the night before. Next, she put the few pieces of accumulated dirty laundry into the washing machine. After finishing the housework, she sat down on the living room sofa, took out the silk threads for Zhou Xiuqin's bellyband order that she had sorted yesterday, studied the pattern, and began planning where to start embroidering, first practicing a few simple stitches.
location: Living room and kitchen at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare and enjoy lunch
description: Ma Xiulan began to prepare lunch. She reheated the morning's multigrain porridge, sliced a plate of soy-braised beef, and made a cold salad with the newly bought cucumbers and tomatoes. After the two had a simple lunch, Ma Zhiqiang went to the living room to watch the noon news, and Ma Xiulan cleared the dishes.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Midday rest, embroidery, and preparing afternoon snacks.
description: Ma Xiulan leaned against the bed and rested for a while, then opened her phone and scrolled through local Jinghai news and messages in the handicraft group. Seeing a message from Sister Wang saying that the flowers in the courtyard had bloomed, she felt a strong urge to take a good look when watering in the afternoon. After the nap, she felt refreshed. She spread embroidery cloth on the coffee table in the living room, took out needle and thread and an embroidery hoop, and began to embroider small patterns on a bellyband. She embroidered very attentively. An hour later, the outline of a delicate orchid was beginning to take shape. In the middle, she got up to stretch, went to the kitchen, took out the steamed sweet potatoes and corn, cut them into small pieces, cut a mango, mixed in yogurt, and made a fruit salad, preparing it as a snack for the children when they came home from school.
location: At home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin: bedroom, living room, kitchen.

name: Picking up the children from school and stopping at the supermarket on the way
description: Ma Xiulan got on her electric bike on time and first went to Huakang First Kindergarten (about a 15-minute ride) to pick up Yuxin. As soon as Yuxin saw her mother, she happily shared the new nursery rhyme the teacher had taught that day. Then the two went to the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (about a 5-minute ride) to wait for Mingzhe. Soon Mingzhe came out, holding a neatly written character exercise notebook in his hand. On the way home, Ma Xiulan turned into Jingbai Supermarket (about a 5-minute ride). She went straight to the daily necessities aisle, grabbed a tube of toothpaste that was almost used up at home, and bought a bag of salt and a pack of tissues. At checkout, she habitually glanced at the area where pickled vegetables were sold on consignment by Zhang Shufen's supermarket. Seeing that the sign for her own spicy pickled cabbage was still standing there, she felt quite happy.
location: From Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School on Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and then to Jingbai Supermarket, Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Return home to praise the children, show the commitment card, and take care of the courtyard.
description: After getting home (about a 10-minute drive), Ma Xiulan first had the children wash their hands and eat snacks. She saw that her eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, was already doing homework in his room, so she walked over. Mingxuan proactively told her that he had finished today’s math homework, reviewed the definitions, and organized several wrong questions. Ma Xiulan was very happy and hugged him while praising him. At that moment, Mingzhe also brought over his workbook, and the new characters were written neatly; she praised him warmly as well. Seizing the moment, Ma Xiulan took out the “Beijing Trip Promise Card” from the cabinet, on which was written: “Ma Mingxuan, Ma Mingzhe, Ma Yuxin: For academic progress, you are promised a trip to Beijing!” When the children saw the card, they all cheered happily. Afterwards, Ma Xiulan carried a watering can to the courtyard and carefully watered the flower seedlings. To her surprise and delight, she found that the flower seeds planted a few days ago had actually bloomed into bright little flowers—three of them, in orange, purple, and white. She hurried back inside to get her phone, squatted in front of the flowers, took two short videos from different angles, and snapped a few photos.
location: Living room and courtyard at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare and enjoy dinner
description: Ma Xiulan began preparing dinner in a cheerful mood. Today she made corn and sweet potato porridge, stir-fried tomatoes and eggs, and a cucumber salad, all of which the children loved. She was quick with her hands, and soon the kitchen was filled with the aroma of food. After dinner was ready, the family sat around the dining table. Ma Xiulan shared with her husband and children several happy things from today: she had bought the insurance, the two boys had made the fastest progress in their studies, and the new flowers in the yard had bloomed. The dinner table was warm and harmonious; even Ma Mingxuan, who usually spoke little, said a few amusing things about school.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Cleaning the kitchen and checking homework
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan let her husband go rest, and she neatly cleared the table, wiped it, and washed the dishes. Then she went to the living room to check Mingzhe's Chinese and math homework. Everything was correct, and his handwriting was neater than before. She also looked at Mingxuan's mistake notebook and helped him go through his problem-solving approach.
location: Kitchen and living room of the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Put the youngest daughter to bed and post the video
description: Ma Xiulan bathed Yuxin, changed her into pajamas, then leaned against the headboard and read her a picture-book story about a little rabbit. Yuxin fell asleep as she listened. She quietly turned off the light and closed the door behind her, went back to the living room, added music and the text "Grew it myself, it's blooming!" to the flower video she had taken just now, and posted it to her WeChat Moments.
location: Children's room and living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Evening leisure, socializing, and washing up
description: Ma Xiulan poured herself a glass of warm water and leaned back on the sofa to browse on her phone. Seeing the likes and compliments from friends and family in her Moments, she felt very happy. She then sent a WeChat message to her childhood friend Liu Chunmei, asking if she was free this weekend to come over and make radish together. Liu Chunmei quickly replied and agreed to come on Saturday morning. Afterwards, she went to the bathroom to wash up, carefully washed her face, and applied skincare. Recalling the busy and rewarding day, she felt a deep sense of fulfillment.
location: Living room and bathroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Stretching, reviewing the day, and going to bed
description: She lay down on the bed, turned off the light, and did a simple set of pre-sleep stretches. In her mind she counted off that the most important things of the day were done: the insurance was bought, the children were well-behaved, and the flowers had bloomed. Tomorrow she would continue embroidering the bellyband; life was going smoothly. As she thought about this, listening to her husband's steady breathing, she felt at peace and soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: Master bedroom of the home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning stretching
description: Ma Xiulan was awakened on time by her internal body clock. She got up gently, first went to the window to take deep breaths and stretch her stiff shoulders and neck. Following the doctor's advice, she did five minutes of wrist and finger stretches and felt her wrists become much more flexible.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Sunshine Garden, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Prepare noodles with gravy for breakfast.
description: After washing up, she went into the kitchen, diced the pork belly, and soaked the day lily flowers and wood ear mushrooms. Heating the wok with cold oil, she sautéed scallions and ginger until fragrant, added the diced pork and stir-fried until aromatic, then added the day lily flowers and wood ear mushrooms, stir-fried, seasoned, poured in boiling water, and simmered over low heat. In another pot, she cooked hand-cut noodles; the noodles tumbled in the pot and the aroma filled the air.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Sunshine Garden, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Wake up the children and have breakfast together
description: Just as the noodles were almost ready, she woke Mingxuan, Mingzhe, and Yuxin one by one. Mingzhe lingered in bed, but after his mother kissed him, he got up grinning. The family sat around the table eating noodles with thick gravy. Mingxuan ate quickly, Mingzhe shared funny stories from school while eating, and Yuxin took small bites; Ma Xiulan blew on her noodles to cool them. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang praised the gravy for being just right.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Sunshine Garden, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Clean up the dining table and prepare to go out.
description: Quickly put the dishes and chopsticks into the sink to soak, and wiped down the dining table. Changed into a cotton shirt, slung on a canvas vegetable basket, took some change and her phone, and got ready to go to the market.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Sunshine Garden, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Walking to the vegetable market
description: Walking out of the residential complex and heading west along Jingwen Road, the morning sunlight streamed down and the air was fresh. On the way, she ran into her neighbor Sister Wang and briefly chatted about the grapes in her yard.
location: Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Buying groceries at the vegetable market and socializing
description: At Wutong Community vegetable market, she went straight to Aunt Sun's stall and picked fresh green beans, loofah, and tomatoes while chatting about everyday life. Aunt Sun praised the soy-pickled cucumbers, and Ma Xiulan promised to bring more another day. Before leaving, she bought a small piece of lean pork belly to make steamed buns stuffed with saucy pork.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, at the intersection of Jingwen Road and Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Walk home
description: Carrying the vegetable basket, she walked home at a leisurely pace, and on the way passed the community gate, checked the mailbox, and found no mail.
location: Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Tidying up the house and tending the vegetable garden
description: After returning home, she sorted the groceries, putting what needed refrigeration in the fridge and soaking what needed soaking. Then she went to the small vegetable garden in the yard, squatted down to pull out the weeds under the cucumber vines, and checked whether the tomato trellis was sturdy.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Sunshine Garden, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Hang out the laundry and supervise the children doing their homework.
description: After the washing machine stopped, she shook out the clothes and hung them on the clothesline in the yard. When she went back inside, she saw Mingxuan and Mingzhe playing around in the living room, so she put on a stern face and urged them to go to the desk in the east room to do their weekend homework, requiring them to finish the math and Chinese sections first.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Sunshine Garden, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Helping Mingzhe with his homework
description: Mingxuan studied math problems on his own, while Ma Xiulan sat beside Mingzhe and watched him write the essay 'My Mother.' Although Mingzhe's handwriting was crooked, it was earnest. She patiently pointed out the wrong characters and taught the correct strokes. Mingzhe looked up and said, 'Mom, what I wrote is real; you are the best to me.' She smiled and patted his head.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Sunshine Garden, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Preparing lunch, having the family meal, and urging everyone to take a nap
description: Ma Xiulan went to the kitchen, smashed fresh cucumbers and mixed them with garlic and vinegar, and using the morning's gravy, cooked another pot of noodles. The whole family continued to eat noodles with gravy. After the meal, she urged the children to take a nap. Mingzhe made a fuss and refused to sleep, and only got into bed after she scared him a little.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Sunshine Garden, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Noon break
description: Ma Xiulan also lay down to rest for half an hour. Beside her, her husband Ma Zhiqiang had already fallen asleep, his snores rising and falling. She closed her eyes and rested, feeling her energy restored.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Sunshine Garden, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Embroidered auspicious cloud bellyband
description: After the lunch break, I washed my face to refresh myself, took out the bright red pure cotton fabric and silk thread, sat down in the brightest spot by the living room window, first drew the outline of auspicious clouds, then threaded the needle and started embroidering, using my signature coiled-gold stitch. Every half hour I got up, rubbed my wrists, looked out the window, and stretched my neck. Around 15:00 I went to the courtyard to bring in the clothes that were drying, folded them and put them back in the wardrobe, drank some water, then came back to continue embroidering.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Sunshine Garden, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Continue helping with homework and family interaction
description: The embroidery came to a pause, and she put away the needle and thread. Mingzhe woke from his nap, and Ma Xiulan asked him to finish the remaining homework. While folding clothes, she guided him on new characters and making sentences. Mingxuan played with building blocks beside his sister Yuxin. Yuxin built a little house and held it up for her mother to see; her mother smiled and praised it as beautiful.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Sunshine Garden, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Cutting flowers in the courtyard and arranging them.
description: Ma Xiulan put down her needlework, took a pair of scissors, and went into the courtyard to select several half-open pink and red roses, cutting them off together with some leaves. Back in the room, she found a blue-glazed porcelain vase, filled it halfway with water, trimmed the flower stems, inserted them, and placed the vase upright in the center of the Eight Immortals table in the living room. When her husband Ma Zhiqiang came out to pour some water and saw it, he said with a smile, 'The room has brightened up all of a sudden.' Her heart was sweeter than if she had drunk honey.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Sunshine Garden, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Prepare dinner ingredients and call a childhood friend
description: She was in a great mood and started preparing dinner. Just as she rinsed the rice and put it on the stove, her phone rang—it was her childhood friend Liu Chunmei. Ma Xiulan answered the phone while taking pickled cucumbers from the fridge. Chunmei chatted about the new lazy stock clerk at the supermarket, which made her laugh. Taking the opportunity, she said the newly improved pickle recipe was especially tasty and invited Chunmei to come over on Sunday to taste it, and if it was good, Chunmei could sell it on consignment at her supermarket. Chunmei readily agreed.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Sunshine Garden, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Preparing dinner and dining together as a family
description: After hanging up the phone, she cut the pickled cucumbers into pieces and arranged them on a plate, then stir-fried scrambled eggs with tomatoes and minced pork with eggplant. At dinner, Ma Xiulan happily told her husband about the pickled vegetables, and her husband supported her in making her own decision. The family sat around the table eating, with the children chattering about funny school stories, and the atmosphere was lively. After the meal, she busied herself clearing the dishes and wiping the sink, and urged the children to go take baths.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Sunshine Garden, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Getting the children settled and tidying the house.
description: Ma Xiulan bathed the youngest, Yuxin, coaxed her into bed, and told her a little story. Then she went to remind Mingxuan and Mingzhe to get tomorrow's clothes ready. Returning to the living room, she put the scattered toys into a storage bin, and carefully wrapped the half-embroidered belly band and embroidery threads and put them back in the sewing box.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Sunshine Garden, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Personal relaxation and letting the dough rise
description: After a quick wash, Ma Xiulan finally had some time to herself. She went to the kitchen, dissolved yeast in warm water in a small bowl, poured it into flour, kneaded it into a smooth dough, covered it with a damp cloth, and set it by the stove to rise. Then she sat on the sofa, picked up her phone, asked Aunt Wu in the handicraft group about the finishing stitch for coiled-gold embroidery, and browsed local Jinghai news for a while.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Sunshine Garden, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Pre-sleep check and going to bed
description: Feeling sleepy, Ma Xiulan got up to check that the balcony door and courtyard gate were locked, then took a look at the slightly risen dough by the stove. She turned off the living room light, returned to the bedroom, and lay down. Reflecting that the day had been trivial but solid, and thinking of Chunmei coming on Sunday, she felt something to look forward to and soon fell fast asleep.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Sunshine Garden, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Early morning wake-up and stretching
description: It was just barely getting light. Thinking about taking the children back to her parents' home today, she woke up naturally before the alarm went off. She lazed in bed for a while, moving her shoulders and neck, and felt much more comfortable than the stiff feeling she had when she was younger—insisting on stretching every day really worked. After getting up, she went to the living room, unrolled the yoga mat, and did 15 minutes of targeted morning stretching, focusing on relaxing her wrists and shoulders and neck that were strained from mending clothes. After warming up, she washed her face with warm water and felt completely refreshed.
location: Bedroom and living room at Room 201, Building 3, Jingyuan Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Preparing supplies for returning to her parents' home.
description: Took the dough that had risen since after dinner yesterday out of the fridge, kneaded it to release the air, covered it with a damp cloth, and let it rest again. Then took out the ribs from the freezer and soaked them in cold water to thaw. Ran to the small vegetable garden in the backyard, picked a handful of tender scallions, and tied them up carefully — Mom really likes these. Also folded the floral dress that had been mended for Xinxin last night and put it into the bag, getting everything ready for the trip back to her parents' home.
location: Kitchen and backyard vegetable garden, Room 201, Building 3, Jingyuan Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Woke up the children and helped them wash up and get dressed.
description: She woke the children up one by one and told them they were going to grandma's house today. Xinxin was delighted as soon as she heard this and obediently let her mother braid her hair into pigtails and put on the floral dress that had been mended last night. She urged her two sons to get dressed by themselves. Mingzhe rubbed his eyes and asked if he could bring his toy car. She smiled and told him to pick one to take along.
location: All rooms of Unit 201, Building 3, Jingyuan Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Simple breakfast
description: Lunch would be a big meal, so breakfast was simple. She heated up the leftover steamed buns from yesterday, poured each person a glass of warm water, and cut a plate of her own pickled vegetables. She told the children to eat a few more bites so they would not be hungry on the way.
location: Restaurant at Room 201, Building 3, Jingyuan Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Setting off and cycling to her parents' home.
description: Hung the prepared dough, pork ribs, scallions, and Xinxin's dress on the handlebars of the electric bike, checked everything again, put sun hats on the children, and filled the water bottles. Locked the doors and windows, and called the children to go downstairs. Riding the electric bike, Mingzhe stood on the front footboard, Xinxin sat on the rear seat, and Mingxuan sat on a small stool at the very back. Heading south along Jingwen Road, they passed two traffic lights and turned onto Shengli Avenue. The morning breeze was cool and pleasant, and the children chattered away in the back like little birds.
location: Along the route from Jingwen Road to Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Arrive at parents’ home, chat about daily life, and tend the vegetable garden
description: Dad was already waiting at the courtyard gate, grinning from ear to ear at the sight of his grandchildren. Carrying the things into the kitchen, Mom just put down her broom and came over, muttering 'You spent money again,' but her eyes were full of joy. After changing out of her coat, she followed Mom to the small vegetable garden in the back yard, helping Mom pick the chives she had planted while chatting about everyday family matters.
location: 48 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China: parents' home courtyard and small vegetable garden

name: Making dumplings, parent-child bonding time, and test-flying the kite
description: She and Mom got busy in the kitchen. She kneaded the dough and rolled out wrappers while Mom mixed the filling—chives, eggs, and shrimp, fragrant even as it was being made. The two worked in perfect sync, and before long the cutting board was lined with plump dumplings. Mingzhe and Xinxin washed their hands and ran over to join the fun. Mom gave each of them a small piece of dough to mold into little animals, and the two children had a great time. Dad dug out his treasured old butterfly kite and took the grandchildren to the open space outside the courtyard gate for a test flight. Mingxuan ran fast and helped with the string, while Xinxin chased behind. The kite didn't take off after several tries, but the children's laughter never stopped. She took a moment to slip out and use her phone to record Grandpa teaching the grandchildren to fly the kite, planning to send it to the family WeChat group.
location: Parents' home at 48 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China: kitchen, courtyard, and open area outside the courtyard gate

name: Cooking lunch
description: She tied on her mother's apron, turned on the stove, heated the oil, stir-fried the pork ribs she had brought, added Sichuan peppercorns, star anise, and soy sauce, then put everything into a pressure cooker to simmer. Soon the whole house was filled with the aroma of meat. Her mother boiled a large pot of water and dropped the dumplings in batches; steam rose everywhere. She also smashed two cucumbers and mixed them with garlic paste and vinegar, which was refreshing and helped cut the grease.
location: Kitchen at her parents' home, 48 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Family dinner and taking a family portrait
description: The family of six sat around the old-fashioned square table, on which were steaming dumplings, a large pot of braised pork ribs, and two plates of cold dishes. Dad said with emotion, “A family reunited together is a blessing.” Feeling warm inside, she set up a timed photo with her phone stand on the table and took a formal family portrait. Afterwards, she also took several separate group photos with Dad and the three children.
location: Dining room at her parents' home, No. 48 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: After-meal cleanup and mother-daughter talk
description: After lunch, she hurried to clear the dishes and chopsticks, telling her mother to go and rest. She neatly washed the dishes and put them back in place, then sorted the leftovers and put them in the refrigerator. When everything was tidied up, she sat next to her mother and spoke softly to her. Her mother asked whether she had been short of money recently and reminded her not to spoil the children too much and to eat well herself.
location: Kitchen and living room at the parents' home, No. 48 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Midday rest and helping with household chores
description: The children had been playing all morning and were a little sleepy, so she let them take a nap on the big kang at Grandma's house. She went over to help her mother check the pickled vegetable jars in the yard, and only felt relieved after seeing that the water seals were in good condition. She also gathered a handful of fresh scallions from the yard to take back to her own home.
location: All rooms and the courtyard at the parents' home, 48 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Farewell and Mother's Gift of Dishes
description: I woke the children and got ready to go home. Mom had already packed a bag of homemade pickled vegetables and a bunch of freshly picked scallions into a plastic bag and pressed it into my hands, saying, "Take care of yourself and the kids, don't be too frugal." Dad also told me to ride slowly on the way. Feeling warm inside, I said goodbye to my parents with the children.
location: In front of and outside the yard of the parents' home at 48 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Cycled back, rested at home, and supervised homework.
description: She rode the bike back along the same route. The afternoon sun was hot, so she had Xinxin sit behind her to stay out of the sun. The children were tired from playing and a bit listless, quietly leaning against her. After about 20 minutes, they were back at home on Jingwen Road. Once home, she first had the children drink water and rest. She changed out of her outdoor clothes, took out Xinxin's water bottle and washed it, then urged Mingxuan and Mingzhe to get out their weekend homework and do some work in the study. Xinxin took out her drawing book and quietly drew pictures nearby.
location: Along Shengli Avenue to Jingwen Road in Jinghai District, Tianjin, China, and at home in Room 201, Building 3, Jingyuan Community, Jingwen Road

name: Prepare pickled vegetable samples
description: She put on an apron and began preparing samples of pickled vegetables for Liu Chunmei to taste tomorrow. Opening the refrigerator, she carefully chose three kinds of pickled vegetables that were well stocked and different in flavor: one jar savory, one jar mildly spicy, and one jar sweet-and-sour. She packed them separately in small glass jars, put handwritten labels on them, and wrote down the variety and production date. After cleaning up the kitchen, she neatly arranged the sample jars on the dining table.
location: Kitchen, Room 201, Building 3, Jingyuan Residential Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Tending the small vegetable garden and doing housework.
description: She changed into a pair of old cloth shoes and went to the small vegetable garden in the backyard. First she loosened the soil with a small hoe, put up a few bamboo poles for the newly sprouted bok choy and tomatoes, and picked off the yellowing leaves. The evening was still muggy, and a fine sweat broke out on her forehead, but seeing her vegetables growing vigorously made her feel at ease.
location: Small vegetable garden in the backyard of Building 3, Jingyuan Residential Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Prepare and enjoy dinner
description: Back in the kitchen, she looked at the dumplings left over from lunch and decided to heat them up for dinner, and also cook a pot of millet porridge. She chopped the scallions she had brought back from the vegetable garden, mixed them into the leftover cold dishes from lunch, and sliced a plate of pickled vegetables. Dinner was all set. She called the children to wash their hands and eat. At the table, she asked them what they enjoyed most at Grandma's house today. Mingxuan said flying a kite was the most fun, Mingzhe said making dough bunnies with Grandma was the best, and Xinxin said she liked Grandma's courtyard best. The children chattered all at once, and the family ate and chatted together, warm and lively.
location: Kitchen and dining room, Room 201, Building 3, Jingyuan Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: After-dinner leisure and homework checking
description: After the meal, she cleared the dishes and had Mingxuan and Mingzhe go check their homework, especially Mingzhe's composition. First she washed Xinxin's face and changed her into pajamas, then sat down at the desk to check on Mingzhe's composition progress. He had written half of it; the topic was 'My Grandma.' She encouraged him with a few words and helped him correct several typos.
location: Study and children's bedroom, Room 201, Building 3, Jingyuan Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Supervising washing up and telling the daughter a story
description: Took Xinxin to the bathroom and helped her brush her teeth, wash her face, and wash her feet. After she finished her bath, told the two sons to go wash up too. Then, holding a storybook, sat by Xinxin's bed and told her the story 'Little Horse Crosses the River' to coax her to sleep.
location: Bathroom and Xinxin's bedroom, Room 201, Building 3, Jingyuan Residential Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Evening chores, contacting Sister Chunmei, and chatting in the handicraft group
description: After Xinxin fell asleep, she went to the living room, took down the clothes that had dried on the balcony, and folded them one by one. She took out her phone and sent a voice message on WeChat to her childhood friend Liu Chunmei, telling her that the samples for tomorrow afternoon were ready and inviting her to come around three o'clock. Sister Chunmei quickly replied with a voice message and readily agreed. Then she sat on the sofa and chatted with Sister Xiuqin in the handicraft group. She shared her newly embroidered peony flower pattern, and everyone in the group was discussing the stitching. She also talked a little about the small dress she was making for Xinxin, and thought that she could make a few more children's clothes for the next market. After chatting, she checked the water, electricity, doors and windows at home to make sure everything was closed and turned off.
location: Living room, Room 201, Building 3, Jingyuan Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Foot soaking and stretching, pre-sleep reflection, and falling asleep
description: She brought a basin of hot water and, while soaking her feet, did some simple shoulder and neck stretches to ease the fatigue of the day. After soaking her feet, she poured out the footbath water, did a few sets of waist stretches, and then washed up simply. Changing into her pajamas and lying in bed, she recalled the warm time at her parents' home today and felt especially content and happy. She also thought about Sister Chunmei coming tomorrow to try the pickled vegetables and briefly ran through the process in her mind. After setting the phone alarm and turning off the bedside lamp, the day's fatigue was washed away by the warm current of family affection. She soon drifted off to sleep, a faint smile at the corners of her mouth, and sank into a deep sleep.
location: Bedroom 201, Building 3, Jingyuan Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Morning body care, meal preparation, and family breakfast
description: I woke up naturally at 5:40 in the morning, did deep breathing and shoulder and neck stretches in bed, washed up, and applied hand cream to my wrists. At 6:00, I went into the kitchen to prepare breakfast. Using the scallions and eggs brought from my parents' home and the proofed dough, I made scallion pancakes and millet porridge. At 6:20, I woke the three children, helped my youngest daughter Yuxin get dressed, urged my sons to wash up, and reminded them to finish their weekend homework. At 7:00, the whole family sat around the table eating breakfast, sharing fun stories from school, and the atmosphere was warm.
location: Room 301, Unit 2, Building 6, Jingyuan Residential Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Going to Zhou Xiuqin's home to study double-sided embroidery and discuss the community market
description: After breakfast, she packed up the embroidery patterns and other items, left at 7:45, and walked to Zhou Xiuqin's home. She arrived at 8:00, and Zhou Xiuqin had already brewed tea. Ma Xiulan learned the techniques of splitting silk threads and hiding threads in double-sided embroidery. After repeated practice, she successfully embroidered a double-sided petal sample. During a break, they confirmed the time and place of next Saturday's community craft fair, agreed to set up a stall together, and Ma Xiulan would bring pickled vegetables to share at the booth. They also agreed to meet again next Friday evening.
location: Zhou Xiuqin's home, 18 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Bought groceries on the way home, then cooked and enjoyed lunch.
description: At 11:10, I said goodbye to Zhou Xiuqin and walked home. On the way, I stopped by Wutong Commune vegetable market and bought grass carp, cilantro, and tofu at Aunt Sun's stall. Aunt Sun also gave me some scallions. I got home around 11:30 and started making braised grass carp with tofu, cucumber salad, and tomato egg drop soup. At noon, I had lunch with the children.
location: Kitchen and dining room, Room 301, Unit 2, Building 6, Jingyuan Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Lunch break and household tidying
description: After lunch, she urged the children to clear the dishes, and she took in the bed sheets that had been drying in the morning and folded them. Then she felt tired, so she lay on the sofa for half an hour to rest.
location: Room 301, Unit 2, Building 6, Jingyuan Residential Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Made homemade yogurt and gave it to family and neighbors.
description: In the afternoon, she started making homemade yogurt with whole milk and yogurt starter culture, setting the yogurt maker to ferment for 8 hours. At 14:30, she had her eldest son Mingxuan ride his bicycle to deliver a jar of yogurt to his grandparents at 48 Shengli Street. Grandpa was very happy. Then she took another jar to her across-the-hall neighbor Wang Guilan, and Sister Wang gave her three freshly picked cucumbers in return.
location: Room 301, Unit 2, Building 6, Jingyuan Residential Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and the neighbor's home across the hall.

name: Childhood friend Liu Chunmei came to visit and taste the pickled vegetables.
description: Childhood friend Liu Chunmei arrived on time, and Ma Xiulan brought out the three prepared pickled vegetable samples — pickled cucumber, sweet garlic, and spicy radish strips — for her to taste. Liu Chunmei was full of praise and agreed to ask the community supermarket where she worked whether there was a consignment channel. The two chatted freely for nearly an hour and got along very well.
location: Living room, Room 301, Unit 2, Building 6, Jingyuan Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare cold noodles with shredded chicken and take the children for a walk
description: After seeing Chunmei off, Ma Xiulan began preparing a light dinner. Using the cucumbers Sister Wang had given her, she made cold noodles with shredded chicken and a rich sesame sauce. Her youngest daughter, Yuxin, helped trim the scallions. Then at 17:00, she took her second son, Mingzhe, and youngest daughter, Yuxin, for a walk in the park near Jingwen Road, teaching them to recognize wildflowers and sharing fun stories about learning double-sided embroidery.
location: Room 301, Unit 2, Building 6, Jingyuan Residential Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and the nearby Jingwen Road Park

name: Family dinner sharing the day's gains
description: Her husband Ma Zhiqiang came home after a truck run, and the whole family sat around eating cold noodles with shredded chicken and drinking yogurt. Ma Xiulan shared photos of the embroidered petals she had learned to make at Zhou Xiuqin's home. Her husband encouraged her, and laughter filled the dining table.
location: Dining room, Room 301, Unit 2, Building 6, Jingyuan Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Post-meal cleaning and household tidying
