description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan cleared the dishes, cleaned the stove top, sealed the leftovers and put them in the refrigerator, and mopped the living room floor to keep the home tidy.
location: Room 301, Unit 2, Building 6, Jingyuan Residential Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Soothe Yuxin to sleep and do bedtime care
description: Ma Xiulan told her daughter Yuxin a bedtime story and coaxed her to sleep. Afterwards, she took a hot bath, applied hand cream, and massaged her right wrist.
location: Room 301, Unit 2, Building 6, Jingyuan Residential Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Practiced double-sided embroidery alone in the evening
description: After the children fell asleep, Ma Xiulan sat at the desk in her bedroom, reviewed what she had learned during the day, practiced the hidden stitch technique by following her notes, and studied it repeatedly, full of enthusiasm for double-sided embroidery.
location: Desk in the bedroom, Room 301, Unit 2, Building 6, Jingyuan Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Before bed, write down the day's happenings, check the doors and windows, and go to sleep.
description: Ma Xiulan recorded today's embroidery results and happy social interactions in her phone's memo and did wrist stretching exercises. Then she checked the doors, windows, and gas, organized items for the next day, set the alarm for 6 a.m. the next morning, and went to bed at 22:30, falling asleep with a sense of contentment.
location: Room 301, Unit 2, Building 6, Jingyuan Residential Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Getting up, morning stretching, and wrist care.
description: After the alarm went off, Ma Xiulan sat up and first did 10 minutes of shoulder and neck stretches and hand joint exercises to relieve the soreness from yesterday's embroidery. Then she soaked her hands in warm water, applied hand cream, and moved her finger joints to make sure her wrists were in good shape.
location: Bedroom, Room 502, Building 3, Jingxin Jiayuan, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing breakfast for the whole family
description: Ma Xiulan decided to make a quick breakfast. She heated up a few buns made the day before, cooked a pot of millet porridge, sliced a plate of pickled vegetables (left over from last Sunday), and fried one egg for each child.
location: Kitchen, Unit 502, Building 3, Jingxin Jiayuan, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Wake the children, eat breakfast, and take them to school.
description: 06:45 Ma Xiulan woke the three children on time and urged them to wash up. After eating quickly, the eldest son Ma Mingxuan put on his backpack and went to the Fourth Middle School of Jinghai District (Shengli Avenue) for class. At 07:05, Ma Xiulan had breakfast with her second son Mingzhe and youngest daughter Yuxin. At 07:15, she rode her electric bike to take Yuxin first to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten (12 Chunhua Road), then went to take Mingzhe to the Third Primary School of Jinghai District (Shengli South Street), watching them enter the school gate before leaving.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Jingxin Jiayuan, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Going home to tidy up and tend the vegetable garden
description: Ma Xiulan got home, quickly soaked the dishes and chopsticks, and wiped the dining table. Then she went to the balcony, watered the potted cherry tomatoes and green peppers, and casually picked a fully ripe cherry tomato and took a bite.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Jingxin Jiayuan, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Purchase ingredients for pickled cucumbers
description: Ma Xiulan changed into light clothes, put on a sun hat, and rode her old-fashioned 28-inch crossbar bicycle out. At 07:55 she arrived at the Wutong Commune vegetable market, found Sun Guifang's stall, carefully selected a basket of 8 jin of local tender cucumbers. Then she went to a seasoning shop next door and, following the recipe, prepared low-salt soy sauce, black vinegar, sugar, garlic cloves, Sichuan peppercorns, dried chili peppers, and other spices; she also bought several extra spices to try different flavors. She spent 38 yuan in total.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market and nearby seasoning shops, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Washing ingredients, prepping, and recording expenses
description: At 09:40 Ma Xiulan got home. She carefully scrubbed the cucumbers clean, placed them in a bamboo basket, and put them on the balcony to dry. Then she found the old pickling jar, scrubbed it inside and out, and turned it upside down to drain. After that, she took out her notebook and recorded the money spent today on cucumbers and seasonings; adding the earlier costs of the jar and rock sugar, the total cost of this batch of soy-pickled cucumbers was about 50 yuan.
location: Kitchen and balcony, Room 502, Building 3, Jingxin Jiayuan, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing lunch for oneself
description: While waiting for the cucumbers to dry, Ma Xiulan hand-washed a few pieces of clothing she had changed out of last night. Then she cooked herself some of yesterday's leftover hand-rolled noodles, tossed them with fried sauce, and ate them with garlic cloves and a cold dish made from the cucumbers Wang Guilan had given her yesterday, making a simple lunch.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Jingxin Jiayuan, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Afternoon rest, catching up with people, and relaxing
description: After lunch, Ma Xiulan rested on the sofa. She opened her phone and saw a new embroidery pattern video sent by Aunt Wu in the handicraft group. She sent Chunmei a voice message asking about the community supermarket, and Chunmei replied that she hadn't heard back yet. After chatting for a while, Ma Xiulan set an alarm and closed her eyes for a half-hour nap.
location: Living room, Room 502, Building 3, Jingxin Jiayuan, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Rush to make embroidered bellybands
description: After a refreshing nap, Ma Xiulan brought out the embroidery frame and used the silk-splitting technique for double-sided embroidery she learned from Zhou Xiuqin yesterday to focus on embroidering the main outline of the peony on the chest of the bellyband. Every half hour she stood up to stretch her waist and get water. At 16:00 she successfully completed the main flower outline with even lines and felt satisfied.
location: By the window in the living room, Room 502, Building 3, Jingxin Jiayuan, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the child from school (kindergarten)
description: Ma Xiulan put down her embroidery hoop and rode her electric bike to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up her younger daughter Yuxin. Yuxin happily ran over and chattered about the new nursery rhyme the teacher had taught. Ma Xiulan wiped her sweat and rode her home.
location: Gate of Huakang First Kindergarten, 12 Chunhua Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Settling the children, helping with homework, preparing dinner
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan had Yuxin draw at the small table while she began preparing dinner ingredients (washing vegetables and cutting meat). Before long, Mingzhe walked back by himself. While cooking, she kept an eye on the two children doing their homework. Mingzhe had made a few mistakes on his Chinese test paper, and she patiently had him correct them. During this, she went back to the kitchen to bring in the dried cucumbers, cut them into strips, and sprinkled them with salt to draw out the water.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Jingxin Jiayuan, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The whole family eats dinner
description: After the eldest son Mingxuan came home from school, the meal was ready. Tonight there were braised chicken pieces, garlic broccoli, and seaweed egg drop soup. Her husband Zhiqiang had not taken a long-distance trip today and was also home. All five family members sat together, the children talked about school, and Ma Xiulan and Zhiqiang chatted about buying cucumbers in the morning. It was a lively and happy scene.
location: Dining room, Room 502, Building 3, Jingxin Jiayuan, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Cleaning up the kitchen and handling household chores
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan had the two children go do their homework while she quickly cleared the dishes, scrubbed the pots and dishes, and wiped down the stove. Then she boiled a large pot of hot water, mixed it with cold water, bathed Yuxin first, then urged Mingzhe to wash up. While they were bathing, she scrubbed out the dirty socks they had taken off. At 20:10 she started telling Yuxin a bedtime story.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Jingxin Jiayuan, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Putting the kids to bed.
description: Ma Xiulan held Yuxin in her arms, finished telling two little stories, then gently patted her until she fell asleep. Then she quietly walked out and left the door ajar.
location: Youngest daughter's bedroom, Room 502, Building 3, Jingxin Garden, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Husband and wife discuss starting a business
description: After the children were asleep, Ma Xiulan pulled her husband Zhiqiang to sit on the sofa and took out the account book to do the math: today they spent a total of 50 yuan on cucumbers and seasonings. As Chunmei said, one jin of cucumbers can yield two and a half jars after draining. One jar is planned to sell for 8 yuan. With 20 jars a week, the gross profit could be around 60 yuan. Zhiqiang listened while drinking tea and said he supported her trying it, as long as she didn't wear herself out.
location: Living room, Room 502, Building 3, Jingxin Jiayuan, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Personal washing up and relaxation
description: After chatting, Ma Xiulan was in a good mood. She went to wash up and carefully did her hand care routine. Then she lay in bed, chatted with her sisters in the handicraft group about today's embroidery progress, scrolled through short videos for a while, and watched tips on pickling vegetables. She felt the day had been fulfilling.
location: Bathroom and bedroom, Room 502, Building 3, Jingxin Jiayuan, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Checked the doors and windows, set the alarm clock, and went to bed.
description: Ma Xiulan got out of bed and checked the doors and windows to make sure they were secure. She set the alarm for 5:30 the next day and put her phone back on the nightstand. Closing her eyes, she thought about how she would start pickling the vegetables tomorrow. Full of hope for the future, she soon fell asleep.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Jingxin Jiayuan, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning activities: getting up, stretching, preparing breakfast, and waking the children
description: Woke up naturally at 5:30 in the morning. After sitting up in bed for a moment to clear her head, she did shoulder, neck, and wrist stretches on the bedroom floor to relieve the strain from doing handicrafts. Then she went into the kitchen to simmer red date millet porridge, heat sesame seed cakes, and boil eggs from their own chickens. At 6:40, she woke her second son Ma Mingzhe and youngest daughter Ma Yuxin; her eldest son Ma Mingxuan had already gotten up by himself. The family sat together for breakfast, and during the meal she reminded the children to come straight home after school.
location: Room 101, Unit 2, Building 3, Jingwenli Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Take the children to school.
description: She rode the electric bike to first take her second son, Ma Mingzhe, to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School and watched him enter the school gate; then took her daughter, Ma Yuxin, to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten and handed her to the teacher on duty. Her eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, rode his bicycle to Jinghai District No. 4 Middle School by himself.
location: Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin — Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School; Health Avenue, West Zone, Tuanbo New City, Jinghai District, Tianjin — Huakang First Kindergarten

name: Clean the kitchen and prepare ingredients.
description: Returned home, washed the breakfast dishes, and wiped down the stove. Took out the 8 jin of dry-land cucumbers bought yesterday, scrubbed each one, and soaked them in lightly salted water. Then organized the spice packets to prepare for pickling cucumbers in soy sauce.
location: Room 101, Unit 2, Building 3, Jingwenli Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Shopping for groceries and chatting at the vegetable market
description: She walked to the Wutong Commune vegetable market and, at Sun Guifang's stall, picked out fresh cilantro and small chili peppers. The two chatted about everyday life and the prices of vegetables. Ma Xiulan mentioned that she was pickling cucumbers and invited Sun Guifang to come and try them another day.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, ground-floor commercial space in the North Block of Wutong Commune, West Area of Tuanbo New City, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Embroidery handcraft: butterfly belly band
description: Taking advantage of the good morning light, she continued embroidering the baby belly band on the living room sofa. The day before, she had finished the peony outline; today she used light blue silk thread to embroider the butterfly wing on the other side, stitching carefully stitch by stitch. She planned to finish it in time for the market on June 14.
location: Room 101, Unit 2, Building 3, Jingwenli Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pickling cucumbers in soy sauce.
description: Go into the kitchen and start making pickled cucumbers: cut the soaked cucumbers into segments, sprinkle with salt and mix evenly, let sit for half an hour to draw out water, then wrap them in gauze and press with a heavy object to drain. Meanwhile, simmer the seasoning sauce: cook light soy sauce, black vinegar, sugar, star anise, Sichuan peppercorns, and dried chili peppers over low heat until fragrant, then let cool. Finally, put the cucumber strips into a glass jar, pour in the sauce, add garlic cloves, seal, and refrigerate.
location: Room 101, Unit 2, Building 3, Jingwenli Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare lunch and eat with her husband.
description: After putting the cucumbers into the jars, she cooked two bowls of tomato-and-egg noodles, served with homemade pickled mustard greens, and had a simple lunch with her husband Ma Zhiqiang. During the meal, she told her husband that the pickled cucumbers had been brined and would be ready to eat tomorrow evening; he said they could have a drink then.
location: Room 101, Unit 2, Building 3, Jingwenli Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Midday break
description: After lunch, instead of cleaning up right away, she went back to the bedroom, lay on the bed, and scrolled through short videos on her phone, watching others share their experience pickling vegetables. Gradually feeling drowsy, she took a half-hour nap.
location: Room 101, Unit 2, Building 3, Jingwenli Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tend to the courtyard flowers.
description: In the afternoon, she put on a straw hat, connected the hose, thoroughly watered the blooming roses, and moved the wilted hydrangeas to the shade at the base of the wall. Admiring the waterfall-like clusters of blue snowflowers, she felt joyful.
location: Courtyard, Room 101, Unit 2, Building 3, Jingwenli Residential Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Finishing the embroidery.
description: After washing her face, she went back to the sofa and continued embroidering, filling in the entire butterfly wing pattern. She compared it with the peony pattern to make sure the colors were harmonious. The main pattern was now complete, and the remaining edge stitching and sewing on the straps were planned for tomorrow.
location: Room 101, Unit 2, Building 3, Jingwenli Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Picking up the children from school and receiving praise
description: I rode the e-bike first to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten. My daughter Ma Yuxin rushed over excitedly, holding up her handmade collage 'My Family.' Head teacher Ms. Wang praised her creativity and helped put away the scissors. Then I picked up my second son Ma Mingzhe from Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School. Along the way, my daughter shared funny stories about the painting and my son made jokes, creating a warm atmosphere.
location: Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Health Avenue, West Area, Tuanbo New City, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Supervising homework and preparing dinner.
description: After returning home, she arranged for Ma Yuxin and Ma Mingzhe to do homework in the living room and reminded them about their sitting posture. Then she put on an apron, went into the kitchen, and cut meat in preparation for dinner.
location: Room 101, Unit 2, Building 3, Jingwenli Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tried the pickled cucumbers.
description: She took the soy-pickled cucumbers that had been marinated for more than six hours out of the refrigerator, opened the jar and smelled the aroma, and picked one out to taste. The texture was crisp and tender, salty-sweet with a slight spiciness, and she was very satisfied. She brought it to her husband Ma Zhiqiang for a taste, and he praised it for tasting just right. She decided to serve it as a side dish that evening.
location: Room 101, Unit 2, Building 3, Jingwenli Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Carefully preparing dinner and photographing flowers
description: While she still had the momentum, she stewed braised pork ribs, stir-fried celery, and made smashed cucumbers with garlic. When the dishes were nearly done, she went to the courtyard, arranged the blooming flowers, took several photos and videos with her phone and sent them to the family group, specifically mentioning that her mother enjoyed the garden.
location: Room 101, Unit 2, Building 3, Jingwenli Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The whole family had dinner together and shared funny stories.
description: When dinner was served, the soy sauce cucumbers took center stage. Ma Zhiqiang, her husband, drank wine with the dish and kept praising her cooking. The daughter once again told the story of being praised at kindergarten, and the whole family laughed in a warm, lively atmosphere.
location: Room 101, Unit 2, Building 3, Jingwenli Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Cleaned the kitchen, helped the children wash up, and stayed with them during study time
description: After the meal, she washed the dishes by herself and wiped the stove clean. Then she took her daughter Ma Yuxin to bathe, and after they got into bed, she told her the story of “Little Red Riding Hood.” Her daughter fell asleep when she was reading the second story.
location: Room 101, Unit 2, Building 3, Jingwenli Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Sharing food with neighbors
description: After her daughter fell asleep, she packed a small jar of homemade yogurt and a plate of pickled cucumbers to share with Wang Guilan, the neighbor across the hall. Wang Guilan happily accepted them, and the two chatted at the door about pickle recipes.
location: Room 102, Unit 3, Building 3, Jingwenli Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Contact the market organizer on WeChat and do evening personal care
description: After returning, she sat on the sofa and sent a WeChat message to Zhou Xiuqin to confirm the meeting arrangement for 6:30 next Wednesday evening. The other party replied that she would bring new embroidery patterns to show. Then she took a shower, carefully applied Vaseline to protect her hands, and put on cotton gloves. Sitting at the dressing table, she wrote in her diary: 'June 10, sunny. The pickled cucumbers were a big success, and the whole family loves them! Xinxin was praised by the teacher, the flowers bloomed, little joys in daily life.'
location: Room 101, Unit 2, Building 3, Jingwenli Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Bedtime safety check and going to sleep.
description: Checked that all the doors and windows at home were locked, then did a simple pre-bed yoga stretch in the bedroom to relax her muscles. At 10:30 pm, she turned off the lights and went to sleep, recalling the pickled cucumbers and her daughter's smiling face, and fell asleep smiling.
location: Room 101, Unit 2, Building 3, Jingwenli Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning wake-up and breakfast preparation
description: The 5:30 alarm went off on time. I first exercised my wrists and neck in bed, then after getting up I soaked my wrists in hot water, applied hand cream, and gently massaged to relax my joints. Then I put on an apron and started preparing breakfast: I heated up the leftover millet porridge from yesterday, sliced steamed buns, used five eggs to make fried bun slices, made a pot of soy milk, and sliced a plate of the crisp soy-pickled cucumbers from yesterday. The kitchen was filled with steam, and the aroma of fried egg wafted out. Then I gently woke the three children, urged them to wash up, and the whole family sat at the table to eat breakfast. I watched the children finish eating and promptly stopped Zhezhe's picky eating.
location: No. 35 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (bedroom and kitchen at home)

name: Take the children to school and tidy up the kitchen
description: She rode the electric bike with Xinxin and Zhezhe, while Xuanxuan rode his own bicycle, and they set off together. First she took Xinxin to Huakang First Kindergarten, then took Zhezhe to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, telling him to listen carefully in class, while Xuanxuan rode to Jinghai District No. 4 Middle School. After returning home, she quickly cleared the dishes and chopsticks, scrubbed the pots and plates clean with dishwashing liquid, and wiped down the stove. Then she took out the yogurt maker inner pot, a stirring spoon, and several glass jars, scalded each one with boiling water, and placed them on the drain rack to dry, preparing to make yogurt.
location: Jinghai District, Tianjin, China: from 35 Jingwen Road to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten (32 Jingwen Road), Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (18 Shengli South Street), and Jinghai District No. 4 Middle School (Shengli South Street), then return home.

name: Buying milk at the vegetable market and chatting with Sun Guifang
description: I rode a bicycle to the Wutong Commune vegetable market and went straight to Sun Guifang's stall to buy two liters of fresh milk for making yogurt. At the same time, I gave her a jar of homemade pickled cucumbers to taste. After tasting them, she praised them repeatedly, saying they tasted authentic, with a good balance of salty and sweet, and were even crunchier than the ones sold outside. I shared with her the general method for making the pickled cucumbers and my plan to make twenty jars a week and sell each jar for eight yuan to help support the family, and she warmly agreed to help spread the word. Finally, I bought some scallions and tender ginger for later use.
location: Stall 12, Area A, Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Make yogurt.
description: After arriving home, pour the fresh milk into a stainless steel pot and heat gently over low heat. As soon as small bubbles appear around the edge of the pot, turn off the heat. Let the milk cool to warm, add a packet of yogurt starter, stir well, then carefully pour it into the yogurt maker's inner container. Cover it, plug it in, and set it to ferment for eight hours. Then write the start time on a notepad stuck to the refrigerator to keep track of the fermentation progress.
location: No. 35 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (home kitchen).

name: Picking vegetables and tending the courtyard garden.
description: While the yogurt was fermenting, she changed into rain boots and went to the small vegetable garden in the backyard. She picked a large handful of tender baby bok choy and a bunch of chives and put them in a basket. Then she watered the thriving tomatoes and loofahs, squatted down, and pulled out a few weeds. Looking at the lush green vegetable plot, she felt especially content.
location: No. 35 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (home courtyard vegetable garden)

name: Embroidered bellyband edge stitching
description: After washing my hands, I sat by the brightest window in the living room, took out the unfinished belly wrap, squinted, and used the hidden-stitch method to edge-stitch along the border stitch by stitch, aiming for even stitches. As the sunlight streamed in, the shadow of my fingers fell across the fabric. I hummed a little tune from my childhood while sewing, rubbing my wrists a few times. After forty minutes of work, only a short section at the armhole was left, to be finished in the afternoon.
location: No. 35 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (by the living room window at home)

name: Prepare and cook lunch.
description: Washed the freshly picked baby bok choy, blanched it, cooled it in cold water, and squeezed it dry. Cut the chives into sections and beat the eggs. Made a cold dressed baby bok choy with minced garlic, black vinegar, salt, sugar, and sesame oil, then sprinkled with sesame seeds; stir-fried chives with eggs; sliced and heated the steamed buns. Glanced at her phone and saw the message Chunmei had sent in the morning saying that the consignment sales were making progress. Then set the dishes on the table, laid out the bowls and chopsticks, and waited for her husband to have lunch together.
location: No. 35 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (home kitchen).

name: Had lunch with her husband.
description: My husband didn't take the truck out today, and the two of us had lunch at home together. I excitedly told him that Sun Guifang had praised the pickled cucumbers. He was genuinely happy for me and told me not to overwork myself. I also mentioned that I was going to my parents' home to deliver yogurt in the afternoon. He said he would come back early to look after the children and let me stay longer with my mom.
location: No. 35 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (home dining room)

name: Noon break
description: After cleaning up after the meal, she went back to the bedroom, set her phone alarm to 12:25, and closed her eyes for a quick nap to recharge for the afternoon activities.
location: Bedroom at home, 35 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: After the midday break, tidy up, reply to messages, portion out yogurt, and deliver to neighbors
description: After the alarm went off, she washed her face with cold water, sat on the sofa to look at her phone, replied to Chunmei's WeChat message, thanking her for her efforts regarding the consignment sale, and said they would chat in detail later. She also sent a voice message to Sister Xiuqin, confirming the meeting on the evening of the 13th, and mentioned she would bring the pattern drawings. Then she went to the kitchen to check the yogurt, found it had already curdled, unplugged the power, used a sterilized spoon to divide the yogurt into four glass jars, put date labels on them, and placed them in the refrigerator. Afterwards, carrying a jar of the freshly packed yogurt, she knocked on the door of Wang Guilan across the hallway and gave it to her to taste. Sister Wang happily accepted it and gave her a small bag of homegrown green beans in return.
location: 35 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (the home's living room and kitchen, and the neighbor's home across the hall)

name: Return to my parents' home to deliver yogurt and pickled vegetables and keep my mother company.
description: I got on my bicycle, turned from Jingwen Road onto Shengli Avenue, and arrived at my parents' home in about fifteen minutes. Mother was airing quilts in the yard and was very happy to see me. I put two jars of yogurt and a jar of pickled vegetables on the table and asked whether her back pain had improved. Seeing unwashed dishes in the kitchen sink, I rolled up my sleeves, scrubbed them clean, and wiped down the stove. Then I sat with Mother in the living room and chatted, listening to her talk about the trivial matters of Father after retirement. When I left, Mother pressed a bag of sun-dried green beans into my hands and reminded me to stew them with meat for the children.
location: No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (parents' home)

name: Buy soy sauce on the way
description: After leaving her parents' house, she rode on to Jingbai Supermarket on the way. She went in, picked out a 1.5-liter bottle of light soy sauce, a pack of salt, and a small bag of Sichuan peppercorns. The total came to less than twenty yuan. She put them in the bike basket and continued home.
location: China, Tianjin, Jinghai District, Yuzhou Zunfu, Building 19, Room 104 (Jingbai Supermarket).

name: Pick up the children from school, supervise homework, and cook dinner.
description: First I rode my electric bike to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up my younger daughter Xinxin. She cheerfully sang 'Little Swallow' for me. Then I went to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up my second son Zhezhe, and he excitedly told me he scored 92 on a math quiz. After getting home, I had Zhezhe do his math test paper at the dining table while Xinxin drew pictures nearby. I started preparing dinner: I sliced pork tenderloin into strips and marinated it with cooking wine and starch, washed cucumbers for a cold dish, and put water on to boil for seaweed soup. From time to time I urged Zhezhe to focus on his homework. Then I stir-fried shredded pork with green peppers—after sautéing the aromatics, I added the pork and peppers—then dressed the cucumbers with minced garlic and vinegar, and finally made a bowl of seaweed egg drop soup. After cooking, I glanced at my phone; Chunmei replied that the supermarket manager would look at the samples in a few days, and I replied that there was no rush.
location: Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (No. 32 Jingwen Road), Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (No. 18 Shengli South Street), and the kitchen and dining room at home (No. 35 Jingwen Road)

name: Finished the edge stitching of the embroidered bellyband.
description: Taking advantage of the gap before dinner, she took out the embroidery hoop and finished the last section of hemming on the bellyband's cuff. She examined it carefully; the stitches were neat and flawless. Satisfied, she folded it and put it into her sewing basket, planning to check it again before the market.
location: No. 35 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (by the living room window at home)

name: Family dinner
description: After the eldest son Xuanxuan arrived home by bike, the whole family sat down for dinner. There was shredded pork with green peppers, cucumber salad, seaweed egg drop soup, plus the leftover pickled cucumbers from yesterday and the baby bok choy salad from lunch. My husband had a bite of the pickled cucumbers and praised them endlessly. My youngest daughter Xinxin tried to pick up food like the adults and ended up with rice all over her face. I asked Xuanxuan about school, and he mentioned that he needed to pay 198 yuan for a study tour next week. I made a mental note.
location: No. 35 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (home dining room)

name: Cleaning the kitchen and bathing the children
description: After dinner, as usual, she cleared the dishes, scrubbed the pots, wiped the stove and the table, and tidied up the kitchen. Then she ran hot water, bathed Xinxin first, helped her apply body wash and rinse off, and changed her into clean pajamas. Then she checked how Zhezhe had bathed himself and felt the back of his head to confirm he had washed his hair before she felt reassured.
location: No. 35 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (home kitchen and bathroom)

name: Check Xuanxuan's and Zhezhe's homework.
description: Sitting at the dining table, she first carefully checked her elder son Xuanxuan's math homework and found a geometry proof problem that was not rigorous enough. She called him over and explained the approach, and he corrected it. Then she flipped through her second son Zhezhe's Chinese dictation notebook; the handwriting was crooked, so she had him rewrite a few characters. At the same time, she reminded Xuanxuan to note down the fee for next week's study trip.
location: No. 35 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (home dining room)

name: Helping the younger daughter learn characters and do crafts
description: I took out word cards and taught Xinxin to recognize the four characters "flower, bird, fish, insect." She showed great interest and pointed at the cards, reading them again and again. Then I found a piece of floral fabric scrap and taught her the simplest stitch hand over hand. She carefully held the needle and sewed two stitches on the cloth. Although the stitches were crooked, I praised her enthusiastically, and she was so happy that she clapped her little hands.
location: No. 35 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (home living room)

name: Told her youngest daughter bedtime stories and soothed her to sleep.
description: I took Xinxin to her bedroom, tucked her in with a small quilt, picked up the picture book "Little Rabbit, Be Good" from the bedside, and vividly told her the story of the big white mother rabbit and the big gray wolf. When she heard the wolf pretending to be the mother rabbit, she opened her eyes wide and then giggled. Slowly, she began to yawn. I gently patted her back and only turned off the light and closed the door after she was sound asleep.
location: No. 35 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (Ma Yuxin's bedroom)

name: Personal care, pre-bedtime chores, and going to bed
description: After the children fell asleep, I washed my face with warm water, applied facial cleanser and rinsed it off, then squeezed out a big blob of hand cream and carefully massaged it into every knuckle. Then I spread out the yoga mat in the bedroom and did ten minutes of shoulder, neck, and waist stretches to loosen up my body that had been stiff all day. I picked up my phone's notes app and wrote down today's expenses (milk 15 yuan, supermarket 18 yuan), and added a note to contact Chunmei tomorrow to move forward with the supermarket consignment. Then I checked the living room windows, the kitchen gas valve, and the front door, confirmed they were all closed, returned to the bedroom, and set the alarm for 5:30 tomorrow morning. My husband was propped against the headboard looking at his phone and told me he was going to deliver goods to Cangzhou tomorrow and wouldn't be back until the afternoon. I acknowledged, said goodnight, turned off the light, and lay down. Reflecting on the day: the yogurt turned out well, the pickled cucumbers were promising, the embroidery was finished, the children were good, and my parents were healthy. I felt very content and gradually drifted off to sleep.
location: 35 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (home bathroom and bedroom)

name: Morning activities and family breakfast
description: Just at dawn, Ma Xiulan did 15 minutes of stretching on the bedroom mat, focusing on her shoulders, neck, and wrists. Then she went to the kitchen to heat millet porridge, knead dough and roll out pancakes, and slice pickled cucumbers to prepare breakfast for the family. At 6:00 she woke the three children and helped Xinxin put on her dress. Zhiqiang and the children sat around the table eating breakfast. Zhezhe didn't linger in bed, and Xuanxuan recited vocabulary while eating. Ma Xiulan didn't have time to eat herself; she packed scallion pancakes, pickled cucumbers, and garlic for Zhiqiang, telling him not to make do on the way.
location: No. XX, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Taking the children to school
description: At 6:45, Ma Xiulan set off on her electric bike with Xinxin and Zhezhe, while Xuanxuan rode his own bicycle to Jinghai District No. 4 Middle School. She first took Xinxin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, then took Zhezhe to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, and then returned home.
location: From No. XX Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin to Huakang First Kindergarten (Huakang Street) and Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street)

name: Cleaning the kitchen and picking produce in the courtyard
description: After getting home, Ma Xiulan washed the dishes and wiped the stove, then took a bamboo basket to the small vegetable garden and picked dewy bok choy, tender chives, and cilantro. Looking at the vegetable beds, she felt reassured.
location: No. XX, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning outing, housework, and embroidery preparation
description: Ma Xiulan first called her childhood friend Liu Chunmei to ask about the progress of selling pickled cucumbers on consignment. Chunmei said she would mention it to the store manager in person today. Then she rode her bicycle to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market and bought two jin of fresh milk at Sister Sun Guifang's stall. Sister Sun agreed to help promote the pickled cucumbers. After returning home, she boiled the milk, wiped the tables, mopped the floor, and washed clothes. Then she sat on a rattan chair on the balcony, called her mother to chat about daily life, and prepared the embroidered bellyband and needle and thread.
location: No. XX Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and Wutong Commune Vegetable Market

name: Focus on embroidery
description: The light on the balcony was just right. Ma Xiulan put on her thimble and focused intently on embroidering a twining-branch pattern, her left hand holding the frame and her right hand moving swiftly. Around 10:30, she felt stiffness in her neck and soreness in her lower back, so she stood up to stretch, drank some water, and patted her waist. Then she continued, aiming to finish the main part before 11:30.
location: No. XX, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Lunch and lunch break
description: Using leftover millet porridge with chives and eggs, she stirred it into batter and spread it into golden pancakes; meanwhile she made a cold dressed bok choy salad, preparing a simple lunch. After the meal she washed the dishes, set her phone alarm, and rested on the bed with eyes closed for half an hour. The soreness in her waist and shoulders was somewhat relieved.
location: No. XX, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Continue embroidery and vegetable garden care.
description: After the alarm went off, she continued embroidering, and the veins of the flowers and leaves gradually became clear. At exactly 2 o'clock she finished the last stitch, bit off the thread, examined it with satisfaction, and put it away. She stretched, her lower back gave a soft crack, and then she went to the vegetable garden to water the greens and pull weeds.
location: No. XX, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the child from school
description: Riding the electric bike, she first went to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up Xinxin. Xinxin came out holding a little red flower. Then she went to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School. At 15:50, Zhezhe excitedly said he came in second in the running race in PE class. After praising him, Ma Xiulan took both children home.
location: Huakang First Kindergarten, Huakang Subdistrict, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Supervising homework and preparing ingredients for dinner.
description: She had Zhezhe and Xinxin do their homework in the living room. Ma Xiulan sliced green peppers and pork, smashed cucumbers, and prepared seaweed and eggs. As she bustled about, she reminded the children to sit up straight. Xuanxuan went to his room by himself to do homework after school.
location: No. XX, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Cooking dinner
description: She heated the oil in the wok, sautéed scallion and ginger until fragrant, stir-fried shredded pork with green peppers; mixed garlic paste and poured it over smashed cucumber; boiled water, added egg drop, and put in seaweed and dried shrimp to make soup. The amount of food was just enough for the mother and three children.
location: No. XX, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Cozy dinner
description: When the meal was served, Zhezhe was worried about reciting English words. Xuanxuan put down his chopsticks and patiently taught him, making up a rhyme: 'apple, apple, it's an apple, round and red, that's me; banana, banana, it's a banana, curved and yellow like a little boat...' Ma Xiulan was amused by what she heard in the kitchen, and after they finished reciting, she rewarded each of them with a banana.
location: No. XX, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tidy up the kitchen and give Xinxin a bath
description: After the meal, she let the two brothers read extracurricular books. Ma Xiulan quickly washed the dishes and wiped down the stove, then ran hot water to give Xinxin a shampoo and bath. After scrubbing and rinsing, she wrapped Xinxin in a bath towel and carried her back to the bedroom.
location: No. XX, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Check homework and teach handicrafts
description: Checked Xuanxuan's neat homework, praised Zhezhe for getting all the math problems correct, but asked him to rewrite the poorly written Chinese characters. Then she taught Xinxin to recognize characters in a picture book, took out needle and thread, and taught her how to thread a needle and do simple sewing.
location: No. XX, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Coaxing Xinxin to sleep
description: She changed Xinxin into pajamas, lay down beside her, and patted her while telling the story of a little rabbit planting radishes. By the time she reached the part where the little rabbit harvested the biggest, sweetest radish, Xinxin had already fallen fast asleep.
location: No. XX, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Washing up and personal care.
description: Ma Xiulan took a hot bath to wash away her fatigue, applied a thick layer of hand cream and massaged her stiff fingers, and then did over ten minutes of pre-bedtime stretches in the living room.
location: No. XX, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Recording expenses and organizing accounts
description: She took out the account book, recorded the ten yuan spent on milk, calculated the cost of the three meals, turned to the pickled vegetables page to note Chunmei's reply and Aunt Sun's promise, and calculated the quantity and profit of the first batch of pickles to be sold on consignment.
location: No. XX, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: Checked that the kitchen gas was off and the living room windows and latch were secure, being extra careful because of the previous burglary. Set the alarm for 5:25 the next morning, charged the phone, then got into bed, recalled the warm moments of the day, and fell asleep.
location: No. XX, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning stretching and preparation
description: The alarm went off at 5:20. Ma Xiulan first lay flat on her back and did 5 minutes of gentle lower back stretches, then sat up and moved her neck, shoulders, and wrists. After getting out of bed, she washed her face with hot water, felt much more awake, and prepared for the day ahead.
location: Bedroom at home, No. XX Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare breakfast and lunch boxes.
description: Ma Xiulan simmered millet porridge in the kitchen, chopped scallions and cooked a few egg pancakes, and brought out a small bowl of leftover marinated cucumbers from the previous day. Since her husband Ma Zhiqiang was at home, she boiled two extra eggs and packed an extra serving of porridge and pancakes in an insulated lunch box as his lunch.
location: Kitchen in the home at XX Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Wake up the children and get them going.
description: Ma Xiulan woke the three children one by one—the eldest son Xuanxuan, the second son Zhezhe, and the youngest daughter Xinxin—urging them to wash up and eat breakfast. Xuanxuan rode his bike to school on his own, no need for her to take him; after eating, he grabbed his schoolbag and left first.
location: Bedroom and dining room at home, No. XX Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Send ZheZhe and XinXin to school
description: Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike with Zhezhe on the back seat and Xinxin standing in front. She first stopped at the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School and watched Zhezhe walk into the school gate, then went to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, greeted Teacher Wang, and watched Xinxin being led inside by the teacher before returning home.
location: Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, No. XX Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, No. XX, South Section of Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Go home to tidy up and prepare for shopping.
description: Ma Xiulan returned home, gathered the dishes and chopsticks from the dining table into the kitchen, and quickly rinsed them. She went back into the room, changed into old work clothes, prepared a reusable shopping bag and a large cloth bag, took 200 yuan in cash from her change purse and put it into her pants pocket, getting ready for going out to shop.
location: Home, No. XX Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Purchase bulk pickling ingredients.
description: Ma Xiulan rode her e-bike to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market and bought 10 jin of fresh, crisp, straight cucumbers at Sun Guifang's stall. They chatted and agreed that after pickling, she would give two jars to Sun Guifang. Afterwards she went to Jingbai Supermarket and bought 10 glass jars with lids, two pads of blank label paper, and a roll of new plastic wrap.
location: Tianjin Municipality, Jinghai District, No. XX, Wutong Commune, Wutong Commune Vegetable Market; Tianjin Municipality, Jinghai District, Yuzhou Zunfu, Building 19, Room 104, Jingbai Supermarket

name: Batch pickling and labeling pickled cucumbers.
description: After Ma Xiulan returned home, she poured the cucumbers into a large basin, scrubbed them repeatedly, and drained them. She cut them into evenly sized strips, sprinkled with salt, and mixed well to draw out water. While the salt drew out the water, she scalded 10 glass jars with boiling water, rinsed them, and turned them upside down to dry. After the cucumbers released water, she pressed them with a clean stone slab and let them drain further. She then simmered the sauce (light soy sauce, black vinegar, sugar, star anise, Sichuan pepper, dried chili peppers, etc., in proportion) and let it cool. Then she packed the pressed, drained cucumber strips into the jars in layers, poured the sauce over them, and added garlic cloves and Sichuan pepper to each jar before tightening the lids. Finally, she pasted on a label handwritten by herself: 'Xiulan's handmade low-salt crispy pickled cucumbers.' After three hours of work, her lower back was sore, so she straightened up and pounded it several times.
location: Kitchen in the home at XX Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare lunch.
description: Ma Xiulan cooked a pot of tomato and egg noodles and reheated two leftover steamed buns. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang heard the noise and came over from the living room to help carry bowls. The two had a simple lunch with the freshly pickled cucumber strips and last night's leftovers. During the meal, Ma Xiulan told him she was going to deliver samples to the supermarket in the afternoon, and Ma Zhiqiang reminded her to ride slowly.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, No. XX Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Midday rest break.
description: After the meal, the dishes and chopsticks were left to soak in the sink. Ma Xiulan lay down on the bed, put a pillow under her waist, closed her eyes, and rested for 40 minutes. Because her waist was still faintly aching, she got up again and applied a hot water bottle for 15 minutes before she felt some relief.
location: Bedroom at home, No. XX Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Send samples to Century Hualian Supermarket
description: Ma Xiulan carefully picked out the two jars of pickled cucumbers with the best appearance from the cured jars, packed them in plastic bags, and placed them on the footboard of her electric bicycle. She sent Liu Chunmei a voice message via WeChat telling her they would be delivered soon. Then she rode the e-bike along Shengli Street and reached the Century Hualian Supermarket in the middle section of Huagong Road after about 15 minutes. She found Liu Chunmei in the snack foods section, who was restocking. After tasting them, Liu Chunmei eagerly praised the pickles for being crisp, fragrant and delicious, and the packaging for being presentable. She promised to meet with her supervisor the next day and do her best to secure two shelf spaces. If successful, they would supply three times a week, five jars each time. Ma Xiulan felt heartwarmed and thanked her repeatedly, then rode home.
location: Century Hualian Supermarket (Huagong Road Branch), Middle Section of Huagong Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Returning home to tidy up, keep accounts, and rest.
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan added labels to the remaining jars of pickled cucumbers that had not yet been labeled, and counted a total of 20 jars pickled that day (including a few left from the previous day). She recorded in her notebook that the cost was about 22 yuan, estimated a selling price of 8 yuan per jar, a net profit of 5-6 yuan per jar, and that 20 jars could earn more than 100 yuan. She was in a good mood.
location: The living room of the home at XX Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the child from school
description: Ma Xiulan got everything ready ahead of time, took a small folding stool and a coat, went out, and rode her electric bike to Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up Xinxin. After greeting Teacher Wang, she hurried to the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School and waited 10 minutes to pick up Zhezhe after school. The three of them returned home. She had the children do homework at the living room coffee table, while she took in the clothes that had been drying on the balcony in the morning, folded them, and put them in the wardrobe.
location: Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, South Section of Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing dinner and doing housework
description: Ma Xiulan trimmed and washed the chives she had bought in the morning, sliced the leftover cucumber from lunch into a plate, and took the pork belly bought yesterday out of the fridge and cut it into thin slices. She tied on an apron and started cooking: she rendered the pork belly slices in the wok, added Sichuan peppercorns, dried chili peppers, and chives, and stir-fried them over high heat. She also mashed garlic to mix with the cucumber salad, and finally made a bowl of seaweed and egg drop soup.
location: Kitchen in the home at XX Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner
description: The food was served, and the family of five sat around the dining table. Zhezhe excitedly said he had been praised in math class today, and Xinxin echoed him in a babyish voice. Ma Xiulan picked up a piece of her own pickled cucumber with chopsticks and gave it to Ma Zhiqiang to taste. Ma Zhiqiang nodded and praised that it tasted even better than last time and was good enough to sell. Ma Xiulan was delighted and drank a few more sips of soup.
location: Home dining room, No. XX Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Cleaning up the kitchen and family time
description: After dinner, Ma Zhiqiang offered to wash the dishes, but Ma Xiulan told him to rest and took over the dishes and cleaned up. Then she took Xinxin to the bathroom for a bath, applied body wash, rinsed her off, and wrapped her in a bath towel. After coming out, she urged Zhezhe to finish the last math problem and checked Xuanxuan's English homework.
location: Kitchen and living room, home at XX Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening wrap-up and confirmation for tomorrow's market.
description: After settling the children, Ma Xiulan called Zhou Xiuqin on her phone to confirm they would meet at the community square at 8 a.m. tomorrow to set up their stall together. After hanging up, she organized what she needed to bring tomorrow: embroidered belly bands, two jars of newly pickled soy cucumbers, a small blackboard with prices, spare plastic sheeting, and loose change. She also recorded the day's income and expenses in her account book, along with Liu Chunmei's promise to help.
location: Living room and bedroom at home, No. XX Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Waist Care and Rest
description: Ma Xiulan lay on the bed, her lower back still unbearably sore. Seeing this, her husband Ma Zhiqiang helped place a hot water bottle on the small of her back and massaged it with his hands for over ten minutes. She breathed a sigh of relief through the pain and felt much better. She said that if it still hurt the next day, she would go to the community clinic to have it checked. Ma Zhiqiang urged her not to tough it out.
location: Bedroom at home, No. XX Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: Ma Xiulan got up and went to the bathroom to wash up. She deliberately applied hand cream carefully to her hands because they had been soaked in water for too long during the day and the skin between her fingers had wrinkled. Before bed, she did a 3-minute shoulder and neck stretch, then went to the kitchen to check the gas stove and gas valve, and went room by room to make sure all doors and windows were closed.
location: Bathroom, bedroom, and kitchen at No. XX Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Bedtime and wrapping up.
description: Ma Xiulan set the alarm for 5:20 tomorrow, charged her phone, and turned off the bedside lamp. Lying in bed, she thought back to today's pickling of 20 jars of soy-pickled cucumbers and Liu Chunmei's promise to help promote them, feeling light and reassured. Though her lower back still ached dully, she felt hopeful inside. She turned over, closed her eyes, and slowly fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. XX Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning stretching and washing up
description: She woke up naturally before the alarm went off, and her lower back still felt sore and achy. Ma Xiulan laid a yoga mat on the bedroom floor and began with 15 minutes of gentle stretching for her shoulders, neck, and lower back, moving slowly and carefully to avoid straining her waist. After stretching, she gently massaged her wrists, then went to the bathroom to wash up and splashed her face with warm water to refresh herself.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, Building 5, Jinghuali Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing the family breakfast
description: After washing up, Ma Xiulan went to the kitchen and got busy: she heated up the leftover rice porridge from last night, took out the dough she had prepared beforehand from the refrigerator and made three scallion pancakes, sliced a plate of pickled soy cucumbers as a side dish, and warmed milk for the children. During the preparation, she glanced out the window; the weather was clear and fine, suitable for setting up the stall.
location: Kitchen at home, Building 5, Jinghuali Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Wake the children and have breakfast.
description: Ma Xiulan woke the three children one by one: her 13-year-old eldest son, Mingxuan, got up and washed up on his own; 10-year-old Mingzhe stayed in bed and only got up after being urged several times; 6-year-old little daughter Yuxin had already put on her floral dress. The family ate breakfast at the table, and Ma Xiulan told Mingxuan and Mingzhe to keep an eye on their little sister in the morning, and promised to hold a family review meeting after returning from the stall.
location: Living room and kitchen at home, Building 5, Jinghuali Residential Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare items for the street stall
description: After the children finished eating, Ma Xiulan quickly cleared the dishes, then picked out eight jars of the best-looking pickled cucumbers (six regular and two with chili) and carefully put them into a tote bag along with the two embroidered bellybands and three handkerchiefs she had sewn earlier. She then carried a small folding table and two folding stools out of the storeroom to the front door, getting ready to set up a stall at the community square.
location: Storage room and living room at home, Building 5, Jinghuali Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Set up a stall at the community square
description: Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike with a table and small stools and arrived at the community square at 8 a.m. sharp. Her neighbor Zhou Xiuqin had already saved a spot, and the two set up the stall together. Ma Xiulan neatly placed the pickled cucumbers, belly bibs, and handkerchiefs. The square was crowded on the weekend, and Zhou Xiuqin enthusiastically helped promote the goods, while Ma Xiulan patiently told customers that the pickles were made with traditional methods and good ingredients. After tasting, an elderly man bought 2 jars of pickled cucumbers, and a young mother bought 1 handkerchief. When the crowd thinned at 10:30, they packed up. That day they sold a total of 3 jars of pickled cucumbers and 1 handkerchief, earning 32 yuan. Zhou Xiuqin also gave Ma Xiulan some fresh peanuts to take home for the children to taste.
location: Wutong Community Square, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Returning home to put things away and organize income
description: After the stall came to an end, Ma Xiulan thanked Zhou Xiuqin and cycled home. She put the table and folding stool back in the storage room, put the 32 yuan in cash she had earned that day into the change box, and neatly organized the unsold goods.
location: Living room, Building 5, Jinghuali Residential Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family summary and praise meeting
description: Ma Xiulan called the three children to the living room and officially began the family summary meeting. The elder son, Mingxuan, showed his organized math mistake notebook and physics formula handbook; she praised him for being careful. The second son, Mingzhe, proudly took out his full-score math quiz paper; she hugged him and reminded him not to get conceited. The little daughter, Yuxin, seriously recited the newly learned nursery rhyme 'Little Ant.' Ma Xiulan was gratified. She took out a self-made 'Family Trip Promise Card' (on which was written 'Beijing Appointment' and the day's date), told the children this was a reward, and asked them to solemnly sign it and press their red fingerprints. She promised to plan the itinerary before summer vacation, and the children jumped for joy.
location: Living room, Building 5, Jinghuali Residential Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Enjoying flowers in the courtyard and taking photos for Moments
description: After the meeting, taking advantage of the good sunshine, Ma Xiulan moved a small stool and sat by the flower beds in the courtyard. The roses and hydrangeas were in full bloom. She used her phone to browse the flower photos she had taken from the beginning of the month to now, selected 9, and used a phone app to do simple color correction. She combined them into a nine-grid collage titled 'June Blooms' and posted it to WeChat Moments with the caption 'Summer in the little courtyard, the joy of stealing a little leisure from a busy day.' Looking at the vibrant courtyard, she felt a sense of inner peace.
location: Courtyard of the home, Building 5, Jinghuali Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing and enjoying lunch
description: Ma Xiulan made a simple lunch: she boiled a pot of tomato and egg noodles, sliced some pickled cucumber and leftover scallion pancakes from yesterday. Her eldest son Mingxuan had arranged to go to the library with classmates, so he cooked himself some instant noodles and left first. Ma Xiulan had lunch in the dining room with her second son Mingzhe and youngest daughter Yuxin. Mingzhe also helped clear the dishes.
location: Home kitchen and dining room, Building 5, Jinghuali Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Lunch break and hot compress on the waist.
description: After lunch, Ma Xiulan lay on the living room sofa with a back cushion under her waist and rested with her eyes closed for half an hour. When the alarm rang, her lower back still felt sore, but it was slightly better than before.
location: Living room, Building 5, Jinghuali Residential Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Making yogurt to serve guests
description: After getting up from her nap, her lower back still ached a little. Ma Xiulan went to the kitchen, poured 2 liters of fresh milk into a pot, heated it over low heat until it barely bubbled, about 80°C, then turned off the heat and let it cool. When the temperature dropped to around 40°C, she added a small packet of yogurt starter culture powder and stirred to combine, then divided it into four clean, scalded glass jars, put them in the yogurt maker, and set it to ferment for 8 hours. She thought about how her father Ma Jianguo and neighbor Wang Guilan were coming over in the afternoon, so they could taste the freshly made yogurt.
location: Kitchen at home, Building 5, Jinghuali Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Hosting visits from neighbors and father
description: Just after 3 p.m., Wang Guilan, the neighbor across the hall, came over with a bowl of freshly boiled edamame. Ma Xiulan invited her to sit down, and the two chatted while shelling edamame. Wang Guilan praised her for being capable. Around 4 p.m., her father Ma Jianguo arrived by bicycle. Ma Xiulan quickly poured him tea and also served two small bowls of yogurt that had just been in the yogurt maker and had not fully set yet, adding white sugar for them to taste. Both said it tasted good. When they were leaving, Ma Xiulan gave her father two jars of yogurt that had set in the fridge to take home to her mother, and Wang Guilan gave a few tomatoes grown in her own garden in return.
location: The living room and courtyard of Building 5, Jinghua Li Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare dinner ingredients and pick up the eldest son.
description: After seeing her father and Wang Guilan off, Ma Xiulan began preparing dinner ingredients. She took pork belly out of the refrigerator and diced it, and washed the cucumbers and mung bean sprouts. Then she remembered that her older son Mingxuan had gone to the library and should be about to come back, so she rode her e-bike to the Dongxingli bus stop on Shengli Avenue to wait for him. After waiting about 10 minutes, Mingxuan got off the bus, and the mother and son rode home together.
location: Home kitchen, Building 5, Jinghua Li Residential Complex, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Dongxing Li Bus Stop, Shengli Avenue, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Cook fried sauce noodles for the family dinner.
description: After arriving home, Ma Xiulan put on an apron and began frying zhajiang sauce. In a heated wok with cold oil, she stir-fried diced pork belly until the fat rendered, then added generous amounts of sweet bean sauce and yellow soybean paste, and simmered over low heat until the aroma filled the room. In another pot, she boiled water and cooked the noodles. She shredded cucumber and carrot, blanched bean sprouts, and paired them with homemade pickled cucumber cubes, preparing all the toppings for zhajiang noodles.
location: Kitchen at home, Building 5, Jinghuali Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The entire family enjoys dinner.
description: Ma Xiulan brought a large basin of zhajiang noodles to the table, and the three children had already sat down waiting. She filled each bowl with noodles, topped them with the fried sauce, and added a generous amount of vegetable toppings. The family ate with gusto; her second son, Mingzhe, ate two big bowls and kept saying that his mother made the best zhajiang noodles. At the table, the children excitedly discussed the places they wanted to visit in Beijing.
location: Dining room at home, Building 5, Jinghuali Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Cleaning the kitchen and checking homework
description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan cleared the dishes and wiped the kitchen clean. Then she checked the three children's homework in the living room: the eldest son Mingxuan had finished his study trip report, and she signed it; the second son Mingzhe had a wrong problem in mental math, and she helped him correct it; the youngest daughter Yuxin was quietly drawing a picture of the family going to Tiananmen.
location: Home kitchen and living room, Building 5, Jinghua Li Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Bathe the children and put them to sleep
description: Ma Xiulan first bathed her youngest daughter Yuxin, dried her hair, and told her a bedtime story about a little rabbit until she fell asleep. Then she went to urge her second son Mingzhe to wash up and watched him brush his teeth. After settling the two little ones, it was almost 9 o'clock.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, Building 5, Jinghuali Residential Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Personal care and bookkeeping.
description: After the children were all asleep, Ma Xiulan finally had some time to herself. She filled a basin with hot water and soaked her feet comfortably, then applied a warm compress to her wrists and lower back. Afterward, she took out her account book and carefully recorded the day's income and expenses: stall income of 32 yuan, dinner ingredients costing about 15 yuan, and she also noted separately the cost of her planned visit to the community clinic the next day. Then she sent a WeChat message to her childhood friend Liu Chunmei, asking how her communication with the supermarket manager was going.
location: Bedroom and living room at home, Building 5, Jinghuali Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening stretching and safety check
description: Ma Xiulan did a set of gentle pre-sleep stretches, focusing on her waist and wrists. Then she checked the kitchen gas valve, the living room windows, and the front and back doors one by one to make sure they were locked, a habit she had developed after the burglary in May. Finally, she set an alarm on her phone for 6 a.m. the next morning and plugged it in to charge.
location: Living room and all rooms at home, Building 5, Jinghuali Residential Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Going to bed
description: Ma Xiulan changed into her pajamas and lay down in bed. Her lower back still felt uncomfortable, and she decided that tomorrow morning she would definitely go to the community clinic to see Dr. Wang. Recalling the children's smiling faces at today's summary meeting and the neighbors' praise for the yogurt, she felt content and heartened, and gradually fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Building 5, Jinghua Li Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Early morning wake-up and morning activities
description: At 5:15 in the morning, Ma Xiulan got up quietly. She first did shoulder, neck, and waist stretches on the bedroom floor to relieve the soreness from yesterday's stall vending. After washing up, she put on her sports shoes and walked slowly along Jingwen Road outside her home to stretch her limbs and get fresh air, while thinking over the ingredients and errands she needed to buy and handle today.
location: The master bedroom and bathroom at home in Building No. XX, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and the Jingwen Road section.

name: Shopping at the vegetable market and sorting the ingredients at home
description: Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to the vegetable market at Wutong Commune. At Sun Guifang's stall she bought three jin of pork belly, two jin of hind leg pork, ginger, scallions, and assorted vegetables. Sun Guifang also gave her some cilantro. Then she bought high-gluten flour and dried yellow soybean paste at the grocery store. After returning home, she sorted the meat and vegetables into the refrigerator, put the flour in the cupboard, poured herself a glass of warm water, rested for a while, and checked the weather forecast on her phone.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market on Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and the home kitchen at Building XX, Jingwen Road

name: Wake the children, arrange morning tasks, and have breakfast together.
description: At 7:10, Ma Xiulan woke the three children and told them to prepare Father's Day cards for their dad. The eldest son Ma Mingxuan was responsible for looking after his younger siblings, while Ma Mingzhe and Ma Yuxin made cards with colored paper and markers. Then the whole family had a simple breakfast: millet porridge, scallion pancakes, and boiled eggs. The children ate quickly, eager to start making the cards.
location: Bedroom, living room, and dining room at home, Building XX, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Kitchen meal preparation and flower picking in the courtyard
description: After the children started making cards, Ma Xiulan was busy in the kitchen for nearly two hours preparing sweet and sour pork fillet and noodles with thick gravy for the Father's Day dinner: cutting and marinating the meat, simmering stock, and prepping vegetables. Around 10 o'clock, after finishing a stage of work, she went to the courtyard and cut a few blue-purple hydrangea branches to decorate the dining table. She ran into her neighbor Zhang Shufen and cut a few extra branches for her. They chatted briefly about everyday things.
location: Kitchen and courtyard of Building XX, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Going to Hualian Supermarket to discuss stocking the pickled vegetables
description: Ma Xiulan took two jars of pickled cucumber samples and rode her electric bike to Century Hualian Supermarket, where she found her childhood friend Liu Chunmei in the condiment section. Liu Chunmei told her that the supervisor had agreed to put the pickled vegetables on consignment on the bottom shelf, officially going on sale next Monday at 8 yuan per jar, with delivery three times a week. Ma Xiulan left the samples, agreed with Liu Chunmei on the payment settlement method, and arranged to deliver another batch early the next morning.
location: Century Mart (Huagong Road Branch), Dongfanghong Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Shopping at Jingbai Supermarket on the way, then returning home to continue preparing ingredients
description: After coming out of Hualian Supermarket, Ma Xiulan went around to Jingbai Supermarket and bought three jin of fresh strawberries and a pack of yogurt starter powder, planning to make homemade strawberry yogurt later. After returning home, she continued preparing the vegetable dishes for dinner. She washed and cut garlic sprouts, green beans, and tomatoes, and checked that the broth on the stove had turned rich and milky white. Standing for a long time made her waist sore, so she sat on the sofa and applied a hot water bottle to her waist for more than ten minutes.
location: Jingbai Supermarket, Unit 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and the kitchen and living room at home, Building XX, Jingwen Road.

name: Simple lunch and midday rest
description: At lunchtime, Ma Xiulan and the children reheated the leftover porridge and flatbread from the morning and had a simple meal. Meanwhile, she checked the children's progress on their greeting cards. Ma Mingxuan had already written his blessing message, Ma Mingzhe was drawing a truck, and Ma Yuxin was sticking stickers. She gave them some words of encouragement. After lunch, she went to the master bedroom and rested for forty minutes to relieve the discomfort in her lower back, all the while thinking about getting the preserved vegetables onto the shelves.
location: Dining room and master bedroom at home, Building XX, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Urge the children to finish their Father's Day cards
description: After the afternoon nap, Ma Xiulan sat on the living room sofa and guided the children in finishing the final decorations on the greeting card. Ma Mingxuan coordinated, Ma Mingzhe drew a big truck and wrote "Daddy, you've worked hard," and Ma Yuxin decorated the edges with plastic stars. When it was done, the children hid the card in the TV cabinet drawer, planning to surprise their dad.
location: Living room at home, Building XX, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Went to the community clinic to treat her lower back problem.
description: While the children were organizing the greeting cards, Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to the Hongxingli Community Service Station near the neighborhood. After an examination, Dr. Wang diagnosed lumbar muscle strain, advised her to avoid standing for long periods and lifting heavy objects, and prescribed a medicated plaster to promote blood circulation and remove blood stasis.
location: Hongxingli Community Service Station, Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Batch-produce pickled vegetables to stock up for tomorrow's shelves.
description: After returning home from the clinic, Ma Xiulan immediately processed 20 jin of small cucumbers: she washed them, cut them into strips, salted them to draw out water, pressed them with weights, and boiled the sauce. After the cucumbers had released their water, she rinsed and squeezed them dry, poured the sauce over them, tossed, and sealed them in 10 glass jars. After working bent over for more than an hour in a row, the soreness in her lower back intensified. She went to the bedroom and asked her eldest son to help her apply a newly opened medicated patch, then lay on the bed to rest for half an hour before it eased.
location: Kitchen and master bedroom of the home at Building XX, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Final push for dinner: frying pork tenderloin and cooking noodles.
description: After her lower back improved, Ma Xiulan returned to the kitchen to finish cooking dinner: one wok fried pork tenderloin strips coated in starch batter until golden and crispy, while another burner boiled water for noodles. The aroma of fried tenderloin attracted the children to gather around, and she had her eldest son first bring the noodle sauce to the table.
location: Kitchen at home, Building XX, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Father's Day dinner, family photo, and cleaning up after the meal
description: Around 6 p.m., her husband Ma Zhiqiang came home. The children presented handmade cards in unison and shouted, “Happy Father's Day!” Ma Zhiqiang's eyes reddened, and he picked up his youngest daughter. The family sat together enjoying sweet-and-sour pork and noodles with gravy in a warm atmosphere. After dinner, in the courtyard full of hydrangeas, they used a phone's self-timer to take a family photo and shared it to the family group, where it received likes. Afterwards, her husband took the initiative to help clear the dishes, while Ma Xiulan sat on the sofa applying a hot water bottle to her waist, watching her family bustle about, feeling content.
location: The dining room, courtyard, and living room at Building XX, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Take care of the children's washing up, homework, and putting them to bed
description: After cleaning up dinner, Ma Xiulan urged the three children to take baths one by one. Then she arranged for Ma Mingxuan and Ma Mingzhe to go to their room to finish the remaining weekend homework, while she accompanied her daughter Ma Yuxin to check her craft homework and read two pages of a storybook. After Ma Yuxin fell asleep, she checked the two boys' homework and patiently explained the wrong answers to Ma Mingzhe, watching him correct them.
location: Bathroom and children's bedroom at home, Building XX, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Personal time: washing up, keeping the accounts, and planning tomorrow.
description: After the children were all settled, Ma Xiulan washed up, sat at the dining table to record the day's expenses, estimated the cost and profit of the pickled vegetables, and listed in her phone memo the pickled vegetables to bring tomorrow, the samples for Liu Chunmei, and the key points for discussing travel plans with her husband.
location: Home bathroom and dining-room desk, Building XX, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pre-bedtime preparations, chatting with husband, and going to bed.
description: After changing into pajamas, Ma Xiulan did some simple stretches on the bedroom floor. After her husband Ma Zhiqiang lay down, he asked about her lower back. She told him about seeing the doctor, and he told her not to tire herself out. The two chatted about the husband's schedule for the next day. Ma Xiulan set the alarm for 5:30 the next morning. After checking the doors, windows, and gas, she lay down with peace of mind. Though she had a dull ache in her lower back, she thought about the successful Father's Day and the pickles about to go on sale, and fell asleep full of anticipation.
location: Master bedroom at home, Building XX, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Early morning wake-up and housework preparations
description: The alarm clock went off, and Ma Xiulan got up quickly, used the bathroom, washed her face, tied her hair into a ponytail, and took the opportunity to scrub the clothes that her husband Zhiqiang and the children had left soaking the night before, wringing them out and hanging them up to dry.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, Building 3, Jingwen Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Brisk walking and stretching along Jingwen Road.
description: Putting on her sneakers, she set out from the neighborhood gate and power-walked along the sidewalk on Jingwen Road to Dongxingli Community and then turned back, taking about 18 minutes. Afterward, she did leg stretches, waist twists, and shoulder-and-neck stretches under the porch to warm up for a busy day.
