location: The road section and porch from the entrance of Jingwen Community to Dongxingli Community, on Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Prepare a nutritious breakfast for the family
description: After washing her hands, she used the rice cooker to make millet porridge, steamed buns and flower rolls in the steamer, and boiled eggs. She also sliced a dish of freshly pickled soy sauce cucumbers to taste, and sautéed shredded potatoes, preparing a hearty breakfast for the children heading to school on Monday.
location: Kitchen at home, Building 3, Jingwen Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Wake the children and have breakfast together
description: One by one, she woke up her eldest son Mingxuan, second son Mingzhe, and youngest daughter Yuxin, urging them to get up and wash up. The whole family sat around the table. Ma Xiulan peeled eggs for the children and ate porridge with steamed buns and pickled cucumbers herself, urging the children to eat more.
location: Dining room at home, Building 3, Jingwen Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Riding an electric bicycle to take the child to school
description: Mingxuan rode his bike to school by himself. After clearing the dishes, Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to take Mingzhe and Yuxin to school. She first dropped Mingzhe off at Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, then took Yuxin to Huakang First Kindergarten, telling Yuxin to be good.
location: Tianjin, Jinghai District, Jingwen Road, Jingwen Community, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Huakang First Kindergarten

name: Lower back follow-up at the community clinic
description: After dropping off the child, she rode her electric bike directly to the Chaoyang Street Community Health Service Center to see Dr. Wang for a follow-up on the soreness and swelling in her lower back. Dr. Wang diagnosed it as lumbar muscle strain, advised her to move around every half hour, and taught her a few lower-back protection exercises. Ma Xiulan bought some medicated patches and felt much more reassured.
location: Community Health Service Center of Chaoyang Street, Jinghai District, 16 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (in the backyard of the Jinghai Grain Bureau).

name: Making the first batch of pickled cucumbers in the kitchen
description: After returning home, she rearranged the kitchen and used a small stool to raise the cutting board to protect her lower back. She washed 20 jin of cucumbers, cut them into strips, and sprinkled them with salt to draw out water. During this time, she got up regularly to move around and applied medicated patches. Meanwhile, she simmered a sauce (soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, garlic slices, and shredded ginger). After it cooled, she mixed the squeezed-dry cucumber strips into the sauce, then packed them into jars, sealed them, and attached labels. In total, she finished 10 jars and neatly lined them up.
location: Kitchen at home, Building 3, Jingwen Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Simple lunch and rest.
description: She cooked plain noodle soup with the leftover shredded potatoes and pickled cucumbers from the morning, ate quickly, washed the dishes, then went back to bed for 20 minutes to relax her lower back and set an alarm for the afternoon.
location: Kitchen and bedroom at home, Building 3, Jingwen Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Organizing pickle packaging and promotional materials.
description: After the lunch break, I felt better. I found empty cardboard boxes, markers, and label paper; for each jar of pickled vegetables, I filled in the ingredients, production date, and price, and made an introduction card for "Xiulan's Family Pickled Vegetables." I carefully packed the 10 jars into the cardboard box and tied it up, ready for delivery.
location: Living room at home, Building 3, Jingwen Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Cycle to deliver pickled vegetables to the supermarket.
description: She put on a sun-protective jacket and a helmet, strapped the cardboard box of pickled vegetables onto the rear seat of the electric bike, and rode about 6 kilometers under the scorching sun, reaching the Century Hualian Supermarket on Dongfanghong Road in 20 minutes.
location: From Building 3, Jingwen Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to Century Mart Supermarket on Dongfanghong Road.

name: Putting pickled vegetables on shelves and on-site promotion
description: At the supermarket's condiment section, she and her childhood friend Liu Chunmei placed the pickled vegetables on the shelves, posted price tags and introduction cards, and put samples beside the cash register. Ma Xiulan proactively introduced the pickled vegetables to regular customers, emphasizing the good ingredients and hygiene. Several middle-aged women stopped to ask questions, initially drawing attention.
location: Condiment section, Century Hualian Supermarket, Dongfanghong Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Purchase dinner ingredients on the way home
description: Rode an electric bike from the supermarket to Wutong Commune vegetable market, bought pork ribs, scallions, ginger, and garlic from the veteran stall owner Sun Guifang to make sweet-and-sour spare ribs for her daughter. Shared the good news with Sister Sun that the pickled vegetables would be sold in the supermarket.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the two children from school and take them home
description: After buying groceries, she immediately rode to Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up Yuxin, then hurried to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up Mingzhe. The two children chatted about fun school stories all the way back to Jingwen Community.
location: Huakang First Kindergarten and Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to Building 3, Jingwen Residential Community

name: Prepare a hearty dinner and help the children with their homework.
description: After arranging for Mingzhe and Yuxin to do homework in the living room, Ma Xiulan went into the kitchen to deal with the pork ribs: blanching, caramelizing sugar for color, seasoning, and simmering. Meanwhile, she washed rice and cooked it, smashed cucumbers, and made seaweed egg drop soup. During simmering intervals, she went to the living room to check the children's homework and ensure they were completing it carefully.
location: Kitchen and living room of the home, Building 3, Jingwen Residential Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner with sweet and sour spare ribs
description: Her husband Zhiqiang came home. The ribs had been braised until tender and falling off the bone, and the whole house was filled with a rich aroma. The family sat around the table, Ma Xiulan shared the news that the pickled vegetables had been successfully put on the shelves, Zhiqiang praised her for being capable, and Yuxin was especially happy to eat the ribs she had been craving.
location: Dining room at home, Building 3, Jingwen Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening dishwashing, tidying up, and folding clothes
description: After dinner, Zhiqiang watched TV, and Ma Xiulan quickly cleared the dishes, washed the greasy utensils with dish soap, wiped the stove, mopped the floor, and folded the air-dried clothes and put them back in everyone’s wardrobes.
location: Kitchen and living room of the home, Building 3, Jingwen Residential Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening family walk around the neighborhood
description: As the summer heat gradually faded, Ma Xiulan took her three children for a walk along the community paths and in the central garden. She listened to Yuxin sing a new children's song, Mingzhe boast about winning first place in the run, and Mingxuan chat about funny things in class. The family was full of joy and harmony.
location: The walking path and central garden of Jingwen Residential Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Bathe the children, tell them stories, and soothe them to sleep.
description: First she gave Yuxin a bath, washed her hair, and put her in pajamas, then urged Mingzhe to wash up by himself. After the two younger ones lay down, Ma Xiulan told a story to help Yuxin fall asleep, checked Mingzhe's quilt, and finally went to Mingxuan's room to tell him to go to bed early.
location: Home bathroom and each bedroom, Building 3, Jingwen Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Personal bath and pre-bed meditation
description: After the children were quiet, Ma Xiulan took a shower and let the hot water run over her waist to relieve the soreness. After changing into pajamas, she sent Liu Chunmei a message to ask about the pickled vegetables at the supermarket. Then she sat cross-legged and took deep breaths for 5 minutes, reviewing the day's gains and feeling grounded and content.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, Building 3, Jingwen Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Do a safety check before bed and go to sleep
description: After sitting quietly, Ma Xiulan checked the doors and windows, the gas valve, and the balcony door lock inside the house. After confirming safety, she returned to the bedroom, set the alarm for the next day, and fell asleep peacefully, looking forward to a better tomorrow.
location: Home, Building 3, Jingwen Residential Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning activities and personal preparations
description: At the first light of dawn, Ma Xiulan woke up naturally. She walked briskly along the sidewalk of Jingwen Road and, after feeling a light sweat, turned back home. On the living room mat, she did shoulder, neck, and lower back stretches, focusing on moving the shoulders, neck, and lower back, and added contraction movements to protect the lower back. Then she did her personal care routine: washed her face with warm water, applied moisturizer, and changed into clean, comfortable loungewear. She soaked the clothes the children had changed out of in a basin, preparing to hand-wash them. She took out her phone and glanced at it, thinking about a message from her childhood friend Liu Chunmei about selling pickled vegetables.
location: Jinhaiyuan Residential Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and at home

name: Preparing the family breakfast
description: Ma Xiulan tied on an apron and cooked a pot of rice and mung bean porridge in the kitchen, which was refreshing and filling. She took the steamed buns made yesterday out of the fridge, sliced them, and pan-fried them in a little oil until both sides were golden. She reheated and sliced the leftover shredded potatoes and soy-pickled cucumbers from yesterday, and a simple yet hearty breakfast was ready.
location: Home kitchen, Jinhaiyuan Residential Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Wake up the children and get them settled for breakfast
description: Ma Xiulan went upstairs and called the children to get up room by room. Her eldest son Ma Mingxuan quickly put on his school uniform by himself; her second son Ma Mingzhe stayed in bed unwilling to get up, and only slowly climbed out after she nagged him a few times; her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin sat obediently on the edge of the bed and let her braid two pigtails. The family sat around the dining table, and she told the children to eat more, especially to drink more porridge, saying that it was hot today and easy to get internal heat.
location: Home at Jinhaiyuan Residential Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Take the children to school.
description: Ma Xiulan got on her old electric bike, with Ma Mingzhe on the back seat and Ma Yuxin standing on the front footboard. Her eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, rode ahead on his bicycle first. She first biked Zhezhe to the entrance of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School on Shengli South Street, watched him walk into the school gate, then turned and took Xinxin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, handed her to the teacher, and then rode home by herself.
location: From Jinhaiyuan Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School on South Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin, then returned to Jinhaiyuan Community

name: Go home to cook porridge and hand-wash clothes
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan rinsed the millet, red beans, and brown rice that had been soaking since last night, put them into a clay pot, and simmered a pot of multigrain porridge over low heat. This was prepared for her parents. Taking advantage of the time while the porridge was simmering, she scrubbed and washed the clothes that had been soaking that morning, hung them one by one on the balcony, and felt at ease watching the clothes sway in the wind.
location: Kitchen and balcony at home in Jinhaiyuan Residential Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Visiting parents
description: After the multigrain porridge was cooked and cooled to warm, Ma Xiulan took the portioned homemade yogurt out of the fridge, put it into an insulated bag together with the porridge, hung it on the bicycle handlebars, and rode to her parents' home. Her mother Li Xiuying opened the door and was delighted to see her. She took the things and said she was fussing over nothing. She went inside and chatted with her mother, while her father Ma Jianguo sat nearby reading the newspaper and occasionally chimed in. When she left, her mother insisted she take back a bunch of fresh, tender garland chrysanthemum picked from the family vegetable garden.
location: Tongshanli Community, Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Return home to organize things and follow up on pickle sales.
description: After returning from her parents' house, Ma Xiulan put the crown daisy greens into the kitchen. Sitting on the sofa, she sent a WeChat message to her childhood friend Liu Chunmei asking about yesterday's sales of pickled vegetables. After waiting a few minutes without a reply, she figured that Liu was busy at the supermarket. Then she went to the small vegetable garden in the backyard, tied some ropes on the tomato and bean trellises, and pulled out a few weeds while thinking that she could pick fresh vegetables again in a couple of days.
location: Home and backyard, Jinhaiyuan Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Supermarket shopping and asking about e-bikes
description: It was almost time to prepare lunch, so Ma Xiulan strolled to Zhang Shufen's convenience store at the street corner. She bought eggs, which were almost used up at home, and a bag of chicken bouillon powder. While checking out, she asked the owner Zhang Shufen whether anyone in the community wanted to sell a used electric bike. Zhang Shufen thought for a moment and told her that the Sun family in Building 26 had just moved away and had a seven-out-of-ten condition Yadea electric bike they were planning to dispose of for about 400 yuan. Ma Xiulan noted down the building number and contact information, planning to go see the bike tomorrow.
location: Zhang Shufen Convenience Store, intersection of Jingwen Road and Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare a simple lunch
description: After coming back from the supermarket, Ma Xiulan made lunch at home by herself. She made a bowl of tomato and egg drop soup with dough pieces, and blanched the garland chrysanthemum she had brought back from her mother's, mixing it with mashed garlic and sesame oil. A lunch for one was simple and pleasant.
location: Home kitchen, Jinhaiyuan Residential Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Lunch break and handicraft work
description: After clearing the dishes, Ma Xiulan felt a bit tired. Remembering the doctor's advice, she went to the bedroom and lay down for half an hour with a pillow propped under her waist, which made her feel much better. After getting up, she brought her sewing basket to the living room sofa, took out the child's belly wrap she had half-embroidered yesterday, and finished the remaining overlock stitching. While embroidering, she kept an eye on the time, getting up every half hour to move around and do a few waist-protecting exercises, not daring to sit too long.
location: Bedroom and living room at home, Jinhaiyuan Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare dinner ingredients and take a short rest
description: Tired from the handiwork, Ma Xiulan got up and went to the kitchen to prepare dinner. She carefully picked and washed the garland chrysanthemum her mother had given her, and took out the pork belly from the fridge to thaw, planning to make braised pork for dinner. Then she checked the jar of pickled cucumbers she had made last time, and felt they would be ready to eat after a few more days of pickling. After that, she cut a plate of watermelon and sat on the sofa to rest. She saw Liu Chunmei's reply saying the pickled vegetables had all sold out, and a woman had even asked when the next batch would be available. Relieved, she quickly replied that she would prepare more stock tomorrow and deliver it the day after.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, Jinhaiyuan Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick the children up from school.
description: At 3:30 in the afternoon, Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up Ma Yuxin, then took her to the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to wait for Ma Mingzhe. After picking up both children, the three went home together. On the way, Xinxin chattered about the kindergarten handicraft class, while Zhezhe complained that today's math homework was a bit difficult.
location: From Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Tianjin, then returning to Jinhaiyuan Residential Community, Jingwen Road

name: Help with homework and prepare dinner
description: Back home, Ma Xiulan had the two children do their homework in the dining room first. While preparing dinner in the kitchen, she kept an ear out and came out every now and then to check. When she saw Zhezhe had written a wrong character, she reminded him to erase it and rewrite it; when Xinxin finished her pinyin, she quickly praised her. Tonight's dinner would be braised pork belly, garlic chrysanthemum greens, seaweed egg drop soup, and a plate of pickled vegetables.
location: Dining room and kitchen at home in Jinhaiyuan Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Family dinner and discussion about buying a car.
description: Just after 6 p.m., the elder son Ma Mingxuan came home from school, and her husband Ma Zhiqiang also walked in. The whole family sat around the dining table for dinner. Ma Xiulan brought up the second-hand electric bike she had learned about at Shufen's Supermarket, describing in detail its condition and price. Ma Zhiqiang thought it sounded reliable and told her to be sure to test the brakes when she tried it out tomorrow, and to check whether the battery was durable. She nodded repeatedly, silently taking note of her husband's reminders.
location: Home dining room, Jinhaiyuan Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Clean up the kitchen and prepare fruit.
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan asked her husband to go to the living room to watch TV with the children. She quickly cleared the table, washed the dishes, and wrapped the leftovers in plastic wrap before putting them in the fridge. She also cut a plate of peaches and brought it to the living room for the family. Seeing everyone enjoy the food, she felt very happy.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, Jinhaiyuan Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening family walk
description: Ma Xiulan suggested going downstairs for a walk to aid digestion. The whole family changed shoes and briskly walked for nearly twenty minutes around the neighborhood. The children ran and played in front, while she and her husband walked side by side behind, chatting about household matters and discussing going to see electric bicycles the next day. This was the most relaxing time of the day.
location: Jinhaiyuan Residential Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Helping the children wash up and soothing them to sleep.
description: Back home, Ma Xiulan began urging the children to wash up. She first bathed Ma Yuxin, told her two bedtime stories, "Little Rabbit, Be Good" and "The Three Little Pigs", and coaxed her to sleep. Then she went to check Ma Mingzhe's homework, and only after watching him carefully correct the wrong answers did she urge him to go to bed. Her eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, needed no looking after - he washed up and went to his room to read on his own.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home in Jinhaiyuan Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Personal washing up and relaxation
description: After the children were all settled, Ma Xiulan took a hot bath to wash away the day's fatigue. Once in bed, she saved the house number and contact information of the Sun family, who sold the second-hand electric bicycle, into her phone's memo. Before sleeping, she lay flat on the bed, closed her eyes, and did a few minutes of deep breathing, feeling her whole body relax.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home in Jinhaiyuan Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep.
description: At exactly 10 p.m., Ma Xiulan got out of bed and, as usual, checked the doors, windows, and gas valve around the house. After making sure everything was closed, she charged her phone and set the alarm for 5:20 a.m. Thinking about going to look at an electric scooter tomorrow, she smiled and soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: Bedroom at home in Jinhaiyuan Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Morning activities and breakfast preparation
description: Ma Xiulan got up after the alarm rang. She did 5 minutes of stretching in bed, then put on sneakers and went for a brisk 20-minute walk along Jingwen Road toward No. 3 Primary School. After returning home, she did another 5 minutes of neck and shoulder stretches. Then she went into the kitchen, rinsed millet to cook multigrain porridge, steamed the leftover steamed buns from the previous day, and fried eggs. She deliberately made an extra bowl of porridge to give to the neighbor across the hall. At the same time, she checked the large jar of pickled vegetables from the previous day in the storage room, salted the cucumbers to draw out the water before putting them into jars, and washed and dried the glass jars for use. Later she divided the finished yogurt into small glass jars and put them in the refrigerator so the children could drink them after school.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home) and Jingwen Road (the section in the direction of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School)

name: Wake up the children and take them to school
description: Ma Xiulan went upstairs to wake the three children. The eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, got up on his own; the second son, Ma Mingzhe, lingered in bed and had to be urged; the youngest daughter, Ma Yuxin, behaved well and cooperated while having her braids tied. At breakfast, she put 50 yuan into Ma Mingzhe's pencil case and reminded him to bring the fee for the trip to the science and technology museum the next day. After eating, Ma Mingxuan rode his bicycle alone to Jinghai District No. 4 Middle School. Ma Xiulan rode an old electric bike carrying Ma Mingzhe and Ma Yuxin, first taking Ma Mingzhe to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School on Victory South Street, and then taking Ma Yuxin to Huakang First Kindergarten on Changfu Avenue and handing her to the teacher.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home); Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District; Huakang First Kindergarten, Changfu Street, Jinghai District.

name: Shopping at the vegetable market.
description: After dropping off the children, Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to the Wutong Commune vegetable market on Jingwen Road and went straight to Sun Guifang's stall. Aunt Sun had set aside 10 jin of fresh cucumbers as agreed on WeChat. Ma Xiulan checked them, paid, and also bought a slab of pork ribs and a few seasonal greens. She chatted with Aunt Sun and arranged to order cucumbers again next week.
location: Wutong Commune Market, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Received the market notice and signed up.
description: Ma Xiulan was pushing her electric bike to the entrance of her building when she ran into Zheng Xiuying, the community grid worker. Sister Zheng told her that there would be a summer handicraft market at the Jinghai District Cultural Plaza on June 20, with limited spots, and handed Ma Xiulan a registration form. Ma Xiulan was very happy, filled out the form on the spot, and asked about booth details.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (at the unit entrance)

name: Contact handicraft friend Zhou Xiuqin.
description: After entering the house, Ma Xiulan immediately called her craft friend Zhou Xiuqin to share the market news and ask whether she wanted to join. Zhou Xiuqin had already registered and wanted to find someone to share a stall. The two hit it off immediately and agreed to discuss the details of sharing the stall in the afternoon.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home)

name: Make pickled vegetables to stock up on
description: Ma Xiulan tied on an apron and got to work. She washed the newly bought cucumbers, cut them into strips, and salted them to draw out moisture. While waiting for the moisture to be drawn out, she went to the backyard and put up new bamboo poles for the tomato seedlings. Then she boiled a sauce of soy sauce and spices, let it cool, packed the squeezed-dry cucumber strips into glass jars, poured in the sauce, and screwed the lids on tightly. Ten jin of cucumbers filled exactly five small jars.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home and backyard)

name: Sharing food with neighbors and hearing about the electric bicycle.
description: Ma Xiulan took out some leftover multigrain porridge from the morning and a jar of homemade yogurt and gave them to Wang Guilan, her neighbor across the hall. The two chatted at the doorway. Ma Xiulan mentioned that she wanted to buy a second-hand electric bike. Wang Guilan told her that the Sun family in Building 26 of the community might have one for sale, and that she had seen them wiping it downstairs yesterday. After hearing this, Ma Xiulan decided to go take a look right away.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (opposite Wang Guilan's house)

name: Look at and buy a second-hand electric bicycle
description: Ma Xiulan went to Building 26 in the community and found Lao Sun. Lao Sun brought out a white electric bicycle that was still in good condition. Ma Xiulan carefully checked the frame and tires and rode it around the compound for a few laps, feeling that the brakes and power were both good. After bargaining, they settled on 380 yuan, 20 yuan less than she had expected. She paid on the spot and rode the bike home.
location: Building 26, Jingwen Road Community, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing lunch and having lunch with the eldest son.
description: Ma Xiulan pushed the newly bought electric bike into the yard, wiped it down, and charged it. Then she went into the kitchen to prepare for the next day's stewed ribs, blanching the ribs. After that, using the greens bought in the morning and leftover shredded pork, she cooked a big pot of noodles with greens and shredded pork. At noon, her eldest son Ma Mingxuan came home from school by bike. The mother and son ate noodles together, and Ma Xiulan asked about his studies in a relaxed atmosphere.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home)

name: Midday rest and household tidying
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan sat on the sofa for a while, browsing local information on her phone. After resting for more than ten minutes, she went to the yard, rinsed her new electric bike with a water hose, and covered it with an old sheet. Then she went back inside to tidy the spare bedroom, putting away the books and toys the children had left scattered around, and opened the wardrobe to take out several embroidered items (belly bands, handkerchiefs, etc.) to bring to tomorrow's market, preparing to iron them later.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home and small courtyard)

name: Organize embroidery pieces and prepare for stall setup.
description: Ma Xiulan spread out the embroidery in the living room, carefully checked the stitches, and trimmed the loose threads. She found an old travel bag and packed the embroidery, a small jar of sample pickled vegetables, a coin purse, and a tablecloth. She also made a checklist, reminding herself to bring a small stool, a power bank, and the payment QR code, and planned to ask her eldest son to help make it.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home)

name: Pick up the two children from school and go shopping on the way
description: Ma Xiulan rode her new electric bike first to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten on Changfu Street to pick up her younger daughter Ma Yuxin. Ma Yuxin was very happy to see the new bike. Then she rode to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School on Shengli South Street to pick up her second son Ma Mingzhe, and on the way stopped at the Jingbai Supermarket in Yuzhou Zunfu to buy a bottle of soy sauce and a bag of cooking wine for stewing ribs the next day, and finally took the two children home.
location: Huakang First Kindergarten, Changfu Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District; Jingbai Supermarket, Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu, Jinghai District

name: Supervising the children's homework, preparing dinner, and having family dinner
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan had Ma Mingzhe do his homework in the living room and Ma Yuxin read a picture book, while she tied on an apron and began preparing dinner. She made pork stew with vermicelli using blanched pork ribs, made a plate of smashed cucumber salad, and cooked seaweed egg drop soup. When her eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, came home from school, he helped set out the bowls and chopsticks, and the family of four sat down to dinner together. At the table, the children shared funny stories from school, and Ma Xiulan put food on their plates and reminded them to finish their homework.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home)

name: Tidy up the kitchen and confirm the stall setup by phone
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan neatly cleared the dishes, wiped the table, and washed the bowls. Then she called Zhou Xiuqin to confirm the stall location, meeting time, and what each person should bring for tomorrow's market. Zhou Xiuqin reminded her to bring the payment QR code. After hanging up, Ma Xiulan asked her eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, to print the QR code and paste it on a piece of cardboard.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home)

name: Pack the pickled vegetables for delivery tomorrow
description: Ma Xiulan went into the storage room, gathered the 5 small jars of pickled vegetables made today and several jars stored earlier to make up a total of five jars, wrapped them in clean cloth bags, and neatly placed them in a cardboard box, ready to deliver directly to Hualian Supermarket early the next morning.
location: No. 156, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home storage room)

name: Evening family walk (shortened by rain)
description: Ma Xiulan suggested taking the children for a walk around the neighborhood to help digestion. Just as the family stepped out of the building entrance, raindrops began to fall, so they retreated under the eaves to watch the rain. The shower stopped after about ten minutes. The air was fresh after the rain, and the family walked about 10 minutes in the damp courtyard, enjoying the pleasant post-rain atmosphere.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (courtyard and under the eaves)

name: Helped the children wash up and coaxed the youngest daughter to sleep.
description: Ma Xiulan first helped Ma Yuxin take a bath and change into pajamas, then told the story of "Little Rabbit Be Good" in bed to coax her to sleep. After Ma Yuxin fell asleep, she checked Ma Mingzhe's homework and urged him to brush his teeth and wash his face before going to bed.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home)

name: Chatting with the eldest son and washing up.
description: Ma Xiulan saw her eldest son Ma Mingxuan reading in his room, so she went in and chatted with him for a while, asked about tomorrow's school activities, and told him not to stay up late looking at his phone. Then she returned to her own room to wash up, hummed a tune in front of the mirror, carefully applied hand cream, and did some pre-sleep stretching, feeling relaxed and comfortable all over.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home)

name: Keeping accounts, planning tomorrow's schedule, and checking before bed.
description: Ma Xiulan sat at her desk, took out her account book and recorded the day's expenses in detail: buying an electric bike for 380 yuan, groceries for 45 yuan, pork ribs for 30 yuan, and no income for now. Then she wrote down tomorrow's plan: get up early to deliver goods to Hualian Supermarket, pack up stall items, and set up a stall with Zhou Xiuqin. Finally, she got up to check the doors, windows, and gas valves in each room, locked the front door, set the alarm to 5:10, turned off the lights and went to sleep, falling asleep peacefully after reviewing her fulfilling day.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home)

name: Morning exercise and stretching
description: Because something was on her mind, she woke up before 5:20. It was hot today, so to take advantage of the coolness, she put on her sneakers and went out, power-walking for about 16 minutes along the most shaded tree-lined path in the community garden until she was slightly sweaty. After returning home, she laid out a yoga mat in the living room and did 5 minutes of shoulder and neck stretching, deliberately repeating the newly learned neck circles several times, and felt the stiffness in her neck loosen a lot.
location: Residence at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China, and the tree-lined path in the community garden

name: Prepare breakfast and pickled vegetable samples
description: After exercising, I returned home and first poured the soybeans soaked last night into the soy milk maker to make soy milk. While the soy milk was being made, I took out the jar of newly pickled 'mildly spicy' cucumbers from the refrigerator, tore off a red paper strip, neatly wrote 'Xiulan's homemade pickled vegetables, mildly spicy new flavor' on it, and stuck it on the jar as a sample label. Then I took out three cold steamed buns from the steamer, sliced some of the soy-braised beef that neighbor Sister Wang Guilan had given me yesterday, and prepared breakfast for the family.
location: China, Tianjin Jinghai District, No. 156 Jingwen Road, home kitchen

name: Wake up the child and prepare school supplies
description: She went upstairs to wake her younger son Ma Mingzhe (10 years old) and younger daughter Ma Yuxin (6 years old). Ma Yuxin was a little grumpy after waking up, so she patiently coaxed her and braided her pigtails. She reminded Ma Mingzhe to carefully check his schoolbag, then poured the mung bean soup she had simmered last night into water bottles for them to take. She watched the two children eat half a steamed bun and drink a bowl of soy milk, making sure they were full before going out.
location: Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Riding an electric bicycle to take the child to school
description: Today was the first time I rode the newly bought electric bike to take the children to school. First I carried the two kids, dropped Ma Mingzhe at the gate of Yucai Primary School and watched him enter the school gate; then took Ma Yuxin to Huakang First Kindergarten and handed her to the teacher. The whole round trip took less than 20 minutes, saving a lot of time compared to before, and I was very happy.
location: Starting from No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, went to Yucai Primary School on Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, then to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and finally returned home.

name: Buying groceries at Wutong Commune Market while waiting for the kids' test results
description: Rode the electric bike straight to the Wutong Commune vegetable market. Keeping her eldest son Ma Mingxuan's mid-term exam results on her mind, she turned her phone volume to maximum and held it tightly. First, she bought half a jin of goji berries and a piece of old ginger from Aunt Sun's familiar stall, then went to the live poultry stall and carefully selected a plump, tender local free-range chicken with shiny feathers, and asked the stallkeeper to slaughter and clean it. While paying, she kept her eyes on the phone screen, afraid of missing a call. After buying the chicken, she strolled around a bit more and bought a bundle of spring onions.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Received a call from the homeroom teacher with good news
description: While she was looking at wood ear mushrooms at the dried goods stall in the vegetable market, her phone rang. Seeing that it was the head teacher, Teacher Han, her heart tightened. Teacher Han laughed and congratulated her: "Mingxuan's mom, congratulations! Mingxuan got an A in both biology and geography in the preliminary high school entrance exam! He did very well and is a role model for our class!" Xiulan was so excited that she thanked him repeatedly, her voice trembling. After hanging up, her eyes were rimmed with red.
location: Dried Goods Area, Wutong Community Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Going to Zhou Xiuqin's home to borrow the community market stall permit
description: Feeling happy after the good news, she rode her e-bike directly to Zhou Xiuqin's home. Zhou Xiuqin had already prepared a laminated temporary stall card for the community market. Besides confirming details such as arriving before 7 a.m. the next morning and bringing a tablecloth and small change, they also demonstrated and discussed the newly learned "daisy stitch" technique. Xiulan photographed the steps with her phone, planning to practice again at home.
location: Zhou Xiuqin's home, Room 401, Building 3, Wenhuali Residential Community, Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: 2025-11-22 21:00:00 to 2025-11-22 21:30:00
description: After leaving Zhou Xiuqin's house, she stopped by Chengxin Supermarket on Jianshe Road on the way. Her friend Liu Chunmei was sorting goods in the store, so Xiulan handed her a sample of the pickled cucumbers with the red label 'Xiulan Handmade Pickles, New Mildly Spicy Flavor' and introduced the newly adjusted taste. Liu Chunmei took a bite, nodded and praised that the flavor was not harsh on the throat and had a sweet aftertaste, and said it would definitely sell well. She agreed to set some aside for her regular customers to try.
location: Chengxin Supermarket, Jianshe Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Simmered chicken soup and prepared items for tomorrow's market.
description: After returning home, she first washed the free-range chicken, blanched it, and put it into a clay pot with enough water, ginger slices, and goji berries. She brought it to a boil over high heat, then turned to low heat and simmered slowly. While the soup was simmering, she went to the handcraft corner where she does needlework and picked out three prized embroidered pieces to sell at tomorrow's market: a lotus handkerchief, a set of daisy coasters, and two peace buckle pendants. She also checked the two sealed jars of pickled vegetable samples on the drying rack and confirmed they were intact. Finally, she took out a clean cloth pouch and put the change, the payment QR code, and the stall card into it one by one.
location: Kitchen and craft corner at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Simple lunch and midday rest
description: The aroma of chicken soup filled the whole house. Xiulan cooked a small handful of dried noodles for herself, mixed them with chopped scallions, soy sauce, and a little lard to make a steaming hot bowl of noodles. After eating, she soaked the bowl and chopsticks in the sink, leaned back on the living room sofa, closed her eyes, and rested for about 20 minutes. With things on her mind, she could not sleep soundly, so she got up after a short while.
location: Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Midday tidying and needlework.
description: After washing the dishes, Xiulan sat in a well-lit spot by the living room window, took out paper and a pen, and made a list of things to take to the stall tomorrow: tablecloth, embroidered pieces, pickled vegetables, storage boxes, change, water cup, and a small folding stool. Then she picked up a handkerchief whose edge she planned to embroider, and while doing needlework, she mulled over how to chat with other stallholders at the market tomorrow and introduce her products, occasionally stretching her sore lower back.
location: Living room and craft corner at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Tending to the chicken soup and delivering soup to the neighbors
description: She went to the kitchen to check the clay pot; the chicken soup had turned golden. She skimmed off the surface oil and continued simmering it over low heat. When the time was right, she ladled a small bowl of the freshly simmered chicken soup, sprinkled it with chopped scallions, and carried it to Sister Wang Guilan's home across the hall. Sister Wang was sitting at her doorway trimming vegetables, and as soon as she smelled the aroma she guessed it was Xiulan's stewed chicken. The two sat in the hallway chatting for about ten minutes, and Sister Wang praised Mingxuan for being promising. Xiulan shared the good news that the child had gotten double A's, and Sister Wang was happy for her too.
location: Home kitchen at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and the doorstep of Wang Guilan's home across the hall in the same building

name: Prepare and head to her parents' home to share the good news.
description: Back home, she found a clean insulated lunch box, carefully filled it to the brim with chicken soup, and cut up the leftover cucumber pickles from last night and put them into a clean small jar. She placed both into a carrying bag. At 4 p.m., when the sunlight was weakening, she rode her electric bike to her parents' home on Shengli Street. As soon as she entered, she excitedly told her mother Li Xiuying and father Ma Jianguo the good news that her eldest son had scored double A's. When she opened the insulated lunch box, the aroma of chicken soup filled the air, and she also brought out the cucumber pickles for her parents to taste the new flavor. Her parents were very happy. Her father kept praising his grandson for being promising and said he would call Mingxuan over so Grandpa could make something delicious. Xiulan chatted with her parents for half an hour and felt at ease only after seeing that they were in good spirits.
location: Depart from 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and head to parents' home at 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Pick up the youngest daughter and youngest son from school.
description: After leaving her parents' home, she first rode her bike to Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up Ma Yuxin, then stopped by the gate of Yucai Primary School to pick up Ma Mingzhe. As soon as the two children saw their mother, they chattered about whether there was anything tasty today; Xiulan smiled and told them to go home to find out.
location: Starting from No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, then going in turn to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten in Jinghai District, Tianjin, and Yucai Primary School on Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and finally returning to the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road.

name: Prepare a hearty family celebration dinner
description: Back home, she plunged straight into the kitchen. She reheated the chicken soup that had been simmering all afternoon until it was boiling hot, then quickly stir-fried two dishes the children love: scrambled eggs with tomatoes and garlic stir-fried lettuce. The rice in the steamer was also perfectly cooked, and the whole house was filled with the aroma of the meal.
location: China, Tianjin Jinghai District, No. 156 Jingwen Road, home kitchen

name: Family celebratory dinner
description: Eldest son Ma Mingxuan came home from school, and husband Ma Zhiqiang also came home from work. The family of five sat around the dining table. Xiulan put the biggest chicken drumstick into Mingxuan's bowl. Zhiqiang, in a rare smile, raised his bowl and used soup as wine, praising Mingxuan for bringing honor to the family. Mingxuan scratched his head sheepishly. His younger brother and sister curiously asked him what the exam had felt like, and his younger brother Ma Mingzhe even imitated his brother taking the exam, which made the whole family laugh. The atmosphere at the dinner table was especially warm and lively.
location: Dining room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Walk with the whole family in the community garden
description: After dinner, Xiulan suggested going downstairs for a walk. The family changed into slippers and strolled along the tree-lined path in the community garden for about 18 minutes. Mingxuan and Dad walked ahead chatting about school, while Xiulan held Xinxin and Zhezhe's hands and followed behind. The evening breeze dispersed the day's heat, and the family chatted and laughed, enjoying a rare warm moment.
location: Jingwen Road Community Garden, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Urging the children to wash up and checking the items for tomorrow's market.
description: After returning home from the walk, she urged the two younger children to take baths, while the eldest son Ma Mingxuan went off to review his lessons on his own. Xiulan cleaned up the kitchen and washed the dishes and chopsticks. Then she opened the cloth bag for tomorrow's market and checked it again: stall card, payment QR code, change, three embroidered pieces, two jars of pickled vegetables. After confirming everything was in order, she folded a clean white cotton tablecloth and put it in as well, making sure nothing was left to chance.
location: Every room and the kitchen of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Relaxation and preparation before bed
description: The children and her husband had all gone to bed. Xiulan returned to the bedroom, sat on the edge of the bed, took 5 minutes of deep breaths, and with her eyes closed reviewed the good things that happened during the day, feeling both warm and reassured. Before lying down, she casually reminded her husband Ma Zhiqiang, 'I'll leave early tomorrow morning for the market; make sure you take the children to school.'
location: Bedroom at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Lights out, bedtime
description: Lying on her pillow, Xiulan mentally ran through tomorrow's market preparations one last time, told herself to sleep early and rise early, and go to the market full of energy. As she thought, a smile crept across her lips, and she fell into a peaceful sleep.
location: Bedroom at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Preparing in the morning and attending the summer craft market
description: At 5:40 in the morning the alarm went off. After getting up, Ma Xiulan walked briskly in the courtyard and moved her shoulders and neck. Then she prepared breakfast and checked the items for her stall. At 6:10 she said goodbye to her husband and set out on foot along Jingwen Road toward People's Cultural Square, carrying a basket containing embroidered pieces and pickled cucumbers. The morning air was fresh. At 6:25, after arriving at the market, she set up the booth with her friend Zhou Xiuqin, displayed the embroideries and pickled vegetables, and talked sales strategies. At 7:00 the market officially opened. She warmly introduced the handmade embroideries to the public and demonstrated flat-stitch embroidery on the spot, attracting many customers. Around 10 o'clock, Director Li from the Jinghai District Cultural Center came to the stall, praised her craftsmanship, and invited her to the Jinghai District Folk Culture Festival to be held next month. Ma Xiulan happily wrote down the contact information. Near noon, as the crowd thinned, she talked with the neighboring stall owner and they exchanged contact details. She counted the day's sales revenue, which came to 180 yuan, and put the money away safely. At 11:30 she began to pack up, returned the stall permit with Zhou Xiuqin, said goodbye, and ended a busy morning.
location: People's Cultural Square, Jinghai District, Tianjin (Market Booth Zone B, No. 12)

name: Return home at noon to keep the accounts and rest.
description: At 12:30, Ma Xiulan walked home, a little tired but inwardly satisfied. She first put away the remaining embroideries and pickled vegetables, then took out the family account book and sat at the square table in the living room to carefully record today's market income of 180 yuan and plan how to use the money. After recording, she wiped her face and took a 20-minute nap in the bedroom to regain energy.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: An embroidery gathering with childhood friends in the courtyard.
description: At 13:10, childhood friend Liu Chunmei came to visit, bringing homemade sour plum drink and fried dough twists. Ma Xiulan had arranged the rattan chairs and low table in the courtyard in advance. The two savored the sour plum drink beside the hydrangeas, exchanging embroidery stitching techniques and sharing what they had seen at the market. Ma Xiulan excitedly told her about being invited to the Folk Culture Festival, and Liu Chunmei was happy for her, suggesting that she appropriately raise the price of the soy-sauce cucumbers or run a buy-one-get-one-free promotion. The two chatted freely all afternoon. At about 15:50, Chunmei took her leave. After seeing her off, Ma Xiulan tidied up the courtyard items, put the rattan chairs and cups back in place, organized the embroidery threads, and brought the happy gathering to an end.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Picking up the children from school and contacting the eldest son on the way.
description: At 16:10, Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin, then went to Yucai Primary School to pick up her second son Ma Mingzhe. After picking up the two children, they rode home. On the way, at 16:50, she called her eldest son Ma Mingxuan to confirm that he had ridden his bike home by himself, and reminded him to pay attention to safety. Along the way, she chatted with the children, enjoying the after-school time together.
location: Along the route: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home), Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, and Yucai Primary School.

name: Preparing dinner, having a family meal, and helping with household chores.
description: At 17:10, Ma Xiulan came home, tied on her apron, and carefully prepared dinner: stewed free-range chicken, stir-fried tomatoes with eggs, garlic water spinach, and tiger-skin green peppers. At 18:00, her husband Ma Zhiqiang and eldest son Ma Mingxuan arrived one after another, and the whole family sat together to eat. At the dinner table, she once again shared the good news that the market stall was invited to participate in the cultural festival. Her husband praised her, and the children playfully cheered, creating a warm and lively atmosphere. After dinner, she cleared the dishes and cleaned the kitchen, then urged the two sons to do their homework and patiently tutored her second son Ma Mingzhe in math until 20:00.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening walk, free time, and going to bed
description: At 20:00, Ma Xiulan put on her sports shoes and took a 15-minute walk alone in the neighborhood, enjoying the evening breeze and feeling grounded as she reviewed the day's experiences. After returning home, she washed up and changed clothes. Seeing the children playing in the living room, she sat down to plan the next day's weekend trip to the supermarket to buy pork ribs, and saved Director Li of the Cultural Center's contact information as a note on her phone. At 22:00, after urging the children to bed, she went back to her room, sat cross-legged on the bed for 5 minutes of quiet meditation, emptied her mind of distractions, and thought about how to improve the lotus-pattern embroidery. Then she lay down contentedly and soon fell asleep.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning walk and breakfast preparation
description: Waking up early in the morning, Ma Xiulan walked briskly on the sidewalk on Jingwen Road outside the community for about 15 minutes, then stretched for 5 minutes at the roadside community fitness point. After returning home, she washed up, put on an apron, and prepared breakfast: kneaded dough to make steamed flower rolls, steamed eggs, cooked millet and red date porridge, and sliced pickled cucumber and sausage. She woke up the family and reminded her eldest son to wear new clothes.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home and sidewalk outside the residential community)

name: Family breakfast and getting dressed for graduation.
description: The family sat around eating breakfast. Ma Xiulan urged the children to hurry up and checked the white tulle dress, the phone for recording videos, hair clips and other items prepared for her daughter. After breakfast, she helped her daughter change into the graduation tulle dress, put her hair in a high ponytail, and put on new hair clips. Her husband and eldest son also got changed.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home dining room and bedroom)

name: Set off for the kindergarten
description: The whole family set out in high spirits. The husband rode the electric bike with the second son; Ma Xiulan rode hers with the daughter; the eldest son rode a bicycle. Starting from home on Jingwen Road, they rode along Dongfanghong Road for about 15 minutes and arrived at Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten.
location: The route from 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin to Huakang First Kindergarten, 50 Dongfanghong Road

name: Attended her daughter's kindergarten graduation ceremony.
description: At Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, they first took photos under the graduation arch. After the ceremony began, Ma Xiulan recorded the whole process. Her daughter performed the lead recitation of 'The Promise of the Rainbow,' and she was moved to tears. After the ceremony, she hugged and praised her daughter, and finally asked a teacher to take a family photo in front of the slide.
location: Huakang First Kindergarten, No. 50 Dongfanghong Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Lunch and yard care
description: After the ceremony, she cycled home. Ma Xiulan cooked noodles with thick gravy, and the family ate noodles topped with tomato, egg, wood ear mushroom, and day lily sauce. After the meal she cleared the dishes, carried a bucket to the courtyard to water the hydrangeas and green beans and pull weeds, and cut a few roses to put in the vase on the dining table to add a festive touch.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home kitchen, dining room, and courtyard)

name: Afternoon rest and embroidery handwork.
description: A shower falls outside, and the whole family cozies up in the living room watching TV and a movie. Ma Xiulan sits in a rattan chair by the window, takes out the unfinished Joy-on-the-Brow handkerchief, and continues embroidering by the daylight, enjoying a peaceful afternoon.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home living room)

name: Take her daughter to visit her maternal grandparents.
description: After the rain stopped, Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to take her daughter to her parents' home. Her mother happily hugged her granddaughter, and her father took out a small wooden horse he had polished by hand and gave it to his granddaughter as a graduation gift.
location: 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin (parents' home)

name: Help mother organize the storage room
description: Ma Xiulan took the initiative to help her mother tidy the storage room, fold up the out-of-season quilts, pack up old things, and wipe the cabinets. At the same time, she chatted with her mother about summer vacation plans and things to note when doing handicraft piecework.
location: 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin (the storage room at the parents' home)

name: Shopping at the vegetable market.
description: After leaving her parents' house, she rode her electric bike to the Wutong Commune vegetable market on the way, and at her usual stall bought fresh pork ribs, corn, and carrots to prepare ingredients for a clear, slightly sweet pork rib soup for dinner.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Returning home to prepare food and supervise homework
description: After returning home, she first checked the two sons' homework, praised the elder son for having completed most of it, and urged the second son to hurry up. Then she went into the kitchen, blanched the pork ribs, cut the corn and carrots into chunks, put them into a clay pot with ginger slices and scallion sections to simmer slowly, and cleaned and washed the greens.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (living room and kitchen at home)

name: The whole family had dinner together.
description: The aroma of pork rib soup filled the air. Ma Xiulan brought out the clay pot and also stir-fried garlic lettuce and tomato scrambled eggs. The family sat together for dinner; her husband served soup for everyone, the children ate heartily, and laughter and cheerful conversation never stopped.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home dining room)

name: After-meal chores and a couple's walk
description: Ma Xiulan washed the dishes and tidied the kitchen, then took down the dried clothes, folded them, and put them back in each person's wardrobe. Afterward, she called her husband to go downstairs and walked slowly for 20 minutes in the community central garden, chatting about the touching graduation ceremony and the children's growth.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home and the inner garden of the residential complex)

name: Evening wash-up and parent-child time.
description: After returning from the walk, she urged the two children to take baths, helped her daughter wash her hair, and ran bathwater for her second son. After her daughter finished, she read her a bedtime story and tucked her in after she fell asleep. Then she went to her second son's room to check his red scarf and homework for returning to school the next day.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home bathroom and children's bedroom)

name: Late-night conversation between husband and wife
description: After the children were all asleep, Ma Xiulan lay in bed chatting with her husband, recalling how moving the graduation ceremony had been and discussing preparations for next month's folk culture festival exhibition and the family summer travel plans.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home master bedroom)

name: Review and preparation before bed
description: After her husband fell asleep, Ma Xiulan looked through the videos and photos she had taken that day on her phone, sent a voice message to her childhood friend asking about the pickled vegetable market, and saved the number of Director Li, whom she had met yesterday, as "Jinghai Cultural Center - Director Li." After setting the alarm for the next day, she sat quietly for 5 minutes and then fell asleep peacefully.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home master bedroom)

name: Wake-up and morning exercise
description: Woke up naturally to birdsong outside the window, 20 minutes earlier than usual. Got up quietly, drank a glass of warm water, changed into sportswear, and warmed up wrists and ankles. Then went out and walked briskly along Jingwen Road for about 16 minutes, breathing the fresh morning air and planning the day in mind. After that, did 5 minutes of shoulder and neck stretches on the open space in front of the house to relax tense muscles.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and the sidewalks on both sides of Jingwen Road

name: Family harvesting and washing spinach
description: She called to her second son, Ma Mingzhe, and daughter Ma Yuxin, who had just gotten up. She took out a small bamboo basket, scissors, and gloves from the storage room, and in the courtyard vegetable plot demonstrated how to cut spinach from the roots. The children imitated with earnest looks. The three of them squatted by the vegetable bed, harvesting and chatting. After harvesting, she taught the children to discard the old roots and yellow leaves. Then they went to the kitchen, put the trimmed spinach into a large basin, and rinsed it thoroughly with clean water three times. She told the children to check the underside of each leaf for insects one by one. As she washed, her daughter Ma Yuxin counted how many spinach plants there were in total. After washing, they took them out to drain and set aside.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tend the courtyard and prepare the dough
description: After the children went to do homework, Xiulan first went to the courtyard to water the remaining scallions and chives and pull out weeds. Then she returned to the kitchen, chopped half of the fresh spinach, mixed it with flour, yeast and salt, kneaded it into a smooth green dough, covered it with a damp cloth and left it in a warm place to rise. She then took the multigrain porridge that had been cooked in the morning off the stove and ladled out a bowl as her own breakfast.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Making spinach steamed buns
description: Checked the dough: it had risen to twice its size and was honeycombed inside, very satisfying. Released the gas from the dough, rolled it into a strip, cut into small pieces, and shaped them into round raw mantou buns, placing them neatly on the steaming tray for a second proof. Then steamed them over high heat for 15 minutes. After taking them out, she tried one herself—chewy and fragrant. She cooled most of the mantou and put them in the steamer, leaving them for the whole family to enjoy at noon.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Phone call and getting ready to go out.
description: While the mantou were steaming, she called her childhood friend Liu Chunmei to arrange an afternoon discussion about next week's pickled vegetable promotion. After getting a positive reply, she changed into neat casual clothes, picked up a reusable shopping bag and her phone, and got ready to go grocery shopping.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Go to the supermarket for shopping and talk with Liu Chunmei
description: She rode her electric bike from home, headed west along Jingwen Road, turned onto Shengli Street, and traveled about 1.5 kilometers to reach Century Hualian Supermarket. She went straight to the dried goods section to choose fresh zongzi leaves, glutinous rice, and pitted honey dates, then went to the fresh food section and bought two yellow croakers. At the checkout, she deliberately looked at the promotional posters to compare pickled vegetable prices. Beside the cashier, she met Liu Chunmei, who was tidying the shelf display. They chatted briefly; Chunmei excitedly said the weekend event would surely go smoothly, and Xiulan agreed to discuss details at 2 p.m.
location: Century Hualian Supermarket, southeast corner of the intersection of Dongfanghong Road and Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Returning home and making and enjoying lunch
description: Rode the electric bike back home the same way and immediately prepared the yellow croaker for steaming. At the same time, she reheated the steamed spinach buns thoroughly in the pan and warmed up the leftover pork rib soup from yesterday. At 12:30 in the afternoon, the family sat around the dining table. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang took a bite of the bun and praised it endlessly. Her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin held up a small bun and said that the vegetables her mother grew were the most delicious. The dining table was filled with laughter and joy.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Finishing lunch, putting away spinach, and taking a noon break
description: After the meal, she let her husband take the children to watch TV while she cleaned up the dishes by herself, putting away the leftover pork rib soup and its broth. Then she blanched the remaining fresh spinach, squeezed out the water, rolled it into fist-sized spinach balls, wrapped each one in plastic wrap, and placed them in the freezer for later use in dumplings or vegetable soup. After finishing, she lay on the sofa and set a nap alarm for 35 minutes. When she woke up, she did deep breathing to fully refresh herself, building up energy for the afternoon's main tasks.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Agreed on the pickle promotion details and returned
description: Rode the electric bike to Hualian Supermarket on time, and in the staff break area discussed in detail with Liu Chunmei the pickle promotion plan for next Saturday: the tasting table would be set at the entrance of the pickle section, with supermarket staff providing samples from 8:00 to 12:00; all pickles would have a buy two get one free offer, originally 15 yuan per jar, promotional price 30 yuan for three jars; Chunmei would be responsible for applying for small saucers, toothpicks and special price labels, while Xiulan would prepare enough samples and simple flyers. The two hit it off immediately and finished the discussion in about 1 hour. Xiulan then rode her electric bike back home.
location: Century Hualian Supermarket, southeast corner of the intersection of Dongfanghong Road and Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Urgently prepare samples of the pickled vegetables for tasting
description: After returning home, she immediately brought out two large jars of pickled cucumbers, about 10 jin in total, from the storage room. Wearing disposable gloves, she cut the pickled cucumbers into even small pieces and divided them into about 200 portions, each about 30 grams, using small food bags. With a marker she wrote June 28 promotional tasting sample and Hualian Supermarket on labels, stuck them on the bags, and neatly placed them in the refrigerator's cold-storage compartment.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Make homemade yogurt and prepare portions to share.
description: After handling the pickled vegetables, she started making this week’s yogurt. She poured 1 liter of whole milk into a pot and heated it until it was slightly bubbling (about 80°C), then turned off the heat and let it cool until it was no longer hot to the touch (about 40°C). She poured in a small packet of yogurt starter powder, stirred well, divided it into 4 glass bottles, and put them into the yogurt maker together with the finished pickled vegetable tasting samples, then set the time. At the same time, she portioned out three extra servings of unfermented milk (about 150ml each) and a pack of pickled vegetable tasting samples, preparing to give them to her parents and neighbors.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Giving gifts to parents and neighbors
description: Carrying the portioned milk and pickled vegetable samples, she first rode her electric bike to her parents' home at 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, handed the items to her mother Li Xiuying, and told her about next week's supermarket promotion. Her mother accepted with a smile and gave her a bag of homegrown sweet potatoes in return. After returning home, she knocked on the door of Sister Wang Guilan across the hall, gave her yogurt and pickled vegetables as well, and invited her to go to the supermarket together next week to show support.
location: No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and across from No. 156 Jingwen Road

name: Dinner and family interaction
description: After returning home, the eldest son Ma Mingxuan had already finished his homework. Xiulan made a simple dinner: she reheated the pork rib soup and spinach steamed buns from noon and stir-fried a plate of sweet potato leaves that Sister Wang had given her. The whole family ate and chatted. Xiulan announced the plan to go to the supermarket promotion on the weekend, and her husband Ma Zhiqiang encouraged her, "Work hard—our pickled vegetables are better than what's sold outside!" The three children also said they would help. After dinner, she urged Ma Mingzhe and Ma Yuxin to do their homework and take baths.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening family walk
description: While it was still not fully dark, Xiulan and her husband took their younger daughter Ma Yuxin for a slow walk around the neighborhood for about 10 minutes to relax. They had used a lot of energy during the day, so they walked very slowly. After two laps, their daughter was drawn to some ants on the roadside and stopped to watch. The couple stayed with her, enjoying this rare parent-child time.
location: The residential community at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Children's bedtime, personal matters, and pre-sleep preparation
description: After returning home, she urged her daughter Ma Yuxin to brush her teeth and wash her face, helped her change into pajamas, and read two pages of "The Little Prince" to lull her to sleep. Then she sat down on the sofa and sent a WeChat voice message to Director Li of the Cultural Center asking about the exact date of next month's Folk Culture Festival so she could prepare her embroidery in advance. After sending it, she took out the yogurt made in the yogurt maker and put it in the refrigerator. Once she confirmed the children were all asleep, she started her 5-minute pre-bedtime deep breathing and neck-shoulder stretches, paying extra attention to stretching her sore shoulders. She checked her phone and saw Director Li's reply: tentatively July 20. She replied, "Received, thank you Director Li!" Then she turned off the light with peace of mind and fell asleep in the moonlight.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Early morning walk
description: Woke up naturally at 5:50. Because of a dull ache in her right lower back, Ma Xiulan did not do her usual brisk walk. She put on her sneakers and walked slowly along Jingwen Road outside her door for about 12 minutes. Halfway through, the discomfort in her lower back had not improved, so she turned back early. After returning home, she did a 5-minute shoulder and neck stretch in the living room and gently massaged her lower back with her hands, hoping to relieve the soreness.
location: Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare breakfast
description: After a quick wash-up, Ma Xiulan started preparing breakfast. She boiled some water, took out the millet porridge and two steamed buns made the night before, and reheated them in the steamer. She also cut a small plate of her own pickled cucumbers and peeled an extra boiled egg for her husband, Ma Zhiqiang.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home kitchen)

name: Wake up the children and have breakfast together
description: Ma Xiulan woke up her second son Ma Mingzhe (10 years old) and youngest daughter Ma Yuxin (6 years old) one by one, urging them to get dressed and wash up. Her eldest son Ma Mingxuan (13 years old) got up by himself. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang finished washing up. The family of five sat around the dining table eating breakfast. Ma Xiulan told the children to behave at school today, especially reminding Ma Mingzhe not to get distracted in class. Ma Zhiqiang ate quickly because he needed to leave early for his driving shift, and Ma Xiulan packed his thermos and the lunchbox prepared the night before.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home dining room)

name: Take the children to school.
description: Ma Xiulan got on her electric bike and first took her youngest daughter, Ma Yuxin, to the gate of Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, watching her go into the campus with her teacher. Then she rode to take her second son, Ma Mingzhe, to the gate of Yucai Primary School in Jinghai District (the actual address is Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School). Her eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, rode his own bicycle to junior high school. On the way, the electric bike passed over a small pothole and jolted. Ma Xiulan felt more obvious discomfort in her lower back and instinctively supported her waist with her hand.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten (Jinghai District, Tianjin), then to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin)

name: Buying groceries on the way
description: After escorting the children to school, Ma Xiulan went to Wutong Gongshe Vegetable Market on the way. Although her back was uncomfortable, she still bought a few necessities: a piece of fresh tofu (for soup at noon), a small bunch of chives (to scramble with eggs in the evening), and two tomatoes. At Aunt Sun's stall, she picked out some greens, chatted with Aunt Sun about trivial things, and complained, "This old back got pulled yesterday from moving things." Aunt Sun urged her to rest more and not get too tired.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Organizing craft materials and thinking up new patterns
description: Upon returning home, Ma Xiulan put away the vegetables. She went to the 'handicraft corner' in the living room and sorted the fabrics and embroidery threads stored yesterday by color and material, then put them into storage boxes. She took out two half-finished embroidery hoops, examined them, and gently laid them flat on the table. To prepare for next month's folk culture festival, she sketched a few new patterns on draft paper with a pencil, including the auspicious 'fu' character pattern and lotus designs that match the season. Because her waist was uncomfortable, she strictly controlled her time: every 20 minutes of work she would stand up, walk to the window, and do a few backward bends, or hold the back of the chair with both hands and gently stretch her waist, trying to avoid staying in the same position for a long time.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home living room handicraft corner)

name: Rest between household chores.
description: After doing handwork for a while, Ma Xiulan felt her waist starting to ache again. She put down her work, walked to the balcony, opened the window to let in air, and took a few deep breaths. Then, using the folk method her mother had taught her, she placed both hands on her waist and slowly rotated it clockwise and counterclockwise to loosen the joints. Looking at the traffic passing on Jingwen Road outside the window, she mentally planned what she wanted to say to her mother on the phone in the afternoon.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home living room and balcony).

name: Preparing Lunch and Applying a Warm Compress to Her Waist
description: Since she was the only one at home at noon, Ma Xiulan decided to keep it simple and have a bowl of tomato and egg noodles. She cut the tomatoes into pieces, beat an egg, and quickly made a bowl of noodles. After eating, she boiled a pot of water, filled a hot water bottle with hot water, wrapped it tightly in a towel, lay flat on the bedroom bed, placed the hot water bottle on the sore part of her lower back, and began applying heat. She closed her eyes and rested for 15 minutes, and the muscles in her lower back relaxed a bit.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home kitchen and bedroom)

name: Noon break
description: After the hot compress, Ma Xiulan did not get up immediately. She drew the curtains, covered herself with a light quilt, and rested with her eyes closed for about half an hour, feeling much refreshed.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home bedroom)

name: Phone call with mother
description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan used the landline to call her mother Li Xiuying, who lives at 45 Shengli Street. On the phone, she talked about the children's recent studies and mentioned that her waist was uncomfortable from moving pickle jars. Her mother was concerned for her, scolded her for pushing herself too hard, told her to rest more, and again emphasized that she had homemade blood-activating and stasis-resolving plaster at home, asking her to come by and pick it up sometime in the next couple of days. Ma Xiulan agreed to go over tomorrow. She also asked about her father's health, and only after learning that everything was fine did she hang up with relief.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home living room)

name: Preparing pickle promotion and contacting friends
description: After hanging up, Ma Xiulan remembered the pickled vegetable promotion next Saturday (June 28). She walked to the refrigerator and checked the approximately 200 samples that she and Liu Chunmei had prepared and packaged the night before, confirming the count was correct. She then called her good friend Liu Chunmei to ask about the progress of the promotional poster design, and once again confirmed the details of the “buy two get one free” offer and the location of the tasting table. The two agreed to meet at the supermarket tomorrow to finalize the details in person.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home living room)

name: Short rest before picking up the children
description: After planning the promotion, Ma Xiulan felt a little tired. She took a lumbar support belt from the bedroom drawer (bought when she had a sprain before), fastened it around her waist, and felt better with the support. She packed a small light bag in advance, grabbed the keys to her electric bike, and got ready to go out and pick up the children.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home living room and bedroom)

name: Pick up the child from school
