description: Ma Xiulan first rode her electric bike to Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin. After picking her up, the mother and daughter rode to the gate of Yucai Primary School in Jinghai District to wait for Ma Mingzhe to finish school. The children were delighted to see their mother. Ma Yuxin even told her mother a nursery rhyme the teacher had taught in kindergarten. While riding, Ma Xiulan told the two children to wash their hands as soon as they got home.
location: From Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin)

name: Supervise homework and prepare dinner.
description: After getting home, Ma Xiulan told Ma Mingzhe to go to the study to do his homework, and told him that if he had any problems he didn't understand, he could wait until his older brother came back and ask him. She arranged for Ma Yuxin to do tracing practice on the living room coffee table to practice writing numbers. Then she went into the kitchen, took out the spinach and pork filling frozen the night before and the dough prepared earlier, and started making dumplings. To avoid standing too long, she brought a tall stool and sat in the kitchen while wrapping, keeping an eye on the children. After wrapping about 80 dumplings, she boiled water to cook them.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home study and kitchen)

name: The whole family had dinner together
description: Just after 7 p.m., Ma Zhiqiang came back from driving. Ma Xiulan had just cooked the first pot of dumplings. The family of five sat around the table and ate steaming hot spinach and egg dumplings. Ma Zhiqiang praised the filling for being well seasoned, and the children ate with relish. Watching her family enjoy the meal, Ma Xiulan also ate more than a dozen herself, and the sense of satisfaction in her heart softened the fatigue in her body.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home dining room)

name: After-meal cleanup and leisure
description: After dinner, Ma Zhiqiang took the initiative to wash the dishes and let Ma Xiulan rest. Ma Xiulan sat on the sofa, watched cartoons with her little daughter for a while, and at the same time supervised her second son as he finished the rest of his homework. Ma Mingxuan read in his own room. Ma Xiulan felt that her lower back was still a bit sore after sitting, so she got up and moved around.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home kitchen, living room)

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: Ma Xiulan helped her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin wash up and coaxed her to bed. Her second son Ma Mingzhe washed up by himself and also went to his room to rest. Her eldest son Ma Mingxuan was still reading in his own room. When Ma Xiulan washed up, she deliberately rinsed her lower back with hot water.
location: No. 156, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home bathroom and bedroom)

name: Pre-sleep relaxation and rest
description: Due to waist discomfort, Ma Xiulan canceled today's evening walk plan. She changed into pajamas, lay flat on the bed, placed the hot water bottle under her waist as before, and began 5 minutes of deep breathing relaxation. She closed her eyes and recalled the day's experiences: the discomfort in the morning, the little ideas while doing handicrafts, her mother's care on the phone, and the warm feeling of the family eating dumplings together... A plain sense of happiness welled up in her heart. At 22:10, she turned off the light, hoping to have a good night's sleep and feel better in her waist in the morning.
location: Tianjin, Jinghai District, 156 Jingwen Road (master bedroom at home)

name: Morning walk, stretching, and breakfast preparation
description: After getting up at 5:30 in the morning, Ma Xiulan changed into her running shoes and walked slowly on Jingwen Road for 15 minutes. Then she went home and did shoulder and neck stretches and cat-cow stretches in the living room to relieve the soreness in her lower back. After that, she prepared a nutritious breakfast for the family: cooked multigrain porridge, portioned out homemade yogurt, made a smashed cucumber salad, heated steamed buns, and sliced pickled vegetables, providing a healthy breakfast for her family.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin and the surrounding area

name: Family meeting to summarize the healthy eating plan and share results
description: During breakfast, Ma Xiulan held a brief family meeting and reported on the results of the one-month healthy eating plan, including the popularity of multigrain porridge and homemade yogurt and the improvement of the whole family's health. After the family unanimously gave their approval, she took a photo of the records and sent them to the family group, then called her mother Li Xiuying and her elder sister Li Xiuyun to share the joy and listen to their suggestions.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Taking the children to school
description: Ma Xiulan rode an electric bike to first take her daughter Ma Yuxin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, telling her to listen to the teacher, then take her second son Ma Mingzhe to No. 3 Primary School in Jinghai District, reminding him to drink more water.
location: Tianjin Jinghai District Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten and Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School.

name: Going home to tidy up and arranging with Liu Chunmei to go to the supermarket to discuss the promotion
description: After dropping off the children, Ma Xiulan went home, quickly cleared the dining table, washed the dishes and chopsticks, and put the change of clothes into the washing machine. She then called her friend Liu Chunmei to confirm they would meet at Century Hualian Supermarket around 9:30. She brought two boxes of homemade yogurt, rode her electric bike to the supermarket, and met Liu Chunmei at the pickled vegetable counter. The two carefully reviewed the Saturday promotion plan, discussed the placement of tasting samples and how to implement the buy-two-get-one-free offer, and Ma Xiulan also let Liu Chunmei taste the newly pickled mildly spicy pickled vegetables.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and Century Hualian Supermarket on Huagong Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Going to her parents' home to deliver yogurt and help out.
description: On the afternoon of March 31, 2025, at Jingbai Supermarket, besides Weijixian soy sauce and flour, what other goods did Ma Xiulan buy?
location: Parents' home, 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Go home for a simple lunch and a midday rest.
description: After returning home from her parents' house, Ma Xiulan had a simple lunch of leftover multigrain porridge and steamed buns from the morning, along with smashed cucumber salad. After the meal, she applied a hot water bottle to her lower back for 15 minutes, then set an alarm and took a sound 40-minute nap.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Afternoon housework and courtyard work
description: After waking from her nap, Ma Xiulan took out the clothes washed in the morning to dry and mopped the balcony floor. Then she went to the courtyard to hand-pollinate the flowering cucumber vines and picked tender cucumbers to prepare the next batch of pickled vegetables. While working, she made sure to straighten her back and stretch regularly to protect her waist.
location: Home courtyard at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the child from school
description: At 4 p.m., Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike first to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up her daughter Ma Yuxin, then to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up her second son Ma Mingzhe. Along the way, the two children shared interesting stories from school, and the atmosphere was cheerful.
location: Tianjin Jinghai District Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten and Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School.

name: Prepare dinner and have a family meal
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan started preparing dinner. Her oldest son, Ma Mingxuan, was already doing homework in his room. She stewed pork ribs, stir-fried the crown daisy she had brought back from her mother's house, steamed some buns, and sliced the pickled vegetables. When her husband, Ma Zhiqiang, came home at 6:30, he helped set out the bowls and chopsticks and serve the rice. The family sat around the table, eating and chatting in a warm atmosphere.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Supervise the children's homework and washing up
description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan cleared the dishes and chopsticks, while her husband Ma Zhiqiang was in charge of supervising the two boys' homework and checking their schoolbags. Ma Xiulan accompanied her young daughter Ma Yuxin in the living room to practice writing by tracing characters, and then washed her face and feet. After the two sons finished washing up, she coaxed her daughter to bed and finally did a simple wash-up herself.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Taking a relaxing walk around the neighborhood with her husband and preparing for bed
description: In the evening, after the children became quiet, Ma Xiulan and her husband Ma Zhiqiang went downstairs together and took a slow walk around the neighborhood for about 18 minutes, chatting about family matters and remarking that the soreness in her lower back had eased. After returning home, she sat quietly alone and did deep breathing to relax for 5 minutes, then applied a hot water bottle to her lower back and briefly recorded the fullness of the day in her journal before turning off the light and going to sleep.
location: The community at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and home.

name: Morning wake-up, activity, and hot compress
description: Woke up naturally at 5:15 a.m. Because the symptoms of lumbar disc herniation had eased a little yesterday, she did not dare to be careless. First, she walked slowly in the living room for about 15 minutes to relax. Then she went to the kitchen and simmered millet and red date porridge over low heat. Returning to the bedroom, she used the hot water bottle she had prepared last night to apply heat to her lower back for 20 minutes, feeling warm and comfortable.
location: At home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing breakfast and taking care of the family.
description: At 6:10, she woke up the children and her husband. After getting everyone up, she brought steamed flower rolls, fried eggs, and cooked millet porridge to the table. She packed her husband Zhiqiang's lunch for his driving shift today: reheating yesterday's leftover eggplant with minced pork, along with two large steamed buns and homemade pickled cucumbers. She checked her son Mingzhe's and daughter Yuxin's schoolbags and reminded them that there would be thunderstorms in the afternoon and to be sure to put umbrellas in the side pockets of their backpacks.
location: At home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Riding an electric bicycle to take the child to school
description: She got on the electric bike, first took her daughter Yuxin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, watched her walk through the school gate, and greeted the teacher at the door. Then she turned around and took her son Mingzhe to Yucai Primary School in Jinghai District, reminding him at the school gate to listen carefully in class. Traffic was normal on the way, and it took about 35 minutes.
location: Huakang First Kindergarten (78 Shengli Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin) and Yucai Primary School of Jinghai District (150 Jianshe Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin)

name: Return home, breakfast, and household chores.
description: After returning home, she ladled herself a bowl of porridge and quickly finished breakfast with pickled vegetables and the leftover fried eggs. Then she gathered all the family's bowls and chopsticks into the sink, put the clothes she had changed out of last night into the washing machine, and started the quick-wash mode.
location: At home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Follow-up blood test and lower back consultation at the community health service center
description: At 8:30, she walked about 10 minutes to the community center. After registering, she first had blood drawn for a routine blood test follow-up. After waiting about 35 minutes for the results, her hemoglobin had risen to 108g/L. She then took the lab report to the general practice clinic to see Dr. Wang. Dr. Wang happily said the anemia had improved significantly and reminded her to pay attention to her diet. Ma Xiulan then described in detail the recent lower back soreness and discomfort caused by embroidery and making pickled vegetables. Through consultation and physical examination, Dr. Wang diagnosed lumbar muscle strain, advised her to reduce bending over, and taught her two exercises on the spot: cat stretch and wall-assisted waist twists. Ma Xiulan watched carefully and memorized them attentively.
location: Jinghai District Chaoyang Street Community Health Service Center, 16 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Return home, practice rehabilitation exercises, and have lunch
description: At 11:45 she left the community hospital and walked home. After arriving, she spread a mat on the living room carpet and tried 5 rounds of cat stretch and 5 rounds of wall-supported waist twists. Though her form wasn't standard, she felt a stretch in her lower back. Then she went to the balcony, adjusted the embroidery stand to a height that didn't require bending down, and moved the pickled vegetable jars from the storage room onto higher stools. At noon, she had a simple lunch alone, heating up porridge and steamed rolls, with fermented bean curd.
location: At home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Noon break
description: After the meal, felt tired and lay down on the living room sofa to rest for about 40 minutes to fully relax my lower back.
location: Living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Organize a draft budget for a family trip.
description: After the afternoon nap, she felt refreshed, went to the study, and took out the account book. Based on information found online, she estimated the cost of taking the whole family to Beijing during the summer vacation: train hard-seat round trip about 200 yuan, two nights in a family inn about 400 yuan, plus tickets to the Forbidden City, Tian'anmen, and other sights, and three days of meals, totaling about 1,100 yuan. She wrote the budget on paper and planned to set aside 600 yuan from the education savings as a special fund, intending to discuss it with her husband in the evening.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin — home study

name: Afternoon nap and preparing to pick up the children
description: Feeling sleepy after finishing the budget, she dozed off for about 20 minutes in the rattan chair in the living room. After waking up, she walked slowly for 5 minutes to relax her waist, then put on a sun hat, grabbed the electric bike keys, and got ready to go pick up the children.
location: At home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the child from school
description: Rode the electric bike to first pick up daughter Yuxin from kindergarten, then pick up son Mingzhe from primary school. On the way back, Yuxin chattered about kindergarten fun, and Mingzhe said he got a little red flower in math class. The three of them chatted and laughed all the way home.
location: Huakang First Kindergarten (78 Shengli Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin) and Yucai Primary School of Jinghai District (150 Jianshe Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin)

name: Accompany the children and prepare dinner.
description: After getting home, she arranged for Mingzhe to do his homework while Yuxin practiced calligraphy in the living room. Ma Xiulan started bustling about the kitchen, planning to make noodle soup with gravy and smashed cucumber salad. While boiling water for the noodles, she prepared eggs, wood ear mushrooms, day lily buds and other ingredients for the topping.
location: At home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner and summer vacation plan discussion
description: At 5:40, the eldest son Xuanxuan came home from school. Ma Xiulan cooked the sauce for noodles and then waited for her husband Zhiqiang. A little after 6, Zhiqiang came back, and the whole family sat around the table eating noodles with sauce and smashed cucumber. At the table, Ma Xiulan talked about the follow-up checkup and her back treatment, and the children were happy that their mother's anemia had improved. She proposed going to Beijing for the summer vacation, and the children cheered. After dinner, Zhiqiang helped clean up. Ma Xiulan pulled him into the study, took out the budget draft, and discussed the travel plan in detail, including the cost, how to save money, and the timing. Zhiqiang nodded in agreement and said he would drive more long-distance routes to save up. The two reached a consensus.
location: The dining room and study at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening activities and bedtime
description: After the family meeting, Ma Xiulan urged the children to take turns bathing, arranged for her sons to do homework, and accompanied Yuxin in watching half an hour of cartoons. Because of the thunderstorm outside, she gave up her outdoor walk and did 10 sets each of cat stretch and wall-supported waist twists in the living room, feeling her lower back warm and relaxed. After the children fell asleep, she sent a WeChat message to her childhood friend Liu Chunmei to confirm the Saturday promotion time, silently kept accounts in her mind, reviewed the next day's plan, and applied a hot water bottle to her lower back. Before bed, she checked the doors, windows, and gas, tucked her daughter in, washed up briefly, set the alarm, turned off the light, and fell asleep peacefully to the sound of rain.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, throughout the home

name: Waking up early and morning exercise
description: The phone alarm rang on time, and she got up quickly. First she drank a glass of warm water. Because of lumbar muscle strain, she sat on the edge of the bed for a dozen seconds to ease herself before slowly standing up. After washing up, she changed into loose cotton-linen workout clothes, and took the opportunity to rinse the pea sprouts that had been soaking in a basin overnight, draining them for later. Pushing open the door, she brisk-walked along Jingwen Road for about 15 minutes. When she passed neighbor Wang Guilan's gate, Wang Guilan was watering flowers, and the two chatted a few words across the iron fence. Wang said it was muggy today and told her not to get heatstroke. She replied that she knew, then took a loop and went home. Back on the stone floor of her small courtyard, she spread out the exercise mat and seriously practiced cat stretches and wall-supported waist twists. Her movements were a little stiff, but she gritted her teeth and could clearly feel the sore muscles in her lower back slowly relaxing. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang passed by, watched her hunched on the mat, and said with a smile, 'This is like worshipping Buddha.' She retorted, 'Doctor Wang taught me this, and it really works! Mind your own business.' After that, she did two more sets.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing breakfast, eating, and getting ready to head out.
description: Back in the kitchen, I started preparing breakfast. Today's main dishes were multigrain porridge and fennel and pork dumplings that I had brought back from my mother's house last night. I took the dumplings out of the fridge and steamed them. I also sliced a plate of my homemade pickled cucumber. Hearing the bustle, my husband Ma Zhiqiang got up too. He wasn't driving today, so he was staying home to rest. After washing up, he had already set the breakfast on the table. At 6:45 I went to wake Mingzhe and Xinxin and urged them to wash up and eat. The whole family sat around the table, and my husband said as he ate, "Mom's dumplings are really delicious." I quickly cleaned up the dishes, put the leftover porridge and dumplings in the pot to keep warm for lunch. I changed into my usual going-out outfit of a floral blouse and trousers, grabbed my sun hat and electric bike keys. Before leaving, I took out two small jars of plain yogurt I had made last night from the fridge and put them into a cloth bag, to bring to my mother.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Take the children to school.
description: Riding the electric bike, with Mingzhe on the back seat. On the way she told him: 'Listen carefully in class today, don't wrestle with your classmates, and also watch your posture, don't always slouch.' Mingzhe acknowledged and said he knew. At around 7:30 she arrived at the gate of Yucai Primary School and watched the child walk into the school before turning the bike around. Then she continued riding the electric bike with Xinxin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten. On the way, Xinxin asked, 'Mom, when are we going to Beijing?' She smiled and said, 'After you finish your exams and summer vacation starts, Mom and Dad will take you and your brother to see Tiananmen.' The little girl immediately became happy and hummed a children's song. Around 7:45 she arrived at the kindergarten gate.
location: Yucai Primary School and Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten on Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Strolling through the vegetable market
description: After dropping off the kids, she went to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market on the way. First she went to Aunt Sun's stall and picked fresh green beans, two loofahs, and a bunch of scallions. Then she went to Master Li's butcher shop and weighed out one and a half jin of hind leg meat, planning to go back and mince it for filling, and eat it with the dumplings her mother had given her in the evening. She calculated to herself that since her husband was home, dinner should be a bit more substantial.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Return home to tidy up, rest, and prepare to visit parents.
description: Back home, she first sorted the groceries into the refrigerator by category. While her back wasn't too sore yet, she minced the meat filling needed for the evening and put it on a plate for later. Then she put the clothes changed yesterday into the washing machine to wash. After finishing these tasks, she sat down on the sofa and felt a dull ache in her lower back. Remembering the doctor's orders, she walked to the wall, stood with her back against it, and did a few backward-leaning stretches, which made her feel somewhat relieved. Then she put the yogurt and a few cold dumplings steamed that morning into a cloth bag, and grabbed a handful of fresh scallions bought in the morning. Before getting on the electric bike, she took out her phone and added the memo "Buy promotional packaging bags for pickled vegetables at the market next Monday" to her phone's memo app so she wouldn't forget.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Go to parents' home
description: Rode the electric bike to her parents' home, about 15 minutes in total. A gentle breeze brushed her face on the way, and she thought about how she could spend quality time with her mother today and teach her to stretch.
location: No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Visiting parents, teaching stretching, and family time
description: Arrived at her parents' home. Her mother Li Xiuying was trimming chives in the kitchen and beamed with joy when she saw her come in. She handed over the yogurt and dumplings and said, "Mom, I brought these for you. This is my newly made yogurt. Try it." Not forgetting the main purpose, she led her mother to the living room floor and carefully demonstrated the cat-cow stretch and the wall-assisted waist twist that Dr. Wang had taught her. Her mother also had a bad back and learned very attentively, so she stayed beside her, supporting her waist and helping correct her movements. Her father Ma Jianguo put down his newspaper, watched the mother and daughter practicing cat stretches on the floor, and said with a laugh, "You two look just like a mother cat with her kitten." Everyone burst out laughing. She then took out the scallions she had brought. Her mother said the chives at home were just tender and perfect for making chive pockets, so she helped her mother trim the chives and prepare the ingredients for lunch.
location: No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Returning home for lunch and an afternoon nap with her husband
description: When parting, her mother packed a large steamer basket of chive-and-egg stuffed buns made that morning into a cloth bag and pressed it into her hand, saying, 'Take these back for Zhiqiang and the children to eat.' Feeling warm inside, she urged her mother to practice stretching whenever she had time, then cycled home. When she got home, her husband was sitting in the living room watching TV. She heated up the buns her mother had given her, the leftover congee and dumplings from the morning, and cut a plate of soy-marinated cucumbers. The two had a simple lunch. After the meal, she felt a little tired in her lower back, so she lay down on the bed, applied a hot water bottle to her waist, and slept for about 40 minutes. Her husband also went back to the room to rest. He was not going out with the car today, so he rarely got the chance to take an afternoon nap.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Afternoon housework, socializing, and preparing to pick up the children.
description: After waking up, she felt much better. She took the clothes out of the washing machine and hung them out to dry, then scrubbed the dirty shoes the children had taken off the night before. When she finished, she sat on the sofa in the living room and opened the weather forecast on her phone. It seemed tomorrow would also be hot and muggy, so she planned to make something light for tomorrow's dinner. Then she called her childhood friend Liu Chunmei. On the other end, Liu Chunmei said, "Xiulan, I was just about to call you! The more I think about the thing I told you yesterday (Saturday's promotion), the more excited I get!" She laughed and said, "Yes, I've been thinking about it too. By the way, Chunmei, let me tell you something." She told her about being diagnosed with lumbar muscle strain yesterday and learning stretching exercises, and strongly recommended the "Youjing Yoga Studio" on Dongfanghong Road that Dr. Wang had mentioned, saying, "Chunmei, your back isn't much better than mine. Let's go try it together — it's just for fun, and it's also good exercise. After the promotion on Saturday, shall we go for a trial session on Sunday?" Liu Chunmei agreed at once and said, "Sure! I've been wanting to get some exercise anyway, and it's good to have you with me. So it's settled — let's go take a look on Sunday morning." The two chatted for another ten minutes or so about the specific tasks for Saturday's promotion. She would prepare the tasting table and the "buy two get one free" sign, and Liu Chunmei would handle packaging the pickled vegetables. After hanging up, she felt in a good mood. She put the big steamed buns her mother had given her into the refrigerator, and trimmed and washed the vegetables she would need for the evening (green beans and loofah). She checked the time, saw that it was about right, changed into outdoor sandals, and grabbed her e-bike keys and sun hat. Before leaving, she filled the steamer for the evening with water and put it on the stove, so she could turn on the fire as soon as she got back.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Picking up the children from school and settling them at home
description: She rode the electric bike first to the gate of Yucai Primary School. School ends at 16:00, and after waiting for a while, Mingzhe came out. After picking him up, she told him that Grandma had given them baozi today, and Mingzhe happily said he wanted to eat them. Then she continued riding the electric bike with Mingzhe to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, where Xinxin was already waiting at the gate under the teacher's care. After picking up both children, the brother and sister chattered all the way back about what had happened at school and kindergarten. Xinxin said there would be a paper-cutting class tomorrow and she needed to bring safety scissors, so Xiulan said she would buy her a pair at the stationery store tomorrow. After arriving home, she had the two children wash their hands, drink some water, and eat some fruit. She washed her face and began preparing dinner.
location: Yucai Primary School on Shengli South Street, Huakang First Kindergarten, and No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare dinner
description: She got busy with dinner. She seasoned the minced meat she had chopped in the morning, planning to make green beans with minced pork, stir-fried loofah with eggs, and also heated up the buns her mother had given her and the dumplings she had steamed herself. Her husband woke up and came over to help, so she asked him to oil Mingzhe's bicycle chain and water the flowers on the balcony.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The whole family had dinner together.
description: The food was served and she called the family to eat. Her husband took a bite of the green beans with minced pork and praised it endlessly: 'Mmm! Your cooking really suits my taste, much more flavorful than eating out.' Smiling, she picked up another bite with her chopsticks and put it on his plate. Xinxin was clamoring for the buns her grandmother had made, so she quickly picked one out for her. The family sat together, eating and chatting, in a warm atmosphere.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening housework, supervising homework, and helping the children wash up
description: After dinner, she cleared the dishes and chopsticks into the kitchen. Her husband volunteered, 'Today I'll wash the dishes. Your back is bad, so rest for a while.' She felt warm inside and didn't argue with him. She went to the living room to watch the children do homework. Mingzhe was doing mental arithmetic, and Xinxin was doing character-tracing practice. Sitting beside them, she watched the children while taking out her phone to roughly plan tomorrow's dinner menu, deciding to make tomato scrambled eggs and winter melon meatball soup, which would be simple and light. Afterward, she first helped Xinxin take a bath and changed her into pajamas, then urged Mingzhe to take a bath. She herself quickly washed her face and applied some simple skincare. Once the children were all ready, she checked Mingzhe's homework and signed it, then told Xinxin a bedtime story and gently closed the door only after seeing her fall asleep.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Communicating with her husband and relaxing before bed
description: Back in the bedroom, her husband was leaning against the headboard looking at his phone. She told him about her phone call with Liu Chunmei that afternoon and said she was going to try out the yoga studio on Sunday morning. Her husband said, 'Go ahead, it's good to get some exercise. Ride carefully.' She chatted with him a bit more about the funny things at her parents' home today and felt very relaxed. Then she made the bed, knelt on the floor mat by the bedside, and practiced cat-cow stretch and waist twists against the wall again. This time the movements were much smoother than in the morning, and she could feel the stretching and contracting of her waist muscles more clearly. After finishing the set, her waist felt light and loose. Lying back in bed, she placed the hot water bottle under her lower back, closed her eyes, and did five minutes of deep breathing. The soreness in her body eased, and her heart was filled with a small sense of accomplishment. As for the journal, she silently repeated today's reflections to herself and planned to write them down tomorrow during the day. Gradually relaxing, she turned off the light at 22:20 and fell into a deep sleep.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Early morning courtyard stretching and chores
description: The sky was just beginning to lighten, and the first cicada call came from outside the window. I put on an old cotton shirt and went to a shady spot in the yard. First I leaned against the brick wall beside the grape trellis to stretch my legs, then did 10 minutes of cat stretches, feeling my back, which had been stiff all night, gradually loosen up. Then I picked up the bucket and watered the two beds of cucumbers and green beans thoroughly, and picked three small tender cucumbers with prickly skins to make for breakfast. Looking at all the greenery, I felt very cheerful.
location: Courtyard at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Preparing the family breakfast
description: Washed the freshly picked cucumbers, cut them into chunks, and marinated them with mashed garlic, black vinegar, and salt. Then I took out the millet and mung bean porridge cooked last night from the fridge, steamed four steamed buns and the fennel-stuffed buns Mom gave yesterday, and boiled four eggs. Since it would be hot today, I also made a garlic eggplant dish.
location: China, Tianjin Jinghai District, No. 156 Jingwen Road, home kitchen

name: Wake up the family to have breakfast together
description: Went upstairs to wake Xinxin, who was still lazing in bed, and urged Mingzhe to pack his schoolbag quickly. The whole family sat around the old elm dining table. She told Zhiqiang that today's forecast was 36 degrees and to bring more water for his long-distance drive to avoid heatstroke; she also reminded the two children to drink more mung bean soup at the school cafeteria at noon and not to be too tempted by cold popsicles.
location: Dining room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Take the children to school.
description: I got on the electric bike and first took my daughter Ma Yuxin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten. Xin Xin sat on the small seat at the back, her little hands around my waist, chattering about making crafts today. Five minutes later, we arrived at the kindergarten gate, and I watched her wave to the teacher and go inside. Then I turned around and rode to Yucai Primary School, which took about ten minutes. Mingzhe jumped off the bike by himself, ran inside with his backpack, and shouted back that he wanted to eat zhajiang noodles. I responded and watched him disappear into the teaching building.
location: Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (at the intersection of Huakang Street and Jinghai Road) to Yucai Primary School (No. 48 Dongfanghong Road)

name: Shopping at the vegetable market.
description: After dropping off the children, she went to the Wutong Commune Vegetable Market not far away and went straight to the stall of her old acquaintance Sun Guifang; her vegetables were fresh and reasonably priced. She picked 2 jin of green beans, 1 jin of pork belly, and 4 tomatoes, then went to the seasoning stall next door and bought garlic and cilantro for tomorrow's supermarket promotion. On the way, she weighed out 2 yuan worth of fresh shiitake mushrooms, planning to cook porridge for herself at noon.
location: Wutong Commune Food Market, South Section of Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Housework and stretching between tasks
description: After getting home, she first portioned out the meat and vegetables and put them in the refrigerator. Then she started a thorough cleaning: stuffed the three people's dirty clothes into the washing machine, mopped the dining room and living room three times with the mop, and wiped the windowsills. During the work, she deliberately reminded herself to straighten her back every 25 minutes, hold the kitchen door frame and do side stretches for 20 seconds on each side, and also did a few simple seated waist twists on a chair.
location: Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Preparing a simple lunch.
description: At noon Zhiqiang and the children were not coming back for lunch, so since she was alone, she wanted to keep it simple. She threw the fresh shiitake mushrooms and a little shredded pork into the pot with the leftover millet porridge, making mushroom and pork porridge. She also sliced two pieces of spiced beef, and that was lunch.
location: China, Tianjin Jinghai District, No. 156 Jingwen Road, home kitchen

name: Lunch and lunch break.
description: While drinking porridge, she used her phone to look at the new cross-stitch patterns posted by the sisters in the handicraft group. After the meal, she filled a hot water bottle, wrapped it in a towel, and placed it on her lower back as she lay in bed. Her lower back felt warm and very relaxing. She set a 30-minute alarm and fell into a deep sleep.
location: Dining room and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Indoor crafts and a visit from a childhood friend
description: A little after two in the afternoon, at the hottest time, my childhood friend Liu Chunmei came over on her electric bike, bringing a piece of newly bought blue floral fabric. We wiped the tea table clean. I took out the half-embroidered twin-lotus coasters, and she took out the fabric to discuss what could be made. I suggested making it into a tissue box cover, which would look nice at home. As we chatted and worked, I also minced the garlic and cilantro for tomorrow's promotion, divided them into sealed boxes, and put them in the fridge.
location: Home living room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Pick the children up from school.
description: Chunmei said goodbye and went home at 4 o'clock. I tidied up a bit, then rode the electric bike to pick up Xinxin. As soon as she came out of the school gate, she rushed over and excitedly said the teacher had taught them to fold little paper frogs today. I lifted her onto the back seat and took her to the gate of Yucai Primary School to wait for Mingzhe. Mingzhe ran out holding a basketball, shouting, sweating all over, that his class had won the game today. The three of us rode home chatting and laughing all the way.
location: Huakang First Kindergarten and Yucai Primary School, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China; return to 156 Jingwen Road.

name: Prepare dinner
description: After getting home, I let Xinxin watch cartoons in the living room and quickly went into the kitchen. The kids wanted noodles with gravy, so I diced the pork belly and cut the green beans into small pieces, stir-fried them in hot oil until fragrant, added soy sauce and boiling water, and let it simmer. On another burner I boiled water for the noodles, then shredded cucumber and mixed mashed garlic and vinegar into a sauce. Xinxin also ran in to help get the bowls and chopsticks.
location: China, Tianjin Jinghai District, No. 156 Jingwen Road, home kitchen

name: The whole family had dinner together.
description: Zhiqiang got off work early today and was home by 6:30. He washed his hands and took the initiative to bring the noodles to the table. The whole family sat together. Mingzhe slurped down two big bowls, and Xinxin also ate about half a small bowl. Zhiqiang talked about getting stuck in traffic on the North Outer Ring Road today, and I talked about the details of the promotion discussion with Chunmei in the afternoon. The atmosphere at home was lively.
location: Dining room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: After-dinner fun exercise
description: After the meal, I had Zhiqiang clear the table, and called Xinxin over for a kitten game. The two of us lay on our stomachs facing each other in front of the bed in the bedroom, saying "Kitty arch your back, whoosh~" while doing cat stretches. Xinxin giggled and imitated me, her posture all wobbly, and I smiled and helped correct her. We played for 15 minutes, which also took care of today's stretching task, and my lower back felt comfortably warm.
location: Bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Remind the children to study and wash up.
description: I urged Mingzhe to finish his math homework in the study and checked his wrong answers for him. Then I brushed Xinxin's teeth, washed her face and feet, and coaxed her into bed. She was especially excited today and insisted on hearing the little frog story. After I finished a short one and saw her close her eyes, I quietly turned off the light and came out.
location: Study, bathroom, and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Video call with my sister
description: Just as I sat down, my younger sister Xiufen called on video, excitedly saying that a new yoga studio had opened at the entrance of her residential complex with free trial classes, and she insisted on dragging me along. I told her that I still had a supermarket promotion event tomorrow and would see after this busy period. In the end, we agreed that if the promotion went smoothly, we would go try it together on Sunday the day after tomorrow.
location: Sofa in the living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and falling asleep.
description: After hanging up the phone, she went into the kitchen and took out the plastic bag of tasting samples to bring for tomorrow's promotion. She also checked the buy-two-get-one-free sign, disposable gloves, and toothpicks, and put them all into a bag. Once everything was ready, she went to the bathroom and took a cool shower, then changed into cotton pajamas. Lying in bed, she applied a hot towel to her waist, closed her eyes, and took deep breaths for five minutes, feeling her whole body relax. She mentally calculated that she had to get up at 6 tomorrow morning, confirmed that the phone alarm was set, turned over, and listening to the faint chirping of insects outside the window, soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Early morning courtyard walk and stretching.
description: Woke up naturally at 5:30 and saw that the rain outside the window had stopped, and the air was especially fresh. I put on my sneakers and walked briskly for 15 minutes on the wet tree-lined road in front of the door, enjoying the smell of earth and vegetation after the rain. At 5:45 I returned to the small courtyard at home and, following the key points Dr. Wang taught me, carefully did cat stretch and wall-supported waist twists for 8 minutes each, focusing on moving my waist that had been sore and swollen last night; it felt much looser. Afterwards I applied a hot towel to my waist.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare breakfast and tidy up the house.
description: After the hot compress, she simply cooked a pot of millet porridge and sliced some leftover pickled cucumbers from last night as a side dish. She ate breakfast first, then quickly tidied the kitchen, wiped down the stove, and put the clothes that had been soaking overnight into the washing machine. She watered the cucumbers and green beans in the vegetable garden and picked a few tender cucumbers to eat in the evening.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Check promotional materials and prepare.
description: She took out the pickled cucumber samples that Liu Chunmei had helped prepare yesterday from the refrigerator and filled a stainless steel basin. Then she checked one by one the
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Household chores, free time, and preparing to go out
description: The washing machine started running, and while it was working, I wiped down the living room tables and chairs and mopped the floor. Then I went back to the bedroom, found a neat floral short-sleeved shirt and dark trousers, and changed into them. I smoothed my hair in front of the mirror and felt much more spirited. Before leaving, I checked the things in the cloth bag once more.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Ride an electric bike to Hualian Supermarket
description: She got on her e-bike, with a big cloth bag packed full in the basket. Turning from Jingwen Road onto Dongfanghong Road, there was little traffic on the streets on the weekend morning, and she arrived at the entrance of Hualian Supermarket in about 15 minutes.
location: From 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin to Hualian Supermarket, 88 Dongfanghong Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Supermarket pickled vegetable promotion event
description: Chunmei had already saved our spot in the dried goods section and set up the table. She deftly spread clean gauze, arranged the cut pickled cucumbers, dishes of minced garlic and cilantro, and toothpicks, and put the poster in a prominent place. At 9:30 the event officially began. While cutting fresh goods, she warmly greeted passing customers: "Sister, try our home-pickled cucumbers—buy two get one free, really good value!" Customers responded very well after tasting and bought them one after another. Chunmei helped with bagging and taking payment. The morning's sales quadrupled compared to normal, and we also added several returning customers on WeChat. Before the event ended, Chunmei's manager came over, was very satisfied with the results, and expressed interest in long-term cooperation. We agreed with the manager and Chunmei to discuss the details later.
location: Dried goods section, first floor, Hualian Supermarket, 88 Dongfanghong Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Returning home after the promotion ended
description: The activity ended on time at 12:00. Chunmei and I quickly tidied up the table. Taking the remaining half basin of pickled vegetables (leaving some for Chunmei) and the empty bags, I stopped at the supermarket on the way and bought a bottle of light soy sauce and a bag of salt. At 12:10, I rode the electric bike home. When I got there, Zhiqiang and the children were all there.
location: From Hualian Supermarket, No. 88 Dongfanghong Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Simple lunch and a short break
description: The children and Zhiqiang had already eaten, so she kept her own share. She reheated the leftover millet porridge from the morning and had it for lunch with pickled cucumbers and the leftover noodles with gravy sauce from last night. After the meal, she put the remaining pickles in the fridge and told the children not to rummage through them in the afternoon.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Younger sister came to visit and went to the yoga studio.
description: Just as she finished cleaning up, her younger sister Ma Xiufen pushed the door open, wearing a tracksuit, and said excitedly, 'Sis! Let's go, I'll take you to experience a free yoga class at that newly opened Hehe Yoga Studio in our Jinghai Town!' She felt a little lazy and wanted to rest. Xiufen wouldn't give in and kept coaxing and pestering her. Unable to resist, she changed into a loose T-shirt, the two locked the door, and walked there. On the way, Xiufen chatted enthusiastically about the benefits of yoga. After about 15 minutes of walking, they arrived at the yoga studio at 13:40.
location: From 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to Hehe Yoga Studio, 78 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Experience a yoga class.
description: At the studio, Xiufen signed them up at the front desk, and the two received borrowed yoga clothes and changed in the changing room. They found the clothes tight and a bit uncomfortable. At 14:10 the class began — a basic Hatha yoga class. When the teacher had them do Downward-Facing Dog, her arms trembled and she inwardly shouted, “Oh my goodness”; when they moved into the Cat-Cow stretch, she remembered Dr. Wang's advice and did it with extra care, feeling that her lower back was indeed very comfortable. During the final relaxation pose, she was so relaxed that she actually fell asleep and even let out a slight snore. Xiufen, sitting next to her, gently nudged her awake, and both of them couldn't help snickering. After the class, although she had made quite a spectacle of herself, she did feel much more comfortable all over.
location: Hehe Yoga Studio, 78 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: After-class discussion and heading home
description: After class and changing clothes, Xiufen stood at the door and teasingly remarked that her sister had fallen asleep in class. A bit embarrassed, she said frankly, 'Although I haven't fallen in love with it, moving around really feels good—much better than just lying around!' She expressed willingness to try other sports. The sisters walked and chatted along the way, and bought two crispy ice-cream cones at a street-side stall. At 15:40 they arrived at the door of her home, and Xiufen rode her bike back to her own house.
location: From Hehe Yoga Studio, 78 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin to 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Recommending to Chunmei and reassuring her parents
description: After arriving home, she rested on the sofa for a while. Then, remembering the yoga studio's free trial was nice, she picked up her phone and sent Liu Chunmei a WeChat voice message, describing the experience in detail and recommending she try it too, and included the yoga studio's WeChat contact that Xiufen had obtained. Next, she made a video call to her mother, Li Xiuying: "Mom, today's sale was great—the pickled cucumbers sold out! You and Dad don't worry, I'll bring some over early tomorrow morning so you can taste them fresh!" Her mother laughed happily on the other end and told her not to tire herself out.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare dinner
description: After finishing the phone call, she tied on an apron and started preparing dinner. The children specifically asked for cola chicken wings and the garlic stir-fried water spinach that Zhiqiang loved. She took out the cucumbers picked in the morning and made smashed cucumbers with garlic sauce, then pulled a piece of pork belly from the fridge to make braised pork. Soon the kitchen was filled with the symphony of pots and pans, and the air was thick with the aroma of cooking.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner together.
description: Zhiqiang and his eldest son Ma Mingxuan helped serve dishes and set out bowls and chopsticks. The family sat around the table and excitedly talked about the bustling morning sales and the funny moments from the afternoon yoga class, making the children laugh out loud. Zhiqiang listened while picking up food for the children, praising them for their hard work today. The atmosphere at the table was warm and harmonious.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family leisure and tidying up
description: After the meal, she asked Zhiqiang and her son to help clear the dishes. She then played with her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin in the living room for a while; the mother and daughter mimicked yoga class moves on the bed, playing a game of "cat stretch". Zhiqiang cut up a plate of watermelon, and the family ate watermelon while watching TV, enjoying the leisure time of the weekend.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Supervising homework and preparing for evening stretches
description: Checked her second son Ma Mingzhe's math homework and urged her daughter Ma Yuxin to practice tracing characters. At 20:00, she returned to the bedroom, changed into pajamas, and prepared for bedtime stretching.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Sticking to bedtime stretching exercises.
description: She laid out the mat on the bed and, following what Doctor Wang had taught her, first did three minutes of deep breathing to relax. Then she focused on 10 minutes of stretching the back of the hips and twisting the waist. She could clearly feel that, compared with the past few days, the soreness in her lower back had greatly eased, and the pain during movement had also lessened. She was secretly pleased, feeling that persisting with the rehabilitation exercises had been the right choice.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Relaxation and reflection before bed
description: After stretching, she felt very relaxed. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang had also finished showering. The two leaned against the headboard, and she chatted with him about what had happened during the day. Together they planned what to bring when delivering pickled vegetables to her parents' home tomorrow. At 21:30, she turned off the main light, leaving only a small night light on. Closing her eyes to rest, she ran through the day's experiences in her mind, from the success of the promotion to the amusing moments in the yoga class, and the corners of her mouth involuntarily curled up slightly.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Washing up and getting ready for bed
description: At 22:00, she got up and went to the bathroom to wash up, with a satisfied smile on her face.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Falling asleep peacefully.
description: At 22:30, after checking the doors, windows, and gas, she returned to bed. Carrying a full sense of achievement and relaxation from the day, she quickly fell asleep.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning stretching and walking in the courtyard.
description: After waking up naturally, Ma Xiulan first exercised in the courtyard. She was now very skilled at stretching. Following the method Dr. Wang taught her before, she accurately completed the cat stretch and the wall-supported waist twist, 8 minutes each. She could hardly feel the soreness in her lower back, and every movement was held properly. After stretching, she walked slowly along the sidewalk on Jingwen Road for 15 minutes, feeling the gradually rising morning sun and the fresh air, and she felt completely refreshed.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; own courtyard and the sidewalk on Jingwen Road

name: Prepare and enjoy breakfast
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan quickly rinsed the rice and cooked millet porridge, and set on the table the leftover soy-sauce cucumbers from yesterday and the fresh cucumber salad made this morning. At around 6:20, she woke her husband Ma Zhiqiang and the three children one by one. The family sat around the dining table, drinking hot porridge and eating fresh side dishes while talking about the big cleaning they had planned for today. The children were a bit reluctant but agreed anyway.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin - home kitchen and dining room

name: Post-meal cleanup and morning preparations
description: After her husband and children had eaten, Ma Xiulan quickly cleared away the dishes and wiped down the stove. Then she sorted the family's dirty laundry, put dark and light clothes into the washing machine separately, added laundry detergent, and started the wash. While the washing machine was running, she took out a large garbage bag and cleared waste paper, empty bottles, and other clutter from each room, preparing for the thorough cleaning that was about to begin.
location: Kitchen and various rooms at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Gathered the whole family and assigned spring-cleaning tasks.
description: At 8 o'clock sharp, Ma Xiulan gathered the whole family in the living room and solemnly announced that today they would do the quarterly deep cleaning. Holding a task list she had written herself, she assigned tasks to everyone: Ma Zhiqiang was responsible for the window glass throughout the house and carrying heavy items; Mingxuan was responsible for tidying the bookshelves and desks in the study; Mingzhe was responsible for sorting and organizing the toys in his and his brother's room and sweeping the floor; Yuxin was responsible for wiping the tables and chairs in the living room and dining room with a damp cloth. Ma Xiulan herself focused on the hardest part: the kitchen grease and the clutter in the courtyard.
location: Living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Deep cleaning of the kitchen and courtyard
description: Ma Xiulan put on rubber gloves, first sprayed a powerful degreaser on the stove, range hood, and cabinet doors. After the grease softened, she scrubbed carefully with steel wool, then wiped repeatedly with a damp cloth until the kitchen countertops were shiny like new, without a trace of grease. She then moved on to the courtyard. She cleared out old flowerpots, dead branches, withered leaves, and other clutter piled in the corner, swept the ground clean with a broom, and finally connected the hose and rinsed the cement floor until it was thoroughly clean. During the process, she stopped every half hour to take a drink of water and went inside to check on the children's progress, guiding them on how to wipe more cleanly and tidy up more neatly.
location: Kitchen and courtyard at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Check spring cleaning progress
description: After more than two hours, the deep cleaning was drawing to an end. Ma Xiulan made a round of inspection: Mingxuan's bookshelf had been neatly organized, with the books arranged by size; Mingzhe had put all the toys into storage bins and swept the floor clean; Yuxin was struggling to wipe the coffee table, and the water stains on its surface were still wet; Ma Zhiqiang had just finished the last window with a glass squeegee, and the glass was crystal clear. Ma Xiulan praised the children for their hard work and personally taught Yuxin how to wipe away the water stains with a dry cloth.
location: Various rooms at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Simple lunch and rest
description: After the big cleanup, everyone was tired. Ma Xiulan used the pot from the morning's noodles to quickly cook a pot of noodles with gravy. She reheated the leftover cola chicken wings and pork rib soup from yesterday, and served them with freshly dressed cucumbers. The family sat together, eating and talking about the morning's hard work. After dinner, she urged the children to wash their hands and faces, and she cleaned up the dishes.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin - home kitchen and dining room

name: Lunch break and hot compress on the waist.
description: After a busy morning, her waist felt a little tight. Ma Xiulan applied a hot water bottle to her waist and lay in bed with her eyes closed for half an hour. This half-hour rest restored her energy for the afternoon.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, master bedroom

name: Gave away old clothes and in return received rice wine from a neighbor and a promise to spread the word.
description: After her midday rest, Ma Xiulan found more than ten old clothes in fairly good condition from the wardrobe and storage room, including several of Ma Zhiqiang's T-shirts and the children's jackets. She folded them neatly and put them into a bag. She knocked on the door of Sister Wang Guilan across the hall and gave the clothes to her. Wang Guilan was so happy she couldn't stop smiling. After repeatedly thanking her, she turned and went back into her home, brought out a small jar of homemade rice wine, and gave it to Ma Xiulan. She also revealed that her daughter worked in a workplace cafeteria and could help ask whether the cafeteria's pickled-vegetable supplier could be switched to Ma Xiulan's pickled cucumbers. Ma Xiulan was overjoyed and thanked her again and again.
location: Wang Guilan's house, opposite 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Ride an electric bike back to her parents' home to deliver things.
description: Ma Xiulan tied the newly obtained rice wine and a jar of pickled vegetables prepared yesterday to the back seat of her electric bike, got on the electric bike, rode south along Jingwen Road, turned onto Shengli Avenue, and arrived at her parents' home in less than 15 minutes. She handed the rice wine and pickled vegetables to her mother, Li Xiuying. Her mother was very happy and pulled her into the kitchen to pick vegetables while catching up on family news. Ma Xiulan helped her mother clean out the refrigerator, chatted with her father Ma Jianguo for a while, sat for about 40 minutes, and talked about last night's promotional sale of pickled vegetables. They were also very happy to hear about it.
location: Parents' home, 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Stopped by the vegetable market to buy groceries on the way
description: After leaving her parents' house, Ma Xiulan rode north along the way, turned back onto Jingwen Road, and reached Wutong Commune Vegetable Market in a few minutes. She went straight to Sister Sun Guifang's stall, picked a jin of fresh pork ribs, and also bought some water spinach with garlic and a few tomatoes. Sun Guifang gave her a small discount by waiving the change. Ma Xiulan smiled and thanked her, mentally planning to make sweet and sour pork ribs that evening.
location: Sun Guifang's stall at Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The whole family reviews the results of the big cleaning and wraps up
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan put away the groceries and then led the whole family on a thorough inspection. After confirming that the windows were bright, the floors were dust-free, and everything was back in place, she took the children to wash and put away the cleaning tools, tied up the several large bags of trash from the deep cleaning, and carried them together to the trash bins downstairs in the neighborhood. Seeing the whole house bright and spotless, looking completely refreshed, she felt extremely pleased.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; the rooms, courtyard, and hallway of the home.

name: Prepare dinner
description: Looking at the tidy home, Ma Xiulan felt pleased and began to prepare dinner. She first blanched the ribs she had bought and put them in a pot to braise sweet-and-sour ribs; then she quickly stir-fried water spinach with garlic over high heat; finally she sliced the remaining cucumbers and tossed them into a salad. The rice was also quickly steamed. The aroma of food wafted from the kitchen, mixing with the fresh scent left by the afternoon cleaning products, making everything feel reassuring and happy.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, home kitchen

name: A hearty dinner and pleasant chat
description: The family of five sat around the dining table, enjoying the delicious food after all their hard work. Ma Xiulan shared the good news that their neighbor, Sister Wang Guilan, had said she could help promote the pickled vegetables. Ma Zhiqiang also rarely showed a smile and thought it was a good thing. The children were full of praise for the sweet and sour pork ribs, and the dining table was filled with laughter and cheerful conversation.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family walk around the neighborhood.
description: Half an hour after the meal, the whole family went downstairs together and took a slow stroll along the path in the community. The adults chatted about daily life and tomorrow's work while the children chased and played around them. The slow walk of about 20 minutes soothed their bodies after the meal, and they also enjoyed a rare moment of leisure as a family.
location: The community path of the residential complex at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Supervise the children's washing up and check their homework
description: After walking home, Ma Xiulan urged Yuxin to take a bath, while checking Mingzhe's weekend homework. She found a mistake in one of the math problems and patiently explained it to him. Mingxuan, on the other hand, had already been doing his own homework in his room, so there was nothing to worry about.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin: the bathroom and the children's rooms at home

name: Personal time: stretching and keeping accounts
description: After the children settled down, Ma Xiulan returned to her room. She did a 10-minute cat stretch and waist twist on the bed and felt relaxed from head to toe. Then she took out her small account book, recorded the money spent on groceries and rice wine today, and calculated the family's expenses for the month.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, master bedroom

name: Pre-sleep preparation and relaxation
description: Ma Xiulan went to the bathroom to wash up and shake off the fatigue of the day. Back in bed, she leaned against the headboard, sent her mother a WeChat message to report that she was safe, and checked her phone to confirm that tomorrow, Monday, had nothing special. Ma Zhiqiang had also lain down. They chatted a little. He said he would drive to Tanggu tomorrow, and she told him to be careful on the road. They said goodnight to each other.
location: Jinghai District, Tianjin, 156 Jingwen Road, master bedroom and bathroom

name: Deep breathing before bed and going to sleep
description: Before bed, Ma Xiulan did another simple set of deep-breathing relaxation, feeling the relief spread through her lower back. At 22:30, she turned off the desk lamp on time and, feeling refreshed in body and mind and looking forward to the next day, gradually fell asleep.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, master bed

name: Morning exercise and breakfast preparation.
description: Ma Xiulan woke up naturally at 5:20 and felt in good spirits. She put on her sneakers and power-walked for 15 minutes on the sidewalk of Jingwen Road, with the morning breeze blowing on her face. Back home, she spread a straw mat on the cement floor of the courtyard and did 5 minutes of neck-and-shoulder stretches and 10 minutes of cat-cow stretches, feeling her body loosen up. She then went into the kitchen to prepare lunch for her husband Ma Zhiqiang to take on his drive: she sliced steamed buns and filled them with homemade pickled cucumbers and scrambled egg pieces, wrapping them in plastic wrap; millet porridge simmered slowly on the stove. Seeing the roses in full bloom in the courtyard, she took a photo, posted it on Moments, and captioned it: The last day of June, persistence is victory.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (own courtyard and kitchen)

name: Wake up the family and have breakfast together
description: At 6:30, Ma Xiulan woke the children and told them that the summer vacation routine must not be disrupted. The family sat around the table eating millet porridge, pickled cucumbers with pancakes. After discussing with her husband Zhiqiang, she decided to take her second son Zhezhe to have his eyes checked in the morning. During the meal, she reminded her eldest son Xuanxuan to do his summer homework according to plan and soothed her little daughter Xinyu to eat properly. After the meal, she helped Zhiqiang pack his bag for going out and told him to be safe on the road.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Discovered that the second son was nearsighted and went to the hospital for an examination.
description: After breakfast, Ma Xiulan found her second son Ma Mingzhe lying on the desk doing homework in the study, his head almost touching the notebook. After asking, she learned that he couldn't see the blackboard clearly and immediately decided to take him to the ophthalmology department of Jinghai District People's Hospital for an eye exam. At 7:45, she walked to the hospital holding ZheZhe's hand, comforting the child along the way. After arriving, they queued up to register. Doctor Zhang performed cycloplegic refraction and diagnosed myopia of 150 degrees in both eyes. Ma Xiulan blamed herself. The doctor comforted her and suggested getting glasses and regular follow-ups.
location: Ophthalmology Department, 2nd Floor, Outpatient Building, Jinghai District People's Hospital, No. 18 Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin; departure point: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Go to the optical shop to get glasses and return home
description: After leaving the hospital, Ma Xiulan walked with Zhezhe to Mingshi Glasses Store on Beiwei Second Road. She had Zhezhe try on several frames, and he finally chose a pair of blue semi-rimless glasses. After bargaining, they settled on 350 yuan. When Zhezhe put on the new glasses, he said in surprise that he could see clearly. Ma Xiulan told him that from now on he must wear them while doing homework and keep a proper distance. Then the two walked home, where she placed the new glasses case on Zhezhe's desk and told him to wear them when doing homework.
location: Mingshi Optical Shop, No. 8 Beiwei 2nd Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, then returned to No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare lunch and handle chores
description: Around ten o'clock, Ma Xiulan began preparing lunch. It was hot, so she decided to make cold noodles with sesame paste. She kneaded and rested the dough, blanched green beans and mung bean sprouts, and cut cucumber shreds and minced garlic. In between, she called her mother Li Xiuying, who lives on Shengli Street, to ask about her health. Then she cut watermelon for her youngest daughter Xinyu and watched her play with building blocks while continuing to work.
location: Kitchen and balcony at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Lunch and lunch break.
description: At noon, Ma Xiulan and the three children had lunch together. Cold noodles with sesame paste and generous toppings were a big hit with the children. She reminded Zhe-Zhe again to wear his glasses and maintain proper sitting posture. After the meal, she urged the children to wash the dishes and take an afternoon nap. She herself applied a hot-water bottle to her lower back for ten minutes, then lay down for a forty-minute nap.
location: Dining room and master bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Afternoon errands: supermarket checkout and vegetable market shopping
description: At 1:30 in the afternoon, Ma Xiulan put on a sun-protective jacket and rode her electric bike to Hualian Supermarket. She found her childhood friend Liu Chunmei and the finance staff at the logistics office, and checked the June sales ledger for pickled vegetables. The total revenue for the month was 258 yuan, and sales of pickled cucumbers had doubled. She received the cash, discussed adding a new spicy and numbing flavor next month with Liu Chunmei, and mentioned that Wang Guilan across the street had helped promote the products, expanding sales. Afterwards, she rode on to the Wutong Commune vegetable market and bought chives, eggs, and water spinach at Sun Guifang's stall. She chatted with Aunt Sun about family matters, learned that her daughter-in-law was about to give birth, congratulated her, and asked if she needed any help.
location: Logistics office of Hualian Supermarket, 62 Dongfanghong Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; then to Sun Guifang's stall at Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Chaoyang Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Returning home to prepare dinner and relax with family
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan started preparing dinner, planning to make chive and egg dumplings and garlic water spinach. She nimbly kneaded the dough, chopped the filling, and seasoned it, while her daughter Xinyu helped peel garlic. Around five o'clock, she put the dumpling filling and dough in the fridge, and in the meantime urged Zhezhe to put on his glasses and do homework. She sat in the living room embroidering an order for a while, with Xinyu playing with building blocks nearby. The early evening was quiet and peaceful.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner, after-meal chores, and helping the children with their studies
description: At six in the evening, her husband Ma Zhiqiang and eldest son Xuanxuan returned home, and the family sat around eating steaming hot dumplings and water spinach. Ma Xiulan told them about Zhezhe getting fitted for glasses, and the whole family discussed protecting eyesight; Zhiqiang comforted her. She shared the good news that Wang Guilan had helped promote the pickled vegetables, and the atmosphere was harmonious. After the meal, the couple cleared the table and washed the dishes. Ma Xiulan urged the two children to finish their homework and checked it. Xuanxuan got all the math problems right, and Zhezhe's new-character writing was neat. Afterwards she helped the youngest daughter wash up, read a bedtime story, and settled the children down to sleep.
location: Home dining room and various rooms at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: June financial review and planning
description: At 8:30 p.m., Ma Xiulan spread out her account book and mobile banking app on the dining table and calculated June income and expenses item by item: income from pickled vegetables was 258 yuan, embroidery income was 250 yuan, social security subsidy was 200 yuan, and total part-time income was 708 yuan. Expenses included electric bike repair of 400 yuan, glasses fitting of 350 yuan, her husband's annual accident insurance fee of 150 yuan, and Children's Day expenses of 200 yuan, with total expenses around 2,300 yuan, meaning she overspent. She noted that daily accounts should be recorded on the same day, and squeezed 150 yuan from her cash balance to transfer into the education fund account through mobile banking. She resolved to increase the consignment volume of pickled vegetables and take more embroidery orders next month, aiming for part-time income to exceed 800 yuan.
location: Home dining table, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Exercise summary and video call with my sister
description: Around ten o'clock, Ma Xiulan returned to her bedroom. Her lower back no longer felt sore, and she could hold her embroidery sitting posture for longer. She lay down and did cat stretches and wall-supported waist twists for 10 minutes, then sat quietly and breathed deeply for 5 minutes. Afterwards, her elder sister Li Xiuyun called via WeChat video. Ma Xiulan shared the day's events of taking Zhezhe to get glasses and doing a financial review. Her sister warmly invited them to visit Beijing during the summer vacation and stay at her home. Ma Xiulan happily agreed and planned to bring Jinghai local specialties to her sister. The two sisters agreed to set a specific date when Zhiqiang has his next day off.
location: On the bed in the master bedroom at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: After hanging up, Ma Xiulan went to the bathroom to wash up. She reviewed the fulfilling day; although there were some small worries, everything was under control. She checked the doors and windows, turned off the lights, lay down, and soon fell asleep peacefully.
location: Master bedroom and bathroom, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning activities and breakfast preparation
description: Woke up naturally at 5:20 in the morning. First did shoulder and neck stretches and lumbar muscle rehabilitation exercises in the bedroom; the movements were smoother than yesterday, and my lower back felt relaxed. Then I put on running shoes and walked briskly for 18 minutes along the tree-lined Jingwen Road, breathing deeply until a light sweat appeared on my forehead. After returning home, I wiped off the sweat, changed clothes, washed up, and took care of my skin, then made the bed and opened the windows for ventilation. Then I went into the kitchen, cooked millet porridge from the millet that had been soaked in advance, reheated the leftover pancakes from last night, and cut cucumbers into a refreshing cold dish to prepare breakfast for the family.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and the tree-lined avenue on Jingwen Road

name: Breakfast and family meeting
description: At 6:50, she woke the children up for breakfast. At the dining table, Ma Xiulan wrote on the living room blackboard with chalk: 'Three Summer Vacation Rules' and 'Family Eye-Protection Rules', stipulating that each day they should study, do housework, and work in the vegetable garden for 1 hour each, watch TV for no more than 30 minutes, and turn on the desk lamp when writing. She announced that the eldest son Mingxuan would be in charge of caring for the roses, the second son Mingzhe would record the cucumber watering, and the youngest daughter Yuxin would put away toys and wipe the table. The three children nodded in agreement, and her husband Ma Zhiqiang smiled and expressed support.
location: Living room and dining room of the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Courtyard management and care.
description: After breakfast, Ma Xiulan directed her husband to move her second son Mingzhe's desk to the well-lit spot by the south window, and had Mingzhe help out. Then she went alone to the courtyard, checked the branches, leaves, and trunk of the persimmon tree, found no insect eggs or boreholes, sprayed diluted chili water on the undersides of the leaves to prevent aphids, and removed yellowing old leaves. She also checked the mint in the corner; her youngest daughter had watered it yesterday, and it had grown a few new leaves, so she pulled up the weeds while she was at it.
location: Secondary bedroom and courtyard at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Meal planning and household chores
description: After returning home from the courtyard, Ma Xiulan sat in the living room planning a healthy diet plan for the entire month of summer vacation. She neatly copied the light, refreshing breakfast and dinner combinations (such as yogurt multigrain porridge, millet pancakes, cucumber salad, red bean and barley soup, etc.) onto paper and stuck it on the refrigerator door. Then she began the housework: she turned on the washing machine to wash the family's clothes, thoroughly mopped the living room and bedroom floors, and regularly collected the dried towels, folded them, and put them in the wardrobe.
location: Living room and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Lunch and mandatory afternoon nap
description: At 11:00, she began making noodles with gravy: stir-fried wood ear mushrooms, day lily flowers, and diced meat, thickened into a gravy, then she cooked the noodles. At 11:30, she called the three children to eat. After eating a bowl herself, she told everyone to go back to their rooms for a nap and not to play with phones or watch TV.
