She went back to the bedroom, set a 30-minute alarm, and rested with her eyes closed.
location: Kitchen, dining room, and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Midday rest and craft socializing
description: After the afternoon nap alarm went off, she stayed in bed for two more minutes, then took out her cloth bag and phone to get ready for the afternoon shopping. She then took out the small embroidered peony ornament and started sewing it, while messaging her childhood friend Liu Chunmei on WeChat. She confirmed that yesterday’s pickled vegetable accounts were correct, asked Liu Chunmei if she needed anything bought, and finalized the details of taking the children to Nanhu Park at 2 p.m. the next day.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Shopping and returning home to organize
description: She put on a sun hat, rode her electric bike with her youngest daughter Yuxin along Jingwen Road to the Wutong Commune vegetable market. First she found the stall owner Sun Guifang and bought coarse grains such as mung beans, red beans, and coix seed, as well as water spinach and tomatoes. Then she went to a grocery store to buy a new clay pot and mint seeds. After returning home, she put the coarse grains into sealed jars and soaked the vegetables in clean water. Then she took Yuxin to the corner of the courtyard, washed the clay pot, filled it with soil, watered it, carefully planted the mint seeds, and placed it in a cool place.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market in Jinghai District, Tianjin, and the courtyard and kitchen of the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Prepare and enjoy dinner
description: At 4 p.m. she started preparing dinner. She first blanched the pork ribs, caramelized sugar for color, then added seasonings and simmered them over low heat. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang helped watch the stove, and the couple chatted. Ma Xiulan trimmed and washed water spinach, peeled garlic, and also put mung bean soup on to cook. At 5:30, braised pork ribs, garlic water spinach, and chilled mung bean soup were served. The family sat around the table to eat. Ma Xiulan again emphasized the summer vacation rules, and Ma Zhiqiang also chimed in to encourage the children to follow them.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening activities and homework check
description: After dinner, the whole family took a walk of about 20 minutes along the paths in the neighborhood to help digestion. After returning home, she urged her youngest daughter Yuxin to bathe and wash her hair by herself, then went to the living room to check Mingzhe's and Mingxuan's summer homework: Mingzhe's diary was done very well and was praised; Mingxuan had a few math problems he couldn't solve, and Ma Xiulan patiently helped him sort out his thoughts.
location: Community walkway at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and the home living room.

name: Recording accounts and relaxing the body.
description: After settling the child, Ma Xiulan went back to the bedroom, took out her ledger, and recorded the day's expenses: 52 yuan for grains and vegetables at the market, 10 yuan for flowerpots and seeds, and the handmade work-in-progress not yet settled. She listed this month's education fund as a separate line. After recording, she changed into loose clothes and did waist-relaxing exercises such as cat stretch on the floor for 10 minutes, feeling especially limber.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Pre-sleep conversation and going to bed
description: Before bed, she video-called her elder sister Li Xiuyun in Beijing to talk about the weather and the children's summer rules, and they made an initial plan of when to visit Beijing. After hanging up, she told her husband Ma Zhiqiang about taking the children to Nanhu Park tomorrow afternoon and asked whether he was free to join. Then she checked all the doors and windows, the kitchen gas, and the water valve, set the alarm for 5:20 the next morning, returned to the bedroom, said goodnight to her husband, and turned off the light to sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Morning Wake-Up and Exercise
description: At 5:25 in the morning, the alarm went off, and Ma Xiulan did a five-minute shoulder-and-neck stretch in bed to loosen up. Then she put on her sneakers and went outside to the sidewalk on Jingwen Road for a brisk 15-minute walk, breathing in the morning air and feeling refreshed.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; the bedroom at home and the sidewalk on Jingwen Road in front of the door.

name: Vegetable garden inspection and maintenance
description: Back home, Ma Xiulan went to the backyard vegetable garden, bent down to pull new weeds, checked the undersides of cucumber and tomato leaves for pests, and cut off old leaves with yellow spots to improve ventilation. Seeing the soil was moist, she felt satisfied that her second son had watered on time yesterday.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, home backyard vegetable garden

name: Prepared breakfast and reiterated the summer vacation rules.
description: Ma Xiulan was in the kitchen cooking millet and pumpkin porridge, heating up meat buns, and slicing pickled cucumbers. When breakfast was served, she noticed her youngest daughter Yuxin already seated, so she ladled out porridge for her and emphasized the rules for the first day of summer vacation: no more than half an hour of TV, and sit up straight when doing homework or reading. The clock struck 7, and she went upstairs to wake the two sons. The oldest son, Mingxuan, was already reading in bed, and she reminded him not to read while lying down; the second son, Mingzhe, was reluctant to get up, so she pulled him out of bed. The family sat around the table, and she once again reiterated the 'eye protection rules': keep a proper posture when doing homework, and don't look at the phone for more than 20 minutes. She also placed food on the children's plates.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; home kitchen, dining room, and second-floor bedroom.

name: Housework and planning
description: After breakfast, while the children went to play, Ma Xiulan cleared the dishes, wiped down the stove, and mopped the living room floor. While putting things away, she used her phone's memo app to jot down the day's tasks: buy groceries, make soup, and call her mother. Then she went to the backyard to collect the dried clothes and folded them neatly.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; home kitchen, living room, and backyard

name: Supervising the children's studies and correcting habits.
description: Ma Xiulan paced back and forth between the study and the living room. When Mingxuan hunched over while doing math homework in the study, she pushed his back to remind him to sit up straight and keep his eyes about a foot away from the book. Mingzhe was doing homework at the coffee table in the living room and tried to run off in less than ten minutes; she called him back and corrected his pencil grip with hands-on guidance. Her youngest daughter, Yuxin, was being good and playing with a jigsaw puzzle nearby.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, home study and living room

name: Go out to buy ingredients and daily necessities.
description: Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike west along Jingwen Road to the Wutong Commune vegetable market, selected two fresh sea bass, greens, scallions, and fresh shrimp, and chatted with the stall owner about prices. Then she walked to the nearby Jingbai Supermarket, bought a bag of flour and a roll of plastic wrap, and after checking the rock sugar jar decided not to buy it. After checkout, she hung the items on the handlebars of her electric bike and returned home by the same route.
location: Tianjin Jinghai District, Wutong Commune Market (and nearby Jingbai Supermarket)

name: Preparing lunch and having lunch together
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan put the ingredients into the refrigerator by category, marinated the sea bass, deveined the shrimp, and washed the greens. Then she cooked steamed sea bass, garlic broccoli, and tomato and egg soup. During lunch, she asked Mingxuan about his homework progress, told Mingzhe to eat more vegetables, and the family finished the meal chatting and laughing.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin — kitchen and dining area at home

name: Midday nap
description: After lunch, Ma Xiulan urged the children to take a nap, while she lay down on the living room sofa, covered her stomach with a blanket, and rested for about forty minutes. The cicadas chirped outside the window as she recharged her energy.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, sofa in home living room

name: Preparing summer heat-relieving soup and doing embroidery work
description: Waking up at 2 p.m., Ma Xiulan washed her face, rinsed the mung beans, red beans, and Job's tears that had been soaked overnight, put them in a pot, added water, brought it to a boil over high heat, then turned to low heat to simmer slowly. While the soup was simmering, she sat in the rattan chair on the balcony, took out her sewing basket, and embroidered the upper of tiger-head shoes for the newborn in neighbor Wang Guilan's family. After the soup was done, she let it cool naturally, poured it into a glass pitcher and put it in the fridge, and noted the proportions on a sticky note to fine-tune the sweetness next time.
location: Kitchen and balcony at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Taking the children for outdoor activities and pruning the roses
description: The afternoon wind was cool, so Ma Xiulan called the children to the yard for activities. Mingxuan jumped rope, Mingzhe kicked a soccer ball against the courtyard wall, and Yuxin played with a sandbag. Ma Xiulan put on gardening gloves and trimmed the overgrown rose hedge beside the vegetable garden to make sure it didn't affect passersby. She kept an eye on the children from time to time.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin — the courtyard outside the front door.

name: Preparing dinner and bottling the cooling soup
description: After the outdoor activity, Ma Xiulan had the children wash their faces. She went to the kitchen, took the cooled summer soup from the refrigerator, divided it into small glass bottles, screwed the lids on tightly, and put them back in the fridge. Then she prepared dinner ingredients: amaranth, preserved eggs, soft tofu, shrimp, and free-range eggs. She tied on an apron and made amaranth salad, preserved egg tofu, scrambled eggs with shrimp, and cooked rice, humming as she worked.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, home kitchen

name: Dining together and tasting the summer heat-relief soup.
description: Dinner was served on time, with perfect color, aroma, and taste. Ma Xiulan served rice to everyone and shared the tiger-head shoe patterns she had embroidered in the afternoon, which the children curiously gathered around to see. After the meal, she took the summer heat-relieving soup out of the fridge and poured a small half bowl for each person. The children all said it was delicious. Mingzhe wanted more but was refused, and she told them one bowl each to satisfy their cravings.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Checked the children's summer tasks and corrected their habits.
description: Half an hour after the meal, Ma Xiulan called the children to the living room to check their summer assignments. Mingzhe brought out his watering record book; she held his hand and wrote 'July 2' neatly beside the drawing. She looked through Mingxuan's rose weeding observation report and praised him for observing carefully and writing neatly. Noticing Mingxuan lying on the sofa looking at his phone, she immediately reminded him to sit up straight. Yuxin had already sorted the toys into the storage box. Ma Xiulan happily hugged her and gave each of the three children a little red flower sticker as a reward.
location: Living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Urge the children to wash up and put the youngest daughter to sleep.
description: Ma Xiulan urged her two sons to bathe themselves, while she ran a bath for Yuxin, bathed her, changed her into pajamas, told her two little stories, and gently patted her to sleep.
location: Bathroom on the second floor of the home and Yuxin's room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Video call with mother.
description: She changed into her practice clothes, brought a water bottle, checked her phone to confirm Aunt Zhao was already waiting at the fitness square, locked the courtyard gate, and prepared to leave.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, sofa in home living room

name: Wash up, go to bed, and relax with handicrafts
description: Ma Xiulan took a hot bath to wash away the fatigue, applied skin care products, and checked the water, electricity, doors, and windows. Then she leaned against the headboard, took out the unfinished tiger-head shoe upper and embroidered for a while until her eyes felt tired. Putting down the needle and thread, she thought back on the children's achievements today and that bowl of popular heat-relieving soup, and fell asleep contentedly.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin: bathroom and bedroom at home

name: Early morning exercise and Baduanjin practice.
description: Naturally woke up at 5:30 in the morning and first did some simple stretches in the bedroom. After washing up, she changed into cotton-linen clothes, went to the courtyard to breathe fresh air, and warmed up by doing leg stretches. Then she went out and walked briskly along Jingwen Road, watching the roses in full bloom on the roadside. At the community bulletin board by the alley entrance, she read a notice about learning Baduanjin and planned to attend next Tuesday. After returning, she practiced three movements of Baduanjin on her own by the pomegranate tree in the courtyard, following a video on her phone: 'Starting Posture,' 'Holding the Hands High to Regulate the Triple Burner,' and 'Drawing the Bow to Shoot the Eagle.' Although her movements were still unfamiliar, she felt much more relaxed in her shoulders and neck.
location: Her own home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and the Jingwen Road outside the door

name: Prepare and enjoy breakfast
description: After exercising, she went into the kitchen to prepare breakfast, heating meat buns and flower rolls, cooking millet porridge, and slicing pickled vegetables. Then she woke the three children: Ma Mingxuan, Ma Mingzhe, and Ma Yuxin. The whole family sat around the dining table for breakfast. During the meal, she reiterated the summer rules: homework must start at nine, TV time must not exceed half an hour, and she encouraged the children to finish the summer heat-relieving soup.
location: Home kitchen and dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning housework and planting mint
description: After breakfast, cleared the table and started household chores. First, on the south-facing windowsill of the kitchen, planted mint seeds in a new flowerpot with nutrient soil. The detailed steps included laying clay pellets, filling with soil, poking holes, sowing seeds, covering with soil, and watering. My younger daughter Ma Yuxin watched curiously. Then went to the backyard vegetable garden to check the greens and tomato seedlings and pulled out weeds; returned inside, put the laundry into the washing machine, and mopped the living room floor.
location: Kitchen, backyard vegetable garden, and living room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Go out to buy ingredients and daily necessities.
description: Riding her electric bike, she first went to the Wutong Commune vegetable market to buy fresh pork ribs, winter melon, and cilantro, preparing for the pork rib soup at lunch; then on the way, she went to Jingbai Supermarket in Yuzhou Zunfu to buy plastic wrap and laundry detergent. The two locations are about ten minutes apart.
location: Vegetable market at Wutong Community, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jingbai Supermarket, Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Supervise the children's studies and prepare lunch
description: After coming back from shopping, she first checked the children's studies: Ma Mingxuan was doing summer homework in his room, Ma Mingzhe was writing new characters in the living room but his pencil grip was wrong, and Ma Yuxin was looking at a picture book. After correcting Ma Mingzhe's posture, she went into the kitchen to prepare the pork ribs and winter melon, then cooked lunch, including rib soup, garlic stir-fried water spinach, and tomato scrambled eggs. During the family lunch, the children finished the rib soup. After the meal, she cleared the dishes and asked the children if they wanted to take a nap. Ma Yuxin was sleepy, Ma Mingxuan wanted to read, and Ma Mingzhe wanted to play with toys.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin - own living room, kitchen, and dining room

name: Midday nap
description: After lunch, feeling a sore back, she took her younger daughter Ma Yuxin to the master bedroom for a nap. She drew the curtains, told Ma Yuxin two short stories to lull her to sleep, and then closed her eyes and rested for about forty minutes, regaining her energy.
location: Own master bedroom at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Afternoon embroidery and preparing dinner ingredients
description: After waking from her afternoon nap, she covered Ma Yuxin with a blanket and went to the bright spot by the window in the living room to embroider. To prepare for next week's community handicraft exchange, she embroidered a white handkerchief. She tried the overcast stitch; after two failed attempts, on the third try she finally embroidered an even overcast pattern, and continued embroidering bamboo leaves. After nearly two hours of embroidery, she went to the kitchen to cut the winter melon into pieces for the evening meal and thaw shrimp for later, then woke Ma Yuxin, who was still sleeping.
location: Living room and kitchen of the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Children's outdoor activities
description: In the afternoon the temperature was pleasant, so she encouraged the children to play in the yard. Ma Mingxuan was reading under the porch, Ma Mingzhe was digging in the soil by the vegetable garden looking for earthworms, and Ma Yuxin was chasing butterflies. Ma Xiulan sat on a small stool, keeping an eye on the children while trimming greens for dinner.
location: The courtyard of her home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Cooking and enjoying dinner
description: After going back inside, she prepared dinner: she reheated the leftover pork rib soup from lunch, stir-fried shrimp with winter melon, lightly stir-fried baby bok choy, and cooked a pot of mung bean soup to ward off the heat. After calling the children to wash their hands, the family sat around the table for dinner. Ma Xiulan served soup to each person and reminded them to eat more vegetables.
location: Home kitchen and dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening walk at the lane entrance and casual chat with neighbors
description: After dinner, she took her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin out for a walk. When they reached the alley entrance, they met their neighbor Wang Guilan, who was cooling off outside. The two chatted about the trouble of children being restless during the summer vacation. Wang Guilan quietly shared the good news that her daughter-in-law was pregnant. Ma Xiulan quickly congratulated her and shared her recipe for a summer heat-relieving soup, suggesting that the pregnant woman could drink mung bean soup in moderation to reduce internal heat.
location: At the entrance of the alley on Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, in front of Wang Guilan's home.

name: Evening family activities and washing up.
description: After returning home from the walk, she checked the children's homework: Ma Mingxuan had washed the dishes and was reading an extracurricular book; Ma Mingzhe's homework was neat; Ma Yuxin was doodling on paper. She poured mung bean soup for the children, played with blocks with Ma Yuxin, and reminded Ma Mingzhe to write down the watering task. Then she arranged for the children to wash up, helped Ma Yuxin take a bath, supervised Ma Mingzhe brushing his teeth correctly, and Ma Mingxuan washed up by himself.
location: Her own living room, kitchen, and bathroom at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Putting the younger daughter to sleep
description: Carried her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin to the bed in the second bedroom, told her two stories about little rabbits, and left only after she fell asleep with even breathing.
location: Own second bedroom, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Video call with husband
description: After returning to the master bedroom, she had a video call with her husband Ma Zhiqiang, who was away. They talked about everyday matters such as how the children had been that day, planting mint, and chatting with neighbors. She learned that her husband was expected to arrive home the day after tomorrow, reminded him to be safe, and then hung up.
location: Own master bedroom at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening textile work and bedtime
description: After the call, she leaned against the headboard and continued embroidering the bamboo leaf pattern on the handkerchief in the lamplight. After about an hour, her eyes felt sore, so she set aside the needlework, went to the bathroom to wash up, came back to bed, turned off the light, and went to sleep, reviewing her fulfilling day and drifting off to the chirping of insects.
location: Own master bedroom at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning stretching and vegetable garden care
description: At 5:20 in the morning, the sky was faintly brightening. Rain was forecast, so the air was humid and muggy. Ma Xiulan first did 5 minutes of shoulder and neck stretches in the yard, then spent 10 minutes loosening her waist muscles. She then went into the vegetable garden, squatted in front of the tomato trellis, carefully pinched off the extra side shoots, and guided the bean vines along the bamboo poles. Seeing the cucumber vine standing upright with its leaves and the soil at the roots still moist, she thought, 'This kid really didn't slack off yesterday.' She went back inside and, in her notebook, solemnly drew a small star in the 'Mingzhe watering' column.
location: The courtyard and vegetable garden of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Wake the children and get them washed up.
description: Ma Xiulan washed her face with clean water, changed into everyday clothes, and went into the children's bedroom. She first gently woke the eldest child, Ma Mingxuan. Xuanxuan rubbed his eyes and sat up on his own. Then she patted Mingzhe, who was sleeping like a little pig, and scooped her youngest daughter Yuxin out of the blanket. While slipping a dress onto Xinxin, she reminded them: 'Get a move on, wash up and come have breakfast. I've already written out this morning's task list.'
location: Kitchen and bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Preparing breakfast and assigning summer study tasks
description: Ma Xiulan was busy in the kitchen, with millet porridge simmering on the stove and the pork-and-scallion buns bought yesterday heating in the steamer. She found a moment to wipe down the dining table and put the fermented bean curd and pickled cucumbers from the fridge onto small plates. As the children came to the table one after another, she took out three sheets of paper clearly listing the morning's study tasks: Mingxuan was to complete 30 math application problems and memorize a lesson text; Mingzhe was to finish two pages in the tracing workbook and 20 mental arithmetic problems; Yuxin was to trace two pages in the pinyin workbook and complete a 100-piece puzzle. Watching the children eat with their heads down, she picked up a bun herself and ate it with the porridge.
location: Kitchen and living room of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Tidy up the house and wash clothes.
description: After breakfast, Ma Xiulan quickly cleared the dishes and wiped the stove and dining table shiny with dish soap. She then sorted a few pieces of clothes she had changed out of yesterday and the children's sportswear into the washing machine, added laundry detergent and fabric softener, and pressed the start button. Listening to the washing machine begin to fill with water, she felt that the morning had truly begun.
location: Living room, kitchen, and bathroom at the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Supervising the children's studies and embroidery practice
description: In the living room, the three children each occupied a corner of the desk. Ma Xiulan moved a chair over and sat beside them, holding the white handkerchief she had embroidered the day before, practicing the newly learned backstitch edging. She looked up at the children from time to time: Xuanxuan was frowning over his math problems, so she didn't disturb him; Mingzhe seemed to have nails in his bottom—after writing two characters, he started picking at his eraser, so she gave a soft cough, and Mingzhe immediately buried his head in his work; Xinxin had written a couple of strokes of pinyin and then reached for the building blocks nearby, so Ma Xiulan said gently, "Xinxin, be good. Finish tracing this line, and Mom will play blocks with you for a while." The room was filled only with the rustling of pen tips across paper and the occasional sound of her changing threads.
location: Home living room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Prepared lunch, had family lunch, and coaxed the youngest daughter to take a nap.
description: Around noon, Ma Xiulan put down her embroidery and went to the kitchen to prepare lunch. With quick hands, she kneaded a piece of dough, baked five golden scallion pancakes, sliced some tomatoes, made an egg drop soup, and reheated last night's leftover green pepper stir-fried pork and garlic stir-fried water spinach. The lunch was simple but delicious. After the meal, she asked Xuanxuan and Mingzhe to read extracurricular books for a while, and took Xinxin for a nap. She covered Xinxin with a small blanket, patted her back, and hummed a tuneless lullaby until the child's eyelids grew heavy and she fell deeply asleep.
location: Kitchen, living room, and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Midday rest and collecting air-dried items
description: Seeing Xinxin asleep, Ma Xiulan propped herself against the headboard and dozed for half an hour. Then she looked out the window; the sky had indeed darkened and the wind had picked up. She quickly got up and went into the yard, first bringing in the quilt she had hung out in the morning, then folding the dry clothes from the clothesline one by one, muttering to herself: "The rain comes as soon as it says; luckily I brought them in in time."
location: Bedroom and courtyard at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: After the rain, the cucumber plants were found wilted.
description: Just past two in the afternoon, raindrops as big as beans came clattering down. Ma Xiulan took an umbrella, put on rain boots, and hurried to the vegetable garden. In the rain, the cucumber vine leaves hung limp and listless. She squatted down and touched the soil, and her heart skipped a beat—the soil was dry and hard, cracked with fissures. Only then did she realize that the dampness she had seen in the morning was dew, and the child hadn't watered it at all these past two days. She immediately called Mingzhe, who was watching the rain under the eaves, and pointed at the drooping cucumber vines. Her tone was serious but not harsh: "Zhezhe, look, what's going on here?" Mingzhe's little face went pale at once, and tears welled up in his eyes.
location: The yard and vegetable garden at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Educate Mingzhe and water the cucumbers to make up for it.
description: Ma Xiulan said no more. She took Mingzhe's hand, and together they carried the small bucket, filled it with water, and watered the roots of the cucumber vines bit by bit. While watering, she said gently, "Crops are like people—how uncomfortable it is when they are thirsty. What you promised Mom must be remembered in your heart, not just said with your mouth." Mingzhe, with tears in his eyes, nodded hard and followed behind his mother, stumbling a bit, helping carry the empty bucket to fetch water.
location: Home vegetable garden at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Preparing ingredients and planning to treat my husband tomorrow
description: The rain gradually stopped, and the air carried the fresh scent of earth. Ma Xiulan let Mingzhe and Xuanxuan play in the puddles in the yard, wiped the face of Xinxin, who had just woken up, and had her watch cartoons in the living room. She herself went back to the kitchen and began preparing ingredients for dinner. While washing the baby bok choy she planned to stir-fry plain, she mulled over the fact that Zhiqiang would be back tomorrow and she needed to give him a good treat. Should she buy a sea bass to steam, or make his favorite braised pork ribs? She muttered to herself, but her hands never stopped.
location: Kitchen and yard at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Cooking dinner and eating as a family
description: Ma Xiulan began stir-frying with quick, deft movements. She heated oil in the wok, sizzled minced garlic, and the kitchen filled with the hearty aroma of home cooking. Her dinner included a plate of stir-fried baby bok choy, a plate of smashed cucumber with garlic, a plate of tender scrambled eggs with scallions, and a bowl of liangpi dressed with sesame paste and vinegar. The family sat around the table. Xuanxuan ate with gusto; Mingzhe, who had cried that afternoon, was now wolfing down rice; and Xinxin was slurping up liangpi, getting it all over her face.
location: Kitchen and living room of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Evening study time and embroidery practice.
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan cleared the dishes and wiped the table clean. The children each took out their homework notebooks; today's tasks were not done yet. She also took out the new handkerchief and, taking advantage of her clear mind after dinner, wanted to try the blanket stitch she had practiced yesterday to embroider a flying butterfly on the corner of the handkerchief. Under the lamplight, the children did their homework while the mother threaded her needle; the scene was quiet and warm.
location: Home living room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Discussing the pickled vegetable cooperation by phone
description: Ma Xiulan picked up her phone and called her neighbor Zhou Xiuqin. The two chatted enthusiastically, first about how hot the weather was this year and how it was just the right time to make pickled vegetables, then they agreed to start preparing ingredients next week and officially begin work on July 14. Sister Xiuqin readily agreed to contact their next-door neighbor Wang Guilan, saying one person alone couldn't handle washing and chopping the vegetables. After hanging up with Sister Xiuqin, Ma Xiulan immediately called Wang Guilan. Sister Guilan was also quick to agree over the phone, adding that she was an expert at simmering the sauce.
location: Home living room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Arrange the child's washing up and bedtime story
description: After finishing the phone call, Ma Xiulan checked the time and started getting the children ready for bed. First she gave Xinxin a nice warm bath, then made sure Mingzhe brushed his teeth for a full three minutes, and finally pulled Xuanxuan away from his book. When all three children were tucked in, she sat on the edge of Xinxin's bed, picked up Bambi, and read softly until Xinxin's eyes slowly closed and her breathing became even.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Personal time before bed and preparing to sleep
description: The children were all asleep. Ma Xiulan returned to her own room and gently closed the door. She leaned against the headboard but didn't lie down right away; her mind was still on tomorrow's plans: Zhiqiang would be back tomorrow, so she needed to go to the market early to buy a fresh sea bass; she also needed to go over the pickled vegetable matters again in the morning so she wouldn't be caught unprepared. She took out her phone and sent her husband a WeChat message: "What time will you be home tomorrow? Drive slowly on the way, and I'll make you something delicious." After sending it, she turned off the light and gradually fell asleep in quiet anticipation.
location: Bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Early morning wake-up and exercise.
description: The alarm went off. Ma Xiulan got up immediately, washed up briefly, changed into light sneakers, pushed open the courtyard gate, and walked briskly along the sidewalk on Jingwen Road for about fifteen minutes. When she got home, she did shoulder and neck stretches under the Chinese toon tree in the yard and felt refreshed.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and the sidewalk on Jingwen Road

name: Preparing breakfast and enjoying breakfast time with family.
description: Ma Xiulan carefully cooked millet porridge in the kitchen, made dough drop soup, and fried sliced steamed buns. At seven o'clock she woke her husband Ma Zhiqiang and the three children, and the family sat around the table for breakfast. Mingxuan shared his experience observing aphids, Mingzhe quietly admitted that he had forgotten to water the cucumbers yesterday, Zhiqiang gently taught him, and the youngest daughter Xinxin came around behind Ma Xiulan to pound her back. The breakfast table was full of warmth.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Cucumber incident wrap-up and lesson
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan took Mingzhe to the backyard vegetable garden. They saw that the cucumber vines had revived after last night’s rain and dew and the additional watering. Mingzhe drew a green cucumber with colored pencils and wrote “Don’t forget” neatly below it. Ma Xiulan praised him for correcting his mistake right away, and together they used bamboo poles to reinforce the cucumber trellis and guide the new vines to climb.
location: Backyard vegetable garden, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Housework and supervising the children's studies
description: Ma Xiulan started the washing machine to wash dirty clothes, urged Mingxuan to recite ancient poems in the study and corrected his posture, while trimming the water spinach for lunch. Her youngest daughter Xinxin played with building blocks nearby, asking questions from time to time. After washing, she took the clothes to the yard to dry. The sunlight shone on the wet clothes, giving off a fresh scent.
location: Home yard, living room, and study at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Rode the electric bike to the vegetable market to buy groceries
description: Ma Xiulan put on her straw hat and rode her electric bike to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, where she bought live sea bass, tender tofu, tomatoes, water spinach, and scallions. At the market, she ran into her neighbor Wang Guilan. The two chatted about the plan to make pickled vegetables with Zhou Xiuqin next week. Wang Guilan said she had come up with a new sauce recipe and they would try it together then.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing lunch, Chunmei's surprise visit, having lunch together, and seeing her off
description: Ma Xiulan returned home, put on an apron, and was preparing the meal. While she was salting the fish and cutting tofu, her childhood friend Liu Chunmei made an unexpected visit. Overjoyed, Ma Xiulan invited her inside to sit and continued cooking while chatting, also making mixed noodles and flower tea. At lunch, the family and Chunmei had a lively meal; Zhiqiang was also delighted, and the children excitedly called her Aunt Chunmei. After the meal, Chunmei took her leave, and Ma Xiulan walked her to the door and gave her some newly bought condiment sauce. Then she and Zhiqiang scrubbed the kitchen together.
location: Kitchen, dining room, and courtyard gate at home, No. 156, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Putting the children down for their afternoon nap
description: After lunch, Ma Xiulan took the children to wash up and settled them into bed. She told Xinxin two stories about little rabbits, watched her close her eyes, then went to Mingzhe's room and told him to close his eyes and sleep. Only after his breathing became even did she gently close the door and leave.
location: Children's room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Afternoon embroidery time
description: After the child had gone down for his nap, Ma Xiulan sat by the living room window, took out her embroidery hoop and sewing box, and embroidered lotus petals stitch by stitch with pink silk thread. Her stitches were slow and steady, and she imagined the piece becoming an exquisite round fan, savoring the rare quiet.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare afternoon snacks and tidy up the house.
description: Ma Xiulan took the chilled mung bean soup out of the refrigerator to bring it to room temperature, brought in the dried clothes from the yard, folded them and put them in the wardrobe, and checked her memo to confirm that she needed to go to Jingbai Supermarket in the evening to buy daily necessities and supplements for her mother.
location: Kitchen and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Take the children for outdoor activities.
description: After the children woke up one after another and drank mung bean soup, Ma Xiulan took them to the Jingwen Road Community Square for activities. Mingxuan sat in the shade reading 'The Book of Insects' and observed ants. Mingzhe played football with several kids his age, and she accompanied Xinxin on the slide and swing. They ran into neighbor Zhang Shufen, and the two chatted about Chunmei's visit; Zhang Shufen smiled and said Chunmei should come by her supermarket another day.
location: Jingwen Road Community Square, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Go shopping at Jingbai Supermarket
description: While the children were playing in the square, Ma Xiulan called Zhiqiang to come and watch them, then walked to the nearby Jingbai Supermarket. Following the list, she bought nutritional supplements and daily necessities for her mother, and also picked a bag of newly available juicy peaches.
location: Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu, Jinghai District, Tianjin (Jingbai Supermarket)

name: Going home to prepare dinner
description: Ma Xiulan returned home carrying the groceries. Zhiqiang had already brought the children back and was repairing a wobbly chair in the yard. She put on an apron and started cooking dinner: she turned the leftover sea bass from lunch into steamed fish pieces, stir-fried water spinach with garlic, and made shrimp and winter melon soup.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: A warm dinner time
description: Dinner was served, and the family gathered around the table again. Zhiqiang praised the soup for its delicious taste, Mingxuan shared the story of ants moving house that he had observed in the square, and while eating, Ma Xiulan checked Mingzhe's summer homework list to confirm that he had completed the day's study tasks.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening family activities and homework check
description: After dinner, Zhiqiang did the dishes, and Ma Xiulan moved chairs to enjoy the evening cool in the courtyard with the whole family. She asked Mingxuan to recite the newly learned ancient poem, checked Mingzhe's diary and signed it, while Xinxin squatted nearby using foxtail grass to tease ants. She chatted with Zhiqiang about what he had seen on his driving trips and mentioned the division of work for making pickled vegetables with Zhou Xiuqin and Wang Guilan next week. Zhiqiang expressed his full support.
location: Home courtyard at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Bathing the children and putting them to bed.
description: As it got late, Ma Xiulan ran hot water for Xinxin to take a bubble bath, changed her into clean pajamas, carried her to bed, and told her a bedtime story. Xinxin soon fell asleep sweetly. Afterward, she went to remind Mingzhe that even though tomorrow is Sunday, he should not sleep in and should get up early to help water the vegetables.
location: Bathroom and children's room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Time alone with her husband and a phone call to greet her mother
description: The children were all asleep. Ma Xiulan and Zhiqiang sat in the living room watching local news, and she peeled an apple for Zhiqiang. She took out her phone and called her mother, Li Xiuying, who lived on Shengli Street, to ask about her health and tell her that she planned to bring the children to visit tomorrow, along with honey peaches and some nourishing supplements. Her mother smiled and told her to take good care of the children. After hanging up, the couple talked intimately for a while, both feeling that life was steady and full of promise.
location: Living room and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Finishing up embroidery before bed and going to sleep
description: Ma Xiulan took out her embroidery hoop and added a few more stitches to the lotus petals she had embroidered that afternoon, admiring the soft luster of the silk threads under the light. She stood up, rolled her shoulders, went to the bathroom to wash up and change into pajamas. When she returned to the bedroom, Zhiqiang was already snoring. She lay down gently, thinking back on this full and peaceful day, and fell into a deep sleep with a smile.
location: Living room and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning preparations and personal activities
description: At 5:25 in the morning, Ma Xiulan was naturally awakened by her biological clock. Instead of getting up immediately, she lay on her side, gently turned her neck, and did some simple shoulder and neck stretches. Then she got up, changed into light cotton-linen clothes, walked to the yard, took deep breaths of the morning air beside the pomegranate tree, and moved her arms, waist, and hips to prepare for the day's activities.
location: Home (156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin) - bedroom and courtyard

name: Prepare breakfast
description: At 6 o'clock, Ma Xiulan returned to the kitchen, tied on an apron, and began preparing breakfast. She took the mung beans that had been soaked overnight out of the fridge, put them in a clay pot with water, and simmered them over low heat. At the same time, she took the steamed buns and flower rolls made yesterday from the freezer and put them in the steamer to heat up. While the porridge was simmering, she quickly sliced a plate of pickled vegetables bought yesterday at Jingbai Supermarket.
location: Home kitchen (No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin)

name: Family breakfast
description: At exactly 7 o'clock, Ma Xiulan went upstairs to wake up her husband Ma Zhiqiang and the three children Ma Mingxuan, Ma Mingzhe, and Ma Yuxin. The family sat around the dining table for breakfast, which included steaming mung bean porridge, soft baozi, and flower rolls, served with pickled vegetables and half a plate of tomatoes with sugar left from last night. While eating, Ma Xiulan said to her husband, "After breakfast I'll go to the community to sign up for that Baduanjin class. You keep an eye on the children's homework at home in the morning. In the afternoon, we'll go to my mother's place together." She also reminded Mingxuan and Mingzhe to do their summer homework first in the morning and watch less TV, and told Yuxin she could watch cartoons for only half an hour.
location: Home dining room (156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin)

name: Clean the kitchen and contact the neighbors.
description: After breakfast, Ma Xiulan quickly cleared away the bowls and chopsticks, wiped down the stove, rinsed the dishes, and put them back in place. Then she used her phone to send a WeChat message to her childhood friend Liu Chunmei and her neighbor across the hall Wang Guilan: “Are you all set? Let’s meet at the community center entrance at 8:30!” Both quickly replied, “Got it! See you in a bit!”
location: Home kitchen and living room (No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin)

name: Walking to the community service center
description: Ma Xiulan put on her sun hat, grabbed her phone and notebook, locked the front door, and walked along the sidewalk on Jingwen Road toward the community service center. The morning street was quiet; she saw Grandpa Zhang out for his morning walk and nodded with a smile in greeting. After about 10 minutes, she arrived at the Chaoyang Street Community Health Service Center in Jinghai District, near the intersection of Jingwen Road and Chaoyang Road.
location: Sidewalk on Jingwen Road (Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin)

name: Community center registration and Baduanjin exercise class
description: When Ma Xiulan arrived, Liu Chunmei and Wang Guilan were already waiting at the door. The three walked into the service center hall chatting and laughing. Under the guidance of the staff, they filled out the "Summer Health and Wellness Promotion Activity Registration Form" and confirmed that the class time was 9:00-10:00 every Sunday morning. After registering, at exactly 9 o'clock, the instructor started the class on time in the activity room, first leading everyone in warm-ups, and then demonstrating the entire set of Baduanjin movements. When it was Ma Xiulan's turn to practice "Drawing the Bow to Shoot the Eagle," her shoulders were stiff, so she stumbled while turning and lost her balance. An aunt in the back row joked that she "swayed like a duck." She stood still in embarrassment, cheeks flushing, and humbly asked the instructor for advice. The instructor patiently guided her to relax her shoulders and lower her center of gravity. After class, the three exchanged insights with the instructor and other students, and agreed to continue on Wednesday.
location: Lobby and activity room, Chaoyang Street Community Health Service Center, Jinghai District (No. 16 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin)

name: Morning market shopping and putting things away at home
description: After leaving the community center, the three of them walked about 15 minutes to the Wutong Commune vegetable market. Ma Xiulan bought tender tofu, greens, and chicken breast from a familiar stall. As she passed Sun Guifang's vegetable stall, she was warmly greeted, 'Sister Xiulan! Today's waxy corn is really sweet!' Unable to resist the persuasion, she bought four more ears. Liu Chunmei grabbed a handful of home-dried long beans from her reusable bag and shared them with the other two. After shopping, Ma Xiulan carried a full bag of vegetables home. Once inside, she first refrigerated the tender tofu, drained the greens and chicken breast, and planned to cook a tender ear of corn at noon to sample the freshness.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market (near the intersection of Jingwen Road and Shengli Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin), home (No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin)

name: Prepare and have lunch together
description: The weather was hot, so Ma Xiulan decided to make a refreshing lunch. She reheated yesterday's leftover rice, cooked a pot of plain noodles and rinsed them in cold water, then tossed them with sesame paste, minced garlic, and shredded cucumber to make a large serving of sesame-paste noodles. She also made an egg drop soup with greens and tomatoes. The family of five sat around the table, eating a simple and satisfying meal.
location: Home kitchen and dining room (156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin)

name: Noon break
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan urged Mingzhe and Yuxin to rinse their mouths and go to take a nap, while Mingxuan went to his room to read on his own. Feeling tired, she lay down on the living room sofa, set a 30-minute alarm, and took a short rest.
location: Living room at home (156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin)

name: Extra Baduanjin practice in the afternoon
description: After the alarm rang, Ma Xiulan felt her energy restored. She walked to the shade of the pomegranate tree in the yard and recalled the Baduanjin movements she had learned in the morning, focusing on practicing 'Holding Both Hands Up to Regulate the Triple Burner' and 'Single Hand Raising to Regulate the Spleen and Stomach.' She deliberately slowed down her movements, felt the stretch in her arms and body, and tried hard to perfect her posture. After practicing for about half an hour, a light sweat appeared on her forehead, and she felt that the stiffness in her shoulders had eased considerably.
location: Home yard (156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin).

name: Preparing items for the trip back to her parents' home.
description: Ma Xiulan went back inside, put the supplements she had bought at Jingbai Supermarket yesterday (a box of protein powder and a carton of whole milk) and the two fresh ears of corn she had bought that morning into a tote bag. Then she went to the vegetable garden in the courtyard and cut a few stalks of homegrown cilantro to take to her mother.
location: Living room and courtyard at home (No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin)

name: The family of five set out for the wife's parents' home.
description: Ma Xiulan called her husband and children together. Ma Zhiqiang carried a heavy bag, she held her youngest daughter Yuxin, and Mingxuan and Mingzhe followed behind. The family of five walked out of the courtyard. Ma Zhiqiang rode a bicycle carrying the two sons, while Ma Xiulan rode another electric bike with Yuxin. They turned from Jingwen Road onto Shengli Street, rode for about ten minutes, and arrived at her parents' home at No. 45 Shengli Street.
location: On the way from home (156 Jingwen Road) to her parents' home (45 Shengli Street).

name: Went back to her parents' home to visit them.
description: Mother Li Xiuying had already been looking out from the yard entrance. When she saw her daughter's family, her face was full of smiles. Father Ma Jianguo also came out to greet them and gave the grandchildren muskmelons he had grown himself. In the small courtyard, loofah vines covered the trellis, cool and comfortable. Ma Xiulan handed the things she had brought to her mother, and sat under the eaves with Zhiqiang, drinking tea and chatting with her father about how they were doing. Yuxin pestered her grandma to tell stories, Mingzhe was very interested in grandpa's birds and asked questions nonstop, while Mingxuan quietly read grandpa's collection of books.
location: Parental home (first-floor small courtyard at 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin)

name: Returned home from her parents' house
description: They chatted for nearly an hour and a half. Seeing that it was still early, Ma Xiulan got up to say goodbye. Her mother was reluctant to part and packed her another bag of green beans and chives from the family yard. The family of five headed back the same way and arrived home at 4:30 p.m.
location: On the way from her parents' home (45 Shengli Street) to her home (156 Jingwen Road)

name: Preparing dinner ingredients and boiling corn
description: Back home, Ma Xiulan washed her face, let the family do as they pleased, and tied on an apron to start preparing dinner. She washed the tender corn she had brought back, put it into a large pot with water to boil, took out the pork tenderloin from the refrigerator and cut it into strips, marinated it with cooking wine, salt, and pepper, then trimmed and washed the water spinach, and smashed cucumbers to make a cold salad.
location: Home kitchen (No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin)

name: The whole family had dinner together
description: Dinner was served, with sweet and sour pork, garlic stir-fried water spinach, cucumber salad, and boiled corn. The family sat around the table, and the children praised the corn. Ma Xiulan, while picking food for Yuxin, smiled and told the funny story of learning Baduanjin that morning and "waddling like a duck," making the whole family laugh, and her husband Ma Zhiqiang also teased her.
location: Home dining room (156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin)

name: Cleaning Up the Kitchen and Relaxing in the Shade
description: After dinner, Ma Zhiqiang volunteered to do the dishes. Ma Xiulan spread a straw mat in the yard, and she and her husband each sat on a folding stool to enjoy the cool evening air. The evening breeze dispersed the daytime heat. The two chatted about what they had seen and heard at her parents' house that afternoon and discussed the pickled vegetables for next week, while the children chased each other around the yard, laughing merrily.
location: Home yard (156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin).

name: Family evening activities
description: Ma Xiulan called Yuxin into the bathroom, bathed her, and changed her into dry pajamas, then took her to the living room to watch cartoons. Afterward, she checked Mingzhe's summer homework, found two math problems wrong, and patiently guided him to correct them. Mingxuan had already finished reviewing his lessons and was reading an extracurricular book in his room. Around nine o'clock, she urged the three children to take turns washing up and get ready for bed.
location: Bathroom, living room, and children's room at home (156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin)

name: Personal time before bed
description: After the children fell asleep, Ma Xiulan returned to the bedroom. Standing by the window, she closed her eyes and silently recalled the Baduanjin moves she had practiced extra that afternoon, gently mimicking them in the room a few times. Then she picked up her phone and called her mother to ask if her parents were doing well. Only after confirming everything was fine did she feel at ease.
location: Home bedroom (No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin)

name: Embroidering, washing up, and going to bed.
description: After hanging up the phone, Ma Xiulan took out the round fan with half a lotus embroidered on it the day before from her sewing box. By the soft desk lamp light, she focused on embroidering a few more pink lotus petals, with fine, dense stitches and a well-graded color transition. When her eyes grew sore, she carefully put away the embroidery and went to the bathroom to wash up. At 22:45, she turned off the desk lamp and fell into a deep sleep.
location: Home bedroom (No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin)

name: Early morning wake-up and morning preparations
description: The alarm went off on time. Ma Xiulan put on a light jacket and got up. After washing up briefly, she went to the courtyard to check the temperature and felt it was a bit stuffy. She went back inside to change into sportswear, grabbed an umbrella, checked her phone and saw that the weather was cloudy at 32C, and decided to exercise in the courtyard in the early morning.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning brisk walk and Baduanjin review
description: Ma Xiulan walked briskly east along Jingwen Road for about 15 minutes to the Chaoyang intersection, and on the way met a neighbor exercising in the morning and nodded in greeting. After returning to the courtyard at home, she first stretched, then focused on practicing "Drawing the Bow to Shoot the Eagle" from Baduanjin, paying attention to the coach's guidance on relaxing the shoulders and pushing the palm flat. Her movements were smooth and steady without stumbling.
location: Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and the home courtyard.

name: Breakfast preparation and family breakfast
description: After finishing her exercises and wiping off sweat, Ma Xiulan went back inside, then into the kitchen to rinse mung beans and cook porridge, steam the tender corn bought the day before, and toss a cucumber salad. At the same time, she organized the green beans and chives her mother had given her for later use. Around 7 o'clock she woke the three children and urged them to wash up. At 7:10 the whole family sat down to breakfast, which included mung bean porridge, corn, cucumber salad, and leftover buns. While eating, she reminded the children to do their homework seriously and patiently fed her youngest daughter Yuxin porridge.
location: Kitchen and dining room of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Cleaning and household tidying
description: After the children finished eating and went back to their rooms, Ma Xiulan began to tidy the dining room and kitchen. She soaked the dishes and chopsticks in water, wiped down the stove and dining table first, then washed the dishes one by one. She sorted the dirty clothes from the previous night into the washing machine for a quick wash, then mopped the living room floor and dusted the coffee table and TV cabinet.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Rest and plan tomorrow's family visit
description: While the washing machine runs, Ma Xiulan rests briefly on the living room sofa. She checks her phone: tomorrow will be sunny with a high of 35°C. She mentally plans the items to take to her parents' home tomorrow: her own pickled vegetables, two packs of walnut powder, leftover green beans and chives, and so on.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Called her mother to arrange a family visit
description: Ma Xiulan called her mother Li Xiuying, first asked about her parents' health, and learned that her father had fixed the small stool. She told her mother that she planned to bring the three children to her parents' home on Shengli Street the next day. Her mother was very happy, said she would prepare watermelon and snacks, and asked whether to make the sweet-and-sour spare ribs her granddaughter loved. Ma Xiulan told her mother not to get too tired and that she would bring some pickled vegetables. Her father also chimed in beside the phone, and the atmosphere was warm. She reminded the elderly to guard against heatstroke.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Finishing housework and prepping ingredients.
description: After hanging up, Ma Xiulan washed the green beans and chives she had trimmed in the morning. She cut the green beans into sections and chopped the chives for later use. She soaked the dried green beans sent by Liu Chunmei, planning to take them to her mother's home the next day. After the washing machine finished, she hung the clothes on the clothesline in the courtyard.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Shopping at Wutong Commune Vegetable Market
description: Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market and bought two pieces of firm tofu, greens, chicken breast, and other ingredients. On the way back, she ran into her neighbor Wang Guilan at the entrance of the market. They stood and chatted for a bit. Wang Guilan said she would go to the community service center in the afternoon to pick up the Baduanjin registration materials, and Ma Xiulan said she would attend the class on Sunday.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, 32 Yunhe West Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare and enjoy lunch
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan put away the purchased items and began preparing lunch: green beans cut into diagonal sections, garlic sliced; leeks drained; firm tofu cut into cubes; chicken breast thawed and diced. She then reheated mung bean porridge and corn, and stir-fried in turn garlic green beans, chive scrambled eggs, mapo tofu, and chicken dices with greens. At 11:50 she called the children to wash their hands for dinner, and the whole family sat around the table. Ma Xiulan took care of her youngest daughter Yuxin, while her son Mingzhe, who said the food was spicy, was encouraged to drink more porridge. The atmosphere was calm.
location: Kitchen and dining room of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Lunch cleanup and midday rest
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan cleared the dishes, covered the leftovers with plastic wrap, and put them in the refrigerator. She arranged for her eldest son, Mingxuan, to take his younger siblings back to their room for a midday nap. After settling Yuxin, she went to the living room, flattened the sofa, used a cushion as a pillow, draped a thin jacket over herself, set an alarm, and took a 50-minute nap. During that time she vaguely heard Yuxin talking, but it soon became quiet. When the alarm rang, she washed her face with cold water and regained her energy.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Baduanjin practice in the courtyard and tidying up the exercise area
description: After changing into sportswear and going to the courtyard, Ma Xiulan reviewed the entire Baduanjin routine from the beginning, practicing the 'Drawing the Bow' and 'Regulating the Spleen and Stomach with One Hand Raised' movements repeatedly and slowly with precision. Then she moved two old bamboo chairs from the southeast corner to the storage shed under the west wall, clearing about three square meters of space. She swept up the fallen leaves, spread out an old yoga mat, and created a dedicated morning exercise area. She also wiped the bamboo chairs clean.
location: Home courtyard at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Hand embroidery and activity area inspection
description: Ma Xiulan returned to the window by the living room, took the round silk fan with embroidered lotus flowers and needle and thread from her craft basket, and at the brightest spot embroidered lotus leaves, carefully outlining the veins with light and dark green thread. She got up midway to drink water. After finishing the embroidery, she rubbed her eyes to rest, then went to the courtyard to check whether the exercise area floor was too hard, laid down an old yoga mat, and arranged the bamboo chairs to make sure the path was clear.
location: Living room and courtyard at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Dinner preparation and cooking
description: Ma Xiulan took ribs out of the fridge, blanched them, and prepared ingredients, picking scallions and cucumbers from the vegetable garden to prepare dinner ingredients. She skillfully made sweet and sour ribs, while stir-frying water spinach with garlic, making a smashed cucumber salad, steaming leftover buns from breakfast, and quickly making a pot of tomato egg drop soup. When the ribs were reducing the sauce, she tasted them and was satisfied with the sweet-and-sour flavor.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner
description: Ma Xiulan called the three children to dinner. Her youngest daughter Yuxin likes to mix rice with the sauce from sweet and sour ribs, so Ma Xiulan spooned a little over for her. Mingzhe and Mingxuan chatted about funny school stories as they ate, and the atmosphere at the table was relaxed and cheerful.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Cleaning up and family interaction after dinner
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan asked Mingxuan to take his younger brother to do homework while she cleaned up the kitchen: washing the dishes, wiping down the stove, and putting leftovers in fresh-keeping boxes in the refrigerator. When she got to the living room, she saw Yuxin playing with building blocks and Mingzhe hanging around by the door, so she reminded Mingzhe to finish his math homework before watching TV.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing for family visits and chatting with neighbors
description: Ma Xiulan called the three children into the living room and taught them the etiquette for visiting Grandma's house tomorrow: greet her actively, don't rummage through things, help set the bowls and chopsticks, and don't chase or roughhouse. She had Yuxin practice saying ‘Hello, Grandma’ and assigned Mingxuan to look after his younger siblings. Then she listed in her notebook the items to bring: two jars of pickled vegetables, two bags of walnut powder, soaked dried green beans, and so on. After the children returned to their room, she opened WeChat on the sofa to contact her childhood friend Liu Chunmei, asked about her pickled vegetable recipe, and copied it down carefully. The two chatted about family matters, and when Liu Chunmei asked about going back to her parents' home the next day, Ma Xiulan gave a brief reply.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Bedtime personal care and falling asleep
description: Ma Xiulan first checked the three children's rooms. Yuxin was already asleep, but Mingzhe was still reading, so she urged him to go to sleep quickly. Returning to the bedroom, she washed up with warm water and put on a face mask, then leaned against the bed and scrolled through local news for a while. After turning off the main light, she reviewed the next day's plan under the bedside lamp: get up early to make soft-boiled eggs with runny yolks, cook porridge, and take the children to her parents' home. Recalling the cheerful tone of her phone call with her mother, she felt warm. The phone prompted her to charge it, so she plugged in the charging cable, set the alarm for 5:20 the next morning, and lay on her side, falling asleep peacefully.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Morning stretching and housework preparation
description: Just at dawn, Ma Xiulan woke up and first stretched her neck, shoulders, and waist in bed, then went to the courtyard to practice the first two forms of Baduanjin. Afterward, she returned indoors, gathered the clothes that had been drying in the yard the day before, folded them and put them in the wardrobe, and took a broom to sweep the living room and courtyard, keeping the home clean and tidy.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; home courtyard and living room

name: Prepare breakfast and pack for the visit to her parents' home
description: Ma Xiulan rinsed the millet and put it into the pot to cook porridge, while heating the hand-rolled noodles and steamed buns bought yesterday. While the porridge was cooking, she went to the storage room, took out the prepared two jars of homemade pickles (sweet pickled garlic and pickled radish), and also got the walnut powder and dried green beans she had bought for her parents. She placed them neatly into a canvas bag and carefully checked to ensure the jar lids were tightly sealed.
location: Kitchen and storage room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Wake the children and shepherd them out of bed
description: The aroma of breakfast filled the house. Ma Xiulan went upstairs and woke the three children one by one. The eldest son Mingxuan got up and made his bed on his own; the second son Mingzhe stayed in bed and had to be teased up; the youngest daughter Yuxin rubbed her eyes and looked for her mother. Ma Xiulan helped them wash up and watched them get neatly ready.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; the bedrooms at home

name: The whole family had breakfast, and I reminded them of today's rules.
description: The family of four sat around the table eating breakfast, drinking millet porridge and eating steamed buns. While eating, Ma Xiulan reminded the children to be polite and well-behaved at their grandmother's house, and not to make noise or run around chasing each other. The children nodded obediently, and her little daughter said she would tell her grandmother that she missed her.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Final checks and preparations before departure
description: After breakfast, Ma Xiulan quickly cleared the dishes and put them to soak in the sink, put sun hats on the children, and filled three water bottles with boiled water. She checked the canvas bag once more to make sure nothing had been left behind, then told the children to hold hands along the way, sit steady, and hold on. They answered in unison.
location: Home entryway, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Took the bus and walked to her parents' home
description: Ma Xiulan held her youngest daughter's hand with one hand and carried a canvas bag with the other, leading her three children on foot to the Jingwen Road bus stop, where they caught the No. 6 bus at 8:05. On the bus, the children found seats and excitedly talked about the big jujube tree at their grandmother's house. Ma Xiulan reminded them to keep their voices down. Twenty minutes later, they got off at Shengli Street stop and walked another 5 minutes along a familiar alley. From a distance, they saw the big jujube tree in front of her parents' house and heard the sound of her father hammering and fixing things in the yard. They arrived at her parents' home.
location: Outside the courtyard gate of the parents' home at No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Reunion at Her Parents' Home and Learning Cooking by Helping in the Kitchen
description: As Ma Xiulan's family came in, her father Ma Jianguo was repairing a bench in the yard, and her mother Li Xiuying came out to greet them. Watermelon and grapes were already set on the table. After saying hello to their grandparents, the children played in the yard. Ma Xiulan tied on an apron and followed her mother into the kitchen to learn to make cold noodles, carefully noting every step of boiling the noodles, cooling them in cold water, mixing the sesame paste, vinegar, garlic water, and the side dishes. The mother and daughter chatted about family matters while working, touching on Mingxuan's studies and Mingzhe's mischief. The kitchen was filled with warm laughter.
location: No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, inside the courtyard and kitchen of her parents' home.

name: Get lunch ready and prepare to serve the meal
description: After learning how to make cold noodle salad, Ma Xiulan and her mother began preparing the other dishes. She helped wash the greens, cut tomatoes, and beat eggs. Her mother took out braised beef, sliced it, and made smashed cucumber salad. Mother and daughter worked in perfect harmony, and the sounds of pots and pans in the kitchen were like a symphony.
location: No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, parents' home kitchen and dining room

name: The whole family sat around and enjoyed lunch.
description: At twelve noon, a hearty meal was served: cold noodles, stir-fried greens, tomato and egg soup, spiced beef, and smashed cucumbers. Her father praised the cold noodles as authentic. During the meal, the family ate and chatted, talking about Mingxuan's studies and the children's growth. Ma Xiulan mentioned the rules she had set for the children during summer vacation, and her parents supported her. Everyone was happy and harmonious.
location: 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, dining room of her parents' home.

name: Midday rest and idle chat in the courtyard
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan and her mother cleared away the dishes. The children played in the yard for a while and then began to get sleepy. Since the weather was hot, Ma Xiulan suggested taking an afternoon nap. She held her younger daughter and dozed on the living room sofa. Her mother went to her room and lay down, while her father lay on a rattan chair in the yard, waving a palm-leaf fan and listening to a storytelling program on the radio. Before long, he too was dozing off.
location: No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin; living room and courtyard of the parents' home.

name: Farewell and Red Envelopes
description: At 2:30 in the afternoon, Ma Xiulan woke the children and washed her face, preparing to leave. Her mother, Li Xiuying, took out three red envelopes each containing 200 yuan and pressed them into the grandchildren's hands. Ma Xiulan quickly declined, but her parents insisted, so she had the children accept them and say thank you. In her heart, she planned to use the money to buy her parents two sets of soft autumn thermal underwear.
location: Parents' home living room, 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Return bus ride and going home
description: Ma Xiulan and the children walked again to the Shengli Street bus stop and took the No. 6 bus at 3:05 back to Jingwen Road. On the bus, the youngest daughter kept holding the red envelope tightly. Ma Xiulan felt both touched and uneasy, thinking she would record the expense when she got home.
location: From Shengli Street Bus Stop, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to Jingwen Road Bus Stop (Bus No. 6)

name: Arriving home to rest and keep the accounts.
description: After arriving home, Ma Xiulan had the children drink water and rest, and washed her own face. She took out her account book and, in the income column, recorded the total of 600 yuan that her mother had given the children as red envelopes, with the note 'Earmarked for designated purposes; plan to go to the clothing market soon to buy soft autumn thermal underwear for Mom and Dad.' She told Yuxin that Grandma's money should be saved for school supplies and that she should be grateful. Yuxin nodded sensibly.
location: Living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Reassure mother, contact childhood friend
description: Putting down the account book, Ma Xiulan first called her mother to report that they were safe. Then she sent a WeChat message to her childhood friend Liu Chunmei, telling her that she had taken the children back to her parents' home today and had just arrived home safely, and reminded her that they would start preparing ingredients to make pickled vegetables next week, and that they would compare recipes another day. Chunmei quickly replied, and the two chatted briefly about recent happenings.
location: Living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Supervise the children doing homework and prepare ingredients for dinner
description: After the rest, Ma Xiulan urged Mingxuan and Mingzhe to do their summer homework, while Yuxin read a picture book nearby. She went into the kitchen to prepare dinner, rinsed mung beans and started cooking mung bean porridge, then smashed cucumbers to make a cold cucumber salad, and washed the greens for later.
location: No. 156, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; the living room and kitchen at home.

name: Dinner time
description: The mung bean porridge was cooked soft and fragrant. Ma Xiulan served the cucumber salad and stir-fried greens, and the family of four had dinner. At the table she asked Mingxuan about his summer study plan and reminded Mingzhe to finish his homework on time tomorrow.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: After-meal tidying and family activities
description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan cleared the table and washed the dishes. The children watched cartoons in the living room. When she finished cleaning up, she sat on the sofa, took out the round fan embroidered with half a lotus, put on her reading glasses, and embroidered, feeling especially peaceful.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, kitchen and living room at home

name: Remind the children to wash up and prepare for bed
description: After the cartoon ended, Ma Xiulan urged the children to take baths. She first bathed her younger daughter Yuxin and changed her into pajamas, then checked whether her second son Mingzhe had washed properly and scrubbed his neck for him, and finally washed herself. The eldest son Mingxuan brushed his teeth on his own first.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; the bedrooms at home

name: Put the children to sleep and contact her husband
description: After the children went to bed, Ma Xiulan told Yuxin two bedtime stories until she fell asleep. She checked the rooms of Mingxuan and Mingzhe. Mingxuan was still reading, and Mingzhe was already asleep, so she reminded Mingxuan to go to sleep soon. Once all the children were settled, she lay back in bed and sent a voice message to her husband Ma Zhiqiang, telling him about taking the children back to her parents' home, saying that her mother had given her a red envelope which she planned to use to buy autumn underwear for her parents, and urging him to drive safely and not to worry about things at home.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; the bedrooms at home

name: Personal time and rest
description: After putting down her phone, Ma Xiulan did not go to sleep immediately. Leaning against the headboard, she planned to go to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market the next day to buy fresh pork, and to go to the clothing market to look at autumn clothes for her parents when it got cooler. Thinking of how happy her parents would be when they received the new clothes, a smile tugged at the corners of her mouth. Feeling at ease, she turned off the light and fell into a deep, peaceful sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning Baduanjin exercise and vegetable garden work.
description: Woke up promptly at 5:20 in the morning, changed into workout clothes, first did 5 minutes of shoulder, neck and lower back stretches in the courtyard, then walked briskly along Jingwen Road for 15 minutes. At 6:00 returned to the courtyard, laid out a yoga mat in the regular exercise area and began reviewing the entire set of Baduanjin, focusing on the move "Draw the Bow to Shoot the Eagle" with steady movements. After exercising, went to the vegetable garden to check the cucumber vines that had wilted from the rain, found the leaves had recovered, and picked two tender cucumbers while there.
location: Home courtyard at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare breakfast and eye-care education
