description: After washing up, she prepared breakfast, including cold noodles, steamed buns, millet congee, and cucumber salad. At 6:20 she woke the three children, adjusted the living room desk lamp, and handed out mini timers. She set the rule that homework, reading, and watching TV must use the timer, with a 10-minute break to look out the window every 40 minutes, emphasizing that they must not rub their eyes. The eldest, Mingxuan, nodded sensibly; the second child, Mingzhe, answered vaguely; the youngest daughter, Xinxin, played with the timer.
location: Kitchen and central room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Household tidying and getting ready to go out
description: After breakfast, Ma Xiulan put away the dishes, wiped down the stove, and put the dirty clothes into the washing machine. She checked the WeChat reminder from her neighbor Zhou Xiuqin about going to the vegetable market, reviewed the accounting book to confirm the ingredients needed for pickled vegetables, put the accounting book and pen into her cloth bag, and got ready to go out and meet up.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Market research on pickled vegetable ingredients at the vegetable market
description: At 8:55, Zhou Xiuqin came over, and they walked together to Xingwang Vegetable Market. They ordered 20 jin of tender cucumbers at Sun Guifang’s stall and agreed to pick them up next Monday. After comparing several vendors’ radishes, they ordered 15 jin of white radish from Old Zhao at a price one mao lower than the market price. Before leaving, they asked about the price of pork belly.
location: Xingwang Vegetable Market, north of the intersection of Dongfanghong Road and Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Buying seasonings at the supermarket
description: After leaving the vegetable market, she went to the nearby Jingbai Supermarket to buy large bottles of premium light soy sauce and dark soy sauce. After comparing production dates and prices, she chose a brand with good value for money. She discussed the division of labor for making pickled vegetables next Monday with Zhou Xiuqin.
location: Jingbai Supermarket, Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Returning home, organizing belongings, and keeping accounts.
description: 10:45 left the supermarket and returned home separately. Put the purchased soy sauce into the cupboard, and in the account book recorded in detail the quantity, unit price, and pickup date of the ordered cucumbers and radishes, as well as the price of the pork belly she had checked. Remembered the 600 yuan red envelope given by mother to the child, and noted that the money is earmarked for going to look at autumn clothes the day after tomorrow.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Lunch, embroidery, and afternoon rest
description: She heated the leftover cold noodles and pickled vegetables from the morning as lunch. After the meal, she rested on the sofa with eyes closed for half an hour to refresh herself. Then she took out the lotus round fan and continued embroidering. Her overlock stitching was skilled, the stitches fine and dense, and the lotus leaf outline was already clear. At the same time, she made a WeChat voice call with Zhou Xiuqin to arrange to go to the clothing market tomorrow to look at autumn underwear. At 1:30 p.m. she felt sleepy, went to the bedroom for a half-hour nap, woke up at 2:00, washed her face, checked the children's naps, and prepared for the afternoon outing.
location: Home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin: central room, living room, and bedroom

name: Afternoon outdoor activities in the park
description: 14:00 Woke up the whole family, urged Mingxuan to check his homework and bring his badminton racket, Mingzhe put on his roller skates and was reminded to pay attention to safety and look at green leaves more often, while she took the jump rope and changed Yuxin into her sneakers. 14:45 Set off on foot to Jinghai District Park. At the park, Mingxuan played badminton, Mingzhe roller-skated, Ma Xiulan supervised under the shade of trees, reminding Mingzhe to look up at the trees, and accompanied Yuxin in jump rope and waist stretches. During breaks she had the children drink water, and pointed at leaves for Yuxin to observe their shapes and rest her eyes.
location: Jinghai District Park, northwest corner of the intersection of Shengli Street and Dongfanghong Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Return home to prepare and cook dinner.
description: At 16:30 she called the children home, set a timer on her phone for half an hour so they could wash their hands, drink water, and rest. At 17:15 she went into the kitchen and started steaming rice, making garlic water spinach and tomato egg drop soup. Mingzhe asked when his father would be home, and was told he had work in the evening and wouldn't be back; he was also warned to keep an eye on his younger sister and not let her touch the sewing box.
location: Kitchen and central room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Dinner and after-meal cleanup
description: The food was served, and she called the children to eat. She asked Mingxuan about his reading, whether Mingzhe had a good time at the park, and Yuxin described almost falling while jump-roping. After the meal, she had the children help clear the bowls, then cleaned up the dishes and chopsticks, wiped the table and floor, and tidied the kitchen.
location: Main hall of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening homework supervision and guidance.
description: At 19:30, she gathered the children in the main room to do their homework. Ma Xiulan supervised Mingzhe and found that he had used an old phone to play games for at least half an hour while getting some water. She confiscated the phone and turned it off, scolded him for using his phone against the rules, and stipulated that it could only be used to look up questions and for no more than 15 minutes a day. She also punished him by making him wash the dishes after finishing his homework. Then she hurried the children to take baths. She first bathed Yuxin and told her stories to lull her to sleep, then urged Mingzhe and Mingxuan to wash. By 21:00, all three children were settled in bed.
location: At home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin: the main hall, living room, bathroom, and bedroom.

name: Personal rest and bedtime preparation
description: After the children fell asleep, Ma Xiulan took a hot bath to relax. Lying in bed, she called her mother Li Xiuying and talked about looking at pickle ingredients and about Mingzhe secretly playing with his phone; her mother comforted her. Then she went through her account book, silently thought about the preparations for going to the clothing market tomorrow, and decided to have her husband drive her there on Saturday. Thinking about the color of her father's autumn thermal underwear, she gradually fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Waking up in the early morning and exercising in the courtyard
description: Ma Xiulan woke up shortly after five in the morning. In her own courtyard she first did ten minutes of stretching to loosen up, then walked briskly along the flagstone path for over ten minutes, feeling the cool morning air and refreshing herself for the day ahead.
location: Home courtyard at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare breakfast and wake the children up to eat.
description: After morning exercise, Ma Xiulan cooked millet porridge in the kitchen, heated up steamed buns, and made scallion egg pancakes. When breakfast was almost ready, she woke up her eldest son Ma Mingxuan, second son Ma Mingzhe, and youngest daughter Ma Yuxin one by one, braided her daughter's hair, and then the family ate at the dining table. While eating, Ma Xiulan checked the children's schoolbags and change of clothes, and urged them to eat their fill.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Riding an electric bicycle to take the child to school
description: At 6:50, Ma Xiulan set off on an electric bike with her second son Ma Mingzhe and youngest daughter Ma Yuxin. She first took Ma Mingzhe to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, then turned around and took Ma Yuxin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, and only left after handing the child to the teacher.
location: In Jinghai District, Tianjin, starting at 156 Jingwen Road, proceed to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street) and then Huakang First Kindergarten.

name: Go home, do housework, and change clothes to go out
description: After dropping off the children, Ma Xiulan returned home and immediately threw herself into housework. She used the washing machine to wash dirty clothes, watered the Chinese roses, blue snowflowers, and mint in the courtyard, then washed the dishes and wiped down the stove. After finishing, she changed into sportswear, grabbed her water bottle and phone, and walked to the community fitness square.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and on the way to the community fitness plaza

name: Joined the morning Baduanjin exercise and made the acquaintance of Aunt Zhao.
description: At exactly 9 o'clock, Ma Xiulan practiced Baduanjin with the leading instructor at the community fitness square. Her movements were more skilled than before, and her shoulders and neck felt relaxed. During the break, she noticed Aunt Zhao Sufen in the front row, whose movements were standard, and took the initiative to strike up a conversation. Aunt Zhao, a retired teacher, warmly shared her homemade hawthorn tea and taught her how to press the lumbosacral points and the Weizhong acupoint to relieve lower back soreness. The two chatted happily, added each other on WeChat, and agreed to practice together every day.
location: Community fitness plaza and pavilion at the intersection of Jingwen Road and Jianshe Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Bought parents autumn underwear and bought groceries to prepare lunch
description: After morning exercise, Ma Xiulan went home, changed into everyday clothes, took the 600 yuan red envelope her mother had given her, and rode her electric bike to the Golden Triangle Clothing Market. She chose carefully: a dark gray thick pure-cotton thermal top for her father, and a purplish-red one with a dark floral pattern for her mother, spending 185 yuan in total. Then on the way she stopped by Wutong Commune Vegetable Market to buy baby bok choy and grass carp. After returning home, she quickly trimmed the greens, sliced the fish, and called her husband Ma Zhiqiang to confirm that he had gone out with the truck and would be back early.
location: Tianjin Jinghai District, Golden Triangle Clothing Market (Dongfanghong Road), Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, and home at 156 Jingwen Road

name: Family lunch and sharing
description: Her husband Ma Zhiqiang arrived home before twelve. Ma Xiulan served stir-fried bok choy and braised grass carp pieces. The family of four (the eldest son Ma Mingxuan was also home from school, while the youngest daughter Ma Yuxin ate at kindergarten) sat around and ate lunch. At the table, Ma Xiulan excitedly talked about her experience learning acupressure massage from Aunt Zhao and demonstrated the technique of pressing the lower-back point on her husband and son right there. The atmosphere was warm.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Cleaning up after the meal and relaxing in the courtyard for a chat
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan cleaned up the dishes by herself, wiped the kitchen clean, and folded and put away the autumn long underwear she had bought for her parents. Then she went to the courtyard, where her husband Ma Zhiqiang was resting on a recliner and said that his right arm had fully recovered and had strength. Ma Xiulan made tea for him, and the two chatted casually under the shade, talking about the children's studies and her husband's route for the next trip.
location: Home courtyard at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Husband tills the soil while Ma Xiulan does handiwork
description: After resting, her husband Ma Zhiqiang picked up a shovel and turned over the soil in the corner of the yard, preparing to plant radishes in autumn. Ma Xiulan, on the other hand, moved a small stool to the shady part of the porch, took out the round lotus fan she had embroidered more than half of, and carefully embroidered the lotus leaves. One worked with the shovel, the other with needlework, chatting occasionally, and the yard was filled with a peaceful atmosphere.
location: Home courtyard at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Collect dried laundry and prepare to pick up the children
description: At 3:30 pm, Ma Xiulan put down her handwork, collected the clothes that had been drying in the morning, folded them, and put them into each person's wardrobe. Then she washed her face briefly, took the pick-up card, and got ready to go out to pick up the children from school.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the two children from school.
description: Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike first to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin. The teacher praised the child for being well-behaved during naptime. Then she hurried to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to wait for her second son Ma Mingzhe to finish school. After picking up both children in one trip, she rode home all the way, listening to the children share amusing stories from school.
location: Jinghai District, Tianjin: from Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street), then return home to No. 156 Jingwen Road.

name: Supervise the children's homework and prepare dinner.
description: After arriving home, Ma Xiulan had her second son, Ma Mingzhe, do homework in the living room, while she started preparing dinner in the kitchen. She prepared a cold dish of smashed cucumber and sliced ham sausage, and simmered the pork rib soup using ribs that had been soaked that morning. She periodically checked on Mingzhe's homework, while her youngest daughter, Ma Yuxin, doodled alongside.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Husband moves the pickling jar back
description: Her husband Ma Zhiqiang finished turning the soil and, seeing that Ma Xiulan was about to move the heavy pickling jars, immediately stepped forward to stop her. He said that his right arm had healed and that all such heavy work should be left to him. He swiftly moved the two pickling jars back to the kitchen storage room and checked the water seal around the jar rims. Ma Xiulan watched from the side with relief, feeling warm inside.
location: Courtyard and kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Family dinner
description: The eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, also came home. The family of five sat around the dining table, enjoying the pork rib soup, cucumber salad, garlic water spinach, and freshly pickled cucumbers. The meal was lively. Ma Xiulan again brought up the fun story of learning massage from Aunt Zhao, Ma Mingzhe shared his running results from PE class, and Ma Mingxuan told them about what he had seen at school.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tidying the kitchen, checking homework, and coaxing my daughter to wash up
description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan washed the dishes and chopsticks, checked her second son Ma Mingzhe's math work and signed it, then looked over her eldest son Ma Mingxuan's homework. Afterward, she bathed her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin, changed her into pajamas, leaned against the headboard, and read her two short stories to help her fall asleep.
location: Various rooms of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Spending time alone with her husband watching TV and contacting Aunt Zhao.
description: After settling the children, Ma Xiulan and her husband Ma Zhiqiang sat on the living room sofa watching TV and chatting about everyday things. She picked up her phone and sent a WeChat message to her new acquaintance Aunt Zhao Sufen, thanking her for teaching her a massage method that worked well, and arranged to meet again for morning exercise the next day. She soon received a reply from Aunt Zhao.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Video call with mother.
description: Ma Xiulan made a video call to her mother Li Xiuying, excitedly showing the autumn clothes she had bought for her parents. She said they were bought with the 600-yuan red envelope her mother had given her, and that the pure cotton material was very soft. Her mother beamed on the other side of the screen and told her not to spend money carelessly.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Washed up and went to bed
description: After the call ended, Ma Xiulan went to the bathroom to wash up and apply face cream. As she did, she recalled the fulfilling day: making new friends, buying satisfactory gifts for her parents, and her husband recovering and helping with housework. She felt grounded and content. Then she lay down in the bedroom, exchanged a few words with her husband Ma Zhiqiang, and fell into a deep sleep with a smile.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Morning stretching and exercise
description: Woke up at 5:20 in the morning. First, I moved my ankles and wrists in bed, then did shoulder, neck, and lower back stretches on the yoga mat in the living room. Then I went out and walked briskly along Jingwen Road for 15 minutes. Around 6:00, I returned to the courtyard and practiced Baduanjin to the music, focusing on the movement "Shake the Head and Wag the Tail to Remove Heart Fire." It was a bit hard on my knees, so I slowed down. After the practice, I recorded a video of "Hold Both Hands High to Regulate the Triple Burner" and sent it to Aunt Zhao for advice.
location: Private residence at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and Jingwen Road.

name: Prepare breakfast and urge the children to eat
description: After morning exercise, she went into the kitchen to prepare breakfast: she cooked millet porridge, heated up fresh pork buns and steamed buns, and washed and cut apples and pears for the children to take to school. At 6:50 she woke up her son Ma Mingzhe and her daughter Ma Yuxin, and the family sat around the dining room to eat breakfast. During the meal, she reminded Mingzhe to come home earlier after school and told Xinxin that she would pick her up in the afternoon.
location: Kitchen and dining room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Riding an electric bicycle to take the child to school
description: Putting safety helmets on the two children, she rode the electric bike, first taking Ma Mingzhe to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School. After watching him enter the school gate, she took Ma Yuxin to Huakang First Kindergarten, and left after seeing the teacher lead her into the classroom.
location: From 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street), then to Huakang First Kindergarten.

name: Tidying up the house and cleaning the pickle tools.
description: After returning home, first gather and wash the dishes and utensils, then sweep and mop every room. Next, go to the yard and shake out the towels and clothes drying there. At 8:30, change into old clothes, move the large vat, the pickling stone, and the wooden stick over to the faucet, carefully scrub off the residual dirt from last year, scald and disinfect them with boiling water, and set them out in the sun to dry. At 9:30, check the quantity of vegetables ordered the day before with neighbor Zhou Xiuqin, and contact her via WeChat voice message to let her know the pickling tools are ready, and agree to start early in the morning on the 14th.
location: Home and courtyard at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning market shopping and having brunch alone
description: She rode her electric bike with a cloth bag to Wutong Community Vegetable Market, bought tomatoes, water spinach, cucumbers, and pork belly to prepare for dinner. At the market entrance, she met neighbor Wang Guilan and had a brief chat. She returned home at 10:45, sorted the ingredients into the refrigerator, then reheated last night's leftovers and homemade pickled radish for a brunch, and ate it slowly by herself in the dining room.
location: Wutong Commune Food Market in Jinghai District, Tianjin, and home at 156 Jingwen Road

name: Noon break
description: Feeling drowsy after the meal, she lay down in the bedroom and set the alarm for 1 o'clock, but her mind was occupied with embroidery work, and she tossed and turned for a while before falling asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Taking an order to embroider tiger-head shoe uppers
description: She got up right after the alarm rang. In the living room, she took out the newborn tiger-head shoe upper order that her neighbor Zheng Xiuying had passed on to her (payment 50 yuan). Referring to the pattern on her phone, she selected bright red, bright yellow, and black silk threads and prepared her sewing kit. At 13:00 she sat on the rattan chair on the porch, making use of the afternoon sunlight. She put on her thimble, fixed the embroidery hoop, traced the tiger's outline with a pencil, and then carefully embroidered the tiger's nose and mouth with red silk thread, while also referring to the enlarged cartoon pattern on her phone to make sure it was vivid.
location: Living room and front porch of home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Took in the clothes and rested for a while.
description: She set aside the embroidery work, went to the courtyard, gathered the dried towels and clothes, folded them neatly, and brought them back inside. Then she washed her face, drank some water, and prepared to pick up the children.
location: The courtyard of her home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Rode her electric bike to pick up the two children from school.
description: Set off on the e-bike at 15:40, first went to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up Ma Yuxin, then waited at the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School for Ma Mingzhe to finish school. After picking up the two children, she listened to them share fun stories from school: Mingzhe did well on his math quiz, and Xinxin got a little red flower. She rode them home.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street), and back home.

name: Supervised the children's homework and cooked dinner, with her husband helping to move the jars
description: After arriving home, she urged Ma Mingzhe to do his homework in the living room and set a 40-minute timer. She put on an apron and started preparing dinner: rinsed the rice, steamed it, and prepared vegetables. At 17:30 her husband Ma Zhiqiang came home from work and helped move the two large vats that had been drying in the morning sun into the kitchen storage room, then helped wipe the jar mouths. She continued cooking: blanched pork belly, caramelized sugar for color, and simmered it slowly; stir-fried garlic water spinach; and made smashed cucumber salad. She was busy in the kitchen until 18:30, and the aroma of braised pork filled the air.
location: Living room, kitchen, and courtyard of the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner
description: She placed the cooked dishes on the dining table and called Mingzhe, who was doing homework, and Xinxin, who was watching TV, to come over. The family of four sat around the table. Mingzhe reported scoring 95 on his math test, Xinxin showed off her little red flower, and Ma Zhiqiang kept putting food on everyone's plates. The atmosphere was warm and content.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: After the meal, tidy up and check the son's homework.
description: She let her husband rest and quickly washed the dishes and scrubbed the stove. Then she went to the living room to check Mingzhe's homework. Finding that one math word problem had an erroneous approach, she patiently guided him to re-read the question and correct it, and finally signed the exercise book.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Help the child take a bath and lull the daughter to sleep
description: Urged the two children to take baths. First helped her 6-year-old daughter Ma Yuxin wash and change into pajamas, let her go back to the bedroom to wait, and urged her son Ma Mingzhe to bathe himself. At 20:00, her daughter became sleepy; she lay beside her younger daughter and told the story of the little rabbit looking for the sun until she fell asleep.
location: Bathroom and bedroom in the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Nighttime embroidery and WeChat communication
description: After the children fell asleep, she made tea, sat back on the living room sofa, and continued embroidering the tiger ears and eye sockets of the tiger-head shoe upper. Near 10 p.m., she checked WeChat, replied to Zhou Xiuqin to confirm making pickled vegetables on the 14th, received encouragement from Aunt Zhao about the morning exercise video, and made an appointment to practice Baduanjin together at the usual place tomorrow morning.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Stretching and Washing Up Before Bed
description: Stand up and do a few minutes of pre-sleep stretching in the living room to relieve soreness in the waist and legs. Then go to the bathroom to wash up and change into pajamas. When returning to the bedroom, her husband is already asleep; she quietly turns off the light and gradually falls asleep with a sense of fulfillment.
location: Living room and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Get up in the morning, observe the children, and do stretching
description: Woke up naturally before the alarm went off. First went to her son Mingzhe's room to check the sore at the corner of his mouth; finding it red, swollen, and peeling, she felt worried. Then she did shoulder, neck, and lower back stretches in the living room to loosen up her muscles and started the new day.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Brisk walk in the early morning and a chance chat with a neighbor.
description: Put on sports shoes and went out, walking briskly east along Jingwen Road to get some fresh air. At the intersection of Jingwen Road and Wutong North Street, she met her neighbor Wang Guilan, and the two exchanged experience on managing children's internal heat and shared the dietary remedy of tomato salad.
location: Near the intersection of Jingwen Road and Wutong North Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Prepare breakfast and discuss the fruit order with my husband
description: After returning home, she washed the apples and cut them into pieces, cooked millet porridge, and reheated vegetable buns. While the porridge was simmering, she cleaned the living room and put away the children's things. After her husband got up, she specifically reminded him to watch the children eat apples at noon, and announced the rule that everyone in the family should eat at least one fruit a day.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family breakfast, and remind the children to eat fruit
description: After the children got up, she handed out apple pieces to each of them, encouraged Mingzhe, whose mouth corner was chapped, to eat more, and announced that tomato salad would be added to lunch and dinner. After the family finished breakfast together, Mom again emphasized the importance of the fruit rule.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Husband helped move the large vat and clean the courtyard
description: After breakfast, her husband moved the two pickle jars in the yard to the shady spot by the north wall at his wife's request. Ma Xiulan then swept up the footprints and loose dust in the yard, keeping the home clean and tidy.
location: Home courtyard at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Changing clothes and getting ready to go out for exercise.
description: I worry that the flavor won't suit the tourists, packaging costs are high, and also, do I need to get a food license?
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Practiced Baduanjin with Zhao Sufen.
description: When she arrived at the fitness square in Yaozhuangzi Village, Zhao Sufen had already finished her tai chi practice. The two practiced Baduanjin together three times. Aunt Zhao guided Ma Xiulan to adjust the 'shake the head and sway the tail to dispel heart fire' posture and relax her knees; her body was slightly sweaty and her joints felt loose and comfortable.
location: Fitness Square, Yaozhuangzi Village, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Went to the vegetable market to confirm the order for pickled vegetable ingredients.
date: At 21:10, it finally quieted down. Leaning on the living room sofa, I made a video call to my mother. She had not gone to bed yet and was watching TV. I told her about the social security allowance, then showed her the T-shirt my eldest sister had sent, and told her the clothes fit well and not to worry. Hearing this, my mother was happy for us and said life would get better and better. After hanging up, I sent my eldest sister a WeChat voice message telling her that the package had arrived and the food tasted very good. At 22:00, I went to wash up and then returned to the bedroom.
description: After working out, she stopped by the Wutong Commune vegetable market on the way, found the stall owner Sun Guifang, and confirmed again the 20 jin of cucumbers and 15 jin of white radishes to be picked up on the 14th. The other party assured her that the freshest produce had already been reserved, so she felt relieved.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin, at the southwest corner of the intersection of Jingwen Road and Wutong North Street.

name: Going home to do housework and embroider tiger-head shoe uppers
description: After getting home at half past ten, she first collected and folded the dried clothes and mopped the living room floor. Then she sat under the porch and continued embroidering the tiger-head shoe uppers. Today she needed to use black thread to embroider the tiger's whiskers and sharp teeth. Stitch by stitch, fully absorbed, the little tiger gradually began to look mighty.
location: Home porch, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing lunch and having a family meal together, sticking to the fruit rule.
description: Put down the needlework and made lunch, specially cooking scrambled eggs with tomatoes and cold tomato salad, drawing simple patterns with sugar on the edge of the plate to please the children. When the meal started, she first served tomatoes to everyone, reiterating the importance of fruit. After the meal, she watched Mingzhe and Yuxin share an apple, completing the daily fruit quota.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Lunch break and picking out evening party clothes in advance
description: After a half-hour afternoon nap, she did not get up right away. She opened the wardrobe, took out a newly made light-blue short-sleeved shirt, and paired it with dark straight-leg pants. Holding them up in front of the mirror, she confirmed the outfit was neat and understated for the gathering and felt satisfied.
location: Master bedroom of the home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Continuing and completing the embroidery on the tiger-head shoe uppers
description: After the midday rest, she sat under the porch again and continued embroidering the tiger-head shoe upper. After a fine afternoon of embroidery, the tiger's whiskers and sharp teeth appeared clearly, and the whole tiger head looked spirited. She looked at her work with satisfaction and planned to finish it tomorrow.
location: Home porch, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing for the class reunion and giving the family instructions.
description: She began to tidy herself up, washed her face, changed into a light blue outfit, and combed her hair. She prepared a 200 yuan red envelope and wrote birthday wishes on it. Before going out, she told her husband to take care of the children's dinner and asked her eldest son to supervise his younger siblings' homework.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Riding an electric bike to the KTV to meet up with classmates
description: She got on her electric bike and rode along Jingwen Road toward Tuanbo West Area. About 15 minutes later, she arrived at the agreed KTV entrance. Liu Chunmei and other classmates were already waiting, and everyone went in chatting and laughing.
location: From Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to near the intersection of Hongzehu Road and Poyanghu Road in Tuanbo West Area

name: Attending Zhao Xiaohong's birthday KTV gathering
description: In the private room, surrounded by lights and music, she initially felt shy and shrank into a corner. The birthday girl, Zhao Xiaohong, pulled her up to sing "Sweet Honey," and later, encouraged by everyone, she sang "Friends" in a duet with Liu Chunmei. A classmate recorded the video and posted it to the group. Though she made a show of declining, she was delighted inside and experienced a lively, joyful gathering.

participant.name: Zhao Xiaohong
participant.relation: High school classmate, the birthday celebrant.

location: JUZC Juzhen Pure KTV, near the intersection of Hongzehu Road and Poyanghu Road, Tuanbo West Area, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: After the gathering ended, rode the electric bike home
description: She politely declined a classmate’s invitation to have a late-night snack, saying goodbye on the excuse that her children were young, then rode her electric bike home. The cool night breeze brushed her face, and she felt relaxed, unconsciously humming “Sweet Sweet”.
location: Tuanbo West Area, Jinghai District, Tianjin to No. 156 Jingwen Road

name: Quietly went to bed and briefly talked with her husband.
description: She slipped in quietly, washed up, and tried not to disturb the family. After she got into bed, her husband drowsily asked why she was home so late. Ma Xiulan simply said they had been having a good time and lost track of time. Then she closed her eyes, reviewed the day, and fell asleep with a satisfied smile.
location: Master bedroom of the home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning wake-up and brisk-walking exercise
description: The phone alarm went off at 5:25 in the morning. Ma Xiulan woke up and did shoulder and neck stretches in bed. Remembering that the weather forecast had mentioned possible showers, she got out of bed and went to the window to check the sky; it was overcast. She changed into light sportswear and running shoes, loosened up in the courtyard, then pushed open the courtyard gate and walked briskly along the community paths for about 15 minutes, breathing in the cool morning air and completing her morning exercise.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, at home and on community roads

name: Getting her husband's car ready for departure
description: Returning from her morning exercise, Ma Xiulan heard her husband Ma Zhiqiang getting up. She went into the kitchen and poured him a glass of warm water. Zhiqiang had to move the pickle jars early today, so Ma Xiulan quietly reminded him that everything for tomorrow's truck annual inspection had been prepared, and told him to focus on the moving. She handed him his jacket and watched him push the tricycle out of the courtyard gate.
location: Home kitchen and courtyard at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing the family breakfast
description: After seeing her husband off, Ma Xiulan started to prepare breakfast. She rinsed the millet and cooked a pot of millet porridge, then took last night's buns and boiled eggs out of the refrigerator and heated them in the steamer. While waiting, she quickly tidied the living room and courtyard, put away the children's scattered toys, swept the yard, and also checked the vegetable plot, noticing that the leaves were a bit wilted.
location: Home kitchen and courtyard at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Having breakfast with the children
description: After breakfast was ready, Ma Xiulan went upstairs and gently woke Mingzhe, Yuxin, and Xuanxuan. The family sat around the dining table, drinking warm millet porridge and eating steaming hot buns. Ma Xiulan especially picked up a bite of tomato salad for Mingzhe, who had sores at the corners of his mouth, and told him to eat more so he would get better soon. After the meal, she told the children not to run around at home during the weekend, and she prepared to go out.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Go to the community fitness square
description: Ma Xiulan changed into comfortable cotton-linen sportswear, grabbed her water bottle and umbrella, and locked the courtyard gate. She quickened her pace and caught up with Auntie Zhao Sufen, who was coming out of the opposite building. The two chatted as they walked together to the Chaoyang Street Community Fitness Plaza for a Baduanjin class.
location: Along the route from No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin to the Chaoyang Street community fitness square

name: Baduanjin Course and Completion Ceremony
description: Today was the last class of the community Baduanjin class, and the square was bustling. The instructor led everyone through a warm-up and a full review of the movements. Ma Xiulan was full of energy, with smooth and flowing movements. During the 'Two Hands Hold the Feet to Strengthen the Kidneys and Waist' move, she could easily touch her toes, and the instructor asked her to stand in the front row and lead. During the break, she enthusiastically guided new students in adjusting their ball-holding posture, and Liu Chunmei teased her for being like a coach. At the end of the class, community staff awarded each student a fitness bag printed with 'Tai Chi Baduanjin' as a completion souvenir, and the three of them happily took a group photo on the square.
location: Chaoyang Street Community Fitness Plaza, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Dropped by neighbor Wang Guilan's place on the way.
description: After the class ended, Ma Xiulan parted with Aunt Zhao and Liu Chunmei. Since she planned to meet Zhou Xiuqin the next day at the vegetable market to pick up the pre-ordered cucumbers and white radishes, she stopped by the building where her neighbor, Sister Wang Guilan, lived, and sent a voice message asking her to come downstairs for a brief meeting. The two agreed at the building entrance to meet at 7:30 tomorrow morning at the east gate of the vegetable market.
location: Downstairs in the residential community at No. 12 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Return home to rest and freshen up.
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan washed her face, changed into loungewear, and put away the gym bag given as a memento of completing the course, feeling filled with fulfillment. Outside the window, a light drizzle began to fall; the shower arrived on schedule.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Housework tidying and lunch preparation
description: Since it was raining and she could not go out, Ma Xiulan began doing housework. She sorted the dirty clothes she had changed out of yesterday and put them into the washing machine. Then she took out the water spinach and pork belly she had bought yesterday from the refrigerator, and also cut up a tomato and mixed it with sugar. This tomato salad was specially prepared for Mingzhe. She also moved a box of pork ribs from the freezer to the refrigerator to thaw, planning to make a rib soup for dinner.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Lunch and lunch break.
description: Ma Xiulan stir-fried a plate of garlicky water spinach and pork belly, served with rice and cold tomato salad. The family's lunch was simple and to everyone's taste. After the meal, she urged the children to clear the dishes. Feeling tired, she leaned back on the sofa and dozed off once the children quieted down.
location: Dining room and living room of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Organize truck annual inspection documents and backups
description: After waking from her lunch break, Ma Xiulan took out the drawer from her husband's old iron file cabinet where he kept his documents, found the truck's compulsory traffic accident insurance policy, vehicle license, and vehicle registration certificate, carefully checked the expiration dates, and photocopied the key pages one by one on the printer in the living room. She then put away the originals, clipped the copies together with paper clips, and placed them in a transparent document folder. She also opened the memo on her phone and recorded the inspection details in detail: the inspection station is the Vehicle Inspection Center on Jinwen Road, Jinghai District; the fee is about 300 yuan; and the process is first queue for vehicle inspection, then check the lights, and finally pay and receive the sticker. She decided to handle it herself and save the 100 yuan for a broker.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Embroidered tiger-head shoe upper
description: After the rain stopped, the sky remained overcast. Ma Xiulan took out the tiger-head shoe upper order that Zheng Xiuying had recommended a few days earlier, sat by the living room windowsill, and threaded her needle. She began sewing the ears and eyes onto the shoe upper, which already had the nose embroidered. As she sewed quickly, she calculated that the shoe uppers could earn 50 yuan. If she managed to get the annual inspection done herself tomorrow, the money she saved would let her buy Mingzhe a few more exercise books.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing dinner ingredients
description: Hearing the washing machine's completion chime, Ma Xiulan got up to hang the laundry. Then she went into the kitchen, blanched the thawed pork ribs to prepare soup, and started peeling cucumbers, planning to make a smashed cucumber salad for the evening. Raindrops began to fall outside the window, so she took the opportunity to close the kitchen window.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Short break and checking messages
description: With dinner prep done for the moment and her husband not due back for a while, Ma Xiulan sat in the living room and picked up her phone. She saw that Aunt Zhao Sufen had posted group photos from that morning's final class in the community group, and she saved a few. Then she noticed that her daughter Yuxin's painting had been praised by the teacher in the class group, and she felt very pleased.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Cooking dinner
description: The pork rib soup simmered over low heat, its aroma filling the room. Ma Xiulan began stir-frying: she heated oil and bloomed the aromatics, first making sauce-fried diced pork with a rich, savory aroma; then she swiftly smashed cucumbers and mixed a garlic-vinegar dressing, her movements fluid and effortless.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Husband returned carrying the jar
description: As dusk fell, Ma Zhiqiang came back pushing a tricycle loaded with several large jars. Ma Xiulan heard him and went out to greet him, and together they moved the jars to the foot of the north wall. Zhiqiang opened one of the jar lids, smelled it with satisfaction, and praised the pickled cucumbers this time for having a bright, clear flavor. Ma Xiulan smiled and replied, revealing that she had added an extra spoonful of sugar to enhance the umami. They smiled at each other, and the day's fatigue melted away.
location: Courtyard and kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Family dinner
description: Steaming hot sauce-fried diced pork with bean paste, sweet spare rib soup, and crisp smashed cucumbers were brought to the table, and the family sat together for dinner. Ma Zhiqiang repeatedly praised the dishes for being to his taste, and the children ate happily too. Mingzhe in particular took the initiative to eat several pieces of tomato. The dinner table was full of warmth and harmony.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Clearing the dining table and helping with homework.
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan cleared the dishes into the kitchen while her husband helped wipe the table. She settled little Yuxin down to watch cartoons, then sat beside Mingzhe to check his weekend homework. She focused on the math test paper and found that he was stuck on a word problem, so she patiently guided him through reading and analyzing the problem step by step until Mingzhe fully understood.
location: Dining room and study at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Continue embroidery and rehearse the annual inspection.
description: After the children had all calmed down, Ma Xiulan took out the tiger-head shoe upper under the desk lamp and focused on embroidering the ears and eyes stitch by stitch, with fine and even stitches. While embroidering, she kept mentally rehearsing the next day's annual inspection procedure, hoping to pass it in one go and save money to buy a good dictionary for Mingzhe.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: Ma Xiulan rubbed her tired, swollen eyes, put away the half-embroidered shoe upper, and stood up to stretch her stiff shoulders. Then she went to the bathroom to wash up and soaked her feet in warm water to relieve fatigue. After lying in bed, she chatted with her husband Ma Zhiqiang, who was looking at his phone, about the annual inspection the next day. His words "I'm at ease when you handle things" made her feel secure. Outside the window, thunder rumbled in the distance and rain began to fall again. Listening to the patter of rain, she pictured herself leading everyone in Baduanjin in the square that morning. Filled with a sense of fulfillment, she soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Early morning wake-up and solo morning exercise.
description: Ma Xiulan woke up naturally before the alarm went off and got up at 5:20. She stretched in bed, moving her shoulders and waist, and felt full of energy. After a quick wash, she put on loose sportswear and went to the courtyard. She first briskly walked for 15 minutes to loosen up, then stood still, took a deep breath, and performed a complete set of Baduanjin on her own. Without music, she silently counted the rhythm. Her movements were smoother than when she first learned them, especially the move 'Two Hands Holding the Feet to Strengthen the Kidneys and Waist,' which she did exceptionally well, and her lower back felt comfortable and relaxed. After finishing, she stood in the courtyard for a moment and recorded her morning exercise experience in her phone's memo.
location: Home courtyard, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Helped her husband carry the pickling jars
description: After morning exercise, Ma Xiulan was about to go inside to cook when she saw her husband Ma Zhiqiang had already lifted up the large pickle jar in the corner of the yard. This jar was newly bought this year and was quite large. Ma Xiulan quickly went over to lend a hand, holding the door frame while her husband steadily moved the jar into the kitchen and put it on the workbench that had been cleared in advance. Looking at the jar, Ma Xiulan felt reassured and said to her husband, "Today's annual inspection, thanks for your hard work." Ma Zhiqiang wiped his sweat and replied, "No problem, I'll move another one when I get back tonight."
location: Home courtyard and kitchen, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare breakfast for the whole family.
description: After moving the jars into place, Ma Zhiqiang went to wash up, while Ma Xiulan hurried to prepare breakfast. She thought that her husband would be doing physical work today and the children were growing, so breakfast had to be hearty. She took out the pork buns she had steamed yesterday, heated them up, cooked a pot of millet porridge, and sliced a plate of homemade pickled cucumbers, which the children all loved. She also cut fresh fruit, one portion per person, to ensure the whole family's vitamin intake.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Family breakfast and preparations before setting out for the annual inspection
description: Ma Xiulan woke the children, and the family of five sat around the living room eating breakfast. During the meal, she confirmed again with her husband the procedure for today's truck annual inspection and the documents to bring, ensuring that the document folder packed yesterday (containing the compulsory traffic accident liability insurance policy, vehicle license, and registration certificate) was complete. She instructed her eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, to keep his younger brother and sister at home doing their summer homework and not to watch TV too much. She also checked her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin's little backpack to make sure she had put in her drawing notebook and colored pens.
location: Home living room and courtyard, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Set off for the testing station.
description: After breakfast, Ma Xiulan put the dishes and chopsticks into the kitchen, changed into a long-sleeved shirt and pants that were convenient for work, and put on a sun hat. She followed her husband to the truck in the yard and watched him check the tires and engine oil. Then she sat in the passenger seat. Ma Zhiqiang started the car, and they left home at about 7:45, driving north along Jingwen Road toward the Jinghai District Motor Vehicle Inspection Station. The trip took about 15 minutes, and they arrived exactly at 8:00.
location: Direction from Jingwen Road to Beihua Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Handle the truck's annual inspection.
description: They arrived at the inspection station at 8 o'clock, and there were already five or six cars in front. Ma Zhiqiang parked the car in the waiting area to queue up, and the two of them first went to the hall to take a queue number. While waiting, Ma Xiulan kept herself busy. She took a screwdriver out of her carry-all tool bag and, following her husband's usual instructions, checked the car's headlights, turn signals, brake lights, and horn, confirming they were all normal. Around 9:30 it was their turn, and Ma Zhiqiang drove the car onto the inspection line. Ma Xiulan waited nervously at the exit. At around 10 o'clock, the car passed the inspection smoothly, and she breathed a sigh of relief. The two went to the window together, paid 350 yuan, and received the annual inspection qualification sticker and the updated vehicle license endorsement page.
location: Motor vehicle inspection station at the intersection of Beihua Road and Dongxing Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up reserved vegetables on the way
description: After completing the annual vehicle inspection, Ma Xiulan looked at her phone; it was just past 10 o'clock. She discussed with her husband that the inspection station was not far from the Wutong Commune vegetable market, so it would be convenient to stop by on the way and pick up the cucumbers and white radishes that she had already ordered from Sister Wang Guilan, saving another trip in the afternoon. Ma Zhiqiang agreed, and the two drove for 5 minutes to the east gate of the vegetable market. Ma Xiulan asked her husband to wait in the car, walked quickly to the agreed spot, and saw Wang Guilan in the distance waiting with two large woven bags. When they met, Wang Guilan helped load the 50 jin of cucumbers and 30 jin of radishes into the car. Ma Xiulan thanked her and said she would see her again in the afternoon.
location: Wutong Commune Food Market at the intersection of Dongfanghong Road and Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Went home to tidy up and put things away.
description: Before 11 o'clock, Ma Xiulan got home. Together with her husband, she carefully stuck the annual inspection sticker on the upper right corner of the truck's front windshield, then put the document folder back into the bedroom cabinet. After that, the two carried the vegetables from the truck to a shady corner of the yard and covered them with a sunshade cloth to keep them from wilting in the sun.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Counting the pickled vegetable tools and confirming the division of labor
description: After finishing all this, Ma Xiulan washed her hands, went into the kitchen, and carefully checked the large vat, the pickling stone, and the tools that her husband had brought in that morning, confirming that they were clean, oil-free, and neatly arranged. She took out her phone and called Zhou Xiuqin to tell her that the ingredients had been picked up and the tools were ready. The two went over the next day's division of labor on the phone: at 7 the next morning, Zhou Xiuqin would come to her home to help wash and cut the ingredients, and at 8 Wang Guilan would come to simmer the seasoning liquid.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Lunch and lunch break.
description: Ma Zhiqiang went to call the children, and Ma Xiulan quickly made lunch: tomato and egg noodles, smashed cucumber salad, and reheated the morning porridge. The family had a simple lunch. After the meal, Ma Xiulan urged her eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, to take his younger brother and sister to their rooms for an afternoon nap. She herself went back to the bedroom and lay down for half an hour to rest and conserve energy for the afternoon shopping.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Afternoon shopping preparations and departure.
description: At 1:30 p.m., Ma Xiulan woke up and washed her face. She called Zhou Xiuqin and Wang Guilan and arranged to meet at Sun Guifang's stall at 2 p.m. At 1:50, she changed her shoes, picked up her phone and some change, and rode her electric bike to the Wutong Commune food market, taking about 15 minutes on the way.
location: On the way from Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market

name: Purchasing seasonings and finalizing the production process
description: At 2:00 p.m., Ma Xiulan, Zhou Xiuqin, and Wang Guilan met in front of Sun Guifang's stall at Wutong Commune Vegetable Market. Sun Guifang had already prepared the goods as ordered. Ma Xiulan checked the weight and quality of the cucumbers and radishes and paid the balance with confidence. Then the three split up to buy seasonings: Zhou Xiuqin went to buy salt and Sichuan peppercorns, Wang Guilan went to buy large rock sugar lumps, and Ma Xiulan went to buy cumin, cinnamon, star anise, and other spices. After everything was bought, the three returned together to the entrance of Ma Xiulan's home and carried the ingredients and seasonings into the courtyard. Then they moved a few small stools to sit in the shade and finalized tomorrow's procedure once again: Zhou Xiuqin would arrive before 7:00 a.m. tomorrow to be in charge of washing and cutting; Wang Guilan would arrive at 8:00 to be in charge of making the sauce marinade with the seasonings bought today; Ma Xiulan would be in charge of the final jar filling and sealing.
location: At the intersection of Dongfanghong Road and Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market; and home at 156 Jingwen Road.

name: Pre-soaking and initial preparation of the ingredients.
description: After seeing off Zhou Xiuqin and Wang Guilan, Ma Xiulan did not rest. She filled a large basin with clean water, poured the cucumbers and radishes needed for tomorrow into it separately, gently scrubbed the mud off their surfaces with a brush, and then soaked them in clean water, making them easier to wash tomorrow morning and the vegetables crisper. She also checked the tools she would need tomorrow once more.
location: Home courtyard, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepared dinner for the whole family
description: After finishing the yard work, Ma Xiulan returned to the kitchen and began preparing dinner. Her husband was home today and the annual inspection had gone smoothly, so she was happy and decided to make some of her specialty dishes. She steamed a large pot of rice, made clear simmered pork rib soup, stir-fried water spinach with garlic, tossed a tomato salad, and stir-fried shredded pork with green peppers to ensure balanced nutrition.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Family dinner and family interaction
description: The family of five sat around the dinner table. The atmosphere was relaxed. Ma Xiulan told her husband that today's annual vehicle inspection had gone smoothly and saved 100 yuan. Ma Zhiqiang, who rarely smiled, praised her, saying she really looked the part when checking the headlights. The children also chattered about what they had done at home during the day: Ma Mingxuan read a book with his younger brother Ma Mingzhe for a while, and Ma Yuxin drew a picture of the big cucumber she saw in the yard today.
location: Home living room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tidying the kitchen and supervising the children's homework
description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan briskly cleared the table and wiped the kitchen clean. Then she sat down in the living room and supervised the three children doing their homework. She watched Ma Mingzhe work on math problems. After checking, she found one wrong answer and patiently guided him to correct it. She also looked at Ma Yuxin's calligraphy practice and praised her for the progress she had made in writing the character for "person."
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening leisure and embroidery
description: After all the children were settled, Ma Xiulan finally had time to herself. She made a cup of tea, took out the unfinished tiger-head shoe upper, sat under the living room light, and began embroidering stitch by stitch. She was in good form today; after a short while, she had almost finished the Wang character pattern and a few tiger whiskers on the shoe upper. It looked lively and lifelike, and she felt very content. Midway, she stood up and stretched her neck and back.
location: Home living room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: Ma Xiulan put down her needlework and went to the bathroom to wash up. She washed her face with warm water and simply applied moisturizer. When she returned to the bedroom, her husband Ma Zhiqiang was already lying down. The two chatted briefly about the next day's arrangements, and she reminded him that they still needed to get up early tomorrow morning to move the jar. Then she set the alarm on her phone, turned off the light, and lay down.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin: home bedroom and bathroom

name: Going to bed
description: Although a little tired, Ma Xiulan felt at ease. Looking back on the day, the annual inspection had gone smoothly, and the ingredients and tools for the pickled vegetables were all ready. Tomorrow she could get down to work. She soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning Stretching and Simplified Baduanjin
description: The alarm went off, feeling sore in the lower back. First laid out a yoga mat in the courtyard and did a gentle shoulder and neck stretch and a simplified version of Baduanjin, focusing on moving the waist, and did a few gentle cat-cow stretches. Felt the muscles and joints loosen up a bit, and the lower back soreness eased considerably.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, home courtyard

name: Moving the jar together and family breakfast
description: Together with her husband Ma Zhiqiang, she moved the three jars of pickled vegetables filled yesterday to the cool, ventilated spot under the west wall of the courtyard and checked that the clay seals were intact. Then Ma Xiulan deftly made millet porridge, fried egg pancakes, and cut pickled cucumber strips for breakfast. She woke the three children, Xuanxuan, Zhezhe, and Xinxin, helped Xinxin braid her hair, and urged the boys to wash up. The family sat together and ate breakfast. Ma Xiulan put two washed pears into Zhezhe's schoolbag.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, home courtyard, kitchen, and bedroom

name: Take Zhezhe and Xinxin to school and buy groceries
description: She rode the electric bike, first taking Zhezhe to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School and watching him enter the school gate. Then she took Xinxin to Huakang First Kindergarten and handed her over to Principal Teacher Zhang. After that, on the way, she went to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, bought baby bok choy and tomatoes at Aunt Sun's stall, then picked out a few Ya pears at the fruit stand, buying a few extra for the children to have as snacks.
location: Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, and Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pickled vegetable assembly-line work and bookkeeping break
description: At a little after 8 a.m., neighbors Zhou Xiuqin and Wang Guilan arrived at the home and began making pickled vegetables. Zhou Xiuqin was in charge of washing the radishes, Wang Guilan simmered the sauce, and Ma Xiulan cut the radishes into strips in the courtyard. Around 9 a.m., Zhou Xiuqin temporarily left because of a leaking water pipe at her home, and Ma Xiulan and Wang Guilan continued. At noon the two stopped to check the saltiness of the sauce. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang came home at noon, moved the pickled vegetable jars in the courtyard to a spot with even sunlight, and cooked egg and hot noodle soup. The three ate quickly, and Wang Guilan went home first. Around 1 p.m., Zhou Xiuqin returned. The two worked together to layer the radish strips and sauce, filling two small jars and completing all the jarring tasks. Finally, they lined up the five jars of pickled vegetables side by side and took a photo. After seeing Zhou Xiuqin off, Ma Xiulan returned to the living room, carefully recorded the ingredient weights and labor costs in her notebook, and affixed labels with the date and type to the jars. Because she was tired and her lower back was sore and swollen, she poured some warm water, lay on the sofa with a cushion under her waist to rest, and then rubbed her waist with medicated oil to relieve the discomfort.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; kitchen, courtyard, and living room at home

name: Watering the leafy greens in the courtyard
description: Taking advantage of the break, Ma Xiulan carried a small bucket to water the baby bok choy and scallions in the courtyard, feeling cheerful at the sight of the lush green seedlings.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, home courtyard

name: Picking up Xinxin and Zhezhe from school and shopping on the way
description: She set out early to pick up Xinxin at Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten. When Xinxin saw her mother, she ran over and excitedly handed her a drawing of the family. Then she took Xinxin to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to wait for Zhezhe to get out of school. When Zhezhe came out and saw the pear in his little sister's hand, he happily bit into it. On the way home, they stopped by the Jingbai Supermarket in Yuzhou Zunfu, where she bought ground pork, tofu, and a pack of wafer cookies to reward the children.
location: Tianjin Jinghai District Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu, Jingbai Supermarket

name: Supervise the kids' homework and prepare dinner.
description: After returning home, Xuanxuan was already doing homework in the living room. Ma Xiulan had Zhezhe and Xinxin wash their hands, then asked Xuanxuan to do homework with his younger siblings. She tied on an apron and went into the kitchen to prepare dinner: braised tofu with minced pork, stir-fried baby bok choy, and tomato and egg drop soup.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; living room and kitchen at home

name: Family dinner, cleaning up, and cutting fruit
description: Her husband Ma Zhiqiang came home, and the whole family sat around the dinner table. During dinner, Ma Xiulan asked the children about school. Xuanxuan said he scored 95 on the math test, Zhezhe said his composition was praised, and Xinxin told about her painting again. After dinner, Ma Xiulan cleared the table, washed two pears, and cut them into pieces as dessert for the children.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, home dining room and kitchen.

name: Checking family accounts and depositing into the travel fund
description: While the children watched cartoons, Ma Xiulan and her husband Ma Zhiqiang checked the expense ledger for the first half of the month in the living room. After confirming it was correct, they took today's 180 yuan surplus from the pickled vegetables, added previous spare change to make up 300 yuan, and put it into the “Beijing Trip” envelope. Then they stuck the account record on the refrigerator door and were especially happy to see the growing figure.
location: Living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Organize the reading corner, do parent-child reading, and tell Xinxin a bedtime story
description: Ma Xiulan took out a tape measure and measured the open space by the window in the living room, used her phone to look up layout ideas for a small-apartment reading corner, then called the three children over to clear out the old books and clutter in the corner. With a small bookshelf and cushions, she set up a simple reading corner. Xuanxuan and Zhezhe immediately picked out books and sat close together to read, while Xinxin also lay beside them looking at picture books. When it got late, Ma Xiulan took Xinxin to bathe and change into pajamas, told her two little princess stories, and watched her slowly fall asleep.
location: At home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin: living room, Xinxin's bedroom, bathroom.

name: Check doors and windows, stretch, and write bedtime notes.
description: After the children were all asleep, Ma Xiulan checked that the front door and the windows of every room were locked and that the gas valve was turned off. Back in the bedroom, she did five minutes of deep breathing and lower-back stretches before bed, and her fatigue melted away. She changed into pajamas, leaned against the headboard, and used the memo app on her phone to jot down the day's expenses. She wrote, "Another 300 yuan saved for the travel fund, awesome!" Then she looked at the children's clothes for the next day and fell asleep contentedly.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; around the house and in the bedroom.

name: Morning shoulder and neck stretches and Baduanjin
description: At 5:15 in the morning, Ma Xiulan woke up to her body clock and quietly felt the lingering soreness in her lower back from yesterday's labor. She then did shoulder and neck stretches and Baduanjin exercises in the living room. Her movements were smooth, her breathing even, and after working up a light sweat she felt comfortable.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Washed up, went out, did community morning exercise, and answered a phone call.
description: After washing up, she put on her sneakers, took warm boiled water and a towel, and went to the community square. She practiced Baduanjin with Auntie Zhao, and afterward Auntie Zhao personally taught her to massage the Zusanli and Hegu acupoints and shared some refreshing hawthorn tea. The two chatted about their grandchildren and agreed to learn again next Wednesday. At the end of the morning exercise, she received a call from Zhou Xiuqin, whose mother suddenly felt unwell and needed care, so she could not help with packing the pickled vegetables today. Ma Xiulan comforted Zhou Xiuqin and then replanned the pickled vegetable work.
location: Jingwen Road Community Square, Jinghai District, Tianjin (northeast side of the intersection of Jingwen Road and Shengli Street)

name: Prepare breakfast and have breakfast with the whole family.
description: Ma Xiulan returned home quickly to prepare breakfast, heating steamed buns and porridge, boiling eggs in water, while sending a WeChat message to neighbor Wang Guilan to ask her to come over early to help. She woke up the three children, helped her youngest daughter Xinxin get dressed, and after urging them to wash up, the family of five had breakfast together. Ma Xiulan discussed with her husband Ma Zhiqiang about helping move the pickled vegetable jars first in the morning before heading out with the car.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Finalize division of labor and pickle production (including rest and inspection)
description: After the meal, as she was clearing the dishes, Wang Guilan came in and discussed the division of work: Wang Guilan would be responsible for simmering the sauce and preparing the ingredients, and Ma Xiulan would be responsible for cutting, assembling, and packing the jars. Ma Zhiqiang helped carry out the clay jars and the pickled radishes and cowpeas. Ma Xiulan cut the radish strips, Wang Guilan simmered the sauce and packed the jars, and Ma Zhiqiang sealed and arranged them. They took a short rest and drank water in the middle; Ma Xiulan checked the water in the jar rims and topped up one jar. They continued packing jars until noon, and the courtyard was filled with the aroma of sauce.
location: The courtyard at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (under the osmanthus tree)

name: Prepared and ate lunch; reminded about outdoor activities
description: Ma Xiulan asked Wang Guilan to go home and rest. She quickly stir-fried minced pork with bean paste to make fried sauce, cut cucumber shreds, and boiled noodles. The whole family ate zhajiang noodles, and the children loved them. Ma Xiulan reminded the children to get an hour of outdoor activity in the courtyard in the afternoon instead of watching TV all the time. Ma Zhiqiang ate two big bowls.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Brief personal rest
description: After clearing away the dishes and chopsticks, Ma Xiulan seized the chance to lie down in the bedroom and rest for 10 minutes, then rubbed the sore spots with medicated oil to relieve her fatigue.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Final pickling work (husband helped move and adjust the jars)
description: In the afternoon, they finished making the pickled vegetables. Wang Guilan also came to help, doing a final check, adding more seasoning, and sealing the pickles made yesterday and today. Because rain was forecast toward evening, Ma Zhiqiang moved the three jars of pickles that had been drying in the courtyard back into the storeroom. Ma Xiulan stuck the date label on the last jar.
location: Yard and warehouse at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Accompanied the children for outdoor activities and did needlework
description: After finishing the pickled vegetables, Ma Xiulan sat at the doorway watching the children play in the courtyard: her sons were playing marbles, and her daughter was watering the vegetables with a small spray bottle. While embroidering the fabric for tiger-head shoes, she kept an eye on the children, enjoying the parent-child time after a busy day.
location: Home courtyard at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepared dinner (braised pork belly, steamed buns).
description: Put away the needle and thread, went into the kitchen to prepare dinner. Thawed the pork belly, trimmed water spinach, made braised pork and steamed buns; the aroma filled the air.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Supervise washing up, have dinner together as a family, and clean up the kitchen
description: Ma Xiulan urged the three children to wash their hands and faces and change out of their dirty clothes, and then the family of five had dinner. The braised pork was well received; the children shared funny stories, and the dinner table was filled with laughter. After dinner, Ma Xiulan quickly cleared the dishes, cleaned the stove and the dining table, and put the leftover braised pork in the refrigerator.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Check children's homework, eye-care habits, and lead reading.
description: Ma Xiulan checked the children's summer homework in the living room reading corner: Ma Mingxuan's math exercises, Ma Mingzhe's handwriting practice book, and Ma Yuxin's drawings, and praised them. She especially checked the brightness of the desk lamp to protect their eyesight. Afterward, she took the three children to read picture books on the bean bag sofa, enjoying parent-child time.
location: Reading corner in the living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Settle today's pickled vegetable accounts with Sister Wang Guilan
description: Wang Guilan came to return the leftover star anise. Ma Xiulan checked today's pickled vegetable ingredients and work hours with her, settled her wages, and thanked her for her help.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Arrange washing up and tell Xinxin a bedtime story
description: Urging the children to wash up, Ma Xiulan helped Ma Yuxin wash and change into pajamas, and leaned by her daughter's small bed to read the picture book “Little Tadpoles Looking for Their Mother.” The daughter fell asleep listening to the story.
location: Bathroom and Xinxin's bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Tidy up the house and check the doors, windows, and gas
description: After coaxing her daughter to sleep, Ma Xiulan tidied up the toys in the living room, prepared dishes for the next day, and routinely checked the kitchen gas and the safety of all doors and windows. She felt reassured after confirming everything was secure.
location: Living room and kitchen at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare for bed and organize the day's small joys and accounts.
description: Ma Xiulan sent Wang Guilan a thank-you WeChat message. Then she recorded today's pickled vegetable balance of 180 yuan on the "Beijing Travel Fund" envelope on the refrigerator door, did some deep breathing before bedtime, recalled the warm moment of her daughter helping, and gradually fell asleep with a sense of satisfaction.
location: Master bedroom of the home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Going to bed
description: Ma Xiulan lay in bed. After a brief exchange with her husband Ma Zhiqiang, she sank into sleep amid the sound of cicadas.
location: Master bedroom of the home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning easy stretching and a walk
description: Woke up at 6:05 in the morning. Because she was tired from yesterday, she did not do Baduanjin, but instead walked slowly in the courtyard for 10 minutes and did shoulder and neck stretches for 3 minutes. The soreness in her lower back was lighter than yesterday. After that, she went back inside, washed up, changed into household clothes, and prepared to make breakfast.
location: Home courtyard and kitchen, Shengli Avenue, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare breakfast and wake up the children.
description: She rinsed millet and cooked millet porridge, steamed frozen xiaolongbao, boiled eggs, and took out some of her own pickled crunchy radish. At 6:55 she woke the children: Xuanxuan was self-disciplined, Zhezhe lingered in bed, and Xinxin needed help putting on her dress. At 7:10 the family of five sat around and ate breakfast; the children were in good spirits.
location: Home kitchen and bedroom on Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: See off her husband.
description: After breakfast, her husband Ma Zhiqiang was getting ready to go to work at the freight station. She slipped a washed apple into his pocket, told him to turn on the air conditioner at noon, and said she would make sweet-and-sour pork to reward him in the evening. He left on his electric bike.
location: In front of home on Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Soaking laundry and tidying the kitchen
description: The children watched cartoons. I sorted the dirty clothes and pajamas that had been taken off, soaked them in a large basin with laundry detergent, then scrubbed the kitchen stove twice and put the dishes and chopsticks away. The kitchen was spotless.
location: Bathroom and kitchen at the home on Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Shopping at the vegetable market and thanking the neighbor
description: She walked to the Wutong Community vegetable market. First she went to Aunt Sun Guifang's vegetable stall to buy pork tenderloin, tomatoes, green peppers, and potatoes. Aunt Sun gave her a bunch of scallions. Then she went to the dried goods stall and bought half a jin of dried black fungus. On the way home, she sent a voice message to Sister Wang Guilan, thanking her for her help yesterday and telling her that the pickled vegetable jar would be completely finished today.
location: At the Wutong Commune Vegetable Market in Jinghai District, Tianjin, and on the way back.

name: Preparing ingredients and finishing the pickled vegetables.
description: After returning home, she marinated the pork tenderloin strips with cooking wine, light soy sauce, and ginger slices, then refrigerated them to absorb the flavors. She washed and cut tomatoes, green peppers, and potatoes, and soaked dried black fungus.
