Then she went to the storage room, wiped the rims of the pickle jars clean, swept the floor, and put the tools back in place. Looking at the neat rows of jars, she took a photo as a memento, and the seven consecutive days of pickle-making came to a successful conclusion.
location: Kitchen and storeroom at home on Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Preparing lunch and checking the children's homework
description: At noon she stir-fried fresh tomatoes until the oil turned red to make egg noodles, and quickly stir-fried water spinach with garlic. At 11:30 she called the children to wash their hands and eat. During the meal she asked Xuanxuan about his summer homework progress. After the meal she checked his math test paper and found that he had done up to page 10.
location: Kitchen and living room at home on Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Lunch break and handicraft videos.
description: After urging the children to take a nap at 12:20, she went back to her bedroom and lay on her side to rest for 40 minutes to relieve the soreness in her lower back. She woke up at 1:00 p.m., leaned against the headboard, and scrolled through her phone. She saw a video about turning old jeans into storage bags, thought it was practical, and planned to try it another day.
location: Bedroom at home on Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing for guests and sewing chair cushions
description: First she tidied up the living room coffee table, boiled water, and took out the Tieguanyin tea leaves. While waiting, she sat by the window and continued sewing the chair cushion covers with tight stitches, feeling calm and grounded while doing handwork.
location: Living room at the home on Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Resolving the conflict with Zhou Xiuqin
description: Around 3 p.m., Zhou Xiuqin came to the door with fruit to apologize, explaining that yesterday she couldn't come to help because her mother had acute cholecystitis. I poured her tea and told her how Wang Guilan had helped yesterday. The two of us had a candid chat and decided to create a WeChat group called Pickles Squad. We agreed to confirm next week's tasks every Sunday evening, and if anything came up, we would switch shifts in advance or postpone. Her mother's condition was stable, so we were both relieved.
location: Living room at the home on Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Seeing off Zhou Xiuqin and tidying up
description: I saw Zhou Xiuqin out and watched her leave, feeling a weight off my mind. Back in the house, I rinsed the teacups, put the fruit in the fridge, and reflected that today's conflict had been handled perfectly — with a bit more understanding and one less knot in my heart.
location: Front door of the home and kitchen on Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing sweet and sour pork for dinner
date: On April 4, after calming her emotions, Ma Xiulan took samples of the newly formulated pickled vegetables she had made by hand to her mother's home at No. 45 Shengli Street. The mother and daughter tasted the samples together in the kitchen. Relying on years of experience, her mother suggested adding a bit more sugar to enhance the umami and helped adjust the spice ratios. Ma Xiulan felt her mother's warmth and support. When she left, her mother pressed a jar of homemade broad bean paste into her hand and told her to take some whenever she needed it.
description: Take the marinated pork tenderloin out of the fridge, mix a sweet-and-sour sauce (ketchup, sugar, white vinegar), coat the meat strips in starch, and deep-fry twice until crispy outside and tender inside. The aroma from the kitchen draws the children over to watch.
location: Home kitchen on Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Group photo to celebrate the completion of the pickled vegetables.
description: When my husband Ma Zhiqiang came home from work, he helped move the last few jars of pickled vegetables back to the storage room. I excitedly announced that the pickling task had come to a successful end and asked him to take a photo of me with the jars. I sent the photo to the Loving Family group chat. My husband smiled and said he would have a nice drink tonight.
location: Home warehouse and courtyard, Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Warm family dinner
description: My husband set up a small table in the yard. I stir-fried sweet and sour pork, and also made tomato and egg soup, stir-fried shredded potatoes, and heated up steamed buns. The five of us ate dinner in the yard, with a pleasant evening breeze. I thanked my husband for his support over the week, and the children said Mom's cooking was the best in the world. We chatted while eating, and laughter never stopped.
location: Home courtyard and dining room on Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: After-meal chores and homework tutoring.
description: After dinner, my husband took the boys for a walk in the yard, and Xinxin played with building blocks. I cleared the dishes, wiped the stove, and washed the pots and bowls. Then I urged Xuanxuan to go over his math mistakes, had Zhezhe trace calligraphy copybooks, and since Xinxin wanted to learn sewing, I demonstrated with a chair cushion cover.
location: Kitchen and living room at home on Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Evening parent-child time and bedtime preparation
description: At almost 8 o'clock, she urged the children to take baths. First she helped Xinxin bathe, blow-dry her hair, and change into pajamas, then checked how Xuanxuan and Zhezhe were washing up, and said goodnight to each of them. All three children were asleep before 9 o'clock.
location: The bathroom and all the bedrooms at the home on Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Mugwort foot soak for wellness.
description: After the children fell asleep, my husband watched TV in the living room. I steeped dried mugwort in boiling water, added cool water to adjust the temperature, and soaked my feet in the foot bath bucket in the bedroom. The warmth rose from the soles of my feet to my lower back, and the fatigue of the past few days seemed to melt away.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Keeping accounts and preparing for bed
description: After soaking your feet, dry them off, and write down today's expenses such as groceries. Wash the rice in advance for tomorrow morning's egg-stuffed pancakes and put it on the stove. Check the doors and windows, and turn off the living room light.
location: Bedroom at home on Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Going to bed
description: Told her husband she was going to sleep, soon fell into a deep sleep, and had a dreamless night.
location: Bedroom at home on Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning exercise
description: At 5:20 in the morning, the alarm went off on time. Ma Xiulan was in good spirits and did not linger in bed. In the living room, she first did 5 minutes of shoulder and neck stretches, which relieved the stiffness in her shoulders and neck from being upset with Zhou Xiuqin the day before, and she felt much more relaxed. Then she went to the courtyard and, in the dim light, completed a full set of Baduanjin. Her movements were smoother than before. Although she felt a slight pulling sensation in her lower back during the 'Two Hands Climbing Feet to Strengthen Kidneys and Waist' movement, overall she felt comfortable.
location: Living room and courtyard at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning chores and getting the children up
description: After finishing her boxing and returning inside, the soy milk maker had just finished its cycle. Ma Xiulan poured out the soy milk to let it cool, then heated up the buns bought yesterday and the spiced eggs she had boiled. At 6:50, she called the children to get up right on time: Xuanxuan got up on his own without being reminded, Zhezhe only moved after being called twice, and Xinxin was the best behaved—she woke up at the first call and dressed herself in her skirt. While the children washed up, she quickly got herself ready, changing into a light-purple floral short-sleeved top and dark-blue trousers.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family breakfast.
description: At 7 o'clock, the family sat around the dining table. Ma Xiulan poured soy milk for everyone, and the children helped themselves to steamed buns. She reminded Xuanxuan not to forget the morning tutoring class and to pack his summer homework; Zhezhe and Xinxin checked their schoolbags and confirmed nothing was left behind. Seeing the three children eat their fill, she felt very reassured.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Taking the children to school
description: At 7:30, they left home right on time. Ma Xiulan rode an electric bike, with Xinxin sitting on the front footboard and Zhezhe sitting at the back. She first rode to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, arriving at about 7:45, and watched Zhezhe walk into the school gate by himself. Then she turned around and rode for about 5 minutes, arriving at Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten at 7:50. She handed Xinxin to the teacher, watched her wave goodbye, and only then left with peace of mind.
location: Jinghai No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Vegetable market shopping and chatting with neighbors.
description: After dropping off the children, Ma Xiulan went by the Wutong Commune Vegetable Market. At Auntie Sun Guifang's stall, she bought fresh soybean sprouts, tender cucumbers, and a bunch of water spinach, and chatted for a while about her little granddaughter's summer vacation. As she was about to leave, she ran into Sister Wang Guilan from across the way, who had also come to shop. The two stood at the market entrance and chatted for about ten minutes. Sister Wang praised how well the tomatoes in her yard were growing, and Ma Xiulan took the opportunity to mention she wanted to learn how to make tomato sauce. Sister Wang readily agreed, saying the recipe had been handed down from her mother and was guaranteed to be delicious.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Housework and pickled vegetable sample preparation
description: Arriving home around 9 o'clock, Ma Xiulan first put away the groceries and tied on an apron. She walked into the storage room and, among the five jars of pickled vegetables sealed yesterday, carefully opened the jars of sweet pickled garlic and soy-sauce cucumbers. Using clean bamboo chopsticks, she picked out the six best-looking heads of sweet pickled garlic and eight soy-sauce cucumbers, and arranged them on a clean blue-and-white porcelain plate. She also put a small portion of each into separate small dishes, preparing to give Sister Wang Guilan a taste in the evening. Looking at the brightly colored pickles on the plate, she felt a sense of accomplishment.
location: Tianjin, Jinghai District, 156 Jingwen Road, home kitchen and storage room

name: Tending the courtyard vegetable garden
description: The sun was getting hot. Before noon arrived, Ma Xiulan hurried to the yard to check. Two tomatoes were already turning red, and she figured they could be picked by the weekend. She mentally noted that she had almost all the ingredients needed to make tomato sauce. She watered the tomatoes, green beans, and peppers, checked for bugs and found none, and pulled out a few weeds. Looking at the thriving little vegetable garden, she felt very content.
location: Home courtyard at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the children and prepare lunch.
description: At 11:30, Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to school to pick up Xuanxuan. Xuanxuan got out of school at 11:45, and she waited a short while before meeting him. On the way, she asked if the morning tutoring session was tiring. Xuanxuan said it was okay and that he understood the math lesson. After getting home, she had Xuanxuan wash his hands and do homework for a while, and she started preparing the cold noodles for lunch: boiling water to cook the noodles, meanwhile shredding cucumber, blanching bean sprouts, frying a bowl of fragrant egg sauce, and chopping minced garlic and cilantro. With the noodles and sauce ready, she just had to wait for her husband to come back.
location: Jinghai District No. 1 Middle School, 19 Diwei Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and the kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road

name: Family lunch.
description: At 12:30, her husband Zhiqiang came back from work and arrived just in time for the meal. The family sat at the table, and Ma Xiulan scooped the noodles, which had been rinsed in cold water, into bowls. Xuanxuan added shredded cucumber, bean sprouts, and egg sauce, drizzled with vinegar and minced garlic, and slurped down two big bowls, saying the cold noodles at home still suited his taste best. Zhiqiang also said the sauce was especially fragrant today, and she said it was a new recipe she had learned from Sister Wang last time. The meal was thoroughly enjoyable.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Afternoon break and finishing up housework
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan had Xuanxuan take a nap. She quickly cleared the dishes and chopsticks, wiped the stove clean, and put the leftover sauce and dishes into food containers. When she was done, she leaned back on the living room sofa and dozed for 20 minutes, feeling much refreshed. When she got up, she went to look at the small sample dish of pickled vegetables, sealed it with plastic wrap, and put it in a cool place.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Afternoon leisure time
description: In the afternoon, it was hot, so Ma Xiulan didn't go out. She took out the linen cloth she had washed and dried a couple of days before and, following a pattern on her phone, prepared to make a small skirt for Xinxin's rag doll. While listening to a TV drama, she threaded her needle with nimble fingers, and soon the rough shape of the little skirt was done. In between, she poured her husband a cup of tea and went to check how Xuanxuan's homework was going, urging him to concentrate.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick the children up from school.
description: She left at 3:40 p.m. and went to pick up Xinxin first. At 4:00 kindergarten ended. As soon as Xinxin came out, she held up the family portrait she had drawn that day for her mother to see. In the picture, there was a mother in a red dress. Ma Xiulan felt warm in her heart. Then she immediately got on the bike and went to pick up Zhezhe (school ended at 4:10). The two children chattered about school on the bike, and they made a lively trip home together.
location: Tianjin Jinghai District Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten and Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School.

name: Help with homework and prepare dinner.
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan had the three children do their homework in the dining room. Since Xinxin didn't have any written homework, she let her draw pictures nearby. She went into the kitchen to prepare dinner, put pork rib and kelp soup on to simmer, and washed and cut garlic water spinach for later. In between, she came out to check Xuanxuan's math test paper, pointed out a calculation error, and helped Zhezhe with a dictation of new characters.
location: Dining room and kitchen of home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Family dinner
description: Her husband Zhiqiang came home from work, and the family sat around the dinner table. The pork rib soup was delicious, the water spinach was crisp and tender, and the children all ate with relish. At the table, Xinxin told everyone the story in her drawing, saying that Mom looked best in a red dress, which made everyone laugh. Xuanxuan reported what he had gained from his summer tutoring classes, and Zhiqiang also shared something interesting he had seen on the road today.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening chores and washing up the children
description: After the meal, she had Zhiqiang go rest in the living room and watch the news. Ma Xiulan quickly cleared the dishes, wiped the table, washed the bowls, and tidied the kitchen. Then she bathed and washed the hair of the three children one by one. When the children were all clean and in their pajamas, she put the pickled vegetable samples to take out that evening on a plate, placed them in a small basket, and brought two palm-leaf fans.
location: Kitchen and bathroom of the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Cooling off with neighbors and sharing pickled vegetables.
description: As dusk fell, a cool breeze blew. Ma Xiulan carried a small stool, a chair, and a small basket, and sat down at the door. Before long, Sister Wang Guilan also arrived with her stool as promised. The two fanned themselves with palm-leaf fans and chatted about everything under the sun, from the children's summer vacation to neighborhood gossip. Ma Xiulan brought out sweet garlic and pickled cucumbers. Wang Guilan tasted one and kept saying, Crisp! Fragrant! Then she took another bite of sweet garlic, which was sweet and sour, and nodded approvingly. As the conversation continued, Wang Guilan lowered her voice and told her the good news that her daughter-in-law was pregnant. Surprised and delighted, Ma Xiulan quickly congratulated her, then ran home to get a small jar of sour plums pickled last year and asked Wang Guilan to take it back for her daughter-in-law to whet her appetite. As the chat was ending, she brought up making tomato sauce again. Sister Wang patted her chest and said she would take care of the recipe and tools. The two planned a rough division of labor and then went home satisfied.
location: Open space in front of 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening personal care and parent-child time
description: After returning home, the children had already been playing in bed for a while. Ma Xiulan first told Xinxin two bedtime stories and watched her fall asleep; then she went to check on Xuanxuan and Zhezhe and tucked them in. Only then did she wash up. She had walked quite a bit today, and her waist was still a little sore, so as usual she boiled mugwort water to soak her feet. While soaking her feet, she recalled how Sister Wang had praised the pickled vegetables today, the good news about her daughter-in-law, and that they had finalized making tomato sauce, and she felt especially grounded and happy. After soaking her feet, she did 5 minutes of deep breathing before bed and felt her whole body relax.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Personal time before bed
description: After soaking her feet, Ma Xiulan still felt a bit energetic, so she took out the doll dress she had been embroidering during the day, and by the bedside lamp, sewed a few stitches, just in time to finish a nice hem. Then, satisfied, she turned off the light and lay down. In her mind, she planned to water the tomatoes more the next day so they would ripen quickly and she could learn to make tomato sauce from Sister Wang early.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Morning exercise and breakfast preparation
description: I had to catch the morning market today, so I woke up at 5:10 a.m., feeling both expectant and a little nervous. Instead of doing the full Baduanjin routine as usual, I just did a quick 5-minute shoulder and neck stretch in the yard, then walked briskly twice around the yard for about 10 minutes. Back inside, I put the soybeans that had been soaked overnight into the soy milk maker, took out the steamed buns from the day before to heat up, and made simple preparations for the early start.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Meticulously preparing goods for the market
description: After washing up, she felt full of energy and began to take stock of the market goods. In the kitchen, she stuck eye-catching price labels on the 12 jars of pickled cucumbers and 10 jars of sweet pickled garlic that had been portioned out the night before, and wiped the outside of the jars with a dry cloth. Back in the living room, she carefully wrapped three embroidered round fans—one with lotus flowers and two with butterflies—in soft cloth and put them into dustproof bags. Finally, she put the printed tablecloth, the handwritten "Sister Ma's Handmade" price sign, the change bag, and the printed WeChat payment QR code into her shopping bag, making full preparations for setting up the stall. Only then did she feel at ease.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Organize the family and a quick breakfast
description: The soymilk and mantou were ready, so she woke up the children, who were still drowsy. She hastily ate one mantou and drank a bowl of soymilk. Before leaving, she reminded her husband Ma Zhiqiang that the market would be crowded today, that the children were in his care, not to forget to water the tomatoes in the yard, and to make lunch for the children; she had brought her own dry food, so he didn't need to worry about her. She also reminded her oldest son Ma Mingxuan to take good care of his younger siblings, and only then felt at ease.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Meet up with companions and head to the market
description: Just as she had tied the goods and folding table to the back seat of the electric bike, a horn sounded at the intersection—her companion Zhou Xiuqin had arrived on time. Xiulan waved to greet her, and the two rode one behind the other, carrying their goods east along Jingwen Road toward South Lake Park, setting off for a busy day.
location: In front of 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Morning market stall setup and sales
description: They arrived at the 'Nanhu Folk Rhyme' handicraft market in the plaza at the North Gate of Nanhu Park, where the crowd was buzzing. Quick of eye and hand, she found an empty spot in the middle, and she and Zhou Xiuqin swiftly spread out a tablecloth, arranged the pickled vegetables and round fans in a fan shape, and set the price signs at the very front. Just as they finished setting up, people gathered around. Xiulan took out small plates and toothpicks and warmly invited the woman to taste the low-salt pickled cucumbers. A middle-aged woman in a floral dress nodded approvingly after tasting and bought three jars on the spot. A young woman was drawn to the lotus round fan, so Xiulan took out the fan and let her examine it, chatting about the embroidery techniques and patterns. Tempted, the young woman left her contact information to commission one. Zhou Xiuqin worked in seamless coordination beside her, and in one morning most of the pickled vegetables were sold.
location: North Gate Square, Nanhu Park, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Rotating lunch breaks and observing the stall
description: At noon the sun was blazing and the market crowd was thinning. Xiulan asked Sister Xiuqin to buy two jianbing guozi from a nearby stall, and the two had a simple lunch with plain water from their thermos cups. After lunch, Xiulan walked around, paying special attention to a stall selling handmade cloth shoes and another selling shadow puppets. She observed how they displayed goods and greeted customers, quietly noting down a few business tips.
location: North Gate Square, Nanhu Park, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Afternoon market sales and client contact.
description: In the afternoon, foot traffic picked up again, and Xiulan perked up and continued hawking. A tea shop owner tasted the sweet pickled garlic and couldn't stop praising it, immediately ordering five jars to serve as tea snacks to his customers. Xiulan quickly noted down his contact information, hoping for long-term cooperation. Some customers were interested in embroidery, so she took out her needlework kit and demonstrated thread splitting and stitching on the spot, which attracted several more customers to stop. She seized the opportunity to introduce her custom round fan service and noted down the request from a customer who wanted a "Peonies in Bloom" pattern. By after 4 p.m., only three or four jars of pickles were left, and Xiulan was overjoyed.
location: North Gate Square, Nanhu Park, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Packing up the stall in the evening and sheltering from the rain
description: The sky was getting dark and the wind picked up. Xiulan remembered the forecast of showers and quickly called to Sister Xiuqin to pack up the stall. The two briskly cleared the remaining goods, tablecloths, and display racks, and carefully wrapped the few jars of pickles in plastic bags. Just as they tied everything onto the electric bike, a flash lit up the distant sky and raindrops began to fall sparsely. They exchanged a smile and said, 'That was close — we almost got soaked!' Pushing the bike, they hurried out of the market, ending a busy day.
location: North Gate Square, Nanhu Park, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Returning home to rest and tally the results
description: When she got home, it had already started raining. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang said the children had all eaten and told her to rest for a while. Xiulan didn't bother to change clothes. She carefully took out the day's earnings and several slips of paper with customers' contact information from her waist bag and spread them flat on the dining table. Counting the money jar by jar, she silently calculated: she sold 16 jars of pickled vegetables for 320 yuan. After deducting the 50 yuan stall fee and adding the deposit for the round fans, she made a net profit of 180 yuan today. She took out the envelope labeled “Beijing Travel Fund,” neatly put the money in, and felt delighted, sensing that she was one step closer to her goal. Then she discussed with Sister Xiuqin about going to the next market together, saying that the payment for her hard work must not be reduced.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Simple dinner and doing household chores
description: Xiulan reheated the meal her husband had left and ate a couple of bites. The rain had stopped, so she went to check the tomatoes in the yard; the fruits were still covered with water droplets and looked redder. She pulled up a few weeds by the way, then remembered that she had arranged with Sister Wang Guilan to make tomato sauce together yesterday, and planned to discuss the specific time with her tomorrow. After going back inside, she scrubbed the dirty towel and apron she had brought home today and hung them on the balcony.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Evening foot soaking and recording lessons learned
description: The children were doing homework and playing in the room, and her husband was watching the news. Xiulan boiled a pot of hot water, poured it into a basin, and soaked her feet comfortably. While soaking, she took out a small notebook and wrote down the day's experiences: next time at the market she could bring more small change, the prices of the round silk fans should be set in tiers, and it would be best to make a more exquisite set of samples. She clearly wrote down the customization requirements of the three customers who ordered round silk fans (lotus, peony, and according to the pattern), thinking she would start drawing the designs tomorrow. After soaking for over ten minutes, her whole body felt warm.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Pre-bedtime family time and preparing for sleep
description: After soaking her feet, she went to the courtyard, brought in the dried clothes, folded them, and put them in the wardrobe. Then she went to the children's room to check their homework and told her daughter Xinxin to go to bed early. Back in the bedroom, she chatted with Ma Zhiqiang for a while about the interesting things at today's market, feeling a strong sense of accomplishment. Lying in bed, she was still savoring the day's experiences and felt that life was full of promise.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Sleep soundly.
description: Although she went to bed a little later than usual, the day, though tiring, was exceptionally full and satisfying. With dreams of showing off her skills at the next market, she soon fell asleep.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Morning exercise and courtyard activities
description: Early in the morning, Ma Xiulan, wearing loose sportswear, came to the courtyard. She first stretched her sore lower back and legs, and when she saw the light on in her eldest son Ma Mingxuan's room, she called him to exercise together. The two followed a phone instructional video and did a set of Baduanjin on the concrete floor of the courtyard. After exercising, Ma Xiulan watered the cucumbers and green beans in the yard and picked two ripe red tomatoes. Ma Mingxuan helped pull weeds and felt his shoulders much lighter.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, home courtyard

name: Preparing breakfast and doing housework
description: Ma Xiulan returned to the kitchen, used the soaked soybeans to make soy milk, took out the chives and eggs she had bought yesterday at Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, and deftly made pan-fried dumplings stuffed with chives and eggs. As the dumplings went into the pan, she quickly sorted the family's laundry and put it into the washing machine.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin - home kitchen and dining room

name: Wake the family and have breakfast
description: Ma Xiulan woke up her husband Ma Zhiqiang, her second son Ma Zhe, and her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin one after another, and the family sat down to eat breakfast: pan-fried dumplings with freshly ground soy milk, in a warm atmosphere. Xiulan announced that she would take Xinxin to claim the prize today. Xinxin was so excited that she ate an extra half, and Ma Zhiqiang smiled and said he would pick them up after he had his car serviced in the afternoon.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin — the dining room and bedrooms at home

name: Took her youngest daughter to the painting award ceremony.
description: Ma Xiulan changed Xinxin into a floral dress, braided her hair, changed into a printed blouse herself, took her shoulder bag containing the certificate folder, and rode her electric bicycle along Jingwen Road, turning onto Shengli Street, arriving at the Jinghai District Community Cultural Center in about ten minutes. The awards ceremony in the third-floor auditorium was formal. When "Little Ma Yuxin, third prize, for the work 'Mother's Pickled Vegetables'" was announced, Xiulan excitedly held Xinxin's hand. Xinxin went up to the stage gracefully to receive 48-color watercolor pens and a gold-bordered certificate. Xiulan squatted beside Xinxin and used her phone to capture the radiant smile as Xinxin held up her certificate and prize.
location: No. 37 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, third-floor auditorium of the Jinghai District Community Cultural Center.

name: Shopping at the vegetable market and preparing lunch at home.
description: After the award ceremony, Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike with Xinxin to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, where she selected a Hami melon, juicy peaches, and green grapes. The stall owner Aunt Sun praised Xinxin for being pretty and gave her a nectarine. Xiulan also bought lean meat and soft tofu. After returning home, Ma Mingxuan and Ma Zhe were watching TV. Xiulan went into the kitchen, steamed rice, and made minced pork and tofu soup and the tomato scrambled eggs Xinxin loved. The family had a simple and warm lunch, and Xinxin shared the nectarine with her two brothers.
location: Wutong Community Vegetable Market in Jinghai District, Tianjin, and the kitchen and dining room at home, 156 Jingwen Road

name: Start a dedicated savings plan for the Beijing trip and handicraft design
description: After lunch, Ma Xiulan gathered the three children in the living room. In the account book, she solemnly wrote Beijing Travel Fund, put the 180 yuan earned at the market yesterday into a special envelope, and announced that from today on they would save 400 yuan a month, aiming to take the whole family of five to Beijing to see Tiananmen next summer vacation. The children cheered. Then Xiulan let the children rest and study, while she returned to the bedroom, took out her embroidery hoop and patterns, and began sketching the design for a round fan ordered by a customer. She first drew a lotus draft on paper, then carefully traced the peony pattern on her phone.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, home living room and bedroom

name: Making a Celebratory Fruit Platter and Doing Household Chores
description: After resting, Ma Xiulan called Xinxin into the kitchen and taught her to use molds to cut the Hami melon into star and flower shapes. Mother and daughter together arranged green grapes, peach chunks, and shaped fruit pieces on a large white platter, making a colorful fruit platter. They sealed it with plastic wrap and put it in the refrigerator as a surprise for Dad. Afterwards, Xiulan took the clothes washed in the morning to the courtyard to sun-dry, then swept the floor and wiped the table.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin: the kitchen and living room at home.

name: Finishing handcraft work and keeping in touch with neighbors.
description: Ma Xiulan received a call from her husband Ma Zhiqiang and learned that the maintenance was done; he was about to buy a fire extinguisher and a first aid kit. After hanging up, Xiulan continued sketching peony pattern details in the living room and checking the custom round fan order notebook. Seeing the ripe red tomatoes in the yard, she called her neighbor Wang Guilan and arranged to make tomato paste together at nine the next morning. Wang Guilan readily agreed.
location: Living room and courtyard, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The whole family celebrates the husband's return home
description: Ma Zhiqiang came home carrying a newly bought fire extinguisher and first-aid kit. Xinxin immediately took out a fruit platter from the fridge and held it up in front of her father, saying that she and her mother had made it to celebrate her winning a painting prize. Ma Zhiqiang laughed heartily, picked up Xinxin and called her his little painter. The whole family gathered around the coffee table, eating fruit while listening to Xinxin recount the award ceremony, and the living room was filled with laughter.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; living room and dining room at home.

name: Prepare and enjoy dinner
description: Taking advantage of the celebratory mood, Ma Xiulan prepared a hearty dinner. The main dish was pork ribs bought at yesterday's market and simmered in clear broth, served with stir-fried garlic water spinach and the leftover minced pork and tofu soup from lunch. The family sat together, and Ma Zhiqiang shared that the repair shop had done a free safety inspection when he took the car in for maintenance. The dinner table was filled with warmth and laughter.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin - home kitchen and dining room

name: Putting away safety equipment, organizing documents, and learning new embroidery stitches.
description: After clearing the dishes, Ma Xiulan carefully fastened the fire extinguisher and first-aid kit in the truck cab, organized all vehicle documents, insurance policies, and the vehicle license into a transparent document bag, and placed it in the passenger-side glove box. Then she returned to the bedroom, took out the embroidery hoop and silk thread, and followed a Suzhou embroidery tutorial video to carefully learn the 'rolling needle stitch' and 'seed stitch' techniques. She practiced repeatedly on plain white silk, finally embroidering a small, three-dimensional pink flower, and felt a strong sense of accomplishment.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, home living room and bedroom

name: Children's washing and bedtime stories
description: Ma Xiulan put down her needlework, went to the bathroom to help Ma Mingxuan and Ma Zhe wash up, then took Xinxin back to the children's room and told her the story of "The Little Carp Leaps Over the Dragon Gate," congratulating her on being today's little champion. Xinxin soon fell into a sweet sleep.
location: At home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin: bathroom and children's room.

name: Soaking feet for wellness and going to bed
description: Ma Zhiqiang had already lain down. Ma Xiulan boiled hot water, poured it into a foot-soaking tub, and added a few drops of mugwort essential oil. While soaking her feet, she massaged the Zusanli acupoint, feeling the day's fatigue melt away with the hot water. She closed her eyes and reviewed the new stitch, took five minutes of deep breaths, and recalled the fulfilling day, feeling grounded and happy. After soaking her feet, she dried herself, turned off the light, and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning exercise and helping her husband get ready to head out.
description: Early in the morning, Ma Xiulan laid out her yoga mat in the courtyard of her home, first stretching her shoulders and neck, then practicing the full set of Baduanjin, paying special attention to the moves "Holding the Hands High to Regulate the Triple Burner" and "Looking Back to Cure Five Strains and Seven Injuries." Her body gradually loosened up. After finishing the exercises, she helped her husband Ma Zhiqiang with the pre-trip inspection of the truck, verbally reminding him to check the tires and engine oil, and helping to confirm that the fire extinguisher and first-aid kit were securely fixed in place. She put the driver's license and vehicle license into a clear document folder to ensure the trip was perfectly prepared.
location: At the home courtyard and beside the truck at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing breakfast and reminding the children
description: Ma Xiulan returned to the kitchen to prepare breakfast. She heated up millet porridge and the leftover meat buns from yesterday, and sliced a plate of pickled cucumbers. She woke the three children and urged them to wash up and eat. At the table, she especially reminded her eldest son Xuanxuan to finish his summer homework carefully and to look after his younger brother and sister. At 7:10, her husband Ma Zhiqiang finished breakfast and left to start his long-distance transport work.
location: Kitchen and living room of the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Clean the kitchen and follow up on embroidery orders by phone
description: After the children finished eating, Ma Xiulan quickly cleared the dishes and chopsticks, wiped the table, and swept the floor. Then she went to the handcraft area in the bedroom, took out an old notebook, and went through the potential customer information recorded at last Saturday's market: 'Ms. Li - lotus round fan', 'Mr. Zhang - hesitating', and so on, and checked the reserved phone numbers. She first called Ms. Li and successfully finalized an order for a 20 cm diameter lotus round fan, priced at 60 yuan, with delivery agreed for three days later. Then she contacted Mr. Zhang and patiently explained that she could embroider a sample first for him to see the effect, and successfully added him on WeChat. Finally, she called Mr. Liu's number, but it was no longer in service. She sighed softly and crossed out the record. After finishing the follow-ups, she took out plain round fans and silk thread, neatly arranged them in her work area, and prepared materials for the order.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, home kitchen and bedroom craft area.

name: Making tomato sauce with neighbor Wang Guilan.
description: Ma Xiulan brought over a dozen clean glass jars she had saved up at home and knocked on the door of Wang Guilan, who lived across the hall. With a smile, she asked, 'Sister Guilan, shall we start making the sauce?' In Wang Guilan's kitchen, the two divided the work. Wang Guilan guided Ma Xiulan in quickly peeling and chopping the tomatoes, while Ma Xiulan was responsible for boiling water and sterilizing the jars in hot water. Wang Guilan used a food processor to puree the tomato chunks, then poured them into a large pot with sugar and simmered. Ma Xiulan kept stirring with a long spoon to prevent sticking. After about an hour, the sauce became thick. The two filled the jars while hot, tightened the lids, and turned them upside down to cool. They made 8 jars in total. The atmosphere during the sauce-making was relaxed, and the two chatted about daily life while working.
location: Wang Guilan's kitchen at 158 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Prepare lunch, have lunch with the children, and take a midday rest
description: Ma Xiulan carried the freshly made tomato sauce home, washed her hands, and began to prepare lunch. She made noodles with tomato and egg sauce, and cut up juicy peaches as a dessert fruit. When she called Xuanxuan, Zhezhe, and Xinxin in to eat, she praised the children for doing well in the morning and rewarded each with a piece of peach. After the meal, she had Xuanxuan take his younger brother and sister to the living room floor mat for a nap, while she cleaned up the dishes.
location: Kitchen, dining room, and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Noon rest, then housework and embroidery practice after waking.
description: Ma Xiulan changed into loose loungewear, turned off her phone alarm, and tried to extend her lunch break to 45 minutes. She lay down, emptied her mind, and listened to the children in the living room gradually quieting down as she fell asleep. After waking up feeling refreshed, she put the family's dirty clothes into the washing machine, then returned to the craft area in the bedroom, took out the Su embroidery stitch pattern book, carefully studied the "rolling stitch" and "seed stitch", and tried a few stitches on practice cloth. The feel was smooth.
location: Main bedroom and handicraft area in the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Check the children's homework and activities
description: Ma Xiulan walked to the study desk in the living room to check the summer homework of Xuanxuan and Zhezhe and gave them guidance. Her younger daughter Xinxin was drawing with crayons, drawing the scene of the family eating fruit in the yard yesterday. Ma Xiulan praised her for being creative and let her keep drawing.
location: Study desk in the living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Buying ingredients for dinner at the vegetable market
description: Ma Xiulan changed into her going-out clothes and rode her e-bike to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market. She first picked out 2 fresh pork ribs, a bunch of water spinach, and a piece of soft tofu at the stall of her acquaintance Sun Guifang. Seeing the live crucian carp, she bought one too, and Sun Guifang scaled and gutted it for her. She also bought some tomatoes and eggs. After shopping, she hung the ingredients on the handlebars and rode home. Once home, she dealt with them right away: blanching the ribs, washing and draining the water spinach, and soaking the tofu in water to prepare for dinner.
location: From home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market (round trip)

name: Prepare a hearty dinner and have dinner with the whole family
description: Ma Xiulan began making dinner. She first put the blanched pork ribs into a pressure cooker with ginger slices, scallion sections, and cooking wine to make soup. In another pan, she heated oil and made garlic water spinach and pan-fried tofu. Her eldest son, Xuanxuan, came in to help peel garlic and set out bowls and chopsticks. At 6 p.m., her husband Ma Zhiqiang arrived home after completing a long-distance trip. Ma Xiulan served the steaming hot pork rib soup, and the whole family sat around eating. At the table, the children chattered noisily as they shared funny stories, and Ma Xiulan also told her husband the good news that she had lined up a round fan order and made tomato sauce that day. The family atmosphere was warm and cheerful.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: After-dinner chores, parent-child bonding, and putting the children to bed
description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan had her husband watch TV with the children in the living room while she cleared the table, washed the dishes, wiped the stove, and took out the trash. Then she ran hot water and let Xuanxuan and Zhezhe bathe themselves; she bathed her little daughter Xinxin herself. After the washing up, Ma Xiulan read a picture book to Xinxin and one to Zhezhe, while Xuanxuan sat nearby reading the extracurricular book The Ordinary World. She talked with the children and asked what they wanted to eat tomorrow. Finally, she urged the three children to brush their teeth and use the bathroom, sent them to their own bedrooms to sleep, and turned off the living room light after making sure they were lying down.
location: Kitchen, bathroom, living room, and bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Soaked feet, kept accounts, and relaxed before going to bed.
description: Ma Xiulan brought hot water to the bedside in the master bedroom to soak her feet, and took out her small accounting notebook at the same time. She first noted down the 60-yuan round fan order she had successfully followed up on today, and wrote down the lesson from the dead number: "Next market day, remember to be more careful." Then she calculated today's grocery expenses, and flipped to the back pages to write tomorrow's plan: "Start embroidering the main flower of the lotus round fan in the morning." After soaking her feet for 20 minutes, she dried them and felt completely relaxed. She changed into her pajamas, did 5 minutes of bedtime deep breathing, thought about the lotus pattern she was going to embroider and felt confident, set the alarm for 6:20, turned off the light and lay down, listening to the summer night insects chirping outside the window, and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Master bedroom of the home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Early morning emergency response to rain leaking into the kitchen.
description: Early in the morning, Ma Xiulan was woken by the sound of heavy rain and muffled thunder. She found the kitchen ceiling leaking, with water running down the wall. She quickly placed a stainless steel basin under the leak and laid out rags to soak up the water on the floor. Then she immediately pulled out her phone and contacted the handyman, Master Liu. Master Liu promised to come over and check once the rain let up. After hanging up, she put a dry cloth under the basin to muffle the dripping sound, feeling a bit more at ease.
location: Kitchen, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Settling the children and having a simple breakfast
description: The children were woken by thunder and noise. Ma Xiulan told her eldest son, Xuanxuan, to watch his younger siblings while they washed up. She quickly warmed the milk, sliced the leftover steamed buns and toasted them until golden brown, and fried two eggs, preparing breakfast for the three children—busy and flustered, but not at all sloppy.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Took the two children to school in the rain.
description: When the rain let up a bit, Ma Xiulan had Xuanxuan stay home and keep an eye on things. She rode her e-bike to first take her second son, Ma Mingzhe, to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School. After watching him go through the school gate, she turned around and rode along Jingwen Road to take her daughter, Ma Yuxin, to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten. Only after handing her over to the teacher did she feel reassured.
location: Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China; Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Master Liu inspected the roof and discussed repairs with her husband.
description: When Ma Xiulan came home, Master Liu was already waiting at the door. He climbed onto the roof in the rain to inspect it and found that the tiles had been loosened and broken by the heavy rain. New tiles and waterproofing were needed, and he quoted 1,000 yuan. After Master Liu left, Ma Xiulan called her husband Ma Zhiqiang, who was out on a long-distance haul, to explain the situation. Her husband agreed it was a necessary expense and took the initiative to propose setting aside 200 yuan from the monthly household budget as a 'home repair fund' for emergencies.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Thorough cleaning and tracing of craft drafts
description: After hanging up, Ma Xiulan thoroughly scrubbed the kitchen, put away the water basin and rags, and loaded the dirty clothes into the washing machine. While the washing machine was running, she sat in the living room, took out the draft for the lotus round fan order she had taken earlier, and carefully traced the outline with a pencil to prepare for tomorrow's formal embroidery.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Went out to buy ingredients and daily necessities
description: After the rain passed and the sky cleared, Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike first to the Wutong Commune Vegetable Market. At the stall of Aunt Sun, an acquaintance, she picked out fresh water spinach and 1 kilogram of pork ribs, planning to make soup that evening. On the way back, she stopped by Shufen Convenience Store at No. 85 Jingwen Road to buy mung beans, soy sauce, and salt.
location: China, Tianjin, Jinghai District, southeast corner of the intersection of Jingwen Road and Wutong Road, Wutong Commune Vegetable Market; China, Tianjin, Jinghai District, No. 85 Jingwen Road, Shufen Convenience Store

name: Simple lunch and a short midday rest.
description: It was almost noon when she got home. Ma Xiulan cooked herself a bowl of noodles with greens, added a poached egg, and had a simple meal. After eating, she set a 45-minute alarm and lay down for a nap. Though she didn't fall fully asleep, she felt noticeably refreshed after resting with her eyes closed.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Embroidering a lotus round fan and chatting online in the handicraft group
description: After her nap, Ma Xiulan focused on embroidering a lotus round fan in the living room, using the rolling needle stitch for the petal outlines and the seed stitch to embellish the flower stamens. Halfway through, she sent a close-up photo of the small flowers from the previous day to the handicraft group, sharing her insight that "rolling needle and seed stitches make the flowers three-dimensional." Aunt Wu in the group immediately sent a private message praising the even stitches and offered to teach her more complex Suzhou embroidery patterns by video next week. Ma Xiulan gladly agreed.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Picking up the two children from school and the children's chatter along the way.
description: At 3 p.m., Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up her younger daughter Ma Yuxin. Yuxin excitedly said that her painting had been praised by the teacher and put up on the wall. Then the mother and daughter went to Third Primary School in Jinghai District to wait for her second son Ma Mingzhe. After the two children met, they chattered nonstop on the way home. Ma Xiulan listened while riding them home on her bike.
location: Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China; Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Preparing a hearty dinner and family collaboration
description: After arriving home, the eldest son Ma Mingxuan, who had already finished his homework, helped look after the younger children. Ma Xiulan began kneading dough and chopping chive filling to make the chive and egg dumplings the children loved, while also blanching pork ribs to make soup and cooking mung bean soup to relieve the heat. The kitchen was filled with steam, Xuanxuan came over to roll dumpling wrappers, and the youngest daughter played by pinching dough at the side. The family worked together joyfully.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: The whole family had dinner together.
description: The dumplings were out of the pot, and the pork rib soup and mung bean soup were also served. The family sat around and tasted them. At the table, Ma Xiulan told the children that the roof repair had been arranged by their father and herself, so there was no need to worry. The children nodded understandingly, and the meal was filled with warmth.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Helping with homework and family embroidery time
description: After cleaning up after the meal, Ma Xiulan sat on the living room sofa, continuing to embroider the outline of the round fan while checking Xinxin's painting and Zhezhe's math homework. Her eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, went to his room to read on his own. She explained the symbolic meaning of lotus flowers to Xinxin, who was interested in the round fan, making it both fun and educational.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Evening family financial discussion and bookkeeping
description: After putting the two younger children to sleep and seeing her eldest son back to his room, Ma Xiulan called her husband Ma Zhiqiang to discuss in detail the daytime roof repair arrangements and the details of the newly established housing maintenance fund, and she received her husband's full approval. After hanging up, she soaked her feet to relieve fatigue, took out the family ledger to record the day's expenses, and for the first time entered "housing maintenance fund: 200 yuan," adding a new item to the family finances.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Pre-bedtime relaxation and a peaceful night's sleep
description: After soaking her feet, Ma Xiulan felt relaxed all over. She changed into pajamas and lay in bed, checking tomorrow's weather forecast on her phone. Seeing that the rain would stop and turn cloudy, she was relieved that Master Liu could come to fix the roof. She then browsed the handicraft group and replied to Aunt Wu's like. Recalling the day from panic to steadiness, she felt the preciousness of a stable family. She turned off the light with peace of mind and soon fell asleep.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Morning Baduanjin practice and acupressure
description: At 5:55 a.m., Ma Xiulan stretched her muscles in her own yard and practiced a full round of Baduanjin, paying special attention to the "Shake Head and Swing Tail" movement, and felt her lower back become more relaxed. Afterward, she massaged the Zusanli and Hegu acupoints for a few minutes, feeling a comfortable soreness in the acupoints.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (their own yard).

name: Community group practice and acupoint study
description: At 6:10, Ma Xiulan walked to the small community garden beside Jingwen Road and met Aunt Zhao. The two practiced Baduanjin together. Aunt Zhao then explained in detail the health-care techniques for the Zusanli, Hegu, and Fengchi acupoints. Ma Xiulan practiced on herself as she learned. Before parting, they agreed to meet again on Sunday morning to review.
location: Community garden beside Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing breakfast and doing housework
description: At 6:45, Ma Xiulan got home. She rinsed the rice and cooked millet porridge, and steamed buns and eggs. While waiting for the porridge, she soaked some laundry, dried the dishes and chopsticks from the previous night's washing, and tidied the kitchen counter.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (kitchen)

name: Wake up the children and arrange the day's plan.
description: At 7:15, after the children got up, Ma Xiulan called them to breakfast: millet porridge with steamed buns and eggs. At the table, she took out an old notebook and made a morning plan together with the children: Xuanxuan would study eighth-grade lessons at home and finish summer homework; Zhezhe and Xinxin would first play with building blocks and watch half an hour of cartoons, and clean up the desk before noon. She also emphasized taking them to the park for outdoor activities at 2 p.m.
location: No. 156, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (living room and dining room)

name: Prepare tools and greet Master Liu, the repairman.
description: At 7:50, Ma Xiulan swept the broken tiles and debris from the courtyard, boiled water and filled the large thermos, and set out paper cups and jasmine tea in the living room. At 8:20, the repairman, Master Liu, arrived on his modified tricycle. Ma Xiulan welcomed him into the courtyard and showed him the damage to the roof above the kitchen.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (courtyard and living room)

name: Assisted with roof repairs.
description: Master Liu set up a ladder and worked on the roof. Ma Xiulan handed him small tools from below, held the ladder, and periodically looked up to check progress. She swept the broken tile fragments that fell into the yard, and halfway through, poured more tea for Master Liu and brought out pickled cucumbers. Around 11:30, the waterproofing layer and new tiles were finished, and the roof looked brand new.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (rooftop, courtyard, and living room)

name: Lunch and lunch break.
description: After finishing work at 12 o'clock, Ma Xiulan invited Master Liu to have noodles with gravy at home, with minced pork and mushroom sauce and various toppings; the children also ate together. After the meal, she settled Master Liu's wages of 1,000 yuan (paid from the maintenance fund), cleaned up the dishes, then told Xuanxuan to look after the younger siblings and took a 25-minute nap on the living room sofa.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (dining room and kitchen)

name: Midday tidying up and getting ready to go out.
description: After waking up at 13:15, Ma Xiulan filled the children’s water cups with warm water, changed Xinxin into light thin trousers and put on a sun hat, changed into a clean cotton T-shirt herself, checked the change in her wallet and her phone, and restringed Xuanxuan’s badminton racket.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (living room and bedroom)

name: Take the children to Jinghai Park for outdoor activities.
description: Left at 13:45, walked 10 minutes to Jinghai Park. On the lawn, Xuanxuan played badminton with a junior high school student he happened to meet; Ma Xiulan took Zhezhe and Xinxin to the children's play area. Zhezhe went down the slide, and Xinxin swung on the swing. She pointed out the blooming Chinese roses and hollyhocks, teaching Xinxin to identify the flowers over and over.
location: Intersection of Diwei Road and Ruihe Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (Jinghai Park)

name: Strolling in the park and buying groceries along the way
description: At 15:15, the family walked slowly along the tree-lined path in the park, and the children picked up pretty leaves. Then they walked back, passing a vegetable stall by Jingwen Road, where Ma Xiulan bought a bunch of garlic scapes and two pieces of tofu.
location: Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (from Jinghai Park to the vegetable stall on Jingwen Road)

name: Visited her mother on the way
description: At 16:00, Ma Xiulan rode an electric bike to her parents' home with the children. Her mother, Li Xiuying, was delighted to see her grandchildren and brought out snacks and fruit. Ma Xiulan chatted with her mother about family matters and told her the roof had been repaired. After the children played with their grandmother for a while, they said goodbye and went home around 16:20.
location: No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing dinner
description: After getting home, Ma Xiulan had the children wash their hands and drink water, then went into the kitchen to prepare dinner. She planned to make stir-fried shredded pork with garlic scapes, mildly spicy mapo tofu, and steam a large plate of the meat-filled dumplings wrapped yesterday. The aroma of scallions and garlic sizzling in the wok gradually filled the kitchen.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (kitchen)

name: Family dinner
description: At 17:30, the dishes were served, and the children washed their hands and sat down on their own. The family ate and chatted, with the children vying to talk about what they had seen at the park. Xuanxuan mentioned that he didn't get to play basketball with the middle school students to his satisfaction and asked if they could go again tomorrow. Ma Xiulan smiled and agreed, reminding them to be safe.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (restaurant)

name: Tidying up the kitchen and family leisure time.
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan deftly washed the dishes, wiped the stove, and packed the leftovers. Around 19:00, she turned on the TV and watched the news with the children for a while, then spent some relaxing time with Xinxin drawing crayon pictures.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (kitchen and living room)

name: Supervising Zhezhe's homework and correcting his habits.
description: At 19:30, Ma Xiulan took Zhezhe to the small desk to do summer homework and moved a stool over to sit beside him and watch. Seeing that Zhezhe was slouching with his eyes too close to the book, she gently straightened his shoulders, demonstrated the correct sitting posture of one foot, one inch, one fist, and adjusted the angle of the desk lamp.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (the study in the second bedroom)

name: Help children wash up and tell bedtime stories
description: At 20:30, Ma Xiulan urged the three children to take turns bathing and brushing their teeth. At 21:00, after Xinxin lay down, she asked to hear a story. Ma Xiulan vividly told 'Little Bear Learns to Draw', and Xinxin soon fell asleep. Zhezhe and Xuanxuan also quietly settled down.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (bathroom and bedroom)

name: Embroidering round fans and wrist care.
description: After all the children had fallen asleep, Ma Xiulan took out the half-embroidered lotus round fan and, under the living room light, used the seed stitch technique to embroider the flower stamens. She controlled the force of each stitch. After about 40 minutes, her right wrist became sore and swollen, so she immediately stopped to flex her fingers and planned to cut down her embroidery time tomorrow.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (living room)

name: Soaking feet, applying warm compresses to wrists, and keeping household accounts.
description: At 22:00, Ma Xiulan brought hot water to soak her feet, while applying a hot towel to her sore right wrist and gently massaging it. She took out her notebook and recorded the day's expenses: roof repair 1,000 yuan, groceries 15 yuan, with a note about her happy mood from taking the children to the park and visiting her mother.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (living room and bedroom)

name: Going to bed
description: At 22:30, after soaking her feet, Ma Xiulan dried her hands and feet, applied hand cream, put on her wrist brace, turned off the light, and lay down. Thinking that the roof had been repaired and the children were settled, she felt at ease and soon fell into a peaceful sleep.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (master bedroom)

name: Morning Baduanjin and vegetable garden care
description: At 5:40 in the morning, Ma Xiulan got up, spread out her yoga mat in the living room, and began practicing Baduanjin. Because her right wrist was sore from yesterday, she deliberately reduced the range of arm raises, focusing on stretches for the lower back and legs, such as "Shake the Head and Wag the Tail to Remove Heart Fire" and "Hands Climb Feet to Strengthen Kidneys" to fully relax her body. After about 45 minutes of exercise, she went to the courtyard to tend the small vegetable garden, put away the dried chili peppers, watered the wilted cucumber seedlings, and picked a handful of fresh green onions for later use.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (home living room and courtyard)

name: Prepare breakfast and wake up the three children.
description: Ma Xiulan deftly cooked millet porridge in the kitchen, kneaded dough, chopped scallions, made a few scallion pancakes that were crisp outside and tender inside, and sliced pickled cucumbers. At 6:55, she went upstairs to wake the three children one by one: she reminded her eldest son Ma Mingxuan to bring the racket for his PE class, urged her second son Ma Mingzhe to check his homework, and gently helped her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin change into her kindergarten uniform.
location: Home kitchen and bedroom, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Warm family breakfast.
description: Husband Ma Zhiqiang had returned from a long trip yesterday and was resting at home today. The family of five sat around the dining table, drinking warm millet porridge and eating scallion pancakes and soy-sauce cucumbers. Ma Xiulan mentioned to her husband that Master Liu would be coming in the afternoon to collect the remaining payment for the roof repair, and she had the money ready. Ma Zhiqiang praised her pancake-making skill. The children chatted and laughed, and the atmosphere was warm and cozy.
location: Dining room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Take the children to school.
description: Ma Xiulan rode her electric bicycle to first take her second son, Ma Mingzhe, to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, reminding him to wait at the school gate after school. Then on the way she took her younger daughter, Ma Yuxin, to Huakang First Kindergarten. Xinxin said in a sweet, childish voice that she wanted to fold a paper airplane, and Ma Xiulan smiled and promised to look at the paper airplane when she picked her up. Only after watching the teacher lead Xinxin into the kindergarten did she leave.
location: Jinghai District, Tianjin, China, passing Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (18 Shengli South Street) and Huakang First Kindergarten (9 Huakang 2nd Road)

name: Buy groceries at the Wutong Commune vegetable market
description: After dropping off the children, Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market. She asked her acquaintance Aunt Sun to pick out two pork ribs, and also bought a bunch of water spinach, a few tomatoes, one Chinese yam, and a bunch of cilantro. Aunt Sun also gave her a few homegrown scallions. The groceries cost 72 yuan. She deliberately used only her small wallet, and the 1,000 yuan repair money in the hidden pocket of her apron was not touched at all. Then she rode home, washed and refrigerated the ribs, sorted the vegetables, and changed into old clothes for a thorough cleaning.
location: The Wutong Community vegetable market at No. 156 Jingzhong Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China, and the way home

name: Morning thorough house cleaning.
description: Ma Xiulan started her morning housework. She first put the clothes the three children had changed out of last night into the washing machine for a quick wash. While the laundry was running, she swept the living room and bedrooms, then mopped the floor with a wet mop until it shone. Afterwards, she went upstairs to collect the fluffy quilts that had been aired, folded them, and put them in the cupboard. When the washing machine stopped, she hurriedly took the clothes to the backyard to hang them out to dry.
location: Various places in the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Keeping accounts and preparing ingredients
description: Ma Xiulan sat at the square table in the central room, took out the family account book, and wrote in pen: "July 24, 2025, reserve 1,000 yuan for the final payment of roof repairs" and added an entry: "Family repair fund, reserve 200 yuan this month." After finishing the bookkeeping, she went to the kitchen to prepare dinner, peeled the Chinese yam, cut it into rolled chunks, soaked them in water, and blanched the pork ribs.
location: Main hall and kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Simple lunch and rest.
description: The children had lunch at school, and her husband was also home. Ma Xiulan made herself a bowl of plain noodle soup, added a poached egg, and ate it with soy-pickled cucumbers, feeling very comfortable. After the meal, she cleaned up the dishes and the stove, then changed into loose pajamas and lay in bed for about an hour with her eyes closed to rest. Although she did not fall completely asleep, she regained a lot of energy, and the soreness in her wrist almost disappeared.
location: Dining room and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Settlement of the final payment for roof repair
description: After the midday rest, Ma Xiulan took out the envelope containing 1000 yuan in cash and checked it, brewed some cold herbal tea, and put away the tools in the yard. At 13:30 Master Liu arrived on time, climbed onto the roof, and carefully inspected the newly replaced tiles and the waterproof layer. Ma Xiulan also went up to check it herself and, after confirming it was sturdy, came down satisfied. She counted out 1000 yuan from the envelope and handed it to Master Liu. Master Liu signed the receipt, pressed his fingerprint, and wrote, “Final payment for replacing the roof tiles at 156 Jingwen Road settled.” Ma Xiulan carefully tucked the receipt under the glass top of the coffee table.
location: The courtyard and rooftop of the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Rushing to make an embroidered round fan.
description: Taking advantage of the brief free time before picking up her youngest daughter, Ma Xiulan took out the half-finished lotus round fan, deliberately put on a wrist brace to protect her right wrist, and used the most effort-saving rolling stitch to slowly work along the petal outlines. After embroidering for about twenty minutes, she felt some fatigue in her wrist and immediately stopped, shook out her hand, and rested with a few sips of cold tea.
location: Home living room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Picking up the youngest daughter from school and preparing for exercise.
description: Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up Ma Yuxin after school. Xinxin ran to her mother holding up a folded paper airplane, and she happily praised her daughter. After getting home, she let Xinxin watch cartoons in the living room, then checked two badminton rackets, took out a new shuttlecock, and changed into a sweat-wicking T-shirt to prepare for playing with her eldest son later.
location: Huakang First Kindergarten, No. 9 Huakang 2nd Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China, and home at No. 156 Jingwen Road

name: Played badminton with the eldest son at Jinghai Park
description: After Ma Mingxuan came home from school, Ma Xiulan took him on her electric bicycle to Jinghai Park. The park was shaded by trees. The mother and son found an empty area to play badminton. Because her wrist felt sore, Ma Xiulan deliberately hit the shuttlecock to Xuanxuan so he would run around more. After about half an hour of activity, she sat on a bench to rest and let Xuanxuan practice bouncing the shuttlecock on his own.
location: Jinghai Park, at the intersection of Shengli Street and Fuxing Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Dinner preparation and family dinner
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan put the blanched spare ribs into a clay pot with ginger slices and scallion segments to simmer. Then she trimmed and washed water spinach, tomatoes, and Chinese yam. Around 17:45 she turned on two stove burners at once, stir-frying water spinach with sizzling garlic on one while cooking tomato and Chinese yam soup on the other. She also sprinkled goji berries and salt into the rib soup to season it. At 18:10 the food was served; her husband Ma Zhiqiang helped set out bowls and chopsticks. The family of five sat around the table, the children gnawed on ribs, and the adults put food on the kids' plates. The meal was lively and harmonious.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: After-dinner cleanup and homework tutoring
description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan quickly cleared the dishes and wiped down the stove. Then she went into the study and saw her second son Ma Mingzhe doing math homework. She sat down beside him to check it and found that the equation for a word problem was wrong, so she guided him to correct it on his own. She then spot-checked his Chinese character writing and praised Zhezhe for writing more neatly than yesterday.
location: Home kitchen and study, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Embroidering a lotus round fan in the evening.
description: After settling the children down, Ma Xiulan continued embroidering a lotus round fan under the soft light in the living room. She still wore her wrist guard and used the rolling-needle stitch to slowly work the thread, pausing every so often to rub her fingers and wrist. Her youngest daughter Xinxin ran over, leaned on her mother's legs, and asked when the lotus would bloom. Ma Xiulan smiled, tapped her nose, and said it would bloom once she fell asleep.
location: Home living room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Organizing receipts and family account books
description: Putting down her embroidery frame, Ma Xiulan went to the study. She carefully placed Master Liu's receipt for the final roof-repair payment into the receipt folder, and on the "Home Repairs" page of the ledger recorded 1000 yuan in expenses, noting the balance was fully settled. Under the "Family Repair Fund" column, she wrote the first reserved installment of 200 yuan. She felt she had a clear account in her mind and was very reassured.
location: Home study, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Evening wash-up and relaxation before bed.
description: Ma Xiulan first washed Xinxin's face and little feet and coaxed her into bed. Then she drew a basin of hot water, added mugwort essential oil to soak her feet, and the warm steam relaxed her whole body. While soaking her feet, she browsed through the photo album on her phone, planning to stop by "Jinghai Quick Print" on the street while buying groceries the next morning to print the photos from the trip to Beijing and make a photo wall. Afterward, she leaned against the headboard, opened her phone to watch embroidery stitch tutorial videos, and heard her two sons in the next room whispering about what snacks to bring tomorrow. She smiled and did not interfere.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Fell asleep peacefully
description: Ma Xiulan turned off her phone, left only a small night light on, and pulled up the thin quilt to cover herself. Listening to the occasional chirping of insects outside the window, she planned in her mind: the new tiles were sturdy and not afraid of rain, and the children would surely be happy when the photos were developed tomorrow... After going through the next day's plan once, her breathing gradually became even, and she fell into a peaceful sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Morning exercise and housework preparation
description: At 5:45 in the morning, Ma Xiulan laid out a yoga mat in the living room and did a simplified version of Baduanjin, paying special attention to gently rotating her wrists and stretching her neck and shoulders. After finishing, she put on a wrist brace and applied a hot towel to her right wrist. Then she quickly tidied the bed in the bedroom and sorted the children's changed clothes into the washing machine. While washing up, she applied sunscreen. Then she went to the small courtyard to water the tomatoes and water spinach and picked some spring onions.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare and enjoy breakfast
description: Ma Xiulan prepared breakfast in the kitchen: millet porridge in the rice cooker, steamed handmade flower rolls and eggs in the steamer, and sliced pickled cucumbers. Then she woke up the three children, Ma Mingxuan, Ma Mingzhe, and Ma Yuxin, urged them to wash up, and checked their school uniforms. The family sat around the table for breakfast, and Ma Xiulan told the children that today they would organize the photos from the first half of the year and look at them together in the evening.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Take the child to school and buy groceries.
description: Ma Xiulan first rode her electric bike to take her second son, Ma Mingzhe, to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, telling him to listen carefully in class. Then she took her daughter, Ma Yuxin, to Huakang First Kindergarten; the daughter happily waved goodbye. Afterwards, Ma Xiulan rode to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market and bought fresh ribs, water spinach, potatoes, and tomatoes at Aunt Sun's stall.
location: Jinghai District, Tianjin: cycling from home on Jingwen Road to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, and Wutong Commune Vegetable Market

name: Household cleaning and clearing out the old bookcase.
description: Ma Xiulan returned home, put away the vegetables, started the washing machine, and mopped the living room and bedroom floors. Then she went to the utility room, pulled out the unused old bookcase, emptied the old magazines and clutter, wiped it clean with a damp cloth, checked the cabinet door hinges, and planned to move it into the living room in the afternoon.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Select the best family photos from the first half of the year.
description: Ma Xiulan made jasmine tea, sat on the sofa, and opened the photo album on her phone and the digital camera memory card.
