From the photos taken from January to July, she carefully selected 20 precious moments, including her eldest son's report card, her second son blowing dandelion seeds, her youngest daughter holding up sweet pickled garlic, and the back view of her husband repairing furniture.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Simple lunch
description: Ma Xiulan reheated the leftover millet porridge and steamed rolls from the morning, had a simple lunch with pickled cucumbers, and thought about finishing the photo printing before picking up the child.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Midday rest and browsing handicraft videos
description: After lunch, Ma Xiulan lounged on the living room sofa and rested with her eyes closed for 20 minutes. When she woke up, she watched two short videos about the three-dimensional petal stitching method of Suzhou embroidery on her phone, and liked Aunt Wu's work in the handicraft group.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Print photos and purchase decoration materials.
description: Ma Xiulan copied the 20 selected photos to a USB drive, walked to Dongfanghong Photo Studio, and confirmed printing 5-inch matte photo paper, ready in about 30 minutes. While waiting, she browsed the nearby Fashion Stationery Bookstore. After picking up the photos, she stopped by the stationery store to buy three candy-colored stickers and two packs of photo corners, then walked home.
location: Dongfanghong Photo Studio at the intersection of Shengli Street and Jianshe Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and the Fashion Stationery Bookstore on Jianshe Road

name: Hand embroidery, picking up daughter, and accompanying her during the lunch break
description: Ma Xiulan put the photos and stickers on the coffee table. While waiting to pick up her daughter, she put on her wrist guard and embroidered a lotus round fan, using the rolling-needle stitch to embroider the lotus leaf stem. At 14:45 she left, rode her electric bike to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up her daughter Ma Yuxin. Her daughter showed her a colorful tree she had drawn. After returning home, she washed her daughter's face, coaxed her to lie down, told her two Andersen fairy tales, and after her daughter fell asleep, she closed her eyes and rested for 20 minutes.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and Huakang First Kindergarten

name: Preparing a family reading corner
description: After her daughter fell asleep, Ma Xiulan pushed the cleaned bookshelf to the empty wall by the window in the living room by herself, found Robinson Crusoe, Sanmao Wanders the World, and several picture books, and neatly placed them on the bottom shelf.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Picking up her second son from school and helping with homework
description: Ma Xiulan woke up her daughter and rode the bike together to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up her second son, Ma Mingzhe. On the way, her daughter talked about fun things at kindergarten. After picking up Ma Mingzhe, he reported that he scored 90 on his math quiz. Ma Xiulan praised him and said she would make braised pork ribs as a reward in the evening. After getting home, she had the children wash their hands and eat fruit, then start homework. Ma Xiulan checked Zhezhe's math homework and reminded him to add the units, while her daughter colored beside them.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School

name: Prepare a hearty dinner
description: Ma Xiulan tied on an apron and got busy in the kitchen. After blanching the pork ribs, she caramelized sugar and simmered them for 40 minutes to make red-braised ribs. She stir-fried garlic water spinach over high heat and quickly stir-fried hot and sour shredded potatoes. The aroma of the cooking filled the kitchen, and the children, tempted, ran over to look.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The whole family had dinner together.
description: Her husband Ma Zhiqiang rushed back, and the whole family gathered. At the table, Ma Xiulan brought up printing photos and setting up a reading corner. Ma Zhiqiang praised her craftsmanship, and the daughter picked shredded potatoes for her father, creating a warm and happy atmosphere.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Cleaning up the kitchen and tidying up after meals
description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan and her husband cleaned up the dishes together. He washed the dishes while she wiped down the stove and dining table, wrapped the leftovers in plastic wrap, and put them in the fridge. They worked in perfect coordination.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Decorate photo albums and set up a family reading corner
description: Ma Xiulan took out the printed photos, stickers, and photo corners, and fixed the photos onto the old album with her daughter using the photo corners. Her daughter chose flower stickers to decorate it. Then she called the whole family to the newly arranged reading corner and announced that 8:00 to 8:30 every evening would be family reading time, requiring everyone to read quietly for the first 15 minutes. The eldest son chose Robinson Crusoe, the second son took The Wandering Life of Sanmao, and her daughter pestered her mother to read Guess How Much I Love You. Ma Xiulan sat by the window and told her daughter the story.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Children's evening wash-up and bedtime settling
description: After reading time, Ma Xiulan urged her daughter to wash up and brush her teeth, and prepared warm water for her to wash her face and feet. After the daughter lay in bed, she used the story machine to play a bedtime story, kissed her forehead, and after the daughter fell asleep, quietly closed the door and left.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Soaking her feet while browsing photo albums to relax.
description: Ma Xiulan filled a basin with hot water, dropped in a mugwort pack to soak her feet. While soaking, she scrolled on her phone and flipped through the newly decorated old photo album, feeling full of contentment.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Recording expenses, taking photos as keepsakes, and relaxing before bed.
description: After soaking her feet, Ma Xiulan went to the study to record the day's expenses: 68 yuan for groceries, 22 yuan for photo printing, and 8 yuan for sticker photo corners. She was satisfied to see that both the reading corner and the family album were completed, and used her phone to take a commemorative photo of the new reading corner. Then she went back to the bedroom, changed into pajamas, did a simple leg stretch, savored the scene of the family reading together that evening, and turned off the light with a smile to go to sleep.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning exercise and getting ready
description: The sky was just beginning to lighten, and my biological clock woke me right on time at 5:30. Today I was going to my younger sister's home in Tanggu, so I felt especially light-hearted. I first rotated my right wrist - yesterday, while reorganizing the reading corner and moving books, it felt a bit sore and swollen, but it was much better than before. Carefully, without waking my little daughter Xinxin sleeping beside me, I got out of bed and walked to the window to check the sky. It was clear and cloudless - a perfect day for going out. Taking advantage of the quiet courtyard, I quickly did a set of Baduanjin. Today I paid special attention to the two movements "Holding Both Hands Up to Regulate the Triple Burner" and "Drawing the Bow to Shoot the Eagle" - I slowed down, slowly raised my palms, and stretched them outward, pulling at the old injury in my arm, and felt my sinews and bones stretch comfortably. The morning breeze blew over, carrying the fresh scent of the potted mint in the corner of the courtyard - it was extremely pleasant. After finishing the exercises, I went back inside and gave my luggage, packed the night before, one last check: the pickled vegetable gift box was securely placed in the cloth bag, and the children's sun hats and water bottles were all ready. I also took an empty eco-friendly shopping bag to hold the books I would borrow. After confirming everything was in order, I quickly washed my face with cold water and felt completely refreshed.
location: Home and courtyard at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Ma Xiulan got up at 05:40 and fell asleep at 23:50. She walked 8,235 steps and cycled 4.2 kilometers during the day. Her weight was 53.2 kg, and she slept for 7 hours and 10 minutes. Her stress score was 65, indicating that she felt anxious that day over social security matters but the issue was eventually resolved.
description: I started bustling around the kitchen. The millet porridge was bubbling on the stove, the jujube flower rolls steamed yesterday were warming in the steamer, and I took out a few pieces of homemade pickled cucumber and a small plate of fermented bean curd from the jar. In a spare moment, I sent my younger sister Xiufen a WeChat message: "Xiufen, we'll set off right after breakfast and arrive at Tanggu Station around 8:30. You can leave a bit later to pick us up." Then I added, "Don't spend too much on lunch—I've brought some pickled vegetables for you." After that, I went upstairs to wake my eldest son Xuanxuan and my second son Zhezhe. As soon as they heard we were going to their aunt's house, they scrambled out of bed and dressed themselves quickly. My youngest daughter Xinxin was still clinging to the blankets, so I gently tickled her and said, "Get up, quick—Aunt has bought you lots of snacks!" Only then did she rub her eyes and get up. I helped her put on her dress and told the three children, "When we get to Aunt's house today, be polite, listen to her, and don't run around." The four of us sat around the dining table. Xinxin sipped her millet porridge and asked, "Mommy, does Aunt have a little girl?" Zhezhe asked, "Is Aunt's house far from the sea? I want to see the sea!" As I peeled eggs for them, I answered with a smile, "You'll find out when we get there. Eat your fill first, so you'll have energy on the way."
location: Kitchen and dining room of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Getting ready and walking to the bus stop.
description: After breakfast, I checked each child's gear again: water cups and hats were all packed. I put on my small shoulder bag with my phone and change, and carried a big bag containing pickled vegetables and an empty cloth bag in one hand. Xuanxuan, being thoughtful, took the lighter cloth bag from me. I checked the doors, windows, and gas one last time, and after confirming everything was fine, locked the front door and set out with the three children. We walked to the bus stop on Shengli Street in Jinghai District. After a while, Xinxin said she was tired, so I carried her for a stretch, and Xuanxuan quickly took the bag from my hand. The morning air was fresh; we walked through familiar streets and greeted a few neighbors doing morning exercise. After about half an hour, we arrived at the bus stop on Shengli Street.
location: Along the route from No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin to Shengli Street bus stop

name: Taking the bus to Tanggu
description: The early bus to Tanggu arrived on time and wasn't crowded. We found seats by the window. The three children watched the fields and buildings rushing past outside and chattered excitedly about what they would play at their aunt's house. I sent Xiufen a message: “We're on the bus, we'll be there in about an hour.” Then I leaned back in my seat, looked at the scenery outside, and felt very relaxed.
location: On the bus from the Shengli Street bus stop, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to Tanggu Station.

name: Arrived at Tanggu Station and returned to younger sister's home to rest
description: The bus came to a smooth stop at Tanggu Station. As soon as I got off, I saw my younger sister Xiufen waving hard at me from the exit. She hurried over, smiled and called out “Sis!”, then, as if by magic, pulled a few packs of cookies and lollipops from her pocket and handed them to my three children. The children happily shouted “Auntie!”. Seeing my sister made me very happy too, and I handed her the pickled vegetable gift box, saying, “For you, homemade.” Xiufen’s home was not far from the station, about a fifteen-minute walk. The neighborhood was quiet and tree-lined. Along the way, the two sisters had endless things to talk about. When we arrived at Xiufen’s home, the three children stood in the living room looking around curiously. I told them to drink some water and wash their hands. I put the pickled vegetable gift box on the dining table and carried the duffel bag into the guest room. While the children sat on the sofa watching cartoons, I discussed with my sister: “What should we do today?” Xiufen said, “First, let’s go to Jinyuanbao to buy two outfits for the children, then have lunch at the mall. In the afternoon, when it’s cooler, we can take a walk along the Hai River. Is that okay?” I nodded in agreement.
location: Tanggu Station exit, No. 2543 Dalian Road, Binhai New Area, Tianjin, and Ma Xiufen's home (a residential area near Dalian Road, Binhai New Area).

name: Shopping and lunch at Jinyuanbao Mall
description: After a short rest, Xiufen suggested walking to Jinyuanbao Shopping Mall, saying it wasn't far, just across two streets. Once inside the mall, it was cool and lively. Xiufen pulled me straight to the children's clothing section. She has excellent taste: she picked a blue sports T-shirt for Xuanxuan, chose a handsome denim shorts set for Zhezhe, and bought a pink floral dress for Xinxin that she took a liking to at first sight. When the children tried them on, their faces beamed. I said, "You shouldn't have spent so much," but I remembered her kindness in my heart. Then Xiufen took the three children to the mall's children's play area, where they played on the slide and in the ball pit. We sat on the bench beside it, keeping an eye on the children while chatting about our own lives and how we were raising the kids. After the children had played to their hearts' content, Xiufen took us to the fifth floor of the mall to eat. We chose a home-style restaurant and, considering the children's tastes, ordered shredded pork in garlic sauce, scrambled eggs with tomatoes, sweet and sour pork, and a large serving of rice. The children, tired from playing, wolfed down their food and kept talking about the 'new friends' they had just made in the play area.
location: Jinyuanbao Commercial Building, 668 Jiefang Road, Binhai New Area, Tianjin.

name: Return to younger sister's home for an afternoon rest and organize borrowed books
description: After lunch, the sun outside was scorching. Carrying the new clothes we had bought for the children, we slowly walked back to my sister's house. Once home, Xiufen arranged for the three children to take their afternoon nap on the bed in the guest room. I wasn't sleepy, so while the children settled down, I told my sister about the newly arranged reading corner at home: "I cleared out the old bookcase and cleaned it. It's completely empty now, and I wanted to find some children's books to fill it, so the kids can do more reading when they come home." Xiufen immediately got excited: "Sis, wait! Our family has kept a lot of books from when Xuanxuan was little, and we never had the heart to throw them away!" With that, she opened an old bookcase in the study. I saw Andersen's Fairy Tales, Grimm's Fairy Tales, One Hundred Thousand Whys, Journey to the West (Children's Edition)... a dozen or so hardcover books in total, all preserved as good as new. Overjoyed, I quickly took out the eco-friendly cloth bag I had brought, carefully put the books in one by one, wrapped them up, and tied the bag tightly.
location: Ma Xiufen's home (residential area near Dalian Road, Binhai New Area, Tianjin).

name: Visit to Haihe Bund Park
description: A little after 2 p.m., I gently woke the drowsy children, urged them to use the bathroom and drink enough water, and personally put sunscreen on each child and put sun hats on them. Xiufen had also changed into light sandals, and we walked to the Haihe Bund Park. The wind blowing off the river carried moisture and felt very cool. The children chased each other and played on the wide walkway, shouting excitedly at the cargo ships and pleasure boats coming and going on the river. I walked along the railing of the Haihe River with Xiufen, chatting about funny stories from our childhood in our hometown of Jinghai and about how our husbands and children were doing, and we laughed constantly. I suggested, "Let's take a group photo in front of the 'Oriental Princess' — it will be something to remember." We found a passing tourist to help us, and with the famous cruise ship and the Haihe River Bridge as the background, we took the most precious group photo of the day. After walking around for over an hour, the children's faces were flushed and they were a bit tired, so we slowly headed back.
location: Haihe Bund Park in Tianjin Binhai New Area and the route back to Ma Xiufen's home

name: Helping prepare dinner and enjoying dinner
description: After returning home, Xiufen began preparing dinner. I volunteered to help in the kitchen, saying, 'You've worked hard today; let me help out!' I took the vegetables from her hands and quickly trimmed the green beans, washed the green peppers, and peeled garlic. Xiufen, meanwhile, heated the wok in front of the stove and stewed the pork ribs, and the kitchen soon filled with the aroma of the food. We chatted while we worked and cooperated smoothly, as if we had gone back to the days when we helped our mother cook as children. Dinner was very hearty. Xiufen brought out her signature dishes: braised pork ribs, stir-fried shrimp, and a plate of cucumber salad I helped make. Xiufen's husband Li Ming came home from work and greeted me warmly, and their daughter Li Yue quickly started playing with my three children, making the dinner table lively. The adults chatted as they ate and made tomorrow's plan: 'Tomorrow morning, let's go to Haihe River Bund Park again and take a good look around the Oriental Princess cruise ship. I hear there are exhibitions inside too!' The whole family talked and laughed, and the atmosphere was wonderfully cozy.
location: Ma Xiufen's home kitchen and dining room (a residential community near Dalian Road, Binhai New Area, Tianjin)

name: Post-meal casual chat and household chores
description: After the meal, Xiufen's husband Li Ming took the children to the living room carpet to build blocks and read picture books. Xiufen and I sat on the sofa, brewed a pot of jasmine tea, and chatted while folding and sorting the new clothes we had bought for the children today. Xiufen also taught me to use a mixture of vinegar and baking soda to clean the limescale in the kettle, saying it works really well. This leisurely time alone with my sister made me feel especially relaxed and happy.
location: Ma Xiufen's home living room (neighborhood near Dalian Road, Binhai New Area, Tianjin)

name: Washing up before bed and having a late-night chat with the sisters
description: It was getting late, and I began to get the children ready for bed. I first brushed the teeth of the youngest, Xinxin, washed her face, and coaxed her into her cartoon pajamas. Then I told Xuanxuan and Zhezhe to wash themselves properly. That night, Xuanxuan and Zhezhe shared a room with my aunt's son, while Xinxin slept with me in the guest room. After all the children were settled, I returned to the guest room, carefully took out the cloth bag of books I had borrowed today, wiped off any dust that might have gotten on the covers with a clean cloth, and neatly placed them on the nightstand, thinking about how I would arrange them on the bookshelf by size and type when I got home. Then I spread a towel on the floor and did a few minutes of simple leg stretches to relieve the fatigue from walking all day. After stretching, I took out my little ledger and a pen from my bag and made a brief note of today's expenses: round-trip bus fare for the whole family, 20 yuan. Although my younger sister had paid for lunch and the clothes, I kept it in mind. Just as I lay down, my sister Xiufen knocked gently on the door and poked her head in: 'Sis, you're not asleep yet?' I smiled and said not yet. She sat down on the edge of the bed and chatted with me about the details of going to the 'Oriental Princess' the next day. We talked for a long time, about the children and our parents, until we heard the even breathing of the children from the next room, and then she got up and returned to her own room. I lay in bed, thinking back on this fulfilling and warm day, my heart full of gratitude and satisfaction toward my sister, and soon drifted into a sweet sleep.
location: Ma Xiufen's home bathroom and guest room (a neighborhood near Dalian Road, Binhai New Area, Tianjin)

name: Morning exercise and wrist care
description: At 6:30 in the morning, in the courtyard of my sister's home in Lishuiyuan Community, Shanghai Road, Tanggu District, Binhai New Area, Tianjin, I started my daily exercise in the morning light. The air after the rain was especially fresh. I performed a simplified set of Baduanjin and deliberately slowed down movements such as “Two Hands Hold Up the Sky.” My nephew Xiaoyu watched curiously from the side, so I simply taught him a few basic stretching moves. After the exercise, I used a hot water bottle my sister provided to apply heat to my right wrist for about 5 minutes, then put on the wrist brace again to relieve the soreness from carrying heavy things while shopping yesterday.
location: Courtyard of Lishuiyuan Residential Community, Shanghai Road, Tanggu District, Binhai New Area, Tianjin

name: Shared breakfast with my younger sister's family and said goodbye
description: At exactly seven o'clock, the aroma of millet porridge and scallion pancakes wafted from my younger sister's kitchen. Our whole family sat around the dining table, including my sister Ma Xiufen, my brother-in-law Zhang Wei, and my three children Xuanxuan, Zhezhe, and Xinxin. The children chattered about the pretty clothes they had bought the day before. While eating breakfast, I carefully put the dozen or so children's books my sister had lent me into a sturdy canvas bag. After the meal, I said goodbye to my sister, and my brother-in-law reminded me of the way to the Bohai Oil bus stop. My sister thoughtfully stuffed boiled eggs and a few washed peaches into our bag for the journey.
location: Living room, Lishuiyuan Residential Community, Shanghai Road, Tanggu District, Binhai New Area, Tianjin

name: Going to the bus stop
description: After saying goodbye to my brother-in-law, I walked with the three children to the nearby Bohai Oil bus stop. Xinxin trotted along the way, while Zeze and Xuanxuan looked at the breakfast stalls as they walked. The distance was not far; it took about 10 minutes on foot.
location: Bohai Oil Bus Stop, Binhai New Area, Tianjin

name: Taking the bus back to her home in Jinghai
description: After arriving at Bohai Oil Bus Stop, we got on Bus No. 652 heading to Jinghai. There weren't many passengers, and the children leaned by the window looking at the scenery. Before long, Xinxin fell asleep in my arms. The bus swayed along, and after about an hour and 15 minutes, we got off at Shengli Street Station in Jinghai District.
location: Bus No. 652 (from Bohai Oil Bus Stop, Binhai New Area, to Shengli Street Stop, Jinghai District)

name: Arrived home, brief rest, and lunch preparation
description: At 9:05, we returned to our home at No. 156 Jingwen Road in Jinghai District. I first settled the children on the sofa to rest. I brought out the boiled eggs and peaches my younger sister had given us, cut two apples, and poured each person a glass of warm water so the children could take the edge off their hunger. I myself drank a large glass of water and felt completely at ease.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Organize children's books and decorate the family reading corner
description: After regaining energy in the morning, I began to organize the dozen or so children's books brought back from my younger sister's house. I took out the colorful star stickers I bought the day before yesterday and, together with the old books at home and the borrowed books, sorted them into categories: 'Animal Stories,' 'Fairy Tales and Fables,' and 'Knowledge Encyclopedia.' I had Xuanxuan and Zhezhe help pass the books to me, and I placed them one by one into the freshly cleaned small bookshelf. Xinxin helped stick stickers on the side, and although they were stuck on crooked, I still encouraged her. After finishing, I looked at the completely refreshed reading corner and felt very satisfied.
location: Living room reading nook, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparation and reminders before going out
description: I told Xuanxuan that, as the older brother, he should take care of his younger siblings at home, reading, writing, or drawing, and I told them I would be back around 11:30. I checked my phone and confirmed that Aunt Wu was at home, then took my keys and an empty cloth bag and went out.
location: Living room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Go to Aunt Wu's home to learn acupoint massage
description: I walked about 15 minutes to Aunt Wu's house, which is near my parents' home. Aunt Wu is an old friend of my mother's and lives at 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin. Aunt Wu greeted me warmly. This time I learned acupressure massage for shoulder and neck soreness. Aunt Wu explained the locations and pressing techniques of the 'Fengchi' and 'Jianjing' acupoints while demonstrating on her own hand. I studied seriously and, under Aunt Wu's guidance, practiced the pressing technique on my own wrist, jotting down the key points.
location: No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Stop by the vegetable market on the way to buy dinner ingredients
description: After saying goodbye to Aunt Wu, I went to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market on the way. At Aunt Sun's familiar stall, I bought baby bok choy, tomatoes, and a bunch of scallions. Then I bought fresh hand-rolled noodles at the noodle shop and a box of eggs at the grain and oil shop. I planned to make tomato and egg noodles with gravy for dinner—simple and to the children's liking.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Return home to prepare lunch and have a meal with the family
description: At about 11:50, I brought the ingredients home. The children were obediently sitting in the living room reading. I settled Xinxin down to play with toys and then threw myself into the kitchen. I washed and cut vegetables quickly, boiled water, and cooked noodles. I cut the tomatoes into chunks, stir-fried them until a red sauce formed, added water and let it simmer, then drizzled in the beaten eggs. A fragrant topping was ready. I rinsed the cooked noodles in cold water, poured the topping over them, and sprinkled with chopped scallions. The simple yet delicious lunch was ready. The whole family sat together and enjoyed this warm meal.
location: Kitchen and dining room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Took care of the youngest daughter and urged the eldest and second sons to study.
description: After lunch, I first gave my younger daughter Xinxin a hot bath. While bathing her, I asked Xinxin if she had fun today. After the bath, Xinxin was a little sleepy, so I lay in bed with her for half an hour, told her the story of The Three Little Pigs, which I had borrowed from my younger sister's family, and coaxed her to sleep. After that, I went back to the living room, urged Xuanxuan and Zhezhe to each finish their weekend homework, and checked it.
location: Living room and bedroom at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Clean up the kitchen, tidy the house, and contact her husband
description: While the children calmed down, I started cleaning the kitchen. I washed and put away the dishes, wiped down the stove and table, and then mopped the floor. After finishing these chores, I called my husband, who was on a long-distance trip, to tell him that I had returned from my younger sister's home in Tanggu today, that the children were all doing well, and that he should rest assured and take care to rest while away.
location: Kitchen and living room at No. 156, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Mugwort foot soak and relaxation
description: After being busy for most of the day, this is the moment I enjoy most. I boiled a pot of water, added a few dried mugwort leaves, mixed in warm water, and began soaking my feet. I leaned back on the living room sofa, scrolling through handicraft videos on my phone while soaking my feet. The children were playing with building blocks on the living room carpet, and the atmosphere was warm and peaceful. After soaking my feet, I felt completely revived.
location: Living room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family reading corner time
description: After soaking my feet, I called the children over to the sofa in the reading corner. I took the copy of Andersen's Fairy Tales my younger sister had borrowed from the shelf, opened to "The Little Mermaid," and read it to the children in a gentle voice. Xuanxuan and Zhezhe each picked up a science book and a storybook they were interested in and quietly flipped through them. This is our family's unshakable parent-child time.
location: Living room reading nook, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Planning tomorrow's tasks and family bookkeeping
description: While the children were washing up, I used the memo app on my phone to briefly sketch out a script for recording the pickled vegetables video, planning to try it tomorrow morning. I sent Aunt Wu a WeChat message thanking her for today's instruction and arranged to go learn new stitching techniques next week. After that, I took out the family ledger and recorded today's grocery expenses (hand-pulled noodles, greens, eggs, etc., totaling 35 yuan), and also checked the 200 yuan set aside for the monthly housing maintenance fund.
location: Living room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Bedtime embroidery time.
description: Xin Xin fell asleep listening to a story, and Xuan Xuan and Zhe Zhe also returned to their own rooms. I turned off the main light, leaving only a small bedside lamp on. I picked up the lotus round fan that was a little less than half embroidered, put on my wrist guard, and calmed down to embroider stitch by stitch. Tonight I embroidered a few lotus leaves and mulled over the script for tomorrow's pickled vegetable video. Moonlight streamed through the window into the room, especially peaceful.
location: Bedroom at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Washed up and went to bed
description: After embroidering for about half an hour, I felt my right wrist getting a bit sore, so I put away the needlework. I got up, went to the bathroom to wash up, and then applied basic skincare products. Back in bed, I sent a WeChat message to my younger sister Xiufen to report that I was safe: "I'm home, the kids are all asleep. The kids loved the children's books, and we also ate the eggs and peaches you gave us. Tired but happy." After sending the message, I set the alarm for 5:40 tomorrow morning, and with a sense of fulfillment and satisfaction, I soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning wake-up and Baduanjin.
description: At 05:30 in the morning, the sound of cicadas started outside the window. Ma Xiulan got up, laid out a mat in the living room, and began doing Baduanjin. She deliberately exercised her right wrist, which had been sore before, and stretched fully with every movement. Finally, she massaged her Zusanli and Hegu acupoints, feeling refreshed and clear-headed, and got the day off to a good start.
location: Home living room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing the family breakfast
description: After a quick wash, Ma Xiulan kneaded dough and chopped filling in the kitchen, steamed buns stuffed with pork and cabbage, while also starting another pot to cook millet porridge and cutting pickled vegetables. In the gaps, she checked the three children’s schoolbags and clothes to make sure nothing was missing.
location: Home kitchen, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Wake up, wash up, and have breakfast
description: At 06:30, Ma Xiulan woke Ma Mingxuan, Ma Mingzhe, and Ma Yuxin one by one, and urged the three to wash up and sit around the table. The family enjoyed steaming hot steamed buns and millet porridge. Ma Xiulan reminded Xuanxuan not to be late for school on Monday and crumbled a fried egg into Xinxin's porridge. After the meal, she quickly cleared the dishes and got ready to go out.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, her own home

name: Taking children to school, buying groceries, and tidying up after returning home.
description: At 07:15, Ma Xiulan took Ma Mingzhe and Ma Yuxin out on her electric bike. She first took ZheZhe to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School and told him to listen carefully in class; then took Xinxin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten. On the way back, at Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, she bought white radish, scallions, eggplant, and soft tofu from Aunt Sun, the vegetable vendor. After returning home, she put the vegetables into the refrigerator by category and quickly swept the living room and kitchen floors.
location: From No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, and Wutong Commune Vegetable Market on Shengli South Street, Jinghai District

name: Recorded a short video of making pickled radish
description: Ma Xiulan set up her phone stand in the kitchen, washed the white radishes, and explained while cutting them into pieces, demonstrating the whole process of salting to draw out water, sun-drying, mixing the sauce, and sealing the jars. She repeatedly adjusted the angle and volume, and finally produced a smooth video of over 3 minutes, which she sent to the "Jinghai Sisters Handmade Pickle Workshop" WeChat group with a caption introducing the new pickled radish.
location: Home kitchen, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Aunt Wu privately messaged to share techniques and had an in-depth exchange.
description: After the video was posted, Aunt Wu sent Ma Xiulan a private WeChat message with tips for washing radishes (soak them in salt water before scrubbing so your hands don't get irritated). Ma Xiulan immediately tried it in the kitchen and sent a photo to thank her. The two chatted about pickles, family matters, and embroidery. Aunt Wu said she wanted to see the embroidery works in person after the weather turned cool, and Ma Xiulan enthusiastically agreed.

participant.name: Aunt Wu
participant.relation: Friends from the pickled vegetable group and embroidery enthusiasts

location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, her own home

name: Prepare lunch and Xuanxuan coming home.
description: At 11:00, Ma Xiulan put down her phone and started preparing lunch: she cut eggplant, heated steamed buns, and cooked seaweed egg drop soup. At 12:00, Ma Mingxuan came home from school, and Ma Xiulan asked him to wash his hands and get ready to eat.
location: Home kitchen, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Lunch and midday conversation
description: Mother and son chatted over lunch. Xuanxuan mentioned doing a friction experiment in physics class, and Ma Xiulan told him to take his homework seriously. After the meal, Xuanxuan helped clear the dishes.
location: Home dining room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Lunch break and confirming the production schedule.
description: Ma Xiulan lay in bed to rest for about half an hour. During that time, she contacted her business partner Zhou Xiuqin via WeChat to confirm that the next day's shift schedule for the pickled vegetable workshop was correct. Only after receiving a reply did she feel at ease and close her eyes to rest for half an hour.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin - home bedroom

name: Doing laundry and organizing household affairs
description: After the lunch break, Ma Xiulan put the dirty clothes in the washing machine for a quick wash, while wiping down the living room coffee table and TV cabinet and tidying up scattered toys to restore the home to order.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, her own home

name: Embroidery crafts and rest.
description: After finishing a round of housework, Ma Xiulan took out the almost-finished lotus round fan embroidery, sat by the window where the light was good, and stitched the last few lotus leaf textures stitch by stitch, planning to finish at 16:00.
location: Home living room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare to pick up the children and pick them up after school
description: Ma Xiulan put away her embroidery early, took out pork ribs from the refrigerator to thaw, grabbed her keys, and at 16:00 rode her e-bike to Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up Ma Yuxin, listening to Xinxin recite a new nursery rhyme she had learned. Then she went to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up Ma Mingzhe. Zhezhe, covered in sweat, said he had just played basketball. The three of them—mother and two children—rode home together on the e-bike.
location: Huakang First Kindergarten in Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School on Shengli South Street, Jinghai District; 156 Jingwen Road

name: Preparing dinner, family dinner, and after-dinner cleanup.
description: Back home, Ma Xiulan blanched and braised the pork ribs, simmering them over low heat, while stir-frying Shanghai bok choy. At 18:00, her husband Ma Zhiqiang came home after finishing his shift, and the family sat around the table for dinner, sharing stories about school and work. After the meal, Ma Xiulan cleared the table, washed the dishes, and cleaned the stove by herself.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, her own home

name: Family free time
description: After dinner, Ma Mingxuan went to his room to do homework, Ma Mingzhe watched cartoons in the living room, Ma Yuxin pestered her father to read picture books, and Ma Xiulan sat in the courtyard in the breeze, replying to messages in the pickled vegetables group and browsing local news.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, her own home

name: Keep up family reading time
description: At 20:00, Ma Xiulan turned off the TV and gathered the three children in the newly arranged reading corner, emphasizing that they should be quiet and focused. Ma Mingxuan read 'One Hundred Thousand Whys', Zhezhe and Xinxin flipped through picture books, and Ma Xiulan shared the little story behind 'Dongpo Pork' while reading a home-style cookbook, sparking hushed discussion.
location: Reading corner in the living room of her home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Supervise washing up and getting ready for bed
description: After reading, Ma Xiulan urged the three children to wash up one by one. She helped Xinxin brush her teeth and wash her face, checked whether Zhezhe had washed his feet, and reminded Xuanxuan to lie down early, making sure the children went to bed.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, her own home

name: Contacting Zhou Xiuqin and doing a foot soak
description: After the children went to sleep, Ma Xiulan soaked her feet in hot water with a mugwort bag, and at the same time used a WeChat voice message to confirm with her partner Zhou Xiuqin that the production schedule for the next day was fine, receiving a confirmation reply from her.
location: Home bathroom, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Late-night heart-to-heart chat with Aunt Wu and preparing ingredients for tomorrow.
description: After soaking her feet, Ma Xiulan lay in bed and continued chatting with Aunt Wu on WeChat, from radish washing techniques to funny stories from their younger days. Aunt Wu once again said she would come over to see the embroidery when the weather turns cool in autumn, and Ma Xiulan warmly invited her. They chatted until nearly 22:00, then she got up to check the ingredients for tomorrow's breakfast. Seeing there were noodles, she decided to make clear noodle soup with a poached egg, washed the greens and had everything ready, then went back to the bedroom reassured.

participant.name: Aunt Wu
participant.relation: Friends from the pickled vegetable group and embroidery enthusiasts

location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, her own home

name: Pre-sleep relaxation and bedtime
description: After returning to the bedroom, Ma Xiulan leaned against the headboard and browsed her phone for a while longer, finally confirming that the scheduling details for the pickled vegetable workshop were correct. At 23:20, she turned off the bedside lamp and fell asleep with a sense of fulfillment and security, full of hope for her new habits and the promotion of the pickled vegetables.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin - home bedroom

name: Morning exercise, breakfast, and chatting with neighbors.
description: After getting up at 6:10, she first practiced Baduanjin in the small courtyard and greeted Sister Wang from across the street. Then she went into the kitchen to prepare breakfast: she made soy milk from the soaked soybeans, heated steamed buns, and cut a small dish of homemade pickled mustard greens. While the soy milk was cooking, she took her teacup to the courtyard gate and chatted with Grandma Zhang, 76, from next door, reminding her that there might be afternoon showers. At 7:10 she went back inside and woke the three children, Ma Mingxuan, Ma Mingzhe, and Ma Yuxin, for breakfast. While serving the soy milk, she told them to bring their water bottles in the hot weather and not to drink unboiled water. Yuxin praised the soy milk for being fragrant.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (her residence and courtyard gate)

name: Take the children to school and chat along the way.
description: Rode the e-bike out with Mingzhe and Yuxin. Dropped Mingzhe off at Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School on Shengli South Street at 7:30, and Yuxin at Huakang First Kindergarten at 7:35. On the way home, passing Wang Guilan's house on Jingwen Road, she saw Wang Guilan watering flowers and stopped to chat. Wang Guilan thanked Ma Xiulan for sharing the pickled vegetable recipe. Ma Xiulan promised to bring her some sour plum soup in the afternoon, and they agreed to make tomato paste together on Friday afternoon.
location: 158 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (in front of Wang Guilan's house, passing Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten)

name: Rushing to make a lotus round fan and doing household chores
description: After returning home, she changed into casual clothes and sat in the best light under the east window. Using rolling stitch and seed stitch techniques, she carefully worked on the lotus round fan customized for Ms. Li, completing the outlines of the last few lotus leaves, then embroidered the golden stamens stitch by stitch with seed stitch. In between, she got up twice to drink water, conveniently washed the breakfast dishes and utensils, and put the clothes the children had changed out of into the washing machine.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (at her embroidery frame under the east window at home)

name: Prepare and enjoy lunch.
description: She put down her embroidery and went into the kitchen. Using leftover winter melon from yesterday, rehydrated wood ear mushrooms, and sausage, she made a stir-fried dish of winter melon slices and wood ear mushrooms. At 11:50, her eldest son Mingxuan came home from school on his bicycle, and the mother and son had lunch together in the living room. Ma Xiulan asked about the morning's classes. Mingxuan said buoyancy in physics was a bit tricky, and Ma Xiulan encouraged him to ask the teacher more questions and listen carefully in class.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home kitchen and living room)

name: Noon break
description: After dinner, Mingxuan returned to school. After cleaning up the dishes, Ma Xiulan went to the bedroom to lie down and rest, thinking about the afternoon arrangements. She only dozed for forty minutes and woke up at 12:50 feeling fairly well.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home bedroom).

name: Simmering sour plum drink and getting ready to go out.
description: After waking up, she saw it was overcast and remembered the forecast said there would be showers, so she quickly folded the clothes that had been dried and brought in earlier that morning. Then she went into the kitchen, mixed sour plum paste with cold water, added rock sugar, and simmered a big pot of refreshing sour plum drink over low heat. She ladled out a full enamel mug to give to Wang Guilan, and also folded a rain poncho and put it in the electric bike basket for later.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (own kitchen and yard)

name: Food market shopping and finalizing the tomato sauce plan
description: Rode an electric bike to the Wutong Commune vegetable market at 13:40 and bought fresh spareribs, baby bok choy, and Chinese yam at Sun Guifang's stall. Then she stopped by Wang Guilan's house at 158 Jingwen Road on the way, bringing a sour plum drink in an enamel mug. Wang Guilan happily accepted it and gave her a few tender cucumbers in return. The two immediately agreed to make a large batch of tomato sauce together on Friday afternoon, with the children also joining in to help.
location: No. 158, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (Wang Guilan's home; first go to the Wutong Commune vegetable market to shop)

name: Finishing embroidery, recording an instructional video, preparing food, and resting
description: Back home, she first soaked the ribs in water to remove the blood. Then, under the east window, she finished embroidering the last few flower stamens on the round fan and carefully checked it to confirm there were no flaws, fully completing it. Remembering that she had to teach Zhou Xiuqin seed-stitch embroidery, she picked up her phone, set it in a well-lit spot beside the pomegranate tree in the small courtyard, recorded a clear one-minute teaching video, and sent it to her. After that, she went to the kitchen to prepare dinner: blanched the ribs, cut the winter melon into chunks, and peeled and sliced the yam. After 15:00, she moved a small folding stool under the pomegranate tree to rest, replied to messages in the pickle group, and watched the loofahs filling the courtyard and the reddening tomatoes, feeling at peace.
location: No. 156, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (own home and small courtyard)

name: Pick up the child from school
description: Ride the electric bike first to Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up Yuxin, then to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up Mingzhe. On the way home, Yuxin happily talked from the back seat about the braised pork she had at kindergarten lunch, while Mingzhe boasted about the braised lion's head meatballs from the school cafeteria.
location: Along Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (from Huakang First Kindergarten to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School)

name: Parent-child time and preparing dinner
description: As soon as they got home, the children started running around happily in the yard. Ma Xiulan rinsed the rice and put it on to cook while telling Mingzhe to fetch water and water the green beans. Yuxin also came over and used a small hose to spray the roots of the loofah vines, splashing water everywhere. The pork rib soup simmered slowly on the stove, and the aroma of meat filled the yard.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (family courtyard and kitchen)

name: The whole family had dinner together.
description: When Mingxuan came home from school, the family gathered around the dining table in the living room. Dinner included winter melon and pork rib soup, stir-fried baby bok choy, and a cucumber salad made from the tender cucumbers Wang Guilan had given them. The two younger children were delighted and drank two big bowls of rib soup, their little faces flushed.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (own living room)

name: Cleaning up after the meal and family free time
description: She had the children go out into the yard to walk off their meal. Ma Xiulan quickly washed the dishes, wiped down the stove and range hood, and boiled water to prepare the foot bath bucket and medicine packet. Then she went back to the living room, where Mingxuan returned to his room to do homework, Mingzhe watched the animated show Boonie Bears, and Yuxin played with building blocks. Ma Xiulan sat nearby, sorting the new embroidery floss patterns she planned to stitch tomorrow by color and winding them onto thread boards.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home kitchen and living room)

name: Family Reading Time
description: Turned off the TV right on time, and the whole family sat in the reading corner of the living room. Mingxuan continued to read the original Journey to the West, Mingzhe flipped through the Father and Son comic, and Ma Xiulan held Yuxin on her lap and told the story “The Little Horse Crossing the River,” asking questions as she told it. Yuxin tilted her head and answered, “You have to try it yourself to know.”
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (reading corner in the living room at home)

name: Supervising the children washing up and going to bed
description: After reading, she urged the children to wash up. She squeezed toothpaste onto Yuxin's toothbrush, urged Mingzhe to stop dawdling and finish washing quickly and get into bed, and reminded Mingxuan to finish his homework and go to sleep early. Once all three children were lying down, she turned off the lights one by one.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home bathroom and bedroom)

name: Soaking feet and organizing the pickle production ledger
description: Finally, it was her own time. She soaked her feet comfortably in hot water. She took out her account book and the pickled vegetable production ledger, first recorded the 33 yuan spent today on groceries and pork ribs, then turned to a new page to tally this month's pickled vegetable output, number of bottles sold, and the records of division of labor with Wang Guilan and Zhou Xiuqin.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home bedroom).

name: Communicated about scheduling via WeChat.
description: Still soaking her feet, she sent Zhou Xiuqin a WeChat message on her phone with the sorted next week's duty roster for her to check and adjust. Zhou Xiuqin quickly replied that she had received it and thanked her for the previously sent seed-stitch embroidery tutorial video, praising it as very clear and practical.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home bedroom).

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: After soaking her feet and pouring out the footbath water, her whole body felt warm and the day's fatigue melted away. She walked to the window and looked at the pomegranate tree's shadow in the moonlight, then got into bed and opened her phone to check tomorrow's weather forecast. Reflecting on the day, although busy, every task was done with care, and life felt full of flavor. She turned off the light and went to sleep at 22:50.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home bedroom).

name: Get up and prepare for morning exercise
description: At 05:50 in the morning, Ma Xiulan woke up naturally. The sky was bright and it was a sunny day. She remembered that today she would complete the last Baduanjin practice of July, and felt a sense of ritual. She changed into light sportswear and cloth shoes, washed up quickly, and went out refreshed.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Morning Baduanjin exercise with Aunt Zhao to say goodbye to July
description: At 06:00, Ma Xiulan arrived on time at the community garden beside No. 156 Jingwen Road. Aunt Zhao was already stretching. The two faced the morning light and practiced the complete Baduanjin twice, then pressed each other's Zusanli acupoints. Aunt Zhao encouraged her: “Xiulan, this is our last practice in July. Let's continue next month!” Ma Xiulan smiled and agreed, feeling reluctant to see their days of exercising together end.
location: Community garden on the east side of the intersection of Jingwen Road and Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare breakfast and wake up the children
description: After morning exercise, Ma Xiulan hurried back to the kitchen at home, used the dough proofed overnight to make steamed buns, and cooked millet porridge. Hearing birds chirping outside the window, she worked while planning the day's tasks. At 06:40, she urged the children to get up, put two pigtails in her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin's hair, placed a washed pear in her son Ma Mingzhe's schoolbag, and reminded him to be careful in PE class.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Riding an e-bike to take the children to school and buying groceries on the way
description: At 07:40, Ma Xiulan set off on her electric bike carrying her daughter and son. She first dropped Ma Mingzhe off at Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, and then took Ma Yuxin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten. On the way back, she stopped by Wutong Gongshe Vegetable Market and bought cucumbers, water spinach, and tofu at Aunt Sun's stall. Aunt Sun praised the freshness of the cucumbers. At 08:25, she returned home fully loaded.
location: Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District; Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Huakang Street; Wutong Community vegetable market

name: Complete the handmade lotus round fan and deliver it to Ms. Li.
description: Ma Xiulan finished the last few seed-stitch stitches on the round fan at home, carefully ironed it smooth with a steam iron, leaving every texture exquisite and clear. At 09:20 she contacted Ms. Li and agreed to meet at 09:45 at the old bookstall on the corner of Jingwen Road. She changed into a floral blouse, put the fan in a cloth bag, and arrived early. Ms. Li was full of praise for the round fan, complimenting her exquisite craftsmanship, and paid 60 yuan for the labor. Ma Xiulan responded modestly, feeling grounded and content.
location: Next to the used book stall at the southeast corner of the intersection of Jingwen Road and Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Go home, put away the ingredients, and prepare lunch
description: After delivering the round fan, Ma Xiulan returned home in a cheerful mood, put away the vegetables and tofu she had bought, and took out the old hen from the refrigerator to thaw, planning to make chicken soup at noon.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: On WeChat, guided her younger sister in making pickled radish and stewed old hen soup.
description: Ma Xiulan first sent a WeChat message to her younger sister Ma Xiufen, who lives in Binhai, sharing a homemade pickled radish video tutorial with text instructions. Then she started making soup: she cleaned and blanched an old hen, put it in a clay pot with ginger slices and red dates, and simmered it slowly over low heat. Gradually the aroma of chicken soup filled the house.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Having lunch with eldest son Ma Mingxuan and asking about his studies
description: At 11:30, Ma Mingxuan, a second-year junior high school student, came home from school. Ma Xiulan served chicken soup, cucumber salad, and stir-fried water spinach. During the meal, she asked her son how well he understood the physics knowledge point about buoyancy. He replied that he had understood it by drawing diagrams. She was very gratified and told him to stay energetic in the afternoon.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Afternoon rest and simple housework.
description: After finishing the post-meal cleanup, Ma Xiulan put her son down for a nap, then went back to her room to lie down for about half an hour to recharge. After getting up, she tidied the living room, checked the memo on her phone, and noted the arrangement to make tomato sauce with Wang Guilan on August 1.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Handmade an eye-care certificate and organized clothing.
description: While the children were napping and the house was quiet, Ma Xiulan used red paper and scissors to make three certificates of merit. She wrote “Eye-Protection Little Guardian,” “Good-Posture Little Model,” and “Outdoor Little Expert” on them for her three children, praising their progress in following the family eye-protection rules over the past two months. Afterward, she also folded the clothes washed the previous day and put them in the wardrobe.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Resting in the yard and checking the WeChat handmade pickled vegetable group
description: After finishing the housework, Ma Xiulan rested and drank water under the pomegranate tree in the courtyard. She browsed the WeChat group "Jinghai Sisters Handmade Pickle Workshop," read everyone's discussion about the new pickled vegetables for next quarter, and liked the photo of spicy cabbage shared by Aunt Wu.
location: In the courtyard at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Rode her electric bike to pick up the two children from school.
description: At 15:50, Ma Xiulan set off on her electric bike. She first went to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up the delighted Ma Mingzhe, who boasted that his long jump score in PE class was the farthest in the class. Then she went to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up her daughter Ma Yuxin, who happily said her teacher had praised her drawing. Ma Xiulan rode home with the two children cheerfully.
location: Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and Huakang First Kindergarten, Huakang Street

name: Prepare dinner while humming a tune.
description: After arriving home, Ma Xiulan started busy preparing dinner: she reheated the leftover chicken soup from noon, made a cold dish with the newly bought cucumber and tofu, and stir-fried a plate of water spinach. While cutting vegetables, she hummed a tune from “Liu Sanjie,” looking forward to her movie date that evening with her childhood friend Liu Chunmei.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family-of-four dinner and reminders to the children.
description: At 18:00, the family of four sat down to dinner on time. Ma Xiulan served rice to the children while reminding her eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, to look after his younger siblings at home that evening as they did their homework and to protect their eyes; she would be going out to watch a movie.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Watched the open-air movie Liu Sanjie with childhood friend Liu Chunmei.
description: At 18:30, Ma Xiulan brought home-roasted sunflower seeds and two small folding stools and walked to the fitness square on Dongfanghong Road. After meeting her childhood friend Liu Chunmei, the two chatted about old times while cracking sunflower seeds, laughing nonstop. At 20:00, the public welfare film Liu Sanjie began. Amid the folk songs, the two were immersed in memories, slapping their thighs and laughing at the exciting parts. After the show, they cleaned up the sunflower seed shells together and agreed to meet again. After saying goodbye, Ma Xiulan walked home.
location: Dongfanghong Road Fitness Plaza, west of the intersection of Dongfanghong Road and Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Award the children eye-care certificates and reaffirm the eye-care rules
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan called the three children, who had washed up, to the living room and solemnly presented the certificates made that afternoon: Ma Yuxin received the "Little Eye-Protection Guard", Ma Mingxuan received the "Little Sitting-Posture Model", and Ma Mingzhe received the "Little Outdoor Expert". The children were extremely excited, and Ma Mingzhe took the initiative to paste the certificate on the wall. Ma Xiulan took the opportunity to once again stress the importance of eye protection.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Soak feet to relax, record expenses, and wash up.
description: After the children fell asleep, Ma Xiulan boiled water to soak her feet. The hot water soothed the day's fatigue. With her eyes closed, she savored fragments of Liu Sanjie and considered participating in more community activities in the future. After soaking her feet, she took out her ledger and recorded the day's handicraft income of 60 yuan, then washed up.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Remind the son before going to bed and then rest
description: At 22:30, Ma Xiulan changed into her pajamas, went to Ma Mingxuan's door, and reminded her son, who was still reading, to go to bed early. After getting a response, she returned to her own bedroom, thought back on the fulfilling and steady day, and gradually fell asleep to the sound of crickets outside the window.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning courtyard exercise and brisk walking
description: Woke up at 5:20 a.m., first did shoulder and neck stretches on the kang, then went to the courtyard and did a full set of Baduanjin. Her younger daughter Ma Yuxin was attracted out, and Xiulan taught her the movement 'Hold the Hands High to Regulate the Triple Burner'. The daughter imitated it quite well. After that, she walked briskly alone along the tree-lined avenue on Jingwen Road for 15 minutes, breathing in the fresh air and planning the day's schedule.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and the nearby tree-lined section of Jingwen Road

name: Prepare breakfast and wake up the family.
description: After returning from her brisk walk, Ma Xiulan quickly prepared breakfast in the kitchen: millet porridge, boiled eggs, and cucumber salad; the steamed buns had been steamed the night before. At 6:30, she woke her husband Ma Zhiqiang and their three children one by one, urged them to wash up, and started the new day.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Breakfast and school drop-off.
description: The family sat around eating breakfast. At 7 o'clock, Ma Xiulan cleared the dishes, rode her electric bike out with the three children. At 7:15 she first took Ma Mingzhe to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, at 7:25 she turned back to take Ma Yuxin to Huakang First Kindergarten, and the eldest son Ma Mingxuan went to school on his own.
location: Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Grocery shopping at the vegetable market and supermarket.
description: After dropping off the children, Ma Xiulan went by the Wutong Commune Vegetable Market and bought pork ribs, winter melon, tomatoes, and greens. To make tomato sauce with her neighbor Wang Guilan tomorrow, she then went to Jingbai Supermarket and bought 3 glass jars with lids and 2 jin of rock sugar.
location: Tianjin Jinghai District Wutong Commune Vegetable Market; Jingbai Supermarket, Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Putting away purchases and morning housework
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan put away the vegetables and items, poured a glass of water for her husband, and drank some warm tea to rest under the pomegranate tree in the yard. Then she started the morning chores: first she washed a large basin of clothes, then swept the floor, wiped the tables, and tidied the living room. Finally, she went to the courtyard to water the pomegranate tree and flower beds and pulled weeds from the vegetable beds.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Vegetable garden picking and sauce-making preparations
description: Ma Xiulan went to the vegetable garden to check the tomatoes, picked more than a dozen fully red ones for later use, and also picked some green beans and cucumbers. While watering and weeding, she taught little Yuxin, who was playing nearby, to recognize the vegetable seedlings. After she went back inside and hung up the laundry, she played the folk song “Liu Sanjie” on her phone, and while listening, she washed and drained the glass bottles and lids she would use to make pickles the next day.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Call her parents.
description: Taking advantage of a free moment, Ma Xiulan called her parents who live on Shengli Avenue, asked about their health, told them about her plan to make tomato sauce with Sister Wang tomorrow, asked whether she should make some for them as well, and reminded them to add more clothes as autumn sets in.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare and enjoy lunch
description: At 11 o'clock, Ma Xiulan began preparing the hand-rolled noodles with three-delicacy gravy that her husband had been craving for days. She kneaded the dough, let it rest, rolled it out, and cut it into noodles with quick, deft movements. At 12 o'clock, her eldest son Ma Mingxuan arrived home early from school, and the family of three (Ma Xiulan, her husband Zhiqiang, and Mingxuan) had lunch together. At the table, she asked about Mingxuan's physics studies and encouraged him to ask more questions and practice more.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Midday nap
description: After the meal, having cleaned up the kitchen, Ma Xiulan leaned on the living room sofa and rested with her eyes closed for half an hour to store up energy for the afternoon.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Afternoon crafts and preparations for picking up the children
description: After a short rest, Ma Xiulan took out her sewing basket and began embroidering patterns for shoe insoles, listening to folk mountain songs while she worked. At 14:30 she took down the dried clothes, folded them, and put them in everyone's closets. Then she prepared to pick up the children: she moved pork ribs from the freezer to the fridge to thaw, and poured a large pitcher of iced mung bean soup, ready to relieve the family from the heat when they came back.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick the children up from school.
description: Ma Xiulan rode an electric bike first to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up Ma Yuxin, then went to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up Ma Mingzhe. On the way home, she deliberately detoured to the Jingwen Road tree-lined avenue to let the children get some fresh air and look at the greenery.
location: Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Tree-lined avenue on Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: End-of-month summary party
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan placed iced mung bean soup and cookies on the small stone table under the pomegranate tree in the courtyard and called the three children over for a "month-end summary party." She gave each child a small notebook and had them draw or write down the happiest thing from July. Ma Mingzhe drew the outdoor movie they had watched last time, Ma Yuxin drew eating watermelon, and Mingxuan also wrote down his own fun experience.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare dinner.
description: Xiulan returned to the kitchen to prepare dinner. The main dish was winter melon and pork rib soup, plus garlic green beans and smashed cucumbers. Her eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, took the initiative to help peel garlic and pass plates, and the mother and son chatted while they worked.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner
description: Dinner was served, and the family of five sat around the table. Ma Xiulan announced the plan to make tomato sauce with Aunt Wang tomorrow. The children were excited and all said they wanted to help, creating a warm and harmonious atmosphere.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The husband and wife review the July accounts and diet statistics
description: After dinner, her husband volunteered to do the dishes. Ma Xiulan took out the July account book and receipts, and the couple went through the income and expenses line by line on the sofa. She showed that the 'travel fund' had saved 180 yuan, wrote in colored pen 'Travel fund: goal 2,000 yuan, saved 180 yuan' and stuck it on the refrigerator, then suggested putting aside 300 yuan first from August's salary; her husband readily agreed. Next, they checked the grocery account book and were happy to find that this month they had eaten healthily and saved 50 yuan. Her second son's mouth ulcer had also healed, so they decided to keep it up next month.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Eye-care knowledge quiz with prizes
description: The family gathered in the living room. Ma Xiulan started a “Little Eye Guard” quiz, asking, “How long should you rest after watching TV?” and “Is it right to read in a dim place?” Children who answered correctly were rewarded with the “glorious task” of helping wash tomatoes tomorrow. The three children rushed to answer, and the atmosphere was lively.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening family walk
description: Ma Xiulan suggested the family take a walk on the community trail to help with digestion. The family of five walked along the trail for 20 minutes, watching the evening clouds and chatting about daily life. Ma Mingxuan discussed car construction with his father, while Xiulan laughed and talked with the two children.
location: Community walking path near Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Warm family time soaking feet together.
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan boiled a large pot of hot water, set up a foot-soaking tub in the living room, and the family sat together soaking their feet and chatting. She told the children they would need to help make the sauce tomorrow, and everyone was full of expectation.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and planning for tomorrow
description: After the children and her husband had gone to bed, Ma Xiulan briefly noted the day's events in her blue ledger, pleased that July had come to a successful close. Turning to the new August page, she wrote the first entry, “Make tomato sauce with Wang Guilan,” and then went over the tools and ingredients she would need the next day. Afterwards she washed up and applied face cream.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Relaxation before bed and falling asleep
description: Before turning off the light and lying down, Ma Xiulan sat on the edge of the bed, closed her eyes, and took deep breaths for 5 minutes. She pressed the Hegu acupoint on her hand, and after relaxing her whole body, fell asleep peacefully, ending a fulfilling day.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning courtyard walk and Baduanjin
description: At dawn, Ma Xiulan was walking slowly and stretching in the courtyard when she was pleasantly surprised to find that the two rose bushes she had planted last year were blooming for the first time this summer. Excitedly, she woke up Zhezhe, her second son, and her daughter Xinxin, who had just gotten up, and the three of them admired the little pink flower together. Under her guidance, the children carefully watered the flowers, and Ma Xiulan took close-up photos with her phone and shared them in the “Jinghai Skilled Sisters” photography group, deciding to tend to the roses every morning from now on. Then she returned to the living room and opened the window for ventilation. She practiced a set of Baduanjin by herself; her movements were not precise but smooth, and with deep breathing she felt her muscles and bones loosen up, storing energy for the new day.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home courtyard and living room)

name: Prepare breakfast and eat breakfast with the family
description: Ma Xiulan began preparing breakfast. She used the tomatoes bought yesterday to make tomato and egg drop soup with dough pieces, and heated up steamed buns. Then she woke the children one by one—her eldest son Xuanxuan, second son Zhezhe, and little daughter Xinxin—urging them to wash up and get dressed. The family sat around the dining table for breakfast. While eating, Ma Xiulan reminded the children of things to remember before school started, asked Xuanxuan how much of his summer homework he had finished, and reminded Zhezhe and Xinxin that today was Friday and to wait for their mom at the school gate after school.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (own kitchen and dining room)

name: Ride the electric scooter to take Zhezhe and Xinxin to school.
description: Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to first take Zhezhe to Jinghai District Third Primary School, which took about 10 minutes; then she turned to Huakang First Kindergarten to take Xinxin, about 8 minutes. On the way, she reminded the children to wait for their mother to pick them up on time after school.
location: Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin (on the way to pick up/drop off children)

name: Harvesting from the vegetable garden and preparing ingredients for making tomato sauce
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan went straight to the vegetable garden and carefully picked a dozen or so fully ripe red tomatoes into a basket. Then she cleaned the glass jars, rock sugar, and the tools prepared yesterday, and placed them on the kitchen stove for later use, fully preparing to make tomato sauce in the afternoon.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home vegetable garden and kitchen)

name: Set up a stall selling pickled vegetables at Xingwang Vegetable Market and pack up afterward
description: Ma Xiulan transported the 30 jars of pickled vegetables to her stall at Xingwang Vegetable Market by electric bike, set up the sun umbrella, and arranged the tasting dishes. Although the weather was hot and foot traffic was light, she still hawked enthusiastically and actively invited passers-by to taste. By near noon, she had sold 3 jars in total. Seeing lunchtime approaching, Ma Xiulan packed up her stall and went home, loading the unsold 27 jars of pickles onto the electric bike, thinking about how to adjust her sales strategy and considering trying the entrance of the residential community on the weekend.
location: Stall at Xingwang Vegetable Market at the intersection of Jingwen Road and Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Lunch and nap with Xuanxuan, and handling tomatoes
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan made a simple bowl of tomato and egg noodles. At noon, her eldest son Xuanxuan came home from school, and the two had lunch together. She asked Xuanxuan how his studies had gone at home that morning, and asked him to keep an eye on his younger brother and sister in the afternoon. After the meal, Ma Xiulan took a half-hour nap to regain her strength. After getting up at 13:00, she washed the tomatoes she had picked in the morning, scored a cross on the tops, blanched them in hot water and peeled them, then cut them into large chunks to prepare for making tomato sauce in the afternoon.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (own kitchen and bedroom)

name: Making tomato sauce with Wang Guilan.
description: Neighbor Wang Guilan arrived as promised, and the two of them got busy in the kitchen: one was in charge of cooking the tomato sauce, and the other was in charge of sterilizing the glass jars. They chatted about household matters while working. After repeated stirring and simmering, by 4 p.m., two large pots of sweet-and-sour tomato sauce were done, filling the prepared glass jars. They screwed the lids on tightly, turned the jars upside down to cool. Afterward, Wang Guilan helped clean up, and Ma Xiulan saw her off at the door. She then quickly washed her face, grabbed her e-bike keys, and got ready to go pick up the children.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (own kitchen and front door).

name: Picking up the child from school, buying an eye-protection desk lamp online, and enjoying flowers in the yard.
description: Ma Xiulan first went to the elementary school gate to pick up Zhezhe, then went around to the kindergarten to pick up Xinxin and go home. On the way, the children chattered and shared funny stories from school, and she listened patiently. After getting home, Ma Xiulan remembered that the children often hunched over while doing homework, so after comparing options repeatedly on an e-commerce platform, she ordered an 80-yuan LED eye-protection desk lamp, expected to arrive in 2-3 days. After paying, she took the children to the yard to look at the morning roses, taught Xinxin to water the flowers, and let Zhezhe see the tomato sauce made in the afternoon with his own eyes. The children felt a great sense of accomplishment.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (own small courtyard and en route to pick-up/drop-off)

name: Make sweet and sour pork ribs and have dinner with the family.
description: Ma Xiulan started preparing dinner. She took the ribs that had been thawed yesterday out of the fridge, made sweet-and-sour pork ribs that the children loved, stir-fried a green vegetable, and boiled a pot of mung bean soup. The family sat around eating dinner, and the children couldn't stop praising the sweet-and-sour ribs. Ma Xiulan felt very satisfied. She mentioned how the pickled vegetables had sold during the day, and Xuanxuan suggested they could run some promotions.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (own kitchen and dining room)

name: Cleaning the kitchen and chatting with Wang Guilan on WeChat
description: Ma Xiulan tidied up the kitchen, sat down on the living room sofa, and chatted with her neighbor Wang Guilan on WeChat about buying a desk lamp. Although she hated to spend the money, she felt it was worth it.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (own living room)

name: Family Reading Time and Talking About Plans for the New Semester
