description: It is Friday, and family reading time is a little later than usual. Ma Xiulan asked the three children to each pick a favorite book and sit in the reading corner. She sat with them, reading alongside them while chatting about the September school start and asking what plans they had for the new semester.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (reading corner in the living room at home)

name: Supervising the children's washing up and calling her husband
description: Ma Xiulan urged the three children to line up to wash up. Taking advantage of this time, she called her husband Ma Zhiqiang, who drives long-distance routes, to tell him about making sauce and buying a desk lamp today, to remind him to drive safely, and to remind him not to forget their agreement to save for the travel fund in August.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home bathroom and living room)

name: Relaxing with a mugwort foot soak
description: Ma Xiulan prepared a basin of hot water and sprinkled in mugwort. While soaking her feet, she cleared her mind and reviewed the things she had accomplished that day: seeing beautiful roses, making a few jars of tomato sauce, and buying desk lamps for the children. Although she was a bit worried about the slow sales of pickles, she felt fulfilled by these small gains for her family, and her mood settled considerably.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home bedroom).

name: Shoulder and neck stretching and bookkeeping
description: Ma Xiulan did five minutes of shoulder and neck stretches, relaxing her shoulders and neck from a day of work. Then she took out her account book and recorded today's expense: desk lamp, 80 yuan. She took stock of the remaining 27 jars of pickled vegetables and thought about trying to sell them at the community entrance on the weekend.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home bedroom).

name: Turned off the lights and went to sleep.
description: Ma Xiulan checked the doors and windows, tucked the children in, turned off the light, and went to sleep, ending this busy and fulfilling day.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home bedroom).

name: Morning courtyard walk, parent-child flower watering, Baduanjin, and washing up
description: At first light, Ma Xiulan woke up and went to the courtyard for a walk, strolling slowly around the pomegranate tree and the rose bushes, breathing in the morning air. Then the children got up. She had Xuanxuan carry a watering can to water the roses, while Zhezhe and Xinxin playfully scrambled to water the flowers too. Ma Xiulan photographed the dewy flower buds, planning to pick one to send to the family group chat. Then she returned to the living room, practiced Baduanjin on a yoga mat, and did shoulder, neck, and waist stretches, feeling much relieved in her lower back. After that she washed up, neatly put her hair up in front of the mirror, and changed into clean loungewear.
location: Courtyard and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare breakfast
description: Ma Xiulan tied on an apron and got busy making breakfast for the whole family. She steamed pork-and-scallion buns, cooked thick millet and pumpkin porridge, and boiled several tea eggs. The kitchen was filled with steam and a delicious aroma.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family breakfast
description: At breakfast, Ma Xiulan called the three children over to eat. While peeling an egg for Xinxin, she told Zhezhe to eat slowly. She talked with Xuanxuan about his summer homework. Xuanxuan said he still did not understand the buoyancy section in physics, so Ma Xiulan told him to think it over on his own in the afternoon and watch an explanation video together in the evening.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tidying up and selling pickled vegetables at the community entrance
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan quickly cleared the tableware and scrubbed the stove. Then she went to the storage room, picked up the 27 jars of pickled vegetables left from last night and a simple sign reading "Jinghai Handmade Pickled Vegetables, 10 yuan/jar," and set up a stall by the flower bed at the entrance of the residential complex. Her neighbor Zhang Shufen tasted one, praised the authentic flavor, and bought 5 jars, saying she would send them to her mother's family. Unfortunately, more people asked than bought, and in the end she sold only 8 jars, earning 80 yuan. With 19 jars remaining, she packed up and went home.
location: Open area at the entrance of No. 158, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Chatting with Wang Guilan on the way home
description: As soon as Ma Xiulan entered the neighborhood carrying a cardboard box, she ran into Wang Guilan, who was rushing along in a flurry. Wang Guilan grabbed her and said the community had a square dance friendship match that afternoon and was one person short, insisting that Ma Xiulan fill in. Ma Xiulan begged off, saying she was stiff and had never danced it, but unable to resist the other's tugging and pulling, she had no choice but to agree.
location: Roads inside the Jingwen Road residential community, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tidying the house, doing laundry, and preparing lunch
description: Back home, Ma Xiulan quickly sorted the dirty clothes changed yesterday and put them into the washing machine, then took a mop and mopped the floors of the living room and bedrooms. After finishing these, she started preparing lunch, reheated the leftover buns from the morning, and made a pot of tomato and egg soup, simple and efficient.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Lunch and helping Xuanxuan with physics
description: At noon, the mother and her three children sat around the dining table. Xuanxuan finished quickly and went back to his room to look at physics problems. After cleaning up the dishes, Ma Xiulan went to Xuanxuan's room and found him staring at a buoyancy problem. She patiently explained with examples from daily life, and Xuanxuan seemed to understand a bit better. Zhezhe and Xinxin were playing with building blocks on the living room floor, building a crooked castle.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, home dining room and Xuanxuan's room

name: Midday rest and getting changed to go out.
description: Feeling sleepy, Ma Xiulan took advantage of the children playing by themselves and dozed against the bed for twenty minutes, recovering a bit of energy. Wang Guilan's urging call came, and she hurriedly changed into her loosest, most comfortable sweatpants and T-shirt, grabbed a jacket, feeling a little nervous, afraid she would embarrass herself at the square.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Went to the community activity center.
description: Ma Xiulan followed Wang Guilan and walked for about 15 minutes to the Renmin Road Community Service Center. Along the way, Wang Guilan kept chattering about the key movements, while Ma Xiulan kept shaking her head, but she still braced herself and walked through the door of the service center.
location: Along the way from 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin to the Renmin Road Community Service Center

name: Square dance warm-up, competition, and post-competition chat.
description: When she arrived at the lobby of the community service center, more than ten aunties in pink T-shirts had already gathered. A community worker handed Ma Xiulan a brand-new pink T-shirt, and she had no choice but to put it on. Everyone followed the lead dancer, Sister Wang, through a simple rehearsal. Ma Xiulan stood at the very back, flustered and all over the place, which made the aunties laugh good-naturedly. At 2 p.m., the competition began in the central square. She kept her eyes fixed on the front row, but her hands and feet could never keep up with the rhythm, and mistakes came one after another: she moved the same-side arm and leg, rushed the beat, and danced in the wrong direction. In the second half, she simply threw caution to the wind and danced along randomly to the rhythm, which instead made the watching neighbors burst out laughing. After it was over, sweating all over, she waved her hands at Wang Guilan as she came off the field and said, 'Please spare me next time.' In the end, the team won a participation award, and each person received a bag of laundry detergent. After the competition, Ma Xiulan, Wang Guilan, and Aunt Zhao rested in a pavilion next to the square, drinking the mung bean soup provided by the community and chatting about daily life, until the sun was no longer blazing and they each went home.
location: First-floor lobby and central square of the Renmin Road Community Service Center, Jinghai District, Tianjin, plus the pavilion beside the square.

name: Pick up packages on the way home
description: Carrying the laundry detergent and walking back, Ma Xiulan passed the Fengchao lockers at the entrance of the community. She remembered that the eye-protecting desk lamp she had bought online yesterday was expected to arrive. She checked on her phone and saw that it had been delivered to the locker, so she entered the pickup code and took out a rather heavy box with the lamp. She thought to herself that she could replace Xuanxuan's lamp with the new one tonight.
location: Hive Box parcel locker at the entrance of No. 158 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Making dinner
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan washed her hands and started preparing dinner. Happy from dancing today, she decided to make a few extra dishes. She heated the wok, sautéed scallions, ginger, and garlic, made the children's favorite braised pork and dry-fried green beans, tossed a cold dish, and boiled a pot of winter melon and vermicelli soup. The kitchen was filled with the clatter of the spatula and tempting aromas.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner
description: When the food was on the table, Ma Xiulan called the children to eat. Zhezhe and Xinxin chattered and imitated the way she danced today, making the whole family laugh, and Xuanxuan joined in the fun. Ma Xiulan picked up a piece of braised pork and put it in Xuanxuan's bowl, telling him to eat more. The atmosphere was very relaxed.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Cleaned the kitchen, replaced the eye-care desk lamp, and posted photos to the WeChat group.
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan neatly cleaned up the kitchen, washing the dishes and putting them away. Then she took out the new desk lamp she had bought and called Xuanxuan over to replace the lamp on his desk with the new LED eye-protection lamp. Xuanxuan said the light was much brighter and his eyes felt comfortable. While she was tidying up, a message came through on the WeChat group: community staff had posted photos from the competition, including a candid shot of her doing the same-side arm-and-leg walk, which drew amused likes and funny comments from everyone. She shook her head, laughing, and showed the photos to the children. The whole family burst into laughter again. She pretended she was going to hit Wang Guilan, but secretly saved the photo to her album.
location: Kitchen, Mingxuan's room, and living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening family walk
description: It was completely dark, with a cool breeze blowing. Ma Xiulan took the three children downstairs and strolled along the quiet walking path in the neighborhood. As she walked, she told them how she had been "dragged" away by Wang Guilan today and how flustered she had been on the court, making the two little ones giggle. Xuanxuan also smiled, which was rare, and said Mom looked like an internet celebrity today.
location: The walking path in the Jingwen Road community, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Washing up
description: After getting home, Ma Xiulan urged the children to wash up in turn. Xinxin brushed her teeth and washed her face by herself, Zhezhe soaked his feet in a basin, and Xuanxuan changed into his pajamas. Everyone was properly cleaned up and settled.
location: Bathroom and various rooms at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Soaking feet to relax and keeping accounts
description: The children were all asleep. Ma Xiulan brought over a basin of hot water, added mugwort, and soaked her feet comfortably. As she soaked, she took out her account book and recorded today's income of 80 yuan from pickled vegetables. She closed the book, leaned back in her chair, and thought back on her square-dancing experience. The corners of her mouth turned up unconsciously. Although she was tired, she felt relaxed and content.
location: Living room or bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tidying up and talking with husband on the phone before bed
description: After soaking her feet, Ma Xiulan gave the clothes she had changed out of a quick wash and hung them up. She picked up her phone and sent a voice message to her husband Ma Zhiqiang, who was still out on the road, briefly telling him about selling pickled vegetables and dancing today, and letting him know the new desk lamp had arrived and not to worry. After sending the message, she checked the front door was locked, then turned off the light and lay down.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Pre-sleep reading and falling asleep
description: After lying down, Ma Xiulan didn't fall asleep immediately. She took out her phone, scrolled through the square dance photos still being hotly discussed in the community group, and watched a few videos about everyday life tips. Feeling drowsy, she put down her phone, closed her eyes, listened to the occasional cricket chirps outside the window, and slowly drifted off to sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Waking up in the morning, morning exercise, and buying breakfast
description: Woke up naturally at 5:15 in the morning, did some simple stretches in bed and loosened up her shoulders and neck. Then she changed into her exercise clothes, tiptoed out of the house, and met Aunt Zhao at the community garden, where they practiced Baduanjin together. Aunt Zhao helped correct the “sway the head and swing the tail to expel heart fire” movement. After finishing, they strolled around the garden chatting. On the way home, she stopped at Wang's breakfast stand at the entrance of the alley, bought jianbing guozi for the three children, and got a steamed corn bun and soy milk for herself, then carried the breakfast home.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home), community small garden (next to 108, East Section, Jingwen Road), Wang's breakfast stall (148 Jingwen Road).

name: Courtyard stroll and watering flowers together with the kids
description: After returning home, she put the breakfast in the kitchen, called the children to get up, and took them to the courtyard to water the roses. Ma Mingxuan took the initiative to water with a small watering can, while Ma Mingzhe and Ma Yuxin played with water guns. Ma Xiulan smiled and reminded them not to splash water into the flower centers, then took out her phone and snapped a few close-up photos of the flowers with water droplets and sent them to the family WeChat group.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Arrange breakfast and discuss the division of labor.
description: She set the savory crepes with fried dough sticks, congee, and soy milk on the table, and the children had breakfast. Ma Xiulan told them that in the afternoon she and Aunt Chunmei were going to set up a stall at the vegetable market, and that Ma Mingxuan should stay home and keep an eye on his younger brother and sister while they did their homework. She also reminded them there was watermelon in the fridge. Zhezhe and Xinxin nodded and agreed, hoping their mother would sell more and earn enough to buy pork ribs.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tidying up the house and sorting the pickled vegetable inventory
description: After breakfast, the children cleared the dishes. Ma Xiulan wiped the table, washed the dishes, did the laundry, and swept the fallen leaves in the yard. Then she went to the storeroom in the west wing and gathered the 19 jars of pickles left from yesterday plus 1 returned jar, 20 jars in total. She wiped the jar mouths with a cloth and carefully arranged them in a bamboo basket. Ma Mingxuan came over and helped her carry the basket to the door.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Install an eye-protection desk lamp and remind everyone about the eye-care rules.
description: The courier delivered an LED eye-protection desk lamp. Ma Xiulan opened the packaging, installed the lamp on Ma Mingxuan's desk according to the manual, adjusted the angle of the lamp arm and the brightness, and asked him if the light glared. Then she called the three children over and stressed that they must turn on the lamp and maintain proper posture when doing homework.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Mend clothes and chat with neighbors
description: She moved a small stool to sit in the shade of the doorway, took out the hole in Ma Yuxin's pajama pants, and mended it with the sewing machine. Neighbor Wang Guilan passed by and vividly described how funny the short video in the group chat was from last night's community square dance competition. The two chatted and laughed. Ma Xiulan quickly repaired the pants and added a cartoon bear patch.
location: The alley in front of No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Prepare and enjoy lunch
description: Ma Xiulan was in the kitchen making tomato egg noodles. She kneaded the dough, rolled it out, cut the noodles, and stir-fried a sauce using tomatoes picked from the family yard. After the noodles were cooked, she ate with Ma Mingxuan, who had come home from school. While eating, she asked about his physics summer homework progress and encouraged him to think more about the buoyancy chapter, saying he could ask his father that evening if he did not understand.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Noon break
description: After clearing away the dishes, she immediately lay down on the bed and rested for half an hour. When the alarm rang, she got up and washed her face right away, feeling much more refreshed.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing supplies for the market stall
description: After changing into going-out clothes, she went to the storeroom and counted again the 20 jars of pickled vegetables in the bamboo basket. She put the "buy three get one free" cardboard sign, the payment QR code, and a small loudspeaker into her cloth bag, and also took a piece of gauze to cover the jars to keep off dust and flies.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Rode an electric bike to the vegetable market to set up a stall
description: Ma Xiulan put the bamboo basket on the footboard of the e-bike, gave Ma Mingxuan a few instructions, then rode along Jingwen Road for about 10 minutes to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market. Just as she set up the stall, her childhood friend Liu Chunmei arrived, took out her phone to play a pre-downloaded video about making pickled vegetables, and enthusiastically hawked with a small loudspeaker. Ma Xiulan was in charge of letting customers taste the products and introducing them. After selling 8 jars, the customer flow decreased. The two took a breather and counted; there were 12 jars left.
location: Wutong Commune food market at the intersection of Jingwen Road and Chaoyang Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: After closing the stall, discuss online promotion with Chunmei and buy groceries on the way.
description: After packing up the stall, Ma Xiulan packed the remaining 12 jars of pickled vegetables and walked with Liu Chunmei to Xiao Li's bun shop diagonally across from the vegetable market. They ordered two baskets of pork-and-scallion buns and two bowls of millet porridge. While eating, she listened to Chunmei explain in detail how to shoot short videos and post on Moments to promote the pickled vegetables. After the meal, she said goodbye to Chunmei, rode her electric bike and stopped by Shufen's Convenience Store run by Zhang Shufen inside the vegetable market, bought 2 jin of pork ribs, 1 jin of baby bok choy, and a bunch of water spinach, and chatted with Shufen a bit about the remaining pickled vegetables.
location: Xiao Li Bun Shop, No. 108 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Shufen Convenience Store in Wutong Commune Market.

name: After arriving home, the children helped tidy up
description: After returning home, Ma Mingxuan helped her carry the bamboo basket back to the storage room. Ma Xiulan took out the pork ribs, asked Ma Mingzhe to go to the small vegetable plot and pull up two scallions, and Ma Yuxin helped put the baby bok choy into the washing basin.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Cooking dinner and eating as a family
description: Ma Xiulan put on an apron and started making dinner: braised pork ribs, garlicky water spinach, and tomato egg drop soup. Once the dishes were on the table, the family of four sat around it. Ma Xiulan picked out ribs for the children, and Xinxin said her mother's ribs were delicious. They ate and chatted, filling the room with a warm atmosphere.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tidy up the kitchen and teach my daughter to fold clothes.
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan cleared the dishes and washed them in the kitchen, wiping down the stove. Then she called Ma Yuxin over and taught her to fold her little pajamas and the clothes she had changed out of neatly. Ma Yuxin learned very earnestly, and although the folds were crooked, she was praised by her mother.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family evening outdoor activity
description: She took the children downstairs to the small neighborhood square. Ma Xiulan sat on a bench watching Ma Mingzhe and the boys play soccer, while Ma Mingxuan, phone in hand, competed with Ma Yuxin in a badminton keep-ups contest in the fitness area and she enjoyed the cool evening air.
location: The small square in the residential community at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Family reading and literacy games
description: After returning home, Ma Mingxuan went to his room to read a physics book. Ma Xiulan took out The Little Prince and told Ma Yuxin and Ma Mingzhe the story of Chapter Three. After that, she used flashcards to teach Ma Yuxin to recognize the words 'sauce', 'vegetable', and 'mom', and played a word-finding game with her. When Xinxin recognized them correctly, she clapped her hands happily.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Urge the children to wash up and have a video call with her husband
description: Made sure the three children took showers and brushed their teeth one by one. After settling them down, Ma Xiulan returned to the bedroom and video-called her husband Ma Zhiqiang, who drives long-distance routes, to briefly tell him about how the stall went that day. He told her not to work too hard, and she said that with Chunmei helping to think of ways, she felt much more at ease.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Soaking feet before bed, keeping accounts, and relaxing into sleep.
description: She boiled water and soaked her feet with mugwort, took out the ledger, and recorded the day's income of 24 yuan from pickled vegetables and expenses of 32 yuan for groceries. While soaking her feet, she closed her eyes and breathed deeply, recalling the details of setting up the stall and the promotional method Chunmei had mentioned. After soaking, she got into bed, leaned against the headboard, looked at the photos in the square-dance group on her phone and liked them, then browsed promotional videos by a local food blogger. She turned off the light at 22:45 and fell asleep.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning courtyard exercise and shoulder-and-neck relaxation.
description: She woke up naturally at 5:20 a.m. It was overcast and dim, and her shoulders and back felt slightly tense. Ma Xiulan walked slowly around her small courtyard, moving her shoulder joints and rotating her waist, doing shoulder circles and chest-expanding exercises to gradually loosen her body. In her mind, she silently went through today's to-do list: organize the pickled vegetable inventory and contact her childhood friend Chunmei.
location: Own small courtyard, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Practiced Baduanjin in the living room
description: After entering the living room, Ma Xiulan performed a complete set of Baduanjin with slow, gentle movements and even breathing. After working up a slight sweat, she felt refreshed and energized, storing up energy for the day's activities.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, living room of own home.

name: Wake the children and tend to the plants.
description: After finishing the exercise, Ma Xiulan woke up the three children, Ma Mingxuan, Ma Mingzhe, and Ma Yuxin. The family went to the courtyard and watered the roses and the pomegranate tree. Xinxin sprayed water on the flowers with a small watering can, Zhezhe loosened the soil with a small shovel, and Xuanxuan checked the leaves for pests. Xiulan coached Xinxin on how to photograph flowers from the side, then took two photos and shared them in the photography group, earning praise from the group members.
location: Own small courtyard, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Prepare and enjoy breakfast
description: After going back inside and washing up, Ma Xiulan began preparing breakfast. She cooked a pot of millet porridge, reheated last night's pork and cabbage buns, boiled tea eggs, and sliced a plate of homemade pickled vegetables. After the children washed up, they sat around the table to eat. Xiulan reminded them to clear their own dishes after the meal and told them she would be focusing on the pickled vegetable business in the morning.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin: home kitchen and dining room

name: Tidying up the house and doing laundry
description: After the meal, she quickly cleared the dishes and chopsticks, wiped the dining table, swept the floor, and put the children's clothes to be changed into the washing machine. She told Xuanxuan to take good care of his younger brother and sister at home and not to watch TV for too long.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, own home

name: Took stock of the pickled vegetable inventory
description: Ma Xiulan moved all the pickle jars out of the kitchen and counted them one by one. Including the newly pickled cucumbers, radishes, spicy cabbage, and the leftovers from yesterday, there were 28 jars in total. She noted the number in her notebook and, combined with Chunmei's suggestion from yesterday, began planning a sales strategy in her mind.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, her own kitchen

name: Discussing online sales over the phone with a childhood friend.
description: After checking her inventory, Ma Xiulan called her childhood friend Liu Chunmei. Over the phone, the two discussed in detail strategies for writing Moments posts, matching images, and promoting in WeChat groups of acquaintances. Chunmei agreed to help promote it in her coworker group.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, living room of own home.

name: Organized the pickled vegetables and prepared photo materials
description: After the call ended, Ma Xiulan selected the pickled cucumbers and pickled radishes that looked best for sale and took them to the stone table under the pomegranate tree in the yard. She found a clean glass jar, polished it, thought about how to arrange the dishes for tomorrow's video shoot, and used her phone to take a few test photos to check the lighting.
location: Own small courtyard, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Prepare lunch.
description: Around noon, Ma Xiulan kneaded and rolled out noodles, cooked a tomato and egg sauce, and cut cucumber shreds as toppings, making delicious tomato and egg sauce noodles for the whole family.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, her own kitchen

name: The whole family had lunch together.
description: Put the thick-gravy noodles on the table and call the children to eat. During the meal, ask Xuanxuan about the progress of his summer vacation homework and remind him to look after his younger brother and sister at home in the afternoon and not to quarrel.
location: Home dining room, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Noon break
description: After finishing the meal and cleaning up, she urged the children to take a nap. Ma Xiulan also rested on her bed in her bedroom for about twenty minutes to recover her energy.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, her own bedroom.

name: Walk to her parents' home.
description: After waking up, she packed two jars of pickled cucumbers in a bag and took the three children out, walking from Jingwen Road to Shengli Street. Along the way, she kept reminding the children to be polite at grandma's house and not to rummage through things. They arrived after about 25 minutes of walking.
location: From 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin to 45 Shengli Street

name: Helping with housework and chatting at parents' home
description: After entering and greeting everyone, Ma Xiulan immediately helped her mother Li Xiuying pick vegetables to prepare for dinner. She had her parents taste the pickled cucumbers she had brought. Her mother praised the authentic flavor and suggested giving some to relatives to try so as to expand sales. Her father Ma Jianguo was teaching Xuanxuan and Zhezhe to play Chinese chess in the living room, while Xinxin played with her grandmother's thimble beside them.
location: Kitchen and living room of the parents' home, No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing dinner at her parents' home
description: While chatting with her mother, she cooked dinner, making her mother's favorite braised hairtail fish, garlicky crown daisy stems, and tomato and egg soup, filling the room with a fragrant aroma.
location: No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, kitchen at her parents' home

name: Had dinner together at the parents' home.
description: The whole family sat together to eat in a warm atmosphere. Father praised Yuxin for not being picky today, and the table was filled with laughter and joy.
location: 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, dining room of her parents' home.

name: Said goodbye to my parents and walked home
description: After dinner, she helped clear the dishes, sat for a short while, then took leave of her parents and walked back with the three children to their home on Jingwen Road by the same route.
location: From 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to 156 Jingwen Road

name: Remind the children to wash up and check their homework.
description: After getting home, she urged the three children to take turns bathing. In her spare time, Ma Xiulan went to Xuanxuan's desk, checked his summer homework notebook, and asked him two physics questions. Xuanxuan answered fluently, which put her mind at ease.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, own home

name: Pre-bed stretching and relaxation
description: After the children finished washing up, Ma Xiulan took a shower herself. Because the weather was hot and stuffy, she skipped soaking her feet. Lying in bed, she did a set of waist and back stretches, then sat cross-legged with eyes closed and breathed deeply for five minutes, completely relaxing her whole body.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, her own bedroom.

name: Bookkeeping and online learning about pickle marketing
description: She took out the account book to record today's expenses for bringing food to her parents' home. Then she opened her phone, reviewed the photos she had shared in the photography group during the day, and found three videos of a local food blogger selling pickled vegetables. She watched them repeatedly, studying the wording and filming techniques to gather inspiration for tomorrow's video.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, her own bedroom.

name: Family leisure and bedtime
description: After studying, Ma Xiulan went to the living room to look after the children. Xuanxuan was reading, and Zhezhe and Xinxin were playing with building blocks on the carpet. She poured them water, chatted with them for a while, then urged them to go to bed. She turned off the light, lay down, thought about tomorrow's plan, and gradually fell asleep.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin — the living room and bedroom at home.

name: Morning courtyard exercise and thoughts on selling pickled vegetables
description: At 5:15 a.m., Ma Xiulan got up quietly; the sky was just beginning to lighten. She first took a walk in her courtyard and went to the pomegranate tree to check the unripe fruit and estimate this year's harvest. Twenty minutes later, she did arm raises and chest expansion stretches, then went to the living room to perform a set of Baduanjin and complete a 5-minute shoulder and neck stretch. During the exercise, she kept mulling over the WeChat Moments marketing method Liu Chunmei had taught her yesterday, thinking about how to photograph pickled vegetables and write captions to attract more customers.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare breakfast and wake up the children.
description: After exercising, Ma Xiulan dried her sweat, changed into home clothes, and entered the kitchen to start preparing breakfast. Today's breakfast was Tianjin baozi (using leftover filling from yesterday), millet porridge, and tea eggs. While busy making the baozi and cooking the porridge, she urged the three children to get up toward the bedroom: "Xuanxuan! Zhezhe! Xinxin! Hurry up, you're going to be late!" The children responded one after another, and she quickly served the breakfast dishes one by one on the table.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family breakfast and reminders before going out.
description: The family sat around the dining table. Ma Xiulan peeled a tea egg for Ma Xinxin while urging Ma Mingxuan to eat more so he would have the energy to do homework in the morning. She did not forget to remind her eldest son, Ma Mingxuan: “I won't be home in a little while. You need to look after your younger brother and sister. Don't just play on the computer—you have to finish the reading you're supposed to do.” Then she reminded the two younger children that the weather forecast called for thundershowers, that the umbrellas had been placed by the door, and that they should not run around after school.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Take the children to school and buy groceries along the way.
description: Ma Xiulan prepared umbrellas for each child. She first rode her electric bike to take Ma Mingzhe to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, telling him to wait at the school gate after school; then she took Ma Xinxin to Huakang First Kindergarten and watched the teacher lead her inside. On the way back, she stopped by Wutong Commune Market to buy fresh vegetables and noodles for lunch, and chatted briefly with Aunt Sun Guifang, a stall owner, about prices and the weather.
location: Jinghai District, Tianjin: residence at 156 Jingwen Road; Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School on Shengli South Street; Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten on Huakang Road; Wutong Commune Vegetable Market on Chaoyang Road

name: Housework and preparation for pickled vegetable sales
description: Back at home, Ma Xiulan immediately threw herself into housework: she sorted dirty clothes into the washing machine, swept the living room and bedroom floors, and put away the children's toys scattered around. Then she moved to the kitchen to prepare for the pickled vegetable sales. She took out the two jars of pickled cucumbers and dried radish she had carefully selected yesterday, checked their appearance, and took out her phone to try to find the best light by the window, thinking about angles for product photos, striving to achieve the "appetizing" effect Liu Chunmei had mentioned.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Taking product photos of the pickled vegetables and posting them on Moments.
description: Ma Xiulan moved the pickle jar to the stone table under the pomegranate tree in the courtyard. Using the natural light and rose leaves as accents, she adjusted the shooting angle repeatedly and finally took a satisfactory photo. She used a photo-editing app on her phone to adjust brightness and contrast, added a filter, and carefully wrote the caption: “Sisters, these are pickles I made myself — traditional old-school flavor, clean and affordable, appetizing and great with rice! Available in large and small jars, and I can deliver within Jinghai city. Friends from elsewhere, add my WeChat!” After confirming it was correct, she tapped send, feeling a little nervous.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Send private messages to relatives and friends to help promote the pickles
description: After posting to Moments, Ma Xiulan immediately sent a message to her childhood friend Liu Chunmei, asking her to check how it looked and repost it. She also sent voice messages to her handicraft friend Zhou Xiuqin and neighbor Wang Guilan, asking them to help spread it. Wang Guilan readily agreed, promising not only to repost it in the neighborhood owners' group but also suggesting that Ma Xiulan bring a few jars of pickled vegetables to the gate of Chunhuali Community in the afternoon, where she would help watch over and sell them. Ma Xiulan was very grateful and arranged the afternoon delivery with Wang Guilan.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Lunch and midday break
description: At noon, Ma Xiulan used the leftover hand-rolled noodles from yesterday to cook tomato and egg sauce noodles, served with shredded cucumber, and had lunch with Ma Mingxuan, who was doing homework at home. She asked about his homework progress; Ma Mingxuan responded vaguely, and Ma Xiulan did not press further, only telling him to keep an eye on the house and finish the remaining homework while she was out in the afternoon. After cleaning up following the meal, she told her son to take a nap, and she also rested in bed for about half an hour.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Packing pickled vegetables into portions and preparing for delivery
description: After the midday break, Ma Xiulan regained her energy. She checked her phone and found no new updates in WeChat Moments. Though a little disappointed, she perked up. She went into the kitchen, counted all 27 jars of pickled vegetables, sorted them, carefully wiped 4 jars (2 jars of pickled cucumbers, 2 jars of dried radish), and packed them in clean plastic bags. She planned to take them to Chunhuali Residential Community, where Wang Guilan lives, silently reminding herself that the first step is always the hardest and she had to take it steadily.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Delivered goods to Chunhuali Residential Community and arranged to sell them on commission.
description: Ma Xiulan rode her electric bicycle, placed four jars of pickled vegetables securely on the footboard, and headed to Chunhuali Community. Upon arrival, Wang Guilan was already waiting at the gate. Together they put the jars inside the security guard room. Wang Guilan then asked a security guard she knew to keep an eye on them, telling him to say they were homemade by Sister Ma if any neighbor asked. Ma Xiulan felt much more at ease, chatted with Wang Guilan for a while, thanked her, and left.
location: Chunhuali Residential Quarter, Xinkai Road, Hedong District, Tianjin

name: Mending clothes and online sales engagement
description: Returning home, Ma Xiulan took out her sewing basket and sat on the sofa mending Ma Xinxin's worn-out pants. Meanwhile, she frequently checked Moments updates on her phone. Around 14:50, she finally saw a like and a comment: "That looks delicious! How much is it?" She immediately replied, "15 yuan a jar, two jars for 25 yuan! Sister, which part of Jinghai are you in?" After some communication, the other person turned out to be Sister Liu from another building in the same residential complex, who ordered two jars of pickled cucumbers and agreed to have them delivered in the evening. This greatly boosted her confidence.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Picking up the children from school and teaching photography in the courtyard
description: In the afternoon, a light rain fell. Ma Xiulan put on a raincoat, first went to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up Ma Xinxin, then circled around to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up Ma Mingzhe. The two children chattered all the way, sharing fun stories from school. When they got home, the rain gradually stopped. The stone path in the courtyard was wet, and the roses were dotted with water droplets. Ma Xiulan took the opportunity to call the three children over to the flowers, using the budding roses with water droplets as an example to explain diagonal composition techniques. She let the children take turns practicing with her phone, and they were very excited.
location: Jinghai District, Tianjin: returning from Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten and Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to home at No. 156 Jingwen Road.

name: Prepare a hearty dinner
description: After the photography activity, Ma Xiulan let the children play freely and went into the kitchen to prepare dinner. She decided to make a hearty meal, took out the pork ribs bought yesterday from the refrigerator, blanched them, and made braised pork ribs; she also stir-fried garlic water spinach, reheated the leftover steamed buns from yesterday, and made a bowl of tomato egg drop soup. The stove bubbled as the aroma of meat and vegetables filled the small courtyard.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner and sharing fun stories.
description: Ma Mingxuan put away his homework, Ma Mingzhe and Ma Xinxin washed their hands, and the whole family sat around the dining table. The braised pork ribs stimulated the children's appetites. During the meal, Ma Mingzhe shared a funny story about his deskmate giving him candy, while Ma Xinxin happily said that her teacher praised her for drawing well. Ma Xiulan smiled and encouraged the children to keep working hard, and suggested that mixing some ribs soup into their rice would make it especially delicious.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Guided photo composition and supervised household chores.
description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan first urged Ma Mingxuan to wash the dishes while she looked through the afternoon photos with Ma Mingzhe and Ma Xinxin. She pointed out the strengths and weaknesses of each composition, explaining how diagonal composition highlights the subject and avoids cluttered backgrounds. The children were only half-understanding but very interested.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Completed the first door-to-door delivery of pickled vegetables order
description: After finishing the photography lesson, Ma Xiulan remembered her appointment with Sister Liu, so she told Ma Mingxuan to watch the house, check homework, and not watch TV. She took two jars of pickled cucumbers, rode her electric bike to the entrance of Chunhuali Residential Community, contacted Sister Liu via WeChat, handed over the pickled vegetables in person, and received 30 yuan in cash, successfully completing her first Moments order.
location: Chunhuali Residential Quarter, Xinkai Road, Hedong District, Tianjin

name: Family Reading Time
description: Returning from the delivery just at 8 o'clock, Ma Xiulan organized family reading time. She held the picture book Little Horse Crosses the River to teach Ma Xinxin to recognize characters, while Ma Mingxuan read The Three-Body Problem beside her. Ma Mingzhe, imitating his older brother, also picked up a pinyin-annotated Journey to the West to read. In the living room, there was only the rustling of pages turning, a quiet and warm atmosphere.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Children washing up and going to bed
description: After reading, Ma Xiulan urged the children to wash up. She helped Ma Xinxin wash her face and brush her teeth, checked behind the ears of Ma Mingxuan and Ma Mingzhe, while nagging that they still had school tomorrow morning and urging everyone to sleep early. She changed Ma Xinxin into pajamas, tucked the three children into their beds one by one, and finally checked the doors and windows to make sure everything was safe before she rested.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening relaxation and recording the day's accounts
description: After the children fell asleep, Ma Xiulan spread out a mat in the bedroom and did 10 minutes of lower back stretches to relieve the day's fatigue, then sat cross-legged with her eyes closed and took deep breaths to relax for 5 minutes. Then she took out her account book and carefully recorded the day's pickle sales: “August 5: 6 jars of pickles pre-ordered online (18 yuan deposit), 4 jars delivered to Sister Wang's door (payment pending), and one order from Sister Liu with 30 yuan actually received. Total income: 48 yuan. Ask the others again tomorrow.” She felt that the day's efforts had gotten a real start.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Browse phone and rest before bed
description: Ma Xiulan leaned against the bed headboard and scrolled on her phone. She saw the photography group discussing the weather and street scenes after the rain. Reviewing her own photos of Chinese roses, she felt the lighting could still be improved and planned to try again tomorrow morning. Her pickled vegetable post on Moments gained two more likes, and she was secretly pleased. Growing sleepy, she turned off the light, turned over, and quickly fell asleep.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning exercise and chatting with neighbors
description: Woke up naturally at 5:20. After some light exercise in the bedroom, changed into sportswear and walked to the community garden. Met Aunt Zhao on time at 5:30. The two of them completed a full set of Baduanjin, and Aunt Zhao praised that her movements were becoming more and more standard. Afterwards, they took a slow walk along the garden path, chatting about the acupoints Aunt Zhao recommended for relieving knee soreness. She noted them carefully and felt her body relaxed.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home) to the community garden (intersection of Jingwen Road and Wutong Street).

name: Waking up the children and taking photos while watering the flowers in the courtyard
description: After returning home, she woke up the three children. Xuanxuan got up and washed up on his/her own, while ZheZhe and XinXin were still lying in bed. She gently but firmly urged them to get dressed. Then the whole family went to the yard to water the roses and pomegranate tree. Xuanxuan was in charge of the west flower bed, and ZheZhe and XinXin had a race using watering cans. She took out her phone and used the diagonal composition she had learned yesterday to photograph the roses with water droplets, and also shot a few short videos and sent them to the photography group, specifically @-ing Zhou Xiuqin and Aunt Wu to ask for advice on how to add light to dark-colored flowers.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing and enjoying breakfast
description: Steamed the leftover buns from yesterday, quickly made millet porridge, and sliced a plate of pickled radish. Warmed a glass of milk for Xinxin. At 7:00 the whole family sat down for breakfast, reminding the children of today's study tasks while eating, and telling Xuanxuan to use the lunch break to correct his physics mistakes.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Taking the children to school
description: Put away the dishes and chopsticks, set off on the electric bike at 7:20. First take Zhezhe to the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School and remind him to drink more water between classes. Then turn to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, hand Xinxin to the teacher, and watch her bounce into the classroom.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin to No. 11 Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin (Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School) to No. 20 Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin (Huakang First Kindergarten)

name: Buying ingredients and tidying up at home
description: After dropping off the children, she went to the Wutong Commune vegetable market on the way. At the stall of her old friend Aunt Sun, she picked a lively crucian carp and two pieces of soft tofu, and also bought a bunch of bok choy and a few scallions, planning to make soup for Xuanxuan at noon. She got home at 8:10, put the ingredients into the refrigerator by category, and marinated the fish with ginger slices for later use.
location: No. 20 Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin to the intersection of Jingwen Road and Wutong Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin (Wutong Commune Vegetable Market) to No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Posting promotional updates and preparing deliveries
description: After a short rest, she took out her phone and combined the rose photos taken this morning with the close-up photos of the pickled vegetables taken yesterday, carefully composing a Moments post: “A new day, flowers in full bloom, pickled vegetables are fragrant~ Thanks to my dear sisters for your support! Home delivery starts today.” After sending it, she carefully checked the 6 orders received yesterday (all reserved by neighbors and friends), wiped the pickle jars clean, packed them into a sturdy cloth bag, and pulled a few small bunches of fresh scallions from the yard to take along.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Deliver the pre-ordered pickled vegetables and pay a visit.
description: At 9:30 she walked to Wang Guilan's home on the same street at 158 Jingwen Road and gave her two jars of pickled vegetables and spring onions. Sister Wang Guilan was full of praise for the flavor and also kindly told her that someone downstairs wanted to order some too. After leaving, she rode her e-bike to Zhou Xiuqin's home on Shengli Avenue. Sister Zhou warmly received her; as they tasted the newly dried apricots, they exchanged embroidery tips in the living room. Sister Zhou showed a just-completed double-sided embroidered pomegranate picture with fine stitching. Ma Xiulan took several close-up photos with her phone and said she would study them carefully at home. The two also agreed to visit the newly opened handcraft materials market in Jinnan together soon. Then she went home.
location: 158 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (Wang Guilan's home), 32 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin (Zhou Xiuqin's home) to 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Purchase daily necessities
description: On the way back from Sister Zhou's house, she rode her e-bike to Jingbai Supermarket. She quickly bought light soy sauce, alkali noodles, and white sugar for the new pickles, which were almost used up at home. At checkout she paid by phone and earned points on her membership card. She got home at 11:00 and put everything away.
location: From Yuzhou Zunfu, Building 19, Unit 104, Jinghai District, Tianjin (Jingbai Supermarket) to No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing lunch and having a meal with the eldest son
description: At 11:15, she went into the kitchen, fried the crucian carp until golden on both sides, added boiling water, put in tofu pieces, and simmered over low heat until the fish soup turned milky white. She also stir-fried a plate of baby bok choy. At 11:45, Xuanxuan came home from school, and the mother and son had lunch together. She gave Xuanxuan a big bowl of fish soup and asked which part of the physics test he hadn't understood. He said he was still confused about the buoyancy section. She comforted him not to worry and said they could look for instructional videos online together in the evening.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tidying up and midday rest
description: After the meal, she cleaned up the kitchen and washed the dishes and chopsticks. She sat down on the living room sofa, used her phone to browse the account of a local food blogger recommended by Liu Chunmei, and liked a few pickled vegetable videos. Feeling a bit tired, she set an alarm and leaned back on the sofa for a nap of about twenty minutes.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Focused on embroidery at home in the afternoon.
description: Woke up at 13:20, feeling refreshed. She brought out her embroidery tools and sat in the best-lit spot by the living room window, continuing to embroider the white handkerchief with the peony pattern. She chose pink and rose-red silk threads, starting from the outermost petals and stitching very attentively, with the TV on as background noise. At 14:40 Liu Chunmei called, saying that two more neighbors had seen the posts on Moments and wanted to order pickled vegetables, and they confirmed the plan to set up a stall at the convenience square in Dongcheng District next week. She happily noted the orders, and Liu Chunmei praised how good the photos on Moments looked. After hanging up, she was in a good mood and embroidered another small petal attentively before stopping.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Recording accounts and resting in the front yard.
description: After embroidering for a while, she felt a bit tired, so she got up and went to the courtyard to water the pomegranate tree and the chili seedlings. Back inside, she took out her ledger, recorded the six payments from today's pickled vegetable deliveries, and tallied the inventory. She was mulling over the plans for setting up a stall next week.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Picking up the children from school and buying groceries on the way
description: At 16:35, she rode her electric bike out, first picked up Xinxin, then went to the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up Zhezhe. After picking up the two children, she stopped by Wutong Commune Vegetable Market on the way and bought a bundle of fresh chives and two jin of ground pork belly, planning to make dumplings the next day. On the way home, the two children chattered about school. Xinxin said her teacher praised her painting today, and Zhezhe said he got an 'Excellent' on his math quiz.
location: From 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin to 20 South Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin (Huakang First Kindergarten) to 11 South Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin (Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School) to the intersection of Jingwen Road and Wutong Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin (Wutong Community Vegetable Market) to 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing Dinner and Dining Together
description: After getting home, had the children wash their hands, change clothes, and eat fruit. First washed the chives and left them to drain, seasoned the pork belly filling and set it aside. Then made dinner: cut the pre-thawed pork into pieces and made a pot of braised pork; stir-fried a plate of free-range eggs with chives; and quickly made seaweed egg drop soup. At 18:00 the whole family sat around and had dinner.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Housework, homework tutoring, and parent-child time
description: She cleared the dishes and wiped down the stove. Then she supervised the three children doing homework: first she checked Zhezhe's math workbook and corrected two calculation mistakes; then she sat with Xinxin doing pinyin tracing practice, encouraging her to write neatly; finally, she found a short video explaining the buoyancy formula for Xuanxuan and had him follow it.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare for tomorrow and make sure everyone washes up
description: After checking all the homework, she went to the kitchen, chopped the chives, sealed in the moisture with oil, and mixed them with the meat filling to prepare for tomorrow's breakfast. Then she urged the children to take turns bathing. She helped Xinxin wash her hair, rinse it, and blow it dry. Meanwhile, she told Zhezhe to scrub his sneakers clean himself.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Phone call with her husband
description: After the children were settled, she made a video call to her husband Ma Zhiqiang, who was out on the road driving his truck. She showed him the photos she had taken that day of the roses and the embroidered handkerchief, and happily told him about the good momentum of the pickles and her plan to set up a stall next week. Ma Zhiqiang was also happy on the other end of the line, said he should be able to come home for a couple of days next week, and told her not to work too hard. They chatted for about ten minutes, and her heart felt warm.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pre-bed preparation and deep relaxation
description: After hanging up the phone, she checked the doors, windows, and gas to confirm everything was safe. Returning to the bedroom, she did 10 minutes of waist and back stretches on the floor beside the bed as usual, focusing on relaxing her shoulders and neck, which had become stiff from today's embroidery. Then she sat cross-legged in silence for about 5 minutes, took deep breaths, emptied her mind, and let the day's fatigue slowly settle down.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (bedroom)

name: Personal washing and bedtime
description: After stretching, went to the bathroom to wash up, carefully washed my face and applied skincare. At 22:10 lay down on the bed, picked up my phone and scrolled through photos of the roses taken in the evening, and sent my husband a “Good night”. Then I turned off my phone and slowly fell asleep in the night, ending a plain but fulfilling Wednesday. My body was slightly tired, but I felt a small sense of accomplishment inside.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning courtyard walk and Baduanjin.
description: After waking naturally at 5:20 in the morning, she walked slowly in her own courtyard for 20 minutes, focusing on practicing the new shoulder circle movement and slowing down the overhead raises and side stretches to deepen the shoulder and back stretch. Then she went into the living room and did a complete set of Baduanjin on the mat, with deep, long breaths. The movements were smooth, her body slightly sweated, and she felt her strength had improved.
location: Courtyard and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Watering flowers, asking for photography advice, and breakfast.
description: After finishing her exercises, she woke up the three children. Ma Mingxuan checked the rose leaves, while Ma Mingzhe and Ma Yuxin sprayed water on the vegetable seedlings. Xiulan used her phone to take a low-angle photo of the roses with dewdrops on them and sent it to the Tianjin Skillful Sisters group chat, asking Aunt Wu for composition advice. Aunt Wu praised her for progress with aperture and light. Then the children washed up, and Xiulan heated up the steamed buns she had made yesterday, cooked millet porridge, and cut some soy-pickled cucumber. At breakfast, Xuanxuan ate very quickly, Zhehe chatted about fun things at school, and Xinxin sipped her porridge slowly. Xiulan reminded the children to bring everything they needed for school.
location: Home courtyard, kitchen, and dining room at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Taking the children to school
description: Riding the electric bike, she first took Ma Mingzhe to the gate of the Third Primary School in Jinghai District and told him to listen carefully in class; then she took Ma Yuxin to Huakang First Kindergarten and only felt relieved after seeing the teacher take her. Then she rode back home alone, thinking about going to the vegetable market in the morning.
location: Tianjin Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street) and Huakang First Kindergarten, plus return trip to No. 156 Jingwen Road

name: Tidy up the house and rush to finish embroidered handkerchiefs.
description: After getting home, she hurriedly washed a few pieces of clothing she had changed out of the day before, then swept the floor and wiped the tables. After tidying up, she took out the peony handkerchiefs she was preparing for next week's stall, sat by the window in good light, and began embroidering. Between stitches, she pondered the recipe for pickled vegetables.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Went to Xingwang Vegetable Market to discuss consignment of pickled vegetables.
description: She took two jars of the sweet garlic she had made yesterday and rode her e-bike to Aunt Sun's stall at Xingwang Vegetable Market. Aunt Sun greeted her warmly. Xiulan offered the sweet garlic for her to taste and suggested leaving it at the stall to sell on consignment. Aunt Sun agreed readily and said she would recommend it to customers. The two agreed on how to split the proceeds after selling. Then Xiulan bought eggplant and green beans for lunch, returned home, put the vegetables away, and noted down the sweet garlic consignment.
location: Xingwang Vegetable Market at the intersection of Jingwen Road and Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Continuing embroidery and preparing lunch ingredients
description: Continued embroidering the peony handkerchief, with finer and finer stitches. In between, she went to the kitchen, cut the eggplant into rolling chunks, snapped the green beans into sections, and prepared the lunch dishes, then returned to the living room and embroidered for a while.
location: Living room and kitchen at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing lunch and having lunch with the eldest son
description: Entered the kitchen and turned on the stove to cook: braised eggplant and garlic green beans. Around 11:30, the eldest son Ma Mingxuan came home from school. After serving rice, the mother and son sat down facing each other. Xiulan asked whether he had figured out the physics buoyancy problem. Xuanxuan said he understood after watching a video explanation. Xiulan picked food for him with her chopsticks and told him to do a problem for her in the evening. Xuanxuan agreed and also mentioned the physics class representative in his class.
location: Kitchen and dining room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Clean up the kitchen and take a lunch break
description: She sent Ma Mingxuan to take a midday rest, then deftly cleared the dishes, wiped clean the stove, and glanced at her phone — there were no new order messages. Afterward, she set a 30-minute alarm and lay on the bed for a midday rest. Although she didn't fall asleep, she lay quietly with her eyes closed and her body felt relaxed.
location: Home kitchen and bedroom at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Visiting neighbor Wang Guilan to chat about consignment sales.
description: After getting up, she gathered a few clean clothes folded in the morning, took her embroidery patterns, and strolled to Wang Guilan's home across the way at 158 Jingwen Road. Sister Wang was picking vegetables in the yard. Xiulan pulled up a small stool and sat down, and talked about asking Aunt Sun at the vegetable market that morning to sell her pickled vegetables on consignment. Sister Wang was very supportive and even asked Xiulan to bring her tiger-head shoes along to sell at the stall next week. Xiulan agreed readily.
location: At Wang Guilan's home, 158 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Went home and continued embroidery and taking stock of pickled vegetable orders
description: After returning from Sister Wang's house, she continued embroidering the peony handkerchief, and the petals gradually took shape. She got up to water the scallions in the yard, mentally calculating the pickled vegetable inventory and orders, and wrote down the orders from the two neighbor households that Liu Chunmei had mentioned yesterday in the special notebook on the wall.
location: Living room and courtyard at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Picking up the children from school and buying groceries on the way
description: Putting on a sun hat, she rode her electric bike first to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up Ma Yuxin, who excitedly showed off her painting. Then she went to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up Ma Mingzhe, who ran out sweating. Xiulan announced that they would have zhajiang noodles for dinner, and the children cheered. On the way, she went to the Wutong Commune vegetable market to buy pork belly, cucumbers, hand-made noodles, and a piece of tofu. After arriving home, she had the children wash their hands and do homework, while she tied on an apron to prepare dinner.
location: Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten in Jinghai District, Tianjin, Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, and the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road

name: Prepare dinner and have a family meal
description: Cut the meat into cubes, make the fried sauce, cook the hand-rolled noodles, and shred the cucumber. The fried sauce noodles were served before 18:00, along with yesterday's leftover braised pork and cold tomato salad. The eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, returned home, and the whole family ate together, chatting about funny things at the children's school.
location: Kitchen and dining room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Clean up the kitchen and help the children with their homework
description: After the meal, she cleaned up the kitchen and washed the dishes and chopsticks. Then she sat in the living room, checked Ma Mingzhe's math workbook, and taught Ma Yuxin to trace pinyin. Ma Mingxuan went back to his room to do physics buoyancy problems on his own. The only sounds in the house were pen nibs scratching paper and the occasional question.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The children washed up and had free time.
description: After helping with homework, she urged the children to wash up in turn. Ma Yuxin brushed her teeth and washed her face by herself, Ma Mingzhe was reading an extracurricular book in the living room, and Ma Mingxuan was packing his schoolbag for the next day in his own room.
location: The bathroom, living room, and bedroom of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family Reading Time
description: The unshakeable family reading time. Xiulan read books on pickling and home-style cooking borrowed from the community activity room; Ma Mingxuan read a science magazine; Ma Mingzhe and Ma Yuxin read a fairy tale book with pinyin together. After 20 minutes, each shared something interesting they had read. Ma Yuxin told a little story in her sweet childish voice, making the whole family laugh.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening walk and contacting her husband
description: Took the three children for a 20-minute walk in the courtyard and in front of the house. Ma Mingxuan took a few photos of the moon, Ma Mingzhe chased a kitten, and Ma Yuxin followed along slowly. Xiulan used her phone to send a voice message to her husband Ma Zhiqiang, who was out driving his truck, to report that they were safe and to tell him to be careful on the road.
location: Courtyard and nearby roadside at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Bedtime preparations and bedtime stories.
description: After returning home, she urged the children to get ready for bed, helped Ma Yuxin wash and dry her feet, and watched her lie down. Ma Mingxuan and Ma Mingzhe got themselves ready. Xiulan told Ma Yuxin a two-minute little story and waited until she fell asleep.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Personal stretching, bookkeeping, and interacting with the photography group.
description: After the children were all asleep, she spread out a mat in the living room and did 10 minutes of waist and back stretches and 5 minutes of deep-breathing relaxation, feeling much looser in her neck, shoulders, and back. Then she took out the account book and recorded the day's spending on vegetables and noodles. She also opened the photography group on her phone, admired the photos posted by group members, and replied to Aunt Wu's morning comment with thanks. Seeing a sunset photo with beautiful composition, she thought she might also try photographing the sunset in the yard tomorrow. At 22:00 she turned off the light and went to sleep, recalling that the consignment sale had been settled, feeling more hopeful, and gradually drifted off in the faint moonlight.
location: Living room and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Waking up, walking in the courtyard, and doing Baduanjin exercises.
description: At 5 a.m., Ma Xiulan woke up early because she was looking forward to her friend Chen Yulan's visit, but because she had gone to bed late the night before, she dozed for another half hour. She got up at 5:30, first walked for more than ten minutes in the courtyard, breathing the moist morning air; the pomegranate flower fragrance was refreshing. Then she practiced a simplified version of Baduanjin under the pomegranate tree. Although her movements were not standard, her whole body felt comfortable after a light sweat. When she finished, she watered the roses and pomegranate in the courtyard, watching the water droplets roll on the leaves, feeling at ease.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (the home courtyard)

name: Preparing breakfast and waking up the family.
description: At a quarter past six, Ma Xiulan went into the kitchen to prepare breakfast. While thinking about how to sell the stock of pickled vegetables, she took out the proofed Tianjin buns (pork and cabbage filling) and steamed them, cooked a thick millet and pumpkin porridge, and made a smashed cucumber salad with garlic and sesame oil. As the aroma grew, she woke the children one by one: first she coaxed her youngest son Ma Mingxuan (Xuanxuan) to get up quickly, saying that Aunt Yulan would bring her little brother Xiaojun over; then she urged her oldest son Ma Mingzhe (Zhezhe) not to stay in bed; and finally she helped her daughter Ma Yuxin (Xinxin) braid her little pigtails. Steam filled the kitchen, and the children's responses made the small courtyard lively.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family breakfast and preparation for sending the kids to school.
description: The family of four sat around the table eating breakfast. Ma Xiulan peeled an egg for her daughter while telling her two sons, "After we pick you up this afternoon, Aunt Yulan and little brother Xiaojun will both be there. You have to act like big brothers, take good care of your little brother, and no fighting." Xuanxuan buried his head in his congee, and Zhezhe excitedly asked whether Xiaojun knew how to play Ultraman cards. Looking at her husband's empty seat, Xiulan thought to herself that if only Zhiqiang could come home early tonight. After the meal, she quickly cleared the dishes, checked the children's schoolbags and water bottles, and changed into a clean floral blouse to get ready to take them to school.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Taking children to and from school
description: Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to take the children to school. She first went south along Jingwen Road and reached Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten in about five minutes. She watched her daughter Xinxin skip through the gate; then she turned around and went along Jingwen Road to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School on Shengli South Street, took her son Zhezhe to the school gate, told him to listen carefully in class, and only after seeing him walk into school chatting and laughing with classmates did she leave with relief.
location: Starting from 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, first go to Huakang First Kindergarten (Jinghai District, Tianjin), then to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin).

name: Shopping at the market and tidying up at home
description: After dropping off the children, Ma Xiulan stopped by Xingwang Vegetable Market. She greeted Aunt Sun, an acquaintance. To welcome her good friend Chen Yulan, she specially picked out live crucian carp and live shrimp, and also bought crown daisy, shiitake mushrooms, and soft tofu. Aunt Sun mentioned that the sweet garlic she had made last time was popular and asked her to make some more. Xiulan figured she could let Yulan taste the sweet garlic and give her opinion. At 9:15 she got home, put the vegetables in the fridge by category, checked the living room and guest room once more, changed the water for the pomegranate flowers in the vase, and made full preparations for receiving guests.
location: Xingwang Vegetable Market in Jinghai District, Tianjin; then returned home to 156 Jingwen Road.

name: Waiting for pickup and preparations
description: Yulan's stop was still some time away, and Ma Xiulan was both full of anticipation and unable to sit still. She took out the half-embroidered peony handkerchief and tried to sew a few stitches, but her mind was elsewhere; the stitches became crooked, so she simply put it away. She went back to the kitchen, sliced the braised beef, and mixed a garlic and vinegar sauce, thinking it would stave off hunger for Yulan and Xiaojun when they arrived. Just after 9:30, she pushed her electric bike out of the yard; the big yellow dog wagged its tail, and she laughed, saying she was going to pick up Aunt Yulan and would bring it a meat bone when she came back.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Picking up at the station and a small family gathering
description: Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to the Jinghai Long-Distance Bus Station in less than ten minutes and waited early at the exit. At exactly ten o'clock, the long-distance bus from Tangshan arrived. She immediately recognized Chen Yulan in a floral-print dress and the sturdy-looking Xiaojun beside her. The two clasped hands and smiled at each other. Xiulan crouched down and greeted Xiaojun warmly. The three chatted and laughed all the way home. Once home, Xiulan had the guests wash their hands, drink millet porridge first, and then served hot buns, braised beef, pickled cucumbers, and sweet garlic. Yulan praised the buns as authentic, and Xiaojun ate two. As the two of them ate and chatted, Yulan talked about the hardships of running a clothing store in Tangshan, and Xiulan told funny stories about the children. The living room was filled with laughter. Near noon, she began preparing lunch.
location: Pick them up at Jinghai Bus Station (Chaoyang Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin), then return home to 156 Jingwen Road.

name: Lunch and taking the children to school
description: At noon, Ma Xiulan quickly prepared lunch: she made egg fried rice, boiled a pot of milky white fish soup with the crucian carp and tofu bought that morning, and stir-fried some garland chrysanthemum. At 11:40, her eldest son Ma Mingxuan came home from school, politely greeted Aunt Yulan, and got to know Xiao Jun. The four sat around the table and ate, with a warm atmosphere. Xiulan told Yulan to make herself at home, saying she would take her to the vegetable market in the afternoon and cook a big dinner in the evening. After the meal, at 1:20, Xiulan rode her electric bike to take Xuanxuan back to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School. On the way, she told him to come home early after school to help entertain Xiao Jun. Only after watching her son run into the school gate did she relax and return home.
location: Dined at home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; then took Ma Mingxuan to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin).

name: Browsing the vegetable market, tasting pickled vegetables, and having heart-to-heart talks with sisters
description: After taking the children home, Ma Xiulan took Chen Yulan and Xiaojun on a stroll to Xingwang Vegetable Market. As they walked, Xiulan introduced the changes in Jinghai. At the market, she skillfully picked out a plump grass carp, pork belly, and ribs. Yulan praised her for being so well-liked. Back home, Xiulan pulled Yulan into the kitchen and opened several waist-high jars of pickled vegetables, letting her smell the rich sauce aroma. She admitted that this summer had been too hot, with few customers at the market, and that several jars had piled up, which worried her a lot. She offered Yulan a taste of the pickled cucumbers. Yulan's eyes lit up, saying they were crisp and refreshing with just the right saltiness, and suggested packaging them in nice glass jars with labels—they would surely sell well. Yulan runs a clothing store in Tangshan and knows packaging and marketing inside out. These words were like a beam of light into Xiulan's heart. The two chatted while picking vegetables in the yard, and the more they talked, the closer they became. Xiulan began planning to start the business together with her sisters.
location: Walk from 156 Jingwen Road to Xingwang Vegetable Market (Jinghai District, Tianjin), then return home.

name: Prepare the dinner, pick up the children, and cook.
description: At 4 p.m., Ma Xiulan let Yulan and Xiaojun rest in the living room. She went into the kitchen and first prepared the grass carp: she scored it with a knife, rubbed it with salt and cooking wine to marinate, cut the pork belly into small cubes, blanched the ribs, and prepared scallions, ginger, and garlic. At 4:20, she rode her electric bike to pick up the other two children: first to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up her daughter Ma Yuxin, then to No. 3 Primary School in Jinghai District to pick up her son Ma Mingzhe, reminding them along the way to be polite to their younger brother Xiaojun. Back home, the three children quickly started playing together in the yard, looking for ants and bouncing a ball.
