Xiulan tied on an apron and went all out, making red-braised pork, preparing sweet-and-sour sauce and deep-frying ribs; on the stove, pots and pans clattered. She also made braised fish, sweet-and-sour pork tenderloin, red-braised pork, steamed shrimp with garlic and vermicelli, and wood ear mushroom and cucumber salad. The aroma filled the whole yard.
location: Starting from No. 156 Jingwen Road, go first to Huakang First Kindergarten and then to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up the children, and finally return home.

name: Family dinner and reunion with old friends
description: Just after 6 p.m., the table was filled with dishes. Just as she was about to call the children to the table, her husband Ma Zhiqiang walked into the courtyard carrying two bottles of drinks and was especially happy to see Yulan arrive. Seven people sat around the steaming dishes; the adults drank and chatted while the children chattered and shared snacks and toys. Ma Zhiqiang was a down-to-earth man. Hearing Yulan's idea about pickle packaging, he nodded repeatedly and said that once packaged well, the all-natural goods would surely sell. Ma Xiulan listened, looked at the laughter around the table, and felt that life had hope again.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tidying up, homework tutoring, and family reading
description: After dinner, Ma Zhiqiang voluntarily washed the dishes and tidied up, while Ma Xiulan looked after the three children doing homework in the living room. Xuanxuan had a physics problem he couldn't solve, and Yulan took a look to help (she said the young woman at her shop was a college student); Xiulan watched Xinxin practice pinyin tracing, checked Zhezhe's mental arithmetic, and Xiaojun sat obediently nearby drawing. At 8:10, they entered family reading time. Xiulan took out The Little Prince and had Xinxin read it aloud to Zhezhe and Xiaojun, while Xuanxuan quietly read a science magazine. Xiulan and Yulan sat on the sofa flipping through an old photo album, softly chatting about the past, with the children's childish reading voices in their ears; the atmosphere was peaceful.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Girlfriends' night chat and seeking a way out for pickled vegetables
description: At nine in the evening, Ma Xiulan urged the children and Xiaojun to wash up and go to bed. After they all fell asleep and the courtyard quieted down, she brewed two pots of tea in the living room and had a heart-to-heart talk with Yulan. They reminisced about middle school and chatted about family matters, and the topic eventually came back to the pickle jar. Yulan took out her phone and showed Xiulan pictures of beautifully packaged handmade food she had collected, urging her: "Your pickled vegetables taste absolutely amazing. As long as you tidy up the storefront, buy clean glass jars, and design a simple label, your skill plus a nice appearance will definitely fetch a good price." These words greatly inspired Ma Xiulan. She listened carefully, planning in her mind how to do it together with her neighbors Wang Guilan and Liu Chunmei. They talked until ten o'clock, then reluctantly saw Yulan back to the guest room.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pre-sleep preparation and relaxation
description: Ma Xiulan helped Yulan and Xiaojun settle into the guest room, then checked whether the children had kicked off their blankets. Back in the bedroom, though she felt a little tired in her waist and back, she was in a good mood. They had talked late today, so she skipped soaking her feet and only did 5 minutes of waist and back stretches, then lay in bed breathing deeply to relax. As she closed her eyes, Yulan's words still echoed in her mind. She seemed to see herself going to Jingbai Supermarket tomorrow to pick out beautiful glass jars and studying packaging with her sisters, and she drifted off to sleep with a smile at the corner of her mouth.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning walk in the courtyard and admiring flowers.
description: Just before 5:30, Ma Xiulan was awakened by a faint light. Seeing her family was still sound asleep, she quietly got out of bed. She walked alone in the courtyard to get some fresh air. The early summer sunlight fell on the roses. She looked at them carefully and picked two of the fullest blossoms, planning to put them in a glass vase in the living room for guests, hoping her daughter Yulan would be happy to see them.
location: Own small courtyard at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning exercise and breakfast preparation
description: After taking a deep breath, Ma Xiulan quietly practiced a full set of Baduanjin in the living room, moving gently so as not to disturb the guests. After finishing, she went into the kitchen, tied on an apron, washed the millet and cooked porridge, took baozi from the refrigerator and steamed them, then sliced the freshly pickled cucumbers in soy sauce and arranged them on a porcelain plate. The kitchen was filled with the aroma of rice and savory pickles.
location: Her living room and kitchen at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Prepare for guests and freshen up
description: While the porridge was simmering, Ma Xiulan trimmed the rose leaves, put the flowers into a clean wine bottle, and placed it on the small side table to add life to the home. She then went to the yard to check the green peppers and scallions, pulling up weeds as she went. Afterward, she washed her face with cold water, gathered her hair simply, and changed into a neat floral-print top, welcoming the new day with a tidy appearance.
location: Living room, kitchen, and bedroom of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Wake up family members and guests
description: After the porridge and steamed buns were ready, Ma Xiulan first woke her three children, Xuanxuan, Zhezhe, and Xinxin, and urged them to wash their faces and eat. Then she went to the next room and gently woke the guest Chen Yulan and her son. Chen Yulan smelled the aroma, and the two exchanged smiles, easily starting the day.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (bedrooms at home)

name: Warm breakfast time
description: The whole family sat around the table, where there were steaming millet porridge, Tianjin baozi with thin wrappers and generous fillings, and crisp soy-pickled cucumbers. The children ate happily, with Xiaojun and Xinxin competing to drink porridge. Ma Xiulan kept putting baozi on Chen Yulan's plate, saying they were newly steamed yesterday with a pork and cabbage filling. After tasting them, Chen Yulan was full of praise. Everyone ate and chatted, and the atmosphere was harmonious.
location: Home restaurant, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning: taste pickled vegetables, do handicrafts, and have casual chat in the courtyard
description: After breakfast, the children played with building blocks and puzzles in the living room, with Ma Mingxuan looking after his younger siblings. Ma Xiulan brought Chen Yulan into the kitchen and arranged pickled vegetables such as sweet garlic, pickled cucumbers, and pickled radish in small dishes for tasting. Chen Yulan thought the sweet garlic was sweet, crisp, and tasty, and suggested switching to small earthenware jars for packaging to raise the price. The two returned to the living room, spread out the embroidery hoop, and Ma Xiulan personally taught Chen Yulan to embroider leaf outlines. While learning, Chen Yulan filmed the pickle jars and embroidery work with her phone, planning to post on Moments to help promote them.
location: Kitchen and living room of the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Lunch preparation and enjoyment
description: Ma Xiulan tied on her apron to prepare lunch, deftly cleaned the live fish to make braised fish, while Chen Yulan helped beat eggs. Together they made braised fish, scrambled eggs with tomatoes, and smashed cucumbers. Around noon, a table of home-style dishes was served, looking appetizing. The children ate with gusto, and Chen Xiaojun even had another half bowl of rice.
location: Her own kitchen and dining room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Noon rest and free activities.
description: After lunch, Ma Xiulan cleared the dishes and settled the children for naps on the bed or on the sofa. She and Chen Yulan leaned back on the sofa and chatted, and before long both fell asleep peacefully, enjoying a rare quiet afternoon.
location: Various rooms of her home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Sewing cushions and filling chili sauce
description: Waking up in the afternoon, Ma Xiulan dug out floral fabric scraps and, following Chen Yulan's instructions, sewed a small cushion for her sister Li Xiuyun in Beijing. Chen Yulan handed her fabric and straightened the thread beside her. After more than an hour, a thick, pretty cushion was finished. Ma Xiulan also packed a bottle of homemade chili sauce and wrote a note to send her best wishes.
location: Home living room at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Going to Jingbai Supermarket
description: Ma Xiulan changed into a neat set of clothes and set out with her close friend Chen Yulan and Yulan's son Xiaojun. They walked south along Jingwen Road through the hutong, heading on foot to Jingbai Supermarket in the Yuzhou Zunfu residential community.
location: The road section from Jingwen Road to the intersection of Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Shopping at Jingbai Supermarket
description: Entering Jingbai Supermarket, Ma Xiulan went straight to the daily necessities section and spent 8 yuan to buy two new-style glass jars with cork stoppers, planning to use them later for filling with pickled vegetables and giving as gifts. Chen Yulan helped pick out a roll of twine for decoration and bought a pack of cookies for Xiaojun.
location: Jingbai Supermarket, Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu, at the intersection of Jingwen Road and Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Go to Jinghai Post Office to send a parcel
description: After leaving the supermarket, the three walked east along Shengli Street, turned onto Jingwen Road, and after about ten minutes on foot reached the Jinghai Post Office across the road.
location: Jingwen Road section, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Sent a parcel to her older sister.
description: At the Jinghai Post Office, Ma Xiulan filled in the address, carefully packed the seat cushion and chili sauce into a cardboard box, sealed it, and sent it off. Chen Yulan praised her handiwork. Ma Xiulan was happy inside and looked forward to her elder sister's joy upon receiving the package.
location: Jinghai Post Office, 50 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Returning home, cleaning up, and tidying the courtyard
description: After returning home from the post office, everyone drank plain cool boiled water to quench their thirst. While the sun was not too fierce, Ma Xiulan took in the clothes that had been aired in the morning, folded them neatly, and put them back in the wardrobe. She also swept the yard to remove the rose petals, keeping the courtyard fresh and tidy. The children played chasing ants in the yard.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin - my own courtyard and living room

name: Prepare dinner: zhajiang noodles
description: For dinner, she prepared light hand-rolled zhajiang noodles. Ma Xiulan kneaded the dough and rolled out the noodles, while Chen Yulan helped wash the bean sprouts. Ma Xiulan cut the noodles neatly, made the minced pork and soybean paste sauce, blanched the bean sprouts, and shredded cucumber. The kitchen was filled with the aroma of meat and noodles.
location: Home kitchen at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The entire family enjoys dinner.
description: The steaming hot noodles were brought to the table. Everyone mixed in rich fried sauce and fresh toppings themselves and ate to their hearts' content. Zhe Zhe ate two full bowls, and Xiaojun followed his lead. The adults chatted about funny stories from their school days, while the children had a contest slurping noodles. Laughter and joy filled the room.
location: Home restaurant, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Clearing the dining table and kitchen.
description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan briskly cleared the dishes and wiped the kitchen clean, not letting Chen Yulan lift a finger. Chen Yulan leaned against the doorframe watching, feeling very much at ease.
location: Home kitchen at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family walk around the neighborhood
description: As the summer heat faded, Ma Xiulan and Chen Yulan took the children out of the house and strolled slowly along the community path. The children ran ahead, chasing and playing hide-and-seek, while the two walked arm in arm behind, chatting about their past at Jinghai Middle School and their recent lives, laughter mingling with the evening breeze.
location: Inside Jingwen Community, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Going home, washing up, and having an in-depth heart-to-heart talk
description: After returning from the walk, Ma Xiulan urged the three children to take turns bathing. Once the children were settled, she washed the newly bought glass jars in boiling water, left them to dry, and then sat with Chen Yulan under the living room light to discuss what handwritten labels to make for the jars next time. The two also talked about the family's difficulties and plans for the future, and both grew teary-eyed at the emotional moments.
location: Own bathroom and living room at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pre-sleep stretching and relaxation
description: In the dead of night, Ma Xiulan washed up, changed into her pajamas, and did 10 minutes of lower-back and waist stretches on the bedroom floor to loosen stiff muscles. Then she closed her eyes and did 5 minutes of deep breathing to calm her mind and body completely. Thinking back on the day, although busy, it was warm and fulfilling; with friends around, life was not so hard to endure.
location: Her own bedroom at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning exercise and Baduanjin
description: On Sunday morning, Ma Xiulan walked into the yard in loose athletic wear. She first walked slowly around the yard for 20 minutes to loosen up, then did 10 minutes of stretching beside the roses, enjoying the fresh scent of the vegetables. She then returned to the living room and practiced a set of Baduanjin by herself. Though she quickened the pace, her movements were precise, and after working up a light sweat she felt refreshed.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; own small courtyard and living room.

name: Family breakfast
description: Ma Xiulan went upstairs to wake her husband and children, told them to wash up and change clothes, then went to the kitchen to cook millet porridge, steam buns, and stir-fry shredded potatoes and eggs. The family of five sat around the dining table enjoying breakfast, simple and warm.
location: Kitchen and dining room of the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family deep-cleaning mobilization and execution
description: After breakfast, Ma Xiulan gathered the family in the living room for a mobilization meeting and assigned the thorough-cleaning tasks: her husband Ma Zhiqiang was responsible for cleaning the living room and kitchen windows; her eldest son Ma Mingxuan was to organize the desk and old books; her second son Ma Mingzhe was to sweep the floor; and her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin was to put away toys. The whole family immediately took action. Ma Xiulan took down all the curtains and bedsheets and duvet covers, stuffed them into the washing machine, and washed the dishes and chopsticks. Zhiqiang carefully wiped the windows, and the children each did their part: Xinxin put the plush toys and the toy train into boxes. Working together, they also reorganized the miscellaneous boxes in the corner of the living room and cleared out an empty space. Ma Xiulan took a photo of the tidy living room as a keepsake.
location: Various rooms at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Making and selling pickled vegetables
description: After the big cleanup, Ma Xiulan started making gift boxes of pickled vegetables. Wearing gloves, she packed the pickled cucumbers, pickled radishes, and other items into 10 paper boxes, paired the flavors, and tied red-string bows. Then she took photos with her phone and sent them to her younger sister Ma Xiufen, who runs a clothing store in Binhai New Area, asking her to help promote them on Moments. She also called her childhood friend Liu Chunmei and old neighbor Zhou Xiuqin to help spread the word in the community. At the same time, she and her husband sorted the clutter cleared from the living room, tied up the waste, and put the useful items in the storage room. This busyness made her feel at ease.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; home kitchen and living room

name: Simple lunch and rest.
description: After a tiring morning, Ma Xiulan asked her husband Ma Zhiqiang to buy cold noodles and sesame flatbread, while she made smashed cucumber and cut watermelon. The family had a simple lunch. After the meal, her husband and children went for a nap, and Ma Xiulan rested with her eyes closed on the living room sofa for half an hour to regain energy.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, home dining room and living room

name: Riding a bike to buy groceries and visiting parents
description: At 1 p.m., Ma Xiulan set off on her small tricycle, first going to the Wutong Commune vegetable market to buy fresh vegetables and meat for dinner. Then she stopped by No. 45 Shengli Avenue to visit her parents. Her mother Li Xiuying was trimming chives, and her father Ma Jianguo was drinking tea and watching TV. She chatted with her parents and told them about the pickled vegetable gift box. Her mother praised her for being skillful with her hands. After a short reunion, Ma Xiulan rode home warmed by family affection.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market (Jinghai District, Tianjin); 45 Shengli Street (45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin)

name: Keeping track of pickle orders and hand embroidery
description: After getting home, Ma Xiulan checked WeChat on her phone and saw that a friend of her younger sister had ordered 3 gift boxes, and Liu Chunmei had also sent word that 3 or 4 people in the community wanted bulk pickled vegetables. She noted them all down. After handling the orders, she took out the embroidery hoop she had been working on, sat by the living room window, and embroidered carefully while listening to storytelling, enjoying the quiet solitude.
location: Living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepared and enjoyed a hearty dinner, then cleaned up after the meal.
description: At 4:30 in the afternoon, Ma Xiulan put on an apron and started cooking dinner. Her little daughter Xinxin helped by peeling garlic and handing her plates. She made the noodles with gravy the children loved, mixing, rolling, and cutting the noodles by hand, and also cooked sweet and sour pork loin. At 5:30 in the evening, the steaming noodles with wood ear mushroom, day lily, and egg gravy, served with garlic paste and vinegar, and the sweet and sour pork loin with a crispy outside and tender inside, were enjoyed by the whole family sitting around the table for a reunion dinner. The children ate with great relish. After dinner, she and her husband cleaned up together, washing the dishes, storing leftovers, and restoring the dining area to order.
location: Kitchen and dining room of the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family reading and getting ready for bed
description: After tidying up, Ma Xiulan had the children wash their hands and faces, then took out the newly bought picture book The Little Prince and led the children to the freshly cleaned mat in the corner of the living room. She read the story to the two younger ones while the eldest son listened along; when she reached the funny parts, the children laughed joyfully. Then she urged the children to take baths and brush their teeth to get ready for school the next day.
location: A newly cleared corner in the living room of the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Evening accounting, stretching, and relaxing to fall asleep
description: After settling the children down, Ma Xiulan returned to the bedroom, took out her phone and notebook, organized the pickle orders, and calculated the income, feeling more secure. Then she changed into her pajamas, did 10 minutes of lower-back and waist stretches on the floor, and then did 5 minutes of deep breathing in bed to ease the day's fatigue. She chatted with her husband Ma Zhiqiang for a few minutes and felt fulfilled and content. After turning off the light, she soon fell into a deep sleep, bringing the weekend to a perfect close.
location: Master bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Early morning walk and courtyard work
description: Xiulan woke up at 5:15, thinking about the pickles, so she quietly got up. First she walked a few slow laps in the yard to stretch her muscles. Seeing that the green beans in the vegetable bed were ready to pick, she pulled up weeds and picked a small handful of tender beans, planning to take them to her parents' home at noon. By then, Yulan was also awake and came out to join her. The two of them chatted softly about everyday things while moving around in the yard; it was simply delightful.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing breakfast and morning chores
description: After picking vegetables, Xiulan went inside, put on an apron, and started preparing breakfast: heated up the red bean paste buns and steamed dumplings made yesterday, warmed a bowl of milk for each of the three children, and cut some fruit. At 6:10, she went upstairs and woke the children one by one: "Xuanxuan, get up quickly, don't be late! Zhezhe, stop lying in bed! Xinxin, Mommy will help you get dressed." Yulan also helped braid Xinxin's hair. The family sat down at the dining table. Xiulan kept reminding them: "Xinxin, hold your spoon properly. Zhezhe, you must eat the egg!" Xuanxuan took a few bites of food, slung his backpack on, and pushed his bike out the door: "Mom, I'm leaving!" Xiulan ran to the door and called after him: "Slow down on the road! Come home early after school!"
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Ride a bike to take the children to school
description: At exactly 7:00, Xiulan put on the jacket for her youngest daughter Xinxin, took her second son Zhezhe along, and set off on the small tricycle. Along Jingwen Road they turned onto Shengli Street. At 7:10, she dropped Zhezhe off at the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School. Then she turned around and rode for 5 minutes, arriving at Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten at 7:15, where she watched Xinxin being received by a teacher before she felt reassured. At 7:20 she rode home.
location: Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Sisters practice Baduanjin together
description: After dropping the children off and returning home, Xiulan saw Yulan waiting in the living room. The two exchanged smiles, and Yulan said, "Sister, you've been looking well these past few days. How about we practice your Baduanjin again?" Xiulan gladly agreed. They spread mats in the living room and, with soothing music playing, Xiulan led Yulan through each movement. Yulan's movements were unfamiliar, but she practiced earnestly. As they practiced, they corrected each other and felt much more comfortable.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Handling pickled vegetable inventory and passing it on to neighbors.
description: After finishing Baduanjin, Xiulan put away the mat and tidied up the living room that the children had messed up. She had been thinking about the pickled vegetables and said to Yulan, "Yulan, while I'm still energetic, I need to deal with those twenty-plus jars of pickled vegetables. This can't be delayed any longer." Then Xiulan and Yulan moved all 28 jars of pickled vegetables out of the corner of the kitchen and counted them one by one. Xiulan became increasingly clear that if they were kept any longer, the flavor would only get worse. She picked up her phone and first called her husband, who was out, to share her idea. Her husband supported her: "Just make the decision yourself, and don't tire yourself out." Then she contacted, respectively, Sister Wang Guilan from across the way (giving away two jars), Zhang Shufen, who ran a small supermarket diagonally opposite (giving away two jars to try), and Aunt Sun at the vegetable market (agreeing to sell the remaining 24 jars on consignment at cost). When Wang Guilan and Zhang Shufen heard the jars were free, they happily agreed to come pick them up soon. After hanging up, Xiulan found clean fresh-keeping bags and old plastic bags, packed the pickled vegetables for Wang Guilan and Zhang Shufen separately, and tied them up. Wang Guilan came over first. Xiulan handed them to her and said, "Sis, these are homemade with no additives. Just put them in the refrigerator when you get back." After a while, Zhang Shufen also came to get hers and chatted a bit about her supermarket business. After seeing them off, Xiulan restacked the 24 jars for Aunt Sun to sell on consignment, covered them with the tricycle cloth, and got ready to deliver them in the afternoon.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Going to my parents' house for lunch together.
description: After finishing the pickles, Xiulan felt half the weight lifted from her heart. She checked the time and called to Yulan and the children, who had just come home from school, 'Come on, let's go to Grandma's for noodles with gravy!' Xiulan locked the door. Yulan took Xinxin's hand, Zhezhe skipped along, and Xuanxuan followed behind pushing his bicycle. The group chatted and laughed as they walked through several familiar alleys and arrived at her parents' home at 11:45. As soon as they entered, her mother Li Xiuying beamed at the sight of Yulan, took her hand, and kept saying she had put on weight. The smell of the gravy drifted from the kitchen. Xiulan tied on an apron to help her mother, cutting cucumber into strips and peeling garlic. Her father Ma Jianguo sat in the living room playing Chinese chess with Xuanxuan and Zhezhe, asking Yulan about the development and weather in Tangshan. At noon the family sat around together, eating piping-hot handmade noodles, chatting and laughing noisily. After the meal, Xiulan helped her mother clear away the dishes and was pleased to see her mother in good spirits. She took leave with Yulan, and on the way home said to her, 'Go back and rest for a while. I'll ride the tricycle to the vegetable market and deliver the pickles to Aunt Sun.' Then she walked home herself.
location: No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Afternoon outing: pickled vegetable consignment sales and shopping
description: Back home, Xiulan took a drink of water, rode her small tricycle carrying the 24 carefully prepared jars of pickled vegetables, and headed straight to the Wutong Commune Vegetable Market. At the market, she found the stall of her regular customer, Aunt Sun. Aunt Sun was very straightforward. After looking at the goods and tasting them, she was very satisfied, and the two agreed on a wholesale price. Xiulan helped her move the pickle jars under the stall and stack them neatly, then carefully reminded her about storage and shelf life. Aunt Sun said, “Xiulan, don’t worry. I’ll sell them slowly for you and pay you after they’re sold.” With this done, Xiulan felt as if a weight had been lifted off her shoulders, and her steps became light. Since she was at the market anyway, she bought the evening groceries on the way: a piece of fresh pork belly, two scallions, a piece of ginger, and a few jin of potatoes. Everything went smoothly. Then Xiulan rode out of the market and, thinking that the dried noodles and eggs at home were almost gone, made a detour to Jingbai Supermarket. She bought a bundle of dried noodles and a carton of eggs to prepare for the next morning’s breakfast. After paying, she rode home fully loaded, facing the afternoon breeze, in a cheerful mood.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Building 19, Room 104, Yuzhou Zunfu, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Returned home to rest and chatted with sisters while doing embroidery
description: Xiulan returned home, put away the vegetables and dried noodles, and washed her hands. Yulan was sitting on the living room sofa, fiddling with an embroidery hoop. Xiulan laughed when she saw it: 'When did you take out my work?' Yulan said, 'I might as well, since I have nothing to do; the peony you embroidered is really beautiful, so I wanted to try it too.' So Xiulan brewed two cups of tea and took out her own embroidery. The two sat by the window, stitching away and chatting about household matters, enjoying a rare and quiet afternoon.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepared dinner and made dumplings.
description: Xiulan looked at the time—it was time to make dinner. She tied on her apron and, humming a tune, deftly kneaded the dough and chopped the meat filling to make pork-and-scallion dumplings that the children love. She also made a cucumber salad and boiled a few ears of corn. Her mood was relaxed throughout the whole process; the pickle matter was completely set aside, and she felt life was back on track.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner time
description: Husband Ma Zhiqiang didn't go out driving today, so he happened to come home for dinner. After Xuanxuan finished evening self-study, the whole family sat together. Xiulan told her husband about her decision to finish handling all the pickled vegetables. Zhiqiang nodded and said, “Okay, let's put this behind us. Don't overdo it from now on.” At the dinner table, the children talked about funny things at school. Xinxin picked up a dumpling and said, “Mom's dumplings are the best!” Xiulan smiled and served food to the children, feeling warm inside.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Cleaning up after meals and supervising homework
description: After the meal, Xiulan and Yulan cleared the dishes together, while her husband Zhiqiang wiped the table and swept the floor. After cleaning up, Xiulan sat at the living room table and urged Zhezhe and Xinxin to do their homework. Xuanxuan, now in the second year of junior high school, was studying hard in his own room upstairs. Yulan helped Xiulan husk the steamed corn. Her husband sat on the sofa watching TV news for a while, occasionally interjecting a few words.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Sisters' late-night chat and putting the children to bed
description: After the children finished their homework, Xiulan urged them to go wash up. She and Yulan sat on the sofa, looking through photos of the children on their phones, and chatted about how hard their husbands worked and their plans for the children's future. The atmosphere was warm. The husbands were enjoying the cool air in the courtyard. At 21:00, the children were all in bed, and Xiulan settled them down.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pre-bed stretching and relaxation
description: Xiulan returned to the bedroom, changed into pajamas, and did 10 minutes of stretching and deep breathing on the floor. She felt her joints being pulled open and let out a long breath. Today's pickled vegetable task had been completed successfully, and the chat with her sisters had been enjoyable; the anxiety in her heart completely dissipated, leaving only calm. At 22:15, she turned off the light and said to her husband beside her, 'Today was a fulfilling day.' She soon fell asleep.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning courtyard activity
description: In the early morning, Ma Xiulan took a walk in her own courtyard, breathing in the fresh air. Seeing rose petals fallen all over the ground, she woke the three children and had them pick up the petals and bury them in the soil as fertilizer, and she took a photo of the fallen flowers and sent it to the family group. Afterward, she practiced a complete set of Baduanjin in the courtyard, feeling that the Two Hands Hold Up the Heavens to Regulate the Triple Burner movement was accurate, and her lower back felt comfortable.
location: Home courtyard at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare breakfast and breakfast.
description: Ma Xiulan steamed multigrain buns, cooked millet and mung bean porridge, sliced pickled vegetables, and fried eggs in the kitchen. At 6:30 she woke Xuanxuan, Zhezhe, and Xinxin to wash up, and the family ate breakfast together in the dining room. At the table she reminded Xuanxuan that second-year junior high school studies were important, warned Zhezhe to behave at school, and helped Xinxin peel her egg. Her husband Zhiqiang had left early for a drive and did not eat at home.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Taking the children to school
description: Ma Xiulan rode the tricycle, first taking Zhezhe to the gate of Jinghai District Third Primary School and watching him enter; then she turned around to take Xinxin to Huakang First Kindergarten, handed her to the teacher, and chatted for a while. Xuanxuan rode his own bicycle to No. 5 Middle School.
location: Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and Huakang First Kindergarten, Huakang Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Picking vegetables in the vegetable patch
description: After dropping off the child, Ma Xiulan stopped by her family's vegetable plot on Jingwen Road on the way, picked four or five fresh autumn cucumbers and a few scallions, and planned to bring them to her friend Chen Yulan.
location: Own vegetable plot on Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tidy up the house and prepare to receive guests.
description: Back home, Ma Xiulan briskly cleared the dishes, wiped down the kitchen, and tidied the toys and sofa in the living room. She washed the cucumbers and scallions she had picked, arranged them on plates, and set them on the table. She also gave the three children's bedrooms a quick tidy, soaked the laundry, and sat in the living room waiting for Chen Yulan to arrive.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Designed and printed labels for the pickled vegetables
description: Chen Yulan came to the house, tasted the newly made pickled radish, and then designed a label for Ma Xiulan's pickled vegetables. She hand-drew a pickle jar and the Tianjin Eye pattern and wrote "Xiulan Handmade". Ma Xiulan was very satisfied, and the two decided to make gift-box packaging. Then they went together to Bowen Graphic Quick Print at the street corner and printed 10 A5 coated-paper samples. While waiting, they discussed the gift-box packaging plan.
location: Living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and Bowen Graphic & Quick Printing, 167 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Lunch and rest
description: Back home, Ma Xiulan and Chen Yulan made a cold dish with the cucumbers and scallions they had picked, heated up steamed buns, and had a simple lunch with the pickled vegetables. After the meal, Yulan helped clear the table and left. Ma Xiulan then rested on the sofa for about 20 minutes.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Go to her parents' home for a gathering
description: After the afternoon nap, Ma Xiulan woke up the three children, put sun hats on them, and walked to her parents' home. At her parents' home, her mother Li Xiuying had steamed red date cake and handed it out to the children, and her father Ma Jianguo invited his grandson to play chess. Ma Xiulan discussed with her mother that she wanted to set up a reading corner for the children but lacked a bookshelf, so her mother gave her her father's old bookshelf. Ma Xiulan was very happy after looking at the bookshelf, and also asked her mother for the secret recipe for date cake.
location: Parents' home, 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Carrying the bookshelf home
description: Ma Xiulan, her father, and her eldest son Xuanxuan carried the old bookshelf down from her parents' home together. The three took turns carrying it for 20 minutes and moved the bookshelf back to their home at 156 Jingwen Road.
location: From No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin to No. 156 Jingwen Road

name: Wipe down the bookshelf and set up a reading corner.
description: After arriving home, Ma Xiulan wiped the bookshelf clean with a damp cloth, directed the children to neatly arrange their extracurricular books and comics, then brought over floor cushions and a desk lamp to set up a cozy reading corner in a corner of the living room.
location: Reading corner in the living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Clean the house and prepare ingredients for dinner.
description: After setting up the reading corner, Ma Xiulan swept and mopped the floor, then went into the kitchen to prepare dinner. She took out the ground pork to thaw, planned to make braised lion's head meatballs, and washed the tomatoes and eggs.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the child from school
description: Ma Xiulan rode a tricycle to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up Xinxin, then went to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up Zhe Zhe. On the way, Xinxin shared the 'Imaginary Reading Corner' she had drawn in kindergarten. Ma Xiulan found it both amusing and heartwarming.
location: Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Huakang Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Prepare dinner and share a family meal.
description: When she got home, Ma Xiulan was busy in the kitchen, making braised pork meatballs, scrambled eggs with tomatoes, and dressed cucumber salad, and steaming the jujube cake she had brought from her mother's. Around 18:30, Xuanxuan came home from his evening self-study session, and the whole family sat around the dining table for dinner. At the table, Ma Xiulan brought up setting up a reading corner, and the children all said they would read there together in the future.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening walk in the courtyard
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan took the children for a walk in the courtyard to aid digestion. The children played in the yard while Ma Xiulan did stretching exercises beside them, breathing in the fresh air and feeling the day's fatigue melt away.
location: Home courtyard at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family reading and homework time
description: After the walk, Ma Xiulan asked the children to study in the newly arranged reading corner. Xuanxuan solved math problems, Zhezhe practiced writing new characters, and Xinxin flipped through picture books. Ma Xiulan sat beside them, meanwhile examining the labels printed during the day and planning the gift box production.
location: Reading corner in the living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Help the children wash up
description: Ma Xiulan urged Zhezhe and Xinxin to take a bath, helped Xinxin wash her hair, and watched Zhezhe take a shower. She also heated water for Xuanxuan to soak his feet and ease his fatigue.
location: Home bathroom, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and falling asleep.
description: After the children went back to their rooms, Ma Xiulan did pre-sleep stretching and deep breathing in the bedroom and thought back on the big things she had accomplished that day: the labels and the reading corner. Then she wrote down tomorrow's plan in her phone memo: go to the market to pick out kraft paper boxes and dried lotus leaves to make gift box samples. Finally, she checked the doors, windows, and gas, made sure the children were sound asleep, set the alarm for 5:20 the next morning, and turned off the lights to sleep around 22:30.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Morning walk in the courtyard and watering flowers with the children
description: Early in the morning, Ma Xiulan and her three children Ma Mingxuan, Ma Mingzhe, and Ma Yuxin walked in their small courtyard. They admired the roses. Mingxuan pulled up weeds, and Yuxin watered the flowers with a small watering can. Ma Xiulan took close-up photos of dewy flowers with her phone and posted them to the photography enthusiasts' group, where they received likes.
location: Own small courtyard, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Practicing Baduanjin alone
description: While the children were washing up, Ma Xiulan laid out a mat in the living room, played soothing music, and practiced the third set of Baduanjin. She paid special attention to the movement "Two Hands Hold the Feet to Strengthen the Kidneys and Waist," felt that her waist had become more flexible, and after finishing, she felt refreshed.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, living room of own home.

name: Prepare breakfast and wake up the children
description: Ma Xiulan cooked millet porridge in the kitchen, heated up steamed rolls, sliced pickled cucumbers, and boiled eggs. She called the children to get up, and the whole family sat at the table for breakfast. Yuxin peeled her own egg but scattered eggshells everywhere, and Xiulan wiped her mouth.
location: Own kitchen and dining room at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Take the children to school.
description: After breakfast, Ma Xiulan rode a small tricycle with Ma Yuxin in the front seat and Ma Mingzhe in the back seat. She first took Mingzhe to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, then pushed the tricycle and walked with Yuxin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten. Ma Mingxuan rode his bicycle by himself to Jinghai District Experimental Middle School.
location: From 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, via No. 3 Primary School in Jinghai District (Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin), to Huakang First Kindergarten (12 Huakang Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin).

name: Housework and preparing ingredients for pickled vegetables
description: After Ma Xiulan returned home, she washed the dishes and used the washing machine to wash the children's changed clothes. Then in the kitchen she took out the air-dried pickled cucumbers, pickled radishes, and sweet garlic, along with clean glass jars, to prepare for bottling in the morning.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, home kitchen and living room

name: Prepare the first batch of pickled vegetable gift boxes.
description: Ma Xiulan put on gloves, packed the pickled vegetables into clear glass jars, pressed them down, pasted on the hand-drawn labels designed by Chen Yulan (the designs included a pickle jar and the Tianjin Eye), and tied red string into a bow around each jar mouth. Each gift box contained one jar of each of three kinds of pickled vegetables, and she made 6 gift boxes in total. Whenever she finished one, she took photos and short videos with her phone, feeling satisfied.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, her own kitchen

name: Buying packaging materials and vegetables at the market
description: Ma Xiulan walked to the Wutong Commune vegetable market, chatted at the stall of her acquaintance Sun Guifang, and bought baby bok choy. Then she went to a grocery store and selected 6 kraft paper boxes and dried lotus leaves for packaging the pickled vegetable gift boxes.

participant.name: Sun Guifang
participant.relation: An acquaintance who runs a stall at the vegetable market

location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Improve the packaging and promote it online.
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan packed the pickle jars into kraft paper boxes, lined them with dried lotus leaves, and closed the lids. She posted photos of the gift boxes and a short video in the community WeChat group with the caption, 'Jinghai Old Taste — Xiulan's handmade pickles, new packaging, great for personal use or as gifts!' She also privately messaged close neighbors and relatives to recommend them.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, home kitchen and living room

name: Simple lunch and midday rest
description: Since the children had lunch at school, Ma Xiulan made simple fried rice with leftover rice and eggs, and had it with pickled vegetables for lunch. After eating, she rested with her eyes closed on the sofa for about 20 minutes.
location: Home dining room and living room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Door-to-door sales pitch for pickled vegetable gift boxes.
description: Ma Xiulan packed three sample bottles in a plastic bag. She first went to Wang Guilan's home, the neighbor across the hall, who loved the packaging so much she couldn't put it down and bought one on the spot. Then she went to Zhang Shufen's supermarket diagonally across the way. Zhang Shufen tasted it and also praised the packaging, buying one. Ma Xiulan received 76 yuan in cash.
location: Near No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; across the street is Wang Guilan's home, and diagonally opposite is Zhang Shufen's supermarket.

name: Continued sales pitching and obtained a prospective order.
description: Ma Xiulan rode her small tricycle to her mother Li Xiuying's home on Shengli Street. Her parents praised the gift boxes and ordered one. Then she went to a distant aunt's home on Jingwen Road; the aunt also ordered one, saying it was for a Mid-Autumn Festival gift. Ma Xiulan told her she would bring it when ready, then went home and put away the remaining samples.
location: Mother's home: 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Mother's cousin's home: Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Visited a handicraft exhibition with a close friend.
description: Ma Xiulan walked to 182 Jingwen Road to pick up Chen Yulan, and the two took a taxi to the Jinghai District Cultural Activity Center to visit the handicraft exhibition. At the exhibition they met an acquaintance, Zhou Xiuqin, who was displaying embroidered cushions. The three exchanged embroidery techniques. Yulan showed the pickled vegetable labels, and Xiuqin praised them and promised to help promote the pickled vegetable gift boxes in the Sunset Red dance team group.
location: No. 18 Nanwei First Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, Jinghai District Cultural Activity Center

name: Picking up the child from school and heading home
description: Ma Xiulan said goodbye to her friends, took a taxi to Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up Ma Yuxin, then led Yuxin and pushed the small tricycle while walking to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up Ma Mingzhe, and then went home with them.
location: From Jinghai District Cultural Activity Center, via Huakang First Kindergarten (No. 12 Huakang Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin), then to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin), and finally returned to No. 156 Jingwen Road.

name: Prepare a hearty dinner
description: Ma Xiulan kneaded dough, rolled it out, and cut noodles in the kitchen, making egg and tomato sauce and minced pork and eggplant sauce. She also cooked mung bean soup and sliced cucumber for a cold salad, preparing a noodle dinner with toppings for the whole family.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, her own kitchen

name: The whole family had dinner together and chatted freely
description: After Ma Mingxuan rode his bike home, the whole family sat around the table eating noodles with gravy. Ma Xiulan asked Mingxuan about his physics class, asked whether Mingzhe had quarreled with his desk mate, and asked about the new nursery rhyme Yuxin had learned. The children shared funny stories from school, and the home was filled with laughter.
location: Home dining room, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Helping the children with their schoolwork and drawing
description: After clearing the dishes, Ma Xiulan sat beside Ma Mingxuan and watched him do his physics homework, and checked Ma Mingzhe's math workbook. Ma Yuxin was drawing pictures by herself nearby, and Ma Xiulan praised her cute little duck drawing.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, living room of own home.

name: Evening leisure and manual bookkeeping
description: While the children were busy, Ma Xiulan sat on the sofa watching "New Legend of Madame White Snake" while continuing to embroider the unfinished handkerchief. During commercial breaks she went to the bedroom to record the day's income: 76 yuan in cash, 152 yuan in pre-orders from her mother and maternal cousin, 228 yuan in total, and felt satisfied with the results.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; her own living room and master bedroom

name: Put the children to bed.
description: At 9:30, Ma Xiulan urged the children to wash up, helped Ma Yuxin take a bath and coaxed her to sleep, watched Ma Mingzhe brush his teeth, checked whether Ma Mingxuan was lying down properly, and said goodnight to each in turn.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, the family bathroom and the children's bedroom

name: Stretching and relaxing before bed
description: Ma Xiulan stretched for 10 minutes in the bedroom and felt relaxed all over. Then she sat cross-legged and did 5 minutes of deep breathing to clear her mind. She checked the doors, windows, and gas, packed the snacks for the next day into her bag, planned to prepare more pickled vegetables, then turned off the light and went to sleep.
location: Own bedroom, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning walk and vegetable garden work
description: At the crack of dawn, Ma Xiulan was strolling slowly alone in the courtyard to loosen up her limbs, then walked to the small vegetable garden, bent down to pick half a basket of ripe tomatoes and a few tender green beans, planning to bring them to her mother the next day. Just then she heard Yulan calling her from inside the house to have breakfast.
location: Own courtyard and small vegetable garden at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare breakfast and wake up the children
description: Ma Xiulan put the freshly picked vegetables into the kitchen sink, quickly washed the rice and cooked millet porridge, reheated the big steamed buns made yesterday, and stir-fried a plate of eggs with scallions. Then she walked to the doorway of the three children's room and softly called Xuanxuan to get his younger brother and sister up to wash their faces and eat breakfast.
location: Home kitchen and children's bedroom doorway at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Having breakfast with the whole family and chatting with Chen Yulan.
description: Ma Xiulan served the porridge and steamed buns. As Chen Yulan ate, she praised how fragrant the porridge was. Ma Xiulan smiled and said that today she would have to send them home well-fed, and while speaking, she peeled a boiled egg for Yulan's son, all the while thinking ahead to seeing the guests off later.
location: Home dining room, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Practiced Baduanjin with Chen Yulan.
description: After breakfast, Chen Yulan suggested practicing Baduanjin once more, and Ma Xiulan nodded in agreement. The two spread a mat on the living room floor and slowly performed a set. Ma Xiulan felt her lower back slightly warm and thought to herself that she must keep up this habit.
location: Living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Seeing off Chen Yulan and her son
description: Yulan packed her luggage. Ma Xiulan stuffed two jars of newly pickled cucumbers and a bag of home-dried green beans into her bag, then squatted down and patted Yulan's son on the shoulder, telling him to listen to his mother. The two hugged tightly at the door. Ma Xiulan watched them get into a Didi Express car and leave, and only went back inside when her eyes turned red.
location: Home entrance, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tidy up the house and take stock of the pickled vegetables.
description: After seeing off the guests, Ma Xiulan spread out the tomatoes and green beans she had picked in the morning, swept the floor and wiped the tables, then went to the storage room to count the pickled vegetable stock: 8 jars of pickled cucumbers, 7 jars of pickled radishes, and 5 jars of sweet garlic, 20 jars in total. She called her childhood friend Liu Chunmei and arranged to meet at the entrance of Xingwang Vegetable Market at 9 o'clock to set up a stall and clear the stock with a buy-three-get-one-free offer.
location: Home kitchen and utility room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Ride a tricycle to Xingwang Vegetable Market
description: Ma Xiulan changed into an old coat, put on a straw hat, packed 20 jars of pickled vegetables into two boxes, tied them firmly with rope onto the back of her tricycle, pushed the tricycle out of the courtyard gate, and rode to Xingwang Vegetable Market. The weather was overcast, and it took about 15 minutes to ride there. Liu Chunmei was already waiting at the entrance holding a cardboard sign reading 'Buy three, get one free.'
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin to Xingwang Vegetable Market, Shangmao Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Holding a clearance sale with Liu Chunmei at the vegetable market stall.
description: Ma Xiulan and Liu Chunmei set up a stall at the open space near the west entrance of Xingwang Vegetable Market. They neatly arranged the pickled vegetables. Chunmei played a video of making pickled vegetables on her phone as an advertisement, while Ma Xiulan used a small spoon to offer passersby samples. Thanks to the buy-three-get-one-free promotion, a few older women came over to buy. At noon, the two took turns going to the snack stall to buy baked flatbreads to share. By nearly 3 p.m., all 20 jars of pickled vegetables were sold, collecting 230 yuan in cash. They clapped their hands in celebration, relieved it was finally all sold out.
location: West side entrance of Xingwang Vegetable Market, Shangmao Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: On the way home, go to the private plot to pick cucumbers.
description: After saying goodbye to Chunmei, Ma Xiulan rode her tricycle around to the family plot on the east side of Jingwen Road. Bending down, she carefully picked a dozen or so tender cucumbers still bearing blossoms and prickles, put them into her cloth bag, and thought blissfully that she would pickle them when she got home and bring them to her mother the next day.
location: The family's small private plot on the east side of Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Go home to rest and check on the children
description: After a 10-minute bike ride home, Ma Xiulan put the cucumbers in the kitchen, washed her face, poured water, and sat down in the living room to catch her breath. She walked to the children's bedroom door and saw Xuanxuan reading an extracurricular book, Zhezhe playing with LEGO, and Xinxin drawing. She quietly asked if they had been good at home in the morning and told them not to wander far before sunset. Then she returned to the kitchen to prepare pickled vegetables.
location: Home living room and children's room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pickling the soy-sauce cucumbers prepared for mother's birthday
description: Ma Xiulan put on an apron, washed the freshly picked cucumbers, dried them, and cut them into long strips. Following the recipe her mother had taught her, she made a sauce with light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, rock sugar, star anise, Sichuan peppercorns, and sliced ginger, boiled it, and let it cool. She layered the cucumber strips into a small jar, poured the sauce over them, and added a spoonful of baijiu before sealing the jar to enhance the aroma. Smelling the sauce, she remembered how her mother had taught her step by step, and felt warm inside. During this, Xinxin ran in and asked what was for dinner; she smiled and said she was making zhajiang noodles.
location: Home kitchen, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare ingredients for dinner
description: After pickling the cucumbers, Ma Xiulan cut the tomatoes she had picked that morning into pieces, washed and cut the green beans into segments, took a small piece of pork belly out of the fridge to thaw, and mixed the sweet bean paste and yellow soybean paste in advance for the fried sauce. She put water on to boil, ready to cook the noodles when the children said they were hungry.
location: Home kitchen, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Make zhajiang noodles for dinner
description: Ma Xiulan cut the pork belly into small dice, stir-fried them in a pan until fragrant, added minced scallions and ginger, poured in the mixed bean sauce, and slowly fried it over low heat until aromatic, then set it aside in a bowl. In another pot, she brought water to a boil and added hand-rolled noodles. At the same time, she quickly stir-fried the tomatoes, added water, brought it to a boil, and drizzled in beaten egg to make tomato egg-drop soup. Around six o'clock, she called out to the children to wash their hands and sit down at the table.
location: Home kitchen, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The whole family eats dinner
description: The table was set with a large bowl of fried sauce, a basin of vegetable toppings (shredded cucumber, bean sprouts, green beans), a pot of cold noodles, and a large basin of tomato egg drop soup. Ma Xiulan served noodles to the children one by one, adding sauce and toppings, and while eating asked Xuanxuan what book he was reading, Zhezhe what he had built with Lego, and Xinxin what she had drawn. The children all answered at once, the table was lively and noisy, and Ma Xiulan felt deeply content.
location: Home dining room, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Clearing the dining table and checking the second son's homework
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan asked Xuanxuan to help clear the dishes while she quickly washed the bowls and wiped down the stove. Then she went to the study and stopped ZheZhe, who was trying to slip away to play on his phone. Checking his summer homework, she found several math word problems left blank. With a frown, she asked him why he had missed so many and told him to make them up after returning from Grandma's house. ZheZhe nodded in agreement, and she patted her son's shoulder and told him to go get some activity to digest.
location: Home dining room and study at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Called younger sister Ma Xiufen to confirm arrangements for mother's birthday.
description: Ma Xiulan sat on the sofa and made a WeChat voice call to her younger sister Ma Xiufen. The two chatted for about 20 minutes and agreed that tomorrow each would bring items to their mother's home on Shengli Street and cook a meal together as a birthday surprise for their mother. Xiufen would buy the cake, and Ma Xiulan would do the stir-frying. After hanging up, she went to the bedroom and took out the patchwork chair cushions she had sewn recently, nodded with satisfaction, and planned to bring them along tomorrow.
location: Living room and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Watching TV and hand embroidery
description: Ma Xiulan sat on the sofa, turned on the TV to Jinghai local news, and while listening to the weather forecast, took out her embroidery hoop and embroidered a Chinese rose with fine needle and thread on a piece of white cotton cloth. Xinxin ran over and lay on her lap. While embroidering, she quietly told her daughter stories about embroidery. After embroidering for about 40 minutes, she rubbed her sore fingers and put down the hoop.
location: Living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Relaxing with a mugwort foot soak
description: After a busy day with sore and tired waist and legs, Ma Xiulan boiled a pot of hot water and poured it into a wooden basin, grabbed a handful of dried mugwort and tossed it in, sat on a small stool and soaked her feet in the hot water. She closed her eyes and let out a long breath, feeling comfortable all over. After soaking for about 15 minutes, she dried her feet and poured out the water.
location: Home bathroom at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Stretching and deep breathing before bed
description: Ma Xiulan spread a thin mat on the bedroom floor, did 5 minutes of simple stretching to move her legs and shoulders, then lay flat with her hands on her stomach and took a few deep breaths. She ran through tomorrow's plan in her mind: get up early to buy live fish, take the children to Shengli Street... After confirming nothing was missed, she set the alarm and turned off the light.
location: Bedroom, home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Check the doors and settle in for bed
description: Ma Xiulan got up and walked into the children's room. Seeing that all three children were fast asleep, she carefully tucked in the corner of Xinxin's quilt, then went to bolt the courtyard gate and the front door. She returned to bed and lay down, thinking that the pickled vegetables were finished and tomorrow she would celebrate her mother's birthday. Life was finally going smoothly. She closed her eyes and slowly fell asleep.
location: Children's room and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Getting up in the early morning and doing morning activities in the courtyard
description: At dawn, Ma Xiulan woke up naturally. Lying in bed in the bedroom, she picked up her phone, opened the community secondhand goods group, and confirmed the deal for a used bookshelf and thirty books with the seller "Wutong Renjia," agreeing to meet at seven o'clock on Shengli Street. Then she put on a coat and went to the family courtyard, slowly walked two laps along the brick path, loosened her waist and hips, then picked up the watering can to water the roses and vegetables, enjoying the fresh scent of soil and grass and gaining energy for the new day.
location: Bedroom and small courtyard of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Practicing Baduanjin and washing up in the early morning.
description: Ma Xiulan spread an old blanket in the living room and seriously practiced a complete set of Baduanjin, focusing on the movements “Two Hands Hold Up the Heavens to Regulate the Triple Burner” and “Seven Heel Bounces to Dispel All Diseases,” feeling that the soreness in her waist and hips had eased. After finishing, she quickly washed up, changed into going-out clothes, checked the e-bike key, and planned the route to pick up the bookshelf.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Rode the electric bike to pick up a secondhand bookshelf and books.
description: Ma Xiulan rode her small electric bike to the seller's building on Victory Avenue and met the young seller, "Wutong Renjia." She examined the solid wood multi-layer bookshelf that was 85% new, flipped through some literary magazines and children's books, and felt it was well worth the price. She wrapped the books in the coarse cloth wrapper she had brought, took the bookshelf apart and tied the pieces to the back seat of the electric bike, and transported everything back to her home on Jingwen Road in two trips. After arriving home, she was sweating profusely. She first drank a large glass of warm water, then ate two pork buns with millet porridge as breakfast, and afterward stacked the books and bookshelf parts in the corner of the living room.
location: Downstairs of a residential building on Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and at home at 156 Jingwen Road

name: Tidying up the house and preparing gifts to bring to her parents' home
description: Humming a tune from a Pingju opera, Ma Xiulan swept the dust from the corners of the living room and mopped the floor. Then she took out her homemade pickled cucumbers and hand-pieced patchwork chair cushions from the kitchen, packed them in clean cloth bags, and took two prepared pickled vegetable gift boxes out of the refrigerator—one for her mother and one for Aunt Li.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Welcome husband Ma Zhiqiang home.
description: Her husband Ma Zhiqiang hurried home along the night road, looking tired. Ma Xiulan went out to meet him, took his tool bag, brushed the dust off him, handed him a hot towel, and asked with concern about the trip. Ma Zhiqiang washed up after a brief reply. Ma Xiulan told him to get some sleep in the west room first, and they would go together to her parents' home at noon to celebrate her mother's birthday.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Walk with the children to her parents' home and give pickled vegetables to Aunt Li
description: Ma Xiulan woke up her three children and told them to wash up and change clothes. Her eldest son Ma Mingxuan got himself ready quickly, while her second son Ma Mingzhe and daughter Ma Yuxin dawdled a bit. Ma Xiulan urged them on while helping her daughter braid her hair. After checking the gifts and water bottles, the family carried the gifts and walked along Jingwen Road to her parents' home on Shengli Street. On the way, she first stopped at the building where Aunt Li lived and handed up a gift box of pickled vegetables. Aunt Li thanked her repeatedly and paid 76 yuan. Then the family continued on to her parents' home at 45 Shengli Street.
location: From Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to Shengli Street, downstairs at Aunt Li's house, finally arriving at 45 Shengli Street

name: Gathering at her parents' home to celebrate her mother's birthday
description: Ma Xiulan and the children arrived at her parents' home. Her younger sister Ma Xiufen was already busy in the kitchen. The sisters helped their mother Li Xiuying to the living room to rest, while their father Ma Jianguo played with the grandchildren. Ma Xiulan and her sister worked together and made dishes their mother loved: sweet and sour pork, noodles with gravy, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and cucumber salad. At noon the whole family sat around the table, and Ma Xiulan raised a toast to wish her mother health and longevity. Her mother was moved to tears. During the meal, the children eagerly toasted with their 'drinks,' and the atmosphere was lively. After the meal, Ma Xiulan cleared the table and chatted with her parents until 2 p.m.
location: Parents' home at No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Walk home and pick up the cake on the way.
description: After saying goodbye to her parents' home, Ma Xiulan let the children walk home slowly while she quickened her pace to the community bakery at 218 Jingwen Road. She picked up the pre-ordered Tianjin baozi shaped cake, which was white, plump, and cute, and was very satisfied. Then she carefully carried the cake box and walked home.
location: From Shengli Avenue to Jingwen Road in Jinghai District, Tianjin, stopping at the community bakery at No. 218 Jingwen Road along the way.

name: Arrived home and set the cake in place
description: Ma Xiulan gently put the cake box on the dining table and told the children not to touch it. At this time, her husband Ma Zhiqiang had woken up and was sitting in the living room drinking water.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Assemble the bookshelf, set up a reading corner, organize the books, and enjoy parent-child reading.
description: Ma Xiulan and her husband Ma Zhiqiang worked together to move the bookshelf parts they had picked up in the morning to the corner of the living room. Ma Zhiqiang assembled it while she helped from the side. After the bookshelf was put together, the couple spread an old blanket on the bottom layer and arranged cushions. Ma Xiulan also hung a small embroidered cloth she had made with the words 'Light of Reading,' and a cozy reading corner began to take shape. Then Ma Xiulan led the three children to carry books from their rooms to the bookshelf and directed them to place them by category: picture books and fairy tales on the bottom shelf, extracurricular reading materials on the middle shelf, and reference books and embroidery patterns on the top shelf. After tidying up, each family member picked a book and read quietly in the reading corner, filling the living room with peace and warmth.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare dinner and celebrate Ma Mingxuan's birthday
description: Ma Xiulan and her husband went into the kitchen to prepare dinner. She did the stir-frying, while her husband washed and chopped the vegetables. They made scrambled eggs with tomatoes, vinegar-sautéed cabbage, and braised tofu with minced pork, and steamed some extra rice. At dinner, the whole family sat around the table. After the meal, Ma Xiulan turned off the main light, brought out a Tianjin-baozi-shaped cake, inserted and lit 13 candles, and the family sang the birthday song. The eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, closed his eyes, made a wish, and blew out the candles. Ma Xiulan held up her phone to record, deeply moved as she watched her thoughtful son. The children happily shared the cake, with laughter echoing through the room.
location: Kitchen and dining room of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family financial turmoil: a pay cut proposed by the husband leads to an argument and reconciliation.
description: Just after the birthday celebration ended, her husband Ma Zhiqiang hesitantly brought up at the dinner table that because of the company's off-season salary cut, he was earning several hundred yuan less each month, and he wanted to suspend the 150 yuan monthly education savings for the children. Ma Xiulan immediately objected, believing that education funds were a long-term plan and could not stop no matter how tight things got. The two grew more and more agitated, and Ma Zhiqiang slammed the door and left. Ma Xiulan wept at the table, while the children cowered in the corner in fear. About an hour later, Ma Zhiqiang returned home exhausted. The two sat in silence, until finally Ma Xiulan wiped away her tears, took out the thick ledger and invoices/receipts, and they went over the month's income and expenses together. They found that due to recent higher spending and the pay cut, they were over budget by 120 yuan at the end of the month. After a sigh, they understood each other and their relationship eased.
location: Dining room and living room of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Record the day's income and expenses and add new ledger categories.
description: Ma Xiulan put on her reading glasses and entered the day's income and expenses one by one into the ledger: received 76 yuan from Aunt Li for pickled vegetables, paid 80 yuan for the bookshelf, 35 yuan for the cake, and so on. She also added a new "packaging materials" category at the end of the ledger, planning to record the costs of hand embroidery and pickled vegetable packaging separately in the future. She resolved to cut unnecessary expenses next month and stop buying fabric for now.
location: At the dining table in the living room of her home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Relaxing with a mugwort foot soak
description: Ma Xiulan boiled a pot of hot water, poured it into a deep wooden basin, and grabbed a handful of dried mugwort from the windowsill that she had brought back from her parents' home, dropping it into the water. She took off her shoes and socks and immersed her sore, swollen feet in the hot water, letting the steam rise. Closing her eyes, she reviewed the day: joy, heartache, exhaustion after quarrels, but the foot soak slowly relaxed her. She decided to make foot soaking a daily habit to reward herself.
location: Home bathroom, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: After soaking her feet, Ma Xiulan boiled water and filled a thermos, then went to check on the children's room. The eldest son was already asleep; the second son and daughter were still whispering, so she gently urged them to go to sleep. Then she carefully checked that the courtyard gate, living room door, and windows were closed and the gas valve was turned off tightly. After everything was in order, she got into bed and left a small night light on for her husband. Although her heart was still a little heavy, she firmly believed that life would go on, and soon fell asleep.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning courtyard activities and Baduanjin practice.
description: At 5:45 in the morning, just after dawn, I quietly got up and went to the yard to water the greens and pick off old leaves to feed the Luhua chickens, breathing in the fresh air tinged with the smell of soil. At 6:00 I returned to the living room and practiced the full set of Baduanjin, deliberately repeating "Shake the Head and Wag the Tail to Dispel Heart Fire" several times, trying to synchronize my breathing with the movements. Although I was a bit rusty, after finishing I was slightly sweaty and the stuffiness in my chest had eased considerably.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Prepare breakfast and enjoy it with the whole family
description: After the practice, I quickly made noodles with gravy, using fresh pork belly, dried day lily flowers, wood ear mushrooms, and eggs, and thickening the gravy with starch. The gravy was fragrant. At 6:40 I woke the children one by one and put a pink dress on Xinxin, who was still lingering in bed. The family of five sat around eating noodles. Although Zhiqiang was quiet, I put extra meat on his plate, and his eyes softened a bit. Xinxin said the noodles were tastier than kindergarten's. The atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Clean up the kitchen and get ready to go out
description: After the meal, I quickly washed the dishes and wiped down the stove, went back inside to change into a floral-print blouse, picked up the jar of pickled cucumbers and tied it tightly with a red string. When I checked the bicycle, I found the rear tire was low on air, so I pumped it up with a bicycle pump to prepare for the trip back to my parents' home.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Rode a bike back to her parents' home to deliver pickled cucumbers.
description: Turning from Jingwen Road onto Shengli Street, I cycled to my parents' home. Mother was trimming Chinese chives in the yard. I handed her the soy-sauce cucumbers, and she praised that they had my grandmother's skill. I chatted with her about everyday things for a while, only bringing up happy topics and not mentioning the quarrel with Zhiqiang. Seeing that she looked well, I took my leave so as not to delay her lunch preparation.
location: No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Going to the community Party-Mass Service Center to see Zheng Xiuying
description: After leaving my parents' home, I rode my bike to the Hu'an Qiting Community Party-Mass Service Center. In the service hall, I found Sister Zheng Xiuying and quietly asked if there was any odd work in embroidery or hand packaging. Sister Zheng readily agreed to help contact the Zhou family stationery factory about holiday greeting card ribbon work. I was extremely grateful.
location: Hu'an Qiting Community Party-Mass Service Center, Tuanbo Avenue, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Buy groceries at the Wutong Commune vegetable market
description: Rode her bike to the Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, first went to Aunt Sun Guifang's vegetable stall and picked out scallions, cilantro, and tomatoes, and bought three fresh crucian carp. Aunt Sun helped net the fish. After paying, she ran into Aunt Zhao from the neighborhood and chatted about her granddaughter's exam results and other small talk, then went home.
location: China, Tianjin City, Jinghai District, Wutong Commune Vegetable Market

name: Went home to rest, tidied up handicrafts, contacted friends, and made lunch.
description: After getting home, she first put the vegetables and fish in the kitchen, drank some water, and rested. Then she brought out her embroidery thread box and the half-finished piece 'Sunlit Lotus', sorted the threads, and noted down the two thread colors she was missing. She sent a WeChat voice message to her childhood friend Liu Chunmei to exchange ideas on handmade patterns. Liu sent back a video of an auspicious knot she had just made, and they chatted for half an hour. Then she started making zhajiang noodles, slowly frying the leftover pork belly with Liubiju yellow soybean paste over low heat. Zhiqiang came in to help peel garlic, and she mentioned that Xuanxuan needed his school fees prepared for next week. He nodded in response.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: The whole family had lunch
description: After rinsing the noodles in cold water, I topped them with shredded cucumber, bean sprouts, and green soybeans, then poured zhajiang sauce over them. The children ate with great relish. I gave Zhiqiang a bowl of noodle soup, and he slurped it down. The atmosphere was much more relaxed than at breakfast.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Noon break
description: After the meal, I urged the children to take a nap. Xuanxuan and Zhezhe went back to their own room, while I lay down with Xinxin in the master bedroom and dozed for nearly an hour, regaining my energy.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: The couple discussed the family savings plan and did embroidery.
description: After waking from an afternoon nap, while I was washing dishes, Zhiqiang came in to wipe the stove. We spread out the old account book and finalized the family savings plan: the monthly education fund was cut from 150 yuan to 50 yuan, the Beijing trip was postponed, and 500 yuan was set aside from existing savings as dedicated education funds.
