Afterwards, I sat alone by the window embroidering "lotus in the sun" for more than half an hour, and my mind calmed as the needle and thread moved.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Husband returns home with fish, couple talk, and tending the vegetable garden
description: Zhiqiang bought a grass carp and said, in a placating tone, that he would make soup for the children. I took the fish and pulled him to sit down in the living room for a heart-to-heart talk, saying that from now on household accounts should be discussed together. After that, when the sun wasn't so harsh, I changed into rubber boots and went to the yard to pick cucumbers and green beans. ZheZhe came running over to help water the plants and got his pant legs soaking wet. I teased him a bit and called Xinxin to play too.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Prepare dinner
description: First put the millet porridge on to simmer, then boil water for the sweet-and-sour fish. Zhiqiang is cleaning the fish in the yard, while I am in charge of marinating, coating with flour, and deep-frying until both sides are golden, then pouring the sweet-and-sour sauce over it and letting it simmer. With freshly picked cucumbers, I make smashed cucumber with garlic and stir-fry a seasonal vegetable. The kitchen is filled with mouth-watering aromas.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: The whole family eats dinner
description: On the table were sweet-and-sour fish, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and millet porridge. Zhiqiang praised my cooking, and the children copied him. The whole family chatted and laughed, and yesterday's unhappiness drifted away with the steam from the food.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Evening family activities: reading, homework help, and tucking the children in
description: After dinner, the family reading time was officially launched. The whole family sat quietly in the reading corner for half an hour. I praised everyone and wrote "Family reading time 19:00-19:30 every night" on the fridge memo board. Then I checked Zhezhe's summer homework and corrected three math mistakes; asked Xuanxuan about his physics preview. Finally, I washed Xinxin and changed her into pajamas, and read "Guess How Much I Love You" until she fell asleep holding my arm.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Personal care, relaxation, planning tomorrow, and going to bed
description: After the children fell asleep, I washed up and soaked my feet in mugwort water for twenty minutes. Sitting on the edge of the bed, I pressed the Hegu point and took deep breaths, thinking back on the good things of the day: visiting my parents' home, hope for odd jobs, the savings plan settled, and reading time kicked off. Then I checked the doors, windows, and gas, and jotted down tomorrow's plan in my phone memo: call my mother, contact Zheng Xiuying about work, and go to Wutong Commune to buy tofu. Finally, I got into bed quietly, snuggled under the quilt, and fell asleep feeling secure.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Morning walk and Baduanjin
description: After getting up in the early morning, she walked in her own courtyard for about 15 minutes, breathing fresh air and moving her arms and legs. Then she stood in the middle of the yard and skillfully practiced the complete set of Baduanjin movements, stretching her muscles and bones, feeling relaxed and refreshed.
location: Courtyard at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare gravy noodles and family breakfast
description: In the kitchen she carefully prepared a breakfast of noodles with gravy, making the sauce from wood ear mushrooms, day lily flowers, eggs, and pork belly, and specially added two extra poached eggs for her husband Ma Zhiqiang. After putting the breakfast on the table, she woke the family, and they all sat around the table together. During the meal, Ma Xiulan discussed with her husband having him check the washing machine's strange noise in the afternoon. The atmosphere was warm.
location: Kitchen and dining room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: After-meal chores
description: Cleared away the breakfast dishes, wiped the table, and washed the dishes; then shook out the sheets washed in the washing machine and hung them on the balcony to dry, and watered a few pots of asparagus fern on the balcony.
location: Kitchen and balcony, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Mother called to share her joy.
description: While hanging clothes, she received a call from her mother Li Xiuying. Her mother praised the pickled cucumbers she had brought back, saying they tasted excellent, and that her father had drunk a few extra glasses of wine because of them. Her mother also told her not to work too hard. The call lifted Ma Xiulan's spirits and swept away her earlier unhappiness.
location: Balcony and living room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Took the children to take care of the rose bushes.
description: She called her second son Zhezhe and little daughter Xinxin into the courtyard to water the roses, trim dead branches, and taught the children to identify rose varieties. Her eldest son Xuanxuan sat under the porch reading Five Thousand Years of Chinese History, and the family enjoyed a peaceful Sunday morning in the garden.
location: Courtyard at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Doing handicraft odd jobs and contacting friends
description: After resting for a while in the living room, she dug out her sewing box and embroidery hoop to check the progress of the embroidery. Then she sent Zheng Xiuying a voice message on WeChat, asking whether the card-and-ribbon odd job mentioned earlier was still available.
location: Living room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family lunch
description: In the kitchen, using the leftover tofu, garlic sprouts, eggs, and pork belly, she made garlic-sprout stir-fried pork, home-style braised tofu, and tomato egg-drop soup. The whole family sat together eating and chatting. The atmosphere was noticeably calmer than last night. Zhiqiang shared stories from his hauling work.
location: Kitchen and dining room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Midday nap
description: After putting away the dishes and chopsticks, she arranged for the family to take a midday rest, lay down in the master bedroom herself, set an alarm to rest for 40 minutes, and enjoyed the rare Sunday nap time.
location: Master bedroom at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Underwater World jigsaw puzzle game.
description: After the afternoon nap, she brought out an underwater-world themed jigsaw puzzle in the living room and worked on it with her second son Zhezhe and youngest daughter Xinxin, sorting the pieces by color and fitting them together. The room was filled with laughter. Her eldest son Xuanxuan sat nearby reading quietly. A small part of the puzzle was still unfinished, and they agreed to continue the following Sunday.
location: Living room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Bookshelf organization and washing machine malfunction handling
description: She took her eldest son Xuanxuan to organize the old bookshelf brought back from her parents' home, sorted the books, labeled them, and made cute fabric bookmarks from scraps of cloth. Meanwhile, the washing machine in the bathroom made a strange noise. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang checked it and found a small coin stuck in the drain pump; after removing the blockage, the washing machine returned to normal. Then the mother and son put the last few books in place, and the reading corner looked completely refreshed.
location: Reading corner and bathroom at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Going to the vegetable market and supermarket to buy groceries
description: Riding my electric bike along Jingwen Road to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, I bought fresh garlic scapes and greens at the stall of my acquaintance Sun Guifang, chatting about everyday things. Then I rode to the dried goods section of Jingbai Supermarket and bought 3 jin of fresh garlic, planning to make sweet pickled garlic. After buying everything, I returned home.
location: Jinghai District, Tianjin: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market (at the intersection of Jingwen Road and Dongxing Road) and Jingbai Supermarket (Yuzhou Zunfu, Building 19, Unit 104).

name: Family dinner time
description: After returning home from the vegetable market, she immediately started preparing dinner in the kitchen, cooking home-style dishes such as greens, braised tofu with minced pork, and tomato and egg drop soup. At dinner, the family sat together again; Ma Xiulan urged her daughter Xinxin not to be picky about food, and her husband rarely praised the dishes for tasting good, creating a warm atmosphere at the table.
location: Kitchen and dining room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening parent-child reading
description: After dinner, the family gathered in the reading corner and read together for half an hour according to the newly set rule. Ma Xiulan told Xinxin the illustrated story of The Cowherd and the Weaver Girl, her husband read a safety manual, Xuanxuan read a history comic, and Zhezhe read a dinosaur encyclopedia. The home was filled with the fragrance of books and tranquility.
location: Reading corner at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening chores and washing up the children
description: After reading, she urged the children to bathe and get washed up, and reminded Zhezhe to finish two pages of summer math homework. Then she wiped down the kitchen, sealed the leftovers and put them in the fridge, and checked the balcony doors and windows and how Xinxin was doing in her bath.
location: Bathroom and kitchen at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Nighttime embroidery time
description: After settling the children, she returned to the master bedroom, took out the embroidery hoop, and continued embroidering "Sunlit Lotus", enjoying a peaceful and focused moment with every stitch.
location: Master bedroom at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Try a mugwort foot bath
description: Used mugwort gifted by a friend to boil water for soaking her feet. The fragrance of mugwort filled the air, and the warm water relieved the fatigue of the whole day. She decided to keep up this habit in the future.
location: Master bedroom at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Stretching and relaxation, and recording household accounts
description: After soaking her feet, she stretched her shoulders, neck, and waist. Then she took out the account book, recorded the day's expense of 22 yuan for buying vegetables and garlic, and wrote down tomorrow's plan in her phone memo: get up early to cook millet porridge, steam buns, fill the children's water bottles, and finally call her father to say hello.
location: Master bedroom at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Safety check and going to bed
description: She checked the doors, windows, and gas valves one by one, confirmed they were off, turned off the lights, returned to the bedroom, lay down, and quickly fell asleep, ending a fulfilling Sunday.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin: entire house and master bedroom

name: Morning wake-up and courtyard exercise.
description: At 6:00 in the morning, dawn was just breaking and the sky was cloudy. After getting up, Ma Xiulan first strolled in her yard for 20 minutes to loosen up, then went back inside and practiced a set of Baduanjin, feeling comfortable all over. Then she went into the kitchen, made soy milk with the soybeans soaked the night before, reheated the steamed buns from yesterday, and scrambled some eggs to prepare a nutritious breakfast for the children.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Wake the children and have breakfast together
description: At 6:50, Ma Xiulan went from room to room waking the three children. Her eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, got up quickly on his own. Her second son, Ma Mingzhe, stayed in bed and needed urging. Her youngest daughter, Ma Yuxin, was very good and dressed herself. Just past 7, the whole family sat down for breakfast. While drinking soy milk, Ma Xiulan told the children not to be late for school and checked Ma Mingzhe's schoolbag to make sure nothing was left behind.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Take the two young children to school
description: At 7:30, the eldest son Ma Mingxuan rode his bicycle by himself to Jinghai District Middle School. Ma Xiulan rode her small electric tricycle, taking Ma Mingzhe and Ma Yuxin. She first headed east to Huakang First Kindergarten and handed Ma Yuxin to the teacher, then turned back and headed south on Shengli South Street, taking Ma Mingzhe to the gate of Jinghai District Third Primary School and telling him to wait for pickup after school. After dropping him off, she returned home.
location: Depart from No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, pass Huakang First Kindergarten (Jingwen Road) and Jinghai District Third Primary School (Shengli South Street), and return home.

name: While doing housework, she noticed the faucet was dripping and discussed it with her husband.
description: After dropping off the children, she returned home around 8:20. Ma Xiulan cleared away the dishes, wiped down the kitchen, and soaked the dirty clothes. While washing vegetables and getting ingredients ready, she noticed that the bottom of the kitchen faucet was wet and that it was dripping. She dried her hands and sent her husband Ma Zhiqiang a WeChat message explaining the situation. He replied that it was a minor issue and told her to close the angle valve first and that he would come back to fix it, saving a few dozen yuan. She followed his instructions, and the matter was temporarily settled.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Call her mother and ask about the handicraft work.
description: It was still early before dinner, so Ma Xiulan first called her mother Li Xiuying, who lives on Shengli Street, to ask about her back pain. They chatted for a while, and she said she would bring the children to visit in a couple of days. After hanging up, she called her neighbor Sister Zheng Xiuying to ask about the handwork they had discussed earlier. Sister Zheng told her there was a job threading ribbons through greeting cards, and she could go to her house the day after tomorrow in the afternoon to pick up a sample. Ma Xiulan calculated that she could earn a little extra pocket money this month.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Going to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market for shopping
description: At 10 a.m., Ma Xiulan changed clothes and rode her electric bike to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market (at the intersection of Shengli Street and Wutong Road). Planning to make zhajiang noodles for lunch, she went to her usual meat stall and bought one and a half jin of pork belly, then went to the dried goods store and bought sweet bean sauce and a small bag of dried yellow soybean paste. There were still enough vegetables at home, so she didn't buy anything else. After paying, she rode home.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market at the intersection of Shengli Street and Wutong Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Accidentally cut her finger while preparing lunch ingredients
description: At about 10:40 she returned home. Ma Xiulan tied on an apron and prepared lunch. She first cut the pork belly into dices the size of chopstick tips, then shredded the cucumber and washed the bean sprouts. Before stir-frying the sauce, she wanted to add more potato dices. In her haste, she didn't hold the knife steady and cut her left index finger. The cut was not deep, but blood beads immediately oozed out. She quickly put down the knife, went to the living room to find iodophor and a Band-Aid, disinfected and applied it, blaming herself for being old and useless.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Had lunch alone.
description: After treating the wound, Ma Xiulan continued to stir-fry the fried sauce and cooked a bowl of noodles. She lifted out the noodles, topped them with shredded cucumber and bean sprouts, poured the fried sauce over them, and sat alone in the kitchen eating slowly. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang was not coming back at noon, so she ate simply, washed the dishes, and thought about the pile of things to do in the afternoon.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Midday nap
description: After eating, with nothing else to do, Ma Xiulan set an alarm for 1:30 p.m. and went back to the bedroom to lie down and rest. She did not fall completely asleep, just closed her eyes and rested, and felt somewhat refreshed.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Hand embroidery and washing and drying sheets
description: After the alarm rang, Ma Xiulan got up and first stuffed the bed sheets that needed changing into the washing machine. Then she took out the half-finished 'Sunlit Lotus' cross-stitch and sat by the living room window, embroidering stitch by stitch. After more than half an hour, the washing machine stopped, so she went to the yard and hung out the sheets to dry. It was cloudy with little wind, just right for drying.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Organizing the family ledger
description: After hanging the bed sheets out to dry, Ma Xiulan took out her old ledger and recorded the more than twenty yuan she had spent on vegetables and sauce in the morning. Then she flipped to the back and saw the note about her eldest son Ma Mingxuan's tuition for next semester. She calculated that the 500 yuan education fund she had previously set aside was still there, so she could simply take it out and pay when the time came. Seeing that the accounts were clear, she felt relieved; you have to keep track of things to run a household.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the two children from school.
description: At exactly 4 p.m., Ma Xiulan rode her small electric tricycle out. She first went to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School on Shengli South Street to pick up Ma Mingzhe, who excitedly said that they had done a rainbow experiment in science class today. Then she turned to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten on Jingwen Road to pick up Ma Yuxin; as soon as she got on the tricycle, she held up a drawing and said she had drawn her mother, which made Ma Xiulan feel very happy.
location: Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School on Shengli South Street and Huakang First Kindergarten on Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare dinner and arrange the children's studies.
description: It was almost 5 o'clock when she got home. Ma Xiulan asked Ma Mingzhe to do homework and draw with Ma Yuxin in the living room, while she went into the kitchen to fix dinner. Tonight she planned to make tomato scrambled eggs and garlic oil lettuce; when her husband came home in the evening, she would cook the leftover zhajiang noodles from lunch. She had the ingredients ready.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Husband and wife work together to fix the faucet
description: After her husband Ma Zhiqiang came back, the two started fiddling with the faucet. Ma Xiulan handed him a wrench, and Ma Zhiqiang squatted down and worked on it for a while. When they removed the old faucet, they saw that the rubber gasket inside had aged and turned hard. The two decided to go to Xingwang Hardware Store to buy a new gasket. They rode an e-bike first to the Xingwang Hardware Store on Shengli Street. The owner found a gasket according to the model; it cost 5 yuan each. Ma Zhiqiang bought two extra for future use. The owner advised applying sealing compound for a more secure fit. On the way home, they passed the home of their neighbor Wang Guilan. Ma Xiulan felt the wrench at home wasn't convenient, so she knocked on the door and borrowed an adjustable wrench from Sister Wang. After getting home, Ma Zhiqiang cleaned the joint, applied sealing compound, and installed the new gasket, while Ma Xiulan lit the area with a flashlight. After installation, they opened the angle valve to test it. There was no leak, and the water flowed normally. Ma Xiulan smiled and praised her husband for being capable, saving at least 30 yuan in repair costs. Then she took out her account book and wrote down "Faucet repair - 5 yuan".
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Xingwang Hardware Store on Shengli Street; and Wang Guilan’s home at No. 154 Jingwen Road

name: Warm family dinner
description: When dinner was served, the family of five finally sat down together. Ma Xiulan brought out stir-fried tomatoes and eggs and garlic stir-fried leaf lettuce, and also made a bowl of zhajiang noodles for Ma Zhiqiang. At the table, Ma Mingxuan talked about school, Ma Yuxin showed off her painting, and Ma Mingzhe chimed in with stories about his experiments. The whole family chatted and laughed, and Ma Xiulan's heart felt sweeter than honey as she listened.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family reading time
description: After dinner we rested for a while. At exactly 7 o'clock, it was the unbreakable family reading time. Ma Xiulan held her younger daughter Ma Yuxin and read "Grimm's Fairy Tales" to her. Ma Mingzhe was absorbed in the "Dinosaur Illustrated Handbook" and ran over to ask, "Which is stronger, Tyrannosaurus rex or Spinosaurus?" Ma Mingxuan quietly read an extracurricular book. Ma Zhiqiang was also reading an "Auto Repair" magazine. During this half hour, the house was especially quiet and especially reassuring.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Supervise washing up, check homework, and prepare for bed
description: After the reading, Ma Xiulan urged the children to go wash up. While they did, she checked Ma Mingxuan's math homework for today, pointed out a calculation error, and the child corrected it himself. After Ma Yuxin washed up, she pestered Ma Xiulan into telling the story The Kitten Goes Fishing before she would go to sleep. As it approached 9 o'clock, Ma Xiulan also began her pre-bedtime stretches, stretching out her waist and legs, and then, remembering how comfortable soaking her feet had been the night before, went to boil some water.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Couple’s mugwort foot soak and tomorrow’s plans
description: Ma Xiulan brought out the foot-soaking bucket and soaked her feet with Ma Zhiqiang. Mugwort packets were added to the water; it was pleasantly warm and made the whole body relax. The two chatted about going to Sister Zheng Xiuying's home the day after tomorrow to pick up handwork, and agreed to return the wrench to Wang Guilan's home tomorrow morning. After soaking, Ma Xiulan checked the doors, windows, and gas, and jotted down two things to do tomorrow in her notebook.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Going to bed
description: She set the alarm for 6 a.m. the next morning. Ma Xiulan said to Ma Zhiqiang, “Let's sleep; today was tiring too.” Although she had been busy all day and her fingers still hurt a little, thinking that the faucet was fixed and all the day's big and small matters had been sorted out, she felt at ease and content. She turned off the light and fell asleep before long.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning wake-up and courtyard exercise.
description: The sky was overcast. Ma Xiulan woke up right at 05:30. She touched the Band-Aid on her left index finger from yesterday's vegetable cutting; it didn't hurt anymore, but she still needed to be careful. She got up quietly to avoid waking her sleeping husband Ma Zhiqiang, went to the bathroom, and washed her face with warm water, deliberately avoiding the wound. After washing up, she stepped into her own small courtyard. The air felt damp, promising rain. She walked slowly around the yard twice to loosen up, then did a set of Baduanjin exercises. Holding on to the old locust tree in the yard, she did 5 minutes of shoulder-and-neck stretching and 10 minutes of lower-back stretching, which eased the soreness from standing for a long time while fixing the faucet yesterday.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; the courtyard and bathroom at home

name: Preparing breakfast and waking the children to eat together
description: After exercising, Ma Xiulan returned to the kitchen, cooked corn grits porridge, steamed the white buns, took half a bowl of homemade pickled mustard tuber from the jar, shredded it, and drizzled sesame oil over it. Thinking the children liked flavorful food, she also scrambled a plate of eggs with scallions. After breakfast was ready, she pushed open the children's door: her oldest son Xuanxuan had already dressed, her second son Zhezhe was coaxed out of bed, and her youngest daughter Xinxin sat up rubbing her eyes. The family gathered around the dining table. Ma Xiulan served the children porridge and dishes, telling them to eat well before going to school.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Taking the children to school
description: At 07:15, eldest son Xuanxuan rode his bicycle to school by himself. Ma Xiulan brought out the small tricycle, first took daughter Xinxin to Huakang First Kindergarten, watched her walk into the classroom, then turned to take second son Zhezhe to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, and only returned after seeing him meet up with his classmates. It was cloudy all the way but no rain.
location: Along the route from Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School

name: Returning home to tidy up and do household chores
description: After sending the children to school and getting home at nearly eight o'clock, Ma Xiulan took no rest. She cleared away the breakfast dishes, wiped down the stove, put away the toys and books the children had left scattered in the living room, and mopped both the living room and the bedrooms with a half-dry mop. When the work was done, she glanced at the clock and remembered that she had not yet returned the adjustable wrench she borrowed yesterday.
location: At home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Visiting neighbor Wang Guilan to return the wrench and chat about everyday things
description: Ma Xiulan took the adjustable wrench from behind the door, wiped it clean, and went across the hall to neighbor Wang Guilan's house to return it. Sister Wang was doing laundry and invited her to sit down, so the two sat on small stools at the doorway and chatted. Sister Wang asked about the faucet repair, and Ma Xiulan mentioned that her waist was still a bit sore. Sister Wang immediately slapped her thigh and said that her old man's trick of soaking his feet in boiled mugwort water worked well for waist soreness. She went back inside and came out with a large bundle of dried mugwort, pressing it firmly on Ma Xiulan. The two also talked about their children's studies. It was almost 9:15 before Ma Xiulan thanked her and went home, feeling warm inside.
location: Home of neighbor Wang Guilan, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Buy groceries and return home to put things away
description: After leaving Sister Wang's house, Ma Xiulan rode her tricycle to the vegetable market at Wutong Commune and headed straight to the stall of Sister Sun Guifang, whom she knew well. Because Lao Ma wanted to eat soy-marinated cucumbers, she planned to make a new batch of pickled vegetables in a couple of days. That day she first bought white radishes, peppers, ginger, and garlic as ingredients, and also bought spinach and baby bok choy. Sister Sun gave her some scallions from her own garden. After returning home, she put away the vegetables one by one: washed the radishes and peppers and drained them, put the leafy greens in the fridge, washed her hands, drank a large glass of cold boiled water, and rested for five minutes.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and Wutong Commune Vegetable Market

name: Organized old fabric and planned patchwork chair cushions
description: After resting for a moment, Ma Xiulan brought a ladder and took out an old cloth bag that had been stored for years on top of the bedroom wardrobe. She poured the floral fabric scraps, trouser legs cut from old jeans, and unused pillowcases onto the living room floor. She sat down cross-legged and sorted the fabric pieces by color and material, picked out thick red and blue cotton pieces, used cardboard to cut a square template based on the size of the wooden bench at home, and then used tailor's chalk to draw diamond and triangle shapes on the fabric pieces. In her mind, she planned to ask Zheng Xiuying, when she went to pick up handmade samples the day after tomorrow, whether it would be feasible to use the fabric scraps for patchwork. Once the idea took shape, she neatly stacked the sorted fabric pieces, the template, and the selected thick cotton fabric.
location: Living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare and enjoy lunch
description: After sorting the fabrics until nearly noon, Ma Xiulan went into the kitchen and cooked herself a bowl of dried noodles. She sliced some of yesterday's leftover spiced beef, added two stalks of baby bok choy, and poached an egg, finishing with two drops of sesame oil. She savored the steaming hot bowl of beef and vegetable noodles. After eating, she washed the pot and dishes and checked that the gas stove was off.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, home kitchen

name: Lunch break and a nap
description: After lunch, Ma Xiulan put a clean adhesive bandage on the wound on her left index finger, lay down on the bed in the bedroom, set the alarm, and quickly fell into a deep sleep. She woke up only after the alarm rang several times; because she had gotten up early, she slept very soundly.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: In the afternoon, prepared and sewed the semi-finished patchwork chair cushion.
description: At 13:30 she woke up, feeling much better. Ma Xiulan washed her face with cold water, glanced at the gloomy sky, but it wasn't raining. She remembered that she had agreed to go to Chen Yulan's home tomorrow to look at cross-stitch, and since she wasn't going out this afternoon, she tidied up the living room a bit, took out the fabric scraps and templates she had sorted in the morning, and moved a small stool to sit under the window with the best light in the living room. First, following the cardboard templates, she cut the thick cotton cloth into diamond and triangle pieces. Then she found the strongest silk thread from the sewing box and stitched the pieces together one stitch at a time according to the sketch, stitching slowly and carefully, striving for every stitch to be even. By a little past four in the afternoon, she had roughly sewn the first chair cushion into shape. She rubbed her sore eyes, filled with a sense of accomplishment.
location: Living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the child from school
description: At 16:20, Ma Xiulan rode her tricycle first to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up Zhezhe, letting him sit in the rear compartment, then went to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up Xinxin. As soon as Xinxin saw her, she reached out her little hands and rushed over. After picking up both children, she rode all the way home; Zhezhe chattered about fun things at school while Xinxin kept shouting that she was hungry.
location: Along the route from Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to the No. 3 Primary School and Kindergarten.

name: Rested and went to the supermarket for shopping, encountered counterfeit money.
description: After getting home, Ma Xiulan washed the children's hands and let them eat some crackers to tide them over. She riffled through her wallet for small change, then remembered that the laundry detergent was almost used up, so she took the children to Jingbai Supermarket. She walked with the two children to the supermarket and headed straight for the daily necessities section, where she grabbed a bottle of Blue Moon laundry detergent. Unable to resist Xinxin's pleading, she also bought some discounted yogurt. At checkout, the laundry detergent cost 19.9 yuan and the yogurt 8 yuan, for a total of 27.9 yuan. She pulled out a crumpled 20-yuan note and a 10-yuan note. The cashier checked the money and pointed out that the 20-yuan note was counterfeit. Ma Xiulan took it and looked closely: the paper was smooth and the watermark was unclear. Only then did she remember that it had been part of the change a customer had given her a few days earlier when she was selling pickled vegetables at the market. She found it both funny and frustrating, and could only swap it for a genuine note to pay. On the way home, she sighed and taught the children to check money carefully. Once home, she tucked the counterfeit note into her account book as a lesson.
location: Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jingbai Supermarket

name: Prepare dinner
description: After returning from the supermarket, Ma Xiulan tied on an apron and began preparing dinner. The menu was tomato and egg drop soup with dough pieces and vinegar-sautéed shredded potatoes. She peeled and shredded the small potatoes and soaked them in water, beat the eggs, cut the tomatoes into chunks, and stirred water into flour to make small dough lumps. In hot oil, she sautéed chopped scallions until fragrant, stir-fried the tomatoes until they released juice, added water, and after it came to a boil, dropped in the dough pieces. The kitchen filled with the aroma of home-style cooking.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, home kitchen

name: Family dinner and cleanup
description: Her eldest son Xuanxuan happened to arrive home just then. Ma Xiulan set the dough drop soup and shredded potatoes on the table and called over the father and two sons who were playing in the yard. The whole family sat down to eat. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang took a sip of the soup and praised it, saying, 'Tastes pretty good.' Ma Xiulan shot him a look but felt happy inside. During the meal, she told them about encountering counterfeit money today and Wang Guilan sending mugwort. Her husband asked her to buy a new faucet washer tomorrow as a spare. After dinner, she had Xuanxuan go do his homework, quickly cleaned up the dishes, brought the leftovers back to the kitchen, washed the dishes and chopsticks, wiped the stove clean, packed the kitchen waste, and put it by the door to throw away the next morning.
location: Dining room and kitchen at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family reading time.
description: At 19:45, Ma Xiulan told the children to turn off the TV and tablets and start family reading time. She sat on the sofa in the reading corner, flipping through 1000 Homestyle Recipes, and let Xinxin lean against her as she opened the picture book Chang'e Flying to the Moon with pinyin, reading it sentence by sentence with exaggerated gestures and tones. Zhezhe was absorbed in The Hundred Thousand Whys (Animals), occasionally looking up to ask, "Why don't dinosaurs have hair?" Xuanxuan, flipping through an old Weapons Knowledge, explained without raising his head that they were reptiles and didn't grow hair. Half an hour passed in the blink of an eye.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; reading corner in the living room at home

name: Urge the children to wash up and get ready for bed
description: After reading time, Ma Xiulan started urging the children to wash up. She first took Xinxin to brush her teeth and wash her face, changed her into clean pajamas, and put her to bed. Then she went to supervise Zhezhe, squeezed toothpaste onto his brush and made sure he brushed for a full two minutes. Next, she checked Xuanxuan's homework and signed his notebook. Only when all three children were in bed did she breathe a sigh of relief.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; home bathrooms and bedrooms

name: Mugwort foot soak, stretching, and bookkeeping
description: After settling the children down, Ma Xiulan found the mugwort that Wang Guilan had given her, grabbed a handful, put it in a small pot with water, and boiled it. She poured the dark brown mugwort water into a basin, added cool water, and carried it to the bedroom. She and her husband Ma Zhiqiang sat side by side soaking their feet, letting out a comfortable sigh. While soaking, she took out her phone and replied in the pickle group with her thoughts on making chili sauce. After about fifteen minutes, the soreness in her lower back had eased considerably. After finishing, she poured out the water, did ten minutes of waist and leg stretches on the bed, then took out her accounting notebook and wrote down today’s expenses: 26.5 yuan for groceries and 27.9 yuan at the supermarket. In the social exchanges column, she wrote “Wang Guilan sent a bundle of mugwort.” Then, looking at the counterfeit bill clipped in the notebook, she wrote with a wry smile: “Lesson: 20-yuan counterfeit bill.”
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Washing up, checking things, and going to bed
description: After finishing the bookkeeping, Ma Xiulan went to the bathroom to wash up, changed the dressing on the wound on her left index finger for the last time, and applied a waterproof band-aid. Returning to the bedroom, she saw her husband already snoring lightly. She laughed softly, then tiptoed to check the gas in the kitchen and the lock on the front door. She went into the three children's rooms, covering Xinxin, who had kicked off the blanket. Finally, she went back to her own room, turned off the light, and lay down. Listening to the occasional barking of dogs outside, she thought about going to Zheng Xiuying's house to pick up greeting card samples the next day, and gradually fell asleep with anticipation.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, various areas of the home

name: Morning courtyard activity
description: After getting up in the morning, she washed up briefly at the faucet in her own yard, loosened her wrists and shoulders, then cleared weeds from the vegetable beds and walked slowly for a few minutes. After that, she began practicing Baduanjin on the concrete floor of the courtyard, with gentle and well-executed movements, paying special attention to her wrists and waist. After finishing, she also did five minutes of shoulder, neck, and waist stretches, leaving her whole body relaxed.
location: Home (courtyard), 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning family time and taking the children to school.
description: She walked into the kitchen, tied on an apron, rinsed the millet and cooked millet porridge, heated up the steamed buns, and scrambled eggs with scallions. During this, she went upstairs to wake the three children. The family sat around the table eating breakfast. Xiulan put food on the children's plates and reminded the eldest son to ride carefully. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang ate quickly and said he would go to the freight yard in the afternoon. Afterward, Xiulan first sent the eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, off on his bicycle to school, then rode her small tricycle, carrying Ma Mingzhe and Ma Yuxin on the back seat. She stopped at the entrance of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to let Zhezhe get off and go in, then rode to Huakang First Kindergarten and handed Xinxin to the teacher.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin - home (kitchen, dining room); Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin - Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School; Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: On the way, she heard about Aunt Zhao’s situation and offered to deliver meals.
description: On the way home from kindergarten riding a tricycle, she ran into neighbor Wang Guilan at the intersection of Jingwen Road, who was just returning from the vegetable market. Wang Guilan told her that Aunt Zhao's husband, Uncle Zhao, had suffered a stroke and been hospitalized at Jinghai District Hospital last night. Upon hearing this, Xiulan immediately decided to cook and deliver meals for Aunt Zhao's family over the next two days. Wang Guilan praised her for her kind heart.
location: Intersection of Jingwen Road and Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning housework and handicrafts.
description: After returning home, she first tidied the kitchen and washed the dishes, then called Aunt Zhao to express concern. Aunt Zhao sounded tearful, so Xiulan comforted her, saying she would bring food over soon and telling her to rest easy at the hospital. After hanging up, she took out the old fabric and cotton scraps cut the day before from the cabinet, sat down at the sewing machine, and began making patchwork chair cushions. Using a diamond-patch method, she sewed them on the old-fashioned sewing machine. It took about an hour and a half to finish the main part of two chair cushions. When her wrists felt sore, she stopped and stretched.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, home (living room, kitchen)

name: Prepare and deliver lunch to Aunt Zhao.
description: She rode her electric bike to the Wutong Gongshe vegetable market and bought an old hen, pork ribs, streaky pork, greens, tomatoes, baby bok choy, apples, and bananas at Sun Guifang's stall. When Sun Guifang learned the groceries were for Aunt Zhao, who was in the hospital, she threw in a bunch of spring onions as a gift. After returning home, Ma Xiulan put on an apron and immediately washed the vegetables and cut the meat. She simmered the old hen in a clay pot for soup, cooked millet porridge, steamed egg custard, stir-fried baby bok choy, made scrambled eggs with tomatoes, and also prepared a bowl of noodles with minced pork and mushroom sauce. She packed the dishes into two insulated lunch boxes and put the fruit in bags. After a bicycle ride of about 20 minutes, she reached the inpatient department of Jinghai District Hospital and delivered the hot meal to Aunt Zhao, who was moved to tears. Xiulan stayed to chat and comfort her, and helped feed Uncle Zhao half a bowl of egg custard. She did not leave until almost 1 p.m.

participant.name: Sun Guifang
participant.relation: Friend who is a vendor at the vegetable market

location: Tianjin, Jinghai District, Wutong Commune Vegetable Market; No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, home (kitchen); Inpatient Department of Jinghai District Hospital, Diwei Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Going home for lunch and a nap.
description: She rode home from the hospital; the sky had cleared up a bit. She heated leftover porridge and had steamed buns with pickled vegetables for a simple lunch, then washed last night's dishes too. Afterward, she went to the bedroom, lay down with her eyes closed, and rested for about forty minutes to regain energy.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, home (dining room, bedroom)

name: Continue hand-making chair cushions in the afternoon.
description: Refreshed after the midday rest, she sat back down at the sewing machine to piece together the fabric for the two remaining chair cushions. During this time, she remembered to get up regularly to stretch her wrists and do stretching movements. By four in the afternoon, the main bodies of all four patchwork chair cushions were completed, with neat stitching and attractive color combinations. She tidied away the scraps. Her right wrist was a bit sore, so she planned to stuff the cotton wadding another day.
location: Home (next to the sewing machine in the living room), 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Go to the hardware store to buy washers
description: Remembering that her husband had asked her to buy faucet washers, she rode her electric bike to Xingwang Hardware Store. After telling the owner the model number, she bought two washers, paid, and put them away.
location: Xingwang Hardware Store, Dongfanghong Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare dinner and deliver it to Aunt Zhao.
description: After returning home, she saw that the old hen soup that had been simmering on the stove all afternoon had turned golden and fragrant. She took out the chicken, shredded the meat, and skimmed the oil off the soup. Then she steamed minced-pork tofu and baked scallion pancakes. She packed the chicken soup, chicken, steamed tofu with minced pork, and scallion pancakes into lunchboxes, and added two apples. Just as she finished packing, a rain shower started outside. She put on a raincoat, covered the lunchboxes with plastic sheeting, and rode her electric bike through the rain; her trouser legs and shoes were soaked, and her hair and the hem of her jacket were also dripping wet. When she arrived at the hospital, Aunt Zhao was very distressed. Xiulan smiled and said that if she promised something, she had to do it no matter what. She laid out the hot meal, asked about Uncle Zhao's afternoon condition, and agreed to deliver again tomorrow.
location: Jinghai District Hospital, Diwei Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Picking up the children in the evening and preparing dinner for the whole family
description: After hurrying home in the rain, she quickly changed out of her wet clothes, dried her hair, put on loungewear, and grabbed her rain poncho. Riding the small tricycle, she first went to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up Ma Mingzhe, then turned to Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up Ma Yuxin. The rain had stopped and the sky glowed with evening clouds; the children chattered noisily. After getting home, she had Zhezhe and Xinxin wash their hands and play in the living room. She tied on an apron, reheated the leftover lunch, stir-fried shredded potatoes with vinegar, sliced braised beef, and cooked fine noodles for the children in old hen soup. At about 6:30, her husband Ma Zhiqiang came back, and her eldest son Ma Mingxuan also pushed his bicycle into the yard.
location: Home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The whole family had dinner together.
description: The family sat around the dining table. While eating, Xiulan mentioned helping deliver meals to Aunt Zhao's family today, and her husband expressed approval. The eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, quietly put a piece of chicken on his mother's plate, while the second son and the daughter bickered over the soy-braised beef. The atmosphere was warm.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, home (dining room)

name: Evening family reading
description: After dinner and clearing the dishes, the family came to the reading corner they had set up. Ma Mingxuan read Weapons Knowledge on his own, Ma Mingzhe flipped through the Dinosaur Encyclopedia, and Xiulan read the fairy tale Little Red Riding Hood to her daughter. Her right wrist hurt, making it hard to turn pages, so her husband Ma Zhiqiang sat beside her and clumsily helped turn the pages, making Xinxin laugh.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, home (living room reading corner)

name: Evening family care and bedtime preparation
description: After reading, she noticed obvious soreness when rotating her right wrist. She soaked a towel in hot water and applied a warm compress for nearly 20 minutes, then asked her husband to help rub on safflower oil with a gentle massage. Then she urged Ma Mingzhe and Ma Yuxin to take baths and brush their teeth, helped Xinxin bathe and change into pajamas, coaxed the two into bed, tucked them in, and turned off the light. When the children were asleep, she and her husband soaked their feet in water boiled with mugwort, the warmth relieving the day's fatigue. After soaking her feet, she took out the account book and recorded the day's expenses: 48 yuan for groceries and 5 yuan for washers. She then checked that the gas, doors, and windows were properly shut. Finally, she did some simple waist and leg stretches on the bedroom floor, avoiding using her right hand for support, and turned off the light to go to bed, recalling the fulfilling day and soon falling asleep.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, home (bathroom, children's room, bedroom, study, etc.)

name: Getting up, washing up, and light morning exercise
description: Waking up in the early morning, it was sunny outside. Ma Xiulan felt her right wrist a bit sore and heavy. She first took a slow walk in the courtyard to wake up her body, then began doing Baduanjin, paying special attention to relaxing her wrist during the drawing-the-bow movement and feeling her lower back stretch in the morning light. After washing up, her body gradually loosened up.
location: Home courtyard at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing breakfast and waking the children
description: After morning exercise, Ma Xiulan went into the kitchen and quickly put on a pot of cornmeal porridge, heated up steamed buns, sliced a plate of pickled mustard tuber, and boiled three poached eggs. At the same time, she called the three children to get up and urged Ma Mingxuan, Ma Mingzhe, and Ma Yuxin to wash up and get dressed.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The whole family had breakfast together
description: The family sat around the dining table eating hot porridge, steamed buns, and pickled vegetables. Ma Xiulan told Ma Mingzhe not to roughhouse at school and helped Ma Yuxin stir the egg yolk into her porridge. After the children finished eating, they each packed their school bags. Ma Xiulan quickly cleared the dishes and left the leftover food for her own lunch.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Taking the two children to school.
description: Ma Mingxuan rode his bike ahead. Ma Xiulan brought out the small tricycle and set off with Ma Mingzhe and Ma Yuxin. First she arrived at Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, reminded Ma Mingzhe, and watched him enter the school gate. Then she turned to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten and only relaxed after watching Ma Yuxin be led in by the teacher.
location: From Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street), then to Huakang First Kindergarten

name: Check the handmade chair cushions and prepare a meal for Aunt Zhao.
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan first checked the four patchwork chair cushions she had made the day before, trimmed the loose threads, tightened the edge stitching, and confirmed they were sturdy. Then she prepared a meal for the hospitalized Aunt Zhao: fish porridge simmered in chicken broth, steamed flower rolls, and stir-fried loofah, packed into an insulated lunchbox.
location: Living room and kitchen at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Going to the hospital to visit Aunt Zhao
description: Ma Xiulan rode her bicycle to Jinghai District Hospital carrying an insulated lunch box. In the ward, she met Aunt Zhao, set down the food, and asked how things were, learning that Uncle Zhao was in stable condition. She stayed and chatted with Aunt Zhao for a while before leaving, then cycled back.
location: Inpatient Department of Jinghai District Hospital, 14 South Shengli Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Chair cushion sold successfully and income recorded
description: After returning home, neighbor Wang Guilan came over to look at the chair cushions and was full of praise for their quality and workmanship. She decided to buy them all as welfare for her daughter's workplace. Wang Guilan paid 60 yuan on the spot. Ma Xiulan put the money away carefully and then recorded this handicraft income in her ledger, thinking about buying a coat for her daughter.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Had lunch and a midday rest alone
description: Feeling happy, Ma Xiulan heated up the leftover cornmeal porridge from the morning and had a simple lunch. Because her right wrist was sore, she applied a hot water bottle to it, lay in bed listening to a storytelling radio program, and rested with her eyes closed for about half an hour.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, home dining room and bedroom

name: Her phone accidentally shattered while she was doing housework
description: After her midday nap, Ma Xiulan began tidying up the living room. While wiping the tables, chairs, and writing desk, her phone slipped off the corner of the table, and the top right corner of the screen cracked. She picked it up with distress and taped the crack with clear tape to prevent it from cutting her finger.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Reviewing the family ledger and doing simple crafts
description: After finishing the housework, Ma Xiulan browsed through the family ledger and planned the living expenses before the end of the month. Then she found some leftover fabric scraps and, using her left hand to assist her right, did simple edge binding stitches to practice her needlework.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Rest and reply to messages in the pickled vegetable group
description: After half an hour of handicraft work, her right wrist began to ache again. Ma Xiulan leaned back on the sofa to rest, opened the pickled vegetables group on her phone, discussed pepper prices with her sisters, and shared her experience of soaking mugwort water to relieve lower back soreness.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing dinner ingredients
description: Ma Xiulan took the thawed ground meat out of the refrigerator, washed the luffa, tomatoes, and potatoes, and cut them up for later. She planned to make ground meat with shredded potatoes and tomato scrambled eggs for dinner.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the child from school
description: Ma Xiulan rode a small tricycle first to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up Ma Mingzhe, then to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up Ma Yuxin. Ma Yuxin was holding a paper flower she had made in kindergarten and said she wanted to give it to Grandma Zhao.
location: Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street) and Huakang First Kindergarten in Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing dinner and setting aside food for family members who come home late.
description: After returning home, she washed the children's hands and gave them some cookies to take the edge off their hunger. Ma Xiulan tied on an apron and stir-fried shredded potatoes with minced meat and scrambled eggs with tomatoes, then heated up flower rolls. After cooking, she specifically set aside and kept warm one serving for Ma Mingxuan, who had evening study, and one for her husband.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The whole family had dinner together.
description: Ma Mingzhe and Ma Yuxin were starving and wolfed down their food. Ma Yuxin again mentioned that she wanted to give the paper flowers to Grandma Zhao, and Ma Xiulan promised to take her on the weekend. At the table, Ma Xiulan asked Ma Mingzhe about his homework and told Ma Yuxin to be good.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family reading time.
description: After clearing the dishes, the family gathered in the living room to read. Ma Mingxuan read "Dawn Blossoms Plucked at Dusk," Ma Mingzhe read "One Hundred Thousand Whys," and Ma Yuxin flipped through comic books. Since Ma Xiulan's right hand was inconvenient, her husband helped her turn the pages of "Home-style Cookbook," while she told her daughter the story of "Chang'e Flying to the Moon."
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Supervise homework and put the children to bed
description: After the reading session, Ma Xiulan urged Ma Mingzhe to finish his Chinese homework and checked it. Then she washed Ma Yuxin's face and feet and told her a little white rabbit story to lull her to sleep.
location: Various rooms of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Husband and wife soaking their feet and chatting
description: After the children went to bed, her husband prepared mugwort water, and the couple soaked their feet in the bathroom. As she soaked, Ma Xiulan used her left hand to reply to messages in the pickled vegetables group chat and told her husband the good news that she had sold a chair cushion for 60 yuan today. The two discussed going to Zheng Xiuying's home the day after tomorrow with samples.
location: Home bathroom, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Bedtime stretching, washing up, and safety check
description: After soaking her feet, Ma Xiulan did some simple stretches in the bedroom to relieve lower back soreness, then washed up, checked that the doors, windows, and gas were turned off, and finally lay down at ease, thought back on the fulfilling day, and drifted off to sleep.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning wake-up and courtyard exercise.
description: Ma Xiulan got up quietly at 6 a.m. so as not to wake her family. She first took a slow walk in the small courtyard for about 20 minutes, feeling the cool morning air and loosening up her body. Then she stood beside the rose bushes and began practicing Baduanjin, paying special attention to slowing down her right hand movements. She focused on stretching and mobility instead of using force, and felt that her wrist had improved a lot compared with yesterday, which made her quite happy.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing breakfast and taking the children to school
description: After morning exercise, Ma Xiulan began to prepare breakfast. She made the cornmeal porridge the children loved, heated up the leftover steamed buns from last night, and stir-fried a plate of eggs and pickled mustard. She woke the three children at 6:50 on time. The eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, washed up quickly by himself. After finishing breakfast at 7:10, he rode his bicycle to school. The second son, Ma Mingzhe, dawdled a bit. Ma Xiulan urged him to finish his meal and told him to come home early after school today. Then she let him walk to the nearby Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School by himself.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Carefully dressing up the youngest daughter for school enrollment registration.
description: After seeing off her two sons, Ma Xiulan focused all her attention on her younger daughter Ma Yuxin. She took out the new dress she had ironed long ago and put it on Xinxin, then carefully combed her hair into two braids and tied them with red yarn, making her look just like a little magpie. While combing her hair, she said, 'Xinxin is a primary school student today. When you get to school, listen to the teacher. They'll give you new books and a school uniform. Are you happy?' Xinxin answered crisply, 'Happy!' Ma Xiulan checked the household register and vaccination certificate one last time, made sure they were in her cloth bag, and prepared for school registration.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Take her daughter to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to complete enrollment registration
description: At 8 o'clock sharp, Ma Xiulan got on her electric bike, with Xinxin on the back seat, and set off for Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School. As soon as they reached the school gate, they ran into their neighbor Zhang Shufen, who had also brought her child to register. The two mothers chatted. Zhang Shufen mentioned her worries about buying school supplies for the new term, and Ma Xiulan took out her notebook, saying she wanted to have a look too. They entered the teaching building together, queued and registered as instructed, and received textbooks and brand-new school uniforms. Xinxin put on the new schoolbag, looked at herself in the big hallway mirror, and shouted happily, "I'm starting elementary school!" Ma Xiulan quickly took a photo of Xinxin with her phone and sent it to the family WeChat group with the caption: "Our Xinxin has registered today; she's a primary school student now!" She also deliberately took a photo of the silver bracelet on Xinxin's wrist that Xinxin's grandma had given her, to make the old lady happy too.
location: Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, 68 South Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Go to the M&G Stationery Store and write down the prices of school supplies.
description: Coming out of the teaching building, Ma Xiulan went with her neighbor Zhang Shufen to the Chenguang Stationery Store at the school gate. Holding her small notebook, Ma Xiulan carefully wrote down the prices of essentials such as book covers, square-grid exercise books, pencils, and erasers, planning to go to Jingbai Supermarket on the weekend to buy them more cheaply.
location: M&G Stationery (Kouzhang Road store), Kouzhang Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Take a detour to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market to shop for ingredients.
description: After leaving the stationery store, Ma Xiulan swung by the Wutong Commune Food Market on the way. She went straight to Aunt Sun Guifang's stall and picked a jin of fresh green beans, two tomatoes, and a bunch of scallions. Aunt Sun smiled and asked, 'Xiulan, what brings you here so late today? Busy with the kids again?' Ma Xiulan replied, 'Exactly. I took my little girl to register at No. 3 Primary School. School starts next week, and once it does, I'll have to take her back and forth every day.' She paid, bought some seasonal pears, and then rode home.
location: Wutong Community Vegetable Market, Diwei Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Washing the new school uniform at home and mending the old schoolbag
description: After getting home, Ma Xiulan first rinsed Xinxin's new school uniform in clean water and hung it in the yard to dry. Then she took out the eldest and second sons' old schoolbags from the cabinet and inspected them carefully. The stitching on the eldest son's backpack straps was slightly loose, and the bottom of the second son's schoolbag had worn thin. She turned on the sewing machine and slowly mended them stitch by stitch. Remembering the lesson from yesterday when her wrist hurt from excessive use, she paid special attention to time. After finishing one schoolbag, she stood up and rested for five minutes, moving her wrist and neck to avoid fatigue.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing lunch and resting with a hot compress on the wrist
description: After mending the schoolbag, Ma Xiulan made a simple tomato and egg drop soup with dough balls and heated up two steamed buns for lunch. While eating, she took out the towel she had soaked in safflower oil yesterday and applied it to her right wrist. It felt warm and comfortable, helping the wrist recover.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Short midday rest after lunch
description: After eating and washing the dishes, Ma Xiulan leaned back on the sofa in the living room and rested for half an hour. She didn't really fall asleep, just closed her eyes to rest, mentally going over the afternoon's craft work and the trip to the supermarket, sorting out her thoughts for the afternoon activities.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Design and make new handmade fabric craft samples.
description: Now came the highlight of the day. Ma Xiulan took to heart the handiwork Sister Wang had mentioned and specially set aside this time to do it. She dug out the floral fabric scraps and plain cotton cloth that had been stored at the bottom of the chest, sketched a few simple designs on a piece of white paper, and finally decided to make a patchwork coaster and a small key case. She picked and matched colors, began cutting the fabric, then sat at the sewing machine and sewed away with a 'da-da-da' sound. Soon the basic shape of the coaster was done. She picked up the needle and thread again to overcast and sew the edges of the key case, looking focused and completely immersed in the joy of handcrafting.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Go to Jingbai Supermarket to buy rice and daily necessities.
description: After doing handicrafts for nearly an hour, Ma Xiulan looked at her watch and knew it was time to go out shopping. She rode her electric bike north along Shengli Street for about ten minutes and arrived at Jingbai Supermarket. She first carried a 10-kilogram bag of Northeastern rice, and then bought some laundry detergent, toilet paper, and other daily necessities. At the checkout, she deliberately counted the money she had with her, confirmed that she had not received any counterfeit bills, and then paid with peace of mind.
location: Jingbai Supermarket, Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Go home and continue refining the handmade samples
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan put away the purchased items and sat back down at her handicraft corner. She added a lace border to the patchwork coaster she had just made, making the whole thing look more exquisite. The key pouch was also sewn, and she made sure to leave a spot for a lanyard, making it small and practical. Looking at her works, Ma Xiulan felt very happy and thought about going to Sister Zheng Xiuying's place tomorrow to show her and ask if she could get some piecework.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Riding an e-bike to pick up the second son from school
description: It was almost time. Ma Xiulan carefully put away her handmade items, got on her electric bike, and went to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up her second son, Ma Mingzhe. After waiting at the school gate for a while, she saw Zhezhe running out with his schoolbag. She asked, "Is there a lot of homework today?" Zhezhe said there wasn't much, so she felt relieved. Mother and son rode home together.
location: Entrance of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, 68 Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing dinner and a warm family dinner
description: Returning home, Ma Xiulan began preparing dinner. She washed the rice and put it on to cook, then trimmed, washed, and cut the green beans she had bought. She also took out the leftover meat from the refrigerator, planning to make minced pork with green beans. As she was cutting the vegetables, her youngest daughter Xinxin came home from kindergarten (kindergarten lets out early, and she was brought back by the school bus). Ma Xiulan let her play in the yard for a while. At 17:30, her eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, also came home from school. Once all the children were home, Ma Xiulan sped up her cooking. Besides the minced pork with green beans, she also made a tomato egg drop soup. The kitchen filled with the clatter of pots and pans and the aroma of food. At 18:30, her husband, Ma Zhiqiang, also sat down at the table, and for once the family of five sat together for dinner in a rare scene of togetherness. At the table, Xinxin could not wait to talk about registering at school that day, saying the school uniform she had been given was too big, which made everyone laugh. Ma Xiulan also told her husband about Sister Wang mentioning the handicraft work, and showed him samples of the coasters and key pouch she had made today. Zhiqiang said, 'Your hands are getting more and more skillful. Be a little careful, don't wear yourself out.' The whole family was happy and harmonious.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family evening reading time
description: After dinner and clearing the dishes, it was the family's unbreakable reading time. The whole family sat around the newly arranged reading corner in the living room. Xinxin opened her new textbook and read pinyin to her father with a serious look. Ma Xiulan herself picked up the "Complete Collection of Home-style Recipes" and flipped through it, wondering if she could make something new for the children. She also remembered to exercise her right wrist and said to her husband: "See, it really doesn't hurt at all now, it's fine!" Her husband was happy for her too.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Urge the children to wash up and put away their clothes
description: After reading, Ma Xiulan urged the three children to take turns washing up. She went to the yard to bring in the school uniforms that had been drying all day, folded them, and put them into Xinxin's schoolbag. She also checked the two sons' old schoolbags again, confirmed the mended places were sturdy, and prepared for school the next day.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The couple soaked their feet in mugwort water and video-called relatives and friends
description: After getting the children settled, Ma Xiulan and her husband Ma Zhiqiang took out the dried mugwort Sister Wang had given them a couple of days ago, boiled water, and soaked their feet. While enjoying the warm soak, Ma Xiulan took out her phone and made a video call to her childhood friend Liu Chunmei, telling her about Xinxin's registration today and showing off the coaster samples she had made today. On the other end, Liu Chunmei kept praising how nice they looked. The couple chatted for a while, mainly about preparing for the start of school next week and the family's monthly expenses.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening household chores and bookkeeping
description: After soaking her feet, Ma Xiulan poured out the water and started tidying up the house. She first recorded the money spent on buying rice and groceries item by item on the small blackboard on the wall. Then she checked each room to make sure the gas and windows were properly turned off and closed. Finally, she went to the children's room, tucked them in, and looking at their sleeping faces, felt deeply at ease.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Stretching before bed and personal hygiene.
description: Back in the bedroom, Ma Xiulan did a set of simple waist and leg stretches by the bed. After keeping it up these days, she felt that her backaches and soreness had improved a lot. After stretching, she went to the bathroom to wash up, changed into pajamas, and got ready for bed.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: End-of-day review and plan for tomorrow
description: Lying beside her husband, Ma Xiulan did not fall asleep right away. She went over the day’s events in her mind: Xinxin’s registration went smoothly, her wrist was better, and she had made another new sample. Her heart was full of joy. She also thought: tomorrow is Saturday, should she take the children to Shengli Street to see her parents, and also meet Sister Zheng Xiuying so she could look at the handicrafts? Thinking of these things to look forward to, she closed her eyes contentedly and soon fell asleep.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning preparation and breakfast
description: Xiulan got up at 6 a.m., did some simple stretches, and began preparing breakfast. She made egg fried rice and heated up milk. At the same time, she packed her things, putting a water bottle, crackers, tissues, a light jacket, and other items into a large canvas bag, and checked her phone and power bank. Then she woke the three children and urged them to wash up. The family had breakfast together, and after the meal Xiulan filled everyone's water bottle.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Walk to Jinghai Passenger Station and wait for the bus.
description: The family walked to Jinghai Coach Station. On the way, Mingzhe wanted to chase a butterfly but was stopped by Xiulan. After arriving at the station, Xiulan bought tickets and confirmed they would get off at Cultural Center Station, while the children waited in the waiting hall.
location: Jinghai Bus Station, Chaoyang Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Took a long-distance bus and arrived at Tianjin Museum.
description: At 7:30, took a long-distance bus from Jinghai Passenger Station to downtown Tianjin. Xiulan looked after the children; Mingxuan noted the place names, while Mingzhe and Yuxin played games. After getting off at Cultural Center Station at 9:05, they walked through the Cultural Center Plaza and arrived at Tianjin Museum in about 15 minutes. They queued up and got free tickets with their ID cards before entering.
location: Tianjin Museum, No. 62 Pingjiang Road, Hexi District, Tianjin, China

name: Visit the Ancient Tianjin exhibition hall.
description: In the Ancient Tianjin exhibition hall on the second floor of Tianjin Museum, Mingxuan was drawn to ancient weapons and sketched an iron armor spear; Mingzhe asked questions about fishing gear models, Xiulan told stories of old Tianjin; Yuxin watched curiously.
location: Second floor, Tianjin Museum, 62 Pingjiang Road, Hexi District, Tianjin, China

name: Visiting the folk customs exhibition hall and the incident of Mingzhe getting lost
description: In the folk customs exhibition hall, Yuxin was attracted by a loom model. While Xiulan was explaining the principle of weaving, she realized Mingzhe had wandered off. She told Mingxuan and Yuxin to wait where they were, asked a staff member for help, found Mingzhe at the souvenir counter on the first floor, and sternly told him not to run off.
location: First and third floors, Tianjin Museum, No. 62 Pingjiang Road, Hexi District, Tianjin, China.

name: Lunch at a fast-food restaurant
description: After leaving the museum, they had lunch at the fast-food restaurant across the street, ordering noodles with gravy and sweet and sour pork. While eating, they talked about what they had seen that morning: Mingxuan liked the weapons, Mingzhe mentioned the loom, and Yuxin insisted on the wax figures.
location: Jinwei Express Restaurant, No. 1 Leyuan Road, Hexi District, Tianjin, China

name: Buying souvenir postcards and taking a rest
description: After lunch, they returned to the museum souvenir shop. Each person picked out a postcard, and Xiulan paid 20 yuan for them. Then they rested in the seating area on the first floor, where Mingzhe and Yuxin took a nap beside Xiulan.
location: Souvenir shop and rest area on the first floor of Tianjin Museum, No. 62 Pingjiang Road, Hexi District, Tianjin, China

name: Free tour and outdoor plaza activities
description: After the children rested, they continued visiting the modern and contemporary history exhibition hall 'A Century of China Seen in Tianjin,' and Mingxuan was deeply moved. In the afternoon, at the museum's outdoor plaza, Mingzhe and Yuxin chased each other, Mingxuan drew pigeons, and Xiulan took photos.
location: Tianjin Museum exhibition areas and outdoor square, No. 62 Pingjiang Road, Hexi District, Tianjin, China

name: Left the venue and headed to the Cultural Center bus stop to wait for the bus.
description: A little after 3 p.m., Xiulan packed up, took the children out of the museum, walked about 10 minutes to the Cultural Center bus stop, and waited for the return long-distance bus.
location: Cultural Center Bus Stop, Hexi District, Tianjin, China

name: Take the long-distance bus back to Jinghai.
description: At 16:00 they took the bus back to Jinghai. The children chatted excitedly; Mingxuan planned to put up weapon pictures, Mingzhe still wanted to see dinosaurs, and Yuxin fell asleep on her mother's shoulder. Xiulan looked out the window, feeling tired but fulfilled.
location: Long-distance bus (from Hexi District, Tianjin to Jinghai District)

name: Buy groceries while walking home.
description: After getting off at Jinghai Passenger Station, she walked home. Passing the vegetable stall at the entrance of the residential complex, she bought greens and tomatoes for dinner.
location: Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China, passing by the community vegetable stall

name: Dinner, family sharing, and evening reading
description: Xiulan cooked noodles with gravy, stir-fried tomatoes and eggs, and green vegetables. The family sat around the table for dinner, sharing museum photos and experiences. After dinner, she sorted tickets, brochures, and postcards into albums. Mingxuan shared his notes, and the younger siblings watched cartoons. Then came a short reading time; Mingxuan talked about the museum notes, and Xiulan told the history of Sanchakou.
location: Dining room and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Children's bedtime preparation and Xiulan's stretching
description: Xiulan arranged for the children to bathe and go to bed, then did 10 minutes of lower back stretches to relieve the day's walking fatigue.
location: Bathroom and bedroom in the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Going to bed
description: The children played all day and got sleepy early. Xiulan settled them into bed at 22:00. After sorting out the expenses, she went to bed at 23:30, planning to visit her parents the next day.
location: Bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Morning washing, exercise, meal preparation, and housework
description: Woke up at 6:30 in the morning with some soreness and swelling in the knees. First went to the bathroom to wash up, washed her face with warm water, and applied moisturizer. Then went to the yard to move the joints and completed a set of Baduanjin to stretch the body. After that, she went into the kitchen to prepare breakfast, making tomato and egg noodles and heating up red bean paste buns. While the water was boiling, she soaked the clothes that needed changing and tidied up the picture books and toys the children had left scattered on the living room coffee table.
location: At home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Wake the family up for breakfast together and clean up after the meal
description: At 7:20, she woke the children and her husband one by one. Mingxuan was the first out of bed, rubbing his eyes; Mingzhe stayed in bed; Yuxin needed to be held for a while before getting up. The whole family sat at the table to enjoy the fragrant tomato and egg noodles and red bean buns, chatting while eating. Zhiqiang mentioned that he would be making a long trip to Cangzhou, Hebei next week, and Xiulan told him to get enough rest and planned to prepare some dry provisions and pickled vegetables.
