After the meal, Xiulan asked Mingxuan to help wash the dishes, Mingzhe to wipe the table, and Yuxin to arrange the stools, while she cleaned the stove and range hood and tidied up the kitchen. Looking at the bright and clean room, she felt refreshed.
location: Dining room and kitchen at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Going out to have photos developed, buy a photo album, and visit the vegetable market.
description: Once everything was tidied up, Xiulan took her USB drive and walked 5 minutes to the print shop at the entrance of the community. She asked the owner, Xiao Li, to print 20 6-inch photos. While waiting, she went to the stationery store next door and spent 15 yuan on a blank photo album with a cartoon dinosaur cover. After picking up the photos and the album, she rode her electric bike for 3 minutes to Wutong Commune vegetable market. At Aunt Sun's fruit stall, she picked 2 jin of local green plums, planning to make low-sugar green plum jam for her father. Aunt Sun recommended fresh shiitake mushrooms, so she weighed out 1 jin of those, and also bought leafy greens and eggs. Then she rode home, put the green plums and ingredients in the kitchen, and carefully placed the printed photos and photo album on the living room coffee table.
location: Print shop near No. 158 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Wutong Commune vegetable market on the north side of the intersection of Shengli Avenue and Jingwen Road; return to home at No. 156 Jingwen Road

name: Go to her parents' home to deliver postcards and chat with them.
description: Xiulan put the postcards she had bought at the museum into her small shoulder bag and rode her bike south along Shengli Street for less than 10 minutes to her parents' home. When she entered, her mother was cleaning vegetables and her father was watching TV. She excitedly handed the postcards to her parents and recounted yesterday's experiences one by one, especially the scary episode when Mingzhe got lost; her mother slapped her thigh as she listened. Her father held the postcards and looked at them for a long time, then said with feeling that going to the museum yesterday was truly worthwhile and the children had broadened their horizons. The family chatted warmly.
location: 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, at the parents' home

name: Buy groceries on the way, then prepare and enjoy a chive dumpling lunch
description: At 11:30, after saying goodbye to her parents, Xiulan stopped by the vegetable stall at the entrance of the neighborhood to buy a bunch of fresh chives and went home. Zhiqiang went to his father's place to check the water pipe, while Xiulan started bustling in the kitchen, kneading dough and mixing a filling of chives, eggs, and dried shrimp. The children smelled the food and ran over to help: Yuxin peeled garlic, Mingzhe learned to roll wrappers, and although the wrappers were lopsided, the atmosphere was warm. At 12 o'clock the dumplings came out of the pot, and Zhiqiang returned saying the pipe had been fixed. The whole family sat around dipping dumplings in vinegar and chili oil. Xiulan mentioned that the summer homework would be checked tomorrow; Mingxuan acknowledged it, while Mingzhe buried his head in his dumplings, pretending not to hear. After the meal, Zhiqiang took the initiative to clear the dishes.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Lunch break and afternoon tidying
description: After the meal, Xiulan leaned on the sofa for 20 minutes to let her sore waist and back relax. After waking up, she washed her face with cold water and began preparing to make green plum jam. She scrubbed the green plums with salt water, removed the stems, found the xylitol and clean glass jars, and arranged them neatly on the kitchen counter.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin — the living room sofa and kitchen at home

name: Simmered low-sugar green plum jam and treated a burn
description: Xiulan set a clay pot on the gas stove, put in green plums and a little water, and boiled them over medium heat. The children curiously gathered at the kitchen doorway, and Mingxuan helped watch the heat. The green plums gradually softened and released their pectin, and a sweet-and-sour aroma filled the kitchen. At around 15:00, just as she was about to turn off the heat and bottle the jam, hot jam overflowing from the rim of the pot splashed onto the back of her left hand, immediately turning a small patch red. Xiulan quickly turned off the stove, rushed to the bathroom, and ran cold water over her hand, with Yuxin following behind, asking in concern. After rinsing for five or six minutes, she took out aloe vera gel from the medicine box and applied a thin layer. Wearing rubber gloves, she returned to the kitchen and carefully poured the green plum jam into two sealed glass jars.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin — the kitchen and bathroom of the home

name: Deliver green plum jam to Granny Li across the way
description: Xiulan picked up a jar of freshly made green plum jam and walked across to Grandma Li's house. Grandma Li opened the door, took the jar, tasted a spoonful, and gave a thumbs-up, praising that the jam was perfectly sweet without being cloying. The two sat on small stools at the doorway chatting, and Grandma Li recalled her experience of working at the state-run cannery in her youth. Xiulan promised that the next time she made pear syrup, she would definitely have Grandma Li join her.
location: At Grandma Li's home, No. 158 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Teach the children to identify plants in the courtyard and prepare dinner
description: While it was still light out, Xiulan took the children to the yard. She pointed to the perilla and mint in the corner and taught the children to identify them: perilla leaves have purple edges and can be soaked in water to treat colds; mint leaves are wrinkled, smell cool, and can be used in cooking or to repel mosquitoes. The children curiously touched and smelled them. Mingzhe used a magnifying glass to observe the leaf veins, and Yuxin picked a mint leaf and stuck it to her forehead. Then Xiulan asked Mingxuan to cut scallions in the vegetable plot, Mingzhe to peel garlic, and Yuxin to hand out the bowls and chopsticks. They began to prepare dinner, planning to make shredded pork with green peppers, cucumber salad, and tomato and egg soup, and reheat the leftover dumplings from lunch. Zhiqiang was repairing his bicycle in the corner of the yard, occasionally joining in the conversation. The warm twilight hour flowed amid the sounds of pots and pans.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin: the courtyard and kitchen of the home.

name: The whole family has dinner together
description: The food was served, and the family sat together again. The burn on Xiulan's hand no longer hurt as much after she applied aloe vera gel. During the meal, Mingxuan brought up his afternoon observation of an ant nest; Mingzhe corrected him, saying it was the ants' "home," and Yuxin eagerly said that Mom had told her mint can cure mosquito bites. Xiulan listened with a smile, and the day's fatigue dissolved in the children's innocent words.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family reading time and growth journal
description: After dinner and a short rest, reading time began. Mingxuan sat at his desk, opened Chinese Historical Story Collection, and vividly read “Sleeping on Brushwood and Tasting Gall” to his younger brother and sister. Xiulan sat on the living room sofa and told Yuxin the picture book Little Tadpoles Looking for Mom. Half an hour later, Xiulan took out the growth journal and wrote, “Mingzhe observed the ants very attentively today and asked why ants move their homes,” and asked Mingxuan to record his own reading reflections.
location: No. 156, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; home study and living room sofa

name: Parent-child album creation and household tidying
description: Xiulan took out the printed photos and a new photo album, and the family sat together on the carpet to make a 'Museum Trip' themed album. Mingxuan wrote titles for each photo (such as 'Ancient Weapons Exhibition' and 'Secrets of the Loom'), Mingzhe was responsible for sticking in the photos, and Yuxin put cartoon stickers in the blank spaces as decoration. Xiulan guided from the side, occasionally correcting placement. In between, the children had free time and bathed: Yuxin first, then Mingzhe, and finally Mingxuan. Everyone was happily busy.
location: Living room and bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing foot bath, couple discussing next month's expenses
description: After the children had taken their baths one after another, Xiulan rinsed off quickly and changed into loungewear. She filled the foot bath with hot water, then found the account book and calculator and placed them on the nightstand. As she soaked her feet in the hot water with Zhiqiang, Xiulan opened the account book and calculated next month's expenses item by item: Mingxuan's and Mingzhe's supplementary learning materials and stationery, Yuxin's new sneakers, and the money to buy mooncakes for her parents at the end of the month. Zhiqiang listened quietly and approved the plan, saying he would try to save more on the next job. The two discussed it and set a budget cap, and Xiulan carefully recorded it in the account book.
location: Bathroom and master bedroom at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Pre-sleep stretching, review, and going to bed.
description: After finishing the foot soak, Xiulan got up to pour out the water, unrolled her yoga mat, and did 10 minutes of lower back and leg stretches to relieve the day's fatigue. While stretching, she silently reviewed in her mind: the photos were developed, the green plum jam had been cooked, the scald was not serious, she had delivered the sauce to Grandma Li, the yard work was done, and the accounts were settled before bed. Everything was going according to plan, and she felt especially at ease. At 22:30 she turned off the light and lay down; Zhiqiang had already fallen into a deep sleep, and the children's room was quiet too. Moonlight spilled through the curtains onto the floor. Thinking about checking the summer vacation homework tomorrow, she smiled gently and slowly drifted off to sleep.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin - bedroom floor and master bedroom at home

name: Get up in the early morning and prepare supplies for the trip
description: At 5:00 in the morning, Ma Xiulan got up quietly so as not to wake the children. After washing up, she took out the six plain steamed buns she had made yesterday from the refrigerator, put them into a cloth bag, and filled a large jug with cool boiled water for her husband Ma Zhiqiang to drink on the road. She also took out a newly bought blue cloth jacket from the cabinet to bring along. While tidying up, she noticed that the index finger on her left hand, scalded yesterday while making green plum jam, still had a dull pain, but it was nothing serious.
location: Ma Xiulan's home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Handle housework and arrange the children's affairs.
description: Ma Xiulan packed everything she needed for the trip into a large canvas bag, including a change of clothes, a power bank, band-aids, and low-sugar green plum jam for her parents. She quickly took in the clothes drying in the courtyard and folded them, then took out her ledger and wrote down reminders about the children: Ma Mingxuan still had two pages of math left in his summer homework, Ma Mingzhe had to take a nap at noon, and Ma Yuxin had to sleep with her little plush toy. She packed the children's clothes for the trip into another large bag, ready to take them to her mother's house.
location: Ma Xiulan's home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Make breakfast and wake the children up.
description: At 6:20, Ma Xiulan started making breakfast, cooking a pot of millet porridge and reheating the leftover chive-and-egg buns from yesterday. At 6:30, she woke the children one by one, helped her younger daughter Ma Yuxin get dressed, while Ma Mingzhe stayed in bed and her elder son Ma Mingxuan washed up on his own. Once the children were all seated, she squatted down and earnestly told them: today Dad and I are going on a long trip, and Grandma will come to take care of you; you must be obedient, especially Ma Mingzhe, who has to finish his homework before watching TV. Ma Yuxin clung to her, and she kissed her daughter on the cheek.
location: Ma Xiulan's home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Taking the children to her mother's home to settle them in.
description: After breakfast, Ma Xiulan shouldered her large bag, holding Ma Yuxin by one hand and taking her two sons, and hurried toward her mother Li Xiuying's home at 45 Shengli Street. Her mother was already waiting at the gate. Once inside, Ma Xiulan, not bothering to wipe off her sweat, gave detailed instructions about the children's meals, naps, homework, and Yuxin's habit of needing to sleep holding her plush toy. Her mother patted her chest to reassure her and pressed two washed big apples into her hand. She then told Ma Mingxuan to look after his younger siblings before leaving.
location: At the home of mother Li Xiuying, 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Returning home to pick up luggage and heading to the logistics park parking lot.
description: Ma Xiulan walked briskly from her mother's home back to her own home, picked up the prepared canvas bag and the cloth bag with a water bottle. She hailed a tricycle on Jingwen Road, spent 8 yuan, and headed to the parking lot of the logistics park in Beihuan Industrial Park, Jinghai District. The tricycle driver was a familiar acquaintance and chatted with her about how today's weather was suitable for long-distance driving. Around 8:10, she arrived at the logistics park parking lot and saw her husband Ma Zhiqiang's Jiefang-brand truck.
location: Parking lot, Logistics Park, Beihuan Industrial Park, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Meet up with her husband and get ready to leave.
description: Ma Xiulan found her husband Ma Zhiqiang, who was checking the truck tires. She climbed into the passenger seat and put her luggage on the bunk in the back. The cab smelled of diesel and sweat, which she silently endured. She handed over an apple her mother had given her. Ma Zhiqiang took it, took a big bite, and started the truck. The truck slowly drove out of the logistics park. Ma Xiulan watched her husband's focused profile as he drove, thinking that she could finally spend some good time with him.
location: Parking lot, Logistics Park, Beihuan Industrial Park, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Took her husband's truck to Shijiazhuang.
description: The truck drove onto the Jincang Expressway, passed through the Shihuang Expressway, and headed toward Luquan District, Shijiazhuang. Ma Xiulan sat in the passenger seat, watching the navigation on her phone while chatting with her husband about everyday things and tallying the tutoring and stationery costs for her eldest son, Ma Mingxuan. They rested for twenty minutes at a service area, eating steamed buns and pickled mustard. The two said little, but their eyes conveyed complete mutual understanding. At nearly two in the afternoon, the truck arrived at Zhandao Xinsheng Pipe Fittings Factory in Luquan District.
location: Along the expressway from Jinghai District, Tianjin, to Luquan District, Shijiazhuang, Hebei Province

name: While her husband unloaded the goods, she watched over the cargo and bought lunch
description: The truck stopped in the unloading area of the pipe fitting factory, and Ma Zhiqiang began carrying pipes weighing several dozen jin off the truck one by one. Ma Xiulan stayed by the truck watching the goods, her heart aching as she watched her husband's work clothes soaked with sweat and covered with gray dirt. After he finished one trip, Ma Xiulan quickly told him to rest, then walked quickly to the snack stall at the factory gate and bought two hot roujiamo and two bottles of mineral water.
location: Unloading area, Zhandao Xinsheng Pipe Fittings Factory, 012 Township Road, Luquan District, Shijiazhuang City, Hebei Province

name: Have a late lunch with her husband.
description: After unloading the goods, the two sat in the shade by the wall next to the truck and ate lunch. Ma Zhiqiang wolfed down a steamed bun in a few bites, clearly starving. Ma Xiulan broke off more than half of her own bun and pressed it on him, saying her stomach was small and she couldn't finish it. Watching him eat the bun and drink water in big mouthfuls, Ma Xiulan felt a mix of emotions—both heartache and contentment.
location: Shaded area at the parking lot of Zhandao Xinsheng Pipe Fittings Factory, 012 Township Road, Luquan District, Shijiazhuang, Hebei

name: Waiting for return cargo information and resting in the driver's cab
description: After the meal, Ma Zhiqiang went to the factory dispatch office to ask about the shipment back to Tianjin. Ma Xiulan sat in the driver's cab, using her phone to send a WeChat message to her mother to report that they were safe. Only after learning that the children were obedient did she calm down. Ma Zhiqiang came back and said the return cargo would not be loaded until around 5 or 6 p.m. So the two reclined their seats and dozed off in the cab.
location: Driver's cab in the parking area of Xinsheng Pipe Fittings Factory, Zhandao, Luquan District, 012 Township Road, Shijiazhuang City, Hebei Province

name: Walk around the factory area and learn about her husband's daily routine.
description: While waiting for the delivery, Ma Xiulan pulled Ma Zhiqiang out for a walk outside the factory area, wanting to see the places he usually went. Her husband took her to the small shop where he often bought cigarettes, and then to the Laiweixuan Knife-Cut Noodles restaurant where he often ate, saying the sauce there was generous and affordable. He also talked about which stretches of road were easy to drive and which service area had clean restrooms, giving Ma Xiulan a more vivid sense of his daily commute.
location: Haishan South Street, Luquan District, Shijiazhuang City, Hebei Province (near the pipe fittings factory)

name: Prepare a simple dinner in the driver's cab and rest.
description: In the evening, Ma Xiulan used hot water from a thermos to soak a bowl of instant noodles for Ma Zhiqiang, and also brought out the dry rations and pickled vegetables they had brought with them. The two ate a simple meal in the cab under the small overhead light. After the meal, Ma Zhiqiang got out of the car, leaned against the front, smoked, and chatted briefly with a driver waiting nearby for cargo. Ma Xiulan turned on the flashlight on her phone and continued embroidering the tiger-head shoes she had not finished yesterday, with fine, dense stitches.
location: Driver's cab in the parking area of Xinsheng Pipe Fittings Factory, Zhandao, Luquan District, 012 Township Road, Shijiazhuang City, Hebei Province

name: Washed up simply and made the bed.
description: The sky was completely dark, and the streetlights in the factory area came on. Ma Xiulan wiped her face briefly with a wet towel, then she and Ma Zhiqiang flattened the seats and pulled a thin quilt out from the back row to spread over them. The cab was cramped, and the two could barely lie side by side.
location: Driver's cab in the parking area of Xinsheng Pipe Fittings Factory, Zhandao, Luquan District, 012 Township Road, Shijiazhuang City, Hebei Province

name: Late-night emotional talk and falling asleep together
description: Outside the car window, insects chirped in bursts. Ma Zhiqiang turned on his side and soon fell into even snoring. Ma Xiulan lay beside him, smelling the diesel and sweat on him, and tears suddenly welled up. She asked softly whether he usually slept here, and he answered drowsily. Her heart felt pricked by a needle; she quietly turned to the side and held his rough hand, covered in calluses and cracks, as tears slid silently down. She thought to herself that following him for life was worth it. With this complex yet warm feeling, she nestled against her husband, listening to his breathing, and slowly drifted off to sleep.
location: Driver's cab in the parking area of Xinsheng Pipe Fittings Factory, Zhandao, Luquan District, 012 Township Road, Shijiazhuang City, Hebei Province

name: Return trip in the early morning and rest stop at a service area.
description: At a little past 4 a.m., Ma Xiulan woke up to the slight shaking of the truck and saw her husband Ma Zhiqiang driving intently. She gently patted his arm to let him know she was awake. The two chatted about yesterday's trouble unloading goods in Shijiazhuang, and then around 6 o'clock they drove into the Tangguantun Service Area on the Jincang Expressway. Xiulan went to the restroom to wash her face with cold water, and they bought hot steamed buns and millet porridge at the service area snack stand for breakfast. Zhiqiang refueled the truck, and Xiulan filled her thermos with hot water, preparing for the rest of the journey.
location: Tangguantun Service Area on the Jincang Expressway (Jinghai District, Tianjin)

name: Drove home alone
description: After breakfast at the service area, her husband Ma Zhiqiang had to pick up goods at Jinghai North Ring Logistics Park, so he asked Xiulan to drive home by herself. Although Xiulan rarely drove on normal days, to save her husband the detour, she took the wheel and steadily drove their van along the Jincang Expressway exit toward the familiar Jinghai urban area. After about a 30-minute drive, she arrived home safely.
location: On the way from Tangguantun Service Area on the Jincang Expressway to No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Arrived home and settled in.
description: After getting home, Xiulan first watered the roses and vegetables in the yard, then went inside and soaked the dirty clothes she had brought back from Shijiazhuang in a washbasin. She checked her phone and saw the photos of the children that her mother had sent the night before, which made her feel much more at ease.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home)

name: Pick up the child and bring them home to settle down.
description: Xiulan walked to her mother's home, where her mother Li Xiuying was looking after the three children. She handed her mother the pastries bought in Shijiazhuang and chatted about the driving job. Then she walked home with Mingxuan, Mingzhe, and Yuxin. Once home, Xiulan reheated leftover rice and steamed buns, fried three eggs, and had brunch with the children. After the meal, she called her mother to report that they were safe, told her eldest son Mingxuan to help his younger siblings with their homework, and hugged her youngest daughter Yuxin.
location: No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin (mother's home) and No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home)

name: Catch-up afternoon nap.
description: Overcome with drowsiness, Xiulan spread a blanket on the living room sofa and fell asleep as soon as her head hit it. In a daze, she even felt in her dream as if she were in the cab of a swaying truck, until she was woken by the laughter of children in the courtyard. Although she had slept for only a little over an hour, she felt much better.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home living room)

name: Lunch and household chores
description: After waking up, Xiulan washed her face, cooked the children a noodle soup with greens and eggs, and had a small bowl herself. After the meal, she quickly cleared the dishes, hand-washed the clothes that had been soaking since morning, wrung them out, and hung them on the wire in the courtyard. Then she gave the east room a quick dusting and mopped the floor.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home)

name: Doing crafts and going over lessons with the child.
description: Xiulan brought out a small folding stool and sat under the eaves. She took the shoe upper of a tiger-head shoe from her sewing basket and began to embroider. Mingzhe was doing math problems, Yuxin was lying at a small table drawing, and Mingxuan was reading Journey to the West beside them. The courtyard was quiet and peaceful. Xiulan was silently planning to find time after school started the next day to buy new fabric and sew a cartoon patch onto Yuxin's little schoolbag.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home courtyard)

name: Husband came home to say goodbye.
description: The courtyard gate rang. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang had taken a moment to come home and change into a clean undershirt. Xiulan immediately put down her needlework and went to greet him, handing him the freshly washed blue cloth jacket to put on. She then had him sit on a stool and stood behind him, firmly massaging his stiff shoulders, telling him to rest at a service area if he felt tired on the road and to put safety first. As he was leaving, Xiulan tucked a washed Fuji apple into his work clothes pocket. Zhiqiang got onto his truck and disappeared at the mouth of the alley, and Xiulan felt a warmth rise in her heart.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home)

name: Housework and children's afternoon nap
description: After Zhiqiang left, Xiulan had Mingxuan take his younger siblings to lie on the bed in the west room for a while. She took down the dried clothes, folded them, and put them in the wardrobe. She also scooped out the beans that had been soaking in the morning, drained them, and got ready to cook bean porridge in the evening.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home)

name: Go to the vegetable market to buy groceries
description: After the children fell asleep, Xiulan drove the small van alone to the Wutong Commune vegetable market she usually went to, a drive of about 23 minutes. At the stall of her familiar Aunt Sun, she bought chives, baby bok choy, and tofu, and Aunt Sun said she looked well. Then she went to the dried fruit shop next door and bought some snacks to have ready for the children in the evening. After shopping, Xiulan drove home, with the round trip taking about 45 minutes in total.
location: Wutong Community Market, Wutong Community Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Helping the children prepare for the new school term
description: The children woke up one after another. Xiulan asked Mingxuan and Mingzhe to check whether the pencil cases, textbooks, and red scarves in their new schoolbags were all there. She put the washed little schoolbag on Yuxin and packed spare clothes and a sweat towel. Once everything was ready, she let the children play in the yard for a while. Mingzhe dug in the soil with a toy shovel, and Xiulan smiled and reminded him not to damage the rose roots.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home)

name: Dinner
description: Xiulan deftly wrapped chive and egg dumplings and deliberately put coins in two of them. She also stir-fried a plate of baby bok choy and made tofu soup. The family sat around the dinner table. Xiulan put dumplings into the children's bowls and listened to them talk about the stories they had read during the summer vacation. The child who found a coin was especially delighted, and the table was full of laughter.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home)

name: Family reading and homework organization
description: After clearing the table, Xiulan asked Mingxuan to supervise his younger siblings in giving the summer practice report a final check. She herself took out the “A Hundred Years of Tianjin” postcards brought back from the museum and asked Mingxuan to tell the stories on them. Yuxin, meanwhile, pestered her mother to read the picture book Guess How Much I Love You. Xiulan’s gentle voice held the children spellbound.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home)

name: Washing up and back-to-school reminders
description: Xiulan urged the children to take baths. She helped Yuxin wash her hair and checked whether Mingxuan's and Mingzhe's fingernails needed trimming. After everything was done, she placed the clothes and schoolbags for tomorrow at each child's bedside. She especially sat by Mingzhe's bed and reminded him to greet his new classmates tomorrow and to listen attentively in class.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home)

name: Foot soaking and reflection
description: After the children were all asleep, Xiulan boiled a large pot of mugwort water and poured it into a wooden basin. Sitting on a small stool, she slowly put her feet into the hot water and let out a long, comfortable sigh. While soaking her feet, she looked through postcards from the Tianjin Museum and thought to herself: her husband Zhiqiang had had a hard time along the way; though she was tired, life was like this—supporting each other. Tomorrow the children would start school, and she would be busy again. After soaking for about fifteen minutes, the soles of her feet felt much lighter.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home)

name: Expense Tracking and Budgeting
description: After soaking her feet, Xiulan sat down at the sewing machine in the east room and opened the old account book. She recorded that she had spent 28 yuan on groceries today, and thought about the supplementary exercise books and stationery the children would need after school started. She suddenly remembered the "zero-basics sewing crash course" advertisement she had seen near the railway station yesterday, and thought that if she studied for a little over a month, she might be able to take on finer handwork to help with household expenses. So she drew a circle in her notebook as a to-do item.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (east room of the house)

name: Chatting on her phone before bedtime
description: After lying down in bed, Xiulan spent a while on her phone. Her childhood friend Liu Chunmei asked in the group chat whether she had gotten home safely. Xiulan replied that she had, and joked that from tomorrow she would again have to be a 'three-accompaniment' (accompanying meals, accompanying study, accompanying sleep). Several women in the group laughed, and they chatted about the children going back to school. Xiulan also sent her husband a WeChat message asking whether he had eaten and where he was, but she didn't get an immediate reply. She wasn't worried.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home bedroom)

name: Falling asleep
description: After putting down her phone, Xiulan recalled this special day in the dark. From the early-morning truck to the quiet home at this moment, it was like a dream. She remembered the simple smile on Zhiqiang's face as he left, and a warm feeling rose in her heart. She silently resolved to be more considerate of her husband in the future and to take better care of the household. She turned on her side, listened to the autumn insects chirping outside the window, and soon fell into a peaceful sleep.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home bedroom)

name: Wake-up and morning exercise
description: At 5:45 in the morning, the alarm went off and Ma Xiulan got up. The day was cloudy with fresh air. She walked slowly in her yard for 20 minutes, checked the roses, removed dried leaves, and did a 5-minute neck and shoulder stretch under the porch to relieve the shoulder fatigue from yesterday's driving and handicraft work.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home courtyard)

name: Preparing breakfast and hurrying the children
description: After exercising, she returned to the kitchen, reheated the leftover millet porridge from the night before, steamed the stuffed buns and plain steamed buns, and cut up pickled cucumbers and preserved vegetables. Meanwhile, she woke Ma Mingxuan, Ma Mingzhe, and Ma Yuxin and urged them to wash up. Ma Mingxuan got himself ready and rode his bicycle to school for morning self-study; Ma Mingzhe was slow, so Ma Xiulan urged him a couple more times.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home kitchen and dining room).

name: Took Yuxin to her grandmother's house and took Mingzhe for an eyesight recheck
description: After breakfast, Yuxin clung to her grandmother, so Ma Xiulan decided to leave her with her mother for the morning. At 6:50 she took Yuxin on her electric bike to her parents' home (No. 45 Shengli Street), arriving in about 5 minutes. Her mother, Li Xiuying, took the child. Then Ma Xiulan set off from her parents' home with Ma Mingzhe, heading north on Shengli Street and turning onto Shengli Road, arriving at the Jinghai District Eye Hospital (No. 58 Shengli Road) in about 10 minutes. She registered and saw the doctor. After the examination, the doctor told Mingzhe that his myopia had remained stable at 150 degrees, was well controlled, and praised his eye care measures. Ma Xiulan was in a great mood. She spent 30 yuan on a shatterproof resin eyeglass chain. Mingzhe chose blue and promised not to secretly take off his glasses again. She used her phone to take photos of the test results and Mingzhe wearing his new glasses chain, and sent them to the family WeChat group.
location: Jinghai District Eye Hospital, 58 Shengli Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (going from her parents' home at 45 Shengli Avenue)

name: Shopping at the vegetable market.
description: After coming out of the eye hospital, it was still early, so Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike along the way to Wutong Community Vegetable Market to shop. She planned to make braised eggplant, so she picked out a few tender purple long eggplants and also bought potatoes, green peppers, and wide sweet potato noodles. At Aunt Sun's familiar stall, Aunt Sun gave her a bunch of cilantro, and the two chatted about everyday things.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin (beside the east gate of the Wutong Commune residential community)

name: Return home and prepare ingredients (including an unexpected incident)
description: After shopping, she returned to her home at 156 Jingwen Road. Ma Xiulan put the vegetables away by category, then called her mother to say she would pick up Yuxin at noon for lunch. After a short rest, she started handling the eggplants: cutting them into roll-cut chunks, salting them to marinate, and preparing minced garlic, green pepper segments, and scallion and ginger. Just then her phone rang—her childhood friend Liu Chunmei was calling. The two chatted about the kids starting school tomorrow and the sewing class, and got so caught up in the conversation that she forgot about the oil pan heating on the stove. Only when she smelled a strong burning odor did she snap back to reality. She rushed into the kitchen and found the pot bottom already black and the eggplants completely burnt. Feeling upset, she scrubbed the pot while mocking herself, 'Getting old, memory is bad,' and had to start over again with a new pot and oil to cook.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home kitchen)

name: Pick Yuxin up and bring her home
description: Before stir-frying the second dish, Ma Xiulan first rode her electric bike to her parents' home to pick up her daughter Yuxin. On the way, Yuxin chattered about the little dog at grandma's house. After returning home, she tidied up a bit.
location: No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin (parents' home) to No. 156 Jingwen Road (home)

name: Lunchtime.
description: Ma Xiulan re-cooked the braised eggplant and made a cucumber salad. At noon, Ma Mingxuan came home from school, and the family of four (her husband Ma Zhiqiang was out driving) sat down to lunch together. She served rice to the children. Ma Mingzhe ate with relish, and Yuxin also ate a lot.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home dining room)

name: Lunch break and rest.
description: After the meal, as she cleared the dishes, Ma Xiulan felt a little tired, so she leaned back on the living room sofa and rested with her eyes closed for half an hour. After getting up, she looked at the sisters' group chat on her phone, briefly replied to a few messages, and planned the afternoon's tasks.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home living room and bedroom)

name: Check holiday homework
description: Ma Xiulan called Ma Mingzhe into the living room and spot-checked his math workbook. She found several word problems on the last two pages left blank. In a calm but serious tone, she told Mingzhe to make sure to complete them in the afternoon. Mingzhe nodded sheepishly and went back to his room. Then she checked Yuxin's pinyin tracing workbook and found that the writing order for 'b' and 'd' was mixed up, so she held Yuxin's little hand and corrected the stroke order one by one.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home living room)

name: Mended her husband's work trousers and did handicrafts.
description: After arranging the children's study tasks, Ma Xiulan took out her husband Ma Zhiqiang's work pants, whose knees were almost worn through, and brought out the old sewing machine to mend them in a shady spot under the courtyard eaves. She carefully compared the worn areas, cut two thick pieces of matching cloth, patched them with the sewing machine, and reinforced around the patches with repeated stitching to make sure they were sturdy. While mending, she thought about looking at the sewing class materials in the afternoon if she had time.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (under the corridor in the home courtyard)

name: Check and supervise the finishing touches
description: After sewing the pants, Ma Xiulan went to Mingzhe's room and saw that he was indeed working on his math exercises and was almost done, so she praised him a little. Then she went to Yuxin's room. Yuxin was doodling, so Ma Xiulan took out her pinyin notebook and asked her to write another line of the corrected letters. Yuxin obediently did so.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (various rooms in the home)

name: Teaching Baduanjin in the courtyard.
description: Ma Xiulan came to the courtyard and began practicing Baduanjin. When she reached the movement "Holding Up the Hands to Regulate the Triple Burner," Mingzhe, who had finished his homework, came over curiously to watch. She slowed down and smilingly taught him: "Come, Mom will teach you. This move can make you taller." She patiently broke down the two movements "Holding Up the Hands" and "Drawing the Bow to Shoot the Eagle." Mingzhe imitated her with proper form, and the mother and son happily practiced in the afterglow of the setting sun.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home courtyard)

name: Making dinner
description: After teaching Baduanjin, Ma Xiulan went back to the kitchen to make dinner. Tonight was simple: steamed rice, stir-fried tomatoes and eggs, reheated leftover braised eggplant from noon, and a seaweed egg drop soup. Nothing went wrong today, and she quickly made two dishes and one soup.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home kitchen)

name: Family dinner
description: The family had dinner together. At the table, Ma Mingzhe brought up the afternoon's eye exam on his own and proudly showed off his new glasses chain. The atmosphere was relaxed. Ma Mingxuan also talked about some things at school.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home dining room)

name: Family Reading Time
description: After cleaning up after the meal, it was family reading time. Mingzhe said proactively, "Mom, I didn't play with my phone today." Ma Xiulan smiled and praised him for being sensible. She sat on the sofa and read an illustrated story from The Little Prince to Yuxin and Mingzhe, while Mingxuan quietly read Those Things in the Ming Dynasty beside them.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home living room)

name: Urge her to wash up and pack her schoolbag.
description: After reading, Ma Xiulan urged the three children to wash up one by one. She checked Mingzhe and Yuxin's schoolbags and confirmed each item they needed for the first day of school tomorrow: uniform, water bottle, stationery, and newly wrapped book covers. She reminded Mingxuan to leave earlier in the morning so he wouldn't be late.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home bathroom and bedroom)

name: Bookkeeping and soaking feet
description: After the children had all gone to bed, Ma Xiulan prepared a basin of mugwort water, moved a small stool to the bedside, and soaked her feet. At the same time, she took out her account book and pen to record the day's expenses: 32 yuan for groceries, and 38 yuan for hospital registration plus an eyeglass chain. She mentally calculated how much money was left for the month and also thought about the sewing class enrollment. After soaking her feet for 15 minutes, her whole body felt relaxed.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home bedroom)

name: Chatting with a childhood friend
description: After soaking her feet, Ma Xiulan saw a WeChat voice message from her childhood friend Liu Chunmei, and the two chatted back and forth about the day's trivial matters. Ma Xiulan mentioned the burnt pot bottom, and Chunmei burst out laughing on the other end. After chatting for more than twenty minutes, they said goodnight to each other.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home bedroom)

name: Stretching and daily review before bed.
description: After hanging up, Ma Xiulan did 10 minutes of lower back stretches on the bed. Before turning off the light, she picked up her phone and checked Mingzhe’s school opening notice for tomorrow, making sure nothing was missed. Thinking that the children would officially start school tomorrow and her life could get back to a regular rhythm, she felt both expectation and reassurance.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home bedroom)

name: Prepare for sleep.
description: Checked the doors and windows again and confirmed the alarm clock was set. After lying down, Ma Xiulan reviewed the day's events in her mind. Although there were some minor interruptions, overall everything went smoothly. She naturally fell asleep, bringing all the day's big and small matters to an end.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home bedroom)

name: Morning exercise and mental preparation
description: Ma Xiulan woke up at 5:40, didn't get up immediately, and first moved her ankles in bed. Outside the window the sky was gloomy and oppressive. She put on a coat and went to her own yard, took a deep breath of fresh air, and walked slowly on the concrete for 20 minutes. Because cloudy days made her shoulders and neck easily stiff, she deliberately did an extra 5 minutes of shoulder-neck stretches and waist circles. After warming up, she returned to the main room, boiled water to make tea while mentally encouraging herself: don't get angry today, be patient, and definitely help Mingzhe pass this homework hurdle.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (own courtyard and main room)

name: Prepare breakfast and do the morning housework cleaning.
description: The children were still asleep, so Ma Xiulan moved quietly. She opened the refrigerator, used the chives and eggs bought yesterday to make chive pockets, cooked a pot of millet porridge, and stir-fried potatoes with vinegar. While the dough was resting, she wiped down the stove and washed two pieces of underwear from the night before, hanging them in the yard to dry. Once the porridge was simmering, the aroma drifted out, and the home felt warm and lived-in.
location: China, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home kitchen)

name: Wake up the children and take them to school.
description: Ma Xiulan woke up the three children one by one: Ma Mingxuan, Ma Mingzhe, and Ma Yuxin, and urged them to wash up and get dressed. She helped her daughter Yuxin tie two neat braids and fastened the pink hair tie she had sewn yesterday. During breakfast, she deliberately observed Mingzhe. His eyes were a little evasive. She suppressed her suspicions and urged him in a calm tone to eat quickly. At 7:40, Ma Xiulan rode her e-bike, with Yuxin standing in the front and Mingzhe sitting in the back. She first took Mingzhe to the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (today they were returning to school to get textbooks and clean up, ending at 10:30), told him not to run around and to wait for her to pick him up. Then she turned to Huakang First Kindergarten, took Yuxin to the classroom, tucked a lollipop she had bought yesterday into the side pocket of Yuxin's backpack, and coaxed her into promising to learn painting well with the teacher.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (home) Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School) Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Shopping at the vegetable market.
description: After dropping off the children, Ma Xiulan rode her e-bike to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market. At the stall of her familiar Aunt Sun, she picked two fresh tender bream and asked Aunt Sun to clean them. She also bought some pork belly, a bunch of baby bok choy, and two jin of dried wood ear mushrooms. Aunt Sun said with a smile, "Boosting the kids' brains again?" Ma Xiulan smiled and agreed. After shopping, she prepared to go home.
location: China, Tianjin City, Jinghai District, Wutong Commune Vegetable Market

name: Stop by to visit her mother on the way
description: After leaving the vegetable market, Ma Xiulan made a detour to her mother Li Xiuying's home and handed her one jin of pork belly and half a bag of dried wood ear mushrooms. She told her mother that school officially started tomorrow and that she would not be back for lunch today, and asked her mother to take care of herself. Her mother took the groceries and fussed a bit about the children's schooling. Ma Xiulan did not stay long and quickly cycled home.
location: No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (mother's home)

name: Household chores and checking homework
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan first tidied up the kitchen and put away the groceries she had bought by category. Then she made herself a cup of jasmine tea, sat down at the large square table in the main room, and spread out Mingzhe's summer practice workbooks and test papers. She started checking directly with the math workbook, flipping through them one by one, page by page, silently telling herself to stay calm. When she reached two-thirds of the way through, she indeed saw three consecutive blank pages, totaling 7 pages of calculation and word problems left undone. She took a deep breath, folded that page, then checked Chinese and English to confirm there was nothing else missing.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (family's main hall and kitchen)

name: Pick up Mingzhe and discuss homework issues.
description: It was about time. Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up Mingzhe and bring him home. She had him sit across from her and calmly pointed at the blank pages, asking, "Mingzhe, these weren't written. Did you forget?" Mingzhe hung his head, and his eyes immediately reddened. In a low voice he said, "I... I was going to write them last, but then I forgot." Ma Xiulan patted him on the shoulder. "Alright, it's good that you know you did wrong. Today, let's finish up this loose end. Go to your desk and write now. Write as many pages as you can before noon, and rest if you get tired." Mingzhe nodded and obediently went to get his pencil. Ma Xiulan poured him a glass of water, placed it on the desk, and went into the kitchen to prepare lunch.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (home) Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School) No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (home)

name: Preparing lunch and mending school uniforms
description: Ma Xiulan steamed the flatfish in the kitchen and stir-fried leaf lettuce with pork belly. In the middle, she went to the main room to check on Mingzhe. He was leaning over the desk doing math problems, brows furrowed, but his pen never stopped. She turned to get the sewing kit and took out the fall school uniforms that her older son Mingxuan and second son Mingzhe would wear tomorrow. The inside of Mingxuan's uniform sleeve had a seam coming undone. She found matching thread, sat on the sofa in the main room, and while keeping an eye on Mingzhe doing homework, threaded the needle and carefully sewed up the open seam. She also reinforced a button on Mingzhe's uniform pants that was about to fall off.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (home kitchen and main room)

name: Lunch and rest after the meal.
description: Once the food was on the table, Ma Xiulan called Mingzhe to dinner. He was probably hungry and ate two bowls of rice. The steamed fish was delicious, and he ate most of it. After the meal, she told Mingzhe not to rush off to do homework, but to walk around the yard for ten minutes to help digestion. Ma Xiulan cleared the bowls and chopsticks into the kitchen, rinsed them briefly, and soaked them in hot water.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (home restaurant)

name: Lunch break and preparing craft materials
description: Ma Xiulan felt drowsy and lay on the bed in the master bedroom, dozing for half an hour. She felt much better after waking. She went to the yard, trimmed and washed the chives, and left them to drain. Then she split the fresh mugwort bundle bought yesterday, preparing half for soaking her feet in the evening. She also tidied up the embroidery pattern that neighbor Sister Zheng had given her last time, thinking to herself that after the next few busy days, she would first trace the draft.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (master bedroom, courtyard)

name: Sewing up schoolbags and contacting for handcraft work
description: At two in the afternoon, Ma Xiulan woke Mingzhe, who was dozing in the main room, and told him to finish the rest of his homework. She took out the new small schoolbag she had bought for her daughter Yuxin the day before. The front of the bag was a bit plain, so she planned to sew on a small daisy fabric patch she had embroidered earlier. While threading the needle, she sent a voice message on WeChat to her neighbor Sister Zheng Xiuying: 'Sister Zheng, that handmade beadwork you mentioned last time, can you still take it on? The kids have started school these days, so I can find time during the day to do it.' More than ten minutes later, Sister Zheng replied by voice message saying she could take it on and that she could come to the shop to pick up a sample anytime. Ma Xiulan felt more confident, and her needlework became steadier.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (family hall)

name: Picking up the youngest daughter and second son from school
description: When it was time to pick up the children, Ma Xiulan told Mingzhe to stay home and keep doing homework, then rode her electric bike to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up her daughter Yuxin. The little one chattered away as soon as she came out of the school gate, saying she had drawn sunflowers today. Then she turned around and rode to the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, waited five minutes, and saw Mingzhe walk out with his backpack. The three rode home together on the electric bike. The wind was a bit cool on the way, and Yuxin pressed her face against her mother's back.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (Home) Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School) 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (Home)

name: Helping with homework and preparing dinner
description: After getting home, Ma Xiulan had Mingzhe go to the main room to continue catching up on math. Yuxin spread out her drawing book on the coffee table and drew. Ma Xiulan started making dinner in the kitchen, preparing noodles with gravy. She diced the pork belly, chopped the rehydrated dried black fungus, and beat two eggs. As she boiled water for the noodles, she stir-fried the topping, and the aroma of meat and sauce filled the house. While waiting for the noodles, she went to the main room to check on Mingzhe's progress. He had already written up to page 5, and his handwriting was fairly neat. She praised him: 'Not bad. At this speed, write two more pages before dinner and the evening will be a little easier.' Mingzhe buried his head in his work again.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (home kitchen and main room)

name: Dinner and cleaning up
description: At dinner, Ma Xiulan served everyone a big bowl of noodles with gravy. Mingzhe ate very heartily; he seemed starving. Yuxin did not like the diced meat, so Ma Xiulan picked the pieces out and mixed them into the noodles. She did not push the children about homework during the meal, only chatting about daily life and mentioning what to bring for the first day of school the next day. After the meal, she quickly took the dishes into the kitchen, washed them, and wiped the stove until it was gleaming.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (home dining room and kitchen)

name: Accompany the children to make up homework and family reading time.
description: After dinner, Mingzhe continued working on math exercises under the bright light in the main hall. Ma Xiulan turned the desk lamp up brighter, pulled a chair over next to him, and took out some pieces of fabric cut from an old sofa cover, thinking of making a chair cushion. Yuxin played with literacy cards nearby for a while, and her eldest son Ma Mingxuan came out after finishing his homework in the room. Ma Xiulan said to Mingxuan, "Mingxuan, your sister hasn't had her story yet. Come read to her for 15 minutes; I'll listen from here." Mingxuan nodded, took a copy of Little Stories, Big Truths from the bookshelf, and led Yuxin to the sofa to read. Ma Xiulan listened while sewing the cushion with her head down, occasionally looking up to check Mingzhe's progress and gently reminding him to sit up straight. Mingzhe sped up, and by 10:30 p.m. he had finally finished the nearly ten pages of word problems. He let out a long breath, rubbed his wrist, and slumped over the desk.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (family hall)

name: Checking homework and giving praise and encouragement
description: Ma Xiulan took Mingzhe's workbook and flipped through it from beginning to end, confirming that he had finished it all. She patted his head and said, "Mingzhe, you did it. Even though you put it off until the last day, you still managed to finish it—that's what matters. From now on, let's do homework first, so we won't have to rush like this, right?" Mingzhe rubbed his sore wrist and nodded firmly. Ma Xiulan told him to wash his face and brush his teeth. When he came out after washing his face, she stopped him and said, "Your wrist is sore, isn't it? Come here, let Mom rub it for you." She took his wrist and massaged the Shousanli acupoint with her thumb, then gently squeezed his finger joints. Mingzhe said softly, "Mom, I'll do my homework on time from now on." Ma Xiulan felt warmth in her heart and said, "I believe you. Go to sleep now—you still have the school opening ceremony tomorrow morning."
location: Main hall and bathroom of the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Personal care and bill reflection
description: The children were all asleep, and the world suddenly became quiet. Ma Xiulan boiled a pot of water, poured it into the foot soaking bucket, and dropped in a mugwort bag. She sat on the small stool in the living room and soaked her feet in the slightly scalding water. The rising aroma of mugwort was relaxing. She began to recall the day: though she was angry that Mingzhe hadn't finished his homework earlier, this time she didn't shout or scold, and it worked quite well. Raising children really can't be done by yelling alone; you need methods and patience. After soaking her feet, she took out her ledger and recorded that she had spent 37 yuan on groceries and 22 yuan on meat today. Then she locked the iPad Mingzhe had turned in into the drawer in the main room, took out the key and put it away, planning to praise him properly tomorrow when he voluntarily handed over the iPad.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (home bathroom and living room)

name: Stretching before bed and going to sleep.
description: Lying in bed, feeling that her lower back was a bit stiff after the day, Ma Xiulan did a 10-minute bedtime lower-back stretch, hugging her knees to her chest and rocking from side to side. After finishing, her body felt much better. She picked up her phone and sent her husband Zhiqiang a WeChat message: “Everything is fine at home, and the children's back-to-school preparations are all done. Be safe on the road.” After sending the message, she put the phone on the nightstand. It was almost midnight. She turned off the light, listened to the faint sound of insects outside the window, and fell asleep quickly.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (master bedroom)

name: Morning exercise and courtyard time
description: At 5:35 in the morning, Ma Xiulan woke up naturally in her bedroom to the chirping of birds outside the window. She first massaged her temples and did five minutes of shoulder and neck stretches in bed, then put on a light jacket and took a slow 20-minute walk in the courtyard, breathing in the morning air mixed with the scent of earth and roses. Afterwards, she practiced Baduanjin for 20 minutes on the stone floor of the courtyard, moving smoothly and feeling her body gradually warm up. Finally, she held onto the courtyard wall and did five minutes of shoulder and neck stretches, finishing her morning exercise.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (own courtyard and bedroom)

name: Breakfast preparation and morning time with family
description: At 6:30, Ma Xiulan returned to the kitchen, tied on an apron, and made golden egg pancakes, cooked millet porridge, and sliced a plate of crispy homemade pickled radish strips. Her second son, Ma Mingzhe, walked into the kitchen rubbing his eyes and solemnly handed her his phone, saying he would take it back after finishing the homework he had missed. Ma Xiulan felt a warmth in her heart, took the phone, and locked it in the bedroom drawer. Then she went upstairs to wake up her eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, Mingzhe, and her youngest daughter, Ma Yuxin. The family sat around the table. Mingzhe ate the pancakes in big bites, and Yuxin obediently finished her millet porridge. As she ate, Ma Xiulan reminded Mingxuan to stay focused in the new semester, and she checked again that the children's schoolbags and uniforms were all in order, reminding Yuxin to bring her water bottle.
location: No. 156, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home kitchen and dining room)

name: Take the children to school.
description: At 7:55, Ma Xiulan wheeled out the electric bike and set off with Mingzhe and Yuxin. She first rode to the gate of Jinghai No. 3 Primary School, watched Mingzhe walk into the school with his classmates, and told him to wait for her at the school gate after school. Then she turned a corner, rode five minutes to deliver Yuxin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, greeted Teacher Wang at the door, and watched Yuxin run bouncing into the classroom.
location: Along the way from 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (88 Shengli South Street) and Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten (8 Chunxi Road)

name: Browse the vegetable market and visit mother.
description: After dropping off the children, Ma Xiulan cycled to the Wutong Commune Vegetable Market. At the stall of Aunt Sun, who she knew well, she bought 2 jin of fresh wide noodles and also picked out some potatoes, tomatoes, eggs, and a bunch of tender chives. While weighing the vegetables, Aunt Sun chatted about family life, saying that Mingzhe had been much less trouble this year. As she spoke, she also pressed a handful of scallions into Ma Xiulan's hand. After leaving the market, Ma Xiulan spent 5 minutes cycling to the home of her mother, Li Xiuying, not far away. She gave her half of the potatoes and tomatoes she had just bought, went inside, sat for more than ten minutes, asked about her father's health, and reminded her mother to put on more clothes as the weather got colder. Li Xiuying smiled and waved her hand, telling her not to worry and that she and her father were doing just fine.
location: Tianjin, Jinghai District, Wutong Community Vegetable Market (at the intersection of Jingwen Road and Xuhua Road) and mother's home at 45 Shengli Street

name: Tidying up the house and preparing for a power outage
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan first sorted the vegetables she had bought and put them into the refrigerator and vegetable basket, and hung the wide noodles in a cool place. Then she tidied up the kitchen and living room, wiped the gas stove top until it shone, and checked that the gas tank valve was working normally. She also took out three candles and a lighter from the storage cabinet and placed them on the coffee table, so as not to be caught unprepared if the power went out in the afternoon.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Received a thank-you call from Aunt Zhao
description: Just after she finished cleaning, the phone rang. It was Aunt Zhao, a neighbor. Aunt Zhao was especially happy on the phone, saying that her husband had recovered well and could be discharged from the hospital tomorrow morning. She thanked Xiulan for delivering meals over the past few days and insisted on coming over to thank her in person. Ma Xiulan quickly said, "Aunt Zhao, please don't be so polite. We're neighbors; everyone has hard times. Take good care of Uncle, and don't worry about me." After hanging up, she walked to the wall calendar and drew a small circle on the "August 30" box to remind herself to call tomorrow to ask about the discharge.
location: Living room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing and having lunch and cleaning up afterward.
description: At 11:00, Ma Xiulan began heating water on the gas stove, cut a plate of pickled vegetables, cracked four eggs, and chopped a tomato to make the tomato-egg sauce for noodles. She thought to herself that with the power outage in the afternoon, she could use the gas stove to cook the noodles without any rush. At 11:40, her eldest son Mingxuan came back by bike, and Ma Xiulan began cooking the noodles. At 12:00, her husband Ma Zhiqiang brought Mingzhe and Yuxin home. The family sat around the table eating steaming noodles with sauce (zhajiang sauce with tomato-egg sauce), accompanied by crisp pickled vegetables and shredded cucumber. The children ate with relish, and Zhiqiang also praised the day's sauce for being authentic. After lunch, Ma Xiulan briskly cleared the dishes, wrapped the leftovers in plastic wrap and put them in the fridge, wiped down the stove and dining table, and thought to herself that since the children had just eaten, they could play for a while before the power went out.
location: Kitchen and dining room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Power outage bonding time with paper cutting and hand shadows
description: At 13:10, the room suddenly went dark. The power went out, and both the lights and the TV turned off. The children gasped. Ma Xiulan calmly lit the candles she had prepared in advance and said with a smile, 'Perfect, let's do something different!' She brought out the colored paper and scissors she had prepared earlier and taught the children to cut simple paper window decorations and stars. In the dim candlelight, the family of five sat around a bamboo mat on the floor. Ma Xiulan guided Yuxin by hand to cut little stars, while Mingxuan and Mingzhe eagerly cut out little animals. After half an hour of paper cutting, she led the children in a shadow-play game, making a rabbit, a bird, and a wolf on the wall with her hands. Yuxin laughed uproariously.
location: Living room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: After the call, tidied up and prepped dinner ingredients.
description: At 15:20, the lights came on—the power was back. Ma Xiulan let the children go to the yard to rest their eyes, while she quickly put the scattered paper scraps and scissors into a box, and also put the candles away and wiped them clean. Then she went into the kitchen, chopped the pre-soaked black fungus, and minced some meat filling, planning to make the children's favorite noodles with minced meat and gravy for dinner. She also washed a bunch of cilantro and garlic sprouts and left them in a basket to drain.
location: Living room and kitchen at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick the children up from school.
description: At 15:45, Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up Yuxin. After picking up Yuxin, she rode to the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to wait for Mingzhe. Mingzhe was especially excited today. As soon as he saw his mother, he chattered: “Mom! Today at school I finished all the homework I had missed and even did a test paper!” Ma Xiulan felt sweeter than if she had eaten honey, and praised him again and again: “You've grown up and become so sensible.”
location: Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten (8 Chunxi Road) and Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (88 Shengli South Street), Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening parent-child time and family dinner
description: Back home, Mingzhe indeed took out his homework and started writing it on his own initiative. Yuxin spread out drawing paper and painted beside him, while Mingxuan read an extracurricular book in his own room. Ma Xiulan bustled between the kitchen and the living room, chopping vegetables and mixing meat filling for the sauce, occasionally glancing at the children and reminding Yuxin to sit up straight and Mingzhe not to bite his pen cap. At 17:30, dinner began: noodles with minced pork and black fungus sauce that Ma Xiulan had carefully prepared, served with blanched mung bean sprouts, cucumber strips, and garlic paste. The family ate and chatted. Ma Xiulan mentioned that Mingzhe had voluntarily handed over his phone today and finished all his homework at school. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang smiled and patted Mingzhe on the shoulder: 'Good boy, you're really making progress!' Mingzhe puffed out his chest proudly.
location: Kitchen and dining room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family Reading Time
description: After cleaning up after dinner, Ma Xiulan took out the picture book Dinosaur Encyclopedia and read it with Mingzhe and Yuxin. Mingzhe was especially active today, eagerly reading aloud the stories of Tyrannosaurus rex and Triceratops. Yuxin pointed at a picture and asked, "Mom, can this dinosaur fly?" Mingxuan sat nearby quietly reading Those Things in the Ming Dynasty. Under the soft lamp light, only the sounds of turning pages and reading could be heard, creating a quiet and warm atmosphere.
location: Living room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Remind the children to wash up and prepare their things for tomorrow.
description: Reading time was over, and Ma Xiulan began to urge the children to wash up. She first helped Yuxin wash her face and apply moisturizer, then watched Mingzhe finish brushing his teeth. After that, she checked the three children's schoolbags, filled their water bottles with warm water, and made sure the clothes for tomorrow were folded and placed at the head of each bed.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening rest, couple's chat, and bookkeeping
description: After the children were all asleep, Ma Xiulan and her husband Ma Zhiqiang sat together on the sofa soaking their feet. While soaking, she took out her account book and reviewed the day’s expenses: wide noodles 4 yuan, potatoes and tomatoes 7 yuan, eggs 9 yuan, chives 2 yuan... Meanwhile, Zhiqiang brought up amusing things he had heard at the logistics park that afternoon, and they chatted softly. Then they talked about plans for the Mid-Autumn Festival next month. Ma Xiulan said, “Why don’t we make some small mooncakes ourselves this year, and buy two good boxes to take to Mom and Dad.” Zhiqiang nodded in agreement. After finishing her foot soak, she felt comfortable all over, and the day’s fatigue melted away.
location: Bedroom at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pre-sleep check and going to bed
description: Ma Xiulan got up, went to the courtyard to make sure the gate was locked, and checked that the gas and the circuit breakers were turned off. Back in the bedroom, she drew the curtains, set the alarm clock for 6:00 tomorrow, and lay in bed thinking back on everything that had happened: from Mingzhe voluntarily handing over his phone to the sound of paper cutting and laughter filling the room during the afternoon power outage. Her heart was full of relief and contentment. She turned over gently, listened to the occasional chirping of insects outside the window, and fell soundly asleep.
location: Bedroom and courtyard at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning courtyard exercise
description: At first light, as the shower had just stopped, Ma Xiulan walked slowly in the wet courtyard for 20 minutes to loosen up her body. Then she completed a full set of Baduanjin under the corridor, and finally did 5 minutes of shoulder and neck stretches, feeling completely refreshed.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (own courtyard)

name: Preparing breakfast and eating breakfast with the family
description: Ma Xiulan simmered millet porridge over low heat in the kitchen, made five egg pancakes, and sliced her homemade pickled vegetables and cucumber. While the porridge was cooking, she washed the socks the children had taken off the night before and hung them up to dry. Then she went from room to room, quietly waking her husband and children. The family sat around the table for breakfast, and during the meal she mentioned that she would be going over the accounts with Zhiqiang later.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (kitchen, dining room, bedroom)

name: Organize household income and expense vouchers
description: After cleaning up the dishes, Ma Xiulan took the ledger out of the bedroom cabinet, spread all the receipts, water and electricity bills, her husband's pay slips, and her own handicraft income records on the dining table, put on her reading glasses, and sorted everything neatly by date and category (groceries, children, daily expenses, medical).
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (restaurant)

name: The couple reviewed the month's income and expenses.
description: After washing up, Ma Zhiqiang sat at the dining table with Ma Xiulan. Xiulan read out the expenses item by item, and Zhiqiang added them up with his phone calculator. Total income decreased by 580 yuan because of Zhiqiang's salary cut, but total expenses increased by 120 yuan, resulting in a deficit. When they checked together, they found that the overspending was mainly on Mingzhe's new schoolbag and stationery, the additional embroidery fabric Xiulan bought, and several meals eaten out.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (restaurant)

name: Formulate next month's spending-reduction plan
description: The couple discussed and decided to cut expenses. Ma Xiulan wrote a plan in the ledger: do not buy fabric for now, eat out at most once a week, halve the children's snack allowance, and keep a separate small notebook for future income from handcraft work.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (restaurant)

name: Stopped her husband from smoking.
description: After reviewing the income and expenses, Ma Zhiqiang felt gloomy and instinctively reached for his trouser pocket. Ma Xiulan saw him pull a half pack of hidden cigarettes from a gap in the cabinet, snatched it, snapped it in two, and threw it into the trash, urgently urging him to spend the saved money on books for the children. Ma Zhiqiang was left speechless with embarrassment.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (living room)

name: Prepare lunch.
description: Ma Xiulan took out pork belly, tender long beans, and baby greens from the refrigerator. She deliberately cut extra meat to prepare the dry-fried long beans and stir-fried baby bok choy that her husband loved. Her younger daughter Yuxin helped peel garlic beside her, and she smiled while teaching her.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (kitchen)

name: Family lunch.
description: When the food was on the table, the family ate with gusto. Ma Xiulan noticed that her husband took several helpings of the dry-fried green beans, and she felt a little more at ease. During the meal she did not bring up the account book; she only mentioned that snacks would be reduced in the evening, so the children could prepare themselves. Mingzhe and Yuxin pouted but did not object.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (restaurant)

name: Afternoon rest
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan briskly cleaned up the dishes and chopsticks, wiped down the stove, then drew the bedroom curtains, leaned against the headboard, and rested with her eyes closed for about half an hour. The three children each went back to their rooms to play quietly.
location: No. 156, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (bedroom)

name: Hand sewing
description: After resting, Ma Xiulan took out light blue and white cotton-linen fabric and spread it on the living room coffee table to sew a flounce onto Yuxin's small dress; the leftover scraps were to be used for embroidering handkerchiefs. She asked Mingzhe and Yuxin to draw quietly nearby so as not to be disturbed.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (living room)

name: Relaxing and chatting in the courtyard
description: Ma Xiulan sat down on the recliner in the yard to prune the dead branches of the rose bushes. Her neighbor Zhang Shufen passed by the gate, and the two chatted across the low wall for a bit about where it was cheaper to buy groceries.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (own courtyard)

name: Round trip to the vegetable market for shopping
description: Ma Xiulan changed into a clean jacket, then rode her electric bike to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market about 4.5 kilometers away. After arriving, she bought two jin of fresh pork ribs, a bunch of water spinach, two loofahs, and a few tomatoes. Aunt Sun, at the usual stall, also gave her a bunch of cilantro. After shopping, she rode her electric bike home the same way.
location: China, Tianjin City, Jinghai District, Wutong Commune Vegetable Market

name: Preparing dinner and supervising the children's homework
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan first blanched the pork ribs and began preparing the braising aromatics. She poked her head into the living room to urge Mingzhe and Yuxin to do their summer homework, while she busied herself in the kitchen.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (kitchen, living room)

name: Family dinner
description: Dinner was braised pork ribs, garlic stir-fried water spinach, luffa and egg soup, and tomato salad. The family sat around the table. Ma Zhiqiang ate happily and praised the ribs for being tender enough to fall off the bone. Ma Xiulan was delighted, and the mood was warm. After the meal, Zhiqiang took the initiative to help clear the dishes.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (restaurant)

name: Evening family reading and announcing spending cuts
description: After tidying up, Ma Xiulan read The Little Prince to Yuxin, Mingzhe read a dinosaur encyclopedia, Mingxuan read Dawn Blossoms Plucked at Dusk, and Ma Zhiqiang browsed a phone forum beside them. After reading a few pages, Xiulan gently but firmly announced that starting next month the snack budget would be cut in half, with purchases allowed only twice a week. The children nodded reluctantly but agreed.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (living room)

name: Urge the children to wash up and get ready for bed.
description: Ma Xiulan first bathed Yuxin, dried her hair, and changed her into pajamas. Then she urged Mingzhe to brush his teeth and wash his face, checked his schoolbag, and herself quickly washed her face and applied baby cream.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (bathroom, bedroom)

name: Husband and wife soaked their feet and had a heart-to-heart talk.
description: Ma Xiulan boiled hot water, poured it into two plastic foot-soaking buckets, and sat on the sofa with her husband to soak their feet, much of the day's fatigue melting away. She said softly that saving money mattered, but they couldn't shortchange their health, and the children's milk couldn't be cut. Zhiqiang gave her hand a squeeze.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (living room)

name: Evening stretching and washing up
description: After soaking her feet, Ma Xiulan felt warm all over. She made the bed, and before getting into bed did 10 minutes of lower back stretches, which relieved her lower back quite a bit. Then she went to the bathroom to rinse her feet and brush her teeth.
location: No. 156, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (bedroom and bathroom)

name: Bookkeeping and tomorrow's plan.
description: After things quieted down, Ma Xiulan sat down at the bookkeeping desk and neatly wrote down the package of cost-cutting plans she had made today: keeping handmade items as a separate account, eating out once a week, and halving the snack budget. She also thought about tomorrow, Sunday: keep breakfast simple, then go visit her mother and keep her company. After writing, she closed the notebook and felt at ease.
location: No. 156, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (bedroom)

name: Going to bed
description: Ma Xiulan lay down in bed and chatted with Ma Zhiqiang for a while about saving money. She felt that as long as the whole family thought together, there was no obstacle they couldn't overcome. As they talked, she grew drowsy and fell into a sound sleep at about 22:30.
location: No. 156, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (bedroom)

name: Morning activities
