description: I woke up naturally at 5:45 a.m., feeling energetic. First I did 5 minutes of shoulder and neck stretches and 10 minutes of waist stretches in the bedroom to wake up my body. Then I changed into loose clothes, came to my own courtyard, and took a slow 20-minute walk along the path in the yard in the dim early-morning light to loosen my limbs. After the walk, Aunt Zhao from next door came to the courtyard, and the two of us practiced a complete set of Baduanjin together in the open area of the yard. As we moved through the postures, Aunt Zhao mentioned that her husband had been discharged from the hospital to recuperate at home, thanked Xiulan again for bringing meals to take care of them recently, and warmly invited her to come over when she had time. Xiulan happily agreed and reminded Aunt Zhao to take care of herself too.
location: Home bedroom and courtyard, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing and enjoying breakfast
description: After finishing her morning exercise, Xiulan returned home and began preparing breakfast. She reheated the leftover chive pockets from last night in a frying pan over low heat until thoroughly warm, cooked a pot of fragrant and thick millet porridge, and cut a small plate of her own pickled cucumbers. At 7:15, she woke the children and her husband one by one. The family sat around the dining table, eating warm chive pockets with pickles and drinking millet porridge, starting an ordinary yet heartwarming Sunday.
location: Kitchen and dining room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Cleaning up after the meal and getting ready to go out
description: After breakfast, Xiulan quickly cleared the dishes and wiped the stove clean. She changed into a long-sleeved top for going out, put on a sun hat, and took an old envelope from the drawer containing the budget cash for today's shopping. Before leaving, she told her husband Zhiqiang that after she came back, they would wash the jars together in the afternoon.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Buying ingredients and picking in the courtyard
description: Xiulan rode her electric bike to the Xingwang Vegetable Market, where she usually shopped. At Aunt Sun Guifang's vegetable stall, she bought 40 jin of radishes, 20 jin of cucumbers, and 10 jin of green beans as planned. Aunt Sun teased her, saying, 'Your business is getting bigger and bigger,' and Xiulan smiled in response. Then she went to the dried goods store, weighed out 5 jin of salt, and bought 3 bottles of soy sauce and half a jin of Sichuan peppercorns. Finally, she turned to the glassware shop at the end of the market, paid the remaining balance, and securely strapped the 30 glass jars with lids she had ordered onto the back of her electric bike. At checkout, she carefully counted and spent 215 yuan in total. When counting her change, she discovered a counterfeit 10-yuan bill. With a wry smile, she tucked the fake bill into her pocket ledger, reminding herself to be more careful when accepting money in the future. After returning home from shopping, Xiulan temporarily piled the ingredients and jars in the yard. She walked to the vegetable trellis and picked all the remaining green beans and cucumbers, which were growing well, leaving the trellis suddenly neat and clear. Xiulan divided these fresh vegetables into two bags, planning to give them to her neighbors.
location: Xingwang Vegetable Market on Dongfanghong Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and the home courtyard at 156 Jingwen Road

name: Gifts from neighbors and putting them in place.
description: Xiulan carried the vegetables and first knocked on the door of her neighbor Wang Guilan, handing over a bag of fresh tender cucumbers. Wang Guilan could not refuse, so she went back inside and came out with two home-made sausages, pressing them into Xiulan's hands. Then Xiulan went to the home of Grandma Li across the hallway, who lived alone, and gave her a handful of crisp green beans. Grandma Li held her hand and chatted about everyday matters for a while, praising her for being thoughtful. Back in her own yard, Xiulan placed the 30 glass jars and all the ingredients in the shady spot under the eaves. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang had also just finished washing the car and came home, and the two of them carried the heavy radishes and green beans into the kitchen together.
location: Wang Guilan's home at No. 154 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Grandma Li's home at No. 158 Jingwen Road; and our own courtyard at No. 156 Jingwen Road.

name: Lunch preparation and dining
description: Xiulan began preparing lunch and decided to make tomato egg sauce noodles, which the whole family loved. She asked Zhiqiang to help knead the dough, while she skillfully cut tomatoes, beat eggs, and soaked black fungus. Her second son Mingzhe and youngest daughter Yuxin were also called over to help; Mingzhe peeled garlic and Yuxin helped her break green beans. The kitchen was filled with the clatter of pots and pans, along with the family's laughter and chatter, extremely lively. Lunch was served on time: chewy noodles topped with a fragrant tomato and egg sauce, served with a few cloves of fresh garlic. The family of five ate with great satisfaction. Xiulan talked about her plan to make pickled vegetables in the afternoon and told Mingzhe to keep an eye on his little sister and not run around the yard.
location: Kitchen and dining room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Lunch break
description: After the meal, Xiulan quickly cleared away the dishes. She flattened the bamboo recliner in the living room, drew the curtains, and lay down for a nap. She set the alarm for 45 minutes later, as she needed to recharge for the afternoon's work.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Handling ingredients and preheating products
description: After waking from her nap, Xiulan was full of energy. She first started processing the radishes and cucumbers in the kitchen: she scrubbed off the mud with a brush, cut them into evenly sized strips, sprinkled them evenly with salt, and began the first step of drawing out the water. Meanwhile, she had Zhiqiang sit under the eaves and repeatedly wash the 30 glass jars with dish soap and water. During this time, Xiulan used her phone to post a pre-order message in the "Jingwen Road Sisters Group" and her daughter's "Huakang Big Class One Parents Group": "Hello neighbors and parents, freshly homemade sweet-and-sour radish and soy-sauce cucumbers, clean and hygienic, 8 yuan per jar, pre-orders welcome, pickup starts in the evening." Soon after the message was sent, three parents responded and pre-ordered 6 jars. Xiulan registered each order in her notebook and gained a little more confidence in this small business.
location: Kitchen and courtyard at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Handling accounts and visiting mother
description: While the vegetables were set out to dry, Xiulan sat down at the bookkeeping desk in the dining room. She took out the counterfeit 10-yuan bill she had found while buying vegetables that morning, let out a helpless sigh, and clipped it into the ledger as a "living reminder." Then she opened last month's ledger and, based on yesterday's reconciliation, added a new memo: "From now on, when receiving cash of 50 yuan or more, I need to be extra careful to check the bills." After that, Xiulan packed a small jar of freshly pickled radish strips that had not yet fermented, and picked out a few of the most tender cucumbers from the vegetables picked in the morning, putting them all into a cloth bag. She rode her electric bike to her mother's house. Her mother, Li Xiuying, was trimming vegetables in the yard and broke into a huge smile when she saw her. Xiulan handed the pickles and vegetables to her mother, explaining that these were a new variety and that she would bring the proper batch once they were fully flavored in a couple of days. The mother and daughter sat on small stools in the yard and chatted about daily life for half an hour. Xiulan asked about her father's health, listened to her mother recount an amusing story about her eldest sister's video call the day before, and then left reluctantly.
location: Home dining room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and mother's home at No. 45 Shengli Street

name: Preparing ingredients and dinner
description: After returning from her mother's house, Xiulan started preparing dinner. She sliced a piece of pork belly she had bought that morning into thin pieces and washed a bunch of bok choy. She had Mingzhe and Yuxin go under the eaves and use a clean cloth to wipe the inside of the glass jars that Zhiqiang had washed, making sure they were completely dry. Mingzhe did the task earnestly and asked his mother, “Is pickling vegetables like doing an experiment?” Xiulan smiled and nodded, then taught him how to tighten the lids to ensure a good seal. In the evening, Xiulan quickly stir-fried the sliced pork belly with bok choy and made a soup using the leftover braising sauce from lunch. The whole family sat around the dinner table, ending a busy day.
location: Kitchen and courtyard at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Evening leisure time
description: After the meal, the whole family gathered in the living room. Today was Saturday, and the reading activity went on as usual. Xiulan picked up her phone and found an article about "autumn dryness-moistening health care". She picked out a few simple and practical tips, such as "eat more white foods" and "go to bed early and get up early", and read them to the family. Mingzhe then volunteered to share the "pickling know-how" he had learned from his mother today, which made the family laugh. After the reading, Xiulan allowed the children to watch TV for a while. Mingxuan changed to the science and education channel, which was showing a documentary about natural scenery. She and Zhiqiang sat nearby, idly chatting about the day's events while watching TV. Xiulan scrolled through her phone, replied to a parent who had ordered pickled vegetables in the evening with a confirmation message, and told her she could come to pick them up.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: Xiulan boiled a pot of mugwort water, poured it into the foot basin, and adjusted the temperature. She and her husband Zhiqiang sat side by side on the edge of the bed, soaking their feet in the warm water, and let out a comfortable long sigh. She took out her account book and looked through every income and expense in August, then opened the photo album on her phone and swiped through this month's photos one by one - photos of the children getting ready for school, vegetables she had planted in the courtyard, and Aunt Zhao's smiling face. She said to Zhiqiang: "Although August was a bit tight with money, our family is safe and sound, and life will gradually get better." Zhiqiang patted her hand and nodded. After foot soaking, Xiulan rolled up her trouser legs and did a 10-minute bedtime stretch beside the bed to loosen up her lower back, which was sore from the day's work. Then she checked on the sleeping children, made sure the doors and windows were closed, and set an alarm on her phone for 5:45 the next morning. Lying in bed, Xiulan felt her body slightly warm and especially relaxed. She reviewed the day - though busy, everything had been taken care of, and she felt a deep sense of stability and peace. Soon, she fell into a deep sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Morning wake-up and courtyard work
description: After the alarm rang, Ma Xiulan got up gently and first did a 5-minute neck-and-shoulder stretch in bed. The sky outside the window was just beginning to brighten. She put on a light jacket, walked to the courtyard, and took a few slow laps along the path, deeply breathing in the fresh morning air mixed with the scent of soil and roses. Then she performed a slow-paced set of Baduanjin. After finishing, she picked up a watering can and carefully watered her favorite roses in the courtyard.
location: Home bedroom and courtyard, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare for the back-to-school breakfast with the whole family
description: Ma Xiulan tied on an apron and carefully prepared breakfast for the first day of school: she cooked a pot of millet porridge with red dates, made soft-boiled eggs with free-range eggs, and cut a large plate of her own crisp pickled vegetables. At 6:35, she went upstairs and woke the children one by one. Her little daughter Yuxin lingered in bed and was coaxed up gently. Her husband Zhiqiang also washed up and came downstairs. At 7:00, the family sat around the dining table. Ma Xiulan peeled eggs for Yuxin while reminding Mingzhe and Mingxuan to check their schoolbags. The children were excited and nervous about the first day of school.
location: Kitchen and dining room of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Take the children to school.
description: After breakfast, Ma Xiulan urged her dawdling sons to leave. The eldest son, Mingxuan, walked by himself to Jinghai District Experimental Middle School. Ma Xiulan held Mingzhe's hand and walked to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, reminding him all the way to listen carefully in class in the new semester. There were many parents and students at the school gate, and she only felt at ease after watching Mingzhe enter the school. After returning home, she took her younger daughter, Yuxin, to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten. Yuxin hopped into the classroom, and after a brief greeting with the teacher, Ma Xiulan left.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School; Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten.

name: Tidy up the house.
description: After the children had all left home, the house became quiet in an instant. Ma Xiulan quickly cleared the dishes, wiped down the stove, then used a cloth to wipe the living room furniture one by one, and tidied up the room.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Go to the library to borrow books and start Family Reading Month.
description: Ma Xiulan changed into a neat outfit, took her library card, and walked to the Jinghai District Library. She knew her way around and found the long-awaited Jinghai Folk Tales in the local documents section, then carefully chose Basic Embroidery Tutorial in the handicraft section. After checking out, she wrapped the two new books in cloth and went home, placed them solemnly on the reading corner in the living room, took a photo and sent it to the family group, announcing: “This month's ‘Family Reading Consolidation Month’ officially begins tonight! From 8 to 8:30 every evening, that's our reading time!”
location: Jinghai District Library, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to home at 156 Jingwen Road.

name: Buying daily necessities at the vegetable market
description: Ma Xiulan walked to the Wutong Commune vegetable market. She first went to Aunt Sun's stall, whom she knew well, and bought some scallions, ginger, and a piece of soft tofu. Then she went to a general store and bought a large bottle of lemon-scented dish soap and two jin of free-range eggs.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing ingredients for pickled vegetables.
description: After returning from shopping, Ma Xiulan put away the items and started handling the radishes, cucumbers, and green beans bought yesterday in the kitchen: she placed the radishes and cucumbers in a large basin and scrubbed them repeatedly with clean water, trimming off the radish roots and the bitter ends of the cucumbers; for the green beans, she removed the strings from both ends and broke them into small sections. After draining, she sorted the three types of vegetables into a large vegetable basket, preparing for the afternoon pickling.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Simple lunch and midday rest
description: Ma Xiulan heated the leftover braised pork ribs and soup from last night and poured them over cooked dried noodles to make pork rib soup noodles. She sat alone at the dining table, eating while reading community group messages. After the meal, she leaned on the living room sofa, covered herself with a small blanket, and rested with her eyes closed for about 40 minutes. After waking up, she drank some water and tidied up the dishes.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Making pickled vegetables together with my mother and friends.
description: At 1 p.m., her mother Li Xiuying arrived on time carrying a bag. Ma Xiulan and she spread a plastic sheet over the stone table in the courtyard to serve as a workbench, brought out large basins, vegetable baskets and cleavers, and prepared coarse salt, Sichuan peppercorns and other seasonings. Soon, her craft friend Zhou Xiuqin arrived by electric bike, and the three happily divided up the tasks. Ma Xiulan was in charge of cutting radishes into thumb-thick long strips, cucumbers into one-cun sections, and beans into small pieces; her mother Li Xiuying mixed the brine and spices based on experience; Zhou Xiuqin put the cut vegetables into the brine to pickle, then scooped them out, layered them in the baskets, and sprinkled a thin layer of salt. The courtyard echoed with the sound of chopping vegetables and laughter. By 5 p.m., all the vegetables had completed the initial pickling and draining, and the semi-finished products were carried to an airy place in the kitchen; some were put into jars and sealed. Ma Xiulan arranged for her mother and Xiuqin to wash their hands and rest, and thanked them for their help.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (own courtyard and kitchen)

name: Prepare dinner, have a family meal, and clean up
description: After seeing off her mother and Xiuqin, Ma Xiulan began preparing dinner. She cut fresh cucumber and made smashed cucumber with garlic and vinegar, reheated the braised pork ribs, stir-fried tomatoes with eggs, and steamed rice. At 6 p.m., the children and her husband came home one after another, and the family sat around the table for dinner. Yuxin excitedly talked about her new classmates and new classroom; Mingzhe said the math teacher had been replaced; Mingxuan complained that there was a bit too much homework; her husband Zhiqiang listened with a smile. After dinner, Ma Xiulan cleaned up the dishes by herself, sealed the leftovers and put them in the refrigerator, washed and put away the dishes, and wiped the stove clean.
location: Kitchen and dining room of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Discuss family financial adjustments with her husband.
description: After the sky was completely dark, Ma Xiulan asked her husband Ma Zhiqiang to sit with her in the courtyard, poured two cups of tea, and took out the family ledger. She came straight to the point about last month's drop in income. After discussion, the two decided to lower this month's family savings target to 50 yuan, give priority to daily expenses, and cancel the plan to buy new fabric. Ma Xiulan solemnly wrote in the ledger: "September plan: save 50 yuan."
location: The courtyard of her home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Urge the kids to wash up and get their schoolbags ready
description: After finishing the main matter, Ma Xiulan went inside and urged the three children to wash up. Yuxin washed her face herself, and Ma Xiulan squeezed toothpaste onto her toothbrush. Mingzhe had already changed into pajamas. Mingxuan was still reviewing his lessons, so she urged him to go brush his teeth and reminded him that they would read together in the evening. Then she checked each child's schoolbag one by one to make sure all the textbooks and stationery were packed.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family reading time
description: At exactly 8 p.m., the whole family sat down in the living room reading corner. Ma Xiulan took out Jinghai Folktales, turned to the first story, and read softly; Mingxuan read The Ordinary World, Mingzhe flipped through the Dinosaur Encyclopedia, and little daughter Yuxin leaned against her mother looking at picture books. For half an hour, only the sounds of page-turning and storytelling filled the room, which was unusually peaceful.
location: Reading corner in the living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Personal bookkeeping and expense review
description: After reading time ended and the children went back to their rooms to sleep, Ma Xiulan returned to the bedroom. She took out the day's account book, recorded in detail the costs of pickled vegetables and the book borrowing schedule, recalculated next month's spending plan, and confirmed that after adjusting her savings, there was still enough money for groceries and snacks. Before bed, she took out the counterfeit 10-yuan bill tucked inside the account book, looked at it, and reminded herself to be careful when accepting cash next time.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Soak feet to relax and have a call with Mom
description: Ma Xiulan brought a wooden basin, filled it with hot water, and sat on the sofa to soak her feet and relax. She called her mother Li Xiuying, asked if she was tired, talked about the progress of the pickled vegetables, and agreed to finish the remaining steps tomorrow. After hanging up, she leaned back on the sofa and felt the day's fatigue slowly dissolve from the soles of her feet.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Mending clothes, chatting with her husband, and going to bed
description: After soaking her feet, Ma Xiulan felt more refreshed. She took Yuxin's socks from the sewing box and patiently mended them by the light. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang finished his chores and came over to sit, talking briefly about the route he would take to transport goods the next day. Ma Xiulan told him to be careful on the road. Around 23:00, she checked the doors and windows, turned off the light, and lay down. Though her body was tired, her mind was still on the pickling progress and the things to remember for taking Yuxin to school, but listening to her husband's even breathing beside her, she gradually calmed down and finally fell into a deep sleep at 23:30.
location: Living room and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning wake-up and morning exercise
description: At 5:35 a.m., Ma Xiulan was awakened by her phone alarm. Feeling a bit stiff in the neck, she did five minutes of shoulder and neck stretches in bed. Then she changed into loose cotton workout clothes, walked onto the concrete floor of her yard, opened the Baduanjin instructional video on her phone, and followed along with a full set. The roses in the yard were covered with dewdrops, the air was fresh, and after exercising she felt refreshed and energetic.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing breakfast and tidying up the house
description: After morning exercise, Ma Xiulan returned to the kitchen and began bustling around. She put the millet that had been soaked before bed last night into a pot to cook porridge, and put the steamed meat buns from yesterday into the steamer to heat up. While the porridge was cooking, she quickly tossed a cucumber side dish, and washed and put away yesterday's dishes and chopsticks. She also wiped down the kitchen stove and floor, keeping the room bright and spotless.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Wake the children, have breakfast together, and take them to school
description: The millet porridge was boiled until thick, and the aroma of steamed buns wafted out. Ma Xiulan first woke up her eldest son Ma Mingxuan, who was in middle school, then woke Ma Mingzhe and Ma Yuxin, and helped Yuxin tie her braids. The family of four sat at the dining table for breakfast, and she urged the children to listen to their teachers on the second day of school. After breakfast, she checked Mingzhe's and Yuxin's schoolbags and lunch boxes. At 7:45, Ma Mingxuan rode his bicycle to school by himself. Ma Xiulan rode her bicycle to take Ma Mingzhe to the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, told him to be safe, then took Ma Yuxin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten and handed her to the teacher before leaving with peace of mind.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street; Huakang First Kindergarten

name: Shopping at the vegetable market.
description: After leaving the kindergarten, Ma Xiulan cycled to the Wutong Commune vegetable market on the way. At Aunt Sun's stall she bought pork ribs, water spinach, and two tomatoes for the evening, and then went to the dried goods shop to buy star anise and ginger for the household. After paying, she cycled home and arrived at about 8:30.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Clean and prepare the tools for pickled vegetables.
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan washed her hands, put on an apron, and took out the glass jars and sealing lids from the storage room cabinet that had been washed and dried the day before. She boiled water and sterilized more than thirty jar lids one by one, then turned them upside down on white gauze to drain. She also arranged the sauce made last night, the pickled and dehydrated radishes and cucumbers, and tools such as stainless steel basins and wooden spoons on the kitchen counter, waiting for her mother and Sister Xiuqin to start work.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning: collaborative jarring of pickled vegetables.
description: At exactly 9 o'clock, her mother Li Xiuying and handicraft friend Zhou Xiuqin arrived on time. After exchanging greetings, the three began to divide the work and cooperate. Ma Xiulan was in charge of mixing: she used her hands to thoroughly mix the radish strips and cucumber chunks with the sauce in a large basin. Her mother was in charge of filling: she used chopsticks to press the seasoned vegetables firmly into the jars and slowly poured in the sauce. Zhou Xiuqin was in charge of sealing: she tightened the lids, wiped the jars clean with a damp cloth, and neatly stacked them. The three worked well together and finished part of the jarring work in the morning.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Picking up the child from school and heading home
description: Looking at the packed pickled vegetables, Ma Xiulan let her mother and Sister Xiuqin rest first. She rode her bike first to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up Ma Yuxin, then turned back to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up Ma Mingzhe. As soon as Mingzhe came out of the school gate, he chattered about the day's lessons, while Yuxin threw herself into her arms and said she was hungry. The three of them rode home together.
location: Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street; No. 156 Jingwen Road

name: Prepare and enjoy lunch
description: When she got home, her mother and Sister Xiuqin had already helped make the tomato-and-egg noodle sauce. Ma Xiulan quickly boiled a pot of noodles and stir-fried a plate of the water spinach she had just bought. The five of them sat down for lunch. The noodles were smooth, and the sauce was sweet and tangy. During the meal, her mother praised the pickled vegetables for being well seasoned, and Sister Xiuqin suggested registering the trademark as soon as possible.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Midday rest and light tidying up
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan arranged for Ma Mingzhe and Ma Yuxin to take a nap and let her mother and Sister Xiuqin lean back on the sofa to rest for a while. She quickly tidied up the kitchen and washed all the dishes and chopsticks, and only then did she lean back on the single sofa in the living room and close her eyes to rest for about 20 minutes.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Continuing to jar the pickled vegetables in the afternoon
description: At 1:30 in the afternoon, the three of them started work again. With the morning's experience, they worked faster. Her mother brought a ladle that made pouring the brine more efficient, and Sister Xiuqin arranged the jars more neatly. Ma Xiulan worked while calculating the remaining orders. By 4 p.m., the last bit of pickled vegetables on the counter had been filled into jars. After counting, they had exactly 40 jars today. Her face lit up with joy, and together with the others, she moved the jars into the cool area of the storage room.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Final cleanup and seeing Mother and Sister Xiuqin off.
description: After finishing 40 jars, the three of them cleaned up the kitchen together, mopping the floor and washing up. Ma Xiulan gave her mother and Sister Xiuqin two jars each of the freshly made pickled vegetables, packed in plastic bags, to show her gratitude. Her mother and Sister Xiuqin told her not to overwork herself, then left chatting and laughing with the pickled vegetables in hand.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Picking up the children from school and preparing dinner ingredients
description: After seeing off her mother and Sister Xiuqin, it was nearly 5 p.m. Ma Xiulan quickly changed shoes and went out. First she went to Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up Ma Yuxin, then to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up Ma Mingzhe. After getting home, she blanched the pork ribs bought in the morning and began preparing ingredients for dinner.
location: Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street; No. 156 Jingwen Road

name: Cooking dinner for the whole family
description: In the kitchen, Ma Xiulan skillfully put the blanched ribs into the pressure cooker, added scallions, ginger, star anise, Sichuan peppercorns, and hot water, and pressed it for 15 minutes. Taking advantage of this gap, she began washing the water spinach, beating eggs, and cutting tomatoes, preparing for the garlic water spinach and tomato egg drop soup, her movements smooth and fluid.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The whole family had dinner together.
description: The aroma of braised pork ribs filled the house, and the eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, also came home from school. The family of four sat around the table. Ma Xiulan put ribs on the children's plates. Ma Yuxin mumbled, "Mom's stewed meat is the best." Ma Mingzhe shared interesting news about his classmates while eating. The table was filled with laughter and cheerful talk. Watching the children eat so heartily, Ma Xiulan felt much of the day's fatigue melt away.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tidying up, supervising homework, and mending clothes
description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan cleared the table and told Ma Mingzhe to do his homework. After washing the dishes, she walked into the living room and saw Mingzhe bent over the coffee table doing math. She sat down beside him, opened his workbook, saw the teacher's red corrections, and patiently explained them. Ma Yuxin sat on a small stool nearby drawing. While supervising Mingzhe's corrections, Ma Xiulan took out her sewing kit and carefully mended the torn knee of her husband Ma Zhiqiang's work pants.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family reading time
description: At exactly 8 p.m., the second day of 'Family Reading Consolidation Month' began. Ma Xiulan took out 'Jinghai Folk Tales,' borrowed from the community library, and sat down on the sofa. Ma Mingzhe and Ma Yuxin put down what they were doing and gathered around, and her eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, also came out of his room when he heard her. She cleared her throat and read the stories aloud with vivid expression in Mandarin with a Jinghai accent, while the children listened attentively.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Reminding everyone to wash up and recording personal finances
description: After reading time ended, Ma Xiulan urged Ma Mingzhe and Ma Yuxin to brush their teeth and wash their faces, telling them to go to bed early. After settling the children, she soaked her feet in hot water in the bedroom, took out her old ledger, and carefully recorded today's pickled vegetable costs: pork ribs 10 yuan, water spinach 3 yuan, ginger, garlic, star anise, and so on, along with the count of 40 finished jars. She also wrote the expected 0 (not settled) under the handicraft income column, feeling hopeful about this future income.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Embroidery for leisure and staying in touch with family
description: Feeling comfortable all over after soaking her feet, Ma Xiulan took out the peony pillowcase she had previously half-embroidered and continued embroidering under the desk lamp. Her younger sister Ma Xiufen sent photos in the family group asking about the pickled vegetables, and she replied with a voice message saying she had made 40 jars today and would bring two jars for her brother-in-law in a couple of days. She then called her mother Li Xiuying, asked whether she was tired from going home, and told her to rest early.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Bedtime preparation and daily review
description: At 10 p.m., Ma Xiulan put away her needlework, went to Ma Yuxin's room to cover her with the quilt she had kicked off, and checked the doors, windows, and gas valve. Back in her own bedroom, she lay down, turned off the main light and turned on the small lamp, and silently planned for the next day: first deliver pickled vegetables to a few households, then visit her parents' home and ask about an improved recipe. Thinking back on the busy and fulfilling day, she set her alarm for 5:35 the next morning, then fell asleep peacefully amid the chirping of autumn insects.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning exercise
description: Woke up naturally at 5:40 a.m. and found that her husband Zhiqiang was not at home because he had gone out driving. First she did 15 minutes of shoulder and neck stretches on the wooden floor in the bedroom (looking up, side stretches, shoulder shrugs), then walked slowly for 5 minutes in the small courtyard to breathe fresh air and admire the blooming roses. At exactly 6 o'clock, Aunt Zhao from next door arrived at the courtyard gate as promised. The two spread out mats in the courtyard and practiced a set of Baduanjin to soothing music. Aunt Zhao shared tips for relieving lower back soreness; after trying the adjustments, Xiulan felt more comfortable. They corrected each other's movements, and after 25 minutes finished the practice. Aunt Zhao praised Xiulan's good complexion, and they agreed to continue the next day.
location: Bedroom and courtyard of her own residence on Shengli Street, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing breakfast and getting the children ready for school
description: After seeing off Aunt Zhao, Xiulan began preparing breakfast. She cooked the millet that had been soaked overnight into porridge, steamed flower rolls, stir-fried a plate of cabbage, and took out pickled cucumbers and radishes from the pickle jar, cutting them and arranging them on a plate. At 7:10, she woke the children. Her eldest son, Mingxuan, had already ridden his bike to school. She helped her youngest daughter, Yuxin, get dressed and braid her hair, and urged her second son, Mingzhe, to finish breakfast. The children were full of praise for their mother's newly made pickles, and Xiulan, while reminding them, stuffed water bottles and fruit into their schoolbags.
location: Kitchen and dining room of her home on Shengli Street, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Take the children to school and buy groceries along the way.
description: At 7:45, Xiulan rode her electric bike to first take Mingzhe to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, watched him enter the school gate, then rode another 5 minutes to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to drop off Yuxin. After sending the children off, she stopped by Wutong Commune Vegetable Market on the way, bought fresh pork ribs, old tofu, baby bok choy, garlic sprouts, and other items from Aunt Sun's stall, a vendor she knew well. The stall owner also threw in a handful of cilantro. After chatting briefly with the stall owner, she rode home fully loaded and arrived exactly at 9.
location: Jinghai No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin), Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten (No. 99 Huakang Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin), Wutong Commune Market (beside the south entrance of Wutong Commune, Jinghai District, Tianjin), and the family home.

name: Wrapping up the pickled vegetables: filling jars and applying labels.
description: Mother Li Xiuying and her handicraft friend Zhou Xiuqin arrived as promised, and the three worked together to finish up the pickled vegetables. After Xiulan brewed tea, they divided the work: her mother filled and pressed the jars, Xiuqin weighed and sealed them, and Xiulan wiped the jar surfaces. When all 20 jars were filled, Xiulan made "Xiulan Homemade Pickles" labels with a marker and stickers and applied them. The 60 jars of pickled vegetables were neatly stacked. Around 11:20, when her mother and Xiuqin had to go home to cook for their families, Xiulan gave each of them two jars of pickles as a thank-you gift. After seeing them off, she changed her jacket and got ready to pick up the children.
location: Kitchen of the family home on Shengli Street, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the children from school and prepare lunch.
description: At 11:30, Xiulan walked to pick up Mingzhe first (because home was near the primary school), then rode an electric bike to pick up Yuxin, and got home close to noon. Without a moment's rest, she made lunch: blanched pork ribs stewed with seaweed, garlic-stir-fried greens, and steamed flower rolls. Simple as it was, the children wolfed it down and kept praising the soup.
location: Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin), Huakang First Kindergarten (No. 99 Huakang Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin), and home dining room.

name: Noon break and housework handling
description: After lunch, Xiulan urged the children to take a nap. She leaned back on the sofa and rested for half an hour. When she woke up, she cleaned up the dishes and wiped down the stove. Then she used her phone's memo app to record the numbers of jars filled in the morning and the material costs.
location: Own residence, Shengli Street, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Sending pickled vegetables and checking inventory
description: At 2 p.m., Xiulan walked back to her mother's home (45 Shengli Street) with two jars of her homemade pickled vegetables. Her mother was cleaning vegetables. Xiulan set down the jars, asked for the recipe for improving the sauce that she hadn't fully noted down before, and recorded it in detail in her phone's memo. After chatting for half an hour, she took a detour along Jingwen Road to deliver pre-ordered pickles to two nearby neighbors (168 and 182 Jingwen Road), collected 16 yuan, and asked for their taste feedback. At about 15:00, she got home, washed her face and drank water, then counted the pickle stock again (56 jars remaining), took out the account book, and recorded the delivery details and income.
location: Her mother's home (45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin), the neighbor's home on Jingwen Road, and her own residence

name: Pick up the children from school and help with homework
description: At 15:40, Xiulan rode her electric bike to pick up Yuxin first, then Mingzhe, arriving home around 16:00. The two children did their homework while Xiulan sat beside them, sewing loose threads on her husband's work pants, tutoring Yuxin in pinyin and arithmetic, and patiently drawing diagrams to explain division problems to Mingzhe until he understood.
location: Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten (99 Huakang Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin), Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin), and her own living room

name: Prepare dinner
description: While the children were doing their homework, Xiulan began preparing dinner as a “wrap-up feast.” Braised pork ribs simmered in the pot; she prepared garlic water spinach, tomato egg drop soup, and used the leftover tofu to make scallion-braised tofu. The kitchen became fragrant, and Mingzhe curiously poked his head in to ask what was for dinner tonight.
location: Kitchen of the family home on Shengli Street, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The whole family had dinner together.
description: Dinner was served at 6 o'clock sharp, with braised pork ribs, garlic stir-fried water spinach, tomato and egg drop soup, and more filling the table. Although her husband was not there, Xiulan and the two children ate with relish. She served food to the children and encouraged them to eat more, celebrating the successful completion of the small pickled vegetable business.
location: Dining room at the family home on Shengli Street, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Housework and parent-child communication
description: After the meal, Xiulan cleared the dishes and wiped down the stove, then checked Mingzhe and Yuxin's homework. Mingzhe had done his more carefully than yesterday, and Xiulan praised him. Yuxin was playing with building blocks nearby, and Xiulan listened to her talk about fun things at kindergarten while sweeping the floor, enjoying the mother-child time.
location: The kitchen and living room of her home on Shengli Street, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Family reading reinforcement
description: At 7:30 pm, Xiulan called the children to the living room for family reading. She took out the borrowed "Idiom Story Picture Book" and asked Mingzhe to read "Waiting by a Stump for a Rabbit" aloud and explain the words. When Mingzhe became impatient, she told the story of "The Foolish Old Man Who Moved the Mountains" with vivid expressions, captivating the children.
location: Sofa area of the living room at home on Shengli Street, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Urge the children to wash up and tidy up
description: After reading time, Xiulan helped Yuxin wash her face, brush her teeth, and change into pajamas, urged Mingzhe to wash up by himself, and checked his schedule and backpack for the next day to make sure nothing was left out. Then she put the children to bed.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at the residence, Shengli Street, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Keeping accounts and chatting with friends
description: After soothing the children to sleep, Xiulan sat at the head of the bed, took out the account book, and carefully recorded the day's income from delivering pickled vegetables and the grocery expenses, calculating the total cost of the 60 jars of pickled vegetables. Then she sent a WeChat voice message to her childhood friend Liu Chunmei, talked about how the pickled vegetables were wrapping up, and asked her to help promote them in the community group. The two chatted for about ten minutes, and Chunmei agreed to help.
location: Bedroom of the family residence, Shengli Street, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Relaxing before bed
description: After the call, Xiulan soaked her feet in hot water to relieve fatigue while browsing local WeChat groups. At 9:20 p.m., she got up to check the doors, windows, gas valve, and alarm clock. After confirming everything was safe, she got into bed and lay down.
location: Bedroom of the family residence, Shengli Street, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Reflecting on the day and going to sleep
description: Lying in bed, Xiulan recalled that today the pickles had been successfully completed, the children were obedient, and the family was warm. Though tired, she was full of anticipation. She turned over and soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: Bedroom of the family residence, Shengli Street, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Morning wake-up, exercise, and stall preparation
description: At 5:30 in the early morning, Ma Xiulan woke to her biological clock. She first stretched her neck and wrists in the bedroom and took deep breaths to wake up her body. Then she put on a jacket and went out to the courtyard. In the cool early-autumn breeze, she stretched her limbs and performed a complete set of Baduanjin, feeling comfortable and refreshed all over. After exercising, she went back to the kitchen and storage room and checked the tricycle parked in the courtyard. In the carrier, 60 jars of pickled vegetables were neatly stacked, each with a conspicuous label reading 'Xiulan Pickles'. Then she packed clean plates for tasting, toothpicks, disposable spoons, an account book, and a pen into a cloth bag, filled a large flask with warm water, and took two steamed flower rolls as rations, making final preparations for going to the stall.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Set out for the vegetable market.
description: Everything was ready, and Ma Xiulan pushed her tricycle out of the courtyard. In the early morning, Jingwen Road was sparsely populated, with only a few elderly people taking a stroll and street sanitation workers; the autumn breeze was cool. She rode for about twenty minutes and arrived at the entrance of Jingwen Road Vegetable Market, right at the busiest entrance of the morning market.
location: At the entrance of Jingwen Road Vegetable Market, on the east side of the intersection of Jingwen Road and Lianmeng Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: First time setting up a stall to sell pickled vegetables.
description: Ma Xiulan found a conspicuous spot at the entrance of the vegetable market that did not block the way. She parked her tricycle steadily and neatly arranged the pickled vegetables on the cart board covered with a clean blue cloth. At first she felt a little embarrassed, but thinking of the quality of her homemade pickles, she mustered up the courage and began to shout: 'Sister, try our newly pickled vegetables! They're clean and hygienic, and they taste great with porridge or rice!' She proactively picked up a radish strip with a toothpick and offered it to people to taste. Gradually, customers gathered around the stall: a middle-aged woman tried a sample, found it crisp and tasty, and bought three jars at once; an elderly man liked the spicy flavor, and Ma Xiulan noted his request and told him she might make a spicy version next week. The morning was bustling, and she was too busy to drink water. By 11:30 the crowd thinned, and she counted and found she had sold 25 jars of pickled vegetables and earned 200 yuan. She was extremely excited.
location: At the entrance of Jingwen Road Vegetable Market, on the east side of the intersection of Jingwen Road and Lianmeng Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Packed up the stall and went home
description: Seeing the morning market crowd thinning out, Ma Xiulan smiled with her lips pressed together, covered the remaining 35 jars of pickled vegetables with cloth, packed away the tasting utensils, clutched the 200 yuan she had just earned, and rode her tricycle home. On the way, she thought about how she would tell her childhood friend Chunmei the good news in the afternoon.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the child from school
description: After arriving home, Ma Xiulan parked the tricycle, washed her face, and seeing it was almost noon, quickly rode her electric bike to Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up her younger daughter Ma Yuxin, then turned around and went to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up her second son Ma Mingzhe. On the way, Yuxin chattered about the nursery rhyme she had just learned in kindergarten, while Mingzhe sat quietly on the back seat. When Ma Xiulan asked how the morning classes had gone, Mingzhe said the math teacher had praised him for doing problems carefully, which made her very happy. Then the three of them went home together.
location: Huakang First Kindergarten, Huakang Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jinghai District Third Primary School, 2 Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin; and home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing lunch
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan let the two children play in the yard first, while she tied on an apron and busied herself in the kitchen. She took out the pork ribs she had bought yesterday from the fridge, blanched them, and braised them in soy sauce; then she pulled a few scallions from the backyard, cracked three eggs to make tomato and egg drop soup, and stir-fried a plate of greens with minced garlic. Thinking that her husband Zhiqiang would be able to eat a hot meal at noon, she moved especially quickly.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Sharing lunchtime with family.
description: While Ma Xiulan was stir-frying, she heard the sound of a three-wheeled cart outside the yard and knew her husband Ma Zhiqiang was back. She quickly brought the dishes to the table in the main room, and the family sat down together. She couldn't wait to share the good news that she had sold 25 jars of pickled vegetables today and earned 200 yuan. Zhiqiang smiled honestly and said, "My wife is amazing! This good on the first try — it'll only get better from here!" The two children joined in, saying their mom made the best pickled vegetables. The family happily enjoyed lunch together.
location: Main hall of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Cleaning up the kitchen and resting
description: After the meal, Ma Zhiqiang went into the room to rest. Ma Xiulan told the two children they could watch TV for a while but not too long, and then she briskly cleared the dishes, scrubbed the pots and washed the bowls, wiped down the stove, and tidied the kitchen neatly.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Afternoon rest, sorting accounts, and personal time.
description: After a busy morning, Ma Xiulan went back to her room and lounged on the kang, planning to doze for a while, but her mind was still occupied with the pickle business. She took out her notebook and phone and calculated the day's income and expenses: vegetables and seasonings cost about 120 yuan, plus the earlier investment in jars and labels, bringing the total cost to nearly 200 yuan. She had received 200 yuan in cash today, so the remaining 35 jars sold would be pure profit. The more she calculated, the more motivated she became. She started thinking about adding spicy varieties to attract young people. After settling the accounts, she dozed off. When she woke up, it was already past three. She felt refreshed, washed her face, went to the storage room to organize and count the remaining 35 jars of pickled vegetables, then took out her sewing basket and sewed up the open seams on her husband's work clothes, all the while planning to knit sweaters for the children when the weather turned cooler.
location: Bedroom and storage room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Picking up the children and buying seasonings
description: At 4:30 p.m., Ma Xiulan got on her electric bike and first went to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up Ma Mingzhe, then went to Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up Ma Yuxin. On the way home, passing the Lvying Vegetable Shop on Shengli Street, she stopped and took the children inside. She bought half a jin of dried chili peppers and two liang of star anise from the familiar shopkeeper, preparing to start making a new spicy pickle tomorrow. Then the three went home.
location: Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, No. 2 Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Huakang Road; Lüying Vegetable Shop, west side of Shengli Street

name: Help with homework and prepare dinner.
description: After getting home, Ma Xiulan had Mingzhe do math division homework at the desk in the main room, had Yuxin draw pictures beside him, and she herself got busy in the kitchen preparing dinner. She cooked the garlic scape and shredded pork dish her husband loved, made egg drop soup, and heated up several steamed buns bought that morning, planning a simple, comfortable dinner for the family.
location: Main room and kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Family dinner
description: When the dishes were brought to the table, the whole family gathered again. At the table, Ma Xiulan talked about an interesting auntie she had met while running the stall that morning, and discussed with Zhiqiang the possibility of having a regular stall twice a week in the future. The two children also vied to talk about what was new at school. Yuxin said she had been praised by her teacher for helping a little classmate tie her shoelaces, and everyone said she was very sensible.
location: Main hall of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Cleaning the kitchen and checking homework
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan was in charge of clearing the table and cleaning the kitchen, while her husband Zhiqiang went to the yard to check the tricycle. She asked Mingzhe to check his homework by himself first, while Yuxin played with a tangram beside them. After finishing the kitchen chores, Ma Xiulan carefully checked Mingzhe's math homework, found two calculation errors, and patiently had him correct them.
location: Kitchen and main room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening relaxation and socializing
description: While the children were watching cartoons, Ma Xiulan boiled a pot of hot water, made a cup of tea, and brought out the foot-soaking bucket. As she soaked her feet, she sent a voice message on WeChat to her childhood friend Liu Chunmei, telling her the good news that she had sold 25 jars of pickled vegetables today, thanking her for helping spread the word, and saying she would bring two jars over on the weekend for her to try. Chunmei was happy for her too and said she would keep helping promote them in the group chat.
location: Main hall of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family reading time
description: After soaking their feet, it was the family's regular reading time. Ma Xiulan took out the 'Idiom Story Picture Book' and told Mingzhe and Yuxin the story of 'Kong Rong Yielding Pears.' After telling it, she asked the children to each explain the moral in their own words. Mingzhe spoke with great confidence, and Yuxin said in a sweet, childish voice, 'We should learn from Kong Rong and give the bigger one to others.' Her heart warmed when she heard this.
location: Main hall of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tuck the children into bed and have a late-night talk with my husband
description: After the reading session, Ma Xiulan urged the two children to wash up and use the toilet, helped Yuxin tie her hair, and had them take out and lay out the clothes they would wear the next day. Once the children were in bed, she tucked in the corner of Mingzhe's blanket and told Yuxin a little bedtime story. Afterward, she went back to the couple's bedroom, where her husband Zhiqiang had already lain down. She poured a glass of hot water, placed it by the bedside, and gave him a detailed account of the day's stall sales, discussing whether they could appropriately adjust the prices of the pickled vegetables.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Evening bookkeeping and planning.
description: After Ma Zhiqiang fell asleep, Ma Xiulan took out the account book, recorded today's income of 200 yuan under the "Pickled Vegetables Sideline" column, and entered the 13 yuan spent on dried chili peppers and star anise flowers as cost. She wrote down the contact information and taste preferences of the several repeat customers she had recorded that day, and planned to make time tomorrow morning to pickle a new batch of spicy pickled vegetables.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Pre-sleep preparation.
description: Ma Xiulan quietly checked the courtyard gate and the gas in the kitchen, set the alarm for 5:30 the next morning, and took the millet she would soak tomorrow morning out of the cupboard. Only after everything was ready did she settle into bed.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Relaxed mentally and prepared for bed.
description: After lying down, Ma Xiulan opened her phone and saw someone in the local life group asking about good pickled vegetables, so she casually posted a photo she had taken that day of the product, along with contact information. Thinking that the new spicy pickled vegetable flavor was about to be launched, she felt excited about tomorrow.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Falling asleep
description: With the satisfaction of a business getting started and expectations for the future, Ma Xiulan gradually fell asleep. Though her body was weary, she felt especially reassured at heart.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Morning exercise and personal preparation
description: Just at dawn, Ma Xiulan got up and stretched her body in the yard. She practiced Baduanjin under the jujube tree to relax her neck and shoulders, then watered the roses in the corner, enjoying the tranquility of the early morning and energizing herself for the day.
location: Courtyard at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing breakfast for the family
description: Ma Xiulan quickly prepared breakfast in the kitchen, cooked millet porridge, heated meat buns, took out the pickled cucumbers, and warmed milk for each child. At the same time, she packed lunch for the eldest child, Ma Mingxuan, into an insulated lunch box.
location: Home kitchen, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Wake the children and have breakfast
description: Ma Xiulan woke up the three children one by one — Ma Mingxuan, Ma Mingzhe, and Ma Yuxin — and urged them to wash up. At the table, she peeled an egg for her youngest daughter and told her second child, Ma Mingzhe, not to dawdle over breakfast. At exactly 7 o'clock, the oldest child, Ma Mingxuan, rode his bicycle to school by himself, and then Ma Xiulan took Ma Mingzhe and Ma Yuxin on her bicycle to the entrance of the residential complex.
location: Home dining room and kitchen, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Take the second child and the youngest daughter to school
description: Ma Xiulan rode her bike, first taking Ma Mingzhe to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School. She watched him walk into the school gate with his classmates, then took Ma Yuxin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, handed her to the teacher personally, and told the teacher that the child had a slight runny nose and should drink more water. Then she went home.
location: No. 3 Primary School of Jinghai District (Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin), Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten (Jinghai District, Tianjin)

name: Stocking up and preparing to set up the stall
description: Ma Xiulan returned home, went to the storage room on the south side to check the remaining 35 jars of pickles, and after confirming the sealing film was intact, moved the pickles into the foam insulated box on the tricycle. She also loaded a folding table, small stools, a coin purse, and a large water bottle, making thorough preparations for setting up the stall.
location: Home storage room and courtyard, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Transporting pickled vegetables and tidying up the stall.
description: Ma Xiulan rode a tricycle loaded with pickled vegetables east along Jingwen Road for about 15 minutes to reach Wutong Commune Vegetable Market. In the fixed stall area, she set up a table, arranged the radish, mustard greens, and sweet garlic into three piles, covered them with blue cloth to keep off dust, and hung up a cloth sign reading "Xiulan's Pure Handmade Pickles".
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Sell pickled vegetables in the morning.
description: The vegetable market was noisy and bustling. Ma Xiulan called out loudly to attract customers. A woman who had bought pickles yesterday praised their authentic taste and bought two more jars. Sun Guifang, who sold vegetables nearby, helped invite regular customers to taste them. In the morning, they sold 10 jars of pickles in all, earning 80 yuan, and Ma Xiulan was very happy.

participant.name: Sun Guifang
participant.relation: Vegetable stall owner, fellow vendor in the same market.

location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pack up the stall, pick up the children, and buy noodles.
description: At 11:30, Ma Xiulan closed the stall and loaded the remaining 25 jars of pickled vegetables onto the tricycle. She first went to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up Ma Mingzhe, then went to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up Ma Yuxin. On the way, she stopped at Wang's Noodle Shop at the entrance to the neighborhood and bought 2 yuan worth of fresh-cut noodles, planning to make tomato-and-egg sauce noodles for lunch.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, and Wang's Noodle Shop nearby.

name: Make lunch and call my mother
description: Ma Xiulan let Ma Yuxin watch cartoons, Ma Mingzhe did homework at the dining table, and she went into the kitchen to stir-fry tomato-egg sauce and cook noodles. While the noodles were cooking, she called her mother Li Xiuying to check on her health and asked about her blood pressure medication. Only after hearing that her mother sounded fine did she feel relieved.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Have lunch and take a midday nap.
description: Ma Xiulan ate tomato-egg sauce noodles with her two children. Ma Mingzhe said they were very tasty, and Ma Yuxin finished a small bowl by herself. At the dinner table, Ma Xiulan asked Ma Mingzhe about his morning studies. After the meal, she cleared the dishes, let the children lie down to rest, and took a 20-minute nap herself on the living room sofa.
location: Home dining room, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Book covers are available at the stationery store near the school; they are on sale today and tomorrow. It is suggested that Mingzhe bring some pocket money, or you can buy them along the way when you take him to school tomorrow morning. Also remind Yuxin to bring her sweat towel, and you can write her name on it to avoid mix-ups. During the first week of school, help the children adjust their daily routine, and go to bed early tonight.
description: At 1:20 p.m., Ma Xiulan woke the children. She first took Ma Yuxin to kindergarten, then took Ma Mingzhe to primary school. Considering that the vegetable market would be less crowded in the afternoon, she went home, loaded the remaining 25 jars of pickled vegetables onto the tricycle, and moved her stall to the Jingwen Road Community Square behind the neighborhood, where more elderly people gathered.
location: Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Jingwen Road Community Square (intersection of Beiwei No. 1 Road and Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin)

name: Selling Pickled Vegetables at the Community Square
description: Ma Xiulan parked her tricycle at the community square and set up a small folding table. Wang Guilan, the neighbor across the street, enthusiastically helped her call out to people, attracting Grandpa Zhao, Grandma Liu, and other elderly people who were playing cards to come and taste. Everyone praised the pickled vegetables as authentic old-time flavor and bought some. She sold 7 jars in the afternoon, earning 56 yuan.
location: Jingwen Road Community Square, at the intersection of Beiwei 1st Road and Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Pack up the stall and go home to sort out the accounts.
description: Ma Xiulan packed up her stall and headed home, calculating on the way that she had sold 17 jars of pickled vegetables that day, earning 136 yuan. Adding the previous day's income of 200 yuan, the two-day total came to 336 yuan. After arriving home, she put the remaining 18 jars of pickled vegetables back on the cool shelf in the storage room, and neatly recorded in her account book: September 5, sold 17 jars, received 136 yuan.
location: Home storage room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the children from school and prepare dinner.
description: Ma Xiulan rode her bicycle first to Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up Ma Yuxin, then to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up Ma Mingzhe. After getting home, she had the two children do homework while she went into the kitchen to wash vegetables and cut meat, planning to make potato braised pork, garlic lettuce, and egg drop soup.
location: Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, and the home kitchen at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Eat dinner and clean up the kitchen.
description: The eldest child, Ma Mingxuan, came home from school, and the whole family had dinner together. Ma Mingxuan mentioned that the textbook fee is due next week, and Ma Xiulan asked him to get the notice to confirm. After dinner, the children went to do homework, and Ma Xiulan quickly cleared the dishes and wiped down the stove and range hood.
location: Dining room and kitchen at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Discuss the pickled vegetable delivery plan with neighbors
description: Ma Xiulan carried a plate of washed winter jujubes to Apartment 202, directly opposite, to see her neighbor Wang Guilan, and discussed in detail the delivery of the remaining 18 jars of pickled vegetables to the neighbors. Wang Guilan took out the notebook with the neighbors' names, phone numbers, and addresses, and the two planned the weekend delivery route together: Saturday morning to the 3 households on the east side of the community, Sunday afternoon to the 2 households on the west side, and they agreed to visit the doors together on Saturday.
location: Neighbor Wang Guilan's home: Room 202, same unit, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Supervise the children's homework and do family reading.
description: Ma Xiulan returned from Wang Guilan's home, checked Ma Mingxuan's math test paper and Ma Mingzhe's mental arithmetic cards, and accompanied Ma Yuxin in recognizing characters with literacy cards. Around nine o'clock, the family moved to the reading corner in the living room and read quietly together for half an hour, creating a family learning atmosphere.
location: Family reading corner in the living room, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: The children washed up and got ready for bed.
description: Ma Xiulan urged the three children to wash up in turns. She helped Ma Yuxin wash her face and feet, change into pajamas, and settled her into bed first. Then she reminded Ma Mingxuan and Ma Mingzhe to get up early the next morning to deliver the pickled vegetables together. After that, she turned off the lights and let the house fall quiet.
location: Bathroom and children's room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Personal embroidery leisure
description: After the children fell asleep, Ma Xiulan made herself a cup of hot tea and continued embroidering the peony pillowcase under the bedside lamp. In every stitch she felt a sense of calm and steadiness, while thinking about tomorrow's delivery arrangement with Wang Guilan.
location: Main bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Washed up, soaked feet, and went to bed.

She packed the pickled vegetables in clean cloth bags and brought change and a handwritten delivery note.

location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

description: After getting ready, Ma Xiulan called the three children to change into their going-out clothes, reminded Xuanxuan to bring his water bottle and homework, had Yuxin put on her small water bottle, and carried a reusable bag full of vegetables and pickled vegetables herself before locking the door. After lunch, Xiulan insisted on washing the dishes, then chatted with her mother. Her eldest son Xuanxuan sat quietly reading nearby, while Mingzhe and Yuxin pestered their grandfather for stories.

Ma Xiulan took the children into Jingbai Supermarket, carefully compared prices, and bought a pack of toilet paper, a large bottle of soy sauce, a bag of salt, and a bag of bulk cookies. At checkout she used her own reusable tote bag.
location: From Shengli Street bus stop, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to Jingbai Supermarket, Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare and enjoy dinner
description: Seeing that Xuanxuan had almost finished his homework, Ma Xiulan got up and went to the kitchen to prepare dinner. The children wanted noodles with gravy, so she quickly kneaded the dough, rolled it out, and cut the noodles, and made tomato-egg gravy and minced pork with diced green beans. During dinner, the whole family sat around the table, each serving noodles and ladling gravy over them, eating with great relish. Ma Xiulan felt gratified watching the children look so satisfied.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

description: After clearing the dishes, Ma Xiulan called her second son, Mingzhe, and her youngest daughter, Yuxin, to the living room sofa and began family reading time. She took out 'Jinghai Folk Tales' and continued reading. Mingzhe was unusually quiet and attentive today. After listening to the story of the Earth God, he even asked to hear another one. Xiulan was delighted, so she told another short story about a hardworking wife and a lazy man, and hugged Mingzhe in praise.
location: Home living room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

Ma Xiulan went back to the bedroom, took out her diary, and wrote about the warmth at her parents' home and Mingzhe's progress, especially noting the pleasant surprise of Mingzhe eagerly asking her to tell another story. Her fatigue melted away and she felt thoroughly relieved.
location: Bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

location: Various rooms in the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

She shared photos of the day's roses in the 'Sisters' Love' WeChat group, chatted with relatives, and also checked the activity schedule for the 'Jinghai Handicraft Workshop' group. Around 10:30, feeling sleepy, she set her alarm, checked the doors, windows and gas, turned off the lights and went to bed, drifting off to sleep with contentment and happiness.
location: Living room and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Morning activities and breakfast
description: At 5:35 in the morning, she got up and did shoulder and neck stretches in the master bedroom. Then she put on a coat, went to the courtyard, and did three rounds of Baduanjin to loosen up her body. Next she strolled to the small vegetable garden in the backyard, squatted down to check how the autumn cabbages were growing, found the cabbage hearts firmer, and casually pulled up a few scallions and picked 3 shiny purple eggplants. Back in the kitchen, she rinsed the millet and cooked porridge, and steamed buns and eggs. While the porridge was simmering, she opened the refrigerator, soaked the three children's dirty socks in a basin, and then opened the rice and flour cabinet to check the remaining amounts of rice and flour. At 6:50, she went upstairs and woke Ma Mingxuan, Ma Mingzhe, and Ma Yuxin one by one. Mingzhe was reluctant to get up and had to be coaxed and pulled out of bed; Yuxin scrambled up immediately and asked for her braids to be tied. At 7:00, the whole family sat around the dining table eating millet porridge, steamed buns, boiled eggs, and homemade pickled cucumbers. During the meal, she told Mingxuan to stay relaxed about the class cadre election and slipped a carton of milk into Mingzhe's schoolbag.

After watching Mingzhe enter the school gate, she turned around and hurried home. She got home at 7:42, immediately rode her electric bike with Yuxin, turned from Jingwen Road onto Huakang Street, and arrived at Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten in about 8 minutes. Yuxin walked into the classroom by herself; after watching her, Ma Xiulan rode home at 7:52.

At 9 o'clock, she started sweeping, carefully cleaning the living room and the two bedrooms, especially under the beds and the sofa, then mopped twice with a wet mop, and the floor was soon clean. At 9:30, the washing machine finished, she hung up the clothes, and then sat on the sofa drinking water and resting.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Clean out the refrigerator and go shopping at the vegetable market

I went straight to the familiar stall of Aunt Sun Guifang and bought 2 jin of pork ribs, 3 tomatoes, a bunch of garlic sprouts, and a piece of tofu; Aunt Sun threw in a bunch of cilantro and a small handful of green peppers. During the chat, I asked about storage boxes, and Aunt Sun recommended Old Liu's grocery store, so I went there and bought a small pen-holder-style storage box. At 10:50, I rode home.

name: Going to bed
description: At 22:50, I checked the doors, windows, and gas, then turned off the lights and lay down. In the darkness, I felt proud of Mingxuan and sensed the steadiness of ordinary life. Thinking about making new-style breakfasts for the kids tomorrow, I gradually fell asleep and drifted into a dream around 23:35.
location: Master bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning exercise, breakfast preparation, and housework
description: At 5:35 in the morning, Ma Xiulan woke up and did shoulder and neck stretches on the bedroom floor to relieve the soreness from the previous day. Then she changed into sportswear and went to the yard to practice Baduanjin five times, feeling refreshed. At 6:15 she entered the kitchen, put the mantou on to steam, cooked millet porridge, and sliced homemade pickled cucumbers. While the porridge was on the stove, she soaked the clothes the children had changed out of the night before in a basin, and tidied up the books and homework notebooks in the living room to keep the home fresh and organized.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Family breakfast and seeing everyone off
description: At 7:10 she woke up her second son Ma Mingzhe and daughter Ma Yuxin. After washing up, the family sat around the table for breakfast. Ma Xiulan added sugar to Yuxin's millet porridge and reminded Mingzhe to take an umbrella. At 7:25 Mingzhe put on his backpack and left. Ma Xiulan wheeled out her e-bike, gave Yuxin a ride, and prepared to set off.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Taking the children to school
description: At 7:35, she rode her electric bike with Yuxin. She first went south along Jingwen Road and turned onto Shengli South Street to take Mingzhe to the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School. After watching him enter the school gate, she turned around and took Yuxin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten and handed her to the teacher.
location: China, Tianjin, Jinghai District, from 156 Jingwen Road, via 80 Shengli South Street, Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, to 16 Beiwei Third Road, Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten

name: Going to the supermarket to drop off pickled vegetables for consignment
description: After leaving the kindergarten, Ma Xiulan turned from Beiwei Third Road back onto Jingwen Road and rode to Zhang Shufen's convenience store. She handed four jars of homemade pickles to Zhang Shufen, priced at 7 yuan per jar to sell on commission. After chatting about vegetable prices for a while, they took their leave.
location: Zhang Shufen Convenience Store, southeast corner of the intersection of Jingwen Road and Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Vegetable market shopping and chatting
description: After leaving the supermarket, she walked east along Jingwen Road to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market and went to Sun Guifang's vegetable stall. Aunt Sun still sold her eggs, tofu, greens, and scallions at the old price. Ma Xiulan mentioned that her husband was returning from Shijiazhuang in the afternoon and she needed to prepare more dishes; Aunt Sun praised her for being a virtuous wife.
location: Sun Guifang's vegetable stall, Wutong Commune Market, middle section of Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Morning housework and meal preparation
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan chopped the pork ribs into pieces and blanched them, and soaked the greens and tofu in water. Then she hand-washed the clothes, scrubbing collars and cuffs especially, rinsed them, and hung them in the yard to dry. Then she mopped the living room floor tiles until they shone. After tidying up, she went back to the kitchen to prepare ingredients: she scooped out the ribs to drain, sliced ginger and spring onions, took pickled cowpeas from the pickle jar and chopped them, getting ready to cook a plain noodle soup for herself at noon, leaving the greens for the evening.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Picking up the children from school, lunch, and midday rest
description: Left at 11:20, first picked up Yuxin, then went around to the elementary school to pick up Mingzhe, and got home at 11:50. She quickly boiled noodles, eating hers with pickled beans, and served the children pork rib soup. After the meal, she reminded them to rinse their mouths and arranged naptime: Mingzhe went back to his own room, while Ma Xiulan told Yuxin a little rabbit story to coax her to sleep. Once Yuxin fell asleep, she leaned against the headboard and dozed for half an hour.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China, and the pick-up route along the way.

name: Take the children to school and afternoon embroidery exchange
