description: Set off at 13:20, first drop Mingzhe at the elementary school, then take Yuxin to the kindergarten, and in the fine rain remind the teacher to let the children be picked up early after school. After returning home at 13:45, set up the embroidery frame by the living room window, embroider the last few stitches of the baby bib, take a photo and send it to craft friend Zhou Xiuqin. Zhou Xiuqin replies with a voice message praising the stitching, sends a photo of a peony pattern, and suggests color matching and stitch techniques for the community salon; the two chat about this for over half an hour.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (pick-ups first, then at home).

name: Finishing up housework and preparing ingredients for dinner
description: After putting down her phone, Ma Xiulan went to the kitchen. She scooped up the soaked greens to drain, cleaned the pork ribs again, and soaked dried shiitake mushrooms in warm water to add umami when stewing the ribs. After everything was ready, she waited to pick up the children and for her husband to return.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Delivering pickled vegetables to neighbor Wang Guilan
description: Before picking up the kids, Ma Xiulan took a jar of pickled vegetables and knocked on Wang Guilan's door across the hall. Wang Guilan thanked her repeatedly. Ma Xiulan smiled and said they were homemade, and mentioned that her husband would be back tonight. After exchanging pleasantries, Ma Xiulan went home to get an umbrella and get ready to go out.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (the opposite neighbor's home)

name: Picking up the child from school and heading home
description: In the afternoon the rain had not stopped. Ma Xiulan took an umbrella and first picked up Yuxin, put on her rain boots, and watched over her while she splashed in puddles. Then she went around to the elementary school to pick up Mingzhe, who was waiting with an umbrella in the guard room. After the three got home, she had the children wash their hands and change out of their slightly damp shoes and socks.
location: Jinghai District, Tianjin, China: starting from No. 156 Jingwen Road, passing Huakang First Kindergarten to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, then returning home

name: Husband returned home and had a brief exchange
description: Just after settling the children, the door lock clicked and her husband Ma Zhiqiang arrived home, bringing back Shijiazhuang specialties. The children excitedly ran up and shouted 'Daddy.' Ma Xiulan took his luggage, asked if the trip had gone smoothly, told Zhiqiang to wash his face and rest, and said the spareribs were already stewing and dinner would be ready soon.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Prepare dinner and have a family meal
description: Ma Xiulan went into the kitchen, stewed pork ribs with tofu, added soaked shiitake mushrooms to enhance the umami, and stir-fried greens over high heat. Her eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, came home from school, and the whole family was gathered. The dinner table had stewed ribs with tofu and stir-fried greens with rice. The children wolfed down their food. Ma Zhiqiang praised that home-cooked meals were really delicious. Ma Xiulan's fatigue from the day melted away, and she felt content.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Family reading time
description: After dinner, Ma Zhiqiang washed the dishes on his own initiative while Ma Xiulan rested. Once everything was cleaned up, the family gathered in the living room for family reading time. Ma Xiulan found an insect picture book and told the children about how ants and bees divide labor and cooperate. Mingzhe and Yuxin listened, fascinated, and asked questions. Mingxuan listened for a while, then went back to his room to do homework. Rain pattered outside the window, and the light inside was warm.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Urging household chores and advising to wear extra clothes.
description: After reading, Ma Xiulan urged the children to wash up: she squeezed toothpaste for Yuxin, went to Mingzhe's room to check his schoolbag and homework, then told Mingxuan and the younger brother and sister to wear their thermal underwear to school the next day since it was cold. The children casually agreed.
location: Second-floor bedroom and bathroom, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Relaxing before bed, couple communication, and going to sleep
description: After the children went to sleep, Ma Xiulan washed her face, soaked her feet in hot water, and took out the account book to record the day's grocery expenses. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang lay nearby and mentioned that his wages in Shijiazhuang had been settled smoothly. At 21:05 Ma Xiulan sent a WeChat message to her mother Li Xiuying to report that she was safe, and checked the weather forecast. Then she looked at her phone, liked Zhou Xiuqin's peony embroidery pattern in the handicraft group, and arranged with her childhood friend Liu Chunmei to get together with the kids on the weekend. At 22:00 she turned off the lights and went to bed, falling into a deep sleep listening to her husband's snoring and the dripping sound from the eaves.
location: Second-floor bedroom at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Getting up, exercising, and morning time in the courtyard
description: She woke up naturally at 5:35 in the morning without disturbing her sleeping husband Ma Zhiqiang. First she did 10 minutes of shoulder and neck stretches on the bedroom bed to loosen up, then put on a coat and went to the family courtyard. Facing the morning light, she did a complete set of Baduanjin (about 25 minutes). After warming up, she checked the vegetable plot in the yard: the bok choy seeds planted a few days earlier had sprouted tender shoots, which made her very happy. Seeing that the roses by the corner were in full bloom, she bent down to pull out a few weeds, then returned indoors.
location: Bedroom and courtyard at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing breakfast and doing housework
description: After washing up, she went into the kitchen, tied on an apron, and began preparing breakfast. Since her husband Zhiqiang was rarely at home, she cooked a pot of thick millet porridge, steamed a few large steamed buns she had made herself, and took out soy-sauce cucumbers and sweet garlic from the pickle jar, cutting and arranging them on a plate. While the porridge was cooking, she tidied the kitchen counter, put away the dishes and chopsticks washed the night before, swept the floor, and also put the clothes she had changed out of last night into the washing machine for a wash.
location: Kitchen and dining room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family breakfast, reminding the children.
description: Woke the three children up to wash up, and the family sat around the table for breakfast. During the meal, Xiulan gave her eldest son Mingxuan a steamed bun and told him: "It's good that you're the physics class representative, but you must not do experiments at home with those magnifying glasses and mirrors, understand?" Mingxuan mumbled an agreement. She also told her little daughter Yuxin to listen to the teacher at kindergarten, and reminded her second son Mingzhe to check his schoolbag so he wouldn't leave anything behind. Zhiqiang watched the mother and children from the side and smiled as he smoothed things over.
location: Dining room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Taking the second son and youngest daughter to school
description: At 7:30, Xiulan cleared the dining table, picked up a light jacket, and rode her electric bike to take Mingzhe to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (a 10-minute ride). At the school gate, she told him to listen carefully in class. Then she turned around and rode for 5 minutes on the electric bike to take her younger daughter Yuxin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten. She watched as the teacher led her into the classroom before leaving at ease.
location: From 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street) and Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten.

name: Shopping at the vegetable market.
description: At 7:55, Xiulan rode her electric bike to the Wutong Commune vegetable market. She first met Wang Guilan, her neighbor across the hall, at the agreed spot, and the two began walking around the market chatting like old friends. They stopped at the stall of Sun Guifang, a vendor they knew well. When Xiulan asked the price, Sun Guifang said loudly, “Eggs have gone up another 0.2 yuan today! Take my advice, buy fewer—enough for two or three days will do.” Taking the hint, Xiulan bought only 20 eggs. She also chose a piece of pork belly to make braised pork that evening, and bought potatoes, green peppers, tofu, a bunch of scallions, and two crucian carp (to make soup for Yuxin). As she and Wang Guilan strolled and chatted, Wang Guilan mentioned that her son was about to go on a blind date, and Xiulan enthusiastically offered suggestions. Around 9:00, the two finished shopping, parted at the market entrance, and each went home.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Returning home to tidy up, prepare ingredients, and take a short rest.
description: After returning home, Xiulan first sorted the groceries into the refrigerator. Then she started a thorough cleaning: vacuumed the living room and bedroom floors, then mopped them with a wet mop; briefly tidied the three children's desks; folded the sheets washed the day before and put them in the wardrobe. Around 10 o'clock, she went into the kitchen to prepare ingredients: cut the pork belly into cubes and blanched them, peeled and cut the potatoes, cleaned the crucian carp and rubbed it with salt to marinate, getting ready for lunch and dinner. During this time, she specifically checked the fire extinguisher in the corner of the kitchen, confirmed that the needle was in the green zone and that it was valid until the end of the year, and then, relieved, placed it in a conspicuous and easily reachable spot next to the gas stove. After working for more than two hours, Xiulan sat down on the living room sofa, drank some water, and rubbed her sore lower back. She picked up her phone to check the time and figured it was about time to pick up the children.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the child from school
description: At 11:20, Xiulan rode her electric bike to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up her youngest daughter, Yuxin. Yuxin happily handed her a little red flower given by the teacher as a reward. Then, with Yuxin on the bike, she arrived at the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School five minutes later. After a short wait, she picked up her second son, Mingzhe, who was out of school. As soon as Mingzhe got on the bike, he chattered away about how his deskmate had brought a rhinoceros beetle to school and the kids had all gathered around to look. Xiulan smiled and reminded him, 'Just take a look, don't touch it with your hands, careful it might pinch you.' The three rode home together.
location: Huakang First Kindergarten (Jinghai District, Tianjin), Jinghai District Third Primary School (Shengli South Street), home at 156 Jingwen Road

name: Simple lunch and a short family get-together
description: When she got home, her husband Zhiqiang had already steamed rice in the rice cooker. Xiulan quickly stir-fried two simple dishes: scrambled eggs with scallions and garlic stir-fried lettuce, and reheated the leftover dishes and steamed buns from the morning. She called her husband and the two children who were home early from school to eat. The lunch atmosphere was relaxed. Zhiqiang mentioned that he planned to go to the hardware store on the street in the afternoon to buy a brand-new light switch and replace the old one in the hallway. Xiulan nodded and said okay, telling him she would keep an eye on Mingxuan in the afternoon.
location: Dining room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Taking the children to school
description: After the meal, Xiulan urged the two children to pack their schoolbags, then got on the electric bike again and, following the same route, first took Mingzhe to school and then Yuxin to kindergarten. When saying goodbye, she told them to pay attention in class that afternoon.
location: From 156 Jingwen Road to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street) and Huakang First Kindergarten.

name: Midday household chores
description: Returning home, Xiulan quickly cleaned up the dishes, washed them with dish soap, and put them on the draining rack. She saw that her husband Zhiqiang had already gone out to the hardware store, and the house became quiet. She untied her apron and prepared to have her personal time in the afternoon.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Finished embroidery (finishing the baby bellyband)
description: This was her own quiet time. Xiulan took out the baby bib that she had mostly embroidered yesterday from the sewing basket, sat on the single sofa by the window where the light was sufficient, and began finishing the last few pomegranate leaves and the outline of the four characters "Long Life and Wealth." Her hands were skilled, with fine, even stitches. During this time, she chatted with her handicraft friend Zhou Xiuqin over WeChat voice for 10 minutes. Sister Zhou shared a new "Five Poison" bib pattern. Xiulan thought it looked nice, so she saved the picture to try it next time. At 2 p.m., all the remaining edges of the bib were properly finished. She rinsed it with clean water and hung it over the chair back to dry, thinking that it would be presentable at next week's community salon.
location: By the living room window at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Unexpected discovery and safety education
description: At 14:10, Xiulan was about to go to the backyard to check the vegetable garden when she suddenly noticed a faint smell of something burning. Her heart tightened, and she quickly followed the smell to the balcony. There she saw her eldest son Mingxuan crouching on the ground, in front of him the magnifying glass from his physics experiment kit and several sheets of draft paper. A corner of the old curtain beside him had been burned into a black charred hole, with wisps of grey smoke drifting upward. Xiulan instantly understood what had happened and shouted sternly, 'Mingxuan! What are you doing!' She hurried over in large strides and stamped out the still-smoking edge of the curtain with her foot, confirming the fire source was completely extinguished. Then she led the obviously frightened Mingxuan to the living room sofa. Her expression was serious but her voice was under control: 'What did Mom tell you yesterday morning? Now you see the consequences? There's so much cloth and paper in the house—what would happen if it caught fire?' She asked Mingxuan to describe the just-now focusing-and-igniting process, and analyzed its danger step by step. During this, Mingxuan kept his head down and admitted his mistake in a low voice. To make a deep impression, Xiulan took out a blank sheet of paper and had him immediately write by hand a 'Safety Pledge', stating: 'I will not use lighters, matches, magnifying glasses, or other fire sources and experimental equipment to do any experiment without supervision,' and sign it. After that, she took Mingxuan to the fire extinguisher in the kitchen and clearly told him again where it was and how to use it: 'Remember, pull this pin, then aim at the base of the fire and spray. But more importantly, don't touch it yourself. In a fire, the most important things are calling the police and escaping!' The whole lesson lasted about 40 minutes, and the atmosphere in the room gradually shifted from tension to calm.
location: Balcony, kitchen, and dining room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Balcony cleanup and home safety check
description: Xiulan told Mingxuan to go back to his room and reflect, while she went to the balcony to clean up. She wiped the smoke-blackened curtains and floor with a wet rag, and put the magnifying glass away in the drawer of her own bedroom so it could not be taken again. Then she checked every room in the house again, especially Mingxuan's desk and under his bed, and confirmed there were no more flammable or dangerous items. After finishing, she went back to the kitchen, made a cup of tea to calm herself, and while she was at it, further prepared the crucian carp for the soup and sliced the ginger for later use.
location: Balcony, hallway, and kitchen at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Picked up the two children when Mingxuan got out of school.
description: At 4:20 PM, Xiulan went out to pick up the children as usual. After picking up Mingzhe and Yuxin, just as she reached the front door, she saw that Mingxuan had already come back from school on his bike by himself. Seeing his mother, Mingxuan looked a little evasive. Xiulan did not scold him in front of his younger brother and sister; she just said calmly, “You’re back? What do you want for dinner? Mom will make braised pork for you.” Mingxuan was stunned for a moment and whispered, “Anything is fine.” The family went in one after another, and the house returned to its usual rhythm.
location: Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, and home at 156 Jingwen Road

name: Prepare a hearty dinner
description: Her husband Zhiqiang happened to return with the newly bought switch. Xiulan put on an apron and started making dinner. Zhiqiang came over to help peel garlic and trim vegetables. Xiulan first braised the pork belly she had bought that morning, and the kitchen filled with a rich meaty aroma. She also made a clear crucian carp soup, stir-fried water spinach with garlic, and steamed an egg custard for Yuxin. The three children were watching TV and playing with building blocks in the living room. In the kitchen, Xiulan lowered her voice and told Zhiqiang about Mingxuan's experiment and how she had handled it. Zhiqiang's face darkened after hearing it, and he said, 'I'll talk to him later.' Xiulan advised him, 'I've already taught him a lesson. Just repeat the fire safety rules in front of the whole family during dinner. Don't be too harsh.'
location: Kitchen at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner
description: Dinner time. The red-braised pork was glossy and bright, and the crucian carp soup was milky white and rich. The whole family ate with great relish. During the meal, Xiulan put two pieces of meat into Mingxuan's bowl and brought up the daytime incident in a gentle tone: "Mingxuan, I'm happy that you're good at physics, but experiments must be conducted in a scientific and safe way. About the balcony thing, I'll trust you once, but there must be no next time. If you want to do experiments in the future, when Dad is around, have him take you to do them in the yard, or tell Grandpa in advance." Zhiqiang also put down his chopsticks and added seriously, "Mingxuan, safety comes first, and your mother is right. Let's set a rule at home: fire and electricity must only be used with an adult present." Mingzhe and Yuxin listened with vague understanding. Mingxuan nodded and answered solemnly, "Dad, Mom, I understand. I won't do it again."
location: Dining room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Family reading and fire safety discussion
description: After dinner, Xiulan cleared the dishes and put them in the sink. At 7 o'clock, it was the regular family reading time. Today, Xiulan did not read a storybook; instead, she took a copy of the Resident Fire Safety Handbook distributed by the community from the bookshelf and flipped through it with the children. Pointing at the pictures, she helped the children identify various safety signs and explained fire escape knowledge such as "cover your mouth and nose and bend low when evacuating." Mingxuan watched very attentively and even asked a few questions about the safe distance for using dry powder fire extinguishers. Zhiqiang, meanwhile, told Mingzhe and Yuxin a little story about "firefighter uncle putting out a fire" and finally told them to call 119 when in danger. Around 8 o'clock, Xiulan suggested: "Let's come up with a few family safety rules, such as don't touch electrical sockets with wet hands and check fire sources after experiments, and have Mingxuan write them down and post them on the dining room wall." The whole family agreed.
location: Living room reading nook, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Contacting parents to confirm their health checkup
description: After finishing her reading, Xiulan walked to the corner of the living room and dialed her mother Li Xiuying's number on the landline. When the call connected, she got straight to the point: "Mom, have you and Dad decided about the free community checkup on September 15?" Her mother said on the other end that she had just been hesitating. Xiulan made the decision on the spot: "Then go! It's a rare opportunity. I'll write down the date and time. Have Dad bring the blood pressure medication he usually takes and his medical records. You should also have a checkup—it'll only be reassuring if we both get checked." Over the phone, she also reminded her a few times to drink more milk for calcium. After hanging up, she found the wall calendar, circled this Wednesday (September 15), wrote "Parents' checkup" on it, and put all the family members' medical insurance cards together in the drawer of the TV cabinet. Only after doing all this did she let out a relieved sigh.
location: Living room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Children wash up and get ready for bed
description: Xiulan put away her phone and urged the three children to go wash up. She and Zhiqiang divided the work: she helped Yuxin wash her face and feet, changed her into pajamas, and coaxed her into bed first; Zhiqiang watched Mingzhe brush his teeth and wash his face by himself, and checked whether Mingxuan's schoolbag was packed. After the two younger ones were settled, she again had a brief word with Mingxuan alone, patted his shoulder, and told him to go to sleep, with trust and concern in her tone.
location: Bathroom and bedrooms at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Night chat, keeping accounts, and personal relaxation.
description: The children were all asleep, and the house was quiet. Xiulan and Zhiqiang leaned against the headboard chatting, and talked about today's alarming moment. Zhiqiang sighed again: “You’re really more careful; otherwise something big would have happened.” Xiulan said, “We’ll have to keep a closer eye on him from now on.” She then took out the account book and recorded today's grocery expenses (about 70 yuan) and income records (the pickled vegetables consignment needed to be checked at the supermarket in a few days). After that, she soaked her feet and felt completely refreshed.
location: Master bedroom at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Relaxation before bed and falling asleep
description: Xiulan looked at her phone for a while, chatted with her sisters in the family group, and reminded them to have regular checkups. She also browsed the embroidery group and liked a few exquisite handmade pieces. Around 10 p.m., she turned off the main light, leaving only a small night light beside the bed. Lying next to her husband, she reflected on the day's experiences—though there had been a frightening moment, it had been handled properly, and everything at home was fine, so she felt settled. She first whispered a few words with Zhiqiang about tomorrow's plan, then gradually felt drowsiness come over her. Today she was physically and mentally tired, but she had handled things well, and her mood calmed down. At 11:40 p.m., she finally fell into a deep sleep.
location: Bedroom at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning exercise and airing out bedding
description: At 5:30 in the morning, Ma Xiulan woke up naturally, did shoulder and neck stretches in bed, then went to the courtyard to practice a set of Baduanjin to stretch her whole body. After exercising, she walked to the vegetable patch in the backyard and carefully watered the newly sprouted greens. When she was done, she carried out two thin quilts and hung them on the clothesline in the yard, gently patting them so the bedding could fully absorb the autumn sunlight, preparing warm sleep for the children.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (home bedroom, courtyard, and backyard)

name: Prepare breakfast and eat breakfast with the family
description: Ma Xiulan went into the kitchen and began preparing breakfast. She ladled out the cooked millet porridge, heated up the steamed buns and eggs, and sliced the homemade pickled cucumbers. She started busy work at 6:25, went upstairs at 7:10 to wake her second son Ma Mingzhe and youngest daughter Ma Yuxin, told Mingzhe to bring his vision exam form, and helped Yuxin tie her little braids. Her eldest son Ma Mingxuan had already washed up and was reciting vocabulary. At 7:20 the whole family sat down for breakfast. Ma Xiulan filled the children's bowls with porridge and peeled eggs for them, reminded Mingzhe to get his eyes checked later, and told Mingxuan to ride carefully on the way home from school.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (home kitchen, bedrooms, and dining room)

name: Took her youngest daughter to kindergarten and returned
description: After breakfast, Ma Xiulan rode an electric bicycle to take her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten. Yuxin sat on the back seat, holding her mother's waist. They arrived about 8 minutes later. She handed Yuxin to the teacher, watched her line up for the morning check-up, and then left, riding the electric bicycle straight back home.
location: Round trip from 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China to Huakang First Kindergarten (north section of Jingwen Road)

name: Took second son for an eye exam, ordered glasses, and took him to school
description: Ma Xiulan walked with her second son Ma Mingzhe to the Chaoyang Street Community Health Service Center in Jinghai District. On the second floor in the ophthalmology department, Doctor Wang Jianguo examined Mingzhe using an eye chart, found that his myopia had deepened to 150 degrees, and advised on eye care points. Ma Xiulan wrote down the points and took Mingzhe to the glasses fitting area on the first floor, spending 240 yuan to get a pair of lightweight children's glasses frames. After a short wait to pick up the glasses, Mingzhe put on the new glasses and could see clearly farther away. Then Ma Xiulan rode an electric bike to take Mingzhe to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, explained to the homeroom teacher that her child had new glasses, and asked the teacher to keep an eye on him.
location: No. 16 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China, the backyard of the Jinghai Grain Bureau (Chaoyang Street Community Health Service Center) and Shengli South Street (Third Primary School)

name: Buying groceries at the vegetable market and running into a neighbor
description: After dropping off the children, Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to the Wutong Commune vegetable market. At the stall of her acquaintance Sun Guifang, she bought crucian carp, tofu, tomatoes, and scallions for 28 yuan, and the two chatted for a while. After shopping, she rode home quickly. As she reached the doorstep, she ran into her neighbor across the hall, Wang Guilan, and they talked about Mingzhe's eyes. Ma Xiulan told her that he had just got new glasses, and they exchanged a few pleasantries.
location: Near Wutong Commune, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (Wutong Commune Vegetable Market) and the entrance of 156 Jingwen Road.

name: Household tidying, meal preparation, consignment sales of pickled vegetables, and handling safety hazards
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan sorted and stored the groceries, kept the crucian carp in a basin of water, started the washing machine, and began preparing ingredients by cutting the tofu into pieces and slicing the tomatoes. At 11:00, she found time to go to Zhang Shufen Convenience Supermarket, diagonally across the street, and learned that 2 of the 4 jars of pickled vegetables she had made had been sold. She received 14 yuan from the consignment sales and checked the accounts. After returning home, she remembered that Mingxuan had almost caused a fire by playing with a magnifying glass yesterday, so she immediately locked the magnifying glass and other physics experiment equipment in the bottom layer of the living room storage cabinet, and put the key in a high drawer.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (home) and the place diagonally opposite 156 Jingwen Road (Zhang Shufen Convenience Store).

name: Create a family eye care plan
description: Ma Xiulan took out fluorescent sticky notes, sat down at Mingzhe's desk, and carefully wrote down Dr. Wang's eye care tips (screen time no more than 1 hour a day, keep a foot's distance when reading, and blink often) on the notes. She stuck them on the front of the desk and on the base of the desk lamp. She also adjusted the angle of the desk lamp light and had Mingzhe repeat the eye care tips on the spot.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (in the home study, beside Ma Mingzhe’s desk)

name: Pick up the two children from school.
description: Ma Xiulan rode her electric bicycle to Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up Yuxin. Yuxin happily ran over holding up a little red flower awarded by her teacher. Then the mother and daughter went to the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to wait for Mingzhe to finish school. After picking him up, Ma Xiulan immediately asked whether his new glasses were comfortable and whether he could see the blackboard clearly, confirming there was no discomfort.
location: North section of Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten) to Shengli South Street (No. 3 Primary School)

name: Lunch, parent-child conversation, and eye-care agreement.
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan quickly made stir-fried tomatoes and eggs, crucian carp and tofu soup, and heated up steamed buns. Before eating, she formally made an agreement with Mingzhe: only half an hour of TV each day, the phone was to be used only for studying, and she would accompany him for half an hour of outdoor exercise in the evening. The three chatted while eating. Ma Xiulan asked Mingzhe whether he could see the blackboard clearly with his new glasses, and Mingzhe said he could see the English words very clearly. She also encouraged Yuxin to do well in kindergarten. After the meal, Ma Xiulan cleaned up the kitchen and prepared to take the children to school.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (home kitchen and dining room)

name: Take the children to school and collect the final payment for the pickled vegetables.
description: Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to first take Mingzhe to No. 3 Primary School, then took Yuxin to kindergarten. After dropping them off, she stopped by Zhang Shufen Convenience Store on the way and was told that the remaining 2 jars of pickled vegetables had also sold out, and she received another 14 yuan. Today's total income from pickled vegetables was 28 yuan. Ma Xiulan was very happy and said she would bring newly pickled ones another day.
location: China, Tianjin, Jinghai District: Shengli South Street (No. 3 Primary School), Jingwen Road North Section (kindergarten), diagonally opposite No. 156 Jingwen Road (convenience store).

name: Embroidery practice and handicraft exchange
description: The afternoon belonged to Ma Xiulan. She took out the baby bib, sat in the best light by the living room window, and focused on embroidering twin lotus flowers with fine stitching. Midway, her handicraft friend Zhou Xiuqin sent a teaching video showing a novel overcast stitch. She watched it carefully twice, tried it herself, and quickly mastered the technique.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (by the living room window at home)

name: Tending the vegetable garden and organizing seasonal clothes.
description: During a break from embroidering, Ma Xiulan changed into old clothes and went to the backyard vegetable garden, picking some autumn cucumbers and green peppers for dinner. Then she returned to the bedroom, took out the children's thick long-sleeved jackets from the wardrobe, folded and stored the summer short-sleeved shirts into compression bags, and completed the seasonal changeover.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (the backyard vegetable garden at home and the bedroom wardrobe)

name: Pick up the children and do outdoor activities.
description: Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to pick up Yuxin first, then Mingzhe. Instead of going straight home, she stopped at the open area in the center of the residential complex, took out badminton rackets, and let Mingzhe and Yuxin run, jump, and play on the open ground while she walked nearby keeping an eye on them, fulfilling the daily half-hour outdoor activity agreement for eye protection.
location: Inside the courtyard of No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (the open area at the center of the residential community) and along the route for pickups and drop-offs

name: Prepare dinner
description: After getting home, Ma Xiulan put on an apron and started cooking dinner. She made braised potato chunks and stir-fried water spinach, and reheated the half pot of crucian carp soup left over from lunch. Knowing that her eldest son and husband would both be home for dinner tonight, she deliberately prepared a larger amount.
location: No. 156, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (home kitchen)

name: Family returning home and dinner conversation
description: The eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, rode his bike home by himself and called out that he was hungry as soon as he came in. Ma Xiulan told him to wash his hands and change clothes. Before long, her husband Ma Zhiqiang also came home. The whole family sat down to dinner together. Ma Xiulan asked Mingxuan about his work as the physics class representative, and Mingxuan said he was quite busy; then she asked Mingzhe how his new glasses felt, and Mingzhe said they were much more comfortable. The meal had a lively and warm atmosphere.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Family reading and homework tutoring
description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan cleared the dishes, then sat in the living room with her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin, reading picture books and teaching her to recognize characters and tell stories. Her second son Ma Mingzhe did homework at the desk, and Ma Xiulan occasionally reminded him to keep one foot away. Her eldest son Ma Mingxuan focused on math problems in his own room.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (the living room and each person's room at home)

name: Phone call to check on mother's preparation for the medical checkup.
description: Ma Xiulan went to a corner of the living room and called her mother, Li Xiuying, to ask whether she had remembered the schedule for the free community checkup on September 15. She reminded her to bring her ID card and medical insurance card, and said she would come over early that day to help. Her mother happily said she knew on the phone.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (beside the sofa in the living room at home)

name: Evening washing up, bookkeeping, and WeChat chatting
description: Ma Xiulan urged the three children to wash up one by one, helped Yuxin comb her hair, and told Mingzhe to put away his new glasses case. Afterwards, she returned to the bedroom, took out the account book, and recorded the day's expenses: 240 yuan for glasses, 42 yuan for groceries and other items, 28 yuan in income from pickled vegetables, and a net expenditure of 254 yuan. After lying down, she picked up her phone, chatted with her childhood friend Liu Chunmei on WeChat, arranged for the children to play together on Saturday afternoon, and liked the works posted in the handicraft group.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (home bathroom and bedroom)

name: Soaking feet, chatting, and pre-bedtime safety check
description: Ma Xiulan boiled water to soak her feet and relax. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang also came in after washing up, and the two talked about Mingzhe's eyes and today's income from the pickled vegetables, planning to take the children to the park on the weekend. After soaking her feet, Ma Xiulan habitually checked that the doors and windows of the living room, kitchen, and balcony were locked. After confirming everything was safe, she draped the next day's clean clothes over the back of a chair, and packed Mingzhe's schoolbag, making sure the checklist and glasses case were inside.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (bedroom and other rooms at home)

name: Turned off the lights and went to bed
description: Ma Xiulan returned to the bedroom, drew the curtains, and turned off the main light, leaving only a small night light. She lay down beside her husband, thinking back on today's busy but important matters—Mingzhe's eye problem had finally been resolved. She mulled over tomorrow's plans and soon fell asleep.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (home bedroom)

name: Getting up, morning exercise, and watering the courtyard
description: Woke up at 5:35 in the early morning, first did shoulder and neck stretches in bed for 5 minutes, then quietly put on a jacket. In her own small courtyard, she did two full rounds of Baduanjin, breathing the fresh morning air with the scent of soil and roses. After finishing, she carried a watering can and watered the roses at the corner of the wall and the baby bok choy and scallions in the vegetable plot.
location: Home master bedroom and courtyard at 286 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing breakfast, waking the children, and having breakfast together as a family
description: After washing her hands, Ma Xiulan went into the kitchen, put on an apron, and started preparing breakfast. She cooked millet porridge, sliced the pickled cucumbers, took out some of her own fermented bean curd, steamed the buns, and took eggs from the fridge to fry one for each of her three children. At 6:50 she went upstairs to wake the children, and at 7:00 the whole family sat down to eat breakfast. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang drank porridge with fermented bean curd; her second son Mingzhe disliked egg yolk and was nagged into eating it; her eldest son Mingxuan finished first and went back to his room to pack his schoolbag; her youngest daughter Yuxin ate slowly, so she fed her a few spoonfuls.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, No. 286 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Taking the children to school and checking on the consignment sales of pickled vegetables
description: After tidying the kitchen, she rode her electric bike to first take her youngest daughter Yuxin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten and watched her run into the classroom with her backpack. Next she took her second son Mingzhe to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School. At the school gate, she greeted his homeroom teacher, Teacher Wang, and reminded her to pay more attention to Mingzhe’s sitting posture in class because he had just been fitted with new glasses. After dropping off the children, she stopped by Jingbai Supermarket on the way to find Zhang Shufen and check how the pickles were selling on consignment. Zhang Shufen said the pickles were selling well and gave her 28 yuan for the goods that had been sold.
location: Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School; and Jingbai Supermarket, Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu, Jinghai District

name: Buy groceries at the Wutong Commune vegetable market
description: After going home to put down the money, she took her vegetable basket and reusable bag and walked to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market. At Sister Sun Guifang's stall, she picked fresh crucian carp, tofu, and spring onions, and also bought a piece of pork belly, thinking she would improve the meal since it was her birthday today. When Sister Sun learned of this, she threw in a bunch of cilantro for free.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Cleaning and tidying the house
description: After arriving home, I first drank some water and then started a thorough cleaning. I carefully wiped the coffee table and TV stand in the living room with a cloth and tidied up the toys the children had scattered around. Then I washed the whole family's clothes, including the school uniform Mingzhe had changed out of. While the washing machine was running, I removed the range hood filter in the kitchen and soaked it in baking soda water to clean it. Finally, I used a broom to sweep the courtyard spotless.
location: At home, No. 286 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Learned a new embroidery stitch
description: After finishing housework for the time being, she took out the half-embroidered baby bellyband and called her embroidery friend Zhou Xiuqin on WeChat video to ask about edge stitching techniques. Zhou Xiuqin demonstrated in the video how to loosen the thread tension. She followed along and practiced, and indeed it felt much smoother, so they agreed to continue practicing in the afternoon.
location: At the living room window of the home at 286 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Prepared lunch and picked up the children from school
description: After turning off the video, she took leftover rice and greens out of the fridge and simply fried some egg fried rice for lunch. While heating the food, she kept checking the time. She left at 11:20, first went to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up Mingzhe, then went to Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up Yuxin. The three walked home chatting and laughing.
location: Home kitchen at 286 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School; Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten

name: Lunch, nap, and taking the children to school
description: After returning home, the two children washed their hands and ate. She had egg fried rice, while the children drank millet porridge with pickled vegetables. After the meal, she had Mingzhe take his sister to play in the living room, and she rested on the sofa with her eyes closed for 15 minutes. At 1 p.m., she called the children and set out. She first took Mingzhe to the primary school gate, reminding him not to take off his glasses in class, then took a detour to take Yuxin to kindergarten. Only after watching them both enter the school gates safely did she ride her bike home.
location: No. 286 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home), Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten

name: Embroidery practice and call to her mother
description: The afternoon was entirely her own. She set up the embroidery hoop by the window and continued practicing the overcast stitch, taking special care with every stitch. After practicing the technique Sister Xiuqin taught her until she was proficient, she took out the twin lotus pattern she had embroidered before and studied it. At 15:30, she put down her needle and thread. Remembering that her mother Li Xiuying's physical exam was approaching, she called to remind her not to forget to bring her medical insurance card on the 15th. Her mother laughed on the phone and said she had remembered, then asked how she would spend her birthday today. She smiled and said her husband would come home in the evening and make something delicious.
location: At the living room window of the home at 286 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Prepare dinner ingredients and pick up the children from school.
description: She went into the backyard vegetable garden and picked bok choy, cucumbers, and cilantro to make garlic bok choy and cilantro crucian carp soup. Back in the kitchen, she cut the pork belly she had bought in the morning into chunks and blanched it to prepare braised pork, and soaked the tofu in water. Just after 4 PM, she rode the e-bike out to pick up Mingzhe and Yuxin from school. The two children chattered away on the bike about interesting things at school: Mingzhe said he won a race in PE class, and Yuxin said the teacher taught a new nursery rhyme.
location: Home kitchen and backyard vegetable garden at No. 286 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School; Huakang First Kindergarten

name: Prepare dinner
description: She put on an apron and started preparing dinner. The braised pork was simmering slowly in the pot, giving off a tempting aroma. She cleaned the crucian carp and prepared to make soup. Mingzhe was doing homework at the small table, and Yuxin was playing with building blocks in the living room. The clatter of pots and pans in the kitchen, along with the sounds of the children, made her feel grounded.
location: Kitchen at home, 286 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Husband comes home early, birthday surprise, and the whole family cooking together.
description: Just after 5 o'clock, while stir-frying garlic broccoli, her husband Ma Zhiqiang came home early, walked into the kitchen holding a beautiful fuchsia plant, and said 'Happy birthday' with a smile. Her eldest son Mingxuan held up a card that read 'Happy birthday, Mom, we love you,' and Mingzhe and Yuxin also gathered around. She was so moved that her eyes welled up as she took the flowerpot and the card. Afterwards, Zhiqiang took over watching the stove, Mingxuan helped peel garlic, and Mingzhe set out the bowls and chopsticks. Holding the flowerpot, she had Yuxin take a photo in the courtyard, with the sunset-colored yard in the background, grinning from ear to ear.
location: Home kitchen and courtyard at No. 286, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: A warm birthday dinner.
description: The whole family sat around the table, which was set with braised pork, crucian carp and tofu soup, garlic broccoli, cucumber salad, and stir-fried greens. Mingxuan led the singing of the birthday song, and Yuxin sang the loudest. There was no cake, but Zhiqiang poured juice for everyone, and the children vied to pick up dishes with their chopsticks. Looking at the smiling faces before her, she felt this was the best birthday gift.
location: Home dining room at 286 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Cleaning up the kitchen, posting on Moments, Mingxuan's progress, and a family meeting
description: After the meal, her husband Zhiqiang hurried to wash the dishes while she stood aside watching. After washing her hands, she sat on the sofa and posted photos of the fuchsia in the courtyard and the greeting card from Mingxuan to her Moments, with the caption, “41 years old, flowers in the yard, food in the bowl, and you by my side. Content!” She quickly received likes and blessings from relatives and friends. Then her eldest son Mingxuan came over and said that today's Chinese essay had been praised by the teacher. Happily, she took out her notebook to record it and gave him a hug. Afterward, she called a family meeting. To protect Mingzhe's eyes, she proposed that the whole family watch TV for no more than 1 hour a day and use phones only for study; in exchange, the family would take a half-hour walk together after dinner. Everyone agreed unanimously and signed the agreement paper, which was posted on the refrigerator door.
location: Living room of the home, 286 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family walk on Jingwen Road
description: The meeting ended right at 7:30. The family put on their coats, locked the door, and took a leisurely stroll along Jingwen Road. Her husband Zhiqiang walked at the front; she and her youngest daughter Yuxin followed behind, while Mingxuan and Mingzhe chased and played alongside. The evening breeze was cool, the streetlights stretched the shadows long, and she felt especially grounded and at ease.
location: Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Urge the children to wash up.
description: After returning from the walk, she urged Mingzhe and Yuxin to wash their faces and brush their teeth first. Mingzhe still wanted to watch TV, but after she pointed to the family rules posted on the refrigerator, he went obediently. Mingxuan, sensible as always, went to wash up on his own first. She helped Yuxin apply baby lotion. Seeing her smelling nice and sweet, she gave her a kiss on the cheek.
location: Bathroom at home, 286 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Confirm tomorrow's plans with a childhood friend and keep the accounts.
description: After settling the children, she sent a WeChat message to her childhood friend Chunmei, confirming a meeting at the community square at 9 a.m. tomorrow to take the kids out to play. Then she took out her account book to keep records: morning pickled vegetable income of 28 yuan, vegetable shopping expense of 35 yuan, and she also flipped through next week's spending plan.
location: Desk in the master bedroom at home, No. 286 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Foot Soaking and Couples' Night Talk
description: She filled a basin with hot water and soaked her feet comfortably. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang pulled up a chair and sat beside her to chat. He mentioned the fuchsia plant again, saying he bought it because it looked nice and was easy to grow. She thought to herself how rare it was for him, a big rough guy, to be so thoughtful for once. They chatted about the children and his work until the water turned cold and their feet had become warm.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 286 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Check doors and windows and prepare tomorrow's items
description: After soaking her feet and putting on slippers, she checked the whole house from top to bottom: making sure the front door was locked, the kitchen gas stove was turned off, and all the windows were tightly shut. She went into the children's room to look around and tucked their quilt corners in. Back in the bedroom, she helped her husband lay out his work pants for tomorrow at the head of the bed, and also prepared her own coat.
location: Rooms in the home at 286 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Write diary and archive birthday photos.
description: Before bed, she opened her diary and wrote down today's truest feelings: “Life is plain and ordinary, but every moment today made me feel happy. The first day of being 41 years old began with the love of my family.” After writing, she took out her phone and transferred the photos of her holding the fuchsia and the greeting card to the old computer, created a folder marked with the date, and planned to have them printed when she went to Jingbai Supermarket tomorrow and put them in the photo album. After doing all this, she turned off the desk lamp. Moonlight outside the window spilled into the yard, and her heart was at peace; she soon fell asleep.
location: At home, 286 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin: on the desk and bed in the master bedroom

name: Got up in the morning, did morning exercise, prepared breakfast, and had breakfast with the family.
description: At 6:30 in the morning, Ma Xiulan got up and stretched in bed in the bedroom, feeling refreshed. She went to the living room and did a round of Baduanjin on the yoga mat to loosen up her muscles and joints. Then she went to the bathroom to wash up. Starting at 7:15, she tied on an apron and prepared breakfast for the whole family in the kitchen: millet porridge, steamed meat buns, and sliced homemade pickled cucumbers. At 7:45 she woke her husband Ma Zhiqiang and the three children, and the family sat around the dining table eating breakfast together. Ma Xiulan told the children to be good when they went to the community activity center in the morning for Mom's Salon, and her daughter Yuxin clapped happily. After the meal, at 8:15, she quickly cleaned up the dining table and kitchen, then returned to the bedroom and carefully placed the baby belly apron sample embroidered the day before yesterday, embroidery thread, embroidery hoop, and handwritten stitch diagrams into a cloth tote bag printed with orchids.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Go to the community activity center and attend the "Clever Hands Mom" handicraft salon
description: At 8:30, Ma Xiulan, with a handbag in one hand and leading her daughter Yuxin by the other, walked to the Jingwen Road Community Service Center, with Mingxuan and Mingzhe following behind. They arrived about 10 minutes later at the service center on the east side of the intersection of Jingwen Road and Jianshe Road. At the entrance, they happened to run into her childhood friend Liu Chunmei and her son, and the two greeted each other warmly. They went upstairs to the activity room on the second floor, where community worker Sister Liu gave them a warm welcome. Ma Xiulan generously brought out a sample of an infant bellyband embroidered with twin peonies. The three young mothers present (Mother Zhang, Mother Li, etc.) all praised the fine stitching and the beautiful pattern. She taught them the flat stitch hand by hand, explaining in great detail from threading the needle to the technique of moving the needle. At the end of the activity, Sister Liu gave her a set of professional embroidery tools, and Mother Zhang and Mother Li immediately added her on WeChat, wanting to order bellybands for their soon-to-be-born babies. Liu Chunmei was happy for her from the side.
location: Activity room on the second floor of Jingwen Road Community Service Center, east of the intersection of Jingwen Road and Jianshe Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Walked to Jingbai Supermarket to have birthday photos printed and returned home.
description: After the salon ended, Ma Xiulan asked Liu Chunmei to go back first, saying she would contact her in the afternoon. She took the three children along Jingwen Road and walked to the town's Jingbai Supermarket. At the self-service photo printer in the supermarket, she exported the fuchsia potted plant, greeting card photos, and family portrait taken yesterday from her phone, printed one 6-inch photo of each, paid 20 yuan, and carefully put the photos into her bag. Then she walked home with the photos and the children. Passing the fruit stall at the entrance of the community, she saw fresh Kyoho grapes and bought a bunch for 8 yuan, planning to give them to the children as an afternoon snack.
location: Jingbai Supermarket, Jinghai District, Tianjin (Building 19, Room 104, Yuzhou Zunfu) and the Jingwen Road section

name: Preparing lunch, the whole family enjoying it, and organizing photo albums after the meal.
description: After getting home at 11:45, Ma Xiulan immediately went into the kitchen and quickly made stewed pork with kidney beans, scrambled eggs with tomatoes, and cucumber salad. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang helped set out the bowls and chopsticks, and the family sat around the dining room table for lunch, with the children chattering about interesting things from the salon. After the meal, the eldest son Mingxuan helped clear the dishes into the kitchen. While washing the dishes, Ma Xiulan thought about putting up the photos later. When she finished cleaning up, she took out the family album from the cabinet, turned to the "Golden Autumn Memories" page, glued the three photos in place with a glue stick, and wrote neatly beside them: "September 12, 2025, in memory of Xiulan's 41st birthday."
location: Kitchen, dining room, and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Afternoon family leisure and personal interests (caring for potted plants)
description: After lunch, Ma Zhiqiang watched TV on the living room sofa, Mingxuan and Mingzhe went back to their room to do homework, and Yuxin played with building blocks on the living room mat. Ma Xiulan moved the fuchsia potted plant that her husband had given her yesterday to the courtyard, looked up care tips on her phone, and learned that it likes partial shade and cannot be exposed to strong sunlight. She felt the pot soil was a little dry, so she watered it thoroughly, then moved it to a semi-shaded, well-ventilated spot beside the rose bushes. She picked off a withered leaf as she went, and looking at the vibrant courtyard, she felt very content.
location: Living room and courtyard at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: At home: embroidering, taking orders, chatting with friends, and preparing dinner
description: Back inside the house, Ma Xiulan sat by the window in a well-lit spot and took out her embroidery tools. She first sent WeChat messages to Aunt Zhang and Aunt Li, thanking them for liking the pieces, and discussed the size, pattern, and delivery time of the bibs. They initially decided to use softer infant cotton fabric and embroider a simple peace-lock pattern, then she began cutting the fabric. Midway through, her craft friend Zhou Xiuqin sent a video call, and they spent half an hour discussing the newly learned layered stitch. Zhou Xiuqin also praised her for doing well at today's salon. At 16:00, Ma Xiulan paused her work and went to the backyard vegetable plot, with her youngest daughter Yuxin following like a little tail. She picked a handful of tender green water spinach, pulled up a few spring onions, and saw a red tomato. Happily, she picked it and gave it to Yuxin to wash and eat. Then she returned to the kitchen and started preparing dinner, planning to make stir-fried seasonal greens (using the picked water spinach), braised crucian carp (bought and marinated yesterday), and winter melon soup. Her second son Mingzhe ran in to help peel garlic, and Ma Xiulan praised him for being sensible.
location: At home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin: by the living room window, in the backyard vegetable plot, and in the kitchen

name: Family dinner and after-meal cleanup.
description: At 17:40, the stir-fried seasonal vegetables, braised crucian carp, and winter melon soup were all done, and the family sat around the dining table again for dinner. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang said with feeling that it was a rare day off, and that being together as a family was happiness. The children ate with gusto, and especially the braised crucian carp was very popular. After the meal, Ma Xiulan and Ma Zhiqiang cleaned up together. He wiped the table and she washed the dishes. They chatted while working and planned the route for a walk later.
location: Dining room and kitchen of home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Family reading time and reaffirming the 'screen limit and walking pact'
description: After tidying up, the whole family entered family reading time. Mingxuan and Mingzhe went back to their rooms to read their own books, while Ma Xiulan held Yuxin and read her a fairy tale. The living room was very quiet, with only the sounds of pages turning and story reading. At 19:00, Ma Xiulan called everyone to the living room, took out the "Screen Limit and Walking Pact" that the whole family had signed yesterday, read it aloud, and emphasized that it would officially take effect starting tonight. Everyone looked at one another and nodded in agreement. Mingxuan voluntarily put his phone at the charging spot in the corner of the living room.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The whole family took a walk along Jingwen Road
description: At 19:15, the whole family walked out of the house together and strolled along Jingwen Road. Ma Xiulan asked Yuxin to look at the little insects in the grass by the roadside. Mingzhe noticed his shadow getting longer under the streetlight and played a game of stepping on shadows with Mingxuan. Ma Zhiqiang was rarely so relaxed and chatted with Ma Xiulan about an amusing thing he encountered while driving yesterday. The evening breeze was gentle, and the family talked and laughed.
location: Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (section near home)

name: Urge the children to wash up and go to bed
description: After returning home from the walk, Ma Xiulan immediately urged the children to wash up. She first washed Yuxin's face and brushed her teeth, helped her change into pajamas, then Mingzhe and Mingxuan also finished washing up on their own and went back to their rooms. She checked on each room, tucked them in, and said goodnight.
location: No. 156, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin - home bathroom and children's bedroom

name: Soaking her feet to relax, late-night talk between husband and wife, and personal bookkeeping and diary writing
description: The children were all asleep. Ma Xiulan prepared a basin of hot water and chatted with her husband Ma Zhiqiang while soaking her feet. She told Zhiqiang about the two bellyband orders she received at today's salon and felt very happy. Zhiqiang also mentioned his plan to drive the truck next week. After soaking her feet, Ma Xiulan sat at the desk, took out her diary, and briefly recorded the fulfilling day. Then she took out her phone to keep accounts: expenses 20 yuan (photos) + 8 yuan (grapes); income: deposits for two bellyband orders (Zhang's mother 50 yuan, Li's mother 50 yuan).
location: Living room and bedroom desk at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare for tomorrow and go to bed
description: At 22:00, Ma Xiulan checked the weather forecast and prepared clothes for the next day. Remembering that her mother Li Xiuying had a medical checkup the day after tomorrow (the 15th), she sent her a WeChat voice message: "Mom, I'll come to pick you up early the day after tomorrow—bring your medical insurance card." After that, she turned off the light and lay down, feeling very reassured, and soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Getting up, morning exercise, breakfast, and household chores.
description: The phone alarm rang, Ma Xiulan got up, threw on a jacket, and went to the courtyard to get some fresh air. She checked the fuchsia and found that two more small flower buds had opened. Then she did 15 minutes of simplified Baduanjin on the concrete floor in the courtyard. Back inside, she quickly cooked a pot of hot noodle soup with vegetables from the backyard, eggs, and tomatoes, and sliced some of her own pickled cucumbers. She woke the children, helped Ma Mingxuan and Ma Mingzhe wash up, and braided her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin's pigtails. The whole family ate breakfast at the dining table in the living room. After the meal, Ma Xiulan cleared the dishes and put the previous night's clothes into the washing machine to soak. Then she wrote the children's morning tasks on the small blackboard in the living room: Ma Mingxuan was to finish a math worksheet, Ma Mingzhe was to read two extracurricular stories, Ma Yuxin was to draw a picture, and she stressed the "screen-time pact," telling them not to touch their phones or iPads before she got back. With everything arranged, she changed into her clothes to go out.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Go to Zhou Xiuqin's home to collaborate on designing the embroidered pattern for a dudou.
description: Ma Xiulan put the fabric from yesterday's salon, the notebook with measurements, two spools of embroidery thread, and a small bamboo basket into the basket of her electric bike, and also picked three green loofahs from her own vegetable garden to bring to Zhou Xiuqin. She rode her electric bike west along Jingwen Road, turned right onto Shengli Street, and arrived at Zhou Xiuqin's home about eight minutes later. Zhou Xiuqin greeted her warmly, and the two spread out the fabrics and patterns on the coffee table in the living room. Ma Xiulan conveyed the requests from Zhang's mom (a baby girl) who wanted a soft pink color and Li's mom (a baby boy) who wanted a lively pattern. Zhou Xiuqin sketched two designs with a pencil, Carp Playing Among Lotuses and Rich Peony. After comparing them repeatedly, Ma Xiulan chose Carp Playing Among Lotuses, which symbolizes many children, good fortune, and auspiciousness. Then Zhou Xiuqin personally taught her a new overlock stitch technique that produced denser stitches and more three-dimensional lines. Ma Xiulan practiced earnestly, repeatedly stitching and unpicking on an old piece of cloth, and frequently asking for details. The two chatted about family matters while embroidering, in a warm and harmonious atmosphere.
location: Zhou Xiuqin's home, No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Having lunch at Zhou Xiuqin's home
description: Zhou Xiuqin made a large pot of authentic Tianjin-style noodles with thick gravy, and the gravy contained pork slices, day lily flowers, wood ear mushrooms, and eggs. Ma Xiulan gave the luffa she had brought to Xiuqin, and Xiuqin stir-fried it with eggs. The two ate and chatted. Zhou Xiuqin also shared a few parenting tips, mentioning that her little grandson had recently fallen in love with eating noodles and his appetite had grown. The atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant.
location: Zhou Xiuqin's home, No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Return home and urge the children to take a midday rest.
description: After saying goodbye to Zhou Xiuqin, Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike back. Passing the fruit stall at the entrance to the community, she saw fresh Kyoho grapes, weighed out two jin (8 yuan) and prepared to bring them home for the children to try. When she got home, she saw that the children had been fairly obedient: the eldest son was doing test papers, the second son was reading a storybook, and the youngest daughter was quietly drawing. She praised them. Then she urged them to put down their books and each go to their rooms for a half-hour nap, gently closing the door and reminding Ma Mingxuan not to secretly play with his phone. She herself leaned back on the living room sofa and rested with her eyes closed for twenty minutes.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tended the backyard vegetable garden and organized order information.
description: During the children's nap, Ma Xiulan changed into a pair of old cloth shoes and went to the small vegetable garden in the backyard. She squatted down and focused on weeding the several rows of scallions and cilantro, and also checked how the tomatoes were growing. A few tomatoes were starting to turn red. Delighted, she cut two half-ripe ones and picked a handful of long beans, planning to cook them in the evening. After washing her hands in the backyard, she returned to the desk in the living room, took out her phone, and looked at the WeChat messages from Mother Zhang and Mother Li that she had added yesterday. She opened the notes app and created two order files, recording in detail: Mother Zhang (baby girl) ordered an embroidered bib with the pattern 'Carp Playing with Lotus,' and Mother Li (baby boy) ordered an embroidered bib with the pattern 'Prosperous Peony.' She also noted the babies' heights, weights, and nicknames that the mothers had told her over WeChat. She calculated in her mind, aiming to complete these two orders within two weeks.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare a dumpling dinner and spend time with the family
description: Ma Xiulan started to prepare dinner. She took pork and Chinese cabbage out of the fridge, chopped the filling, kneaded the dough, and decided to make dumplings. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang was off work and at home that day, and hearing the kitchen noise, he proactively came over to help roll out the wrappers. The three children woke up from their naps and gathered at the coffee table to do homework. The youngest daughter Yuxin occasionally ran into the kitchen to "steal" a small sheet of dough her mother had rolled out, which made Ma Xiulan pretend to be angry. The kitchen was filled with the couple's conversation and the children's laughter, creating a warm and lively atmosphere.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner and after-meal cleanup.
description: Steaming pork and cabbage dumplings came out of the pot, and the whole family sat around the dining table as Ma Xiulan set out the vinegar dishes and garlic cloves. Ma Zhiqiang was rarely home today, so he talked a bit more and asked about the children's studies. Ma Mingxuan mentioned the principle of the lever he had learned in physics class, and Ma Zhiqiang casually said, "That's the same idea as shifting gears in a truck." Father and son hit it off from there, and the atmosphere was very harmonious. After dinner, Ma Xiulan cleared the dishes, and Ma Zhiqiang volunteered to do the washing up. Ma Xiulan wiped the dining table, cleaned the kitchen countertops, and then sat on the living room sofa with her husband for a ten-minute rest, scrolling through family group messages on her phone. She saw that her sister had shared a photo of the flowers blooming brightly on her balcony.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family reading time and a discussion about cars
description: When the agreed family reading time arrived, Ma Xiulan turned off the TV. The children each took out their books. After doing homework for a while, Ma Mingxuan suddenly thought of something, ran to his father's bookshelf, and pulled out an old copy of Fundamentals of Automotive Mechanics. Pointing at the cross-section diagram of an engine in the book, he asked one question after another. Ma Zhiqiang, usually a man of few words, became animated as soon as the topic turned to car parts and principles, explaining piston movement to his son with words and gestures. Watching the father and son chat enthusiastically, Ma Xiulan quietly took a heartwarming photo of their backs with her phone and sent it to the family group chat shared by the three sisters.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family walk and WeChat order taking
description: According to the family agreement, the whole family got dressed and went out for a walk. Ma Xiulan changed into sports shoes, Ma Zhiqiang walked ahead leading the way, and the family of five walked along Jingwen Road toward the street park. On the way, Ma Xiulan's phone received two WeChat messages in a row: formal orders from Mother Zhang and Mother Li, each having transferred a 25 yuan deposit. She immediately replied and recorded the babies' nicknames and sizes, then told Zhiqiang quietly. Both were delighted, feeling that this month's grocery money had an additional source.
location: Street park at the intersection of Jingwen Road and Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Remind the children to wash up and prepare for bed
description: After returning home from the walk, Ma Xiulan urged the three children to take turns washing up and brushing their teeth. She checked Ma Mingxuan's and Ma Mingzhe's schoolbags and uniforms to make sure everything for tomorrow's classes was ready. Her youngest daughter Yuxin coquettishly asked her mother to tell a story, and she promised to tell one during tomorrow's lunch break. Around 21:15, the three children went to bed one after another.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Personal relaxation, keeping accounts, and practicing embroidery stitches.
description: Her husband Ma Zhiqiang was watching TV in the living room, and Ma Xiulan went back to the bedroom. She first filled a basin with hot water to soak her feet, and at the same time took out her phone, opened the bookkeeping app, and recorded the day's income and expenses: expenses 8 yuan (grapes), income 50 yuan (deposits for two bellyband orders). She also chatted briefly in the sisters' WeChat group, sending in the photo she had just taken of the father and son reading, which drew a flood of praise. After soaking her feet, she took out a new embroidery practice notebook and carefully drew the steps and thread-path diagrams of the new overlock stitch she had learned from Zhou Xiuqin that day, as if afraid of forgetting the key details.
location: Bedroom at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pre-Bedtime Preparations
description: Ma Xiulan first checked the doors and windows to make sure they were all locked. Then she went to the yard and moved the fuchsia pot to a better spot so it would catch the morning sun. Finally, she checked the weather forecast on her phone and confirmed it would be cloudy with pleasant temperatures. Back in the bedroom, her husband Ma Zhiqiang was already ready for bed. She lay down gently, turned off the reading lamp, and ended a busy but fulfilling day, feeling especially grounded and content.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Getting up early in the morning for exercise and breakfast preparation
description: At 5:35 in the morning, Ma Xiulan woke up naturally before the alarm went off. After stretching in bed, she walked barefoot to the window, opened it to breathe in the fresh air, and admired the fuchsias blooming in the courtyard. Then she drank half a glass of warm water, finishing it slowly by the window. Next, she went to the courtyard and began doing shoulder and neck stretches and Baduanjin, with gentle movements and calm breathing. After her morning exercise, she used clean water to water the fuchsias in the courtyard and the autumn cabbage and scallions in the vegetable garden, and picked a few ripe tomatoes. Then she went into the kitchen to prepare breakfast for the family: millet porridge simmered over low heat, boiled eggs and pork-and-scallion steamed buns, and sliced tomatoes sprinkled with sugar as a refreshing side dish. At the same time, she took the sea bass needed for dinner out of the freezer to thaw.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Waking the children and having breakfast as a family
description: When breakfast was almost ready, Ma Xiulan woke up her second son Mingzhe and her youngest daughter Yuxin one by one; her eldest son Mingxuan had already gotten up on his own. The family sat around the dining table, enjoying millet porridge, boiled eggs, steamed buns, and tomatoes with sugar. During the meal, she told Mingzhe and Yuxin to wait at the usual place after school in the afternoon, and praised Mingxuan for being self-disciplined, telling the younger children to follow his example.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Taking the children to school
description: After breakfast, Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to first take her second son Ma Mingzhe to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School and watched him enter the school gate; then she rode about 5 more minutes to take her younger daughter Ma Yuxin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, handed her to Teacher Wang and told her to be obedient before leaving.
location: From No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street), then to Huakang First Kindergarten

name: Returning home to tidy up and then going to Zhou Xiuqin's house
description: After dropping off her child, Ma Xiulan returned home, pushed her e-bike into the yard to charge, drank some water, gathered her things, and took the bellyband sample fabric she had made with Zhou Xiuqin and her phone. Then she walked to Zhou Xiuqin's home, which is in a residential area near Shengli Avenue.
location: From 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to the residential area near Shengli Avenue

name: Completed making bellybands and learning the craft with Zhou Xiuqin.
description: At Zhou Xiuqin's home, the two of them worked together to finish the final stitches on the 'Carp Playing with Lotuses' bellyband. Zhou Xiuqin once again demonstrated the newly worked-out overlock stitch, and Ma Xiulan recorded the finger movements on her phone for practice. The finished pink bellyband featured a vivid red carp, and each kept one as a sample to prepare for future orders.
location: Zhou Xiuqin's home in the residential area near Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Shopping on the way and arriving at her parents' house
description: After saying goodbye to Zhou Xiuqin, Ma Xiulan walked to her parents' home. On the way, she passed Old Zhang's fruit stall. Considering that her parents had poor teeth, she bought 500 grams of soft bananas and a bag of sugar-free peach crisps. She then arrived at her parents' home at No. 45 Shengli Street, gave the fruit and peach crisps to her mother Li Xiuying, while her father Ma Jianguo was watching the morning news. She told her parents to bring their medical insurance card and ID card, ready to take them for a physical examination.
location: Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, finally arriving at the parents' home at No. 45 Shengli Street.

name: Accompanying parents to their autumn health check-up
description: The three of them walked about an hour from Shengli Street to Chaoyang Street Community Health Service Center. Ma Jianguo had his blood pressure measured and an ECG done; the results were stable. Li Xiuying's blood test showed high blood lipids. Doctor Wang Jianguo advised using less oil in cooking, eating less fatty meat and fried food, and eating more whole grains and vegetables. Ma Xiulan carefully wrote down every piece of advice from the doctor in her small notebook to adjust the family diet later.
location: Chaoyang Street Community Health Service Center, No. 16 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Take parents home and prepare lunch.
description: After the physical examination, Ma Xiulan walked slowly back to No. 45 Shengli Street with her parents. After settling her mother down to rest, she went into the kitchen and quickly cooked two bowls of tomato and egg noodles. While her mother was eating, she checked the refrigerator and put away unhealthy foods such as lard and fried meatballs to prevent her mother from eating them.
location: Parents' home, 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Shopping for low-fat ingredients at the vegetable market
description: After settling her parents in, Ma Xiulan hurried to the Wutong Commune vegetable market. At the familiar stall of Sister Sun Guifang, she followed the doctor's advice and bought fresh crucian carp, white radish, tomatoes, brown rice, and oat groats. Sister Sun heard about her mother's condition and gave her an extra bunch of tender garland chrysanthemum, recommending stir-frying it with minced garlic, which is light and delicious.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Returning home for a simple lunch and midday rest
