description: After buying groceries and returning home, Ma Xiulan put the ingredients away in the fridge and had a simple lunch of leftover millet porridge and steamed buns from the morning, with shredded pickled vegetables. Because of the early start and rushing around, she felt tired, so she leaned back on the bed in the bedroom and rested with her eyes closed for about half an hour to regain energy.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Afternoon housework and handicrafts
description: After the nap, Ma Xiulan's energy recovered. Following Dr. Wang's advice, she carefully revised the family's menu for the coming week, changing braised pork to steamed sea bass and fried chicken cutlets to boiled prawns, and increasing the proportion of brown rice and oatmeal porridge. She made a health reminder card recording her blood pressure and blood lipid values and the doctor's advice, stuck it on the refrigerator door with a magnet, and took a photo to send to the family WeChat group to remind her sisters to pay attention to their parents' health. Then she took out the fabric for a custom belly band and sewed it using the overcast stitch she had learned from Zhou Xiuqin. After working for more than 40 minutes continuously, her eyes grew tired, so she paused, then hand-washed the clothes the whole family had changed out of.
location: Living room and bathroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare and pick up the children from school.
description: Ma Xiulan prepared dinner ingredients in advance, cleaned and marinated the crucian carp and sea bass, then changed clothes and pushed her electric bike out. She first went to Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up her younger daughter, Ma Yuxin, gave her a biscuit to tide her over, then took Yuxin to the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to wait for her second son, Ma Mingzhe, and the three of them went home together.
location: Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street)

name: Supervise the children's studies and prepare dinner
description: After arriving home, Ma Xiulan had Mingzhe and Yuxin wash their hands, eat fruit, and then do homework. Her eldest son Mingxuan rode his bike home by himself and went inside to study. She then went into the kitchen and started cooking dinner: crucian carp soup, steamed sea bass, stir-fried broccoli with garlic, blanched shrimp, and a pot of multigrain rice (mixed with brown rice and oats). The kitchen was filled with a rich aroma.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family low-fat dinner and cleanup
description: Her husband Ma Zhiqiang got off work early, and the whole family gathered for dinner, a rare occasion. Ma Xiulan announced the new family dining rules and explained her mother's high blood lipid condition and the doctor's advice. Everyone accepted dishes such as steamed fish and boiled shrimp. Mingzhe initially wanted braised pork, but Ma Xiulan promised to make it on the weekend to satisfy his craving. After dinner, Zhiqiang helped clear the dishes, and the couple talked about their checkup results; he supported the healthy diet adjustments.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family reading time
description: This was a fixed family rule: no phones after dinner. The whole family gathered in the reading corner of the living room. Ma Xiulan read the picture book “The Little Pony Crosses the River” with her youngest daughter Yuxin, checked Mingzhe's math homework, and looked over Mingxuan's physics test paper, giving him encouragement.
location: Reading corner at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family walk and supermarket shopping.
description: The whole family took a walk along Jingwen Road, enjoying the evening breeze. On the way back, they passed Jingbai Supermarket, and Ma Xiulan bought a bottle of low-sodium soy sauce and a bottle of extra virgin olive oil to prepare seasonings for the healthy eating adjustment.
location: Along Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and Jingbai Supermarket, Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu

name: Supervising washing up and evening chores.
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan urged the three children to line up to wash up, and checked the next day's books and homework. Then she soaked her feet in mugwort water to relieve the fatigue of the day's walking, feeling relaxed throughout her body.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Keep accounts, have a late-night talk with husband, and prepare for bed
description: Ma Xiulan took the old ledger out of the drawer and recorded the day's expenses: fruit 18 yuan, groceries 43 yuan, soy sauce and oil 58 yuan. She discussed visiting her parents over the weekend with her husband Ma Zhiqiang, planned to buy tartary buckwheat tea to lower blood lipids, and reminded him to limit how much lamb liver her father ate. Before bed, she checked all the doors, windows, and gas valves, looked over the potted plants in the yard, set the alarm for 5:35 the next morning, turned off the light, and went to sleep. The day had been full and orderly, and she felt reassured about managing her family's health.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Morning routine and family breakfast
description: At 5:30 in the morning, after the alarm went off, Ma Xiulan did shoulder and neck stretches in bed to wake up her body, then went to the bathroom to wash up. She began preparing breakfast for the whole family, cooking multigrain porridge, steaming sweet potatoes and eggs, and prepared white sugar for her youngest daughter Yuxin. At 6:40, she woke up her husband Ma Zhiqiang and the three children Mingxuan, Mingzhe, and Yuxin one by one, and the whole family sat around the dining table to eat breakfast. During the meal, Xiulan posted a health tips card on the refrigerator door, reminding everyone to eat more multigrain and steamed dishes. Mingzhe asked about the National Day trip, and Xiulan said the tickets had already been bought.
location: Bedroom and dining room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Rode an e-bike to take the two children to school
description: After breakfast, Ma Xiulan first rode her electric bike to take her younger daughter Yuxin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten. On the way, Yuxin shared funny stories from kindergarten. After arriving, she watched Yuxin enter the classroom, then returned home to pick up her second son Mingzhe, checked his backpack, and rode her electric bike to take him to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, reminding him to rest his eyes.
location: Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China, and Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School

name: Return home, do morning exercise, and tidy up the house
description: After sending off the children, Ma Xiulan cycled home. She first checked the well-tended fuchsias and tomatoes in the courtyard, then did a full set of Baduanjin to stretch her body. Afterward she went inside, cleared away the breakfast dishes, wiped the living room table, and put the dirty clothes into the washing machine to keep the house tidy.
location: Courtyard and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Hand embroidery and National Day trip preparations.
description: Ma Xiulan sat down by the living room window. First, she practiced the new overlock stitching technique by following Zhou Xiuqin's video, and after becoming proficient, she continued working on Grandma Zhang's baby bib order. Then she took out a notebook from the drawer and drafted a detailed packing list for the National Day trip, including clothes, medicine, and other items. During this time, she communicated with her husband Ma Zhiqiang via WeChat about travel details and confirmed the train ticket times. Zhiqiang promised to come home early in the evening to check the luggage together. Afterward, she continued focusing on embroidery, using the newly learned stitching technique to make the stitching denser and neater.
location: By the living room window at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Buy assorted grains and vegetables at the vegetable market.
description: Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to the Wutong Commune vegetable market. At the coarse grain stall of Sun Guifang, she bought brown rice and oat groats, and picked out fresh crown daisy. The two chatted about everyday things, and Aunt Sun recommended ingredient pairings for healthy meals.
location: China, Tianjin City, Jinghai District, Wutong Commune Vegetable Market

name: Preparing ingredients and picking up the children from school
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan portioned out the mixed grains, washed and cut the greens, and put water on to boil in preparation for lunch. At 11:20, she rode her electric bike to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up Mingzhe, then went to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up Yuxin. The two children excitedly shared their school stories from the back seat, and Xiulan smiled knowingly.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China, and the route to and from school.

name: Lunch and Nap Arrangements for Mother and Son
description: After arriving home, Ma Xiulan quickly made tomato and egg noodles and had lunch with Mingzhe and Yuxin. After the meal, she urged the children to brush their teeth and arranged for them to take a nap, while she cleaned up the dishes and rested briefly on the sofa for about 20 minutes.
location: Dining room and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Taking the children to school by electric bike
description: After the afternoon nap, Ma Xiulan woke Mingzhe and Yuxin, rode an electric bike to first take Mingzhe to Jinghai District Third Primary School, then take Yuxin to Huakang First Kindergarten, and only after watching them through the school gate did she return at ease.
location: Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School and Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Visit parents and help improve their diet
description: After dropping off the children, Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to her parents' home, stuck a health reminder card on the refrigerator door, and found lard and fried meatballs in the fridge. She urged her mother Li Xiuying to eat less of them and discussed with her father Ma Jianguo making lighter dishes for lunch, such as steamed eggplant and stewed tofu. Though her mother grumbled, her eyes showed relief.
location: Her parents' home, 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Shopping at the supermarket for travel supplies.
description: After leaving her parents' home, Ma Xiulan went to Jingbai Supermarket and, according to the outing list, bought items such as biscuits, dried fruit, wet wipes, band-aids, and children's picture books. While selecting items she calculated the cost; the total was 68 yuan, within budget. Before checkout, she checked the list again to make sure nothing was missing.
location: Jingbai Supermarket, No. 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Returning home, tidying up, and doing hand embroidery.
description: After cycling home, Ma Xiulan sorted and put away the purchased snacks, picture books, and medicines. Noticing that the medicine box was short of medical tape, she noted it in her phone memo. Then she made tea and continued studying embroidery stitches by the living room window, focusing on completing part of the embroidered bellyband, enjoying the quiet afternoon.
location: By the living room window at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Walk to pick up the children after school.
description: At 4:30 p.m., Ma Xiulan walked to Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up Yuxin, then held Yuxin's hand and walked to the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to wait for Mingzhe. The two children started bickering and play-fighting as soon as they met. Xiulan mediated and walked home with them.
location: Streets near Huakang First Kindergarten and Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Preparing dinner and doing housework
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan had Mingzhe and Yuxin do their homework in the living room, while she went into the kitchen to prepare a hearty dinner. She steamed the marinated yellow croaker, prepared blanched live shrimp, and carefully washed garland chrysanthemum to stir-fry. The clatter of pots and pans in the kitchen created the warm, cozy atmosphere of home.
location: Kitchen and living room of the residence at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Whole family gathered for dinner
description: Her husband Ma Zhiqiang came home after his driving shift, and her eldest son Mingxuan also joined the dinner. Xiulan placed the blanched shrimp and steamed fish near her parents' seats, explaining that this was for the elders' health. At the table, the family shared the day's trivialities; the children excitedly discussed what toys to bring for the National Day trip; Zhiqiang asked about things at home, and Xiulan told him about the supermarket shopping and her concern for her parents' diet.
location: Dining room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Family reading and homework tutoring
description: After dinner, Ma Zhiqiang took the initiative to wash the dishes, while Ma Xiulan accompanied the children in their studies. location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tidying up the house and contacting a neighbor to help watch the children.
description: Ma Xiulan quickly cleaned the kitchen and mopped the floors of several rooms. After finishing, she called her neighbor Wang Guilan in the building across the way and asked her to help watch Mingzhe and Yuxin during lunch and put them down for their afternoon nap at noon. Wang Guilan readily agreed, and Ma Xiulan expressed her thanks repeatedly, feeling relieved.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Organize photos to post on Moments and update the reading growth notebook.
description: After finishing the housework, Ma Xiulan opened the photo album on her phone in the bedroom, looked through the photos of the children reading quietly that she had taken this week, chose her favorites to make a nine-grid post and published it to her Moments, with the caption 'Our family's reading time is getting better and better. Persistence is victory!' It received many likes and comments. Then she took out the reading growth notebook wrapped in a book cover, and with a fountain pen wrote in detail about Mingxuan writing reading notes for Romance of the Three Kingdoms and discussing Zhuge Liang, and Mingzhe voluntarily telling his little sister the story of Little Red Riding Hood. She also drew a small sun on the title page, planning to discuss with her husband in the evening how to keep up family reading.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Make lunch, arrange the children's midday nap, and prepare for the afternoon outing.
description: At noon, Ma Xiulan cooked the children's favorite egg and fried sauce noodles, and added a fried egg for Mingzhe and Yuxin each. After the meal, she coaxed her youngest daughter Yuxin to sleep, then tucked Mingzhe in and told him to take a good nap. At 1:30 p.m., she took the two children, who had woken up, to the neighbor Wang Guilan's home for care, then returned home and napped for forty minutes. After getting up, she washed her face to refresh herself, took out the 500 yuan her husband had given her last week and the 100 yuan she had saved from handiwork, made up 600 yuan and carefully put it in her small personal bag. After checking that her ID card and phone were both with her, she prepared to take Mingxuan out to sign up.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Walked with the eldest son to Boxue Education to enroll in the history enrichment class.
description: At 2:30 p.m., Ma Xiulan walked to Boxue Education in town with Mingxuan, holding an umbrella. On the way, the air smelled of earth after the rain. After arriving, she consulted the front-desk teacher in detail about the content, class sessions, and times of the history enrichment course. Mingxuan was reluctant at first, but when he flipped through the textbook he was drawn to comic illustrations such as the 'Battle of Chibi', and his attitude turned positive. Ma Xiulan immediately signed and paid 600 yuan, and took the receipt and class schedule. On the way home, she patiently reasoned with her son, emphasizing the importance of history in the high school entrance examination. Mingxuan listened quietly and finally nodded in agreement.
location: Boxue Education, 23 Wenhua Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Picked up the children, prepared dinner, and had dinner with the whole family to discuss things.
description: After returning to the community, Ma Xiulan told Mingxuan to go upstairs and do homework, while she went to neighbor Wang Guilan's home to pick up Mingzhe and Yuxin, thanking the neighbor repeatedly. Once home, she immediately put on an apron, leavened the dough, cut the meat, and prepared the filling to make Tianjin baozi, her husband Ma Zhiqiang's favorite. At 5:40 p.m., Ma Zhiqiang got home from finishing his shift, and the steaming hot baozi came out of the steamer at the same time. During dinner, the family sat around the table. Ma Xiulan showed her husband the receipt for Mingxuan's tutoring class and told him it cost 600 yuan. Ma Zhiqiang said, "For the children, this money is well spent." Then she brought up the reading growth notebook, and the couple discussed how to cultivate the children's reading habits. Ma Zhiqiang offered to spend half an hour on weekends reading with the children, which made Ma Xiulan feel very gratified.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family leisure and parent-child time after dinner
description: After dinner, Ma Zhiqiang helped clear the dishes, and Ma Xiulan wiped down the kitchen. Mingzhe and Yuxin were building blocks on the living room floor. Ma Xiulan accompanied Yuxin in reviewing character cards while using her phone to look up the National Day reservation rules for the Palace Museum, silently noting the opening hours and important reminders. After Mingxuan finished his homework, he joined in and played with his younger brother and sister.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Urged the children to wash up and continued searching for Forbidden City tour information.
description: At 8 p.m., Ma Xiulan began urging the three children to wash up in turn. Mingzhe and Yuxin were quick, while Mingxuan was a bit slow and got a few gentle grumbles from his mother. Once all the children were ready and in bed, she returned to her bedroom, picked up her phone again, and carefully looked up details such as the Palace Museum's opening hours and visitor notes. She screenshotted the key information and sent it to the family group chat and to her younger sister Ma Xiufen on WeChat.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Washing up and sorting out accounts before bed
description: After putting down her phone, Ma Xiulan went to the bathroom to wash up and carefully apply face cream. Then she returned to the bedroom, took out her accounting book, and recorded the 600 yuan tutoring fee she had paid for Mingxuan during the day. Lying in bed, she began to plan what food to prepare for Ma Zhiqiang to eat on the road early the next morning, and made a simple shopping list in her mind.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Browsing the handicraft group and slowly falling asleep
description: After Ma Xiulan lay down on the bed, she opened the "Jinghai Skilled Embroideresses" WeChat group on her phone, browsed the new stitching techniques discussed by group members and the finished coasters they showed off, and silently liked and saved a coaster knitting video tutorial. After turning off the light, she thought about how the children's studies had been arranged and her husband had agreed to accompany them during study time. Although the days were busy, she felt grounded, and gradually fell asleep amid the occasional sound of cars passing outside the window.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Early morning chores and exercise
description: After waking up at 6 o'clock, Ma Xiulan spread out a yoga mat in the master bedroom and did a ten-minute simplified version of Baduanjin, exercising her shoulders, neck, waist, and legs. Then she tidied up the children's toys from last night in the living room and wiped the TV cabinet and coffee table with a wet cloth. In the bedroom, she checked the phone's storage, deleted blurry photos and cache to free up space. Finally, she went to the kitchen to prepare breakfast, cooking millet porridge, steaming eggs, making whole-wheat egg pancakes, and cutting pickled cucumber and cherry tomatoes.
location: Master bedroom, living room, and kitchen at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family breakfast and picnic plans
description: Ma Xiulan woke her husband Ma Zhiqiang and the three children one by one. After washing up, the family sat around the dining table for breakfast. During the meal, Ma Xiulan suggested going to Jinghai Cultural Park for a picnic. Her husband agreed, the children cheered excitedly, and her younger daughter Ma Yuxin said she wanted to fly a kite. They spent breakfast in a relaxed and pleasant atmosphere, and the whole family reached an agreement.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Borrowed picture books from a neighbor.
description: After breakfast, Ma Xiulan went to knock on Wang Guilan's door across the hall to borrow some picture books for the children. Wang Guilan readily brought out a stack of picture books and a craft magazine. Ma Xiulan thanked her and carried the books home.
location: At home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and Wang Guilan's home across the street.

name: Prepare picnic food and supplies, then set off
description: Ma Xiulan busily prepared for the picnic in the kitchen: she fried meat sauce, boiled noodles, rinsed them in cold water, and mixed them into zhajiang noodles, which she packed into a large insulated container. She washed apples, tangerines, and cherry tomatoes and packed them separately. Then she checked the picnic mat, water bottles, kite, and other items. At exactly 9 o'clock, she called the family together. Her eldest son carried the food bag, her husband took the picnic mat, and she led her little daughter by the hand and carried the kite bag. The family locked the door and set off.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Walking to Jinghai Cultural Park
description: The family walked along Jingwen Road toward Jinghai Cultural Park. The autumn sun was warm and a gentle breeze blew. The two sons ran and jumped ahead, while the little daughter held her mother's hand and looked around curiously. Ma Xiulan reminded the children to be careful while chatting with her husband about his trip to Tianjin Port to pick up goods the day before. They arrived at the park about 20 minutes later.
location: Along Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Picnic on the park lawn, kite flying, and walking by the lake while taking photos
description: After entering the Cultural Park, Ma Xiulan chose a grassy area with a wide view by the lake, spread out the picnic mat, and laid out zhajiang noodles, fruit, and more. The family enjoyed the picnic; after the meal, the children could not wait to take out their kites. Her second son Mingzhe and eldest son Mingxuan worked together to get the eagle kite up into the sky, while her little daughter Xinxin ran after it cheering. Ma Xiulan and her husband sat on the mat watching the children play and chatting. At 1 p.m., they cleaned up the trash and the family strolled along the lakeside path. Ma Xiulan enthusiastically used her phone to photograph the golden plane tree leaves, the reflections on the lake, and a big family group photo, feeling glad that this time the photos could be saved properly, making up for the regret from last time when the phone's memory card was damaged.
location: Lakeside lawn and walking path at Cultural Park, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Walk home and rest.
description: On the way back from the park, the children were exhausted. The younger daughter was held in her husband's arms, the second son said his legs were sore, and Ma Xiulan coaxed and hurried them along all the way. After getting home, everyone drank water and washed their hands. The younger daughter watched cartoons, the second son played with LEGO, the eldest son did his summer homework, and Ma Xiulan and her husband sat down in the living room to rest.
location: Along Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and the living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road

name: Organizing photos to share and setting up a reading corner
description: Ma Xiulan leaned back on the sofa and selected four favorite photos from today in her phone album, including the reflection on the lake, the back view of the children flying kites, and a family photo. She sent them to her mother and older sister Ma Xiufen via WeChat and shared the joy of the picnic by voice message. Afterward, she put the picture books such as 'Little Tadpoles Looking for Mama' and handicraft magazines borrowed from Wang Guilan into the reading corner in the living room. Her youngest daughter Xinxin came over curiously and flipped through them, and Ma Xiulan squatted down to teach her to recognize the new books.
location: Sofa and reading corner in the living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare dinner
description: Ma Xiulan went into the kitchen to prepare dinner. She took out zucchini, eggs, soaked wood ear mushrooms, hairtail, and other ingredients, planning to make stir-fried zucchini, wood ear mushroom scrambled eggs, steamed hairtail, and tomato salad. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang looked after the three children in the living room.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner and sharing amusing stories
description: The food was set on the table, and the family sat around eating dinner. The second son, Mingzhe, rushed to say that he had flown his kite highest today; the eldest son, Mingxuan, said he had helped his younger brother untangle the line; and the youngest daughter, Xinxin, praised Mom for taking such good photos. Laughter filled the table as everyone shared the happiness of the day at the park.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: After-meal cleanup and going out with the husband and children
description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan asked her husband Ma Zhiqiang to take the three children to the small square at the entrance of the residential community to play. She put on rubber gloves, carefully washed the dishes, scrubbed them with dish soap, rinsed them with clean water, put the tableware back in place, and wiped down the kitchen counter and sink. She didn't stop until the kitchen was clean and tidy.
location: Home kitchen, living room, and small community square at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Organized photos alone and checked the portable hard drive.
description: While the family was out, Ma Xiulan sat alone in the living room, sorting all of today's photos into a new folder named "2025 Autumn Outing" on her phone. Then she opened a shopping app, browsed portable hard drives, compared prices and capacities, saw a 1TB Western Digital portable hard drive on sale for 299 yuan, took a screenshot and saved it, planning to buy it next time she got her living allowance to prevent losing photos again.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family leisure time
description: After her husband brought the children back, everyone began to relax. The youngest daughter, Xinxin, was drawing with watercolor pens on the coffee table, and Ma Xiulan sat nearby watching over her; the second son, Mingzhe, was reading a dinosaur book aloud and from time to time used his little dinosaur toy to cause trouble and mess up Xinxin's picture; the eldest son, Mingxuan, was quietly reading the popular science magazine he had borrowed that morning in the corner. Ma Xiulan praised Xinxin for drawing well while nagging Mingzhe not to make trouble.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Supervise the children's washing and bedtime story.
description: At 8:30, Ma Xiulan urged the children to wash up. She helped her youngest daughter Xinxin brush her teeth, wash her face, and change into pajamas. Then she had Xinxin lie in bed, sat by the bedside, and picked up 'The World Champion Who Doesn't Sleep' to tell the story softly. Halfway through the story, Xinxin closed her eyes and fell asleep.
location: Bathroom and second bedroom, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Personal washing up and waist and back stretches
description: After the children had all fallen asleep, Ma Xiulan tiptoed back to the master bedroom bathroom, washed her face carefully with warm water, and applied skin care products. Then she spread a yoga mat on the bedroom floor and did ten minutes of waist and back stretches. Thinking back on the day's joys, she felt content.
location: Home bathroom and master bedroom, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Keep the books and chat with a childhood friend
description: After stretching, Ma Xiulan picked up the account book beside her bed and recorded today's expenses: about 30 yuan for vegetables and noodles, with no extra cost for the picnic. Then she picked up her phone and sent a WeChat voice message to her childhood friend Liu Chunmei, sharing the joy of taking the children on an impromptu picnic and arranging to go out together with the kids another day.
location: Master bedroom of the home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Turned off the lights and went to sleep
description: At 22:00, Ma Xiulan turned off the bedside lamp. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang had already fallen into a deep sleep from the fatigue of driving his car. She listened to the faint wind outside the window and distant traffic sounds, savored the happiness of today's family picnic and the little wish to buy a hard drive, and soon fell asleep.
location: Master bedroom of the home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Getting up early in the morning, morning exercise, and preparing breakfast
description: At the break of dawn, Ma Xiulan woke up naturally. She first stretched and moved her body in the bedroom, then went to the courtyard to breathe fresh air. Amid the birdsong, she attentively practiced Baduanjin for twenty minutes and felt refreshed and invigorated. After the morning exercise, she made a point of checking the thriving autumn cabbages in the yard. Then she entered the kitchen and began preparing a nutritious low-fat breakfast for the whole family: she cooked millet porridge, boiled eggs, sliced cucumbers and small radishes, tossed them with a little salt and sesame oil into a refreshing side dish, and put out multigrain steamed buns. At the same time, she soaked the clothes dirtied from yesterday's picnic in a basin to be washed.
location: Bedroom, courtyard, and kitchen at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Waking up the family, having breakfast together, seeing off her husband for work, and checking the schoolbag.
description: At 6:45, Ma Xiulan went upstairs to wake the three children, and her husband Ma Zhiqiang was already up. She combed her daughter Yuxin’s hair and urged Mingzhe and Mingxuan to wash up. At exactly 7:00, the whole family sat around the dining table for breakfast. Her husband mentioned that he was going to Tianjin Port to pick up goods that day and wouldn’t be back at noon. Ma Xiulan told him to be careful and not to have a makeshift meal for lunch. After breakfast, Zhiqiang checked the truck and set off. Ma Xiulan then did a final check of Mingxuan’s, Mingzhe’s, and Yuxin’s schoolbags to make sure the textbooks, homework, and red scarves were all there. She noticed Mingxuan’s pencil case was old and planned to take him to buy a new one on the weekend.
location: Home dining room and living room, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Taking the children to school
description: At 7:30, Ma Xiulan left home on foot with Mingzhe and Yuxin. Mingxuan, now a middle school student, rode his bike to school himself. She first walked fifteen minutes to take Mingzhe to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, telling him to listen carefully in class and not to horse around with classmates; then she held Yuxin's hand and walked another ten minutes to Huakang First Kindergarten, telling her daughter a little story on the way, and Yuxin was very happy.
location: Tianjin City, Jinghai District, Jinghai Town, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School; Tianjin City, Jinghai District, Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten

name: Buying groceries and daily necessities
description: After dropping off the children, it was still early, so Ma Xiulan walked on her way to Wutong Commune Market. She went straight to the stall of Aunt Sun Guifang, a familiar vegetable vendor, and bought fresh bok choy, tomatoes, scallions, ginger, and a piece of tofu, planning to make a light tofu soup for lunch. Then she walked to the nearby Jingbai Supermarket and bought a bottle of soy sauce and a bag of laundry detergent to restock household supplies.
location: Tianjin Jinghai District Wutong Commune Vegetable Market; Jingbai Supermarket, Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Go home and do housework
description: At nine o'clock she returned home. Ma Xiulan sorted the vegetables she had bought and put them in the refrigerator, then started cleaning: she mopped the living room floor, wiped the coffee table and the TV cabinet, put the dirty clothes that had been soaking that morning into the washing machine, and went to the yard to water the vegetables and pull weeds. After finishing all this, it was soon ten o'clock.
location: Living room, courtyard, and kitchen of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Complete the handmade craft order and notify for pickup
description: After a pause in the housework, Ma Xiulan sat down at the living room coffee table and focused on finishing the baby bib embroidery that had been put off yesterday. She carefully checked the stitches, then used an electric iron to press the two bibs smooth. When the pieces were done, she called the customer Sister Zhang to let her know the bibs were ready. Sister Zhang happily said she would come to pick them up around 3:30 p.m. Ma Xiulan then pulled out last month's ledger for handmade goods and pickles and wrote down a note about the money she was about to collect.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing lunch and taking a midday rest
description: At noon, she was the only one at home, so Ma Xiulan made a simple lunch: she stir-fried the bok choy she had bought that morning with minced garlic, and used the leftover braised pork sauce from the fridge to cook a bowl of noodles, topping it with a few slices of spiced beef. While the noodles were cooking, she took the laundry out of the washing machine and hung it on the balcony. She ate lunch quietly and cleaned up the dishes before twelve, then set an alarm and took a half-hour nap in the bedroom to ensure she would have plenty of energy in the afternoon.
location: Kitchen, dining room, and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Finishing up household chores and sharing crafting inspiration
description: After waking from her nap, refreshed, Ma Xiulan took out the picture book borrowed from her neighbor Sister Wang yesterday and her own handicraft magazines to browse, looking for new embroidery patterns and conceiving designs for her next piece. Then she thoroughly tidied up the living room and placed the payment QR code for the afternoon on the coffee table.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Going to Shufen Supermarket to Settle the Pickled Vegetable Payment and Shop Along the Way
description: At 1:30 p.m., Ma Xiulan took her account book and water bottle and walked to Shufen Convenience Store on Jingwen Road. On the way, she ran into Wang, her neighbor across the hall, and briefly chatted about the fun of yesterday's picnic. After arriving at the store, she checked last month's pickled vegetable sales records with the owner, Zhang Shufen: a total of 14 bottles were sold in August, 8 yuan per bottle, and after deducting a 5% fee, the actual income was 106.4 yuan. Sister Shufen also suggested developing new spicy autumn and winter products, and Ma Xiulan gladly agreed. On the way home, she bought two new colored pens and a Chinese character practice notebook for her daughter Yuxin at the small shop near the entrance of her home, to have them ready for use.
location: Shufen Convenience Store, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; small shop near No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Rest at home and deliver the bellyband order.
description: Just after 3 o'clock when she got home, Ma Xiulan poured water and rested, put the newly bought colored pens on Yuxin's desk, and put away the 106.4 yuan cash from the pickled vegetables. At about 3:30, the customer Sister Zhang arrived as promised. Ma Xiulan showed her the two ironed baby bibs. Sister Zhang was very satisfied and readily paid 50 yuan for the labor. Ma Xiulan also carefully explained washing suggestions for the pure cotton bibs: soak in warm salt water for the first time to set the color, then hand wash as much as possible, and avoid bleach.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up daughter from school
description: After seeing off Sister Zhang, Ma Xiulan left ten minutes early to pick up Yuxin from Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten. Yuxin excitedly said that the teacher had rewarded her with a little red flower today. Ma Xiulan praised her and walked home slowly holding her daughter's little hand.
location: At the entrance to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up her son from school and prepare dinner ingredients.
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan first had Yuxin read picture books in the living room, then went out again and walked to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up Mingzhe, who was in fourth grade. Mingzhe looked a little worried and said there was a problem on the math test that he couldn't solve. Ma Xiulan comforted him and said they would look at it together at home. After getting home, she immediately began preparing dinner ingredients, planning to make scrambled eggs with wood ear mushrooms, baby bok choy with shiitake mushrooms, and steamed hairtail fish, all low-fat and nourishing dishes.
location: Tianjin Municipality, Jinghai District, Jinghai Town, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School; Tianjin Municipality, Jinghai District, No. 156 Jingwen Road, home kitchen

name: Dinner, phone calls, screen-time limits, and homework help
description: At 5:30, Mingxuan, who is in eighth grade, also came home from school, and the family of four sat around the table for dinner. Ma Xiulan called her husband at Tianjin Port and told him to stay safe and remember to eat. Mingzhe brought up the math test on his own, so Ma Xiulan asked Mingxuan, who was very good at physics, to help him look at it after dinner, and Mingxuan nodded in agreement. After the meal, the children watched a 20-minute cartoon in the living room and then strictly followed the screen-time agreement by turning off the TV. Mingxuan took Mingzhe to the room to explain math problems, while Ma Xiulan accompanied Yuxin in drawing and practicing pinyin. The household ran with clear roles and stayed quiet and orderly.
location: Dining room, living room, and Mingzhe's room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family walk
description: At seven in the evening, as it was getting dark, Ma Xiulan urged the family to change into comfortable shoes and take a walk together on Jingwen Road outside the community for about half an hour. On the way, she talked with the children about the plan to go to Beijing for National Day. Mingxuan wanted to see the Nine-Dragon Wall and the Treasure Gallery in the Palace Museum, Mingzhe wanted to buy a cultural creative ice cream, and Yuxin wanted to see the goldfish in the big vat. Ma Xiulan smiled and agreed, and planned to book Palace Museum tickets in advance.
location: Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Supervise washing up, prepare items for tomorrow, and coax daughter to sleep
description: After returning home from the walk, Ma Xiulan urged the children to wash up one by one. She helped Mingzhe and Yuxin wash their faces and brush their teeth, had them get ready tomorrow's clothes and schoolbags, and put the newly bought crayons and notebooks into Yuxin's small schoolbag. At 8:30, she took Yuxin to bed and read a new picture book borrowed from Sister Wang's home. The child fell asleep listening.
location: Bathroom and bedrooms, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Learning electronic bookkeeping and nighttime washing and relaxation
description: After Yuxin fell asleep, Ma Xiulan went to the study, turned on the old computer, and, following her friend Chunmei's advice, tried to set up an electronic ledger in Excel. She created a new spreadsheet and entered, one by one, the day's income of 50 yuan for handiwork and 106.4 yuan for pickled vegetables, as well as expenses such as groceries and stationery. Though she was unfamiliar with the operation, she felt it was clearer than using pen and paper. Afterwards she took a hot shower, returned to the bedroom and did ten minutes of lower back and leg stretches to relieve the day's fatigue. Lying in bed, she picked up her phone to browse the handicraft group and Moments, liked Chunmei's new coaster, and planned the next morning's breakfast and made arrangements with her husband to reserve tickets for the Forbidden City.
location: Study, bathroom, and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Falling asleep
description: At eleven, Ma Xiulan turned off her phone and soon fell asleep feeling fulfilled and at ease, sleeping soundly until dawn.
location: On the bed in the bedroom at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning exercise
description: I got up right on time at dawn. After washing up briefly, I took a few deep breaths in the small courtyard, walked slowly around the yard for fifteen minutes, and then performed a complete set of Baduanjin in the open space beside the pomegranate tree, stretching my limbs and bones, feeling the quiet of the early morning, and building up energy for the new day.
location: Home courtyard at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare ingredients for breakfast and lunch
description: After morning exercise, she changed clothes and went into the kitchen. She started kneading dough to steam Tianjin buns, chopped the meat filling, and mixed it with soy sauce and scallion-ginger water. In another pot, she cooked millet porridge and boiled eggs. She scaled and gutted the fresh sea bass bought the day before, marinated it with salt and cooking wine, wrapped it in plastic wrap, and put it in the refrigerator to be steamed in the evening. She also took out dried chili peppers from the cupboard and pondered the ratio for making spicy pickled vegetables for Sister-in-law Shufen.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family Breakfast and Communication
description: Once breakfast was on the table, I woke the whole family. The steaming hot buns were the most popular. While eating, I reminded my husband Ma Zhiqiang to buy high-speed rail tickets to Beijing after work, reminded my elder son Ma Mingxuan to plan his homework in advance before the National Day holiday, and told the two younger ones, Mingzhe and Yuxin, to come straight home after school and not to hang around outside.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Taking the children to school
description: She put away the dishes and chopsticks, checked Mingzhe's schoolbag, and braided Yuxin's hair. At 7:20 she left the house, walked ten minutes, first taking Mingzhe to the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School and watching him enter. Then, holding Yuxin's hand, she walked another eight minutes to Huakang First Kindergarten, where Yuxin waved goodbye sweetly at the entrance.
location: Jinghai District Third Primary School on Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, then went to Huakang First Kindergarten on Huakang Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: On the way, buy groceries and check on chili pepper prices
description: After dropping off the kids, walked five minutes to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, bought spinach and scallions at Sun Guifang's stall, and deliberately chatted with Sister Sun a little longer about the price and market conditions of red chili peppers to estimate the cost of making spicy pickled vegetables.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Housework and tending the vegetable garden
description: After getting home, she put away the groceries and began washing the family's clothes in batches. Then she put on gloves, went to the vegetable garden in the yard, checked how the autumn cabbages were growing, pulled up weeds, and watered the vegetables. Looking at the green leaves, she felt especially grounded and content.

name: Search for Beijing travel guides and print out the route.

description: After the meal, she cleared the dishes and had her eldest son Mingxuan look after his younger siblings while they did homework. She took out the receipt folder, family ledger, and travel notebook that she had sorted during the day, and went over the accounts with her husband Ma Zhiqiang. She first briefly summarized several large mid-month expenses, then checked the receipts item by item. When calculating the education expenses, they found that the itemized figures far exceeded the budget, and the two fell silent for a moment. Ma Xiulan wrote "September education expenses over budget" in red pen in the ledger. After discussion, they decided to reduce purchases of snacks and unnecessary potted plants starting in October, and to set aside a fixed 200 yuan from Zhiqiang's salary each month as an "education emergency fund." She wrote the new rule on the flyleaf of the ledger and set a monthly reminder on her phone calendar for the 26th at 8 p.m. called "Family Finance Day." Then she opened the travel notebook to estimate the high-speed rail, meals and lodging, and ticket costs for the National Day trip to Beijing, and noted that funds needed to be reserved for taking Yuxin to the dentist on October 28.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening child care and personal rest
description: After handling the accounts, she urged Yuxin and Mingzhe to wash up, watched Yuxin brush her teeth, read her a 10-minute bedtime story, and coaxed her to sleep. She checked Mingzhe's math homework, found two wrong problems, and patiently explained them. She went to the boys' room and told Mingxuan, who was packing his schoolbag, to go to bed early. After all the children were asleep, she sent a voice message to her childhood friend Chunmei about the stress of overspending after tallying the accounts, then browsed the handicraft group and saved new embroidery patterns. She went to the bathroom to wash up, washed her face with warm water, and applied skincare products. Before going to bed, she did 10 minutes of lower back stretches at the bedside, checked all windows and doors, set the alarm for 5:35 the next morning, briefly ran through in her mind the plan for sending Mingzhe to the sports meet the next day and going back to her parents' home at noon, and turned off the lights and went to sleep at 23:40.
location: Bathroom, second bedroom, and master bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning exercise and courtyard inspection
description: After waking up in the early morning, Ma Xiulan spread a yoga mat on the bedroom floor and did a ten-minute simplified version of Baduanjin to loosen her muscles and joints. Then she put on a jacket and went to the yard to check on the roses and the freshly watered Chinese cabbage, enjoying the fresh air and dew, feeling relaxed and cheerful.
location: Bedroom and courtyard at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare breakfast and assign spring-cleaning tasks
description: Ma Xiulan went into the kitchen to cook millet porridge, slice pickled radish peels, and fry eggs, while also waking up the three children and her husband Ma Zhiqiang. She held a brief family meeting in the living room and announced that the whole family would do a thorough cleaning today, then assigned tasks: Zhiqiang would clean the windows and move furniture; the eldest son Mingxuan would organize the books and desk; the second son Mingzhe would put away toys and sweep the floor; the youngest daughter Yuxin would wipe the coffee table and TV cabinet; and Ma Xiulan herself would focus on kitchen grease and tidying the courtyard.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: The whole family had breakfast together
description: The whole family sat around the dining table eating millet porridge, flower rolls, fried eggs, and pickled radish peel for breakfast. Ma Zhiqiang said he could pitch in more on weekends, Mingzhe was full of energy, and Yuxin asked Ma Xiulan to feed her an egg. The family chatted and laughed, with a lively atmosphere.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Full-scale cleaning is underway (Phase 1).
description: After breakfast, everyone took their positions and started a thorough cleaning. Ma Zhiqiang moved a ladder to wipe the large glass windows in the living room and bedrooms; Mingxuan tidied the bookshelf, rearranged books and cleared out old test papers; Mingzhe put scattered Transformers and toy cars into the toy box and swept the floor with a small broom; Yuxin wiped the coffee table with a damp cloth under guidance; Ma Xiulan loaded the dishes and chopsticks into the dishwasher, then took out the degreaser and steel wool to clean the kitchen.
location: Living room, bedrooms, and kitchen in the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Focus on tackling kitchen grease and the courtyard.
description: As the others finished their first-stage tasks one after another, Ma Xiulan started dealing with the grease in the kitchen. She removed the range hood filter and soaked it in hot water and baking soda, put on rubber gloves, and used a steel wool ball dipped in degreaser to scrub the stove, wall tiles, and stainless steel sink. She even cleaned the years of grease on top of the refrigerator. After more than two hours of hard work, the kitchen looked brand new. Then she took a big broom to the courtyard to sweep fallen leaves and dust, and used garden shears to trim the overgrown rose branches. The yard became neat and fresh.
location: Kitchen and courtyard at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Simple lunch and rest
description: After the big cleaning came to an end, Ma Xiulan stir-fried a plate of tomatoes and eggs, cooked a pot of noodles, and served them with the morning's steamed rolls and radish peels. The whole family had a warm lunch together. After the meal, Ma Zhiqiang and the children went back to their rooms to rest. After cleaning up the kitchen, Ma Xiulan dozed off on the living room sofa for half an hour to recharge.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, home dining room and living room

name: Seasonal clothes sorting and storage.
description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan did the seasonal wardrobe changeover. She opened the wardrobes in the master bedroom and second bedroom, took out the summer T-shirts, dresses, and thin pants, put the dirty ones in the washing machine, packed the folded ones into vacuum compression bags and stored them in bins, hung the prepared light jackets, long-sleeve T-shirts, and other autumn clothes in convenient spots, and specially hung the new clothes she would wear for National Day in Beijing at the front, full of anticipation.
location: Master bedroom and second bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Take a short rest and prepare to welcome guests.
description: After the seasonal tidying, Ma Xiulan rested by the window and drank some water. Remembering that her neighbor Zheng Xiuying might come over in the afternoon, she wiped the living room table, picked up the scattered toys, placed a bamboo chair beside the rose bush for chatting, and washed two apples for her daughter Yuxin to eat in the living room while watching TV.
location: Living room and courtyard of the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Neighbor Zheng Xiuying dropped by to share the good news.
description: Just after three in the afternoon, Zheng Xiuying, the community grid worker, came by for a visit. The two sat down on bamboo chairs beside the roses in the courtyard. Zheng Xiuying took Ma Xiulan's hand and quietly told her that the subdistrict was selecting the "Most Beautiful Family" at the end of the year, and that she had already recommended Ma Xiulan's family. She praised the couple for being loving, the children for being well-behaved, and the courtyard for being like a small garden, saying it was practically a sure thing. Ma Xiulan was both surprised and delighted, quickly humbly deflected the praise, but inwardly she was full of joy and pride.
location: Home courtyard at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Inspired, she continued to tidy up the courtyard and the living room.
description: After seeing off Zheng Xiuying, Ma Xiulan was full of energy. She swept the fallen leaves and grass clippings in the yard several times with a big broom, even cleaning the dust from the cracks around the flower bed, and carefully pruned the rose branches. Back inside, she directed Mingzhe and Yuxin to put away their schoolbags, toy boxes, and other odds and ends, then wiped the TV cabinet, coffee table, and windowsills until they shone. Ma Zhiqiang also took the initiative to help wipe the dust under the living room chandelier.
location: The courtyard and living room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Wrapping up the big cleaning and a family-wide inspection.
description: After sunset, Ma Xiulan called the whole family to do a final inspection walk-through. They checked each room one by one: the windows were bright, Mingxuan's bookshelf was tidy, Mingzhe's toy box was neat, the kitchen stove was clean and reflective, and the roses in the courtyard were gorgeous. Ma Zhiqiang threw the last few large bags of trash into the trash can at the corner of the yard. Though the family was tired, looking at the completely renewed home, they wore satisfied smiles on their faces.
location: Each room and the courtyard of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Making dinner and chatting about everyday things at the family meal
description: After the big cleaning, Ma Xiulan washed her hands and made dinner: stewed pork ribs, stir-fried light vegetables, and noodles with gravy. The whole family sat around the table, eating and chatting about the day's hard work and rewards. Ma Xiulan mentioned the good news that Zheng Xiuying had recommended them for the 'Most Beautiful Family' award. Ma Zhiqiang grinned from ear to ear and said he would take on some housework. After dinner, Ma Xiulan reminded Mingzhe to check the things he needed for tomorrow's sports meet.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare sports day items for son Mingzhe for tomorrow.
description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan asked Mingzhe to take out the shorts, running shoes, and water bottle he would need for the next day's sports meet. She helped check them, and finding that the race number bib had a curled edge, she took out her sewing box, put on her thimble, and re-stitched it neatly stitch by stitch. Yuxin sat beside her drawing a picture of today's big clean-up, while Mingxuan read in his own room under a desk lamp. The room was quiet except for the ticking of the old clock, and Ma Xiulan felt steady and content.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Washing up and stretching before bed
description: After getting the three children washed and into bed, Ma Xiulan took a hot shower to wash away the sweat and fatigue. Then she spread a yoga mat on the bedroom floor and did ten minutes of lower-back stretches to soothe the sore muscles from the day's work.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Track spending and record today's mood
description: Ma Xiulan took out her account book and recorded the day's expenses on pork ribs, vegetables, and daily necessities. She also wrote a short diary in a small notebook beside it, noting the spring cleaning, Zheng Xiuying recommending her for the Most Beautiful Family award, and sewing a number cloth for Mingzhe. She felt that life was tiring but fulfilling.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Pre-sleep relaxation and rest
description: Ma Xiulan leaned against the headboard and scrolled through the Jinghai District Handicraft Enthusiasts WeChat group, looking at new patterns others had posted. She also had a WeChat voice chat with her childhood friend Liu Chunmei, sharing the good news that Zheng Xiuying had recommended her. As they talked, her eyelids began to droop. She turned off the bedside lamp, thought about Mingzhe's sports meet the next day, silently ran through the prepared items, and fell asleep contentedly with a smile.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Morning exercise in the courtyard at dawn
description: At 6:10 in the morning, Ma Xiulan put on a thin jacket, walked into the courtyard, and breathed in the cool air as she began a simplified Baduanjin workout to loosen up her muscles and joints. The morning exercise helped her recover from last night's big cleaning, and she also remembered her daughter Ma Yuxin's toothache, deciding to take her to the dentist soon.
location: Home courtyard at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Breakfast preparation, family communication, and travel arrangements.
description: After morning exercise, Ma Xiulan went into the kitchen and prepared a light breakfast for the family, including millet porridge, steamed buns, and boiled eggs. She gently woke her daughter Ma Yuxin, specially ladled out some millet porridge that had been cooled a little, and told her to eat slowly. Afterwards, her two sons Ma Mingxuan and Ma Mingzhe got up one after another. As she handed out breakfast, Ma Xiulan discussed family matters with her husband Ma Zhiqiang, told him that their daughter's toothache was serious, and asked him to stay home today to take care of the sons, supervise Ma Mingzhe in finishing his homework, and remind Ma Mingxuan to keep an eye on his younger brother.
location: Kitchen and dining room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Took her daughter to Qingmei Dental Hospital No. 3
description: Ma Xiulan put her medical insurance card, 200 yuan in cash, and her medical insurance booklet into her shoulder bag, then rode her electric bike with her daughter Ma Yuxin. She drove along Jingwen Road toward Qingmei Dental Hospital No. 3 on Shengli Street. On the way, she comforted the nervous Xinxin and promised to make her a little floral cloth doll after the dental visit in the afternoon. Ten minutes later, they arrived at the hospital.
location: In Jinghai District, Tianjin, on the way from 156 Jingwen Road to Qingmei Dental No. 3 (Shengli Avenue Branch)

name: Accompanying daughter for root canal treatment
description: After arriving at Qingmei Dental Third Hospital, Ma Xiulan registered. The doctor examined Ma Yuxin and found that her lower left second deciduous molar had decayed to the pulp, requiring root canal treatment. During the treatment, Xinxin cried because of the pain, and Ma Xiulan held her hand tightly and comforted her in a soft voice. The treatment ended after about an hour. The doctor prescribed anti-inflammatory medication and reminded them of precautions. Ma Xiulan paid 200 yuan for the treatment and carefully kept the receipt.
location: Dental clinic, Qingmei Dental Third Hospital (Shengli Street branch), Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Return home and hold a family meeting
description: After the treatment, Ma Xiulan took Xinxin home on her electric bike, calling her husband Ma Zhiqiang on the way to let him know the situation was stable. When she got home, she let Xinxin rest on the sofa, poured water, and gave her the medicine. Then Ma Xiulan opened the snack cabinet in the living room, cleared out all the unhealthy snacks such as candy and sandwich cookies, put them in a black plastic bag, and placed it up high, leaving only additive-free dried fruit. She called the three children into the living room and held a serious family meeting, explaining the harm of eating sugar and announcing the new snack rule: sugar was only allowed on special days, and fruit would be used instead on ordinary days. The children were reluctant, but they nodded in agreement.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Making a handmade cloth doll to comfort her daughter.
description: After the family meeting, Ma Xiulan took out her sewing box and floral fabric scraps and kept her promise to sew a palm-sized little floral cloth doll for her daughter. Xinxin sat close by watching, and gradually calmed down. Making the doll not only soothed her daughter but also exercised Ma Xiulan's handicraft skills. She thought she might even take a photo of the finished product and upload it to the handicraft group as a sample.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare and enjoy a soft, tender lunch.
description: Considering that Xinxin had just had root canal treatment, Ma Xiulan specially prepared a soft, easy-to-chew lunch: tomato and egg soft noodles and a bowl of tender steamed egg custard. After the mother and daughter had a simple meal, Ma Xiulan let Xinxin go back to her room for a nap.
location: Kitchen and dining room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Noon break, wrapping up household chores, and financial planning
description: After lunch, Ma Xiulan urged her two sons to take a nap or read, while she rushed to finish the leftover work from yesterday's big cleaning, putting away the toolbox and wiping down the bookshelves in the study. After that, she sat at the desk, took out the family ledger, and recorded the 200 yuan spent on the dental visit that day, noting the date and reason. Then, using her phone memo, she planned the pre-trip preparations for next week's trip to Beijing. Based on the September 30 high-speed rail ticket purchased by her husband, she listed the items to bring. At the same time, she looked through the ledger and reviewed the new financial rule set on September 26: reduce snack expenses and withdraw 200 yuan each month as an education emergency fund, reminding herself to start implementing it next month.
location: Study at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Contact a childhood friend and call mother.
description: Ma Xiulan sent a WeChat voice message to her childhood friend Liu Chunmei, asking if she was free that evening to come pick up the newly pickled vegetables and chat. The other party readily agreed. Afterward, she called her mother Li Xiuying, who lived at 45 Shengli Street, asked after the old couple's health, shared her son Ma Mingzhe's performance at the sports meet and her daughter Ma Yuxin's dental visit, with words showing self-blame.
location: Home study at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; 45 Shengli Street (mother's home)

name: Spend time with the children and prepare a hearty dinner
description: As the children woke up one after another, Ma Xiulan first played badminton for a while with her son Ma Mingzhe in the courtyard, then took her daughter Ma Yuxin to water the roses that had been pruned the day before. As the children's spirits picked up, Ma Xiulan's mood brightened as well. After that, she tied on an apron and went into the kitchen to prepare dinner. Since her husband had said to make a few extra dishes to celebrate their son's successful sports meet and comfort their daughter, she carefully cooked stir-fried broccoli, steamed egg with shrimp, stewed beef brisket with tomatoes, and cucumber salad, and the aroma of food filled the kitchen.
location: Home courtyard and kitchen at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner and hosting a childhood friend.
description: When dinner was served, childhood friend Liu Chunmei arrived with two boxes of yogurt. Ma Xiulan warmly invited her to sit down and eat together. During the meal, everyone chatted as they ate; Ma Mingzhe animatedly described the relay race at the sports meet, and Ma Yuxin happily showed off the little cloth doll her mother had sewn. The atmosphere was warm. After dinner, Ma Xiulan bottled the pickled vegetables and gave them to Chunmei.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family evening leisure activities
description: After dinner, her husband Ma Zhiqiang took the two sons to watch a documentary in the living room, while Ma Xiulan sat on the sofa with her daughter Ma Yuxin, playing with word-recognition cards and reading picture books, silently planning the tooth-brushing supervision session for the evening.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Supervise the whole family as they brush their teeth thoroughly.
description: At 8 p.m., Ma Xiulan called the three children into the bathroom, used an hourglass timer, and demonstrated the correct way to brush teeth: brush up and down, brush inside and outside, and brush every tooth surface for a full two minutes. She personally helped Ma Yuxin brush once, and then supervised Ma Mingxuan and Ma Mingzhe as they brushed on their own. She officially appointed Ma Mingxuan as the tooth-brushing supervision team leader, responsible for reminding and checking on his younger siblings every day. Afterward, each of the children was rewarded with a sugar-free mint candy.
location: Home bathroom, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening reading and a literacy surprise
description: Ma Xiulan kept up her nightly reading time, helping her daughter Ma Yuxin recognize basic literacy cards. She was pleasantly surprised to find that after the last tutoring session, Xinxin could already independently recognize the five characters for sky, big, small, up, and down. Ma Xiulan hugged her daughter excitedly and called the two older brothers over to join in, and the whole family clapped in celebration. She solemnly wrote in her reading log: September 28, 2025, Yuxin independently recognized 5 characters.
location: Ma Yuxin's bedroom at the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Put the children to sleep and talk with her husband
description: Ma Xiulan told her daughter the newly borrowed picture book "The Fresh Story of Tooth Street" to lull her to sleep. Then she went to check her son's room and saw Ma Mingzhe still discussing math problems with his father Ma Zhiqiang, so she gently urged them to rest early. Back in the master bedroom, she talked with her husband about the day's expenses and feelings, and the two agreed to manage the children's diet more strictly from now on.
location: Children's room and master bedroom in the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Personal relaxation, financial records, and bedtime preparations
description: After the children were all sound asleep, Ma Xiulan washed up, changed clothes, and did a set of bedtime stretches. She picked up her phone and sent a voice message to her childhood friend Liu Chunmei asking how the pickled vegetables tasted. She also saw a new pattern for baby belly bands in the handicraft group and saved it. Then she opened the family ledger and notes app and recorded the day's details: the dental visit cost, the snack cleanup, Xinxin's progress in learning characters. She also took photos of the picture book "The Fresh New World of Teeth" and Xinxin's character-recognition work and saved them to the 2025 Family Memories folder. Before bed, she checked the doors and windows, made sure the children were all asleep, then turned off the light and lay down, thinking about tomorrow's breakfast and the water bottles to bring, gradually drifting off to sleep.
location: Master bedroom of the home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning wake-up, breakfast preparation, and pre-departure checks
description: At 5:35 a.m., Ma Xiulan was woken by her phone alarm. After some simple stretching, she washed up and did a final check of the luggage, making sure her ID card, train ticket, charger, and small cloth bag were all there, and also brought the homemade pickled vegetables for her elder sister. Then she prepared a simple breakfast: heated frozen buns and milk, boiled eggs, and washed apples. At 6:40 she woke her husband Ma Zhiqiang and the three children, and the family sat together for breakfast. The children were especially excited about going to Beijing. Ma Zhiqiang checked the water, gas, and electricity in the house to make sure everything was safe.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Took a taxi to Tianjin South Station and waited for the train.
description: At 7:05, the reserved taxi arrived on time. Ma Zhiqiang and the driver loaded the luggage, while Ma Xiulan helped the children into the car. About 24 minutes later, they arrived at the entrance of Tianjin South Railway Station, passed through real-name verification and security checks smoothly, and collected paper tickets. The family rested and waited in the waiting hall near the ticket gate; the children looked at picture books, Ma Zhiqiang used his phone, and Ma Xiulan closed her eyes to rest while planning the trip in her mind.
location: Tianjin South Station, Floor 1, Jinjin Expressway, Zhangjiawo Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Take G8922 high-speed train to Beijing South Railway Station.
description: At exactly 9 o'clock, the announcement said that Train G8922 was beginning boarding. The family queued through the ticket gates, walked to the platform, and found Carriage 06. After boarding, the children scrambled to find seats while Ma Zhiqiang stowed the luggage. At 9:22 the train pulled out. During the nearly 50-minute ride, the children leaned against the window watching the scenery. Ma Xiulan peeled an apple for her daughter, took out a dinosaur picture book for her son to look at, and occasionally pointed to tall buildings in Beijing outside the window. The family enjoyed the short high-speed rail trip.
location: Train G8922, Car 06 (Tianjin South Railway Station to Beijing South Railway Station)

name: Arrived at Beijing South Railway Station, met up with older sister and went to her home to settle in.
description: At 10:10, the train arrived on time at Beijing South Railway Station. After getting off, Ma Xiulan immediately spotted her elder sister Li Xiuyun waiting at the station, and the sisters hugged excitedly. The group then took her sister's car to her home at 88 Kangzhuang Road, Huangcun Town, Daxing District. Along the way, her sister deliberately slowed down so the children could see the streets of Beijing. They arrived at 11:20. Her brother-in-law Wang Zhiqiang greeted them warmly and helped carry the luggage. After settling in briefly, the family sat together to enjoy the mung bean porridge and cold dishes her sister had prepared—simple but comforting. The children played on the floor mats while the adults put away the luggage.
location: Li Xiuyun's home, Courtyard 88, Kangzhuang Road, Huangcun Town, Daxing District, Beijing.

name: Afternoon rest, prepare dinner, and go out to buy daily necessities
description: After lunch, the brother-in-law took Ma Zhiqiang to the supermarket to buy milk and fruit, while Ma Xiulan and her elder sister stayed home to look after the children and start preparing the evening's big meal of noodles with fried bean sauce. The sisters chatted about family matters and new pickle recipes while dicing meat and vegetable toppings and kneading and resting the dough. At 2:30 in the afternoon, because the child had forgotten his toothpaste, Ma Xiulan, her sister, and Mingzhe walked to the Beijing Guochuntang Discount Pharmacy (Xiangsheng Store, designated medical insurance pharmacy) at the entrance of the community to buy children's toothpaste, and also bought throat lozenges. After returning home, they continued rolling out dough and cutting noodles; the aroma of fried bean sauce filled the kitchen. When the men returned, they joined the children in the living room to play with LEGO and watch cartoons.
location: Li Xiuyun's home at Courtyard 88, Kangzhuang Road, Huangcun Town, Daxing District, Beijing, and Beijing Guochuntang Low-Price Pharmacy (Xiangsheng Store, medical insurance pharmacy) on Xiangsheng Street

name: A sumptuous family dinner
description: At 6:30 p.m., dinner officially began. The table was laden with zhajiang noodles with a full array of toppings, the braised pork hock and roast chicken bought by her brother-in-law, plus cold dishes and the crisp, appetizing pickled vegetables Xiulan had brought. The two families sat around the table in a lively atmosphere. Her brother-in-law and Ma Zhiqiang opened beers and drank together, while the children competed in a noodle-eating contest, their slurping sounds drawing constant laughter from the adults. Xiulan opened the gift box of pickled vegetables she had brought, and after tasting them, her sister repeatedly praised the flavor.
location: Li Xiuyun's home, Courtyard 88, Kangzhuang Road, Huangcun Town, Daxing District, Beijing.

name: After-meal leisure and discussion of the Beijing travel plans
description: After the meal, Xiulan helped her elder sister clear the dishes, and then the family sat in the living room watching TV, drinking tea, and eating fruit. The children were excitedly discussing the itinerary for the coming days. Xiulan showed her sister the pickled vegetable gift box, and they all settled on the following arrangements: on October 1, watch the flag-raising ceremony at Tiananmen and visit the Forbidden City; on October 2, go to Beijing Zoo; on the morning of October 3, go shopping before taking the high-speed rail back. Mingzhe took out his notebook and wrote it down carefully, and the children's eyes lit up.
location: Li Xiuyun's home, Courtyard 88, Kangzhuang Road, Huangcun Town, Daxing District, Beijing.

name: Washing up and going to bed, bedtime stories, and late-night sisterly chat
description: After 9 p.m., Ma Xiulan got the children ready for bed. She washed the face and feet of her youngest daughter Yuxin, who was reluctant to sleep, and told two bedtime stories. Mingzhe and Mingxuan whispered to each other on the floor bed. Once the children quieted down, Xiulan sat in the living room with her elder sister, brewing tea and chatting late into the night, from their girlhood days to the daily grind of life now, sharing a deep sisterly bond. They didn't say goodnight until 10:30.
location: Li Xiuyun's home, Courtyard 88, Kangzhuang Road, Huangcun Town, Daxing District, Beijing.

name: Personal time before bed and going to sleep.
description: After the nighttime chat, Xiulan sent a WeChat message to her parents in Tianjin to let them know she was safe, and briefly noted down her feelings in her phone memo, reflecting that the trip had gone smoothly, the reunion was lively, and the children were all very happy. Afterwards, she went to the bathroom to wash up, took deep breaths in front of the mirror to relax, returned to the floor bed, looked at her sleeping family, and gradually fell asleep with a satisfied smile.
location: Li Xiuyun's home, Courtyard 88, Kangzhuang Road, Huangcun Town, Daxing District, Beijing.

name: Getting up and receiving a commemorative gift
description: Morning light streamed through the curtains. Ma Xiulan woke up, and her husband Ma Zhiqiang pulled a keychain made from an old key out from under the pillow, engraved with “05.10.01,” as a twentieth wedding anniversary gift. The children were woken by the noise and gathered around to offer their blessings together. Ma Xiulan was moved to tears. Then she washed up briefly and changed into clean clothes.
location: Room 402, Unit 3, Building 2, Anhuili Residential Community, Chaoyang District, Beijing

name: Helping in the kitchen and family breakfast
description: Ma Xiulan went into the kitchen to help cook dumplings. Her elder sister Li Xiuyun made soy milk, and her brother-in-law Zhang Jianguo bought back fried dough sticks and baked flatbreads. The family of eight sat around eating breakfast, with pork and cabbage dumplings and chive and egg dumplings. The TV was playing National Day programs, the children were playing, and the atmosphere was lively.
location: Room 402, Unit 3, Building 2, Anhuili Residential Community, Chaoyang District, Beijing

name: Pre-departure preparations
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan urged the children to tidy their clothes and carry their water bottles. She stuffed tissues, wet wipes, crackers, ham sausages, and a thin jacket into the big bag. Ma Zhiqiang checked the subway route plan. She deliberately touched the new keychain, sprayed mosquito repellent on each child, handed her daughter a small national flag, and got ready to leave.
location: Room 402, Unit 3, Building 2, Anhuili Residential Community, Chaoyang District, Beijing

name: Take the subway to Tiananmen.
description: The family walked from Anhuili to Datun Road East Station on Metro Line 5 and took the train to Tiananmen Square. It was rush hour, and the car was crowded. Ma Zhiqiang held his daughter Xinxin in his arms, while Ma Xiulan tightly gripped the hands of her two sons.
