After transferring to Line 1 at Dongdan, there were even more people, all tourists going to watch the flag-raising and sightsee. She told the children to hold on to the handrails.
location: From Datunlu East Station, Chaoyang District, Beijing, to Tian'anmen East Station, Dongcheng District, via Metro Line 5 and Line 1

name: Visit to Tiananmen Square
description: Coming out of the subway station, the family arrived at Tiananmen Square. The square was packed with people, and the giant flower basket with "Blessings to the Motherland" at the center was dazzling. Ma Xiulan took out her phone and took photos in turn in front of the flower basket, the Monument to the People's Heroes, and the National Museum. Ma Zhiqiang took a group photo of the mother and her three children, then asked a passerby to take a family portrait. The daughter Xinxin, holding a small national flag, wiggled in front of the flower bed, and Ma Xiulan helped tidy her collar. Although they missed the morning flag-raising ceremony, the strong National Day atmosphere stirred the whole family's hearts.
location: Tiananmen Square, East Chang'an Avenue, Dongcheng District, Beijing

name: Queueing to enter the Palace Museum
description: Walked from Tiananmen Square to the Meridian Gate, waited in line for 20 minutes to pass through security. Ma Zhiqiang opened the thermos cup for Ma Xiulan to drink water, and she buttoned up her son Ma Mingxuan's sun-protection jacket. Daughter Xinxin looked at the golden tiles and red walls and shouted excitedly, 'Mom, this place is so big and beautiful!'
location: Meridian Gate entrance, Palace Museum, 4 Jingshan Front Street, Dongcheng District, Beijing

name: In-depth tour of the Forbidden City
description: After entering the Forbidden City, the family toured the Hall of Supreme Harmony, the Hall of Central Harmony, the Hall of Preserving Harmony, and the Palace of Heavenly Purity along the central axis. Ma Zhiqiang carried a backpack and held Xinxin; Ma Xiulan, feeling sorry for him, suggested they take turns holding her. As she asked a young man to take a family photo in front of the Hall of Supreme Harmony, the key chain glinted in the sunlight. Ma Xiulan told the children the story of 'the emperor holding court.' Though her telling was not smooth, the children listened intently. Passing by the Treasure Gallery without going in, she taught the children to recognize the ridge beasts on the rooftops.
location: The palaces along the central axis of the Palace Museum, Dongcheng District, Beijing.

name: Lunch break
description: After coming out of the Shenwu Gate of the Forbidden City, they went to the zhajiang noodle restaurant across the street for lunch. After waiting ten minutes for a table, they ordered four bowls of zhajiang noodles, a bowl of millet porridge, a plate of shredded pork with Beijing sauce, and a bottle of yogurt. Ma Zhiqiang looked at a map while eating and planned to go to Jingshan in the afternoon. Ma Xiulan connected to the restaurant's Wi-Fi, scrolled through her Moments to see likes from sisters back home, and helped the children eat.
location: Laojiefang Zhajiang Noodle Restaurant, Jingshanqian Street, Dongcheng District, Beijing

name: Climbing Jingshan Park to enjoy the view
description: After dinner, they walked to the south gate of Jingshan Park and bought tickets to enter. Ma Zhiqiang suggested climbing Wanchun Pavilion. On the way, Ma Mingzhe said he was tired, and Ma Xiulan pointed to the outline of the Bird's Nest in the distance to encourage him. When they reached the top of Wanchun Pavilion, they had a panoramic view of the Forbidden City, with golden glazed tiles glittering in the autumn sunlight. Ma Xiulan asked Ma Zhiqiang to take a photo of her and the children, with the layers of palace buildings in the background. The children shouted toward the valley, and their laughter echoed.
location: Wanchun Pavilion, Jingshan Park, Dongcheng District, Beijing

name: Going down the mountain and buying souvenirs.
description: Descending from the west gate of Jingshan Park, she stopped by Nanluoguxiang on the way. The crowds were thick; she bought tanghulu and lüdagun, tasted douzhi, and the children stuck out their tongues, making everyone laugh. Ma Xiulan picked Daoxiangcun pastries and bought an embroidered sachet for her elder sister. They came across a dough figurine craftsman, and her two sons each chose a Sun Wukong dough figurine.
location: Nanluoguxiang, Dongcheng District, Beijing

name: Evening return trip
description: It was the return rush hour, and the area near Nanluoguxiang was congested, making it hard to get a taxi. Ma Zhiqiang was a bit irritated; Ma Xiulan calmed him down, and they decided to take the bus to Gulou Street and then transfer to the subway. The family held hands, took the special-line bus to Gulou Street Station, and transferred to Subway Line 8. On the subway, the children were tired: Mingxuan and Mingzhe dozed leaning against Ma Xiulan, while Xinxin slept leaning on Ma Zhiqiang's shoulder. Ma Xiulan's legs were sore, but she felt at ease.
location: Take the bus from Nanluoguxiang to Gulou Street, then transfer to Subway Line 8 and get off at Anhuili Residential Area.

name: Arrival and Brief Rest
description: Back at her sister's apartment building, Ma Zhiqiang carried the sleeping Xinxin upstairs. Ma Xiulan and the children washed their hands and faces and changed their jackets. She put the packed lvdagun and pastries into the refrigerator. Brother-in-law Zhang Jianguo went downstairs to pick up a package and bought some fresh fruit on the way. Ma Zhiqiang leaned back on the sofa and remarked on how much exercise he had gotten today.
location: Room 402, Unit 3, Building 2, Anhuili Residential Community, Chaoyang District, Beijing

name: Family dinner and anniversary celebration
description: The dinner was sumptuous, with Kung Pao Chicken and braised pork ribs made by her brother-in-law. At the table, Ma Xiulan brought up the keychain matter. Her eldest sister revealed that Ma Zhiqiang had asked about the keychain's wear last year. Ma Zhiqiang blushed in embarrassment. The children eagerly talked about what they had seen at the Forbidden City, and Xinxin said she saw really big stone lions. Ma Xiulan, raising tea instead of wine, thanked her family, saying today was the happiest day.
location: Room 402, Unit 3, Building 2, Anhuili Residential Community, Chaoyang District, Beijing

name: After-dinner chat and evening entertainment.
description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan insisted on going to the kitchen to wash the dishes, while her eldest sister watched the National Day gala on TV in the living room. The children ate lüdagun while watching the gala. Ma Zhiqiang and his brother-in-law talked about the next day's plans. After washing the dishes, Ma Xiulan took out her sewing basket, sewed the loose button on Xinxin's clothes, and occasionally spoke softly with her sister about family matters.
location: Room 402, Unit 3, Building 2, Anhuili Residential Community, Chaoyang District, Beijing

name: Washing up and putting the children to bed
description: Ma Xiulan urged the children to wash up one by one. The oldest and second children took the initiative to shower. Xinxin was very sleepy, so she helped Xinxin take a quick bath, carried her to bed, and hummed a nursery rhyme to coax her to sleep; the girl soon fell asleep. She drew the curtains and checked the window locks.
location: Room 402, Unit 3, Building 2, Anhuili Residential Community, Chaoyang District, Beijing

name: Couple alone time and bedtime.
description: After the children were settled, Ma Xiulan and Ma Zhiqiang sat side by side on the sofa with the TV volume turned down. She took out the keychain and looked at it closely. Ma Zhiqiang explained that he had filed it down from an old key of their old house in Tianjin and had kept it all along. Ma Xiulan was touched and held his hand, feeling the calluses on his palm. The two briefly discussed the plan to go to Tianjin the next day to visit her younger sister. A little after ten, Ma Xiulan got up to bring in the clothes from the balcony, checked the security door, and then prepared for bed. She lay down at 22:30 and soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: Room 402, Unit 3, Building 2, Anhuili Residential Community, Chaoyang District, Beijing

name: Waking up and morning tidying
description: Woke up naturally in the bed of the guest room at my elder sister's home. The autumn morning light of Beijing filtered through the gap in the curtains. I felt more recovered than yesterday. I got up quietly, went to the bathroom to freshen up, combed my hair neatly in front of the mirror, and planned to take a good rest at home today while helping my sister tidy up her place.
location: Li Xiuyun's home, a building in Anhuili Erqu, Huizhong Road, Chaoyang District, Beijing

name: Mending clothes and leaving a note
description: Taking out the sewing kit she carried with her, she found the jacket her sister had changed out of last night and noticed the thread at the cuff was a bit loose. She put on her reading glasses, and using thread of the same color, carefully sewed a few stitches to reinforce it. After finishing, she tore off a sticky note and wrote, "Sister Xiuyun, we'll be staying home today, so I'll arrange lunch. Lan." She stuck it on the refrigerator door, worried that her sister would be anxious.
location: Li Xiuyun's home, a building in Anhuili Erqu, Huizhong Road, Chaoyang District, Beijing

name: Family waking up and a simple breakfast
description: The children and Zhiqiang were woken up one after another. Ma Xiulan set out the leftover Daoxiangcun pastries, milk, and boiled eggs on the table. “Eat quickly. Today we'll rest all day at your aunt's house and not go running around anywhere.” Her husband Ma Zhiqiang rubbed his calves and agreed, “Right, right. After those tens of thousands of steps yesterday, we need to take it easy today.” Hearing that they could play at home, the children happily ate breakfast.
location: Li Xiuyun's home, a building in Anhuili Erqu, Huizhong Road, Chaoyang District, Beijing

name: Pre-purchase preparations and contacting younger sister
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan called her younger sister Ma Xiufen on a video call while clearing the table. 'Xiufen, I'm staying at your eldest sister's place today. Zhiqiang and the kids were worn out from yesterday's trip. When you have time, bring the kids back to Jinghai, and I'll cook fish for you.' 'It's fine, it's fine. You all just have a good time at eldest sister's place. Okay, I'll hang up now.' After the call, she had Zhiqiang keep an eye on the children in the living room, and carrying her cloth bag for grocery shopping, she got ready to go out.
location: Li Xiuyun's home, a building in Anhuili Erqu, Huizhong Road, Chaoyang District, Beijing

name: Morning shopping
description: Ma Xiulan walked alone for about 8 minutes to the Caijidi Fresh Food Market (Anhuili store). She looked around as she walked, planning the menu: she bought a lively grass carp, a piece of pork belly, a bunch of celery, a bunch of garlic scapes, several tomatoes, a box of soft tofu, and also deliberately bought dried chili peppers and Sichuan peppercorns. Then she went to the deli counter and bought half a jin of Harbin red sausage as a snack for the children. After shopping, she walked about 10 minutes back to Li Xiuyun's home.
location: Caijidi Fresh Food Market (Anhuili Store), Huizhong Road, Chaoyang District, Beijing

name: Busy in the kitchen and preparing lunch
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan put on an apron and quickly dealt with the ingredients: she sliced the fish and marinated it with starch, egg white, and cooking wine; sliced the pork belly; and washed and cut the vegetables. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang came in and asked if she needed help, and without turning her head she said, "Trim the garlic sprouts, and prepare the scallions, ginger, and garlic." The couple worked in perfect coordination in the kitchen, the sounds of pots and pans mixed with laughter, while the children watched cartoons in the living room.
location: Li Xiuyun's home, a building in Anhuili Erqu, Huizhong Road, Chaoyang District, Beijing

name: Lunch and family gathering
description: At 12:40 noon, Li Xiuyun rushed back from the supermarket after work, just in time for lunch. On the table were bright red boiled fish in chili oil, glossy twice-cooked pork, stir-fried garlic stalks, cold dressed red sausage, and tomato and egg soup. Li Xiuyun took a bite of the fish and gave a thumbs-up: “Lanzi, your cooking is really amazing, even more fragrant than restaurant food!” Ma Xiulan smiled and replied, “Of course, this is our Jinghai-style secret recipe.” The family ate and chatted about what they had seen at the Forbidden City yesterday. Laughter kept ringing out, and her brother-in-law also eagerly told amusing stories about National Day in old Beijing.
location: Li Xiuyun's home, a building in Anhuili Erqu, Huizhong Road, Chaoyang District, Beijing

name: Noon break and craft preparation
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan hurried to clear the dishes. Feeling a bit tired, she leaned against the sofa in the living room and dozed off for a short while. When she woke up, she saw that her husband and brother-in-law had taken the two sons downstairs to play badminton. She took out the embroidery cloth and colored threads she had brought from her suitcase—several cross-stitch kits with strawberry and little flower patterns already drawn on them. She called over her sister and daughter Yuxin: "Come, since they're not here, let me teach you to embroider a small keychain pendant. It's really pretty."
location: Li Xiuyun's home, a building in Anhuili Erqu, Huizhong Road, Chaoyang District, Beijing

name: Afternoon crafting and relaxation
description: In the soft afternoon sunlight, the three of them sat around the small tea table on the balcony. Ma Xiulan first threaded a needle for Yuxin and taught her hand-in-hand the simplest flat stitch: 'Sweetheart, watch Mom. The needle goes down here, then comes up there, and pull the thread evenly.' Then she turned to her sister and said, 'Sister, you should try this strawberry too; it's the best for practicing patience.' Li Xiuyun awkwardly stitched a few stitches, always crooked, and burst out laughing herself. Yuxin, however, was fully focused and embroidered a small strawberry shape, crooked but recognizable. It was rare for the home to be so quiet and warm.
location: Li Xiuyun's home, a building in Anhuili Erqu, Huizhong Road, Chaoyang District, Beijing

name: Evening leisure and snacks
description: When the handicraft time ended, Ma Xiulan packed up the unfinished pieces and placed them on the coffee table. The men also came back from playing ball, all sweating. Everyone sat in the living room drinking tea, eating fruit, and watching the news. Ma Xiulan took out the leftover Daoxiangcun pastries from yesterday and handed them to the children. She said to her elder sister, "Let's not go to any trouble for dinner. We'll heat up the leftovers from lunch, and I'll stir-fry a couple of greens, and we'll keep it simple." Li Xiuyun nodded: "Okay, whatever you say. Don't wear yourself out."
location: Li Xiuyun's home, a building in Anhuili Erqu, Huizhong Road, Chaoyang District, Beijing

name: Prepare dinner and share pickled vegetables.
description: Ma Xiulan tied on her apron again, rearranged the leftovers from lunch on plates, heated oil in the wok, and stir-fried a plate of garlic oil wheat lettuce and a plate of shredded potatoes with green pepper. While busy, she cheerfully told her elder sister interesting stories about pickling and growing vegetables at home: "Sis, the sweet garlic I pickled this year is so crisp! And the cucumbers in the yard can be picked and eaten right away, sweet and fresh. When I go back, I'll send you a jar." Li Xiuyun was amused and also talked about the supermarket's promotional gossip. The two sisters seemed to have endless things to say.
location: Li Xiuyun's home, a building in Anhuili Erqu, Huizhong Road, Chaoyang District, Beijing

name: Evening Family Dinner
description: Dinner began. Though not as lavish as lunch, the atmosphere was more relaxed. The children chattered about the afternoon ball game wins and losses. Her brother-in-law and Ma Zhiqiang chatted about the elderly at home. Ma Xiulan watched the lively, bustling family and felt especially content. She picked up a piece of pork belly and put it in her mouth, thinking: this is how life should be lived to have real flavor.
location: Li Xiuyun's home, a building in Anhuili Erqu, Huizhong Road, Chaoyang District, Beijing

name: Evening cleanup and weighing records
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan washed the dishes and wiped the kitchen until it was spotless. She went to the bathroom and stepped on the electronic scale; the screen showed “53.8kg”. She noted to herself: “Same as this morning, didn’t gain weight.” After showering and changing into pajamas, she felt the fullness and fatigue of the day turn into a sense of peace.
location: Li Xiuyun's home, a building in Anhuili Erqu, Huizhong Road, Chaoyang District, Beijing

name: Let mother know I'm safe and organize photos
description: Ma Xiulan leaned against the headboard and made a video call to her mother in Jinghai, Tianjin. "Hello, Mom, it's me, Lanzi. We're doing fine at eldest sister's place. Zhiqiang and the kids are all well. Have you eaten? Okay, don't worry. We'll be back the day after tomorrow." After chatting for about ten minutes, she hung up. She opened the photo album on her phone and selected a few nice photos from the group photo taken at Tiananmen yesterday and the strawberries she had embroidered today, saving them separately. The three children were messing around on the bed beside her. She said softly, "Stop messing around. Lie down and get ready for sleep."
location: Li Xiuyun's home, a building in Anhuili Erqu, Huizhong Road, Chaoyang District, Beijing

name: Soothing the youngest daughter to sleep and ending the day.
description: Yuxin was tired from playing and lay down beside her mother. Ma Xiulan gently patted her on the back and hummed an out-of-tune Tianjin nursery rhyme she had heard for decades: "The three-wheeled cart runs fast, inside sits an old lady..." Before long, the child fell into a deep sleep. Looking at her daughter's peaceful sleeping face, she touched the old keychain her husband had given her, and felt a sense of peace. Outside the window were the myriad lights of Beijing. She turned off the light and whispered softly: "This day is really nice." Then she too drifted into a deep sleep.
location: Li Xiuyun's home, a building in Anhuili Erqu, Huizhong Road, Chaoyang District, Beijing

name: Morning tidy-up, breakfast, and goodbyes
description: At dawn, Ma Xiulan got up, washed up, changed clothes, packed her luggage, and carefully put away the keychain her husband had given her. She then helped her elder sister Li Xiuyun prepare breakfast, and the family sat together eating millet porridge and steamed buns. After the meal, Ma Xiulan said goodbye to her sister and brother-in-law, thanked them for their hospitality, and agreed to meet again next time.
location: At Li Xiuyun's home in Anhuili Community, Anli Road, Chaoyang District, Beijing

name: Elder sister seeing off at the station and contacting along the way
description: The brother-in-law helped load the luggage into the car, and Li Xiuyun drove to take Ma Xiulan and the three children to Beijing South Railway Station. On the way, Ma Xiulan reminded the children to pay attention to safety, filmed the Beijing street scenes, and sent a voice message to her younger sister Ma Xiufen saying they were returning today. After arriving at Beijing South Railway Station, she reluctantly said goodbye to her sister and took the children into the station to wait for the train.
location: On the way from Anhuili, Chaoyang District, Beijing to Beijing South Railway Station, and the waiting area at Beijing South Railway Station (Yongwai Street, Fengtai District).

name: Return to Tianjin by high-speed rail.
description: Ma Xiulan took her three children on the G8919 high-speed train from Beijing South Railway Station to Tianjin South Railway Station. On the way, the children excitedly watched out the window. Ma Xiulan peeled an orange for Yuxin, reminded Mingxuan and Mingzhe not to take off their coats, and rested a bit herself. The train arrived at Tianjin South Railway Station on time.
location: High-speed train G8919 from Beijing South Station to Tianjin South Station.

name: Arrived at Tianjin South Station and took a taxi home
description: After arriving at Tianjin South Railway Station, Ma Xiulan took a taxi with the children as directed. The driver chatted with her about National Day experiences in a Jinghai accent. More than twenty minutes later, the taxi arrived at their home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District.
location: On the way from Tianjin South Station (Liujing Road, Xiqing District) to No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, and at the front door.

name: Returning home to tidy up and clean
description: Back home, Ma Xiulan immediately opened windows for ventilation and started a thorough cleaning. She sorted the clothes from the suitcase for washing, and divided the Daoxiangcun pastries brought back from Beijing into three portions: for her mother, her younger sister, and herself. Then she wiped the dust off the furniture, placed the souvenirs the children had bought in Beijing, and asked Mingxuan to sweep the fallen leaves in the courtyard. More than an hour later, the house was tidy again.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Simple lunch and a short break
description: Ma Xiulan used the last ingredients at home to make tomato and egg noodles, and the children ate happily. After the meal, she arranged for Mingxuan to supervise his younger siblings' homework, while she sat on the sofa drinking water and checking messages in the local handicraft group to rest a bit.
location: Dining room and living room of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pruning the courtyard and washing and hanging laundry
description: Ma Xiulan went to the small yard to prune the roses, cutting off faded flowers and dead branches and watering them. Then she took the washed clothes out of the washing machine, shook them flat, and hung them out on the balcony, and also brought in the clothes that had already dried, folded them neatly, and put them into the wardrobe by category.
location: The courtyard and balcony at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Cross-stitch practice.
description: After finishing the housework, Ma Xiulan took out the new cross-stitch pattern "Everything as Wished" featuring little persimmons that she had brought back from Beijing. She sat on the living room sofa, threaded the needle, and carefully embroidered according to the stitching techniques her elder sister taught her, planning to finish this piece as a birthday gift for her friend Zhou Xiuqin.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Shopping at the vegetable market and chatting with neighbors
description: Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market. She chatted with Aunt Sun at her stall about holiday life and shared what she had seen and heard in Beijing. She chose leaf lettuce, spring onions, cucumbers, and two live crucian carp, planning to make a light dinner at home.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare dinner and call mother.
description: Ma Xiulan was in the kitchen preparing dinner, planning to make crucian carp and tofu soup, garlic lettuce, and cucumber salad. While the fish was simmering, she called her mother, who lives on Shengli Street, to let her know she was safe and to tell her that the Daoxiangcun pastries she brought back would be delivered by Mingxuan tomorrow. She also checked the children's homework.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner and National Day topics
description: When dinner was served, Ma Xiulan served rice to the children, and the atmosphere at the table was warm. She asked the children about their feelings from the Beijing trip: Mingxuan said the Forbidden City was more magnificent, Mingzhe said the flag at Tiananmen was the most beautiful, and Yuxin said she missed her uncle. Ma Xiulan took the opportunity to explain the origin of National Day and encouraged the children to cherish the present.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening leisure and video call with grandma
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan cleaned up. Mingxuan and Mingzhe played with building blocks, while Yuxin snuggled against her mother watching cartoons. Ma Xiulan video-called her mother and let Yuxin interact with Grandma. After that, she browsed local handicraft groups and short videos to relax.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Washing up the children and getting them to sleep
description: Ma Xiulan urged the children to take turns bathing. She first washed and changed Yuxin, then let the two sons wash themselves. Afterwards, she took Yuxin into the bedroom, turned off the light, and told the story Guess How Much I Love You until she fell asleep, then left quietly.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Phone call with husband and going to bed
description: After washing up, Ma Xiulan got into bed and called her husband Ma Zhiqiang, sharing the little happenings since she got home and news about her sister's family, and they said goodnight to each other. After hanging up, she leaned against the headboard and continued her cross-stitch until she felt sleepy, then turned off the light and went to sleep around 10:30.
location: Master bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning courtyard walk and neck-shoulder stretches
description: After the fatigue from the National Day trip faded, Ma Xiulan naturally woke up in the early morning, strolled slowly in her own courtyard to enjoy the autumn tranquility, then focused on shoulder and neck stretches beside the pomegranate tree, loosening her stiff joints and injecting vitality into her day.
location: Courtyard, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Preparing and enjoying a family breakfast
description: Ma Xiulan cooked millet porridge in the kitchen, heated Daoxiangcun pastries and homemade meat buns, and fried eggs, preparing a hearty breakfast for the family. The family sat around the dining table and enjoyed the meal. The children couldn't stop praising the breakfast. Ma Xiulan discussed the day's housework plan with her husband Ma Zhiqiang.
location: Kitchen and dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Handling household chores and preparing to go out
description: Ma Xiulan quickly cleared away the dishes, wiped the dining table clean, sorted the dirty clothes brought back from the trip and put them into the washing machine. She checked the children's toothpaste and found it was almost used up. Recalling the community doctor's advice about fluoride toothpaste, she took out some change and a shopping bag, planning to go to the supermarket to buy toothpaste, apples, and pears.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China; living room, kitchen, and bathroom

name: Going to Jingbai Supermarket to buy groceries
description: Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to Jingbai Supermarket. In the personal care section, she carefully chose three kinds of children's fluoride toothpaste—strawberry, orange, and mint—and then in the fruit section she picked fresh apples and crown pears, spending about 65 yuan in total.
location: No. 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China; Jingbai Supermarket.

name: Return home and sort the ingredients.
description: Ma Xiulan returned home, put the new toothpaste on the shelf in the children's bathroom, and replaced the old toothpaste. She then washed the apples and pears, peeled and cored them, and cut them into uniform thin slices about 5 mm thick. She arranged them neatly on the baking tray, preparing to make healthy dried fruit.
location: Kitchen, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Make healthy dried fruit and check pickled vegetable orders
description: Ma Xiulan put the fruit slices into the oven to bake at a low temperature. While they were baking, she looked through the pickled vegetable ledger in the living room and found that the "autumn new products" pre-orders from 3 regular customers had been delayed by her trip to Beijing for National Day, so the new products would need to be launched nearly two weeks late. Feeling anxious, she decided to discuss adjusting the ingredients with her childhood friend Liu Chunmei the next day. During baking, she turned the fruit slices every half hour to ensure even heating.
location: Kitchen and living room, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Prepare a simple lunch and share a family meal.
description: The dried fruit was almost done. Ma Xiulan used the residual heat to dry it further and started cooking noodles in crucian carp soup, and stir-fried garlic lettuce as a simple lunch. The family sat around the table eating. Ma Xiulan told her husband Ma Zhiqiang about her worry over the delayed pickled vegetable orders, and her husband comforted her.
location: Kitchen and dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Finishing up the dried fruit and having a midday rest
description: Ma Xiulan put the dried apples and dried pears into glass jars, sealed them, and put them in the snack cabinet. Then, feeling sleepy, she took a half-hour nap on the living room sofa with a blanket to regain her strength.
location: Kitchen and living room, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Video call with younger sister Ma Xiufen
description: After her lunch break, Ma Xiulan made a video call to her younger sister Xiufen in Binhai New Area, sharing funny stories from visiting their older sister's home in Beijing and the Daoxiangcun pastries she had brought back, and pouring out her anxiety about the pickled-vegetable orders. She received her sister's guidance and comfort, and said she would bring pastries to visit them in a couple of days.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China, living room

name: Practicing new cross-stitch patterns
description: After the call, feeling relaxed, Ma Xiulan took out the "Fu" character cross-stitch pattern and red embroidery thread she had bought at a handicraft shop in Beijing. Sitting by the window where the light was sufficient, she focused on studying the new stitch, comparing the effect stitch by stitch, immersed in the tranquility of handcrafting.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China, by the window next to the sofa in the living room

name: Prepare a hearty dinner
description: Ma Xiulan tied on an apron, methodically prepared the ingredients, and cooked braised spare ribs, sweet-and-sour pork tenderloin, garlic broccoli, and seaweed egg drop soup. The kitchen filled with a tempting aroma as she made her signature dishes for her family.
location: Kitchen, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Family health management and household repair matters.
description: Ma Xiulan took out new toothpaste, encouraged the children to brush their teeth carefully with their favorite flavors, and personally guided the youngest daughter on the correct method. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang used a toolbox to fix the loose socket in the kitchen, and Ma Xiulan thanked him for his handyman skills.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China, bathroom and kitchen.

name: Enjoying a family dinner
description: A sumptuous meal was served. Braised pork ribs and sweet and sour pork were quite popular with the children. The family enjoyed dinner around the table, chatting happily about the funny things that happened during the day. Although Ma Xiulan still had the pickled vegetables on her mind, she felt the warmth of family.
location: Dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Household chores and family leisure
description: Ma Xiulan and her husband cleaned up the dining table and washed the dishes together. Then the family relaxed in the living room: Ma Zhiqiang watched a football match, the children played with puzzles, and Ma Xiulan watched TV while mentally planning what to say when discussing with Chunmei the next day.
location: Kitchen and living room, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Children's bedtime and personal relaxation
description: Ma Xiulan urged the children to wash up, bathed her younger daughter and read her a bedtime story until she fell asleep, then checked on her two sons' sleeping arrangements and told them to go to bed early.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China; bathroom and children's room

name: Evening handcrafts and getting ready for bed
description: After the children fell asleep, Ma Xiulan returned to the master bedroom, leaned against the headboard and continued her cross-stitch, enjoying the tranquility of being alone. Half an hour later, she carefully put away the embroidery, turned off the light, and rested, bringing this fulfilling yet slightly worrying day to a close.
location: Master bedroom, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Got up early in the morning and contacted her mother
description: The first rays of morning light came through the gap in the curtains, and Ma Xiulan woke up naturally. She moved quietly so as not to wake her sleeping husband Ma Zhiqiang, picked up her phone from the bedside table, and called her mother Li Xiuying to confirm what time they would come home in the afternoon. Her mother said they would arrive around 4 p.m., and her younger sister Xiufen's family would also arrive at about that time.
location: Master bedroom of her home in Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing breakfast and morning exercise.
description: After hanging up, Ma Xiulan went to the kitchen to rinse millet and cook millet porridge, then took eggs and steamed buns out of the fridge to heat them up. While the porridge was cooking, she did some simple stretching in the yard to loosen up, enjoying the fresh morning air with dew on an autumn day.
location: Kitchen and courtyard of her home in Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family breakfast
description: After breakfast was ready, Ma Xiulan woke up her eldest son Ma Mingxuan and second son Ma Mingzhe, and dressed her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin. The family sat around the table, enjoying millet porridge, steamed buns, and eggs. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang was rarely at home, and the children, excited about the festival, talked about the mooncakes and rabbits in their dreams last night. Ma Xiulan told the children to be polite today, as Grandma and Grandpa and the aunt's family were coming.
location: Dining room at her own home in Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tidied the kitchen and made a shopping list.
description: After breakfast, Ma Xiulan quickly cleared the dishes and washed and tidied up. Then she took out the material list for the "pickled vegetable commemorative pack" she had written earlier, and, based on that evening's menu, added the items she needed to buy on paper: pork tenderloin for sweet-and-sour pork tenderloin, fresh vegetables, soft pastries her parents loved, and the yogurt her niece liked to drink.
location: Kitchen and living room of her own home in Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Shopping at the vegetable market.
description: Ma Xiulan got on her electric bike and rode to the Wutong Commune vegetable market, taking her wallet and a large shopping bag. At the stall of her acquaintance Sun Guifang, she bought high-quality pork tenderloin, choy sum, carrots, and scallions, and was given a bunch of cilantro for free. Then she bought a carp and several kinds of seasonal fruit at other stalls, filling the bike basket to the brim.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, South Section of Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Purchasing at grocery and stationery stores
description: After leaving the vegetable market, Ma Xiulan first went to Jingbai Supermarket, bought fruit and yogurt, and put them in a locker. Then she went to the Jingwen Stationery Store she usually visited on Jingwen Road and carefully selected red label paper with gold patterns, a roll of red string, and some blank small cards, to use for making handmade packaging for the pickled vegetables. The shop owner suggested buying small clay jars wholesale online, and she noted down the suggestion.
location: Jingbai Supermarket, Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jingwen Stationery Store, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Going Home to Organize the Purchased Items
description: Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike home and found the children watching TV in the living room. She put the vegetables and meat into the refrigerator in an organized way, washed the fruit and arranged it on a fruit plate, and put the label paper, red string, and small cards into the bedroom drawer, ready to start making packaging tomorrow.
location: Kitchen, living room, and bedroom in her own home in Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare the dinner ingredients.
description: Taking advantage of the remaining morning time, Ma Xiulan began preparing the hearty dishes for dinner. She cut the pork tenderloin into strips and marinated them with cooking wine, egg white, and starch, planning to make sweet-and-sour pork. Next, she cleaned the carp, scored both sides, and rubbed it with salt and cooking wine to marinate. Then she started braising pork belly: she cut the pork belly into chunks, blanched them, stir-fried rock sugar to make caramel color, added star anise, cinnamon bark, and boiling water, and simmered over low heat, filling the house with a rich aroma.
location: Kitchen at her own home in Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Simple lunch
description: At noon, Ma Xiulan used the leftover pork rib soup from the morning to cook a pot of thin hanging noodles, poached a few eggs, and blanched some leafy greens. The family had a simple lunch. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang said he needed to go to town in the afternoon to pick up Chinese herbal medicine for his old mother, and Ma Xiulan told him to come back early.
location: Dining room at her own home in Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Noon break
description: After clearing the dishes, Ma Xiulan felt a bit tired. The children were playing in their rooms and her husband had gone out. She returned to the bedroom, set an alarm for 1:30, listened to soothing music, and took a nap to recharge for the busy evening.
location: Master bedroom of her home in Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Afternoon leisure and preparation for the reunion dinner
description: After waking from her nap, Ma Xiulan felt refreshed. She first cleaned the living room coffee table and set out plates of preserved fruit and snacks. Then she found the card draft she had designed earlier and carefully transcribed three or four copies of the pickled vegetable introduction onto small cards. Around three o'clock, she went to the yard, wiped the stone table and stone stools clean, and mopped the floor tiles, making the yard look brand new.
location: The living room, study, and courtyard of her own home in Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Cooking a reunion meal
description: Tying on her apron, Ma Xiulan officially showed off her skills. First she made cold dishes such as three-shred salad, mouth-watering chicken, and century egg with tofu. Then she fried and stewed the fish. She prepped the ingredients for stir-fried choy sum, her mother's favorite, and garlic broccoli, her younger sister's favorite. Next, she began frying sweet and sour pork fillet: she coated the marinated meat strips in starch batter, deep-fried them until golden, then fried them again, quickly tossed them in sweet and sour sauce, and sprinkled with white sesame seeds before plating. The kitchen was filled with an enticing aroma.
location: Kitchen at her own home in Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family arrival and welcome
description: Ma Xiulan had just plated the sweet-and-sour pork when she heard familiar voices and laughter outside the door. She hurried out to greet them and saw that it was indeed her parents Ma Jianguo and Li Xiuying, along with her younger sister Ma Xiufen's family. Her father handed her a box of Daoxiangcun pastries, and her mother held her hand and said she had worked hard. Her niece Zhao Yuhan sweetly called out "Auntie." Her husband Ma Zhiqiang also came back from town, and everyone chatted in the living room, making the house lively at once.
location: The porch and living room of her own home in Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Mid-Autumn Festival reunion dinner
description: All the delicious dishes were placed on the table, and the family sat around the round table. Ma Xiulan brought out the last soup, Ma Zhiqiang poured wine for his father and brother-in-law, and the children had yogurt and juice in front of them. The braised pork was tender and flavorful, the sweet and sour pork tenderloin was crispy outside and tender inside, and the steamed sea bass was fresh and smooth. The whole family ate and chatted, with the clinking of glasses, laughter, and praise rising one after another, creating a warm and harmonious atmosphere.
location: Dining room at her own home in Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Moon viewing in the courtyard and family entertainment
description: After dinner, everyone moved to the courtyard. The bright moon hung high, and the yard was brightly lit. Ma Xiulan set mooncakes, fruit, and tea on the stone table, and the adults sat around chatting about family matters. The children played in the yard: the youngest daughter Ma Yuxin and the niece Zhao Yuhan ran around the yard with paper lanterns, while the two sons Ma Mingxuan and Ma Mingzhe pestered their father and uncle to light small sparklers; the flickering light reflected the children's excited faces.
location: The courtyard of her home in Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Saw off the family and helped her parents settle down to rest.
description: Late at night, Xiufen's family drove home. Ma Xiulan held her younger sister's hand and told her to be careful on the road. Since her parents were getting old, she quickly let them go wash up and rest in the prepared guest room. Ma Zhiqiang helped his father get his medicine, and Ma Xiulan poured a cup of warm water for her mother and placed it by the bedside. After settling her parents in, the noisy little courtyard gradually became quiet.
location: Courtyard entrance and guest room of her home in Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: The couple did the housework together.
description: The children, tired from playing, washed up and went to bed on their own. Ma Xiulan and Ma Zhiqiang cleaned up the messy dishes in the kitchen and living room. Ma Xiulan wiped the table, and Ma Zhiqiang washed the dishes. While tidying up, she remembered the stationery store owner's suggestion and mentioned to her husband the idea of buying small clay pots wholesale online. Ma Zhiqiang expressed support.
location: Kitchen and living room of her own home in Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Before-bed wash-up and reflection
description: After a busy day, Ma Xiulan felt a sore back, so she soaked her feet in hot water and felt relaxed all over. Lying in bed, with the bright moon still outside the window, Ma Zhiqiang had already begun to snore softly. In her mind, she replayed scenes of the whole family gathering tonight and the children laughing, feeling warm inside and thinking that the day had been well worth it.
location: Master bedroom of her home in Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Waking up and simplified morning exercise
description: At 6 a.m., it was already light outside. Thinking about the 30 jars of pickled vegetables she needed to make today, Ma Xiulan felt a surge of energy and didn't linger in bed. After quickly washing up, she did 5 minutes of shoulder and neck stretches on the master bedroom floor, feeling her muscles and joints relax. Then she went to the courtyard and walked briskly along the decorative brick path for 10 minutes, breathing the dew-laden morning air and loosening up her arms and legs.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home master bedroom and courtyard)

name: Preparing the family breakfast
description: Xiulan busied herself quickly in the kitchen. She first put the leftover buns from yesterday's Mid-Autumn Festival into the steamer to reheat, then cut two mooncakes into small pieces and arranged them on a plate. Millet porridge was cooked in a large pot over a low simmer. While that was going, she took out the dried fruit she had made last time from the storage cabinet, picked out a few kinds with nice colors, placed them in small saucers, and set them on the dining table.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home kitchen)

name: Wake up the family for breakfast together and divide up tasks.
description: Xiulan served the dishes at the table, then went upstairs to wake Zhiqiang and the three children one by one. The family sat around the dining table. Sipping millet porridge, Xiulan told them the plan for the whole family to make 30 jars of "Beijing Trip Souvenir" pickles together. She arranged for her eldest son Mingxuan to help wipe the jars after finishing his homework, her second son Mingzhe to pass the jars and labels, and her youngest daughter Yuxin to hand over the red strings. Her husband Zhiqiang was responsible for carrying the jars and purchased supplies from the storeroom, and then taking the children out for a stroll to give her time to focus on the work.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home dining room)

name: Tidy up the kitchen
description: After breakfast, the children went off to play and Zhiqiang went to tidy the yard. Xiulan quickly gathered the dishes and chopsticks into the sink, added dish soap, scrubbed them clean in a jiffy, and drained them. She also wiped down the stove, clearing a clean, spacious counter for the pickled vegetables she was about to make.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home kitchen)

name: Go to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market to buy fresh vegetables
description: Xiulan put on her jacket, picked up her eco-friendly shopping bag, and rode her little electric bike from her home at No. 156 Jingwen Road. Heading west along Jingwen Road, she reached the familiar Wutong Commune Vegetable Market in less than 10 minutes. She went straight to Sister Sun Guifang's stall and greeted her with a smile. She carefully selected 10 jin of tender cucumbers with blossoms and prickles, 5 jin of green beans, and 3 jin of red peppers with thin skins and thick flesh. Sister Sun weighed them while chatting about how lively yesterday's Mid-Autumn Festival was. Xiulan asked if she had any fresh old ginger and purple-skinned garlic. Sister Sun dug out a few pieces from the basket and threw in some scallions as a bonus. In total, she spent less than 40 yuan.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, at the intersection of Shengli Street and Beiwei Third Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Visited parents along the way.
description: After leaving the vegetable market, Xiulan didn't go straight home. She turned west on her electric bike and went to her parents' home at 45 Shengli Street. Carrying a few leftover mooncakes from yesterday and some homemade dried fruit, she called out "Dad, Mom" as soon as she entered. She sat on the living room sofa with her parents and chatted for more than ten minutes, asking whether they had slept well last night and telling them about her plan to make pickled vegetables today. Her parents both praised her for being capable.
location: 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin (parents' home)

name: Return home to put materials away
description: Xiulan left her parents' home and rode back home in five minutes. She took the vegetables to the tap in the courtyard and began scrubbing them carefully. Meanwhile, she called to her husband Zhiqiang to carry out the 30 small glass jars that had gathered a layer of dust in the storage room, and to find the red label paper, red string, and printed cotton cloth she had bought earlier. Zhiqiang then began wiping the glass jars with an old towel.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home kitchen and courtyard)

name: Batch-making commemorative packaged pickles.
description: The kitchen was bustling. Xiulan tied on an apron and cut the washed cucumbers and green beans into long strips and the chilies into rings. Strictly following the old recipe handed down from her father, she mixed a large basin of secret sauce with salt, sugar, light soy sauce, aged vinegar, Sichuan pepper, star anise, and other seasonings. After finishing his homework, her eldest son Mingxuan found a dry cloth and carefully wiped the inside and outside of each glass jar; her second son Mingzhe was like a little spinning top, handing over jars one moment and red string the next. Her youngest daughter Yuxin sat on a small stool nearby, using her little hands to help her father sort out the scattered red string.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home kitchen)

name: Preparing a simple lunch
description: Seeing that it was almost noon, Zhiqiang took Mingzhe and Yuxin for a walk in the neighborhood. Xiulan stopped her work, opened the fridge, took out some leftover dishes from last night (braised pork belly, stir-fried bok choy) and reheated them, then cooked a big pot of dried noodles and made a soup base with a little soy sauce and sesame oil. Having been busy all morning, she wanted to keep lunch simple.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home kitchen)

name: Simple family lunch
description: Zhiqiang came back with the children, and the family sat around the dining table. On the table were reheated leftovers and freshly cooked fine dried noodles. While eating the noodles, Xiulan said, 'Let's just have a simple meal at noon today; once the pickles are made, we'll have a proper dinner in the evening!' As they ate, the children chattered about the fun things they did helping in the morning.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home dining room)

name: Lunch break and online search
description: Xiulan cleared away the dishes, felt a slight ache in her back, and sat down on the living room sofa. She took out her phone and, as agreed with Zhiqiang yesterday, opened the Pinduoduo shopping app, searched for "small clay pots wholesale", carefully compared the specifications, prices, and shipping costs of several shops, and sent online messages to two factories that seemed reliable, asking whether they could customize the LOGO and the minimum order quantity. After finishing this, she saw a WeChat message from her childhood friend Sister Chunmei, and replied that the pickled vegetables would be fully ready in the afternoon and she would send photos then. After that, she went back to the master bedroom and lay down for 20 minutes, taking a light nap.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home living room and master bedroom)

name: Continued and completed pickle making
description: After waking from her nap, Xiulan was full of energy and continued working in the kitchen. She used a slotted spoon to scoop out the pickled vegetables, drained them, and layered them into smooth glass jars, then poured in the prepared sauce, making sure it covered the ingredients. After each jar was filled, Xiulan tightened the lid and asked Mingzhe to hand her a red label. She wrote 'Beijing Memories' and the date on it with her own marker, and then Zhiqiang tied the label around the jar's neck with red string. At 4:30 p.m., all 30 jars were finished and sealed, neatly lined up on the kitchen counter.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home kitchen)

name: Tidy up the kitchen and display the results.
description: Xiulan looked at rows of bright red pickled vegetable jars tied with red string, and her heart was filled with joy. She first wiped the soy sauce stains off the stove with a damp cloth, then cleaned up the water stains on the floor. Finally, she took out her phone, found a few nice angles, took some “family portrait” photos of the pickles, and immediately sent them to Sister Chunmei with the message: “30 jars, done! Take a look!”
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home kitchen)

name: Short rest and family interaction
description: Just as she finished tidying up, her youngest daughter Yuxin ran in from outside, grabbed her hand, and insisted on going to the yard to see the pomegranate tree. Xiulan took her daughter's hand and walked around the yard, looking at the newly grown bok choy in the vegetable plot, then looking up at the pomegranates hanging on the tree, feeling especially happy.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home courtyard)

name: Prepare dinner
description: Xiulan returned to the kitchen and started preparing dinner. Zhiqiang had said at noon that he wanted noodles with gravy, so Xiulan diced some pork belly, soaked wood ear mushrooms and day lily flowers, and stir-fried a fragrant gravy. She also boiled a pot of hand-rolled noodles. She additionally opened a jar of freshly made pickled vegetables, picked out some cucumbers and green beans, and put them in a small dish as an appetizer.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home kitchen)

name: The entire family enjoys dinner.
description: Dinner was served, with noodles, gravy sauce, and newly pickled vegetables. The noodles were chewy, the sauce savory, and the pickles crisp. The whole family enjoyed the meal. At the table, Zhiqiang kept praising Xiulan for being resourceful and capable. The children also chattered about how it felt to help out today, feeling that they had also contributed to the family. The atmosphere was wonderful.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home dining room)

name: Evening family relaxation.
description: After the meal, Xiulan and Zhiqiang cleaned up the dishes and chopsticks together. The whole family was in the living room; the children turned on the TV to watch cartoons, while Xiulan and Zhiqiang sat on the sofa, quietly discussing things as they watched the news. Zhiqiang said, “Ask about those clay jars. If the price is right, we’ll order a batch and make the packaging more presentable. It might really work.” Xiulan nodded, mentally calculating the costs: vegetables and seasonings cost about 50 yuan, the bottles were old ones from home, red string and labels cost less than 5 yuan, so the total cost of 30 jars could be kept within 55 yuan. She and Zhiqiang had a preliminary discussion, and the price could be set at 10 yuan per jar, or 15 yuan for two jars.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home living room)

name: Accompanying and taking care of the children
description: After watching the cartoon, Xiulan got up, ran hot water in the bathroom, coaxed her little daughter Yuxin into a bath, changed her into clean pajamas, and told her two bedtime stories until she fell asleep. Then she went to her two sons' room, checked Mingzhe's holiday homework, reminded Mingxuan that he could preview his lessons a bit tomorrow, and urged them to wash up.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (various rooms in the home)

name: Personal relaxation before going to bed.
description: The children were all asleep, and the house quieted down. Xiulan returned to the living room, spread a yoga mat on the floor, and seriously did 10 minutes of waist and back stretches to relieve the soreness from standing all day. After finishing, she went to the bathroom, got some hot water, and comfortably soaked her feet for 15 minutes. While soaking her feet, she picked up her phone, called her mother, and said goodnight.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (living room and master bedroom bathroom at home)

name: Bedtime conversation and bookkeeping
description: Xiulan returned to the bedroom; Zhiqiang was still awake. Leaning against the headboard, the two talked again about the pickled vegetables. Xiulan took out a small notebook and a calculator, figured out today's vegetable costs and the previous material costs item by item, and recorded them in the ledger. She then showed Zhiqiang the preliminary cost and pricing plan. Both felt that as long as Chunmei helped promote it, these 30 jars should not be difficult to sell. They talked until 10:30. Xiulan yawned, Zhiqiang turned off the lamp, and the two fell fast asleep in each other's arms.
location: Tianjin, Jinghai District, 156 Jingwen Road (master bedroom at home)

name: Morning routine: getting up, washing up, morning exercise, breakfast, and checking messages
description: At 6:30 a.m., Xiulan woke up naturally, folded the quilt simply, and washed her face in the bathroom to refresh herself. She then changed into loose loungewear, walked slowly in the front yard for twenty minutes while admiring the roses, pulled up weeds, and did a set of Baduanjin and shoulder-neck stretches under the pomegranate tree. After exercising, she returned to the kitchen, warmed milk, and had Daoxiangcun pastries for breakfast while checking her phone messages. She saw a message from her childhood friend Liu Chunmei about photos and a message from the ceramics manufacturer.
location: Home and front courtyard at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Send the youngest daughter to school.
description: Xiulan helped her youngest daughter Yuxin pack her schoolbag and insulated water bottle, then rode her e-bike to take her to school. On the way, she bought Yuxin an egg pancake at the breakfast stall by the community gate, then took her to Huakang First Kindergarten and only left after watching the teacher take her through the school gate.
location: Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin (Diwei Road)

name: On the way back, pick up packages and buy groceries
description: On the way back from the kindergarten, Xiulan first went to the Wutong Commune vegetable market. At Sun Guifang's stall, she bought baby bok choy, cucumbers, and tomatoes, and Aunt Sun gave her a bunch of cilantro. Then she went to the package pickup point at the market entrance to collect a parcel for Wang Guilan, her neighbor across the hall, before riding her electric bike home.
location: Wutong Community vegetable market on Tuanjing Road and its surroundings, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Tidying up items, writing travel cards, and wrapping
description: After returning home, Xiulan washed the bought vegetables and drained them, moved the thirty sealed jars of "Beijing Travel Souvenir Edition" pickled vegetables to the dining table, and prepared labels, red string, and a pen. Starting at 8:50, she concentrated on handwriting thirty small travel souvenir cards, recalling the details of her trip to Beijing and writing messages such as "the solemnity and joy brought back from Tiananmen." After finishing, she tied the cards around the jar mouths, stuck on red labels, and completed the packaging of all the souvenir jars.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare pickled side dishes for lunch and contact the manufacturer.
description: After moving the packed jars of pickled vegetables into the cabinet, Xiulan returned to the kitchen, checked her phone, and replied to a message from the customer service of Tangshan Xiangyun Ceramics about printing text on the jar bottoms. They told her the minimum order was 500 and each jar would cost an extra 0.3 yuan. She decided to order 200 samples first, left her home address, and waited for their reply. Then she quickly pickled a small lunchtime side dish.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Light lunch
description: Alone at home, Xiulan cooked herself a pot of plain noodles in clear broth, using last night's chicken soup as the base, and adding fresh greens from her own small yard and newly made pickled vegetables. Simple, yet warming and comforting.
location: Kitchen and dining room of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Noon break and phone browsing
description: After the meal, Xiulan leaned against the headboard and scrolled through short videos for twenty minutes, watching some cooking and handicraft tutorials. Then she set an alarm and took a forty-minute nap, fully resting.
location: Master bedroom of the home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Organized travel photos and prepared content to share
description: After her nap, Xiulan felt refreshed. She sat on the living room sofa, opened the photo album on her phone to organize the Beijing travel photos, and in order of the tour created folders such as "Group Photo in Front of Tian'anmen", "In-Depth Tour of the Palace Museum", "Viewing the Capital from Jingshan Hilltop", and "The Bustle of Hutong Life". She selected more than fifty photos and thought about what to tell her sister in the evening.
location: Sofa in the living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Household chores: washing, drying and organizing
description: Taking advantage of the afternoon sun, Xiulan washed the leftover jars and bottles from yesterday's pickle making, drained and stored them, then went to the backyard to tend the small vegetable garden. She picked okra, watered the baby bok choy, pruned the dead rose branches, and got some exercise at the same time.
location: Kitchen and backyard at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Prepare to pick up the child from school, and on the way, take a walk and buy groceries.
description: At 3:15 p.m., Xiulan put on her coat, rode her electric bike first to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up her younger daughter Yuxin, and then waited at the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School for her second son Mingzhe to finish school. After picking up the two children, she did not go straight home. On the way, she stopped at Wutong Commune Vegetable Market and bought a live crucian carp as the ingredient for the crucian carp and tofu soup for dinner, then took the children home.
location: Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School; Wutong Commune Vegetable Market

name: Prepare dinner and communicate with the children
description: After arriving home, Mingzhe took his younger sister to do homework in the living room, while Xiulan was busy in the kitchen preparing dinner. She cleaned the fish and chopped vegetables, meanwhile asking from the other room about the children's schoolwork. Tonight's menu was crucian carp and tofu soup, minced pork with green beans, tomato and egg stir-fry, and cucumber salad.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Communicating with my eldest son during dinner.
description: When the eldest son, Mingxuan, came home from school, the family of four sat around the table. Xiulan served everyone crucian carp and tofu soup. She asked the children how things were at school. Mingxuan shared that his work as the physics class representative was going smoothly, Mingzhe got a perfect score on his math quiz, and Yuxin learned a new children's song. The family atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tidy up the kitchen
description: After dinner, the children each went to do homework or play. Xiulan cleared the dishes and chopsticks, wiped down the stove, wrapped the leftovers in plastic wrap, put them in the refrigerator, and restored the kitchen to order.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Video-called my younger sister to share travel stories.
description: In the bedroom, Xiulan chatted with her younger sister Xiufen, who lives in Binhai New Area, over a WeChat video call. Using screen sharing, she played the Beijing photos she had organized in the afternoon one by one, vividly describing what she had seen at Tiananmen, the Forbidden City, and Jingshan. Xiufen praised them repeatedly. The sisters finally settled on a plan for both families to travel together next summer to Beidaihe or Qingdao, and reminded each other to take care of their health.
location: Master bedroom of the home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Recorded the outing plan, soothed the youngest daughter to sleep, and checked homework.
description: After hanging up the video call, Xiulan jotted down the preliminary plan for the two families' trip next summer vacation in her little notebook. Then she went to her daughter's room and told Yuxin two bedtime stories, "Little Horse Crosses the River" and "The Tortoise and the Hare," and watched her daughter fall asleep. Then she went to the living room to check Mingzhe's math homework, guided him to correct a word problem, and told her eldest son, Mingxuan, to rest early.
location: Master bedroom, children's room, and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Personal washing up and relaxation
description: Xiulan took a comfortable hot bath, cleansed her face with facial cleanser, and patted on moisturizing toner. She changed into clean pajamas, leaned against the headboard, and scrolled through her phone for a while, checking her Moments feed. Not seeing any photos from Chunmei, she thought she would remind her tomorrow.
location: Bathroom and master bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Recording before bed, reading, and falling asleep
description: Before bed, Xiulan wrote tomorrow's to-do list in her notebook: urge Chunmei to post on Moments, wait for the manufacturer's sample reply, deliver pickles to her parents, and buy yarn to knit a scarf for her husband. Then she turned off the light, picked up Dream of the Red Chamber from the nightstand, read for about twenty minutes, put the book down as drowsiness came over her, and fell asleep peacefully.
location: On the bed in the master bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Getting up, morning exercise, and breakfast preparation
description: At 6:30 in the morning, Ma Xiulan got up quietly, stretched on the bedroom floor, then went to the courtyard and did a set of Baduanjin in the morning light. Before 7 o'clock, she returned to the kitchen, tied on an apron, took the soaked millet and mung beans from the fridge to cook porridge, steamed buns and eggs, and put out a dish of her own pickled crispy radish peel.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Woke the children and had breakfast together.
description: When the porridge was ready, Ma Xiulan went upstairs to wake Ma Mingzhe and Ma Yuxin, helped Yuxin braid her hair into pigtails, and urged Mingzhe to wash up. At 7:10, the three sat around the small square table for breakfast. While eating, she reminded Mingzhe to bring his math test paper and broke up a steamed bun with fermented bean curd for Yuxin.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Take the child to school and buy groceries along the way.
description: Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike with the two children, first taking Mingzhe to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, then taking Yuxin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten. Afterwards, she went to Wutong Commune Market and bought crisp radishes, celery, old ginger, and front leg pork from Sister Sun Guifang's stall to make dumplings.
location: Home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School on Shengli South Street, Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Wutong Community Vegetable Market, then return home

name: Putting things away and light housework
description: After arriving home, Ma Xiulan sorted the vegetables into baskets and refrigerated the ground meat for later use; started the washing machine to wash clothes, wiped the living room coffee table, TV cabinet, and windowsills, and gathered up the picture books and toys on the sofa.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Signing up for elderly care volunteer service at the community center
description: Ma Xiulan walked to the Jingwen Road Community Service Center and signed up with the staff member Sister Wang for the Double Ninth Festival elderly care volunteer service. Sister Wang registered her information and told her the service time was 9 a.m. on October 11, visiting two elderly people living alone. Ma Xiulan noted down the addresses and planned to bring her homemade low-salt pickles.
location: Jinghai District Chaoyang Street Community Health Service Center, No. 16 Jingwen Road, Tianjin (Jingwen Road Community Service Center)

name: Making low-salt pickled vegetables and organizing home-visit supplies
description: After returning from the community center, Ma Xiulan went to the small vegetable garden in the backyard, cut cucumbers and chili peppers, pulled up white radishes, washed and drained them, and cut them diagonally into strips. Using a low-salt recipe, she mixed a dressing with Sichuan peppercorns, rock sugar, and light soy sauce, tossed the strips in it, and packed them into 10 glass jars. She tied red-string cards reading "May you enjoy peace and health on the Double Ninth Festival — respectfully presented by Ma Xiulan" to the jars, and prepared cloth bags containing rags, trash bags, and rubber gloves for her visits.
location: Kitchen and courtyard at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Simple lunch
description: Ma Xiulan cooked a handful of dried noodles in the leftover tomato and egg soup, sprinkled scallions on top, and ate this simple meal quietly by herself with the newly made pickled vegetables.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Noon break
description: After lunch, Ma Xiulan set an alarm for 1:10 p.m., lay down in the bedroom to rest. Thinking about the pickled vegetables she had made and the plan for the Double Ninth Festival, she felt a sense of fulfillment and soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Organizing photos, handling miscellaneous tasks, and contacting the manufacturer
description: After getting up from her afternoon nap and washing her face, Ma Xiulan sat on the living room sofa and sorted the National Day Beijing trip photos by date. Then she sent a voice message to her childhood friend Liu Chunmei, asking her to help promote the Beijing Travel Souvenir Pack pickled vegetables. She also called Tangshan Xiangyun Pottery Factory, learned that the samples were already on the way, and reminded them to watch for the delivery.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Deliver pickled vegetables to parents and buy yarn on the way.
description: Ma Xiulan brought a jar of low-salt pickled vegetables and Beijing-style preserved fruit, and rode her electric bike to 45 Shengli Street to visit her parents. Her mother, Li Xiuying, was airing quilts. She told the elderly woman that the low-salt pickles were safe to eat, chatted with her for about ten minutes, then took her leave. On the way back, she bought one jin of dark gray medium-weight yarn at Boya Stationery Store on Jianshe Road, planning to knit scarves for the children.
location: Parents' home at 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin; passing Boya Stationery Store on Jianshe Road, Jinghai District.

name: Prepare ingredients for dinner
description: After getting home, Ma Xiulan washed the front leg pork, cut it into pieces, and ground it into filling. She added minced scallion and ginger, light soy sauce, sesame oil, and Sichuan peppercorn water, and stirred it vigorously until it became springy. She chopped the cabbage, squeezed out the water, and mixed it into the meat filling. Then she kneaded dough with warm water and let it rest, preparing to make dumplings.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the child from school
description: At 3:10 in the afternoon, Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up her youngest daughter Yuxin, then went to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up her second son Mingzhe. On the way home, the two children shared funny stories from school. After getting home, Ma Xiulan washed their hands and brought out dried fruit and warm water as a snack.
location: Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin, Jinghai District Third Primary School on Shengli South Street, to home at 156 Jingwen Road

name: Supervising the children's homework and making dumplings.
description: Ma Xiulan told Mingzhe to do his homework at the coffee table in the living room, and Yuxin to draw beside him. In the dining room, she kept an eye on the children while pulling off dough pieces, rolling out wrappers, and wrapping dumplings, pinching neat and even pleats. During this time, she looked up to remind Mingzhe about his sitting posture, and when he had math problems he didn't understand, she patiently drew diagrams to explain.
location: Living room and dining room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Boiling dumplings, family dinner, and contacting her husband
description: When her oldest son Mingxuan came home from school, the dumplings had just been wrapped. Ma Xiulan boiled the dumplings, and the kitchen was filled with aroma. At dinner, the family of four sat together, and the children competed to eat dumplings. She dialed her husband Ma Zhiqiang on a video call and put it on speaker. The children vied to talk, and Zhiqiang told her not to work too hard, saying he would be home in a couple of days.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tidy up the kitchen and wash dishes
description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan asked Mingxuan to help clear the dishes. She put on an apron and washed the pots and dishes, carefully wiping down the stove and countertops; Mingxuan wiped the dining table clean and put the leftover dumplings in a storage container in the refrigerator.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The whole family took a walk along Jingwen Road
description: After tidying up, Ma Xiulan suggested going for a walk. The family of four changed into jackets and strolled slowly along the sidewalk on Jingwen Road. The autumn night was slightly cool, streetlights stretched their shadows, the two younger children chased and played, and Mingxuan walked beside his mother, talking about interesting experiments from physics class.
location: Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (departed from 156 Jingwen Road, walked along the road, and returned)

name: Evening chores and parent-child time
description: After returning from the walk, Ma Xiulan first helped Yuxin take a bath and change into pajamas, and told the bedtime story 'Little Rabbit Be Good' to put her to sleep. Then she checked Mingzhe's Chinese homework, corrected wrong characters, and reminded him to bring his watercolor pens. Passing Mingxuan's room and seeing him memorizing vocabulary words, she quietly closed the door.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Personal washing up, knitting a scarf, bookkeeping and planning
description: After the children quieted down, Ma Xiulan took a hot bath, changed into clean pajamas, sat in the living room to brew tea, took out dark gray yarn, and cast on to knit a scarf. More than half an hour later, she put down the yarn, took out her ledger to record today's expenses such as buying vegetables and yarn, and wrote down tomorrow's to-dos: ask about samples from the pottery jar factory and deal with the leftover dumpling filling.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Chatting on the phone with mother and getting ready for bed
description: At 9:30 p.m., Ma Xiulan called her mother Li Xiuying and chatted about how the pickled vegetables she had sent today tasted great and that her father loved them too, and she felt very pleased. After hanging up, she checked the doors, windows and gas, turned off the lights, set the alarm for the next morning, and lay down to rest at ease.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Get up in the morning, take the children to school, and buy groceries
description: After getting up at 6 in the morning, she did some simple neck and shoulder stretches and morning exercises. After washing up, she had lotus root starch and steamed buns for breakfast. Then she woke up her second son Mingzhe and her younger daughter Yuxin, heated millet porridge, boiled eggs, and pan-fried stuffed pancakes for them, urged them to wash up, and helped Yuxin braid her hair. At 7:10 she took Mingzhe to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School by electric bike, then took Yuxin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten. Finally, on the way, she stopped by the Wutong Commune vegetable market and bought pork ribs, greens, and scallions, ginger, and garlic for dinner from the familiar Aunt Sun's stall.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (home) and the schools and vegetable markets along the way

name: Organize and sell pickled vegetables online.
description: After dropping off the children and buying groceries, she returned home, sorted and put away the vegetables, blanched the spare ribs and refrigerated them. Then she organized 30 jars of "Beijing Travel Souvenir Edition" pickled vegetables, arranged them neatly on the living room coffee table, and prepared a USB drive and phone. At 8:30 she carefully composed a Moments post, published the pickled vegetable sales information, and contacted her childhood friend Liu Chunmei to help forward it in community groups. After the message went out, orders came one after another, and all 30 jars sold out within two hours. While replying to customer messages and tallying orders and profits, she found that this batch of souvenir edition pickled vegetables had a profit 30% higher than usual, and she felt very happy.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (Home)

name: Developing photos and supermarket shopping
description: She rode her electric bicycle to Yuanyuan Bookstore Stationery, Photo and Copy Shop and asked to print 60 6-inch photos, reminding them not to crop them. While waiting for the prints, she went to Jingbai Supermarket across the street and bought a bottle of soy sauce and a bottle of vinegar. After picking up the photos, she rode home, carefully put the photos into a paper bag, and planned to make a family album with the children on the weekend.
