location: Yuanyuan Bookstore Stationery, Photo & Copy Shop (Jinghai Branch) and Jingbai Supermarket (near Jingwen Road), Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Simple lunch
description: At home alone, she boiled frozen dumplings and served them with homemade pickled vegetables for lunch.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (Home)

name: Afternoon rest and hand embroidery.
description: After lunch, she took a nap on the sofa. When she woke up, she organized the supplies she needed to bring for tomorrow's visit to elderly people living alone: a blood pressure monitor, rags, trash bags, and so on. Then she took out her unfinished embroidery and sat by the window sewing, while keeping an eye on her phone for follow-up messages about pickled vegetable orders.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (Home)

name: Community verification visits and buying stationery
description: Rode an electric bike to the Chaoyang Street Community Health Service Center in Jinghai District, found the grid worker Zheng Xiuying, confirmed the latest addresses, health conditions, and needs of the two elderly people living alone to be visited on the Double Ninth Festival tomorrow, and obtained a detailed visit list. After finishing, she stopped by Boya Stationery Store on the way to buy a math exercise book for Mingzhe and a cartoon pinyin notebook for Yuxin. Then she rode home, put things away, and rested a little.
location: Chaoyang Street Community Health Service Center (16 Jingwen Road), Jinghai District, Tianjin, China, and Boya Stationery Store (Jianshe Road)

name: Prepare dinner ingredients in advance
description: Using the free time before picking up the children, she went into the kitchen and began prepping. She washed and blanched the pork ribs, put them in the pressure cooker with scallion, ginger, and cooking wine to cook. She broke the broccoli into small florets and washed the tomatoes, setting them aside.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (Home)

name: Pick up the child from school
description: Riding the electric bike, she first went to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up Yuxin, then went to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up Mingzhe. The two children shared funny school stories on the back seat, chatting and laughing all the way home.
location: Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China, and Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School

name: Spending time with the children and cooking dinner.
description: After getting home, she washed some fruit for the children to tide them over. She tied on an apron and started stir-frying. She reduced the sauce on the pressure-cooker pork ribs, then stir-fried broccoli with minced garlic, and made tomato and egg drop soup.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (Home)

name: The whole family had dinner together.
description: The eldest son, Mingxuan, rode his bicycle home. Ma Xiulan served braised pork ribs, garlic broccoli, and tomato egg drop soup. The four of them, mother and children, sat around the table enjoying dinner, chatting while eating, in a warm atmosphere.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (Home)

name: Tidy up the kitchen
description: After dinner, she let the children play freely while she washed the dishes, wiped the stove, and disposed of the kitchen waste, leaving the kitchen spotlessly clean.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (Home)

name: Invite neighbors to join the elderly-respect visit
description: Went to next-door neighbor Wang Guilan's home and formally invited her to visit the elderly people living alone together tomorrow morning. The two agreed on a division of labor: Wang Guilan would be in charge of cleaning, and Ma Xiulan would be in charge of measuring blood pressure and delivering pickles. They agreed to meet in the hallway at 9 o'clock tomorrow morning.
location: No. 158 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (neighbor Wang Guilan's home)

name: Family evening interaction and outdoor walk
description: Back home, she sat in the living room peeling an apple for Yuxin while asking about the children's performance at school. She praised Mingzhe for scoring 90 in Chinese, checked Mingxuan's English homework and pointed out spelling mistakes, and listened to Yuxin sing a newly learned nursery rhyme. At 7 PM, she took the three children for a half-hour walk along Jingwen Road, enjoying quality family time.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (home) and along Jingwen Road.

name: Evening care and homework guidance.
description: After returning home from the walk, first give Yuxin a bath, read her a bedtime story, and coax her to sleep. Then check Mingzhe's math homework and urge him to pack his schoolbag. Finally, go upstairs and tell Mingxuan not to stay up late and to rest early.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (Home)

name: Personal relaxation and bedtime preparations.
description: Finally, she had some personal time. First she took a hot shower and relaxed with a warm eye mask and ear patches. Then she did cat-cow stretches and wall-supported waist twists to ease the soreness in her lower back. Next she soaked her feet and scrolled through short videos for a while. After soaking her feet, she sat at the head of the bed knitting a dark gray scarf for her husband, and took out her account book to record the day's expenses and pickled vegetable profits. Finally, she checked WeChat and replied to messages.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (Home)

name: Turned off the lights and went to sleep
description: At 10 p.m. she turned off the bedside lamp, set the alarm for 6 a.m. the next day, went over tomorrow's 9 a.m. plan to visit the elderly with Wang Guilan, and after confirming everything was correct, fell asleep peacefully.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (Home)

name: Morning tidy-up and photo export
description: Woke up at 6:30 in the morning, opened the curtains and saw that the sky outside was overcast. First she went to the second-floor bedroom and sorted in chronological order the 60 6-inch family photos (including the National Day trip to Beijing and the children's growth moments) that she had picked up from the digital printing shop the night before. Then she went downstairs to the study, opened the old laptop, plugged in the portable hard drive, and backed up and imported the photos from the phone and camera that would be needed today.
location: First-floor study and second-floor bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Stretching, preparing breakfast, waking the family, and having breakfast
description: While the photos were importing in the background, she did a few simple yoga stretches on the dining room floor. Then she took eggs, toast, and milk out of the fridge to prepare simple sandwiches and hot milk. At 7:10 she went upstairs to wake the children: the eldest, Mingxuan, had set his own alarm and got up quickly; the second child, Mingzhe, and little Yuxin stayed in bed a while longer and only got up after being coaxed. At 7:35 the whole family ate breakfast in the dining room, and as they ate, she reminded the children that although it was Saturday, Mom had important business in the morning, and told Mingxuan to keep an eye on his younger brother and sister and make sure they finished their homework.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Organize and inspect the supplies for the visit.
description: After the children were busy with their own things, she quickly cleared away the dishes and chopsticks. From the storage cabinet she took out the cloth bag prepared last night and counted the contents again: two jars of low-salt pickled vegetables, a portable blood pressure monitor, a clean rag, and a pack of garbage bags. She carefully checked the seals on the pickle jars, confirmed that the red string and the small card reading "Peace and health on the Double Ninth Festival" were intact, and then placed them on the entryway cabinet.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Met up with Sister Guilan and walked to Grandma Zhao's house
description: At almost 8:40, I grabbed my cloth bag and headed out. At the entrance of the corridor, I ran into my neighbor Sister Wang Guilan. We greeted each other and confirmed the division of labor again: she is responsible for cleaning, and I am responsible for taking blood pressure and delivering pickled vegetables. The two of us walked out of the community together, along the sidewalk of Jingwen Road to Building 16 where Grandma Zhao lives. The plane trees on both sides of the street had leaves in a mix of yellow and green, and the air carried a touch of autumn chill. We chatted about family matters as we walked.
location: From the entrance of Building 156, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to Building 16, Jingwen Road Community.

name: Visiting Grandma Zhao and Grandpa Li for the Double Ninth Festival to pay respects to the elderly.
description: First went to Grandma Zhao’s home at Room 102, Unit 3, Building 16, Jingwen Road Community. Grandma Zhao, 86, lives alone and was very happy to see us. We measured her blood pressure, and it was normal, and reminded her to take her medicine on time. Wang Guilan helped wipe the windows and clean the tables and chairs. When we handed her the prepared jar of pickled vegetables, Grandma Zhao took my hand, her eyes moist, and said, “You are closer to me than my own daughter.” We chatted with her for a while. Then we went to Uncle Li’s home at Room 301, Unit 2, Building 18 nearby. Uncle Li has a leg problem, so we helped tidy up the kitchen and living room. Wang Guilan carefully cleaned the floor, while I measured Uncle Li’s blood pressure and gave him some pickled vegetables. Uncle Li thanked us repeatedly, and we chatted with him for a while, reminding him to take care of his health.
location: Room 102, Unit 3, Building 16, Jingwen Road Community, Jinghai District, Tianjin; and Room 301, Unit 2, Building 18

name: Return home to rest and change cars.
description: After the visit, she parted with Sister Guilan downstairs at Building 18 and walked quickly home. Once home, she went to the kitchen, drank some water, and caught her breath. She took the electric bike key out of her bag, changed into her going-out coat, and prepared to ride the electric bike to her father's house.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Rode an electric bike to her father’s house.
description: She wheeled out the small electric bike, started from Jingwen Road, and headed north along Chaoyang Road. After passing two traffic lights, she arrived at her parents' building at No. 45 Shengli Street around 10:50.
location: From 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin to 45 Shengli Street

name: Cooked, ate, chatted, and cleaned up at her father's home.
description: After entering, she greeted her father Ma Jianguo and saw that he was in good spirits. Knowing that her father had poor teeth, she went straight to the kitchen to prepare lunch. The pork ribs had been bought by her mother yesterday. She skillfully blanched them to remove the smell, put them in the pressure cooker to stew, and took out eggs from the fridge to steam an egg custard. Half an hour later, the pork rib and winter melon soup was stewed until tender enough to fall off the bone, the egg custard was done, and she also stir-fried a light dish of garlic lettuce. At exactly 12 o'clock, the family sat together for lunch, and her father repeatedly praised the food for being just to his taste. After the meal, she sat with her father on the sofa and chatted about her morning visits to the elderly, which made him feel gratified. After her father began his afternoon nap, she cleared the dishes and wiped the kitchen clean.
location: Parents' home, 1st floor, No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Go to the community service center to register points, buy groceries, and return home.
description: After leaving her parents' home, she rode her e-bike to the community service station on Jingwen Road, found Zheng Xiuying, the grid worker in charge of volunteer activities, showed the records from the morning activity, and signed to confirm, completing the points registration for the Double Ninth Festival elderly-care service. She learned that at the end of the year the points could be exchanged for rice and cooking oil. After that, she stopped by the Wutong Commune vegetable market on the way and bought 2 fresh cabbages and 1.5 jin of pork at Aunt Sun Guifang's stall, plus some scallions and ginger. She arrived home at about 13:10 and carried the groceries into the kitchen.
location: Jingwen Road Community Service Station, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and Wutong Commune Vegetable Market

name: Resting in the courtyard, preparing ingredients for dumplings, doing housework and handcrafts, and organizing photos
description: Parked the electric bike, washed her hands and changed into home clothes, carried a small bamboo chair to sit under the grape trellis in the courtyard, brewed a cup of jasmine tea, and enjoyed the leisurely afternoon watching the roses and autumn chrysanthemums. After about half an hour, refreshed, she went into the kitchen to prepare the filling for the evening dumplings: she washed the cabbage, blanched it, chopped and squeezed it dry; minced the pork, added scallion and ginger, salt, soy sauce, and sesame oil, and stirred until the filling was well combined and springy; then kneaded the dough and let it rest. While the dough was resting, she took out yarn and knitted for a while on a scarf for her husband, and also went into the study to sort the photos imported that morning into the '2025 Family Album' folder by category: 'Beijing Trip', 'Daily Life', and 'Growth Records'. During this time she received a message from her childhood friend Liu Chunmei, saying that everyone on Moments had responded very well to the pickled vegetables, and some neighbors asked when they would be available again. She happily replied that it would be in a few days.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the child from school
description: After changing clothes, she got on her electric bike and went first to Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up her younger daughter Yuxin, then on the way went to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up her second son Mingzhe. When the two children saw their mother, they chattered about fun things at school, and Yuxin held up her handmade drawing to show her mother.
location: Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School

name: Making dumplings, having dinner, and cleaning up the kitchen as a family.
description: Back home, Yuxin and Mingzhe washed their hands and called the eldest, Mingxuan, to make dumplings together. They kneaded the rested dough into a long strip, cut it into small pieces, and rolled them into wrappers. Mingxuan and Mingzhe learned to wrap, and although some dumplings were a bit crooked, they were all enthusiastic. Yuxin was responsible for placing the wrapped dumplings on the dumpling tray. The family chatted and laughed in the kitchen. After the dumplings were wrapped, they boiled water and cooked them, serving with Laba vinegar and garlic paste. The children ate ravenously, saying over and over that Mom's dumplings were the best. After the meal, they cleared the dishes, scrubbed the pots, and wiped the table to restore the kitchen to neatness.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening walk with the family.
description: After dinner, I took the three children out for a walk, strolling slowly along the greenway beside Jingwen Road. When we passed the small square, we saw elderly people doing square dancing. The children chased and played ahead while I followed behind, feeling a simple yet happy life.
location: Riverside trail along Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Help children with schoolwork and tell stories
description: After the walk, she urged Mingzhe and Yuxin to start their weekend homework. Mingzhe came across a math problem he couldn't solve, so she explained it patiently. Yuxin drew a picture of Mom visiting the old lady in the morning, and she praised her for drawing well. Afterwards, she washed Yuxin up and told her the bedtime story 'Little Rabbit, Be Good' to lull her to sleep.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: After a video call with her husband, knitted a scarf and did bookkeeping
description: After the children were all settled, she sat on the sofa and made a video call to her husband Ma Zhiqiang, who was out on a long-distance driving trip. She chattered at length about everything she had done on the Double Ninth Festival: visiting the elderly, her father's condition, wrapping dumplings, and the children's studies. Her husband listened patiently and told her not to get too tired. They chatted for over ten minutes. After hanging up, she took out wool yarn and knitting needles and continued knitting the dark gray scarf, planning to have her husband take it with him on his next trip. At the same time, she was mentally calculating the day's expenses, and then she took out her account book and carefully recorded the costs of groceries and other things that day.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Went to bed after washing up.
description: Closed the ledger, went to the bathroom to wash up, cleanse her face, and apply skincare, then soaked her feet in hot water. Back in the bedroom, she set the alarm for 6:30 the next morning on her phone, casually picked up Dream of the Red Chamber from the bedside table, flipped a couple of pages, and her eyelids began to droop. At 22:00 sharp, she turned off the light and lay down, reviewing in her mind like a movie the busy but fulfilling day. Thinking about calling Chunmei tomorrow to discuss new pickle flavors, she fell into a deep sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: At 7 a.m., it was drizzling outside. Ma Xiulan woke from a peaceful sleep and felt her back and waist were relaxed. She got up, went to the kitchen to boil water, then washed up simply. Looking at the rainy scene outside the window, she thought that although it was raining today, she could do some of the accumulated tasks at home.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare breakfast and wake up the family
description: After boiling water, Ma Xiulan began preparing breakfast. She cooked millet porridge to warm the stomach, reheated the leftover meat buns from yesterday, and cut a plate of preserved fruit. Then she woke her eldest son Mingxuan, second son Mingzhe, and youngest daughter Yuxin one by one, and helped her daughter put on a coat. The family sat around the dining table to enjoy breakfast, and she told the children that they all needed to help pack up today.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Check the community bulletin board
description: After breakfast, Ma Xiulan cleared away the dishes, picked up her folding umbrella, and went out. She walked along Jingwen Road to the notice board outside the community service center. The photos from yesterday's Double Ninth Festival visits and the thank-you list had been posted. Seeing her name and the group photo with Grandma Zhao, a warm feeling rose in her heart, and she felt that volunteer service was very meaningful. After pausing for a moment in the rain, she went home in a good mood.
location: Bulletin board outside the Jingwen Road Community Service Center, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Organizing old photos.
description: After returning home from the bulletin board, Ma Xiulan began her long-planned photo organizing project. She carried several heavy old photo albums out of the cabinet and spread them on the large living room table. Her eldest son Mingxuan carefully removed the photos, while her second son Mingzhe and youngest daughter Yuxin sorted them by year and place. Ma Xiulan gently wiped the dust off each photo with a dry cloth, occasionally telling the children the stories behind them—for instance, one was taken when her husband first bought his e-bike, and another showed Yuxin taking her first steps. The living room was filled with warm memories. After more than two hours, over a thousand photos had been sorted, laying the groundwork for making the annual photo album.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing dumpling filling and kneading dough
description: After sorting the photos, Ma Xiulan began preparing lunch. She took fennel sprouts and pork out of the fridge, asked her eldest son Mingxuan to help trim and wash the vegetables, her second son Mingzhe to peel garlic, and her little daughter Yuxin to imitate dough kneading with a small basin and wooden spatula. Ma Xiulan skillfully chopped the fennel sprouts, mixed them with the minced pork and seasoning, and the aroma immediately filled the kitchen. Then she kneaded the dough and let it rest, everything proceeding in an orderly way.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Contacted the Tangshan pottery jar factory and had lunch
description: After the dough and filling were ready, Ma Xiulan let the children watch TV in the living room and called the Tangshan Xiangyun Pottery Factory she had contacted earlier. She politely asked about the delivery status of the pottery jar samples and pricing details. The other party replied that the samples had been sent and were expected to arrive tomorrow or the day after, and explained the minimum order quantity for custom logos and the price ranges for different sizes. Ma Xiulan carefully noted down the key information. After hanging up, she went to the kitchen and cooked tomato egg noodles as a simple lunch.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Lunch break
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan cleaned up the kitchen and, watching the rain still falling outside the window, felt a little tired. She sent the children back to their own rooms to read or take an afternoon nap, then leaned back on the sofa in the living room, closed her eyes, and rested for half an hour to recharge for the afternoon's plans.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Afternoon shopping
description: The rain had lightened a bit. Ma Xiulan put on her raincoat and rode her electric bike to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market. At the familiar stall of Aunt Sun Guifang, she bought some chives, tomatoes, green beans, and two jin of pork ribs, preparing for dinner and tomorrow's soup. Aunt Sun chatted with her for a bit and praised her for looking well.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Talking with the community grid worker.
description: Coming out of the vegetable market, Ma Xiulan rode past the community service center and happened to run into Sister Zheng Xiuying, the community grid worker. She stopped the bike, smiled, and greeted Sister Zheng. Sister Zheng told her that the volunteer service points for autumn had been registered and could be exchanged for rice, flour, oil, and other staples at the end of the year. She also mentioned that Granny Zhao and several other old sisters had jointly written a thank-you letter to the community, specifically thanking Ma Xiulan for the pickled vegetables she had brought. Hearing this, Ma Xiulan felt warm inside and said she would be available whenever needed.
location: Entrance to Jingwen Road Community Service Center, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Return trip and putting supplies away
description: After saying goodbye to Sister Zheng, Ma Xiulan rode her bike home. She first sorted the vegetables she had bought: chives and green beans went into the refrigerator, and the pork ribs were put in water to soak out the blood. Then she called the three children into the living room and announced the afternoon task: together they would clear out the old bookshelf cluttered with odds and ends and make room for a family reading corner. The children were all excited when they heard this.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Transforming the home reading corner
description: Ma Xiulan led the three children to the old bookshelf in the corner of the living room. She stood on a stool to clean the dust and clutter on the top shelf. The eldest son, Mingxuan, was responsible for moving the old books from the lower shelf and sorting them by size. The second son, Mingzhe, and the youngest daughter, Yuxin, wiped the shelves with wet cloths. The family divided the work and cooperated, and after more than an hour, they finally completely emptied and wiped the bookshelf clean. Discarded items were also put into trash bags, making preparations for setting up a family reading corner.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Making dumplings.
description: After tidying the bookshelf, Ma Xiulan brought the prepared dumpling filling and rested dough to the dining table. Her eldest son Mingxuan took the initiative to knead the dough; she taught her second son Mingzhe to roll out the wrappers; her youngest daughter Yuxin wrapped them crookedly but very seriously, producing several dumplings shaped like little buns. The family chatted as they wrapped. Ma Xiulan mentally planned to buy some small cushions and a desk lamp once the weather improved, to make the bookshelf area cozier.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Cook dumplings and dinner
description: After the dumplings were wrapped, Ma Xiulan went to the kitchen to boil water and cook them. Once the water boiled, plump white dumplings tumbled around in the pot. She filled a full bowl for the children but took only a few for herself. At the dinner table, the whole family ate the fennel sprout dumplings they had made by hand and chatted about the fun of sorting photos and tidying bookshelves during the day, filling the atmosphere with warmth and joy.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening leisure and housework
description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan cleared the dishes and let the children watch cartoons in the living room. She then neatly folded the clothes they would wear to school the next day and placed them by each child's bed, and checked their schoolbags to confirm homework and stationery were all there. After that, she washed the pork ribs she had bought, blanched them to remove the scum, and marinated them with ginger slices and cooking wine, preparing dinner for the next day.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Indoor exercise
description: The children went back to their rooms to read. Ma Xiulan laid out a yoga mat in the living room and first followed a video on her phone to do a set of Baduanjin. Her movements were slow and well-executed, and she felt her whole body's qi and blood flow. Then she did 10 minutes of waist and back stretching to ease the fatigue from a day of bending over to clean and wrapping dumplings. It was still raining outside, but she felt warm all over.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Video call with mother.
description: After finishing her exercise, Ma Xiulan sat down and drank a glass of warm water, then picked up her phone and made a video call to her mother Li Xiuying, who lives on Shengli Street. On the other end, her mother was watching TV with her father. Ma Xiulan shared the fun of tidying photos today and her joy at being praised by the community. Her mother told her to be careful not to catch a cold on rainy days and to take care of herself and the children. The mother and daughter chatted for more than ten minutes, and both felt reassured.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pre-sleep preparation.
description: After hanging up the phone, Ma Xiulan urged her younger daughter Yuxin to wash up, helped her change into pajamas, then went to check on Mingzhe and Mingxuan and told them to go to bed on time. She herself then took a hot shower and relaxed her eyes with a heated eye mask.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Organizing records and making plans
description: After the children fell asleep, the house became quiet. Ma Xiulan sat at the desk in the bedroom, took out her account book, and recorded the 35 yuan spent on groceries at the market today. She also wrote a memo: contact the Tangshan pottery jar factory, samples are in transit. Looking at the thick stack of old photos she had sorted out, she planned to buy a photo album tomorrow and start making the annual album, and thought that if the weather was good on the weekend, she would go choose a small side table for the bookshelf.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Going to bed
description: At exactly 22:00, Ma Xiulan checked the doors and windows, turned off the living room light, and lay down in bed. Recalling the fulfilling and warm day—the company of family, the recognition of the community, and the family reading corner that was about to take shape—she smiled, listened to the rain outside gradually stopping, and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Get up early, wake the children, and prepare breakfast.
description: At 6:30 in the morning the alarm went off, and Ma Xiulan felt that the discomfort in her lower back from yesterday had basically gone. She did a few minutes of gentle cat stretch and waist twists in bed to loosen up. After washing up, she went into the kitchen, cooked millet pumpkin porridge, fried a dozen or so frozen pork-and-cabbage dumplings on an electric griddle, and made a plate of smashed cucumbers with garlic, preparing breakfast for the family.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home kitchen and bedroom)

name: Woke up the children and had breakfast together.
description: At 7:10, Ma Xiulan woke the children one by one. Her eldest son Ma Mingxuan had already gotten up by himself and was doing morning reading, which made her feel pleased. The family sat at the table for breakfast, and Xiulan urged the children to eat plenty. After breakfast, she helped her little daughter Ma Yuxin check her schoolbag to make sure all her drawing markers were packed, added new pen refills to her second son Ma Mingzhe's pencil case, and retied his red scarf that he had left forgotten on the sofa.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home dining room)

name: Take the children to school.
description: At 7:55, Ma Xiulan rode her e-bike to first take Ma Mingzhe to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, watched him walk through the school gate, then took Ma Yuxin to Huakang First Kindergarten, handed her to the teacher, and told her to behave. The whole ride took about 20 minutes, plus the stops at the school gates, for a total of about half an hour.
location: Jinghai No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Shopping at the vegetable market, putting things away, and checking delivery tracking.
description: After dropping off the children, Ma Xiulan detoured to the Wutong Commune Vegetable Market on the way. At the familiar stall of Sun Guifang, she bought one jin and two liang of fine pork ribs, two purple onions, a bunch of baby bok choy, and a piece of ginger. Sister Sun also threw in some cilantro, and the two chatted a bit about everyday family matters. Then she rode her electric bike home before nine o'clock, put the vegetables away by category, and soaked the ribs in cold water. While resting on the sofa in the living room, she read the WeChat message her husband Ma Zhiqiang had sent at 3 a.m. to report that he was safe, and checked the delivery tracking, which showed the package from the Tangshan clay pot factory was expected to arrive tomorrow.

participant.name: Sun Guifang
participant.relation: Friend who is a vendor at the vegetable market

location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, at the ground-floor shops of Wutong Commune on Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; and home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Organized seasonal photos and recorded the potted plants' growth.
description: After resting, Ma Xiulan first went to the yard and took a photo of the fuchsia to record its mid-October blooming period, saving it to her phone's album. Then she returned to the living room, spread the dozens of photos sorted yesterday on the coffee table, removed a dozen or so blurry or duplicate ones, and classified the remaining photos into the four seasons—spring, summer, autumn, and winter—using binder clips and sticky notes. Midway, after sitting for a long time, she felt her waist stiffen, so she did about ten minutes of cat stretch and wall-supported waist twists by the sofa to relieve it.
location: Home courtyard and living room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Setting up a family reading corner.
description: After relaxing her waist, Ma Xiulan began arranging the old bookshelf that the children had cleaned yesterday. She brought out 20 books bought from a second-hand bookstore from the bedroom, sorted them by category such as novels, cookbooks, and life encyclopedia, and placed them on the lower shelves. On the top shelf, she carefully arranged souvenirs brought back from Beijing's Forbidden City: bookmarks, postcards from the Summer Palace, and a small copper gourd, creating a small family reading corner.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (in front of the bookshelf in the corner of the living room at home)

name: Lunch and midday break
description: At noon, Ma Xiulan cooked the frozen cabbage and pork dumplings made yesterday, and prepared a garlic-vinegar dipping sauce for lunch. After the meal, she cleared the dishes, set her phone to ring mode and put it on the nightstand so as not to miss the delivery driver's call, then set a half-hour alarm and took a short nap to let her body rest.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (kitchen and bedroom at home)

name: Buying a photo album and inquiring about community elderly-care points
description: After her lunch break, Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to Jingbai Supermarket on the ground floor of Yuzhou Zunfu and chose an A4-sized 6-inch loose-leaf photo album. Then she went to the Xinhuali Community Party-Mass Service Center on Jingwen Road, found the grid worker Zheng Xiuying, and consulted her about the elderly care points redemption rules. Sister Zheng warmly took out the redemption chart and told her that 50 points could be exchanged for a 5 kg bag of flour or a bottle of oil. After understanding clearly, she rode home and put the photo album and the points redemption chart on the living room table.
location: Jingbai Supermarket, Unit 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Xinhuali Community Party-Mass Service Center, 32 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Organizing the family photo album and unexpected lower back discomfort.
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan sat down and inserted the photos she had sorted in the morning into a new album one by one. At one point she wanted to move a jar of low-salt pickled vegetables given by neighbor Wang Guilan from the balcony to the kitchen. When she bent down to pick it up, she felt a sudden pain in the right side of her lower back. She immediately put the jar down, supported her waist, and slowly straightened up, realizing she had strained it. She lay down in the bedroom and did ten minutes of cat stretches and waist twists against the wall. After feeling some relief, she slowed down and finished inserting the remaining photos, completing an initial version of a new family annual album. Throughout the process, she kept an eye on her phone from time to time, waiting for the courier's call.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (living room and balcony at home).

name: Preparing dinner ingredients and picking up the children from school
description: Close to 4 p.m., Ma Xiulan went into the kitchen, blanched and washed the pork ribs she had bought in the morning, put them in an enamel soup pot, added ginger slices, scallion segments, and water, and simmered them over low heat. She also washed and cut the tomatoes and bok choy. At exactly 4 o'clock, she changed into a thick coat, protected her waist, and set off on her electric bike. She first picked up Ma Yuxin at Huakang First Kindergarten, then went with her to the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School and waited a while to pick up Ma Mingzhe after school. The two children chatted about funny school stories along the way, and the three rode home together. The whole trip took about fifty minutes.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home kitchen); Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Tianjin.

name: Parent-child book corner display and dinner cooking
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan had the children wash their hands and mysteriously showed off the transformed bookshelf. Ma Yuxin clapped happily when she saw the small gourd on the top shelf, and Ma Mingzhe excitedly flipped through the Journey to the West picture book. The three of them also looked through the newly completed family photo album together. Then Xiulan went back to the kitchen to cook: she made stir-fried tomatoes and eggs, garlic-flavored baby bok choy, and seasoned the simmered pork rib soup. During this time, her eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, came home from school by himself, and she told him to do his homework first, then set out the dishes.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (living room and kitchen at home)

name: Family dinner and conversation.
description: During dinner, the family sat around the table. The eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, took a sip of the pork rib soup and praised how fresh it was, making Ma Xiulan happy. She asked the children about their schoolwork. Ma Mingzhe said they would have a dictation of new characters tomorrow, and Ma Yuxin said her teacher praised her drawing. The family atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home dining room)

name: Post-meal chores and checking homework
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan quickly cleaned up the dishes, wiped the stove, and put the leftovers in the refrigerator. Then she checked the three children's homework one by one: she explained two wrong math problems about the volume of cones to Ma Mingxuan; checked Ma Mingzhe's dictation notebook and told him to memorize the new characters again; and sat beside Ma Yuxin, listening to her falteringly read the new text.
location: Tianjin, Jinghai District, 156 Jingwen Road (kitchen at home and children's rooms)

name: Video call with husband
description: After settling the children down, Ma Xiulan sat on the living room sofa and made a video call to her husband Ma Zhiqiang, who was out driving long-distance. She showed him the newly arranged reading corner and the completed family photo album, told him that her waist had been uncomfortable yesterday but was better today, and reminded him to drive safely. The two chatted about everyday matters for nearly half an hour before hanging up.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (living room sofa at home)

name: Evening lower back and waist stretching and bookkeeping record
description: After the call, Ma Xiulan went into the bedroom and did ten minutes of careful lower back stretches and relaxation exercises on the yoga mat, which basically relieved her waist discomfort. Then she took out her account book, recorded the day's expenses: groceries (spareribs 32 yuan, vegetables 15 yuan) and the photo album (28 yuan), and flipped through the new album, feeling content.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home bedroom)

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: Ma Xiulan urged the children to wash up and get into bed one after another, then she took a hot bath last and changed into her pajamas. Before going to sleep, she specially put a heat patch on her lower back, hoping to fully recover tomorrow.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home bathroom and bedroom).

name: Settling the children to sleep and going to bed myself
description: Ma Xiulan first told a bedtime story to her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin to lull her to sleep, then checked whether Ma Mingzhe's quilt was properly tucked in, and reminded her eldest son Ma Mingxuan not to read extracurricular books for too long. After the children quieted down, she turned off the light at nearly 10:30 and gradually fell asleep with memories of a fulfilling day with a few small twists and turns.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (bedrooms at home)

name: Getting up and stretching the back and waist
description: When the alarm rang, Ma Xiulan did not get up right away. Instead, she stayed in bed and did 5 minutes of lower back stretches, including knee-to-chest and torso twists, which eased the soreness left from moving the pickled vegetable jars the day before. She felt relaxed all over.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Preparing the family breakfast
description: After washing up, Ma Xiulan busied herself in the kitchen. She made the soft egg pancakes the children loved, chopped scallions, and heated milk. Knowing her husband would come home at noon for noodles with gravy, she deliberately mixed an extra piece of dough and let it rest.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The whole family had breakfast together
description: The family of five sat around the dining table eating breakfast. Ma Xiulan spread ketchup for her daughter, reminded her sons to pay attention in class, and her husband hurriedly finished three pieces of flatbread before saying he was going to Daqiuzhuang to pick up goods in the morning and would be back at noon. The oldest son ate quietly and went back to his room to pack his schoolbag.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Taking the children to school
description: Ma Xiulan pushed her electric bike, with her younger daughter on the rear seat and her second son riding his own bicycle alongside. She first went to the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School and watched her second son enter, then turned around and rode about 10 minutes to Huakang First Kindergarten, where she handed her daughter over to the teacher.
location: Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Shopping at the vegetable market.
description: After leaving the kindergarten, Ma Xiulan went to the Wutong Commune vegetable market. At the stall of her familiar Aunt Sun, she bought fresh pork belly, cucumbers, greens, and tomatoes, preparing for the midday noodles with gravy and the afternoon sugared tomatoes. She also asked Aunt Sun to keep an eye out for the local time-honored mung bean cake, to serve to Liu Chunmei the next day.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Received a letter of commendation from the community
description: Ma Xiulan had just reached her doorstep when she ran into Xiao Wang, a young woman from the neighborhood community committee, who came to deliver a letter of praise jointly written by three elderly people in the courtyard. She took the letter, felt a surge of warmth in her heart, and thanked her repeatedly. After going inside, she tucked the letter under the glass plate on the living room desk.
location: Home entrance, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Curated and organized family photos
description: Ma Xiulan brought out several large boxes of categorized photos, brewed a cup of chrysanthemum tea, and sat in a rattan chair by the window, carefully examining each photo one by one, recalling everyday moments such as a group photo at Tiananmen in Beijing, feeding giraffes at the zoo, and scenes outside her sister's building. In the end she selected the 100 most memorable photos and placed them in a new album, writing on the title page, 'Our Happy Times in 2025.'
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare lunch and eat it with her husband
description: Ma Xiulan went into the kitchen, rolled out the rested dough and cut it into noodles, diced the pork belly and stir-fried it with sweet bean paste to make a sauce, and served it with shredded cucumber and blanched bean sprouts. Her husband came home exactly at noon. The steaming noodles with sauce were brought to the table. The two ate and chatted about what they had seen and heard that morning, and Ma Xiulan told her husband that she had received a letter of praise.
location: Kitchen and dining room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Midday tidying and a short nap.
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan quickly cleared away the dishes and wiped down the stove, then found tape, scissors, and an empty photo frame and placed them on the living room coffee table to prepare for the afternoon. Taking advantage of the pleasant afternoon sunshine, she leaned back on the living room sofa and dozed for about twenty minutes to recharge.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Buying supplies at the supermarket and contacting a childhood friend
description: After waking from her afternoon nap, Ma Xiulan walked to Jingbai Supermarket. She picked out a plain glass plate for entertaining guests and bought a pack of dried goji berries. After returning home, she sat in the courtyard, basking in the sun, and sent voice messages on her phone to her childhood friend Liu Chunmei, agreeing that Chunmei would come over for a visit tomorrow afternoon.
location: Jingbai Supermarket, Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu, Jinghai District, Tianjin; courtyard of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Picking up children from school and making a family photo wall.
description: Ma Xiulan first rode her bike to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up her daughter, then went to the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up her son. After returning home, she and the two children selected photos and stuck them on the wall beside the desk, with the Tiananmen family photo in the center and zoo photos around it. After that, she took out colored pens and paper and worked with them to create a "Family Reading Pact", with her son writing the words and her daughter drawing pictures. They stuck it on the side of the bookshelf, and the children felt a great sense of accomplishment.
location: Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin; living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing dinner and contacting a childhood friend
description: Ma Xiulan let the children look through the new photo album in the living room while she picked vegetables and rinsed rice in the kitchen to prepare dinner. In between her busy work, she sent a WeChat message to her childhood friend Liu Chunmei, inviting her to come over tomorrow for tea and to try the newly pickled vegetables. Liu Chunmei readily agreed and said she would bring some freshly made osmanthus cake.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Warm family dinner
description: When the eldest son came home from school, the family of five sat around the table for dinner again. The second son and daughter vied to show their father and big brother the afternoon's creations: the photo wall and the 'Family Reading Pact.' Her husband praised them repeatedly, and the eldest son also smiled and nodded in approval. The dinner table was filled with laughter and cheerful talk.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tutoring children's homework and family activities
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan cleaned up and began to help the children with their homework. She sat with her eldest son, encouraging him to work through the geometry problems, checked her second son's pinyin homework, and her youngest daughter drew pictures nearby, saying she wanted to draw one called “Mom making pickles” to give to Aunt Chunmei.
location: Living room and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening personal leisure and preparations for receiving guests.
description: After the children washed up and went to bed, Ma Xiulan sat on the living room sofa and embroidered the daisy pattern she had just learned, enjoying some time alone. Then she went to the kitchen, found the dried osmanthus flowers for tomorrow's tea, washed and dried the newly bought glass dish, and happily made plans for the gathering with Chunmei the next day.
location: Living room and kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Stretching and rest before bed.
description: Before going to bed, Ma Xiulan stood by the bed and carefully did 5 minutes of lower back and spine stretches, dispelling the day's fatigue. Then she changed into her pajamas, lay down, thought back on the fulfilling day, and fell peacefully asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Morning preparations and school drop-off
description: After the alarm went off, Ma Xiulan did shoulder and neck stretches in bed, then washed up, cooked millet porridge, and made scallion egg pancakes. At 6:10 she woke her younger daughter Ma Yuxin, braided her hair, and they drank porridge and ate pancakes together. At 6:25 she walked Xinxin to Huakang First Kindergarten, then returned home.
location: From home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin to Huakang First Kindergarten (18 Huakang Road, Jinghai District), then back home

name: Morning exercises in the courtyard and autumn flower arranging
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan walked slowly in the yard to get some exercise, then used scissors to trim the blooming roses and arranged them in a celadon vase. Around 7 o'clock she practiced Baduanjin in the yard. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang woke up and saw the roses, praising them as more beautiful than those from a flower shop.
location: Home courtyard at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family breakfast and school drop-off
description: Ma Xiulan served the freshly made egg pancakes and cucumber salad, and had breakfast with her husband Ma Zhiqiang, eldest son Ma Mingxuan, and second son Ma Mingzhe. The children discussed The Book of Insects. After breakfast, Xuanxuan and Zhezhe walked to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School by themselves, and Zhiqiang went back to the room to catch up on sleep.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Finishing up sorting photos
description: After putting away the dishes and chopsticks, Ma Xiulan took the photos out of the cardboard box, made a final selection, sorted them into the four seasons—spring, summer, autumn, and winter—and placed them in storage boxes. She put a label reading '2025 Family Album' on them, and pulled out and threw away the overexposed photos that were unusable, completing the photo-organizing task.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing for an afternoon tea gathering
description: Ma Xiulan carried water to wipe down the stone table and stone stools in the courtyard and swept away fallen petals and leaves. She brewed rose tea in a blue-and-white porcelain loop-handled teapot and arranged dried osmanthus, low-salt pickled vegetables, and Beijing preserved fruit on plates. Then she went back indoors, took out her embroidery hoop, and continued practicing a new pattern with the wrapped-stitch technique.
location: Courtyard and interior of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Lunch and rest
description: Husband Ma Zhiqiang woke up. Ma Xiulan made two bowls of tomato-and-egg gravy noodles with tomatoes and scallions. The couple ate them at the small table in the kitchen with pickled vegetables. Ma Zhiqiang praised the noodles for being springy. After the meal, Ma Xiulan washed the dishes and chopsticks.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Noon break
description: After tidying the kitchen, Ma Xiulan set an alarm for 1 p.m. and lay on the bed in the bedroom for half an hour with her eyes closed to rest. Although she didn’t fall asleep, she felt refreshed.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Last-minute preparations before welcoming guests.
description: After the alarm went off, Ma Xiulan poured the brewed and cooled floral tea into a clear glass pot, set out a plate of osmanthus cakes and small forks for the preserved fruit. Then she sat on the sofa by the living room window and finished the embroidered daisy petals with neat stitches, waiting for her childhood friend Liu Chunmei to visit at 2:30.
location: Courtyard and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: A courtyard tea chat with her childhood friend Liu Chunmei
description: Liu Chunmei came to visit with osmanthus cakes, and Ma Xiulan welcomed her into the courtyard. The two sat down at the stone table in the yard, drank rose tea, tasted the osmanthus cakes, and showed each other their new embroidery works—Ma Xiulan's wrapped-stitch pattern and Chunmei's embroidered pouch. They talked about funny things the children had done and discussed setting up a stall at the community handicraft market next month. When she left, Ma Xiulan gave Chunmei a jar of homemade pickled vegetables.
location: Home courtyard at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the younger daughter from school
description: After seeing Chunmei off, Ma Xiulan walked to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin from school. She received Xinxin at the gate and walked home holding her little hand.
location: From home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin to Huakang First Kindergarten (18 Huakang Road, Jinghai District), then back home

name: Prepare dinner
description: After returning home, she let her youngest daughter Xinxin play with building blocks in the living room. Ma Xiulan tied on an apron, made soup with pork ribs and white radish, stir-fried garland chrysanthemum with minced garlic, mixed tofu with preserved eggs, and steamed rice in an electric pressure cooker.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner
description: At the dinner table, the family enjoyed pork rib and radish soup, stir-fried crown daisy, and century egg tofu. Ma Zhiqiang praised the soup for being well-flavored. As Ma Xiulan was putting food on Xinxin's plate, she announced that the first family reading activity would begin after dinner.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: First Family Reading Night and Recipe Discussion
description: After clearing the dining table, the whole family moved to the reading corner in the living room. Ma Xiulan held Xinxin and read the picture book "Guess How Much I Love You"; Ma Mingxuan read "Insect Records"; Ma Mingzhe looked at dinosaur picture books; Ma Zhiqiang put down his phone and read car books. While the children read quietly, Ma Xiulan whispered with her husband about next week's menu, deciding to eat more steamed fish and cold dishes and less fried food. She took out the oil and salt record sheet, pasted it on the refrigerator door, and suggested recording the amount of oil and salt used in each meal; her husband supported the idea.
location: Reading corner in the living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Washing up the children and getting them to sleep
description: After the reading session, Ma Xiulan first bathed her younger daughter Ma Yuxin, changed her into pajamas, and told her a story to coax her to sleep. Then she urged her eldest son Ma Mingxuan and second son Ma Mingzhe to take turns bathing and brushing their teeth until they were all in bed.
location: Home bathroom and children's room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Personal craft time.
description: After all the children had fallen asleep, Ma Xiulan sat on the living room sofa and picked up her embroidery hoop. After finishing the wrapped-stitch pattern from the daytime, she began practicing stitches on a new piece of cloth, enjoying the most relaxing craft time of the day.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Bedtime relaxation ritual
description: Ma Xiulan boiled water and poured it into a foot-soaking bucket, added dried mugwort and soaked her feet for 15 minutes, listening to local storytelling on her phone radio while soaking. After soaking, she dried her feet and got into bed, did 5 minutes of deep breathing, massaged the soles of her feet and her temples, turned off the light at 23:50 and fell asleep, ending the day with contentment and peace.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Getting up in the morning and taking youngest daughter to school
description: At 5:50, Ma Xiulan woke up and first did shoulder, neck, and lower back stretches in bed, feeling much more relaxed in her lower back. After washing up, she changed into home clothes and went to the kitchen, put the soaked soybeans into the soy milk maker and started it. At 6:10, she went to her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin's room, opened the curtains and gently woke her, helped her into her kindergarten uniform, and combed two little pigtails. At 6:25, she put a helmet on her daughter and rode an electric bike along Jingwen Road toward Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten. On the way, she ran into neighbor Wang Guilan and chatted briefly while waiting at a red light; Wang Guilan praised Xinxin's pigtails. At 6:50 they arrived at the kindergarten. Xiulan handed her daughter to the teacher and left only after watching her walk into the classroom.
location: At home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, then rode to Huakang First Kindergarten (Chaoyang Subdistrict, Jinghai District, Tianjin).

name: Morning Exercise in the Courtyard
description: At 7:00, she got home. Xiulan walked in the courtyard for ten minutes, checked how the roses and chrysanthemums were doing, pinched off yellow leaves, and watered the flowers. From 7:10, she practiced Baduanjin in the open space of the yard, moving slowly and breathing evenly. After the whole set, she felt her muscles and joints were fully loosened up.
location: Home courtyard at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Breakfast and taking the second son to school
description: At 7:40, Xiulan made soft egg pancakes, cut a plate of homemade pickles, and warmed milk and soy milk. She had breakfast with her husband Ma Zhiqiang, her eldest son Ma Mingxuan, and her second son Ma Mingzhe. Zhiqiang mentioned that he had short-distance hauling to do around Jinghai that day. Zhezhe excitedly told funny stories from PE class, and Xiulan reminded him to eat more slowly. At 8:20, Xuanxuan walked to middle school on his own. Xiulan rode her e-bike to take Zhezhe to the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, watched him enter the school gate, then returned home to clear the dishes and clean the kitchen.
location: From the home dining room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; then cycled to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin); then returned home.

name: Making a family photo album
description: At 8:50, Xiulan spread out a blank photo album and the developed autumn photos in the study, carefully selecting the 8 best-composed ones, including Fragrant Hills red leaves, the ginkgo trees of the Forbidden City, and shots of the children running. After repeatedly arranging them on the first two pages of the album, she fixed them with corner mounts and neatly wrote captions and dates such as 'Fragrant Hills Red Leaves, Autumn 2025' under each photo with a gel pen. Every so often she stood up and moved around, mindful of balancing work and rest.
location: Study at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Shopping, lunch, and midday rest
description: At 10:50, Xiulan rode her electric bike to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, found Aunt Sun, whom she knew well, and bought pork ribs and tender garlic sprouts. She also asked about the mung bean cake she had previously asked Aunt Sun to keep an eye out for; Aunt Sun said it had not arrived yet. Back home, she blanched the pork ribs and made soup with winter melon, and stir-fried garlic sprouts with eggs. Around 12:00, her husband Ma Zhiqiang came home for lunch. The two chatted about family matters while eating, and Zhiqiang encouraged her to go learn cooking in the afternoon. After the meal, Xiulan cleaned up the dishes, went back to the bedroom, leaned on the bed, looked at the family group chat, replied to her younger sister Xiufen's message, and then rested with her eyes closed for half an hour.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market (Wutong Commune, Chaoyang Subdistrict, Jinghai District, Tianjin), then returned home to No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Learn to cook low-fat dishes from my mother.
description: At 13:00, Xiulan took an empty lunch box and rode her electric bike along Jingwen Road, turned onto Shengli Street, and arrived at her mother Li Xiuying's home 15 minutes later. After exchanging pleasantries in the living room, Xiulan took out a small notebook, and her mother taught her hand by hand the techniques for removing the fishy smell and controlling the heat in steamed sea bass, for blanching broccoli with minced garlic and keeping it green, and a special dressing for cold black fungus salad. Xiulan took careful notes and did it herself. When it was done, they tasted the dishes together; the dishes were low in oil and salt yet delicious. Before leaving, her mother gave her a small bag of homemade dried radish.
location: 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin (at mother Li Xiuying’s home)

name: Pick the children up from school.
description: At 15:20 Xiulan left her mother's home and rode her electric bike to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten. She arrived a bit early, so she waited and chatted with other parents at the gate. After picking up her younger daughter Ma Yuxin at 16:10, she immediately rode with her to the gate of No. 3 Primary School in Jinghai District, just in time for her second son Ma Mingzhe to get out of school. As soon as the two children met, they chattered noisily. Xiulan rode them back along Shengli South Street to Jingwen Road, arriving home at 16:20.
location: Huakang First Kindergarten (Chaoyang Subdistrict, Jinghai District, Tianjin), Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin), then return to home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare a hearty dinner
description: At 16:20, after getting home, Xiulan put on an apron and began preparing dinner. She used the techniques she had learned that afternoon to prepare steamed sea bass, and also made garlic broccoli. She steamed egg custard for the children, stir-fried a dish of sliced pork with hot peppers that her husband Ma Zhiqiang loved, and cooked a pot of millet porridge. The kitchen filled with the aroma of cooking, and the home gradually became lively.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The whole family has dinner together
description: At 18:00, her husband Ma Zhiqiang got off work and came home. The family of five sat around the dining table. Xiulan pointed at the steamed sea bass and said she had just learned it from her mother. After tasting it, Zhiqiang praised the fish for being tender and fresh without any fishy smell. Xinxin scooped up the steamed egg custard with a spoon and ate it with great relish. The children took turns telling funny stories from school, and the table was full of laughter and cheerful chatter.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: After-dinner chores and getting ready for a walk
description: After dinner, Xiulan cleared the dishes and chopsticks into the kitchen. First she brought out a plate of fruit, told Ma Mingxuan and Ma Mingzhe to go do their homework, then asked Xinxin and Zhiqiang to come along, found a thin jacket for each person, and prepared the family for an autumn evening walk.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family evening walk in the autumn night
description: At 19:30, Xiulan called the whole family to go out. The autumn night was slightly chilly, and the streetlights on both sides of Jingwen Road were bright. The children ran and jumped ahead; Zhezhe picked up a plane tree leaf and asked his father to guess the tree name, while Xinxin pulled her mother and pointed at the stars asking questions. The couple walked behind, chatting about everyday life, enjoying the most pleasant forty minutes of the day.
location: Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening family time
description: After returning from the walk, Xiulan urged Xuanxuan and Zhezhe to continue finishing their homework, while she sat with Xinxin in the living room drawing. Only after the children had all finished did she go to the kitchen to wash dishes and wipe down the stove. Then she took out the two new pages of the photo album she had made that day and looked through them on the sofa, feeling a strong sense of accomplishment.
location: Living room and study at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening bedtime and relaxation.
description: At 21:00, Xiulan arranged for the children to wash up. She first bathed Xinxin and told her a bedtime story. After coaxing her to sleep, she urged Xuanxuan and Zhezhe, who were still reading, to brush their teeth and go to bed quickly. At 21:30, all three children were quietly asleep. Xiulan boiled a pot of hot water with mugwort to soak her feet, pressing the Hegu acupoint and taking deep breaths while reflecting on the fullness of the day. Then she did lower back stretching, changed into her pajamas, and lay down in bed. She picked up her phone and replied to her childhood friend Chunmei's greeting: “I'm doing well, I learned a couple of dishes from my mom, and I'll talk to you tomorrow.” She also said goodnight to her younger sister Xiufen. After putting down her phone, she closed her eyes and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Bedroom and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Waking up and morning stretching
description: At 5:48 a.m., Ma Xiulan woke up naturally and felt relaxed. She did 5 minutes of shoulder and neck stretches and back extensions in bed to relieve stiffness from sleeping. Then she got up, washed up, combed her hair in the mirror, and started a new day.
location: Bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Wake the children and have breakfast.
description: Ma Xiulan first woke her youngest daughter Xinxin, helped her tie her hair and put on her little yellow duck jacket, then urged her second son Zhezhe to get up and reminded her eldest son Xuanxuan to wear his school uniform. She checked the children's insulated water bottles and school supplies. In the kitchen, millet porridge and eggs were ready. She served the porridge and cut a plate of pickled dried radish. The family of four sat around the table eating breakfast, chatting about Friday's fun moments and weekend plans. Xinxin said she wanted to draw autumn trees, and Zhezhe said he wanted to draw Peking opera masks.
location: Children's bedroom, kitchen, and living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Take her daughter to school.
description: After breakfast, Ma Xiulan put a little yellow hat on Xinxin, helped her put on her small backpack, and walked hand in hand with her west along Jingwen Road to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten. On the way, the plane tree leaves were yellowing, and Xinxin chatted about fun things at kindergarten. They arrived at the kindergarten gate at 7:05. After watching Xinxin enter the school gate, Ma Xiulan walked back along the same route and got home at 7:30.
location: Huakang First Kindergarten, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Courtyard exercise and household chores.
description: When she got home, Ma Xiulan changed into loose clothes. As the cloud cover was increasing, she first watered the roses and flower beds in the yard. Then she walked in the courtyard for 15 minutes to get some fresh air. At 7:50 she returned to the living room and did a complete set of Baduanjin, and specially added the new lower-back muscle stretching variation she had learned from her mother, feeling her lower back obviously loosen up. After finishing, she wiped off her sweat and drank warm water.
location: Home courtyard and living room, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Making a family photo album and tidying up the household
description: In the study, Ma Xiulan continued making the family photo album. She selected 7 autumn-atmosphere photos from the Beijing trip and pasted them onto pages 3-4, neatly writing captions in colored pens and paying attention to layered composition. After about 30 minutes, she stood up to stretch her neck, then brought in the quilt that had been airing in the morning and wiped down the kitchen counter. Recalling that Wang Guilan, the neighbor across the hall, had brought dumplings yesterday, she decided to return the kindness. She took out a jar of homemade dried radish pickles, wrapped it up, and prepared to send it over.
location: Study, living room, and kitchen at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Shopping at the vegetable market.
description: Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike along Jingwen Road for about 15 minutes to reach the Wutong Commune vegetable market. She went straight to the stall of her old acquaintance Sun Guifang and, following the low-fat diet plan, selected tofu, live crucian carp, lean meat, eggs, and low-sodium soy sauce. She also asked about the mung bean cakes; Sun Guifang said there was still no news. Before she left, Sun Guifang gave her an extra bunch of cilantro. At 9:40 she rode her electric bike home, sorted the ingredients into categories and put them in the refrigerator, and changed the water for the fish to keep it alive.
location: China, Tianjin City, Jinghai District, Wutong Commune Vegetable Market

name: Returning a courtesy visit and tending the vegetable garden.
description: Ma Xiulan took the dried radish strips and knocked on Wang Guilan's door across the hall. Wang Guilan was hanging out clothes. She took the dried radish and thanked her. The two chatted about everyday things at the doorstep. Wang Guilan praised her for raising such good flowers, and Ma Xiulan said she would bring her a pot of jasmine another day. After going home, Ma Xiulan went to the small vegetable garden in the courtyard and picked baby bok choy and scallions to add fresh vegetables to dinner.
location: Wang Guilan's home and the family vegetable garden across from No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Lunch and casual embroidery.
description: Ma Xiulan cooked a simple bowl of tomato and egg noodles, ate lunch alone in the kitchen, washed the dishes, and made a cup of flower tea. She sat by the living-room window, took out her embroidery hoop, tried the French knot stitch, and focused on embroidering a small daisy. About 40 minutes later, the full, three-dimensional flower took shape, and she put it away with satisfaction.
location: Kitchen and living room of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Noon break
description: Ma Xiulan set an alarm for 13:00 and lay down on the bed for a nap. Because she had gotten up early and was a bit sleepy, she fell asleep quickly. She didn't sit up and rub her eyes until the alarm rang, and her energy had recovered considerably.
location: Bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Afternoon meal preparation and leisurely embroidery
description: After her nap, Ma Xiulan put on an apron, scraped the scales off the crucian carp and removed its internal organs, then marinated it with shredded ginger and cooking wine. She cut the tofu into pieces and washed and spun dry the spinach and broccoli. Next, she went to the small vegetable garden, set up bamboo poles for the cucumber trellis, pulled weeds, and picked some cilantro and scallions. At 13:30, she took out her embroidery hoop again, refined the daisy leaves, and shared photos of the new stitch in the artisan WeChat group. The group members praised her for making fast progress; she replied with emojis and studied other people's works.
location: Kitchen, courtyard vegetable garden, and living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Pick up the younger daughter from school
description: At 14:00, Ma Xiulan put on her coat, put on a sun hat, and walked to Huakang First Kindergarten. At 14:15, Xinxin came bouncing out, holding up a leaf collage for her mother to see. Ma Xiulan praised her for making it beautiful, took her hand, and got ready to pick up her second son.
location: Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Pick up second son from school and return home
description: The mother and daughter walked about 15 minutes to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School. At 3 p.m., Zhezhe ran out excitedly carrying a Wukong face mask, saying that his teacher had praised him. The three of them walked home together. On the way, Zhezhe and Xinxin bickered, and Ma Xiulan gently smoothed things over. They arrived home at 3:20 p.m. The children changed into their home clothes, and Ma Xiulan cut apples for them.
location: Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Dinner cooking and recording
description: Ma Xiulan cooked multi-grain porridge in an electric pressure cooker in the kitchen, steamed the pickled crucian carp, and at the same time blanched spinach and stir-fried broccoli with garlic. She used an oil-control pitcher and a salt-limiting spoon and recorded that she used about 20 ml of olive oil and 4 grams of salt. At 5 pm, the fish was steamed and drizzled with soy sauce, the cold spinach salad was dressed, and everything was placed on the table one by one. The multi-grain porridge was also taken out of the pot.
location: China, Tianjin Jinghai District, No. 156 Jingwen Road, home kitchen

name: Family dinner
description: Ma Xiulan put the food on the warming mat and had her eldest son Xuanxuan set out the bowls and chopsticks. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang replied at 5:25 p.m. that he had arrived at the entrance of the community, and Ma Xiulan hurriedly ladled out the soup. At 5:30 p.m. Zhiqiang arrived home, and the whole family sat around the table. Ma Xiulan introduced the low-fat menu: steamed fish, cold dressed spinach, garlic broccoli, and multigrain porridge. Zhezhe muttered that the food had no taste, Xinxin frowned, and Ma Xiulan patiently explained the concept of healthy eating. Zhiqiang praised the dishes as refreshing and the fish tender, and Ma Xiulan felt warm inside. Xuanxuan silently finished a big bowl of rice and helped clear the dishes after the meal.
location: Dining room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: After-dinner cleanup and family walk
description: Ma Xiulan quickly cleared away the dishes, rinsed them with hot water and put them in the draining rack, wiped down the stove, and swept the floor. She asked her husband and children to put on their shoes first, then changed into a thin sweater herself, packed some tissues, and called everyone to head out. The family walked west along Jingwen Road to the newly built Music Square Park. On the way, Zhe Zhe imitated Sun Wukong and teased Xin Xin into chasing and running, while Zhiqiang talked about funny stories from deliveries in Tanggu. As they walked, Ma Xiulan asked the children what they really thought of dinner. Xuan Xuan suggested using less salt, and Zhe Zhe wanted ketchup added; she carefully noted these for future adjustments. After a walk of about 40 minutes, the family returned chatting and laughing.
location: Along Music Square Park, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Movie night preparation and viewing
description: Back home, Ma Xiulan made a batch of popcorn in a pressure cooker, and the caramel aroma filled the air. She poured several bowls, brewed a pot of licorice chrysanthemum tea, went to the living room, and put the DVD of "Havoc in Heaven" into the player. The movie started at 8 PM. The whole family of five squeezed together on the sofa to watch. Zhezhe imitated Sun Wukong doing somersaults, Xinxin giggled, Zhiqiang was fully engaged, and Xuanxuan asked his mom why the Great Sage Equal to Heaven had to cause havoc in Heaven. The movie ended at 9 PM. Everyone discussed who they liked the most: Xuanxuan said Sun Wukong's wisdom, Zhezhe imitated the Monkey King's moves, Xinxin said the fairies were beautiful, and the whole family burst into laughter.
location: Home living room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Washing up the children and getting them to sleep
description: After the movie ended, Ma Xiulan turned off the TV and arranged for the children to wash up. She first bathed Xinxin, changed her into piggy pajamas, and read "Guess How Much I Love You" for 5 minutes until Xinxin fell asleep. Then she urged ZheZhe to brush his teeth and wash his face, and hung Xuanxuan's school uniform on the doorknob. At 9:40 p.m., all the children were in bed, and the living room became quiet again.
location: Bathroom and children's bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Personal bedtime care and relaxation
description: Ma Xiulan went into the bathroom, washed her face carefully, and applied skincare products. Then she prepared a basin of mugwort water with hot water, sat on the sofa, and massaged her feet while browsing messages in the embroidery group on her phone. Afterward, she did several sets of bedtime lower-back stretches and acupressure, and felt her whole body relax.
location: Bathroom and living room at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Checking and sleeping
