description: After finishing her foot soak, Ma Xiulan tiptoed to each child's room to check whether their quilts were properly tucked in, then turned off the living room light. She returned to her bed; her husband Ma Zhiqiang was already snoring evenly. Ma Xiulan lay down to rest, ending a fulfilling day.
location: All rooms and bedrooms in the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Morning stretching, courtyard exercise, and photographing flowers
description: After waking naturally in the early morning, she did 5 minutes of shoulder, neck, waist, and back stretches in bed. She got up at exactly 6:00, changed into loose workout clothes, and went to the courtyard. She first walked a few slow laps in the courtyard and checked the several pots of chrysanthemums that had been moved the night before, confirming the night breeze had not harmed them. Then she performed a complete set of Baduanjin in the middle of the courtyard, her movements especially fluid. After the exercise, she took several close-up photos with her phone of the chrysanthemums about to bloom and covered with dew, planning to post them in the sisters' group chat to share.
location: Courtyard at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Preparing a healthy breakfast that the children will love.
description: Thinking about how the children had reacted to yesterday's bland dishes, she decided to improve things starting with breakfast. She washed and cut sweet potatoes and corn into sections, steamed them, boiled three eggs, and heated milk. She specially cut her second son Zhezhe's egg in half and drew a smiley face with ketchup. She pressed the steamed sweet potatoes into small flower and star shapes with cookie cutters and arranged them carefully. She hummed while working, feeling happy.
location: China, Tianjin Jinghai District, No. 156 Jingwen Road, home kitchen

name: Warm family breakfast and discussion of family visit plans.
description: Woke up the children and her husband, and the whole family sat down to eat breakfast. Daughter Xinxin and second son Zhezhe were delighted to see the flower-shaped sweet potato and smiley-face eggs. Taking the opportunity, she discussed with the children going to see their maternal grandparents at noon, and suggested making steamed egg with minced meat together and hiding vegetables in it. The children clapped in agreement. The eldest son Xuanxuan volunteered to recite a newly learned poem for his grandmother.
location: Dining room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Tidying up the house and checking the items for visiting relatives.
description: After breakfast, she quickly cleared the dishes and chopsticks, wiped the dining table, and swept and mopped the floor. She checked and packed the things to bring to her parents: fresh spinach bought at the market yesterday, 20 free-range eggs she had saved up, and a small jar of her own pickled dried radish. She brought a small water bottle and a thin jacket for her daughter, and reminded her two sons to bring their weekend homework.
location: Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Took the children to her parents’ home and helped with meal prep and chatted
description: At 9:30, they set off as a group of four: Ma Xiulan rode the electric bike with her youngest daughter Xinxin, her second son Zhezhe rode a small bicycle, and her eldest son Xuanxuan rode a big bicycle. It took 12 minutes to reach her parents' house. Her mother was in the yard picking over chives, and her father was watching the opera channel in the living room. She had Xuanxuan stay with his grandfather to chat and keep him company, while Zhezhe and Xinxin played in the yard. She put on an apron and went into the kitchen to help her mother wash vegetables and cut meat, chatting as they worked about the low-fat dishes she had researched yesterday. Her mother smiled and said she was getting better and better at running a household.
location: Parents’ home, No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Sharing a hearty lunch at her parents' home
description: At 11:00, she started steaming eggs with minced meat and chopped baby bok choy, while preparing stir-fried seasonal vegetables and oil-braised prawns. At 11:30, her husband Ma Zhiqiang arrived by electric bike. The whole family sat down to eat. The steamed eggs had vegetables mixed in, and the children didn't notice. ZheZhe curiously asked why the eggs were a little green, and she smiled and explained that it was a secret vegetable. During the meal, Xuanxuan recited the newly learned poem Spring View for his grandparents with cadence and expression, and the old people were so delighted that they couldn't stop smiling. After the meal, her mother pulled her aside to talk about making snacks with Chinese yam and pumpkin.
location: Parents' home dining room, No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Midday rest and returning home
description: Around 12:30, the children and their father were watching cartoons in the living room at the grandparents' house. She leaned back on the sofa and rested with her eyes closed for about 25 minutes. At 13:00, she called the children to get ready for the return trip. The second son and eldest son rode ahead on bikes to lead the way, while her daughter sat on the back of her electric bike. They chatted and laughed all the way home, arriving safely at 13:45.
location: Parents’ home, No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Meticulous care of potted chrysanthemums on the balcony
description: After returning home, she changed out of her coat, put on gloves, and started tending the potted chrysanthemums on the balcony. The afternoon sun was just right, and the side branches were too dense. She picked up the pruning shears and performed the second pinching and shaping on each pot: after keeping 3–4 pairs of leaves, she pinched off the tips, cut away crossing and weak branches to make the plants rounder and more open. After pinching, she watered them with the fermented rice-water liquid fertilizer she had prepared in advance, and turned the pots to ensure each received even light.
location: Balcony at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Shared beautiful photos in the sisters' group and launched the shared recipe document.
description: After tending to the flowers and plants, I washed my hands and went to the study to turn on the computer. I first posted 9 photos in the "Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei Handicraft Sisters Group": photos of chrysanthemum buds taken in the early morning, photos of the Great Wall in winter snow sorted out earlier, and a "family portrait" of the pickled vegetables I made at home, plus the making process. As soon as the photos were posted, the group immediately became lively. Aunt Wu liked the post and said the pickled vegetables looked authentic. Seizing the moment, I responded to Aunt Wu's suggestion from yesterday, created a new Tencent Doc named "Sisters' Handicraft Shared Recipe Library", shared it to the group, and proactively pasted the previously organized pickled vegetable recipes and the French knot embroidery step-by-step diagrams under the two categories "Pickling Vegetables" and "Embroidery Stitches". Aunt Wu then added content under the "Crochet Crafts" category. I was excited and felt that the group had truly come alive.
location: Home study, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Outdoor family time at Jinghai District Cultural Square Park
description: At 16:00, she closed the computer, called the children playing in the yard, and brought along the daughter's scooter, the second son's football, and the eldest son's jump rope. They walked 15 minutes to Cultural Square Park in Jinghai District. The park was lively, with elderly people playing chess and young people walking dogs. She agreed with the children on their own activities: the daughter rode the scooter, the second son played football with kids his age, and the eldest son jumped rope. She sat on a bench under the shade of a tree, keeping an eye on the children while photographing the golden ginkgo leaves and fiery red maple leaves in the park, saving them as material for her photo album. At 17:10 they gathered, bought three roasted sweet potatoes to share, and walked home while eating.
location: Jinghai District Cultural Square Park, Middle Section of Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Carefully prepare a family dinner
description: After returning home, she had her husband help trim and wash the vegetables while she took charge of cooking. Considering what the kids said yesterday, tonight she made a tomato and egg stir-fry that all the kids love (with extra ketchup for the second son), a plate of stir-fried lettuce with garlic (low salt), a dish of steamed baby cabbage with garlic and vermicelli, and a pot of winter melon pork rib soup (the ribs had been blanched last night). She strictly controlled the oil amount and recorded in the small notebook on the fridge: oil 20 ml, salt 4 g.
location: China, Tianjin Jinghai District, No. 156 Jingwen Road, home kitchen

name: Warm dinner shared by the whole family
description: The dinner atmosphere was very good. The second son finished off all the scrambled eggs with tomatoes, and the daughter also ate a lot of baby cabbage. Her husband praised the soup for being well-flavored. She took the opportunity to mention the shared document she had created in the WeChat group that afternoon. While drinking soup, her husband expressed support, saying it was a good idea and they could learn from each other, and maybe later learn some crochet from Aunt Wu to make the pickled vegetable packaging more distinctive. After hearing this, she nodded and thought she would definitely ask for advice next week.
location: Dining room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: The whole family took a walk along Jingwen Road and exchanged ideas about a side business.
description: After dinner, they rested for 15 minutes, and at 19:30 the whole family went out for a walk along Jingwen Road. She and her husband walked behind, watching the three children chase and play ahead. She also talked with her husband about the follow-up on the shared document, planning to invite Aunt Wu over sometime next week to learn crochet skills in person, and see if they could be used for the cloth covers decorating the pickle jars. Her husband expressed support again, saying it was a good idea. They returned home after walking for 30 minutes.
location: Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Remind the children to wash up and tidy up before bedtime.
description: After returning home, she urged the eldest son and the second son to take a bath and brush their teeth first. Then she bathed her daughter and read her the picture book *Guess How Much I Love You*. At 20:30, after all the children were in bed, she checked that the windows in every room were closed, tidied the living room sofa, and put the toys back in place.
location: Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Personal relaxation: foot soak with mugwort and organizing photos.
description: The children were all asleep. She boiled a pot of mugwort water, mixed in cold water, and soaked her feet. While soaking her feet, she took out her phone to organize today's photos of the park and chrysanthemums, saving them into the '2025 Family Memories/October 18' folder. She also read the replies from her sisters in the group chat about the shared document and sent Liu Chunmei a voice message, asking if she was free to come over for tea next week. After soaking her feet, she did a set of pre-sleep acupoint massage, pressing Zusanli and Yongquan acupoints, and felt comfortable all over.
location: Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Bedtime journaling and facial care
description: In the bedroom, she took out her diary and briefly recorded today's weight of 53.9 kg and a few happy things: the kids accepted the new breakfast, the potted plant pinching was done, and the shared document was successfully launched. Then she put on a hydrating mask and lay flat to rest for 15 minutes, while mentally going over tomorrow's plan: go to the vegetable market in the morning to buy some pork ribs, and continue embroidering the Peony Blooming picture in the afternoon.
location: Bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Going to bed
description: At 22:15 she took off the face mask and applied night cream. She got out of bed to check the door locks and gas one last time, then turned off the light and lay down at 22:30. With a sense of fulfillment from what she had gained that day, she soon fell into a sound sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Morning stretching and breathing exercises in the courtyard
description: At 6:30 in the morning, Ma Xiulan woke up naturally. Outside the window the sky was gray, an overcast day. She didn't sleep in. She lay in bed and did ten minutes of shoulder, neck, and lower back stretches to ease the soreness from yesterday. Then she threw on a jacket and went to the courtyard. The ground was slightly damp. She watered the flowers a little, breathed in the moist air deeply a few times, and felt refreshed.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, bedroom and courtyard

name: Waking up the family and preparing breakfast
description: Ma Xiulan went back inside and started preparing breakfast. She cooked millet porridge, steamed the leftover mantou from yesterday, and boiled eggs. At the same time, she took a cucumber out of the fridge, sliced it, and made a cold salad with a drizzle of sesame oil and vinegar. At 7:10, she woke her husband Ma Zhiqiang and the three children one by one: Xinxin was rubbing her eyes, Zhezhe was reluctant to get out of bed, and Xuanxuan had already dressed himself.
location: Kitchen and bedroom, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The whole family shares Sunday breakfast
description: The family sat around the dining table. Ma Xiulan served millet porridge to everyone, and the children slurped it loudly. Ma Zhiqiang praised the cucumber salad for its refreshing taste. While eating, Ma Xiulan reminded Xuanxuan to do his math homework in the morning, Zhezhe to review the texts learned last week, and Xinxin showed off a new nursery rhyme she learned in kindergarten. The atmosphere was warm.
location: Dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Designing photo album layout and helping children with homework.

She pasted the family group photo taken in front of the ice during last year's Spring Festival and Xinxin's photo of making a snowman in chronological order, writing the dates and brief captions with a patterned pen. When Xuanxuan got stuck on a geometry problem, Ma Xiulan put down the glue, sat down beside him, opened the textbook, and walked through the example problem with him, gradually guiding him to figure out the approach.
location: Study, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Make and enjoy a lunch of tomato and egg noodles.
description: Around noon, Ma Xiulan put away the photo album and used the tomatoes and greens she had brought back from her parents' home yesterday to quickly make tomato and egg noodles and blanch baby bok choy. At twelve o'clock, the family had lunch. At the table, she said she would go buy some soft tofu tomorrow to make tofu with chopped scallions.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, kitchen and dining room

name: Midday nap
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan urged the children to go back to their rooms for a nap. Xuanxuan obediently lay down, Zhezhe tossed and turned, and Xinxin was already asleep hugging her doll. She and Ma Zhiqiang returned to the master bedroom, set a 30-minute alarm, and rested with their eyes closed, recovering a good deal of energy.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, each in their own bedroom

name: Cleaning the house and organizing clothes for the season change
description: At 1:30 p.m., after getting up, Ma Xiulan first picked up the mop and mopped the living room and bedroom floors. Then she changed into an old smock and organized the master bedroom wardrobe. She folded the children's thin long-sleeved T-shirts for summer and early autumn and put them into storage bins. She also took out several thick jackets and sweaters for Xuanxuan and Zhezhe and hung them beside the wardrobe door so that the children could easily take them next week.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin: living room, kitchen, and master bedroom wardrobe

name: Small Garden Harvest and Next Week's Shopping Plan
description: After finishing housework, Ma Xiulan took a small basket to the vegetable garden in the courtyard, picked some scallions, and thinned out a few overcrowded baby bok choy plants. She squatted at the edge of the plot to check how the eggplants were growing, and mentally planned to go to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market the next morning to buy tofu and grains, and see if there were any good pork ribs.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, courtyard vegetable plot.

name: Personal hand embroidery and crochet study.
description: The children woke up one after another. Xuanxuan continued doing his homework, while Zhezhe and Xinxin watched cartoons. Ma Xiulan had some quiet time, so she took out her embroidery hoop and worked on the osmanthus sachet she had conceived yesterday. As she stitched swiftly, she used her phone to search for videos of basic crochet stitches, planning to discuss them with Aunt Wu later and prepare for next year's pickle packaging.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, living room sofa

name: Neighbor Wang Guilan came by to bring pickled vegetables and chat
description: Ma Xiulan was deeply absorbed in her embroidery when she heard a knock at the door. She opened it and saw Wang Guilan, the across-the-hall neighbor, holding a small bowl of freshly made pickled radish and offering her a taste. Ma Xiulan thanked her repeatedly. Wang Guilan saw the sachet in her hand and praised it for being beautiful. Ma Xiulan then gave her the embroidered osmanthus sachet and told her it was filled with dried osmanthus flowers. The two stood at the door chatting for quite a while about pickling tips, and Ma Xiulan invited her to try out new recipes together next week when she had time.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, living room entrance

name: Preparing a light dinner
description: After seeing off Wang Guilan, Ma Xiulan returned to the kitchen to prepare dinner. She decided to make a few light dishes: using the pickled radish Wang Guilan had given her as an appetizer, scrambling eggs with the scallions she picked in the afternoon, and stir-frying Chinese greens. She used an oil-control bottle and a salt-limiting spoon to strictly control the amount of oil and salt. After Ma Zhiqiang woke up, Ma Xiulan had him sweep the yard.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, kitchen and courtyard

name: The whole family had dinner together.
description: At 6:30 p.m., the dishes were served. Wang Guilan's pickled radish was very popular, and the children finished a large bowl of rice with the light stir-fried dishes. Ma Xiulan ate contentedly and had a clearer idea of tomorrow's menu.
location: Dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening family walk along Jingwen Road
description: After dinner, they rested for half an hour. Then the family of five put on jackets and went out for a walk along Jingwen Road. Under the cloudy night sky, the streetlights stretched their shadows long, and the air was cool and crisp. Xinxin held Ma Xiulan's hand and sang 'Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star.' Zhezhe imitated cricket chirps and looked around by the roadside. Xuanxuan walked side by side with his father, discussing the circuit diagram for next week's physics class. The family walked slowly, enjoying the warm and happy time.
location: Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (section near home)

name: Washing up with the children and telling bedtime stories
description: Back home, Ma Xiulan urged the children to wash up in turn. She first helped Xinxin wash her face and feet and change into pajamas, told two 'Peppa Pig' stories, and watched her fall asleep. Then she checked Zhezhe's tooth brushing and urged him to put tomorrow's coat at the head of the bed. Then she went to Xuanxuan's room, saw that he had already packed his schoolbag and was reading an extracurricular book, told him to go to bed early, and turned off the light for him.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin - bathroom and children's room

name: Personal relaxation: foot soaking, contacting old friends, and crochet practice.
description: After the children quieted down, Ma Xiulan had some time to herself. She boiled water, added mugwort to her foot bath basin, and soaked her feet for fifteen minutes, feeling her exhaustion dissipate. While soaking her feet, she sent a voice message to her childhood friend Liu Chunmei, inviting her over for tea next Wednesday afternoon. After soaking her feet, she sat at the head of the bed, looked over the shopping list for next week, then opened a crochet stitch video on the web to learn two new patterns, trying them with yarn scraps until her fingers grew sore. She did a few minutes of deep breathing and pre-sleep stretching, feeling very peaceful inside.
location: Bedroom and bathroom, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening reading, daily review, and going to bed
description: Ma Xiulan leaned against the headboard in her clothes, picked up the 'Home Cookbook' she hadn't finished reading yesterday, and flipped through a few recipes for light steamed dishes. Then she turned off the light, got into bed, closed her eyes, and silently reviewed the day in her mind: she had finished another page of the photo album, the housework was done, tomorrow's meals were planned, she had chatted with Sister Guilan, the family had taken a walk in the evening, and she had learned a new crochet stitch. She felt content with her calm, fulfilling day. Beside her, Ma Zhiqiang had long since fallen into a deep sleep, with even snoring that reassured her. She turned over and soon fell asleep.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, master bedroom

name: Morning wake-up, stretching, and breakfast
description: The phone alarm went off. Ma Xiulan did shoulder, neck, waist, and back stretches in bed, feeling her muscles and joints loosen up. She got out of bed, opened the window, and saw a clear day. After washing up, she went to the kitchen, took out the steamed pork buns and boiled eggs from yesterday from the fridge and heated them, grabbed millet and red dates to cook porridge, and while the porridge was cooking, sliced pickled radish. At 6:35 her husband Ma Zhiqiang got up, and the two of them ate porridge, buns, and pickled vegetables together, simple and satisfying.
location: Master bedroom, kitchen, and dining room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Efficient morning trip: school drop-off, morning exercise, grocery shopping, and depositing money.
description: Woke the children at 6:50 and reminded Zhezhe to have his eyes rechecked after school. At 7:00, took Xinxin and Zhezhe out, first dropping Zhezhe at Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (arrived at 7:05), then taking Xinxin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten (arrived at 7:16). Then went to Wutong Community vegetable market to buy loofah, baby bok choy, tofu, and eggs, spending 18 yuan. Next, went to the Agricultural Bank of China (Tianjin Jinghai Sub-branch) to deposit 500 yuan of the pickled vegetable income into the emergency fund passbook, bringing the balance to 2,000 yuan. Finally walked home, arriving at 7:55.
location: Departing from No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, passing Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street), Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, and Agricultural Bank of China (Tianjin Jinghai Sub-branch) (near the intersection of Jingwen Highway and Lianmeng Street), then returning to No. 156 Jingwen Road

name: Keeping accounts and doing Baduanjin in the courtyard
description: After getting home and putting away the vegetables, I took out the ledger and recorded the pickled vegetable income of 680 yuan, saved 500 yuan, and spent 18 yuan on groceries, with a note: “Advancing toward the 5,000 yuan goal!” Then I went to the yard and did a set of Baduanjin, focusing on “bouncing on the heels seven times to dispel all ailments,” and felt my qi and blood flowing smoothly. After finishing, I saw the chrysanthemums in the corner budding and took a photo to remember.
location: Kitchen and courtyard at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Spring album layout
description: Ma Xiulan took out the spring album and the printed photos. By the study window, she selected 8 photos: 3 close-ups of cherry blossoms at Yuyuantan, 3 family photos from a spring outing at the Summer Palace, and 2 photos of the children running, seen from behind, at the Botanical Garden. She pasted the photos onto pages 9–10 of the album and wrote beside them in a gel pen: “Cherry blossoms at Yuyuantan in spring 2025,” “Summer Palace family photo,” and so on. She looked at the photos with a smile, looking forward to the next trip.
location: By the study window, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare and enjoy lunch
description: At noon, her husband Ma Zhiqiang was watching TV in the living room. Ma Xiulan went to the kitchen to cook tomato and egg noodles, and also made loofah and egg soup with the newly bought loofah. As they ate and chatted, Zhiqiang said he would go to the repair shop to check on the truck in the afternoon and would not come home for dinner.
location: Kitchen and dining room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Noon break and tending the flowers and plants in the courtyard
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan rested and took a half-hour nap. She woke up at 13:10 feeling refreshed, walked to the yard, turned on the radio to listen to the storytelling program "The Legend of Yue Fei," and while listening, pinched back the chrysanthemums, removed dead leaves, and watered the other potted plants, enjoying the afternoon.
location: Bedroom and courtyard, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing outing supplies and sharing the recipe.

She took out her phone to look at the new embroidery patterns shared by the sisters in the handicraft group and saved them one by one. Then she posted yesterday's prepared pickled vegetable recipe to the shared document 'Sisters' Handicraft Shared Recipe Library', hoping the sisters could use it.
location: Living room and study at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Mending the children's socks
description: In the afternoon, she found some time, took out the sewing box, picked out the cotton socks that Xuanxuan and Zhezhe had worn thin, and carefully mended them while listening to the radio. The stitches were fine and close, making the socks sturdy and warm, and she thought about how comfortable the children would feel wearing them.

name: Take the second son for a vision recheck and bring him home
description: At 14:30, Ma Xiulan walked to the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up Zhezhe after school, and then they walked together to the Chaoyang Street Community Health Service Center in Jinghai District (No. 16 Jingwen Road). Dr. Wang Jianguo checked Zhezhe's eyesight. The results were good, and his prescription had not worsened. The doctor praised the routine of insisting on walking and limiting screen time. Ma Xiulan immediately sent a WeChat voice message to her husband with the good news, feeling a weight off her mind.
location: From No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street), to Jinghai District Chaoyang Street Community Health Service Center (No. 16 Jingwen Road, back courtyard of Jinghai Grain Bureau)

Seeing the freezer, he rewarded Zhezhe with a Little Pudding ice pop, and Zhezhe ate it happily.

name: Family spring album layout

She recounted in detail the data from this week's dietary control and the positive feedback from her family. Her mother kept praising her and reminded her to take care of herself as well.

The children cheered with joy.

After soaking her feet, she went to the study, wrote down the next week's oil and salt control targets in the kitchen record book (oil 140 ml, salt 32 g), stuck the new recipe on the refrigerator door, finally checked phone messages, then returned to the bedroom to get ready for rest.
location: Bedroom and study at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Falling asleep and relaxing rest
description: Ma Xiulan lay in bed reviewing the day, felt fulfilled and content, and soon fell asleep in the moonlight.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Getting up, morning stretching, and breakfast preparation

She put the pre-soaked millet on to cook porridge, then took eggs and baby bok choy out of the fridge, planning to fry the eggs and stir-fry the bok choy.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning Exercise in the Courtyard
description: In the fresh morning air, Ma Xiulan went to the courtyard and did two rounds of Baduanjin with Aunt Zhao. Aunt Zhao praised her, saying her movements were more fluid than last time. The two then walked slowly around the flower beds for 15 minutes, chatted about family matters, and agreed to exercise together again on Sunday morning.
location: Home courtyard at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Breakfast and taking the child to school
description: After morning exercise, Ma Xiulan returned inside; the porridge was already cooked. She woke up her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin and second son Ma Mingzhe, helped Xinxin braid her hair, and the whole family had breakfast together, including millet porridge, fried eggs, and stir-fried bok choy. At 7:10 she rode her electric bike to first take Xinxin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, watched her enter the school gate, then took Zhezhe to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, arriving at the school gate around 7:35.

name: Shopping at the vegetable market.
description: After dropping off the children, Ma Xiulan rode her bike to the Wutong Commune vegetable market. At Sun Guifang's stall, she bought sweet corn, pork ribs, eggs, baby greens, and scallions, spending 38.5 yuan in total. Sister Sun also gave her a bunch of cilantro. Then she bought cut noodles and dry yeast at the breakfast stall at the market entrance, planning to steam buns tomorrow.

name: Returning home to tidy up and prepare osmanthus cake

Then she took out the osmanthus sauce, mixed it with glutinous rice flour, sugar, and water into a thick batter, and set it aside to wait for Liu Chunmei so they could steam osmanthus cakes together.

description: At exactly 9 o'clock, childhood friend Liu Chunmei came to visit with a bag of tangerines. Ma Xiulan steamed the osmanthus cake batter and brewed jasmine tea. The two chatted over tea in the living room. When the cake was done, she cut it into pieces and plated it, serving it with homemade pickled radish as a snack. Ma Xiulan took out a crochet hook and yarn, taught Chunmei the "pineapple flower" pattern, guided her hand by hand, and also drew the stitches on paper for her. The courtyard was warm with sunshine, and they had a pleasant morning.
location: Living room and courtyard at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Lunch preparation and a quiet meal
description: After Chunmei took her leave, Ma Xiulan cleared away the tea snacks and the remaining osmanthus cake and packed them in a food storage container. She checked the corn and spare rib soup simmering on the stove; it had already filled the house with fragrance. She ladled out a small bowl of soup and a few ribs for her husband Ma Zhiqiang, and for herself cooked a bowl of dried noodles using the rib soup as broth, and had a simple lunch.
location: Kitchen and dining room of the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Lunch break and household tidying
description: After lunch, Ma Xiulan simply wiped the stove and dining table, then went back to the bedroom, closed the curtains, and lay down to rest for 40 minutes. After getting up, she washed her face, felt much more refreshed, and hand-washed several clothes that had been changed off the day before, then hung them in the yard to dry.
location: Bedroom and living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Afternoon gardening and tending the vegetable garden
description: The weather was nice, so Ma Xiulan went to the yard to tidy the flowers and shrubs. She moved a few pots of chrysanthemums to the sunniest spot under the window and applied compound fertilizer. Then she went to the small vegetable garden, watered the greens and spring onions with a watering can, and pinched off a handful of fresh spring onions for dinner.
location: The home courtyard and small vegetable garden at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Making a family photo album
description: Ma Xiulan took out the summer photo album and a box of materials, and selected 8 photos: 4 of the Seventeen-Arch Bridge and lotus flowers at the Summer Palace, 2 group photos of the whole family in front of the Western-style buildings at the Old Summer Palace, and 2 candid shots of the elder son Xuanxuan and the younger son Zhezhe running on the grass. She used photo corner mounts to neatly affix the photos to pages 13-14 of the album, and handwrote 'Summer Palace lotus flowers, summer 2025' beside them, adding a simple sketch of a small lotus. Looking through the lush green photos, she felt warm inside.
location: Home study at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the child from school
description: At 3:30, Ma Xiulan walked to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up her youngest daughter Xinxin. She arrived around 4:00 and waited a while before picking her up. Then the two walked together to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to wait for her second son Zhezhe. About 10 minutes later, Zhezhe was dismissed from school. Ma Xiulan held Xinxin with her left hand and Zhezhe with her right hand, and they strolled home together, arriving around 4:40.
location: From Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten on Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to Jinghai No. 3 Primary School, and on the way home.

name: After-school time and dinner preparation
description: After getting home, Ma Xiulan washed Xinxin's hands, cut an apple for her, and let her watch cartoons, while she had Zhezhe do homework at the desk. She went to the kitchen to prepare dinner, reheated the morning's pork rib soup, added corn pieces and ribs, and at the same time prepared the ingredients for garlic steamed ribs and steamed egg, and rinsed the greens.
location: Living room and kitchen at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner
description: At 5:30, her husband Ma Zhiqiang came home from driving. Ma Xiulan put garlic steamed pork ribs and steamed eggs into the steamer, and dinner was served at 6:00, with corn and pork rib soup, garlic steamed pork ribs, steamed eggs, and stir-fried seasonal vegetables. The family sat together and had a lively meal. During the meal, Ma Xiulan brought up next week's menu and said they should discuss it properly after eating; her husband nodded in agreement.
location: Dining room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Finishing housework and taking a short post-meal rest
description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan had her husband go to the living room to watch TV with the children, while she cleared the dishes, washed the bowls, wiped the stove, and sorted the trash. Once everything was tidied up, she made two cups of weak tea, sat on the living room sofa leaning against her husband to rest for a while, and pondered how to discuss the recipe with him.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening walk and family discussion
description: At 7:20, the whole family went out, walking east along Jingwen Road to Chaoyang Road and then turning back. Xinxin and Zhezhe chased each other in front, Xuanxuan followed behind, and Ma Xiulan and her husband walked side by side at the rear. As they walked, they discussed next week's menu, deciding to continue the low-oil, low-salt approach, add steamed eggs, use more ginger and vinegar, and keep the corn and sparerib soup and garlic steamed spareribs that the children loved. Halfway, Ma Xiulan reminded her husband that the heating fee next month would be about 1,500 yuan and needed to be set aside in advance; her husband said he would keep it in mind.
location: Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin (from home heading east to Chaoyang Road and turning back).

name: Children's washing and bedtime stories
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan told her two sons to wash up by themselves, and took her youngest daughter Xinxin to the bathroom to wash her face, wash her feet, and brush her teeth. After changing into pajamas, she brought her to the bed in the bedroom, picked up the picture book The Very Hungry Caterpillar, and read it aloud expressively twice. When the story ended, Xinxin gave her mother a kiss. Ma Xiulan turned off the main light, turned on the night light, and gently patted her until she fell asleep.
location: Bathroom and Xinxin's bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

description: After Xinxin fell asleep, Ma Xiulan tiptoed to the dining room, where her husband had already prepared paper and pen. Drawing on what they had discussed during their walk, the two wrote out the second week's meal plan for October 23 to 31: Wednesday steamed egg and corn pork rib soup, Thursday pickled fish, etc., keeping to low oil and low salt, using vinegar and ginger to enhance flavor. The husband dictated while Ma Xiulan wrote it down and neatly copied it out. Finally, they used a magnet to stick the meal plan on the refrigerator door.
location: Dining room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening washing up and foot bath to relax
description: After washing up, Ma Xiulan brought over a basin of hot water and sprinkled mugwort into it, soaking her feet comfortably for 15 minutes. Sitting on the sofa with her eyes closed, she reviewed the entire day: the gathering with Chunmei, the arranged photo album, the set recipes, and felt very grounded in her heart. After soaking her feet, she did 5 minutes of bedtime deep breathing to let her body and mind fully relax.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pre-sleep preparation and information browsing
description: Ma Xiulan went to the living room, placed the keys, phone, and wallet she needed to bring tomorrow on the entryway cabinet, and mentally reviewed the items she needed to buy. Then she went back to the bedroom and lay on the bed. She opened the handicraft group and saw a new stitching technique video shared by Zhou Xiuqin. She saved it to study tomorrow, and also shared in the group a small crochet tutorial for the "pineapple flower" she had learned from Chunmei today.
location: Living room and bedroom at home, 156 Zhenwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Going to bed
description: It was past 10:30. Ma Xiulan turned off her phone and put it on the bedside table, then adjusted her pillow and quilt. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang was already snoring softly beside her. She pulled up the quilt, closed her eyes, and with a peaceful mind, soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom in the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

Then she went to the kitchen and, following the recipe, prepared millet pumpkin porridge, boiled eggs, and soy-pickled radish. After breakfast was ready, she first went to the master bedroom to wake her husband Ma Zhiqiang, then went to the children's room. Her younger daughter Ma Yuxin was acting coquettish, so Ma Xiulan helped her put on her coat and tied her hair into little bunches. Her second son, Ma Mingzhe, was lying in bed and had to be urged to get up; Ma Xiulan also checked his math workbook. Her eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, had already put on his school uniform by himself. The whole family sat around the table for breakfast. Ma Xiulan peeled an egg for Yuxin, reminded Mingzhe not to smack his lips while eating, and added more porridge for Mingxuan. The whole morning was filled with a warm family atmosphere.

name: Took the children to school in the rain and bought groceries along the way.
description: The yogurt maker has all its accessories, and the starter powder packaging is intact. Everything has been put away for later use.
location: Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin

She first laid out a yoga mat and did 15 minutes of neck, shoulder, and back stretches to warm up her muscles and joints. Then she opened the window to air the room, closed it, and began a complete set of Baduanjin. She deliberately did two extra sets of the Two Hands Hold Up the Heavens to Regulate the Triple Burner movement. She felt her chest tightness dissipate and broke into a light sweat.
location: Living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

Then she went to the study, opened the photo album she had left unfinished the day before, carefully selected 7 summer photos — the children having a water gun fight in the yard, the whole family eating watermelon, Xuanxuan and Zhezhe catching fish, etc. — and pasted them on pages 15 and 16, writing notes with a marker such as “Summer 2025 water gun fight in the yard” and “The watermelon is so sweet!” as she relived those happy summer moments.
location: Home study, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

description: After organizing the photo albums and desk, Ma Xiulan vacuumed the bedroom and living room floors and sorted this morning's laundry into the washing machine. Then she went into the kitchen, took out the leftover pork rib soup from last night as the base for the midday soup, and started preparing the tomato and egg noodles for lunch.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

description: Ma Xiulan cooked herself a hot bowl of tomato-and-egg noodles, with pork rib soup, and enjoyed a simple, warm lunch. While eating, she scrolled through the handicraft sisters' group on her phone and saw a new leaf edging stitch shared by Zhou Xiuqin. Thinking it looked nice, she saved it. After lunch, she leaned back on the living room sofa, set a half-hour alarm, and rested with her eyes closed. When she woke up, she checked the weather forecast on her phone, confirmed tomorrow would be overcast, and planned to take the children to her parents' home.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Focusing on embroidery on a rainy day
description: The rain outside kept pattering, perfect for quiet concentration. Ma Xiulan took out her sewing basket and sat by the brightest window in the living room to continue embroidering the peony pillowcase. She carefully compared the pattern, tackled the half-opened peony, and paid attention to the direction and force of the needle and thread, striving for natural transitions between petals. Every 20-odd minutes of focused embroidery, she got up to stretch her neck and wrists and gaze at the rainy scene outside. After more than two hours, the peony pattern was clear and the embroidery surface was smooth and delicate, and she felt very satisfied.
location: Living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Pick up the younger daughter from school
description: Ma Xiulan put down her needlework, washed her hands, picked up an umbrella and Yuxin's small jacket, and walked to Huakang First Kindergarten. On the way she met another parent who was also coming to pick up a child and chatted about the children’s situation at school. After picking up Yuxin, the little one excitedly pointed at a puddle on the ground and called her mother to look at the “little mirror.” Ma Xiulan smiled and taught her to observe the ripples made by raindrops falling into the water. The mother and daughter enjoyed a warm after-the-rain time.
location: Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the second son from school and supervise his homework
description: After leaving the kindergarten, Ma Xiulan stopped by the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School on the way to pick up Mingzhe. After getting home, she asked Mingzhe to finish his homework before dinner, while she tidied up the small quilt Yuxin had brought back, and also took time to use WeChat to urge her older son Mingxuan to come home earlier after school.
location: Tianjin, Jinghai District, Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School on Shengli South Street; Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing dinner and having dinner together with the family.

The menu was green peppers stuffed with meat, stir-fried baby bok choy, and mushroom egg drop soup, with rice as the main staple. She mixed the meat filling, stuffed it into the green peppers, washed and cut the baby bok choy, and the kitchen filled with the aroma of meat. Meanwhile, her husband Ma Zhiqiang called to say he had gotten off work early, and the eldest son Mingxuan also came back from a classmate's house after finishing his homework. Ma Xiulan urged Mingzhe to tidy up his desk. At six in the evening, all five family members gathered. Ma Xiulan served food to her husband and listened to him talk about things on the way; she praised Mingzhe for writing his homework quickly; Mingxuan quietly picked up the rice grains Yuxin had dropped; Yuxin cheerfully showed off that her painting had been praised at kindergarten. The dinner proceeded in a lively and warm atmosphere.
location: Home kitchen and dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Clean up the kitchen after the meal.
description: After the meal, the family dispersed. Ma Xiulan cleaned up the dishes and chopsticks by herself, scrubbed the stove and range hood, put the oil, salt, soy sauce, and vinegar back in place, and finally mopped the kitchen and dining room floors clean.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family stretching routine and quiet evening time
description: Because the ground was slippery after rain, Ma Xiulan suggested the whole family exercise in the living room. She led the three children in stretching exercises on the mat, patiently teaching them the cat stretch and neck rotations. Mingzhe deliberately made funny moves that made Yuxin laugh, and even Zhiqiang, who usually does not like exercise, followed along. After the exercise, it turned into quiet family time: Yuxin drew pictures nearby, Zhiqiang and Mingxuan each read a book, Mingzhe previewed his lessons, and Ma Xiulan continued embroidering the peony pillowcase under the soft lamplight, occasionally glancing at new stitch pattern images on her phone.
location: Living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Urge the child to wash up and lull them to sleep.
description: Ma Xiulan put down her embroidery needle, first took Yuxin to wash her face and feet and put on pajamas, told her two stories from The Little Horse Crosses the River to lull her to sleep. Then she went to check Mingzhe's tooth-brushing, confiscated the small cards he had hidden under his pillow, and urged him to close his eyes and go to sleep quickly.
location: Bathroom and children's room of the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Nighttime self-relaxation — foot soak with mugwort
description: After the children settled down, Ma Xiulan boiled a pot of mugwort water, poured it into the foot basin, and soaked her feet comfortably. She took deep breaths while organizing in her mind the plans for going back to her parents' home tomorrow, thinking about taking the embroidered pillowcase to show her mother.
location: Home bathroom at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Recording expenses, chatting, and falling asleep before bed
description: After soaking her feet and changing into pajamas, Ma Xiulan took out her account book and recorded the grocery spending and completed tasks (finishing the photo album and embroidering a peony). Then she checked and prepared the coats that her husband and children would need the next day. After getting into bed, she had a brief conversation with her husband Ma Zhiqiang, listening to him talk about helping their neighbor Lao Wang change a spare tire. Ma Xiulan mentioned the plan to take the kids to her parents' home on the weekend, and Zhiqiang agreed. She turned off the light but left the night light on, reviewed the fulfilling day, listened to the dogs barking outside, and slowly drifted off to sleep with satisfaction.
location: Bedroom, home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Waking up in the morning, morning exercise, and family breakfast
description: At 5:35 in the morning, Ma Xiulan woke up on time. First, she did a 5-minute neck and shoulder stretch in bed to relax her body. Then she got up and went to the courtyard to enjoy the blooming chrysanthemums, walking slowly to stretch her legs in the crisp autumn air. Next, she began to prepare breakfast for the family, cooking rice and millet porridge, making scallion egg pancakes, and taking out her homemade pickled radish. At 6:30, she woke the three children, helped the youngest daughter Ma Yuxin get dressed, and urged the second son Ma Mingzhe to wash up. At 7:00, the whole family sat around and had breakfast together. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang praised the egg pancakes for being tender and fragrant with scallions. Ma Xiulan served food to the children while reminding them to do their homework carefully after school on Friday. The eldest son Ma Mingxuan nodded in response, ZheZhe was focused on eating pancakes, and XinXin was obediently scooping porridge with rice grains stuck to her face. The scene was full of warmth.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin
