Then she took her little daughter Ma Yuxin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten. Xinxin waved and greeted the teacher, smiling as she entered. Ma Xiulan then returned home, and on the way stopped at the community bulletin board, where she saw a newly posted "Notice on 2026 Urban and Rural Residents' Basic Medical Insurance Payment." She read it carefully and took a photo with her phone, silently noting the payment standard of 532 yuan per person. She took out her account book, marked "medical insurance reserve," and reminded herself to prepare early.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School; Huakang First Kindergarten; and nearby community bulletin boards

name: Making a family photo album and tidying up the house
description: After returning home at 8:10, Ma Xiulan first moved several pots of flowers that needed sunlight to the courtyard, then went into the study and took out the family photo album she had spent days carefully making. She pasted the last 8 photos, which recorded the children playing in summer and autumn, onto pages 17-18, and wrote the dates and brief captions neatly with a carbon pen. After the album was finished, she checked it from beginning to end without finding any mistakes, then took a photo and sent it to the "Our Family" WeChat group with a strong sense of accomplishment. Riding that momentum, she also swept the living room floor and wiped down the tables and chairs, making the home brighter.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Had lunch and a midday rest alone
description: At noon, Ma Xiulan reheated the leftover porridge and flatbread from the morning and had a simple lunch with pickled vegetables. After the meal, she leaned back on the sofa and rested with her eyes closed for half an hour; the short break restored her energy.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Market shopping and hand embroidery.
description: At 12:40, Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to the food market at Wutong Commune. At Aunt Sun Guifang's familiar stall, she picked out one jin of fresh large shrimp, a pork rib, and a piece of winter melon to make soup in the evening; following the recommendation, she also bought some dried shiitake mushrooms, plus broccoli, garlic scapes, and other vegetables. After returning home, she turned the pickled vegetable jars and added spices. Then she sat by the window, picked up the half-embroidered peony pillowcase, and under the afternoon sun, listened to opera on the radio while embroidering leaves with focused attention, the needle and thread flowing quietly between her fingers.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and 156 Jingwen Road

name: Pick up the two children from school.
description: At 14:30, Ma Xiulan walked to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin. As soon as Xinxin came out of the kindergarten, she excitedly talked about the butterfly she had made in her arts and crafts class. After going home and letting Xinxin play by herself for a while, at 15:00 Ma Xiulan took Xinxin to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up her second son Ma Mingzhe, and the three walked home chatting and laughing.
location: Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School; and 156 Jingwen Road

name: Supervise the children's homework and prepare dinner
description: After arriving home, Ma Xiulan washed the two children's hands and poured them water, got Zhezhe settled with homework, and let Xinxin play with building blocks in the living room. Then she went into the kitchen and began preparing a hearty dinner—shelling and deveining shrimp for stir-fried shrimp, putting pork ribs and winter melon into a clay pot to simmer slowly over low heat, and sorting and washing broccoli and garlic scapes. Amid the busy work, she did not forget to keep an eye on the living room and reminded Zhezhe to write his characters neatly.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner and discussion about medical insurance payment.
description: 17:30, her husband Ma Zhiqiang and eldest son Ma Mingxuan came home, and the whole family sat around the dining table. On the table were delicious dishes such as stir-fried shrimp and pork rib and winter melon soup. The children's eyes lit up as they ate; Zhe Zhe grabbed large helpings of shrimp, while Zhiqiang drank the soup and praised it, 'Fresh, tastes like home.' During the meal, Ma Xiulan mentioned the medical insurance payment announced by the community: 532 yuan for each of the five family members. Zhiqiang said very directly that it had to be paid and couldn't be skimped on; he would pay for it and asked Ma Xiulan to go handle it the next day.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Cleaning up the kitchen and taking an evening walk with the family
description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan quickly cleaned up the dishes and kitchen, sealed the leftovers and put them in the refrigerator, and wiped down the stove and countertops. At 19:00, the whole family changed shoes and went out for a walk, heading along Jingwen Road toward Music Square Park. Xuanxuan and Zhezhe chased each other in front, while Xinxin rode on her father's shoulders, laughing. Ma Xiulan and her husband walked behind, discussing using the money saved from selling pickled vegetables to pay for medical insurance first. Zhiqiang told her not to worry. At the park entrance they met their neighbor Zhang Shufen, chatted about everyday things, and Zhang Shufen also placed an order for Ma Xiulan's pickled vegetables. After a walk of about forty minutes, they returned home happily.
location: Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin to Music Square Park

name: Prepared the children for bed, kept personal accounts, and soaked her feet.
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan took care of the children's washing up one by one: she bathed Xinxin, changed her into pajamas, and told her two stories to help her fall asleep; she checked whether Zhezhe had brushed his teeth carefully, and reminded Xuanxuan to pack his schoolbooks for the next day. Once the children were all settled, she boiled a pot of mugwort water and soaked her feet comfortably, while taking out her account book to record the day's grocery expenses in detail. In the next day's plan section, she wrote 'go to the community service center to handle medical insurance.' After soaking her feet, she flipped through the newly completed family photo album for a while, feeling full of contentment.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Nighttime conversation between husband and wife
description: At 21:30, Ma Xiulan and her husband were lying in bed. She confirmed again about going to handle medical insurance tomorrow, mentioning that she had more than 300 yuan saved from selling pickled vegetables that could be used for now. Zhiqiang told her not to worry about the money, that he would take care of it. They also talked about the children's studies and plans for next weekend, and being tired from the day, they gradually became drowsy.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Going to bed
description: At 22:00, Ma Xiulan turned off the lights and lay down. She mentally planned tomorrow's tasks: going to the community to handle medical insurance, calling her mother, and going to the vegetable market. Everything was well organized, and she felt at ease. Soon she fell into a deep sleep.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning courtyard exercise and tidying up
description: Ma Xiulan woke up naturally at 6:30 in the morning, and her husband Ma Zhiqiang took the initiative to go to the vegetable market to buy groceries. She walked in the courtyard for 20 minutes, applied a light top dressing to the blooming chrysanthemums, and then slowly performed a set of Baduanjin in the morning light, feeling the coordination of breath and movement, with her body at ease.
location: The courtyard of her home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Husband returned from grocery shopping and prepared breakfast.
description: Ma Xiulan had just finished her exercises when her husband Ma Zhiqiang came back carrying freshly bought shrimp, pork ribs, and other items. Xiulan sorted the prawns, ribs, winter melon, broccoli, and more into the refrigerator, then started preparing breakfast: she heated the rice-and-millet porridge, cut up pickled radish and salted duck eggs, and heated scallion pancakes on the electric griddle.
location: Home kitchen at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family breakfast and discussion of plans
description: The family sat around eating breakfast. Xiulan told her husband she would go to the community to pay the medical insurance shortly, and her husband agreed to stay home and watch the children do their homework. Xiulan also reminded her eldest son Xuanxuan to look after his younger brother and sister. The atmosphere was warm.
location: Home restaurant, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Housework and making pickled vegetables
description: After breakfast, Xiulan cleared away the dishes. Her husband tutored the eldest son on homework in the living room, so she let the second son and the youngest daughter play in the yard. She put on an apron, took out the soaked dried string bean strips, cut chili peppers and minced garlic, and made spicy pickled vegetables using the recipe Sister Zhou Xiuqin had taught her. Listening to the children playing and laughing, she felt at ease.
location: Own kitchen and courtyard at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Go to the community to handle medical insurance payment.
description: Around 9:30, Xiulan untied her apron, took her ID documents and cash from the bedroom, put them into her cloth bag, said goodbye to her husband, and walked out. She walked east along Jingwen Road and arrived at the Chaoyang Road Community Service Station in about 15 minutes. After queuing, she handed over the documents and 532 yuan in cash to pay medical insurance for her family of five and her parents. The staff completed the process quickly and printed two receipts. Xiulan carefully checked that the names and amounts were correct, folded the receipts carefully, and put them into her bag.
location: Jinghai District Chaoyang Street Community Health Service Center, 16 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Bought groceries on the way home.
description: On her way home after finishing her errands, Xiulan passed by her usual vegetable shop and bought cilantro, tender tofu, and a few fresh mushrooms, planning to make soup in the evening.
location: Convenience vegetable store at the intersection of Chaoyang Road and Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Bookkeeping and setting the family budget.
description: Back home, Xiulan took out the ledger in the study and neatly recorded the medical insurance expense of 532 yuan, planning to make it up next month with the income from pickled vegetables. Noticing her husband's tobacco and alcohol spending last month, she took the chance when he brought water in to suggest smoking less to save money. He agreed to smoke one carton less per month, saving 100 yuan a month. Xiulan smiled and wrote in the ledger: "Zhiqiang voluntarily cuts smoking: +100 yuan/month."
location: Home study at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare and enjoy lunch.
description: Around noon, Xiulan made tomato and egg noodle soup for the children and boiled plain noodle soup for herself and her husband. During the meal, Xinxin said she saw a butterfly, but Zhezhe insisted it was a moth. The two argued, and Xiulan and her husband found it hilarious.
location: Home kitchen and dining room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Lunch break and cleaning the kitchen
description: After the meal, her husband took the initiative to clear the table. Xiulan leaned back on the living room sofa and rested with her eyes closed for half an hour. When she got up, she carefully wiped down the kitchen again.
location: Her own living room and kitchen, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family album finishing touches and parent-child craft time
description: In the afternoon, during her free block of time, Xiulan decided to finish the family photo album. She first checked page 60 of the album and used a glue stick to reattach the photo corners that had curled up. Next, she erased the pencil draft on the title page and solemnly wrote the annual message in pen: “2025, we are on the road.” After finishing, she placed the album on the coffee table. Xinxin, who had woken up from her nap, saw it and rushed over to look at it together. Xiulan held her and flipped through it, telling the story behind each photo; Xinxin listened, completely fascinated. Then Xinxin went to play with blocks, and Xiulan took out the half-embroidered pillowcase, sat by the window, and continued embroidering peonies, enjoying the peaceful time.
location: Study and living room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing to invite Aunt Wu and going out to shop.
description: Xiulan put down her needlework and, thinking about formally inviting Aunt Wu that evening, went to the kitchen and packed the sweet garlic and pickled vegetables she had made into glass jars as gifts. Wanting to add something handmade, she found apricot-colored yarn and crocheted a simple coaster while mulling over how to ask Aunt Wu. At around 4:30, she told her family she was going out, rode her electric bike to Jingbai Supermarket, and carefully selected a box of local pastries and fresh fruit to take to Aunt Wu that evening, making the invitation more sincere.
location: Living room and kitchen of our home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jingbai Supermarket, Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare a hearty dinner
description: After getting home, Xiulan started preparing dinner. She made winter melon soup with the newly bought pork ribs, steamed prawns with garlic and vermicelli, and stir-fried broccoli and shredded pork with garlic scapes. Her eldest son Xuanxuan, after finishing his homework, also came to help peel garlic and pass plates, and the kitchen was filled with aroma.
location: Home kitchen at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The entire family enjoys dinner.
description: During dinner, Xiulan told her husband that the medical insurance had been paid and the photo album was finished. Her husband picked up a spare rib and put it in her bowl, praising her as the big contributor. The children also competed to praise the food, and the meal was warm and lively.
location: Home restaurant, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tidy up the kitchen and send invitation messages
description: After the meal, Xiulan and her husband cleaned up the dining table and kitchen together; he washed the dishes and she wiped the stove. When they were done, Xiulan sat on the sofa to rest, took out her phone to send a WeChat message to Aunt Wu, inviting her to come stay at their home in the middle of next month to learn crochet and taste Jinghai local snacks.
location: Her own kitchen and living room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening walk and received a reply from Aunt Wu.
description: After a while, Aunt Wu replied and readily agreed. Xiulan happily told the good news to her family. The family changed clothes and went out, strolling along Jingwen Road to the Music Square on Shengli Street. The evening breeze was gentle, the children ran and jumped ahead, and Xiulan walked arm in arm with her husband, chatting about the plan with Aunt Wu. When they reached the square, Aunt Wu sent a message saying they would discuss the specific date later, and Xiulan felt delighted.
location: From Jingwen Road to Shengli Street Music Square, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening family washing and tutoring.
description: After walking home, Xiulan urged the three children to wash up in turn. She washed Xinxin's face and told her a bedtime story to lull her to sleep, then checked Zhezhe's homework. Her husband leaned back on the sofa reading news on his phone, occasionally chatting with her. The home was filled with a peaceful atmosphere.
location: Living room and bathroom at her home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Relaxation and reflection before bed
description: The children were all asleep. Xiulan brought hot water and soaked her feet with mugwort, feeling her fatigue melt away. Leaning against the headboard, she scrolled through embroidery patterns shared by her sisters in the phone group and saved them. Thinking of successfully inviting Aunt Wu, a smile rose at the corners of her mouth. She felt grounded and content, then turned off the light and fell asleep.
location: Her own bedroom at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Getting up, morning exercises in the courtyard and watering flowers, preparing breakfast, and waking up the family
description: Got up at 6:40, did simple shoulder and neck stretches by the bed, then went to the yard to move around. The chrysanthemums looked fresh after the rain; she watered them and breathed in the fresh air. Then she went back inside to start breakfast: millet porridge, several soft egg pancakes, and a plate of sliced homemade pickled cucumbers. Then she went room to room waking the family: her husband Ma Zhiqiang turned over; Xuanxuan was already awake, leaning against the headboard reading; Zhezhe was still lying in bed and only opened his eyes after having his nose pinched; Xinxin was sleeping soundly, but when she heard that there would be a sports meet in the courtyard in the morning, she sat right up.
location: Bedroom, courtyard, and kitchen at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family breakfast and weekend discussion
description: The whole family sat around the dining room drinking millet porridge and eating egg pancakes and sauce cucumber. During the meal, Ma Xiulan announced that a family fun sports meet would be held in the yard in the morning, with jump rope and shuttlecock kicking as the events; whoever won would decide the evening walking route. The children immediately cheered. Xuanxuan asked about the rules, Zhezhe wanted to compete with Dad in shuttlecock kicking, and Xinxin also raised her little hand wanting to jump rope. Ma Zhiqiang smiled and agreed, saying he would go find the rope after finishing the meal.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family fun games in the courtyard
description: After cleaning up the table, Ma Zhiqiang moved the chairs to the edge of the yard, and Ma Xiulan organized everyone to jump rope first. Xuanxuan jumped fast and steadily, completing 83 jumps in one go; Zhezhe kept tripping over the rope, but each time he started again with a grin, and his 23 jumps also earned applause; Xinxin acted as referee and counted aloud very seriously. Then Ma Zhiqiang demonstrated shuttlecock kicking—inner kicks, knee kicks, and even a knee bump—and the children clapped as they watched, and the yard was filled with laughter.
location: Home courtyard at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Household cleaning and hand embroidery
description: After the sports meeting ended and the children rested, Ma Xiulan took down the thin curtains from the three bedrooms and soaked them in a basin, then vacuumed the living room and hallway. After finishing the housework, she sat on the embroidered stool by the window, took out her embroidery hoop, and continued embroidering the peony pillowcase. Using the leaf edging stitch she had learned from Zhou Xiuqin last week, she added two leaves with dense, neat stitches and felt content looking at them.
location: Bedroom, living room, hallway, and windowsill at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare and enjoy lunch.
description: Lunch was simple: I reheated last night's leftover pork rib soup and cooked noodles in it, and stir-fried some garlic crown daisy stems. Xuanxuan and Zhezhe were still practicing jump rope moves in the yard, while Xinxin chased Dad to learn how to kick the shuttlecock. The family then sat around the table together, lively and warm.
location: Kitchen, dining room, and courtyard of the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Noon break
description: After the meal, she urged the children to go back to their rooms for a nap. They had tired themselves out playing in the morning and quieted down before long. Ma Xiulan leaned against the headboard in the master bedroom, closed her eyes, and rested for about half an hour, thinking over the plan to pick up her parents in the afternoon.
location: The bedrooms of the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Personal exercise (Baduanjin)
description: The children were still asleep and the living room was quiet. Ma Xiulan did two rounds of Baduanjin on the yoga mat, moving much more freely than in the morning. When she reached the movement “Both hands hold up the heavens to regulate the Triple Burner,” she felt her lower back straighten, and after finishing, her whole body felt light and refreshed.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Hand embroidery and phone leisure
description: After exercising, she felt refreshed and returned to the windowsill to continue embroidering. She picked up her phone and liked the crochet tutorial posted by the sisters in the handicraft group, then saw Aunt Wu saying in the group that she would come to Tianjin next week. She quickly sent her a private message to ask about the train number and promised to pick her up at the station.
location: Windowsill at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Picked up parents to go out for dumplings, walked them back, and returned home to prepare dinner.
description: Ma Xiulan walked less than 10 minutes to her parents' home at 45 Shengli Street and picked up her elderly parents. Together they walked another 10 minutes to Shengqingyuan Dumpling Restaurant on Dongfang Commercial Street, where she ordered pork and scallion dumplings and several cold dishes. While eating, she talked with them about having paid the medical insurance premium yesterday to reassure them. After the meal, she held her mother's hand and strolled along Shengli Street, walked them to the entrance of their building, and then walked home at a brisk pace herself. Once home, she started preparing dinner: she reheated the leftover egg pancakes from the morning, cooked rice porridge, stir-fried tomatoes and eggs, and steamed the pumpkin steamed buns she had brought back from her parents' home.
location: Parents' home at No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Shengqingyuan Dumpling Restaurant at a1-5 Dongfang Commercial Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin; the area around Shengli Street; and the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road.

name: Family dinner and after-dinner cleanup
description: Ma Zhiqiang helped set out the bowls and chopsticks, and the family sat around the table for dinner. Zhezhe and Xinxin were still arguing over who had jumped rope more at noon, and Xuanxuan asked if they could go to Music Square to play on the horizontal bar during the evening walk. Ma Xiulan said they could as long as their homework was done. After dinner, Ma Xiulan cleared the dishes into the kitchen, Ma Zhiqiang voluntarily wiped the table, and the children played by themselves for a while.
location: Home dining room and kitchen, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening family walk (drove to Music Park and back)
description: When they were ready, the whole family set off. Ma Zhiqiang drove the van and navigated to the Music Park in Dongli District. After nearly 40 minutes they arrived. The children played in the fitness area: Xuanxuan climbed the horizontal bar, Zhezhe played by the sandpit, and Xinxin chased Ma Xiulan. Ma Xiulan and Ma Zhiqiang sat on a bench watching them and chatting, feeling life was very solid. After an hour of play, it was getting late, so they drove back to Jinghai, with the children chattering nonstop in the car.
location: Music Park at the intersection of Xingfu Road in Dongli District, Tianjin, and the route there and back.

name: End-of-month family dental check-up and evening wash-up and tucking the children in.
description: After getting home, she had the children rinse their mouths. Ma Xiulan took out a small flashlight and a health notebook and checked everyone's teeth one by one in the bathroom. Xuanxuan's teeth were clean and he was praised. Zhezhe had some food debris on his molars, so she had him brush again and use dental floss. Xinxin was fine, so she was rewarded with a 'Good Habit' sticker. All the check results were written down in the notebook. Then she arranged for everyone to wash up. After her bath, Xinxin pestered her to read two picture books borrowed from kindergarten and fell asleep listening. Zhezhe had already brushed his teeth on his own. Xuanxuan was still reading in his room, so she went over and told him to go to bed early. After everyone was settled, Ma Xiulan and Ma Zhiqiang chatted on the living room sofa. Her husband said he might make a long-distance trip next week. She told him to be careful, and they also discussed pickling some new pickled vegetables next week and bringing some to Zhang Shufen.
location: Bathroom, bedrooms, and living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening personal relaxation and going to bed.
description: The children were all asleep. She boiled water and poured a full basin of mugwort water to soak her feet. While soaking, she replied to messages in the handicraft group and liked a video of the cup cozy that Sister Zhou Xiuqin had newly crocheted. She also looked at the chrysanthemums in the yard and planned that if the weather was nice tomorrow, she could try making 'spicy dried radish'. After soaking her feet, she applied hand cream and did a set of shoulder and neck stretches. Before bed, she laid out the clothes that Zhezhe and Xuanxuan would wear tomorrow at the head of their beds. Lying in bed, she recalled the day—the laughter in the courtyard, her parents' smiles while eating, the evening breeze at Music Park, and the children being well-behaved during their dental check-up. Her heart felt warm. She turned off the light and fell asleep at 23:32.
location: Living room and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Early rising and morning preparations
description: Ma Xiulan got up immediately when the alarm rang, without lingering in bed. She simply threw on a coat and did 5 minutes of shoulder, neck, and lower back stretches on the bedroom floor to wake her body up from sleep. Because she was going to Jizhou today and had things on her mind, she moved more briskly than usual.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Prepared breakfast and reminded the family of things
description: Ma Xiulan quickly went into the kitchen, put the buns she had prepared the night before into the steamer, turned on the stove to cook millet porridge, and quickly stir-fried some vinegar cabbage. While she worked, she told her husband Ma Zhiqiang, who had just gotten up, that he would take the two sons to school today, and that their daughter Xinxin would be dropped off at kindergarten by neighbor Sister Wang on her way. The children's breakfast was ready, and she reminded her husband to make sure they finished eating.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Packed up and set off.
description: Ma Xiulan packed a steamed bun, a small jar of pickled vegetables, and a thermos filled with hot water into her canvas bag. She checked her phone, power bank, and notebook. Once everything was ready, she said goodbye to her family and hurried out of the house, meeting up with Sister Wang Guilan and a few neighbors at the community gate, ready to board the inspection group's bus.
location: Community entrance near No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Taking a bus to Jizhou
description: The study tour bus departed on time. Ma Xiulan and Wang Guilan sat in a window seat together. After chatting briefly about their children from last night, she leaned back in her seat and rested with her eyes closed, catching up on about half an hour of sleep. Outside the window, the familiar urban area gradually turned into countryside scenery. She silently thought about today's key inspection points, full of energy.
location: On the coach from Jinghai District to Jizhou District, Tianjin

name: Visiting the orchard and learning to make jam
description: After arriving at Xiaying Town in Jizhou District, Ma Xiulan immediately got down to business. In the orchard of the demonstration village, she carefully observed the fruit tree planting and picking process. Most importantly, she pulled aside a farmer auntie who was boiling hawthorn jam and asked in detail about the ratio of sugar to fruit, whether extra water was needed, and how to extend shelf life without preservatives. She opened the memo app on her phone and recorded everything word by word, asking follow-up questions on the spot when she didn't understand something.
location: Orchard in Shifan Village, Xiaying Town, Jizhou District, Tianjin

name: Walked to the farmhouse restaurant and had lunch, picking up tips
description: After the visit, Ma Xiulan walked with the group to a nearby farmhouse restaurant for lunch, chatting eagerly with Wang Guilan along the way about the jam recipe they had just learned. At the farmhouse restaurant, a plate of braised fish in savory sauce was especially flavorful. She went to the kitchen door and smilingly asked the chef in charge for the secret to preparing the sauce. Seeing her sincerity, the chef told her the proportions of several local sauces and the heat control for stir-frying. She thanked him again and again, feeling as happy as if she had found a treasure.
location: A farmhouse restaurant in Xiaying Town, Jizhou District, Tianjin

name: Visiting a homestay and exploring the consignment model
description: During the afternoon visit to Mo Shangyin Homestay, Ma Xiulan's attention was drawn to the embroidered insoles and hand-woven baskets on the display rack. She immediately realized that this was a side-business model she could learn from. She took the initiative to approach the owner, showed the pickled vegetable photos saved on her phone, and sincerely asked whether she could set up a consignment point here. The owner was very interested, and the two exchanged WeChat contacts and agreed to discuss details later.
location: Mosangyin Guesthouse, Xiaying Town, Jizhou District, Tianjin

name: Buying chili sauce before the return trip
description: Before gathering for the return trip, Ma Xiulan took Wang Guilan by the hand and walked into the local specialty supermarket in Xiaying Town. She paid out of her own pocket for two bottles of farm-made chili sauce. She deliberately checked the ingredient list and silently noted the color and aroma, planning to study them carefully after returning home to see how they differed from her own technique and whether she could learn something from them.
location: Local Specialty Supermarket, Xiaying Town, Jizhou District, Tianjin (260 meters northwest of Zhongying Village Committee)

name: Returned to Jinghai by car.
description: The tour bus started its return trip. After the whole day, although she had been sitting on the bus, moving back and forth between the orchard and the homestay had also added up to quite a bit of distance, and Ma Xiulan felt some soreness in her lower back. She chatted with Wang Guilan about the day's gains, shared her discoveries and ideas, and couldn't help feeling more hopeful about her future side-business path.
location: On the long-distance bus from Jizhou District to Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Went home and greeted the family.
description: The shuttle bus stopped at the community entrance. Ma Xiulan walked home quickly with a tired yet content feeling. As soon as she entered the door, the children gathered around. Smiling, she took out the two bottles of chili sauce. Her daughter Xinxin curiously wanted to taste it, but she stopped her. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang took the bag from her hand, asked with concern, and told her to rest for a while.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing and enjoying dinner.
description: Although somewhat tired, Ma Xiulan still put on an apron and brought the meal her husband had warmed in the pot to the table. The family sat together, the children chattering about funny things at school. While serving Xinxin food, she enthusiastically talked about what she had seen in Jizhou, especially the idea about sauced fish and consignment, and her husband nodded approvingly.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Organizing notes and researching chili sauce.
description: After clearing the dishes, Ma Xiulan sat on the sofa, opened the memo app on her phone, and transferred the key information she had noted that day—the jam recipe, the sauce method, the homestay owner's contact information—into a small notebook. Then she carefully examined the two bottles of chili sauce, unscrewed the lids, smelled them, dipped a clean pair of chopsticks in to taste, and wrote in the notebook: 'Bright red oil, strong fermented black bean flavor, worth trying in stir-fry.'
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Soaking feet and listening to the children talk.
description: Ma Xiulan brought a basin of hot water and soaked her feet comfortably. Her son Zhezhe was beside her, gesturing animatedly as he talked about today's PE class, while her daughter Xinxin nestled in her arms, showing her a drawing she had made. She responded to the children while feeling the fatigue in her legs and feet slowly melt away.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening stretching and getting ready for bed.
description: After soaking her feet, Ma Xiulan felt obvious soreness in her lower back, so she did about ten minutes of cat stretches and wall-assisted waist twists on the bedroom floor, slowly loosening up her stiff back. Her husband came over and, following her instructions, gently pressed her lower back a few times. She felt much relieved. Then she turned off the living room light, checked the doors and windows, went back to the bedroom, and lay in bed, replaying scenes from the orchard and the homestay in her mind. Soon she fell into a deep sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Getting up and light exercise
description: Woke up right at 5:35 in the morning. First, she moved her ankles and wrists in bed, then stretched her shoulders, neck, and lower back to relieve the fatigue from yesterday's inspection. Finally, she laid out a mat in the living room and did a full set of Baduanjin, feeling the movements were especially smooth.
location: Bedroom and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning chores and breakfast time
description: After exercising, she quickly washed up and went into the kitchen to prepare breakfast: heating millet porridge, taking out the homemade pickled cucumbers and the farmhouse chili sauce brought back from Jizhou, stir-frying scallion eggs, and steaming mantou. Once ready, she woke the three children, Ma Mingxuan, Ma Mingzhe, and Ma Yuxin, helped the youngest daughter get dressed and combed her hair, and urged the sons to wash up. The family sat down together for breakfast; she served the children porridge and dishes, told them to be good, and ate last herself.
location: Kitchen and dining room of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Paid the heating fee and recorded it.
description: At 1:30 p.m., Xiulan rode her electric bike out and headed along Jingwen Road to the Jinghai Heating Service Hall of Tianjin Heating Co., Ltd. on Dongfanghong Road. Although the sky was cloudy, she felt lighthearted. There were not many people queuing in the hall, so she quickly handed 1,200 yuan in cash through the window and received a receipt. After returning home, she immediately inserted the receipt into her account book and clearly wrote beside it: "October 31, paid this season's heating fee of 1,200 yuan, settled in full." She also sent her husband a voice message saying the fee was paid and the account was settled, and felt reassured.
location: Round trip from 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin to Jinghai Heating Service Hall, Tianjin Heating Co., Ltd., Dongfanghong Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the child from school
description: Seeing that it was almost time, Xiulan rode her electric bike again to pick up her son Zhezhe from Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School. Since it was Friday and school let out early, quite a few parents were already at the gate. After picking up Zhezhe, the mother and son headed together to Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up Xinxin. The two children excitedly shared school stories from the back seat of the electric bike: Xinxin said the teacher praised her for her drawing, and Zhezhe proudly reported scoring 95 on his math quiz. Listening to them, Xiulan felt warm inside and rode home in about ten-plus minutes.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street) to Huakang First Kindergarten (Beihua Road), then return home.

name: Supervising homework and preparing dinner.
description: Back home, Xiulan had her eldest son, Xuanxuan, take the younger children to do their homework, while she plunged into the kitchen. She made the braised ribs the children loved, stir-fried a plate of greens, and steamed the rice. The sound of cooking filled the kitchen. As she bustled about, she reminded the children from the other room to sit up straight and be careful with mental arithmetic.
location: Living room and kitchen of home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: The whole family had dinner together.
description: Her husband Ma Zhiqiang finished driving earlier than usual today and was just in time for a hot meal. The family sat around the dining table, with glossy red braised pork ribs and crisp, tasty greens on the table. During the meal, Xiulan casually mentioned that the heating fee had already been paid, so there were no major expenses left this month. Ma Zhiqiang picked up a rib for her and praised her for being reliable, and the children joined in teasing; the meal was lively and warm.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Clearing the dishes and taking a short rest
description: After the meal, Xiulan quickly cleared the table, washed the dishes and chopsticks clean, and wiped the stove spotless. She poured herself a cup of warm water, sat down in the living room for a short rest, and also found the small dress Xinxin would wear for tomorrow's performance and hung it to one side.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Family evening walk and end-of-month family summary
description: After a short rest, Xiulan got the whole family into sneakers and strolled slowly along Jingwen Road in front of their house. The evening breeze was cool; the children chased and played, while the couple discussed next month's handicraft market. After the walk, the family held a brief month-end summary meeting in the living room. Xiulan praised the family for keeping up the daily walks and limiting phone time, and read out each child's progress one by one: Xuanxuan advanced 5 places in the monthly exam, Zhezhe was more patient when playing with his little sister, and Xinxin learned three embroidery stitches. Ma Zhiqiang applauded and encouraged the children to keep working hard next month. The whole family agreed to maintain the commitments of
location: The section of Jingwen Road outside the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and the living room at home

name: Wash up, keep my daughter company, and relax with a foot soak.
description: After the wrap-up meeting, Xiulan took her daughter Xinxin to wash up and soak her feet, told her a bedtime story, and watched her fall asleep sweetly. After all the children were settled, she brought out the foot basin, poured in hot water, and enjoyed a comfortable fifteen-minute foot soak while pressing the Yongquan point on the soles of her feet with her fingers, feeling her whole body relax.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Reviewing the day before bed and falling asleep peacefully.
description: Lying in bed, Xiulan mentally reviewed her day: the heating fee was paid, health data was recorded, the family summary meeting went smoothly, and everything for October was properly wrapped up. With nothing on her mind, drowsiness quickly came. She picked up her phone and wrote in her memo: “October 31, sunny turning cloudy. End-of-month wrap-up, all smooth. Tomorrow is Saturday; in the morning we'll make dumplings and teach Xin Xin to make pancakes.” After setting the alarm, she lay on her side listening to the occasional sound of cars outside the window, felt a sense of security, and fell into a deep sleep within a few minutes.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Morning stretching and exercise
description: At 5:30 in the morning, Ma Xiulan woke up early. She first did shoulder and neck stretches on the bedroom floor, then went to the yard and practiced a set of Baduanjin in the cool autumn air to loosen up her muscles and joints. Afterward, she tended to the chrysanthemums in the corner, picked off dead leaves, watered the garlic sprouts, and enjoyed the peacefulness of the early morning.
location: Bedroom and courtyard at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Prepare and enjoy breakfast
description: Ma Xiulan went back into the house, cooked low-fat oatmeal porridge, and served it with homemade crunchy pickled cucumbers and salted duck eggs. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang and the children got up one after another, and the family of five sat around and ate breakfast. Ma Xiulan told her eldest son Ma Mingxuan to do homework at home with his younger brother and sister, while she went to the handicraft exhibition and would return before noon.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Packing up display items and tidying the house.
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan swiftly cleared the dishes, then took the carefully embroidered "Ruyi" ornament from the bedroom wardrobe, carefully checked the stitching and wiped it, and put the newly trial-made chili sauce into a cloth bag. She put the display items, phone, keys, and change into a small cloth pouch, and before going out, pulled the living room curtains shut, getting ready to leave.
location: Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Walk to the Cultural Center
description: Ma Xiulan locked the door, picked up her cloth bag, and walked along Jingwen Road toward the Jinghai District Cultural Center. The autumn sunshine was warm. On the way she met her neighbor across the hall, Wang Guilan. She smiled and told her she was going to attend an exhibition, and Wang Guilan wished her success in winning a big prize.
location: Along Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Participated in the Jingu Traditional Handicrafts Exhibition and won an award.
description: Ma Xiulan arrived at the cultural center exhibition hall and displayed her "Ruyi" hanging ornament and chili sauce in the "Traditional Embroidery and Farmhouse Flavor" area. During the exhibition, visitors came in a steady stream. Her embroidered works were well received, and people also asked about the chili sauce. Around 10 o'clock, she met an old acquaintance, Zhou Xiuqin, and the two exchanged tips on new embroidery stitches and making pickled vegetables. At the 11 o'clock award ceremony, her "Ruyi" hanging ornament won the "Outstanding Craft Heritage Encouragement Award." She excitedly went on stage to accept the award and took photos with the other winners.
location: Jinghai District Cultural Center, Tianjin, China (northwest side of the intersection of Jingwen Road and Shengli Street)

name: Walk home
description: After the exhibition ended, Ma Xiulan carefully held the certificate and material package and walked briskly home along Jingwen Road, thinking about how to share the good news with her family.
location: Along Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Lunch and sharing the good news in the WeChat group.
description: When she got home, the three children were watching TV. Ma Xiulan cooked a pot of clear soup noodles with poached eggs, served with flatbread. After the meal, she sent the award-winning photos to the Sisters Embroidery Group and the family group chat, receiving warm likes and congratulations. She also video-chatted with her sisters Xiufen and Xiuyun, feeling especially happy.
location: Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Taking a short rest and going to her parents' home.
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan rested on the sofa for 20 minutes. Then she changed into a clean coat, took the new chili sauce she had prepared for her parents, said a word to her husband, and went out. She walked along Jingwen Road to her parents' home on Shengli Street and told her mother in detail about winning the award. Her father listened with great interest. She left the chili sauce with her mother and reminded her to keep her stomach warm as the weather turned cold.
location: Parents’ home, No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Watch for community computer training class announcements and go home
description: After leaving her parents' home, Ma Xiulan walked by the community bulletin board on the way and noticed a newly posted enrollment notice for a "Computer Basics Training Class for Middle-Aged and Elderly People." She photographed the key information with her phone, planning to discuss it with her husband at home. After taking the photo, she slowly walked home.
location: Community bulletin board near the intersection of Jingwen Road and Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Shopping on the way home
description: When she reached Shengli Street, Ma Xiulan remembered that the sugar at home was almost used up, so she turned into the Jingbai Supermarket on the roadside, bought a bag of sugar, checked the prices of other seasonings while she was there, and left after paying.
location: Jingbai Supermarket, No. 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Go home and teach Xinxin to make pancakes.
description: Ma Xiulan had just entered the house when her younger daughter Ma Yuxin clamored to learn how to make pancakes. She tied on an apron and taught her daughter step by step how to mix the batter, crack eggs, and spread it in a frying pan. Though the first pancake was a bit burnt, the second one turned out just right. The kitchen was filled with aroma and the laughter of mother and daughter.
location: China, Tianjin Jinghai District, No. 156 Jingwen Road, home kitchen

name: Discussing enrolling in a computer class with her husband and preparing dinner.
description: After finishing the pancake lesson, Ma Xiulan was about to prepare dinner when her husband Ma Zhiqiang came in from the balcony. She pulled him over to sit on the sofa, showed him a photo of the training class announcement, and expressed her wish to learn how to use a computer to keep the family's accounts and download embroidery patterns. After thinking it over, her husband expressed support and even paid for her to enroll. Ma Xiulan happily gave her husband a kiss, then began preparing dinner.
location: Living room and kitchen at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Prepare a hearty dinner
description: Ma Xiulan was in high spirits and decided to show off her skills. She blanched the beef brisket and simmered it with tomatoes for more than an hour, making a thick rich broth that filled the house with fragrance. She also stir-fried broccoli with garlic. The children in the living room kept shouting that they were hungry.
location: China, Tianjin Jinghai District, No. 156 Jingwen Road, home kitchen

name: Family dinner and family atmosphere
description: Ma Zhiqiang helped serve the dishes, and the family of five sat around the table. Ma Yuxin proudly pointed at the pancake she had made, and everyone rushed to taste it and said it was delicious. While picking up food with her chopsticks, Ma Xiulan told the story of winning the award again, showed the certificate, and her husband encouraged her to keep doing what she loved, saying life would get better and better.
location: Dining room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: After-dinner walk and short family meeting
description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan cleared the dishes and urged the whole family to put on their coats and go out for a walk. She took out the radio and tuned it to a crosstalk channel. The family walked along the brightly lit Jingwen Road, listening as they walked, in a harmonious atmosphere. After walking for half an hour, while resting on a bench in a small park by the road, she held a brief 'family meeting,' praising the children's performance during the day and reiterating the agreement that daily screen time should not exceed one hour. The children nodded in agreement, and her husband also said he would supervise.
location: Along Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China, and the small park by the roadside

name: Return home and implement the screen time limit plan.
description: When they got home, the children put their phones and tablets into the box on the living room coffee table on their own, and Ma Zhiqiang also handed over the remote control, deciding not to watch TV tonight. Ma Xiulan nodded with satisfaction, feeling that these little family agreements were making the atmosphere better and better.
location: Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Evening hygiene and bedtime routine
description: Ma Xiulan urged the three children to wash up one by one, and she herself simply wiped herself down and changed into pajamas. After washing up, the children went back to their rooms, and the youngest daughter Ma Yuxin pestered her to tell the story of 'The Little Horse Crossing the River' before she would fall asleep.
location: Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Personal relaxation, expense tracking, and bedtime
description: After the children went to sleep, Ma Xiulan sat at the head of the bed and took out her ledger to carefully record the expense of buying sugar at Jingbai Supermarket. She touched her award certificate and embroidery material kit, feeling very pleased, and wrote in her phone memos to sign up for the community computer class early the next morning. At 21:30 she turned off the light and lay down, recalling a full and happy day, and soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Morning exercise and courtyard time
description: Woke up naturally at 5:36 in the morning, got out of bed quietly, and did a few minutes of shoulder and neck stretches on the floor mat in front of the bedroom bed to loosen up. Then she went into the courtyard, felt the cool morning air, strolled around for over ten minutes, and looked at the roses she had watered yesterday, dotted with dewdrops, feeling happy and relaxed. Finally, she did a complete set of Baduanjin in the courtyard, moving her whole body through every posture, and felt energized.
location: Home courtyard at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare breakfast and have breakfast together as a family.
description: After washing up, she went into the kitchen. Since it was Sunday and the whole family was resting, she wanted to give everyone a hot meal. She cooked a pot of millet porridge, steamed the steamed buns made yesterday, quickly fried a few scallion egg pancakes, and put out her homemade pickled cucumbers and chili sauce. At 6:30 she woke her husband Ma Zhiqiang and the three children, helped her little daughter Xinxin braid her hair, and urged her son Zhezhe to wash his face. The whole family sat around the table and had a lively breakfast. After the meal, she quickly cleared the dishes and wiped the kitchen spotless.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Mending her husband's shirt
description: While her husband and children were busy in the house, she remembered that the right cuff of her husband Ma Zhiqiang's blue-gray plaid long-sleeved shirt had been coming unstitched for several days. She found a similar-colored thread in the sewing box, had him hold the shirt against himself to measure the length, then sat on the living room sofa, threaded the needle, and sewed a few neat, tight stitches that were sturdy yet inconspicuous. She thought that when he went out on his truck run dressed neatly, he would also have more dignity.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Go to the community to sign up for the computer class and buy groceries on the way.
description: She changed into a clean maroon coat, put the prepared 150 yuan in cash and her ID card in her pocket, and walked to the Jingwen Road Community Service Center. The staff member was very friendly. She filled out the registration form for the “Computer Basics Training Class for Middle-Aged and Elderly People”, paid the fee, received a course schedule and a simple textbook, and was told to come directly to class next Thursday at 7 p.m. With this matter settled, she felt much lighter on her feet. On the way back, she stopped by Wutong Community Vegetable Market and picked out two pork ribs, baby bok choy, and tomatoes at Aunt Sun's stall, planning to make pork rib soup and stir-fried tomatoes with eggs for lunch. Aunt Sun also pressed a bunch of cilantro into her hands, and she smiled and thanked her.
location: Residents' Committee of Jingwen Road Community, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Household tidying and garden care
description: After getting home, she first arranged for the three children to do homework in the living room: her eldest son Xuanxuan did physics problems, her second son Zhezhe worked on math at the coffee table, and her youngest daughter Xinxin obediently practiced character tracing. After settling them down, she started on housework: mopped the living room floor, wiped down the kitchen stove and range hood. Then she took out some thick clothes from the wardrobe to air, preparing for the season change in a couple of days. After that, she got scissors, went to the yard to trim the dead branches and leaves from the roses, and then carried a watering can to water them thoroughly.
location: Living room and courtyard, home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Preparing lunch and dining with the whole family
description: At 11:30, she washed her hands and started preparing lunch. After blanching the pork ribs, she put them in a clay pot with ginger slices, scallion sections, and a few red dates, and simmered them over low heat, filling the house with the aroma of meat. She then quickly stir-fried garlic broccoli and tomato scrambled eggs. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang smelled the aroma and came over to help set the table and bring out the bowls and chopsticks. The children all said they were hungry, washed their hands, and sat down obediently. The family had a lively lunch. Watching them eat soup and meat with gusto made her happier than if she were eating herself.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Math teacher.
description: After lunch, her husband Ma Zhiqiang took the initiative to do the dishes and told her to take a rest. She didn't decline; she was indeed a bit tired. She picked up her phone and looked at the sisters' group chat, replied to a few messages, then glanced at the course outline sent by the computer class teacher and planned what to learn next week. Having been busy for a few days, she felt drowsy, so she lay down on the living room sofa, covered herself with a small blanket, and dozed for forty minutes. After waking up, she felt much refreshed.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Helping the children with homework and making crafts.
description: Waking up from her nap, she washed her face and urged the children to keep working on their homework. When her eldest son, Xuanxuan, hit a difficult problem on his physics test paper, she sat down next to him and comforted him, saying, "Don't worry, think it over slowly." Her second son, Zhezhe, gave her the most trouble with addition and subtraction within 100; she patiently taught him digit by digit. Her youngest daughter, Xinxin, required the least attention, so she had her trace red characters at the dining table. She herself sat nearby, picked up the shirt she had sewn for her husband, and resumed working on the shoe insoles from her sewing basket, embroidering a few small flowers. The living room was very quiet, with only the sounds of pen tips gliding across paper and needles being threaded.
location: Living room and dining room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Tended the vegetable garden and cleared out household clutter.
description: After helping with homework, the children went off to play, and she didn't sit idle. While it was still light, she went into the yard and swept the dead branches and fallen leaves from the morning pruning into a pile, put them into a dustpan, and dumped them into the trash can. She also watered the pots of scallions and cilantro in the corner, and felt reassured seeing them green and lush. Sundays mean more people and more trash, so she emptied the trash cans in every room and replaced the bags, leaving the house clean and tidy inside and out.
location: Home courtyard at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing dinner and gathering with family
description: As the sun set, she started preparing dinner. She added some white radish to the leftover pork rib soup from noon and stewed it until it was very soft, making the soup even more savory. She also stir-fried green pepper with shredded potato and made tiger-skin green peppers, both of which were her husband's favorite dishes to go with rice. Dinner was simple, but the whole family sat together and ate warmly. At the table, she told her husband about signing up for a computer class during the day and that the class would start next Thursday. Her husband said, "Very good, go and learn; in the future, you can teach the kids too." The children had finished their homework early and were cheerful, chattering about things at school.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The whole family went out for a walk and to the supermarket for shopping.
description: After dinner, she urged everyone to change clothes and go out for a walk to help digestion. Holding her daughter Xinxin's little hand, with her husband walking in the lead and the two sons chasing and horsing around behind, the family of five strolled along Jingwen Road. The streetlights stretched their shadows, and a gentle evening breeze blew—it was very pleasant. When they reached the entrance of Jingbai Supermarket, she remembered they were almost out of vinegar at home, so she called everyone to go in. They bought a bottle of black vinegar and a bag of sugar. The children looked longingly at the snack section, but she exchanged a glance with her husband and didn't agree to buy any, saying, "We have apples at home—we'll each have one when we get back."
location: Jingbai Supermarket, Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Soaking feet to relax and recording household accounts.
description: After returning from the walk, she made sure the children all took baths. Once they were settled, she brought a basin of hot water for herself and soaked her feet for 15 minutes in the bedroom. While soaking, she took out the ledger from the bedside cabinet and recorded the day’s expenses on groceries and registration, mentally counting how much of the monthly budget was left. Her husband sat beside her looking at his phone for a while and told her he had to get up early the next day for a short trip, so she reminded him to be safe.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Putting her daughter to sleep and telling stories
description: After soaking her feet, she went to her daughter Xinxin's room. The little one was not sleepy yet and pestered her for a story. She picked up the book The Well-Behaved Little Rabbit from the bedside, held Xinxin in her arms, and told the story in a soft voice. Before the story was finished, Xinxin fell asleep in her arms. She gently laid her on the small pillow, tucked in the blanket, and looked at her flushed little face, her heart full of love.
location: Children's room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pre-bedtime preparation, relaxation, and planning for tomorrow.
description: Back in the bedroom, she checked the doors and windows, then went to look at the bedroom doors of her two sons, Xuanxuan and Zhezhe, to make sure they were closed. Lying in bed, she went over the day's events: successfully signed up for the computer class, mended the shirt, hung out the laundry, kept an eye on the children's homework... She felt very fulfilled. She took out her phone and jotted down tomorrow's plan in her memo: “Drop the kids off in the morning, then go to Aunt Sun's to buy some white radish and meat filling, and make dumplings in the evening.” After writing it, she felt at ease. Before turning off the light, she did a few minutes of deep breathing and felt her body relax. Although there was a lot to do today, she had not missed a single thing. Life felt peaceful, and she turned over and soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Morning routine: getting up, taking daughter to kindergarten, morning exercise, and breakfast
description: At 5:35 a.m., the alarm went off. Ma Xiulan got up immediately and stretched her shoulders, neck, and lower back while still in bed. Then she put on a thick coat, went to her daughter Ma Yuxin's room, woke her gently, helped her change into a fleece-lined coat and sweater, and told her to wash up. At 6:45, Ma Xiulan took her daughter by the hand and walked to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten. It was windy on the way, so the mother and daughter walked quickly along the sidewalk on Jingwen Road, and Ma Xiulan pulled her daughter's hat tight. After sending her daughter into the kindergarten, Ma Xiulan returned to the courtyard at home. Because of the wind, she only took a short walk before going inside, where she did a set of Baduanjin on the living room floor. After morning exercise, she went to the kitchen to steam sweet potatoes, make soy milk, and prepare a nutritious breakfast. Around 8 o'clock, she enjoyed the sweet potatoes and soy milk with her own pickled cucumbers and finished breakfast.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (home) and Huakang First Kindergarten

name: Preparing and paying the heating bill
description: After breakfast, Ma Xiulan took out the iron box for the month's household expenses from the bedside table, carefully counted out 1200 yuan for her own heating fee, and also took out the 800 yuan advance from her parents. She put them separately in the inner pocket of her padded jacket, confirmed she had all payment cards, and went out. She walked about 15 minutes to the heating service hall on Jingwen Road. In the hall, she first paid her own heating fee of 1200 yuan and checked the receipt, then paid 800 yuan for her parents. After getting the two receipts, she carefully folded and put them in her inner pocket, then walked home. The whole trip took about 35 minutes.
location: Heating Business Hall on Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Thoroughly clean the radiators at home.
description: After paying the heating fee and returning home, Ma Xiulan took a rag, an old toothbrush, a small basin, and a feather duster from the bathroom cabinet and began cleaning all the radiators in the house. She first dusted off the surface with the feather duster, then wiped the front and sides with a wet rag, and finally used a toothbrush dipped in water to carefully clean the gaps. She paid special attention to the radiator in her son Ma Mingzhe's room, because her son liked to play on the floor and a lot of dust had accumulated under the radiator. She spent nearly an hour cleaning the radiators in the three bedrooms, the living room, and the bathroom until they shone. Although her back ached, she felt pleased.
location: Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Cleaning tools and taking a short break
description: After cleaning the radiator, Ma Xiulan washed the rags, toothbrush, and other tools, hung them up to dry, and rinsed and put away the basin. Then she went to the kitchen, washed the breakfast dishes, and wiped down the stove. When she finished, she sat on the living room sofa, poured a cup of hot water, took out her phone to watch a clothing-cutting video shared in the sisters' group chat, and enjoyed a brief moment of relaxation.
location: Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Had lunch and a midday rest alone
description: At noon, her husband Ma Zhiqiang and the children were not home for lunch, so Ma Xiulan made do with a simple meal on her own. She reheated the leftover scrambled eggs with tomatoes and half a plate of braised pork ribs from last night, cooked a bowl of noodles, and finished lunch with the leftovers. After clearing the dishes, she leaned back on the sofa in the living room and took a short nap with her eyes closed for about 20 minutes to refresh herself.
location: Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Calmly doing hand embroidery
description: After waking from her midday nap, Ma Xiulan took out the embroidery kit she had picked up at the market last week from the storage box in the wardrobe. It contained a mandarin ducks playing in water pattern. She spread the pattern drawing on the coffee table, carefully traced the outline onto the fabric with a pencil, then tightened the fabric in an embroidery hoop, threaded a green silk thread, and began stitching stitch by stitch along the edge of the lotus leaves. The wind howled outside, and inside the room there was only the soft rustling of the needle passing through the cloth. She was so immersed in it that she unknowingly embroidered several leaves.
location: Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Pick the children up from school.
description: At 3 p.m., Ma Xiulan put down her needlework, put on a thick coat, picked up her shopping bag, and walked to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up her son Ma Mingzhe. She arrived at the school gate just as classes were letting out. Ma Mingzhe ran over excitedly, took the shopping bag, and talked all the way about playing soccer in PE class. The two then walked together to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up her daughter Ma Yuxin. As soon as she saw her mother, the daughter hugged Ma Xiulan’s leg and said, “Mom, today the teacher taught us how to fold paper frogs!” and showed off the paper frog in her hand. Holding one child with each hand, Ma Xiulan listened as the two children vied to tell her the news from school, and they walked home together.
location: Jinghai District Third Primary School and Huakang First Kindergarten on Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Helping the children with homework and preparing dinner
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan had the children wash their hands and do homework at the living room table. She poured warm water for her daughter Ma Yuxin and let her draw, then checked her son Ma Mingzhe's math workbook. Finding that his approach to the word problems was off, she patiently pointed it out and gave him problems to redo. While the children were doing homework, she went to the kitchen to thaw the pork ribs, clean the garlic scapes, potatoes, and tomatoes, and cut them into pieces for later. At 5 p.m., she heated oil in a wok, blanched the ribs, then put them into a clay pot with ginger slices, scallion sections, and red dates. She brought it to a boil over high heat, then turned down to low and simmered slowly. At the same time, she stir-fried garlic scapes with meat and scrambled eggs with tomatoes. The kitchen was steaming and filled with delicious aromas.
location: Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Family Dinner and Husband Repaying the Advance
description: Around 6 p.m., her husband Ma Zhiqiang came home from work. Dinner was served, and the family sat around the table. Ma Yuxin again took out the paper frog and performed with it, while Ma Mingzhe excitedly described the goal he scored in the school football match. Halfway through the meal, Ma Zhiqiang pulled 800 yuan out of his pocket and handed it to Ma Xiulan, saying it was the money he had withdrawn to repay the heating bill his parents had covered. Ma Xiulan took the money, felt relieved, and nodded to indicate that she would record it in the accounts after dinner.
location: Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Clearing dishes and household bookkeeping
description: After dinner, the children went to watch TV, Ma Zhiqiang went to the balcony to smoke, and Ma Xiulan quickly cleared the table, washing and drying the dishes. Then she took out the thick account book and a pen, turned to that day's date, and wrote in the income column: "November 3, Zhiqiang returned the heating fee advance paid to his parents, income 800 yuan." She also recorded the 2,000 yuan expense for the heating fee paid that morning and the small sundry expenses from picking up the children. After checking that the balance matched the cash in the iron box, she felt completely at ease.
location: Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Evening stretching and mugwort foot soak
description: In the evening, Ma Xiulan urged Ma Mingzhe and Ma Yuxin to wash up first. After they returned to their rooms, she laid a blanket on the living room floor and did 10 minutes of lower back rehab stretches, including cat stretch and slow waist twists, to relieve the stiffness from the day's labor. Then she boiled a kettle of water, poured it into the foot basin, sprinkled in a small handful of mugwort, adjusted the water temperature, and sat on the sofa soaking her feet comfortably for about 15 minutes. She felt warm all over, and most of her fatigue disappeared.
location: Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Helping daughter wash up and coaxing her to sleep
description: After soaking her feet, Ma Xiulan went to her daughter Ma Yuxin's room and saw that her daughter had already brushed her teeth and was lying in bed. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang was sitting on the bedside telling her the story of Sun Wukong beating the White Bone Demon three times. Ma Xiulan listened quietly nearby, watching her daughter slowly close her eyes and fall asleep. Once the girl was sound asleep, she gently closed the door and left.
location: Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Relaxing before bed and falling asleep
description: After the children had fallen asleep, the house grew quiet. Ma Xiulan returned to the master bedroom, changed into her pajamas, and sat propped against the headboard watching cooking videos on her phone for a while, thinking about new ideas for the next morning's breakfast. Her eyelids grew heavy. She turned off her phone, dimmed the lights, lay flat, and took a few minutes of deep breaths to fully relax. Knowing that the day's important matters were all settled—the heating bill paid and the accounts clear—she felt at ease, and before long fell into a peaceful sleep with steady breathing.
location: Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: At first light, Ma Xiulan got up to the sound of the alarm clock. She first did five minutes of shoulder and neck stretches by the bed to ease the soreness from cleaning the radiators yesterday. Then she put on a coat, went to the kitchen to boil water, and washed up quickly. For breakfast today, she was making tomato and egg noodles. She deftly cut the tomatoes, cracked two eggs, and prepared everything skillfully.
location: Bedroom and kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Waking and settling the children
description: Ma Xiulan first woke her eldest son Xuanxuan, who was slow to move, then her second son Zhezhe and her youngest daughter Xinxin. She combed Xinxin’s hair into two braids and told her to wear a thick coat because it was cloudy. As the children ate tomato and egg noodles, they listened to their mother nagging: “It’s getting cold today—everyone put on your long johns!” She checked each child’s schoolbag and outfit, and urged them to eat their fill.
location: Various rooms and dining room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Walk Xinxin to school
description: Ma Xiulan held her youngest daughter Xinxin's hand and walked about 15 minutes to Huakang First Kindergarten. On the way, she reminded her, "It's cloudy today, the kindergarten slide is chilly, so be careful when playing." After seeing Xinxin run in happily and greet her teacher, Ma Xiulan turned and went home.
location: Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Brief exercise and planning after returning home
description: Back in the small courtyard at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Ma Xiulan first took a leisurely stroll in the yard for about 10 minutes, then did a set of Baduanjin to loosen up her muscles and joints. After going inside for a drink of water, she took a small notebook and pen from the drawer and, while planning today's dishes, made a shopping list.
location: Home courtyard at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Stocking up at Wutong Commune Vegetable Market
description: Ma Xiulan walked to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market with her cloth bag and headed straight for Auntie Sun Guifang's vegetable stall. After exchanging pleasantries, she chose 3 heads of Chinese cabbage, a bunch of white radishes, two jin of spinach, and a bag of potatoes and baby bok choy. Auntie Sun generously rounded off the odd amount and also grabbed a handful of cilantro and stuffed it into the bag: 'Grown at home, have a taste!' Ma Xiulan thanked her repeatedly and brought up her plan to pickle Chinese cabbage. Then she went to the meat stall next door and picked out two jin of streaky pork with alternating fat and lean, planning to make braised pork for the children in the evening.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Return home to put away groceries and handle chores
description: As soon as she got home, Ma Xiulan sorted the groceries: she laid the Chinese cabbage and radishes out in the yard to air, planning to deal with them in the afternoon; put the potatoes and bok choy in the refrigerator; and cut the pork belly into pieces and blanched them for later. Seeing that her younger sister Ma Xiufen had left a WeChat message on her phone, she tapped it to listen, then replied by voice: 'Great, I'm looking forward to it! Just send it to our home courtyard on Jingwen Road!'
location: Home kitchen and courtyard, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing lunch and doing light housework
description: Ma Xiulan reheated the leftover stir-fried minced meat and baby bok choy from last night, cooked some thin noodles for herself, and made a simple lunch. After eating, she cleaned the stove and washed the dishes and chopsticks. She also glanced at the living room and put the toys the children had scattered on the floor into the storage bin.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Midday rest and family communication.
description: Ma Xiulan set a 20-minute alarm and lay down on the bedroom bed for a nap. After the alarm went off, she felt much more refreshed. She picked up her phone and sent a long voice message to her younger sister Ma Xiufen, urging repeatedly: “The package must be sent to the home address, don't send it anywhere else. If your brother finds out, he will start nagging again.”
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Washing the pickle jar
description: Ma Xiulan changed into an old smock, put on rubber gloves, and carried a dozen or so glass pickle jars of various sizes out from the corner of the yard. She first scalded them with hot water, then carefully scrubbed the insides with dish soap and a brush, and finally rinsed them thoroughly under the tap with clean water. Then she dried them one by one with a dry cloth and placed them upside down in a row under the windowsill, away from the sunlight, to air dry. This chore was quite tiring; she straightened her back and rested several times along the way.
location: Courtyard, yard corner, and under the faucet at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Getting fresh air in the courtyard and checking the drying progress.
description: After finishing the work, Ma Xiulan washed her face at the tap and stretched her back. She went to the yard to check the Chinese cabbage and radishes that had been drying since morning, shaking the excess water off the leaves. She glanced at her phone as well; there were no new messages. Her sister's package probably wouldn't arrive until tomorrow.
location: Home courtyard at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Picking up the second son and youngest daughter from school
description: Ma Xiulan took the children's jackets and gloves, and first walked to the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to wait for her second son Zhezhe. After picking him up, she asked him about his day at school as they walked. Then she stopped by Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten on the way to pick up her youngest daughter Xinxin. The little girl ran over happily when she saw her mother and older brother. The three of them chatted and laughed all the way home.
