location: Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin; home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Supervising homework and preparing dinner.
description: After arriving home, Ma Xiulan had Zhezhe do his homework at the dining table in the living room and admonished him: "Concentrate and write neatly," especially reminding him that Mom would check tonight's math homework. Xinxin was playing with building blocks nearby. Ma Xiulan tied on an apron, plunged into the kitchen, and began preparing dinner: she put the red-braised pork on to stew, let Chinese cabbage and vermicelli simmer, and quickly shredded potatoes and beat eggs for the tomato egg drop soup.
location: Living room and kitchen at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner
description: Husband Ma Zhiqiang just happened not to be driving today and got home on time. The family sat around the dinner table. The braised pork was rich and fragrant; the steaming stew and hot-and-sour shredded potatoes with rice smelled wonderful, and they ate with gusto. During the meal, Ma Xiulan mentioned to her husband, "Today I promised ZheZhe that starting tonight, he will do five extra math calculation problems every day, and he'll get a reward if he gets them right." Zhiqiang nodded and agreed, "Okay, you decide. The kid is just careless."
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Cleaning up the kitchen and helping with homework
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan quickly cleared the dishes and wiped down the stove. Then she sat down beside Zhezhe and watched him correct his school homework. Next, she took out the small practice notebook she had prepared, in which she had copied 5 addition and subtraction problems within 10. "Zhezhe, our agreement begins now. Get them all right and you get 15 minutes of Boonie Bears." She sat beside him, watching him work through each problem, occasionally reminding him, "Look carefully at the numbers!" The eldest, Xuanxuan, was doing homework in his room with the door closed, and Xinxin was obediently watching TV by herself. Zhezhe got everything right tonight, so Ma Xiulan kept her promise and let him watch 15 minutes of the cartoon.
location: Kitchen and living room of the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening family walk
description: The whole family dressed warmly and walked along Jingwen Road. There were not many pedestrians on the street, the moonlight was bright and clear, and their breath formed white mist under the streetlights. Ma Xiulan walked arm in arm with her husband, quietly talking about giving Zhezhe extra practice, as well as today's vegetable prices and her younger sister's parcel. The children ran and jumped ahead, picking up fallen leaves from the ground, enjoying this rare moment of leisure.
location: Along Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Bedtime preparation and personal care
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan first made sure the three children washed up and brushed their teeth. After they had all fallen asleep, she filled a basin with hot water and soaked her feet comfortably for more than ten minutes to relieve the day's fatigue. While listening to a rural radio program on her phone, she took out her account book and carefully recorded the expenses for buying vegetables and meat today, checking that everything was correct.
location: Home bathroom and master bedroom, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Checked the doors and relaxed before bed.
description: Before going to bed, Ma Xiulan checked one by one that the doors, windows, and courtyard gate were locked. Back in the bedroom, she glanced at the weight record on her phone: 53.2 kg, quite stable. After a few words with her husband, she led the children, who were already in bed, through a few relaxing deep breaths and told them, “Go to sleep early. You still have school tomorrow.”
location: Various places in the home, including bedrooms, at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Going to bed
description: After lying down, Ma Xiulan thought about her sister's package tomorrow and Zeze's math, feeling that although life was tight, everything was proceeding in an orderly way, and she felt at ease. She turned over, adjusted into a comfortable position, thought that tomorrow would be another new day, listened to the occasional sound of wind outside the window, and gradually fell asleep.
location: Master bed in the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Getting up, morning stretches, and preparing breakfast
description: At 5:36 the phone alarm rang. After getting up, Ma Xiulan did shoulder and neck stretches on the bedroom floor, focusing on side bends and backward extensions to relieve the stiffness from washing jars the day before. Then she went to the kitchen to rinse millet and cook millet porridge, took out spinach and eggs from the refrigerator to prepare spinach-egg pancakes, and boiled hot water to fill the children's thermos cups.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Wake up the children, assist with washing up, and prepare the family breakfast
description: At 6:15, Ma Xiulan woke her eldest son Ma Mingxuan, her second son Ma Mingzhe, and her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin in turn, urged them to wash up in the bathroom, helped Ma Yuxin put on her kindergarten uniform, and tied her hair into little pigtails. Then the whole family gathered in the dining room for breakfast. Ma Xiulan ladled out millet porridge, cut the spinach and egg pancakes into pieces, and specifically reminded her husband Ma Zhiqiang that today was his day off at home and to make braised pork ribs at noon, and reminded the children to drink milk and wear their thermal pants.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Take the second son and youngest daughter to school and return.
description: At 7:10, Ma Xiulan filled a thermos with hot water for her husband and one for her daughter, urged Ma Mingzhe to put on his backpack, and went out holding Ma Yuxin's hand. Walking along Jingwen Road, she took Ma Mingzhe to the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School at 7:20 and told him to listen carefully in class; then she continued walking with Ma Yuxin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, greeted the teacher, watched her daughter enter the classroom, and then walked back home.
location: Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School and Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten on Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Morning Exercise in the Courtyard
description: After returning home at 7:45, Ma Xiulan changed into loose clothes, first took a leisurely 10-minute stroll in the courtyard to breathe fresh air and look at the dried vegetables laid out yesterday, then found a flat spot and did a set of Baduanjin. Today the wind was light and the sunshine was good, so she performed every movement fully. She felt her muscles and joints loosen up and her body warm.
location: Home courtyard at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Household tidying and waiting for a package
description: After exercising and going inside, Ma Xiulan first scrubbed the dishes and chopsticks clean and wiped the stove, then moved the pickle jars washed yesterday onto the shelf in the corner of the courtyard to air-dry, and wiped the living room coffee table clean so she could take photos for her younger sister. Around 9:30, the delivery person called, and she trotted to the door to receive the package.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Receiving a Handmade Parcel and Discussing Designs with Younger Sister over Video
description: After signing for the large cardboard box sent from Binhai New Area, Ma Xiulan carried it to the living room coffee table and carefully opened it with scissors. Inside there were floral cotton fabrics in various patterns, thick off-white canvas, several rolls of lace trim and colorful ribbons, and also her younger sister Ma Xiufen's hand-drawn hair flower design drawings. She quickly took photos and made a WeChat voice call to her sister. The two chatted excitedly for nearly an hour about fabric color matching and lace pairing, agreeing to first try making a few samples according to the designs.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare lunch ingredients
description: After the video call, Ma Xiulan hurried to the kitchen, took yesterday's pork belly out of the fridge to thaw, blanched it in cold water to remove the scum, then took potatoes, green peppers, and green beans from the vegetable basket, washed and cut them one by one, and mentally planned the combination of braised ribs, shredded potatoes, and smashed cucumber as the main dishes.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Cooked lunch and had lunch with her husband
description: 11:50 Ma Xiulan put on an apron and started making lunch. She first stir-fried sugar for color, then added the ribs and stir-fried them. She added light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, ginger slices, and star anise, then poured in hot water and simmered over low heat. In another pan she made shredded potatoes and smashed cucumber. At 12:20 her husband Ma Zhiqiang finished tidying the jars in the courtyard and came inside. The food was served, and the two sat down to eat. Ma Xiulan mentioned the fabric her younger sister had sent and planned to try making hair flowers in the afternoon. Ma Zhiqiang praised the ribs for being flavorful and told her to eat more.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: After-meal cleanup and a short afternoon nap
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan told her husband to go rest. She spent more than ten minutes washing the dishes and wiping down the stove, then went into the bedroom, leaned against the headboard, set a 20-minute alarm, and closed her eyes for a nap to build up energy for the afternoon handicrafts and the evening computer class.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Try making fabric hair flowers and prepare for picking up the children and computer class.
description: After the alarm rang, Ma Xiulan energetically spread an old cloth over the living room tea table as a workbench and took out scissors, a sewing kit, a hot glue gun, small beads, and other tools. Following her younger sister’s design, she picked a light blue floral fabric and lace in the same color tone, then cut, folded, sewed, and glued, concentrating on her work. In a little over two hours, she made six samples of fabric hair flowers in different colors and styles. She photographed them one by one and sent them to her sister, earning praise that they were “even more exquisite than the factory samples.” Afterward, she carefully put the hair flowers away, found a new notebook and pen and placed them in a cloth bag to prepare for the evening computer class, and hung her coat in the entryway in advance.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the second son and youngest daughter from school.
description: Ma Xiulan took her cloth bag and went out. She first picked up Ma Yuxin at Huakang First Kindergarten, then the mother and daughter walked hand in hand to the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School and waited until 4:40 for Ma Mingzhe to finish school. The two children chattered as soon as they met; Ma Yuxin said she had learned a new nursery rhyme, and Ma Mingzhe said he got an A on the math quiz. Ma Xiulan was happy to hear this. Holding Ma Yuxin's left hand and Ma Mingzhe's right hand, she walked slowly home along Jingwen Road.
location: Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School on Shengli South Street

name: Preparing dinner, helping the children with homework, and having dinner together as a family
description: When they got home, Ma Xiulan had Ma Mingzhe and Ma Yuxin do homework and draw in the living room, while she tied on an apron and went into the kitchen to prepare dinner. She put the ribs from lunch back in the pot with potatoes and green beans to stew, stir-fried leaf lettuce with garlic, and made a pot of tomato and egg drop soup. During dinner prep, she found time to check her eldest son Ma Mingxuan's homework and patiently explained a geometry problem he had gotten wrong. After checking that Ma Mingzhe's five arithmetic problems were all correct, she rewarded him with 15 minutes of cartoons. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang helped set the table, and the whole family sat down to dinner. The children competed to tell funny stories from school. Ma Xiulan put food in Ma Yuxin's bowl and discussed with her husband going to a computer class at the community center in the evening, asking him to look after the children while they did homework.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Cleaning up after the meal and final preparations before class.
description: Her husband took the initiative to do the dishes. Ma Xiulan took the notebook and pen she needed for class out of the cloth bag and placed them in the key basket by the entrance so she wouldn't forget them when going out. She glanced at her phone and replied to Sister Zheng Xiuying's reminder in the WeChat group: "Got it, Sister."
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Walk to the community activity room
description: At 18:30, Ma Xiulan took her cloth bag with notebooks and pens and left the house. Along Jingwen Road she turned east into Shengli Street and walked to the Jinghai Town Community Cultural Activity Center, walking off her dinner on the way. She felt both nervous and expectant, silently repeating the word "Word" as she walked. She arrived at about 18:55.
location: Along the route from Jingwen Road to Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Attend the first lesson of the computer training class for middle-aged and elderly people
description: At 7 p.m., Ma Xiulan took a seat in the computer classroom on the second floor of the Community Cultural Activity Center and began learning basic Word operations—creating a new document, entering text, and making a simple label template. The teacher spoke slowly; she kept her eyes fixed on the screen, afraid of missing a step, and filled an entire page with dense notes, recording the positions and functions of buttons such as 'New', 'Save', and 'Font'. During the break, she specifically asked the teacher how to save files so she could practice at home.
location: Second-floor computer classroom, Jinghai Town Community Cultural Activity Center, Jinghai District, Tianjin (opposite No. 45 Shengli Street).

name: Walked home after class
description: After class ended at 20:30, Ma Xiulan greeted Sister Zheng Xiuying and headed back. Along the way, her steps were brisk as she savored what she had just learned, feeling that time passed too quickly. She arrived home around 20:45.
location: Along Shengli Avenue to Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: After-class review exercises and neck-shoulder relaxation
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan tiptoed to the sofa in the living room, took out Ma Mingzhe's old homework notebook, and wrote out from memory all the computer operation steps she had learned that evening. Then, facing her phone notes, she closed her eyes and mentally simulated the entire process of opening Word, typing, and saving. Because she had been looking down the whole time, her neck became stiff, so she quickly stood up and did a 10-minute simple neck and shoulder stretching routine.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Supervise the children's washing up, household chores, and hot-water foot soaks
description: 21:30 Ma Xiulan first urged the children to wash up: she helped Ma Yuxin take a bath, urged Ma Mingzhe to brush his teeth, and checked Ma Mingxuan's recitation. After the children were settled, she boiled a pot of hot water, poured it into a foot basin, sat on a small stool, and comfortably soaked her feet while recalling the day's gains—the package had arrived, the hair flower was finished, and she had learned new things in computer class, and a sense of steadiness welled up in her heart. After soaking for 20 minutes, she dried her feet, then couldn't help picking up her notebook and silently reciting the steps to open Word.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: At 22:10, Ma Xiulan checked the doors and windows, said goodnight to her husband, and lay down on the bed. Feeling some lingering soreness in her neck and shoulders, she did a few simple neck stretches while lying in bed. Her mind was still on the computer exercises to practice tomorrow and the new headdress styles, and she felt rather unsettled. Finally, at around 23:30, still turning things over in her mind, she fell into a deep sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Morning wake-up and shoulder and neck care
description: At 5:37 in the morning, the alarm went off on time. Beside the bed, Ma Xiulan first did neck lateral flexion stretches, holding each side for 15 seconds, then went to the bathroom and applied a hot towel to the back of her neck for 5 minutes to relax the muscles.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Waking the children and preparing breakfast
description: Ma Xiulan went to her daughter Ma Yuxin's bed and gently woke her, helped her put on a pink fleece-lined sweater, and reminded her that the weather was getting colder. Then she urged her sons Ma Mingzhe and Ma Mingxuan to get up. After that, she went to the kitchen and made egg fried rice with last night's leftover rice, eggs, and ham sausage, and heated up some pure milk.
location: All rooms and the kitchen at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Taking the children to school
description: Ma Xiulan walked to school holding Ma Yuxin's hand in one hand and Ma Mingzhe's hand in the other. At 7:18, she took Ma Yuxin into Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten. She then continued east along Shengli South Street and delivered Ma Mingzhe to the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School at 7:35, telling him to listen carefully in class. After that, she walked back home and arrived around 7:45.
location: The round-trip route from No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin to Huakang First Kindergarten and Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School.

name: Morning exercise in the courtyard and getting fresh air.
description: Back home, Ma Xiulan took a walk in the courtyard, admiring the rose flowers covered with dew. Then she played Baduanjin music on her phone and did a complete set of Baduanjin exercises to stretch and loosen her muscles and joints.
location: Home courtyard at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning fabric hair flower making.
description: After morning exercise, Ma Xiulan started making fabric hair flowers by hand in the living room work area. She cut navy printed fabric and light gray canvas, and sewed a total of four hair flowers: a dark lace-trimmed style and a patchwork style with yellow flowers on a green background. While getting up to drink water, she would flip through her computer class notes and silently memorize Word shortcut keys.
location: Work area in the living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Lunch and a short break.
description: Ma Xiulan paused her handiwork and went to the kitchen to prepare lunch. She made a cabbage, pork belly, and vermicelli stew using baby bok choy, cellophane noodles, and pork belly, and had lunch with her husband Ma Zhiqiang. After the meal, she quickly cleared the dishes and took a 20-minute nap on the living room sofa.
location: Kitchen and dining room of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Afternoon handicraft making, computer practice, and photo documentation
description: After her nap, Ma Xiulan first practiced creating a mock Excel spreadsheet in a grid notebook and wrote in dummy data, practicing computer skills for half an hour. Then she continued sewing hair flowers, joining pink floral fabric and light blue cotton fabric with a blind stitch. By about 14:30 she had completed her goal of 12 hair flowers. She placed them neatly on the coffee table and took photos with her phone. She then sent the photos to her younger sister Ma Xiufen and her childhood friend Liu Chunmei via WeChat, and asked their opinions by voice message.
location: Work area in the living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Shopping at the community supermarket and chatting with neighbors
description: Ma Xiulan walked to Shufen Convenience Store across from the community to buy white thread. The shopkeeper and neighbor Zhang Shufen saw Ma Xiulan, and the two of them looked at photos of hair flowers together, discussing colors and styles. Zhang Shufen praised the dark green one as stylish. Ma Xiulan also asked for tips on making microwave cake and learned that the eggs need to be whipped thoroughly. Then she paid and left.
location: Shufen Convenience Store, Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Picking up the children from school and spending a short time in the neighborhood
description: Ma Xiulan walked to the Third Primary School of Jinghai District to pick up Ma Mingzhe, then turned back with him to Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up Ma Yuxin. The three of them walked home together. Ma Yuxin excitedly talked about the nursery rhymes she had learned in kindergarten, while Ma Mingzhe corrected her pronunciation.
location: Jinghai District Third Primary School and Huakang First Kindergarten on Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and the way home

name: Preparing dinner, tutoring homework, and doing housework
description: After getting home, Ma Xiulan arranged for Ma Mingzhe and Ma Yuxin to do their homework while she tied on an apron and prepared dinner. She used a meat grinder to grind the meat, added mushrooms and diced carrots, steamed egg custard with minced meat, and also stir-fried shredded potatoes. While busy in the kitchen, she asked Ma Mingzhe how easy or difficult his math homework was.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner
description: Husband Ma Zhiqiang helped serve the dishes; eldest son Ma Mingxuan came home from school, and the family sat around eating dinner. Ma Xiulan told Ma Zhiqiang to take the children for a walk after dinner and to keep a close eye on Ma Mingzhe's math homework. Ma Yuxin praised that Mom's cooking was the best.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening family walk and neck and shoulder care
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan quickly cleared the table. The whole family put on their coats and walked west along Jingwen Road to the small garden at the intersection with Chaoyang Road, then turned back. As she walked, Ma Xiulan rotated her neck to relax. Ma Mingxuan chatted with his father about the school basketball game, while Ma Mingzhe and Ma Yuxin chased each other ahead. When the walk ended, Ma Xiulan parted with her family at the entrance of the neighborhood and went alone to the community activity center.
location: The home community and surrounding streets on Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Attend the second lesson of the computer training class
description: Ma Xiulan arrived on time at the computer classroom on the third floor of the Community Cultural Activity Center. The teacher reviewed creating a new document and typing in Word from the last class, then explained how to adjust font size, font style, color, and paragraph alignment. Ma Xiulan listened carefully and practiced along, raising her hand to ask the teacher when she encountered problems. At the end of the class, homework was assigned to format a self-introduction.
location: Computer Classroom on the 3rd Floor, Community Cultural Activity Center, Jinghai Town, Jianshe Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: After-class exchange and going home
description: After class, Ma Xiulan asked Sister Wang, a student next to her who was doing well, about a question she had in the homework. After getting an answer, she left. She walked 15 minutes home, thinking about the new functions she had learned on the way. She returned home at exactly 9 p.m.
location: Along the route from the Jinghai Town Community Cultural Activity Center on Jianshe Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to 156 Jingwen Road

name: Evening family activities and homework check
description: When she got home, Ma Yuxin had already washed her face and was pestering her father to tell a story. Ma Xiulan checked Ma Mingzhe's math homework, found an error in a word problem, and patiently guided him to redo it until he understood. She also checked Ma Yuxin's pinyin exercise book and signed it.
location: Living room and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Personal neck and shoulder care and getting the family settled
description: After the children were asleep, Ma Xiulan soaked her feet in hot water for 20 minutes and read the complimentary WeChat messages from her younger sister and childhood friend, feeling happy inside. Then she applied a hot towel to her neck and did neck rotations, forward and backward nods, and waist stretches to relax.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pre-sleep review and bedtime
description: Ma Xiulan lay in bed and reviewed the whole day in her mind: 12 hair flowers finished, kept up with the computer class, bought the white thread, and took a family walk. She silently recited the new knowledge from computer class and felt it was clearer than yesterday, then turned off the light and fell asleep.
location: On the bed at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Getting up, indoor exercise, and washing up.
description: At 5:37 in the morning, she woke up in rainy weather, briefly moved her stiff neck and shoulders, then laid out a floor mat in the living room. She first did ten minutes of neck and shoulder stretches, then performed a set of Baduanjin, stretching her whole body. Afterward, she went to the bathroom to wash up and rinsed her shoulders with hot water to ease the discomfort.
location: Bedroom and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing the family breakfast
description: Putting on an apron, she mixed corn, millet, and soybean flour into a batter in the kitchen and spread golden multigrain pancakes in a flat pan. Meanwhile, she boiled the rice and millet that had been soaked overnight into hot porridge. The whole house was filled with aroma as she prepared a warm breakfast for the children and her husband.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Woke the children up and helped them get ready and have breakfast.
description: After the meal, she cleared the dishes. Ma Xiulan had Xuanxuan and Zhezhe do their homework at the desk, while she spread out the half-finished photo album on the opposite side, took out 7 winter-themed photos, glue, and pens, and focused on arranging the layout. She pasted the family group photo taken in front of the ice during last year's Spring Festival and the photo of Xinxin building a snowman in chronological order, writing the dates and brief captions with decorative pens. When Xuanxuan got stuck on a geometry problem, Ma Xiulan put down the glue, sat beside him, opened the textbook, and went through the example problem with him, gradually guiding him to figure out the solution.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Braved the rain to take her daughter to kindergarten and returned home to do housework.
description: She put rain boots on her daughter, held an umbrella for herself, and walked to Huakang First Kindergarten. Along the way, she picked up a few clean plane tree leaves from the community flower beds for her daughter's handicrafts. After safely leaving her daughter with the teacher, she walked home through the rain. When she got home, she first used a dry mop to wipe dry the floors in the living room and bedroom that had been stepped on and wet, then washed the breakfast dishes and put them away, and finally put the clothes changed off the day before into the washing machine.
location: From 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten (Jinghai District) and on the return trip

name: Sort and organize fabric hair clips in preparation for the neighbors' visit in the afternoon.
description: She took out the twelve new hair flowers made yesterday from the sewing box, sorted them into dark, contrasting-color, and plain elegant categories, and pinned them on a square scarf. Then she found a clean tin box for pastries, lined it with flannel, and arranged the hair flowers one by one to look nice, carefully preparing for the afternoon visit of Sun Lihua and Zhao Xiaohong, with her heart full of anticipation.
location: Home living room sofa area, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Daily chores: hanging laundry, mopping the floor, tidying the room.
description: After the washing machine stopped, she took out the clean clothes, shook each one flat, and hung them on the balcony clothes rack. Then she carefully mopped the kitchen and bathroom floors, briefly tidied the children's desks, and put the toys back in place, keeping the home neat.
location: After returning home, she first gathered and washed the dishes and utensils, then swept and mopped every room. Next, she went to the courtyard and shook out the towels and clothes that were drying. At 8:30, she changed into old clothes, carried the large jar, the stone for pressing pickles, and the wooden stick out to the faucet, carefully scrubbed off the mud left from last year, rinsed them with boiling water to sterilize, and set them out to dry in the sun. At 9:30, she checked the quantities of the vegetables she had ordered the previous day from her neighbor Zhou Xiuqin, then contacted Zhou Xiuqin by WeChat voice message to tell her that the pickle tools were ready, and they agreed to start work early on the 14th.

name: Make creative handicrafts, crochet coasters
description: After finishing the housework, she remembered the old-yarn crocheted coasters she had seen at the neighbor's shop, so she rummaged through the leftover yarn at home. While listening to opera on the radio, she crocheted two plain round coasters for her glass cups, adding a little charm to daily life.
location: Home living room sofa area, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Lunch alone
description: Since the children were not coming home at noon and her husband was also out working, she simply cooked herself a bowl of dried noodles with two leafy greens, a poached egg, and her own pickles, and enjoyed a comfortable lunch alone.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Midday nap, phone time, and DIY modification of the door gap draft strip.
description: After cleaning up following the meal, she set a thirty-minute alarm and took a short nap. When she woke up, she browsed her phone, saw and liked her younger sister Xiufen's new hair accessory photo, and chatted with her friend Liu Chunmei on WeChat about someone coming to look at the hair flowers in the afternoon. Afterwards, thinking about the cold weather and the gap in the door letting in wind, she measured the size and sewed several long cloth strips from an old cotton jersey, intending to stuff them under the door to block the draft.
location: Bedroom and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Afternoon tea preparation and getting washed up and dressed
description: Heated up water, washed the glass cups, and prepared jasmine tea. She also specially tried on several of her favorite hair flowers to see the effect, checking herself in the mirror again and again until she was satisfied, then took them off, getting ready for the upcoming visit from her neighbor.
location: Living room and bathroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: A neighbor came to visit and bought fabric hair flowers
description: Just after two o'clock, Sun Lihua and Zhao Xiaohong arrived under umbrellas. She warmly greeted them, asked them to sit down, and served hot tea. After chatting about daily life, she could not wait to take out an iron box full of hair flowers and show them. The two were pleasantly surprised and each picked some to try on. In the end, Sun Lihua chose a navy contrast-color one and a maple-leaf red one, while Zhao Xiaohong chose a dusty pink one and a dark green one. They paid twenty yuan in total. She immediately noted down in her notebook: 'November 7, first order of hair flowers, 4 pieces, 20 yuan. Grand opening!'
location: Home living room sofa area, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Organize rain gear and get ready to pick up the children from school
description: After seeing off the neighbor, she saw that it was about time, put on a raincoat, took two umbrellas, locked the door, and planned to pick up her youngest daughter first and then go by to pick up her second son.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Braved the rain to pick up the two children from school and take them home
description: First she went to Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up her daughter and helped her put on a raincoat. Then she walked ten minutes to the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, just in time for her second son's dismissal. The three of them shared an umbrella and walked home, carefully picking their way along the road. On the way, her son complained that the rain meant he couldn't play football, while her daughter happily shared about making leaf collages.
location: From Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to No. 3 Primary School on Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, and then back to home at No. 156 Jingwen Road.

name: Preparing dinner and dining with the family (partially)
description: After arriving home, she had the two children go do their homework first, then went into the kitchen and heated up the leftover braised pork belly and stewed potatoes from last night. She also washed some greens and made garlic stir-fried lettuce, and the rice cooker had just switched to warm. Since her husband and eldest son would be home late, she had dinner first with her second son and daughter. Zhezhe happily said he had scored 95 on his math test and was praised; Xinxin had to be fed before she would eat the greens, so while feeding her, she hurriedly ate her own rice.
location: Kitchen and dining room of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Reviewing computer knowledge before setting out
description: After the meal, she asked her son to watch his younger sister do her homework. She took out her notebook and quickly reviewed the steps for alignment and font size settings in Word, recited them silently, found an old notebook and pen, and stuffed them into her canvas bag, preparing for the evening computer training class.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Braved the rain to attend the second lesson of the community computer training class and walked home
description: She put on a raincoat, held an umbrella, and walked ten minutes to the computer room on the second floor of the Jinghai Town Community Cultural Activity Center. In class, the teacher taught changing text color, center alignment, and inserting images. She studied seriously and actively asked questions. In the second half of the lesson, the teacher briefly introduced Excel table operations and AutoSum, and she felt as if she had opened a new world. But because she was concentrating on taking notes, her neck and shoulders began to ache again. After class, she shared what she had learned with classmates, then walked home. The rain had gradually lessened, and she moved her stiff neck while walking.
location: From the computer room on the second floor of the Retired Cadres Activity Center on Jianshe Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to home at No. 156 Jingwen Road.

name: Go home to review computer skills and help the children fall asleep
description: After getting home, she first checked and signed the second son's math homework, then coaxed her daughter to brush her teeth and wash her face, and read bedtime stories until she fell asleep. Then she sat back down in the living room, took out her class notes, drew a Word operation flowchart in an old notebook, and wrote out the Excel button functions from memory to make sure she firmly remembered what she had learned.
location: Living room and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening personal care: neck and shoulder stretching and hot compress.
description: After finishing the work, her neck and shoulders ached badly. She did a targeted ten-minute neck and shoulder stretching routine in the living room, then boiled water to fill a hot water bottle. Lying on the bed with it on her sore neck and shoulders, she gradually relaxed.
location: Living room and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Before-bed routine: wash up, keep accounts, check the weather, talk with my husband, and go to sleep.
description: After applying a hot compress for 20 minutes, she took a hot shower and changed into pajamas. Lying in bed, she took out her ledger to record the day's income from hair flowers, then checked the next day's weather forecast on her phone: overcast turning to partly cloudy, with temperatures still on the low side. She sent a WeChat message to her husband Zhiqiang about the good news that the hair flower stall had opened, then turned off the desk lamp. Reviewing the day, although she was busy, the hair flowers had sold and she had learned something new in computer class, so she felt grounded and satisfied, and soon fell asleep.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning exercise and wake-up
description: Ma Xiulan got up at 5:38. She was slightly nervous because of the rehearsal task that day, but still insisted on her morning exercise. She first did shoulder and neck stretches indoors to relieve the soreness caused by the rainy days before, then put on a cotton-padded jacket and walked in the yard. She noticed that the rose leaves had withered and decided to tend to them later. Back indoors, facing the morning light, she practiced a complete set of Baduanjin. Her body gradually warmed up and she felt full of energy.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing breakfast and waking the children up.
description: In the kitchen, Ma Xiulan cooked millet porridge, warmed milk, and made egg pancakes. Starting at 6:30, she woke the three children one by one: the eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, got up quickly on his own; the second son, Ma Mingzhe, stayed in bed and had to be urged; the youngest daughter, Ma Yuxin, obediently let her mother tie her hair into two little bunches. She hurried Ma Mingzhe to brush his teeth and wash his face, making sure the children were ready for class.
location: Home kitchen and bedroom at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Take the children to their extracurricular classes
description: Ma Xiulan had her eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, ride his bicycle by himself to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School for his tutoring class. She herself rode an electric bike with her second son, Ma Mingzhe, and younger daughter, Ma Yuxin. She first took Ma Mingzhe to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, handed him over to the tutor, and told him to be obedient. Then she took Ma Yuxin to the calligraphy class at the Jinghai District Children's Palace and only left after watching her take out her writing brush.
location: Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jinghai District Children's Palace, No. 17 Diwei Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Stopped by the vegetable market to buy groceries on the way
description: After dropping off the children, Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to the Wutong Commune vegetable market. She went to the familiar vegetable stall of Aunt Sun Guifang, bought a head of Chinese cabbage and a piece of streaky pork, planning to make cabbage and pork stew with vermicelli for lunch, and asked Aunt Sun for a bundle of straw to protect the roses at home over the winter.
location: Wutong Community Vegetable Market, Chaoyang Subdistrict, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Go home and tidy up the yard tools.
description: Ma Xiulan returned home, put the vegetables and straw away, then took pruning shears, an old cotton coat, and hemp rope from the storage room and placed the pruning tools at the foot of the courtyard wall. The outdoor temperature was only 5 degrees; she rubbed her hands and breathed on them, determined to finish the yard care work quickly.
location: Courtyard and storage room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Pruning courtyard roses and protecting the roots from cold
description: Ma Xiulan began pruning the dead and weak branches of the roses and gathered the cuttings. Around 9:45, she briefly left to pick up her second son Ma Mingzhe from the Third Primary School. After returning, Ma Mingzhe excitedly asked if they could plant sunflowers in the vegetable garden. Ma Xiulan gladly agreed and asked him to help pile straw around the rose roots for warmth. She patiently taught her son how to properly stack the straw so it would keep the plants warm without crushing the branches. Mother and son worked and chatted as they finished the winter care for the roses.
location: Home courtyard at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Winter care for potted plants.
description: After finishing with the roses in the field, Ma Xiulan began to take care of the frost-sensitive fuchsias and begonia potted plants. She carefully pruned the weak and diseased branches, wiped dust off the leaves with a damp cloth, and laid new moss. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang came out of the house, and Ma Xiulan asked him to help move the potted plants onto the enclosed balcony. Together they moved the pots onto the balcony plant stand, and Ma Zhiqiang also watered them.
location: Home courtyard and enclosed balcony, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Picking up her daughter, making lunch, and sharing noodles with gravy as a family
description: Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to the Jinghai District Children's Palace to pick up her younger daughter Ma Yuxin. After returning home, she deftly kneaded, rolled, and cut the dough, made a sauce with cabbage and minced pork, and brought out her homemade pickled vegetables, preparing noodles with gravy. The family of five sat around together for lunch. Ma Mingzhe told the family about his plan to grow sunflowers, and Ma Yuxin also said she wanted to water the flowers. The family was harmonious and happy, and most of Ma Xiulan's morning tension dissipated.
location: Kitchen and dining room of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Clearing the dishes and reviewing the computer lesson
description: After lunch, Ma Xiulan asked her husband to play with the children while she quickly cleaned up the kitchen. Then she sat down in the study, took out paper and pen, and wrote from memory the Word layout and Excel summation steps she had learned in the previous day's computer class. She also drew a simple family income and expense table on paper to practice. Although she was a bit slow, her thinking was clear and she felt she had gained something.
location: Study at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Midday Baduanjin practice and departure preparations.
description: After the review ended, Ma Xiulan practiced Baduanjin twice more in the living room while recalling the afternoon rehearsal process and loosening up her hands and feet. Then she put on a thick coat, filled a cup with hot water, told her husband about picking up Ma Yuxin after her calligraphy class in the afternoon, and prepared to go to the community activity center.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Go to the community activity center early to rehearse with the exercise leader.
description: Ma Xiulan walked to the rehearsal hall of the Jinghai Town Community Cultural Activity Center. Her childhood friend Liu Chunmei was already waiting, and the two practiced once together first. Then the exercise leader arrived and guided everyone to correct details of the movements, especially personally adjusting her arm height for the move "draw the bow like shooting an eagle." After more than half an hour of practice, the team's coordination had clearly improved.
location: Rehearsal Hall, Jinghai Town Community Cultural Activity Center, Diwei Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Relaxation and rest on the way home.
description: After the joint rehearsal, Ma Xiulan walked home along Diwei Road, enjoying the warmth of the afternoon sun. After arriving home, she rested for a while and drank a glass of water, while mentally going through the full rehearsal schedule for the evening.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Picking up the kids and family craft time
description: Ma Xiulan went to the Children's Palace and then to No. 3 Primary School to pick up her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin and her second son Ma Mingzhe. After returning home, Ma Yuxin practiced brush calligraphy and Ma Mingzhe built with LEGO. Ma Xiulan took out the indigo floral fabric her sister had mailed, and began sewing new hair flowers, cutting cloth pieces and trying different stitching combinations. Ma Yuxin came over curiously to watch, so Ma Xiulan taught her some simple stitches, and the mother and daughter shared a warm, crafty time together.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare dinner
description: Ma Xiulan put down her handiwork and went into the kitchen to prepare dinner. Using the leftover cabbage and meat from noon, she stewed a hot pot of cabbage and pork with vermicelli, and quickly made smashed cucumbers and garlic lettuce, simple yet nutritious.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner
description: Dinner was served, and the family of five sat around the table. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang mentioned that he needed to make a short drive that evening. Ma Xiulan told him to be careful on the road and not to wake her if he came back late. After finishing dinner, the children went back to their own rooms, and the couple tidied up the dining table.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Clean up the kitchen and help the children with their homework
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan cleaned the kitchen thoroughly. Then she sat beside her second son, Ma Mingzhe, and checked his math homework. Seeing that he was confused about adding and subtracting fractions, she patiently explained using drawings until he completely understood. After that, she had her younger daughter Ma Yuxin write the characters from that day's calligraphy class, and praised her for making progress, which made the child very happy.
location: Study at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Full rehearsal for the community gala
description: Ma Xiulan changed into her practice outfit and walked again to the auditorium of the community activity center for a full dress rehearsal with the complete program. She performed Baduanjin twice in full with the performance team, standing in the front row and concentrating on following the music and the leader's movements. The rehearsal went excellently, with perfectly synchronized movements, and she received praise from the community staff. Ma Xiulan felt reassured and completely relaxed.
location: Auditorium of Jinghai Town Community Cultural Activity Center, Diwei Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Going home and helping the children wash up and go to sleep.
description: After the rehearsal ended, Ma Xiulan felt relaxed and returned home. The children had already washed up and were ready for bed. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang had come back from a work trip and was lying on the sofa looking at his phone. Ma Xiulan put her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin to bed, told her a short story, and after she fell asleep, went to check on her two sons and reminded them to cover themselves properly.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Bookkeeping, washing up, and stretching to relax.
description: Late at night, Ma Xiulan took out her account book and recorded the day's expenses: 30 yuan for groceries and 5 yuan for straw. She also noted the 20 yuan earned from selling hair flowers yesterday. Then she soaked her feet in hot water, applied a hot towel to her neck and shoulders, and did a 10-minute neck and shoulder stretch to relieve the day's fatigue.
location: Study and bathroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Going to bed
description: Ma Xiulan lay in bed, reviewing the fulfilling day: the roses had been protected for winter, the plan to plant sunflowers had been made, the children's homework tutoring was completed, and the community rehearsal went smoothly. Feeling grounded and content, she soon drifted off to sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Morning courtyard walk and Baduanjin
description: Ma Xiulan woke up at 7 a.m. feeling refreshed. She first walked in the yard for 10 minutes in the early winter morning light, breathing the crisp cold air. Then she stretched her muscles and did a set of Baduanjin for about 10 minutes, moving her shoulders, neck, waist, and legs, and her body warmed up.
location: Home courtyard at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing the family breakfast
description: Ma Xiulan returned to the kitchen, heated the milk, steamed the buns, and boiled three eggs. She deliberately heated extra buns, thinking that the children would all be home on Sunday and should eat their fill. Then she woke her second son, Ma Mingzhe, and asked him to help set the table.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The whole family has breakfast together and clears the table.
description: The family sat down at the dining table one after another. As she ate, Ma Xiulan told her husband Ma Zhiqiang to remember to buy the time-honored roast duck to entertain Sister Wu in the evening. Ma Zhiqiang reminded the children to finish their homework on time on Sunday. After the meal, Ma Xiulan quickly cleared the dishes and wiped the table clean.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Deep-cleaning the room.
description: Ma Xiulan asked her daughter Ma Yuxin to help hand her rags. She first mopped the floor of the master bedroom and polished the cabinets. Then she went to the living room, fluffed the sofa cushions, changed the water in the vase, and wiped the coffee table and TV cabinet. Finally, she went into the kitchen and cleaned the stove, range hood, and sink, preparing to welcome the guests.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (master bedroom, living room, kitchen)

name: Converting the storage room into a guest room
description: Ma Xiulan asked Ma Mingxuan and Ma Mingzhe to help move the old books, unworn cotton-padded clothes, and discarded toys from the storage room to the yard. Then she used a vacuum cleaner to clean the corners and floor, and wiped the windows bright. She took out the clean sheets and quilt covers that had been dried the day before, put them on, and placed new towels and toothbrushes on the bedside table. The room was small but completely refreshed and cozy.
location: Home storage room, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Riding to buy fresh ingredients
description: Ma Xiulan set off by bicycle. She first went to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market to find Sun Guifang and bought red chili peppers, pork belly, and baby bok choy. Aunt Sun gave her a bunch of scallions. Then she went to Jingbai Supermarket to find Zhang Shufen to buy rock sugar, and the two chatted about the upcoming visit from guests. Finally she rode back home and arrived at 12:25.
location: Wutong Community Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China, and Jingbai Supermarket, Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu

name: Prepare lunch and organize the ingredients.
description: Ma Xiulan returned home, marinated the pork belly she had bought with salt, cooking wine, and light soy sauce, and put the greens in water to soak. Then she cooked a pot of tomato and egg noodles and had a simple lunch with the children. After the meal, she tidied up the kitchen.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Midday rest and preparation of handicraft materials
description: Ma Xiulan felt sore in her lower back, so she asked her eldest son Ma Mingxuan to keep an eye on his younger brother and sister while she took a half-hour nap. When she woke up at 2 p.m., she saw her second son Ma Mingzhe playing with toys. Remembering that he had said at noon he wanted to make a leaf collage, she took out glue, scissors, white paper, and colored pens from the drawer and prepared to make it with him.
location: Bedroom and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Collecting fallen leaves outdoors and making leaf collage artwork.
description: Ma Xiulan took Ma Mingzhe and Ma Yuxin to a small open space outside the courtyard to pick up fallen leaves of various kinds—maple, poplar, ginkgo, and so on. Back in the living room, she helped Ma Mingzhe come up with ideas and glued the leaves into shapes of goldfish and a big tree. Ma Yuxin pasted leaves freely on the side, having a great time. When the leaf collage was finished, Ma Mingzhe excitedly showed it to his father, and the scene was full of joy.
location: Small open space outside the courtyard at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and the family living room

name: Prepare dinner side dishes and make thin pancakes
description: Ma Xiulan tied on an apron and began preparing the side dishes for roast duck. She kneaded and rested the dough, then baked more than 20 spring pancakes as thin as cicada wings on a flat pan, covering them with a damp cloth. She cut cucumber into thin strips and the white part of scallions into shreds, arranging them on small plates. She also boiled water to fill the thermos in the guest room.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Called old friend Aunt Wu and continued preparing meals.
description: Ma Xiulan called her old friend Aunt Wu on her phone, confirmed that she would arrive in Jinghai tomorrow morning, and told her that the guest room was ready and the pancakes had been made. Aunt Wu happily replied that she would bring delicious food. After the call, Ma Xiulan seasoned the egg soup on the stove to go with the roast duck for dinner.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Husband brought home roast duck, the whole family set the table
description: Ma Zhiqiang came home carrying a steaming roast duck. Ma Xiulan immediately took it and quickly sliced the duck meat, setting out the duck, thin pancakes, cucumber strips, scallion slivers, and sweet bean sauce on the table. The children smelled the aroma and hurried over. Ma Mingxuan and Ma Mingzhe helped set out bowls and chopsticks, while Ma Yuxin waited with a small bowl.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family roast duck dinner
description: The family sat together enjoying a roast duck feast. Ma Xiulan first wrapped pancakes for each child; the children ate with greasy mouths, and her second son, Ma Mingzhe, ate five in one go. While eating, Ma Xiulan talked with her husband about tidying up the guest room and with her eldest son about school, in a warm and happy atmosphere.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family movie night watching Liu Sanjie.
description: After quickly cleaning up the meal, Ma Xiulan asked Ma Mingxuan to turn on the TV and cast the old movie Liu Sanjie. She and the children snuggled on the sofa to watch it. When the folk songs began, Ma Mingzhe giggled and Ma Yuxin hummed along. Ma Xiulan pointed at the screen and explained to the children the story of how Liu Sanjie used folk songs to battle with wits and courage. The whole family watched with great enjoyment.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Warm milk before bed, keeping accounts, and diary practice
description: After the movie ended, Ma Xiulan went to the kitchen to heat up four cups of milk and gave them to the children to drink. While Ma Mingzhe and Ma Yuxin went to wash up, she spread out her notebook in the living room, recorded the day's expenses on vegetables, meat, and rock sugar, then used the spreadsheet knowledge she had learned in computer class to draw grids, simulating an income-and-expense table to practice summing. She felt a strong sense of accomplishment.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Wash up, soak feet, and relax
description: After settling the children down, Ma Xiulan prepared a basin of hot water and soaked her feet comfortably, massaging her aching shoulders and neck. Reviewing the day—the guest room was tidied, the roast duck dinner made the whole family happy, and the leaf collage was finished—she felt warm and deeply at peace.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Chat with husband before bed and review the day
description: Ma Xiulan dried her feet, changed into her pajamas, and chatted softly with her husband Ma Zhiqiang, who was already lying down. She said that Sister Wu was coming tomorrow to make dumplings for her, and asked her husband not to drive so the whole family could have a lively get-together. Ma Zhiqiang agreed. After turning off the light, Ma Xiulan shared the day's amusing moments with the children with her husband, feeling very warm.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Gradually fell asleep and entered dreamland
description: Ma Xiulan chatted with her husband and gradually felt drowsy. Listening to the occasional sound of cars outside the window, she felt the tranquility of home and slowly closed her eyes with a satisfied smile, drifting off to sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Got up in the morning to prepare breakfast for her husband and saw him off for his drive.
description: Before dawn, Ma Xiulan quietly got up, put water on to heat, then woke her husband Ma Zhiqiang. She filled his thermos, prepared a fleece blanket and his documents, and kneaded dough to pan-fry scallion pancakes and heated rice porridge for breakfast. After her husband finished eating, she packed the food and hot water into bags, helped him check his clothes, watched him drive his truck out of the courtyard gate, and told him to be careful on the road.
location: Kitchen and courtyard gate at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Wake the children and have breakfast, walk Ma Yuxin and Ma Mingzhe to school
description: After seeing her husband off, Ma Xiulan found her eldest son Ma Mingxuan already doing morning reading, so she went to wake up Ma Mingzhe and Ma Yuxin, helped her daughter braid her hair, and found socks for her son. The family sat around the table eating millet porridge, eggs, and steamed buns. She hurried the children along while finishing her own breakfast quickly. They left at 7:15. She walked 15 minutes to take Xinxin to Huakang First Kindergarten, then walked 10 minutes with Zhezhe to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, reminding him on the way to pay attention in class. She only headed home after watching him enter the school, arriving around 8:10.
location: At home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, then to Huakang First Kindergarten and Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School

name: Sweeping the courtyard, exercising, tidying the house, and reviewing notes
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan picked up a broom and swept the fallen leaves in the courtyard. Once the yard was tidy, she performed a set of Baduanjin exercises in the yard to stretch her muscles. Then she went inside, inspected the guest room to make sure everything was clean, made tea, took out her notes from the computer training class, and wrote out key operation points such as the SUM formula from memory to reinforce what she had learned.
location: Courtyard and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Walked to Jinghai Bus Terminal to pick up Aunt Wu, introducing local sights along the way.
description: Ma Xiulan locked the courtyard gate and walked about 35 minutes to Jinghai Coach Terminal, feeling elated all the way. At the exit she saw Aunt Wu carrying a cloth bag, and the two warmly held hands. On the way back, she enthusiastically pointed out the steamed bun shops and tailor shops along the street, introduced the new changes in Jinghai, and chatted and laughed all the way home.
location: From 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to Jinghai Bus Station on Chaoyang Road, then back to 156 Jingwen Road

name: Getting Aunt Wu settled and chatting about old times in the living room
description: Ma Xiulan led Aunt Wu into the prepared guest room, helped her put away her luggage, and served snacks and hot tea. The two sat on the living room sofa, chatting from their own children to the sisters they had met in the handicraft group, and shared the newly learned crochet stitches. Aunt Wu took out a few small handmade items to give to her. Ma Xiulan could not put them down and praised her exquisite craftsmanship.
location: Guest room and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Made Tianjin-style noodles with gravy and had lunch together.
description: Ma Xiulan put on an apron and went into the kitchen. She made a thick sauce with day lily flowers, wood ear mushrooms, sliced meat, and eggs. Aunt Wu wanted to help, but Ma Xiulan politely declined, insisting on entertaining her personally. The sauce was thick, savory, and fragrant, served with hand-rolled noodles. Each of them filled a bowl and ate happily with garlic cloves.
location: Kitchen and dining room of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Lunch break
description: After lunch, Ma Xiulan arranged for Aunt Wu to take an afternoon nap in the guest room, then went back to the master bedroom herself, set an alarm, and slept lightly for an hour to build up energy for making chili sauce in the afternoon.
location: Rest area at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Collaborated with Aunt Wu to trial-produce Hebei chili paste.
description: As soon as the alarm went off, the two put on aprons and got to work. Aunt Wu brought out the recipe from her hometown in Cangzhou, and Ma Xiulan brought out the red chili peppers and pork belly she had bought in advance. Following the instructions, Ma Xiulan steamed the peppers until soft, Aunt Wu chopped the minced meat and garlic, then heated oil and added them to the pot. The kitchen filled with a rich, spicy aroma. The cooked sauce was poured into glass bottles, which were turned upside down to cool. Ma Xiulan praised it again and again, and planned to show off her skill at future community events; Aunt Wu said she could teach everyone.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up Ma Yuxin and Ma Mingzhe from school and go home, greeting Aunt Wu
description: After finishing the chili sauce, Ma Xiulan hurried out, first walking to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up Xinxin, then holding her hand and walking to the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to wait for Zhezhe. Holding one child with each hand, she listened to Xinxin talk about interesting things at kindergarten and to Zhezhe say that the math problems were a bit difficult. When they got home, she had the children wash their hands and say hello to Aunt Wu.
location: From No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten and Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, then returned home.

name: Prepare dinner and have dinner together with Aunt Wu as a family
description: Ma Xiulan started cooking dinner. She reheated last night's roast duck in the oven, stir-fried lettuce with garlic, and made smashed cucumbers. Aunt Wu helped peel garlic on the side. When her eldest son Ma Mingxuan came home from school, the family and Aunt Wu sat around the table, tasting the hot roast duck and the new chili sauce made today. The children ate until their faces turned red and exclaimed how satisfying it was, and the table was full of laughter and warm conversation.
location: Kitchen and dining room of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Received the Parents' Open Day notice, prepared clothes, and took a family walk
description: After dinner, Ma Mingzhe took out the school’s open-day invitation from his backpack. Ma Xiulan carefully read the next morning’s schedule and decided to attend. She went back to the bedroom, took out the dark red coat she was usually reluctant to wear, hung it up, and sent her husband a voice message to discuss picking up the children the next day. Then the family, along with Aunt Wu, took a walk along Jingwen Road to aid digestion. Along the way she pointed out the newly opened small supermarket and the fitness square, while the children ran and played around them, laughter continuing under the streetlights.
location: At home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and along Jingwen Road

name: Soaking her feet and having a heart-to-heart talk with Auntie Wu
description: After returning from their walk, Ma Xiulan heated up some water, brought over the foot-soaking tub, and sat on the living room sofa with Aunt Wu, chatting while soaking their feet. From handicrafts they moved on to experiences in household management and parenting, and Ma Xiulan also shared amusing stories about learning to use the computer and practicing Baduanjin. The room was warm and cozy, and the two chatted happily.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Urge the children to wash up, check their homework, and soothe them to sleep
description: Ma Xiulan got up to take care of the children: first she brushed her daughter Xinxin's teeth, washed her face, changed her into pajamas, and told a short bedtime story to coax her to sleep; then she supervised her son Zhezhe as he finished the last few homework problems, checked and signed them, and urged him to go wash up; then she went to the eldest son Xuanxuan's room to check on him. He was still reviewing his lessons, so she told him not to stay up late.
location: The child's bedroom and bathroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Studied computer operation alone and practiced bookkeeping.
description: After saying goodnight to Aunt Wu, Ma Xiulan took out her account book and computer lecture notes, opened the old laptop, brought up the household income and expense form she had designed, and practiced the sum formula over and over. She slowly typed '=SUM(C2:C6)' on the keyboard and smiled contentedly when she saw the correct number.
location: Living room and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Stretch before bed, check on the children, and turn off the lights to sleep
description: Ma Xiulan boiled water again to soak her feet and stretched her shoulders, neck, waist and back to relieve the day's fatigue. After drying off, she changed into pajamas, quietly pushed open each child's door to check whether they had kicked off their blankets, and tucked Xinxin's little hands in. Once everything was in order, she returned to the master bedroom, turned off the light and lay down. Thinking about the chili sauce she had made today and tomorrow's parents' open day, she felt warm and secure and soon fell asleep.
location: Bathroom, children's bedroom, and master bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning wake-up and indoor exercise
description: Before dawn, Ma Xiulan got up quietly, washed up briefly, laid out a yoga mat in the bedroom, and did a 15-minute shoulder and neck stretch, silently telling herself, 'Move lightly, don't wake Aunt Wu and the children.' Then she put on a coat, walked out into the yard, and in the cold, slightly damp air performed a gentle set of Baduanjin to loosen up her muscles and joints, feeling completely refreshed.
location: Bedroom and courtyard at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Preparing a hearty breakfast
description: There were guests at home today (Aunt Wu), so breakfast couldn't be taken lightly. Xiulan took out the dough that had been rising overnight from the fridge, planning to steam a pot of steaming hot scallion and pork rolls. She also started a small pot to cook millet and pumpkin porridge, washed some baby bok choy, and would stir-fry it later. The flames on the stove roared, and before long, the kitchen was filled with the aroma of dough and porridge. Xiulan thought to herself, "I'll talk to that boy Zhezhe when he comes back this afternoon. I need to think through what to say - not too harsh, but not letting him have his way either."
location: China, Tianjin Jinghai District, No. 156 Jingwen Road, home kitchen

name: Waking up the family and making arrangements
description: Xiulan woke the children up one by one. Xinxin rubbed her eyes and called for her mother; Zhezhe still wanted to lie in, and Xiulan gently patted his bottom: “Get up now! Today Mom is going to your school to sit in on your class, so you need to be energetic!” While the children were washing up, Xiulan knocked on Aunt Wu's door: “Aunt Wu, breakfast is ready. Come out and eat when you're ready.” The whole family sat around the dining table and ate breakfast noisily and happily. During the meal, Xiulan reminded Zhezhe: “After eating, let's leave early. Mom will walk you to the school gate, and then I have to rush home to pick up Grandma Wu so we can all go to school together.”
location: Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Take her daughter to school.
description: After breakfast, Xiulan quickly cleared away the dishes, put a thick coat on Xinxin, and set off on her electric bike. On the way, Xinxin chattered about the new games at kindergarten, and Xiulan smiled and responded. At the kindergarten gate, only after watching Xinxin being led into the school by the teacher did Xiulan turn the bike around with relief and head home.
location: Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Going to school with Aunt Wu and attending the parents' open day
description: After returning home, Xiulan and Aunt Wu walked together to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School. On the way, Xiulan briefly told her about ZheZhe's situation. After arriving at the school, the two of them were seated, along with the other parents, in the back row of the Class 2, Grade 4 classroom. When the class bell rang, the math teacher, Teacher Zhang, began teaching fraction addition and subtraction. Xiulan's eyes followed ZheZhe, who was sitting in the third row. She saw that ZheZhe was a little restless at first, but was soon called on by the teacher to answer a question. ZheZhe answered quickly and accurately, and even voluntarily raised his hand once. Xiulan felt a surge of joy, took out her small notebook, and seriously wrote down: 'Voluntarily raised hand, reacts quickly. But likes to pick at his eraser while doing problems; attention is not focused.'

participant.name: Teacher Zhang
participant.relation: She woke the three children one by one, helped the youngest daughter put on her jacket and combed her little braids. The family sat around the dining table, drinking hot porridge and chewing multigrain cakes. Xinxin mentioned that the teacher had asked them to bring dried leaves for a craft project, and she promised to pick some up from the community flower beds when taking her to school.

location: Class 2, Grade 4, Tianjin Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Talk with the homeroom teacher after class.
description: The dismissal bell rang, and the parents gradually dispersed. Xiulan asked Aunt Wu to wait by the flower bed downstairs for a while, then quickly caught up with her homeroom teacher, Teacher Yang. The two chatted in the hallway outside the office for a while. Xiulan told her exactly what she had just observed. Teacher Yang nodded and said, 'Ma Mingzhe's mother, you observed very carefully. The child is very smart and has a good foundation, but he is indeed a bit careless—for example, he often copies numbers incorrectly and tends to skip a step when solving problems. I suggest you set up a daily completion plan for him at home, have him do a few calculation problems every day to calm him down, and gradually build up his concentration.' Xiulan listened seriously and nodded repeatedly: 'Teacher Yang, you're absolutely right! When I get back, I'll make a three-point pact with him.'
location: Corridor outside the teachers' office at Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Return home, prepare lunch ingredients, and chat with Aunt Wu
description: After thanking Teacher Yang, Xiulan quickly went downstairs and found Aunt Wu. As they walked, they chatted about their feelings from the lesson just attended. When she got home, Xiulan first washed and cut the vegetables for lunch, marinated the fish, and sorted through the black fungus that had been soaked the night before. While she was working, Aunt Wu came over to help peel garlic. They chatted casually, and Xiulan couldn't help telling Aunt Wu about her conversation with the teacher just now: "...He said he is careless, but I was actually quite happy, because at least it shows he isn't dumb. It's just that this rash temperament needs to be corrected." Aunt Wu comforted her, "Boys are like that. The more anxious you are, the more stubborn he gets. You have to take it slowly."
location: Kitchen and living room of the residence at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Short rest and planning
description: Xiulan drank a glass of water and sat on the sofa for a while. She began to think about what to say when she had a heart-to-heart talk with Zhezhe in the afternoon, and also figured out how to tell Zhiqiang, who was out on a driving trip, about the day's events during the evening walk, so that he could share the joy.
location: Home living room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Pick up her daughter and prepare lunch
description: Xiulan glanced at the time, got on her electric bike and went to pick up Xinxin. After bringing her daughter home, she tied on an apron and started cooking. Steamed sea bass, garlic lettuce, braised tofu with minced pork, and crispy fried peanuts—four dishes and a soup. Although they were home-style dishes, Xiulan made them look, smell, and taste great. Aunt Wu also helped out and served the cooked rice.
location: China, Tianjin Jinghai District, No. 156 Jingwen Road, home kitchen

name: Lunch and family conversation
description: At noon, only Xiulan, Xinxin, and Aunt Wu were eating. Xinxin obediently put food on Grandma Wu's plate, and Aunt Wu smiled and praised her for being sensible. During the meal, Xiulan talked about what she had seen in the morning and said with feeling, 'Teachers these days are really responsible, just like making chili sauce with you — you need patience and the right approach.' After eating, Xiulan urged Xinxin to wash her hands and cleaned up the dishes herself.
location: Dining room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Noon break
description: After coaxing Xinxin to sleep, Xiulan set a 30-minute alarm for herself and lay down on the bed for a midday rest. She was still mulling over the afternoon's matters, but soon fell asleep. Aunt Wu also went back to the guest room to rest.
location: The bedrooms at the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Made another trial batch of chili sauce with Aunt Wu.
description: The alarm went off, Xiulan got up, and found Aunt Wu already waiting in the kitchen. The two set about upgrading the chili sauce recipe based on yesterday's new idea. Xiulan took out a few figs she had saved last time to enhance the umami, and Aunt Wu ground the toasted white sesame seeds. This time they reduced the heat and simmered it for about ten extra minutes. The finished sauce was bright red in color and had a mouthwatering aroma. Xiulan took a taste and said in surprise, “Aunt Wu, this taste is really different! Much more fragrant, and there's a lingering sweetness.” She found two clean glass jars, filled them while hot, and tightened the lids.
location: China, Tianjin Jinghai District, No. 156 Jingwen Road, home kitchen

name: Doing housework alone and light exercise.
description: There was still some time before picking up the kids. Xiulan mopped the floors at home and put yesterday's dirty clothes into the washing machine. While it was running, she opened the courtyard gate and strolled slowly in the yard, stretching her back and catching the faint afternoon sun. She felt wonderful all over.
location: Various places in the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Pick up the second son from school and supervise homework.
description: Xiulan left ten minutes early and walked to the school gate. Seeing Zhezhe coming out while roughhousing with his classmates, she went up to him, didn't rush to bring up school matters, and just naturally took the backpack from his shoulder: "Let's go, son. Grandma Wu is still waiting at home." On the way, she merely asked, "Did you run in P.E. this afternoon? Are you thirsty?" Zhezhe shrugged. "I ran three laps!" Back home, Xiulan first let Xinxin play with her toys for a while, then sat Zhezhe down at the living room desk: "Take out your math homework first. Mom will pick vegetables beside you. After you finish these two pages, we'll talk about something else."
