She took out the freshly washed greens, sat to the side, and while picking them kept an eye on Zhezhe's handwriting posture and speed. Seeing his writing was sloppy, she reminded him: "Be serious. Write neatly, with straight strokes."
location: Living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China (including the walking distance to and from No. 3 Primary School)

name: Preparing dinner
description: Xiulan took out the spare ribs she had marinated in the morning and prepared to make braised pork ribs. She also sliced some green peppers and meat to stir-fry shredded pork with green peppers, and paired it with a seaweed and egg drop soup. The kitchen was full of clattering sounds, filled with the flavor of everyday life.
location: China, Tianjin Jinghai District, No. 156 Jingwen Road, home kitchen

name: The whole family had dinner together.
description: The food was served and the aroma filled the room. Xiulan put braised pork ribs into Aunt Wu's bowl and added rice for the two children. After dinner, Xinxin took the initiative to help her mother clear the dishes, and Aunt Wu also helped wipe the table. Xiulan felt at ease, looking at the family, and felt that life had promise.
location: Dining room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Having a heart-to-heart talk with her second son, making a practice plan, and checking homework
description: Once everything was tidied up, Xiulan led Zhezhe into the study. She first praised him for his good performance in class that morning, then changed the subject: 'But Mom heard from Teacher Yang that you are sometimes careless when doing exercises, aren't you?' Zhezhe looked down and played with the corner of his clothes. Xiulan was not angry and said gently, 'We don't have to aim for a perfect score every time; it's good enough to improve a little each day. Mom wants to discuss something with you. Starting today, do five extra arithmetic problems every evening. If you get them all right, Mom will let you watch one episode of a cartoon. How about that?' Zhezhe's eyes lit up, and he nodded like a little chick pecking at rice. 'Okay!' Xiulan immediately took a workbook from the bookshelf, flipped to a page, and marked five problems. Zhezhe bent over and started working. When he finished, Xiulan carefully checked the answers one by one with a red pen. Two problems had been written wrong because of carelessness. Rather than scolding him, she pointed at the wrong problems and said, 'See, didn't you copy the decimal point wrong on this one?' Zhezhe scratched his head in embarrassment, picked up an eraser, and corrected them. Once all the answers were right, Xiulan smiled and ruffled his hair. 'Good boy, you passed the first level today! Go watch one episode of a cartoon, but only one!' Zhezhe ran out of the study cheering.
location: Home study, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Family walk
description: It was completely dark, but it hadn't rained yet. Xiulan suggested going out for a walk to help digest the meal. So the whole family strolled south along Jingwen Road. The streetlights were dim and yellow, and tree shadows swayed. Aunt Wu led Xinxin in front, while Xiulan and Zhezhe followed behind. Xiulan asked, "Was today's cartoon more fun than usual?" Zhezhe grinned and said, "It was great! Mom, I'll do it again tomorrow!" Xiulan felt sweeter than if she had eaten candy. When they reached South Lake Park, they walked around the entrance, enjoying the peacefulness of the night, and returned home the same way at about 20:30.
location: Nanhu Park, Jingwen Road and Heyou Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Soaking feet while talking with her husband on the phone.
description: Back home, Xiulan boiled a pot of hot water, mixed in some cold water, and soaked her feet with Aunt Wu. She took out her phone and called her husband Ma Zhiqiang, who was out on the road: “Hey, Zhiqiang, the house was really lively today... I'm telling you, today was Zhezhe's school open day. The teacher said he's smart but a bit careless. I told him that if he does five extra math problems every day and gets them right, he can watch cartoons. He was so happy!” From the other end came Zhiqiang's good-natured chuckle: “Okay, Xiulan, do what you think is best, but don't push yourself too hard.” Xiulan smiled and hung up, feeling that although the day had been busy, she felt especially at ease inside.
location: Home living room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Morning preparation, breakfast, and taking the children to school.
description: After being awakened by the alarm at 5:39 in the morning, Ma Xiulan first did some simple shoulder and neck stretches in bed. Then she got up, went to the kitchen, cooked millet pumpkin porridge, steamed handmade buns, and sliced sauce cucumbers, while also filling the children's insulated cups with warm water, soaking the school uniforms, and sweeping the fallen leaves in the courtyard. At 6:45 she woke up her second son Ma Mingzhe and daughter Ma Yuxin. Her eldest son Ma Mingxuan washed up and went downstairs by himself. The family sat around the table for breakfast, and Xiulan urged the children to eat while eating. After the meal, she quickly cleaned up the bowls and chopsticks and got ready to take her daughter to kindergarten on an electric bike.
location: Home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (bedroom, kitchen, dining room, courtyard).

name: Taking her daughter to kindergarten and interacting with family on WeChat.
description: At 7:25, Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to take her daughter Ma Yuxin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten. On the way, Xinxin chatted about the little rabbit at the kindergarten. They arrived at the kindergarten gate at 7:35, and she watched Xinxin being led inside by the teacher before leaving. On the way home, she checked the family WeChat group and saw a video of her father Ma Jianguo doing morning exercise and his blood pressure reading. Her mother Li Xiuying said they would make dumplings at noon. Xiulan gave a like and replied in the group, with warm interactions.
location: On the way from No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to Huakang First Kindergarten in Jinghai District, Tianjin, and then back home.

name: Morning Baduanjin exercise and chores after breakfast
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan changed into cloth shoes and practiced Baduanjin with Aunt Zhao, the neighbor across the way, in her own courtyard. Accompanied by soothing music, they went from Hold the Hands High to Regulate the Triple Burner all the way to the final posture, breaking into a light sweat and feeling refreshed. Later, Aunt Wu got up, and Xiulan heated porridge and ate steamed buns with her as a second breakfast. Afterward, she scrubbed the soaked school uniforms clean, hung them out to dry, and washed the breakfast bowls and chopsticks and put them away.
location: Courtyard and kitchen at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Visit Shengli Street market and have lunch at a mutton soup restaurant
description: At 8:45, Ma Xiulan, Aunt Wu, and neighbor Zhou Xiuqin walked together to the Shengli Street market. At the dried goods stall, Aunt Wu picked dried chili peppers and sesame seeds, Zhou Xiuqin bought handcrafted lace trim, and Xiulan bought white cotton thread. Then they went to the produce stall and selected a big pumpkin and fresh jelly fig seeds. The three chatted along the way; Zhou Xiuqin told funny stories about her husband's younger sister's blind date, and the mood was light. After shopping, they went to Old Ma's Mutton Soup Restaurant, each ordered a bowl of lamb offal soup with sesame flatbread, and had a hot lunch, chatting about hot sauce improvements and community promotion plans. After the meal, they walked back home.
location: Shengli Street market and Old Ma's Mutton Soup Restaurant (near the intersection of Shengli Street and Jingwen Road), Jinghai District, Tianjin, going back and forth to No. 156 Jingwen Road

name: Midday rest and miscellaneous housework
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan felt sore in her legs and leaned back on the living room sofa to rest for about half an hour. During that time, she sent a WeChat message to her husband Ma Zhiqiang, telling him that she would make chili sauce in the afternoon and take a computer class in the evening, and asking him to come home early if he was not on the road. Later, she took out her unfinished embroidery and worked a few stitches. Aunt Wu was taking a nap in the guest room.
location: Living room and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Record of the second trial production and recipe of the fragrant numbing spicy sauce
description: At 13:20, Ma Xiulan and Aunt Wu entered the kitchen and made the second version of the chili sauce according to the improved plan. They first dry-roasted dried Sichuan peppercorns and white sesame seeds over low heat until fragrant, then ground them. Xiulan added the ground peppercorns when the oil was at the right temperature, frying until the numbing flavor was released, then mixed everything—oil and solids—into the original chili sauce, stirring well and balancing the numbing and spicy flavors, resulting in a rich aroma. Coincidentally, Zhou Xiuqin dropped by, and the three of them tasted it together, praising it endlessly. Xiulan then carefully recorded the recipe proportions and steps in her notebook, and portioned and sealed the finished product to prepare for the community promotion on the 17th.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Picking up Zhezhe after school and family afternoon study time
description: At 15:00, Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up her second son, Ma Mingzhe. On the way, she shared the good news that the chili sauce was a success. After returning home, Aunt Wu had already picked up their daughter Ma Yuxin from kindergarten and prepared apples and tea snacks in the yard. Xiulan cut cake to tide the children over, then supervised Zhezhe in the living room as he did his homework and completed the “daily check” mental arithmetic problems. After getting all of them right, Zhezhe was allowed to watch one episode of a cartoon. Meanwhile, Xiulan held Xinxin on her lap and taught her to recognize characters, while Aunt Wu basked in the sun nearby.
location: At the entrance of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School on Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, then returned to the living room and courtyard of the home at 156 Jingwen Road

name: Family dinner and after-school preparation
description: At 16:45, Ma Xiulan put on an apron to prepare dinner, and Aunt Wu helped pick vegetables. Dinner was steamed sea bass, garlic broccoli, and tomato and egg soup, served with leftover steamed buns and millet porridge. At 17:20, her eldest son Ma Mingxuan, a second-year middle school student, came home from school. The whole family, plus Aunt Wu, had dinner together. At the table, the children shared funny stories from school, and the mood was cheerful. After dinner, Xiulan quickly cleared the table, wiped it, and washed the dishes, then went to the bedroom to gather her computer course notebook and hot water bottle, getting ready for the evening training.
location: Kitchen, dining room, and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Computer training class: Word layout and formatting
description: At 18:40, Ma Xiulan walked to the activity room of the Jingwen Road Community Party-Mass Service Center. From 19:00 to 21:00, she attended the third class of the computer training course, learning Word layout, including heading styles, paragraph spacing, headers and footers, and multi-level lists. Xiulan found multi-level lists difficult, but gradually understood after two sessions of one-on-one guidance from Teacher Zhou, and drew a flowchart in her notebook as a record. During the break, she discussed with classmates how to use styles to quickly generate a table of contents. After class ended at 21:00, she walked home, recalling the skills she had learned and thinking about using them to organize her recipes.
location: Activity room at the Jingwen Road Community Party-Mass Service Center in Jinghai District, Tianjin; commuting between there and 156 Jingwen Road

name: Evening relaxation, organizing notes, and falling asleep.
description: After returning home, the family had already gone to sleep. Ma Xiulan quietly boiled water, used a hot water bottle to apply heat to the back of her neck and shoulders, which somewhat relieved the soreness. Then in the living room she recopied her class notes and marked the key points. Next, she soaked her feet in hot water for 20 minutes to relax her whole body. Before bed, she checked the doors, windows, and gas, tucked the quilt corners in for the children, and after lying down did shoulder and neck stretches and deep breathing. While lying in bed, she browsed her phone and saw a message from her husband Ma Zhiqiang saying he would come home the next day; she replied with a smiley face, and also briefly interacted in the family group and community group. At 23:00, drowsiness set in. She set the alarm for 5:50 the next morning, put down her phone, and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Living room, bedroom, and bathroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Getting up, morning exercise, and recording potted plants.
description: At 5:39 a.m., the alarm went off on time. It was still dark. Ma Xiulan slipped on a coat and walked into the yard. She first took a close-up of the potted fuchsia on the balcony to record the newly formed flower buds. Then she did 15 minutes of neck and shoulder stretches and a complete set of Baduanjin exercises to warm up her body. After exercising, she strolled in the courtyard for about ten minutes, taking in the weather and the activity in the yard.
location: Home bedroom and courtyard, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare breakfast and help the children get up
description: At 6:30, she returned to the house. Ma Xiulan rinsed the rice, put millet porridge on to cook, heated the steamed buns, and scrambled eggs with scallions for breakfast. She went to wake her second son, Ma Mingzhe, and her daughter, Ma Yuxin. The daughter behaved well and helped set the table, while the second son stayed in bed and only went to wash up after being urged twice. Only when each child had a bowl of porridge and half a steamed bun did Ma Xiulan feel at ease.
location: Kitchen and dining room of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Riding an electric bicycle to take the child to school
description: At 7:10, Ma Xiulan put thick coats and scarves on the children, drove the electric bicycle to first take her daughter Ma Yuxin to Huakang First Kindergarten. The girl happily recited nursery rhymes on the way. She watched her go in with the teacher at the kindergarten gate. Then she turned and rode for 10 minutes to take her second son Ma Mingzhe to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, telling him not to get distracted in class and to wait for her to pick him up after school.
location: From 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin to Huakang First Kindergarten (Jingwen Road), then to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street)

name: Home organizing and computer class
description: Arriving home close to 8 o'clock, Ma Xiulan spent 20 minutes tidying the kitchen, washing the dishes and chopsticks, and laying out the dried chili peppers and Sichuan peppercorns bought at yesterday's market. At 8:20 she went into the study, took out her computer course notebook, reviewed the multilevel list operations in Word learned yesterday, and practiced on the computer. Then she used her phone to search for several Excel videos, previewing the use of the SUM and AVERAGE functions in advance.
location: Home kitchen and study, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Neighborly chat and phone greetings.
description: At 8:50, Ma Xiulan went to the courtyard for some fresh air and ran into Wang Guilan, the neighbor across the way, who came out to hang clothes. The two chatted across the courtyard wall for more than 10 minutes. She comforted Sister Wang about her husband's knee pain and reminded her to keep warm in the cold weather. After returning indoors near 9 o'clock, she called her mother, asked about her parents' well-being, and reminded them to add clothes as the temperature dropped. When she learned that her father had been talking about her, she felt warm at heart.
location: Courtyard and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing food and getting ready for guests
description: After hanging up the phone, Ma Xiulan began preparing the ingredients for making chili sauce at noon, counting dried chilies, Sichuan peppercorns, sesame seeds, and tidying up kitchen utensils. Around 10 o'clock, she cleared the countertop, set out the stone mortar, large bowls, spoons, and then went to the vegetable plot to pull up some scallions, wash them, and chop them for later. She was looking forward to having her friends Zhou Xiuqin and Aunt Wu come over.
location: Home kitchen and courtyard at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Go to the market to buy spices.
description: Remembering that Auntie Wu had mentioned adding fresh dried ginger powder to the chili sauce, and that she had run out at home, Ma Xiulan, since there was still time, rode her electric bike for 5 minutes to Shengli Street Market. At the dried goods stall, she weighed out 100 grams of dried ginger and had the stall owner grind it into powder on the spot.
location: Market on Shengli Avenue, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Receiving visitors at home
description: She got home at 10:40. Just after putting away the dried ginger powder, she heard the voices of her friends Zhou Xiuqin and Aunt Wu laughing and talking at the door. Ma Xiulan hurried out to welcome them, and the three chatted animatedly at the doorstep. Zhou Xiuqin also brought a bag of fried dough twists she had made herself to share.
location: Home entrance, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Making a trial batch of the final version of chili sauce and a simple lunch
description: At 11 o'clock sharp, the three went into the kitchen and threw themselves into making chili sauce, strictly following Aunt Wu's recipe: stir-frying the chilies, grinding them into powder, simmering the oil, and adding the ingredients. At the final critical step, Ma Xiulan added five-spice powder and sugar to enhance the flavor, and Aunt Wu personally taught her the tricks of sealing with sesame oil and fermenting in an airtight container. The whole house was filled with fragrance. Each of the three bottled some as a keepsake, and they took a group photo with the bottles in front of the kitchen door. Because they were busy cooking, for lunch they simply made plain soup noodles with the fresh chili sauce. Everyone ate until sweating, and all praised it.
location: Kitchen and dining room of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Saw off Sister Xiuqin and recorded the recipe.
description: After lunch, Zhou Xiuqin left early because she had something to do at home. Ma Xiulan and Aunt Wu cleaned up the kitchen together and washed the dishes. Afterward, Ma Xiulan had Aunt Wu rest in the living room and quickly copied the successfully tested final version of the chili sauce recipe into a new notebook, noting the date and the words final version, and treating it as a family heirloom.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: See off Aunt Wu and give her gifts
description: At 2 p.m., Aunt Wu was about to leave. Ma Xiulan helped her pack her things and tucked a small jar of pickled vegetables she had made herself and a pair of delicate embroidered hair flowers sewn in her spare time into Aunt Wu's bag. The two walked about 15 minutes to Jinghai Passenger Station, saying little along the way; Ma Xiulan felt sad. After arriving, she watched Aunt Wu check her ticket and board the bus. After the bus started and turned at the intersection, she still stood behind the glass door of the waiting hall watching the bus go, then turned and walked back, feeling empty inside.
location: Walked from No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to Jinghai Passenger Station (Chaoyang Road).

name: Picking up the children from school and returning home
description: After leaving the passenger station, Ma Xiulan calmed herself down, walked home, and rode her electric bike to pick up the children. She first went to Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up her daughter Ma Yuxin, who happily said the teacher had praised her for drawing well. Then she waited about ten minutes at the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School and picked up her second son Ma Mingzhe. The three of them went home together, arriving near 4:30, and she cut apples for the children.
location: From Jinghai Coach Station (Chaoyang Road) to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten and Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, and finally returning home at 156 Jingwen Road

name: Supervise homework and prepare dinner.
description: Back home, Ma Xiulan let her daughter go play with building blocks, then moved a stool and sat next to her second son to watch him do homework. Because the child was distracted while doing math problems, she reminded him several times. In between, she went to the kitchen to prepare dinner. Since the weather was cold, she made a big pot of hot noodle soup, brought out the leftover chili sauce from noon, and also stir-fried garlic lettuce.
location: Living room and kitchen at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner and sharing joy.
description: At 6 o'clock sharp, her husband Ma Zhiqiang came home and made it in time for dinner. The whole family sat together eating hot noodle soup, and the atmosphere was warm. Ma Xiulan excitedly recounted the process of successfully making chili sauce during the day, her face beaming; the children listened with great interest, and her husband rarely praised her for being capable, saying the sauce was authentic and went well with rice.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The whole family went out for a walk.
description: After getting ready at 7:20, Ma Xiulan, her husband, and the two younger children went out together for a walk along Jingwen Road, except for the eldest son, who stayed behind because he had a lot of homework. Although it was cold, walking warmed them up. The couple each held a child's hand, chatting about the husband's long-distance driving work and weekend plans. After walking for more than half an hour, they went home after it was completely dark.
location: Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening household matters and children's bedtime
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan urged her daughter to brush her teeth and wash her face, told a bedtime story, and watched her fall asleep. Then she checked her second son's homework and had him correct the several mistakes. She also checked her eldest son Ma Mingxuan's math problems, and only let them wash up after confirming he had mastered them. After the two younger children lay down, she went to the eldest son's room to chat for a bit and asked what he wanted to eat on the weekend. He said he wanted to eat the dumplings she made.
location: Each bedroom and the living room of the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Personal care and recipe recording.
description: After the children were all asleep, Ma Xiulan heated water and soaked her feet comfortably for 20 minutes, using a hot water bottle on her sore neck. While soaking her feet, she carefully copied the final version of the chili sauce recipe from the day, from measurements to steps, into her recipe notebook, and noted the precautions in neat handwriting.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pre-bed preparation and rest.
description: At 22:30, Ma Xiulan checked the doors, windows, and stove to make sure everything was safe, then returned to the bedroom and chatted with her husband, learning that he was going on a long trip next week. After turning off the light and lying down, she reviewed the day in her mind: although saying goodbye to Aunt Wu was hard, she had gained an exclusive spicy sauce recipe and friendship, which made her feel fulfilled and warm. She soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Wake-up and morning exercise
description: Before dawn, Ma Xiulan woke up naturally. She first did 10 minutes of shoulder and neck stretches in bed to loosen up. Then she put on a thick cotton-padded coat, walked 10 minutes in the courtyard against the cold air, and then did a full set of Baduanjin for about 15 minutes. After warming up in the cold, her whole body felt warm and comfortable.
location: Home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (bedroom, courtyard)

name: Prepare breakfast and have a meal with the family.
description: After finishing the exercise, Ma Xiulan went back inside and began preparing breakfast. She cooked a pot of millet and sweet potato porridge, heated up steamed buns, and served soy-pickled cucumbers and spicy radish strips, plus poached eggs for everyone. She called her husband Ma Zhiqiang and the children to get up and wash up, and the family sat around the dining table to eat breakfast.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Make dumplings and prepare a package to send.
description: After breakfast, Ma Xiulan began making dumplings. Using the pork belly and cabbage that Ma Zhiqiang had bought the day before, she chopped the filling, cut the vegetables, seasoned it, rolled out wrappers, and wrapped 65 cabbage-and-pork dumplings. She boiled some, let them cool, and packed them in containers, and froze the raw dumplings. At the same time, she found the embroidered insoles and blue satin hair flowers she had made earlier and packed them to send to Aunt Wu in Cangzhou. Her son Ma Mingxuan, after finishing his homework, helped press a few dumpling wrappers.
location: Kitchen and living room of the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Sending gifts and household mending
description: After Ma Zhiqiang got up, Ma Xiulan asked him to ride to the Cainiao Station at the entrance of Wutong Commune to send the packed dumplings, shoe insoles, and hair flowers to Aunt Wu, and reminded him to write Zhou Xiuqin's phone number. Ma Xiulan stayed home to clean up the dumpling board and bowls, then took out her sewing box to mend the frayed cuffs of Xuanxuan's school uniform and the fallen button on Xinxin's shirt, and also watered and wiped the leaves of the fuchsia and roses on the balcony. At about 10:30, Zhiqiang came back after mailing the parcel; the delivery fee was 15 yuan.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and Cainiao Station, Wutong Community, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Prepare lunch and tutor my daughter.
description: After finishing the housework, Ma Xiulan started making lunch. She sautéed scallions with the leftover ground meat from the morning, added tomatoes to make a meat sauce, and cooked noodles for the family; she also steamed a bowl of egg custard for her picky daughter Ma Yuxin. After the meal, she watched Xinxin eat while teaching her to recognize characters on the literacy chart on the wall.
location: Kitchen and living room of the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Noon break
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan urged the three children to take a nap. She took Xinxin to the bedroom, told a little story to help her fall asleep; Xuanxuan and Zhezhe rested in their own rooms. Ma Xiulan and Zhiqiang returned to the master bedroom. She leaned against the headboard, replied to a few messages in the sisters' group chat on her phone, and then took a half-hour nap herself.
location: The bedrooms of the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Tutored the second son with extra practice problems.
description: After her afternoon nap, Ma Xiulan woke up her second son, Ma Mingzhe, and began the first day of daily extra exercises. She selected three word problems and two mental arithmetic questions from the workbook and asked him to complete them within half an hour. Zhezhe tried to get out of it, so Ma Xiulan promised that if he finished and got them all right, he could watch one more cartoon after the evening party. Zhezhe carefully completed the problems, got them all right, and was praised.
location: At Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (Second Son's Room)

name: Prepare craft materials and head to the community activity room
description: After tutoring the children, Ma Xiulan remembered that she had to go to the community at three o'clock in the afternoon to teach pomegranate fabric craft. She found non-woven fabric, needle and thread, stuffing cotton, scissors, and samples, packed them into a canvas bag, changed into a maroon sweater and black down jacket, gathered her hair, told Ma Zhiqiang to watch the children, then walked to the handicraft room on the first floor of the Jingwen Road Community Party-Masses Service Center. On the way she met her neighbor Wang Guilan and chatted as they walked.
location: From 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin to the handicraft room on the first floor of the Jingwen Road Community Party-Mass Service Center, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Community handicraft activity for seniors
description: In the handicraft room of the Jingwen Road Community Party-Mass Service Center, Ma Xiulan displayed pomegranate fabric craft samples and patiently taught about 12 elderly community members how to cut, sew, and stuff them. Her neighbor Wang Guilan helped as an assistant. One elderly man sewed his sample crooked, and Ma Xiulan smiled as she helped him remove the stitches and start over. The atmosphere was warm, and the elderly residents all enjoyed her teaching.
location: Craft Room, 1st Floor, Jingwen Road Community Party and Mass Service Center, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Go home to prepare dinner
description: After the activity ended, Ma Xiulan hurried home, washed her hands, and started preparing dinner. She sliced the leftover braised beef from yesterday, stir-fried cabbage with vinegar, and made seaweed egg drop soup. While reheating the rice, she received a call from Ma Zhiqiang saying the express package had been sent, with shipping cost 15 yuan. She wrote down the tracking number.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Having dinner and mobilizing the whole family.
description: The dishes were served and the family had dinner. Ma Xiulan urged everyone to eat quickly in preparation for the evening's gala performance. The children were excited, and Ma Yuxin said she wanted to go cheer for her mother. Everyone finished eating amid laughter and chatter.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tidying up, dressing up, and preparing to go out.
description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan had Ma Zhiqiang help the children change clothes and wash their faces and hands, while she soaked the dishes and chopsticks. She changed into black athletic wear, applied some face cream, and pinned up her hair with a floral hairpin. She silently ran through the Baduanjin movements in her mind and took deep breaths to get into the right state.
location: At home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin: bedroom, living room.

name: The whole family set out for the evening party venue.
description: The family of five dressed neatly, locked the courtyard gate, and walked to the square of the Jingwen Road Community Party and Mass Service Center. Ma Xiulan told Zhiqiang to keep an eye on their two sons while she held her daughter Ma Yuxin's hand. On the way, neighbors greeted them and wished her a successful performance.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin to Jingwen Road Community Party-Mass Service Center Square

name: Leading Baduanjin at the community cultural evening
description: The evening party was held at the community square. When it was time for the Baduanjin performance, Ma Xiulan led a team of twenty onto the stage. She was fully focused, with smooth and powerful movements, and won applause. After coming off stage, team member Zhang Shufen handed her hot tea and praised her as the most eye-catching one on stage. Ma Xiulan and the team took a group photo in front of the stage.
location: Square stage of the Party-Mass Service Center of Jingwen Road Community, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: After the party, the whole family took a walk and shared their joy.
description: After the performance, the whole family walked out of the square and strolled home along the tree-lined Jingwen Road. The children discussed it excitedly. Ma Mingxuan said Mom was the lead dancer and really cool. Ma Mingzhe imitated the moves with gestures, and Ma Yuxin said Mom was a star. Ma Xiulan felt warm at heart.
location: From the square of the Jingwen Road Community Party and Mass Service Center, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to the Jingwen Road walking path.

name: Returning home to supervise the children washing up
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan hummed a tune while urging the three children to wash up. She helped her daughter Xinxin brush her teeth and wash her face, and urged her two sons not to dawdle.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening relaxation and pre-bedtime tidying.
description: After settling the children down, Ma Xiulan sat on the sofa soaking her feet with a mugwort foot-soak bag steeped in hot water. At the same time, she browsed the party photos in the community group on her phone, saved photos of herself leading the exercises and group photos, and also sent voice messages to chat in her sisters' group. Then she took out her account book and recorded the day's courier fee of 15 yuan, mentally planned Monday's chili sauce promotion, and briefly planned the materials to prepare for tomorrow.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Stretching before bed and going to sleep.
description: After soaking her feet, her whole body felt warm. Ma Xiulan lay on the bed, a little excited because the party had been a success. She asked her husband Ma Zhiqiang to rub her waist, then took deep breaths and did simple lower back stretches. Reviewing the fulfilling day, she felt proud and satisfied, chatted with Zhiqiang for a while, and gradually fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Morning wake-up and courtyard exercise
description: At 5:40 the alarm went off. Ma Xiulan was thinking about Aunt Wu, who was about to leave, so she didn't linger in bed. First she did five minutes of shoulder and neck stretches on the bedroom carpet, feeling much looser in the shoulders and back. Then she went to the living room, put on her coat, pushed open the courtyard gate, took a deep breath of the crisp air, and walked slowly in the yard for ten minutes. Along the way she looked at the pots of autumn chrysanthemums and picked off a withered yellow leaf. Then she performed a set of Baduanjin in the courtyard, with gentle movements, focusing on the stretch of her body. Finally she returned inside, did lower back and cat stretches against the wall, and her waist loosened up too. She felt much more energetic.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Carefully preparing a farewell breakfast.
description: Ma Xiulan got busy in the kitchen, and it gradually warmed up. She scooped out two bowls of flour, added warm water and yeast, kneaded it into a smooth dough, and set it by the radiator to rise. At the same time, she put the millet that had been soaking overnight into a pot and simmered it over low heat. While waiting, she took out the pork-and-cabbage filling she had mixed yesterday, and sliced a plate of homemade soy-sauce pickled cucumbers and shredded mustard stems. Once the dough had risen, she quickly rolled out wrappers, made baozi with beautiful pleats, and steamed two trays. When the baozi came out of the steamer, the whole house was filled with the mouthwatering aroma of wheat and meat—a heartfelt gesture for Aunt Wu, who was about to leave.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Warm breakfast and farewell.
description: Ma Zhiqiang got up with the children, and the whole family sat around the dining table. Ma Xiulan invited Aunt Wu to sit down, handed her steaming hot buns and millet porridge, and said warmly, "Sister Wu, try my cooking—you can't get this when you're away from home." As she spoke, she served food to her with chopsticks. Aunt Wu's eyes turned slightly red, and she kept saying it was good. The children sensibly called her Grandma. After the meal, Ma Xiulan helped Aunt Wu check her luggage. She wrapped two bottles of chili sauce layer by layer in plastic wrap and plastic bags, carefully put them in the very center of Aunt Wu's cloth bag, and wrapped them with clothes.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Preparation before departure and a short rest
description: Before seeing Aunt Wu off, Ma Xiulan pulled Ma Zhiqiang aside and told him to look after the children today and make something simple for lunch; she would buy groceries on the way back after seeing Aunt Wu off. Ma Zhiqiang nodded with a simple, honest smile and told her to be careful on the road. Ma Xiulan put on her thick coat and helmet, wheeled the electric bike into the yard to check the battery, and made sure it had enough for a smooth round trip. Then she took a sip of water, calmed herself down, and got ready to leave.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Seeing Aunt Wu off at the coach station
description: At 8:40, Ma Xiulan got on her electric bicycle, and Aunt Wu sat on the back seat, holding her cloth bag tightly. The morning wind was a bit chilly, so Ma Xiulan asked Aunt Wu to put up the hood of her coat. They said little on the way, both feeling reluctant to part. They rode along Jingwen Road for about 15 minutes and arrived at the bus station. Ma Xiulan accompanied Aunt Wu inside and bought her a ticket to Cangzhou (departing at 10:20). While waiting, Aunt Wu took Ma Xiulan's hand and said, "Xiulan, keep my hot sauce recipe safe. Come to Cangzhou next spring for sure, and I'll take you to see the pear blossoms." Ma Xiulan held back tears and nodded with a smile. At 10 o'clock the bus arrived. She helped Aunt Wu carry her luggage onboard, waved vigorously outside the window, and kept waving until the bus turned at the intersection and disappeared.
location: Jinghai District Passenger Station, at the intersection of Dongfanghong Road and Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Buying groceries and shopping on the way home
description: After seeing Aunt Wu off, Ma Xiulan felt a little empty at heart. After calming down, she rode her bike for about 10 minutes to the Wutong Commune Wet Market. Sister Sun Guifang waved at her. Ma Xiulan bought some fresh spinach, tomatoes, and a few Chinese yams, and Sister Sun also grabbed a handful of scallions to give her. At 10:30 she left the market and rode five minutes to Jingbai Supermarket, which was on the way, where she bought the yogurt the children liked and also bought a pack of five-spice powder from Zhang Shufen. Around 10:45 she left the supermarket and rode about five minutes to get home.
location: Wutong Commune Market, Tuanjing Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Copying out the recipe to pass on the taste.
description: After getting home, Ma Xiulan put away the groceries, and the first thing she did was dig out the handwritten chili sauce recipe Aunt Wu had left her, written on a piece of straw paper in somewhat messy handwriting. She found her long-used recipe book with a kraft-paper cover, turned to a blank page, and copied it out neatly stroke by stroke. Under the line "use Dahongpao peppercorns from Hebei" she deliberately drew a line, and added a note of her own devising: "you can add half a spoonful of sugar to enhance the flavor." Closing the book, she felt that this friendship had been treasured up as well.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Preparing a simple lunch.
description: Back in the kitchen, Ma Xiulan began preparing lunch while Ma Zhiqiang watched TV with the children in the living room. She quickly made a pot of tomato and egg sauce for noodles, cooked a large pot of hand-rolled noodles, and blanched the spinach she had bought to mix into a cold dish. Though the meal was simple, the family ate warmly. While eating, she told the children that Grandma Wu had returned to her hometown and they could visit her another time.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Short nap during lunch break
description: After clearing the dishes, Ma Xiulan felt somewhat tired and lay down on the bed. Recalling the little moments she had spent with Aunt Wu over the past ten days or so, she felt both warm and wistful. As she dwelled on these thoughts, she fell into a deep sleep. After sleeping for about 40 minutes, she regained much of her energy.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Housework tidying and fabric craft time
description: After waking from her afternoon nap, Ma Xiulan put the changed bed sheets and duvet covers into the washing machine and started it, then mopped the floors in the living room and bedroom. When the chores were done, sunlight happened to shine through the window. She brought out her sewing basket, sat in the armchair by the window, and began making fabric hair flowers. Taking out the plaid fabric she had bought yesterday, she tried to make the new style Aunt Wu had taught her—cutting, sewing, and stuffing, doing each step patiently and carefully. Every 20 minutes, she stood up to stretch her neck and rub her shoulders to avoid getting tired.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Call parents to ask how they are
description: After pausing her work, Ma Xiulan picked up her phone and called her mother. Her mother's voice was still strong and clear. Ma Xiulan told her that Aunt Wu had returned to Cangzhou today. Before she could feel sad, her mother comforted her: "All good things must come to an end; it's a good thing she's going back to her own home." Then she chattered on, asking what they had eaten for dinner and whether the children had been obedient. After chatting for more than twenty minutes and knowing that everything was fine at home, Ma Xiulan felt relieved.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Continued fabric crafting and learning new styles.
description: After hanging up the phone, Ma Xiulan returned to the window. The plaid cloth hair flower she had made earlier was already taking shape. She held it in her hand and examined it, then sewed a few small beads on as decoration. Then she remembered the other petal shape Aunt Wu had mentioned, so she sketched it on paper with a pen, gestured at the cutting, and planned to try again tomorrow.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Tutor the second son in math homework.
description: Ma Xiulan put away the fabric crafts and called Ma Mingzhe, who was playing marbles in the yard. She took out his math workbook and turned to the five commonly mistaken problems circled last Friday, which were about multiplication and division with decimals. She let Ma Mingzhe try them on his own first, then explained them one by one, using apples and pears as analogies to help him understand the reasoning. When he got them all right, Ma Xiulan rewarded him with a big hug.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Prepare a hearty dinner
description: It was almost time for dinner, and Ma Xiulan began to get dinner ready. Ma Zhiqiang came out of the room and voluntarily helped her peel garlic and trim vegetables. Ma Xiulan tied on an apron; she was in a somewhat special mood today and wanted to make a more plentiful meal. She made a simple stir-fry of Chinese yam and wood ear mushrooms, made sweet-and-sour pork ribs that the children loved, and simmered a spinach and tofu soup. The most indispensable item was the chili sauce she had learned from Aunt Wu. She scrambled some eggs with the chili sauce and put them in a small dish; the color was bright red and shiny, and it went especially well with rice.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Warm family dinner
description: The dishes were brought to the table, and the aroma filled the room. Ma Xiulan put a spare rib into each of Ma Zhiqiang's and Ma Mingxuan's bowls, then pushed the plate of scrambled eggs with chili sauce to the center and said, “Everyone try it—it's Grandma Wu's cooking, and it's delicious!” She dipped her chopsticks in a little and put it in her mouth; it was spicy with a rich aroma, still that familiar taste. At the table, the children chattered about school. Ma Mingxuan said he had improved on this month's exam, and Ma Mingzhe said he wanted to learn to play basketball. The family sat around together, and the sadness of parting was gradually diluted by the warm, lively atmosphere of the meal.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Evening walk for the whole family on Jingwen Road.
description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan urged everyone to go out for a walk. Ma Mingxuan said he had too much homework and stayed home to read. Ma Xiulan and Ma Zhiqiang took Ma Mingzhe and Ma Yuxin and strolled slowly along Jingwen Road. Most of the leaves on both sides of the road had fallen, rustling underfoot. The children ran ahead chasing each other, while the couple followed behind chatting about everyday matters. Ma Zhiqiang asked softly, 'Sister Wu's leaving—are you feeling down?' Ma Xiulan sighed and said, 'A little, but there is no banquet that lasts forever. As long as everyone is well, we will always meet again.'
location: Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Family reading and study time
description: Back home, the children each kept themselves busy. Ma Yuxin took out a picture book and asked Ma Xiulan to tell the story of Little Red Riding Hood. Ma Xiulan held her close and pointed at the little flowers and grass in the pictures while telling the story. Ma Mingzhe sat nearby reading the comic book Sanmao Wanders the World, giggling from time to time. Ma Mingxuan quietly did his homework in his room. Ma Xiulan also took Prevention and Care of Common Diseases in Middle-Aged and Elderly People from the bookshelf and leaned back on the sofa to read it, focusing on several chapters about neck, shoulder, waist, and leg pain, thinking she could call her mother tomorrow to talk about it.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Stretching the lower back, soaking feet, and bookkeeping.
description: At 20:40, the children washed up and went to bed one after another. Ma Xiulan tidied up the house, rolled out her yoga mat, and did 10 minutes of back and waist stretches. Then she boiled a pot of hot water, sliced some ginger, threw in a small handful of dried mugwort, and filled a large basin with hot water. The moment she put her feet in, warmth rose from the soles of her feet, and she let out a comfortable sigh. While soaking her feet, she took out the old ledger, recorded the day's grocery and supermarket expenses one by one, and checked this month's expenditures.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Sit quietly to relax and end the day peacefully.
description: After soaking her feet, Ma Xiulan changed into her pajamas, sat cross-legged on the bed, turned off the main light, and left only a soft bedside lamp on. She began deep abdominal breathing, and with each inhale and exhale, the day's fatigue slowly melted away. She closed her eyes, and the scene of today's farewell, Aunt Wu's smiling face, and the children's satisfied expressions when eating the chili sauce flashed through her mind like scenes from a movie. She silently thanked this handicraft friend for the warmth and companionship she had brought, and while breathing deeply, pressed the Hegu acupoint with her thumb until she felt completely at peace.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Going to bed
description: At 22:00, everything was in order. Ma Xiulan checked the doors and windows, confirmed they were all locked, and gently slipped into bed. She began to think about what materials she should prepare if the community came the next day to promote the experience of making chili sauce, and how to explain it clearly to everyone. As she thought, drowsiness washed over her, and she fell into a deep sleep. A full day with a touch of parting sadness came to an end.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Getting up in the morning, taking the children to school, and doing morning exercise
description: Ma Xiulan got up at 5:45, did shoulder and neck stretches, then woke her younger daughter Ma Yuxin and put a thick coat on her. At 6:10, mother and daughter left and walked to Huakang First Kindergarten. On the way, Xiulan taught her daughter to recognize the poplar trees by the roadside. After sending Yuxin into the kindergarten, Xiulan walked home alone, fed the chickens in the yard, practiced the 24-form simplified tai chi, and walked slowly to exercise her legs.
location: From home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin to Huakang First Kindergarten (Huakang First Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin) and back.

name: Preparing breakfast and doing housework
description: Xiulan was in the kitchen preparing breakfast for the family: she cooked millet pumpkin porridge, made egg pancakes, and sliced pickled radish skins. At the same time, while the porridge was simmering, she washed the bedsheets and mopped the floor, taking care of some household chores.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Wake the children and eat breakfast.
description: Xiulan went upstairs to wake her second son Ma Mingzhe, then had breakfast with Ma Yuxin and Ma Mingzhe in the dining room, telling the children to dress warmly. Yuxin kept talking about the kindergarten slide, while Mingzhe was thinking about playing football in PE class; the atmosphere at the table was relaxed.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Take the second son to school and go home to rest.
description: Xiulan rode her e-bike to take Ma Mingzhe to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, telling him to listen carefully in class and not to run around after school. After dropping off her son, she rode home alone, drank some water, and rested a bit to relax.
location: From home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to No. 3 Primary School of Jinghai District (Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin) and back

name: Studied Excel on the computer in the morning
description: In the study, Xiulan opened her laptop, reviewed the SUM and AVERAGE functions against her training notes and old exercise books, repeatedly practiced merging cells and adding borders, and set an alarm to get up and stretch her neck every 20 minutes.
location: Study at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Community promotion of chili sauce.
description: Xiulan took her chili sauce recipe notebook and a small bottle of homemade sample, walked to the Hongxingli Community Party-Mass Service Center, found the community grid worker Zheng Xiuying, and proposed using the community activity room to offer free chili sauce cooking classes. Sister Zheng said she needed to report to the director and asked Xiulan to wait for news.
location: Hongxingli Community Party-Masses Service Center, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepared lunch, picked up the child, had lunch, and took an afternoon nap.
description: Xiulan returned home from the community, reheated leftovers and washed cucumbers to prepare lunch. At 11 o'clock she first walked to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up Ma Yuxin, then went to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up Ma Mingzhe. After returning home, she heated up the dishes, made smashed cucumber salad, and the family of three had lunch. After the meal she cleared the dishes, arranged for the children to take a nap, set an alarm and lay down to rest herself, waking at 12:45.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Check the phone after the midday break
description: After waking from her afternoon nap, Xiulan drank some water, picked up her phone, sent a WeChat message to her husband Ma Zhiqiang to check on him, and liked the photo of her sister's granddaughter in the family group.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Afternoon handicrafts and housework.
description: Xiulan took out the frozen pork ribs to thaw, then got out her sewing kit and sewed a pencil case from light blue floral fabric scraps, planning to give it to neighbor Sister Wang's grandson. While doing handicrafts, she listened to opera on the radio and got up every half hour to stretch her shoulders.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Vegetable market shopping and chatting
description: Xiulan rode her electric bike to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market. At Sun Guifang's vegetable stall, she picked white radish, spinach, and scallions. Aunt Sun waived the odd change and gave her some cilantro as a gift. Xiulan chatted with her about the chili sauce promotion plan. Aunt Sun praised her for being capable, and the two talked about everyday family matters for more than twenty minutes.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Go home and pickle radishes
description: After returning home, Xiulan put on an apron, washed the white radishes and cut them into strips, sprinkled them with salt to draw out water. At the same time, she sliced ginger, garlic, and dried chili peppers, and mixed a sweet, sour, and spicy pickling sauce, preparing to make the pickled radish the whole family loved.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the children from school, help with their homework, and learn about their grades.
description: Xiulan rode her electric bike to pick up Ma Yuxin from Huakang First Kindergarten and Ma Mingzhe from Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School. After returning home, she urged the children to do homework. While tutoring Mingzhe in math, she received a WeChat message from Teacher Han, Mingxuan's homeroom teacher, saying Mingxuan failed history and had unfinished homework. Xiulan felt heavy-hearted but did not show it in front of Mingzhe.
location: Home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and school drop-off and pick-up locations

name: Making dinner
description: Xiulan went into the kitchen, blanched the pork ribs, and put them in a clay pot to simmer slowly. At the same time, she stir-fried spinach, scrambled eggs with tomatoes, and dry-fried green beans, thinking that her eldest son Mingxuan might come home for dinner.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The whole family eats dinner
description: Her husband Ma Zhiqiang came home from driving and sat around the dining table with Ma Yuxin and Ma Mingzhe for dinner. The children shared funny stories from school. Xiulan, preoccupied with worry over her eldest son's studies, was distracted and exchanged glances with her husband, planning to talk in detail after dinner.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: After dinner, went for a walk alone to ease anxiety.
description: Xiulan asked her husband to take care of the children and went for a walk alone along Jingwen Road, thinking about Ma Mingxuan's slipping grades and planning to go to school the next morning to talk with his homeroom teacher, Teacher Han. As the cool breeze blew, her mood gradually calmed.
location: Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tutoring the second son and giving the eldest son instructions
description: After returning home, Xiulan first went to the study to patiently explain the math problems that were easy to get wrong and accompanied Ma Mingzhe to finish the rest of his homework. Then she went to Ma Mingxuan's room, gently said she had learned of his grades, asked with concern whether he was having difficulties, and told him that she would go to school the next day to talk with Teacher Han. Mingxuan responded sullenly.
location: The study and Ma Mingxuan's room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Before-bed foot soak, reflection, and family matters
description: Xiulan soaked her feet in hot water with mugwort. While soaking, she thought about how to help her eldest son improve his grades. Afterward, she checked the doors and windows, tucked in the sleeping Ma Yuxin, shared her worries with her husband Ma Zhiqiang and was comforted, then did some pre-sleep stretching, turned off the light, and got ready to sleep.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Falling asleep
description: Having spent a busy day, Xiulan gradually drifted off to sleep, filled with hopes for her children and prepared for the next day's conversation.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Early morning indoor exercise, breakfast, and taking the children to school.
description: Awakened by the alarm at six in the morning, Ma Xiulan chose to exercise at home because of the gloomy weather, strong wind, and temperature drop. In the hallway between the bedroom and the living room, she did neck and shoulder stretches, a full set of Baduanjin, and back and waist stretches, gradually warming up. Then she went to the kitchen to prepare breakfast: millet porridge, steamed sweet potatoes, boiled eggs, and a small pickled dish made of cabbage hearts. At 6:50 she woke her son Mingzhe and daughter Yuxin and told them to put on extra clothes. After the family sat down and finished breakfast, at 7:20 she rode the electric bike, first taking Yuxin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten and watching her enter the school, then taking Mingzhe to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, repeatedly reminding him on the way to listen carefully in class. After dropping him off, she returned home.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; then in turn to Huakang First Kindergarten and Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School

name: Doing housework and receiving a call from the eldest son's homeroom teacher.
description: Back home, Ma Xiulan washed the breakfast dishes, wiped down the stove, mopped the living room and dining room, and took down the clothes dried on the balcony to fold. She kept thinking about school matters and kept an eye on her phone while working. Just after nine o'clock, the homeroom teacher, Ms. Han Mei, called and told her in detail that her eldest son Mingxuan had failed history and failed to hand in several assignments, her tone full of concern. Ma Xiulan forced herself to stay calm and immediately made an appointment with the teacher to meet at school at 1:30 p.m. After hanging up, she sat on the sofa alone for a while to recover, her emotions complicated.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Ask a neighbor to pick up the child and sort out the issues, have a simple lunch, and prepare to go out
description: After calming herself down, Ma Xiulan called her neighbor across the way, Wang Guilan, and asked her to pick up Mingzhe and Yuxin from school in the afternoon. Wang Guilan readily agreed. Then she went to the study, found Mingxuan's schoolbag and exercise books, and noted down all the missing assignments—such as the history workbook and Chinese excerpts—in a small notebook. Only after finishing all this did she feel hungry. She heated up a bowl of noodles with the leftover pork rib soup from yesterday, added some spinach, and ate simply. Then she went back to the bedroom, changed into a clean dark coat, put the notebook and pen into her canvas bag, and prepared for the afternoon trip to school.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Doing handicrafts and calming her mood
description: Feeling a bit unsettled, Ma Xiulan did not dare to do any fine work, so she took out the half-finished simple fabric hair flower and continued sewing. While working, she rehearsed in her mind how to ask questions and express her position during the afternoon talk with the teacher. After about an hour, she felt somewhat tired, leaned back on the sofa, drank a large glass of warm water, and closed her eyes to rest, gradually calming herself down and preparing for the upcoming face-to-face meeting with the teacher.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Go to the school for a face-to-face meeting with the homeroom teacher and return home to reflect
description: At 12:30, Ma Xiulan set out on foot ahead of time for Jinghai Experimental Middle School. The cold wind blew hard on the way, and she reviewed her talking points as she walked. She arrived at the school at 12:45 and sat waiting briefly in the first-floor lobby. At around 1:30 she went up to the second-floor office to meet with Teacher Han Mei. Teacher Han showed her Mingxuan's report card and homework records, pointing out problems such as his mind wandering in class, procrastination on history homework, and science experiments taking up too much study time. Ma Xiulan took careful notes, sincerely admitted that she had recently not been supervising her child's studies closely enough, and asked for ways to coordinate at home. Teacher Han suggested making a homework schedule and limiting experiment time. The forty-plus-minute conversation brightened her outlook considerably. After leaving the school gate, she did not hurry home. Instead, she walked slowly along Jingwen Road to reflect, recalling the teacher's words, examining whether her usual parenting style was too strict or lacked enough encouragement, and pondering how to communicate with Mingxuan. She did not get home until after 2 p.m.
location: Tianjin Jinghai Experimental Middle School, 5 Jianshe Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, then walked back to the home at 156 Jingwen Road.

name: Afternoon housework, drafting a communication outline, and picking up the children.
description: She got home around 2:30. Ma Xiulan thoroughly cleaned the kitchen, tidied up the toys and books scattered on the living room coffee table, and mopped the floors of both bedrooms. It was past 3 o'clock when she finished. Then she sat down, organized what she had discussed with Teacher Han, and, based on Mingxuan's situation, drafted the key points for the evening talk with her husband and children. At 4:30, she went to the neighbor Wang Guilan's house across the hall to pick up Mingzhe and Yuxin. After thanking her, she took the children home, urged Mingzhe to do his homework, and watched Yuxin play.
location: At home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and at the home of Wang Guilan, the neighbor across the hall.

name: Preparing dinner, having dinner with family, and helping her daughter with homework
description: Although troubled, Ma Xiulan still pulled herself together to cook for the family. She rinsed rice and cooked it, stir-fried shredded pork with preserved radish, made a pot of tomato and egg soup, and quickly stir-fried some baby bok choy. When the food was brought to the table, Mingzhe and Yuxin ate happily. When her eldest son Mingxuan came home from school, his eyes avoided hers. Ma Xiulan did not say much; she just filled a bowl of soup and told him to eat first. The family ate quietly. Her worries remained unresolved, so she took only a few bites and put down her chopsticks. After the meal she cleared and washed the dishes, then sat with Yuxin while she did her pinyin homework. Watching her write stroke by stroke with such earnestness, her heart finally relaxed a little.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Go out for an evening walk and confide in a neighbor
description: After settling the children, Ma Xiulan put on her thick down jacket and went out alone for some fresh air. As she walked along Jingwen Road to the small central square of the residential complex, she ran into Zhang Shufen, a neighbor who runs the Jingbai Supermarket, also out for a stroll. Seeing that she looked unwell, Zhang Shufen asked with concern. Ma Xiulan had been holding in her grievances all day and finally couldn't help pouring out Mingxuan's slipping grades and the teacher's warning. Zhang Shufen took her hand, sat down with her on a bench in the square, and patiently comforted her, saying that ups and downs during adolescence are normal, and that she shouldn't get too worked up and should take things slowly. The warm words reassured Ma Xiulan, and she headed home only after she felt better.
location: Community central square near 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Returned home, boiled water, waited for her husband to come back, and discussed countermeasures
description: After returning from the walk, Ma Xiulan boiled a pot of hot water, made herself a cup of tea, and also prepared one for her husband Ma Zhiqiang. She sat on the sofa and went over the notes and drafts from the afternoon conversation again. When Zhiqiang got home, she told him exactly what the teacher had reported and what her own thoughts were. Zhiqiang was silent for a moment, then said that scolding would not help; they needed to find a way. After serious discussion, they reached a consensus: no hitting, no scolding, communicate calmly with Mingxuan, and work together to make a plan that balances interests and schoolwork.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Had an in-depth talk with the eldest son and made a study plan; after reassuring the whole family, relaxed personally
description: After the couple made up their minds, they called Mingxuan into the study. Ma Xiulan first affirmed his enthusiasm for science experiments, then seriously pointed out the problems with his history grades and missing homework, emphasizing that completing homework is a student's duty. She presented the plan she had agreed on with her husband: make up all missing homework within a week, and every day he must finish his homework before doing experiments, for no more than one hour, with homework checked and signed by her. Mingxuan lowered his head and agreed. The three of them solemnly signed the plan and posted it next to the desk. After the talk, Ma Xiulan went to the kitchen to heat a glass of milk for Mingxuan and told him to rest early, and also urged Mingzhe and Yuxin to wash up. Only after all the children were in bed did she soak her feet in hot water in the bathroom for twenty minutes, and the day's physical and mental fatigue gradually eased.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pre-bedtime communication, checking doors and windows, and going to sleep
description: After soaking her feet, she lay down on the bed. Zhiqiang was still awake, so the two of them went over the day's events from beginning to end again. Both felt that plans matter most in execution, and their mood was much calmer than during the day. At 10:20 p.m., Ma Xiulan was still uneasy. She got up to check the doors, windows, and gas one more time, and only after confirming everything was fine did she return to the bedroom and turn off the lights to sleep. Though the stone in her heart had not fully settled, with a direction and her husband sharing the burden, she believed the family could keep moving forward.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning courtyard activities and breakfast preparation
description: The sky was overcast. Ma Xiulan woke up right at 05:30. She touched the Band-Aid on her left index finger from yesterday's vegetable cutting; it didn't hurt anymore, but she still needed to be careful. She got up quietly to avoid waking her sleeping husband Ma Zhiqiang, went to the bathroom, and washed her face with warm water, deliberately avoiding the wound. After washing up, she stepped into her own small courtyard. The air felt damp, promising rain. She walked slowly around the yard twice to loosen up, then did a set of Baduanjin exercises. Holding on to the old locust tree in the yard, she did 5 minutes of shoulder-and-neck stretching and 10 minutes of lower-back stretching, which eased the soreness from standing for a long time while fixing the faucet yesterday.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin — home courtyard and kitchen

name: Taking the two children to school.
description: Put on a helmet and mask, zipped up the fleece-lined jacket, rode the electric bike to first take my daughter Yuxin to Huakang First Kindergarten in Jinghai District, and watched her go inside. Then rode along Jinde Road and Shengli Avenue for about ten minutes, took my son Mingzhe to the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, and told him to listen carefully in class.
location: Departing from 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, passing Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten (No. 68 Jinde Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District), and ending at Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (No. 93 South Shengli Street)

name: Going home to tidy up and take a short break
description: After dropping off the kids and returning home, I felt a little tired. I washed the dishes and chopsticks the kids had used, folded the clothes collected last night, and simply mopped the floor. After finishing, I sat on the living room sofa to rest and drank some hot water to relieve the discomfort.
location: Living room and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Going out to buy groceries and picking up medicine for her father
description: She rode her e-bike along Jingwen Road, turned onto Chaoyang Road, and went to the Wutong Commune vegetable market. At Elder Sister Sun Guifang's stall she bought soft tofu and a bunch of greens. Sister Sun noticed that she looked pale and said a few caring words. Then she returned to Jingwen Road and went to the community clinic to pick up blood pressure medicine for her father Ma Jianguo. Doctor Wang said his blood pressure was well controlled, he just needed to take the medicine on time, and the next follow-up was on December 19. After returning home, she put the medicine in the living room medicine cabinet and recorded the next pickup date on the small note on the wall calendar so she wouldn't forget.
location: Starting from 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to the Wutong Commune vegetable market (ground-floor shops of Wutong Commune on the west side of Chaoyang Road, Jinghai District), then to the community clinic near the intersection of Jingwen Road and Shengli Street, and finally back home.

name: Doing housework and preparing lunch in advance.
description: She trimmed and washed the greens bought from the vegetable market, and soaked the tofu in clean water for later. She started the washing machine to clean the dirty clothes taken off last night. Taking advantage of the time while the washing machine ran, she got out her sewing kit and sewed back on the button that had fallen off her daughter Yuxin's school uniform.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Simple lunch and rest.
description: Alone, I paired the leftover millet porridge from the morning with a hot noodle soup made with freshly bought greens, added an egg, and after the simple meal I felt a little warmer. My cold symptoms worsened, with more nasal discharge; I took cold medicine and lay down in the bedroom for half an hour to restore my energy.
location: Home kitchen and bedroom at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Preparing the study room and practicing Excel.
description: After the noon break, her spirits improved. She went to the study, found her son Mingxuan's history exercise book and reference books, and placed them on the desk. She also charged her phone so she could contact Teacher Han. Then she opened her husband's old laptop and reviewed the Excel knowledge she would need for the evening computer class, practicing data entry and sum formulas. Though she still felt a little dizzy, she managed to recall it after all.
location: Study at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the two children from school.
description: Turn off the computer in advance, put on a heavy coat, bring a mask and the e-bike key, and tell the neighbor across the hall, Wang Guilan, that if I feel unwell, she could help look after the children. At 2 p.m., ride the e-bike to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten first to pick up my daughter Yuxin, then go to the gate of No. 3 Primary School to wait for my son Mingzhe to get out of school. After getting home, have Yuxin play with building blocks in the living room and let Mingzhe do his math homework first in his own room.
location: Starting from No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten (No. 68 Jinde Road, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District), via Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (No. 93 Shengli South Street), and then returning home.

name: Urge Mingxuan to catch up on his history homework and contact the teacher
description: After her son Mingxuan came home by bus, she called him into the study and, in a firm but gentle voice, asked him to keep his promise to Teacher Han and make up the history homework outline. She sat nearby watching him open his textbooks and workbook and start planning. During this time, she used her phone to take a photo of his draft and sent it to Teacher Han for direction. Teacher Han quickly replied that the approach was feasible and encouraged him to keep going. When she relayed the teacher's encouragement to Mingxuan, his brow relaxed a little.
location: Study at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare the family dinner and take a rest before the meal
description: Seeing Mingxuan get into the rhythm of studying, she began preparing dinner. Thinking that a cold calls for light food, she steamed rice, steamed sea bass, stir-fried garlic broccoli, and made tomato and egg soup. After cooking, she covered the dishes to keep them warm. Feeling severely congested and chilled, she rested on the sofa for a while and drank some hot water.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner and husband tutoring the children
description: Her husband Ma Zhiqiang got off work earlier today and was just in time for dinner. The family sat around the dining table to have dinner together. Although she had no appetite, she ate some fish and greens to set an example for the children. After dinner, she told her husband she wasn't feeling well and asked him to tutor their son Mingzhe through the five error-prone math problems assigned by the teacher. Zhiqiang readily agreed and began explaining them to Mingzhe in the living room.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tidied up the house and walked to class
description: She let her husband and sons continue studying, quickly washed the dishes and chopsticks, then went back to the bedroom to change into a clean, warm sweater, took her notebook, reading glasses, and thermos, wrapped her coat tightly, and walked a few minutes in the cool evening breeze to the Jingwen Road Community Party-Mass Service Center, ready to attend computer training.
location: Starting from 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, walk to the Jingwen Road Community Party-Mass Service Center (east side of the intersection of Jingwen Road and Zhenhua Road, Jinghai District).

name: Computer training and post-class discussion, then went home.
description: Arrived on time at the activity room on the second floor of the Party and Community Service Center and sat in a familiar seat. In class, she learned to use Excel to create a family account book, including subtotals and inserting charts. Wearing reading glasses, she listened and took notes; when she encountered unclear points (such as setting cell format), she raised her hand to ask the teacher. Although feeling a bit dizzy, she persisted through the whole session and took detailed notes. After class, she also asked a young trainee nearby to demonstrate the steps she hadn't understood, and only went home slowly after feeling she had mastered them.
location: Activity room on the second floor of the Jingwen Road Community Party-Masses Service Center (east side of the intersection of Jingwen Road and Zhenhua Road, Jinghai District), then returned home to No. 156 Jingwen Road

name: Soaking feet to ward off cold and drinking ginger soup
description: After returning home, the chills felt worse, so I immediately boiled water, sliced ginger, and grabbed mugwort leaves to soak my feet. Once the hot water covered my ankles, the cold gradually dispersed and my nose cleared up a bit. At the same time, I heated up the ginger soup prepared earlier and drank a large bowl, feeling much more comfortable.
location: Living room and bathroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Check the children's homework and bedtime routine
description: After soaking her feet, she felt better. She first went to the study to review the draft history outline Mingxuan had completed, praised him for his clear thinking, and told him to make a clean copy the next day. Then she went to the living room and saw that her husband had already finished tutoring Mingzhe in math, so she told Mingzhe to go wash up. Finally, she went to her daughter's room, where Yuxin had already undressed and gotten into bed. She tucked her in and kissed her forehead. After everything was settled, she turned off the light, left the night light on, and went to bed to rest. Although her nose was still stuffy, she felt at ease and soon fell asleep.
location: Various rooms of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Light activity on the balcony in the early morning
description: Before dawn, Ma Xiulan put on a thick cotton-padded jacket and did light exercise on her balcony. She first stood on tiptoe and moved her arms and legs, then slowly completed a full set of Baduanjin. Although her cold had not fully healed and she still felt congested with a dry throat, after exercising the soreness and heaviness in her shoulders and lower back eased, and her energy and spirits improved.
