location: Home balcony at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare breakfast and wake up the family
description: After morning exercise, Ma Xiulan cooked millet porridge, reheated multigrain steamed buns, and fried eggs in the kitchen. Then she woke her husband Ma Zhiqiang and the children. Her husband helped dress their young daughter Yuxin. The family sat around the table and finished breakfast together with their own pickled vegetables.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Take the second son and youngest daughter to school.
description: Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to take the children to school. Yuxin sat on the front footboard, Mingzhe carried his backpack on the back seat, and both wore hats and masks. She first took Yuxin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, watched the teacher lead her inside, then hurried to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to take Mingzhe, told him to listen carefully in class, and only felt relieved after watching him run into the school gate.
location: Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten: Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School: Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tidying up housework, picking up medication at the community, and preparing the persimmon tree for cold weather
description: After dropping off the children, Ma Xiulan went home and quickly washed the dishes and wiped down the stove. Remembering that her father's blood pressure medication needed to be picked up, she rode her e-bike to the Jingwen Road Community Clinic to get it from Dr. Wang. Dr. Wang kindly reminded her to keep warm since she had a cold. Back home, she went to the storage room, carried out old cloth strips, hemp rope, and straw, and moved them beside the persimmon tree to prepare for the cold weather.
location: Home: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Community clinic: backyard of Jinghai Grain Bureau, No. 16 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (west of the Justice Bureau, diagonally opposite China Construction Bank).

name: Put cold-protection coverings on the persimmon tree
description: Ma Xiulan first swept up the fallen leaves and dead branches around the tree roots, then tightly wrapped old cloth strips around the trunk from the bottom upward to the fork, and finally piled straw around the roots and pressed it down with bricks. During the work, the cold wind made her cough; she stopped to drink some warm water and, after recovering, continued until she finished.
location: Home courtyard at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Take photos for records, contact friends, and organize the pickled vegetable accounts.
description: After finishing the cold-protection measures, Ma Xiulan took a photo of the persimmon tree and sent it to the family group chat and her good friend Aunt Wu. She sent a voice message to her childhood friend Liu Chunmei to arrange a time to meet. Then she put on her reading glasses and checked this year's sales ledger for the pickled vegetables: a total of 56 jars, with income of 1,680 yuan, exact to the last cent. She also tidied up the living room, did a quick sweep, and soaked the pork ribs she planned to stew at noon in water to remove the blood.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Settling the pickled vegetable payment with a childhood friend and family financial planning
description: Liu Chunmei came with a jar of pickled cabbage and transferred the full year's pickled vegetable sales proceeds of 1,680 yuan to Ma Xiulan via WeChat. Ma Xiulan recorded the settlement in her account book. After seeing Chunmei off, she logged into mobile banking and transferred 900 yuan from that amount to her eldest son's education savings account, bringing the balance to 3,500 yuan; she also set aside 200 yuan for better meals.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Lunch and cold medication.
description: At noon Ma Xiulan was home alone, so she simply reheated leftover steamed buns and stir-fried spinach, with a bowl of egg drop soup for lunch. After the meal, she took cold granules to relieve her persistent symptoms.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Went to Wutong Commune Market to buy ingredients
description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan rode her electric bicycle to the Wutong Commune vegetable market and bought pork ribs suitable for soup, sugar tangerines, and apples from the stall owner Sun Guifang. Sister Sun noticed she didn't look well, told her to rest more, and gave her some spring onions. Ma Xiulan paid via WeChat and went home.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market at the intersection of Jingwen Road and Wutong Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Midday nap
description: After returning home from shopping, Ma Xiulan put the pork ribs in the refrigerator and washed the fruit. Feeling very tired, she lay down in the bedroom with her eyes closed to rest for about 40 minutes. Although she didn't fall completely asleep, after resting, her cough eased and the heaviness in her body was relieved.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Cook pork ribs and review the computer course
description: Ma Xiulan began braising pork ribs, going through steps such as blanching, stir-frying, adding seasonings, and simmering. At the same time, she took out her computer class homework notebook, reviewed Excel knowledge, and pondered how to use the SUM formula to categorize and record the accounts for pickled vegetables. When a cough interrupted her thoughts, she drank some water and wrote down the easily forgotten steps on paper.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Picking up her second son and daughter from school
description: At 4 p.m., Ma Xiulan turned off the stove, rode her electric bike to Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up Yuxin. Yuxin ran over and said the teacher praised her painting; then she hurried to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up Mingzhe. The three of them chatted and laughed all the way home.
location: Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten: Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School: Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Supervise children's homework and prepare dinner
description: After arriving home, Ma Xiulan arranged for Mingzhe and Yuxin to do their homework at the living room tea table while she chopped scallions and cilantro and washed spinach. The aroma of spare ribs filled the room; Yuxin, tempted, asked when dinner would be ready, and Ma Xiulan told her to finish writing neatly first. In the evening, her eldest son Mingxuan came home from school and reported that he had finished making up the history outline. Ma Xiulan told him to wash his hands and get ready for dinner.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The entire family enjoys dinner.
description: At 6 p.m., her husband Ma Zhiqiang arrived home, and the family sat down for dinner. The dishes were braised pork ribs and stir-fried spinach, with steamed white rice as the staple. Ma Xiulan placed ribs on everyone's plate; Zhiqiang praised the stew as authentic, and Yuxin, copying her father, said her mother's cooking was the best. The atmosphere at the table was warm.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Husband washed the dishes; Ma Xiulan soaked her feet and took medicine
description: After the meal, her husband took the initiative to clear the dishes and let Ma Xiulan rest. She boiled water, poured it into the foot basin, added mugwort to soak her feet, and took cold granules at the same time. In the rising steam, her stuffy nose eased and her body felt comfortable.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Family evening leisure and sweater knitting
description: The family was active in the living room: her husband checked Mingzhe and Mingxuan's homework, and the two brothers, unusually, did not bicker; Yuxin watched cartoons. Ma Xiulan sat nearby knitting a sweater, occasionally joining in, enjoying the plain and warm family time.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Get the children washed up and ready for bed
description: Ma Xiulan urged the children to wash up, helped Mingzhe brush his teeth, and helped Yuxin wash her face and feet. Then she and her husband took turns washing up. She took out the sweater she would wear the next day and placed the cold medicine by the bed. The family went to bed at 9:30 p.m. Ma Xiulan reviewed the whole day, feeling tired but content, and hoped the cold would get better.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Wake up, exercise, prepare breakfast, and take medication.
description: Woke up at 5:55 in the morning and felt her throat was more comfortable than the past few days. She first stretched her neck and shoulders beside the bed in the bedroom, then slowly practiced a simplified version of Baduanjin in the living room while wearing warm pajamas, keeping the movements small to avoid aggravating her cough. Finally she did back and waist stretches on the floor. After washing up, she went into the kitchen, cooked millet porridge with the soaked millet, steamed steamed buns, and made two egg pancakes with less oil. While the porridge was cooking, she took her morning cold medicine with warm water and felt her throat improving.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Woke up the children and helped them eat breakfast
description: At exactly seven o'clock, she gently woke her daughter Yuxin and helped her put on her coat, then urged her second son Zhezhe, who was still lying in bed, to get up. Her husband Zhiqiang helped get the children washed up and seated at the table. The family sat around eating breakfast. Ma Xiulan reminded Zhezhe to focus on his meal and added more porridge for Yuxin. The atmosphere was warm.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Take the children to school.
description: She put on a thick coat and a helmet, and rode the electric bike in the cold drizzle. She first took her daughter Yuxin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten on Jianshe Road, and watched her run into the kindergarten gate with her backpack. Then she turned the bike around and took her second son, Zhezhe, to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School on Shengli South Street, telling him to listen carefully in class.
location: Huakang First Kindergarten, No. 88 Jianshe Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, No. 29 Shengli South Street

name: Doing housework and shopping for ingredients
description: After dropping off the child and returning home, quickly cleared the dining table, soaked the dishes and chopsticks in the sink, and found the vegetable basket and umbrella. Walked to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, bought yellow-fleshed potatoes, eggs, and fresh tender greens at the stall of Sister Sun Guifang, a regular vendor. Sister Sun asked with concern whether the cold had recovered, and the two chatted for a while. After returning home, stored the ingredients by category, sat on the sofa, drank hot water, and rested.
location: Wutong Commune vegetable market at the southeast corner of the intersection of Shengli Street and Diwei Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Check eldest son's homework and discuss dinner with husband
description: She contacts her eldest son Mingxuan via WeChat and asks him to send photos of his makeup history homework. After carefully checking it, she praises the neat handwriting and rich content, and promises to have his father make his favorite sweet-and-sour pork tenderloin as a reward. Then she walks to the living room and discusses the dinner plan with her husband Zhiqiang, who is repairing a stool. Because she has a cold and is sensitive to cooking fumes, she asks him to cook the sweet-and-sour pork tenderloin, and he readily agrees.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Do handicrafts, mend clothes, and call my parents
description: On the balcony, she put on her reading glasses and used scrap checkered fabric to make simple hair flower prototypes with overlock stitching, drinking warm water several times to relieve her dry throat. After finishing the handicraft, she found the unstitched pocket on her daughter Yuxin's pants and neatly sewed it up with matching thread. Later, she called her mother Li Xiuying, telling her not to go out in the cold and to keep warm, and reminding her father to take his blood pressure medicine on time. Her mother also asked about her cold, and they chatted about everyday matters for more than ten minutes.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up her youngest daughter from school and prepare lunch
description: Rode the electric bike to Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up the bouncing Yuxin. On the way, her daughter happily told stories about kindergarten. After getting home, she cooked a pot of light noodle soup, poached an egg in it, and added the greens she had bought in the morning. Mother and daughter each had a bowl at the dining table. After the meal, she took her afternoon cold medicine with warm water.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Soothe daughter to sleep for a nap and rest
description: Told Yuxin a short story, and after seeing her breathing evenly and falling asleep, quietly left the bedroom. Feeling tired from a cold and the morning's exertion, she leaned back on the living room sofa and rested with her eyes closed for about forty minutes, briefly recovering her energy.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Take daughter to kindergarten, buy pork tenderloin, tidy up the house, and video-call my younger sister.
description: After waking from her nap, she woke Yuxin, put on her coat, and took her to kindergarten. On the way, she stopped again at Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, quickly bought fresh pork tenderloin and a small bottle of cooking wine, and went home. She put the meat and cooking wine in the refrigerator, then began tidying the living room and neatly arranged more than a dozen cloth hair flowers she had made earlier on the coffee table by color and style. At 3 p.m., her younger sister Ma Xiufen video-called. Ma Xiulan showed her the hair flower works and received her sister's praise. The two also chatted about the children's studies and family matters, feeling happy.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing dinner ingredients and picking up the children from school.
description: After the video call ended, she went into the kitchen to prepare dinner: peeled and sliced potatoes and soaked them in water, trimmed and washed greens, and cut the thawed pork tenderloin into strips for later use. At exactly 4 o'clock, she set off on her electric bike, first going to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up Zhezhe, who had just finished school, then turning to Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up Yuxin. On the way home, the two children chattered away sharing what happened at school. Ma Xiulan felt tired but at peace inside.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Urging the second son to do his homework
description: Letting Yuxin play by herself, Ma Xiulan moved a chair over to sit next to her second son Zhezhe and supervised him while he completed his math and Chinese homework. After ten minutes of writing, Zhezhe couldn't sit still and kept asking for water and going to the bathroom. She patiently encouraged him, using a method of letting him rest five minutes after every few problems, and finally got him to basically complete that day's homework.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner and after-dinner cleanup
description: Her husband, Ma Zhiqiang, tied on an apron and took over cooking. He marinated pork tenderloin and made sweet-and-sour sauce, while Ma Xiulan handed him scallions, ginger, and garlic, beat eggs, and wiped the counter. The kitchen filled with fragrance. At six o'clock, the eldest son Mingxuan came home from tutoring, and the family sat together to enjoy sweet-and-sour pork tenderloin, stir-fried potato shreds, and vegetable egg-drop soup. Ma Xiulan served extra food to Mingxuan to reward his progress in homework, and Zhiqiang also praised Zhe-Zhe for finishing homework quickly. The dinner atmosphere was harmonious. After the meal, her husband voluntarily cleared the table and washed the dishes, while Ma Xiulan sat on the sofa drinking hot water and going over her computer course notes to prepare for the evening class.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Taking a community computer training class
description: Walked to the computer room on the second floor of the Jingwen Road Community Party-Mass Service Center for a training class. Teacher Zhou explained data entry techniques, quick fill sequences, and data validation functions. Ma Xiulan, wearing reading glasses, listened attentively and practiced on the computer. When she had difficulty with the data validation drop-down menu, Teacher Zhou guided her step by step until she mastered it. After class, she saved the practice file and walked home in the night wind.
location: Jingwen Road Community Party-Mass Service Center, No. 58 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Practice Excel after class and record questions.
description: After returning home, she drank a large glass of hot water, turned on the computer in the study, and created a new Excel daily ledger based on her accounting notebook. She tried using the quick-fill sequence to generate the date column and data validation to create a drop-down menu for expense categories. While practicing, incorrect cell formatting caused garbled characters. After repeated trial and error she found the cause and immediately wrote it down in her notebook. She practiced for nearly an hour and did not save and close the file until her fingers were sore.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Washing up, soaking feet, and preparing for bed.
description: After closing the computer, she soaked her feet in the boiled mugwort and ginger water, listening to a storytelling program on her phone to relax while soaking. After soaking, she brushed her teeth, washed her face, and applied skincare. She changed into clean pajamas, lay down in bed, and habitually went through the next day's plan in her mind. After confirming there was no omission, she dimmed the lights and soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Early morning restorative exercise
description: I woke up promptly at six in the morning and felt that the heavy sensation from the cold had completely disappeared, leaving my body and mind light. I put on a padded coat and went to the courtyard, briskly walking for 10 minutes to feel the crisp winter air and breathe freely. Then I seriously practiced a set of Baduanjin, along with shoulder, neck, and lower back stretches, trying to do every movement as correctly as possible, loosening up the muscles and joints that had been stiff for several days because of the cold. After exercising, I felt refreshed and felt that my body had fully recovered.
location: Courtyard, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Early morning washing up and preparations.
description: After finishing the exercise, she went back inside to wash up with warm water and changed into clean loungewear. Then she went to the kitchen, boiled a pot of hot water, and prepared to start the day's housework.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China, bathroom and kitchen

name: Prepare breakfast for the whole family and communicate with her husband
description: She tied on an apron and started making breakfast. Knowing that her husband Zhiqiang had just returned from a truck run yesterday, she deliberately cooked a pot of hot millet porridge, heated up steamed buns, and cut a plate of home-pickled vegetables and ham sausage. Zhiqiang heard the noise and got up too. The two of them worked while discussing the most important task of the day — cleaning the dozen or so large earthenware jars that would be used for making autumn pickled vegetables. Zhiqiang took the initiative to take on the heavy work of moving the heavy jars.
location: Kitchen, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Wake the children and have breakfast together
description: When breakfast was almost ready, Xiulan went upstairs to call the children to get up. The eldest son Mingxuan had already gotten up by himself and was sitting at his desk reading; the second son Mingzhe was still lying in bed, muttering that he wanted to sleep more on the weekend; the youngest daughter Yuxin heard her mother's voice, rubbed her eyes, and sat up on her own. The family of five sat around the dining table, quietly eating breakfast. Zhiqiang asked Mingxuan about his midterm exams while drinking porridge, and the atmosphere was harmonious.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China; bedroom and living room

name: In the morning, cleaned the pickle jars with her husband and tidied the courtyard
description: After breakfast, the children went off to play. Xiulan and Zhiqiang changed into old clothes, put on rubber gloves, and officially started cleaning the pickled vegetable jars in the yard. Zhiqiang carried the heavy clay jars one by one to the tap, while Xiulan carefully scrubbed the insides with a long-handled brush, chatting as they worked. Zhiqiang mentioned that on this trip he had brought a jar of the pickled vegetables from last time for someone along the way, and they praised the taste. He suggested buying more vegetables next year and pickling more, perhaps making it a proper business. Xiulan felt warm inside and responded with a smile. After nearly three hours, they finally washed more than a dozen jars clean and turned them upside down on a bench against the wall to drain and dry. Then she tidied up the clutter that had been blown around the yard by the wind and swept the ground clean with a broom.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China - courtyard, storage room

name: Preparing lunch
description: After washing the jars, Xiulan gave them a quick rinse, then tied on her apron and began preparing lunch. Since Zhiqiang was home today, she made a more abundant lunch. She quickly washed and cut the vegetables, planning to make scrambled eggs with tomatoes, vinegar-sautéed cabbage, and stew the piece of pork belly bought yesterday, so the family could enjoy a lively lunch together.
location: Kitchen, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: The family of five had lunch and settled the youngest daughter down for a nap.
description: The food was served and the family sat together for lunch. Zhiqiang kept praising Xiulan's cooking, while Mingzhe and Yuxin competed for the braised pork. After the meal, Xiulan coaxed her younger daughter Yuxin into bed for a nap, told her a little story, and stayed until she fell asleep peacefully.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China: kitchen and bedroom

name: Brief rest and tidying up.
description: After coaxing the children to sleep, Xiulan also felt a bit tired, so she sat on the living room sofa and rested for half an hour, drank a glass of warm water, and browsed messages in the community handicraft group on her phone. Seeing her neighbor Wang Guilan showing off her newly made pickled radish in the group, she thought she should give a nice return gift in the afternoon.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China, living room

name: In the afternoon, tutored the eldest and second sons in their studies and practiced Excel on her own
description: After resting, Xiulan perked up. First, she checked the progress of Mingxuan's make-up homework and found that one assignment remained. She took out the schedule and calmly discussed with Mingxuan how to rearrange the time for extracurricular experiments. After some discussion, they reached an agreement: 2 hours concentrated on weekends, 30 minutes each day on weekdays, and she had him post the new schedule on the refrigerator. Next, she called Mingzhe over and had him redo the several math problems he had gotten wrong last week, and she copied five additional problems of the same type for him to practice. Meanwhile, she practiced Excel by following an online tutorial, working on the data entry and formatting she had learned earlier.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China, living room and study

name: Preparing Pickled Vegetables to Welcome the Neighbors
description: Seeing that it was about time, Xiulan put down the computer for now. She remembered that Sister Wang Guilan was coming over in the evening, so she went to the kitchen, carefully scooped a few pieces of well-pickled cucumbers and radishes from her largest pickle jar, put them in a clean glass bowl, and prepared to give them to Sister Wang later as a return gift.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China; kitchen and living room

name: Exchanging pickled vegetables and chatting with neighbor Wang Guilan in the evening
description: At five o'clock, the doorbell rang. Wang Guilan came over carrying a small basin of freshly pickled crispy radishes. Xiulan quickly took it and handed her the bowl of prepared pickled vegetables in return. The two exchanged a few polite words at the door, and then Xiulan invited her into the living room to sit and chat. When Wang Guilan heard that Xiulan's family was adjusting Mingxuan's study schedule, she comforted her as someone who had been through it: “Children's studies all have ups and downs; don't be too anxious.” Xiulan nodded again and again, feeling warm inside. They chatted for nearly an hour before Wang Guilan got up and left.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China: entrance and living room

name: Cook dinner and have dinner with the family
description: After seeing off Wang Guilan, Xiulan hurried into the kitchen to prepare dinner. Dinner was simple: she reheated the leftovers from lunch and cooked a pot of noodles. Zhiqiang helped bring the dishes to the table and serve the rice. After the family finished dinner, Xiulan cleared the dishes while Zhiqiang watched TV with the children in the living room.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China; kitchen and living room

name: In the evening, systematically reviewed the computer course and created a simulated bookkeeping sheet.
description: After the meal, Xiulan settled her husband and children, then went to the small study where she usually did handicrafts and opened the notebook from the community computer class. She reviewed all the Excel content she had learned that week from beginning to end, focusing on the difficult points of data entry and formatting. After confirming she understood it all, she opened Excel on the computer and, following the steps the teacher had taught, independently created a mock family bookkeeping table with five headers: 'Date', 'Item', 'Income', 'Expense', and 'Balance'. She practiced it several times; once she was sure every step was smooth and error-free, she smiled with satisfaction, feeling a great sense of achievement.
location: Study, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Soaking feet before bed and reviewing cold recovery
date: After dropping off the children, Ma Xiulan went to the Wutong Community vegetable market and, at Sun Guifang's stall, picked out two crucian carp, tender tofu, cilantro, and red pointed peppers, and chatted about the spiciness of the pointed peppers. Then she went to the nearby Jingbai Supermarket to buy soy sauce, laundry detergent, and yeast powder.
description: After reviewing the computer course, Xiulan felt a little sleepy. She went to the bathroom, drew a basin of hot water, and comfortably soaked her feet. While soaking her feet, she chatted with Zhiqiang about the day's events, sighed that she had finally gotten through the cold, and decided that from now on, as soon as the weather turns cold, she would add clothing early and not be careless again.
location: Bedroom, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Washing up before bed and chatting with her husband
description: After soaking her feet, Xiulan went to wash up and changed into her pajamas. When she returned to the bedroom, Zhiqiang was still awake. The two leaned against the headboard and chatted for a while about the children and the pickle jars. Xiulan felt completely at ease.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China: bathroom, bedroom

name: Bedtime checks and lying down to rest.
description: Before bed, she went to check on each of the children, tucked Yuxin in, and checked that the front door and windows were locked. Back in the bedroom, she turned off the light and lay down. Xiulan thought back over the fulfilling day — from the morning exercise, the couple working together to scrub the jars, tutoring the children, and neighborly warmth, to completing her computer study independently — and felt especially satisfied.
location: Bedroom and hallway, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Turned off the lights and went to sleep
description: With this genuine sense of accomplishment, she soon drifted off to sleep.
location: Bedroom, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Morning exercise and household preparations
description: Got up at 5:50 on time, laid out the mat on the living room floor, and began practicing Baduanjin, with gentle movements and even breathing. After finishing one set, I still felt a bit stiff in the shoulders, so I did about 5 minutes of neck and shoulder stretches. Then I went to the kitchen, poured the soybeans and red dates that had been soaked last night into the soy milk maker, and set the timer. I took out the steamed pork buns made yesterday from the fridge and put them in the steamer to heat up. Taking advantage of this gap, I mopped the living room and bedroom floors.
location: Living room and kitchen of home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Tidying up attire and preparing red envelopes
description: At 6:20, her husband Ma Zhiqiang got up to get ready to drive to Tanggu. Ma Xiulan poured him hot water and told him to be careful. After seeing him off, she changed into a handmade blue Chinese-style top with knotted buttons and combed her hair. Then she urged the three children to get up and put on the clean clothes she had prepared in advance. While the children were washing up, she counted out six hundred yuan from the piggy bank on the nightstand, carefully put it into a red envelope, and silently wished her nephew well. Then she placed the small shoulder bag with the red envelope on the shoe cabinet and put the children's water bottles and tissues into it.
location: Bedroom and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family breakfast and reminders
description: The family sat around the dining table eating breakfast, drinking soy milk and eating meat baozi. Ma Xiulan reminded the children again to behave at the wedding, greet elders and say congratulations, especially telling her second son Mingzhe to stay still and not run around. The children all agreed, and her youngest daughter Yuxin obediently said she understood.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Took a taxi to the wedding venue.
description: After checking the doors, windows, and gas at 8:20, I left the house with the three children, hailed a taxi at the neighborhood gate, and headed to Xinyuan Grand Hotel on Shengli Street. On the way, I replied on WeChat to Sister Wang Guilan's invitation, told her I couldn't go to the market, and told the children to sit properly in the car.
location: In a taxi from 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to Xinyuan Grand Hotel, 88 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Arrive at the restaurant to deliver the cash gift.
description: Arriving at Xinyuan Hotel around 9 o'clock, she led the children into the first-floor lobby. At the gift registry table, she greeted her second uncle who was recording the gifts, handed him the red envelope with both hands, and her second uncle recorded it and gave back wedding candies. She told the children to call him "Great-Uncle" and then entered the banquet hall to find seats.
location: First-floor lobby of Xinyuan Hotel, No. 88 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Attend the wedding ceremony and banquet
description: The wedding officially started at 10 o'clock. The master of ceremonies presided, and the bride and groom exchanged rings. Ma Xiulan was moved to tears seeing her nephew get married. After the banquet began, she had her eldest son, Mingxuan, watch over his younger siblings, while she took a drink and chatted with her cousins Liu Hongmei and Zhang Xiuying and others. Her older cousin praised the handcrafted clothes with knotted buttons, and her younger cousin confided about how hard it was to raise children. Ma Xiulan shared her experience with handicrafts and learning to keep accounts on the computer, and took photos of the lace details on the clothes with her phone, planning to copy them at home. While chatting during the meal, she kept an eye on the children.
location: Banquet hall on the second floor of Xinyuan Hotel, 88 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Helping set the table and serve dishes.
description: After a few rounds of drinks, the dishes were coming out more slowly. Ma Xiulan voluntarily went to the prep table in the back kitchen to help. She carefully carried dishes such as steamed fish to the tables, cleared away empty plates, and set out new dishes. An uncle praised her for being diligent, and she smiled and said that they were all family.
location: The back kitchen and corridor of the banquet hall at Xinyuan Grand Hotel, 88 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: End of the wedding and farewells
description: After the banquet ended, holding Yu Xin's hand and leading the sons, she said goodbye to the elders. She and her older female cousin created a WeChat group named "Jinghai Sisters" and added several close female cousins. She had the children say goodbye to their grandparents and other relatives, exchanged a few pleasantries, and then left the restaurant.
location: At the entrance of the lobby of Xinyuan Hotel, No. 88 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Take a taxi home
description: Hailed a taxi at the restaurant entrance to go home. The children were somewhat sleepy, and Yuxin dozed off leaning against her mother. Ma Xiulan discussed homework arrangements with her eldest son Mingxuan and asked her second son to change out of his new clothes once home. The car was quiet, with only the sound of the wind outside the window.
location: In the taxi from Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to 156 Jingwen Road

name: Returning home, settling in, and recording the favor ledger
description: After arriving home, she first had Mingxuan and Mingzhe go to the study to do their homework, and told Yuxin stories to help her fall asleep. Then she sat on the living room sofa, took out the account book, and recorded, 'November 23, 2025, Sunday, sunny. My nephew Ma Ming'an's wedding, gift money 600 yuan. Return gift: a box of wedding candy.' After that, she sorted the dishes she had brought back and put them in the refrigerator by category, then scrubbed the disposable slippers clean and hung them to dry.
location: Living room and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing a simple dinner and doing household chores.
description: Because lunch was too filling, for dinner she simply cooked plain congee in a clay pot and cut a plate of pickled vegetables brought back from the restaurant. At the same time, she took down the clothes dried on the balcony, folded them, and put them in each person's wardrobe. Her second son Mingzhe cried that he was hungry, so she gave him a bowl of congee first.
location: Kitchen and balcony in the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Helping with homework and family dinner
description: For dinner, they had porridge with pickled vegetables. After the meal, she checked Mingxuan's and Mingzhe's homework. Mingxuan got two math word problems wrong; she asked him to redo them and reminded him to read the questions carefully. Mingzhe was praised for his neat handwriting. She drew a small flower in her daughter Yuxin's drawing book, and Yuxin clapped her hands happily. Then she cleared the dinner table.
location: Dining room and study at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Summarize computer course content
description: In the study, she turned on the computer and practiced recording the day's expenses in Excel, including gift money, taxi fare, and pocket change for snacks. When she tried to drag the formula to calculate the total gift money, the formula couldn't auto-fill because of merged cells. After several attempts, she identified the problem. She wrote in her notebook, 'After merging cells, function calculations get confused; you need to unmerge or adjust the reference method,' and resolved to understand it so she could keep the family accounts in the future. The study lasted until 9:30.
location: Study at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Soaking feet and resting before bed.
description: She put away her computer, helped the three children wash up, and hurried them off to bed. Then she carried hot water to the bedroom and soaked her feet beside the bed, recalling the lively scenes of relatives at the wedding and her conversations with her sisters, and felt happy. She sent a good-night message in the “Jinghai Sisters” group and also sent her mother a message to say hello. After drying her feet, she turned off the light and went to rest.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning wake-up and breakfast preparation
description: The alarm went off on time. Although Ma Xiulan was still a little tired from attending the wedding yesterday, she got up right away. After a quick wash, she went into the kitchen, put on an apron, and, since the weather had turned cooler, quickly made soft egg pancakes, sliced pickled vegetables, and reheated the small steamed buns and leftover porridge packed up from the wedding the day before.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The children get up and have breakfast
description: Ma Xiulan went upstairs and woke the three children. Her eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, got up and washed up on his own; her second son, Ma Mingzhe, only got up after whining and grumbling; her youngest daughter, Ma Yuxin, stayed in bed and wanted her mother to hold her. At the breakfast table, Ma Xiulan divided up the food and reminded the children to put on extra clothes because of the cold. Ma Mingzhe complained that the porridge didn't taste good, and Ma Xiulan slipped him a piece of egg pancake, and he quieted down. Ma Yuxin obediently ate by herself, while Ma Mingxuan ate silently and went back to his room to pack his schoolbag.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Took the second son and daughter to school.
description: Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike, first taking Ma Mingzhe to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School and telling him not to run around wildly during recess; then she took Ma Yuxin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, briefly exchanged a few words with the teacher at the gate about the child, and returned home.
location: From No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School on Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, then to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, and finally back home.

name: Morning exercise
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan first brisk-walked for about ten minutes on the garden path to get her legs moving. Then she went inside and practiced a full set of Baduanjin in the living room; she felt her muscles and bones loosen up and became much more energized.
location: Home courtyard and living room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning housework and cleaning
description: Ma Xiulan began tidying up the house, sorting the changed clothes and school uniforms into the washing machine; wiping down the living room coffee table and TV cabinet, mopping the dining room and kitchen floors; noticing her eldest son's desk was a bit messy, she tidied it up for him.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Answered the community invitation call and shared the joy with her mother
description: While she was folding clothes, Xiao Liu from the neighborhood committee called and invited Ma Xiulan to attend next month's handicraft salon to showcase embroidery and fabric art. Ma Xiulan excitedly agreed and wrote down the event details. Afterwards, she called her mother Li Xiuying, sharing the joy of the wedding experiences and the community invitation, and the mother and daughter chatted for more than twenty minutes.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Housework, lunch preparation, and asking a neighbor about how to make frog buttons.
description: Ma Xiulan quickly finished hanging the laundry and gathered the cardboard delivery boxes. She didn't plan to cook at noon, so she put the leftovers from the wedding, such as braised pork and four-joy meatballs, on plates to heat up. Before going out, she knocked on the door of Wang Guilan, who lives across the hall, to ask about the technique for the new frog-button pattern she had seen at yesterday's wedding. Sister Wang warmly provided the pattern and made an appointment to discuss it further in the afternoon.
location: The home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and the neighbor's house across the street.

name: Lunch, midday rest, and preparing craft materials
description: Ma Xiulan reheated the leftovers and ate lunch with steamed buns. Feeling a bit tired after the meal, she set an alarm and dozed in the bedroom for about 25 minutes. When the alarm went off, she splashed her face with cold water, perked up, then opened the camphor chest at the bottom of the bedroom wardrobe, which was specially used for storing craft materials, to prepare for the afternoon.
location: Dining room and bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Searching through and organizing salon display materials
description: Ma Xiulan took the handmade treasures out of the box one by one and spread them on the living room carpet. She specially selected the 'twin lotus' embroidery pieces, which symbolize good fortune, along with fu-character embroideries and plain colored fabric scraps, and sorted out various beads and sequins by color. She carefully backed her two favorite embroideries with cardboard and planned the display layout. During this, she found she was missing lake-blue ice silk thread, so she wrote it down in her notebook as a to-buy item.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Picking up the children from school and shopping on the way.
description: Ma Xiulan packed her materials, changed into a coat, and rode her electric bike to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten first to pick up her daughter Ma Yuxin, then waited at the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School for her second son Ma Mingzhe to finish school. On the way home, she passed Huijing Convenience Store and went in to buy a bottle of soy sauce. Ma Mingzhe wanted to buy a lollipop but was refused. She got home at 16:50.

She cooked a pot of millet and pumpkin porridge, reheated the leftovers from the wedding, stir-fried shredded potatoes with vinegar, and boiled two salted duck eggs, serving them with steamed buns—a light, comforting dinner.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner
description: The eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, came home a little late from school, and by the time he arrived the porridge was already on the table. The family of four sat around the table and ate. Ma Xiulan asked the children about school. Ma Mingxuan said nothing special happened; Ma Mingzhe excitedly talked about a soccer game he learned in PE class; Ma Yuxin said in her soft, childish voice that the kindergarten teacher had taught them a new song. The atmosphere was warm and cozy.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tutoring the second son in math
description: After clearing the dishes following the meal, Ma Xiulan called Ma Mingzhe to the dining table. Since he had recently been learning area calculation and tended to confuse perimeter with area, she had him redo five similar questions he had gotten wrong, and guided him step by step to state the formula differences himself, helping him consolidate his understanding.
location: Dining table in the living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Salon rehearsal
description: After tutoring the children, Ma Xiulan set up a small table in the living room, laid out materials such as embroidery pieces, cloth scraps, and beads, and had her younger daughter Ma Yuxin act as the audience for a handicraft salon rehearsal. She demonstrated how to quickly fold fabric hair flowers and explained the steps and color-matching techniques in plain language. Xinxin listened carefully and praised her mother for explaining clearly. Encouraged, Ma Xiulan practiced the whole demonstration once more and noted the places where she got stuck on a sticky note.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The whole family went out for a walk.
description: After the drill, Ma Mingzhe clamored to go out, so Ma Xiulan let her eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, take his younger siblings downstairs for a stroll along the sidewalk on Jingwen Road. She herself stayed home to sort out the materials and recorded the community phone numbers and salon notes in the favor ledger.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and the surrounding sidewalks on Jingwen Road

name: Accompanying the children with washing up and bedtime preparation
description: After the children came back from their walk, Ma Xiulan urged them to wash up one by one. She first helped her daughter Ma Yuxin wash her face and feet, then watched Ma Mingzhe brush his teeth on his own. When Ma Mingxuan had also finished washing up, she sat by her daughter's bedside, told a short story, and coaxed her to sleep.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening personal care, reflection, and bedtime
description: After making sure the children were asleep, Ma Xiulan heated water and soaked her feet comfortably, while also doing a set of lower back stretches. She was mulling over salon preparations in her mind: tomorrow she would go to the Wutong Commune vegetable market to ask Aunt Sun Guifang for cardboard box backing boards, and she also wanted to try using existing fabric scraps to make the frog button pattern Sister Wang had lent her. After soaking her feet, she put the rehearsal notes and the borrowed pattern in a prominent place in her craft box, sent a goodnight sticker in the 'Jinghai Sisters' group chat, then turned off the light and fell asleep, slipping into her dreams with a sense of fulfillment and anticipation.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Early morning workout
description: Woken by the alarm at 5:50 in the morning, she canceled the courtyard exercise plan due to a cold wave and strong winds. First she did a 5-minute warm-up on the balcony with tiptoe stretches, then practiced a complete set of Baduanjin in the living room, and did targeted stretching for her shoulders, neck, and waist, which had been strained from long-term housework. The whole process took about 25 minutes; she was slightly sweating and felt refreshed.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare breakfast
description: After exercising, she went into the kitchen. She put the millet that had been soaked overnight into a pot and cooked it into porridge, while steaming the white steamed buns in a steamer and frying three eggs in a frying pan. The whole kitchen filled with the aroma of millet and eggs, and she prepared a warm, nutritious breakfast for the family.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Take care of the family breakfast and take the children to school
description: She woke the three children and told them to put on thick coats and cotton shoes because of the cold; especially for her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin, she added a woolen vest and wrapped a scarf around her. The whole family sat together for breakfast. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang left at 7 o'clock on his electric bike for the logistics company. At 7:15, Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike, first taking her second son Ma Mingzhe to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, then taking her youngest daughter to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten. Along the way she repeatedly reminded them not to take off their coats in the cold.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Shop at the vegetable market and get craft materials.
description: After dropping off the children, she stopped by the Wutong Commune vegetable market on the way. She found the familiar stall owner, Aunt Sun Guifang, and explained that she needed to build a warm shed for her flowers. Aunt Sun kindly gave her two sturdy large cardboard boxes and several thick foam boards. Ma Xiulan thanked her again and again, then bought some cabbage, tofu, and vegetables for the next day. She also got the lake-blue ice silk thread she had been thinking about for days, preparing materials for making frog buttons later.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Return home to rest and get ready to go out.
description: Carrying the purchased items back home, she put the vegetables away in the kitchen and temporarily placed the cardboard boxes and foam boards on the balcony for later use. After drinking a glass of warm water, she straightened her collar, picked up the notice for the Most Beautiful Family selection issued by the community earlier, and prepared to go out to attend the selection meeting.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Attend the community 'Most Beautiful Family' selection meeting
description: Bracing against the cold wind, she entered the meeting hall of the Jingwen Road Community Residents' Committee. Encouraged by neighbor Zheng Xiuying and the local residents, she went on stage and sincerely shared small everyday things like regularly visiting the elderly Grandma Zhao, who lived alone, and teaching her children to be grateful and share. She also exchanged experiences in family education. Her speech drew rounds of applause. After review by the selection panel, she was announced as the winner of this year's community 'Most Beautiful Family' nomination award, and a certificate was presented to her on the spot. Ma Xiulan took the certificate with both hands, deeply moved, and felt the recognition and warmth of her neighbors.
location: Jingwen Road Community Neighborhood Committee, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up daughter from school
description: After the review meeting, she stopped by Huakang First Kindergarten on the way to pick up her youngest daughter, Ma Yuxin. Holding her little hand, they walked home chatting and laughing. Once home, she let her play with toys in the living room on her own.
location: Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare lunch and tutor the eldest son in math.

Ma Xiulan quickly reheated the leftover porridge and steamed buns from the morning and stir-fried a plate of hot and sour cabbage. At the dining table, she opened Mingxuan's math homework notebook and, for a word problem about area, analyzed the solution step by step in a gentle tone, helping him completely understand the mistake.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Soothed her daughter to sleep during the midday nap.
description: After lunch, she told Mingxuan to go take a nap quickly. Ma Xiulan took her younger daughter Xinxin into the bedroom, told her a short story, and gently patted her to sleep. After Xinxin fell asleep, she leaned against the headboard, closed her eyes, and rested for about 20 minutes to recharge for the afternoon's tasks.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Taking the children to school and visiting her parents along the way
description: At 1 p.m., she woke Xinxin from her nap, then rode the e-bike to take her elder son Ma Mingxuan to the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School first, and then took her younger daughter back to Huakang First Kindergarten. After that, she rode alone to her parents' home at 45 Shengli Street, not far away. As soon as she entered, she showed the certificate for the nomination award she had won that morning to her parents, and her mother beamed with joy. Ma Xiulan also set aside part of the cabbage and tofu she had bought in the morning at the vegetable market for her parents.
location: No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Keep parents company and help with housework.
description: At her parents' home, Ma Xiulan chatted with her mother, Li Xiuying, about recent everyday matters, then helped her clean up the kitchen and wipe down the stove. Her father, Ma Jianguo, was trimming dead branches from his beloved old pomegranate tree nearby. Ma Xiulan also watered several pots of flowers on the balcony. Noticing that the draft-proof paper her mother had pasted on the screen window had a few tears, she carefully patched them with transparent tape to make her parents' little home warmer.
location: No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Setting up a cold-protection greenhouse for overwintering flowers.
description: After returning from her mother's home, Ma Xiulan changed into an old cotton-padded coat and started working on the balcony. She first used thin bamboo strips to set up a sturdy frame around the fuchsia flowerpot, cut a foam board given by Sun Guifang to line the bottom of the pot against freezing, then carefully covered it with an old cotton quilt and an outer layer of plastic sheeting, binding it tightly with rope. She specially left a small ventilation opening on the south side. Looking at the tightly sealed warm shelter after finishing, she felt much more at ease, and wrote on the desk calendar: 'Built the warm shelter today; from now on, water once every 10 days.'
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up daughter and second son from school.
description: At 16:40, she left on time by e-bike, first going to Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up Ma Yuxin, then to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up her second son, Ma Mingzhe. On the way home, Mingzhe said he wanted to eat roast duck. Ma Xiulan agreed with a smile, and in her heart she also hoped her husband would bring good news.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Received good news from her husband and prepared a hearty dinner
description: As soon as she got home, she tied on an apron and started preparing the meal: washing rice and steaming it, cutting cabbage and soaking the tofu. At about 17:30, her husband Ma Zhiqiang called, and in an excited voice said that his driving performance last month had earned him a perfect attendance award, with a bonus of 300 yuan. He had already bought the roast duck the children had been asking about for days and was on his way home. Ma Xiulan was overjoyed. After hanging up, she moved faster, turned up the heat on the stewed tofu, and added an extra dish of scallion scrambled eggs to make the children happy.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family celebration dinner

The table was filled with vinegar cabbage, stewed tofu, scallion scrambled eggs, and the star dish, roast duck. Ma Zhiqiang poured a glass of beer, first thanked Ma Xiulan for managing the household all day, and promised to smoke less and share more of the housework from then on. Ma Xiulan's eyes reddened slightly, and she also brought out the nomination award certificate she had received during the day to share the joy with everyone. The family was happy and harmonious, and the roast duck was quickly polished off by the children.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Cleaning the kitchen and husband helping the second son with homework
description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan asked her husband to go to the living room to help her second son Ma Mingzhe with his math homework, while she put on an apron, cleared the dishes, wiped the table, and washed the bowls. From the kitchen, she could hear her husband patiently reading out problems and her son occasionally asking questions, which made her feel life was especially steady and secure.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Shared the joy with her mother via video call
description: After cleaning up, Ma Xiulan sat on the sofa and made a video call to her mother Li Xiuying on Shengli Street. She happily told her about her husband winning the full attendance award in the evening and the family celebrating with roast duck. Her mother laughed with joy on the other end, and the mother and daughter chatted about everyday matters for a while.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Research frog-button patterns to prepare for handcraft.
description: After the video call, Ma Xiulan took out the lake-blue ice silk thread she had bought that morning and carefully studied the Chinese knot button pattern she had borrowed from Wang Guilan, tracing the winding method with her fingers to fully prepare for officially starting the Chinese knot button design tomorrow.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Foot soaking, stretching, and reviewing the day
description: She heated hot water, soaked her feet to drive away the day's chill, and did a few simple lower back stretches to ease her muscles. While soaking her feet, she reviewed the day's moments: the recognition she received at the community selection, her husband's promise to share responsibilities, and the children's happy smiles. Her heart felt warm, and she thought that all the hard work was worth it.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Washed up and went to bed

location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning exercise and family breakfast
description: Ma Xiulan was woken by the alarm clock and felt a chill in the room. She put on thick pajamas, went to the balcony to do toe-raise stretches for 5 minutes, felt the cold morning breeze, and checked whether the cold frame she had built for the fuchsia was securely sealed. Back in the living room, she turned on the heater and did a full set of Baduanjin, then stretched her shoulders, neck, and lower back. By then her body had warmed up. At 6 o’clock she went into the kitchen to prepare breakfast: she made cabbage and egg congee with last night’s leftover rice, steamed a few large buns, and sliced a plate of her own pickled crispy radish skin. At 6:30, she woke the three children one by one and helped Yuxin braid her little pigtails. At exactly 7:00, the whole family sat down for breakfast. Ma Xiulan mentioned to her husband Zhiqiang that she had an evening computer training class, and he readily agreed to tutor the children. She gave her eldest son Mingxuan, who is in junior high school, an extra boiled egg and reminded him that he was still growing.

name: Take the children to school and buy groceries.

First she took her daughter Yuxin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten and watched as the teacher led her into the classroom. Then she rode with her second son Mingzhe on the e-bike for 5 minutes, arriving at Jinghai District No. 3 Elementary School at 7:30, and told him to pay attention in class. At 7:35 she rode alone and stopped by the Wutong Commune Vegetable Market on the way. The market was bustling as people stocked up on vegetables before the cold spell. She went straight to Aunt Sun Guifang's stall, picked five large Chinese cabbages and a big bunch of green radishes, which came to 25 yuan. Aunt Sun also gave her a bunch of cilantro. She bought 10 jin of potatoes and 5 jin of sweet potatoes, then tied the vegetables to the back seat of the e-bike. At 8:45, she rode home against the cold wind.
location: Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, 88 Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Wutong Commune Vegetable Market at the intersection of Jingwen Road and Wutong Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

Then she washed her hands, sat down on the living room sofa, and took out the lake-blue ice silk thread she had bought the day before and several pieces of silk satin remnants that had just arrived. Thinking about the style her younger sister Xiufen likes, she devoted herself to making new cloth hair flowers. She was so focused that in one sitting she made 2 wide-ribbon bow-style flowers and 3 bud-style flowers with small pearl drops, for a total of 5 new samples. At 11:30, she took photos and sent them to her younger sister Xiufen via WeChat, asking what she thought of the new styles and to keep one for her niece.

At 2 p.m., I went into the study and took out the computer training textbook and notebook. Thinking about the complicated 'mail merge' I had to learn in the evening, I felt unsure of myself, so I opened my husband's old laptop and, following the textbook steps, tried making a simple 'Xiulan Pickled Vegetables Sales Order' table in Word, and also practiced entering a few names and unit prices in Excel to get familiar with it first.
location: No. 156, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, home

Then she sat next to her second son Mingzhe and helped him with five word problems that are easy to get wrong. Today Mingzhe was quite receptive; he got three out of five right, and she praised him enthusiastically. After tutoring the children, she began to prepare dinner. Ma Xiulan reminded everyone to dress warmer when going out tomorrow, as the wind had picked up again tonight. The family chatted while eating, full of joy and harmony.

Tonight's class was about Word's "mail merge" feature, which batch-generates data from an Excel spreadsheet into a Word template. This was very difficult for her; she got flustered and couldn't get it right no matter what. The trainer came over and patiently demonstrated step by step: from setting up labels, selecting recipients, to completing the merge. She followed along and practiced three times, and finally succeeded in generating a "Xiulan Pickled Vegetables Sales Receipt." She let out a long breath and quickly copied the class assignment onto a USB drive. The class ended at 9 o'clock.
location: Southwest corner of the intersection of Jingwen Road and Jianshe Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jingwen Road Community Neighborhood Committee, computer classroom on the second floor of the community activity center.

She turned on the computer, saved the files from the USB drive, and took out a notebook to jot down key notes: "First create an Excel list of names, then create a Word template, and finally merge them into a new document!" Lying in bed, she thought back on the day: the vegetables were stocked up, the children had all made progress, and she had gritted her teeth and finished the computer course. She felt at ease. She turned off the light and went to sleep.

location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare lunch for the whole family
description: A little after eleven, the family said they were hungry. Xiulan went into the kitchen and cooked a pot of cabbage and tofu soup, reheated a few scallion pancakes made yesterday, and sliced a plate of spiced beef. The whole family ate their fill.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Midday nap and afternoon preparations
description: After lunch, Xiulan urged the children to take a nap. The youngest daughter fussed and wanted her to stay, so she held Xinxin and lay down for half an hour. Once the child fell asleep, she gently got up, washed her face, and put the cleaning cloths and dish detergent in place in advance, preparing for the afternoon's thorough cleaning.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Visiting neighbors and chatting
description: Just as she finished tidying up, Wang Guilan, the neighbor across the hall, came over with newly pickled white radish, and the two sat down to chat. Xiulan briefly mentioned the social security matter she had handled in the morning. Sister Wang was happy for her when she heard it had gone through. She also showed off a newly learned frog-button pattern, and they chatted about handicrafts for half an hour. Sister Wang invited her to go buy thread together another day.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family deep cleaning
description: After Sister Wang left, Xiulan organized the whole family for a thorough cleaning. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang helped remove the thick sheets and duvet covers and put them into the washing machine. The eldest son Mingxuan cleaned the living room windows, the second son Mingzhe tidied up toys and books, and the youngest daughter Xinxin wiped her own little desk with a small cloth. Xiulan also took out the down jackets, wiped the collars and cuffs clean with a damp cloth, and hung them on the balcony. After more than an hour of work, the room felt much fresher. She rewarded each person with a piece of milk candy, and the children were very happy.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Practice creating an electronic ledger on the computer
description: After finishing the general cleaning, Xiulan asked her husband to take the children downstairs to play. She sat at the computer, opened Excel, and built a monthly family income and expense table from scratch. She set up the headers step by step, entered several major expenses from last month, and tried the SUM formula. Seeing the numbers come out correctly, she was especially pleased. Then she used Word to design a Ma Family Pickled Vegetables label, planning to stick it on the pickle jar later.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tutor my second son in math
description: After her husband came back with the children, her second son Mingzhe cried out that he was thirsty as soon as he entered the house. Xiulan told him to drink some water and then pulled him to the desk to do homework. Today she gave him five word problems. His thinking was especially clear and he got them all right, so Xiulan praised him warmly, and Mingzhe was overjoyed.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare dinner for the family (noodles with gravy)
description: After tutoring Mingzhe, Xiulan hurried into the kitchen to prepare dinner. Tonight they were having noodles with thick gravy. She diced the pork belly, chopped the rehydrated day lily flowers and wood ear mushrooms, heated oil in a wok, stir-fried the pork until fragrant, added the side ingredients one by one, poured in water, brought to a boil, thickened the sauce, and drizzled in beaten egg to make the gravy. She then brought another pot of water to a boil and cooked the noodles.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner and family meeting.
description: At 6:30, the whole family sat around the table eating noodles with gravy. Xiulan mentioned to her husband Ma Zhiqiang about checking the roof tiles the next day, and Zhiqiang responded that he remembered. The children were eager to watch cartoons, but Xiulan let them watch half an hour of local news first. The family enjoyed a warm, harmonious meal together.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Watch TV with the children and remind them to wash up
description: After the meal, Xiulan finished clearing the dishes. The children had already turned on the TV to watch the news; after the news ended, they switched to cartoons, and three little heads huddled in front of the screen. Near eight o'clock, Xiulan urged them to go wash up. The oldest and the daughter went, but the second child was still dawdling, so she called out again.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening family walk
description: After the children finished washing up, Xiulan saw that it was not very windy outside, so she suggested going for a walk. Her husband put jackets on the children, and the family of five strolled slowly along the eastern section of Jingwen Road, turned back at the intersection with Shengli Avenue, and returned home after about 20 minutes. The air was cool and fresh, and it was very pleasant.
location: Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Before-bed preparations and the couple soaking their feet together.
description: After returning from the walk, Xiulan first washed her youngest daughter's face, applied lotion, and coaxed her to sleep. Then she filled a basin of hot water for herself and one for her husband, and they sat together soaking their feet. She told Zhiqiang about getting the certificate. Zhiqiang said she could rest assured now, and that the few roof tiles were no big problem—he would just mix some cement and patch them up tomorrow.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Had a phone call with her mother and kept accounts
description: After soaking her feet, her whole body was warm. Xiulan lounged on the bed and called her mother to tell her that the social security subsidy matter had been handled. Her mother was also happy on the other end of the line and said the house was warm, so she didn't need to worry. After hanging up, Xiulan opened her new ledger and wrote down the few yuan she had spent on laundry detergent during the big cleaning today.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Sleep peacefully.
description: Xiulan set the alarm for six o'clock tomorrow morning, put down her phone, and reflected on the big things she had accomplished today and the warmth and harmony of her family, feeling especially at ease. She put on her eye mask, stretched comfortably, and soon fell asleep.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning wake-up and physical exercise
description: The 5:45 alarm went off. It felt warm and cozy in the bed, so I lingered for 5 minutes and didn't get up until 6:00. First, I stood in the bedroom and did 5 minutes of heel raises and stretches to get my body going. Then I put on a coat, walked to the living room, closed the door, and did a full set of Baduanjin. I felt my muscles and joints fully stretch out. Next, I did 10 minutes of shoulder and neck stretches, adding the 'mi-character exercise' to move my neck, and stretched my lower back and spine. After this routine, my whole body was warm and I felt much more energetic.
location: Living room and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare and enjoy breakfast for the whole family.
description: After finishing her exercise, she hurried to the kitchen and boiled a pot of water. The millet porridge had been pre-set in the rice cooker the night before, so it was just ready. She also quickly made a few scallion pancakes and sliced a plate of her own pickled cucumbers. Around 7 o'clock, the children and her husband Ma Zhiqiang got up one after another. The family sat around the dining table and had a warm breakfast. During the meal, she reminded her husband again that he must check the roof today, and he grunted "Mm-hmm" in agreement.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Post-meal chores and urging her husband to check the roof.
description: After finishing breakfast, she cleared the table and washed the dishes with hot water. Then she sorted the clothes changed off yesterday: underwear and outerwear separately, and dark and light colors separately. She hand-washed the underwear first, then put the other clothes into the washing machine in batches. While the washing machine was running, she gave the kitchen stove and the surface of the range hood a quick wipe. Afterwards, seeing that her husband Ma Zhiqiang wanted to slump onto the sofa after breakfast, she hurried him to check the roof while it was still cool, reminding him that the corner near the wall always felt damp and needed a careful look. With no choice, muttering, her husband went to the storage room, carried out the ladder, and climbed up to the roof in the backyard.
location: Kitchen, bathroom, and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Tutoring the second son's studies
description: While her husband was checking the roof, she went to check on the second child, Mingzhe. Sure enough, he was still lying in bed holding Ultraman. She pulled him up, made him wash his face, sit at the desk, and prepare his math practice workbook and mistake notebook. Starting at 8:30, she sat with Mingzhe at the desk in the small north room. First she had him do yesterday's five word problems again; he got all of them right, so she praised him warmly. Then she took out the practice workbook and found three more difficult word problems for him, watching him set up the equations and calculate step by step. When he got stuck, she guided him according to the steps written in her notebook. Midway, the eldest, Mingxuan, also came in to get a book and casually asked a physics question. She looked at it and didn't understand it either, so she told him to ask his father and not disturb his younger brother. During these 90 minutes of supervising Mingzhe, his learning efficiency was quite good.
location: Second son's bedroom and study (small north room) at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Listen to roof inspection feedback and take care of household chores
description: My husband came down from the roof, a bit dusty. He told me that the tile on the corner of the wall was a little loose, but he had pressed it back down and applied some cement, so it would be fine for now, and next spring we'd find someone to fix it thoroughly. I said okay, let's leave it at that, thanked him and told him to go wash up and rest for a while. Then I started preparing lunch, planning to make mushroom and bok choy and stir-fried sliced pork with carrots. I washed the large bok choy, soaked the dried mushrooms, and took out two carrots from the fridge and sliced them. After tidying the kitchen, I took a rag and carefully wiped the living room windowsill, the gaps in the radiator, and the corners of the TV cabinet that had been neglected in yesterday's big cleanup. The room was bright and clean, and it felt refreshing. Finally, I took the washed clothes out of the washing machine and hung them one by one on the balcony.
location: The backyard, living room, kitchen, and balcony at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Prepare and enjoy lunch
description: At 11:30 she started cooking. For lunch, she made stir-fried mushrooms with bok choy, sliced pork stir-fried with carrots, and a simple seaweed egg drop soup. The dishes were home-style, but the children loved them, especially the mushrooms with bok choy — Yuxin ate more than half the plate by herself. As the family ate, local news played on TV; everyone chatted and laughed, and the atmosphere was very warm.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Afternoon nap after lunch
description: After the meal, she asked her husband to watch the children and keep them from running wild. She cleared the dishes and wiped the table. Feeling a bit tired, she sprawled on the sofa for half an hour. Her husband and the children each went back to their own rooms to nap or play quietly. This weekend nap felt especially precious.
location: Living room and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tidy up the house after the midday rest
description: After taking a short nap, she felt much more refreshed. She brought in the clothes that had been drying on the balcony, folded them neatly, and put them into everyone's closets. Then she tidied up the kitchen that had been used at noon, scrubbed the pots that needed scrubbing, and wiped the countertops spotless.
location: Living room, bedrooms, and kitchen in the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: In the afternoon, review the computer course and organize notes.
description: Sitting quietly at the desk in the small north room, she took out the notebook and USB drive from the computer training class. Using four colors of highlighters, she categorized the key points, difficult points, formulas, and shortcuts for Word and Excel. She also used a red pen to supplement the places where her previous notes were too scribbled or had omissions. Then she turned on the computer, started from a new file, and independently practiced twice from beginning to end: the household income and expense table (using the SUM formula to sum) and the pickled vegetable label (setting the font and inserting a text box), until she could complete them smoothly without looking at her notes. After practicing, she clicked 'Print Preview' and saw that it looked like it had been made in a shop, feeling very pleased.
location: Home study (small north room), No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare dinner ingredients in advance
description: Coming out of the study, she moved her neck and wrists, then started preparing dinner. Thinking that everyone would be together tonight and that her husband had worked hard in the afternoon, she decided to make dumplings. She kneaded a dough with warm water and let it rest. Then she chopped the leftover shiitake mushrooms, meat, and a Chinese cabbage from lunch and seasoned them into dumpling filling. Her youngest daughter Yuxin ran over to join in the fun, so she gave her a small piece of dough and let her play with it nearby. Yuxin was absolutely delighted.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Calculated November household income and expenses with her husband.
description: The dough and filling still needed to rest a bit longer, so she called her husband into the living room and took out the family ledger and a calculator. She read out each item while he listened and tallied it up. November income was 7,000 yuan (salary), total expenses were 5,650 yuan, leaving a surplus of 1,350 yuan.
