The biggest items were heating costs and the children's clothes, and both agreed the money had to be spent. After the calculation, she excitedly took out the “education savings” envelope and carefully put another 1,000 yuan in cash into it. Then she solemnly wrote on the last page of the ledger: “As of November 30, 2025, education fund total: 4,500 yuan, only 500 yuan away from the year-end goal of 5,000 yuan!” Turning to her husband, she said that next month they should economize a bit more; in December, if he took his own meals when driving and ate out less, they would definitely meet the target. Her husband nodded in agreement. She also noted down the budget points for next month.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The whole family making dumplings together and having dinner
description: The dough and filling were ready, so I called everyone together to make dumplings. My husband rolled the wrappers, and I made dumplings with the eldest and second child. The dumplings Mingzhe made all lay flat and crooked, and the little dough balls Yuxin made were also treated as treasures and put into the pot. The living room was filled with laughter and cheerful voices; this is what home feels like. After the dumplings were cooked, they were served steaming hot. The whole family sat around the table, dipping them in vinegar and garlic paste, and felt warm inside. Dumplings made at home are really hearty, with thin wrappers and generous fillings, and the children all ate quite a lot.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Post-meal tidying and personal washing.
description: After eating, she let her husband take the children to rest first. She scrubbed all the pots and dishes, wiped down the stove, and tidied the kitchen. Then she washed her face and prepared to start the evening project.
location: Kitchen and bathroom at the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Check the whole family's dental health.
description: I took a flashlight, stood at the bathroom door, and called the three children over one by one to check their teeth. The eldest, Mingxuan, indeed still had some vegetable bits between his teeth, so I made him brush again; the second child, Mingzhe, brushed quite cleanly, and I praised him; the youngest daughter, Yuxin's baby teeth were very white and clean. The children couldn't understand why their mother was so strict every time, but seeing how serious I was, they obediently cooperated.
location: Home bathroom, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Whole-family indoor stretching exercises
description: It was already completely dark and the wind outside had picked up, so we didn't go out for a walk. I called the whole family to the living room, put on some soft music, and led everyone in simple stretching exercises. I did a few stretches first, and the children followed along, laughing and joking—a little family activity.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Bedtime reading time
description: After the excitement died down, she asked everyone to go to their rooms and read. She went to the study, picked up a copy of Zhiyin magazine, and sat on the living room sofa to read. The oldest child and Mingzhe went back to their room to read extracurricular books. She called her youngest daughter Yuxin over and read her two fairy tales.
location: Living room and bedrooms at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Soaking feet and listening to the radio before bed to relax
description: The children had all gone back to their rooms, and she began to get ready to wash up. She boiled a pot of hot water, cut a few slices of ginger, grabbed a small handful of mugwort, put them into the foot basin, added hot water, and soaked her feet. While soaking her feet, she turned on the radio and listened to a local folk art broadcast for a while, feeling very relaxed.
location: Bathroom and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Quiet Sitting, Deep Breathing, and Going to Bed
description: After soaking my feet, my whole body felt warm. Back in the bedroom, I sat cross-legged on the bed and turned off the light. Closing my eyes, I began deep abdominal breathing and felt the breath slowly flowing through my body. I pressed the Zusanli point around the knee and pinched the Hegu point in the web of my thumb. In my mind I quietly reviewed this month: the social insurance had been taken care of, the accounts were sorted out, the computer course was going well, and the education fund was almost fully saved... I felt particularly grounded and content. After ten minutes of deep breathing, I felt completely calm, then lay down and fell into a deep sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Morning wake-up and family breakfast.
description: Ma Xiulan got up at 5:45 a.m., and first did shoulder and neck stretches and waist twists in the living room to wake up her body. Then she went to the kitchen to prepare breakfast. She sliced the steamed buns, dipped them in egg batter, and pan-fried them until golden, and cooked millet porridge in advance, served with homemade pickled radish peel. At the same time, she started the washing machine to do laundry. Around 6:50 a.m., she woke the three children and helped her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin put on warmed knitwear and cotton-padded pants. The family of four had breakfast in the dining room. Ma Xiulan reminded the children to bring their water bottles and red scarves. Her eldest son Ma Mingxuan ate very quickly and got ready for his class duty.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Send daughter to school and morning exercise.
description: At 07:40, Ma Xiulan took Ma Yuxin out and walked to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten. Along the way, she chatted with neighbor Wang Guilan about the drop in temperature. After watching her daughter enter the kindergarten gate, she returned home. On the balcony, she did a simple heel-raise stretch, then followed an audio track on her phone in the living room to practice the full set of Baduanjin. Her movements were gentle, her breathing deep and long, and her body gradually warmed up.
location: Home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and Huakang First Kindergarten

name: Finishing up housework and buying folders
description: After practicing Baduanjin, Ma Xiulan soaked the breakfast bowls and chopsticks in the sink, put on her down jacket, and took a canvas bag containing receipts and a notebook. She walked to the Chenguang Stationery Store at the corner of Jingwen Road and Dongfanghong Road and carefully selected a blue A4 plastic folder to organize the pickled vegetable and embroidery orders.
location: From home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to M&G Stationery (Kouzhang Road Store)

name: Visit childhood friend Liu Chunmei to sign papers and catch up.
description: Ma Xiulan walked to the residential area beside Yucai Primary School on Shengli Street and found her childhood friend Liu Chunmei's home. She took out the prepared pickled vegetable income breakdown and the embroidery receipt copies and asked Liu Chunmei to sign as a witness. The two then made tea and chatted, talking about their children's grades and changes in vegetable prices, reminiscing for half an hour.
location: Residential community next to Yucai Primary School, Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin (Liu Chunmei's home)

name: Organizing side-business records, lunch, and midday rest.
description: Returning from Chunmei's house to her home on Jingwen Road, Ma Xiulan sorted the signed documents, pickle orders, and embroidery receipts by category and time order into a new folder at the square table, determined to keep her accounts in order. She then cooked plain noodle soup with a poached egg for lunch. After eating, she set an alarm and lay down for a midday nap of about 45 minutes, and woke up refreshed.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Process the annual confirmation of the flexible employment subsidy.
description: After her midday rest, Ma Xiulan packed a canvas bag containing her proof of income and ID card, rode her electric bike along Dongfanghong Road, turned onto Guanghai Road, and arrived at the Jinghai District Human Resources and Social Security Bureau. She submitted the materials at Window 1 in the lobby. After the staff confirmed them in the system and told her the subsidy would be paid as usual next month, she finally breathed a sigh of relief.
location: Tianjin Jinghai District Human Resources and Social Security Bureau, No. 9 Guanghai Road

name: Return trip grocery shopping and household leisure
description: After taking care of social security, Ma Xiulan rode on to the Wutong Commune vegetable market on the way, found the familiar Aunt Sun Guifang, and bought half a jin of beef and a bunch of spinach. Aunt Sun also gave her a few sprigs of cilantro. Back home, she took the laundry out of the washing machine and hung it on the balcony, then turned on the TV to listen to the opera "The Flower as a Matchmaker," and did a few embroidery stitches by hand as a way to relax.
location: Wutong Community vegetable market on Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and home at 156 Jingwen Road

name: Pick the children up from school.
description: Ma Xiulan first picked up her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin at Huakang First Kindergarten, then went to Yucai School in Hedong District, Tianjin to pick up her second son Ma Mingzhe. Mingzhe excitedly reported that he scored 87 on his math quiz. She happily praised him, and the three of them headed home chatting and laughing.
location: Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Yucai School, Hedong District, Tianjin; and home at 156 Jingwen Road

name: Prepare dinner and have a family meal
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan put on an apron and simmered beef soup, stir-fried spinach, and reheated steamed buns. Her eldest son Ma Mingxuan came home from school, and the family sat down to dinner. At the table, she told everyone that the social security confirmation had been completed and the money for next month was secured. The children all praised her. After dinner, her eldest son helped clear the dishes, and she wiped the dining table clean.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening parent-child walk and screen time check
description: Her husband had not yet returned from a driving job, so after dinner Ma Xiulan dressed the children warmly and took them for a walk along Jingwen Road. She carried a small radio and listened to Pingju opera, the oldest son voluntarily held his sister's hand, and the second son kicked pebbles by the roadside. After returning home, she checked the screen time on the three children's tablets; none had exceeded the limit, and she verbally praised the children for their self-discipline.
location: Along Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and at Home

name: Tutoring homework and computer practice
description: Ma Xiulan first patiently helped her second son Ma Mingzhe with math word problems about perimeter. After Mingzhe understood, he solved two problems correctly on his own. Then she opened her husband's old notebook and reviewed the Word layout operations learned in computer class, practicing font size, typeface, and centering functions, gradually becoming more skilled.
location: Living room and study corner at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening relaxation and bedtime
description: Ma Xiulan stretched her lower back and did cat stretches to relieve soreness, then urged the three children to wash their faces and feet. She brought mugwort and ginger water for them to soak their feet, while flipping through a newly organized ledger and recording the day's expenses: folder 8 yuan, beef 25 yuan, spinach 3 yuan. After soaking their feet, she tucked the children in, returned to her own room, turned off the light at 21:30, and soon fell into a peaceful sleep, feeling at ease.
location: Bedroom and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning stretching, preparing breakfast, and family breakfast time.
description: At 5:30 in the morning, the alarm went off. After getting up, Ma Xiulan did shoulder-and-neck stretches and waist/back twists on the floor mat beside the bed to loosen up her body. Then she went into the kitchen, boiled water, chopped scallions, and beat eggs to make stir-fried noodle soup; she also took the pickled cucumbers out of the fridge, cut them into strips, drizzled them with sesame oil, and steamed some qiangmian mantou. At 6:50 she woke up the three children and helped her little daughter Yuxin get dressed. The family sat around the table for breakfast. Ma Xiulan reminded her husband Zhiqiang to tutor their second son Mingzhe in math at home today and to pick up Yuxin from school in the afternoon, and Zhiqiang agreed.
location: At home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Took her youngest daughter to kindergarten and asked the teacher to look after her
description: Ma Xiulan combed Yuxin's braids, put on her scarf and hat, and walked her daughter to Huakang First Kindergarten. On the way, she told Yuxin that Mom was going on a trip today, to listen to the teacher, and that Dad would pick her up in the afternoon. At the school gate, she saw head teacher Han Mei. Ma Xiulan smiled and asked Teacher Han to take good care of Yuxin, and told her that her father would pick up the child in the afternoon. Teacher Han readily agreed.
location: Huakang First Kindergarten, Huakang Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Final preparations before departure and saying goodbye to family
description: After dropping off the children and returning home, Ma Xiulan did a final check of her backpack in the bedroom: three jars of homemade pickled vegetables in a woven rattan basket, a peony round fan wrapped in white cloth, a hard-copy train ticket, a charger, and batteries were all properly placed. She shouldered her backpack, went to the living room, said goodbye to Zhiqiang, who was looking at his phone, and reminded Mingzhe again to behave. Zhiqiang urged her to be careful and to send a WeChat message upon arrival. Ma Xiulan pushed open the door and left home, full of anticipation.
location: At home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Walk to Jinghai Station, wait for the train, and go through ticket check
description: Ma Xiulan walked west along Jingwen Road for about 25 minutes to Jinghai Railway Station. Passing by Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, she thought she would go to Aunt Sun's to buy vegetables when she came back tomorrow. Entering the station waiting room, she looked at the electronic screen to confirm that Train K257 was at Platform 2. Then, hearing the announcement, she followed the queue through ticket check, handing over her ticket and ID card.
location: Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin to Jinghai Station, No. 1 Dongfanghong Road

name: Take Train K257 to Renqiu
description: After the train departed, Ma Xiulan took a window seat and placed her backpack on her lap. Outside the window, the urban buildings gradually gave way to winter fields covered with a thin frost. She took out her phone to check the praise in the pickled-vegetables group chat, then admired the embroidery works she had saved, thinking that she would ask Aunt Wu about frog buttons and crochet later. The carriage was quiet; she leaned against the window and rested with her eyes closed, feeling both excited and calm.
location: Train K257, hard-seat carriage, from Tianjin Jinghai Station to Renqiu Station, Hebei

name: Arrived at Renqiu Station and went to Aunt Wu's home.
description: When the train arrived, Ma Xiulan walked out of the exit with the crowd and saw Aunt Wu, wearing a red scarf, waving in the distance. The two were excited to meet for the first time, like old friends. Aunt Wu took the bag from Ma Xiulan's hand and gave her a ride on her electric bike to Jianshe West Road Community, introducing places along the way such as Renqiu Shopping Center.
location: From Renqiu Station in Renqiu City, Cangzhou City, Hebei Province, to the No. 25 community on Jianshe West Road, Xinhua Road Subdistrict

name: Visit Aunt Wu's home, exchange gifts, and share craft skills
description: When she entered Aunt Wu's house, Ma Xiulan was amazed by the crocheted tapestries, potted flowers, and dolls all over the room, and praised it as a handicraft museum. Aunt Wu showed her around the studio filled with materials and an old spinning wheel. Afterward, the two exchanged gifts in the living room: Ma Xiulan gave her homemade pickled vegetables and a peony round fan, and Aunt Wu gave her a hand-crocheted cartoon bear wool hat. In the afternoon, Aunt Wu demonstrated complex crochet stitches while Ma Xiulan recorded videos to learn, and Ma Xiulan showed her gradient color matching in embroidery. The two chatted enthusiastically, with laughter all the while.
location: Aunt Wu's home, No. 25 Residential Community, Jianshe West Road, Xinhua Road Subdistrict, Renqiu, Cangzhou, Hebei Province

name: Leisure time and folk culture experience at Yanling Park.
description: Aunt Wu took Ma Xiulan on an electric bike to Yanling Park for a walk. In the park, elderly people were playing chess and playing the erhu in a pavilion. Aunt Wu told her that this place used to be reed marshes connected to the waterways of Baiyangdian. Ma Xiulan enjoyed the winter scenery and took photos of reeds hung with icicles.
location: Yanling Park, No. 1 Taishan South Road, Renqiu City, Cangzhou City, Hebei Province

name: Prepare dinner, discuss the chili sauce recipe, and have dinner together
description: Back at Aunt Wu's house, the two cooked together. Aunt Wu planned to make Hebei-style fish stew with corn cakes. Ma Xiulan helped peel garlic and slice ginger. Aunt Wu shared her exclusive chili sauce recipe: fresh facing-heaven chilies, fermented black beans, and rapeseed oil, simmered slowly for a richer flavor. Ma Xiulan learned to stick the corn cakes along the edge of the heated iron wok. At dinner, the fish was tender and tasty, and the corn cakes were crispy and fragrant. The two chatted while eating, like family.
location: Aunt Wu's home, No. 25 Residential Community, Jianshe West Road, Xinhua Road Subdistrict, Renqiu, Cangzhou, Hebei Province

name: Overnight stay and in-depth evening conversation
description: After dinner, they helped clean up, then the two sat back on the sofa chatting. Aunt Wu talked about her experiences in the textile factory when she was young, and Ma Xiulan chatted about amusing stories of her three children. The topics ranged from embroidery stitches to supermarket egg specials to hopes for the future. The more they talked, the more they hit it off, until late at night.
location: Aunt Wu's home, No. 25 Residential Community, Jianshe West Road, Xinhua Road Subdistrict, Renqiu, Cangzhou, Hebei Province

name: Pre-sleep stretching and going to bed.
description: Ma Xiulan changed into her pajamas and did waist and back stretches on the bed to relieve fatigue. She saw that her husband Zhiqiang had sent a WeChat message saying the children were all asleep and everything was fine, so she replied that tomorrow she would go to the morning market with Aunt Wu to buy chili peppers. Then she turned off the light, felt the warmth of being away from home, and fell into a sound sleep.
location: Guest room at Aunt Wu's house, residential community at No. 25 Jianshe West Road, Xinhua Road Subdistrict, Renqiu, Cangzhou, Hebei Province

name: Morning stretch
description: At six in the morning, the morning mist outside the window had not yet dispersed. Ma Xiulan sat up gently, not in a hurry to get out of bed. First, she bent her knees on the bed, hugged her calves with both hands, and slowly arched her back, feeling her stiff lower back gradually stretch out. After about ten minutes of lower back stretching, she got out of bed, opened the curtains, and saw that strings of bright red dried chili peppers were already drying in Aunt Wu’s small yard.
location: Aunt Wu's guest room, Jianshe West Road, Renqiu City, Cangzhou City, Hebei Province, China

name: Breakfast with Aunt Wu, shopping, and saying goodbye.
description: Aunt Wu had already heated up the millet porridge and brought out her pickled vegetables and freshly steamed buns with vegetable filling. As they ate and chatted, Ma Xiulan confirmed the spicy sauce recipe she had learned last night with Aunt Wu again, especially the ratio of fermented black beans to fresh chili peppers. After the meal, Ma Xiulan helped Aunt Wu clean up the dishes, and the two took a group photo with their phones in the living room in front of the wall covered with crochet works. Ma Xiulan checked the embroidered round fan and the pickled vegetable gift box she had packed last night once more. Then Aunt Wu rode her electric bike to take Ma Xiulan to Youjian Morning Market, the liveliest morning market in Renqiu, and they went straight to a familiar dried-goods stall. The stall owner was an old master in his sixties. Aunt Wu taught Ma Xiulan how to judge the quality of dried chili peppers by feeling their texture and smelling them. Ma Xiulan finally picked two jin of thick-fleshed, rich-flavored Erjingtiao chili peppers and a small bag of red Sichuan pepper, and used her phone to take a picture of the stall and the owner's phone number. Aunt Wu also insisted on giving her a bag of homemade pear syrup candy, saying to take it back for the children to soothe their throats. Around 8 o'clock, Aunt Wu rode her bike to take Ma Xiulan to the bus stop on Jianshe West Road. The two parted reluctantly and agreed to visit Jinghai when they had the chance.
location: Jianshe West Road, Renqiu, Cangzhou, Hebei, China

name: Riding back to the Jinghai home.
description: After saying goodbye to Aunt Wu, Ma Xiulan walked about 8 minutes to Renqiu Railway Station. After swiping her ID card to enter the station, she found a seat by the window in the waiting hall, took out her notebook from her cloth bag, and went over the crochet stitches and chili sauce recipe she had learned from yesterday to today. At 9:03 she boarded Train K258. Sitting by the window, she watched the fields and villages recede rapidly outside. She took out the pear-syrup candy Aunt Wu had given her, put a piece in her mouth, and continued improving her notes, with special emphasis on the tip of thickening with glutinous rice flour to make the chili sauce shinier, and drew a small chili pepper symbol next to it. Halfway through, she closed her eyes and dozed for a while, feeling that the soreness in her lower back was slightly better than in the morning. Arriving at Jinghai Station at 11:28, she exited the station, turned from Dongfanghong Road onto Jingwen Road, walked about 25 minutes, and returned home to No. 156, Jingwen Road at around 12:10.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Lunch, rest, and letting family know you're safe
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Luggage sorting and resuming housework.
description: After finishing the call, Ma Xiulan began unpacking the luggage she had brought back from Renqiu. She divided the chili peppers and Sichuan peppercorns into sealed jars and labeled them, put the reorganized crochet notes onto the living room bookshelf, and threw the dirty clothes into the washing machine and pressed the wash button. Then she picked up a cloth and wiped down the living room coffee table and TV cabinet, and tidied up the kitchen counter that her husband and children had left messy after dinner last night. Only after doing all this did she feel that the home had returned to its familiar rhythm.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Pick up youngest daughter from school, prepare dinner, and have family dinner.
description: At 16:00, Ma Xiulan left on time and walked 10 minutes to Huakang First Kindergarten. Quite a few parents had already gathered at the school gate, and she greeted Teacher Han Mei, whom she knew well. After picking up her daughter Ma Yuxin, the little girl threw herself into her arms and chattered, "Mommy, you're back!" On the way home, the mother and daughter stopped by the Jingbai Supermarket at the entrance of the residential complex and bought a bottle of soy sauce. After getting home, Ma Xiulan let her daughter watch cartoons in the living room and went into the kitchen to start preparing dinner: she blanched the pork ribs bought from the vegetable market and washed a handful of green vegetables, planning to make sweet-and-sour pork ribs and garlic greens for dinner. Around 17:20, her husband Ma Zhiqiang came back from the courtyard with their second son Ma Mingzhe. As soon as Ma Mingzhe entered, he shouted, "Mom! You're back!" At 18:00, the eldest son Ma Mingxuan came home from school. The whole family sat around the dining table, and Ma Xiulan served the freshly cooked sweet-and-sour pork ribs, garlic greens, and steaming rice. During the meal, she briefly talked about what she had seen and heard in Renqiu, and the children were very interested in the pear-syrup candy. Ma Zhiqiang said, "While you were away these two days, the house was peaceful, and the kids were well-behaved."
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Cleaning up after meals and community computer training class
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan quickly washed the dishes and wiped down the stove. She went back to her room, changed into a thicker down vest, and picked up her notebook and power bank for the community computer training class, then said to her husband in the living room, "I'm going to class; keep an eye on the kids." Ma Zhiqiang answered, "Got it, take your time on the way." At 19:00, she walked for five minutes and arrived on time at the computer classroom on the second floor of the community activity center. This class was the last session of the training course, and the teacher focused on reviewing Word formatting (including paragraph alignment, bullet points, and inserting pictures) and basic Excel formulas (SUM, AVERAGE, and IF functions). Ma Xiulan listened with special attention, because she had indeed missed the hands-on practice in the previous two classes due to family matters. When the teacher asked everyone to independently complete an exercise titled "Family Monthly Income and Expense Sheet," she proactively raised her hand and asked the teacher how to apply the "IF function" in the "Over Budget" column. The teacher came over, guided her through the operation step by step, and praised her: "Sister Ma, you take the most careful notes!"
location: China, Tianjin, Jinghai District, Jingwen Road, Jingwen Community Activity Room, second-floor computer classroom.

name: After-school computer practice and tutoring the second son's homework
description: Class ended at 20:30, and Ma Xiulan walked home quickly. When she got back, she saw that her husband had already washed up their daughter and was helping their older son with homework. She didn't rest. She first sat down at the old computer in the living room and, strictly following the steps the teacher had taught, practiced making three different Excel spreadsheets (a home electricity bill registration form, a children's grades tracking table, and a detailed record of this month's family expenses). Then she used Word to format a directory of her own embroidery works. Half an hour later, she called over her second son Ma Mingzhe, who had been playing with modeling clay nearby, took out his math textbook, and had him complete five after-school practice problems about area. She also corrected one mistake he had made out of carelessness.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Evening stretching and mugwort foot soak
description: After tutoring the children, Ma Xiulan urged them to wash up and go to bed quickly. Once they were all settled, she did a full-body stretching routine seriously again on the bedroom floor, focusing on her lower back. After that, she went to the bathroom, filled a basin with hot water, took a bit of the mugwort ginger slices she had brought back from Aunt Wu's house during the day, threw them into the water, and soaked her feet comfortably for 20 minutes. She felt the day's fatigue gradually dissolve in the hot water and the aroma of mugwort.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Record expenses and go to bed.
description: After soaking her feet, Ma Xiulan picked up the ledger on the bedside table and recorded the day's expenses: 28 yuan for chili peppers and Sichuan peppercorns at the Renqiu morning market, and 6.5 yuan for soy sauce on the way home. She made a point of entering "Aunt Wu gave pear-syrup candy" and "taught new embroidery stitch" under the "social gifts" and "learning investment" notes in the sideline income section. After recording, she glanced at her phone—it was almost 11 o'clock. She gently nudged her husband Ma Zhiqiang, who was already softly snoring, turned off the light and lay down, mentally planning how to deal with the chili peppers she would bring back from Renqiu tomorrow and preparing the embroidery pieces she would bring to the community craft salon on Friday the day after tomorrow. Soon she fell into a deep sleep with reassuring thoughts.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Morning preparation and breakfast
description: Woke up naturally at 5:30 in the morning, gently moved her stiff lower back in bed, then got out of bed quietly so as not to wake her husband Zhiqiang. On the bedroom floor, she did shoulder-and-neck stretches and waist twists, feeling her joints and muscles loosen up. Then she went to the kitchen, rinsed rice and cooked multigrain porridge, sliced steamed buns, and took out pickled radish from the pickle jar. After the porridge was cooking, she woke the three children in turn: first she helped Yuxin, who is in kindergarten, get dressed, then urged Zhezhe, a fifth-grader, and Xuanxuan, a second-year middle school student, to get up and wash up. Once the children sat at the table, she filled each bowl with porridge, urged them to finish quickly, and made sure their schoolbags were packed by 7:00.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Taking the children to school and exercising in the courtyard.
description: Putting on her cotton-padded coat, she rode her e-bike to send Yuxin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten. At the gate she greeted Teacher Han Mei and watched the child go inside. Then she rode to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School and watched Zhezhe walk through the school gate. On the way back, she passed the small courtyard beside Jingwen Road. Seeing that the weather was fine, she walked briskly in the open space for 10 minutes until her back felt slightly warm, then went home.
location: Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jingwen Road Courtyard

name: Practicing Baduanjin and cleaning the kitchen
description: After returning home, she laid out a mat in the living room and did a full set of Baduanjin. The movements were smoother than a few days ago, but when finishing the "Shake the Head and Wag the Tail to Clear Heart Fire" move, she didn't stand steadily enough, so she made a mental note to add extra practice in the evening. After practicing, she put the breakfast dishes and chopsticks into the sink, wiped down the stove, and checked the kitchen. The chili peppers and Sichuan peppercorns were still in the basket, and she decided to deal with them after returning from the morning course.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Organized training notes and prepared for a speech.
description: Sitting on the living room sofa, she read through the training notes she had flipped through last night again, underlining the key points with a pen. In her mind, she silently rehearsed the speech she would give as the outstanding trainee representative. Starting with "I am a housewife. Five weeks ago, I didn't even know how to use Excel to sum numbers," it went smoothly. She also set up a quick action on her phone to send a photo of her completion certificate to Chunmei.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Go to the community classroom and attend the completion ceremony
description: At 8:45, she put on her dark blue coat, picked up her notebook and pen, and walked from home to the Jingwen Road Community Comprehensive Service Center, taking about 15 minutes. Passing the entrance of Wutong Commune Food Market, she glanced at the tofu stall. She arrived promptly at 9:00 in the multi-function classroom on the second floor for the completion ceremony of the computer training course. After the subdistrict director gave a speech and awarded certificates, Ma Xiulan spoke as the representative of outstanding trainees. Her voice was slightly tense but fluent. When she mentioned using Excel to make a household income and expenditure table, she received applause. After the ceremony, holding the completion certificate, she felt grounded and warm.
location: Multifunctional classroom, 2nd floor, Jingwen Road Community Comprehensive Service Center, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Actual computer use: entering ledger data and designing labels
description: After the ceremony, she requested permission to use the computer classroom on the second floor, opened Excel, and entered the data from her handwritten cost records for the pickled vegetable ingredients. She used the SUM formula to calculate the annual sales revenue and net profit of 1,680 yuan, checked it against Chunmei's notebook, took a screenshot, and saved it to a USB drive. Then she opened Word, inserted her own hand-drawn chili pepper and ruyi patterns as taught in class, and designed a label with black text reading 'Xiulan Pickled Vegetables' on a red background, stating the production date as December 4, 2025 and a shelf life of 6 months at room temperature. She printed 20 labels in a row.
location: Computer classroom on the second floor of the Jingwen Road Community Comprehensive Service Center, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Buy groceries on the way home and prepare lunch
description: At 11:35, she left the community center and made a detour to the Wutong Commune vegetable market, where she bought two pieces of tender tofu, a bunch of spinach, and a few garlic sprouts. Aunt Sun Guifang saw her holding a red booklet; she smiled and showed her completion certificate, and was praised for learning a skill. After carrying the groceries home, she took yesterday's leftover braised pork and shredded potatoes out of the refrigerator and heated them up, and stir-fried a plate of garlic sprout and tofu. Her husband, Zhiqiang, was already seated waiting for the meal. As she set out the bowls and chopsticks, she talked about the completion ceremony, and Zhiqiang smiled and responded.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin; home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Noon break
description: After the meal, she cleared away the dishes and chopsticks, felt drowsy, and lay in bed with a 45-minute alarm set. Since she hadn't slept soundly the night before because she was worried about her speech draft, she fell asleep quickly as soon as her eyes closed.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Organize all the training materials.
description: After waking up, her mood improved. She spread all the handouts, class notes, and printed materials from the past five weeks on the coffee table and sorted them into three categories: "Basic Operations," "Word," and "Excel." She used a new notebook to recopy the notes, recalling key points while writing, then put colored sticky labels—red, blue, and green—on them for classification and placed them into folders. Zhiqiang passed by and joked that she looked like she was preparing for the college entrance exam.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Handling the chili peppers brought back from Renqiu
description: The dried chilies and Sichuan peppercorns were still in plastic bags. She sat on a small stool in the kitchen to sort through the chilies, setting aside the good ones for drying or making chili sauce and discarding the ones with insect holes. She sifted the peppercorns to remove ash, put half into an airtight jar, and prepared to grind the other half. She washed the fresh chilies for the chili sauce, drained them, and placed them in a bamboo basket to dry, planning to make it in the next day or two.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the child from school and arrange homework.
description: At 4:05 p.m., she rode her electric bike out, first went to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up Yuxin, then, holding her little daughter's hand, went on to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School. After waiting for Zhezhe to come out of school, she stopped at a small shop on the way to buy a bottle of soy sauce and vinegar. On the way, Zhezhe said he felt good about the math quiz. After getting home, she had Zhezhe do his homework in the living room while Yuxin played with modeling clay nearby. She tied on an apron and began preparing dinner: washing the ribs, blanching them, rinsing the rice, and steaming it.
location: Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin; home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Prepare dinner
description: Heat oil in the wok, add rock sugar and stir-fry to make caramel color, add the blanched ribs and stir-fry until evenly colored, then add cooking wine, light soy sauce, ginger slices, and hot water, and turn down to a simmer. While the ribs are simmering, wash the spinach and greens, and beat two eggs. Zhiqiang checked Zhezhe's math exercise book and came over to help look after Yuxin. After the ribs have simmered for twenty minutes, uncover the pot and reduce the sauce, sprinkle with white sesame seeds and plate. Then rinse the wok and quickly stir-fry the vegetables, and make a bowl of seaweed egg drop soup. By the time the dishes were on the table, Xuanxuan had also come home from school and washed his hands.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner
description: The whole family sat down to eat. Ma Xiulan served herself half a bowl of rice and talked about the completion of the course while eating. Yuxin asked in a baby voice whether Mom wouldn't have to do homework after graduating, which made everyone laugh. Zhezhe shared his math quiz, while Xuanxuan kept his head down eating and occasionally responded. Zhiqiang said he would take a long-distance trip to Shandong next week, and Ma Xiulan told him to bring thick clothes.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Clear the dining table and urge the children to wash up
description: After eating, she had Xuanxuan and Zhezhe finish their remaining homework before washing up, while she cleared the dishes and took them to the kitchen to wash and wipe down the stove. Zhiqiang took Yuxin to the bathroom to wash her face and brush her teeth. By the time the kitchen was cleaned, all three children had finished washing up, and Yuxin, in her pajamas, was waiting in the living room.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: In the evening, practiced Baduanjin as extra training and recorded it
description: In preparation for the community New Year's Day performance, she planned to practice Baduanjin extra in the evening. She had Zhiqiang record with his phone and performed a full routine in the living room. When reviewing the video, she noticed that the latter half of "Sway the Head and Tail to Remove Heart Fire" was unsteady, so she decided to practice that move twice more to correct it. Zhiqiang smiled and said it already looked steady enough.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Completion of family reading and sharing
description: The family followed their habit and read quietly for half an hour. Xuanxuan read "Twenty Thousand Leagues Under the Sea," Zhezhe reviewed his Chinese textbook, and Yuxin flipped through a picture book on the coffee table. Ma Xiulan sat on the sofa reviewing Word table formatting on her phone and took notes. After reading, she used her phone to select photos of the completion certificate and a selfie with the certificate, then sent them to her childhood friend Liu Chunmei: "I got the certificate! Thank you for always encouraging me." She also sent them to her sister Ma Xiufen with the added line "I finished my course today!" The two replied quickly—Chunmei sent a thumbs-up and a happy emoji, and Xiufen said they would talk in detail on the weekend.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Helping with homework in the evening and putting the kids to sleep
description: Putting down her phone, she went into Zhezhe's room. Seeing him biting the end of his pen while doing fraction word problems, she sat down and used scratch paper to draw line segment diagrams, explaining step by step. After two problems, Zhezhe nodded and redid them correctly by himself, and was praised. Then she went to take a look outside Xuanxuan's door; he had already finished his homework and was reading an extracurricular book. Afterward, she helped the sleepy Yuxin into her sleep sack, sat by the bed, gently patted her, and hummed a lullaby. Yuxin fell asleep in less than ten minutes. After quietly closing the door, she returned to the master bedroom, boiled hot water, and added dried mugwort and ginger to a basin to soak her feet, while recording the day's expenses on her phone memo: tofu, 2 pieces for 4 yuan; spinach and garlic sprouts, 8 yuan in total; soy sauce and vinegar, 9.5 yuan in total.
location: Jinghai District, Tianjin, 156 Jingwen Road, children's bedroom and master bedroom at home

name: Before-bed expense tracking, stretching, and going to sleep
description: After soaking her feet and drying them, she sat down at the small desk, first recorded the day's expenses, then turned to a new page and wrote down her course-completion reflections: "December 4, 2025. The computer training class concluded. From the first class on October 29 to today, I didn't miss one session in five weeks, and I finally got my certificate of completion. At the meeting, I spoke as a representative of outstanding trainees, and I didn't say anything wrong. I entered the whole year's pickle accounts in Excel, and I also came up with the new label design. It may not be a big deal, but it feels solid." She closed the notebook, stood up, and did five minutes of lower-back stretching and shoulder joint exercises. Zhiqiang was half-reclining at the head of the bed looking at his phone. The two chatted about how next week, when he took the truck out and passed Dezhou, he would bring back some braised chicken. She said tomorrow, Friday, she would go to the community handicraft salon and bring her crochet samples. She also sent her mother a voice message: "Mom, the computer class ended today, and I got the certificate. I'll have time to go see you this weekend." At 10:45 p.m., she turned off the light and fell into a deep sleep with a smile at the corner of her mouth.
location: Master bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Getting up and morning routine
description: At dawn, the alarm went off right on time. I got up quietly and put on a thick cotton-padded jacket. After a quick wash, I did 10 minutes of shoulder and neck stretches and marching in place on the balcony. I needed to have a fasting physical exam today, so I held back from practicing Baduanjin for fear of low blood sugar. Afterward, I checked the children’s thermos bottles and filled them with warm water.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, home bedroom and balcony

name: Wake children, breakfast, and school run
description: At 6:20, I opened the children's bedroom door and gently woke Zhe Zhe and Xin Xin. I urged them to get dressed and wash up. I gave each of them two slices of bread and a carton of milk, and I myself drank a few sips of warm water. At exactly 7:00, the three of us left. I got on the electric bike, first taking Xin Xin, and arrived at the gate of Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten at 7:10, watching her skip inside. Then I turned the bike around and took Zhe Zhe to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School at 7:20, reminding him that his lunch was packed.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin; and Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Annual health checkup
description: After seeing ZheZhe off, I parked my electric bike at the non-motorized vehicle parking spot near the school, then walked to the health checkup center, arriving at the Jinghai District Chaoyang Street Community Health Service Center in about 10 minutes. Following the instructions, I went through the blood draw, ultrasound, and electrocardiogram one by one. Because I was worried, I also paid out of pocket for a gynecological exam. After the preliminary results came out, Dr. Wang Jianguo smiled and said to me, "Sister Ma, you have a really good constitution; your bone density and blood sugar are normal, and your BMI is normal." He told me to come back in two days to get the official report. I felt very reassured.
location: Rear courtyard of the Jinghai Grain Bureau, 16 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (Chaoyang Street Community Health Service Center, Jinghai District).

name: Replenishing energy and shopping
description: After leaving the hospital, my stomach was indeed empty. At a roadside breakfast stall, I bought a cup of hot soy milk and two pork-and-scallion buns, and ate them right there on the street. They were warm and comforting, and my stomach felt much better. Then I walked to the nearby Jingbai Supermarket, bought some day lily buds and wood ear mushrooms for the noodle soup with gravy I planned to make that evening, and also picked up a box of cookies for the children.
location: Breakfast stall near Chaoyang Street Community Health Service Center, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and Jingbai Supermarket, Unit 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu, Jinghai District

name: Household chores and midday rest
description: After arriving home, I put the dirty clothes that had been soaking overnight (mainly the children's tracksuits and my coat) into the washing machine and washed them, then hung them in the yard to dry. Next, I picked up a broom and swept the floor of the main room and the bedroom, then mopped it. When I finished, I saw it was almost 11 o'clock, so I sat on the sofa in the living room and rested for a while, drinking half a glass of warm water. My waist felt a bit sore. Then I leaned against the bed and rested with my eyes closed for half an hour, casually flipping through a craft magazine on the bedside table and planning which new pattern to make one day.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Picking up children, lunch, and afternoon preparation
description: At 11:30 I went out on my electric bike to pick up Zhezhe from the No. 3 Primary School of Jinghai District. At 11:50 I picked up Xinxin from Huakang First Kindergarten. When we got home, the children said they were hungry, so I made two bowls of noodles in hot soup for them, each with a poached egg, and cooked some fine dried noodles for myself, eating them with pickled radish strips. After the meal, I urged Zhezhe to do his homework and told the children we would go to Grandma's house to help in the afternoon. After clearing away the dishes, I changed into a thicker cotton-padded jacket and put hats and gloves on the children. My lower back still felt a bit sore, so I did a few simple cat stretches in the living room, which relieved it a little, and then got ready to set out with the children for my parents' home.
location: Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin; home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Helping make pickled cabbage at my parents' home
description: At 1:30 in the afternoon, I rode my electric bike with Zhezhe and Xinxin to my parents' home. Mom had already washed and drained the several dozen heads of Chinese cabbage she had bought this year. I quickly rolled up my sleeves to help, neatly stacking the cabbages into the big vat, with a layer of coarse salt after every layer of cabbage. Dad was beside me fixing a small stool with a loose leg. Mom and I chatted while working, and I told her about the idea for improving the chili sauce that I had learned from Aunt Wu. Mom suggested adding some locally ground sesame oil, saying it would make the taste especially rich. The two children were playing in the yard with the neighbor's little native dog, extremely happy.
location: Parents' home on Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Returned home and prepared dinner.
description: At 4:30, we came back from Mom and Dad's house. As soon as we got home, the children shouted that they wanted noodles with gravy. I immediately tied on an apron, diced the pork belly, washed and cut the soaked day lily buds and wood ear mushrooms, and beat two eggs. I heated oil in the wok, and in no time a pot of fragrant gravy was ready. After cooking the noodles, I filled a big bowl for everyone. While we were eating, Ma Zhiqiang called and said he was still out driving tonight and wouldn't come back, so I told him to be safe.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Making hair flowers in the evening
description: After clearing away the dishes, the sky had grown dark. I sat by the living room window, turned on the desk lamp, and took out the colorful fabric scraps and cotton thread I had brought back from the garment factory last time. I carefully recalled the new stitching technique I learned from Aunt Wu in Renqiu last week, and made three children's hair flowers with pom-poms. My younger daughter Xinxin saw them and ran over excitedly to try them on. She looked at herself in the little mirror from every angle and kept saying Mom made them so pretty. I promised her that when we go to the market on the weekend, we would give one to Liu Chunmei's granddaughter as a small gift.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Computer bookkeeping and skill practice
description: After finishing up the handicraft work, I turned on that old computer. Practicing for 20 minutes every evening has become a habit. I skillfully opened Excel and entered, item by item, the money for today's physical examination registration, the money for buying noodles and vegetables, and the small expense for buying fabric scraps, updating the family monthly expenditure sheet. Seeing the numbers neatly arranged in the spreadsheet, I felt quite pleased with myself; this computer isn't that hard to learn.
location: Study at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Washing up, parent-child time, and evening relaxation
description: I turned off the computer and urged the two children to go wash up and brush their teeth. Xinxin was very excited today and sang me the song she had learned in kindergarten again before bedtime. After they had both fallen asleep, I took a hot shower, then sat on the edge of the bed and soaked my feet in the foot bath basin for a good 20 minutes. Afterward, I did a few minutes of gentle lower-back stretches and took several deep breaths, and the fatigue of the day seemed to melt away.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and falling asleep.
description: After everything was tidied up, I drew the curtains, turned off the light, and lay down. My mind reviewed the day's events like a movie: the physical exam went smoothly, the pickled cabbage was salted, and the new-style hair flowers were finished. I felt especially at peace. Before long, I fell into a deep sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Morning Baduanjin Exercise in the Community
description: After getting up at 6:30 in the morning, Ma Xiulan put on her exercise clothes and went to the central garden of the residential complex. Together with her neighbors Liu Chunmei and Zhang Shufen, she did a full set of Baduanjin twice. She specially asked Liu Chunmei to help correct her hip-relaxing movement in "Shake Head and Wag Tail to Remove Heart Fire." Neighbor Wang Guilan passed by and joined in with great interest. After morning exercise, she felt her body relaxed and the stiffness in her lower back relieved.
location: Okay, I'll prepare a list for you: 1) Main ingredients: seasonal vegetables such as cucumber, radish, and green beans, 10 jin each; 2) Supporting ingredients: 3 jin coarse salt, 5 jin sweet bean paste, 2 jin soy sauce, 1 jin sugar, and appropriate amounts of star anise, Sichuan pepper, and other spices; 3) Tools: 2 large earthenware jars, bamboo drying trays, and several sealed jars. It is recommended to complete the shopping before July 10, wash, cut, and dry the vegetables on July 11-13, and do the pickling all at once on July 14. For the division of work, Zhou Xiuqin is responsible for overall coordination and sun-drying the vegetables, Wang Guilan is responsible for washing, cutting, and boiling the seasoning liquid, and you are responsible for seasoning and filling the jars. If the weather is clear, you can dry them outdoors in the open; if it rains, dry them indoors with ventilation. The budget is about 200 yuan. You can first make a 5-jin trial batch to test the flavor.

name: Wake up the children, prepare breakfast, and have family breakfast
description: After her morning exercise, Ma Xiulan returned home. She first washed the millet and put it on to cook millet porridge, then woke the three children—Ma Mingxuan, Ma Mingzhe, and Ma Yuxin—and affectionately coaxed the youngest daughter Ma Yuxin, who was reluctant to get up. She baked scallion pancakes in the electric griddle, sliced the pickled cabbage she had brought back from her mother's, and served it with homemade chili oil. The family sat around the table for breakfast, chatting as they ate. Ma Xiulan asked the eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, about his boarding school studies, and told the two younger ones to take part in the big clean-up in the morning.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Household deep cleaning
description: After breakfast, the whole family started a thorough cleaning. Ma Xiulan was responsible for wiping the high windows and organizing the kitchen cabinets, sweeping up dead leaves in the yard, and watering the scallions and spinach in the small vegetable garden. Her eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, mopped the living room and stairs with a wet mop, tied up the accumulated waste cardboard boxes and old newspapers, and took them to a recycling station at the intersection of Jingwen Road and Chaoyang Road outside the neighborhood, selling them for 8 yuan as his own labor income. Afterwards, he helped move the sofa to clean the dust underneath. The younger son, Ma Mingzhe, and the younger daughter, Ma Yuxin, each used a cloth to wipe the lower cabinet doors and wall bases. In the middle of the cleaning, Ma Xiulan also hung the thick seasonal quilts on the balcony, tidied the children's wardrobes, and picked out clothes that her daughter had outgrown to set aside for later use.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing noodles with thick gravy and lunch for the whole family
description: After the big cleaning came to an end, Ma Xiulan rested a bit and then went into the kitchen to prepare lunch. She soaked dried day lily flowers and wood ear mushrooms, diced pork belly, stir-fried the gravy and thickened it with starch, cooked hand-rolled noodles, and rinsed them in cold water. The three children ladled the gravy over their own noodles, added garlic and vinegar, and paired them with the leftover pickled cabbage from the previous day. The whole family ate to their satisfaction. Her second son, Ma Mingzhe, had two bowls, and her eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, and daughter Ma Yuxin also had hearty appetites.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Lunch break and pockets of free time
description: After lunch, the children each went back to their rooms. Ma Xiulan rested against a pillow on the living room sofa for about half an hour. She then opened her phone, browsed the stitching technique videos shared by Aunt Wu and Zhou Xiuqin in the handicraft group to learn, and checked what documents were needed to pick up the physical examination report at the community health service center tomorrow, preparing for the next day's trip.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Base draft for the embroidery order 'Blossoms of Wealth and Honor'
description: After the afternoon nap, Ma Xiulan took her embroidery fabric, embroidery hoop, pencil, and other tools to the bright window in the living room and began sketching the draft for a customer order, Blossoms of Fortune. She first lightly drew blooming peony heads, winding branches, and fluttering butterflies with the pencil. Her youngest son, Ma Mingzhe, curiously came over to watch, and she patiently taught him the meaning of the pattern. After two hours of repeated revisions, the draft was finalized with a well-balanced composition, and she was very satisfied.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing and cooking dinner
description: After finalizing the embroidery, Ma Xiulan stood up to stretch her neck, shoulders, and wrists, then went into the kitchen to prepare dinner. She took the ribs out of the fridge to thaw, washed and cut the green peppers and potatoes, and mixed the leftover pickled cabbage with sesame oil before putting it into a glass jar. After blanching the ribs, she stir-fried them in caramelized sugar, then added scallions, ginger, star anise, and braised them. When the ribs were tender, she added the potato chunks and green pepper slices and reduced the sauce over high heat, while cooking rice. The kitchen was filled with the aroma of meat.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner and cleanup
description: At dinner, braised pork ribs, shredded potatoes with green peppers, and mixed pickled cabbage were served. The children scrambled to pick up food, and daughter Ma Yuxin ate until her mouth was covered in oil. While eating, Ma Xiulan chatted with her eldest son Ma Mingxuan, who had come back from boarding school, about his life at school and how he got along with his roommates. After the meal, Ma Mingxuan helped clear the dishes and chopsticks, and Ma Xiulan washed the dishes and wiped down the stove.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Had a video call with her husband.
description: After tidying up the kitchen, Ma Xiulan used her phone in the living room to video-call her husband Ma Zhiqiang, who was out on a long-distance drive. Seeing him eating instant noodles at a service area, she told him with concern to go to a restaurant and have a hot meal in the cold weather. She gave him a brief report on the day's thorough cleaning and the children, urged him to be safe and get to bed early, and after a short exchange the couple hung up.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Household bookkeeping and budget checking
description: After hanging up, Ma Xiulan took out her old ledger and calculator at the desk in the bedroom. Comparing with the spending records on her phone, she registered and totaled this week's expenses one by one, including groceries, daily necessities, and allowance for the children. Then she checked the education savings accumulated over the previous months and confirmed that the 150 yuan for December had been deposited on time. Finally, in the remarks column of the ledger, she noted a reminder to persuade her husband to smoke less and keep his cigarette spending within 10 yuan per day.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Arranging to go to the market with neighbor Liu Chunmei via WeChat
description: After finishing the accounts, Ma Xiulan contacted neighbor Liu Chunmei on WeChat and asked whether the child liked the hair flower she had given to Liu Chunmei's granddaughter, and got a positive reply. Then she invited Liu Chunmei to go to the market together next Saturday, planning to bring several of her embroidery pieces to set up a stall and sell them, and asked Chunmei to help watch the stall. Liu Chunmei readily agreed and said she happened to want to buy Spring Festival window grilles. The two agreed to meet at the community gate at eight in the morning.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening extra Baduanjin practice and whole-family stretching
description: After chatting with Chunmei, Ma Xiulan felt some soreness in her back and waist again, so she played Baduanjin music on her phone and, facing the full-length mirror in the master bedroom, practiced movements such as "two hands climbing the feet to strengthen the kidneys and waist" with extra focus. After practicing until her body warmed up, she called the three children, who were watching TV, to do a 10-minute group stretching exercise, and demonstrated the cat stretch to teach her daughter Ma Yuxin. The children cooperated actively.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Urge children to wash up and coax daughter to sleep.
description: After stretching, Ma Xiulan urged the three children to wash up one by one. She personally helped her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin brush her teeth and wash her face, changed her into pajamas, and carried her to the small bed. At her daughter's request, she hummed “Little Swallow” to soothe her to sleep until the child quietly fell asleep. The two sons washed up by themselves and returned to their respective rooms.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Personal relaxation and handicraft learning.
description: After the children fell asleep, the house became completely quiet. Ma Xiulan soaked her feet for twenty minutes in warm water mixed with a mugwort pack to relieve the discomfort in her lower back. Meanwhile, leaning on the sofa, she scrolled through the handicraft group, studied the fine technique of splitting silk threads for Suzhou embroidery shared by Aunt Wu, browsed the works of sisters in the group, and mentally planned which proud embroidered pieces to bring to next week's market.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: After soaking her feet, Ma Xiulan dried herself off, changed into pajamas, first went to her daughter's room to check on her and tuck in the blanket corners, then returned to the master bedroom, turned off the light, and lay down. She briefly reviewed the day in her mind: morning exercise, spring cleaning, finalizing the embroidery design, keeping accounts, and connecting with her husband and neighbors. Everything had been completed in an orderly manner, and she felt at ease. Thinking that the next day she needed to pick up her physical examination report and ask about her waist problem, she gradually fell asleep in the quiet, and the light went out around 11:15 at night.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Getting up, washing up, and preparing household chores.
description: The morning alarm rang. After getting up, Ma Xiulan washed up briefly, put the millet that had been soaking overnight into a pot and simmered porridge over low heat, and at the same time plugged in the electric griddle to make scallion pancakes. During the spare time while the porridge was cooking, she tidied up the children's jackets and picture books scattered on the living room sofa and swept the dust off the floor with a broom.
location: Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Community morning exercise and picking up physical examination reports
description: Ma Xiulan changed into her sports shoes, took her medical insurance card, and walked to the community garden, where she practiced Baduanjin for thirty minutes with her neighbors Liu Chunmei and Zhang Shufen, feeling relaxed and refreshed afterward. She then went to the nearby Chaoyang Street Community Health Service Center and picked up her physical examination report from Dr. Wang, who was on the early shift. She learned that her blood pressure was normal, her blood lipids were stable, and the indicator for mild anemia had improved—overall, her health condition was good. She immediately took a photo with her phone and sent it to her husband Ma Zhiqiang, who was driving long-distance in another city, and also sent a voice message to her mother Li Xiuying to share the good news.
location: The community garden near No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and the Chaoyang Street Community Health Service Center at No. 16 Jingwen Road

name: Shopping at the vegetable market and chatting with old friends
description: Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market and went straight to her old friend Sun Guifang's vegetable stall. She shared the good news from her physical examination report with Sun Guifang and picked out spinach, iron stick yam, live crucian carp, and five jin of apples, planning to make yam and crucian carp soup and dried apples. Sun Guifang gave her a discount as a regular customer, and she also bought seasonings such as scallions, ginger, and garlic.

participant.name: Sun Guifang
participant.relation: Evening walk and chatting with neighbors.

location: Wutong Community Vegetable Market, Diwei Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Calling my mother to tell her I'm safe on the way home
description: Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike home along Jingwen Road, with the vegetable basket hanging on the handlebars. On the way, she stopped at the intersection of Jingwen Road, called her mother Li Xiuying again, and relayed in detail Dr. Wang's analysis of the physical examination results. Her mother breathed a sigh of relief on the phone and told her to take care of her health and eat well. Ma Xiulan promised to visit her mother next Monday with Chinese yams and help take apart and wash the quilts.
location: Along Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Return home to prepare food and spend time with the children.
description: Ma Xiulan returned home, put the ingredients away neatly, and began to prepare the crucian carp: scaling it, gutting it, and marinating it with cooking wine and ginger slices. She peeled the Chinese yam, cut it into segments, and soaked it in water to prevent oxidation. Her three-year-old daughter Ma Yuxin woke up and came to the kitchen clutching a teddy bear. Ma Xiulan gave her a small basin and some spinach to practice trimming the vegetables, while she took the opportunity to put the dirty laundry into the washing machine.
location: Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Prepare lunch and guide the eldest son in his studies
description: The washing machine kept running. Ma Xiulan stewed Chinese yam and crucian carp soup in the kitchen, simmering it slowly over low heat until the soup turned gradually white and fragrant. While stir-frying greens, she heard movement from her eldest son Ma Mingxuan's room, so she asked him to bring his math homework for checking. For a difficult geometry problem, although she was not familiar with the formula, she explained it using everyday analogies of cutting tofu and patching holes. Ma Mingxuan suddenly understood and went back to his room to continue calculating.
location: China, Tianjin Jinghai District, No. 156 Jingwen Road, home kitchen

name: Family lunch
description: The yam and crucian carp soup was simmered until milky white, sprinkled with chopped scallions, and served with stir-fried greens and yesterday's pickled cabbage stir-fried with vermicelli. A hearty lunch was ready. The family of four sat around the table. Ma Xiulan ladled soup for each child and laughingly called it "champion soup" to nourish the body. Her second son, Ma Mingzhe, drank two bowls; her youngest daughter, Ma Yuxin, clumsily scooped up the yam; her eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, who seldom praised, said the soup was delicious. The home was filled with warmth.
location: Dining room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Midday cleaning and rest
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan urged the children to clear the dishes and chopsticks into the kitchen, while she quickly wiped the table, scrubbed the pots, and cleaned the stove. Then she took the washed clothes out of the washing machine and hung them in the courtyard to dry. Feeling tired after all the work, she set a half-hour alarm and took a nap on the bed in the bedroom to regain her energy.
location: Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Parent-child handicrafts and stitch practice
description: After her midday rest, Ma Xiulan felt refreshed and energized. She took out her sewing basket containing fabric scraps, needles and thread, and a crochet hook. She taught her younger daughter Ma Yuxin, hand over hand, how to thread a needle and sew a simple coin purse. Though the girl's stitches were crooked, she learned earnestly. Seven-year-old Ma Mingzhe was building with LEGO bricks on the carpet. Seeing her daughter gradually get the hang of it, Ma Xiulan took out the crochet hook and yarn that Aunt Wu had given her and practiced the basic single crochet stitch. After repeatedly unraveling and reworking it, she finally crocheted a lopsided round coaster and felt a great sense of accomplishment.
location: Home living room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Evening walk and chatting with neighbors
description: At four in the afternoon, the sun was warm. Ma Xiulan put on jackets for the children, and the family went out for a walk eastward along Jingwen Road. On the way, they met neighbor Zhang Shufen with her little grandson, so the children went together to the community square and played on scooters, full of laughter. Ma Xiulan chatted with Zhang Shufen on a bench. Zhang Shufen suggested that at the community New Year's Day party, the sisters who practice Baduanjin every day could perform on stage together. Ma Xiulan smiled, agreed, and promised to practice.
location: The area along Jingwen Road in Jinghai District, Tianjin, and the community square near No. 156 Jingwen Road.

name: Prepare and enjoy dinner
description: After returning from a walk, Ma Xiulan reheated the leftover crucian carp soup from lunch and cooked a big pot of hot noodle soup, stir-frying shredded pork, cabbage, and shiitake mushrooms into a rich sauce. At dinner, her eldest son Ma Mingxuan shared funny stories from school and imitated his deskmate's tone, making the whole family laugh until they rocked back and forth. Even the little daughter joined in, and the atmosphere was warm and happy.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Supervising homework and family entertainment
description: After clearing the dishes, Ma Xiulan urged Ma Mingxuan, who had returned from boarding school, to finish his English homework and signed to confirm it. Then she helped her younger daughter Ma Yuxin recognize a few character flashcards, and played two games of Gomoku with her second son Ma Mingzhe. The children were playing boisterously in the living room; although it was a bit noisy, Ma Xiulan felt grounded watching them.
location: Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Computer skills practice.
description: The children were playing on their own. Ma Xiulan went to the study, opened the old laptop, created a new Word document, and slowly typed out the recipe for the "low-fat yam crucian carp soup" she had made that day, entering everything in detail from ingredient preparation to cooking steps. Watching the lines of text appear on the screen, she felt she was also keeping up with the times.
location: Home study, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Back and waist stretches and pre-bedtime preparation
description: After leaving the study, Ma Xiulan felt soreness in her lower back, so she did ten minutes of back and waist stretches on the bed to relax her muscles. Then she boiled water and soaked her feet for twenty minutes. During that time she checked her phone and saw her husband Ma Zhiqiang's reply of "Fine," and her heart felt warm.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Washed up and went to bed
description: Ma Xiulan urged the three children to wash up and change into pajamas. Her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin pestered her to tell the story of Little Red Riding Hood before she would close her eyes. After all the children were asleep, she washed up herself and lay down, recalling the day: the physical examination report went smoothly, the children were well-behaved, and her hand-stitching skills had also shown results. She felt solid and satisfied, and soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Got up early to wash up and prepare breakfast.
description: Ma Xiulan got up at six in the morning, washed up quickly, and went to the kitchen to prepare breakfast for the family. She took out the steamed buns and seasoned pork filling made the night before, cooked millet and pumpkin porridge, fried four eggs, and sliced a plate of pickled cucumbers. Thinking that her husband could come home a bit earlier from work tonight, she was in a good mood and prepared everything especially efficiently.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, her own kitchen

name: Wake up the children, prepare breakfast, and take them to school
description: At 6:45, Ma Xiulan woke up her eldest son Ma Mingxuan (a boarding student who was returning to school that day), then woke up her younger son Ma Mingzhe and daughter Ma Yuxin, and braided her daughter's hair. During breakfast, she helped the children eat, put Zhezhe's tug-of-war competition registration fee into the inner compartment of his schoolbag, and packed two cartons of milk for Mingxuan. At 7:20, she walked Ma Mingxuan to the Jingwen Road bus stop at the gate and watched him get on the bus. Then she returned home, took her electric bike, first took Ma Mingzhe to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, then took Ma Yuxin to Huakang First Kindergarten and handed her over to the teacher.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home), Jingwen Road Bus Stop, Jinghai District Third Primary School (Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin), Huakang First Kindergarten (Huakang Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin)

name: Morning Baduanjin exercise, picking up the meat filling, and a call with Mother.
description: After dropping off the children, Ma Xiulan practiced Baduanjin with her neighbors Liu Chunmei and Zhang Shufen in her own small courtyard. She took the lead in leading the exercises. Although she wobbled slightly during "Shake Head and Wag Tail to Remove Heart Fire," the overall routine was smooth. During the break, the three settled on a formation-change plan for the New Year's Day gala performance. At nine o'clock, after morning exercise ended, she rode her electric bike to the Wutong Commune vegetable market to pick up the two jin of ground front-leg pork she had ordered the day before. The stall owner Sun Guifang gave her a small bunch of cilantro. On the way home, she called her mother Li Xiuying, told her that her physical exam results were normal, and agreed to buy some Chinese yam and bring it over tomorrow morning, and to help tidy up the house.
location: Own courtyard at No. 156, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, Wutong Commune vegetable market (inside Wutong Commune residential community, Jinghai District, Tianjin), en route

name: Handle online pickled vegetable orders, send courier packages, and buy ingredients for dinner
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan put on an apron and processed the online pickle orders in the kitchen and the main room. She checked three online orders (from Nankai District, Hexi District, and Beijing's Daxing District), took out radishes, cucumbers, mustard stems, and other vegetables from the pickling jars, packed them into 12 glass jars of pickled vegetables, labeled them with "Jinglan Small Pickles" labels, and packaged them securely with foam boxes and tape. At 10:50, she rode her electric bike to the courier station on Dongfang Commercial Street and delivered three boxes, paying 18 yuan in shipping. She also sent the packing photos to the customer group and confirmed receipt of 120 yuan. Then she stopped by Wutong Commune Vegetable Market on the way and bought two pork ribs, a Chinese cabbage, a bundle of bean starch noodles, and a few scallions for dinner, spending 45 yuan in total.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home), courier station on Dongfang Commercial Street (Dongfang Commercial Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin), Wutong Commune Vegetable Market (inside Wutong Commune Residential Area, Jinghai District, Tianjin)

name: Lunch alone and a midday rest.
description: Around noon, Ma Xiulan was home alone and reheated the leftover porridge for a simple lunch with pickled vegetables and half a steamed bun. While eating, she used the memo app on her phone to jot down the formation-change plan for Baduanjin that she had conceived that morning. At 12:15, she set a 45-minute alarm and lay down in the bedroom for a nap. Though she was thinking about the afternoon's tasks, she forced herself to sleep in order to regain her energy.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: After the midday rest: contacting Zhou Xiuqin, tidying up at home, and doing cross-stitch
description: After waking from her nap, Ma Xiulan first used WeChat voice messages to ask Sister Zhou Xiuqin in the handicraft group about how to prevent glass jars from bumping and breaking during packaging, and learned that bubble columns were more reliable. Then she began cleaning the living room and the main hall, sweeping the floor, wiping the tables, and tidying up the books the children had scattered. Around 2 o'clock, she took out the "Blossoms Bring Riches" cross-stitch and, by the window, embroidered several peony petals while listening to the light music "Health-Preserving Baduanjin".
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin
