name: Tidying the courtyard, working with her son, and preparing ingredients for dinner
description: At three o'clock in the afternoon, Ma Xiulan changed into old shoes and gloves, pruned withered branches in her small courtyard, covered the wintering scallions and spinach with straw mats, and moved the fuchsia into the sunroom. Her son Ma Mingzhe joined after school and used a small shovel to mound soil around the roots of the persimmon tree. After four, she went into the kitchen to start preparing dinner: blanching the pork ribs to remove the foam, cutting the cabbage into pieces, soaking the vermicelli, and chopping scallions and ginger to mix the pork and scallion filling, sealing it with plastic wrap and putting it in the refrigerator to prepare for the next day's baozi.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin — own small courtyard and kitchen

name: Pick up the youngest daughter from school and buy vinegar on the way
description: At 4:30 p.m., Ma Xiulan put on her cotton gloves and rode her electric bike to Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up her daughter Ma Yuxin. When she got the child, Xinxin held up a paper-folded little rabbit and said it was an art class work for her father. On the way back, she stopped at Shufen Supermarket at the intersection of Jingwen Road and Huakang Road, bought a bottle of vinegar, chatted briefly with her friend, the owner Zhang Shufen, and then went home.
location: Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten (Huakang Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin), Shufen Supermarket (intersection of Jingwen Road and Huakang Road)

name: Cooking dinner and having dinner with family.
description: After picking up the children and returning home, Ma Xiulan let Xinxin watch cartoons while she bustled around in the kitchen. She stewed pork ribs, stir-fried sweet-and-sour cabbage and garlic lettuce, and made tomato and egg drop soup. Just after six, her husband Ma Zhiqiang came back from finishing his shift, and the dishes were just coming out of the pan. The family sat around the table for dinner. Xinxin gave the little rabbit to her father, and Ma Zhiqiang grinned from ear to ear. Zhezhe excitedly recounted how his class won the tug-of-war in PE. Ma Xiulan and her husband listened while putting food on the children's plates, creating a warm atmosphere.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Supervise children's homework, washing up, and family leisure
description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan cleared the dishes while her husband Ma Zhiqiang wiped the table. As she washed the dishes, she urged her eldest son Zhezhe to do his homework and asked her husband to tell their daughter a story. After finishing in the kitchen, she checked Zhezhe's math homework, pointed out two wrong problems, and had him redo them. Then she washed Xinxin's face and soaked her feet in hot water, and coaxed her to get ready for bed.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Putting the youngest daughter to sleep and the couple taking a short rest
description: At 8:30, Ma Xiulan told Xinxin, who was lying in bed, the story "Little Horse Crossing the River" until she fell asleep peacefully. After gently closing the door, she returned to the main room and saw her husband Ma Zhiqiang sitting on the sofa, so she made two cups of hot tea and brought them over. The two of them enjoyed a moment of peace.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Couple's year-end financial review.
description: After the children were settled, the couple did their year-end financial accounting at the kitchen table. Ma Xiulan took out the account book, put on her reading glasses, and read out the year's income item by item: handiwork jobs, vegetable garden harvest, and her husband's income from driving, totaling about 42,000 yuan. After expenses, only 3,800 yuan was left. She raised the idea of buying a vacuum sealer next year for the pickled vegetables to expand sales and increase savings. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang was silent for a moment, then held her rough hand and said, "You've worked hard." Ma Xiulan was deeply moved, and she smiled and said that as long as the family was of one heart, it didn't feel hard.
location: At the kitchen table, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pre-sleep stretching and mugwort foot bath.
description: After reviewing the accounts, Ma Xiulan boiled water and prepared a mugwort foot-soaking pack, then sat in the living room to soak her feet. At the same time, she held the back of a chair and did several sets of lower-back stretches to ease the day's fatigue. Her husband had already gone to bed. After soaking her feet, she washed her face and applied Dabao, feeling warm all over.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, main room and bedroom

name: Going to bed
description: At 10:50 p.m., Ma Xiulan changed into her pajamas and lay down quietly; her husband beside her was already snoring. Recalling the busy and fulfilling day, hopes for the family's future welled up, and she soon fell asleep, feeling secure and content.
location: Own bedroom, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning wake-up and exercise.
description: At 6:05 in the morning, Ma Xiulan woke up naturally. First, she slowly moved her stiff neck and shoulders in bed. Feeling that her arms, which were sore from packing pickled vegetables yesterday, had loosened up a bit, she gently threw off the covers and got out of bed. She went to her small courtyard, walked briskly for a few laps, and then did a set of Baduanjin. Her back felt slightly warm, and she felt much more comfortable.
location: Bedroom and small courtyard of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare breakfast and eat breakfast with the family
description: After her morning exercise, Ma Xiulan returned to the kitchen, put on an apron, rinsed the rice and cooked millet porridge, and took out the steamed buns made the night before from the refrigerator to reheat. At 6:45, she went upstairs to wake up her 10-year-old son Ma Mingzhe and 6-year-old daughter Ma Yuxin, helping her sleepy daughter pull on a sweater. After the children washed up, the family of three sat around the table and enjoyed the steaming millet porridge and buns. Ma Mingzhe ate quickly, finishing a bowl of porridge and two buns, while Ma Yuxin ate half a bun.
location: Kitchen and dining room of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Take daughter to kindergarten
description: At 7:30, Ma Xiulan got on her electric bike and took her daughter Ma Yuxin to Huakang First Kindergarten. On the way, she reminded Yuxin: 'Be obedient to the teacher today, take a good nap at noon, and Mom will be the first to pick you up after school.' After arriving at the kindergarten, she took the child to the classroom door and left only after seeing the teacher lead her inside.
location: Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Shopping for ingredients at the market
description: After leaving the kindergarten, Ma Xiulan went on the way to the Wutong Commune vegetable market and headed straight to the stall of her acquaintance Aunt Sun Guifang. Aunt Sun recommended the newly arrived Chinese yam. Ma Xiulan picked two evenly sized sticks, and also bought some spinach and tofu, spending 16 yuan in total.
location: Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Take son to school
description: At 8:10, Ma Xiulan hung the groceries on the handlebars of her bike, went home to pick up her son Ma Mingzhe, and rode to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School. On the way, Zhezhe excitedly talked about dreaming last night that he won a soccer game playing with classmates. Ma Xiulan smiled and encouraged him to study hard.
location: Jinghai No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Focus on embroidery: outlining the pattern of Flowers of Prosperity.
description: After dropping off the children, it was almost 8:30 when she got home. Ma Xiulan did not take a break. She spread an old bedsheet over the square table with the best light in the living room, took out her embroidery hoop, silk thread, and scissors, and zoomed in on the Flowers Blooming with Wealth and Honor design image on her phone, studying the stitch directions for the peony petals and butterfly wings. Then she began to trace the outline of the main flower with focused concentration. At 10:45, her neighbor Wang Guilan knocked on the door to borrow soy sauce. She was amazed at the embroidery, sat down to ask about the stitching, and did not leave until 11:15. Ma Xiulan continued embroidering, immersed in it all morning.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Picking up her son from school.
description: At 11:30, Ma Xiulan put down her needlework, stretched her stiff neck and back, and rode her electric bike to the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School. As soon as the school gate opened, Ma Mingzhe and his classmates poured out. Ma Xiulan waved and called to him. Zhezhe ran over, got on the bike, and said he was hungry. Ma Xiulan comforted him, saying she would make something delicious for lunch and that they would go see Grandma first.
location: At the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Tianjin

name: Visit mother and deliver Chinese yam
description: Ma Xiulan first took Zhezhe home to put down the spinach and tofu, then carried the Chinese yam to her mother Li Xiuying's home (45 Shengli Street). Her mother was busy in the kitchen and was delighted to see her grandson, insisting they stay for a meal. Ma Xiulan explained that her husband wasn't driving at noon and needed to go home to cook, so her mother didn't insist, only told her to bring the children over for dumplings tomorrow, the weekend. Ma Xiulan gave the yam to her mother, chatted for a bit, and left with Zhezhe.
location: No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Lunch with my son
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan reheated the leftover porridge and steamed buns from the morning, stir-fried a green vegetable, and had a simple lunch with Zhe Zhe. While eating, Zhe Zhe shared things about school, saying his deskmate forgot to bring a pen and he lent his own pen to the deskmate. Ma Xiulan praised him for doing the right thing, saying classmates should help each other.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Midday nap
description: After tidying up the dishes after the meal, drowsiness hit. Ma Xiulan set a 45-minute alarm, lay down on the bed, and fell asleep quickly. She slept soundly, and after waking up she felt much more refreshed.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Continue embroidering: complete the butterfly outline
description: At 1:45 p.m., Ma Xiulan washed her face, sat back down at the embroidery frame by the window, turned on the desk lamp, and continued embroidering. With the morning's experience, progress was faster, and she focused on completing the line work of the butterfly wings. By 4:15, the outlines of two butterflies were clear and lively, as if about to take flight. The "Blossoms of Wealth and Honor" was beginning to take shape, and Ma Xiulan felt a strong sense of accomplishment.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Shopping at a convenience store.
description: At 4:15, Ma Xiulan saw the time and knew it was time to pick up the children. She first went to the Zhang Shufen Convenience Store diagonally across the street. The owner Zhang Shufen was stocking shelves. Ma Xiulan bought a bottle of vinegar and two liang of Sichuan peppercorns, paid 12.5 yuan, chatted a few words about family matters, then left.
location: Zhang Shufen Convenience Store, next to Jingbai Supermarket, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick the children up from school.
description: At 4:35, Ma Xiulan first went to Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up her daughter Ma Yuxin. Yuxin happily ran over to her. Then she took Yuxin to the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School and waited for Ma Mingzhe to finish school. The siblings chattered in the back seat while Ma Xiulan drove the two children home.
location: Tianjin Jinghai District Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten and Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School.

name: Prepare dinner and await husband's return home.
description: After arriving home, Ma Xiulan had the children do homework in the living room while she went into the kitchen to prepare dinner. She planned to make noodles with thick gravy. She first kneaded a small piece of dough and let it rest, then prepared the topping: wood ear mushrooms, day lily flowers, eggs, sliced pork, and minced garlic. She also stir-fried cabbage with vinegar. While she was busy, her husband Ma Zhiqiang came back from driving, and Ma Xiulan told him to wash up and eat.
location: Kitchen and dining room of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The whole family had dinner together.
description: The steaming noodles with gravy were brought to the table, and Ma Zhiqiang filled a big bowl, enjoying them with vinegar-sautéed cabbage. Ma Yuxin said her teacher praised her drawing, and Ma Mingzhe said he scored 98 on the math quiz. Ma Zhiqiang smiled and praised them. Ma Xiulan watched the family harmony with a contented heart and added another spoonful of gravy to Zhiqiang's bowl.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Helped with homework and did household chores.
description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan asked Zhiqiang to clear the table, and she sat down to check the children's homework. Yuxin's senior kindergarten homework was recognizing characters and drawing, and she finished quickly. Zhezhe had a fourth-grade distance word problem that gave him some trouble; Ma Xiulan used chopsticks to draw a diagram on the table and explained it for a long time before he finally understood. After that, she checked the school uniforms the children would wear tomorrow.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Keeping accounts and stretching to relax
description: After urging the children to wash up, Ma Xiulan sat down and took out her old account book to record the day's expenses: Chinese yam, spinach, and tofu 16 yuan; vinegar and Sichuan peppercorns 12.5 yuan; total 28.5 yuan. After finishing the accounts, she stood up and did a few waist and back stretches in the living room to relieve the day's aches and pains.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Soaking feet and chatting between husband and wife
description: Ma Zhiqiang brought a basin of hot water for Ma Xiulan to soak her feet and relieve fatigue. Ma Xiulan took off her socks and soaked her feet in the hot water, sighing comfortably. Ma Zhiqiang sat beside her and mentioned that the greenhouse vegetables in the neighboring village were growing well today, and they discussed whether they could also grow some next year. The two chatted about family matters and plans for New Year goods. Ma Xiulan felt sore in her shoulders, so Ma Zhiqiang massaged her shoulders with skillful technique.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Told the children a bedtime story
description: After washing up, Ma Yuxin, wearing her little pajamas, climbed into bed and tugged at Ma Xiulan to tell a story. Ma Xiulan picked up a copy of 'The Little Horse Crosses the River' and sat by the bedside reading it gently. Ma Mingzhe, lying in his own small bed, also listened quietly. When the story ended, the two children slowly closed their eyes. Ma Xiulan gently tucked in the corners of the quilt, turned off the lamp, and left the room.
location: Children's bedroom, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Night checks and peaceful sleep
description: Coming out of the children's bedroom, Ma Xiulan returned to her own bedroom, set the alarm for 5:40 tomorrow morning, and plugged in her phone. She looked at the finished 'Flowers Blooming in Prosperity' embroidery hoop; the peonies and butterflies had clear outlines, and she felt at ease. After a quick wash and changing into pajamas, she felt exhausted. Ma Zhiqiang turned off the light, and Ma Xiulan lay down, thinking that tomorrow she would start filling in the colors, so she needed to get enough rest. Before long, she fell fast asleep and slept until dawn.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Morning preparations and taking the children to school
description: The phone alarm went off at 06:05. Ma Xiulan got up and first woke her son Ma Mingzhe and daughter Ma Yuxin, urging them to get dressed and wash up. Then she went to the kitchen, ladled out multigrain porridge, reheated the pancakes, and the three of them had a simple breakfast. At 06:45, Ma Xiulan got on her electric bike, with Yuxin standing in front wrapped up warmly and Mingzhe sitting in back. She first took her daughter to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, settled her in, then continued riding to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, and only left after watching Mingzhe walk through the school gate.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home), Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Returning home to rest and morning exercise
description: At 07:20, after returning home, Ma Xiulan pushed her electric bike to the shed to charge it. After changing into a loose old cotton-padded jacket, she went to the fitness area in the residential compound. Together with her neighbor Liu Chunmei, she practiced Baduanjin along with music on her phone, from "two hands holding up the sky to regulate the Triple Burner" to "seven shakes at the back to eliminate all diseases." She did the full sequence three times, worked up a slight sweat, and felt her muscles and bones relaxed.
location: The courtyard and fitness open area at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Housework and Fine Embroidery (I)
description: After exercising, Ma Xiulan put the dirty clothes into the washing machine, scrubbed the breakfast dishes and chopsticks, wiped down the stove, and swept the floor. Once everything was tidied up, she moved the embroidery frame to the living room window. Because it was overcast and the light was insufficient, she deliberately turned on the main light. Taking the finest embroidery needle and yellow and pink silk thread, she carefully embellished the peony stamens using the seed-stitch technique, striving for even pressure and plump seed knots with every stitch. After finishing a small section, she stepped back to examine it and was satisfied with the color transition.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Shopping and picking up daughter
description: At 10:10, Ma Xiulan put away her needlework, changed into a padded coat to go out, and rode her electric bike to Jingbai Supermarket. She bought a bottle of vinegar, a handful of Sichuan peppercorns, and also grabbed a lollipop for her daughter at the checkout, spending 15 yuan in total. She then rode to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten and waited at the gate to pick up her daughter Ma Yuxin.
location: Tianjin Jinghai District Yuzhou Zunfu Building 19, Room 104, Jingbai Supermarket; Tianjin Jinghai District Huakang First Kindergarten

name: Pick up daughter and prepare lunch.
description: At 10:50 picked up the bouncing Ma Yuxin and rode home together. After arriving home, let Yuxin play in the living room. Ma Xiulan began preparing lunch: reheated the leftover cabbage and vermicelli from the previous day, boiled water to cook noodles for Yuxin, and meanwhile took the washed clothes out of the washing machine to hang in the yard.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up son from school and have family lunch
description: At 11:40, Ma Xiulan took Yuxin on the electric bike to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up Ma Mingzhe, and after picking him up at 11:50, they went home together. At 12:00 they had lunch; the mother and daughter ate hot noodles, while Mingzhe reheated leftover dishes and steamed buns and added a spoonful of Lao Gan Ma for himself, eating with relish.
location: Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Nap and Putting the Children to Sleep
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan cleared the table. Ma Yuxin was a bit sleepy, so Ma Xiulan had her lie down on the kang, tucked her in with a small quilt, and gently patted her to sleep. Ma Xiulan also rested beside her and dozed for half an hour, to relieve the neck soreness from sitting for a long time doing embroidery.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Afternoon: embroidery and caring for daughter
description: At 1 p.m., Ma Yuxin woke up. Ma Xiulan washed an apple for her and let her play with building blocks nearby. She herself sat back down at the embroidery frame and used gold thread to embroider the butterfly's antennae. The gold thread was stiff and slippery; the first two stitches were removed because the curve was stiff or the thread got tangled into a knot. Feeling a little irritated, she got up, drank some water to calm herself, and on the third stitch she held her breath and finished it in one go, finally embroidering a lively curve.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Picking up son from school and family time
description: At 15:10, Ma Xiulan put down her needlework, took Yuxin on the electric bike to pick up Ma Mingzhe from school, and got home at 15:30. After the children came home, she had Mingzhe do his homework first while Yuxin drew with colored markers. Ma Xiulan showed the children the part she had embroidered that day. Yuxin praised the butterfly's antennae as pretty; Mingzhe said they looked like TV antennas. She smiled and told him to focus on his homework.
location: Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Video call with mother.
description: Ma Xiulan made a video call to her mother Li Xiuying and excitedly showed off the flower stamens and butterfly antennae she had embroidered that day. Her mother leaned closer to the screen to examine them carefully, praised the stamens as looking real, and suggested adding some small sequins to the butterfly wings to make them more vivid. Ma Xiulan repeatedly agreed and was already planning to look for sequins.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Dinner preparation and dinner.
description: After hanging up the video call, Ma Xiulan began preparing dinner: cutting tofu, soaking vermicelli, washing cabbage, and beating two eggs. The kitchen soon filled with aroma. At 18:10 she served dinner on time: steaming hot cabbage, vermicelli, and tofu stew, golden scrambled eggs, and multigrain porridge. The two children ate noisily and with gusto; Yuxin scooped up tofu with a spoon by herself, and Mingzhe ate two big bowls of porridge with the scrambled eggs.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Homework tutoring and family activities
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan cleaned up the dishes and chopsticks, then sat down next to Mingzhe to check his math homework and found many mistakes in the word problems. She suppressed her impatience, took out a draft paper, replaced the people in the problems with Mingzhe and Yuxin, and explained step by step with drawings. After two rounds, Mingzhe finally understood. Yuxin was quietly playing with modeling clay nearby, making a crooked little flower.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Bedtime preparation and story time
description: At 20:00, Ma Xiulan first had Yuxin brush her teeth and wash her face, then change into thermal underwear. After that, she led the two children in back and waist stretches, imitating a kitten arching its back; the children giggled and followed along. After stretching, Ma Xiulan prepared hot water to soak her own feet and also let Yuxin dip her little feet in the hot water. At 20:30, after the two children got into bed, Ma Xiulan read Little Horse Crosses the River from Children's Bedtime Stories to her daughter. Yuxin giggled while listening. At 21:00, after finishing the story, she turned off the main light, leaving only the night light on, and the two children soon fell asleep.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Personal rest and going to bed
description: After the children fell asleep, Ma Xiulan washed up and put a hot towel over her sore, tired eyes. Then she picked up her phone and sent a message to her husband Ma Zhiqiang, who was out driving, to let him know she was safe, along with a few photos of that day's embroidery pieces. After sending the message, she reviewed the next day's schedule and set the alarm. At 22:00, she turned off the lights and lay down, feeling that the day had been tiring but full and satisfying.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Getting up and morning exercise
description: Phone alarm rang. I turned it off, thinking that today I could finally finish "Blooming Flowers and Prosperity" completely, and felt happy inside. I stretched, feeling that I'd slept very soundly last night. I put on thick sportswear, added blankets for the children, and then went out quietly. In the central garden of the community, neighbor Liu Chunmei was already stretching her legs. After exchanging greetings, the two of us practiced Baduanjin together, paying special attention to the "Two Hands Hold the Feet to Strengthen the Kidneys and Waist" movement to consolidate bones and muscles. Half an hour later we finished the routine and agreed to meet at the market tomorrow.
location: Central garden of the residential complex, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare breakfast and wake up the children.
description: Once home, her hands and feet were still a little cold. She first refilled the children’s hot water bottles, tied on an apron, and went into the kitchen. For breakfast, she made millet porridge, scallion pancakes, and scrambled eggs. When the porridge was nearly ready, she pushed open the bedroom door and softly called the children to get up: “Xinxin, Zhezhe, get up! The sun is already up and shining on your little butts!” Then she helped her sleepy-eyed daughter get dressed and hurried her son to wash up.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Dropped off the children at school and bought groceries.
description: After the children finished eating, they put on their thickest down jackets. She put on her army overcoat and helmet herself. First she lifted her daughter onto the small seat on the back of the electric bike, told her to hold tight around Mom's waist, then let her son sit behind. Along the way, she first went to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, watched the teacher lead Xinxin through the school gate, then turned around and took Zhezhe to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, and saw him enter the teaching building. Then she rode on to Wutong Commune Market, bought tofu, Chinese yam, and green peppers at Aunt Sun Guifang's vegetable stall, and chatted with Aunt Sun: "The yams today are really fresh," "We have something to celebrate at home today, so I'm making a couple of extra dishes." After paying, she rode the electric bike home.
location: Depart from 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, pass Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten and Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street), and arrive at Wutong Commune Vegetable Market

name: Housework, embroidery finishing touches, and tidying up.
description: After returning home, she put away the groceries, poured a cup of hot water, quickly cleared the table, and washed the dishes and chopsticks. Then she took the embroidery hoop to the 'work area' in the living room, checked the stitches on the butterfly antennae and the peony stamens, and after confirming they were correct, opened the curtains to let in more light and took out small sequins to add embellishments. She brewed a cup of tea, put on some light music, and began the final sprint: using gold thread to hide the thread ends, she carefully sewed the sequins onto the stamens. Sunlight poured in, and the silk threads refracted a soft glow. Finally, she used a steam iron with a thin cloth to gently press the embroidered surface, making it smooth and as good as new. The entire piece 'Blooming Wealth and Honor' was finally completed.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Framing and packaging embroidered pieces
description: Lay the finished embroidery flat on the large table and take out the prepared 50x60cm natural wood-colored wooden frame. Carefully center the embroidery, stretch the fabric tightly over the frame with tools, and make sure it is smooth and even. Back it with cardboard and secure it with a staple gun. Then wrap it in dark red wrapping paper with auspicious patterns and tie it with a gold ribbon. All done.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up son from school, have lunch, and share photos
description: Rode the electric bike to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up Zhezhe. After returning home, she reheated last night's pork rib soup, cooked noodles, and had lunch with her son. She asked how his morning studies had gone, and her son answered vaguely, looking a bit absent-minded. After the meal, she cleared the dishes and sent her son to his room for a nap. Back in the living room, she checked the framed embroidery again, used her phone to find good lighting, and took three photos: a full view, a close-up of the flower center, and the packaged look. She posted them to the handicraft group with the message: 'Sisters, Blossoms of Wealth and Honor is finally finished!' Aunt Wu and Wang Lihua both liked it, and the group immediately became lively.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Lunch break and departure preparations
description: She set an alarm and took a half-hour nap on the small bed beside her son. She fell asleep quickly and, when the alarm went off, felt refreshed. After getting up, she carefully placed the wrapped embroidered pieces on the footboard of her electric bicycle, checked her phone, wallet, and keys, wrapped a scarf around her neck, put on gloves, and pushed the bike out the door. The weather was sunny and clear, and her mood was bright.
location: At home and in the residential community, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Door-to-door delivery, picking up the youngest daughter, and a call on the way
description: Carrying the embroidered piece, she walked to Wang Lihua's home on Jingwen Road. When Wang Lihua opened the door and saw the bag, she smiled. After the embroidery was unfolded, the living room was full of admiration: "Oh, Sister Xiulan, this is beautifully embroidered! With the sequins added, the flowers look alive!" Wang Lihua promptly paid the 350 yuan balance via WeChat, then took out a "Magpies on a Plum Branch" pattern and placed an order for a New Year hanging ornament, paying a 100 yuan cash deposit. Afterwards she left, stopped at Jingbai Supermarket on the way, and then went to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up her daughter. While waiting at the kindergarten gate, she called her mother Li Xiuying and excitedly reported that the embroidery had been successfully delivered and that she had taken a new order. Her mother told her not to work too hard. After picking up Xinxin, she went home together with her.
location: Wang Lihua's home on Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, via Jingbai Supermarket to Huakang First Kindergarten

name: Pick up the second son from school and supervise his homework.
description: She took her daughter on the electric bike to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up Ma Mingzhe. The two children in the back seat chattered and competed to tell funny stories about school. After arriving home, she had her daughter draw on the coffee table, and she moved a chair to sit beside her son and watched him do his math homework. Finding that he was still confused about the drawing problem, she patiently taught him again with a pencil. After checking the homework, she video-called her husband Ma Zhiqiang on her phone and sent him photos of her embroidery, saying proudly, 'How about it? Your wife's craftsmanship.' Zhiqiang kept praising her and said he would try to get home early tonight.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare dinner and have a family meal
description: She put on an apron and started getting dinner ready, making her signature sweet-and-sour pork tenderloin, stir-fried greens, tomato and egg drop soup, and steaming a pot of plump white steamed buns. The kitchen was filled with steam, and the sweet and sour aroma made the children poke their heads in curiously. As dusk was falling, her husband Ma Zhiqiang hurried home, and the family of four sat around the dining table. She poured beer for her husband, while she and the children drank cola. She raised her glass with a smile: "Today our family should celebrate a little too—this first big job went really smoothly!" Zhiqiang also beamed: "Good work, mom. With you here, our family's life is bound to get better and better!" During the meal, they chatted and laughed, warm and harmonious.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: After-dinner cleanup, bookkeeping, and family time.
description: Her husband volunteered to wash the dishes, and she took out her small ledger and sat on the sofa to keep accounts. December 11: final payment of 350 yuan for Blossoming Wealth and Honor, a 100 yuan deposit received, total side-business income of 450 yuan. After discussing with her husband, she put 200 yuan from the final payment into the Education Reserve Fund, 150 yuan into this month's living expenses, and temporarily listed the 100 yuan deposit separately. Then the family soaked their feet. While rubbing her daughter's little feet, she talked about delivery details and asked about her eldest son, Mingxuan, who boards at school, and learned that his midterm grades were good. She took out her phone and scrolled through photos of her embroidered pieces to show the children, and the children said in unison that Mom was the best.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Putting children to sleep and evening care
description: First told her daughter the story Guess How Much I Love You; after seeing her fall asleep listening, she gently closed the door. Then she went to her son's room and kissed his forehead to say goodnight. Back in her own room, feeling sore shoulders, she washed up first and applied a hot towel to her eyes and neck to ease the fatigue. Then she spread a yoga mat in the bedroom, recorded a video of herself practicing Baduanjin alone, completed a few moves that had not been smooth before, and sent it to Aunt Wu for advice.
location: Children's room and bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Relaxing and sorting out thoughts before bed
description: After stretching, she leaned against the headboard and scrolled through her phone, seeing everyone in the handicraft group praising the embroidery. In her mind, she worked on the composition and color scheme of "Magpie on a Plum Branch" ordered by Wang Lihua, thinking about the vivid layout of a magpie perching on a branch. At 22:30 she turned off the bedside lamp and fell asleep with a satisfied and happy mood.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Getting up in the morning, preparing breakfast, and waking the children to eat breakfast
description: At six in the morning, Ma Xiulan got up quietly and splashed cold water on her face to wake up. In the kitchen, she put millet porridge on to cook, sliced the leftover steamed buns from yesterday and put them on the steamer, then took some homemade pickled radish from the jar and cut it into thin strips, drizzling sesame oil over them. Steam rose from the stove. At 6:40, she went upstairs to wake up her ten-year-old son Ma Mingzhe and six-year-old daughter Ma Yuxin, helped them get dressed, squeezed toothpaste onto their brushes, and urged them to wash up. During breakfast, the family sat around the table. Zhezhe ate two hot steamed buns with pickled radish strips, while Xinxin obediently ate a small bowl of porridge.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Taking the children to school
description: At 7:10, Ma Xiulan dressed Xinxin in a down jacket, hat, and gloves. Zhezhe carried his backpack by himself, and the three of them went out on an electric bike. First they arrived at Huakang First Kindergarten. She watched as Xinxin was led inside by the teacher and waved goodbye. Then she turned the bike around and took Zhezhe to the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, telling him to listen carefully in class and wait at the school gate at noon. Zhezhe nodded and ran into the school.
location: Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin  Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning exercise, chatting with neighbors, and harvesting vegetables from the vegetable garden
description: After sending the children off and returning home, Ma Xiulan saw her neighbor Liu Chunmei stretching in the courtyard. They smiled at each other, spread out mats, and did a set of Baduanjin. After finishing, Chunmei suggested stretching to relax, so they did fifteen minutes of free stretching while chatting about the next day's market trip. Ma Xiulan mentioned that her new embroidery piece "Magpies on a Plum Branch" was short of dark blue sequins. Chunmei patted her chest and promised she knew an inexpensive shop with nice ones. After the morning exercise, Ma Xiulan went straight to the backyard vegetable garden. Taking advantage of the good sunlight, she pulled up four plump, firm cabbages, carried them to the sink to rinse off the mud, then moved them under the clothesline and laid them out in a row to dry, planning to put them in a vat to pickle into sauerkraut after her bath the next day.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (home courtyard and backyard vegetable garden)

name: Discussing taking a bath, purchasing bath tickets, and notifying family members.
description: Just after harvesting the napa cabbage, her mother Li Xiuying called, saying that it had been dry and cold these days, and her whole body felt stiff. She suggested going to the Old Street Bathhouse to soak and relax. Ma Xiulan immediately agreed and set it for tomorrow afternoon. After hanging up, she rode her electric bike straight to the Old Street Bathhouse on Shengli Street and bought seven bath tickets for 3 p.m. the next afternoon, including shares for the elderly and children. After buying, she first called her husband Ma Zhiqiang to tell him the tickets were bought and asked him and her father to go together; then she called her mother to confirm the meeting time and what to bring.
location: Old Street Bathhouse on Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin (purchase of bath tickets) and contact by phone.

name: Deliver cotton-padded clothes to the eldest son and buy groceries on the way
description: After buying the bath ticket, Ma Xiulan thought of her eldest son Ma Mingxuan, who boarded at school, and worried that his cotton coat was too thin in the cold snap. She first went home to find a thick down jacket and a pair of thick socks, put them in a bag, and immediately cycled to the Experimental Middle School in Jinghai District. She handed the clothes to the security guard, Master Zhao, and asked him to pass them on to Ma Mingxuan of Class 3, Senior Grade 2. After leaving the school, she stopped by Wutong Commune vegetable market on the way and bought one yuan's worth of cilantro and a small piece of tofu from Sun Guifang's stall to make soup for lunch.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin   Jinghai District Experimental Middle School, Tianjin   Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Housework, lunch alone, and picking up my son from school to come home for lunch
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan first turned over the Chinese cabbage that was set out to dry, tossed the dirty clothes into the washing machine, and mopped the living room and bedroom floors. Near 11 o'clock, she cooked herself a bowl of dried noodles with a poached egg and ate it with pickled radish strips. At 11:45, she rode her e-bike to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up Ma Mingzhe. After getting home, she used the leftover millet porridge from breakfast and steamed buns, along with the freshly bought cilantro and tofu, to make a tomato, cilantro, and tofu soup, and sliced a plate of soy-sauce beef she had brought from her mother's house the day before. Mother and son chatted happily over lunch.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School

name: Afternoon nap and hanging laundry
description: After lunch, Ma Mingzhe went back to his room to read a book outside class. Ma Xiulan felt a bit sleepy, so she set an alarm, covered herself with a small quilt on the living room sofa, and took a nap. When she woke up, the washing machine had just finished, so she went to the balcony and hung up all the washed clothes one by one.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Went to the market with neighbor Liu Chunmei to do shopping.
description: At 1:20 p.m., Liu Chunmei knocked on the door right on time, and the two rode their electric bikes to Shengli Street market. The market was crowded, and Chunmei went straight to the fabric and accessories stall she knew well. Ma Xiulan carefully selected more than a dozen dark blue and silver-white sequins in varying shades and a few embroidery needles as materials for the embroidery piece “Magpie on a Plum Branch,” spending 12 yuan in total. She also took a liking to a thick, sturdy piece of blue floral-patterned cotton fabric, planning to make each of her parents a set of pajamas, so she bought that as well. After shopping, the two bought a bag of sugar-roasted chestnuts and chatted while shelling them on the way home.
location: Shengli Street Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Picking up the child from school and heading home
description: Just after 4:00 p.m., Ma Xiulan parted with Chunmei at the fork in the road and first rode to Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up Ma Yuxin. As soon as Xinxin came out, she threw herself into her mother's arms and happily said that the teacher had taught them how to fold paper frogs, and that hers looked the most like one. Ma Xiulan kissed her to show praise. The two then went to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up Ma Mingzhe, who came out late because he had helped the teacher sort homework books. The mother and her two children rode home cheerfully against the cold evening wind.
location: Huakang First Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin   Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin   156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening family time: supervising homework, preparing dinner, dinner, and foot soaking
description: After arriving home, Ma Xiulan had the children wash their hands first. Ma Mingzhe went to his room to do homework, while Ma Yuxin excitedly pulled out her small schoolbag, took out the little towel and plastic duck she wanted to bring for tomorrow's bath, and carefully laid them on the sofa. Ma Xiulan smiled and helped her put the things into a storage bag, then went into the kitchen to prepare dinner: she stir-fried some greens, made tomato and egg drop soup, and reheated the leftover noodles from lunch. At 6:20 dinner was served. Xinxin said while drinking soup that she wanted to bring the little duck tomorrow; Zhezhe ate very quickly and said he was almost done with his homework. After dinner, Ma Xiulan cleared the dishes, checked her son's homework, and signed it. Around 8 p.m., she boiled a pot of hot water with mugwort and called the children to soak their feet together. Xinxin put the little duck into the basin and splashed water, while Ma Xiulan trimmed Zhezhe's toenails and reminded him not to forget his swim trunks. After soaking for fifteen minutes, the whole family felt warm and cozy.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Selecting the year’s photos and making a digital album in the evening
description: After the children washed up and went to sleep, Ma Xiulan tidied up, went to the study, and opened her old laptop. She imported all the photos from her phone and camera, created folders by month, and then looked through them one by one: in spring, planting sunflowers in the yard, with the children laughing as they watered them; during National Day in Beijing, visiting the Forbidden City, where her eldest son had grown much taller; in summer, Zhezhe's gap-toothed smile with a missing front tooth after swimming; and photos of her husband taken before he set out on his trip. She selected more than eighty favorites from over a thousand photos, created a new folder named “Our Days in 2025,” and planned to turn them into a digital photo album with music another day.
location: Study at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Organizing materials, stretching, and going to bed
description: Ma Xiulan quickly checked and confirmed the photos were correct, then shut down the computer. She did a simple five-minute lower back stretch in the bedroom, then soaked her feet in hot water, feeling relaxed all over. Picking up her phone, she saw a message from her husband Ma Zhiqiang sent just after eight: “Arrived, unloading, see you tomorrow afternoon.” She replied, “Got it, stay safe,” then turned off the light and lay down. Thinking back on the day's fulfilling schedule and looking forward to the family bath tomorrow, she fell asleep with a sense of satisfaction.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Waking up early to prepare and having family breakfast.
description: At 6:30 in the morning, Ma Xiulan got up and washed up, took photos of the fuchsia on the balcony and sent them to the family group chat, and received a thumbs-up from her mother. Then she prepared breakfast: cooked noodles in pork rib soup, poached eggs, blanched baby bok choy, and steamed buns. She woke the three children, and the whole family sat around the table eating pork rib soup noodles, steamed buns, and eggs. The eldest son talked about the school's New Year's Eve party, while the second son and younger daughter bickered. After the meal, she and her husband cleared the table and washed the dishes, and reminded the children to change clothes before going to the public bath in the afternoon. Then she scrubbed the pots and washed the dishes, put away the leftovers, moved the cabbage bought yesterday to the corner of the kitchen, and planned to deal with it after returning from the bath.
location: Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Going to the print shop to make a family photo album
description: Ma Xiulan put on her hat and gloves, tucked the USB drive containing the photos into her pocket, and walked about ten minutes from home to the Good Times Print Shop. At the shop, she repeatedly confirmed with the clerk the more than one hundred photos taken this year, and finally chose to make a 12-inch horizontal leather-covered photo album, using a family photo taken at Tiananmen on last National Day as the cover. She requested rush service, agreed to pick it up on the afternoon of the 15th, and paid an 80 yuan deposit.
location: Good Times Print Shop, 68 Dongfanghong Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Buying groceries at the vegetable market and chatting with neighbors
description: After leaving the print shop, Ma Xiulan walked to Wutong Commune Vegetable Market. At Sun Guifang's stall, she bought cilantro, soft tofu, and white radish, and the two chatted briefly about everyday things. Then she went to a steamed bun shop and bought two yuan worth of qiangmian steamed buns. After shopping, she carried the vegetables and buns and walked home leisurely, greeting familiar neighbors along the way.
location: China, Tianjin City, Jinghai District, Wutong Commune Vegetable Market

name: Pickling cabbage and preparing embroidery
description: Back home, Ma Xiulan put away the vegetables she had bought and began to pickle the cabbages. She pulled the Chinese cabbage leaves apart one by one, rinsed them carefully under the tap in the backyard, drained them, and then, following the method her mother had taught her, rubbed salt layer by layer, packed them into a jar, pressed a stone on top, and sealed it, making pickled cabbage for the winter. After finishing, she took out the embroidered base cloth with a 'magpie on a plum branch' pattern, sequins, and embroidery needles from the cabinet, sat by the living room window, listened to a storytelling program on her phone, and carefully traced the pattern and matched threads to make the base draft.
location: Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Packing bath supplies and asking the neighbor to help
description: Ma Xiulan put down her needlework and began to prepare for the afternoon trip to the bathhouse. She found clean underwear for the whole family, put her youngest daughter Xinxin's yellow rubber duck toy into the bath bag, packed towels, shampoo, and scrubbing mitts into separate categories, and also brought her husband's set of chess. She went out, knocked on Sister Wang's door across the hallway, and asked her to help look after the house and accept any packages on their behalf.
location: At home and at the doorway, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Prepare and enjoy lunch
description: Ma Xiulan prepared lunch: she boiled the leftover pork rib soup from last night, added noodles, poached eggs, and blanched baby bok choy. She specifically reminded her husband not to drink alcohol while taking a bath in the afternoon. The family sat around together eating noodles, enjoying the soup and noodles comfortably.
location: Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Midday rest and preparation after the rest.
description: After cleaning up after the meal, Ma Xiulan felt sleepy and lay down for an afternoon nap of about an hour. The sounds of the children playing and the TV came from around her, and she dozed without falling into deep sleep. She woke up around 1:15 p.m., feeling much more refreshed. She washed her face, checked the bathhouse bag, woke the children one by one, and had them change into loose home clothes plus down jackets. She also put on easy-to-remove sweater and cotton pants, ready to leave for the bathhouse at 2 o'clock.
location: Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: The whole family went to the old street bathhouse for a soak.
description: At two in the afternoon, Ma Xiulan's family of five walked to the Old Street Bathhouse. On the way, Xinxin pressed against the shop windows to look inside. They reached the bathhouse entrance in less than fifteen minutes and happened to meet her parents Li Xiuying and Ma Jianguo there. Her husband bought tickets, and the seven of them entered the bathhouse. Men and women bathed separately. Ma Xiulan, her mother, and her daughter were in the women's area. She first washed Xinxin's hair, put a little rubber duck into the pool to amuse the child, then scrubbed her mother's back and chatted with her. In the men's area, her husband helped his father soak in the big pool, while the two sons practiced holding their breath. After they had soaked thoroughly, everyone gathered in the lounge. The elderly lay on reclining chairs, Ma Xiulan dried the children's hair, and her husband ordered hot soy milk and played Chinese chess with his father while drinking.
location: Old Street Bathhouse, 78 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Say goodbye to parents and walk home
description: After the bath, the family dressed neatly and walked out of the bathhouse. Her parents insisted on going back to their own home and not staying at Ma Xiulan's for dinner. Ma Xiulan bought steamed buns for 4 yuan at a roadside bun shop for her parents to take back. The two families waved goodbye at the entrance to the bathhouse, and Ma Xiulan and the children walked back to their home on Jingwen Road.
location: Jinghai District, Tianjin, China, from the entrance of the Old Street Bathhouse on Shengli Street to No. 156 Jingwen Road.

name: Preparing a warm dinner.
description: Back home, her husband took care of the heating and tea, while Ma Xiulan tied on an apron and prepared dinner: noodles with gravy and stir-fried mixed vegetables. She sliced garlic scapes, wood ear mushrooms, and day lily buds, mixed the starch slurry, and stir-fried bean sprouts, chives, vermicelli, and eggs together over high heat. As she worked, she asked her husband to heat up the steamed buns. The kitchen filled with aroma.
location: Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Warm family dinner
description: Steaming noodles with gravy and stir-fried mixed vegetables were served, and the children ate the noodles heartily. At the table, Ma Xiulan mentioned how comfortable the bath was. Her eldest son Xuanxuan mentioned wanting to sing a Jay Chou song at the school New Year's Day party. Her husband put some food in her bowl and said today had been a comfortable day. The whole family chatted and laughed, and even mischievous Zhezhe was quiet.
location: Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Cleaning up after meals and helping children with homework
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan cleared the dishes and told the children to do their homework. While wiping the stove, she watched Zhezhe and Xinxin practice pinyin and handwriting, and also peeled an apple for Xuanxuan.
location: Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Practice Baduanjin in the evening and record a video.
description: After finishing the housework, Ma Xiulan changed into comfortable sportswear and practiced Baduanjin in the master bedroom following her phone. She recorded the whole session on video, planning to send it to Aunt Zhao and ask her to comment on whether the 'Shake Head and Wag Tail' movement was correct.
location: Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Family bookkeeping and savings
description: After practicing Baduanjin, Ma Xiulan took out her notebook to keep accounts: today's bathhouse cost about 175 yuan, the photo album deposit was 80 yuan, and buying vegetables and steamed buns totaled 20 yuan. After recording it, she transferred 50 yuan to the family emergency fund account via mobile banking.
location: Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Husband and wife chatting and planning before bed
description: After washing up, the couple lay on the bed chatting while soaking their feet. Ma Xiulan talked with her husband about making the photo album and today's success in pickling sour cabbage, and also mentioned that her father would retire next year. Her husband said they should often go back to visit her parents. She felt warm at heart.
location: Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Soothing the children and arranging bedtime
description: Ma Xiulan checked on the children one by one. She read the story of 'Little Red Riding Hood' to Xinxin, who soon fell asleep. Zhezhe turned over and mumbled about what he wanted to play tomorrow. Xuanxuan was still reading an extracurricular book, and she told him not to stay up too late. Finally, she returned to her own bedroom and dimmed the bedside lamp.
location: Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Stretched before bed, then turned off the lights and went to sleep
description: Before bed, Ma Xiulan did five minutes of simple lower-back stretches and felt relaxed all over. She glanced at the lights outside the window, recalled how full and warm today had been, quietly leaned toward her husband, closed her eyes, and fell into a deep sleep.
location: Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Get up, stretch your muscles and joints, and practice Baduanjin.
description: As soon as the alarm went off, I got up quickly. Today I had to go to the market, so I needed to loosen up my body first. I did some shoulder and neck stretches on the bedroom floor, then went to the yard and, facing the cold morning wind, seriously did a full set of Baduanjin. I learned this from Aunt Wu; after one round, my whole body was warm, and I won't be afraid of backache even if I stand at the stall all day today.
location: Bedroom and small courtyard of the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Preparing breakfast for the family and waking up the children
description: After finishing her exercises, she hurried into the kitchen and deftly heated up the steamed buns made yesterday and the leftover noodles with gravy, cooked a pot of thick millet porridge, and fried three eggs. She first went to wake her fourth-grade son, Mingzhe, and told him that Grandma would be coming today and he should be obedient. Then she coaxed her youngest daughter, Xinxin, out of bed, helped her get dressed, and braided her two pigtails. Her eldest son, Mingxuan, was a boarding student and would not be coming home, which saved a lot of worry.
location: Kitchen and bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Have breakfast with the whole family and give the children reminders.
description: The children sat at the table with their heads down eating. As I drank porridge, I kept nagging: “Zhezhe, do your homework at home this morning and don’t keep watching TV. When Grandma comes, let her check it. Xinxin, play with Grandma today. Mom is going to earn some money and will bring you something tasty tonight.” I also filled my big thermos with hot water to drink at the stall.
location: Dining room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Mother took over preparing the goods and loading them into the car.
description: My mother Li Xiuying arrived on time from Shengli Street and brought a jar of her newly pickled sweet garlic for me to try at the market. I gave her a brief update on the children, then went to the small storage room in the back courtyard to move the goods. I carefully wrapped the 20 bottles of pickled vegetables, 10 sets of embroidered coasters, 5 small cloth dolls, and a few newly crocheted wool hair clips that I had inventoried last night in newspaper and plastic bags, and packed them into two large woven bags. I also checked the change purse, the payment QR code sign, and the red velvet cloth for the stall, making sure everything was in order.
location: Living room and yard at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Taking the neighbor's electric tricycle to the market
description: Just as I moved my things to the courtyard gate, my neighbor Zhang Shufen drove over in her small covered tricycle. Together we lifted the two big bags into the cargo bed. I got into the passenger seat, and we chatted and laughed all the way to the People's Cultural Square. Shufen said she mainly came today to buy New Year clothes for her grandson and take a look at my stall.
location: From the entrance at No. 154 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China to People's Cultural Square, No. 5 Dongfanghong Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Stall sales and business communication
description: When I got to the square, I found my stall, right next to Xiuqin's paper-cutting stall. I spread out a red velvet cloth, polished the pickle jars until they shone, and lined them up in a row; I pinned the embroidered pieces to the velvet cloth with safety pins and put the small cloth dolls at the front. The morning foot traffic was really heavy. I enthusiastically called out, "Sister, come take a look at our homemade pickles—they're great with rice!" while introducing the embroidery stitches to customers. Business was good in the morning: I sold 8 jars of pickles, 5 sets of coasters, and 2 small cloth dolls. Chunmei also took time to come over and watch the stall for a while, and brought two pairs of crocheted wool slippers for me to sell on consignment for her.
location: Stall 16, central section of the market, People's Cultural Square, 5 Dongfanghong Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Lunch at the market to discuss the business plan.
description: The crowd thinned out a bit at noon. Xiuqin went and bought boxed meals (braised pork with potatoes and stir-fried mixed vegetables), and the three of us squatted in the rest area behind the stall and had a few quick bites. While eating, we talked business: Xiuqin said she was thinking about opening a shop on Taobao before Chinese New Year and wanted me and Chunmei to join her in selling our handmade crafts online. Chunmei also said the pickled vegetables at the town supermarket were almost out of stock and asked me to bring another 20 jars next week during the market fair. I felt warm inside, and I wrote all this down in a little notebook.
location: Rest area at People's Cultural Square, No. 5 Dongfanghong Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Continue setting up and minding the stall.
description: After lunch, another wave of guests came. A young couple took a liking to my embroidered coasters and bought three sets at once to give as gifts. Taking advantage of a break in the stream of customers, I took out my embroidery hoop with a 'Magpie on a Plum Branch' pattern, sat on the small folding stool behind the stall, and sewed a few stitches while keeping an eye on the stall. The new sequins I had bought sparkled in the sunlight.
location: Stall 16, People's Cultural Square, No. 5 Dongfanghong Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Closed the stall early and picked up the photo album on the way
description: As the sky turned cloudy and the wind picked up, fewer people came to the market. Thinking about today's results, I decided to close the stall early. I said goodbye to Xiuqin and Chunmei and packed up the remaining goods. I remembered the family photo album I had ordered yesterday at Good Times Print Shop. Since it was on the way, I drove over myself on the electric tricycle. At the shop, I checked the order with the clerk. The album was really beautiful. I paid the remaining balance, wrapped it carefully, and placed it in the cargo bed.
location: From People's Cultural Square, No. 5 Dongfanghong Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China to Beautiful Time Print Shop, No. 18 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Returned home, did the bookkeeping, and shared the results in the group.
description: After arriving home, my mother was watching cartoons with the children in the living room. I tiptoed back to my room and took out my account book. Today's total income was 195 yuan. After deducting 10 yuan for the stall fee, my net profit was 185 yuan. I carefully wrote down: 'Pickled vegetables, 8 jars, 80 yuan; coasters, 5 sets, 75 yuan; cloth dolls, 2 pieces, 40 yuan; Chunmei's knitted wool shoes, 2 pairs, payment not yet collected.' Then I took a few photos of the morning's results and sent them to the 'Sisters Handicraft Exchange Group.' Aunt Wu, Chen Yulan, and others in the group all gave likes and praised me for being capable, which made me feel very happy.
location: Bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Spending time with her mother, chatting, looking after the children, and enjoying family togetherness.
description: Mother saw me come back and asked with a smile how my sales had gone today. As I showed her the new photo album I had picked up, I recounted excitedly the people and events I'd met at the market, and told her about the "online store" plan Xiuqin and Chunmei had mentioned today. Mother was very supportive. She said, "Just go ahead and do it. Mom is here at home; watching the kids and cooking are no problem." My daughter Xinxin ran over and pulled me to see the "little garden" she had built with building blocks, and my son Mingzhe also came over with his homework notebook, asking me to check the new Chinese characters he had written. For a moment, the whole family was happy and harmonious.
location: Home living room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Preparing dinner; cooking together with her mother
description: I went into the kitchen to work with my mother. I rinsed the rice and steamed it, while my mother picked and washed the vegetables. Feeling happy today, I made braised pork ribs, stir-fried garlic romaine lettuce, and reheated the leftover pickled cabbage and vermicelli from yesterday. I also specially cut a plate of the sweet garlic my mother brought, ready for my husband to taste when he comes home this evening.
location: China, Tianjin Jinghai District, No. 156 Jingwen Road, home kitchen

name: A Warm Family Dinner Sharing Market Experiences
description: My husband Zhiqiang came back early today and made it in time for dinner. The whole family sat around the table. As I ate, I animatedly talked about what happened at the market today, and the children eagerly told us what Grandma had played with them. Zhiqiang nodded as he listened and said, 'You've worked hard. Earn what you can, but don't wear yourself out.' I said it was nothing, but I felt warm inside. My mother also stayed over, saying she wouldn't go back tonight.
location: Dining room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Tutoring the kids and late-night chat between husband and wife
description: After clearing away the dishes, Zhiqiang went to watch the TV news. I sat down next to my son and helped him with the math word problems I had sent back. I drew diagrams to explain them, and he finally understood. Then I read two pages of the Three Character Classic with my daughter Xinxin and taught her a few characters. When the children had gone back to their room to do homework or play with toys, Zhiqiang and I chatted for a while on the sofa. I told him I was thinking of starting an online shop with Xiuqin and the others. He said we could give it a try, just not to invest too much.
location: Living room and children's bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Soaking feet to relax and discussing handicrafts online.
description: Zhiqiang brought me a basin of hot water to soak my feet and relieve my fatigue. While soaking my feet, I took out my phone and scrolled through the "Sisters Handicraft Exchange Group." Aunt Wu replied several times to the pictures I posted this morning, saying my stitching had improved. I sent Aunt Wu a private message, thanked her for teaching me the stitch last time, and asked her about a new pattern. After soaking my feet for 20 minutes, I felt completely relaxed.
location: Home living room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Put the children to bed and arrange tomorrow's matters.
description: She urged the two children to wash up, told them a bedtime story, and waited until they fell asleep before quietly closing the door. Back in her own room, she checked the children's school supplies for Monday tomorrow and set the alarm for 5:50 the next morning. She had to take the children to school and also go to her mother's place to get something—there was a lot to do.
location: Children's bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Evening Baduanjin stretching and relaxation
description: I stood all day today, and my calves were a bit sore and swollen. Taking advantage of the quiet, I did another set of Baduanjin in the open space in the bedroom. This time I moved slowly, focusing on feeling the stretches. Afterward I did a simple lower back massage and leg stretches, and felt most of the day’s fatigue melt away.
location: Bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Wash up before bed and check accounts
description: After washing up, I took out my ledger again and recorded the remaining 80 yuan payment for picking up the photo album today, then calculated the day's net income. Only after everything was clear did I feel at ease.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Scrolled through phone while lying in bed and fell asleep peacefully.
description: Lying in bed, I scrolled through Moments for a few minutes and saw that Xiuqin had posted behind-the-scenes photos of today's market and even tagged me. I liked the post and left a comment for Chunmei saying her knitted shoes looked quite good. I put my phone on the nightstand, turned off the light, pulled up the quilt, and before long I was sound asleep. What a truly wonderful day today was!
location: Bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Morning chores and preparations
description: Woke up naturally in the early morning. After doing shoulder and neck stretches by the bed, she went to the kitchen to prepare millet porridge, steamed buns, and pickled vegetables for the family breakfast. She then woke her second son, Zhezhe, and her little daughter, Xinxin, helped Xinxin tie her hair, and urged them to wash up and eat breakfast. Her eldest son, Xuanxuan, boards at school, so he was not at home.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Take the children to school and buy groceries along the way.
description: After putting Xinxin's gloves on, checking Zhezhe's red scarf, wrapping herself in her padded coat, and grabbing the e-bike keys and canvas bag, she walked Xinxin to Huakang First Kindergarten, then rode the e-bike with Zhezhe to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School. On the way, she stopped by the Wutong Commune vegetable market, found Sun Guifang's stall, bought firm tofu, white radish, and cilantro, and chatted about the fun of running the stall.
location: From No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, and Wutong Commune Vegetable Market.

name: Morning Exercise in the Courtyard
description: First, brisk-walk for ten minutes in the small courtyard to loosen up, then take off the coat and perform a complete set of Baduanjin, especially practicing the 'Shake the Head and Wag the Tail to Remove Heart Fire' move repeatedly, preparing for the New Year's Day community performance. Felt the lower body was more stable than yesterday.
location: The courtyard of her home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Housework and pickling cabbage
description: She put away the vegetables she had bought, washed the leftover Chinese cabbage from yesterday and cut it into pieces, then pickled it according to the method Liu Chunmei taught her, adding seasonings and pressing it with a stone, while calculating the income from selling the pickles.
location: Kitchen and courtyard at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the photo album, write thank-you notes, and take a short rest
description: She walked to the Good Times Print Shop, checked the gold-foil lettering "Our 2025", reprinted the last page, inserted the selected group photo, and paid the remaining 40 yuan. After returning home, she looked through the photo album in the study and wrote a note of thanks on the last page: "Thank you for this year, we are still together. 2025.12.15." Then she rested in the living room, poured some water to drink, picked up her phone to reply to likes in the handicraft group, and confirmed the details of pickled vegetables with Liu Chunmei.
location: Good Times Print Shop (east section of Jingwen Road near the intersection with Shengli Avenue, Jinghai District, Tianjin) and home

name: Pick up Zhezhe from school and prepare lunch
description: Rode an electric bike to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up Zhezhe after school. After returning home, she had him do his homework in the living room, tied on an apron, and quickly prepared lunch: cabbage stewed with tofu, scrambled eggs with tomatoes, and steamed buns warmed up.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School

name: Lunch and lunch break.
description: Mother and son had lunch in the dining room, chatting about the funny things in Zhezhe's math class that morning. After the meal, she urged Zhezhe to take a nap, quickly cleaned up the dishes and chopsticks, then also lay down for a short rest and set a 30-minute alarm.
location: Home dining room and bedroom at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Taking Zhezhe to school and preparing craft materials
description: After the alarm goes off, wake up ZheZhe and take him to school. After returning home, take out red cloth, gold thread, and small copper bells from the cabinet, spread them on the living room coffee table, and prepare to make a New Year "Fu" character hanging ornament.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School

name: Making a New Year “Fu” character hanging ornament.
description: Putting on a thimble, she focused on cutting red cloth and threading a needle, embroidered the outline of the fortune character, and sewed on copper bells. She made three ornaments in all, intended for her parents, her neighbor Wang Guilan, and her own front door. Her youngest daughter Xinxin's doll sat beside her like a supervisor, and she was amused from time to time.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up Xinxin from school and go shopping
description: She put away the hanging ornament and walked to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up Xinxin, who threw herself into her arms. Then she led her to the convenience store run by her neighbor Zhang Shufen, bought two jin of brown sugar to prepare brown sugar steamed buns for the evening, chatted with Shufen, and then went home together.
location: Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Shufen Convenience Store; 156 Jingwen Road

name: Prepare dinner and pick up ZheZhe from school
description: After getting home, she put on an apron, started kneading the dough, and had Xinxin help fetch things. She cut the pork belly to prepare braised pork with vermicelli and washed the spinach. Once the dough had risen, she kneaded brown sugar into it, shaped it into steamed buns, and steamed them. After the buns were done and the braised pork was stewing, she rode her electric bike to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up Zhezhe and return home together.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School

name: Family dinner and enjoying the family photo album together
description: Her husband Ma Zhiqiang came home early from work, and the whole family sat around the table for dinner. The dishes included braised pork with vermicelli, garlic spinach, and brown sugar steamed buns. After dinner, Ma Xiulan took out the family photo album, and they all squeezed onto the sofa to look through it. Zhezhe excitedly pointed at a photo of watering the persimmon tree, Xinxin pointed at the kindergarten group photo and insisted on going again, and her husband smiled and reminisced. The living room was filled with laughter and warmth.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, home dining room and living room

name: Tutoring homework and tidying up the kitchen
description: Supervised Zhezhe while he did homework, cleared the dishes and wiped the table herself, while Xinxin played with a Fu character ornament beside her. Checked Zhezhe's math homework and corrected two mistakes.
location: Living room and kitchen of home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Evening Baduanjin practice and recording
description: In the spacious area of the living room, she did a set of Baduanjin and asked her husband Ma Zhiqiang to record it on his phone, paying special attention to the "Shake Head and Wag Tail" movement. Reviewing the video, she found that her legs were stronger than before and felt satisfied.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Study the pickled vegetable inventory list.
description: After practice, she opened her husband's old laptop and Excel, and while soaking her feet, learned how to create a pickle inventory sheet. Recalling the method Liu Chunmei taught her, she entered fields such as “cabbage,” “salt,” and “time” into the table, and haltingly built a simple data sheet.
location: Study at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Urging the children to wash up and putting them to sleep
description: She urged the two children to wash up, told Xinxin two little stories, and only gently closed the door after both had fallen asleep.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Soaking feet, listening to the radio, and keeping accounts
description: Boiled water to soak her feet. While soaking, she listened to a health radio program, and also took out her ledger to record today's expenses: groceries 15 yuan, photo album final payment 40 yuan, brown sugar 8 yuan, and so on, as well as yesterday's stall income of 185 yuan, and budgeted this month's living expenses.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Stretching before bed and falling asleep
description: On the yoga mat in the bedroom, she stretched her lower back and back to relax her muscles, prepared tomorrow's clothes, set the phone alarm for 5:55, turned off the light, and lay down. Recalling the fulfilling and satisfying day, she quickly fell asleep in the warmth of the family photo album.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Morning stretching and preparing breakfast
description: As dawn was just breaking, the alarm clock rang. After waking up, Ma Xiulan first moved her ankles and wrists while still under the covers, then opened the curtains and focused on shoulder and neck stretches in the living room to relieve the soreness from sorting photo albums and accounts the day before.
