After stretching, she went into the kitchen, rinsed rice and millet and put them in the rice cooker to cook porridge, took brown sugar steamed buns and eggs out of the refrigerator to steam, and used the spare time to tidy the countertop and drain the soaked beans, preparing breakfast for the whole family.
location: Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Wake up the children, have breakfast, and get ready to go out.
description: At 6:35, Ma Xiulan gently woke up her son Ma Mingzhe and daughter Ma Yuxin in the second bedroom. She squeezed toothpaste onto her daughter's toothbrush and poured warm water, and reminded her son to wear sneakers for PE class. While the children were washing up, she set the cooked porridge, steamed buns, and eggs on the table. The family of three sat down to breakfast. Xinxin talked about the dream she had about the flower hair tie, and Xiulan promised she could make it today. After breakfast, Xiulan dressed Xinxin in her down jacket and put on a hat and scarf, told Zhezhe to take care of his younger sister, and then changed into a cotton coat and picked up the cloth bag for grocery shopping, getting ready to go out.
location: Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Taking the children to school and shopping on the way home
description: Ma Xiulan walked out holding her daughter Ma Yuxin's hand, with her son Ma Mingzhe following beside her; the three of them set off on foot. Just as they left the neighborhood, they met neighbor Wang Guilan, who was also walking her grandson to school. The two chatted as they walked, and Wang Guilan reminded her that the Winter Solstice was in two days, so she should prepare dumplings. They arrived at Huakang First Kindergarten around 07:25. After Xinxin waved goodbye, Xiulan and Zhezhe continued on, and around 07:40 she watched her son enter Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School. On the way back, Xiulan stopped into Jingbai Supermarket to buy a bottle of Shanxi aged vinegar. She greeted Zhang Shufen, who was stocking shelves; Zhang Shufen mentioned some newly arrived patterned yarn, and Xiulan, thinking of her handcraft projects, promised to come back another day to look. After buying the vinegar, she hurried home, changed shoes, and washed her hands.
location: Starting from home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, went successively to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten (Jinghai District, Tianjin), then Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin), on the way back passed Jingbai Supermarket (Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu, Jinghai District, Tianjin), and finally returned home.

name: Morning exercise and a simple breakfast
description: Ma Xiulan opened the Baduanjin instructional video saved on her phone in the living room and did a full set of movements, paying special attention to 'Two Hands Hold the Feet to Strengthen the Kidneys and Waist,' stretching her lower back as much as possible and breathing slowly and deeply. She then marched in place for 10 minutes, swinging her arms and taking deep breaths until her body was slightly warm. After the morning exercise, she heated the leftover half steamed bun and a bowl of porridge from the morning, and quickly finished breakfast with a piece of pickled vegetables. Then she washed the dishes, wiped the stove, and watered the houseplants.
location: Living room and kitchen of the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Vegetable market shopping and putting things away
description: Remembering the neighbor's warning about the upcoming cold snap, Ma Xiulan rode her e-bike straight to Xingwang Market and found Sun Guifang's stall. With Sun Guifang's suggestions and a discounted price, Xiulan bought crisp radishes, firm scallions, old tofu, and napa cabbage, and also asked for extra potatoes and vermicelli. There was so much produce that the rear seat and footrests of the e-bike were completely stuffed. She wobbled home, struggled to carry all the vegetables into the kitchen, stored the cabbage and radishes in the cool storage room, leaned the scallions upright against the wall, and soaked the tofu in water to keep it fresh. Looking at the fully stocked shelves, she felt deeply at ease.
location: Xingwang Vegetable Market (near Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin) and home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Making fabric hair flowers
description: Ma Xiulan wiped her face, sat down in the best-lit spot by the living room window, and laid out the cut pink and blue fabric scraps and tools such as needle and thread and a glue gun. She carefully sewed the pink petals together, stuffed them with cotton, and decorated them with plastic pearls to make a full main flower. Then she cut small leaves from the blue fabric scraps and fixed them onto the hair clip. A fresh and lovely double-layer flower hair clip was successfully completed. In the remaining time, she made two other color designs in the same way and looked at them with satisfaction.
location: By the living room window at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Preparing and enjoying lunch
description: Before she knew it, it was noon. Ma Xiulan stood up and stretched her back. Since she was eating alone, she kept lunch simple. She used the leftover congee from the morning as a base, cut some shredded cabbage and leftover meat shreds, and boiled them into a hot bowl of rice stew, with a poached egg in it. After eating, she quickly washed the dishes, set an alarm for 13:15, and got ready for her lunch break.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Noon break
description: To avoid sleeping too deeply, Ma Xiulan did not go back to the master bedroom. Instead, she lay on her side on her daughter Ma Yuxin's small bed and rested for about 45 minutes. Her body relaxed, she fell asleep quickly, and when the alarm went off, she had regained a lot of energy.
location: Second bedroom of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Cutting fabric for New Year hanging decorations
description: After the afternoon nap, Ma Xiulan continued her handicraft time. She took out red cloth, golden-yellow cloth, and cardboard. First she turned on the radio and tuned to Tianjin Literature and Art Channel, humming along to the Peking opera 'Suo Lin Nang'. She deftly drew templates of fortune bags and auspicious clouds on the cardboard, traced the patterns onto the cloth with chalk, and cut them out with large scissors. After cutting each piece, she carefully folded the raw edges inward and ironed them flat, sorted them by type, and prepared for sewing.
location: Beside the coffee table in the living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Preparations before picking up the child, and picking up the child from school.
description: Ma Xiulan swept up the fabric scraps and loose threads in the living room, changed into her going-out padded coat, and checked her phone and loose change. She walked first to Huakang First Kindergarten, where at about 15:25 she picked up her daughter Ma Yuxin under the teacher's supervision and helped her daughter adjust her scarf; the mother and daughter then walked to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, where at about 15:45 she picked up her son Ma Mingzhe. As soon as the two children met, they chattered away sharing what they had seen and heard, and Xinxin showed off her newly earned reward stickers.
location: Set off from home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to Huakang First Kindergarten (Jinghai District, Tianjin), then to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin)

name: Returned home and prepared dinner
description: Back home, Ma Xiulan had her son take his little sister to play with building blocks in the living room, while she tied on an apron and went into the kitchen. She put water on to boil and started preparing the gravy for noodles: soaked wood ear mushrooms and day lily flowers were rinsed and chopped, and pork belly was sliced thin. When the water boiled, she added the noodles. Meanwhile, in another pan, she sizzled scallions in oil, stir-fried the pork slices, added the wood ears and day lilies, seasoned with soy sauce, salt, and sugar, added water, and brought it to a boil. Thickened with cornstarch slurry and drizzled with beaten egg, a fragrant pot of gravy was ready. She rinsed the noodles in cold water and served them into bowls.
location: China, Tianjin Jinghai District, No. 156 Jingwen Road, home kitchen

name: Dinner and helping with homework.
description: Ma Xiulan brought two bowls of noodles with gravy to the table and called the children to eat. Xinxin ate with gusto, and Zhezhe said the school meals were not as good as his mother's cooking. The three of them ate while listening to the children talk about funny things at school. After the meal, Xiulan had Xinxin help clear the bowls, while she quickly washed the dishes and wiped the table. Then she sat down at the desk in the second bedroom to check Zhezhe's math homework, pointed out two calculation errors, and patiently taught him to verify the answers. Xinxin practiced pinyin tracing beside her and asked her mother whenever she got stuck. Xiulan reminded them to sit up straight as she tutored.
location: Home dining room and second bedroom, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Phone call with eldest son and husband
description: After helping with homework, Ma Xiulan first made a WeChat video call to her eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, who boarded at school. Xuanxuan had just finished evening self-study. Xiulan told him to put on more clothes as the weather was cooling, asked about the cafeteria food, and learned that he had improved on his English monthly exam. She encouraged him but reminded him not to overwork himself. Just after hanging up, her husband Ma Zhiqiang called, saying the goods had been unloaded and he was resting at a service area, and that he could make it home in time for dumplings on the Winter Solstice the day after tomorrow. Xiulan told him to keep warm and drive safely, and after chatting about family matters, they ended the call.
location: Home living room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Bookkeeping and sharing in the handicraft group
description: Ma Xiulan took out her account book and noted down the day's expenses for buying vegetables and vinegar. Then she took photos of the newly made cloth hair flowers and the cut fabric, and together with a screenshot of the hand-kept pickled vegetable accounts she had made in Excel the day before, sent them all to the Jinghai Skillful Hands Women's Army group. Group member Zhou Xiuqin praised the hair flowers' color scheme, and Liu Chunmei was very interested in the Excel accounts and wanted to learn from her.
location: Home living room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Soaking feet to relax and chatting with family
description: The children were watching cartoons in the living room. Ma Xiulan boiled a pot of hot water, put a few mugwort leaves and dried ginger slices into the foot-soaking bucket, and sat down to soak her feet to ward off the winter night chill. While soaking her feet, she watched the children watch TV, occasionally commenting on the plot, enjoying the quiet family time.
location: Living room and bathroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Pre-bed washing, stretching, and checks
description: After soaking her feet, Ma Xiulan urged the children to wash up. Once the two were in bed, she brushed her teeth and washed her face, and carefully applied hand cream. Before going to bed, she did a set of waist and back stretches on the living room mat, including cat-cow pose and child's pose, to relieve tightness in her lower back. Finally, she went to the children's room to tuck Xinxin back in after she had kicked off the blanket, then returned to her own bedroom, set the alarm for 5:50 a.m. the next day, and turned off the light while thinking about buying ingredients to make dumplings for the Winter Solstice the next day. She gradually fell asleep.
location: Bathroom, living room, and bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Morning wake-up and stretching
description: The alarm went off and Ma Xiulan woke up from sleep. She stretched in bed, moved her shoulders and neck, and did some simple stretching. Feeling her muscles and bones loosen up, she became refreshed.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Prepare breakfast, wake the children, and have breakfast as a family.
description: After washing up, Ma Xiulan cooked millet porridge in the kitchen, made scallion egg pancakes, and picked out some pickled radish peels. Then she woke up her son Ma Mingzhe and daughter Ma Yuxin, braided her daughter's hair, and urged her son to wash up. The family of three sat together for breakfast. Xiulan reminded her son to wear his scarf in the cold weather and to come home by himself at noon.
location: Kitchen, children's room, and dining room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Take the children to school.
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan dressed her daughter neatly and walked her to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten. On the way, her daughter recited the nursery rhyme 'Little Snowflake'. After sending her daughter, she returned home, then walked to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School with her son and watched him enter the school at the gate.
location: Huakang First Kindergarten, Huakang Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning Baduanjin exercise
description: After dropping off the children and returning home, Ma Xiulan practiced Baduanjin in the living room. She deliberately lingered on the movement "Regulating the Spleen and Stomach by Single Arm Lifting" with extra breaths, and practiced the whole set for more than twenty minutes, feeling her energy and spirit lift.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Cleaning pickle jars and video-calling her mother for advice
description: Ma Xiulan scalded and dried the twenty or so glass jars she had accumulated in the kitchen, and at the same time asked her mother Li Xiuying over a video call for tips on pickling radish strips. Her mother taught her to add high-proof liquor and apple slices, and reminded her to plant more radishes in early spring.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Rest briefly and tidy up the house
description: After hanging up, Ma Xiulan put away the dried jars, wiped down the kitchen countertops and the stove, and left the kitchen neat and tidy, feeling in a good mood.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Shopping at Jingbai Supermarket and chatting with neighbors
description: Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to Jingbai Supermarket and bought minced pork belly, chives, and a bottle of vinegar for making dumplings for the weekend Winter Solstice. On the way home, she ran into her neighbor Wang Guilan, who was trimming vegetables at her doorstep. The two chatted about dumpling fillings; Wang Guilan shared her method for making radish filling, and they agreed to give each other dumplings to taste.
location: Jingbai Supermarket, Room 104, Building 19, Yuzhou Zunfu, Jinghai District, Tianjin; at the entrance of No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up her son from school and have a simple lunch together.
description: Ma Xiulan walked to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up her son Ma Mingzhe and take him home. Lunchtime was tight, so she reheated the leftover millet porridge and egg pancakes from the morning for her son, and made herself a bowl of clear noodle soup with a poached egg. Mother and son chatted while eating, and her son said he had understood everything in math class.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Noon break
description: After clearing the dishes and utensils, Ma Xiulan set a half-hour alarm in the bedroom and lay down for a short nap to regain energy for the afternoon.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Practiced computer bookkeeping and communicated with her husband via WeChat.
description: After her nap, Ma Xiulan opened her laptop, created a new Excel spreadsheet, entered the supermarket shopping expenses item by item, and checked the previous day's accounts. Seeing that her husband's cigarette spending had decreased, she happily sent him a WeChat message of encouragement, including a thumbs-up emoji and the words, “Dear, well done! Keep it up, and let's make our life prosperous and thriving!” She also continued practicing spreadsheet formulas.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tidying up clothes and picking up the two children from school.
description: Ma Xiulan first collected the dried clothes on the balcony, folded them, and put them in the wardrobe. Then she went out, first to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up her daughter Ma Yuxin, who was holding up a crayon drawing for her father. Then she walked with her daughter to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up her son Ma Mingzhe. The three of them chatted and laughed all the way home.
location: Home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Huakang First Kindergarten, Huakang Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Urged the children to do their homework.
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan had the children wash their hands, then urged her son to do his math homework at the dining table and helped him with it, while her daughter played with building blocks nearby. The house was quiet and orderly.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepared dinner and enjoyed noodles with gravy as a family
description: In the kitchen, Ma Xiulan trimmed and washed chives, prepared the meat filling, stir-fried the pork-and-chive sauce, and boiled the noodles. The family of three had dinner together, and the children ate with relish. After the meal, the children helped clear the bowls. Ma Xiulan quickly tidied the stove, washed the dishes, and prepared hot water for soaking their feet, adding mugwort and dried ginger slices.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Extra Baduanjin practice and a family foot soak with mugwort.
description: Ma Xiulan practiced an extra round of Baduanjin in the living room, striving for standard form in every movement, preparing for the community performance. Then she brought out the foot-soaking bucket and soaked her feet with the two children in mugwort and ginger water. During this time, she talked with her husband Ma Zhiqiang on the phone; he promised to come home for the family reunion dinner on the Winter Solstice and planned to attend the eldest son's awards ceremony.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The children washed up and went to bed.
description: After soaking her feet, Ma Xiulan washed her daughter's face and brushed her teeth, changed her into pajamas, and coaxed her to sleep. She then urged her son to wash up and go back to his room to sleep.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Bedtime stretching, personal washing, and safety check.
description: After the children fell asleep, Ma Xiulan did waist and back stretches and deep breathing in the master bedroom to relieve the fatigue of the day. Then she washed up, and before bed checked the kitchen gas and electrical plugs, confirmed the doors and windows were closed, and ensured safety.
location: Master bedroom, bathroom, and kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Scrolled through phone before bed to plan the next day, then turned off the lights and went to sleep
description: Lying in bed, Ma Xiulan picked up her phone, replied to her sisters' questions about stitching techniques in the handicraft group, checked tomorrow's weather forecast for the winter solstice, and mulled over preparing dumpling filling the next day. Drowsiness washed over her; she put down her phone, turned off the light, and went to sleep, looking forward to her husband coming home for a family reunion.
location: Master bedroom of the home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: In the early morning, prepared breakfast with the whole family.
description: At 6 a.m., the alarm went off right on time. Ma Xiulan got up quietly, put on thick pajamas, and went to the kitchen. She poured the millet and red dates she had soaked overnight into a pot, turned the heat to low to cook porridge, and steamed a few steamed buns and eggs bought yesterday. She thought about the pickled vegetables she needed to bring to the community elderly on Saturday, and that she had to get them done today. At 6:20, she woke her daughter Xinxin and son Zhezhe in turn. Xinxin was still groggy, so Ma Xiulan helped her put on a sweater; Zhezhe was quick and had already put on his school uniform. The family sat down for breakfast together. Xinxin recited a newly learned nursery rhyme, and Zhezhe urged everyone to leave, saying he needed to get to school early to turn in his homework.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China; home kitchen and dining room

name: Take son to school.
description: At 6:40, she set off on time. Ma Xiulan held one child in each hand, first walking her daughter to Huakang First Kindergarten and watching her go in holding the teacher's hand; then she turned around and took her son to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, reminding him to listen attentively in class and not to leave any food at lunch.
location: Jinghai District, Tianjin, China: from home to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, then to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street)

name: Shopping at the food market and returning home.
description: After dropping off the children, Ma Xiulan stopped by the Wutong Commune vegetable market on the way. Familiar with the place, she went straight to Aunt Sun's vegetable stall and, as planned, bought three white radishes, two cucumbers, and a bunch of scallions. Aunt Sun, as always, was generous and threw in a few sprigs of cilantro. After paying, she carried the vegetables and walked home. On the way, she saw a neighbor's dog from the courtyard wagging its tail at her and teased it a little. The autumn wind was a bit chilly, but it felt quite warm in the sun.
location: Jinghai District, Tianjin, China; Wutong Commune Vegetable Market and on the way home

name: Courtyard surprise and online sharing.
description: After arriving home and changing into an old cotton-padded coat, Ma Xiulan could not wait to go to the courtyard to see her treasured rose bushes. Gently brushing aside the straw, she saw a bright red bud pushing out of the frozen soil, and her heart immediately warmed. She quickly took out her phone, squatted down, found a good angle, took two close-up photos, and immediately sent them to the "Ma Family Big Family" WeChat group. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang replied, "This guy is really cold-hardy." Her son Zhezhe, at school, sent three thumbs-up in a row. She also made a video call to her mother Li Xiuying. After seeing it, her mother said it was a good omen and told her to take good care of it. After hanging up, she felt especially cheerful.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China - home courtyard and living room

name: Morning Baduanjin exercise
description: While in high spirits, Ma Xiulan laid out a yoga mat in the living room and did a complete round of Baduanjin. Today she felt that "Two Hands Hold Up the Heavens to Regulate the Triple Burner" was especially smooth, and her muscles and joints were loosened up. After finishing, she added several cat stretches, felt her waist much lighter, broke a light sweat, and was full of energy.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China, home living room.

name: Make traditional pickled vegetables.
description: Wiping off her sweat, Ma Xiulan put on an apron and started making pickled vegetables. Following the tips her mother taught in yesterday's video, she carefully washed the white radishes and cucumbers, cut them into evenly sized strips, sprinkled with salt, and mixed well to draw out the water. When simmering the sauce, she deliberately added some Sichuan peppercorns and ginger slices to enhance the flavor. After the sauce cooled, she squeezed the vegetable strips dry, layered them into pre-washed glass jars, poured the sauce over, and sealed them. In total, she made three jars: one to keep at home, one to send to her parents, and one prepared for Saturday's community activity for the elderly.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China, home kitchen

name: Simple lunch and leisure time on the phone.
description: At noon, alone, Ma Xiulan cooked a bowl of dried noodles, using leftover pickles from the morning and newly made pickles as toppings, and slurped them up. While eating, she scrolled through her phone, replied to the compliments about her flower gardening in the 'Ma Family Big Family' group chat, and glanced at the announcements in the community grid group.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China; home kitchen and dining room

name: Send the pickled vegetables to her parents.
description: Taking advantage of the warm midday, Ma Xiulan took a jar of freshly made pickled vegetables, rode her bicycle to Shengli Street to visit her parents. Her mother tasted a bite and praised her, saying this batch was better than last time, with a rich savory flavor; her father also smiled and said it whetted his appetite, asking for another bowl of porridge. She stayed with them for half an hour, chatted about family matters, and seeing that they were in good spirits, felt reassured, then cycled home.
location: No. 150 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China, at parents' home.

name: Deep cleaning and tidying up in the afternoon
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan thoroughly cleaned the kitchen first. She used a steel wool ball and dish detergent to scrub the grease off the stovetop, and also removed the oil collector from the range hood and scrubbed it clean, leaving the whole kitchen bright and shiny. Then she went to the courtyard, swept the fallen leaves into a pile, used a dustpan to pick them up, and dumped them into the trash can. Noticing the dead leaves on the few cilantro plants in the corner, she cleaned those up as well.
location: Kitchen and courtyard at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Afternoon handicraft activities and material preparation
description: After a busy morning, Ma Xiulan sat down on the sofa with the best sunlight in the living room to catch her breath. She took out the half-embroidered tea coaster, put on her thimble, and stitched it thread by thread. The sun felt warm on her hands, and her mood calmed down as well. Then she remembered that for Saturday's elderly assistance activity, besides delivering pickled vegetables, she could also bring handicrafts for everyone to do. So she dug out the felt ornament craft kits she had brought back from the community, sorted the patterns, colored thread, and stuffing into categories, and planned to take them there to make with the elderly, thinking that a lively time together would be best.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China; home living room and study.

name: Pick up the children from school
description: At 3:40 in the afternoon, Ma Xiulan left home early to pick up her daughter. As soon as the little girl came out of the kindergarten gate, she ran over and chattered about how the teacher had taught a new song that day, and insisted on singing it to her. Holding her daughter's hand, she walked toward the No. 3 Primary School. She waited a while at the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, and her son came out with his classmates. As soon as he saw her, he said he had finished today's math homework at school. Ma Xiulan praised him for being sensible. Holding her daughter with her left hand and her son with her right, she walked home together with them.
location: Along the route from Huakang First Kindergarten to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School in Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Prepare dinner and help with homework
description: After arriving home, Ma Xiulan had the children do their homework in the living room while she busied herself in the kitchen. After finishing his homework, her son took the initiative to run into the yard and dump the pile of fallen leaves she had swept into the trash can. She did not say anything, but thought to herself that this child had really grown up. Quickly and deftly, she stir-fried some garlic greens, made tomato and egg soup, then steamed the sea bass she had bought yesterday. Thinking that her eldest son Xuanxuan was in a growth spurt, she also set a spare rib soup on the rice cooker's timer so he could have it after coming home from evening self-study.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China, home kitchen and living room

name: The whole family has dinner together
description: When the eldest son Ma Mingxuan came home from school, dinner was just on the table. The family of four sat around the table, and the children vied to tell funny stories from school, making the meal lively. Ma Xiulan served each person a bowl of pork rib soup, and watching them eat with relish, she felt very content.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Clearing the dishes and helping with homework.
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan quickly cleared the dishes and wiped the table clean. Then she sat down in the living room to check her son's and daughter's homework. A few decimal multiplication problems in her son's math assignment were wrong, so she patiently explained them to him until he understood. Her daughter's pinyin was written very neatly, so she rewarded her daughter with a jujube.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China, home kitchen and living room

name: Community contact and chatting with neighbors
description: While the children played by themselves, Ma Xiulan took out her phone and sent a WeChat message to Zheng Xiuying, the community grid worker, to confirm the time and meeting place for Saturday's elderly assistance event. Just after sending it, her neighbor Wang Guilan called her from the courtyard gate. She went out and chatted with Wang Guilan while standing. Hearing that she was going to help the community, Wang Guilan praised her for being capable.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China; home living room and front-yard gate.

name: Computer bookkeeping and activity planning
description: Back indoors, Ma Xiulan turned on the computer and, just as she had practiced yesterday, skillfully opened an Excel spreadsheet. She entered the costs of making pickled vegetables last month one by one, and checked the embroidery and handwork fees she had received, calculating that she had earned an extra 450-plus yuan this month. She was quite happy about that. She also made a list of things to bring on Saturday: three jars of pickled vegetables, a non-woven fabric kit, and a pair of scissors.
location: Home study, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Foot soaking and acupressure massage
description: Ma Xiulan fetched a basin of hot water and comfortably soaked her feet for 20 minutes, feeling warm all over. While soaking, she used her thumbs to massage the Hegu acupoints on both hands, feeling an aching soreness, and silently reviewed the schedule for Saturday's event. She felt the day had been busy and fulfilling.
location: Home bedroom, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Parent-child time before bed
description: After soaking her feet, Ma Xiulan went to make sure the children brushed their teeth and washed their faces. Her eldest son Xuanxuan went back to his room to read by himself, while she told her daughter Xinxin and son Zhezhe two bedtime stories, kissed their foreheads, and gently closed the door after seeing them fall asleep.
location: No. 156, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China, children's bedroom at home

name: Evening rest and going to bed
description: Back in her own room, Ma Xiulan glanced at her phone and set the alarm for 6 a.m. the next morning. Lying down, she thought of the red rose buds she had found today, the pickled vegetables she had made, and the children's smiling faces. She felt very secure and soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: Home bedroom, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Early rise, preparation, and taking the children to school
description: She got up at 5:50 in the morning and did some simple stretching. Then she prepared breakfast for the whole family in the kitchen, steaming buns, cooking millet porridge, and frying eggs. At 6:20 she woke up her daughter Ma Yuxin, helped her put on her sweater, tucked a warm pack into her clothes, and reminded her to stay warm in the cold weather. At 6:40 she took her daughter to Huakang No.1 Kindergarten. On the way, she greeted a neighbor. At the kindergarten gate, she handed her daughter to the teacher. She quickly returned home and urged her son Ma Mingzhe, who was still lying in bed, to get up. After helping her son eat breakfast, at 7:15 she took him to Jinghai District No.3 Primary School on an electric bike and watched him enter the school gate.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Huakang First Kindergarten; Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School

name: Baduanjin practice in the community park and supermarket shopping
description: After seeing off her son, she went to the small square of Jingwen Road Community Park to join the Baduanjin group practice. She practiced with 5-6 group members including Liu Chunmei and Zhang Shufen, focusing on rehearsing the entrance, exit, and formation for tomorrow's performance at the community hall. Coach Wang Shulan recorded video and gave comments. She agreed with Liu Chunmei to meet at 7:40 tomorrow morning at the hall entrance to do a stage rehearsal first. After the practice, she went with Liu Chunmei and others to Zhang Shufen's convenience supermarket on the west side of the park to shop, buying discounted laundry detergent and honey cookies. At the checkout counter, she chatted with Zhang Shufen, who praised her eldest son Ma Mingxuan for doing well on the math exam. Ma Xiulan suggested that the children could do homework together.
location: Small square of the community park on Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and Zhang Shufen's convenience store

name: Returning home to tidy up and do household chores
description: Walked home from the supermarket, put away the laundry detergent and biscuits she bought, washed the breakfast dishes and wiped down the stove. Then she sorted the clothes that needed washing and put them into the washing machine, and went to the small vegetable garden in the courtyard to check on the roses. The red shoots that had emerged yesterday were full of vitality today, making her feel happy.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning: hand-cutting materials for the elderly assistance project
description: At the handicraft table by the living room window, she cut out pieces from the non-woven fabric Sister Zheng had brought yesterday. First she drew a pomegranate pattern, then cut out more than twenty red pomegranate bodies and green leaves, thinking about the elderly people sewing at Saturday's senior assistance activity as she worked quickly and neatly.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Lunch and lunch break.
description: At noon, she reheated the leftover tomato and egg noodles from yesterday and had a simple lunch with half a steamed bun. After the meal, she leaned back on the sofa to rest, browsed local news on her phone, and took a short nap.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Video call with mother.
description: After the afternoon nap, I made a WeChat video call to my mother, Li Xiuying, and showed her the pomegranate cut out of non-woven fabric that I had just finished. She asked about Saturday's elder assistance activity and reminded me not to forget to bring pickled vegetables. The two also talked about Father's health, and I urged him not to go out too often in cold weather.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Continued hand cutting and drawing in the afternoon.
description: After the nap, feeling more energetic, she continued her handicraft. She took out the pomegranate pieces cut in the morning, and carefully drew pomegranate seed patterns and little smiling faces on each piece of red cloth with a ballpoint pen. Her phone played local storytelling beside her. She listened while working, and time flew by.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up her daughter from school and teach her to recognize colors.
description: At 3 p.m., she walked out to Huakang First Kindergarten to pick up her daughter Ma Yuxin. After picking her up, she listened to her daughter share the new nursery rhyme she had learned that day. When they got home, her daughter moved a small stool over and sat beside her. She picked up a red felt pomegranate and green leaves and patiently taught her daughter to recognize red and green. Her daughter repeated the words and touched the fabric with her hands.
location: Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and home at 156 Jingwen Road.

name: Prepare dinner and have dinner with the whole family.
description: She let her daughter play in the living room and started preparing dinner: steaming steamed buns, stir-frying garlic lettuce, and making seaweed and egg drop soup. Her son Ma Mingzhe came home from school and said he was hungry; she told him to go do his homework, but he first spent a while playing with his little sister. The eldest son Ma Mingxuan came home just after six, and then her husband Ma Zhiqiang also rushed back. At dinner, everyone shared funny things: Ma Xiulan told an amusing episode from Baduanjin practice, Ma Mingzhe talked about the shuttlecock-kicking competition in PE class, and Ma Yuxin proudly showed off that she had learned to recognize colors. The whole family enjoyed a warm and happy time.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: After dinner, helped with homework and chatted with neighbors.
description: After dinner, she quickly cleared the table and washed the dishes, then sat in the living room to help her two sons with their homework while her little daughter drew pictures with crayons beside her. Her second son, Ma Mingzhe, had difficulty understanding the math word problems and only got them after repeated explanations; her eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, finished his homework on his own and asked her to sign it. During this time, she heard her neighbor Wang Guilan outside taking out the trash. She went out and chatted with her about the plan to make dumplings at the winter solstice, and they agreed to discuss it in more detail tomorrow after the community event. She came back, continued tutoring and checking assignments and signing them. Around eight o'clock, the children finished their homework and packed their schoolbags.
location: Home and front yard at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Stretching with her husband, then soaking feet and chatting.
description: After showering, her husband Ma Zhiqiang said his lower back was stiff. Ma Xiulan pulled him into the living room to do stretching exercises such as cat stretch and wall-supported waist twists. Her husband joked that she was almost a professional trainer. Then the two sat on the sofa soaking their feet, talked about the next day's rehearsal and what the husband had seen while driving, and together planned the pickled vegetables and pomegranate crafts to bring for the day-after-tomorrow elderly assistance activity, as well as discussing year-end expenses.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Personal hygiene and putting the child to sleep
description: After soaking her feet, she washed up first. Then she told her daughter Ma Yuxin two bedtime stories, then went to the sons' room to check on the two boys already lying down and tuck in the quilt corners.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening relaxation, bookkeeping, and going to bed
description: After the children were all asleep, she leaned against the headboard and scrolled through community group messages, opened the bookkeeping app to record today's expenses for laundry detergent and biscuits. Set the alarm for 6:50 tomorrow morning. At 23:45 at night, turned off the light and lay down, recalling the fulfilling and satisfying day, and fell asleep quickly.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Getting up, morning exercise, and breakfast preparation
description: Got up at 6:10, first did some simple stretching by the bed and exercised the shoulders and neck; then followed the phone in the living room to practice the Baduanjin movements that stretch the shoulders and back for about fifteen minutes. After washing up, she made two bowls of milk oatmeal, and put the three jars of pickled vegetables and the blood pressure monitor bag packed the day before by the door, getting ready to go out.
location: Room 101, Unit 1, Building 1, Jingwen Road Community, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Tidying up the house and packing things for going out
description: After breakfast, she quickly washed the dishes, wiped down the stove, tidied the sofa cushions in the living room, and took out the maroon coat she had ironed the day before to try on. She checked each jar of pickled vegetables and the blood pressure monitor in the canvas bag one by one, made sure they were securely wrapped and the zipper was intact, and made final preparations for visiting Grandma Zhang.
location: Room 101, Unit 1, Building 1, Jingwen Road Community, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Walking there and elderly assistance service
description: She changed into a thick gray-green cotton-padded jacket and flat cotton-padded shoes, slung a canvas bag over her shoulder, and walked along Jingwen Road for less than ten minutes to the home of Granny Zhang, who lives alone. She put the three jars of homemade pickled vegetables in the kitchen, then skillfully took Granny Zhang's blood pressure twice; the readings were stable at around 117/75. She reminded her to keep warm and contact the community whenever needed. Afterward she chatted with the old lady for half an hour and listened to her recall memories of pickling vegetables in her youth. She did not leave until Granny Zhang looked a little sleepy.

participant.name: Grandma Zhang
participant.relation: Elderly people living alone in the community

location: No. 40, Hutong, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Buying groceries on the way home.
description: After leaving Grandma Zhang's house, she turned into the Wutong Commune vegetable market and found Aunt Sun's stall, a familiar vendor. She bought fresh spinach and spring onions, and Aunt Sun, as usual, threw in a few extra sprigs of cilantro. She also asked about the price of pork ribs, thinking she could make braised pork ribs for dinner, then walked home carrying the vegetables.
location: Stall B05, 1st Floor, Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, at the intersection of Jingwen Road and Wutong Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Resting, taking inventory of handicrafts, and tending the courtyard
description: After returning home, she first drank some hot water, put away the groceries, and sat on the sofa to sort the pomegranate non-woven fabric craft kit cut out the previous day into main bodies and leaves, bundling them with rubber bands and counting them to have a clear idea. Then she pushed open the back door, walked into the yard, squatted down to look at the rosebush, and found that the red sprouts that had emerged a few days earlier looked more vigorous. She casually pulled out the weeds and watered it, feeling delighted.
location: Room 101, Unit 1, Building 1, Jingwen Road Community, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Make lunch and eat together with her husband
description: She kneaded dough and rolled out noodles, making a light bowl of spinach and egg drop sauce noodles using the freshly bought spinach and eggs. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang returned from a driving trip, and the two sat at the small table in the kitchen, each with a bowl of noodles, eating and chatting. She told her husband that Grandma Zhang's health was stable, and her tone was full of relief.
location: Room 101, Unit 1, Building 1, Jingwen Road Community, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Noon break
description: Feeling sleepy after clearing the dishes, she asked her husband to put the bowls in the sink, then went back to the bedroom for a nap and set the alarm for 1:20. Covered by a soft quilt, she fell into a deep sleep amid the occasional sound of cars outside the window.
location: Room 101, Unit 1, Building 1, Jingwen Road Community, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Changing and dressing up to attend the awards ceremony
description: After the alarm rang, she got up on time, washed up, and felt refreshed. She changed into the ironed maroon coat, carefully combed her hair in front of the mirror, and applied face cream. Seeing her dressed up and spirited, her husband praised her. She smiled, picked up the certificate cover, and told her husband she was going to receive the award.
location: Room 101, Unit 1, Building 1, Jingwen Road Community, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Attend the community's annual Most Beautiful Family award ceremony
description: At 2 p.m., the multifunctional hall of the community activity center was warm and cozy. The community awarded her the Harmonious Family Nomination Award. Grid worker Zheng Xiuying handed her a bright red honorary certificate and an organic cotton quilt. Amid applause, she went on stage to receive the award, expressed her thanks, shook hands with other winners, and said it was an honor for the whole family.
location: Multi-function Hall, 2nd Floor, Community Service Building, intersection of Jingwen Road and Shuguang Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Carrying quilts home, met a neighbor and shared the joy
description: She carefully walked out of the community gate holding the quilt and certificate. At the entrance of the Jingwen Road residential area, she ran into her neighbor Wang Guilan, who was returning from grocery shopping. She happily showed off the certificate, and Wang Guilan leaned in to feel the fabric of the quilt, offering congratulations repeatedly. The two chatted at the alley entrance for a while before going home separately.
location: Entrance to Jingwen Road Residential Community, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Showing the prize and certificate to her husband.
description: Pushing open the door and entering, her husband was sitting on the sofa looking at his phone. She held up the quilt and certificate high and told him happily this was an award the family had won. Her husband stood up, took the certificate, looked through it, then touched the new quilt and nodded in praise. She leaned against him and vividly recounted the award ceremony.
location: Room 101, Unit 1, Building 1, Jingwen Road Community, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Preparing dinner
description: She tied on an apron and got busy: first she blanched the pork ribs, then made braised pork ribs, garlic spinach, and seaweed egg drop soup. The three children came home from playing outside, ran into the kitchen at the smell, and she smiled as she hurried them to wash their hands and go do homework. The aroma of cooking and the lively noise of the family mingled in the kitchen.
location: Room 101, Unit 1, Building 1, Jingwen Road Community, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: The whole family had dinner together.
description: When the dishes were served, she placed the certificate in a conspicuous spot nearby. Her eldest son asked curiously about the award ceremony, and she happily told the story again, while her younger son and daughter reached out to touch the new quilt. Her husband put a piece of spare rib in her bowl and softly said she had worked hard, and she felt warm inside.
location: Room 101, Unit 1, Building 1, Jingwen Road Community, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Cozy family time at night
description: After dinner, her husband voluntarily washed the dishes. She took the three children to the living room, where her husband spread a new quilt over the spacious leather sofa. The family of five squeezed onto it, wrapped in the warm quilt, watching the New Year's Eve program rehearsal on TV. The children burst into laughter at the songs, dances, and crosstalk. She leaned on her husband's shoulder, feeling the warmth and laughter beside her, with a sense of contentment. Meanwhile, she also called her mother to tell her the good news of winning the award, and her mother was delighted for her on the other end of the line.
location: Room 101, Unit 1, Building 1, Jingwen Road Community, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Washing up and putting the younger daughter to sleep
description: After the program ended, she urged the children to wash up. She first washed the younger daughter's face and brushed her teeth, then carried her to the small bed and told her a story to help her fall asleep. The second son also washed up and lay down by himself. She left only after settling the children.
location: Room 101, Unit 1, Building 1, Jingwen Road Community, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Late-night couple talk and going to bed.
description: After settling the children, she returned to the master bedroom, where her husband was already leaning against the headboard. She sat on the edge of the bed and quietly talked with him about the happy events of the day: Grandma Zhang was in good health, and their family had won a prize. Her husband praised her as the family's main contributor. She also mentioned that she had agreed with the neighbor to make dumplings the next day, and her husband nodded in agreement. The two chatted about everyday matters, hugged each other with smiles, and fell asleep, sleeping especially soundly.
location: Room 101, Unit 1, Building 1, Jingwen Road Community, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Woke up early in the morning and prepared breakfast
description: On the morning of the winter solstice, Ma Xiulan woke up at 6:30, got out of bed quietly, put on her cotton pajamas, and went to wash up. Then she went into the kitchen, rinsed millet and cooked porridge, steamed steamed buns, washed and blanched the leftover spinach from yesterday, minced garlic to prepare a stir-fry, and took out her homemade pickled cucumbers from the jar as a side dish. She busily prepared breakfast for her family, with steam filling the kitchen.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family breakfast and announcement of the Winter Solstice plan
description: After the porridge and dishes were served, Ma Xiulan went upstairs to wake her husband Ma Zhiqiang and the children. Although it was Sunday, the children perked up as soon as they heard they would be making dumplings and inviting Grandma and Grandpa over for a meal. At the table, Ma Xiulan served vegetables to her daughter while announcing the plan for a thorough house cleaning and the family reunion dinner in the evening. Everyone responded enthusiastically, and the atmosphere was lively.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family meeting to assign cleaning tasks
description: After dinner, the family gathered in the living room. Ma Xiulan began assigning tasks: her husband Ma Zhiqiang would wipe the windows and move furniture; her eldest son Ma Mingxuan would tidy the bookshelf and desk; her second son Ma Mingzhe would sweep the indoor floors and the fallen leaves in the courtyard; her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin would wipe the coffee table and low cabinets. Everyone took their tasks and began to work with enthusiasm.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Husband cleaned the windows and moved furniture
description: Ma Zhiqiang carried the ladder over and started cleaning from the bedroom windows. He used a wet cloth first, then dry newspaper, polishing them until they were bright and clear, not even missing the gaps in the window frames. Ma Xiulan handed him towels, changed the water, and reminded him to be careful. Afterward, Ma Zhiqiang moved the living room sofa and coffee table aside to make room for the cleaning.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: In the morning, Ma Xiulan boiled milk using her proven recipe, let it cool, added the starter culture powder, stirred well, and poured it into clean jars to keep warm and ferment for 8 hours. She successfully made two jars of yogurt. In the afternoon, she divided it into several small glass bottles. One portion was kept as an after-school snack for the three children, and the other two portions were meant to be given away.
description: Ma Yuxin held a small rag and, imitating her mother, carefully wiped the coffee table and low cabinet. Where she couldn't reach, she stood on tiptoe. Ma Xiulan praised her when she saw this, and the child worked even harder, humming a nursery rhyme as she did.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The sons tidy up and clean
description: Ma Mingxuan organized the entire bookshelf in the study, tied up old books, arranged textbooks by grade, and wiped the desk spotless. Ma Mingzhe carefully swept fallen leaves in the courtyard and filled garbage bags. Ma Xiulan called to him through the window to rest, but he smiled and continued picking up dead branches.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Deep cleaning of the kitchen and display of award certificates
description: Ma Xiulan sprays degreasing cleaner in the kitchen, scrubs the stove with a steel wool ball, removes the range hood filter to soak and wash, takes out the trash, and clears the countertop. Then she goes to the courtyard, shovels dead branches and fallen leaves into the trash bin, and moves the cold-hardy potted plants back to the corner for shelter from the wind. Finally, she takes out the "Harmonious Family" certificate awarded by the community and hangs it squarely in the most prominent spot in the living room. Looking at the spotless home, she feels light-hearted.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Finishing the cleaning and being praised by the whole family
description: Close to noon, Ma Xiulan called the whole family together for a final check. The windows were bright, the floors were spotless, and everything was in its place. She praised each one in turn: Ma Mingxuan's bookshelf was the neatest, Ma Mingzhe swept the floor like a big kid, Ma Yuxin's wiping was the shiniest, and Dad's windows could be used as mirrors. She praised the whole family as the most united. The children jumped for joy, and Ma Zhiqiang smiled too.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Simple lunch and rest.
description: At noon the family simply ate the leftover mantou, stir-fried spinach, pickled vegetables, and millet porridge from breakfast. After the meal, the children went back to their room for a nap, and Ma Zhiqiang also lay down for a rest. Ma Xiulan cleaned up the dishes, then leaned back on the sofa to rest, browsing her phone to check Winter Solstice customs and planning the evening arrangements.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Phone invitation and preparing dumpling ingredients.
description: Ma Xiulan first called her mother, Li Xiuying, to invite her and her father over for dumplings in the evening. Her mother happily agreed and said she would come early in the afternoon to help. Then she called her neighbor Wang Guilan and explained that today's family dinner made it inconvenient to make dumplings together, but she would invite her another day. After hanging up, Ma Xiulan went into the kitchen, took pork belly and dried shrimp from the refrigerator, got out chives and eggs, and began kneading dough, chopping meat, and preparing the filling for the dumplings.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Mother came to help prepare the filling
description: Her mother, Li Xiuying, rode an old-style bicycle, turned from Shengli Street into the alley, and arrived carrying a bag of home-grown scallions. As soon as she saw the filling Ma Xiulan had prepared, she suggested adding some sesame oil. After washing her hands, she deftly washed the vegetables and chopped scallions and ginger, and the mother and daughter prepared everything together, chatting and laughing in the kitchen.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The whole family made dumplings together for the Winter Solstice.
description: After the dough and filling were ready, the whole family sat around the living room to make dumplings. Ma Zhiqiang kneaded the dough and cut the pieces, Ma Xiulan rolled out the wrappers, and her mother Li Xiuying made plump gold-ingot-shaped dumplings. The children curiously joined in: Ma Mingxuan's dumplings looked presentable, Ma Mingzhe made dough lumps, and Ma Yuxin shaped little rabbits out of dough. The lopsided dumplings drew laughter, creating a warm and lively atmosphere.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Boiled dumplings and made Laba vinegar.
description: After wrapping some dumplings, Ma Xiulan heated water and got ready to cook them. Ma Zhiqiang mixed minced garlic with vinegar to make Laba vinegar. Her mother Li Xiuying added the dumplings in batches, gently stirring them with a slotted spoon to prevent sticking. The kitchen was steaming hot, and the aroma of dumplings filled the air.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Winter Solstice Reunion Dumpling Feast
description: Father Ma Jianguo came from Shengli Avenue and arrived just in time for the first pot of dumplings. The whole family sat around the table, eating dumplings with Laba vinegar. Father said with emotion that the Winter Solstice is as important as the New Year, and that nothing is better than the whole family sitting together and eating a hot, hearty meal of dumplings. Ma Xiulan felt warm inside. Seeing everyone eat happily, she felt that all her hard work was worth it.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: After-dinner cleanup and tea chat time
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan cleared the dishes and took them to the kitchen to wash. Her mother, Li Xiuying, helped cover the leftover dishes. Her father, Ma Jianguo, sat in the living room, beaming as the children gathered around him telling funny school stories. Ma Zhiqiang put away the leftover dumplings, made hot tea, and brought it to the living room. The whole family chatted over tea, happy and harmonious.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: See off parents and help the children wash up
description: It was getting late, and her parents said goodbye. Ma Xiulan walked them to the entrance of the lane and told them to take care. After returning, she urged the children to wash up. Ma Yuxin was tired from playing and was fussing, so Ma Xiulan soothed her while washing her. Ma Mingxuan and Ma Mingzhe washed up by themselves. Ma Xiulan put the dirty clothes into the washing machine. Ma Zhiqiang tidied the living room furniture and then mopped the floor.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Couple's evening chat while soaking their feet
description: After the children fell asleep, Ma Xiulan and Ma Zhiqiang soaked their feet on the sofa, the hot water soothing their fatigue. She leaned on her husband's shoulder and talked about the happy things from the day: the house was tidied up, the certificate was put up on the wall, and the dumplings were delicious. Ma Zhiqiang praised her for managing the household well. The two chatted quietly about the future and plans for the children until the water went cold.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pre-sleep tidying, keeping accounts, and going to bed
description: Ma Xiulan asked Ma Zhiqiang to go to sleep first, and she stayed behind to tidy the kitchen, wipe the countertops, turn off the main gas valve, and check the doors and windows. Then she returned to the bedroom, took out her account book, and recorded the day's expenses on groceries and meat filling. Thinking of the warmth of the family reunion and the new certificate of merit, she felt content and at ease, turned off the light, lay down, and soon fell asleep.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning stretching and preparing breakfast
description: It was just beginning to get light. After the 5:30 alarm, Xiulan sat up gently and did a set of shoulder and neck stretches at the edge of the bed to ease the soreness in her lower back from making dumplings the day before. After washing up, she went into the kitchen, opened the fridge, took out some of the leftover three-delicacy dumplings, and placed them on the steaming rack. She scooped half a bowl of millet from the rice jar, rinsed it twice in water, poured it into the rice cooker, and pressed the porridge button. Then she quickly sliced a plate of soy-marinated cucumbers and took out a few pieces of her homemade sweet pickled garlic from the jar, and the side dishes for breakfast were ready. The kitchen gradually filled with the fragrance of millet porridge and the fresh aroma of dumplings.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Wake the children, urge them to eat, and take them to school
description: Xiulan hurried into the children's room, gently woke up her youngest daughter Xinxin, and helped her get dressed. Then she turned to call her second son, Zhezhe, who, as expected, was still lying in bed. Xiulan put on a stern face and urged him a couple of times before he slowly got up. The whole family sat around the dining table. Xinxin ate five dumplings and a small bowl of millet porridge, and only then did Xiulan wipe her mouth. Zhezhe wolfed down his food, grabbed his backpack and rushed out. Xiulan quickly grabbed her small bag and followed. She first rode her e-bike to the gate of Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, watched Xinxin walk inside with the teacher, then turned the bike around and, three minutes later, delivered Zhezhe to the drop-off point at Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, reminding him to pay attention in class.
location: Home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; and Huakang First Kindergarten and Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School.

name: Visited Grandma Zhang and completed the senior assistance service.
description: After leaving school, Xiulan did not rush home; instead, she turned into a nearby alley. She took a thermal lunchbox of hot dumplings from the basket of her electric bike and knocked on Grandma Zhang's door. Grandma Zhang, 80 years old, lived alone; when she saw Xiulan, she beamed as if seeing her own daughter. Xiulan handed the dumplings to the old lady, helped her sit on the sofa, and familiarly took a blood pressure monitor from the cabinet to measure Grandma Zhang's blood pressure. "117/75, great, Grandma!" Xiulan reported with a smile, putting Grandma Zhang's mind at ease. Xiulan then chatted with her for another ten-plus minutes, reminding her to go out less in cold weather and take her medicine on time, before getting up to leave.
location: Grandma Zhang's home, No. 14, a hutong on Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning routine exercise: balcony stepping and Baduanjin
description: Back home, Xiulan took off her heavy coat and first marched in place on the balcony for ten minutes, watching pedestrians on Jingwen Road below. Then she walked to the open space in the middle of the living room, stood steady, relaxed, and began to do a slow round of Baduanjin. She paid special attention to the moves that required strength from the waist and abdomen, doing them more slowly and more thoroughly than usual, and felt that her stiff lower back had indeed loosened up a lot. After finishing the routine, she did a few simple stretches, and a thin layer of sweat appeared on her forehead.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Update the income and expense accounts for the side business.
description: Xiulan wiped off her sweat, poured herself a glass of warm water, went to the study, and turned on the family desktop computer. She first logged into mobile banking to check this month's incoming transactions, then opened the Excel spreadsheet Sister Xiuqin had taught her to use. Muttering to herself, she carefully entered: three online sales of pickled vegetables, 320 yuan in total; the 50-yuan balance for a pair of pillowcases embroidered for Sister Liu from the neighboring community; and the 100-yuan balance for the embroidered pieces sold in summer also arrived. Cross-checking with her ledger, she added in the costs of the fabric scraps, colored threads, and seasoning bottles she had purchased, item by item, then pressed Enter: this month's net income was 168 yuan. "All right, every little bit counts." Xiulan nodded with satisfaction, thinking about what she could buy for the children with the money. In the middle of this, her phone rang. It was a message from the admin of the local handicraft group, asking if she had time next week to take on a batch of Christmas-themed crochet dolls. Xiulan replied, "I'll think about it."
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tidy up the house and tend the vegetable planter on the balcony.
description: Turned off the computer, Xiulan began to tidy up the house. She first hung up the jackets the children had left on the sofa the day before, then wiped the dining table clean. Seeing the newly hung "Harmonious Family Nomination Award" certificate on the wall, she smiled unconsciously. Then she walked to the vegetable planter in the corner of the balcony, picked up a small watering can, and carefully watered the pots of wintering baby bok choy and spring onions, and pulled out a few stray seedlings. These touches of green were a little pastoral pleasure in Xiulan's heart.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Lunch, midday break, and checking gig job information
description: At noon she was alone, so Xiulan reheated a few dumplings left from the morning and the millet porridge she had cooked, and made do with a simple lunch with pickled vegetables. After tidying up a bit, she lay down on the bed in the bedroom for a midday rest. She didn't actually fall asleep, but picked up her phone and scrolled through the local gig groups for a while, checking whether there were any new handcraft or short-term job opportunities. At the same time, she liked the photos her sisters posted in the family group.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Shopping at the vegetable market and chatting with neighbors
description: Just after 1:30, Xiulan changed into her going-out clothes, put on her helmet, and rode her e-bike straight to Xingwang Vegetable Market. She knew the way well and went straight to Aunt Sun Guifang's stall. "Sister Guifang, give me two jin of chives, the local kind with a strong flavor. And pick me six free-range eggs." Sun Guifang weighed the vegetables neatly while chatting with Xiulan: "Xiulan, your Zhigang now knows how to order groceries on his phone? My old man has learned too, saying it's cheaper online and he doesn't like to move." Xiulan smiled and took up the conversation: "Online is convenient, but the freshness of the vegetables and the flavor of these mature chives—I have to pick them myself to feel at ease. Don't you think?" The two laughed and chatted a bit more about the children's grades, and then Xiulan left the market with her vegetables in laughter and joy, riding her e-bike slowly for thirteen minutes to get home.
location: Xingwang Vegetable Market, 168 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing dinner ingredients and doing waist and back stretches to relax.
description: After arriving home, Xiulan first picked over and washed the chives, then spread them out in a bamboo tray to drain. Then she scooped two bowls of white flour, added some salt and cold water, and began kneading the dough. She covered the dough basin with a damp cloth and let it rest. She also moved a piece of pork belly left over from yesterday from the freezer to the refrigerator to thaw. After doing all this, she saw it was still early, so she sat down on the floor mat in the living room, did ten minutes of lower back and waist stretches, and rolled her sore calves a few times with a foam roller.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up younger daughter from school, supervise homework, and prepare dinner
description: At 4:10, Xiulan left on time, riding her electric bike to Xinxin's kindergarten to pick her up and go home. It was just past 4:30 when they got home. She let Xinxin play by herself at the living room table while she started mixing the filling, rolling out the wrappers, and making chive pockets. At exactly 5:00, Zhezhe came running back home with his schoolbag, his footsteps clattering. Xiulan wiped her hands, settled Xinxin first, then moved a chair next to Zhezhe and urged him to take out his homework notebook and do his work. The little rascal indeed had sly ideas; while Xiulan wasn't paying attention, he cut a new eraser into several pieces with a knife. Xiulan saw it but didn't get angry. She patiently took the knife, told him the eraser was for correcting wrong characters, and demonstrated the correct way to erase a few times, then kept watching him do his arithmetic problems. Two neat rows of raw chive pockets were already arranged on the cutting board.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten

name: Family dinner, tasting chive pockets
description: It was completely dark. At 6:20, the eldest son Xuanxuan and her husband Ma Zhiqiang, who had just come back from driving, entered the house one after another. The house immediately became lively. Xiulan tied on an apron, turned on the gas stove, poured in oil, and began to fry chive pockets. The kitchen soon filled with sizzling sounds, and the aroma of chives and eggs drifted through the whole house. When the golden chive pockets were placed on the table, the family sat around together. Zhiqiang took a bite and kept praising the taste. Xiulan also brought out the leftover dumplings from noon and microwaved them for two minutes so the children could eat them together. At the table, Xinxin chattered about how her kindergarten teacher praised her drawing, while Zhezhe guiltily kept his head down and shoveled rice into his mouth.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Clearing the table, helping with homework, and signing it
description: After the meal, Xiulan quickly cleared the dishes, wiped the table, and washed the dishes. Just after seven, she returned to Zhezhe and Xuanxuan's side and watched over them as they finished the rest of their homework. She carefully checked Zhezhe's math exercises and signed his Chinese character notebook. Beside them, Xuanxuan was self-disciplined and finished his homework on his own; after checking that it was correct, Xiulan signed his notebook too.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Urging the children to wash up and coaxing the little daughter to sleep
description: Xiulan glanced at the wall clock and called the three children to wash up. She first took Xinxin to the bathroom, helped her brush her teeth, wash her face and feet, and change into pajamas. Then she urged the two boys to go wash up quickly. When Xinxin was comfortably lying in bed, Xiulan sat by her bedside and told her a little bedtime story about a little white rabbit planting radishes. Within a few minutes, Xinxin was fast asleep with a sweet smile.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening embroidery of small New Year lucky bag ornaments
description: After the children had all quieted down, Xiulan tiptoed to the living room and turned on only the floor lamp beside the sofa. From her sewing box, she took out the red cloth and golden silk thread she had cut a few days earlier, put on her reading glasses, and began sewing a small New Year lucky pouch for Xinxin. Her stitches were fine and close. As she embroidered, she thought about embroidering the word 'fortune' on the front of the pouch. Just as she was getting into it, Xinxin ran out barefoot without her noticing, leaned on the sofa armrest, and watched her mother's hands with bright eyes. Xiulan did not shoo her away; instead, she lovingly pulled her over to sit properly, taught her hand over hand how to hold the needle, and let her sew the simplest straight line. Although it was crooked, Xinxin was delighted. After more than ten minutes of playing, Xiulan persuaded her to go back to sleep. Then she continued sewing quietly by herself until 10:30, when the outline of a small lucky pouch had basically taken shape, stuffed with a ball of cotton, plump and adorable.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Washing up before bed and going to sleep
description: After finishing the last stitch, Xiulan put away the needle, thread, and fabric, got up and went to the bathroom to wash her face and feet with hot water. She returned to the bedroom, glanced at her phone, and set the alarm for 5:30 the next morning. She then thought about what to make for breakfast—the children loved her small wontons, so she decided to chop the filling before bed. She quietly went to the kitchen, took out the ground meat, ginger, and scallions, skillfully chopped and seasoned them, wrapped the filling in plastic wrap, and put it back in the fridge. After all that, she went back to her room at ease, turned off the light, and soon fell asleep.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Getting up, morning exercise, and preparing breakfast
description: At 5:55 in the morning, the alarm went off on time. Ma Xiulan got up quietly and did a 5-minute shoulder and neck stretch by the bedroom window to loosen up. Then she went into the kitchen, opened the refrigerator, took out the wonton filling and wrappers she had prepared last night, and deftly wrapped more than thirty small wontons. At the same time, she put another pot of water on to boil, preparing to cook the wontons.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; bedroom and kitchen at home

name: Taking the two children to school.
description: At 6:40, Ma Xiulan woke up her daughter Xinxin and son Zhezhe and urged them to get dressed and wash up. It was colder and overcast today, so she put masks on both children. She left at 7:00 and rode her electric bike, first taking Xinxin to the gate of Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, watching her greet her teacher and walk into the school. Then she rode for about six minutes and took Zhezhe to the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School. There she happened to meet her neighbor Wang Guilan, who was also there to drop off her grandson and had a worried look on her face. The two stood by the roadside and chatted for a few minutes about how the children's final exams were coming up and how tense the atmosphere at home had become.
location: Starting from 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, via Huakang First Kindergarten (Jinghai District, Tianjin) to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin)

name: Baduanjin group second rehearsal
description: At 7:15, after dropping off the children, Ma Xiulan rode her bike straight to Jingwen Road Community Park. Today was the Baduanjin group's second formal rehearsal before the New Year's Eve party. She parked her bike, jogged to the park corridor, and put on the matching white practice uniforms with a dozen or so group members, forming the formation. With soothing Chinese-style music playing, everyone ran through Baduanjin twice in full, and group leader Lao Li specifically corrected details in several turning and arm-raising movements. The overall result was much smoother than the last rehearsal, and everyone was full of energy. After the rehearsal, she made a point of pulling Liu Chunmei aside and arranging to arrive 45 minutes early tomorrow morning at the community hall for a final walk-through.
location: Community Park next to the Jingwen Road Community Activity Center, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Going home, breakfast, and making fabric hair flowers.
description: At 7:50, Ma Xiulan rode home and quickly ate her portion of cooked wontons. After tidying the kitchen, she sat down at the sewing table by the first-floor window and took out the blue-and-white checkered fabric and satin ribbons in various colors she had bought at the fabric market two days earlier. Following the style drawing sent by the client, she first cut paper patterns for petals and leaves from cardboard, then cut and sewed the fabric. She worked quickly, and by around 9:30 had finished two delicate checkered-fabric hair ornaments—one in the shape of a bow, the other in the shape of a camellia—with a fresh, clean color scheme, ready to be shipped at any time.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tidying up the house, taking care of the vegetable bed, and thinking about handicraft orders
description: After finishing the crafts, Ma Xiulan stood up to stretch and began tidying the house. She first hand-scrubbed the collars and cuffs of a few jackets the children had taken off the day before and put them into the washing machine. Then she took the broom and mop and thoroughly mopped the living room and dining room floors. At 10:30, she went to the balcony, watered the scallions and spinach planted in the foam vegetable beds, and pulled out a few weeds.
