When she returned to the sofa to rest, she opened her phone and scrolled through the craft group. The group was again discussing next week's order for crocheted Christmas dolls. She carefully looked through a few sample pictures and mentally calculated the time and material costs of taking the order. Unable to make up her mind, she decided to set it aside for now and think about it in the afternoon.
location: Living room and balcony at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Simple lunch
description: Alone at home, she kept lunch simple. Ma Xiulan used last night's leftover rice, cut some ham and cucumber into small cubes, stir-fried a plate of egg fried rice, and made a bowl of seaweed soup. While eating, she scrolled through short videos on her phone.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Talked on the phone with her childhood friend Liu Chunmei
description: Just after lunch, the phone rang — it was her childhood friend Liu Chunmei. Ma Xiulan curled up on the sofa and chatted with Liu Chunmei for over forty minutes. Liu Chunmei said excitedly on the phone that her daughter had recently become crazy about origami and complained that she had folded all the previous tutorials until she was tired of them. Ma Xiulan laughed and said: “That’s perfect! Our Xinxin likes these handicrafts too. If you’re free this weekend, bring your daughter to our place so the two of them can fold paper together, and we sisters can drink tea and chat.” Hearing that, Liu Chunmei agreed enthusiastically, and the two initially set a plan for a weekend get-together.
location: Sofa in the living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Lunch break
description: After hanging up the phone, Ma Xiulan felt a little sleepy. She put her phone aside, lay down on the bed, and took a solid nap of about forty minutes to recharge.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Going to Xingwang Vegetable Market to buy groceries
description: At 1:40 in the afternoon, Ma Xiulan put on her helmet and rode her electric bike to Xingwang Vegetable Market. She went straight to Sun Guifang's vegetable stall. Since her grandson would be out of school early today, she planned to make the children's favorite beef stew with potatoes and stir-fried lettuce for dinner. She picked out a large piece of fresh beef brisket and also bought potatoes, carrots, tomatoes, and two bunches of lettuce. Sun Guifang smiled and stuffed an extra bunch of cilantro into her bag, and the two chatted briefly about vegetable prices.
location: Xingwang Vegetable Market, at the intersection of Jingwen Road and Gongnong Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Return home to prepare dinner and take care of housework
description: At 14:10 she returned home. Ma Xiulan washed the beef, cut it into chunks, put it into cold water and blanched it to remove the blood foam, then took it out into an earthenware pot. She added seasonings and enough water and simmered it slowly over low heat. While the beef was simmering, she soaked the cut potatoes and carrots in water to prevent oxidation. At 15:00 she began to tidy the house. She took down the clothes that had dried on the balcony, folded them, and put them into the wardrobe by category, then carefully wiped the living room cabinets and TV stand with a rag.
location: Kitchen and living room of the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the two children from school.
description: At 16:10, Ma Xiulan got on her electric bike again. She first picked up Xinxin from Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, then waited a while at the school gate and picked up Zhezhe, who came rushing out of school. On the way home, the two children sat on the back seat and chattered about interesting things at school. She smiled and responded to them, feeling warm inside.
location: From 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, via Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten (Jinghai District, Tianjin) to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin), then on the way back home

name: Supervising the children's homework and making dinner
description: After getting home, Ma Xiulan told Zhezhe and Xinxin to do their homework in the living room first, while she put on an apron and went into the kitchen. The beef was already about 80-90% tender; she added chunks of potato and carrot and continued stewing. Then she heated oil in a wok to stir-fry leaf lettuce. She stir-fried while occasionally poking her head out to check on the children, reminding Zhezhe to sit up straight and teaching Xinxin a few strokes for writing pinyin.
location: Kitchen and living room of the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner
description: At 17:20, her eldest son Xuanxuan came home from school. Ma Xiulan had just brought the last dish, stir-fried lettuce, to the table, and the beef stew with potatoes in the clay pot was bubbling with steam. The family of four sat around the dining table, eating with piping-hot rice. She picked several pieces of the tender stewed beef for Xinxin and asked Xuanxuan whether he had been feeling tired from studying. The dinner table was warm and joyful.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Cleaning the kitchen and checking homework
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan neatly cleared the dishes and wiped the stove clean. Then she sat down on the living room sofa and began checking Zeze's math homework and Xinxin's pinyin notebook, and signed Xuanxuan's workbook. She found that Zeze had made a mistake in a math word problem; she patiently explained it until he nodded and understood.
location: Kitchen and living room of the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family evening activities
description: After checking the homework, Xuanxuan went back to his room to review his lessons. Zhezhe and Xinxin watched cartoons in the living room for a while. Ma Xiulan embroidered an auspicious cloud ornament nearby, but from time to time she kept an eye on the two children. Around eight o'clock, she urged the two children to take a bath and brush their teeth. She first helped Xinxin wash up, then watched Zhezhe finish washing up on his own.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Focus on embroidering a New Year auspicious cloud ornament.
description: At 20:30, all the children were in bed. Ma Xiulan finally had time entirely to herself. She returned to the bedroom, turned on the desk lamp, and took out her sewing box and the auspicious cloud hanging ornament she had half-embroidered. Today she chose light blue and white embroidery threads and focused on embroidering the cloud pattern according to the drawn design. Xinxin, who had run out to use the bathroom before bed, came over curiously to watch for a moment. Xiulan taught her daughter to do two stitches of 'backstitch' hand in hand. Seeing her daughter clumsy but earnest, she felt warm inside. Then she sent her daughter back to bed and continued embroidery with her head down until 22:30, when the outline and main patterns of the auspicious cloud were basically complete, with better results than expected.
location: Desk in the bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Wash up and get ready for bed
description: At 22:30, Ma Xiulan carefully put away the needles, thread, and embroidery, and went to the bathroom to wash up. She washed her face with warm water and applied a simple moisturizer. Feeling that the corners of her eyes were a little dry, she put in two drops of eye drops.
location: Home bathroom, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Soaking feet while listening to the radio, ending the day
description: At 22:50, Ma Xiulan prepared a basin of hot water and sat on the edge of the bed to soak her feet. At the same time, she opened the radio app on her phone and found the health program she hadn't finished listening to yesterday, which was about how to prevent cardiovascular and cerebrovascular diseases in winter. She listened very attentively. After enjoying this half-hour of relaxation, at 23:45 she turned off her phone and the bedside lamp and fell asleep peacefully, feeling very content and fulfilled.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Morning school drop-off and pre-performance preparation
description: Got up at 5:45, did shoulder and neck stretches, washed up at 6:10, then prepared breakfast, steaming steamed buns and flower rolls, boiling eggs, and warming milk. At 6:40 woke up my younger daughter Xinxin and second son Zhezhe, urged them to finish breakfast, braided Xinxin's hair, and checked Zhezhe's schoolbag. At 7:05 rode the electric bike to take Xinxin to Huakang First Kindergarten, watched her enter the kindergarten at 7:12, then took Zhezhe to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, arriving at 7:20. At 7:25 returned home, briefly ate boiled eggs and oatmeal with milk, changed into workout clothes, put the red practice uniform and cloth shoes into a cloth bag, silently recited the Baduanjin instructions, and at 7:50 rode the electric bike out to the community activity center.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Baduanjin performance award, group photos, and shopping before returning home.
description: At 8:00 she arrived backstage at the Jingwen Road Community Activity Center on time and changed into red practice uniforms with her team members Liu Chunmei, Zhang Shufen, and others, then practiced the formation movements. At 9:30 it was the group's turn to go onstage to perform Baduanjin. Ma Xiulan stood in the second row, slightly left of center. As the music began, during the move Draw the Bow and Shoot the Eagle, her feet wobbled slightly but she immediately steadied herself. The rest of the routine went smoothly, the performance was a success, and the applause was warm. The community director announced that the group had won the Healthy Group Award, and each member was rewarded with a cashmere scarf. After the award ceremony, the eight sisters took a group photo in front of the stage and congratulated one another. At 10:45, Ma Xiulan left the activity center and rode her electric bike to the Wutong Commune vegetable market. She bought chives and free-range eggs at Sun Guifang's stall and got home at about 11:15.
location: No. 58 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (Jingwen Road Community Activity Center)

name: Share joy over lunch and make dumplings with the whole family.
description: At 11:15 she got home, just as her eldest son Mingxuan was coming back from school. Ma Xiulan showed the cashmere scarf to her husband Ma Zhiqiang and Mingxuan, recounting the performance. Zhiqiang was having lunch at home and praised her for practicing well. The couple worked together to knead dough, roll wrappers, mix filling, and make chive and egg dumplings. At 12:15 the dumplings were ready, and the three of them sat around the table for lunch. Ma Xiulan found them especially delicious. After the meal, she cleaned up the kitchen.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Visiting father, passing along a scarf, and buying apples at the supermarket
description: After finishing the meal and cleaning up, Ma Xiulan folded the cashmere scarf and put it in her bag. At 13:30 she walked to her father's house at 45 Shengli Street. She arrived at 14:00 and handed him the scarf, telling him to wear it when the weather turned cold. Her father happily put it on, and her mother Li Xiuying teased him. Ma Xiulan asked about her father's blood pressure and reminded him to take his medicine on time. Her mother suggested taking a photo and sending it to the family group. Her father cooperated for the photo, and Ma Xiulan replied in the group, “As long as Dad likes it!” After chatting for half an hour and helping pick vegetables, she left her father's house at 15:00, walked to the Jingbai Supermarket at the intersection, and bought two big red apples, symbolizing peace and safety on Christmas Eve. At 15:25 she walked home.
location: No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Afternoon rest and preparation of handmade pomegranate ornaments
description: After returning home, she rested and drank water. Around 16:00, she found red cloth scraps and green silk thread, and cut the fabric for a pomegranate ornament from memory. At the same time, she thought about the Christmas crochet doll orders in the handicraft group and planned to study the stitching techniques in the evening. She quietly prepared the craft materials.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pick up the children from school, prepare and enjoy the Christmas Eve dinner.
description: At 17:00, she rode her electric bike to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up Xinxin first. The child excitedly said she had learned a Christmas Eve song. Then she went to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up Zhezhe. At 17:40 she got home, had the children do homework, and went into the kitchen to reheat the leftover dumplings from noon, stir-fry vegetables, and cook millet porridge. At 18:30, her eldest son Mingxuan arrived home, and the whole family sat together. Ma Xiulan gave the two washed apples to Xinxin and Zhezhe, wishing them peace and safety on Christmas Eve. At the dinner table she told the story of winning the award again, and the children listened with great interest. After dinner she cleaned up the dishes and checked Zhezhe's math homework.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening embroidery of pomegranate hanging ornament and relaxation before bed.
description: At 20:00 urged the two children to wash up, coaxed the youngest daughter Xinxin to sleep, and told two short stories. At about 21:00 began embroidering the pomegranate ornament under the living room lamp, using red cloth and green silk thread to embroider the fruit and leaves, and adorned the bottom with golden tassels, finishing at 22:00. Laid out the auspicious cloud and fortune bag ornaments together, trimmed the loose threads, and was very satisfied. Did some waist and back stretches, washed up, and soaked her feet. Set the alarm for 5:45 the next day, turned off the lights at 23:30, and recalling the day felt grounded and warm, soon falling asleep.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning wake-up and family breakfast
description: The phone alarm rang. After getting up, Ma Xiulan did shoulder and neck stretches, then went to the living room to open the windows for air. Afterwards, in the kitchen she made chive pancakes and cooked millet porridge, and specially put two red dates in her daughter Xinxin's bowl. She woke up her husband Ma Zhiqiang and the three children, Ma Mingxuan, Ma Mingzhe, and Ma Yuxin, and the family of five sat around the table to have breakfast together. During the meal, she reminded the eldest son to come home early after school to do homework and told the second son to pack his schoolbag.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; bedroom, kitchen, and dining room at home

name: Morning school drop-off
description: Ma Xiulan put on a heavy coat and rode her electric bike. She first took her eldest son Xuanxuan to Jinghai District No. 1 Middle School and watched him enter the school gate. Then she took Xinxin and Zhezhe with her, dropping Xinxin off at Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, and then Zhezhe at Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, telling him to listen carefully in class. On the way she ran into her neighbor Wang Guilan and exchanged a few pleasantries.
location: Starting from 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, passing by Jinghai District No. 1 Middle School (19 Diwei Road), Huakang First Kindergarten, and Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street), then returning home

name: Returning home, resting up, morning exercise, and a solo breakfast
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan washed her face with warm water, changed into loungewear, and marched in place on the balcony for 10 minutes. Then she did a complete set of Baduanjin in the living room, feeling relaxed and comfortable. After that, she cleaned up and washed the breakfast dishes, served herself a bowl of millet porridge, and ate a simple breakfast with pies, while browsing the handicraft group messages on her phone and seeing the notice about embroidery pattern work posted by Sister Zheng.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; living room, kitchen, and dining room at home

name: In the morning, hang up the New Year festive decorations.
description: Ma Xiulan brought over a small square stool, tied a small lucky pouch ornament to the inner door frame at the entrance, hung an auspicious cloud ornament by the living room window, and tied a pomegranate ornament by the bedroom door. She only loosely draped the strings, planning to wait until her daughter Xinxin came home from school in the afternoon to adjust the positions together.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin - home living room, bedroom, and entrance door

name: Organizing household receipts
description: In the morning, Ma Xiulan dumped a year's worth of pay stubs, utility bills, receipts, and grocery shopping records onto her desk. She put on her reading glasses and roughly sorted them into 12 piles by month, occasionally looking up and stretching her neck. After her afternoon nap, she continued to carefully examine each document. Once they were organized, she clipped them with different colored binder clips, attached month labels, and recorded the approximate income and expense items in her account book. In between, she got up to pour water and stretch her back.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin — home study

name: Lunch and lunch break.
description: Ma Xiulan reheated the two stuffed pancakes left from the morning and ate them with rice porridge for lunch. After the meal, she scrolled through her phone on the sofa and saw photos posted by her younger sister Xiufen in the family group of her child reviewing lessons. She liked them and left a comment. Then she set an alarm, lay down on the bedroom bed and rested with her eyes closed. She woke up about an hour later, her energy considerably restored.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin: home dining room, living room, and bedroom

name: Going out preparations and picking up the children from school
description: Ma Xiulan changed into her dark blue thick coat, grabbed the e-bike key and helmet, checked her phone battery, and went out. She first rode the e-bike to Huakang No.1 Kindergarten to pick up Xinxin, who excitedly said the teacher had praised her. Then the mother and daughter went to Jinghai No.3 Primary School to pick up Zhezhe. Zhezhe voluntarily said he had been praised for writing the new characters neatly in Chinese class. Ma Xiulan happily complimented him and promised a dried fruit reward at home. They chatted and laughed all the way home.
location: Starting from 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, went successively to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten and Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School, then returned home.

name: Supervising homework and preparing dinner.
description: After arriving home, Ma Xiulan asked Xinxin and Zhezhe to do their homework at the desk in the living room. She went into the kitchen, put on an apron, steamed the stuffed pancakes made that morning, stir-fried baby bok choy, and made a pot of egg drop soup.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; living room and kitchen at home

name: Family dinner and homework tutoring.
description: At dinnertime, Ma Xiulan and her two children sat around the table eating. After the meal, she brought out homemade additive-free dried fruit as a reward for Zhezhe and Xinxin. Then she sat between the two children, patiently checked their homework, praised Zhezhe for writing neatly, and explained in detail the math problems he got wrong.
location: Dining room and living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Cleaned up the kitchen and urged everyone to wash up.
description: Ma Xiulan cleared the dishes and wiped the stove clean. Then she urged Xinxin and Zhezhe to go to the bathroom to wash their faces, brush their teeth, and wash their feet, and helped Xinxin re-braid her pigtails.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; kitchen and bathroom at home

name: Video call with my sister
description: After getting the children settled, Ma Xiulan curled up on the living room sofa and made a video call to her younger sister Ma Xiufen. The two sisters chatted for nearly half an hour. Xiufen said she planned to bring the children home after the twentieth of the twelfth lunar month and stay for several days. Ma Xiulan was very happy. They discussed whether to have their parents come over or take the children to their parents’ home, and they agreed to go together to Binjiang Road to buy new clothes for the children.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, home living room (sofa area), younger sister is on the video

name: Adjusting hanging decorations at home in the evening
description: After hanging up the video call, Ma Xiulan called Xinxin and Zhezhe over. She brought a small stool and had Xinxin help hold it while she adjusted the three New Year decorations that had been hung temporarily that afternoon to the most satisfactory positions according to Xinxin's directions. Xinxin clapped her hands and said how pretty they were, and Zhezhe also gave a compliment.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin - home living room, bedroom, and entrance door

name: Putting kids to bed and relaxing
description: Ma Xiulan told the children two stories about little bears celebrating Christmas to coax them to sleep. After seeing that the two children were asleep, she gently closed the door. Then she went to the bathroom, soaked her feet for 20 minutes with a mugwort foot soak bag, and did a simple set of waist and back stretches to relieve the day's lower back soreness.
location: Children's room and bathroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening craftwork and TV relaxation
description: After soaking her feet, Ma Xiulan felt refreshed. She took out the handmade semi-finished zodiac coin purse that Sister Zheng had introduced and sewed it on the living room sofa while watching a rerun of a life drama on TV. Her movements were skillful and her stitches fine. By 11 p.m., she had finished the outline of a little rabbit.
location: Living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Bedtime routine and going to sleep
description: Ma Xiulan put away her handiwork, changed into her pajamas, and lay down on the bed. She opened her phone to check tomorrow's weather forecast (cloudy), browsed the community WeChat group to confirm there were no special activities, and set her alarm for 5:50 a.m. Then she did a few minutes of abdominal breathing and neck relaxation, which relieved the tension in her shoulders and back. Reflecting that the day had been ordinary but fulfilling, she felt calm and content, and soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Waking up in the early morning, preparing breakfast, and having breakfast together as a family
description: Woke up promptly at 5:55, did some simple shoulder and neck stretches in the bedroom, then went to the bathroom to wash up. At 6:20, she went to the kitchen, reheated the stuffed buns and steamed buns made yesterday, cooked millet and red date porridge, and cut a plate of home-pickled radish peel. At 6:50, she woke the three children one by one. The eldest son, Mingxuan, was already awake and looking at his phone; the second son, Mingzhe, was sound asleep; and her daughter Xinxin was the best-behaved—she woke as soon as she was called. At 7:00, the whole family, including her husband Ma Zhiqiang, had breakfast in the dining room. She served herself porridge, urged Mingzhe to eat quickly so they wouldn't be late, and ate a steamed bun with pickled vegetables while mentally planning to check the account book today.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; bedroom, kitchen, and dining room at home

name: Walk the children to school and, after returning home, do morning activities and tidy up the house
description: At 7:30, she put on her cotton-padded jacket and left on foot with Xinxin and Mingzhe. First she took Xinxin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, about an 18-minute walk away. After the teacher led her inside, she walked another 12 minutes to take Mingzhe to the gate of Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School and reminded him to listen carefully in class. After dropping him off, she walked 20 minutes home and arrived at 8:10. On the sheltered balcony, she marched in place for 10 minutes and did a set of Baduanjin. After exercising, her neck and waist felt much looser. At 8:25 she briefly tidied up the breakfast dishes and wiped down the kitchen counter. Then she found the year's account book, receipts, calculator, and pen, placed them on the coffee table, and brewed a cup of hot tea to start doing the accounts.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten (Jingwen Road, Jinghai District); Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street); back home; and the balcony and living room at home

name: Go to the bank to deposit into the education savings account
description: At exactly 9 o'clock, I took 150 yuan in cash and walked to the Postal Savings Bank of China on Jingwen Road. The lobby was not crowded. After taking a number, I filled out the form at the counter and deposited 150 yuan into the education savings account of my eldest son, Mingxuan. After processing, the teller printed a new passbook, showing a balance of 3,500 yuan, one step closer to the goal of 5,000 yuan. After depositing the money, I walked back home the same way and arrived at 9:40.
location: Postal Savings Bank of China (Tianjin Jinghai District Sub-branch), Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Calculating annual household income and expenses (including lunch break)
description: After returning from the bank, she spread the account book and a pile of receipts on the living room coffee table. Starting with her husband Ma Zhiqiang's salary statements, she checked each item and entered it into the calculator one by one. Then she calculated her own irregular handwork income and the subsidy from her husband's younger brother. Several times she had to recall what was purchased from the receipts. She concentrated on the calculations until 12:30 and arrived at a total annual income of about 43,200 yuan and total expenses of about 41,000 yuan. Then she cooked a bowl of hanging noodles with a poached egg and had a simple lunch with the leftover dishes from noon. She rested on the sofa with her eyes closed until 13:15. After her energy recovered in the afternoon, she rechecked and found that a supermarket receipt for daily necessities in October, worth more than 30 yuan, had been missed, and she added it in time. Because sitting for a long time made her neck stiff, she stood up and did several sets of neck resistance exercises and walked around the living room to relax. She continued checking until 16:00, when she had finished verifying all the accounts for the year.
location: No. 156, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin; the living room and kitchen at home.

name: Getting ready to go out and walking to pick up the children from school
description: At 16:00, she put down the ledger, put on her coat, grabbed her keys, and went downstairs, deciding to walk to pick up the children and get some exercise along the way. She first went to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, where Xinxin was already waiting at the gate; Xinxin happily ran over and took her hand. Then she turned around and went to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School. Mingzhe came out with his classmates, and after greeting the teacher, she walked home with the two children, arriving home at 16:40.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, Jiahuakang First Kindergarten (Jingwen Road, Jinghai District), Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street), home

name: Supervise the children's homework and prepare dinner
description: After getting home, she had the children wash their hands first, then asked Mingzhe to do his homework at the living room table while Xinxin drew pictures nearby. She tied on an apron and went into the kitchen to prepare dinner, planning to make hand-rolled noodles with a quick stir-fried tomato and egg sauce.
location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin: living room and kitchen

name: Family dinner and after-dinner cleanup
description: Husband Ma Zhiqiang and eldest son Ma Mingxuan came home one after another, and the family sat around eating noodles with gravy. At the table, Xinxin eagerly said that she had learned a new nursery rhyme today, and Mingzhe said he had a math test tomorrow. Everyone chatted while eating, lively and warm. After dinner at 18:30, Ma Xiulan put on an apron and cleared the dishes, asked Zhiqiang to take the two children to wash their hands and faces, then wiped down the stove and dining table and mopped the floor. She finished cleaning around 18:50.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin - home dining room, kitchen, and bathroom.

name: Discuss the annual income and expenditure account results with her husband.
description: While the children were washing up, she showed her husband Ma Zhiqiang the preliminary annual income and expenditure figures calculated that afternoon, briefly saying total income was about 43200 yuan and total expenditure about 41000 yuan. Her husband nodded, acknowledged her hard work, and they agreed to review the major expenses together on Sunday.
location: Living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tutoring Mingzhe in his math homework.
description: After her husband went to rest, she focused on tutoring her second son Mingzhe through a math test paper. He didn't understand several word problems, and she patiently explained them several times until he got it. Her daughter Xinxin was quietly playing with building blocks nearby, occasionally looking up.
location: Living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Put daughter to bed.
description: Took her daughter Xinxin to the bathroom to wash up, then went back to the children's bedroom and told her two little stories. The little one soon fell asleep. She tucked her in, turned off the light gently, and left the room.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, children's bedroom at home.

name: Personal foot soaking and relaxation
description: The children were all asleep, and the house grew quiet. She poured a basin of hot water to soak her feet, doing lower back stretches while soaking, feeling the day's lower back soreness greatly relieved and her whole body relaxed. Thoughts of the account book still flashed through her mind from time to time, and she considered whether to look through it again tomorrow.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin: living room and bedroom at home

name: Doing handmade embroidery work and organizing receipts
description: After soaking her feet, she took out the decorative embroidery pattern piece that Sister Zheng had given her a few days ago. Sitting in the living room, she embroidered while reorganizing a few loose receipts that had been tucked in the ledger during the day's accounting. She kept at it until nearly 11:30, and her eyes felt a bit sore.
location: Living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: She put down her handicraft work, went to the bathroom for a quick wash-up, changed into her pajamas, and lay in bed. She picked up her phone to look at tomorrow's weather forecast and checked the community WeChat group for any new notices. At 23:55 she set the alarm for 5:55 the next morning, put her phone on the nightstand, and thinking that she had finally finished checking the whole year's accounts and could rest easy over the weekend, she fell asleep before she knew it.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Sleeping in and doing simplified morning exercises.
description: There was no need to rush on Saturday; Ma Xiulan got up half an hour later than usual. Still in the warm bed, she first did five minutes of shoulder and neck stretches, feeling her whole body loosen up. Then she got out of bed, walked to the balcony, and did a simplified version of the five core movements of Baduanjin. Finally she marched in place for ten minutes, working up a slight warmth and dispelling the winter chill.
location: Home master bedroom and balcony, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing breakfast: low-fat scallion pancakes and millet porridge
description: Ma Xiulan took the dough and chopped scallions that had been prepared last night from the fridge, and quickly pan-fried a few low-fat scallion pancakes. She then scooped two bowls of millet from the millet bucket, rinsed it clean, put it into the rice cooker, and pressed the porridge button. In no time, the kitchen was filled with the aroma of scallions and the sweet fragrance of millet porridge.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family breakfast time.
description: Ma Xiulan called the family to get up and eat breakfast. Her husband, Ma Zhiqiang, helped her bring the hot scallion pancakes and millet porridge to the table. Her eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, picked up a pancake, took a big bite, and exclaimed, "Mom, this is so delicious!" Her little daughter, Ma Yuxin, sat in her chair swinging her little legs and sipped the porridge slowly with a small spoon.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Query education savings and household accounts
description: After clearing the dishes, Ma Xiulan took out the family ledger from the drawer and opened the education savings account in the mobile banking app. She confirmed the balance was 3,500 yuan (matching the passbook), took a screenshot to save it, and carefully recorded this information in yesterday's notes in the ledger. At the same time, she sent her younger sister Ma Xiufen a WeChat voice message: 'Fen'er, what are you doing at home? I mentioned my summer plans to you yesterday. Are you free now? Let's have a sisterly chat?' But her sister didn't reply right away.
location: Sofa in the living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tending the small winter vegetable garden
description: Ma Xiulan changed into a thick coat, picked up a watering can, and went into the yard. She watered a few rows of cold-hardy baby bok choy, spinach, and cilantro, and casually pulled up a few scattered weeds. Looking at the little seedlings still showing green in the winter, she felt very reassured.
location: The vegetable plot in the courtyard of her home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Sorting and packing old clothes
description: Ma Xiulan sorted through old clothes at home in several sessions. Starting at 9:15 a.m., she opened the master bedroom wardrobe and carried a few of her husband's unused jackets and the children's outgrown clothes to the living room floor. She called Ma Mingzhe and Ma Yuxin over to see which clothes they really couldn't wear anymore, and took the opportunity to teach them to cherish things. The two children chattered away, recalling the story behind each item. Afterward, she continued sorting on her own, folding the cotton-padded jackets and sweaters that clearly could not be worn again, dividing them into men's, women's, and children's piles, and packing them into large bags made from repurposed old bed sheets. The first two packed bags were temporarily placed in the corner of the living room. After a midday rest, at 12:30 p.m. she resumed sorting with fresh energy, neatly folding the sorted old clothes and packing the last few bags as well. Her eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, came over to help, carrying the five or six bags of old clothes to the storage room entrance one trip at a time and stacking them neatly, ready to take to the community clothing recycling bin next week.
location: Master bedroom, second bedroom, living room, and storage room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: A short phone call with my younger sister
description: The phone showed that her younger sister Fen'er had returned the call. Since she was busy at the moment, Ma Xiulan answered briefly. The two agreed to talk in more detail when they were free in the afternoon, then hung up. Ma Xiulan kept the afternoon appointment in mind.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare a simple lunch, eat, and rest
description: Ma Xiulan took the hand-rolled noodles cooked yesterday out of the refrigerator, boiled a pot of water, cooked some dried noodles, and made a simple sauce with tomatoes and eggs. She thought a simple meal at noon would do, and they would have a better dinner in the evening. She ate the noodles with her eldest son Ma Mingxuan, who was at home, and her husband Ma Zhiqiang. After the meal, Ma Xiulan leaned back on the living room sofa, covered herself with a small blanket, closed her eyes, and dozed for more than ten minutes to regain her energy.
location: Kitchen, dining room, and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Have a detailed phone discussion with my younger sister about summer vacation plans
description: Her phone rang; it was a video call from her younger sister Fen'er. The two chatted for more than 40 minutes. Fen'er said that it would be no problem to bring her children back during summer vacation and suggested that the two families could drive to Beidaihe for a few days. Ma Xiulan laughed and agreed, but she was already thinking about the capital for next year's pickled vegetable business, and said, "Let's set a small goal first; we'll see how the business goes when spring comes." After hanging up, a trace of expectation rose in her heart for the seaside summer breeze and a reunion with her sister.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Rearranging the wardrobe and preparing ingredients for dinner
description: After carrying out several bags of old clothes, the wardrobe was more than half empty. Ma Xiulan wiped the wardrobe clean from the inside out with a damp cloth, thinking that the new quilt she would have made next month could fit perfectly on this shelf. She glanced at the time and began to prepare dinner: she took a box of pork ribs out of the freezer to thaw, washed two Chinese yams and a carrot, and got ready to make braised pork ribs.
location: Master bedroom and kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Make a hearty dinner
description: Ma Xiulan tied on her apron and began frying and cooking. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang came over to help trim vegetables and peel garlic. After blanching the pork ribs, she stir-fried them in the wok until they took on color, added scallions, ginger, and star anise, then poured in enough hot water to cover the ribs and simmered them slowly. The kitchen was steaming and filled with a rich aroma of meat. Ma Xiulan also stir-fried a plate of baby bok choy and cut up a fruit platter.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Weekend dinner for the whole family
description: The family sat around the dining table, on which were fragrant braised pork ribs, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and a large bowl of rice. Ma Zhiqiang was the first to pick up a rib, took a bite, and gave Ma Xiulan a thumbs-up. The children also ate happily, with oil around their mouths. At the table, Ma Xiulan and her husband talked about organizing clothes and her sister's phone call today, and asked the children what they had played today.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Playing an origami game with her daughter
description: After dinner, her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin took out her origami set and tugged at her mother's hand, begging to play together. Ma Xiulan sat down on the living room carpet and patiently taught her to fold paper cranes and little frogs. Her fingers were nimble, and a square piece of paper quickly turned into a clever little frog. Xinxin tried to follow along, but her folds were crooked, and she was so anxious that her little face turned red. Ma Xiulan then held her little hand and guided her step by step. Before long, the floor was covered with colorful paper crafts. Her husband and two sons leaned against the sofa watching variety shows on TV, and laughter came from time to time.
location: Carpet in the living room of the home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening wind-down and bedtime
description: Ma Xiulan urged the children to wash up. She first helped Ma Yuxin wash her face and brush her teeth, then carried her to bed and read a short story. She waited until her daughter fell asleep before quietly turning off the light and leaving. After the children were all asleep, the house fell quiet. She returned to the living room, brewed a pot of hot tea, took a couple of sips, then went into the bathroom and took a good hot shower. After coming out, she did 10 minutes of lower back stretches and then soaked her feet in hot water to fully relax her tense body. After soaking her feet, she changed into pajamas and lay down on the bed. She picked up her phone, scrolled through the community group messages, checked tomorrow's weather forecast, confirmed there were no special plans, then set the alarm for the next morning. Thinking about going over the annual income and expense ledger with her husband tomorrow, she felt both at ease and a little expectant, turned off the bedside lamp, and fell asleep peacefully.
location: At home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin: bathroom, daughter's bedroom, living room, master bedroom.

name: Morning exercise and stretching
description: Just at dawn, Ma Xiulan did not get up immediately. She stretched in bed, then came to the living room in loose home clothes, played soft music, and did a complete set of Baduanjin, with extra emphasis on stretching the lower back. After finishing, she marched in place for ten minutes until her body was slightly warm and she felt refreshed.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Breakfast and morning chores discussion
description: While the children were still asleep, Ma Xiulan went to the kitchen and cooked a pot of millet pumpkin porridge, reheated the vegetarian buns steamed yesterday, and sliced a plate of pickled radish. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang and the three children were woken up one after another, and the family sat around eating breakfast. The youngest daughter, Ma Yuxin, excitedly said she dreamed of butterflies. After the meal, she cleared away the dishes and chopsticks and put the dirty clothes in the washing machine. Then she discussed the day's arrangements with her husband in the living room. Xiulan asked Zhiqiang not to go out in the evening so they could reconcile the accounts together, and Zhiqiang nodded in agreement.
location: Kitchen, dining room, and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Courtyard work and handcraft time
description: After seeing her husband off, Ma Xiulan went to the backyard to water the cold-hardy spinach and cilantro. Then she called her second son and youngest daughter, who were playing in the yard, back inside, took out her sewing basket, and taught her daughter to mend the skirt of a cloth doll, demonstrating the hidden stitch. Her second son watched curiously from the side. Sunlight streamed through the window, creating a warm family atmosphere.
location: Courtyard and living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Redeeming supplies at the community service center
description: Ma Xiulan put on a thick coat, took her volunteer service points card, and rode her electric bike to the Jinghe Community Party-Mass Service Center. At the community, she met an acquaintance, Zheng Xiuying. She handed over her points card and found she had accumulated 120 points for the whole year. Following Sister Zheng's suggestion, she redeemed them for a bag of rice, a jug of oil, and a bag of flour. The staff helped secure the items onto the footboard of her electric bike.
location: Jinghe Community Party-Mass Service Center, 24 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Moving supplies and tidying them up
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan carefully unloaded the exchanged rice, flour, and oil from the bike. She put the oil in the kitchen cabinet, carried the rice and white flour into the storage room, brushed the dust off herself, and felt a sense of security looking at the newly added supplies.
location: The kitchen and storage room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing and enjoying lunch
description: Ma Xiulan made a simple lunch by herself, reheated the leftover braised pork ribs from yesterday, cooked some noodles, and ate together with her second son and youngest daughter. Her youngest daughter tried hard to eat on her own and made a mess of the table, but Xiulan was happy at heart. After the meal, she carefully washed the dishes and tidied up the kitchen.
location: Kitchen and dining room of the home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Organize the family medicine box
description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan took the family medicine kit down from the top of the cabinet, spread a towel on the coffee table, emptied out all the medicines and tools, and checked the production dates one by one. She threw away the expired cold medicine and half a bottle of cough syrup. Then she noted in her small notebook the items that needed to be restocked: adhesive bandages, povidone-iodine, medical gauze, and children's fever suppositories.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Go out to buy medicine and food ingredients
description: Ma Xiulan first rode her electric bike to the medicine section on the second floor of Jingbai Supermarket, where she bought band-aids, iodophor, and other items according to her list. She also bought milk tablets for the children as a reward for their dental checkup, and picked out two pairs of thick socks for her husband. Then she turned into the Wutong Commune vegetable market, bought a dressed three-yellow chicken and vegetables such as green beans, shiitake mushrooms, and bok choy from Aunt Sun Guifang's stall. Aunt Sun gave her a bunch of cilantro as usual.
location: Jingbai Supermarket, Building 19, Room 104, Yuzhou Zunfu, Jinghai District, Tianjin; Wutong Commune Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare a hearty dinner
description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan put on an apron, washed and cut the vegetables, and made cola chicken wings and Kung Pao chicken with chicken meat. The vegetable dishes were mushroom bok choy and tomato egg drop soup. Working quickly, she blanched, sautéed with aromatics, and stir-fried; the kitchen soon filled with delicious smells. The eldest son smelled the food and came over to ask, and Xiulan smiled and told him to go do his homework first.
location: Kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The entire family enjoys dinner.
description: When it got dark, her husband Ma Zhiqiang came home, and the whole family sat around the table, which was laden with a hearty meal. Coke chicken wings were the children's favorite, and each of them took two. Kung Pao chicken made the eldest son full of praise, and he ate two bowls of rice. Seeing her family enjoy the meal, Ma Xiulan felt that her busy day had all been worth it.
location: Home dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Reconciled the family's annual accounts.
description: After dinner, the children went to the living room to watch cartoons. Ma Xiulan and her husband sat at the dining table and, with a notebook, calculator, and receipts, checked the 2025 family income and expenses item by item, including her husband's transport income, her own part-time income, and various expenditures. They finally confirmed total income of 43200 yuan, total expenditure of 41000 yuan, and a surplus of 2200 yuan. Xiulan wrote in red pen, "2025 year-end surplus: two thousand two hundred yuan only," and discussed with Zhiqiang going to the bank the next day to deposit the surplus into a one-year fixed deposit as emergency money and education funds.
location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Show education savings account.
description: After settling the accounts, Ma Xiulan called the children over and asked her eldest son to help open mobile banking and log into the education savings account, which showed a balance of 3,500 yuan. She told the children that this was the money saved for their schooling every month, and that the current goal was 5,000 yuan. She urged them to study hard. The three children nodded solemnly.
location: Sofa in the living room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The last group dental checkup of the year
description: Ma Xiulan took out the new flashlight and had the three children line up in a row in the bathroom. She carefully checked their teeth in order. She praised the eldest son's wisdom teeth for coming in straight, the second son's molars for being brushed clean, and the youngest daughter's baby teeth for being white and cavity-free. She announced that everyone had passed and gave each child a milk tablet she had bought during the day as a reward. The children cheered happily.
location: Home bathroom, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening wash-up and relaxation
description: After settling the three children, Ma Xiulan washed up, soaked her feet in hot water to relax, then sat on the edge of the bed massaging her calves and lower back, did some simple pre-sleep stretches, and reviewed that all the day's tasks were done, feeling relieved and content.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pre-sleep relaxation and bedtime
description: After changing into pajamas and lying in bed, Ma Xiulan checked tomorrow's weather forecast on her phone. After confirming her husband had lain down, she softly reminded him about the fixed deposit to be made tomorrow. The room quieted down; she adjusted her sleeping position, mulled over next year's pickled vegetable business plans in her mind, and gradually fell asleep with anticipation.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Waking up and morning stretching
description: The phone alarm rang on time, and the sky was still barely light. Ma Xiulan sat on the edge of the bed for a while to wake up, then started 20 minutes of neck, shoulder, and waist relaxation exercises to loosen her muscles. After stretching, she walked softly to the window, stretched her arms, looked at the weather outside, and prepared to greet the new day.
location: Bedroom, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Waking up the children and preparing to take them to school.
description: First went to youngest daughter Xinxin's room and gently called her to get up. Xinxin excitedly asked about the award certificate. Ma Xiulan encouraged her while helping her dress. Then she went to call second son Mingzhe, telling him to put on his thick school uniform to avoid catching cold. She urged the children to quickly wash up and pack their school bags.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Walk daughter to school.
description: At 6:40, she took Xinxin out and walked along Jingwen Road to Huakang First Kindergarten. Xinxin was excitedly talking about the award certificate along the way. When they arrived at the kindergarten gate, she watched Xinxin run in happily. Ma Xiulan watched for a while before turning around and going home.
location: Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, Jinghai District, Tianjin (north side of Jingwen Road)

name: Morning exercise and a short rest.
description: After getting home, I first drank half a glass of warm water, then did 10 minutes of marching in place in the living room to loosen up my legs and feet. Then I followed a video and did a complete round of Baduanjin, feeling my whole body stretch out and my energy pick up.
location: Living room, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Prepare breakfast, do housework, and confirm the bank deposit.
description: She steamed small steamed buns with cabbage and pork filling and heated up milk, then had breakfast with Mingzhe, reminding him to come straight home after school. After eating, she cleared the dishes, went back to the bedroom, took out the small iron box from the bedside table, counted 2,200 yuan in cash, and put the money along with her ID card and bankbook into a change purse.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Walk to the bank to make a fixed deposit
description: She put on her coin purse, locked the door, and walked along Jingwen Road to the Postal Savings Bank. She took a number and waited in line, then handed the teller 2,200 yuan in cash, her ID card, and her passbook, asking to open a one-year fixed deposit. She carefully filled out the form, confirmed that the amount, account name, and maturity date were correct, signed it, and received the certificate of deposit, feeling relieved.
location: Postal Savings Bank of China (Tianjin Jinghai District Sub-branch), at the intersection of Jingwen Road and Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Walk home and record the savings.
description: After leaving the bank, she walked home with a light step. She folded the deposit certificate in half and put it in the family archive folder along with important documents. She took out the old ledger book and, on the page for December 29, wrote that she had deposited 2,200 yuan into a one-year fixed deposit, reserved for emergencies and education. She felt secure.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Tidy the bedroom drawers and prepare lunch.
description: Thoroughly organize the bedroom drawers, sort the odds and ends, put them away, and wipe them clean. Look through old records of education savings and silently calculate the balance. Then go to the kitchen, cook a pot of dried noodles with the leftover tomato and egg sauce from last night as lunch, and clean up the kitchen after eating.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Midday nap
description: She drew the bedroom curtains, lay on the bed with her eyes closed to rest, put her phone on silent, and slept soundly for an hour to build up energy for the afternoon.
location: Bedroom, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Preparing for the New Year's Eve handicraft tea party and doing handcrafts
description: After a nap, washed her face and began preparing for the evening tea party. Wiped the coffee table clean, set out the family photo album and a jar of chili sauce, found the phone stand and connected the charging cable. In the WeChat group, used voice messages to confirm the 7 p.m. video call. Then took out the unfinished little tiger sachet, sat by the window and embroidered it stitch by stitch, enjoying some leisure time.
location: Living room, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Go out to pick up daughter and son from school.
description: At 3:30 in the afternoon, she went out, first to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up Xinxin. Xinxin ran over happily holding a 'Good Child' certificate, and Ma Xiulan gently praised her. Then she held her hand and walked along Jingwen Road to the gate of No. 3 Primary School to wait for Mingzhe, and after picking him up, they went home together.
location: Starting from 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, via Huakang First Kindergarten (north side of Jingwen Road) to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School (Shengli South Street), then returning home.

name: Supervising the children's homework and preparing dinner
description: After returning home, she let Mingzhe go to his room to do homework and told him to finish it carefully. Xinxin stood nearby proudly showing her award certificate to the little tiger sachet. Ma Xiulan began preparing dinner, taking out pork ribs from the fridge to make braised ribs, and also stir-fried cabbage with vinegar.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner together.
description: Eldest son Mingxuan came home too and brought braised pork ribs and vinegar-sautéed cabbage to the table. The family had dinner together. Xinxin took out her certificate to show again, and Mingzhe talked about fun school stories; the atmosphere was warm and happy.
location: Dining room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Clearing the dining table and adjusting the equipment.
description: Cleared away the dishes and chopsticks and washed them, then checked the WeChat network and camera on her phone to make sure the video call would go off without a hitch. Tidied the coffee table again, placing the chili sauce bottle, family photo album, and other items in the best display positions.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Lively video call with six sisters and what came afterward.
description: At exactly 7 o'clock, she initiated a video call in the WeChat group. Zhou Xiuqin, Liu Chunmei, Wang Guilan, her mother Li Xiuying, and Aunt Wu came online one after another. They greeted each other, looked through the family album and shared Xinxin's award certificate, and held up the chili sauce bottle to show their creation. Sister Xiuqin displayed the Spring Festival window paper-cutting patterns. Aunt Wu unfolded her newly crocheted shawl, and Liu Chunmei brought out an embroidered chair cushion. Everyone praised one another in a lively chatter, and laughter filled the living room. Aunt Wu invited everyone to get together next spring. After hanging up, she thanked everyone in the group chat and privately messaged Aunt Wu to confirm an intention to meet in early spring.
location: Living room, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Evening reflection and stretching before bed
description: Back in the bedroom, she lay on the bed and flipped through the family album, recalling the smiling faces of everyone in the videos and feeling warm inside. Before bed, she did 10 minutes of waist and back stretches to relax.
location: Bedroom, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Soaking feet, reading, and going to bed
description: She took hot water from the bathroom and soaked her feet for 20 minutes, feeling her whole body warm and most of her fatigue melt away. After drying her feet, she checked the doors and windows and left a bedside lamp on. Leaning against the headboard, she browsed community group notifications and checked the weather forecast (sunny, -3 to 5), thinking about what clothes to dress her child in tomorrow. At exactly 11:55 p.m., she turned off the light, felt immensely fulfilled and content, and soon fell asleep.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Morning wake-up, waking children, preparing clothes, and breakfast
description: At six in the morning, Ma Xiulan was woken by the alarm clock. She got up quietly, went to her daughter's room to check on Yuxin's sleep, and tucked in the quilt corner. Then she went to the kitchen to prepare breakfast, took out toast and eggs, and began to cook millet and red date porridge. At 6:20, she went upstairs and woke up the eldest son, Mingxuan, the second son, Mingzhe, and the youngest daughter, Yuxin, in turn, helping the children get dressed. She specifically reminded Mingzhe to wear his thermal underwear and Mingxuan to put on his down jacket to ward off the temperature drop. At 6:50, the whole family sat around the dining table to enjoy a breakfast of fried eggs, toasted bread, and millet and red date porridge. During the meal, Yuxin was a bit sleepy, and Ma Xiulan encouraged her with the kindergarten's New Year craft activity.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Morning school drop-off
description: After breakfast, Ma Xiulan first saw off her eldest son Mingxuan. Mingxuan rode his bicycle by himself to Jinghai District No. 1 Middle School, and Ma Xiulan told him at the door to pay attention to safety. Then she rode an electric bike carrying her daughter Yuxin and second son Mingzhe. She first took Yuxin to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten and handed her to the teacher, then went to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School and watched Mingzhe enter the school gate, and after that returned home.
location: Jinghai District, Tianjin, China, heading in turn to Jinghai District No. 1 Middle School, Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten, and Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School.

name: Returning home and doing indoor morning exercise.
description: After sending off the children, Ma Xiulan returned home. She turned off the porridge pot on the stove, tidied up briefly, and then went to the balcony to open the window for some air. After that she exercised: ten minutes of marching in place to warm up, followed by a full set of Baduanjin. She felt relaxed all over and full of energy.
location: Balcony at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Morning shopping and chatting with neighbors
description: Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike to Xingwang Vegetable Market. At the stall of her regular vendor Sun Guifang, she bought glutinous rice flour and red dates to steam rice cakes. Sun Guifang warmly gave her an extra handful of dried osmanthus flowers and chatted with her, saying that the children would surely be happy at the New Year. Ma Xiulan also bought a few soft dried persimmons as snacks for the children.
location: Xingwang Vegetable Market, Beiwei 1st Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China

name: Return home to tidy up and prepare ingredients for rice cakes.
description: After returning from shopping, Ma Xiulan put the ingredients away in categories: she poured glutinous rice flour into a mixing bowl, soaked red dates in warm water, put dried persimmons into a storage jar, and carefully stored the dried osmanthus. Then she pitted and chopped the soaked red dates, mixed the glutinous rice flour with warm water, brown sugar, and chopped red dates into a thick batter, preparing to steam New Year cake, and briefly tidied the kitchen counter.
location: Kitchen, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Lunch, afternoon nap, and steaming rice cakes.
description: Home alone, Ma Xiulan reheated the leftover half a fried egg and millet porridge from the morning and had a simple lunch with some pickled vegetables. Afterward, she leaned back on the living room sofa and rested with her eyes closed for half an hour. After her midday rest, she returned to the kitchen, poured the prepared glutinous rice batter into a steaming tray lined with a damp cloth, and steamed it over high heat. While it steamed, she also prepared dinner ingredients: cut cabbage into sections, sliced pork belly and marinated it with cooking wine and light soy sauce. Forty minutes later, the rice cakes were done. She took them out and set them on the cutting board to cool, and the kitchen filled with a sweet aroma.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Pick up youngest daughter and second son from school
description: A little after 2 p.m., Ma Xiulan rode her electric bike out again. She first went to Huakang No. 1 Kindergarten to pick up her daughter Yuxin, who beamed and ran into her mother's arms. Then she went to Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School to pick up Mingzhe. The three rode home together on the electric bike, chatting and laughing all the way.
location: Jinghai District, Tianjin, China, heading to Huakang First Kindergarten and Jinghai District No. 3 Primary School

name: Tasting rice cakes and helping with homework.
description: After arriving home, Ma Xiulan cut some still-warm rice cakes for the children to taste, and Yuxin ate them happily. Then she arranged for Mingzhe to do his homework in the living room, while she sat nearby supervising Yuxin's drawing and doing needlework, sewing the unfinished little tiger sachet.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Continue tutoring and prepare dinner
description: After Mingzhe finished his math homework, Ma Xiulan checked it and found an error in a mixed-operation problem. She patiently explained the calculation logic. At the same time, she started preparing dinner: first she stir-fried tomatoes and eggs, then cooked sliced meat, and finally made vinegar cabbage. The kitchen filled with the aroma of food.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Eldest son comes home and dinner
description: Mingxuan came home from school and praised the aroma of the food as soon as he entered. The whole family washed their hands and sat around the dinner table. Ma Xiulan served everyone dishes and asked Mingxuan about his studies at school. Mingzhe eagerly said the rice cakes steamed by Mom were delicious, and Yuxin excitedly described the nursery rhyme she learned at kindergarten. The atmosphere at the table was warm and lively.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Cleared the dining table, cut window decorations, and arranged the room.
description: After the meal, Ma Xiulan quickly washed the dishes and chopsticks, then spread red paper, scissors, and glue on the tea table to prepare for cutting window decorations. She personally taught Yuxin to cut simple little flowers and the character 'Fu', while she herself focused on cutting complex patterns such as 'Carp Leaping over the Dragon Gate'. Mingzhe and Mingxuan occasionally watched. Finally, the mother and daughter stuck the window decorations on the living room window, and Ma Xiulan also straightened the fortune bag ornament at the door, filling the home with a strong festive atmosphere.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: The whole family watched the New Year's Eve program and urged each other to wash up.
description: Husband Ma Zhiqiang came home early from work, and the family rarely got together, huddled on the sofa watching TV. The program previewed some highlights of New Year's Eve galas. Yuxin mistakenly thought tomorrow was New Year's Day and clapped her hands excitedly. Ma Xiulan urged the children to rest early to build up energy for tomorrow's New Year's Eve celebration, and Zhiqiang chimed in that he would finish work early tomorrow to celebrate together. Then Ma Xiulan urged the three siblings to wash up in order, told Yuxin two little New Year stories after her bath, watched her fall asleep sweetly, while Mingzhe and Mingxuan also got ready for bed.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Couple alone time and foot-soaking stretches
description: After the children had all gone to sleep, Ma Xiulan heated some water and soaked her feet in the living room with her husband Ma Zhiqiang to relieve the day's fatigue. While soaking her feet, she did some lower back stretches and felt much more comfortable. She told Zhiqiang about the fun of steaming rice cakes and cutting paper window decorations during the day. Zhiqiang listened with great interest and said he would eat a few more rice cakes tomorrow.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Pre-sleep wrap-up and going to bed
description: After soaking her feet, Ma Xiulan carefully checked the doors, windows, and gas in the house, then went to the children's bedroom door and listened for sounds, confirming that they were all fast asleep. Back in the bedroom, lying in bed, she mulled over tomorrow's New Year's Eve plans, feeling both expectant and excited, tossing and turning until the dead of night when she finally drifted off into a hazy sleep.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, China.

name: Morning wake-up and vehicle inspection
description: Before dawn, Ma Xiulan got up at 5:55, threw on a cotton coat, went to the living room to drink some warm water, and after stretching her shoulders and neck, walked into the courtyard. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang had already been checking the truck's tires and lights with a flashlight. Ma Xiulan quietly helped verify the last batch of transport documents of the year and the vehicle papers on the passenger seat. After the inspection, she took out the new thickened knee pads she had bought and handed them to him, telling him to drive slowly on the complex road conditions. Finally, she saw Ma Zhiqiang off to the driver's cab.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin – in the family yard and beside the truck

name: After seeing her husband off, took her youngest daughter out for a morning walk and morning exercise
description: 6:20 after seeing off her husband's truck, Ma Xiulan returned home, put a thick coat on her younger daughter Ma Yuxin, and took her for a walk along Jingwen Road toward the street-center park. Xinxin skipped along saying that today was New Year's Eve, and Xiulan promised to take her to cut rabbit window paper-cuts in the evening. After about half an hour of walking, they returned home. Xiulan let Xinxin play in the living room, while she did a slow march in the open space of the living room for ten minutes, then performed a gentle set of Baduanjin to stretch her muscles and bones.
location: Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (the section from their front door to the Jingwen Road Street Park)

name: Prepare breakfast for the whole family and call the children to eat
description: After finishing her morning exercise and washing up, Ma Xiulan tied on an apron and started preparing breakfast. Her eldest son Ma Mingxuan and second son Ma Mingzhe got up one after another. Breakfast was millet porridge, pan-fried egg pancakes, and the glutinous rice cakes steamed yesterday. While heating the porridge, she called the three children to the table and told them to hurry up with their homework today, since they would have the New Year's Eve reunion dinner together in the evening.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, home kitchen/dining room

name: After-meal cleanup and getting ready to go out for shopping
description: After finishing breakfast at 7:40, Ma Xiulan quickly cleared the dishes and chopsticks and arranged the morning's study and activities for the children: the two older ones stayed home to do homework, and Xinxin played on her own. Then she picked up her cloth shopping bag, wheeled the electric bike out of the bike shed, and got ready to go to the vegetable market to buy ingredients for the New Year's Eve feast.
location: Home kitchen, No. 156, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Buy New Year's Eve ingredients at the vegetable market
description: At 8:00, she rode her electric bike south along Shengli Street and reached Xingwang Vegetable Market about 10 minutes later. Ma Xiulan went straight to the stall of her familiar Aunt Sun Guifang and carefully selected live fresh carp, pork belly with alternating fat and lean, fresh baby bok choy, and pork tenderloin. Knowing she wanted to make sweet-and-sour tenderloin for her children, Sun Guifang gave her an extra bunch of cilantro and wished the family happiness. After buying the ingredients, she rode home.
location: Xingwang Vegetable Market, Dongfanghong Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Organize and file annual documents and household accounts
description: After returning home and putting each ingredient in its proper place, at 8:50 Ma Xiulan sat down at her desk. She took out the community thank-you letter and the Harmonious Family nomination certificate from her folder, smoothed them flat, and placed them neatly into a new transparent document pouch, writing "2025—Warm Memories" on it. Then she opened the Excel family ledger on her old computer and reviewed the clear monthly income and expenditure details and the annual surplus of 2,200 yuan. She felt that this year she had lived more clearly than before, and also made an initial plan for next year's volunteer services for the elderly: to keep pickled vegetables and blood pressure measurement as regular activities and participate at least once a quarter. At about 10:50, she called her parents, who live on Shengli Street, to remind them to take care of themselves in the cold weather and told them that the whole family would have a New Year's Eve dinner that evening and would visit them on New Year's Day.
location: Home study and storage room, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Simple lunch with the children
description: She didn't spend much time cooking at noon. Ma Xiulan made tomato egg noodles for the children and had a bowl herself. During the meal, her second son, Ma Mingzhe, said he wanted to go to a classmate's house in the afternoon. Xiulan agreed but required him to come back by 4 p.m. to help set out the bowls and chopsticks. After eating, she urged the eldest and second child to continue their homework and coaxed Xinxin to take a short afternoon nap.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, home dining room

name: Short rest and preparation in the afternoon.
description: After settling the children, Ma Xiulan rested on the living room sofa, reading New Year greetings in the community WeChat group and looking through chats with her craft friends. Then she went to the balcony to check the soil moisture of the fuchsia pot, sprayed water on the leaves to maintain humidity, and returned to the kitchen to prepare the scallions, ginger, and garlic needed for the afternoon in advance. She cut the pork belly into appropriately sized pieces and marinated them with cooking wine and light soy sauce.
location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin — home living room/balcony

name: Carefully cooking a New Year's Eve family feast in the kitchen
description: At exactly 2:00 in the afternoon, Xinxin, who had just woken from her nap, ran over to watch her mother cook. Ma Xiulan tied on her apron and officially began preparing the New Year's Eve meal: first she fried the carp on both sides until golden, then added seasonings and braised it slowly; meanwhile, the pre-marinated pork belly was coated with stir-fried rice flour and put into the steamer; she also deep-fried the pork tenderloin strips until crispy on the outside and tender inside, quickly made a sweet-and-sour sauce, and the aroma filled the whole kitchen. She worked alone at the stove for over three hours, and finally set the four dishes and one soup—braised fish, steamed pork with rice flour, sweet-and-sour pork, stir-fried baby bok choy, and egg drop soup—one by one on the round table. She then took out the family photo album from the drawer and placed it at the corner of the table, waiting for her husband to come back.
location: Home kitchen, No. 156, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Couple's New Year's Eve dinner and warm interaction
description: In the evening, Ma Zhiqiang came home after work. The children were sent to the living room to watch TV, and only the husband and wife sat at the dining table. Ma Zhiqiang poured a small cup of baijiu for each, raised his glass, and said quietly to his wife that she had worked hard this year and they would keep working hard next year. Ma Xiulan felt a warmth in her heart, picked up a piece of the just-cooked sweet and sour pork tenderloin, and put it to her husband's lips. The two smiled at each other, clinked glasses, took a sip, and talked intimately amid the steaming aroma of the food.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, home dining room

name: A pleasant surprise: the photo album preserves the imprints of time.
description: Ma Xiulan was about to switch plates when her right hand trembled. The pork fillet on her chopsticks wobbled, and a drop of sauce splashed precisely onto the hard cover of the old photo album at the corner of the table. She let out a small gasp and quickly wiped it with a tissue, but the sauce had already seeped in, leaving a light brown mark. Ma Zhiqiang smiled and smoothed things over, saying it didn't matter—the mark was like a tree ring, just right for recording this rich, flavorful year. Xiulan gazed at the stain and felt no annoyance; instead, she felt it was the most genuine keepsake of the day.
location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, home dining room

name: Post-meal cleanup and brief family interaction
description: After the couple had eaten, the children sat down to eat. Ma Xiulan and her husband gathered the dishes and chopsticks, briefly washed them in the kitchen, then went back to the living room, picked up that photo album, flipped through some photos taken this year, and told the children interesting stories about their trip to Beijing on the fifth day of the Lunar New Year. The children listened with keen interest.
location: Home dining room/living room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family night walk to reinforce healthy habits
description: It was nearly 7:40 when they finished tidying up. Ma Xiulan suggested the family go out for a walk. Ma Zhiqiang brought along the small radio, and the family of five strolled along Jingwen Road toward Yudai Park. On the way, Ma Xiulan talked with the children about the benefits of looking at screens less and walking more over the past two months. The children said their eyes really did not feel as tired. She encouraged everyone to keep it up in the new year and proposed adding badminton as a family activity after it got warmer in spring. In the night, soothing songs came from the radio as the family walked slowly, feeling very peaceful.
location: Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (starting from her front door, walking along the road to Yudai Park and back)

name: Last inspection and care of potted plants of the year
description: After returning from the walk, the children went to wash up. Ma Xiulan walked to the corner of the balcony, squatted down, and lifted the greenhouse film covering the fuchsia. She first tested the moisture of the pot soil with her fingertip. Feeling it was a bit dry, she picked up a cup of water that had been left to sit and slowly poured it along the wall of the pot. Then she used small scissors to cut off a few yellowed leaves left from winter dormancy, and gently wiped the remaining leaves with a damp cloth, allowing the plant to greet the new year in a tidy state. Finally, she wrote a care note in the small notebook beside her: “2025.12.31, New Year's Eve, watered, pruned dead leaves, in good condition.”
location: Own balcony at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Personal evening relaxation and bedtime preparation
description: After checking on the flowers, she went to the bathroom and boiled water with mugwort and ginger slices, then soaked her feet comfortably for 20 minutes until the soles felt warm. Back in the bedroom, she did a simple set of back and waist stretches to relieve the day's aches from housework. Leaning against the headboard, she picked up her phone and briefly replied to friends' New Year greetings. Then she silently reviewed the day from morning to night—her husband's reminders, the cooking smells in the kitchen, the marks of years in the photo album, the whole family out for a walk, the fuchsia on the balcony... She felt the day had been fulfilling and full of hope.
location: Own bathroom/bedroom, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Go to bed to welcome the New Year.
description: At 22:50, she turned off the bedside lamp, listening to the steady breathing of her husband and children. In the quiet of the last night of 2025, she slowly closed her eyes and fell asleep, full of expectation for the coming year.
location: Own bedroom at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin
